And with clasped hands, they well-pleased, addressed Rama,-These, O highly generous one, are your servants, O Rāghava. And whatever you wish, good betide you, shall by all means be accomplished by us.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना
मनसा मे भविष्यध्वमिति तान्यभ्यचोदयत्
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya ca kākutsthaḥ samālabhya ca pāṇinā
manasā me bhaviṣyadhvamiti tānyabhyacodayat

translations.english: Thus addressed by those highly powerful weapons, Kākutstha Rama, with a delighted soul, accepting them, touched them with his hand, and said, Do you appear before me as I remember you!

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रीतमना रामो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
अभिवाद्य महातेजा गमनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prītamanā rāmo viśvāmitraṁ mahāmunim
abhivādya mahātejā gamanāyopacakrame

translations.english: Then the exceedingly energetic Rāma, well pleased, paying reverence to the mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, prepared to set out. pleased, paying reverence to the mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, prepared to set out.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य ततोऽस्त्राणि प्रहृष्टवदनः शुचिः
गच्छन्नेव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya tato'strāṇi prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śuciḥ
gacchanneva ca kākutstho viśvāmitramathābravīt

translations.english: Having accepted those weapons with purity, Käkutstha while proceeding, with a complacent countenance spoke these words to sage Visvāmitra,-

verses.sanskrit:
गृहीतास्त्रोऽस्मि भगवन्दुराधर्षः सुरैरपि
अस्त्राणां त्वहमिच्छामि संहारं मुनिपुंगव
verses.transliteration:
gṛhītāstro'smi bhagavandurādharṣaḥ surairapi
astrāṇāṁ tvahamicchāmi saṁhāraṁ munipuṁgava

translations.english: O adorable one, I have received these weapons, incapable of being repressed even by the celestials themselves. Now, O best of ascetics, I would acquire a knowledge of with drawing them.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
संहारं व्याजहाराथ धृतिमान्सुव्रतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvati kākutsthe viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
saṁhāraṁ vyājahārātha dhṛtimānsuvrataḥ śuciḥ

translations.english: Upon Kākutstha's representing this, Viśvāmitra of high austerities, endowed with patience, of excellent vows, and pure in spirit, communicated to him the mantras for restraining the weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
गम्यतामिति तानाह यथेष्टं रघुनन्दनः
मानसाः कार्यकालेषु साहाय्यं मे करिष्यथ
verses.transliteration:
gamyatāmiti tānāha yatheṣṭaṁ raghunandanaḥ
mānasāḥ kāryakāleṣu sāhāyyaṁ me kariṣyatha

translations.english: Then the descendant of Raghu answered, saying, Repair whither soever you will! Recurring to my memory, do you in time of need, render me assistance!

verses.sanskrit:
अथ ते राममामन्त्र्य कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्
एवमस्त्विति काकुत्स्थमुक्त्वा जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration:
atha te rāmamāmantrya kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
evamastviti kākutsthamuktvā jagmuryathāgatam

translations.english: Thereupon paying homage to Rāma, and having gone round him, they replied to Kākutstha, What is yonder wood hard by the hill, appearing like clouds? Great is my curiosity.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शनीयं मृगाकीर्णं मनोहरमतीव च
नानाप्रकारैः शकुनैर्वल्गुभाषैरलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration:
darśanīyaṁ mṛgākīrṇaṁ manoharamatīva ca
nānāprakāraiḥ śakunairvalgubhāṣairalaṁkṛtam

translations.english: It is pleasing to the sight, and abounds in beasts, and is exceedingly romantic, and is adorned with various birds singing sweetly.

verses.sanskrit:
निःसृताः स्म मुनिश्रेष्ठ कान्ताराद्रोमहर्षणात्
अनया त्ववगच्छामि देशस्य सुखवत्तया
verses.transliteration:
niḥsṛtāḥ sma muniśreṣṭha kāntārādromaharṣaṇāt
anayā tvavagacchāmi deśasya sukhavattayā

translations.english: Now, O foremost of ascetics, we have come out of a wilderness capable of making one's hair stand on end. And from the pleasantness attaching to this place, I have come to a conclusion.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य तद्वनं परिपृच्छतः
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा व्याख्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
atha tasyāprameyasya tadvanaṁ paripṛcchataḥ
viśvāmitro mahātejā vyākhyātumupacakrame

translations.english: Hearing those words of Rāma of measureless prowess, who had asked the question, the highly energetic Viśvāmitra answered, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिर्बलिः
निर्जित्य दैवतगणान्सेन्द्रांश्च समरुद्गणान्
कारयामास तद्राज्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
etasminneva kāle tu rājā vairocanirbaliḥ
nirjitya daivatagaṇānsendrāṁśca samarudgaṇān
kārayāmāsa tadrājyaṁ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ

translations.english: And this famed as Siddhāśrama, in consequence of that one of potent asceticism having attained fruition there. And it came to pass that at this time Virocana's son, king Välī; having vanquished the celestials with Indra and the Maruts, established that dominion of his, famous in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
बलेस्तु यजमानस्य देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः
समागम्य स्वयं चैव विष्णुमूचुरिहाश्रमे
verses.transliteration:
balestu yajamānasya devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ
samāgamya svayaṁ caiva viṣṇumūcurihāśrame

translations.english: And that mighty chief of the Asuras celebrated a sacrifice. And as Vāli was performing that sacrifice, the deities with Agni at their head, coming to Vişnu himself at this asylum, addressed him saying,

verses.sanskrit:
बलिर्वैरोचनिर्विष्णो यजते यज्ञमुत्तमम्
असमाप्ते क्रतौ तस्मिन्स्वकार्यमभिपद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
balirvairocanirviṣṇo yajate yajñamuttamam
asamāpte kratau tasminsvakāryamabhipadyatām

translations.english: Virocana's son, Vali, O Visnu, is celebrating a sacrifice. Do you, before the ceremony is finished, accomplish your own end.

verses.sanskrit:
ये चैनमभिवर्तन्ते याचितार इतस्ततः
यच्च यत्र यथावच्च सर्वं तेभ्यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration:
ye cainamabhivartante yācitāra itastataḥ
yacca yatra yathāvacca sarvaṁ tebhyaḥ prayacchati

translations.english: He duly confer upon such as repair to him from various quarters all those things that they ask for. And do yourself.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं सुरहितार्थाय मायायोगमुपाश्रितः
वामनत्वं गतो विष्णो कुरु कल्याणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ surahitārthāya māyāyogamupāśritaḥ
vāmanatvaṁ gato viṣṇo kuru kalyāṇamuttamam

translations.english: O Visnu, aided by your power of illusion, assuming a Dwarf form, accomplish the welfare of the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं सिद्धाश्रमो नाम प्रसादात्ते भविष्यति
सिद्धे कर्मणि देवेश उत्तिष्ठ भगवन्नितः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ siddhāśramo nāma prasādātte bhaviṣyati
siddhe karmaṇi deveśa uttiṣṭha bhagavannitaḥ

translations.english: And this place through your grace will attain the name of Siddhasrama. The work, O lord of the celestials, has been accomplished.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ विष्णुर्महातेजा अदित्यां समजायत
वामनं रूपमास्थाय वैरोचनिमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
atha viṣṇurmahātejā adityāṁ samajāyata
vāmanaṁ rūpamāsthāya vairocanimupāgamat

translations.english: Do you now, O you of the six attributes, ascend from hence! And accordingly Vişnu of mighty energy took his birth in Aditi. And assuming the form of a dwarf, he presented himself before Virocana's son.

verses.sanskrit:
महेन्द्राय पुनः प्रादान्नियम्य बलिमोजसा
त्रैलोक्यं स महातेजाश्चक्रे शक्रवशं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
mahendrāya punaḥ prādānniyamya balimojasā
trailokyaṁ sa mahātejāścakre śakravaśaṁ punaḥ

translations.english: And then asking for as much earth as could be covered by three footsteps, that one ever engaged in the welfare of all creatures; with the object of compassing the good of all, stood occupying the worlds. And having by his power restrained Bali, that one of exceeding energy, again conferred the three worlds upon the mighty Indra, and made them subject to his control.

verses.sanskrit:
एतमाश्रममायान्ति राक्षसा विघ्नकारिणः
अत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्र हन्तव्या दुष्टचारिणः
verses.transliteration:
etamāśramamāyānti rākṣasā vighnakāriṇaḥ
atra te puruṣavyāghra hantavyā duṣṭacāriṇaḥ

translations.english: Formerly he used to dwell in this asylum capable of removing fatigue. And hermitage is infested by Raksasas disturbing rites. And, O most puissant of men, here you should slay those ones of wicked ways.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य गच्छामहे राम सिद्धाश्रममनुत्तमम्
तदाश्रमपदं तात तवाप्येतद्यथा मम
verses.transliteration:
adya gacchāmahe rāma siddhāśramamanuttamam
tadāśramapadaṁ tāta tavāpyetadyathā mama

translations.english: To-day, O Rama, will I repair to this supremely excellent Siddhāśrama. And this asylum, child, is as much your as mine.

verses.sanskrit:
यथार्हं चक्रिरे पूजां विश्वामित्राय धीमते
तथैव राजपुत्राभ्यामकुर्वन्नतिथिक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration:
yathārhaṁ cakrire pūjāṁ viśvāmitrāya dhīmate
tathaiva rājaputrābhyāmakurvannatithikriyām

translations.english: And beholding Viśvāmitra, the ascetics inhabiting Siddhāśrama, suddenly rising in joy, worshipped that intelligent one, and extended to the princes the rites of hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
मुहूर्तमथ विश्रान्तौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ
प्राञ्जली मुनिशार्दूलमूचतू रघुनन्दनौ
verses.transliteration:
muhūrtamatha viśrāntau rājaputrāvariṁdamau
prāñjalī muniśārdūlamūcatū raghunandanau

translations.english: And then having reposed for a while, those unreproved princes, the descendants of Raghu, with clasped hands, addressed that foremost of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्यैव दीक्षां प्रविश भद्रं ते मुनिपुंगव
सिद्धाश्रमोऽयं सिद्धः स्यात्सत्यमस्तु वचस्तव
verses.transliteration:
adyaiva dīkṣāṁ praviśa bhadraṁ te munipuṁgava
siddhāśramo'yaṁ siddhaḥ syātsatyamastu vacastava

translations.english: Be you even to-day initiated to the ceremony. Good betide you, O best of ascetics! Let this Siddhāśrama verily attain fruition, and let your words be verified!

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तौ देशकालज्ञौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ
देशे काले च वाक्यज्ञावब्रूतां कौशिकं वचः
verses.transliteration:
atha tau deśakālajñau rājaputrāvariṁdamau
deśe kāle ca vākyajñāvabrūtāṁ kauśikaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Then those princes, repressors of foes, cognizant of place, and time, and words, thus spoke to Kuśika's son agreeably to time and place, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
भगवञ्श्रोतुमिच्छावो यस्मिन्काले निशाचरौ
संरक्षणीयौ तौ ब्रह्मन्नातिवर्तेत तत्क्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
bhagavañśrotumicchāvo yasminkāle niśācarau
saṁrakṣaṇīyau tau brahmannātivarteta tatkṣaṇam

translations.english: O adorable one, do you tell us as to the time when we should oppose those rangers of the night! Let not that hour pass away!

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणौ काकुत्स्थौ त्वरमाणौ युयुत्सया
सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर्नृपात्मजौ
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇau kākutsthau tvaramāṇau yuyutsayā
sarve te munayaḥ prītāḥ praśaśaṁsurnṛpātmajau

translations.english: Upon the two Kākutsthas' saying this, and finding them prompt for the encounter, those ascetics well-pleased, fell to extolling the sons of the king.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य प्रभृति षड्रात्रं रक्षतं राघवौ युवाम्
दीक्षां गतो ह्येष मुनिर्मौनित्वं च गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
adya prabhṛti ṣaḍrātraṁ rakṣataṁ rāghavau yuvām
dīkṣāṁ gato hyeṣa munirmaunitvaṁ ca gamiṣyati

translations.english: For six nights from to-day, you should protects us. This ascetic has been initiated into the sacrifice, and must, therefore, observe taciturnity.

verses.sanskrit:
उपासां चक्रतुर्वीरौ यत्तौ परमधन्विनौ
ररक्षतुर्मुनिवरं विश्वामित्रमरिंदमौ
verses.transliteration:
upāsāṁ cakraturvīrau yattau paramadhanvinau
rarakṣaturmunivaraṁ viśvāmitramariṁdamau

translations.english: Hearing these words of theirs, those illustrious princes, renouncing sleep, began to guard the hermitage day and night; and those heroic and mighty archers protected that best of ascetics and subduer of enemies.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ काले गते तस्मिन्षष्ठेऽहनि समागते
सौमित्रमब्रवीद्रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः
verses.transliteration:
atha kāle gate tasminṣaṣṭhe'hani samāgate
saumitramabravīdrāmo yatto bhava samāhitaḥ

translations.english: When time had thus gone by and the sixth day had arrived, Rāma said to Sumitrā's son. Being well equipped, be you vigilant!

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्यैवं ब्रुवाणस्य त्वरितस्य युयुत्सया
प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः सोपाध्यायपुरोहिता
verses.transliteration:
rāmasyaivaṁ bruvāṇasya tvaritasya yuyutsayā
prajajvāla tato vediḥ sopādhyāyapurohitā

translations.english: When Räma, manifesting emotion, and being eager for encounter, had said this, the priests and spiritual guides lit up the altar. And along with Viśvāmitra and the family priests, they lit up the altar furnished with Kusa, and Kasa, and ladles, and faggots, and flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रवच्च यथान्यायं यज्ञोऽसौ संप्रवर्तते
आकाशे च महाञ्शब्दः प्रादुरासीद्भयानकः
verses.transliteration:
mantravacca yathānyāyaṁ yajño'sau saṁpravartate
ākāśe ca mahāñśabdaḥ prādurāsīdbhayānakaḥ

translations.english: And as reciting mantras, they were about to duly engage in that sacrifice, there arose a mighty and dreadful uproar in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च तयोरनुचरास्तथा
आगम्य भीमसंकाशा रुधिरौघानवासृजन्
verses.transliteration:
mārīcaśca subāhuśca tayoranucarāstathā
āgamya bhīmasaṁkāśā rudhiraughānavāsṛjan

translations.english: And as in the rains, masses of clouds appear enveloping the firmament, the Rākşasas, displaying illusions in that wise, began to rush onward. And Mārīca and Subāhu together with their followers coming in dreadful forms, began to shower down blood upon the altar.

verses.sanskrit:
तावापतन्तौ सहसा दृष्ट्वा राजीवलोचनः
लक्ष्मणं त्वभिसंप्रेक्ष्य रामो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tāvāpatantau sahasā dṛṣṭvā rājīvalocanaḥ
lakṣmaṇaṁ tvabhisaṁprekṣya rāmo vacanamabravīt

translations.english: And on seeing the altar deluged with gore, Rāma suddenly rushed forward, and behold them in the sky. And suddenly seeing them rushing in amain, the lotus-eyed Rāma fixing his gaze at Laksmana, said.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्य लक्ष्मण दुर्वृत्तान्राक्षसान्पिशिताशनान्
मानवास्त्रसमाधूताननिलेन यथाघनान्
verses.transliteration:
paśya lakṣmaṇa durvṛttānrākṣasānpiśitāśanān
mānavāstrasamādhūtānanilena yathāghanān

translations.english: Behold O Lakşmana, by means of a Mānava weapon, I shall, without doubt, drive away the wicked; flesh-eating Raksasas, even as the wind drive away clouds before it. Surely I cannot bring myself to slay such as these.

verses.sanskrit:
मानवं परमोदारमस्त्रं परमभास्वरम्
चिक्षेप परमक्रुद्धो मारीचोरसि राघवः
verses.transliteration:
mānavaṁ paramodāramastraṁ paramabhāsvaram
cikṣepa paramakruddho mārīcorasi rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Saying this, that descendant of Raghu, Rāma, in vehemence fixing on his bow an exceedingly mighty and gloriously-dazzling Mānava weapon, discharged it in great wrath at Mārīca's chest.

verses.sanskrit:
स तेन परमास्त्रेण मानवेन समाहितः
संपूर्णं योजनशतं क्षिप्तः सागरसंप्लवे
verses.transliteration:
sa tena paramāstreṇa mānavena samāhitaḥ
saṁpūrṇaṁ yojanaśataṁ kṣiptaḥ sāgarasaṁplave

translations.english: And wounded by that foremost of Mānava weapons, Mārīca carried off a sheer hundred Yojanas, dropped in the midst of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
विचेतनं विघूर्णन्तं शीतेषुबलपीडितम्
निरस्तं दृश्य मारीचं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
vicetanaṁ vighūrṇantaṁ śīteṣubalapīḍitam
nirastaṁ dṛśya mārīcaṁ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt

translations.english: And finding Mārica senseless, and whirling, and afflicted by the might of the weapon, and overcome, Rama addressed Laksmana, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्य लक्ष्मण शीतेषुं मानवं धर्मसंहितम्
मोहयित्वा नयत्येनं न च प्राणैर्वियुज्यते
verses.transliteration:
paśya lakṣmaṇa śīteṣuṁ mānavaṁ dharmasaṁhitam
mohayitvā nayatyenaṁ na ca prāṇairviyujyate

translations.english: Behold, O Laksmana, this Manava weapon first used by Manu, depriving him of his senses has carried him off, and yet has not taken his life!

verses.sanskrit:
इमानपि वधिष्यामि निर्घृणान्दुष्टचारिणः
राक्षसान्पापकर्मस्थान्यज्ञघ्नान्रुधिराशनान्
verses.transliteration:
imānapi vadhiṣyāmi nirghṛṇānduṣṭacāriṇaḥ
rākṣasānpāpakarmasthānyajñaghnānrudhirāśanān

translations.english: But these shameless, wicked, and blooddrinking Raksasas, delighting in wrong-doing, these disturbers of sacrifices, will I slaughter.

verses.sanskrit:
विगृह्य सुमहच्चास्त्रमाग्नेयं रघुनन्दनः
सुबाहुरसि चिक्षेप स विद्धः प्रापतद्भुवि
verses.transliteration:
vigṛhya sumahaccāstramāgneyaṁ raghunandanaḥ
subāhurasi cikṣepa sa viddhaḥ prāpatadbhuvi

translations.english: Having said this, anon showing to Lakşmaņa his lightness of hand, Raghu's descendant took out a mighty Āgneya weapon, and discharged it at the breast of Subāhu. Thereat being pierced with that shaft, he fell down upon the ground. Then taking a Vāyavya weapon, the illustrious and exceedingly generous Rāghava, bringing delight to those ascetics, slew the rest.

verses.sanskrit:
स हत्वा राक्षसान्सर्वान्यज्ञघ्नान्रघुनन्दनः
ऋषिभिः पूजितस्तत्र यथेन्द्रो विजये पुरा
verses.transliteration:
sa hatvā rākṣasānsarvānyajñaghnānraghunandanaḥ
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitastatra yathendro vijaye purā

translations.english: Having destroyed all those Rākşasas disturbing sacrifices, Raghu's descendant was honoured by the saints, even as Indra in day of yore, after having vanquished the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
निरीतिका दिशो दृष्ट्वा काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha yajñe samāpte tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
nirītikā diśo dṛṣṭvā kākutsthamidamabravīt

translations.english: When the sacrifice had been completed, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, beholding all sides cleared of Rākṣasas, spoke to Käkutstha, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
कृतार्थोऽस्मि महाबाहो कृतं गुरुवचस्त्वया
सिद्धाश्रममिदं सत्यं कृतं राम महायशः
verses.transliteration:
kṛtārtho'smi mahābāho kṛtaṁ guruvacastvayā
siddhāśramamidaṁ satyaṁ kṛtaṁ rāma mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, I have obtained my desire; and you have executed your preceptor's mandate. And, O illustrious hero, you have truly made this a Siddhāśrama. Having thus extolled Rāma, he took Rāma and Lakşmaņa, to perform his evening devotions.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तां रजनीं तत्र कृतार्थौ रामलक्षणौ
ऊषतुर्मुदितौ वीरौ प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
atha tāṁ rajanīṁ tatra kṛtārthau rāmalakṣaṇau
ūṣaturmuditau vīrau prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā

translations.english: Those heroes, Rāma and Laksmana, their interest secured, with glad hearts passed that night there.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियौ
विश्वामित्रमृषींश्चान्यान्सहितावभिजग्मतुः
verses.transliteration:
prabhātāyāṁ tu śarvaryāṁ kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyau
viśvāmitramṛṣīṁścānyānsahitāvabhijagmatuḥ

translations.english: And when the night had passed away and the morning come, they together appeared before the saint, Visvāmitra, and the rest.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्
ऊचतुर्मधुरोदारं वाक्यं मधुरभाषिणौ
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṁ jvalantamiva pāvakam
ūcaturmadhurodāraṁ vākyaṁ madhurabhāṣiṇau

translations.english: And having saluted that foremost of ascetics resembling flaming fire, your addressed him in gentle and honied accents.

verses.sanskrit:
इमौ स्वो मुनिशार्दूल किंकरौ समुपस्थितौ
आज्ञापय यथेष्टं वै शासनं करवाव किम्
verses.transliteration:
imau svo muniśārdūla kiṁkarau samupasthitau
ājñāpaya yatheṣṭaṁ vai śāsanaṁ karavāva kim

translations.english: These servants of yours, O best of ascetics, have come before you. Do you command, O chief of anchorites, what command of your are we to execute

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ते ततस्ताभ्यां सर्व एव महर्षयः
विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य रामं वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
evamukte tatastābhyāṁ sarva eva maharṣayaḥ
viśvāmitraṁ puraskṛtya rāmaṁ vacanamabruvan

translations.english: Thus addressed by them the Maharșis with Viśvāmitra at their head spoke to Rāma, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
मैथिलस्य नरश्रेष्ठ जनकस्य भविष्यति
यज्ञः परमधर्मिष्ठस्तत्र यास्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration:
maithilasya naraśreṣṭha janakasya bhaviṣyati
yajñaḥ paramadharmiṣṭhastatra yāsyāmahe vayam

translations.english: A highly meritorious sacrifice, O foremost of men, is to be celebrated by Mithila's lord, Janaka. Thither shall we repair.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं चैव नरशार्दूल सहास्माभिर्गमिष्यसि
अद्भुतं च धनूरत्नं तत्र त्वं द्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ caiva naraśārdūla sahāsmābhirgamiṣyasi
adbhutaṁ ca dhanūratnaṁ tatra tvaṁ draṣṭumarhasi

translations.english: And you, O tiger among men, men, must accompany us, and there behold a wonderful jewel of a bow.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्धि पूर्वं नरश्रेष्ठ दत्तं सदसि दैवतैः
अप्रमेयबलं घोरं मखे परमभास्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
taddhi pūrvaṁ naraśreṣṭha dattaṁ sadasi daivataiḥ
aprameyabalaṁ ghoraṁ makhe paramabhāsvaram

translations.english: And formerly this bow of immeasurable energy, and dreadful, and exceedingly effulgent at the sacrifice, had been conferred in court by the celestials (on king Devarata.)8

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरा न च राक्षसाः
कर्तुमारोपणं शक्ता न कथंचन मानुषाः
verses.transliteration:
nāsya devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ
kartumāropaṇaṁ śaktā na kathaṁcana mānuṣāḥ

translations.english: And neither gods nor Gandharvas, neither Asuras nor Rākşasas nor men, can fix the string upon it.

verses.sanskrit:
धनुषस्तस्य वीर्यं हि जिज्ञासन्तो महीक्षितः
न शेकुरारोपयितुं राजपुत्रा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
dhanuṣastasya vīryaṁ hi jijñāsanto mahīkṣitaḥ
na śekurāropayituṁ rājaputrā mahābalāḥ

translations.english: And desirous of being acquainted with the prowess of this bow, many kings and princes came; but they in spite of their mighty strength, failed in stringing it.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्धनुर्नरशार्दूल मैथिलस्य महात्मनः
तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि काकुत्स्थ यज्ञं चाद्भुतदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
taddhanurnaraśārdūla maithilasya mahātmanaḥ
tatra drakṣyasi kākutstha yajñaṁ cādbhutadarśanam

translations.english: There, O Kākutstha, you will behold that bow belonging to the high-souled king of Mithila, as well as his exceedingly wonderful sacrifice..

verses.sanskrit:
तद्धि यज्ञफलं तेन मैथिलेनोत्तमं धनुः
याचितं नरशार्दूल सुनाभं सर्वदैवतैः
verses.transliteration:
taddhi yajñaphalaṁ tena maithilenottamaṁ dhanuḥ
yācitaṁ naraśārdūla sunābhaṁ sarvadaivataiḥ

translations.english: That rare bow, O foremost of men, furnished with an excellent device for griping it, had been solicited by Mithila's lord as the fruit of his sacrifice; and the celestials conferred it upon him.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनिवरः प्रस्थानमकरोत्तदा
सर्षिसंघः सकाकुत्स्थ आमन्त्र्य वनदेवताः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā munivaraḥ prasthānamakarottadā
sarṣisaṁghaḥ sakākutstha āmantrya vanadevatāḥ

translations.english: This having been said, that foremost of ascetics, in company with Kākutstha and the saints, departed.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु गमिष्यामि सिद्धः सिद्धाश्रमादहम्
उत्तरे जाह्नवीतीरे हिमवन्तं शिलोच्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
svasti vo'stu gamiṣyāmi siddhaḥ siddhāśramādaham
uttare jāhnavītīre himavantaṁ śiloccayam

translations.english: And on the eve of setting out, he addressed the sylvan deities, saying, Luck! I will, with my desire obtained, go from forth this Siddhāśrama to the Himavat mountain on the north of the Jahnavi.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा सिद्धाश्रममनुत्तमम्
उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
pradakṣiṇaṁ tataḥ kṛtvā siddhāśramamanuttamam
uttarāṁ diśamuddiśya prasthātumupacakrame

translations.english: Having said this, that tiger-like ascetic, Kusika's son, along with other anchorets having asceticism for their wealth, set out in a northerly direction.

verses.sanskrit:
तं व्रजन्तं मुनिवरमन्वगादनुसारिणाम्
शकटी शतमात्रं तु प्रयाणे ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ vrajantaṁ munivaramanvagādanusāriṇām
śakaṭī śatamātraṁ tu prayāṇe brahmavādinām

translations.english: And as that best of ascetics proceeded, he was followed by Brāhmaṇas, unholding the Veda, carrying the sacrificial necessaries on an hundred cars.

verses.sanskrit:
मृगपक्षिगणाश्चैव सिद्धाश्रमनिवासिनः
अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration:
mṛgapakṣigaṇāścaiva siddhāśramanivāsinaḥ
anujagmurmahātmānaṁ viśvāmitraṁ mahāmunim

translations.english: And birds and beasts dwelling in Siddhāśrama followed the high-souled Viśvāmitra having asceticism for wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्को न्वयं देशः समृद्धवनशोभितः
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भद्रं ते वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
bhagavanko nvayaṁ deśaḥ samṛddhavanaśobhitaḥ
śrotumicchāmi bhadraṁ te vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ

translations.english: Then Rama of exceeding energy, influenced by curiosity, asked that foremost of ascetics, Viśvāmitra, having asceticism for his wealth, saying, 'O worshipful one, what country is this, graced with luxuriant woods? I am desirous of hearing this Good betide you, it behove you to tell me this truly.

verses.sanskrit:
चोदितो रामवाक्येन कथयामास सुव्रतः
तस्य देशस्य निखिलमृषिमध्ये महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
codito rāmavākyena kathayāmāsa suvrataḥ
tasya deśasya nikhilamṛṣimadhye mahātapāḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma, that one of high austerities and excellent vows began in the midst of the saints to describe the opulence of that region.

verses.sanskrit:
दीप्तियुक्तान्महोत्साहान्क्षत्रधर्मचिकीर्षया
तानुवाच कुशः पुत्रान्धर्मिष्ठान्सत्यवादिनः
क्रियतां पालनं पुत्रा धर्मं प्राप्स्यथ पुष्कलम्
verses.transliteration:
dīptiyuktānmahotsāhānkṣatradharmacikīrṣayā
tānuvāca kuśaḥ putrāndharmiṣṭhānsatyavādinaḥ
kriyatāṁ pālanaṁ putrā dharmaṁ prāpsyatha puṣkalam

translations.english: That high-souled one beget on Vaidarbha, sprung from a respectable line and endowed with all noble qualities, four sons like to himself, and possessed of extraordinary prowess-Kuśămba, and Kušanābha, and Asūrtarajas, and Vasu, resplendent and breathing exhaustless spirits. And with the desire of enhancing Kșetrya merit, Kuśa said to his truthful and virtuous sons"You sons! do you engage in the task of governing, and thereby acquire immense merit.'

verses.sanskrit:
कुशाम्बस्तु महातेजाः कौशाम्बीमकरोत्पुरीम्
कुशनाभस्तु धर्मात्मा परं चक्रे महोदयम्
verses.transliteration:
kuśāmbastu mahātejāḥ kauśāmbīmakarotpurīm
kuśanābhastu dharmātmā paraṁ cakre mahodayam

translations.english: Hearing Kuśa's words, those four foremost of men and best of sons addressed themselves to founding seats for their government. And the highly energetic Kuśāmba founded the city of Kausambi; and the righteous Kusanabha, the metropolis of Mahodaya; and the magnanimous Asūrtarajas, Dharmāraṇya; and king Vasu, Girivraja, best of capitals.

verses.sanskrit:
सुमागधी नदी रम्या मागधान्विश्रुताययौ
पञ्चानां शैलमुख्यानां मध्ये मालेव शोभते
verses.transliteration:
sumāgadhī nadī ramyā māgadhānviśrutāyayau
pañcānāṁ śailamukhyānāṁ madhye māleva śobhate

translations.english: This city (otherwise) called Vasumatī belongs to the high-souled Vasu. And the river known by the name of Sumāgadhi flows through the Māgadhas. And in the midst of the five foremost of hills, it looks like a garland.

verses.sanskrit:
सैषा हि मागधी राम वसोस्तस्य महात्मनः
पूर्वाभिचरिता राम सुक्षेत्रा सस्यमालिनी
verses.transliteration:
saiṣā hi māgadhī rāma vasostasya mahātmanaḥ
pūrvābhicaritā rāma sukṣetrā sasyamālinī

translations.english: And this Mägadhi, O Råma, belongs to the high-souled Vasu, taking, O Rāma, an easterly course, and flowing through fertile fields furnished with corn.

verses.sanskrit:
कुशनाभस्तु राजर्षिः कन्याशतमनुत्तमम्
जनयामास धर्मात्मा घृताच्यां रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
kuśanābhastu rājarṣiḥ kanyāśatamanuttamam
janayāmāsa dharmātmā ghṛtācyāṁ raghunandana

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, the Rājarși Kusanābha beget an hundred godly daughters on Ghrtaci.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं वः कामये सर्वा भार्या मम भविष्यथ
मानुषस्त्यज्यतां भावो दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ vaḥ kāmaye sarvā bhāryā mama bhaviṣyatha
mānuṣastyajyatāṁ bhāvo dīrghamāyuravāpsyatha

translations.english: I seek for you: do you become my wives. Do you renounce this human guise, and attain long lives.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वायोरक्लिष्टकर्मणः
अपहास्य ततो वाक्यं कन्याशतमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vāyorakliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
apahāsya tato vākyaṁ kanyāśatamathābravīt

translations.english: Hearing this speech of the Air of ever fresh energy, the damsels ridiculing it, said.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तश्चरसि भूतानां सर्वेषां त्वं सुरोत्तम
प्रभावज्ञाश्च ते सर्वाः किमस्मानवमन्यसे
verses.transliteration:
antaścarasi bhūtānāṁ sarveṣāṁ tvaṁ surottama
prabhāvajñāśca te sarvāḥ kimasmānavamanyase

translations.english: You range the hearts of all creatures, O foremost of celestials, and we also know your influence. Wherefore, then, do you dishonour us?

verses.sanskrit:
कुशनाभसुताः सर्वाः समर्थास्त्वां सुरोत्तम
स्थानाच्च्यावयितुं देवं रक्षामस्तु तपो वयम्
verses.transliteration:
kuśanābhasutāḥ sarvāḥ samarthāstvāṁ surottama
sthānāccyāvayituṁ devaṁ rakṣāmastu tapo vayam

translations.english: O foremost of celestials, we are the daughters of Kušanābha O divine one. And god as you are, we can dislodge you from your place; but we refrain from doing so, lest thereby we lose our ascetic merit.

verses.sanskrit:
मा भूत्स कालो दुर्मेधः पितरं सत्यवादिनम्
नावमन्यस्व धर्मेण स्वयं वरमुपास्महे
verses.transliteration:
mā bhūtsa kālo durmedhaḥ pitaraṁ satyavādinam
nāvamanyasva dharmeṇa svayaṁ varamupāsmahe

translations.english: May, O foolish one, that time never come, when disregarding our truthful sire, we following our inclination, shall resort to self choice.

verses.sanskrit:
पिता हि प्रभुरस्माकं दैवतं परमं हि सः
यस्य नो दास्यति पिता स नो भर्ता भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
pitā hi prabhurasmākaṁ daivataṁ paramaṁ hi saḥ
yasya no dāsyati pitā sa no bhartā bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Our father verily is our lord an prime god. Of him even shall we become the wives to whom our father give us away.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वायुः परमकोपनः
प्रविश्य सर्वगात्राणि बभञ्ज भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vāyuḥ paramakopanaḥ
praviśya sarvagātrāṇi babhañja bhagavānprabhuḥ

translations.english: At these words of theirs, that lord and adorable one, the Air, exceedingly enraged, then entered into their bodies, and brake all their limbs. Their bodies being thus broken by Air, those damsels, exceedingly agitated and overwhelmed with shame, with tears in their eyes entered the residence of the king.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः कन्या वायुना भग्ना विविशुर्नृपतेर्गृहम्
दृष्ट्वा भग्नास्तदा राजा संभ्रान्त इदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśurnṛpatergṛham
dṛṣṭvā bhagnāstadā rājā saṁbhrānta idamabravīt

translations.english: And finding his supremely beautiful and favourite daughters with their limbs broken, and woebegone, the king bewildered, spoke.

verses.sanskrit:
किमिदं कथ्यतां पुत्र्यः को धर्ममवमन्यते
कुब्जाः केन कृताः सर्वा वेष्टन्त्यो नाभिभाषथ
verses.transliteration:
kimidaṁ kathyatāṁ putryaḥ ko dharmamavamanyate
kubjāḥ kena kṛtāḥ sarvā veṣṭantyo nābhibhāṣatha

translations.english: You daughters, what is this? Who is it that thus disregards virtue? By whom have you all come by this crooked form? And why demonstrating your grief, do you not answer me?' Having said this, the king heaved a deep sigh and became eager to hear all about it.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कुशनाभस्य धीमतः
शिरोभिश्चरणौ स्पृष्ट्वा कन्याशतमभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ
śirobhiścaraṇau spṛṣṭvā kanyāśatamabhāṣata

translations.english: Hearing those words of the intelligent Kusanābha, his hundred daughters touching his feet with their heads, said,

verses.sanskrit:
वायुः सर्वात्मको राजन्प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति
अशुभं मार्गमास्थाय न धर्मं प्रत्यवेक्षते
verses.transliteration:
vāyuḥ sarvātmako rājanpradharṣayitumicchati
aśubhaṁ mārgamāsthāya na dharmaṁ pratyavekṣate

translations.english: O king, that life of all, the Air, was desirous of overcoming us, having recourse to an improper way; nor did he regard morality.

verses.sanskrit:
पितृमत्यः स्म भद्रं ते स्वच्छन्दे न वयं स्थिताः
पितरं नो वृणीष्व त्वं यदि नो दास्यते तव
verses.transliteration:
pitṛmatyaḥ sma bhadraṁ te svacchande na vayaṁ sthitāḥ
pitaraṁ no vṛṇīṣva tvaṁ yadi no dāsyate tava

translations.english: We have a father, good betide you; and we live at ease. Do you ask our father about it, if he consent conferring us on you.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन पापानुबन्धेन वचनं न प्रतीच्छता
एवं ब्रुवन्त्यः सर्वाः स्म वायुना निहता भृषम्
verses.transliteration:
tena pāpānubandhena vacanaṁ na pratīcchatā
evaṁ bruvantyaḥ sarvāḥ sma vāyunā nihatā bhṛṣam

translations.english: But that wicked wight did not listen to our words; and as we were saying this, were we roughly handled by him.'

verses.sanskrit:
तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा परमधार्मिकः
प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः कन्याशतमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ kanyāśatamanuttamam

translations.english: Hearing those words of theirs, the highly pious and puissant king addressed his hundred beautiful daughters, saying

verses.sanskrit:
क्षान्तं क्षमावतां पुत्र्यः कर्तव्यं सुमहत्कृतम्
ऐकमत्यमुपागम्य कुलं चावेक्षितं मम
verses.transliteration:
kṣāntaṁ kṣamāvatāṁ putryaḥ kartavyaṁ sumahatkṛtam
aikamatyamupāgamya kulaṁ cāvekṣitaṁ mama

translations.english: You have displayed a signal example of that forgiveness which is fit to be followed by the forbearing; and that you have unanimously regarded the honour of my house, also conduces to your praise.

verses.sanskrit:
अलंकारो हि नारीणां क्षमा तु पुरुषस्य वा
दुष्करं तच्च वः क्षान्तं त्रिदशेषु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
alaṁkāro hi nārīṇāṁ kṣamā tu puruṣasya vā
duṣkaraṁ tacca vaḥ kṣāntaṁ tridaśeṣu viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: Alike to men and women, forbearance is an ornament. And difficult it is for one to exercise that forbearance, specially in respect of the celestials. And may every descendant of mine possess forbearance like to yours!

verses.sanskrit:
क्षमा यशः क्षमा धर्मः क्षमायां विष्ठितं जगत्
विसृज्य कन्याः काकुत्स्थ राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
kṣamā yaśaḥ kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamāyāṁ viṣṭhitaṁ jagat
visṛjya kanyāḥ kākutstha rājā tridaśavikramaḥ

translations.english: Forbearance is charity; forbearance is truth; forbearance, O daughters, is sacrifice; forbearance is fame; forbearance is virtue, you, the universe is established in forbearance;

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रज्ञो मन्त्रयामास प्रदानं सह मन्त्रिभिः
देशे काले प्रदानस्य सदृशे प्रतिपादनम्
verses.transliteration:
mantrajño mantrayāmāsa pradānaṁ saha mantribhiḥ
deśe kāle pradānasya sadṛśe pratipādanam

translations.english: Then dismissing his daughters, the king endowed with the prowess of celestials, and versed in counsel, began to consult with his counsellors about the bestowal of his daughters, in respect of time and place and person and equability of lineage.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु चूली नाम महामुनिः
ऊर्ध्वरेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मं तप उपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
etasminneva kāle tu cūlī nāma mahāmuniḥ
ūrdhvaretāḥ śubhācāro brāhmaṁ tapa upāgamat

translations.english: It came to pass that at this time, an ascetic named Culi, highly effulgent, with his vital fluid under control, and of pure practices, was performing Brāhma austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
तप्यन्तं तमृषिं तत्र गन्धर्वी पर्युपासते
सोमदा नाम भद्रं ते ऊर्मिला तनया तदा
verses.transliteration:
tapyantaṁ tamṛṣiṁ tatra gandharvī paryupāsate
somadā nāma bhadraṁ te ūrmilā tanayā tadā

translations.english: And as the saint was engaged in austerities, good betide you, Urmila's daughter named Somada-a Gandharvi-ministered to him.

verses.sanskrit:
सा च तं प्रणता भूत्वा शुश्रूषणपरायणा
उवास काले धर्मिष्ठा तस्यास्तुष्टोऽभवद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration:
sā ca taṁ praṇatā bhūtvā śuśrūṣaṇaparāyaṇā
uvāsa kāle dharmiṣṭhā tasyāstuṣṭo'bhavadguruḥ

translations.english: And in all humility that virtuous one for a definite period was engaged in ministering to him. And thereat, her spiritual guide was gratified with her.

verses.sanskrit:
स च तां कालयोगेन प्रोवाच रघुनन्दन
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते किं करोमि तव प्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
sa ca tāṁ kālayogena provāca raghunandana
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṁ te kiṁ karomi tava priyam

translations.english: And, O descendant of Raghu, once he said to her, I am gratified, good betide you! What good shall I render you?

verses.sanskrit:
परितुष्टं मुनिं ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुरस्वरम्
उवाच परमप्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्यकोविदम्
verses.transliteration:
parituṣṭaṁ muniṁ jñātvā gandharvī madhurasvaram
uvāca paramaprītā vākyajñā vākyakovidam

translations.english: Thereupon, concluding that the ascetic was gratified, the Gandharvi, cognizant of words, exceedingly delighted, sweetly addressed that one versed in speech.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्मभूतो महातपाः
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तं पुत्रमिच्छामि धार्मिकम्
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmyā samudito brāhmyā brahmabhūto mahātapāḥ
brāhmeṇa tapasā yuktaṁ putramicchāmi dhārmikam

translations.english: You are furnished with the Brāhma marks, art sprung from Brahmă, and art of mighty austerities. I desire of you a righteous son endowed with the Brāhma ascetic virtues.

verses.sanskrit:
अपतिश्चास्मि भद्रं ते भार्या चास्मि न कस्यचित्
ब्राह्मेणोपगतायाश्च दातुमर्हसि मे सुतम्
verses.transliteration:
apatiścāsmi bhadraṁ te bhāryā cāsmi na kasyacit
brāhmeṇopagatāyāśca dātumarhasi me sutam

translations.english: I am without a husband, good betide you, and I am no one's wife. Upon me who is your servant you should confer such a son by help of Brāhma means.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याः प्रसन्नो ब्रह्मर्षिर्ददौ पुत्रमनुत्तमम्
ब्रह्मदत्त इति ख्यातं मानसं चूलिनः सुतम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāḥ prasanno brahmarṣirdadau putramanuttamam
brahmadatta iti khyātaṁ mānasaṁ cūlinaḥ sutam

translations.english: Thereupon, well pleased with her, Cūlina conferred upon her an excellent Brāhma mindbegotten son, named Brahmadatta,

verses.sanskrit:
स राजा ब्रह्मदत्तस्तु पुरीमध्यवसत्तदा
काम्पिल्यां परया लक्ष्म्या देवराजो यथा दिवम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rājā brahmadattastu purīmadhyavasattadā
kāmpilyāṁ parayā lakṣmyā devarājo yathā divam

translations.english: And that king, Brahmadatta, founded the flourishing city of Kampilya, even as the sovereign of the celestials founded the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
स बुद्धिं कृतवान्राजा कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः
ब्रह्मदत्ताय काकुत्स्थ दातुं कन्याशतं तदा
verses.transliteration:
sa buddhiṁ kṛtavānrājā kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ
brahmadattāya kākutstha dātuṁ kanyāśataṁ tadā

translations.english: And, O Kākutstha, the righteous king Kusanābha finally decided on conferring his hundred daughters upon Brahmadatta.

verses.sanskrit:
तमाहूय महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तं महीपतिः
ददौ कन्याशतं राजा सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
tamāhūya mahātejā brahmadattaṁ mahīpatiḥ
dadau kanyāśataṁ rājā suprītenāntarātmanā

translations.english: And inviting Brahmadatta, that highly energetic lord of earth, with a glad heart conferred his hundred daughters upon him.

verses.sanskrit:
यथाक्रमं ततः पाणिं जग्राह रघुनन्दन
ब्रह्मदत्तो मही पालस्तासां देवपतिर्यथा
verses.transliteration:
yathākramaṁ tataḥ pāṇiṁ jagrāha raghunandana
brahmadatto mahī pālastāsāṁ devapatiryathā

translations.english: And O descendant of Raghu, king Brahmadatta resembling the lord himself of the celestials, by turns received their hands in marriage.

verses.sanskrit:
स्पृष्टमात्रे ततः पाणौ विकुब्जा विगतज्वराः
युक्ताः परमया लक्ष्म्या बभुः कन्याशतं तदा
verses.transliteration:
spṛṣṭamātre tataḥ pāṇau vikubjā vigatajvarāḥ
yuktāḥ paramayā lakṣmyā babhuḥ kanyāśataṁ tadā

translations.english: And as soon as he touched them, the hundred daughters were cured of their crookedness, and became free from anguish, and were endowed with pre-eminent beauty.

verses.sanskrit:
स दृष्ट्वा वायुना मुक्ताः कुशनाभो महीपतिः
बभूव परमप्रीतो हर्षं लेभे पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
sa dṛṣṭvā vāyunā muktāḥ kuśanābho mahīpatiḥ
babhūva paramaprīto harṣaṁ lebhe punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: And upon beholding them delivered from (the tyranny of) the Air, the monarch Kušanābha became exceedingly delighted, and rejoiced again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतोद्वाहं तु राजानं ब्रह्मदत्तं महीपतिः
सदारं प्रेषयामास सोपाध्याय गणं तदा
verses.transliteration:
kṛtodvāhaṁ tu rājānaṁ brahmadattaṁ mahīpatiḥ
sadāraṁ preṣayāmāsa sopādhyāya gaṇaṁ tadā

translations.english: And he dismissed that lord of earth, king Brahmadatta, in company with his consorts and the priests.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमदापि सुसंहृष्टा पुत्रस्य सदृशीं क्रियाम्
यथान्यायं च गन्धर्वी स्नुषास्ताः प्रत्यनन्दत
verses.transliteration:
somadāpi susaṁhṛṣṭā putrasya sadṛśīṁ kriyām
yathānyāyaṁ ca gandharvī snuṣāstāḥ pratyanandata

translations.english: And the Gandharvī Somadā rejoiced exceedingly at the completion of the nuptials of her son; and embracing her daughters-in-law again and again, and extolling her son, she expressed the fullness of her joy. And he dismissed that lord of earth, king Brahmadatta, in company with his consorts and the priests.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतोद्वाहे गते तस्मिन्ब्रह्मदत्ते च राघव
अपुत्रः पुत्रलाभाय पौत्रीमिष्टिमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtodvāhe gate tasminbrahmadatte ca rāghava
aputraḥ putralābhāya pautrīmiṣṭimakalpayat

translations.english: And, O Raghava, when Brahmadatta was married, that sonless one, (Kušanābha), with the intention of obtaining male offspring, took in hand a son-conferring sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
इष्ट्यां तु वर्तमानायां कुशनाभं महीपतिम्
उवाच परमप्रीतः कुशो ब्रह्मसुतस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
iṣṭyāṁ tu vartamānāyāṁ kuśanābhaṁ mahīpatim
uvāca paramaprītaḥ kuśo brahmasutastadā

translations.english: And when the sacrifice had commenced, that son of Brahmā, the exceedingly noble Kusa, spoke to king Kusanābha, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रस्ते सदृशः पुत्र भविष्यति सुधार्मिकः
गाधिं प्राप्स्यसि तेन त्वं कीर्तिं लोके च शाश्वतीम्
verses.transliteration:
putraste sadṛśaḥ putra bhaviṣyati sudhārmikaḥ
gādhiṁ prāpsyasi tena tvaṁ kīrtiṁ loke ca śāśvatīm

translations.english: O son, there will be born to you a virtuous son like to thyself: you will obtain even Gādhi, and through him enduring fame in this world.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा कुशो राम कुशनाभं महीपतिम्
जगामाकाशमाविश्य ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā kuśo rāma kuśanābhaṁ mahīpatim
jagāmākāśamāviśya brahmalokaṁ sanātanam

translations.english: Having said this to king Kusanabha, Kusa, O Rāma, entering the welkin, went to the eternal regions of Brahmā.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य कुशनाभस्य धीमतः
जज्ञे परमधर्मिष्ठो गाधिरित्येव नामतः
verses.transliteration:
kasyacittvatha kālasya kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ
jajñe paramadharmiṣṭho gādhirityeva nāmataḥ

translations.english: Then after sometime, an eminently virtuous son, named Gadhi, was born to the intelligent Kusanabha.

verses.sanskrit:
स पिता मम काकुत्स्थ गाधिः परमधार्मिकः
कुशवंशप्रसूतोऽस्मि कौशिको रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
sa pitā mama kākutstha gādhiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
kuśavaṁśaprasūto'smi kauśiko raghunandana

translations.english: O Kākutstha, even that highly pious Gadhi is my sire. And, O descendant of Raghu, I, called Kausika, am sprung from Kusa's line.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वजा भगिनी चापि मम राघव सुव्रता
नाम्ना सत्यवती नाम ऋचीके प्रतिपादिता
verses.transliteration:
pūrvajā bhaginī cāpi mama rāghava suvratā
nāmnā satyavatī nāma ṛcīke pratipāditā

translations.english: O Rāghava, I had a sister of noble vows born before me. And her name was Satyavatī; and she was bestowed upon Rcīkā.

verses.sanskrit:
सशरीरा गता स्वर्गं भर्तारमनुवर्तिनी
कौशिकी परमोदारा सा प्रवृत्ता महानदी
verses.transliteration:
saśarīrā gatā svargaṁ bhartāramanuvartinī
kauśikī paramodārā sā pravṛttā mahānadī

translations.english: And following her lord, she ascended heaven in her own proper person. And my highly generous sister, Kausikī, has finally assumed the form of a mighty river.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्या पुण्योदका रम्या हिमवन्तमुपाश्रिता
लोकस्य हितकामार्थं प्रवृत्ता भगिनी मम
verses.transliteration:
divyā puṇyodakā ramyā himavantamupāśritā
lokasya hitakāmārthaṁ pravṛttā bhaginī mama

translations.english: And in order to compass the welfare of all creatures, my sister is now a noble and charming river of sacred waters, issuing from the Himavat mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽहं हिमवत्पार्श्वे वसामि नियतः सुखम्
भगिन्याः स्नेहसंयुक्तः कौशिक्या रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
tato'haṁ himavatpārśve vasāmi niyataḥ sukham
bhaginyāḥ snehasaṁyuktaḥ kauśikyā raghunandana

translations.english: And thenceforth, out of affection for my sister, Kausiki, I ever dwell happily in the vicinity of the Himavat, O Raghava.

verses.sanskrit:
सा तु सत्यवती पुण्या सत्ये धर्मे प्रतिष्ठिता
पतिव्रता महाभागा कौशिकी सरितां वरा
verses.transliteration:
sā tu satyavatī puṇyā satye dharme pratiṣṭhitā
pativratā mahābhāgā kauśikī saritāṁ varā

translations.english: And that virtuous Kausiki, Satyavati, as well established in religion as truth, and chaste, and eminently pious, is now the foremost of streams.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि नियमाद्राम हित्वा तां समुपागतः
सिद्धाश्रममनुप्राप्य सिद्धोऽस्मि तव तेजसा
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ hi niyamādrāma hitvā tāṁ samupāgataḥ
siddhāśramamanuprāpya siddho'smi tava tejasā

translations.english: And, O Rama, it is only for the purpose of completing my sacrifice that leaving her behind, I have come to Siddhāśrama. And now by virtue of your energy, have I attained fruition.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा राम ममोत्पत्तिः स्वस्य वंशस्य कीर्तिता
देशस्य च महाबाहो यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
eṣā rāma mamotpattiḥ svasya vaṁśasya kīrtitā
deśasya ca mahābāho yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripṛcchasi

translations.english: Now, O Rāma, I have narrated to you the circumstances connected with the history of my line and myself, as also of this place, O mightyarmed one, which you had asked me to relate.

verses.sanskrit:
गतोऽर्धरात्रः काकुत्स्थ कथाः कथयतो मम
निद्रामभ्येहि भद्रं ते मा भूद्विघ्नोऽध्वनीह नः
verses.transliteration:
gato'rdharātraḥ kākutstha kathāḥ kathayato mama
nidrāmabhyehi bhadraṁ te mā bhūdvighno'dhvanīha naḥ

translations.english: But, O Kākutstha, while I was speaking, half the night has been spent. Do you now sleep, good betide you, so that you may not feel any difficulty while on the journey.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्पन्दास्तरवः सर्वे निलीना मृगपक्षिणः
नैशेन तमसा व्याप्ता दिशश्च रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
niṣpandāstaravaḥ sarve nilīnā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
naiśena tamasā vyāptā diśaśca raghunandana

translations.english: The trees stand motionless, and the beasts and birds are silent, and, O descendant of Raghu, all sides have become enveloped in nocturnal gloom.

verses.sanskrit:
शनैर्वियुज्यते संध्या नभो नेत्रैरिवावृतम्
नक्षत्रतारागहनं ज्योतिर्भिरवभासते
verses.transliteration:
śanairviyujyate saṁdhyā nabho netrairivāvṛtam
nakṣatratārāgahanaṁ jyotirbhiravabhāsate

translations.english: The noon of night is gradually passing away; and the firmament thick-studded with stars resembling eyes, is illumined up with their light.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठति च शीतांशुः शशी लोकतमोनुदः
ह्लादयन्प्राणिनां लोके मनांसि प्रभया विभो
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭhati ca śītāṁśuḥ śaśī lokatamonudaḥ
hlādayanprāṇināṁ loke manāṁsi prabhayā vibho

translations.english: And that dispeller of darkness, the mildbeaming moon is rising, gladdening the hearts of all creatures with his splendour.

verses.sanskrit:
नैशानि सर्वभूतानि प्रचरन्ति ततस्ततः
यक्षराक्षससंघाश्च रौद्राश्च पिशिताशनाः
verses.transliteration:
naiśāni sarvabhūtāni pracaranti tatastataḥ
yakṣarākṣasasaṁghāśca raudrāśca piśitāśanāḥ

translations.english: And night-ranging being terrible carnivorous Yaksas and Rākşasas—walk here and there,

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा विरराम महामुनिः
साधु साध्विति तं सर्वे मुनयो ह्यभ्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejā virarāma mahāmuniḥ
sādhu sādhviti taṁ sarve munayo hyabhyapūjayan

translations.english: Having said this the mighty ascetic of exceeding energy paused. And those ascetics honouring him, said, Excellent! Excellent!

verses.sanskrit:
रामोऽपि सह सौमित्रिः किंचिदागतविस्मयः
प्रशस्य मुनिशार्दूलं निद्रां समुपसेवते
verses.transliteration:
rāmo'pi saha saumitriḥ kiṁcidāgatavismayaḥ
praśasya muniśārdūlaṁ nidrāṁ samupasevate

translations.english: Rāma too along with Sumitrā's son having in admiration praised that tiger among ascetics, enjoyed the luxury of slumber.

verses.sanskrit:
उपास्य रात्रिशेषं तु शोणाकूले महर्षिभिः
निशायां सुप्रभातायां विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
upāsya rātriśeṣaṁ tu śoṇākūle maharṣibhiḥ
niśāyāṁ suprabhātāyāṁ viśvāmitro'bhyabhāṣata

translations.english: HAVING in company with the ascetics passed the remainder of the night on the banks of the Sona, Visvāmitra, when the day broke, spoke,

verses.sanskrit:
सुप्रभाता निशा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते गमनायाभिरोचय
verses.transliteration:
suprabhātā niśā rāma pūrvā saṁdhyā pravartate
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṁ te gamanāyābhirocaya

translations.english: O Rāma, the night has passed away, and the morn has come. The hour for performing the prior devotions has arrived. Arise! arise! good betide you! Do you prepare for going.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकीं क्रियाम्
गमनं रोचयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṁ kriyām
gamanaṁ rocayāmāsa vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing these words of his, Rāma, having finished his morning devotions and rites, and ready for departure, said,

verses.sanskrit:
अयं शोणः शुभजलो गाधः पुलिनमण्डितः
कतरेण पथा ब्रह्मन्संतरिष्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ śoṇaḥ śubhajalo gādhaḥ pulinamaṇḍitaḥ
katareṇa pathā brahmansaṁtariṣyāmahe vayam

translations.english: This is the Sona, of excellent waters, fathomless, and studded with islets. O Brāhmaṇa, by which way shall we repair

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्
एष पन्था मयोद्दिष्टो येन यान्ति महर्षयः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa viśvāmitro'bravīdidam
eṣa panthā mayoddiṣṭo yena yānti maharṣayaḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma, Viśvāmitra replied. Even this path has been fixed upon by men, that, namely, by which the Maharșis go.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं गतेऽर्धदिवसे तदा
जाह्नवीं सरितां श्रेष्ठां ददृशुर्मुनिसेविताम्
verses.transliteration:
te gatvā dūramadhvānaṁ gate'rdhadivase tadā
jāhnavīṁ saritāṁ śreṣṭhāṁ dadṛśurmunisevitām

translations.english: Having proceeded far, when the day had been half spent, they beheld that foremost of streams, the Jahnavi, worshipped by ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
तां दृष्ट्वा पुण्यसलिलां हंससारससेविताम्
बभूवुर्मुदिताः सर्वे मुनयः सहराघवाः
तस्यास्तीरे ततश्चक्रुस्ते आवासपरिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ dṛṣṭvā puṇyasalilāṁ haṁsasārasasevitām
babhūvurmuditāḥ sarve munayaḥ saharāghavāḥ
tasyāstīre tataścakruste āvāsaparigraham

translations.english: Having beheld that river furnished with sacred waters, and frequented by swans and cranes, the ascetics who accompanied Rāghava were exceedingly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स्नात्वा यथान्यायं संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः
हुत्वा चैवाग्निहोत्राणि प्राश्य चामृतवद्धविः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ snātvā yathānyāyaṁ saṁtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ
hutvā caivāgnihotrāṇi prāśya cāmṛtavaddhaviḥ

translations.english: And they took up their quarters on the banks of the river. And then having bathed and duly offered oblations of water to the gods and the manes of their ancestors, and performed Agnihotra* (Sacrifice with burnt offering.) sacrifices, and partaken of clarified butter like to nectar, those high-souled and auspicious ones, with glad hearts, sat down surrounding Viśvāmitra.

verses.sanskrit:
संप्रहृष्टमना रामो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
भगवञ्श्रोतुमिच्छामि गङ्गां त्रिपथगां नदीम्
त्रैलोक्यं कथमाक्रम्य गता नदनदीपतिम्
verses.transliteration:
saṁprahṛṣṭamanā rāmo viśvāmitramathābravīt
bhagavañśrotumicchāmi gaṅgāṁ tripathagāṁ nadīm
trailokyaṁ kathamākramya gatā nadanadīpatim

translations.english: O adorable one, I desire to hear how the Gangă flowing in three directions and embracing the three worlds, falls into the lord of streams and rivers.

verses.sanskrit:
चोदितो राम वाक्येन विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
वृद्धिं जन्म च गङ्गाया वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
codito rāma vākyena viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
vṛddhiṁ janma ca gaṅgāyā vaktumevopacakrame

translations.english: Influenced by Rama's speech, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra entered upon the history of the Gangā's origin and progress.

verses.sanskrit:
शैलेन्द्रो हिमवान्नाम धातूनामाकरो महान्
तस्य कन्या द्वयं राम रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि
verses.transliteration:
śailendro himavānnāma dhātūnāmākaro mahān
tasya kanyā dvayaṁ rāma rūpeṇāpratimaṁ bhuvi

translations.english: O Rāma, that great mine of ore, Himavat is the foremost of mountains. To him were born two daughters, unparalleled on earth in loveliness.

verses.sanskrit:
या मेरुदुहिता राम तयोर्माता सुमध्यमा
नाम्ना मेना मनोज्ञा वै पत्नी हिमवतः प्रिया
verses.transliteration:
yā meruduhitā rāma tayormātā sumadhyamā
nāmnā menā manojñā vai patnī himavataḥ priyā

translations.english: O Rāma, their mother of dainty waist, the amiable daughter of Meru, named Menā, was the beloved wife of Himavat.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यां गङ्गेयमभवज्ज्येष्ठा हिमवतः सुता
उमा नाम द्वितीयाभूत्कन्या तस्यैव राघव
verses.transliteration:
tasyāṁ gaṅgeyamabhavajjyeṣṭhā himavataḥ sutā
umā nāma dvitīyābhūtkanyā tasyaiva rāghava

translations.english: She of whom was born Gangā the elder daughter of Himavat; and, O Raghava, a second daughter was also born to him, named Uma.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य त्रिलोकार्थं त्रिलोकहितकारिणः
गङ्गामादाय तेऽगच्छन्कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya trilokārthaṁ trilokahitakāriṇaḥ
gaṅgāmādāya te'gacchankṛtārthenāntarātmanā

translations.english: And it came to pass that once upon a time, the deities, with the view of accomplishing some work appertaining to them as divine beings, in a body besought that foremost of mountains for that river flowing in three worlds, Himavat in obedience to duty, conferred upon them his daughter flowing everywhere at will, and sanctifying all creatures. Thereat in the interests of the three worlds, accepting her, those having the welfare of the three worlds, at heart, went away with Ganga, considering themselves as having attained their desire.

verses.sanskrit:
या चान्या शैलदुहिता कन्यासीद्रघुनन्दन
उग्रं सा व्रतमास्थाय तपस्तेपे तपोधना
verses.transliteration:
yā cānyā śailaduhitā kanyāsīdraghunandana
ugraṁ sā vratamāsthāya tapastepe tapodhanā

translations.english: The other daughter of the mountain, O descendant of Raghu, adopting a stern vow, began to carry on austerities, having asceticism for her wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
उग्रेण तपसा युक्तां ददौ शैलवरः सुताम्
रुद्रायाप्रतिरूपाय उमां लोकनमस्कृताम्
verses.transliteration:
ugreṇa tapasā yuktāṁ dadau śailavaraḥ sutām
rudrāyāpratirūpāya umāṁ lokanamaskṛtām

translations.english: And that best of mountains bestowed upon Rudra of unequalled form his daughter Uma, furnished with fiery asceticism and worshipped of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
एते ते शैल राजस्य सुते लोकनमस्कृते
गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा उमा देवी च राघव
verses.transliteration:
ete te śaila rājasya sute lokanamaskṛte
gaṅgā ca saritāṁ śreṣṭhā umā devī ca rāghava

translations.english: And these, O Rāghava, are the daughters of that king of mountains, worshipped of all, viz, Gangā, the foremost of streams, and the divine Uma.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्ते धर्ममाख्यातं यथा त्रिपथगा नदी
खं गता प्रथमं तात गतिं गतिमतां वर
verses.transliteration:
etatte dharmamākhyātaṁ yathā tripathagā nadī
khaṁ gatā prathamaṁ tāta gatiṁ gatimatāṁ vara

translations.english: Now, O best of those endowed with motion, have I related to you how that sin-destroying one flowing with her waters in three diverse directions, first, O child, went to the firmament and then ascended the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन्नुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ
प्रतिनन्द्य कथां वीरावूचतुर्मुनिपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration:
ukta vākye munau tasminnubhau rāghavalakṣmaṇau
pratinandya kathāṁ vīrāvūcaturmunipuṁgavam

translations.english: When the ascetic had spoken thus, both the heroes, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, saluting that first of anchorites, said,

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मयुक्तमिदं ब्रह्मन्कथितं परमं त्वया
दुहितुः शैलराजस्य ज्येष्ठाय वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
dharmayuktamidaṁ brahmankathitaṁ paramaṁ tvayā
duhituḥ śailarājasya jyeṣṭhāya vaktumarhasi

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, you have delivered this noble narration fraught with morality. Now it behoves you to speak about the elder daughter of the mountain-king. You are extensively conversant with everything relative to men or gods.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तरं विस्तरज्ञोऽसि दिव्यमानुषसंभवम्
त्रीन्पथो हेतुना केन पावयेल्लोकपावनी
verses.transliteration:
vistaraṁ vistarajño'si divyamānuṣasaṁbhavam
trīnpatho hetunā kena pāvayellokapāvanī

translations.english: Why is it that purifier of the worlds lave three directions? And why is that foremost of streams, Gangā, famous as wending in three ways

verses.sanskrit:
कथं गङ्गां त्रिपथगा विश्रुता सरिदुत्तमा
त्रिषु लोकेषु धर्मज्ञ कर्मभिः कैः समन्विता
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ gaṅgāṁ tripathagā viśrutā sariduttamā
triṣu lokeṣu dharmajña karmabhiḥ kaiḥ samanvitā

translations.english: And, O you cognizant of morality, what are her performances in the three worlds? Thereat Viśvāmitra having asceticism for this wealth, began to relate to Käkutstha that history in detail in the midst of the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा राम कृतोद्वाहः शितिकण्ठो महातपाः
दृष्ट्वा च स्पृहया देवीं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
purā rāma kṛtodvāhaḥ śitikaṇṭho mahātapāḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca spṛhayā devīṁ maithunāyopacakrame

translations.english: In days of yore, O Rāma, the blue-throated one of mighty asceticism, having entered into matrimony, commenced upon knowing the goddess. And as that intelligent blue-throated god, Mahadeva, was thus engaged in sport, a divine hundred years passed away.

verses.sanskrit:
शितिकण्ठस्य देवस्य दिव्यं वर्षशतं गतम्
न चापि तनयो राम तस्यामासीत्परंतप
verses.transliteration:
śitikaṇṭhasya devasya divyaṁ varṣaśataṁ gatam
na cāpi tanayo rāma tasyāmāsītparaṁtapa

translations.english: And yet, O Rāma, chastiser of foes, no son was born of her. Thereat all the gods with the Grand-sire at their head became exceedingly anxious.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः समुद्विग्नाः पितामहपुरोगमाः
यदिहोत्पद्यते भूतं कस्तत्प्रतिसहिष्यते
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ samudvignāḥ pitāmahapurogamāḥ
yadihotpadyate bhūtaṁ kastatpratisahiṣyate

translations.english: Who will be able to bear the offspring of this union? And thereupon the celestials repairing to Mahadeva, thus addressed him, saluting low,

verses.sanskrit:
अभिगम्य सुराः सर्वे प्रणिपत्येदमब्रुवन्
देवदेव महादेव लोकस्यास्य हिते रत
सुराणां प्रणिपातेन प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
abhigamya surāḥ sarve praṇipatyedamabruvan
devadeva mahādeva lokasyāsya hite rata
surāṇāṁ praṇipātena prasādaṁ kartumarhasi

translations.english: O god of gods! O mighty deity! ever engaged in the welfare of all, it behove you to be propitious at the humble salutations of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
न लोका धारयिष्यन्ति तव तेजः सुरोत्तम
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तो देव्या सह तपश्चर
verses.transliteration:
na lokā dhārayiṣyanti tava tejaḥ surottama
brāhmeṇa tapasā yukto devyā saha tapaścara

translations.english: The worlds, O foremost of celestials, are incapable of bearing your energy. Therefore, for the welfare of the three worlds, do you, being furnished with Brahmā asceticism, in company with the goddess practise austerities, and rein in your energy by your native indomitableness.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रैलोक्यहितकामार्थं तेजस्तेजसि धारय
रक्ष सर्वानिमाँल्लोकान्नालोकं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
trailokyahitakāmārthaṁ tejastejasi dhāraya
rakṣa sarvānimā̐llokānnālokaṁ kartumarhasi

translations.english: Do you preserve these worlds; for it become you not to destroy all.'

verses.sanskrit:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः
बाढमित्यब्रवीत्सर्वान्पुनश्चेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
devatānāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
bāḍhamityabravītsarvānpunaścedamuvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of the deities, the great god of the worlds said to them, 'So be it!' And addressing them again he said,

verses.sanskrit:
धारयिष्याम्यहं तेजस्तेजस्येव सहोमया
त्रिदशाः पृथिवी चैव निर्वाणमधिगच्छतु
verses.transliteration:
dhārayiṣyāmyahaṁ tejastejasyeva sahomayā
tridaśāḥ pṛthivī caiva nirvāṇamadhigacchatu

translations.english: You gods, by my own energy I will assisted by Uma bear my virile vigour, therefore let the creation find rest!

verses.sanskrit:
यदिदं क्षुभितं स्थानान्मम तेजो ह्यनुत्तमम्
धारयिष्यति कस्तन्मे ब्रुवन्तु सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
yadidaṁ kṣubhitaṁ sthānānmama tejo hyanuttamam
dhārayiṣyati kastanme bruvantu surasattamāḥ

translations.english: But tell me, you foremost of celestials, who will sustain my potent virility rushing out from its receptacle?'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तास्ततो देवाः प्रत्यूचुर्वृषभध्वजम्
यत्तेजः क्षुभितं ह्येतत्तद्धरा धारयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
evamuktāstato devāḥ pratyūcurvṛṣabhadhvajam
yattejaḥ kṣubhitaṁ hyetattaddharā dhārayiṣyati

translations.english: Being thus addressed, the gods answered him having the bull for his mark, ‘The earth will today bear your vital flow.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः सुरपतिः प्रमुमोच महीतले
तेजसा पृथिवी येन व्याप्ता सगिरिकानना
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ surapatiḥ pramumoca mahītale
tejasā pṛthivī yena vyāptā sagirikānanā

translations.english: Thus assured, the mighty lord of the celestials let go his vital fluid; and thereat the earth containing mountains and forests was overspread with the energy.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः पुनरिदमूचुश्चाथ हुताशनम्
प्रविश त्वं महातेजो रौद्रं वायुसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ punaridamūcuścātha hutāśanam
praviśa tvaṁ mahātejo raudraṁ vāyusamanvitaḥ

translations.english: Then the gods spoke to the Fire, saying, 'Do you in company with the Wind entrain to this fierce an mighty energy!'

verses.sanskrit:
तदग्निना पुनर्व्याप्तं संजातः श्वेतपर्वतः
दिव्यं शरवणं चैव पावकादित्यसंनिभम्
यत्र जातो महातेजाः कार्तिकेयोऽग्निसंभवः
verses.transliteration:
tadagninā punarvyāptaṁ saṁjātaḥ śvetaparvataḥ
divyaṁ śaravaṇaṁ caiva pāvakādityasaṁnibham
yatra jāto mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo'gnisaṁbhavaḥ

translations.english: When the Wind had entered into it, it was developed into a white hill, and a forest of glossy reeds, resembling fire or the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
अथोमां च शिवं चैव देवाः सर्षि गणास्तदा
पूजयामासुरत्यर्थं सुप्रीतमनसस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
athomāṁ ca śivaṁ caiva devāḥ sarṣi gaṇāstadā
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṁ suprītamanasastataḥ

translations.english: Here sprang from Fire Kārtikeya of mighty energy. And thereupon the celestials and the saints, with gratified hearts, began to pay enthusiastic adorations to Uma and Siva.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ शैल सुता राम त्रिदशानिदमब्रवीत्
समन्युरशपत्सर्वान्क्रोधसंरक्तलोचना
verses.transliteration:
atha śaila sutā rāma tridaśānidamabravīt
samanyuraśapatsarvānkrodhasaṁraktalocanā

translations.english: Then the Mountain's daughter, O Rama, addressed the celestials, cursing them with eyes reddened in wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मान्निवारिता चैव संगता पुत्रकाम्यया
अपत्यं स्वेषु दारेषु नोत्पादयितुमर्हथ
अद्य प्रभृति युष्माकमप्रजाः सन्तु पत्नयः
verses.transliteration:
yasmānnivāritā caiva saṁgatā putrakāmyayā
apatyaṁ sveṣu dāreṣu notpādayitumarhatha
adya prabhṛti yuṣmākamaprajāḥ santu patnayaḥ

translations.english: While in association with Mahadeva for obtaining sons, I was broken in upon by you, for this, you shall not be able yourselves to beget offspring on your wives. And from this day forth, your wives shall remain without issue.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा सुरान्सर्वाञ्शशाप पृथिवीमपि
अवने नैकरूपा त्वं बहुभार्या भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā surānsarvāñśaśāpa pṛthivīmapi
avane naikarūpā tvaṁ bahubhāryā bhaviṣyasi

translations.english: Having thus spoke to the celestials, she cursed the Earth also, saying, 'O Earth, you will have multiform surface and many husbands.'

verses.sanskrit:
न च पुत्रकृतां प्रीतिं मत्क्रोधकलुषी कृता
प्राप्स्यसि त्वं सुदुर्मेधे मम पुत्रमनिच्छती
verses.transliteration:
na ca putrakṛtāṁ prītiṁ matkrodhakaluṣī kṛtā
prāpsyasi tvaṁ sudurmedhe mama putramanicchatī

translations.english: Nor, stained because of my ire, shall you experience the pleasure that is felt on obtaining a son, O you of wicked understanding, O you that do not wish me a son!

verses.sanskrit:
तान्सर्वान्व्रीडितान्दृष्ट्वा सुरान्सुरपतिस्तदा
गमनायोपचक्राम दिशं वरुणपालिताम्
verses.transliteration:
tānsarvānvrīḍitāndṛṣṭvā surānsurapatistadā
gamanāyopacakrāma diśaṁ varuṇapālitām

translations.english: Witnessing the gods, thus distressed, the lord of the celestials set out in the direction presided over by Varuna (The West).

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत्पार्श्वे तस्योत्तरे गिरेः
हिमवत्प्रभवे शृङ्गे सह देव्या महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā tapa ātiṣṭhatpārśve tasyottare gireḥ
himavatprabhave śṛṅge saha devyā maheśvaraḥ

translations.english: And having repaired to the north side of that mountain, Mahesvara along with the goddess became engaged in austerities on the peak Himavatprabhava.

verses.sanskrit:
एष ते विस्तरो राम शैलपुत्र्या निवेदितः
गङ्गायाः प्रभवं चैव शृणु मे सहलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa te vistaro rāma śailaputryā niveditaḥ
gaṅgāyāḥ prabhavaṁ caiva śṛṇu me sahalakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: I have now related to you, O Rāma, the spread of the Mountain's daughter, (Gangā). Do you now together with Lakşmaņa listen to the narration of Bhāgīrathi's potency.

verses.sanskrit:
तप्यमाने तपो देवे देवाः सर्षिगणाः पुरा
सेनापतिमभीप्सन्तः पितामहमुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
tapyamāne tapo deve devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā
senāpatimabhīpsantaḥ pitāmahamupāgaman

translations.english: On that celestial being engaged in austerities, the deities with Indra and Agni at their head, desirous of gaining over the generalissimo, Appeared before the Grand-sire.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽब्रुवन्सुराः सर्वे भगवन्तं पितामहम्
प्रणिपत्य शुभं वाक्यं सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
tato'bruvansurāḥ sarve bhagavantaṁ pitāmaham
praṇipatya śubhaṁ vākyaṁ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ

translations.english: And, O Rāma, the gods with Agni at their head, bowing to him, addressed that possessor of the six attributes, the Grand-sir, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
यो नः सेनापतिर्देव दत्तो भगवता पुरा
स तपः परमास्थाय तप्यते स्म सहोमया
verses.transliteration:
yo naḥ senāpatirdeva datto bhagavatā purā
sa tapaḥ paramāsthāya tapyate sma sahomayā

translations.english: 'O God, that adorable one who had formerly consigned to us the generalissimo, resorting to high asceticism, is practising austerities with Uma.

verses.sanskrit:
यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं लोकानां हितकाम्यया
संविधत्स्व विधानज्ञ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration:
yadatrānantaraṁ kāryaṁ lokānāṁ hitakāmyayā
saṁvidhatsva vidhānajña tvaṁ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ

translations.english: Do you now, O you conversant with resources, so order as is advisable in the interests of the worlds! Verily you are our prime way.'

verses.sanskrit:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः
सान्त्वयन्मधुरैर्वाक्यैस्त्रिदशानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
devatānāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
sāntvayanmadhurairvākyaistridaśānidamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of the deities, the Grandsire of all creatures, 'consoling them with soft words, spoke to them saying

verses.sanskrit:
शैलपुत्र्या यदुक्तं तन्न प्रजास्यथ पत्निषु
तस्या वचनमक्लिष्टं सत्यमेव न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
śailaputryā yaduktaṁ tanna prajāsyatha patniṣu
tasyā vacanamakliṣṭaṁ satyameva na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: 'Even as the Mountain's daughter has said, sons will not be born to you of your own wives. Her words is infallible of a certainty: there is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit:
इयमाकाशगा गङ्गा यस्यां पुत्रं हुताशनः
जनयिष्यति देवानां सेनापतिमरिंदमम्
verses.transliteration:
iyamākāśagā gaṅgā yasyāṁ putraṁ hutāśanaḥ
janayiṣyati devānāṁ senāpatimariṁdamam

translations.english: This is the celestial Gangă she on whom Hutaśana will beget a son-the foe-subduing generalissimo of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्येष्ठा शैलेन्द्रदुहिता मानयिष्यति तं सुतम्
उमायास्तद्बहुमतं भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
jyeṣṭhā śailendraduhitā mānayiṣyati taṁ sutam
umāyāstadbahumataṁ bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: And the elder daughter of the Mountain will consider that son as brought forth by Uma; and Uma also will, without doubt, look upon him with regard.'

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कृतार्था रघुनन्दन
प्रणिपत्य सुराः सर्वे पितामहमपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya kṛtārthā raghunandana
praṇipatya surāḥ sarve pitāmahamapūjayan

translations.english: Hearing these words of him o descendant of Raghu, the gods bowing to the Grand-sire, paid him homage.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गत्वा पर्वतं राम कैलासं धातुमण्डितम्
अग्निं नियोजयामासुः पुत्रार्थं सर्वदेवताः
verses.transliteration:
te gatvā parvataṁ rāma kailāsaṁ dhātumaṇḍitam
agniṁ niyojayāmāsuḥ putrārthaṁ sarvadevatāḥ

translations.english: Then, O Rama, repairing to the Kailasa mountain teeming with metals, the deities commissioned Agni with the view of having a son (born to him.)10

verses.sanskrit:
देवकार्यमिदं देव समाधत्स्व हुताशन
शैलपुत्र्यां महातेजो गङ्गायां तेज उत्सृज
verses.transliteration:
devakāryamidaṁ deva samādhatsva hutāśana
śailaputryāṁ mahātejo gaṅgāyāṁ teja utsṛja

translations.english: ‘Do you, O god, accomplish this work of the oddities! O you of mighty energy, do you discharge your energy into that daughter of the Mountain, Ganga.

verses.sanskrit:
देवतानां प्रतिज्ञाय गङ्गामभ्येत्य पावकः
गर्भं धारय वै देवि देवतानामिदं प्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
devatānāṁ pratijñāya gaṅgāmabhyetya pāvakaḥ
garbhaṁ dhāraya vai devi devatānāmidaṁ priyam

translations.english: Thereupon giving his promise to the gods, Pavaka* (Fire) approached Ganga, saying, Do you, O Goddess, bear an embryo; for even this is the desire of the deities.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दिव्यं रूपमधारयत्
स तस्या महिमां दृष्ट्वा समन्तादवकीर्यत
verses.transliteration:
ityetadvacanaṁ śrutvā divyaṁ rūpamadhārayat
sa tasyā mahimāṁ dṛṣṭvā samantādavakīryata

translations.english: Hearing this speech, she assumed a divine appearance. And beholding her mightiness, Agni was shrunk up on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
समन्ततस्तदा देवीमभ्यषिञ्चत पावकः
सर्वस्रोतांसि पूर्णानि गङ्गाया रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
samantatastadā devīmabhyaṣiñcata pāvakaḥ
sarvasrotāṁsi pūrṇāni gaṅgāyā raghunandana

translations.english: And then Pavaka from all sides discharged his energy into her, and thereat all her streams became surcharged with it,

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच ततो गङ्गा सर्वदेवपुरोहितम्
अशक्ता धारणे देव तव तेजः समुद्धतम्
दह्यमानाग्निना तेन संप्रव्यथितचेतना
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca tato gaṅgā sarvadevapurohitam
aśaktā dhāraṇe deva tava tejaḥ samuddhatam
dahyamānāgninā tena saṁpravyathitacetanā

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu. And to him staying at the head of all the deities, Gangā spoke, saying, "O god, I am incapable of sustaining this new sprung energy of yours: I am burning with that fire, and my consciousness fails me.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाब्रवीदिदं गङ्गां सर्वदेवहुताशनः
इह हैमवते पादे गर्भोऽयं संनिवेश्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
athābravīdidaṁ gaṅgāṁ sarvadevahutāśanaḥ
iha haimavate pāde garbho'yaṁ saṁniveśyatām

translations.english: Thereupon that partaker of the oblations offered to the gods, said to Ganga, 'Do you bring forth your embryo on the side of this Himavat!'

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा त्वग्निवचो गङ्गा तं गर्भमतिभास्वरम्
उत्ससर्ज महातेजाः स्रोतोभ्यो हि तदानघ
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tvagnivaco gaṅgā taṁ garbhamatibhāsvaram
utsasarja mahātejāḥ srotobhyo hi tadānagha

translations.english: Hearing Agni's words, Gangă of mighty energy cast her exceedingly effulgent embryo on her streams, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit:
यदस्या निर्गतं तस्मात्तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रभम्
काञ्चनं धरणीं प्राप्तं हिरण्यममलं शुभम्
verses.transliteration:
yadasyā nirgataṁ tasmāttaptajāmbūnadaprabham
kāñcanaṁ dharaṇīṁ prāptaṁ hiraṇyamamalaṁ śubham

translations.english: And as it came out of her, it wore the splendour of molten gold; and in consequence of its fiery virtue, objects near and objects far were converted into gold and silver of unsurpassed sheen, while those that were more distant were turned into copper and iron.

verses.sanskrit: तदेतद्धरणीं प्राप्य नानाधातुरवर्धत
verses.transliteration: tadetaddharaṇīṁ prāpya nānādhāturavardhata

translations.english: Her excreta were turned into lead. In this wise, various metals began to increase on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
निक्षिप्तमात्रे गर्भे तु तेजोभिरभिरञ्जितम्
सर्वं पर्वतसंनद्धं सौवर्णमभवद्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
nikṣiptamātre garbhe tu tejobhirabhirañjitam
sarvaṁ parvatasaṁnaddhaṁ sauvarṇamabhavadvanam

translations.english: As soon as the embryo was brought forth, the woods adjoining the mountain, being overspread with that energy, were turned into gold.

verses.sanskrit:
जातरूपमिति ख्यातं तदा प्रभृति राघव
सुवर्णं पुरुषव्याघ्र हुताशनसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration:
jātarūpamiti khyātaṁ tadā prabhṛti rāghava
suvarṇaṁ puruṣavyāghra hutāśanasamaprabham

translations.english: And from that day, O descendant of Raghu, gold of effulgence like to that of fire, became known as Jātarūpa, O foremost of men!

verses.sanskrit:
तं कुमारं ततो जातं सेन्द्राः सहमरुद्गणाः
क्षीरसंभावनार्थाय कृत्तिकाः समयोजयन्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ kumāraṁ tato jātaṁ sendrāḥ sahamarudgaṇāḥ
kṣīrasaṁbhāvanārthāya kṛttikāḥ samayojayan

translations.english: And when the son was born, the deities with Indra and the Maruts enjoined upon the Křttikā stars to suckle him.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः क्षीरं जातमात्रस्य कृत्वा समयमुत्तमम्
ददुः पुत्रोऽयमस्माकं सर्वासामिति निश्चिताः
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ kṣīraṁ jātamātrasya kṛtvā samayamuttamam
daduḥ putro'yamasmākaṁ sarvāsāmiti niścitāḥ

translations.english: 'Surely he shall be son to us all’-concluding thus, they as soon as he was born, by turns began to dispense milk to him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु देवताः सर्वाः कार्तिकेय इति ब्रुवन्
पुत्रस्त्रैलोक्य विख्यातो भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tatastu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kārtikeya iti bruvan
putrastrailokya vikhyāto bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Then the celestials called him Kārtikeya, saying, “Without doubt, this son shall become famed over the three worlds.'

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्कन्नं गर्भपरिस्रवे
स्नापयन्परया लक्ष्म्या दीप्यमानमिवानलम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā skannaṁ garbhaparisrave
snāpayanparayā lakṣmyā dīpyamānamivānalam

translations.english: And hearing those words of theirs, the Kșttikās bathed the offspring that had issued from her womb, flaming like fire, and with auspicious marks.

verses.sanskrit:
स्कन्द इत्यब्रुवन्देवाः स्कन्नं गर्भपरिस्रवात्
कार्तिकेयं महाभागं काकुत्स्थज्वलनोपमम्
verses.transliteration:
skanda ityabruvandevāḥ skannaṁ garbhaparisravāt
kārtikeyaṁ mahābhāgaṁ kākutsthajvalanopamam

translations.english: And, O Kākutstha, since Kārtikeya had issued from (Gangā's) womb the celestials called that effulgent and mighty-armed one, Skanda.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रादुर्भूतं ततः क्षीरं कृत्तिकानामनुत्तमम्
षण्णां षडाननो भूत्वा जग्राह स्तनजं पयः
verses.transliteration:
prādurbhūtaṁ tataḥ kṣīraṁ kṛttikānāmanuttamam
ṣaṇṇāṁ ṣaḍānano bhūtvā jagrāha stanajaṁ payaḥ

translations.english: And then the teats of the Křttikās were filled with milk; and thereupon assuming six mouths, he began to suck milk from the teats of those six.

verses.sanskrit:
गृहीत्वा क्षीरमेकाह्ना सुकुमार वपुस्तदा
अजयत्स्वेन वीर्येण दैत्यसैन्यगणान्विभुः
verses.transliteration:
gṛhītvā kṣīramekāhnā sukumāra vapustadā
ajayatsvena vīryeṇa daityasainyagaṇānvibhuḥ

translations.english: Having drunk the milk, that lord although then possessed of a tender frame, by virtue of his inbom prowess in one day vanquished the Dänava forces.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरसेनागणपतिं ततस्तममलद्युतिम्
अभ्यषिञ्चन्सुरगणाः समेत्याग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
surasenāgaṇapatiṁ tatastamamaladyutim
abhyaṣiñcansuragaṇāḥ sametyāgnipurogamāḥ

translations.english: And him possessed of mighty effulgence, the celestials assembled with Agni as their leader sprinkled with water, by way of installing him as their generalissimo.

verses.sanskrit:
एष ते राम गङ्गाया विस्तरोऽभिहितो मया
कुमारसंभवश्चैव धन्यः पुण्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration:
eṣa te rāma gaṅgāyā vistaro'bhihito mayā
kumārasaṁbhavaścaiva dhanyaḥ puṇyastathaiva ca

translations.english: He who, O Kākutstha, on earth revere Kārtikeya, is blessed, and attain righteousness, and being long-lived and obtaining sons and grand-sons, repair to the regions of Skanda.

verses.sanskrit:
तां कथां कौशिको रामे निवेद्य मधुराक्षरम्
पुनरेवापरं वाक्यं काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ kathāṁ kauśiko rāme nivedya madhurākṣaram
punarevāparaṁ vākyaṁ kākutsthamidamabravīt

translations.english: Having said those words to Rāma, composed of melodious letters, Kausika again spoke to Kākutstha, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्याधिपतिः शूरः पूर्वमासीन्नराधिपः
सगरो नाम धर्मात्मा प्रजाकामः स चाप्रजः
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyādhipatiḥ śūraḥ pūrvamāsīnnarādhipaḥ
sagaro nāma dharmātmā prajākāmaḥ sa cāprajaḥ

translations.english: Formerly there was a king-lord of Ayodhyā-named Sagara. And it came to pass that righteous one, though eagerly wishing for children was without issue.

verses.sanskrit:
वैदर्भदुहिता राम केशिनी नाम नामतः
ज्येष्ठा सगरपत्नी सा धर्मिष्ठा सत्यवादिनी
verses.transliteration:
vaidarbhaduhitā rāma keśinī nāma nāmataḥ
jyeṣṭhā sagarapatnī sā dharmiṣṭhā satyavādinī

translations.english: O Räma, Vidarbha's daughter, named Kesinī, was the elder wife of Sagara. And she was virtuous and truthful.

verses.sanskrit:
अरिष्टनेमिदुहिता रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि
द्वितीया सगरस्यासीत्पत्नी सुमतिसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration:
ariṣṭanemiduhitā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi
dvitīyā sagarasyāsītpatnī sumatisaṁjñitā

translations.english: The second wife of Sagara was called Sumati, who was the daughter of Aristanemi and the sister of Suparna (Garuda).

verses.sanskrit:
ताभ्यां सह तदा राजा पत्नीभ्यां तप्तवांस्तपः
हिमवन्तं समासाद्य भृगुप्रस्रवणे गिरौ
verses.transliteration:
tābhyāṁ saha tadā rājā patnībhyāṁ taptavāṁstapaḥ
himavantaṁ samāsādya bhṛguprasravaṇe girau

translations.english: And with those wives of his, that mighty king, coming to the Himavat, began to practice austerities on the mountain Bhrguprasravaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वर्ष शते पूर्णे तपसाराधितो मुनिः
सगराय वरं प्रादाद्भृगुः सत्यवतां वरः
verses.transliteration:
atha varṣa śate pūrṇe tapasārādhito muniḥ
sagarāya varaṁ prādādbhṛguḥ satyavatāṁ varaḥ

translations.english: When a full hundred years had been numbered, the ascetic that had been adored by means of these austerities, Bright, best of those endowed with truth, conferred a boon upon Sagara, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अपत्यलाभः सुमहान्भविष्यति तवानघ
कीर्तिं चाप्रतिमां लोके प्राप्स्यसे पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
apatyalābhaḥ sumahānbhaviṣyati tavānagha
kīrtiṁ cāpratimāṁ loke prāpsyase puruṣarṣabha

translations.english: O sinless one, you shall obtain glorious offspring; and, O foremost of men, you shall attain unparalleled renown among Man.

verses.sanskrit:
एका जनयिता तात पुत्रं वंशकरं तव
षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि अपरा जनयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
ekā janayitā tāta putraṁ vaṁśakaraṁ tava
ṣaṣṭiṁ putrasahasrāṇi aparā janayiṣyati

translations.english: O child, one of your con sorts shall bring forth a son who will perpetuate your race; and the other give birth to sixty thousand sons.'

verses.sanskrit:
भाषमाणं नरव्याघ्रं राजपत्न्यौ प्रसाद्य तम्
ऊचतुः परमप्रीते कृताञ्जलिपुटे तदा
verses.transliteration:
bhāṣamāṇaṁ naravyāghraṁ rājapatnyau prasādya tam
ūcatuḥ paramaprīte kṛtāñjalipuṭe tadā

translations.english: As that best of men was saying this, those daughters of kings, exceedingly delighted, propitiating him, addressed him with clasped hands.

verses.sanskrit:
एकः कस्याः सुतो ब्रह्मन्का बहूञ्जनयिष्यति
श्रोतुमिच्छावहे ब्रह्मन्सत्यमस्तु वचस्तव
verses.transliteration:
