ekaḥ kasyāḥ suto brahmankā bahūñjanayiṣyati
śrotumicchāvahe brahmansatyamastu vacastava

translations.english: Who of us, O Brahmana, shall produce a single son, and who many? This, O Brāhmaṇa, we wish to hear. May your word prove true!

verses.sanskrit:
तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भृगुः परम धार्मिकः
उवाच परमां वाणीं स्वच्छन्दोऽत्र विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
tayostadvacanaṁ śrutvā bhṛguḥ parama dhārmikaḥ
uvāca paramāṁ vāṇīṁ svacchando'tra vidhīyatām

translations.english: Hearing this, the highly pious Bhỉgu said these pregnant words, 'Do you unfold your minds. Who wishes for what boon, between a single perpetuator of the line, and innumerable sons, possessed of mighty strength, and furnished with fame, and endowed with high spirits?'

verses.sanskrit:
मुनेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा केशिनी रघुनन्दन
पुत्रं वंशकरं राम जग्राह नृपसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
munestu vacanaṁ śrutvā keśinī raghunandana
putraṁ vaṁśakaraṁ rāma jagrāha nṛpasaṁnidhau

translations.english: Hearing the ascetic's words, O descendant of Raghu, Kesinī in the presence of the monarch chose, O Rāma, a single son to perpetuate the line.

verses.sanskrit:
षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि सुपर्णभगिनी तदा
महोत्साहान्कीर्तिमतो जग्राह सुमतिः सुतान्
verses.transliteration:
ṣaṣṭiṁ putrasahasrāṇi suparṇabhaginī tadā
mahotsāhānkīrtimato jagrāha sumatiḥ sutān

translations.english: And Suparna's sister, Sumati, sixty thousand sons, high-spirited and furnished with fame.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रदक्षिणमृषिं कृत्वा शिरसाभिप्रणम्य च
जगाम स्वपुरं राजा सभार्या रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
pradakṣiṇamṛṣiṁ kṛtvā śirasābhipraṇamya ca
jagāma svapuraṁ rājā sabhāryā raghunandana

translations.english: Then, O son of Raghu, having gone round the saint and bowed down the head, the king went to his own capital, accompanied by his consorts.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ काले गते तस्मिञ्ज्येष्ठा पुत्रं व्यजायत
असमञ्ज इति ख्यातं केशिनी सगरात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
atha kāle gate tasmiñjyeṣṭhā putraṁ vyajāyata
asamañja iti khyātaṁ keśinī sagarātmajam

translations.english: And after a length of time, the elder, Kesini, bore a son to Sagara, known by the name of Asamanja.

verses.sanskrit:
सुमतिस्तु नरव्याघ्र गर्भतुम्बं व्यजायत
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि तुम्बभेदाद्विनिःसृताः
verses.transliteration:
sumatistu naravyāghra garbhatumbaṁ vyajāyata
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi tumbabhedādviniḥsṛtāḥ

translations.english: And Sumati, O foremost of men, brought forth a gourd. And when it burst open, out came from it sixty thousand sons.

verses.sanskrit:
घृतपूर्णेषु कुम्भेषु धात्र्यस्तान्समवर्धयन्
कालेन महता सर्वे यौवनं प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtapūrṇeṣu kumbheṣu dhātryastānsamavardhayan
kālena mahatā sarve yauvanaṁ pratipedire

translations.english: And the nurses fostered them by keeping them in jars filled with clarified butter. And after a great length of time, they attained to youth.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ दीर्घेण कालेन रूपयौवनशालिनः
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि सगरस्याभवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
atha dīrgheṇa kālena rūpayauvanaśālinaḥ
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi sagarasyābhavaṁstadā

translations.english: And after a long lapse of time, Sagara's sixty thousand sons attained to youth and beauty.

verses.sanskrit:
स च ज्येष्ठो नरश्रेष्ठ सगरस्यात्मसंभवः
बालान्गृहीत्वा तु जले सरय्वा रघुनन्दन
प्रक्षिप्य प्रहसन्नित्यं मज्जतस्तान्निरीक्ष्य वै
verses.transliteration:
sa ca jyeṣṭho naraśreṣṭha sagarasyātmasaṁbhavaḥ
bālāngṛhītvā tu jale sarayvā raghunandana
prakṣipya prahasannityaṁ majjatastānnirīkṣya vai

translations.english: O foremost of men,* the eldest son of Sagara, taking those children, would, O descendant of Raghu, often cast them into the Sarayū, and in mirth behold them sinking in the waters. *The text has Narasresthas, put for Asamanja. Evidently this is an error. I make it a vocative.

verses.sanskrit: पौराणामहिते युक्तः पित्रा निर्वासितः पुरात्
verses.transliteration: paurāṇāmahite yuktaḥ pitrā nirvāsitaḥ purāt

translations.english: Being thus evil-disposed, and injuring honest folks, and engaged in doing wrong to the citizens, he was banished by this father from the city.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य पुत्रोंऽशुमान्नाम असमञ्जस्य वीर्यवान्
संमतः सर्वलोकस्य सर्वस्यापि प्रियंवदः
verses.transliteration:
tasya putroṁ'śumānnāma asamañjasya vīryavān
saṁmataḥ sarvalokasya sarvasyāpi priyaṁvadaḥ

translations.english: Asamañja had a son possessed of prowess, named Anšumān. And he was beloved of all men and fair-spoken towards everyone.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कालेन महता मतिः समभिजायत
सगरस्य नरश्रेष्ठ यजेयमिति निश्चिता
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kālena mahatā matiḥ samabhijāyata
sagarasya naraśreṣṭha yajeyamiti niścitā

translations.english: O foremost of men, it came to pass that after a long time had gone by, that lord of earth Sagara made up his mind, saying, 'I will sacrifice.'

verses.sanskrit:
स कृत्वा निश्चयं राजा सोपाध्यायगणस्तदा
यज्ञकर्मणि वेदज्ञो यष्टुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
sa kṛtvā niścayaṁ rājā sopādhyāyagaṇastadā
yajñakarmaṇi vedajño yaṣṭuṁ samupacakrame

translations.english: Having determined upon it, that one versed in the Vedas set about it, in company with his priests.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा कथान्ते रघुनन्दन
उवाच परमप्रीतो मुनिं दीप्तमिवानलम्
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā kathānte raghunandana
uvāca paramaprīto muniṁ dīptamivānalam

translations.english: When Viśvāmitra had ended, hearing his words, Rāma exceedingly pleased, spoke to that ascetic resembling flaming fire, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोतुमिछामि भद्रं ते विस्तरेण कथामिमाम्
पूर्वको मे कथं ब्रह्मन्यज्ञं वै समुपाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
śrotumichāmi bhadraṁ te vistareṇa kathāmimām
pūrvako me kathaṁ brahmanyajñaṁ vai samupāharat

translations.english: I am anxious to hear in detail, good betide you, how, O Brāhmaṇa, my ancestor arranged for the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रस्तु काकुत्स्थमुवाच प्रहसन्निव
श्रूयतां विस्तरो राम सगरस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitrastu kākutsthamuvāca prahasanniva
śrūyatāṁ vistaro rāma sagarasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words of his, Viśvāmitra, smiling, eagerly spoke to Kākutstha, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
शंकरश्वशुरो नाम हिमवानचलोत्तमः
विन्ध्यपर्वतमासाद्य निरीक्षेते परस्परम्
verses.transliteration:
śaṁkaraśvaśuro nāma himavānacalottamaḥ
vindhyaparvatamāsādya nirīkṣete parasparam

translations.english: Do you, O Rāma, hearken to the story of the high-souled Sagara's sacrifice. Sankara's fatherin-law is the far-famed Himavat. And approaching each other, the Himavat and the vindhya behold each other. And on the region lying between them took place, O foremost of men, that sacrifice of Sagara's.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याश्वचर्यां काकुत्स्थ दृढधन्वा महारथः
अंशुमानकरोत्तात सगरस्य मते स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāśvacaryāṁ kākutstha dṛḍhadhanvā mahārathaḥ
aṁśumānakarottāta sagarasya mate sthitaḥ

translations.english: And that country, O best of men, is excellent as a sacrificial ground. And, O Kākutstha, equipped with a powerful bow, that mighty carwarrior, living under Sagara's sway, Ansumat, O child, followed the horse, for the purpose of protecting it.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य पर्वणि तं यज्ञं यजमानस्य वासवः
राक्षसीं तनुमास्थाय यज्ञियाश्वमपाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya parvaṇi taṁ yajñaṁ yajamānasya vāsavaḥ
rākṣasīṁ tanumāsthāya yajñiyāśvamapāharat

translations.english: It came to pass that with the intention of disturbing the sacrifice of that monarch, on a certain day Vasava, assuming the, form of a Raksasi, stole away the sacrificial horse. us

verses.sanskrit:
ह्रियमाणे तु काकुत्स्थ तस्मिन्नश्वे महात्मनः
उपाध्याय गणाः सर्वे यजमानमथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
hriyamāṇe tu kākutstha tasminnaśve mahātmanaḥ
upādhyāya gaṇāḥ sarve yajamānamathābruvan

translations.english: O Kākutstha, on the horse of that high-souled one being stolen, the priests said to the king engaged in the ceremony, 'On this auspicious day, has the sacrificial horse been stolen by violence. Do you, O Kākutstha, slay him that steals the horse, and bring it back. Otherwise the sacrifice will be defective, bringing misfortune. Therefore, do you, O king, act so, that the sacrifice may not bemired with defects.'

verses.sanskrit:
उपाध्याय वचः श्रुत्वा तस्मिन्सदसि पार्थिवः
षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
upādhyāya vacaḥ śrutvā tasminsadasi pārthivaḥ
ṣaṣṭiṁ putrasahasrāṇi vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of the priests, the king addressed his sixty thousand sons in the midst of his court, saying, 'l'eing, as this great sacrifice is, presided over by eminently pious Brāhmaṇas sanctified by mantras, I do not, you foremost of men, you sons, see how Raksasas may find entrance into it.'

verses.sanskrit:
दीक्षितः पौत्रसहितः सोपाध्यायगणो ह्यहम्
इह स्थास्यामि भद्रं वो यावत्तुरगदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
dīkṣitaḥ pautrasahitaḥ sopādhyāyagaṇo hyaham
iha sthāsyāmi bhadraṁ vo yāvatturagadarśanam

translations.english: I have been initiated into this sacrifice with my grand-sons and priests.' I will stay here till you light upon the horse.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा हृष्टमनसो राजपुत्रा महाबलाः
जग्मुर्महीतलं राम पितुर्वचनयन्त्रिताः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā hṛṣṭamanaso rājaputrā mahābalāḥ
jagmurmahītalaṁ rāma piturvacanayantritāḥ

translations.english: And thereat the mighty princes, enjoined by their father, breathing high spirits, began to range the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
योजनायामविस्तारमेकैको धरणीतलम्
बिभिदुः पुरुषव्याघ्र वज्रस्पर्शसमैर्भुजैः
verses.transliteration:
yojanāyāmavistāramekaiko dharaṇītalam
bibhiduḥ puruṣavyāghra vajrasparśasamairbhujaiḥ

translations.english: O Rāma. Then, they each fell to delving the bowels of the earth for the space of a Yojana in length and breadth, with their hands resembling thunder-bolts in feel, and with darts like to thunder-bolts, and with gigantic ploughshares. And being thus rived, the earth, O descendant of Raghu, began to send forth loud cries.

verses.sanskrit:
नागानां वध्यमानानामसुराणां च राघव
राक्षसानां च दुर्धर्षः सत्त्वानां निनदोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
nāgānāṁ vadhyamānānāmasurāṇāṁ ca rāghava
rākṣasānāṁ ca durdharṣaḥ sattvānāṁ ninado'bhavat

translations.english: O Rāghava, O you hard to repress, there arose an uproar from serpents, and Asuras, and Rāks asas, and other creatures, that were being slaughtered.

verses.sanskrit:
योजनानां सहस्राणि षष्टिं तु रघुनन्दन
बिभिदुर्धरणीं वीरा रसातलमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
yojanānāṁ sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṁ tu raghunandana
bibhidurdharaṇīṁ vīrā rasātalamanuttamam

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, they excavated the earth, O Rāma, for sixty thousand Yojanas, you, as if they had intended to reach the lowest depths underground.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं पर्वतसंबाधं जम्बूद्वीपं नृपात्मजाः
खनन्तो नृपशार्दूल सर्वतः परिचक्रमुः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ parvatasaṁbādhaṁ jambūdvīpaṁ nṛpātmajāḥ
khananto nṛpaśārdūla sarvataḥ paricakramuḥ

translations.english: Thus, O foremost of kings, those sons of the monarch dug all around Jambūdvīpa, filled with mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सासुराः सहपन्नगाः
संभ्रान्तमनसः सर्वे पितामहमुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sāsurāḥ sahapannagāḥ
saṁbhrāntamanasaḥ sarve pitāmahamupāgaman

translations.english: Thereat, the gods together with the Gandharvas, and Asuras, and Pannagas, in trepidation appeared before the Grand-sire.

verses.sanskrit:
ते प्रसाद्य महात्मानं विषण्णवदनास्तदा
ऊचुः परमसंत्रस्ताः पितामहमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration:
te prasādya mahātmānaṁ viṣaṇṇavadanāstadā
ūcuḥ paramasaṁtrastāḥ pitāmahamidaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: And propitiating that high-souled one, they with melancholy countenances and in exceeding agitation, spoke these words to the Grand-sire,

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्पृथिवी सर्वा खन्यते सगरात्मजैः
बहवश्च महात्मानो वध्यन्ते जलचारिणः
verses.transliteration:
bhagavanpṛthivī sarvā khanyate sagarātmajaiḥ
bahavaśca mahātmāno vadhyante jalacāriṇaḥ

translations.english: O adorable one, the entire earth is being excavated by the sons of Sagara; and many are the high-souled ones as well as the aquatic animals that are being slain in consequence.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं यज्ञहनोऽस्माकमनेनाश्वोऽपनीयते
इति ते सर्वभूतानि निघ्नन्ति सगरात्मजः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ yajñahano'smākamanenāśvo'panīyate
iti te sarvabhūtāni nighnanti sagarātmajaḥ

translations.english: This one is the disturber of our sacrifice, and by him has the sacrificial horse been stolen, saying this Sagara's sons are committing havoc upon all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्वै पितामहः
प्रत्युवाच सुसंत्रस्तान्कृतान्तबलमोहितान्
verses.transliteration:
devatānāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānvai pitāmahaḥ
pratyuvāca susaṁtrastānkṛtāntabalamohitān

translations.english: Hearing the speech of the celestials, that possessor of the six attributes, the Grand-sire, spoke to them exceedingly frightened and deprived of their senses on beholding the prowess of Sagara's sons like to the Destroyer himself.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्येयं वसुधा कृत्स्ना वासुदेवस्य धीमतः
कापिलं रूपमास्थाय धारयत्यनिशं धराम्
verses.transliteration:
yasyeyaṁ vasudhā kṛtsnā vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ
kāpilaṁ rūpamāsthāya dhārayatyaniśaṁ dharām

translations.english: This entire Earth belong to the intelligent Vasudeva, she being his consort. And that adorable one is indeed her lord. And assuming the form of Kapila, he unceasingly sustain the Earth. And the sons of king Sagara will be consumed by the fire of his wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिव्याश्चापि निर्भेदो दृष्ट एव सनातनः
सगरस्य च पुत्राणां विनाशोऽदीर्घजीविनाम्
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivyāścāpi nirbhedo dṛṣṭa eva sanātanaḥ
sagarasya ca putrāṇāṁ vināśo'dīrghajīvinām

translations.english: The pre-ordained excavation of the Earth, as well as the testruction of Sagara's sons, had been foreseen by the farsighted.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा त्रयस्त्रिंशदरिंदमः
देवाः परमसंहृष्टाः पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā trayastriṁśadariṁdamaḥ
devāḥ paramasaṁhṛṣṭāḥ punarjagmuryathāgatam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the Grand-sire. those repressors of their foes, the three and thirty* celestials, being exceedingly rejoiced, went back to their respective quarters. *The eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas and two Asvins.

verses.sanskrit:
सगरस्य च पुत्राणां प्रादुरासीन्महात्मनाम्
पृथिव्यां भिद्यमानायां निर्घातसमनिस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
sagarasya ca putrāṇāṁ prādurāsīnmahātmanām
pṛthivyāṁ bhidyamānāyāṁ nirghātasamanisvanaḥ

translations.english: And as the sons of Sagara were riving the Earth, there arose a mighty noise, like to the bursting of thunder.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो भित्त्वा महीं सर्वां कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्
सहिताः सगराः सर्वे पितरं वाक्यमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
tato bhittvā mahīṁ sarvāṁ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
sahitāḥ sagarāḥ sarve pitaraṁ vākyamabruvan

translations.english: Then, having rived the entire Earth and ranged it all around, the sons, of Sagara together (returned to their father) and spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit:
न च पश्यामहेऽश्वं तमश्वहर्तारमेव च
किं करिष्याम भद्रं ते बुद्धिरत्र विचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
na ca paśyāmahe'śvaṁ tamaśvahartārameva ca
kiṁ kariṣyāma bhadraṁ te buddhiratra vicāryatām

translations.english: By us has the Earth been extensively surveyed, and have powerful deities and Dānavas. Rākşasas, Piśācas, Uragas and Pannagas been slain; and yet do we find neither the horse nor the stealer thereof. What are we to do now? Good betide you, do you consider it well.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां राजसत्तमः
समन्युरब्रवीद्वाक्यं सगरो रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā putrāṇāṁ rājasattamaḥ
samanyurabravīdvākyaṁ sagaro raghunandana

translations.english: Hearing those words of his sons, that foremost of kings, getting into a wrath, said, O descendant of Raghu.

verses.sanskrit:
भूयः खनत भद्रं वो निर्भिद्य वसुधातलम्
अश्वहर्तारमासाद्य कृतार्थाश्च निवर्तथ
verses.transliteration:
bhūyaḥ khanata bhadraṁ vo nirbhidya vasudhātalam
aśvahartāramāsādya kṛtārthāśca nivartatha

translations.english: 'Do you yet again, good betide you, delve the earth, and having got at the stealer of the horse, cease.'

verses.sanskrit:
पितुर्वचनमास्थाय सगरस्य महात्मनः
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि रसातलमभिद्रवन्
verses.transliteration:
piturvacanamāsthāya sagarasya mahātmanaḥ
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi rasātalamabhidravan

translations.english: Receiving this mandate of their sire, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara rushed towards the depths of the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
खन्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन्ददृशुः पर्वतोपमम्
दिशागजं विरूपाक्षं धारयन्तं महीतलम्
verses.transliteration:
khanyamāne tatastasmindadṛśuḥ parvatopamam
diśāgajaṁ virūpākṣaṁ dhārayantaṁ mahītalam

translations.english: And as they were engaged in excavating, they beheld the elephant of the quarter resembling a hill, named Virūpākṣa, holding the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
सपर्वतवनां कृत्स्नां पृथिवीं रघुनन्दन
शिरसा धारयामास विरूपाक्षो महागजः
verses.transliteration:
saparvatavanāṁ kṛtsnāṁ pṛthivīṁ raghunandana
śirasā dhārayāmāsa virūpākṣo mahāgajaḥ

translations.english: O son of Raghu, that mighty elephant, Virūpākşa, held on his head the entire earth with its mountains and forests.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा पर्वणि काकुत्स्थ विश्रमार्थं महागजः
खेदाच्चालयते शीर्षं भूमिकम्पस्तधा भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
yadā parvaṇi kākutstha viśramārthaṁ mahāgajaḥ
khedāccālayate śīrṣaṁ bhūmikampastadhā bhavet

translations.english: And, O Kākutstha, when on sacred days the mighty elephant, from fatigue, shake his head, then takes place the earthquake.

verses.sanskrit:
तं ते प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा दिशापालं महागजम्
मानयन्तो हि ते राम जग्मुर्भित्त्वा रसातलम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ te pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā diśāpālaṁ mahāgajam
mānayanto hi te rāma jagmurbhittvā rasātalam

translations.english: Thereupon, O Rāma, going round that mighty elephant, and honouring him duly, they went on piercing the under earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पूर्वां दिशं भित्त्वा दक्षिणां बिभिदुः पुनः
दक्षिणस्यामपि दिशि ददृशुस्ते महागजम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pūrvāṁ diśaṁ bhittvā dakṣiṇāṁ bibhiduḥ punaḥ
dakṣiṇasyāmapi diśi dadṛśuste mahāgajam

translations.english: And having pierced the East, they pierced the South, and in the Southern quarter also they beheld a mighty elephant, the high-souled Mahāpadma, resembling a huge hill, holding the earth on his head. And thereat they marvelled greatly.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा सगरस्य महात्मनः
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि पश्चिमां बिभिदुर्दिशम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā sagarasya mahātmanaḥ
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi paścimāṁ bibhidurdiśam

translations.english: And having gone round him, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara began to penetrate into the Western region.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्चिमायामपि दिशि महान्तमचलोपमम्
दिशागजं सौमनसं ददृशुस्ते महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
paścimāyāmapi diśi mahāntamacalopamam
diśāgajaṁ saumanasaṁ dadṛśuste mahābalāḥ

translations.english: And in the western quarter also those highly powerful ones beheld the elephant of that quarter named Saumanas, resembling a mighty mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
तं ते प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चापि निरामयम्
खनन्तः समुपक्रान्ता दिशं सोमवतीं तदा
verses.transliteration:
taṁ te pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā cāpi nirāmayam
khanantaḥ samupakrāntā diśaṁ somavatīṁ tadā

translations.english: And having gone round him and asked him as to his welfare, they delving on, arrived at the Northern region.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरस्यां रघुश्रेष्ठ ददृशुर्हिमपाण्डुरम्
भद्रं भद्रेण वपुषा धारयन्तं महीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration:
uttarasyāṁ raghuśreṣṭha dadṛśurhimapāṇḍuram
bhadraṁ bhadreṇa vapuṣā dhārayantaṁ mahīmimām

translations.english: And on the North like wise, O foremost of the Raghus, they beheld Bhadra, white as snow, holding this earth on his goodly person.

verses.sanskrit:
समालभ्य ततः सर्वे कृत्वा चैनं प्रदक्षिणम्
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि बिभिदुर्वसुधातलम्
verses.transliteration:
samālabhya tataḥ sarve kṛtvā cainaṁ pradakṣiṇam
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi bibhidurvasudhātalam

translations.english: Having felt as well as gone round him, those sixty thousand sons of Sagara went on penetrating the depths of the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रागुत्तरां गत्वा सागराः प्रथितां दिशम्
रोषादभ्यखनन्सर्वे पृथिवीं सगरात्मजाः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prāguttarāṁ gatvā sāgarāḥ prathitāṁ diśam
roṣādabhyakhanansarve pṛthivīṁ sagarātmajāḥ

translations.english: Then repairing to the famous North eastern region, Sagara's sons becoming enraged, began to dig the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ददृशुः कपिलं तत्र वासुदेवं सनातनम्
हयं च तस्य देवस्य चरन्तमविदूरतः
verses.transliteration:
dadṛśuḥ kapilaṁ tatra vāsudevaṁ sanātanam
hayaṁ ca tasya devasya carantamavidūrataḥ

translations.english: And there those high-souled, exceedingly powerful and vehement ones beheld the eternal Vasudeva in the guise of Kapila.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तं यज्ञहनं ज्ञात्वा क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणाः
अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धास्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
te taṁ yajñahanaṁ jñātvā krodhaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ
abhyadhāvanta saṁkruddhāstiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābruvan

translations.english: And knowing him to be the destroyer of the sacrifice, they bearing spades, and ploughs, and innumerable trees and crags, with eyes reddened with ire, furiously rushed against him, exclaiming, 'Stay! Stay! And you it is that hast stolen our sacrificial horse.' O you of wicked understanding, know that you have fallen into the hands of the sons of Sagara.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं तेषां कपिलो रघुनन्दन
रोषेण महताविष्टो हुंकारमकरोत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tadvacanaṁ teṣāṁ kapilo raghunandana
roṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo huṁkāramakarottadā

translations.english: Hearing this speech of theirs, Kapila, O descendant of Raghu, overwhelmed with rage uttered a tremendous roar.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तेनाप्रमेयेन कपिलेन महात्मना
भस्मराशीकृताः सर्वे काकुत्स्थ सगरात्मजाः
verses.transliteration:
tatastenāprameyena kapilena mahātmanā
bhasmarāśīkṛtāḥ sarve kākutstha sagarātmajāḥ

translations.english: And then, O Kākutstha, the sons of Sagara were reduced to ashes by the high-souled and incomparable Kapila.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रांश्चिरगताञ्ज्ञात्वा सगरो रघुनन्दन
नप्तारमब्रवीद्राजा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration:
putrāṁściragatāñjñātvā sagaro raghunandana
naptāramabravīdrājā dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā

translations.english: Being the delay on the part of his sons, King Sagara, O son of Raghu, addressed his grandson, flaming in his native energy, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च पूर्वैस्तुल्योऽसि तेजसा
पितॄणां गतिमन्विच्छ येन चाश्वोऽपहारितः
verses.transliteration:
śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca pūrvaistulyo'si tejasā
pitṝṇāṁ gatimanviccha yena cāśvo'pahāritaḥ

translations.english: You are heroic and accomplished and like to your uncles. Do you enquire into the circumstances that have befallen your uncles, as also about the way by which the horse has escaped.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तर्भौमानि सत्त्वानि वीर्यवन्ति महान्ति च
तेषां त्वं प्रतिघातार्थं सासिं गृह्णीष्व कार्मुकम्
verses.transliteration:
antarbhaumāni sattvāni vīryavanti mahānti ca
teṣāṁ tvaṁ pratighātārthaṁ sāsiṁ gṛhṇīṣva kārmukam

translations.english: And as there are strong and mighty creatures inhabiting the Earth's interior, with the view of resisting them, do you take your how along with your scimitar.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्याभिवाद्यांस्त्वं हत्वा विघ्नकरानपि
सिद्धार्थः संनिवर्तस्व मम यज्ञस्य पारगः
verses.transliteration:
abhivādyābhivādyāṁstvaṁ hatvā vighnakarānapi
siddhārthaḥ saṁnivartasva mama yajñasya pāragaḥ

translations.english: And honouring those that deserve to be honoured and slaying such as disturb you, do you, having attained your end, come back, becoming the instrument for the completion of my sacrifice.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तोंऽशुमान्सम्यक्सगरेण महात्मना
धनुरादाय खड्गं च जगाम लघुविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktoṁ'śumānsamyaksagareṇa mahātmanā
dhanurādāya khaḍgaṁ ca jagāma laghuvikramaḥ

translations.english: Thus duly enjoined by the high-souled Sagara, Anśumān endowed with fleet vigour, taking his bow as well as his scimitar, set out.

verses.sanskrit:
स खातं पितृभिर्मार्गमन्तर्भौमं महात्मभिः
प्रापद्यत नरश्रेष्ठ तेन राज्ञाभिचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
sa khātaṁ pitṛbhirmārgamantarbhaumaṁ mahātmabhiḥ
prāpadyata naraśreṣṭha tena rājñābhicoditaḥ

translations.english: An commanded by the monarch, he found the underground way that had been carved out by those high-souled ones.

verses.sanskrit:
दैत्यदानवरक्षोभिः पिशाचपतगोरगैः
पूज्यमानं महातेजा दिशागजमपश्यत
verses.transliteration:
daityadānavarakṣobhiḥ piśācapatagoragaiḥ
pūjyamānaṁ mahātejā diśāgajamapaśyata

translations.english: He found an exceedingly powerful elephant belonging to the cardinal point, worshipped by deities, and Dānavas, and Rākşasas, and goblins, and birds, and Uragas.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चैव निरामयम्
पितॄन्स परिपप्रच्छ वाजिहर्तारमेव च
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā caiva nirāmayam
pitṝnsa paripapraccha vājihartārameva ca

translations.english: Having gone round him, and asked him as to his welfare, he enquired after his uncles and the stealer of the horse.

verses.sanskrit:
दिशागजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रीत्याहांशुमतो वचः
आसमञ्जकृतार्थस्त्वं सहाश्वः शीघ्रमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
diśāgajastu tacchrutvā prītyāhāṁśumato vacaḥ
āsamañjakṛtārthastvaṁ sahāśvaḥ śīghrameṣyasi

translations.english: Hearing this, the mighty-minded elephant of that quarter answered, 'O son of Asamañja, having attained your object, you will speedily return with the horse.'

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वानेव दिशागजान्
यथाक्रमं यथान्यायं प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sarvāneva diśāgajān
yathākramaṁ yathānyāyaṁ praṣṭuṁ samupacakrame

translations.english: And hearing those words of his, Ansumat by turns duly asked the same question of all the elephants belonging to the cardinal points.

verses.sanskrit:
तैश्च सर्वैर्दिशापालैर्वाक्यज्ञैर्वाक्यकोविदैः
पूजितः सहयश्चैव गन्तासीत्यभिचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
taiśca sarvairdiśāpālairvākyajñairvākyakovidaiḥ
pūjitaḥ sahayaścaiva gantāsītyabhicoditaḥ

translations.english: And being honoured by those guardians of the cardinal points, knowing words as well as their application in regard to time, place, and person, he was asked by them saying, 'Did you come with the horse?'

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जगाम लघुविक्रमः
भस्मराशीकृता यत्र पितरस्तस्य सागराः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā jagāma laghuvikramaḥ
bhasmarāśīkṛtā yatra pitarastasya sāgarāḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words of theirs, that one of fleet vigour repaired to the spot where the sons of Sagara, his uncles, had been reduced to a heap of ashes.

verses.sanskrit:
स दुःखवशमापन्नस्त्वसमञ्जसुतस्तदा
चुक्रोश परमार्तस्तु वधात्तेषां सुदुःखितः
verses.transliteration:
sa duḥkhavaśamāpannastvasamañjasutastadā
cukrośa paramārtastu vadhātteṣāṁ suduḥkhitaḥ

translations.english: And (arriving there), Asamañja's son, smitten with grief, and being exceedingly afflicted at their destruction, bewailed in heaviness of heart.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञियं च हयं तत्र चरन्तमविदूरतः
ददर्श पुरुषव्याघ्रो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration:
yajñiyaṁ ca hayaṁ tatra carantamavidūrataḥ
dadarśa puruṣavyāghro duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ

translations.english: And exercised by grief and sorrow, at foremost of men espied there the sacrificial horse straying near.

verses.sanskrit:
ददर्श पुरुषव्याघ्रो कर्तुकामो जलक्रियाम्
सलिलार्थी महातेजा न चापश्यज्जलाशयम्
verses.transliteration:
dadarśa puruṣavyāghro kartukāmo jalakriyām
salilārthī mahātejā na cāpaśyajjalāśayam

translations.english: And desirous of offering oblations of water to those princes, that highly powerful one, in need of water, did not find any watery expanse in the neighbourhood.

verses.sanskrit:
विसार्य निपुणां दृष्टिं ततोऽपश्यत्खगाधिपम्
पितॄणां मातुलं राम सुपर्णमनिलोपमम्
verses.transliteration:
visārya nipuṇāṁ dṛṣṭiṁ tato'paśyatkhagādhipam
pitṝṇāṁ mātulaṁ rāma suparṇamanilopamam

translations.english: And it came to pass, O Rāma, that surveying wide, he descried the maternal uncle to the princes, Suparna, resembling the Wind.

verses.sanskrit:
स चैनमब्रवीद्वाक्यं वैनतेयो महाबलः
मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र वधोऽयं लोकसंमतः
verses.transliteration:
sa cainamabravīdvākyaṁ vainateyo mahābalaḥ
mā śucaḥ puruṣavyāghra vadho'yaṁ lokasaṁmataḥ

translations.english: And thereupon Vinata's son possessed of mighty strength spoke to him, saying, 'Do not lament, O foremost of men. The destruction of these was for the welfare of all.'

verses.sanskrit:
कपिलेनाप्रमेयेन दग्धा हीमे महाबलाः
सलिलं नार्हसि प्राज्ञ दातुमेषां हि लौकिकम्
verses.transliteration:
kapilenāprameyena dagdhā hīme mahābalāḥ
salilaṁ nārhasi prājña dātumeṣāṁ hi laukikam

translations.english: These highly powerful ones had been consumed by the peerless Kapila, therefore, you ought not to offer water to them in consonance with social usage.

verses.sanskrit:
गङ्गा हिमवतो ज्येष्ठा दुहिता पुरुषर्षभ
भस्मराशीकृतानेतान्पावयेल्लोकपावनी
verses.transliteration:
gaṅgā himavato jyeṣṭhā duhitā puruṣarṣabha
bhasmarāśīkṛtānetānpāvayellokapāvanī

translations.english: Gangā, O foremost of men, is the elder daughter of Himavat. In her (streams) do you perform the watery rites of your uncles,

verses.sanskrit:
तया क्लिन्नमिदं भस्म गङ्गया लोककान्तया
षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोकं नयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tayā klinnamidaṁ bhasma gaṅgayā lokakāntayā
ṣaṣṭiṁ putrasahasrāṇi svargalokaṁ nayiṣyati

translations.english: O mighty-armed one: let that purifier of the worlds lave these reduced to a heap of ashes. And on these ashes being watered by Gangā, dear to all, the sixty thousand sons of Sagara will repair to the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
गच्छ चाश्वं महाभाग संगृह्य पुरुषर्षभ
यज्ञं पैतामहं वीर निर्वर्तयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
gaccha cāśvaṁ mahābhāga saṁgṛhya puruṣarṣabha
yajñaṁ paitāmahaṁ vīra nirvartayitumarhasi

translations.english: Do you, O highly pious one, go back, taking this horse, O foremost of men; and do you complete the sacrifice of your grand-father,

verses.sanskrit:
सुपर्णवचनं श्रुत्वा सोंऽशुमानतिवीर्यवान्
त्वरितं हयमादाय पुनरायान्महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
suparṇavacanaṁ śrutvā soṁ'śumānativīryavān
tvaritaṁ hayamādāya punarāyānmahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: O hero, Hearing Suparna's speech, the exceedingly powerful Ansumat of mighty asceticism speedily taking the horse, retraced his steps.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो राजानमासाद्य दीक्षितं रघुनन्दन
न्यवेदयद्यथावृत्तं सुपर्णवचनं तथा
verses.transliteration:
tato rājānamāsādya dīkṣitaṁ raghunandana
nyavedayadyathāvṛttaṁ suparṇavacanaṁ tathā

translations.english: Then coming to the king who had been initiated into the ceremony, he, O descendant of Raghu, faithfully communicated to him the words of Suparna.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसंकाशं वाक्यमंशुमतो नृपः
यज्ञं निर्वर्तयामास यथाकल्पं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā ghorasaṁkāśaṁ vākyamaṁśumato nṛpaḥ
yajñaṁ nirvartayāmāsa yathākalpaṁ yathāvidhi

translations.english: Hearing this sorrowful intelligence, the king duly finished the sacrifice agreeably to the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वपुरं चागमच्छ्रीमानिष्टयज्ञो महीपतिः
गङ्गायाश्चागमे राजा निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत
verses.transliteration:
svapuraṁ cāgamacchrīmāniṣṭayajño mahīpatiḥ
gaṅgāyāścāgame rājā niścayaṁ nādhyagacchata

translations.english: And having seen the completion of the sacrifice, that lord of earth entered his capital; but the king could not see how to bring Gangā on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा कालेन महता महान्
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः
verses.transliteration:
agatvā niścayaṁ rājā kālena mahatā mahān
triṁśadvarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṁ kṛtvā divaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: And without being able to ascertain it, the mighty monarch after a long course of time, and having reigned for thirty thousand years, ascended heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
कालधर्मं गते राम सगरे प्रकृतीजनाः
राजानं रोचयामासुरंशुमन्तं सुधार्मिकम्
verses.transliteration:
kāladharmaṁ gate rāma sagare prakṛtījanāḥ
rājānaṁ rocayāmāsuraṁśumantaṁ sudhārmikam

translations.english: When Sagara had bowed to the influence of Time, the subjects selected the righteous Ansumat for their king.

verses.sanskrit:
स राजा सुमहानासीदंशुमान्रघुनन्दन
तस्य पुत्रो महानासीद्दिलीप इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
sa rājā sumahānāsīdaṁśumānraghunandana
tasya putro mahānāsīddilīpa iti viśrutaḥ

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, Ansumat proved a great ruler. And his son, the celebrated Dilīpa, was also a great king.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्राज्यं समावेश्य दिलीपे रघुनन्दन
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
tasminrājyaṁ samāveśya dilīpe raghunandana
himavacchikhare ramye tapastepe sudāruṇam

translations.english: O Raghu's son, consigning to Dilipa his kingdom, Ansumat entered upon rigid austerities on the romantic summit of the Himavat.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वात्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि वर्षाणि सुमहायशाः
तपोवनगतो राजा स्वर्गं लेभे तपोधनः
verses.transliteration:
dvātriṁśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi sumahāyaśāḥ
tapovanagato rājā svargaṁ lebhe tapodhanaḥ

translations.english: Having for the space of thirty-two you sand years carried on austerities in the woods, that highly famous one, crowned with the wealth of asceticism, attained the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
दिलीपस्तु महातेजाः श्रुत्वा पैतामहं वधम्
दुःखोपहतया बुद्ध्या निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत
verses.transliteration:
dilīpastu mahātejāḥ śrutvā paitāmahaṁ vadham
duḥkhopahatayā buddhyā niścayaṁ nādhyagacchata

translations.english: The exceedingly powerful Dilīpa, hearing of the destruction of his grand-fathers, was stricken with grief; yet he could not ascertain his grandfathers, was stricken with grief; yet he could not ascertain his course about it.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं गङ्गावतरणं कथं तेषां जलक्रिया
तारयेयं कथं चैतानिति चिन्ता परोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ gaṅgāvataraṇaṁ kathaṁ teṣāṁ jalakriyā
tārayeyaṁ kathaṁ caitāniti cintā paro'bhavat

translations.english: He constantly thought as to how Gangă could be brought down, how to perform their watery rites, and how to deliver them.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य चिन्तयतो नित्यं धर्मेण विदितात्मनः
पुत्रो भगीरथो नाम जज्ञे परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
tasya cintayato nityaṁ dharmeṇa viditātmanaḥ
putro bhagīratho nāma jajñe paramadhārmikaḥ

translations.english: As that pious one furnished with selfknowledge was always meditating upon this, an eminently virtuous son was born to him named Bhagiratha.

verses.sanskrit:
दिलीपस्तु महातेजा यज्ञैर्बहुभिरिष्टवान्
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि राजा राज्यमकारयत्
verses.transliteration:
dilīpastu mahātejā yajñairbahubhiriṣṭavān
triṁśadvarṣasahasrāṇi rājā rājyamakārayat

translations.english: Performing numerous sacrifices, the mighty king Dilīpa reigned for thirty thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा तेषामुद्धरणं प्रति
व्याधिना नरशार्दूल कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration:
agatvā niścayaṁ rājā teṣāmuddharaṇaṁ prati
vyādhinā naraśārdūla kāladharmamupeyivān

translations.english: And without having arrived at any definite decision in regard to their deliverance, the king, O puissant one, being attacked with an ailment, breathed his last.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रलोकं गतो राजा स्वार्जितेनैव कर्मणा
राज्ये भगीरथं पुत्रमभिषिच्य नरर्षभः
verses.transliteration:
indralokaṁ gato rājā svārjitenaiva karmaṇā
rājye bhagīrathaṁ putramabhiṣicya nararṣabhaḥ

translations.english: Having sprinkled his son Bhagiratha in the way of installing him in the kingdom, that prime of men, the king, by virtue of his own acts, repaired to the region of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
भगीरथस्तु राजर्षिर्धार्मिको रघुनन्दन
अनपत्यो महातेजाः प्रजाकामः स चाप्रजः
verses.transliteration:
bhagīrathastu rājarṣirdhārmiko raghunandana
anapatyo mahātejāḥ prajākāmaḥ sa cāprajaḥ

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, that royal saint Bhagiratha was possessed of righteousness. And being without issue, and desiring to obtain it, the mighty monarch consigned his kingdom and his subjects to the care of his counsellors, and engaged in bringing down Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सुरगणैः सार्धमुपागम्य पितामहः
भगीरथं महात्मानं तप्यमानमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhamupāgamya pitāmahaḥ
bhagīrathaṁ mahātmānaṁ tapyamānamathābravīt

translations.english: And thereat that possessor of the six attributes and lord of all creatures, Brahmā, was well pleased with that high-souled monarch. And presenting himself together with the celestials, the Grand-sire thus spoke to the high-souled Bhagiratha engaged in austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
भगीरथ महाभाग प्रीतस्तेऽहं जनेश्वर
तपसा च सुतप्तेन वरं वरय सुव्रत
verses.transliteration:
bhagīratha mahābhāga prītaste'haṁ janeśvara
tapasā ca sutaptena varaṁ varaya suvrata

translations.english: O Bhagiratha, O mighty monarch, pleased am I with you. O lord' of men, on account of your ardent austerities: do you, O you of excellent vows, ask for the boon you would have.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच महातेजाः सर्वलोकपितामहम्
भगीरथो महाभागः कृताञ्जलिरवस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca mahātejāḥ sarvalokapitāmaham
bhagīratho mahābhāgaḥ kṛtāñjaliravasthitaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon that great car-warrior, the highly powerful and mighty-armed Bhagiratha, with clasped hands, said to the grand sire of all creatures,

verses.sanskrit:
गङ्गायाः सलिलक्लिन्ने भस्मन्येषां महात्मनाम्
स्वर्गं गच्छेयुरत्यन्तं सर्वे मे प्रपितामहाः
verses.transliteration:
gaṅgāyāḥ salilaklinne bhasmanyeṣāṁ mahātmanām
svargaṁ gaccheyuratyantaṁ sarve me prapitāmahāḥ

translations.english: If, adorable one, you are pleased with me, if you would grant me the fruit of my asceticism, may Sagara's sons receive water at my hands; and on the ashes of those high-souled ones being laved by the waters of Gangā, may my greatgrand-father without fail repair to heaven!

verses.sanskrit:
देया च संततिर्देव नावसीदेत्कुलं च नः
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले देव एष मेऽस्तु वरः परः
verses.transliteration:
deyā ca saṁtatirdeva nāvasīdetkulaṁ ca naḥ
ikṣvākūṇāṁ kule deva eṣa me'stu varaḥ paraḥ

translations.english: And, O divine one, I beseech you, may our line never languish for want of offspring. May, O God, this prime boon light upon Iksvāku's race!

verses.sanskrit:
उक्तवाक्यं तु राजानं सर्वलोकपितामहः
प्रत्युवाच शुभां वाणीं मधुरां मधुराक्षराम्
verses.transliteration:
uktavākyaṁ tu rājānaṁ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
pratyuvāca śubhāṁ vāṇīṁ madhurāṁ madhurākṣarām

translations.english: When the king had said this, the Grand-sire addressed him these sweet and auspicious words composed of melting letters.

verses.sanskrit:
मनोरथो महानेष भगीरथ महारथ
एवं भवतु भद्रं ते इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धन
verses.transliteration:
manoratho mahāneṣa bhagīratha mahāratha
evaṁ bhavatu bhadraṁ te ikṣvākukulavardhana

translations.english: O mighty car-warrior Bhagiratha, high is this your aim. Be it so, good betide you, you enhancer of the Ikşvāku line.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं हैमवती गङ्गा ज्येष्ठा हिमवतः सुता
तां वै धारयितुं राजन्हरस्तत्र नियुज्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ haimavatī gaṅgā jyeṣṭhā himavataḥ sutā
tāṁ vai dhārayituṁ rājanharastatra niyujyatām

translations.english: This Haimavati Ganga, Himavat's elder daughter, even her to hold, Oking do you employ Hara.

verses.sanskrit:
गङ्गायाः पतनं राजन्पृथिवी न सहिष्यते
तां वै धारयितुं वीर नान्यं पश्यामि शूलिनः
verses.transliteration:
gaṅgāyāḥ patanaṁ rājanpṛthivī na sahiṣyate
tāṁ vai dhārayituṁ vīra nānyaṁ paśyāmi śūlinaḥ

translations.english: For Gangā's fall, O king, Earth will not be able to sustain. And to hold her, O king find I none save the wielder of the Trident.'

verses.sanskrit:
तमेवमुक्त्वा राजानं गङ्गां चाभाष्य लोककृत्
जगाम त्रिदिवं देवः सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration:
tamevamuktvā rājānaṁ gaṅgāṁ cābhāṣya lokakṛt
jagāma tridivaṁ devaḥ saha sarvairmarudgaṇaiḥ

translations.english: Having thus addressed the monarch, and greeted Gangā, the creator of the worlds repaired to heaven with the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदेवे गते तस्मिन्सोऽङ्गुष्ठाग्रनिपीडिताम्
कृत्वा वसुमतीं राम संवत्सरमुपासत
verses.transliteration:
devadeve gate tasminso'ṅguṣṭhāgranipīḍitām
kṛtvā vasumatīṁ rāma saṁvatsaramupāsata

translations.english: When that god of gods had gone away, Bhagiratha, O Rāma, pressing the earth with his thumb, spent a year in adoring Siva.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः
उमापतिः पशुपती राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha saṁvatsare pūrṇe sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
umāpatiḥ paśupatī rājānamidamabravīt

translations.english: And when the yea was complete, Uma's lord, Pasupati, worshipped of all the worlds, spoke to the king, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतस्तेऽहं नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम्
शिरसा धारयिष्यामि शैलराजसुतामहम्
verses.transliteration:
prītaste'haṁ naraśreṣṭha kariṣyāmi tava priyam
śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi śailarājasutāmaham

translations.english: O foremost of men, I am well pleased with you: I will do what will before your welfare. I will hold the Mountain's daughter on my head.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हैमवती ज्येष्ठा सर्वलोकनमस्कृता
तदा सातिमहद्रूपं कृत्वा वेगं च दुःसहम्
आकाशादपतद्राम शिवे शिवशिरस्युत
verses.transliteration:
tato haimavatī jyeṣṭhā sarvalokanamaskṛtā
tadā sātimahadrūpaṁ kṛtvā vegaṁ ca duḥsaham
ākāśādapatadrāma śive śivaśirasyuta

translations.english: Then, O Rāma. that one bowed to by all creatures, the elder daughter of Himavat, assuming an exceedingly mighty shape, with irresistible impetus precipitated herself from the welkin upon Siva's gracious head.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव सा निर्गमं लेभे जटामण्डलमोहिता
तत्रैवाबभ्रमद्देवी संवत्सरगणान्बहून्
verses.transliteration:
naiva sā nirgamaṁ lebhe jaṭāmaṇḍalamohitā
tatraivābabhramaddevī saṁvatsaragaṇānbahūn

translations.english: O Rāma, as that sacred one plunged upon Rudra's holy head of tangled locks, resembling Himavat she could by no means reach the earth, despite all her endeavours; nor did she obtain egress from under the matted locks. And she wandered there for many a year.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेन तोषितश्चासीदत्यर्थं रघुनन्दन
विससर्ज ततो गङ्गां हरो बिन्दुसरः प्रति
verses.transliteration:
anena toṣitaścāsīdatyarthaṁ raghunandana
visasarja tato gaṅgāṁ haro bindusaraḥ prati

translations.english: And finding Gangā in this plight, Bhagīratha became again engaged in high austerities. And thereupon Siva, O descendant of Raghu, was exceedingly gratified; and cast Gangā off in the direction of the Bindu lake. And as she was let off, seven streams branched out from her.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवर्षिगन्धर्वा यक्षाः सिद्धगणास्तथा
व्यलोकयन्त ते तत्र गगनाद्गां गतां तदा
verses.transliteration:
tato devarṣigandharvā yakṣāḥ siddhagaṇāstathā
vyalokayanta te tatra gaganādgāṁ gatāṁ tadā

translations.english: Then celestials and saints and Gandharvas and Yakşas and Siddhas mounted on excellent elephants and horses and cars resembling cities, looked on Gangă descending upon earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तदद्भुततमं लोके गङ्गापतनमुत्तमम्
दिदृक्षवो देवगणाः समेयुरमितौजसः
verses.transliteration:
tadadbhutatamaṁ loke gaṅgāpatanamuttamam
didṛkṣavo devagaṇāḥ sameyuramitaujasaḥ

translations.english: And the celestials stationed on cars were struck with surprise; and all creatures marvelled at the excellent descent of Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
संपतद्भिः सुरगणैस्तेषां चाभरणौजसा
शतादित्यमिवाभाति गगनं गततोयदम्
verses.transliteration:
saṁpatadbhiḥ suragaṇaisteṣāṁ cābharaṇaujasā
śatādityamivābhāti gaganaṁ gatatoyadam

translations.english: And eager to witness the spectacle, celestial hosts of immeasurable energy thither and the effulgence of their ornaments, the firmament free from clouds, shone as if with an hundred suns.

verses.sanskrit:
पाण्डुरैः सलिलोत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा
शारदाभ्रैरिवाकीर्णं गगनं हंससंप्लवैः
verses.transliteration:
pāṇḍuraiḥ salilotpīḍaiḥ kīryamāṇaiḥ sahasradhā
śāradābhrairivākīrṇaṁ gaganaṁ haṁsasaṁplavaiḥ

translations.english: And the sky was graced with fast-fleeting porpoises and serpents and fishes resembling playing lightning; and the welkin scattered with pale foam-flakes by thousands, appeared as if it was scattered with autumnal clouds swarming with cranes.

verses.sanskrit:
क्वचिद्द्रुततरं याति कुटिलं क्वचिदायतम्
विनतं क्वचिदुद्धूतं क्वचिद्याति शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration:
kvaciddrutataraṁ yāti kuṭilaṁ kvacidāyatam
vinataṁ kvaciduddhūtaṁ kvacidyāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

translations.english: And the river proceeded sometimes rapidly, and sometimes awry, and sometimes in volumes and sometimes sloping, and sometimes ascending and sometimes languidly; and sometimes water clashed with water.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छंकरशिरोभ्रष्टं भ्रष्टं भूमितले पुनः
व्यरोचत तदा तोयं निर्मलं गतकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchaṁkaraśirobhraṣṭaṁ bhraṣṭaṁ bhūmitale punaḥ
vyarocata tadā toyaṁ nirmalaṁ gatakalmaṣam

translations.english: Sometimes ascending an upland, it descended it no a dell. And the pellucid and pure water first descending upon Śankara's head, and thence on to the earth, appeared exceedingly beautiful.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रर्षिगणगन्धर्वा वसुधातलवासिनः
भवाङ्गपतितं तोयं पवित्रमिति पस्पृशुः
verses.transliteration:
tatrarṣigaṇagandharvā vasudhātalavāsinaḥ
bhavāṅgapatitaṁ toyaṁ pavitramiti paspṛśuḥ

translations.english: And there the saints and the Gandharvas, as well as the inhabitants of the earth, touched the sacred water flowing from Bhava's body.

verses.sanskrit:
शापात्प्रपतिता ये च गगनाद्वसुधातलम्
कृत्वा तत्राभिषेकं ते बभूवुर्गतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration:
śāpātprapatitā ye ca gaganādvasudhātalam
kṛtvā tatrābhiṣekaṁ te babhūvurgatakalmaṣāḥ

translations.english: And those that had fallen from the sky to the earth in consequence of some curse of other, having bathed there, and thereby having their sins washed an removed by that sanctifying water, again ascended the sky and entered the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
मुमुदे मुदितो लोकस्तेन तोयेन भास्वता
कृताभिषेको गङ्गायां बभूव विगतक्लमः
verses.transliteration:
mumude mudito lokastena toyena bhāsvatā
kṛtābhiṣeko gaṅgāyāṁ babhūva vigataklamaḥ

translations.english: And through the agency of that shining water, all beings, feeling delight, rejoiced, and having bathed in Gangā, became cleansed from sin.

verses.sanskrit:
भगीरथोऽपि राजर्षिर्दिव्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः
प्रायादग्रे महातेजास्तं गङ्गा पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्
verses.transliteration:
bhagīratho'pi rājarṣirdivyaṁ syandanamāsthitaḥ
prāyādagre mahātejāstaṁ gaṅgā pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt

translations.english: And stationed on an excellent car that mighty king, the royal saint Bhagiratha, went first, and Gangā went at his back.

verses.sanskrit:
देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः
गन्धर्वयक्षप्रवराः सकिंनरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration:
devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ
gandharvayakṣapravarāḥ sakiṁnaramahoragāḥ

translations.english: The gods, and the saints, and the Daityas, and the Dānavas, and the Rākşasas, and the foremost of Gandharvas and Yaksas, and the Kinnaras, and the mighty Uragas, and the Serpents, and the Apsaras, O Rāma, and the acquatic animals in a body following Bhagirahta's car, with glad hearts went in the wake of Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
यतो भगीरथो राजा ततो गङ्गा यशस्विनी
जगाम सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपापविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration:
yato bhagīratho rājā tato gaṅgā yaśasvinī
jagāma saritāṁ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpavināśinī

translations.english: Whither soever king Bhagiratha went, the famous Gangā, foremost of streams, capable of destroying all sins, went.

verses.sanskrit:
भस्मन्यथाप्लुते राम गङ्गायाः सलिलेन वै
सर्व लोकप्रभुर्ब्रह्मा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
bhasmanyathāplute rāma gaṅgāyāḥ salilena vai
sarva lokaprabhurbrahmā rājānamidamabravīt

translations.english: Then having arrived at the Ocean, the king wending in Ganga's wake, entered underneath the Earth, at that spot where those (sons of Sagara) had been reduced to ashes. And, O Rāma, on the ashes being washed by the waters of Gangā, Brahmā, the lord of all creatures thus spoke to the monarch.

verses.sanskrit:
तारिता नरशार्दूल दिवं याताश्च देववत्
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि सगरस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
tāritā naraśārdūla divaṁ yātāśca devavat
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi sagarasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: O most puissant of men, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara have been delivered and they have ascended heaven like to celestials themselves.

verses.sanskrit:
सागरस्य जलं लोके यावत्स्थास्यति पार्थिव
सगरस्यात्मजास्तावत्स्वर्गे स्थास्यन्ति देववत्
verses.transliteration:
sāgarasya jalaṁ loke yāvatsthāsyati pārthiva
sagarasyātmajāstāvatsvarge sthāsyanti devavat

translations.english: O lord of earth, as long as the waters of the ocean shall endure in the world. Sagara's sons shall reside in heaven like to celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं च दुहिता ज्येष्ठा तव गङ्गा भविष्यति
त्वत्कृतेन च नाम्ना वै लोके स्थास्यति विश्रुता
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ ca duhitā jyeṣṭhā tava gaṅgā bhaviṣyati
tvatkṛtena ca nāmnā vai loke sthāsyati viśrutā

translations.english: This Gangā shall become your eldest daughter; and she shall attain celebrity among all, being called after your name.

verses.sanskrit:
गङ्गा त्रिपथगा नाम दिव्या भागीरथीति च
त्रिपथो भावयन्तीति ततस्त्रिपथगा स्मृता
verses.transliteration:
gaṅgā tripathagā nāma divyā bhāgīrathīti ca
tripatho bhāvayantīti tatastripathagā smṛtā

translations.english: And Gangā is called both Tripathagã and Bhăgirathi. And she is know as Tripathagā, is consequence of her proceeding in three directions.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहानां सर्वेषां त्वमत्र मनुजाधिप
कुरुष्व सलिलं राजन्प्रतिज्ञामपवर्जय
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahānāṁ sarveṣāṁ tvamatra manujādhipa
kuruṣva salilaṁ rājanpratijñāmapavarjaya

translations.english: Do you now, O lord of men, her offer oblations of water to your grand-sires, and thereby, O king, make good your promise.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वकेण हि ते राजंस्तेनातियशसा तदा
धर्मिणां प्रवरेणाथ नैष प्राप्तो मनोरथः
verses.transliteration:
pūrvakeṇa hi te rājaṁstenātiyaśasā tadā
dharmiṇāṁ pravareṇātha naiṣa prāpto manorathaḥ

translations.english: O king, that foremost of righteous ones, your ancestor of exceeding renown, had failed to attain his desire.

verses.sanskrit:
तथैवांशुमता तात लोकेऽप्रतिमतेजसा
गङ्गां प्रार्थयता नेतुं प्रतिज्ञा नापवर्जिता
verses.transliteration:
tathaivāṁśumatā tāta loke'pratimatejasā
gaṅgāṁ prārthayatā netuṁ pratijñā nāpavarjitā

translations.english: O child Ansumat likewise unparalleled in the worlds in energy, had failed in realising his cherished promise of bringing down Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
दिलीपेन महाभाग तव पित्रातितेजसा
पुनर्न शङ्किता नेतुं गङ्गां प्रार्थयतानघ
verses.transliteration:
dilīpena mahābhāga tava pitrātitejasā
punarna śaṅkitā netuṁ gaṅgāṁ prārthayatānagha

translations.english: Then again that royal saint, crowned with qualities; of austerities like to mine, ever abiding by his Ksatriya duties, even Dilipa's self, your exceedingly puissant sire.

verses.sanskrit:
सा त्वया समतिक्रान्ता प्रतिज्ञा पुरुषर्षभ
प्राप्तोऽसि परमं लोके यशः परमसंमतम्
verses.transliteration:
sā tvayā samatikrāntā pratijñā puruṣarṣabha
prāpto'si paramaṁ loke yaśaḥ paramasaṁmatam

translations.english: O eminently righteous one, had failed in bringing down Gangā according to his cherished resolve, O sinless one. And now, O foremost of men, that promise having been fulfilled by you, you shall attain signal glory in the world by the common consent of all.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्च गङ्गावतरणं त्वया कृतमरिंदम
अनेन च भवान्प्राप्तो धर्मस्यायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration:
yacca gaṅgāvataraṇaṁ tvayā kṛtamariṁdama
anena ca bhavānprāpto dharmasyāyatanaṁ mahat

translations.english: And, O vanquisher of your foes, having brought about Ganga's dissension, you shall from this act of your also attain the regions of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit:
प्लावयस्व त्वमात्मानं नरोत्तम सदोचिते
सलिले पुरुषव्याघ्र शुचिः पुण्यफलो भव
verses.transliteration:
plāvayasva tvamātmānaṁ narottama sadocite
salile puruṣavyāghra śuciḥ puṇyaphalo bhava

translations.english: Do you, O best of me, lave thyself in these waters worthy of the pious, O prime of men, and thereby become purified, and attain sanctity.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहानां सर्वेषां कुरुष्व सलिलक्रियाम्
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि स्वं लोकं गम्यतां नृप
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahānāṁ sarveṣāṁ kuruṣva salilakriyām
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi svaṁ lokaṁ gamyatāṁ nṛpa

translations.english: Do you perform the watery rites of your grand-sires. May luck be your, I shall now repair to my own regions: do you depart, O king.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवेशः सर्वलोकपितामहः
यथागतं तथागच्छद्देवलोकं महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
ityevamuktvā deveśaḥ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
yathāgataṁ tathāgacchaddevalokaṁ mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Having said this, the illustrious lord of the celestials the Grand-sire of all creatures, went to the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
भगीरथोऽपि राजर्षिः कृत्वा सलिलमुत्तमम्
यथाक्रमं यथान्यायं सागराणां महायशाः
कृतोदकः शुची राजा स्वपुरं प्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
bhagīratho'pi rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā salilamuttamam
yathākramaṁ yathānyāyaṁ sāgarāṇāṁ mahāyaśāḥ
kṛtodakaḥ śucī rājā svapuraṁ praviveśa ha

translations.english: The royal saint king Bhagiratha also of high fame having performed his ablutions and purified himself, and duly and in proper order offered oblations of water to the sons of Sagara, entered his capital. And attaining exceeding prosperity, that foremost of men ruled his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
समृद्धार्थो नरश्रेष्ठ स्वराज्यं प्रशशास ह
प्रमुमोद च लोकस्तं नृपमासाद्य राघव
नष्टशोकः समृद्धार्थो बभूव विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
samṛddhārtho naraśreṣṭha svarājyaṁ praśaśāsa ha
pramumoda ca lokastaṁ nṛpamāsādya rāghava
naṣṭaśokaḥ samṛddhārtho babhūva vigatajvaraḥ

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, having him as their sovereign, the people rejoiced greatly; and with their griefs removed and prosperity secured, they lived in peace of mind.

verses.sanskrit:
एष ते राम गङ्गाया विस्तरोऽभिहितो मया
स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते संध्याकालोऽतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
eṣa te rāma gaṅgāyā vistaro'bhihito mayā
svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṁ te saṁdhyākālo'tivartate

translations.english: Thus, O Rama, have I defailed to you the history of Gangā. Auspiciousness may you obtain! Good betide you, the evening draw nigh.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः
विस्मयं परमं गत्वा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatvā viśvāmitramathābravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of Viśvāmitra, Rāghava, together with Laksmana, was struck with amazement, and spoke to Viśvāmitra, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
अत्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मन्कथितं परमं त्वया
गङ्गावतरणं पुण्यं सागरस्य च पूरणम्
verses.transliteration:
atyadbhutamidaṁ brahmankathitaṁ paramaṁ tvayā
gaṅgāvataraṇaṁ puṇyaṁ sāgarasya ca pūraṇam

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, wonderful is the story that you have recited to us, viz; that of Ganga's sacred dissension and the replenishing of the Ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य सा शर्वरी सर्वा सह सौमित्रिणा तदा
जगाम चिन्तयानस्य विश्वामित्रकथां शुभाम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya sā śarvarī sarvā saha saumitriṇā tadā
jagāma cintayānasya viśvāmitrakathāṁ śubhām

translations.english: And the live-long night has passed away as I in company with Sumitrā's son, was pondering over Viśvāmitra's auspicious speech.'

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रभाते विमले विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
उवाच राघवो वाक्यं कृताह्निकमरिंदमः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale viśvāmitraṁ mahāmunim
uvāca rāghavo vākyaṁ kṛtāhnikamariṁdamaḥ

translations.english: Then in the morning which happened to be bright, that subduer of his foes, Raghu's descendant, addressed the ascetic Viśvāmitra, who had finished his devotion.

verses.sanskrit:
गता भगवती रात्रिः श्रोतव्यं परमं श्रुतम्
क्षणभूतेव सा रात्रिः संवृत्तेयं महातपः
इमां चिन्तयतः सर्वां निखिलेन कथां तव
verses.transliteration:
gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ śrotavyaṁ paramaṁ śrutam
kṣaṇabhūteva sā rātriḥ saṁvṛtteyaṁ mahātapaḥ
imāṁ cintayataḥ sarvāṁ nikhilena kathāṁ tava

translations.english: And, O afflicter of foes, as we had been reflecting upon all this at length, the night has passed away as if it were as moment.

verses.sanskrit:
तराम सरितां श्रेष्ठां पुण्यां त्रिपथगां नदीम्
नौरेषा हि सुखास्तीर्णा ऋषीणां पुण्यकर्मणाम्
भगवन्तमिह प्राप्तं ज्ञात्वा त्वरितमागता
verses.transliteration:
tarāma saritāṁ śreṣṭhāṁ puṇyāṁ tripathagāṁ nadīm
naureṣā hi sukhāstīrṇā ṛṣīṇāṁ puṇyakarmaṇām
bhagavantamiha prāptaṁ jñātvā tvaritamāgatā

translations.english: And learning that you have arrived at this place, the pious ascetics have speedily come hither, and have also brought this barque with a spacious carpet.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरं तीरमासाद्य संपूज्यर्षिगणं तथ
गङ्गाकूले निविष्टास्ते विशालां ददृशुः पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
uttaraṁ tīramāsādya saṁpūjyarṣigaṇaṁ tatha
gaṅgākūle niviṣṭāste viśālāṁ dadṛśuḥ purīm

translations.english: Hearing those words of the high-souled Rāghava, Kausika crossed over the crowds of ascetics; and on reaching the north bank, he paid homage to the saints. And when they had landed on the banks of the Gangā, they beheld a city named Viśālā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मुनिवरस्तूर्णं जगाम सहराघवः
विशालां नगरीं रम्यां दिव्यां स्वर्गोपमां तदा
verses.transliteration:
tato munivarastūrṇaṁ jagāma saharāghavaḥ
viśālāṁ nagarīṁ ramyāṁ divyāṁ svargopamāṁ tadā

translations.english: And thereupon speedily that that foremost of ascetics in company with Rāghava, went towards Viśālā, beautiful and elegant like to the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ रामो महाप्राज्ञो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
पप्रच्छ प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा विशालामुत्तमां पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
atha rāmo mahāprājño viśvāmitraṁ mahāmunim
papraccha prāñjalirbhūtvā viśālāmuttamāṁ purīm

translations.english: Then the highly wise Rāma, with folded hands, asked that mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra concerning the excellent city of Viśālā.

verses.sanskrit:
कतरो राजवंशोऽयं विशालायां महामुने
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भद्रं ते परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration:
kataro rājavaṁśo'yaṁ viśālāyāṁ mahāmune
śrotumicchāmi bhadraṁ te paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me

translations.english: O mighty ascetic, what royal line reside in yonder large city? I desire to hear this, good betide you; and great is my curiosity.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्य मुनिपुंगवः
आख्यातुं तत्समारेभे विशालस्य पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāmasya munipuṁgavaḥ
ākhyātuṁ tatsamārebhe viśālasya purātanam

translations.english: Hearing those words of Rāma, that foremost of ascetics began to relate the history of Viśālā, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
श्रूयतां राम शक्रस्य कथां कथयतः शुभाम्
अस्मिन्देशे हि यद्वृत्तं शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव
verses.transliteration:
śrūyatāṁ rāma śakrasya kathāṁ kathayataḥ śubhām
asmindeśe hi yadvṛttaṁ śṛṇu tattvena rāghava

translations.english: Do you listen, O Rāma to what I had heard from Sakra relating this history; and, O descendant of Raghu, do you listen to all that befell in this city.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वं कृतयुगे राम दितेः पुत्रा महाबलाः
अदितेश्च महाभागा वीर्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration:
pūrvaṁ kṛtayuge rāma diteḥ putrā mahābalāḥ
aditeśca mahābhāgā vīryavantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ

translations.english: Formerly in the Krita age, O Rāma, Diti's highly powerful sons, as well as those of Aditi, possessed of prowess, and virtuous and pious, high-souled ones both.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तेषां नरश्रेष्ठ बुद्धिरासीन्महात्मनाम्
अमरा निर्जराश्चैव कथं स्याम निरामयाः
verses.transliteration:
tatasteṣāṁ naraśreṣṭha buddhirāsīnmahātmanām
amarā nirjarāścaiva kathaṁ syāma nirāmayāḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men, fell to reflecting, 'How can we become exempt from decrepitude and disease, and immortal.'

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां चिन्तयतां राम बुद्धिरासीद्विपश्चिताम्
क्षीरोदमथनं कृत्वा रसं प्राप्स्याम तत्र वै
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ cintayatāṁ rāma buddhirāsīdvipaścitām
kṣīrodamathanaṁ kṛtvā rasaṁ prāpsyāma tatra vai

translations.english: And as they reflected, it struck them, 'By churning the ocean of milk, we must obtain ambrosia.'

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निश्चित्य मथनं योक्त्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम्
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा ममन्थुरमितौजसः
verses.transliteration:
tato niścitya mathanaṁ yoktraṁ kṛtvā ca vāsukim
manthānaṁ mandaraṁ kṛtvā mamanthuramitaujasaḥ

translations.english: Then deciding upon churning (the ocean), those ones of immeasurable energy making Vasuki the cord, and the Mandara (hill), the stick, began to churn the deep.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ धन्वन्तरिर्नाम अप्सराश्च सुवर्चसः
अप्सु निर्मथनादेव रसात्तस्माद्वरस्त्रियः
उत्पेतुर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ तस्मादप्सरसोऽभवन्
verses.transliteration:
atha dhanvantarirnāma apsarāśca suvarcasaḥ
apsu nirmathanādeva rasāttasmādvarastriyaḥ
utpeturmanujaśreṣṭha tasmādapsaraso'bhavan

translations.english: After a thousand years, had rolled on, arose a male being impregnated with the Āyurveda, of exceedingly righteous soul, called Dhanvantari, bearing in his hands a stick, and a Kamandalu. And there arose also, from the cream of the churning waters, those magnificent dames the shining Apsaras. And, O foremost of men, as they had emerged from water, they are called Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit:
षष्टिः कोट्योऽभवंस्तासामप्सराणां सुवर्चसाम्
असंख्येयास्तु काकुत्स्थ यास्तासां परिचारिकाः
verses.transliteration:
ṣaṣṭiḥ koṭyo'bhavaṁstāsāmapsarāṇāṁ suvarcasām
asaṁkhyeyāstu kākutstha yāstāsāṁ paricārikāḥ

translations.english: There sprang sixty koțis of shining Apsaras. And, O Kākutstha, the female attendants of those are numberless.

verses.sanskrit:
न ताः स्म प्रतिगृह्णन्ति सर्वे ते देवदानवाः
अप्रतिग्रहणाच्चैव तेन साधारणाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration:
na tāḥ sma pratigṛhṇanti sarve te devadānavāḥ
apratigrahaṇāccaiva tena sādhāraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ

translations.english: And neither the deities nor the Dānavas would accept them, and in consequence of this nonacceptance, they are known as women belonging to all.

verses.sanskrit:
वरुणस्य ततः कन्या वारुणी रघुनन्दन
उत्पपात महाभागा मार्गमाणा परिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
varuṇasya tataḥ kanyā vāruṇī raghunandana
utpapāta mahābhāgā mārgamāṇā parigraham

translations.english: And then, O Raghu's descendant, arose the eminently pious daughter of Varuna, Varuni, who fell to looking for acceptance.

verses.sanskrit:
दितेः पुत्रा न तां राम जगृहुर्वरुणात्मजाम्
अदितेस्तु सुता वीर जगृहुस्तामनिन्दिताम्
verses.transliteration:
diteḥ putrā na tāṁ rāma jagṛhurvaruṇātmajām
aditestu sutā vīra jagṛhustāmaninditām

translations.english: And Diti's sons, O Rāma, did not accept the daughter of Varuna and Aditi's sons, O hero, accepted that one of blameless limbs.

verses.sanskrit:
असुरास्तेन दैतेयाः सुरास्तेनादितेः सुताः
हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताश्चासन्वारुणी ग्रहणात्सुराः
verses.transliteration:
asurāstena daiteyāḥ surāstenāditeḥ sutāḥ
hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāścāsanvāruṇī grahaṇātsurāḥ

translations.english: Hence Diti's son go by the name of Asuras; and Aditi's by that of Suras. And the celestials became exceeding glad, on having accepted Vāruņi.

verses.sanskrit:
उच्चैःश्रवा हयश्रेष्ठो मणिरत्नं च कौस्तुभम्
उदतिष्ठन्नरश्रेष्ठ तथैवामृतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭho maṇiratnaṁ ca kaustubham
udatiṣṭhannaraśreṣṭha tathaivāmṛtamuttamam

translations.english: O foremost of men, next arose ucchaiśravā best of horses, and also Kaustubha; and next, the excellent ambrosia.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तस्य कृते राम महानासीत्कुलक्षयः
अदितेस्तु ततः पुत्रा दितेः पुत्राण सूदयन्
verses.transliteration:
atha tasya kṛte rāma mahānāsītkulakṣayaḥ
aditestu tataḥ putrā diteḥ putrāṇa sūdayan

translations.english: O Rāma, tremendous was the carnage for the possession thereof (ambrosia); and Aditi's and Diti's sons fought together.

verses.sanskrit:
अदितेरात्मजा वीरा दितेः पुत्रान्निजघ्निरे
तस्मिन्घोरे महायुद्धे दैतेयादित्ययोर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration:
aditerātmajā vīrā diteḥ putrānnijaghnire
tasminghore mahāyuddhe daiteyādityayorbhṛśam

translations.english: And in that exceedingly dreadful battle between the sons of Diti and Aditi, those heroic ones viz., Aditi's heroic sons slaughtered those of Diti.

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य दितिपुत्रांस्तु राज्यं प्राप्य पुरंदरः
शशास मुदितो लोकान्सर्षिसंघान्सचारणान्
verses.transliteration:
nihatya ditiputrāṁstu rājyaṁ prāpya puraṁdaraḥ
śaśāsa mudito lokānsarṣisaṁghānsacāraṇān

translations.english: Having slaughtered the sons of Diti's and regained his kingdom, he happily began to rule the worlds, containing saints and Caranas.

verses.sanskrit:
हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु दितिः परमदुःखिता
मारीचं काश्यपं राम भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
hateṣu teṣu putreṣu ditiḥ paramaduḥkhitā
mārīcaṁ kāśyapaṁ rāma bhartāramidamabravīt

translations.english: On those sons of her being slain, Diti afflicted with great grief, thus addressed her husband, Marici's son, Kasyapa.

verses.sanskrit:
हतपुत्रास्मि भगवंस्तव पुत्रैर्महाबलैः
शक्रहन्तारमिच्छामि पुत्रं दीर्घतपोऽर्जितम्
verses.transliteration:
hataputrāsmi bhagavaṁstava putrairmahābalaiḥ
śakrahantāramicchāmi putraṁ dīrghatapo'rjitam

translations.english: O adorable one, your high-souled sons have slain mine. I now wish for a son, who, obtained through long austerities, will be able to slay Sakra.

verses.sanskrit:
साहं तपश्चरिष्यामि गर्भं मे दातुमर्हसि
ईदृशं शक्रहन्तारं त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
sāhaṁ tapaścariṣyāmi garbhaṁ me dātumarhasi
īdṛśaṁ śakrahantāraṁ tvamanujñātumarhasi

translations.english: I will engage in austerities: it behoves you to grant me such an embryo, such a slayer of Sakra it behoves you to promise me.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मारीचः काश्यपस्तदा
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा दितिं परमदुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā mārīcaḥ kāśyapastadā
pratyuvāca mahātejā ditiṁ paramaduḥkhitām

translations.english: Hearing those words of hers, Marici's son, Kaśyapa of exceeding energy answered the deeply aggrieved Diti, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शुचिर्यदि भविष्यसि
पुत्रं त्रैलोक्य हन्तारं मत्तस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu śuciryadi bhaviṣyasi
putraṁ trailokya hantāraṁ mattastvaṁ janayiṣyasi

translations.english: Be it so. Good betide you, do you become pure, O ascetic. If you remain pure, when a full thousand years shall be complete, you will give birth to a son who will slay ſakra in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः पाणिना स ममार्ज ताम्
समालभ्य ततः स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा स तपसे ययौ
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejāḥ pāṇinā sa mamārja tām
samālabhya tataḥ svastītyuktvā sa tapase yayau

translations.english: And through me, you will give birth to a son that will destroy the three worlds. Having said this, that highly energetic one rubbed her person with his palm. And having rubbed her, he said, 'Luck!' and then went away to carry on austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
गते तस्मिन्नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परमहर्षिता
कुशप्लवनमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
gate tasminnaraśreṣṭha ditiḥ paramaharṣitā
kuśaplavanamāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam

translations.english: When he had gone, Diti, O foremost of men, becoming exceedingly delighted, went to, Kuśaplava and began to practise rigid mortifications.

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्तस्यां हि कुर्वत्यां परिचर्यां चकार ह
सहस्राक्षो नरश्रेष्ठ परया गुणसंपदा
verses.transliteration:
tapastasyāṁ hi kurvatyāṁ paricaryāṁ cakāra ha
sahasrākṣo naraśreṣṭha parayā guṇasaṁpadā

translations.english: O foremost of men, as she was practising austerities, the thousand-eyed deity most dutifully ministered to her.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निं कुशान्काष्ठमपः फलं मूलं तथैव च
न्यवेदयत्सहस्राक्षो यच्चान्यदपि काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
agniṁ kuśānkāṣṭhamapaḥ phalaṁ mūlaṁ tathaiva ca
nyavedayatsahasrākṣo yaccānyadapi kāṅkṣitam

translations.english: The thousand-eyed one provided for her fire, and Kusa, and faggots, and water, and fruits, and roots, and other things that she wanted.

verses.sanskrit:
गात्रसंवाहनैश्चैव श्रमापनयनैस्तथा
शक्रः सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिं परिचचार ह
verses.transliteration:
gātrasaṁvāhanaiścaiva śramāpanayanaistathā
śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditiṁ paricacāra ha

translations.english: And at all times, Sakra served Diti by rubbing her person, and removing her fatigue.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वर्षसहस्रेतु दशोने रघु नन्दन
दितिः परमसंप्रीता सहस्राक्षमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha varṣasahasretu daśone raghu nandana
ditiḥ paramasaṁprītā sahasrākṣamathābravīt

translations.english: When ten years only were wanting to complete the thousand years, Diti, O descendant of Raghu, being exceedingly delighted, thus spoke to the thousand-eyed one.

verses.sanskrit:
तपश्चरन्त्या वर्षाणि दश वीर्यवतां वर
अवशिष्टानि भद्रं ते भ्रातरं द्रक्ष्यसे ततः
verses.transliteration:
tapaścarantyā varṣāṇi daśa vīryavatāṁ vara
avaśiṣṭāni bhadraṁ te bhrātaraṁ drakṣyase tataḥ

translations.english: O best of those endowed with prowess, of me engaged in austerities, ten years only remain (to complete the period.) And after that time, good betide you, you will behold your brother.

verses.sanskrit:
तमहं त्वत्कृते पुत्र समाधास्ये जयोत्सुकम्
त्रैलोक्यविजयं पुत्र सह भोक्ष्यसि विज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tamahaṁ tvatkṛte putra samādhāsye jayotsukam
trailokyavijayaṁ putra saha bhokṣyasi vijvaraḥ

translations.english: I will, O son, bind him to you in affection, whom I had besought for to compass your destruction, so that, the fever of your heart removed, you will with him enjoy the victory of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा दितिः शक्रं प्राप्ते मध्यं दिवाकरे
निद्रयापहृता देवी पादौ कृत्वाथ शीर्षतः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā ditiḥ śakraṁ prāpte madhyaṁ divākare
nidrayāpahṛtā devī pādau kṛtvātha śīrṣataḥ

translations.english: And it came to pass that having said this, the sun being in his meridian, the worshipful Diti with her feet placed at that part of the bed which should contain her head, was overpowered by sleep.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तामशुचिं शक्रः पादतः कृतमूर्धजाम्
शिरःस्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tāmaśuciṁ śakraḥ pādataḥ kṛtamūrdhajām
śiraḥsthāne kṛtau pādau jahāsa ca mumoda ca

translations.english: And thereupon seeing her resting her feet at the place where she should place her head, and consequently unclean, Śakra was exceedingly delighted, and smiled.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याः शरीरविवरं विवेश च पुरंदरः
गर्भं च सप्तधा राम बिभेद परमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāḥ śarīravivaraṁ viveśa ca puraṁdaraḥ
garbhaṁ ca saptadhā rāma bibheda paramātmavān

translations.english: O Rāma, Purandara entered into her womb, and that highly self-controlled one served the embryo in seven parts.

verses.sanskrit:
बिध्यमानस्ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा
रुरोद सुस्वरं राम ततो दितिरबुध्यत
verses.transliteration:
bidhyamānastato garbho vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
ruroda susvaraṁ rāma tato ditirabudhyata

translations.english: And the embryo being pierced by the thunderbold of an hundred knots, cried at the top of its voice, and thereat Diti awoke.

verses.sanskrit:
मा रुदो मा रुदश्चेति गर्भं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत
बिभेद च महातेजा रुदन्तमपि वासवः
verses.transliteration:
mā rudo mā rudaśceti garbhaṁ śakro'bhyabhāṣata
bibheda ca mahātejā rudantamapi vāsavaḥ

translations.english: 'Do not cry, do not cry,' exclaimed Sakra: and even while it was crying, the mighty-minded Vāsava continued piercing it.

verses.sanskrit:
न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इत्येवं दितिरब्रवीत्
निष्पपात ततः शक्रो मातुर्वचनगौरवात्
verses.transliteration:
na hantavyo na hantavya ityevaṁ ditirabravīt
niṣpapāta tataḥ śakro māturvacanagauravāt

translations.english: 'Do not slay it; do not slay it' said Diti. Thereupon, in consideration of the honour of his mother, Sakra went out.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राञ्जलिर्वज्रसहितो दितिं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत
अशुचिर्देवि सुप्तासि पादयोः कृतमूर्धजा
verses.transliteration:
prāñjalirvajrasahito ditiṁ śakro'bhyabhāṣata
aśucirdevi suptāsi pādayoḥ kṛtamūrdhajā

translations.english: Then he with clasped palms accosted Diti, saying, 'O worshipful one, you did sleep with they feet placed where your head should have lain, and hast therefore become impure. And finding this opportunity, I severed in seven pieces that would-be slayer of mine in battle. Do you, O worshipful one, excuse me.'

verses.sanskrit:
सप्तधा तु कृते गर्भे दितिः परमदुःखिता
सहस्राक्षं दुराधर्षं वाक्यं सानुनयाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
saptadhā tu kṛte garbhe ditiḥ paramaduḥkhitā
sahasrākṣaṁ durādharṣaṁ vākyaṁ sānunayābravīt

translations.english: When the embryo had been sundered is seven, Díti exceedingly aggrieved humbly spoke to the irrepressible thousand-eyed deity, saying, as

verses.sanskrit:
ममापराधाद्गर्भोऽयं सप्तधा विफलीकृतः
नापराधोऽस्ति देवेश तवात्र बलसूदन
verses.transliteration:
mamāparādhādgarbho'yaṁ saptadhā viphalīkṛtaḥ
nāparādho'sti deveśa tavātra balasūdana

translations.english: By my fault it is that the embryo has been sundered in seven. O chief of the celestials, herein you are guilty of no transgression, o destroyer of Bala.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियं तु कृतमिच्छामि मम गर्भविपर्यये
मरुतां सप्तं सप्तानां स्थानपाला भवन्त्विमे
verses.transliteration:
priyaṁ tu kṛtamicchāmi mama garbhaviparyaye
marutāṁ saptaṁ saptānāṁ sthānapālā bhavantvime

translations.english: And since calamity has befallen the embryo, I wish to do you a good turn. Let the seven parts become the guardians of the seven Maruts.

verses.sanskrit:
वातस्कन्धा इमे सप्त चरन्तु दिवि पुत्रकाः
मारुता इति विख्याता दिव्यरूपा ममात्मजाः
verses.transliteration:
vātaskandhā ime sapta carantu divi putrakāḥ
mārutā iti vikhyātā divyarūpā mamātmajāḥ

translations.english: O son, let my sons having noble forms, becoming famous Marutas range the Vātaskandha regions in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मलोकं चरत्वेक इन्द्रलोकं तथापरः
दिवि वायुरिति ख्यातस्तृतीयोऽपि महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
brahmalokaṁ caratveka indralokaṁ tathāparaḥ
divi vāyuriti khyātastṛtīyo'pi mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Let one range Brahmā's regions, and another Indra's, and the highly illustrious third also range around, being known as Divya Vāyu. (Ether).

verses.sanskrit:
चत्वारस्तु सुरश्रेष्ठ दिशो वै तव शासनात्
संचरिष्यन्ति भद्रं ते देवभूता ममात्मजाः
त्वत्कृतेनैव नाम्ना च मारुता इति विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration:
catvārastu suraśreṣṭha diśo vai tava śāsanāt
saṁcariṣyanti bhadraṁ te devabhūtā mamātmajāḥ
tvatkṛtenaiva nāmnā ca mārutā iti viśrutāḥ

translations.english: O best of celestials, by they command, let the four remaining sons of mine, known by the name which you have mentioned, range about in appointed periods.'

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं दितिं बलनिषूदनः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ puraṁdaraḥ
uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ ditiṁ balaniṣūdanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing her words, that destroyer of Vala; the thousand-eyed Purandara, with clasped palms said.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमेतद्यथोक्तं ते भविष्यति न संशयः
विचरिष्यन्ति भद्रं ते देवभूतास्तवात्मजाः
verses.transliteration:
sarvametadyathoktaṁ te bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ
vicariṣyanti bhadraṁ te devabhūtāstavātmajāḥ

translations.english: All this that you have said must come to pass; there is no doubt about it. Good betide you, your sons endowed with celestial forms, shall range about.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा मातापुत्रौ तपोवने
जग्मतुस्त्रिदिवं राम कृतार्थाविति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ tau niścayaṁ kṛtvā mātāputrau tapovane
jagmatustridivaṁ rāma kṛtārthāviti naḥ śrutam

translations.english: And it has been heard by us that having thus ascertained in that hermitage, the mother and the son, O Rama, went to heaven, their desire obtained.

verses.sanskrit:
एष देशः स काकुत्स्थ महेन्द्राध्युषितः पुरा
दितिं यत्र तपः सिद्धामेवं परिचचार सः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa deśaḥ sa kākutstha mahendrādhyuṣitaḥ purā
ditiṁ yatra tapaḥ siddhāmevaṁ paricacāra saḥ

translations.english: Even this O Kākutstha, is the place where formerly the mighty Indra sojourned, and where he attended upon Diti of accomplished ascetic success.

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकोस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः
अलम्बुषायामुत्पन्नो विशाल इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākostu naravyāghra putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
alambuṣāyāmutpanno viśāla iti viśrutaḥ

translations.english: O most powerful of men, Ikşvāku had an exceedingly righteous son born to him of Alambusa, known by the name of Viśāla. And here stood a palace, built by him, called Viśālā.

verses.sanskrit:
विशालस्य सुतो राम हेमचन्द्रो महाबलः
सुचन्द्र इति विख्यातो हेमचन्द्रादनन्तरः
verses.transliteration:
viśālasya suto rāma hemacandro mahābalaḥ
sucandra iti vikhyāto hemacandrādanantaraḥ

translations.english: Viśāla's son, O Rāma, was the mighty Hemacandra. And after Hemacandra comes the celebrated Sucandra.

verses.sanskrit:
सुचन्द्रतनयो राम धूम्राश्व इति विश्रुतः
धूम्राश्वतनयश्चापि सृञ्जयः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
sucandratanayo rāma dhūmrāśva iti viśrutaḥ
dhūmrāśvatanayaścāpi sṛñjayaḥ samapadyata

translations.english: O Rāma, the son of Sucandra was Dhumrāśva, and then was born Sšñjaya son to Dhumrāśva.

verses.sanskrit:
सृञ्जयस्य सुतः श्रीमान्सहदेवः प्रतापवान्
कुशाश्वः सहदेवस्य पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
sṛñjayasya sutaḥ śrīmānsahadevaḥ pratāpavān
kuśāśvaḥ sahadevasya putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ

translations.english: Srinjaya's son was the powerful Sahadeva, And Sahadeva's son was the pre-eminently pious Kuśāśva.

verses.sanskrit:
कुशाश्वस्य महातेजाः सोमदत्तः प्रतापवान्
सोमदत्तस्य पुत्रस्तु काकुत्स्थ इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
kuśāśvasya mahātejāḥ somadattaḥ pratāpavān
somadattasya putrastu kākutstha iti viśrutaḥ

translations.english: Kuśāśva's son was the puissant Somadatta. And now, O Kākutstha, Somadatta's son, the effulgent and invincible and renowned Sumati reside in this mansion.

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकोस्तु प्रसादेन सर्वे वैशालिका नृपाः
दीर्घायुषो महात्मानो वीर्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākostu prasādena sarve vaiśālikā nṛpāḥ
dīrghāyuṣo mahātmāno vīryavantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ

translations.english: And by the grace of Ikşvāku, all the sovereigns of Viśālā are long-loved, and highsouled, and puissant, and pious.

verses.sanskrit:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम सुखं वत्स्यामहे वयम्
श्वः प्रभाते नरश्रेष्ठ जनकं द्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
ihādya rajanīṁ rāma sukhaṁ vatsyāmahe vayam
śvaḥ prabhāte naraśreṣṭha janakaṁ draṣṭumarhasi

translations.english: And here will we happily spend a night; an on the morning of the morrow you will, O foremost of men, behold Janaka.'

verses.sanskrit:
सुमतिस्तु महातेजा विश्वामित्रमुपागतम्
श्रुत्वा नरवरश्रेष्ठः प्रत्युद्गच्छन्महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
sumatistu mahātejā viśvāmitramupāgatam
śrutvā naravaraśreṣṭhaḥ pratyudgacchanmahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: And having heard that the illustrious Viśvāmitra had come, that best of kings, the effulgent Sumati, appeared before him.

verses.sanskrit:
पूजां च परमां कृत्वा सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः
प्राञ्जलिः कुशलं पृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
pūjāṁ ca paramāṁ kṛtvā sopādhyāyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ
prāñjaliḥ kuśalaṁ pṛṣṭvā viśvāmitramathābravīt

translations.english: And having paid Viśvāmitra high homage together with his priests and friends, and with clasped hands enquired after the former's welfare, he addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे विषयं मुने
संप्राप्तो दर्शनं चैव नास्ति धन्यतरो मम
verses.transliteration:
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yasya me viṣayaṁ mune
saṁprāpto darśanaṁ caiva nāsti dhanyataro mama

translations.english: Blessed are we, and obliged are we, whose domains, O ascetic, have been graced with your presence. Surely none is more blessed than I am.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलं तत्र परस्परसमागमे
कथान्ते सुमतिर्वाक्यं व्याजहार महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṁ tatra parasparasamāgame
kathānte sumatirvākyaṁ vyājahāra mahāmunim

translations.english: Having met together they enquired after each other's welfare. And then Sumati spoke to the mighty ascetic, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छयैव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ
कथं पद्भ्यामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने
verses.transliteration:
yadṛcchayaiva gāṁ prāptau devalokādivāmarau
kathaṁ padbhyāmiha prāptau kimarthaṁ kasya vā mune
