translations.english: Good betide you, boasting the prowess of celestials of elephantine or leonine gait, heroic, resembling tigers or bulls, possessed of come expansive eyes like lotus-patals, bearing scimitars and bows and quivers, like to the Aśvins in grace, endowed with youth, like to celestials fancy-led, descended from ethereal regions to the earth beneath, whose sons; O ascetic, are these boys, and what for have they come hither, and why also is it that they journey of foot?

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं च नरश्रेष्ठौ संप्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि
वरायुधधरौ वीरौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ ca naraśreṣṭhau saṁprāptau durgame pathi
varāyudhadharau vīrau śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ

translations.english: And adorning all directions, like to the Sun or Moon adorning the firmament, and resembling each other. in personal proportions, and expressions, and gestures, and equipped with excellent weapons, and war-like, how have these paragons of men, into this impracticable way? I Wish to hear all this related truly.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा राजा परमहर्षितः
अतिथी परमौ प्राप्तौ पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ
पूजयामास विधिवत्सत्कारार्हौ महाबलौ
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā rājā paramaharṣitaḥ
atithī paramau prāptau putrau daśarathasya tau
pūjayāmāsa vidhivatsatkārārhau mahābalau

translations.english: Having heard his words, Viśvāmitra faithfully related all about it. Hearing Viśvāmitra's words, the king was extremely surprised; and having those sons of Daśaratha as his all-worthy guests, received with becoming respect those highly powerful ones deserving of hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः परमसत्कारं सुमतेः प्राप्य राघवौ
उष्य तत्र निशामेकां जग्मतुर्मिथिलां ततः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paramasatkāraṁ sumateḥ prāpya rāghavau
uṣya tatra niśāmekāṁ jagmaturmithilāṁ tataḥ

translations.english: Meeting with such splendid reception from Sumati, those descendants of Raghu spent there a night, and the next day set out for Mithila.

verses.sanskrit:
तां दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीं शुभाम्
साधु साध्विति शंसन्तो मिथिलां समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve janakasya purīṁ śubhām
sādhu sādhviti śaṁsanto mithilāṁ samapūjayan

translations.english: Beholding Janaka's beauteous city, the ascetics exclaiming, 'Excellent' fell to admiring Mithila.

verses.sanskrit:
मिथिलोपवने तत्र आश्रमं दृश्य राघवः
पुराणं निर्जनं रम्यं पप्रच्छ मुनिपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration:
mithilopavane tatra āśramaṁ dṛśya rāghavaḥ
purāṇaṁ nirjanaṁ ramyaṁ papraccha munipuṁgavam

translations.english: And in a grove at Mithilā, Rāghava saw an ancient, lonely, and romantic asylum, and asked that foremost of ascetics, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीमदाश्रमसंकाशं किं न्विदं मुनिवर्जितम्
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन्कस्यायं पूर्व आश्रमः
verses.transliteration:
śrīmadāśramasaṁkāśaṁ kiṁ nvidaṁ munivarjitam
śrotumicchāmi bhagavankasyāyaṁ pūrva āśramaḥ

translations.english: What is this that look like an asylum, though without any ascetics? I wish to hear, O worshipful one, to whom this asylum belonged in time past.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुता राघवेणोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutā rāghaveṇoktaṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātejā viśvamitro mahāmuniḥ

translations.english: Hearing this speech addressed by Raghu's descendant that one versed in speech, the highly energetic and mighty saint, Viśvāmitra, answered.

verses.sanskrit:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव
यस्यैतदाश्रमपदं शप्तं कोपान्महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena rāghava
yasyaitadāśramapadaṁ śaptaṁ kopānmahātmanā

translations.english: Ah! Do you listen. I will tell you through the wrath of what high-souled one this hermitage came to he cursed.

verses.sanskrit:
गौतमस्य नरश्रेष्ठ पूर्वमासीन्महात्मनः
आश्रमो दिव्यसंकाशः सुरैरपि सुपूजितः
verses.transliteration:
gautamasya naraśreṣṭha pūrvamāsīnmahātmanaḥ
āśramo divyasaṁkāśaḥ surairapi supūjitaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men, this excellent asylum honoured by the celestials themselves, formerly belonged to the high-souled Gautama.

verses.sanskrit:
स चेह तप आतिष्ठदहल्यासहितः पुरा
वर्षपूगान्यनेकानि राजपुत्र महायशः
verses.transliteration:
sa ceha tapa ātiṣṭhadahalyāsahitaḥ purā
varṣapūgānyanekāni rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: Here, O illustrious prince, in days of yore Gautama in company with Ahalyā carried on austerities for a long series of years.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यान्तरं विदित्वा तु सहस्राक्षः शचीपतिः
मुनिवेषधरोऽहल्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāntaraṁ viditvā tu sahasrākṣaḥ śacīpatiḥ
muniveṣadharo'halyāmidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: And perceiving occasion Saci's lord, the thousand-eyed deity assuming the form of that ascetic thus addressed Ahalyā.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋतुकालं प्रतीक्षन्ते नार्थिनः सुसमाहिते
संगमं त्वहमिच्छामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration:
ṛtukālaṁ pratīkṣante nārthinaḥ susamāhite
saṁgamaṁ tvahamicchāmi tvayā saha sumadhyame

translations.english: O exceedingly beautiful one, those bent upon sport, do not stay for the menstrual season. And, O graceful one, I desire to enjoy your company (on the instant).

verses.sanskrit:
मुनिवेषं सहस्राक्षं विज्ञाय रघुनन्दन
मतिं चकार दुर्मेधा देवराजकुतूहलात्
verses.transliteration:
muniveṣaṁ sahasrākṣaṁ vijñāya raghunandana
matiṁ cakāra durmedhā devarājakutūhalāt

translations.english: Thereupon, out of curiosity, that one of perverse understanding consented to the proposals of the chief of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाब्रवीत्सुरश्रेष्ठं कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना
कृतार्थोऽसि सुरश्रेष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रमितः प्रभो
आत्मानं मां च देवेश सर्वदा रक्ष मानदः
verses.transliteration:
athābravītsuraśreṣṭhaṁ kṛtārthenāntarātmanā
kṛtārtho'si suraśreṣṭha gaccha śīghramitaḥ prabho
ātmānaṁ māṁ ca deveśa sarvadā rakṣa mānadaḥ

translations.english: Then, having attained her object, she spoke to that foremost of the celestials, saying, 'O best of the immortals, I have obtained my desire, do you speedily go from this place, O lord. Do you, O lord of the celestials, from a sense of respectability preserve yourself and me also.'

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रस्तु प्रहसन्वाक्यमहल्यामिदमब्रवीत्
सुश्रोणि परितुष्टोऽस्मि गमिष्यामि यथागतम्
verses.transliteration:
indrastu prahasanvākyamahalyāmidamabravīt
suśroṇi parituṣṭo'smi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam

translations.english: Indra too said to Ahalyā, 'O you of shapely hips, pleased am I. Now I repair to my own place.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवं संगम्य तु तया निश्चक्रामोटजात्ततः
स संभ्रमात्त्वरन्राम शङ्कितो गौतमं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ saṁgamya tu tayā niścakrāmoṭajāttataḥ
sa saṁbhramāttvaranrāma śaṅkito gautamaṁ prati

translations.english: Having known her thus, Indra, O Rama, exceedingly apprehensive of Gautama, then hurriedly sallied out of the thatched cottage.

verses.sanskrit:
गौतमं स ददर्शाथ प्रविशन्तं महामुनिम्
देवदानवदुर्धर्षं तपोबलसमन्वितम्
तीर्थोदकपरिक्लिन्नं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्
गृहीतसमिधं तत्र सकुशं मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration:
gautamaṁ sa dadarśātha praviśantaṁ mahāmunim
devadānavadurdharṣaṁ tapobalasamanvitam
tīrthodakapariklinnaṁ dīpyamānamivānalam
gṛhītasamidhaṁ tatra sakuśaṁ munipuṅgavam

translations.english: Just at this time, Indra saw that mighty ascetic Gautama entering, that foremost of anchorets, incapable of being repressed by the deities and the Dānavas, and equipped with ascetic energy, having based in the waters of holy spots, and flaming like fire, carrying faggots and Kuća grass.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं मुनिवेषधरं मुनिः
दुर्वृत्तं वृत्तसंपन्नो रोषाद्वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaṁ muniveṣadharaṁ muniḥ
durvṛttaṁ vṛttasaṁpanno roṣādvacanamabravīt

translations.english: And seeing him, the countenance of the lord of the celestials turned pale. And seeing the wicked thousand-eyed deity in the guise of an ascetic, the well-behaved anchorite fired with rage said.

verses.sanskrit:
मम रूपं समास्थाय कृतवानसि दुर्मते
अकर्तव्यमिदं यस्माद्विफलस्त्वं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
mama rūpaṁ samāsthāya kṛtavānasi durmate
akartavyamidaṁ yasmādviphalastvaṁ bhaviṣyati

translations.english: 'And since, O you of wicked understanding, assuming my form, you have done this foul. deed, you shall lose your scrotum.'

verses.sanskrit:
गौतमेनैवमुक्तस्य सरोषेण महात्मना
पेततुर्वृषणौ भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration:
gautamenaivamuktasya saroṣeṇa mahātmanā
petaturvṛṣaṇau bhūmau sahasrākṣasya tatkṣaṇāt

translations.english: And soon as the high-souled Gautama had said this in ire, the scrotum of the thousand-eyed one dropped to the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा गौतमो दुष्टचारिणीम्
इममाश्रममुत्सृज्य सिद्धचारणसेविते
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये तपस्तेपे महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejā gautamo duṣṭacāriṇīm
imamāśramamutsṛjya siddhacāraṇasevite
himavacchikhare ramye tapastepe mahātapāḥ

translations.english: Having said this the highly energetic Gautama of rigid austerities, forsaking this hermitage, began to carry on penances on the romantic summit of the Himavat, inhabited by Siddhas and Caranas.

verses.sanskrit:
अफलस्तु ततः शक्रो देवानग्निपुरोगमान्
अब्रवीत्त्रस्तवदनः सर्षिसंघान्सचारणान्
verses.transliteration:
aphalastu tataḥ śakro devānagnipurogamān
abravīttrastavadanaḥ sarṣisaṁghānsacāraṇān

translations.english: And having been deprived of his scrotum, Śakra with eyes tremulous with fear, addressed the celestials with Agni at their head, as well as he Siddhas and the Gandharvas and the Cāraņas, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
कुर्वता तपसो विघ्नं गौतमस्य महात्मनः
क्रोधमुत्पाद्य हि मया सुरकार्यमिदं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
kurvatā tapaso vighnaṁ gautamasya mahātmanaḥ
krodhamutpādya hi mayā surakāryamidaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: I have accomplished the work of the celestials by stirring the ire of the high-souled Gautama, and thereby disturbing his austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
अफलोऽस्मि कृतस्तेन क्रोधात्सा च निराकृता
शापमोक्षेण महता तपोऽस्यापहृतं मया
verses.transliteration:
aphalo'smi kṛtastena krodhātsā ca nirākṛtā
śāpamokṣeṇa mahatā tapo'syāpahṛtaṁ mayā

translations.english: And in doing so, I have been deprived of my scrotum; and Ahalyā also has been put down. And I have deprived him of his ascetic energy by causing him to utter a mighty curse.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्मां सुरवराः सर्वे सर्षिसंघाः सचारणाः
सुरसाह्यकरं सर्वे सफलं कर्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration:
tanmāṁ suravarāḥ sarve sarṣisaṁghāḥ sacāraṇāḥ
surasāhyakaraṁ sarve saphalaṁ kartumarhatha

translations.english: And, therefore, you celestials, and saints, and Cāraņas, you should restore my scrotum to me who have served the gods.'

verses.sanskrit:
शतक्रतोर्वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः
पितृदेवानुपेत्याहुः सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration:
śatakratorvacaḥ śrutvā devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ
pitṛdevānupetyāhuḥ saha sarvairmarudgaṇaiḥ

translations.english: Hearing Satakratu's (performer of an hundred sacrifices, one of the appellations of Indra). The manes of ancestors. words, the deities along with the Maruts led by Agni, presented themselves before the divine Pitrs. And then Agni addressed the latter, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं मेषः सवृषणः शक्रो ह्यवृषणः कृतः
मेषस्य वृषणौ गृह्य शक्रायाशु प्रयच्छत
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ meṣaḥ savṛṣaṇaḥ śakro hyavṛṣaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ
meṣasya vṛṣaṇau gṛhya śakrāyāśu prayacchata

translations.english: This ram is possessed of a scrotum; while Śakra has been deprived of his. Do you taking the scrotum of the ram furnish Sakra with it.

verses.sanskrit:
अफलस्तु कृतो मेषः परां तुष्टिं प्रदास्यति
भवतां हर्षणार्थाय ये च दास्यन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration:
aphalastu kṛto meṣaḥ parāṁ tuṣṭiṁ pradāsyati
bhavatāṁ harṣaṇārthāya ye ca dāsyanti mānavāḥ

translations.english: And although deprived of the scrotum, the will be able to grant consummate satisfaction to you. And on those that will offer such a ram for your entertainment, you will bestow undying and profuse merit.'

verses.sanskrit:
अग्नेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा पितृदेवाः समागताः
उत्पाट्य मेषवृषणौ सहस्राक्षे न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration:
agnestu vacanaṁ śrutvā pitṛdevāḥ samāgatāḥ
utpāṭya meṣavṛṣaṇau sahasrākṣe nyavedayan

translations.english: ram Hearing Agni's speech, the assembled Pitrs, rooting up the scrotum of the ram, joined it to the person of the thousand-eyed deity.

verses.sanskrit:
तदा प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ पितृदेवाः समागताः
अफलान्भुञ्जते मेषान्फलैस्तेषामयोजयन्
verses.transliteration:
tadā prabhṛti kākutstha pitṛdevāḥ samāgatāḥ
aphalānbhuñjate meṣānphalaisteṣāmayojayan

translations.english: Thence forth, O Kākutstha, the divine Pitrs together feast upon scrotumless rams, for their scrotum had been joined to the person of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रस्तु मेषवृषणस्तदा प्रभृति राघव
गौतमस्य प्रभावेन तपसश्च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
indrastu meṣavṛṣaṇastadā prabhṛti rāghava
gautamasya prabhāvena tapasaśca mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Thenceforth, O Rāghava, Indra also through the high-souled Gautama's ascetic energy, has been bearing the scrotum of a ram.

verses.sanskrit:
तदागच्छ महातेज आश्रमं पुण्यकर्मणः
तारयैनां महाभागामहल्यां देवरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration:
tadāgaccha mahāteja āśramaṁ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ
tārayaināṁ mahābhāgāmahalyāṁ devarūpiṇīm

translations.english: Therefore, O highly powerful one, do you enter into the hermitage of that pious one, and deliver the dignified and divinely fair Ahalyā.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः
विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य आश्रमं प्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
viśvāmitraṁ puraskṛtya āśramaṁ praviveśa ha

translations.english: On hearing Viśvāmitra's words, Rāghava in company with Lakşmaņa, placing Viśvāmitra in their front, entered the asylum.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नान्निर्मितां धात्रा दिव्यां मायामयीमिव
धूमेनाभिपरीताङ्गीं पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव
verses.transliteration:
prayatnānnirmitāṁ dhātrā divyāṁ māyāmayīmiva
dhūmenābhiparītāṅgīṁ pūrṇacandraprabhāmiva

translations.english: They beheld that magnificent dame flaming in ascetic energy; and incapable of being gazed at too near even by the celestials and the Asuras; as if created by the Deity to be the divinely charming Woman; like a flame hid in smoke; or the brightness of the full moon clouded and dimmed in mist; or the solar splendour incapable of being beheld of account of clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि गौतमवाक्येन दुर्निरीक्ष्या बभूव ह
त्रयाणामपि लोकानां यावद्रामस्य दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa hi gautamavākyena durnirīkṣyā babhūva ha
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṁ yāvadrāmasya darśanam

translations.english: And by virtue of Gautama's word, she had been incapable of being seen by any in the three worlds, till the sight of Rāma. And now the curse having come to an end, she could be perceived by them.

verses.sanskrit:
पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथातिथ्यं चकार सुसमाहिता
प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
pādyamarghyaṁ tathātithyaṁ cakāra susamāhitā
pratijagrāha kākutstho vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā

translations.english: The two descendants of Raghu then took hold of her feet; but remembering Gautama's words, she on her part took hold of theirs. And with a collected mind she gave them water for their feet as well as Arghya, and extended to them the rites of hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्देवदुन्दुभिनिस्वनैः
गन्धर्वाप्सरसां चापि महानासीत्समागमः
verses.transliteration:
puṣpavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīddevadundubhinisvanaiḥ
gandharvāpsarasāṁ cāpi mahānāsītsamāgamaḥ

translations.english: And the Kākutstha accepted the homage thus rendered according to the ordinance. And blossoms began to shower copiously to the sounds of kettledrums; and the Gandharvas and the Apsaras began to rejoice greatly.

verses.sanskrit:
साधु साध्विति देवास्तामहल्यां समपूजयन्
तपोबलविशुद्धाङ्गीं गौतमस्य वशानुगाम्
verses.transliteration:
sādhu sādhviti devāstāmahalyāṁ samapūjayan
tapobalaviśuddhāṅgīṁ gautamasya vaśānugām

translations.english: And exclaiming, 'Excellent, excellent,' the celestials honoured Ahalyā, as with as person purified by penance, she again come under Gautama's governance.

verses.sanskrit:
गौतमोऽपि महातेजा अहल्यासहितः सुखी
रामं संपूज्य विधिवत्तपस्तेपे महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
gautamo'pi mahātejā ahalyāsahitaḥ sukhī
rāmaṁ saṁpūjya vidhivattapastepe mahātapāḥ

translations.english: And the highly energetic Gautama also happy on his union with Ahalyā, honoured Rāma highly, and that one of mighty mortifications then became engaged in austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
रामोऽपि परमां पूजां गौतमस्य महामुनेः
सकाशाद्विधिवत्प्राप्य जगाम मिथिलां ततः
verses.transliteration:
rāmo'pi paramāṁ pūjāṁ gautamasya mahāmuneḥ
sakāśādvidhivatprāpya jagāma mithilāṁ tataḥ

translations.english: And having duly received signal honours from the great ascetic Gautama, Rāma set out for Mithila.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रागुत्तरां गत्वा रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञवाटमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prāguttarāṁ gatvā rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
viśvāmitraṁ puraskṛtya yajñavāṭamupāgamat

translations.english: Then proceeding north-east Rāma is company with Sumitrā's son, placing Viśvāmitra at their head, appeared before the sacrificial ground.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्तु मुनिशार्दूलमुवाच सहलक्ष्मणः
साध्वी यज्ञसमृद्धिर्हि जनकस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
rāmastu muniśārdūlamuvāca sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
sādhvī yajñasamṛddhirhi janakasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: And Rāma and Lakşmaņa said to that puissant ascetic, Great is the pomp and splendour of the high-souled Janaka's sacrifice. And, o pious one, many thousand of Brāhmaṇas inhabiting various regions, and well-read in the Vedas (have come to this sacrifice);2-3

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिवाटाश्च दृश्यन्ते शकटीशतसंकुलाः
देशो विधीयतां ब्रह्मन्यत्र वत्स्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣivāṭāśca dṛśyante śakaṭīśatasaṁkulāḥ
deśo vidhīyatāṁ brahmanyatra vatsyāmahe vayam

translations.english: And the abodes of ascetics are thronged with hundreds of cars. Do you, O Brahmana, arrange for some place were we may put up.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
निवेशमकरोद्देशे विविक्ते सलिलायुते
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya vacanaṁ śrutvā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
niveśamakaroddeśe vivikte salilāyute

translations.english: Hearing Rāma's words, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra selected for their abode a wellwatered spot free from bustle and tumult.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋत्विजोऽपि महात्मानस्त्वर्घ्यमादाय सत्वरम्
विश्वामित्राय धर्मेण ददुर्मन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛtvijo'pi mahātmānastvarghyamādāya satvaram
viśvāmitrāya dharmeṇa dadurmantrapuraskṛtam

translations.english: And hearing of Viśvāmitra's arrival, the best of monarchs without blame, placing the priests Satānanda before him, as well as the high-souled family priests, speedily taking the Arghya, at once went out in humble guise, and offered it to Viśvāmitra according to the ordinance.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां जनकस्य महात्मनः
पप्रच्छ कुशलं राज्ञो यज्ञस्य च निरामयम्
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya tu tāṁ pūjāṁ janakasya mahātmanaḥ
papraccha kuśalaṁ rājño yajñasya ca nirāmayam

translations.english: Having accepted that homage of the highsouled Janaka, the ascetic enquired after the king's welfare, and the uninterrupted performance of his sacrifice. And the king together with his priests, having enquired of the ascetics as to their welfare, cheerfully embraced them all in a proper way.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ राजा मुनिश्रेष्ठं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
आसने भगवानास्तां सहैभिर्मुनिसत्तमैः
verses.transliteration:
atha rājā muniśreṣṭhaṁ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
āsane bhagavānāstāṁ sahaibhirmunisattamaiḥ

translations.english: Then he with clasped hands, spoke to that foremost of anchorets, saying, O worshipful one, do you along with these eminent ascetics take your seat.

verses.sanskrit:
जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा निषसाद महामुनिः
पुरोधा ऋत्विजश्चैव राजा च सह मन्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration:
janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā niṣasāda mahāmuniḥ
purodhā ṛtvijaścaiva rājā ca saha mantribhiḥ

translations.english: Hearing Janaka's words, the mighty ascetic sat him down. And the king also, in company with his priests and counsellors sat down around in order of rank.

verses.sanskrit:
आसनेषु यथान्यायमुपविष्टान्समन्ततः
दृष्ट्वा स नृपतिस्तत्र विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
āsaneṣu yathānyāyamupaviṣṭānsamantataḥ
dṛṣṭvā sa nṛpatistatra viśvāmitramathābravīt

translations.english: And then the monarch looking into Viśvāmitra's face, said, To-day by the grace of the gods, has my sacrifice been crowned with success, to-day.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुंगव
यज्ञोपसदनं ब्रह्मन्प्राप्तोऽसि मुनिभिः सह
verses.transliteration:
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yasya me munipuṁgava
yajñopasadanaṁ brahmanprāpto'si munibhiḥ saha

translations.english: Have I reaped the fruit of my sacrifice by beholding your worshipful self. Blessed and obliged am I whose sacrificial ground, O Brāhmaṇa, has been graced by you along with these ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वादशाहं तु ब्रह्मर्षे शेषमाहुर्मनीषिणः
ततो भागार्थिनो देवान्द्रष्टुमर्हसि कौशिक
verses.transliteration:
dvādaśāhaṁ tu brahmarṣe śeṣamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
tato bhāgārthino devāndraṣṭumarhasi kauśika

translations.english: Twelve days, O Brahmarși, have been fixed for the period of initiation by the sages. On the expiry of that term, you will, O Kausika, behold the celestials come to the sacrifice for claiming their respective shares.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलं प्रहृष्टवदनस्तदा
पुनस्तं परिपप्रच्छ प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतो नृपः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā muniśārdūlaṁ prahṛṣṭavadanastadā
punastaṁ paripapraccha prāñjaliḥ prayato nṛpaḥ

translations.english: Having said this, the king with a cheerful countenance, with folded hands, again intently asked that foremost of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जनकस्य महात्मनः
न्यवेदयन्महात्मानौ पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā janakasya mahātmanaḥ
nyavedayanmahātmānau putrau daśarathasya tau

translations.english: Hearing this speech of the high-souled Janaka, that ascetic of immeasurable soul related all about Dasaratha's sons.

verses.sanskrit:
अहल्यादर्शनं चैव गौतमेन समागमम्
महाधनुषि जिज्ञासां कर्तुमागमनं तथा
verses.transliteration:
ahalyādarśanaṁ caiva gautamena samāgamam
mahādhanuṣi jijñāsāṁ kartumāgamanaṁ tathā

translations.english: Their sojourn in Siddhāśrama, and the slaughter there of the Raksasas, their undaunted journey, the sight of Viśālā, the encounter with Ahalyā and Gautama, Rāma's curiosity about the mighty bow, and visit there for beholding the same.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्सर्वं महातेजा जनकाय महात्मने
निवेद्य विररामाथ विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration:
etatsarvaṁ mahātejā janakāya mahātmane
nivedya virarāmātha viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ

translations.english: Having related all this to the high-souled Janaka, that one endowed with exceeding energy, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, paused.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः
हृष्टरोमा महातेजाः शतानन्दो महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
hṛṣṭaromā mahātejāḥ śatānando mahātapāḥ

translations.english: Hearing the narration of the intelligent Viśvāmitra, Gautama's eldest son, the exceedingly energetic Śatänanda of rigid austerities, highly effulgent by virtue of his asceticism, with his down standing on end wondered greatly at the sight of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
स तौ निषण्णौ संप्रेक्ष्य सुखासीनौ नृपात्मजौ
शतानन्दो मुनिश्रेष्ठं विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tau niṣaṇṇau saṁprekṣya sukhāsīnau nṛpātmajau
śatānando muniśreṣṭhaṁ viśvāmitramathābravīt

translations.english: And seeing the king's sons seated at their ease, he said to that foremost of ascetics. Visvamitra.

verses.sanskrit:
अपि ते मुनिशार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी
दर्शिता राजपुत्राय तपो दीर्घमुपागता
verses.transliteration:
api te muniśārdūla mama mātā yaśasvinī
darśitā rājaputrāya tapo dīrghamupāgatā

translations.english: O most powerful of anchorets, by you was my illustrious mother, grown old in asceticism, shown to the king's son.

verses.sanskrit:
अपि रामे महातेजो मम माता यशस्विनी
वन्यैरुपाहरत्पूजां पूजार्हे सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
api rāme mahātejo mama mātā yaśasvinī
vanyairupāharatpūjāṁ pūjārhe sarvadehinām

translations.english: Did my famous and exalted mother entertain with the produce of the woods this one worthy of every one's homage?

verses.sanskrit:
अपि रामाय कथितं यथावृत्तं पुरातनम्
मम मातुर्महातेजो देवेन दुरनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
api rāmāya kathitaṁ yathāvṛttaṁ purātanam
mama māturmahātejo devena duranuṣṭhitam

translations.english: O highly energetic one, has that old story relative to my mother having been wronged by that celestial, been communicated to Rāma?

verses.sanskrit:
अपि कौशिक भद्रं ते गुरुणा मम संगता
माता मम मुनिश्रेष्ठ रामसंदर्शनादितः
verses.transliteration:
api kauśika bhadraṁ te guruṇā mama saṁgatā
mātā mama muniśreṣṭha rāmasaṁdarśanāditaḥ

translations.english: O Kausika good betide you, has my mother, in consequence of beholding Rāma, been united with my revered sire?

verses.sanskrit:
अपि मे गुरुणा रामः पूजितः कुशिकात्मज
इहागतो महातेजाः पूजां प्राप्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
api me guruṇā rāmaḥ pūjitaḥ kuśikātmaja
ihāgato mahātejāḥ pūjāṁ prāpya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: And, O son of Kusika, has the highly energetic Rāma come hither, after having been rendered homage by my high-souled revered sire?

verses.sanskrit:
अपि शान्तेन मनसा गुरुर्मे कुशिकात्मज
इहागतेन रामेण प्रयतेनाभिवादितः
verses.transliteration:
api śāntena manasā gururme kuśikātmaja
ihāgatena rāmeṇa prayatenābhivāditaḥ

translations.english: And, O Kusika's son, was my revered sire of quiescent soul, saluted by Rāma when he arrived there?

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
प्रत्युवाच शतानन्दं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
pratyuvāca śatānandaṁ vākyajño vākyakovidam

translations.english: Hearing those words of his, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, skilled in speech, replied to Śatānanda, cognizant of words, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
नातिक्रान्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत्कर्तव्यं कृतं मया
संगता मुनिना पत्नी भार्गवेणेव रेणुका
verses.transliteration:
nātikrāntaṁ muniśreṣṭha yatkartavyaṁ kṛtaṁ mayā
saṁgatā muninā patnī bhārgaveṇeva reṇukā

translations.english: O best of ascetics, nothing necessary was omitted by me, but everything has been done. And the ascetic's wife has been united with him, even as Renuka with Bhrgu's son. (Jamadagni, father of Paruśurāma).

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः
शतानन्दो महातेजा रामं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
śatānando mahātejā rāmaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing the speech of the intelligent Viśvāmitra, the exceedingly energetic Satānanda said to Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव
विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षिमपराजितम्
verses.transliteration:
svāgataṁ te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto'si rāghava
viśvāmitraṁ puraskṛtya maharṣimaparājitam

translations.english: Art you well come, O chief of men? It is by our luck that, O descendant of Raghu, you have come to us, headed by the respected Maharși Visvamitra.

verses.sanskrit:
अचिन्त्यकर्मा तपसा ब्रह्मर्षिरमितप्रभः
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वेत्स्येनं परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
acintyakarmā tapasā brahmarṣiramitaprabhaḥ
viśvāmitro mahātejā vetsyenaṁ paramāṁ gatim

translations.english: This highly energetic. Viśvāmitra, Brahmarşi is of prowess measureless; and deeds inconceivable, by virtue of his asceticism. Him you know as the prime way.

verses.sanskrit:
नास्ति धन्यतरो राम त्वत्तोऽन्यो भुवि कश्चन
गोप्ता कुशिकपुत्रस्ते येन तप्तं महत्तपः
verses.transliteration:
nāsti dhanyataro rāma tvatto'nyo bhuvi kaścana
goptā kuśikaputraste yena taptaṁ mahattapaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, there exist of this earth not one that is more fortunate than thyself. Your protector is even Kusika's descendant, by whom mighty austerities have been performed.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रूयतां चाभिदास्यामि कौशिकस्य महात्मनः
यथाबलं यथावृत्तं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration:
śrūyatāṁ cābhidāsyāmi kauśikasya mahātmanaḥ
yathābalaṁ yathāvṛttaṁ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu

translations.english: Do you listen as I faithfully describe to you the ascetic power of the high-souled Kausika.

verses.sanskrit:
राजाभूदेष धर्मात्मा दीर्घ कालमरिंदमः
धर्मज्ञः कृतविद्यश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः
verses.transliteration:
rājābhūdeṣa dharmātmā dīrgha kālamariṁdamaḥ
dharmajñaḥ kṛtavidyaśca prajānāṁ ca hite rataḥ

translations.english: Do you listen to me relating this. This righteous one was for a long time a king, subduing his enemies, cognizant of morality, accomplished, and intent upon the welfare of his subjects.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजापतिसुतस्त्वासीत्कुशो नाम महीपतिः
कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान्कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatisutastvāsītkuśo nāma mahīpatiḥ
kuśasya putro balavānkuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ

translations.english: And there was a king named Kuša, the son of Prajāpati. And Kuśa's son was the powerful and pious Kušanābha.

verses.sanskrit:
कुशनाभसुतस्त्वासीद्गाधिरित्येव विश्रुतः
गाधेः पुत्रो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration:
kuśanābhasutastvāsīdgādhirityeva viśrutaḥ
gādheḥ putro mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ

translations.english: And Kušanābha's son was Gadhi. And Gādhi's son is the highly energetic and mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वमित्रो महातेजाः पालयामास मेदिनीम्
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि राजा राज्यमकारयत्
verses.transliteration:
viśvamitro mahātejāḥ pālayāmāsa medinīm
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi rājā rājyamakārayat

translations.english: And that king reigned for thousands of years.

verses.sanskrit:
कदाचित्तु महातेजा योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम्
अक्षौहिणीपरिवृतः परिचक्राम मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
kadācittu mahātejā yojayitvā varūthinīm
akṣauhiṇīparivṛtaḥ paricakrāma medinīm

translations.english: And it came to pass that once with his four fold forces marshalled, he set out for ranging the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
स दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो विश्वामित्रो महाबलः
प्रणतो विनयाद्वीरो वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्
verses.transliteration:
sa dṛṣṭvā paramaprīto viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ
praṇato vinayādvīro vasiṣṭhaṁ japatāṁ varam

translations.english: Upon seeing that foremost of these reciting mantras, the highly powerful and heroic Viśvāmitra, exceedingly delighted, bowed to him in humility.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वागतं तव चेत्युक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
आसनं चास्य भगवान्वसिष्ठो व्यादिदेश ह
verses.transliteration:
svāgataṁ tava cetyukto vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā
āsanaṁ cāsya bhagavānvasiṣṭho vyādideśa ha

translations.english: Having enquired as to the pleasantness of Viśvāmitra's journey, the high-souled and adorable Vasiştha ordered a seat for the former.

verses.sanskrit:
उपविष्टाय च तदा विश्वामित्राय धीमते
यथान्यायं मुनिवरः फलमूलमुपाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
upaviṣṭāya ca tadā viśvāmitrāya dhīmate
yathānyāyaṁ munivaraḥ phalamūlamupāharat

translations.english: And on the intelligent Viśvāmitra having been seated, that best of ascetics properly entertained him with fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां वसिष्ठाद्राजसत्तमः
तपोऽग्निहोत्रशिष्येषु कुशलं पर्यपृच्छत
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya ca tāṁ pūjāṁ vasiṣṭhādrājasattamaḥ
tapo'gnihotraśiṣyeṣu kuśalaṁ paryapṛcchata

translations.english: And having accepted Vasiştha's hospitality, that foremost of monarchs, the exceedingly energetic Viśvāmitra then enquired of Vasiştha as to the welfare of his asceticism, his Agnihotras, and his disciples, and his trees. Thereupon Vasiştha of fierce austerities communicated the welfare of all to that best of king, Viśvāmitra, seated at his ease.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखोपविष्टं राजानं विश्वामित्रं महातपाः
पप्रच्छ जपतां श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठो ब्रह्मणः सुतः
verses.transliteration:
sukhopaviṣṭaṁ rājānaṁ viśvāmitraṁ mahātapāḥ
papraccha japatāṁ śreṣṭho vasiṣṭho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ

translations.english: Then Brahma's son, Vasistha, the best of those reciting mantras, asked Visvāmitra, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चित्ते कुशलं राजन्कच्चिद्धर्मेण रञ्जयन्
प्रजाः पालयसे राजन्राजवृत्तेन धार्मिक
verses.transliteration:
kaccitte kuśalaṁ rājankacciddharmeṇa rañjayan
prajāḥ pālayase rājanrājavṛttena dhārmika

translations.english: O king, is it well with you? And, O king, do you rule your subjects pleasing them consistently with morality?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चित्ते सुभृता भृत्याः कच्चित्तिष्ठन्ति शासने
कच्चित्ते विजिताः सर्वे रिपवो रिपुसूदन
verses.transliteration:
kaccitte subhṛtā bhṛtyāḥ kaccittiṣṭhanti śāsane
kaccitte vijitāḥ sarve ripavo ripusūdana

translations.english: O virtuous one, are your retainers maintained on salaries from the kingdom? Do they abode by your mandates? And, O destroyer of foes, hast you vanquished your enemies?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिद्बले च कोशे च मित्रेषु च परंतप
कुशलं ते नरव्याघ्र पुत्रपौत्रे तथानघ
verses.transliteration:
kaccidbale ca kośe ca mitreṣu ca paraṁtapa
kuśalaṁ te naravyāghra putrapautre tathānagha

translations.english: And O repressor of foes, is it well with you as to, O most powerful of men, your forces; exchequer, and friends, and, O sinless one, sons and grandsons?'

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वत्र कुशलं राजा वसिष्ठं प्रत्युदाहरत्
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वसिष्ठं विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration:
sarvatra kuśalaṁ rājā vasiṣṭhaṁ pratyudāharat
viśvāmitro mahātejā vasiṣṭhaṁ vinayānvitaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the highly powerful king, Viśvāmitra, with humility communicated to Vasiștha his complete welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
कृत्वोभौ सुचिरं कालं धर्मिष्ठौ ताः कथाः शुभाः
मुदा परमया युक्तौ प्रीयेतां तौ परस्परम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtvobhau suciraṁ kālaṁ dharmiṣṭhau tāḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ
mudā paramayā yuktau prīyetāṁ tau parasparam

translations.english: Having conversed for a long time, those virtuous ones, experiencing exceeding joy, ministered to each other's delight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वसिष्ठो भगवान्कथान्ते रघुनन्दन
विश्वामित्रमिदं वाक्यमुवाच प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration:
tato vasiṣṭho bhagavānkathānte raghunandana
viśvāmitramidaṁ vākyamuvāca prahasanniva

translations.english: Then, O descendant of Raghu, after the conversation had ended, the adorable Vasiştha, smiling, addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि बलस्यास्य महाबल
तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य यथार्हं संप्रतीच्छ मे
verses.transliteration:
ātithyaṁ kartumicchāmi balasyāsya mahābala
tava caivāprameyasya yathārhaṁ saṁpratīccha me

translations.english: O highly powerful one, I desire to properly entertain you of immeasurable power, as well as your forces, do you, therefore, accept my hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्क्रियां तु भवानेतां प्रतीच्छतु मयोद्यताम्
राजंस्त्वमतिथिश्रेष्ठः पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration:
satkriyāṁ tu bhavānetāṁ pratīcchatu mayodyatām
rājaṁstvamatithiśreṣṭhaḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ

translations.english: Do you receive the hospitality which I extend to you. O king, you are the foremost of guests, and art worthy of assiduous homage.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रो महामतिः
कृतमित्यब्रवीद्राजा पूजावाक्येन मे त्वया
verses.transliteration:
evamukto vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitro mahāmatiḥ
kṛtamityabravīdrājā pūjāvākyena me tvayā

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Vasiştha, that mighty ascetic, king Viśvāmitra; said, 'Even by this word of your relative to receiving me, hast you in fact done so.'

verses.sanskrit:
फलमूलेन भगवन्विद्यते यत्तवाश्रमे
पाद्येनाचमनीयेन भगवद्दर्शनेन च
verses.transliteration:
phalamūlena bhagavanvidyate yattavāśrame
pādyenācamanīyena bhagavaddarśanena ca

translations.english: And, O worshipful one, even with the fruits and roots that are in your asylum, with the water for washing my feet, and for sipping, you, with the sight of your revered self, have I been.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा च महाप्राज्ञ पूजार्हेण सुपूजितः
गमिष्यामि नमस्तेऽस्तु मैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā ca mahāprājña pūjārheṇa supūjitaḥ
gamiṣyāmi namaste'stu maitreṇekṣasva cakṣuṣā

translations.english: O profoundly wise one, excellently entertained by you, who art yourself worthy of homage. I how to you. I will go now. Do you regard me with a friendly eye.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानं वसिष्ठः पुनरेव हि
न्यमन्त्रयत धर्मात्मा पुनः पुनरुदारधीः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvantaṁ rājānaṁ vasiṣṭhaḥ punareva hi
nyamantrayata dharmātmā punaḥ punarudāradhīḥ

translations.english: As the king was speaking thus, the righteous souled and generous Vasiştha again and again pressed him to accept his hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
बाढमित्येव गाधेयो वसिष्ठं प्रत्युवाच ह
यथा प्रियं भगवतस्तथास्तु मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
bāḍhamityeva gādheyo vasiṣṭhaṁ pratyuvāca ha
yathā priyaṁ bhagavatastathāstu munisattama

translations.english: Then Gadhi's son answered Vasistha, Very well. O potent ascetic, let that be which find favour in your sight.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः
आजुहाव ततः प्रीतः कल्माषीं धूतकल्मषः
verses.transliteration:
evamukto mahātejā vasiṣṭho japatāṁ varaḥ
ājuhāva tataḥ prītaḥ kalmāṣīṁ dhūtakalmaṣaḥ

translations.english: This having been said by him, Vasistha, the best of those reciting mantras, joyfully called his sacrificial dappled cow, capable of purging away sins.

verses.sanskrit:
एह्येहि शबले क्षिप्रं शृणु चापि वचो मम
सबलस्यास्य राजर्षेः कर्तुं व्यवसितोऽस्म्यहम्
भोजनेन महार्हेण सत्कारं संविधत्स्व मे
verses.transliteration:
ehyehi śabale kṣipraṁ śṛṇu cāpi vaco mama
sabalasyāsya rājarṣeḥ kartuṁ vyavasito'smyaham
bhojanena mahārheṇa satkāraṁ saṁvidhatsva me

translations.english: O Śabala! do you come soon; and hear my words. I intend to entertain this royal saint together with his forces. Do you enable me to entertain him, by yielding excellent viands.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य यस्य यथाकामं षड्रसेष्वभिपूजितम्
तत्सर्वं कामधुग्दिव्ये अभिवर्षकृते मम
verses.transliteration:
yasya yasya yathākāmaṁ ṣaḍraseṣvabhipūjitam
tatsarvaṁ kāmadhugdivye abhivarṣakṛte mama

translations.english: And, O divine one, O you that confer everything that is desired, do you grant everyone whatever be ask among edibles impregnated with the six tastes.

verses.sanskrit:
रसेनान्नेन पानेन लेह्यचोष्येण संयुतम्
अन्नानां निचयं सर्वं सृजस्व शबले त्वर
verses.transliteration:
rasenānnena pānena lehyacoṣyeṇa saṁyutam
annānāṁ nicayaṁ sarvaṁ sṛjasva śabale tvara

translations.english: And do you, O Śabala, speedily create sapid viands to be chewed, sucked, licked, or drunk.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन शबला शत्रुसूदन
विदधे कामधुक्कामान्यस्य यस्य यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā vasiṣṭhena śabalā śatrusūdana
vidadhe kāmadhukkāmānyasya yasya yathepsitam

translations.english: Thus addressed by Vasiştha, that bestower of all that was desired, Sabala, O destroyer of your foes, brought forth everything that was desired by everyone.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमासीत्सुसंतुष्टं हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलम्
विश्वामित्रबलं राम वसिष्ठेनाभितर्पितम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvamāsītsusaṁtuṣṭaṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākulam
viśvāmitrabalaṁ rāma vasiṣṭhenābhitarpitam

translations.english: And, O Rāma, the tarry of Viśvāmitra being superbly entertained by Vasiştha, heartily filled, became exceedingly gratified.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि राजर्षिर्हृष्टपुष्टस्तदाभवत्
सान्तः पुरवरो राजा सब्राह्मणपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitro'pi rājarṣirhṛṣṭapuṣṭastadābhavat
sāntaḥ puravaro rājā sabrāhmaṇapurohitaḥ

translations.english: And the royal saint, Viśvāmitra himself, together with the priests and Brāhmaṇas and the inmates of the inner apartment, was also heartily filled.

verses.sanskrit:
सामात्यो मन्त्रिसहितः सभृत्यः पूजितस्तदा
युक्तः परेण हर्षेण वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sāmātyo mantrisahitaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ pūjitastadā
yuktaḥ pareṇa harṣeṇa vasiṣṭhamidamabravīt

translations.english: And being hospitably entertained with his courtiers and counsellors and retainers, he, exceedingly de-lighted, spoke to Vasistha, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पूजितोऽहं त्वया ब्रह्मन्पूजार्हेण सुसत्कृतः
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि वाक्यं वाक्यविशारद
verses.transliteration:
pūjito'haṁ tvayā brahmanpūjārheṇa susatkṛtaḥ
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi vākyaṁ vākyaviśārada

translations.english: Received and excellently entertained have I been by you, O Brāhmaṇa, who thyself art worthy of being honoured. Do you, O you conversant with speech, listen to me. I will tell you a word.

verses.sanskrit:
गवां शतसहस्रेण दीयतां शबला मम
रत्नं हि भगवन्नेतद्रत्नहारी च पार्थिवः
तस्मान्मे शबलां देहि ममैषा धर्मतो द्विज
verses.transliteration:
gavāṁ śatasahasreṇa dīyatāṁ śabalā mama
ratnaṁ hi bhagavannetadratnahārī ca pārthivaḥ
tasmānme śabalāṁ dehi mamaiṣā dharmato dvija

translations.english: Do you bestow on me Śabala for an hundred thousand kine. O worshipful one, verily this one is a jewel; and as it is the function of kings to acquire jewels, do you confer on me Śabala; for, O twice-born one, this one by right belongs to me.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान्वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः
विश्वामित्रेण धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu bhagavānvasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ
viśvāmitreṇa dharmātmā pratyuvāca mahīpatim

translations.english: Thus addressed by Viśvāmitra, the righteous and adorable Vasiştha best of ascetics, replied to that lord of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं शतसहस्रेण नापि कोटिशतैर्गवाम्
राजन्दास्यामि शबलां राशिभी रजतस्य वा
verses.transliteration:
nāhaṁ śatasahasreṇa nāpi koṭiśatairgavām
rājandāsyāmi śabalāṁ rāśibhī rajatasya vā

translations.english: O king, neither for an hundred thousand nor for an hundred Koți of kine, nor yet for heaps of silver, will I part with Sabala. O subduer of enemies, this one deserves not to be separated from my side.

verses.sanskrit:
न परित्यागमर्हेयं मत्सकाशादरिंदम
शाश्वती शबला मह्यं कीर्तिरात्मवतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
na parityāgamarheyaṁ matsakāśādariṁdama
śāśvatī śabalā mahyaṁ kīrtirātmavato yathā

translations.english: Even like to the fame of the mighty, this Śabala is ever joined with me. my oblations to the gods and the Pitrs as well as my subsistence itself are established even in her. And my Agnihotras, (Maintenance of the perpetual fire). bali, (Offering to the spirits of air) and Homa (Burnt offerings) depend upper her.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ विद्याश्च विविधास्तथा
आयत्तमत्र राजर्षे सर्वमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau vidyāśca vividhāstathā
āyattamatra rājarṣe sarvametanna saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: And, O royal saint, my Svahākāras and Vasaſkāras* as well as my various lore depend upon her. *Sacrifice performed with the exclamation of svadhả and Vașat respectively.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्व स्वमेतत्सत्येन मम तुष्टिकरी सदा
कारणैर्बहुभी राजन्न दास्ये शबलां तव
verses.transliteration:
sarva svametatsatyena mama tuṣṭikarī sadā
kāraṇairbahubhī rājanna dāsye śabalāṁ tava

translations.english: All this is so: there is no doubt about it. Verily she is my all; and in her do I find my delight. And many are the reasons, O king, why I cannot give to you Sabala.'

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठेनैवमुक्तस्तु विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीत्ततः
संरब्धतरमत्यर्थं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhenaivamuktastu viśvāmitro'bravīttataḥ
saṁrabdhataramatyarthaṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed by Vasiștha, that one versed in speech, Viśvāmitra, eagerly rejoined.

verses.sanskrit:
हैरण्यकक्ष्याग्रैवेयान्सुवर्णाङ्कुशभूषितान्
ददामि कुञ्जराणां ते सहस्राणि चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration:
hairaṇyakakṣyāgraiveyānsuvarṇāṅkuśabhūṣitān
dadāmi kuñjarāṇāṁ te sahasrāṇi caturdaśa

translations.english: I shall confer upon you fourteen thousand elephants decked in gold chains and gold neckornaments and hooks.

verses.sanskrit:
हैरण्यानां रथानां च श्वेताश्वानां चतुर्युजाम्
ददामि ते शतान्यष्टौ किङ्किणीकविभूषितान्
verses.transliteration:
hairaṇyānāṁ rathānāṁ ca śvetāśvānāṁ caturyujām
dadāmi te śatānyaṣṭau kiṅkiṇīkavibhūṣitān

translations.english: I will confer upon you cight hundred golden cars furnished with bells and reins, and each yoked with four white horses; and, O you of auspicious vows, I will confer upon you one thousand and ten high-mettled horses of noble breeds, and I will confer upon you a koți of youthful and variegated kine, do you grant to me Sabala.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान्विश्वामित्रेण धीमता
न दास्यामीति शबलां प्राह राजन्कथंचन
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu bhagavānviśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā
na dāsyāmīti śabalāṁ prāha rājankathaṁcana

translations.english: Thus besought by the intelligent Viśvāmitra, that adorable one replied, saying, 'Oking, Śabala I will not by any means give.'

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शश्च पूर्णमासश्च यज्ञाश्चैवाप्तदक्षिणाः
एतदेव हि मे राजन्विविधाश्च क्रियास्तथा
verses.transliteration:
darśaśca pūrṇamāsaśca yajñāścaivāptadakṣiṇāḥ
etadeva hi me rājanvividhāśca kriyāstathā

translations.english: This is verily my jewel: this is verily my riches: this is verily my all: this is verily my subsistence. And this is my Darsa,* Gifts to Brāhmaṇas on occasions of sacrifice. and this my Paurnamäsa, and this my various sacrifices with dakşiņās; and, O king, this my various rites. *Bi-monthly sacrifice, performed at change of the moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire. A ceremony performed at the full moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire.

verses.sanskrit:
अदोमूलाः क्रियाः सर्वा मम राजन्न संशयः
बहूनां किं प्रलापेन न दास्ये कामदोहिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
adomūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā mama rājanna saṁśayaḥ
bahūnāṁ kiṁ pralāpena na dāsye kāmadohinīm

translations.english: This, O king, is without doubt, the root of all my rites. And what need of dilating? This one bestowing everything that is desired will I not part with.

verses.sanskrit:
कामधेनुं वसिष्ठोऽपि यदा न त्यजते मुनिः
तदास्य शबलां राम विश्वामित्रोऽन्वकर्षत
verses.transliteration:
kāmadhenuṁ vasiṣṭho'pi yadā na tyajate muniḥ
tadāsya śabalāṁ rāma viśvāmitro'nvakarṣata

translations.english: When the ascetic Vasiștha would not part with the cow of plenty then Viśvāmitra, O Rāma, forced Śabala away.

verses.sanskrit:
नीयमाना तु शबला राम राज्ञा महात्मना
दुःखिता चिन्तयामास रुदन्ती शोककर्शिता
verses.transliteration:
nīyamānā tu śabalā rāma rājñā mahātmanā
duḥkhitā cintayāmāsa rudantī śokakarśitā

translations.english: And, O Rāma, carried away by that highsouled king, ſabala, stricken with grief and afflicted with sorrow, bethought herself, weeping.

verses.sanskrit:
परित्यक्ता वसिष्ठेन किमहं सुमहात्मना
याहं राजभृतैर्दीना ह्रियेयं भृशदुःखिता
verses.transliteration:
parityaktā vasiṣṭhena kimahaṁ sumahātmanā
yāhaṁ rājabhṛtairdīnā hriyeyaṁ bhṛśaduḥkhitā

translations.english: Have I been forsaken by the high-souled Vasiştha that the royal retainers carry me off thus aggrieved?

verses.sanskrit:
किं मयापकृतं तस्य महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः
यन्मामनागसं भक्तामिष्टां त्यजति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ mayāpakṛtaṁ tasya maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ
yanmāmanāgasaṁ bhaktāmiṣṭāṁ tyajati dhārmikaḥ

translations.english: What wrong have I done to that mighty ascetic of concentrated spirit, that, knowing me to be faultless, that righteous one leave her that was devoted to his service?'

verses.sanskrit:
इति सा चिन्तयित्वा तु निःश्वस्य च पुनः पुनः
जगाम वेगेन तदा वसिष्ठं परमौजसं
verses.transliteration:
iti sā cintayitvā tu niḥśvasya ca punaḥ punaḥ
jagāma vegena tadā vasiṣṭhaṁ paramaujasaṁ

translations.english: Revolving this in her mind and sighing again and again she darted to where the pre-eminently energetic Vasiştha was; and cutting off those servants (of the king),5

verses.sanskrit:
शबला सा रुदन्ती च क्रोशन्ती चेदमब्रवीत्
वसिष्ठस्याग्रतः स्थित्वा मेघदुन्दुभिराविणी
verses.transliteration:
śabalā sā rudantī ca krośantī cedamabravīt
vasiṣṭhasyāgrataḥ sthitvā meghadundubhirāviṇī

translations.english: She with the speed of the wind, appeared at the feet of that high-souled one. And weeping, she spoke in distressful accents.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्किं परित्यक्ता त्वयाहं ब्रह्मणः सुत
यस्माद्राजभृता मां हि नयन्ते त्वत्सकाशतः
verses.transliteration:
bhagavankiṁ parityaktā tvayāhaṁ brahmaṇaḥ suta
yasmādrājabhṛtā māṁ hi nayante tvatsakāśataḥ

translations.english: O Brahma's son, wherefore have I been forsaken by you, that the servants of the king were carrying me from off your presence?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
शोकसंतप्तहृदयां स्वसारमिव दुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu brahmarṣiridaṁ vacanamabravīt
śokasaṁtaptahṛdayāṁ svasāramiva duḥkhitām

translations.english: Thus addressed the Brahmarși said these words to that one aggrieved, and of heart afflicted with sorrow, and like to a sister.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वां त्यजामि शबले नापि मेऽपकृतं त्वया
एष त्वां नयते राजा बलान्मत्तो महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
na tvāṁ tyajāmi śabale nāpi me'pakṛtaṁ tvayā
eṣa tvāṁ nayate rājā balānmatto mahābalaḥ

translations.english: O Śabala, not that I forsake you; nor hast you done me any wrong. But this mighty king proud of his prowess has been carrying you away.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि तुल्यं बलं मह्यं राजा त्वद्य विशेषतः
बली राजा क्षत्रियश्च पृथिव्याः पतिरेव च
verses.transliteration:
na hi tulyaṁ balaṁ mahyaṁ rājā tvadya viśeṣataḥ
balī rājā kṣatriyaśca pṛthivyāḥ patireva ca

translations.english: Surely, my strength is not equal to his. More specially, he is a king, a powerful king, more particularly, this day he should not be slain by me (inasmuch as he is my guest): he is a Ks atriya and lord of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
इयमक्षौहिणीपूर्णा सवाजिरथसंकुला
हस्तिध्वजसमाकीर्णा तेनासौ बलवत्तरः
verses.transliteration:
iyamakṣauhiṇīpūrṇā savājirathasaṁkulā
hastidhvajasamākīrṇā tenāsau balavattaraḥ

translations.english: And he is foremost in might by virtue of possessing this entire Akşohiņi abounding in elephants and horses and cars and standards.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत्
वचनं वचनज्ञा सा ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā vasiṣṭhena pratyuvāca vinītavat
vacanaṁ vacanajñā sā brahmarṣimamitaprabham

translations.english: Thus addressed by Vasistha, that cognizant of words humbly said in reply to that Brahmarși of incomparable power.

verses.sanskrit:
न बलं क्षत्रियस्याहुर्ब्राह्मणो बलवत्तरः
ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मबलं दिव्यं क्षत्रात्तु बलवत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
na balaṁ kṣatriyasyāhurbrāhmaṇo balavattaraḥ
brahmanbrahmabalaṁ divyaṁ kṣatrāttu balavattaram

translations.english: The might of the Kșatriyas is not great, the Brāhmaṇas are more mighty than they. O Brāhmaṇa, super-human is the power of the Brāhmaṇas, excelling that of the Kşatriyas.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रमेयबलं तुभ्यं न त्वया बलवत्तरः
विश्वामित्रो महावीर्यस्तेजस्तव दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration:
aprameyabalaṁ tubhyaṁ na tvayā balavattaraḥ
viśvāmitro mahāvīryastejastava durāsadam

translations.english: Your power is immeasurable; and the exceedingly energetic Viśvāmitra is not more one powerful than thyself. Your energy is unequalled.

verses.sanskrit:
नियुङ्क्ष्व मां महातेजस्त्वद्ब्रह्मबलसंभृताम्
तस्य दर्पं बलं यत्तन्नाशयामि दुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
niyuṅkṣva māṁ mahātejastvadbrahmabalasaṁbhṛtām
tasya darpaṁ balaṁ yattannāśayāmi durātmanaḥ

translations.english: O highly energetic one, do you command me bursting with Brahmā forces: the pride, power and endeavours of that wicked one will I bring down.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तस्तु तया राम वसिष्ठः सुमहायशाः
सृजस्वेति तदोवाच बलं परबलारुजम्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktastu tayā rāma vasiṣṭhaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ
sṛjasveti tadovāca balaṁ parabalārujam

translations.english: Thus accosted by her, the highly famous Vasistha, O Rama, said, 'Create you forces capable of crushing the forces of the enemy.'

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तानाकुलान्दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रास्त्रमोहितान्
वसिष्ठश्चोदयामास कामधुक्सृज योगतः
verses.transliteration:
tatastānākulāndṛṣṭvā viśvāmitrāstramohitān
vasiṣṭhaścodayāmāsa kāmadhuksṛja yogataḥ

translations.english: And beholding them sore harassed, and overwhelmed by Visvāmitra's weapons, Vasistha directed (Sabala) saying, 'o cow of plenty, do you create (fresh troops), through your Yoga power.'

verses.sanskrit:
योनिदेशाच्च यवनः शकृद्देशाच्छकास्तथा
रोमकूपेषु मेच्छाश्च हरीताः सकिरातकाः
verses.transliteration:
yonideśācca yavanaḥ śakṛddeśācchakāstathā
romakūpeṣu mecchāśca harītāḥ sakirātakāḥ

translations.english: And from her roar, there came into being Kamvojas, resembling the Sun. And from her udders sprang Barbaras, arms in hand; and from her mysterious parts, Yavanas; from her anus, Sakas; and from the pores of her skin, those barbarians, Hārītas and Kirātas.

verses.sanskrit:
तैस्तन्निषूदितं सैन्यं विश्वमित्रस्य तत्क्षणात्
सपदातिगजं साश्वं सरथं रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
taistanniṣūditaṁ sainyaṁ viśvamitrasya tatkṣaṇāt
sapadātigajaṁ sāśvaṁ sarathaṁ raghunandana

translations.english: And, (descendant of Raghu, Viśvāmitra's entire host consisting of foot, and elephant, and horse, and car, was exterminated by them.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा निषूदितं सैन्यं वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
विश्वामित्रसुतानां तु शतं नानाविधायुधम्
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā niṣūditaṁ sainyaṁ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā
viśvāmitrasutānāṁ tu śataṁ nānāvidhāyudham

translations.english: Seeing the army annihilated by the highsouled Vasiştha, the hundred sons of Viśvāmitra, equipped with various weapons, rushed in high ire against that best of mantra-reciting ones. Thereupon, uttering a roar, that mighty ascetic consumed them quite.

verses.sanskrit:
ते साश्वरथपादाता वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
भस्मीकृता मुहूर्तेन विश्वामित्रसुतास्तदा
verses.transliteration:
te sāśvarathapādātā vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā
bhasmīkṛtā muhūrtena viśvāmitrasutāstadā

translations.english: In a moment, Viśvāmitra's sons together with horse and car and foot were reduced to ashes by the high-souled Vasistha.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा विनाशितान्पुत्रान्बलं च सुमहायशाः
सव्रीडश्चिन्तयाविष्टो विश्वामित्रोऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā vināśitānputrānbalaṁ ca sumahāyaśāḥ
savrīḍaścintayāviṣṭo viśvāmitro'bhavattadā

translations.english: And witnessing them all destroyed, together with the army, the illustrious Viśvāmitra, covered with shame, became plunged in thought.

verses.sanskrit:
संदुर इव निर्वेगो भग्नदंष्ट्र इवोरगः
उपरक्त इवादित्यः सद्यो निष्प्रभतां गतः
verses.transliteration:
saṁdura iva nirvego bhagnadaṁṣṭra ivoragaḥ
uparakta ivādityaḥ sadyo niṣprabhatāṁ gataḥ

translations.english: And like to a tideless ocean or a fangless snake, he instantly became shorn of his effulgence, like to the sun overwhelmed by Rahu.* *A Daitya with the tail of a dragon, whose head was served from his body by Vişnu; but being immortal, the head and tail retained their separate existence, and being transferred to the stellar sphere, became the author of eclipses.

verses.sanskrit:
हतपुत्रबलो दीनो लूनपक्ष इव द्विजः
हतदर्पो हतोत्साहो निर्वेदं समपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
hataputrabalo dīno lūnapakṣa iva dvijaḥ
hatadarpo hatotsāho nirvedaṁ samapadyata

translations.english: And deprived of his forces and sons, he appeared like a bird bereft of its wings; and losing his entire army and with it the high spirits that it had inspired him with, his heart died within him.

verses.sanskrit:
स पुत्रमेकं राज्याय पालयेति नियुज्य च
पृथिवीं क्षत्रधर्मेण वनमेवान्वपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
sa putramekaṁ rājyāya pālayeti niyujya ca
pṛthivīṁ kṣatradharmeṇa vanamevānvapadyata

translations.english: Then entrusting one of his (remaining) sons with the sovereignty, with, 'Do you rule the earth agree ably to the duties of the Kșatriya,' he went into the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा हिमवत्पार्श्वं किंनरोरगसेवितम्
महादेवप्रसादार्थं तपस्तेपे महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā himavatpārśvaṁ kiṁnaroragasevitam
mahādevaprasādārthaṁ tapastepe mahātapāḥ

translations.english: And repairing to the side of the Himavat inhabited by Kinnaras and Serpents that one of mighty asceticism began to perform austerities with the view of propitiating Mahādeva.

verses.sanskrit:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन देवेशो वृषभध्वजः
दर्शयामास वरदो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration:
kenacittvatha kālena deveśo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
darśayāmāsa varado viśvāmitraṁ mahāmunim

translations.english: On a certain occasion the lord of the celestials, Vrsadhvaja,* intending to confer a boon, appeared before a mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra. *An appellation of Śiva: meaning who has the bull for his vehicle.

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं तप्यसे राजन्ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम्
वरदोऽस्मि वरो यस्ते काङ्क्षितः सोऽभिधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ tapyase rājanbrūhi yatte vivakṣitam
varado'smi varo yaste kāṅkṣitaḥ so'bhidhīyatām

translations.english: What for, O king, art you performing penance?. Do you unfold what you have to say. I am for conferring a boon: do you express what boon you would obtain.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन विश्वामित्रो महातपाः
प्रणिपत्य महादेवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu devena viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
praṇipatya mahādevamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed by that god, that performer of mighty austerities, Viśvāmitra, bowing down to him, addressed him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि तुष्टो महादेव धनुर्वेदो ममानघ
साङ्गोपाङ्गोपनिषदः सरहस्यः प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva dhanurvedo mamānagha
sāṅgopāṅgopaniṣadaḥ sarahasyaḥ pradīyatām

translations.english: If, O mighty god, you are pleased (with me), do you confer upon me the science of archery with all its mysteries and mantras, as well as its virtues of helping from far and near.

verses.sanskrit:
यानि देवेषु चास्त्राणि दानवेषु महर्षिषु
गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षःसु प्रतिभान्तु ममानघ
verses.transliteration:
yāni deveṣu cāstrāṇi dānaveṣu maharṣiṣu
gandharvayakṣarakṣaḥsu pratibhāntu mamānagha

translations.english: O sinless one, may all those weapons that are with the celestials and the Dānavas and the Maharșis and the Gandharvas and the Yakşas and the Rākşasa, shine on me! May this my desire be granted me through your grace, O god of gods!

verses.sanskrit:
तव प्रसादाद्भवतु देवदेव ममेप्सितम्
एवमस्त्विति देवेशो वाक्यमुक्त्वा दिवं गतः
verses.transliteration:
tava prasādādbhavatu devadeva mamepsitam
evamastviti deveśo vākyamuktvā divaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: Thereupon, saying, 'Be it so' the lord of the celestials vanished. And obtaining the arms from the lord of the celestials, the mighty Viśvāmitra, naturally haughty, became swelled with insolence.

verses.sanskrit:
विवर्धमानो वीर्येण समुद्र इव पर्वणि
हतमेव तदा मेने वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
vivardhamāno vīryeṇa samudra iva parvaṇi
hatameva tadā mene vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam

translations.english: Surcharged with energy, like to the sea during the equinox, he considered, O Rāma, as if that foremost of saints, Vasistha, was already slain.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गत्वाश्रमपदं मुमोचास्त्राणि पार्थिवः
यैस्तत्तपोवनं सर्वं निर्दग्धं चास्त्रतेजसा
verses.transliteration:
tato gatvāśramapadaṁ mumocāstrāṇi pārthivaḥ
yaistattapovanaṁ sarvaṁ nirdagdhaṁ cāstratejasā

translations.english: And repairing to Vasistha's asylum, the king began to discharge weapons; and by their energy the hermitage began to burn.

verses.sanskrit:
उदीर्यमाणमस्त्रं तद्विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः
दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुता भीता मुनयः शतशो दिशः
verses.transliteration:
udīryamāṇamastraṁ tadviśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
dṛṣṭvā vipradrutā bhītā munayaḥ śataśo diśaḥ

translations.english: Beholding those weapons discharged by the intelligent Viśvāmitra, the ascetics, overtaken by fear, by hundreds began to fly.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठस्य च ये शिष्यास्तथैव मृगपक्षिणः
विद्रवन्ति भयाद्भीता नानादिग्भ्यः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhasya ca ye śiṣyāstathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
vidravanti bhayādbhītā nānādigbhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ

translations.english: Vasiştha's disciples as well as the animals and birds inhabiting there, fled in all direction by thousands.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं शून्यमासीन्महात्मनः
मुहूर्तमिव निःशब्दमासीदीरिणसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhasyāśramapadaṁ śūnyamāsīnmahātmanaḥ
muhūrtamiva niḥśabdamāsīdīriṇasaṁnibham

translations.english: For a time the hermitage of the high souled Vasiştha was bare of living beings, and still like to a wilderness.

verses.sanskrit:
वदतो वै वसिष्ठस्य मा भैष्टेति मुहुर्मुहुः
नाशयाम्यद्य गाधेयं नीहारमिव भास्करः
verses.transliteration:
vadato vai vasiṣṭhasya mā bhaiṣṭeti muhurmuhuḥ
nāśayāmyadya gādheyaṁ nīhāramiva bhāskaraḥ

translations.english: And Vasistha cried momentarily, 'Do not fear. To day will I slay Gadhi's son, even as the sun (destroys) mist.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः
विश्वामित्रं तदा वाक्यं सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejā vasiṣṭho japatāṁ varaḥ
viśvāmitraṁ tadā vākyaṁ saroṣamidamabravīt

translations.english: Having said this, that best of mantra reciting ones, Vasistha, in high wrath, addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
आश्रमं चिरसंवृद्धं यद्विनाशितवानसि
दुराचारोऽसि यन्मूढ तस्मात्त्वं न भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
āśramaṁ cirasaṁvṛddhaṁ yadvināśitavānasi
durācāro'si yanmūḍha tasmāttvaṁ na bhaviṣyasi

translations.english: Since, O fool, you have destroyed this hermitage that had been prospering for a long time, you of execrable ways shall not live long.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धो दण्डमुद्यम्य सत्वरः
विधूम इव कालाग्निर्यमदण्डमिवापरम्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā paramakruddho daṇḍamudyamya satvaraḥ
vidhūma iva kālāgniryamadaṇḍamivāparam

translations.english: Saying this, he, transported with wrath, and like the smoking flame at at universal dissolution, speedily upraised a staff resembling another mace of Yama itself.' to

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रो महाबलः
आग्नेयमस्त्रमुत्क्षिप्य तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamukto vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ
āgneyamastramutkṣipya tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed by Vasiştha, the mighty Viśvāmitra, aiming a fiery weapon, said, 'Stay! Stay!'

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो भगवान्क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho bhagavānkrodhādidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: The worshipful Vasiştha also on his part, raising a Brahmā staff resembling another staff of Kala, exclaimed in wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षत्रबन्धो स्थितोऽस्म्येष यद्बलं तद्विदर्शय
नाशयाम्येष ते दर्पं शस्त्रस्य तव गाधिज
verses.transliteration:
kṣatrabandho sthito'smyeṣa yadbalaṁ tadvidarśaya
nāśayāmyeṣa te darpaṁ śastrasya tava gādhija

translations.english: Wretch of a Kșatriya! here am I, do you display the might you are master of. To-day, O Gādhi's son, will I humble your pride of arms.

verses.sanskrit:
क्व च ते क्षत्रियबलं क्व च ब्रह्मबलं महत्
पश्य ब्रह्मबलं दिव्यं मम क्षत्रियपांसन
verses.transliteration:
kva ca te kṣatriyabalaṁ kva ca brahmabalaṁ mahat
paśya brahmabalaṁ divyaṁ mama kṣatriyapāṁsana

translations.english: You disgrace of the race, where is your Kș atriya might, and where my high Brahmä energy? Do you behold my superhuman Brahmā energy.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्त्रं गाधिपुत्रस्य घोरमाग्नेयमुत्तमम्
ब्रह्मदण्डेन तच्छान्तमग्नेर्वेग इवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstraṁ gādhiputrasya ghoramāgneyamuttamam
brahmadaṇḍena tacchāntamagnervega ivāmbhasā

translations.english: And even as water ally the fierceness of a flame, the Brahmā staff quenched the energy of the powerful fiery weapon discharged by Gadhi's Son.

verses.sanskrit:
वारुणं चैव रौद्रं च ऐन्द्रं पाशुपतं तथा
ऐषीकं चापि चिक्षेप रुषितो गाधिनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
vāruṇaṁ caiva raudraṁ ca aindraṁ pāśupataṁ tathā
aiṣīkaṁ cāpi cikṣepa ruṣito gādhinandanaḥ

translations.english: Then Gādhi's son, waxing wroth, discharged Vāruņa and Raudra and Aindra and Pāśupata and Aișika weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषु शान्तेषु ब्रह्मास्त्रं क्षिप्तवान्गाधिनन्दनः
तदस्त्रमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
teṣu śānteṣu brahmāstraṁ kṣiptavāngādhinandanaḥ
tadastramudyataṁ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ

translations.english: And on those (weapons) being resisted, the son of Gadhi hurled a Brahm, weapon. And on that weapon being discharged the deities with Agni at their head, and the Devarsis, and the Gandharvas, and the mighty Serpents, became afflicted with fear. And on that Brahm, weapon being discharged, all the three worlds became exceedingly alarmed.

verses.sanskrit:
तदप्यस्त्रं महाघोरं ब्राह्मं ब्राह्मेण तेजसा
वसिष्ठो ग्रसते सर्वं ब्रह्मदण्डेन राघव
verses.transliteration:
tadapyastraṁ mahāghoraṁ brāhmaṁ brāhmeṇa tejasā
vasiṣṭho grasate sarvaṁ brahmadaṇḍena rāghava

translations.english: O Raghu's descendant, Vasistha by virtue of his Brahmā energy completely baffled that terrible Brahmā weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मास्त्रं ग्रसमानस्य वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः
त्रैलोक्यमोहनं रौद्रं रूपमासीत्सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
brahmāstraṁ grasamānasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ
trailokyamohanaṁ raudraṁ rūpamāsītsudāruṇam

translations.english: When the high-souled Vasiştha had baffled the Brahmă weapon, his form the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
रोमकूपेषु सर्वेषु वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः
मरीच्य इव निष्पेतुरग्नेर्धूमाकुलार्चिषः
verses.transliteration:
romakūpeṣu sarveṣu vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ
marīcya iva niṣpeturagnerdhūmākulārciṣaḥ

translations.english: And from the pores of his body, resembling a smoking flame, darted out scintillation's of fire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राज्वलद्ब्रह्मदण्डश्च वसिष्ठस्य करोद्यतः
विधूम इव कालाग्निर्यमदण्ड इवापरः
verses.transliteration:
prājvaladbrahmadaṇḍaśca vasiṣṭhasya karodyataḥ
vidhūma iva kālāgniryamadaṇḍa ivāparaḥ

translations.english: And resembling another staff of Yama, the Brahmā staff raised by Vasiştha's arm flamed like to the fire at the universal dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽस्तुवन्मुनिगणा वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्
अमोघं ते बलं ब्रह्मंस्तेजो धारय तेजसा
verses.transliteration:
tato'stuvanmunigaṇā vasiṣṭhaṁ japatāṁ varam
amoghaṁ te balaṁ brahmaṁstejo dhāraya tejasā

translations.english: Then the ascetics in a body fell to eulogizing that best of mantra-reciting ones, Vasistha, saying, “Your might, O Brāhmaṇa, is infallible. Do you rein in the (Brahmā) energy, by your own.'

verses.sanskrit:
निगृहीतस्त्वया ब्रह्मन्विश्वामित्रो महातपाः
प्रसीद जपतां श्रेष्ठ लोकाः सन्तु गतव्यथाः
verses.transliteration:
nigṛhītastvayā brahmanviśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
prasīda japatāṁ śreṣṭha lokāḥ santu gatavyathāḥ

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, Viśvāmitra of mighty strength has been subdued by you. Infallible is your extraordinary mighty. Let the creatures now be relieved from their distress.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महातेजाः शमं चक्रे महातपाः
विश्वामित्रोऽपि निकृतो विनिःश्वस्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamukto mahātejāḥ śamaṁ cakre mahātapāḥ
viśvāmitro'pi nikṛto viniḥśvasyedamabravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed, that highly energetic one of rigid austerities, became pacified.

verses.sanskrit:
धिग्बलं क्षत्रियबलं ब्रह्मतेजोबलं बलम्
एकेन ब्रह्मदण्डेन सर्वास्त्राणि हतानि मे
verses.transliteration:
dhigbalaṁ kṣatriyabalaṁ brahmatejobalaṁ balam
ekena brahmadaṇḍena sarvāstrāṇi hatāni me

translations.english: And Viśvāmitra, being put down, heaving a sigh said, 'Fie upon the Ksatriya might: the strength begot of Brahma energy, is might indeed. By one Brahmā staff has all my weapons been put to the rout.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत्समवेक्ष्याहं प्रसन्नेन्द्रियमानसः
तपो महत्समास्थास्ये यद्वै ब्रह्मत्वकारकम्
verses.transliteration:
tadetatsamavekṣyāhaṁ prasannendriyamānasaḥ
tapo mahatsamāsthāsye yadvai brahmatvakārakam

translations.english: Beholding this, I with a placid mind and senses will engage in mighty austerities, which shall earn for me Brāhmaṇa-hood.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संतप्तहृदयः स्मरन्निग्रहमात्मनः
विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य कृतवैरो महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁtaptahṛdayaḥ smarannigrahamātmanaḥ
viniḥśvasya viniḥśvasya kṛtavairo mahātmanā

translations.english: Then with his heart burning, in consequence of the remembrance of his humiliation, and having made enemies with that high-souled one, Viśvāmitra of mighty asceticism sighing and sighing, went towards the south, in company with his queen, and became engaged in dreadful austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
अथास्य जज्ञिरे पुत्राः सत्यधर्मपरायणाः
हविष्पन्दो मधुष्पन्दो दृढनेत्रो महारथः
verses.transliteration:
athāsya jajñire putrāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ
haviṣpando madhuṣpando dṛḍhanetro mahārathaḥ

translations.english: O Rāghava. And subsisting on fruits and roots, and restraining his senses, he performed the most rigid austerities. And four sons engaged in observing truth and duty, Havișpanda, Madhuspanda, Dhrdhanetra, and Maharatha, were born to him.

verses.sanskrit:
जिता राजर्षिलोकास्ते तपसा कुशिकात्मज
अनेन तपसा त्वां हि राजर्षिरिति विद्महे
verses.transliteration:
jitā rājarṣilokāste tapasā kuśikātmaja
anena tapasā tvāṁ hi rājarṣiriti vidmahe

translations.english: And when a thousand years had been completed, the Grand-sire of all, Brahma, addressed the ascetic, Viśvāmitra in sweet words, saying, 'O son of Kusika, the regions of the Rājarșis have been won by you through your austerities. And account of this your asceticism, we recognise you as a Rājarși.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा जगाम सह दैवतैः
त्रिविष्टपं ब्रह्मलोकं लोकानां परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejā jagāma saha daivataiḥ
triviṣṭapaṁ brahmalokaṁ lokānāṁ parameśvaraḥ

translations.english: Having said this, the highly energetic prime Lord of all creatures went to the celestial regions in company with the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः
दुःखेन महताविष्टः समन्युरिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
viśvāmitro'pi tacchrutvā hriyā kiṁcidavāṅmukhaḥ
duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ samanyuridamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing this, Viśvāmitra hanging down his head from shame and possessed by a mighty sorrow, said, in piteous accents, I have performed rigid austerities, yet the deities and the saints recognise me only as a Rājarși. I do not consider the fruit of my asceticism as gained.' on

verses.sanskrit:
एवं निश्चित्य मनसा भूय एव महातपाः
तपश्चचार काकुत्स्थ परमं परमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ niścitya manasā bhūya eva mahātapāḥ
tapaścacāra kākutstha paramaṁ paramātmavān

translations.english: Ascertaining this in his mind, that righteous one of high austerities, O Kākutstha, again engaged in penances with a composed self.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः
त्रिशङ्कुरिति विख्यात इक्ष्वाकु कुलनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
etasminneva kāle tu satyavādī jitendriyaḥ
triśaṅkuriti vikhyāta ikṣvāku kulanandanaḥ

translations.english: O Rāghava, it came to pass that at this time, that enhance of Ikşvāku's line, the celebrated and truthful Trisanku of subdued senses made up his mind, saying, 'I will perform a sacrifice, and in body win the prime way of the celestials.'

verses.sanskrit:
स वसिष्ठं समाहूय कथयामास चिन्तितम्
अशक्यमिति चाप्युक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
sa vasiṣṭhaṁ samāhūya kathayāmāsa cintitam
aśakyamiti cāpyukto vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā

translations.english: And summoning Vasiştha, he unfolded his mind to him. And on the high-souled Vasiştha saying, 'I am incapable of doing this,'

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्याख्यातो वसिष्ठेन स ययौ दक्षिणां दिशम्
वसिष्ठा दीर्घ तपसस्तपो यत्र हि तेपिरे
verses.transliteration:
pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena sa yayau dakṣiṇāṁ diśam
vasiṣṭhā dīrgha tapasastapo yatra hi tepire

translations.english: And disregarded by the latter, the King went towards the southern quarter. And with the view of securing success to his endeavours, the king repaired to where Vasiştha's sons had for a long time been performing austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानः सर्वानेव गुरोः सुतान्
अभिवाद्यानुपूर्व्येण ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः
अब्रवीत्सुमहातेजाः सर्वानेव कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
so'bhigamya mahātmānaḥ sarvāneva guroḥ sutān
abhivādyānupūrvyeṇa hriyā kiṁcidavāṅmukhaḥ
abravītsumahātejāḥ sarvāneva kṛtāñjaliḥ

translations.english: And the highly energetic Trisanku saw the hundred exceedingly effulgent sons of Vasistha engaged in austerities with fixed faculties. And approaching all those high-souled sons of his spiritual guide, and paying them reverence he, hanging down his head from shame, with clasped hands, addressed those mighty spirits, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
शरणं वः प्रपद्येऽहं शरण्याञ्शरणागतः
प्रत्याख्यातोऽस्मि भद्रं वो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
śaraṇaṁ vaḥ prapadye'haṁ śaraṇyāñśaraṇāgataḥ
pratyākhyāto'smi bhadraṁ vo vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā

translations.english: I seek protection of you; and I take refuge in you capable of conferring it. Disregarded have I been, good betide you, by the high-souled Vasiştha. I have set my heart upon celebrating a mighty sacrifice: it behove you to command me.

verses.sanskrit:
शिरसा प्रणतो याचे ब्राह्मणांस्तपसि स्थितान्
ते मां भवन्तः सिद्ध्यर्थं याजयन्तु समाहिताः
सशरीरो यथाहं हि देवलोकमवाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration:
śirasā praṇato yāce brāhmaṇāṁstapasi sthitān
te māṁ bhavantaḥ siddhyarthaṁ yājayantu samāhitāḥ
saśarīro yathāhaṁ hi devalokamavāpnuyām

translations.english: And with the view of propitiating you, I, lowly bowing down my head, beseech the sons of my spiritual guide, Brāhmaṇas ever staying by asceticism, do you with collected minds officiate in this sacrifice, so that success may be secured to me; and that in body I may attain the regions of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्याख्यातो वसिष्ठेन गतिमन्यां तपोधनाः
गुरुपुत्रानृते सर्वान्नाहं पश्यामि कांचन
verses.transliteration:
pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena gatimanyāṁ tapodhanāḥ
guruputrānṛte sarvānnāhaṁ paśyāmi kāṁcana

translations.english: Disregarded by the ascetic Vasiştha, other way find I none, you anchorets, except the sons of my spiritual guide.

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकूणां हि सर्वेषां पुरोधाः परमा गतिः
तस्मादनन्तरं सर्वे भवन्तो दैवतं मम
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākūṇāṁ hi sarveṣāṁ purodhāḥ paramā gatiḥ
tasmādanantaraṁ sarve bhavanto daivataṁ mama

translations.english: To the Ikşvākus, their preceptor is their prime way. Therefore after him (Vasistha), even you are the objects of my adoration.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्रिशङ्कोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रोधसमन्वितम्
ऋषिपुत्रशतं राम राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tatastriśaṅkorvacanaṁ śrutvā krodhasamanvitam
ṛṣiputraśataṁ rāma rājānamidamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing Trišanku's speech, the hundred sons of the saint, O Rāma, excited by wrath, said these words to the king, ‘Disregarded hast you been, O you of perverse understanding, by our truth-telling sire, why then, having passed him by, do you seek for others' help?

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकूणां हि सर्वेषां पुरोधाः परमा गतिः
न चातिक्रमितुं शक्यं वचनं सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākūṇāṁ hi sarveṣāṁ purodhāḥ paramā gatiḥ
na cātikramituṁ śakyaṁ vacanaṁ satyavādinaḥ

translations.english: To the Ikşvākus, their spiritual guide is their prime way; nor art you capable of setting at naught the words of that truth-telling one.

verses.sanskrit:
अशक्यमिति चोवाच वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः
तं वयं वै समाहर्तुं क्रतुं शक्ताः कथं तव
verses.transliteration:
aśakyamiti covāca vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ
taṁ vayaṁ vai samāhartuṁ kratuṁ śaktāḥ kathaṁ tava

translations.english: That worshipful saint said, that he was incapable (of accomplishing this), how can we then undertake that sacrifice?

verses.sanskrit:
बालिशस्त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गम्यतां स्वपुरं पुनः
याजने भगवाञ्शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि पार्थिव
verses.transliteration:
bāliśastvaṁ naraśreṣṭha gamyatāṁ svapuraṁ punaḥ
yājane bhagavāñśaktastrailokyasyāpi pārthiva

translations.english: You are ignorant, O foremost of men. Do you speedily retrace your steps. And, O king, that adorable one is competent to officiate at the sacrifice itself of the three worlds, how can we then contribute to his dishonour?'

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रोधपर्याकुलाक्षरम्
स राजा पुनरेवैतानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā krodhaparyākulākṣaram
sa rājā punarevaitānidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those words of theirs, that king, with accents tremulous with passion, again addressed them, saying, 'Disregarded by that worshipful one as well as by the sons of my spiritual guide, I will go after another way, so peace he to you, ascetics.'

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिपुत्रास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं घोराभिसंहितम्
शेपुः परमसंक्रुद्धाश्चण्डालत्वं गमिष्यसि
एवमुक्त्वा महात्मानो विविशुस्ते स्वमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣiputrāstu tacchrutvā vākyaṁ ghorābhisaṁhitam
śepuḥ paramasaṁkruddhāścaṇḍālatvaṁ gamiṣyasi
evamuktvā mahātmāno viviśuste svamāśramam

translations.english: The saint's sons, on their part, hearing that speech couching a fierce intent, cursed him in exceeding wrath, saying, 'You shall come by Candāla-hood.' Having said this, those highsouled ones entered each into his dwelling.'

verses.sanskrit:
अथ रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां राजा चण्डालतां गतः
नीलवस्त्रधरो नीलः परुषो ध्वस्तमूर्धजः
चित्यमाल्यानुलेपश्च आयसाभरणोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
atha rātryāṁ vyatītāyāṁ rājā caṇḍālatāṁ gataḥ
nīlavastradharo nīlaḥ paruṣo dhvastamūrdhajaḥ
cityamālyānulepaśca āyasābharaṇo'bhavat

translations.english: And vhen the „ight had gone by the king came by Chandala-hood. And clad in a blue garb, blue and rough of person, having a short head of hair, wearing a garland composed of materials culled from a cemetery, his body bedaubed with ashes from the same quarter, he was decked out with iron ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा चण्डालरूपिणम्
प्राद्रवन्सहिता राम पौरा येऽस्यानुगामिनः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā mantriṇaḥ sarve tyaktvā caṇḍālarūpiṇam
prādravansahitā rāma paurā ye'syānugāminaḥ

translations.english: And, O Rāma, beholding him in the guise of a Chandala, his counsellors as well as followers, renouncing him, fled in a body. And, O Kākutstha, maintaining himself in patience, the monarch burning day and night, all alone went to the ascetic Viśvāmitra.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य राजा चण्डालतां गतः
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्
verses.transliteration:
atha tadvākyamākarṇya rājā caṇḍālatāṁ gataḥ
abravītprāñjalirvākyaṁ vākyajño vākyakovidam

translations.english: Hearing him, the king conversant with words, fallen into Candāla-hood, with folded hands, said to that one versed in speech.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्याख्यातोऽस्मि गुरुणा गुरुपुत्रैस्तथैव च
अनवाप्यैव तं कामं मया प्राप्तो विपर्ययः
verses.transliteration:
pratyākhyāto'smi guruṇā guruputraistathaiva ca
anavāpyaiva taṁ kāmaṁ mayā prāpto viparyayaḥ

translations.english: Disregarded had I been by my spiritual guide as well as his sons. And far from attaining my desire, I came by this calamity.

verses.sanskrit:
सशरीरो दिवं यायामिति मे सौम्यदर्शनम्
मया चेष्टं क्रतुशतं तच्च नावाप्यते फलम्
verses.transliteration:
saśarīro divaṁ yāyāmiti me saumyadarśanam
mayā ceṣṭaṁ kratuśataṁ tacca nāvāpyate phalam

translations.english: O you of placid presence, I had desired to repair to heaven in body. By me have an hundred sacrifices been performed, but yet do I not obtain the fruit thereof.

verses.sanskrit:
अनृतं नोक्त पूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन
कृच्छ्रेष्वपि गतः सौम्य क्षत्रधर्मेण ते शपे
verses.transliteration:
anṛtaṁ nokta pūrvaṁ me na ca vakṣye kadācana
kṛcchreṣvapi gataḥ saumya kṣatradharmeṇa te śape

translations.english: I have never before told an untruth; and I swear by my Ksatriya morality, that albeit fallen on evil days, I will never do so in future, O gentle one.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञैर्बहुविधैरिष्टं प्रजा धर्मेण पालिताः
गुरवश्च महात्मानः शीलवृत्तेन तोषिताः
verses.transliteration:
yajñairbahuvidhairiṣṭaṁ prajā dharmeṇa pālitāḥ
guravaśca mahātmānaḥ śīlavṛttena toṣitāḥ

translations.english: I have celebrated many sacrifices, and I have ruled my people in righteousness; and I have pleased my preceptors by my character and conduct. But, O. best of ascetics, now endeavouring to do my duty and intending to perform a sacrifice, I have failed in enlisting the good graces of my spiritual guides. Therefore do I consider Destiny as supreme; and action as nothing.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मे परमार्तस्य प्रसादमभिकाङ्क्षतः
कर्तुमर्हसि भद्रं ते दैवोपहतकर्मणः
verses.transliteration:
tasya me paramārtasya prasādamabhikāṅkṣataḥ
kartumarhasi bhadraṁ te daivopahatakarmaṇaḥ
