translations.english: And the Earth desired for her lord even him (Rāma) possessing an excellent character and of prowess incapable of being repressed, like to Lokanātha (Vişnu.) himself.

verses.sanskrit:
एतैस्तु बहुभिर्युक्तं गुणैरनुपमैः सुतम्
दृष्ट्वा दशरथो राजा चक्रे चिन्तां परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
etaistu bahubhiryuktaṁ guṇairanupamaiḥ sutam
dṛṣṭvā daśaratho rājā cakre cintāṁ paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: And finding his son crowned with so many incomparable qualities, that subduer of his enemies, king Dasaratha, thought within himself.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा ह्यस्य परा प्रीतिर्हृदि संपरिवर्तते
कदा नाम सुतं द्रक्ष्याम्यभिषिक्तमहं प्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣā hyasya parā prītirhṛdi saṁparivartate
kadā nāma sutaṁ drakṣyāmyabhiṣiktamahaṁ priyam

translations.english: Surely he always wished for the prosperity of the people; and he showed kindness to all creatures. And like to the showering rain-cloud, he is dearer to the people than myself.

verses.sanskrit:
यमशक्रसमो वीर्ये बृहस्पतिसमो मतौ
महीधरसमो धृत्यां मत्तश्च गुणवत्तरः
verses.transliteration:
yamaśakrasamo vīrye bṛhaspatisamo matau
mahīdharasamo dhṛtyāṁ mattaśca guṇavattaraḥ

translations.english: He is like to Yama and Sakra in prowess, and to Brhaspati in intelligence; and in forbearance, to a mountain, yea, he is far more qualified than myself.

verses.sanskrit:
महीमहमिमां कृत्स्नामधितिष्ठन्तमात्मजम्
अनेन वयसा दृष्ट्वा यथा स्वर्गमवाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration:
mahīmahamimāṁ kṛtsnāmadhitiṣṭhantamātmajam
anena vayasā dṛṣṭvā yathā svargamavāpnuyām

translations.english: Therefore in this age, beholding my son established in (the dominion of) this entire earth, I shall repair to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
तं समीक्ष्य महाराजो युक्तं समुदितैर्गुणैः
निश्चित्य सचिवैः सार्धं युवराजममन्यत
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samīkṣya mahārājo yuktaṁ samuditairguṇaiḥ
niścitya sacivaiḥ sārdhaṁ yuvarājamamanyata

translations.english: And that intelligent (king) mentioned (to his ministers) the dreadful evils portended by appearances and phenomena in heaven and the air and on the earth, and also pointed out the circumstance of decrepitude having taken possession of his person.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ राजवितीर्णेषु विविधेष्वासनेषु च
राजानमेवाभिमुखा निषेदुर्नियता नृपाः
verses.transliteration:
atha rājavitīrṇeṣu vividheṣvāsaneṣu ca
rājānamevābhimukhā niṣedurniyatā nṛpāḥ

translations.english: Facing and eyeing the monarch, those kings sat them down on different seats pointed out by the former.

verses.sanskrit:
स लब्धमानैर्विनयान्वितैर्नृपैः; पुरालयैर्जानपदैश्च मानवैः
उपोपविष्टैर्नृपतिर्वृतो बभौ; सहस्रचक्षुर्भगवानिवामरैः
verses.transliteration:
sa labdhamānairvinayānvitairnṛpaiḥ; purālayairjānapadaiśca mānavaiḥ
upopaviṣṭairnṛpatirvṛto babhau; sahasracakṣurbhagavānivāmaraiḥ

translations.english: Surrounded by those prime and noble of the various provinces, and all those lowly rulers, who had been received honourably and who generally resided at Ayodhyā, the sovereign appeared like to the adorable thousand-eyed (one) surrounded by the immortals. 51

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहमिक्ष्वाकुभिः पूर्वैर्नरेन्द्रैः परिपालितम्
श्रेयसा योक्तुकामोऽस्मि सुखार्हमखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration:
so'hamikṣvākubhiḥ pūrvairnarendraiḥ paripālitam
śreyasā yoktukāmo'smi sukhārhamakhilaṁ jagat

translations.english: Now it is my intention to bring welfare to this entire earth worthy of being rendered happy, which had been governed by all those sovereigns, Ikşvāku and the rest.

verses.sanskrit:
मयाप्याचरितं पूर्वैः पन्थानमनुगच्छता
प्रजा नित्यमतन्द्रेण यथाशक्त्यभिरक्षता
verses.transliteration:
mayāpyācaritaṁ pūrvaiḥ panthānamanugacchatā
prajā nityamatandreṇa yathāśaktyabhirakṣatā

translations.english: Following the path trod by my predecessors, I have, heedless of my own happiness, to the best of my power, always protected the people.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं शरीरं कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य चरता हितम्
पाण्डुरस्यातपत्रस्यच्छायायां जरितं मया
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ śarīraṁ kṛtsnasya lokasya caratā hitam
pāṇḍurasyātapatrasyacchāyāyāṁ jaritaṁ mayā

translations.english: And under the shade of the white umbrella, I effecting the good of the entire community, have brought decrepitude upon my body.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य वर्षसहस्राणि बहून्यायूंषि जीवितः
जीर्णस्यास्य शरीरस्य विश्रान्तिमभिरोचये
verses.transliteration:
prāpya varṣasahasrāṇi bahūnyāyūṁṣi jīvitaḥ
jīrṇasyāsya śarīrasya viśrāntimabhirocaye

translations.english: Having attained an age extending over many thousands of years, and lived for a long period, desire rest for this decrepit frame.

verses.sanskrit:
राजप्रभावजुष्टां हि दुर्वहामजितेन्द्रियैः
परिश्रान्तोऽस्मि लोकस्य गुर्वीं धर्मधुरं वहन्
verses.transliteration:
rājaprabhāvajuṣṭāṁ hi durvahāmajitendriyaiḥ
pariśrānto'smi lokasya gurvīṁ dharmadhuraṁ vahan

translations.english: Bearing in the interests of the people the heavy burden of duty, incapable of being borne by even those that have controlled their senses, and requiring (in the bearer) right royal qualities, I have become fatigued.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं विश्रममिच्छामि पुत्रं कृत्वा प्रजाहिते
संनिकृष्टानिमान्सर्वाननुमान्य द्विजर्षभान्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ viśramamicchāmi putraṁ kṛtvā prajāhite
saṁnikṛṣṭānimānsarvānanumānya dvijarṣabhān

translations.english: I therefore wish for rest, after in the interests of the subjects installing my son, with the permission of all these excellent twice-born ones around me.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुजातो हि मे सर्वैर्गुणैर्ज्येष्ठो ममात्मजः
पुरंदरसमो वीर्ये रामः परपुरंजयः
verses.transliteration:
anujāto hi me sarvairguṇairjyeṣṭho mamātmajaḥ
puraṁdarasamo vīrye rāmaḥ parapuraṁjayaḥ

translations.english: My worthy son, like to Purandara himself in prowess, Rāma, the conqueror of hostile cities, had been born, endowed with all my virtues.

verses.sanskrit:
तं चन्द्रमिव पुष्येण युक्तं धर्मभृतां वरम्
यौवराज्येन योक्तास्मि प्रीतः पुरुषपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ candramiva puṣyeṇa yuktaṁ dharmabhṛtāṁ varam
yauvarājyena yoktāsmi prītaḥ puruṣapuṁgavam

translations.english: Him, like to the moon while in conjunction with the Puşya constellation, the foremost of those maintaining righteousness, the chief of men, will I, in the morning with a delighted heart, install as the heir-apparent to the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेन श्रेयसा सद्यः संयोज्याहमिमां महीम्
गतक्लेशो भविष्यामि सुते तस्मिन्निवेश्य वै
verses.transliteration:
anena śreyasā sadyaḥ saṁyojyāhamimāṁ mahīm
gatakleśo bhaviṣyāmi sute tasminniveśya vai

translations.english: And that auspicious elder brother of Laksmana* will make a fit ruler for you, yea, the very three worlds might consider themselves as having a lord, by possessing him, through his agency I shall this day bring about the welfare of the world; and shall renounce my toil by reposing in him the task of government. *There is an alliterative beauty here in the original: Laksmīvān Laksmanāgraja; which of course is impossible to be retained in the translation.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ब्रुवन्तं मुदिताः प्रत्यनन्दन्नृपा नृपम्
वृष्टिमन्तं महामेघं नर्दन्तमिव बर्हिणः
verses.transliteration:
iti bruvantaṁ muditāḥ pratyanandannṛpā nṛpam
vṛṣṭimantaṁ mahāmeghaṁ nardantamiva barhiṇaḥ

translations.english: As the king had said this, the princes, exceedingly delighted, seconded him even as peacocks dance at sight of a mighty mass of clouds showering down rain.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य धर्मार्थविदुषो भावमाज्ञाय सर्वशः
ऊचुश्च मनसा ज्ञात्वा वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya dharmārthaviduṣo bhāvamājñāya sarvaśaḥ
ūcuśca manasā jñātvā vṛddhaṁ daśarathaṁ nṛpam

translations.english: Then being in complete possession of the views of that one (the king) versed in morality and interest, the Brāhmaṇas and the principal personages of the army, in company with the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces, took counsel together, and became unanimous, and, having again revolved the mater individually in their mind, spoke to the aged king Dasaratha, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवर्षसाहस्रो वृद्धस्त्वमसि पार्थिव
स रामं युवराजानमभिषिञ्चस्व पार्थिवम्
verses.transliteration:
anekavarṣasāhasro vṛddhastvamasi pārthiva
sa rāmaṁ yuvarājānamabhiṣiñcasva pārthivam

translations.english: O king, being many thousand years old, you have become aged. Do you then install Rāma as the heir-apparent to the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा तेषां मनःप्रियम्
अजानन्निव जिज्ञासुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
iti tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājā teṣāṁ manaḥpriyam
ajānanniva jijñāsuridaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those welcome word of theirs, the monarch, as if not knowing their mind, asked them, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं नु मयि धर्मेण पृथिवीमनुशासति
भवन्तो द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति युवराजं ममात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ nu mayi dharmeṇa pṛthivīmanuśāsati
bhavanto draṣṭumicchanti yuvarājaṁ mamātmajam

translations.english: Why, while I am righteously governing the earth, do you wish to see the highly powerful Rāma as the heir-apparent?

verses.sanskrit:
ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदैः सह
बहवो नृप कल्याणा गुणाः पुत्रस्य सन्ति ते
verses.transliteration:
te tamūcurmahātmānaṁ paurajānapadaiḥ saha
bahavo nṛpa kalyāṇā guṇāḥ putrasya santi te

translations.english: And those high-souled ones together with the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces said to him, O king, many are the virtues of your son, having for their object the welfare of the people.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यैर्गुणैः शक्रसमो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
इक्ष्वाकुभ्यो हि सर्वेभ्योऽप्यतिरक्तो विशाम्पते
verses.transliteration:
divyairguṇaiḥ śakrasamo rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
ikṣvākubhyo hi sarvebhyo'pyatirakto viśāmpate

translations.english: O monarch, furnished with the choicest qualities, Rāma having truth for prowess is like to Sakra's self; and he towers above Ikşvāku and all.

verses.sanskrit:
रामः सत्पुरुषो लोके सत्यधर्मपरायणः
धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंधश्च शीलवाननसूयकः
verses.transliteration:
rāmaḥ satpuruṣo loke satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
dharmajñaḥ satyasaṁdhaśca śīlavānanasūyakaḥ

translations.english: Rāma is the one excellent person among men; and is true and devoted to truth. And in very Rāma is established morality with prosperity.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षान्तः सान्त्वयिता श्लक्ष्णः कृतज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः
मृदुश्च स्थिरचित्तश्च सदा भव्योऽनसूयकः
verses.transliteration:
kṣāntaḥ sāntvayitā ślakṣṇaḥ kṛtajño vijitendriyaḥ
mṛduśca sthiracittaśca sadā bhavyo'nasūyakaḥ

translations.english: He is cognizant of duty, and true in promise, and honest; and not given to detraction. He is forgiving, and soothing, and sweet-speeched and grateful, and of subdued senses. He is pliable to entreaties and staid, and of agreeable carriage, and un-calumniating. Rāghava speaks everyone fair, and is of truthful speech.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियवादी च भूतानां सत्यवादी च राघवः
बहुश्रुतानां वृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता
verses.transliteration:
priyavādī ca bhūtānāṁ satyavādī ca rāghavaḥ
bahuśrutānāṁ vṛddhānāṁ brāhmaṇānāmupāsitā

translations.english: He ministers to variously-versed aged Brāhmaṇas. It is for this that in this world his fame and renown and energy go on increasing.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनास्येहातुला कीर्तिर्यशस्तेजश्च वर्धते
देवासुरमनुष्याणां सर्वास्त्रेषु विशारदः
verses.transliteration:
tenāsyehātulā kīrtiryaśastejaśca vardhate
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṁ sarvāstreṣu viśāradaḥ

translations.english: He has mastered all the weapons that are extant among the gods, the Asuras, and human beings. He has performed his ablutions after having acquired learning; and knows the Vedas with their branches.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा व्रजति संग्रामं ग्रामार्थे नगरस्य वा
गत्वा सौमित्रिसहितो नाविजित्य निवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
yadā vrajati saṁgrāmaṁ grāmārthe nagarasya vā
gatvā saumitrisahito nāvijitya nivartate

translations.english: He is lowly to those twice bom ones that are worthy and are conversant with morality and interest. And when in company with Sumitra's son he wended to the fight with the view of protecting a city or a province, he came not back without conquering the foe. on or

verses.sanskrit:
संग्रामात्पुनरागम्य कुञ्जरेण रथेन वा
पौरान्स्वजनवन्नित्यं कुशलं परिपृच्छति
verses.transliteration:
saṁgrāmātpunarāgamya kuñjareṇa rathena vā
paurānsvajanavannityaṁ kuśalaṁ paripṛcchati

translations.english: And even as a father enquired after the welfare of his sons, he, returning from the field horse or elephant, exhaustively and consecutively enquired after the weal of the citizens, concerning their sons, their (sacrificial) fire, or their wives, or their servants, or their disciples.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यसनेषु मनुष्याणां भृशं भवति दुःखितः
उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति
verses.transliteration:
vyasaneṣu manuṣyāṇāṁ bhṛśaṁ bhavati duḥkhitaḥ
utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu piteva parituṣyati

translations.english: And that tiger-like Rāma always asked the Brāhmaṇas, 'Do your disciples tend you' and the Kșatriyas, 'Do your disciples always remain mailed?' When calamity befallen the people, he experienced excess of sorrow; and on their festal occasions, he rejoiced ever like their own father.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः
वत्सः श्रेयसि जातस्ते दिष्ट्यासौ तव राघवः
दिष्ट्या पुत्रगुणैर्युक्तो मारीच इव कश्यपः
verses.transliteration:
satyavādī maheṣvāso vṛddhasevī jitendriyaḥ
vatsaḥ śreyasi jātaste diṣṭyāsau tava rāghavaḥ
diṣṭyā putraguṇairyukto mārīca iva kaśyapaḥ

translations.english: By our good luck it is that your son has acquired competence in the task of administration; and also by your good luck it is that Rāghava has been born endowed with sonly qualities, like to Marici's son Kasyapa.

verses.sanskrit:
बलमारोग्यमायुश्च रामस्य विदितात्मनः
आशंसते जनः सर्वो राष्ट्रे पुरवरे तथा
verses.transliteration:
balamārogyamāyuśca rāmasya viditātmanaḥ
āśaṁsate janaḥ sarvo rāṣṭre puravare tathā

translations.english: The gods, and the Asuras, and men, with the Gandharvas, and the Uragas, and the inhabitants rural and urban, pray for the strength, health, and long life of self-knowing Rāma. And whether inmates or outsiders, citizens or natives of provinces, everyone speaks high of him.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वान्देवान्नमस्यन्ति रामस्यार्थे यशस्विनः
तेषामायाचितं देव त्वत्प्रसादात्समृध्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvāndevānnamasyanti rāmasyārthe yaśasvinaḥ
teṣāmāyācitaṁ deva tvatprasādātsamṛdhyatām

translations.english: Women, old and young, in both the morning and evening, with intent minds, bow down to all the gods on behalf of the intelligent Rāma. Let their desire, O worshipful one, be fulfilled, through your grace.

verses.sanskrit:
राममिन्दीवरश्यामं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम्
पश्यामो यौवराज्यस्थं तव राजोत्तमात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṁ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam
paśyāmo yauvarājyasthaṁ tava rājottamātmajam

translations.english: And we would behold the son of the foremost of monarchs, the foe-destroying. Rāma dark-blue like a lotus, installed as the heir-apparent to the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
तं देवदेवोपममात्मजं ते; सर्वस्य लोकस्य हिते निविष्टम्
हिताय नः क्षिप्रमुदारजुष्टं; मुदाभिषेक्तुं वरद त्वमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
taṁ devadevopamamātmajaṁ te; sarvasya lokasya hite niviṣṭam
hitāya naḥ kṣipramudārajuṣṭaṁ; mudābhiṣektuṁ varada tvamarhasi

translations.english: Therefore, O bestower of boons, it behoves you, for the sake of our well-being, with a delighted mind to speedily install your son furnished with noble qualities resembling the god of gods, and every intent upon the welfare of the entire community.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामज्ञलिपद्मानि प्रगृहीतानि सर्वशः
प्रतिगृह्याब्रवीद्राजा तेभ्यः प्रियहितं वचः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmajñalipadmāni pragṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ
pratigṛhyābravīdrājā tebhyaḥ priyahitaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: And when they had raised to their heads their clasped hands resembling lotuses, the king responding to them addressed them in welcome words fraught with their good.

verses.sanskrit:
अहोऽस्मि परमप्रीतः प्रभावश्चातुलो मम
यन्मे ज्येष्ठं प्रियं पुत्रं यौवराज्यस्थमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration:
aho'smi paramaprītaḥ prabhāvaścātulo mama
yanme jyeṣṭhaṁ priyaṁ putraṁ yauvarājyasthamicchatha

translations.english: Exceedingly pleased am I, and incomparable also is my influence, because you wish to behold my dear first born installed as heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
इति प्रत्यर्च्य तान्राजा ब्राह्मणानिदमब्रवीत्
वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च तेषामेवोपशृण्वताम्
verses.transliteration:
iti pratyarcya tānrājā brāhmaṇānidamabravīt
vasiṣṭhaṁ vāmadevaṁ ca teṣāmevopaśṛṇvatām

translations.english: Having greeted them thus, the king in their hearing spoke to Vasiștha Vāmadeva, and other Brāhmaṇas saying

verses.sanskrit:
चैत्रः श्रीमानयं मासः पुण्यः पुष्पितकाननः
यौवराज्याय रामस्य सर्वमेवोपकल्प्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
caitraḥ śrīmānayaṁ māsaḥ puṇyaḥ puṣpitakānanaḥ
yauvarājyāya rāmasya sarvamevopakalpyatām

translations.english: This is the holy month of Caitra; and the groves look beautiful with blossoms. Do you now prepare for the installation of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतमित्येव चाब्रूतामभिगम्य जगत्पतिम्
यथोक्तवचनं प्रीतौ हर्षयुक्तौ द्विजर्षभौ
verses.transliteration:
kṛtamityeva cābrūtāmabhigamya jagatpatim
yathoktavacanaṁ prītau harṣayuktau dvijarṣabhau

translations.english: When everything had been got ready those foremost of the twice-born ones gladly and wellpleased presented themselves before the master of the earth, and said to him, Everything as ordered has been done.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सुमन्त्रं द्युतिमान्राजा वचनमब्रवीत्
रामः कृतात्मा भवता शीघ्रमानीयतामिति
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sumantraṁ dyutimānrājā vacanamabravīt
rāmaḥ kṛtātmā bhavatā śīghramānīyatāmiti

translations.english: Then to Sumantra, the effulgent monarch spoke, saying, “Do you speedily bring the virtuous Rāma hither."

verses.sanskrit:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय सुमन्त्रो राजशासनात्
रामं तत्रानयां चक्रे रथेन रथिनां वरम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tatheti pratijñāya sumantro rājaśāsanāt
rāmaṁ tatrānayāṁ cakre rathena rathināṁ varam

translations.english: Thereupon saying, "so be it” Sumantra at the mandate of the king brought thither in a car Rāma the foremost of car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तत्र समासीनास्तदा दशरथं नृपम्
प्राच्योदीच्याः प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भूमिपाः
verses.transliteration:
atha tatra samāsīnāstadā daśarathaṁ nṛpam
prācyodīcyāḥ pratīcyāśca dākṣiṇātyāśca bhūmipāḥ

translations.english: The kings of the North, and the South and the East and the West, together with the Mlecchas and the Arya princes, with those inhabiting mountains and forests were then paying homage to him (Daśaratha) even as the celestials do to Vasava.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुंगवः
आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ kailāsaśṛṅgābhaṁ prāsādaṁ narapuṁgavaḥ
āruroha nṛpaṁ draṣṭuṁ saha sūtena rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Accompanied with Sumantra, Raghava, the descendant of the Raghus, for the purpose of beholding the monarch, began with rapid steps, to ascend the palace resembling a peak of the Kailasa hill.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्राञ्जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके
नाम स्वं श्रावयन्रामो ववन्दे चरणौ पितुः
verses.transliteration:
sa prāñjalirabhipretya praṇataḥ piturantike
nāma svaṁ śrāvayanrāmo vavande caraṇau pituḥ

translations.english: Rāma humbly approaching his father with clasped hands, and announcing his name bowed low and worshipped his father's feet.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं नृपः
गृह्याञ्जलौ समाकृष्य सस्वजे प्रियमात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā praṇataṁ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṁ nṛpaḥ
gṛhyāñjalau samākṛṣya sasvaje priyamātmajam

translations.english: Thereupon seeing Rāma at his side with clasped hands, and in lowly guise, the king took hold of Rāma's clasped hands, and drawing his beloved son, embraced the latter.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मै चाभ्युद्यतं श्रीमान्मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम्
दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmai cābhyudyataṁ śrīmānmaṇikāñcanabhūṣitam
dideśa rājā ruciraṁ rāmāya paramāsanam

translations.english: Then the king desired Rāma to seat him upon a seat prepared expressly for him, excellent, and flaming and garnished with gold and gems.

verses.sanskrit:
तदासनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः
स्वयेव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः
verses.transliteration:
tadāsanavaraṁ prāpya vyadīpayata rāghavaḥ
svayeva prabhayā merumudaye vimalo raviḥ

translations.english: Rāghava shed lustre on that noble seat, as the unclouded sun at his rising lighted up the Sumeru hill with his rays.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन विभ्राजिता तत्र सा सभाभिव्यरोचत
विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना
verses.transliteration:
tena vibhrājitā tatra sā sabhābhivyarocata
vimalagrahanakṣatrā śāradī dyaurivendunā

translations.english: That entire assembly looked beautiful in his presence, like the cloudless, autumnal sky crested with stars and planets, in the presence of the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
तं पश्यमानो नृपतिस्तुतोष प्रियमात्मजम्
अलंकृतमिवात्मानमादर्शतलसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ paśyamāno nṛpatistutoṣa priyamātmajam
alaṁkṛtamivātmānamādarśatalasaṁsthitam

translations.english: The king experienced delight, beholding his dearly beloved son, like to his own image, richly adorned, reflected on mirror.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं सस्मितमाभाष्य पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः
उवाचेदं वचो राजा देवेन्द्रमिव कश्यपः
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ sasmitamābhāṣya putraṁ putravatāṁ varaḥ
uvācedaṁ vaco rājā devendramiva kaśyapaḥ

translations.english: And even as Kasyapa addressed Indra of the celestials, the king, the best of those possessing sons addressed his sons, well seated, in these words, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया यतः प्रजाश्चेमाः स्वगुणैरनुरञ्जिताः
तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि
verses.transliteration:
tvayā yataḥ prajāścemāḥ svaguṇairanurañjitāḥ
tasmāttvaṁ puṣyayogena yauvarājyamavāpnuhi

translations.english: Born of my eldest wife worthy of myself, you crowned with the best qualities, are my worthy son, O Rāma dear to me. You have by your virtues drawn to yourself the hearts of the people, therefore do you during the conjunction of the moon with the Puşya constellation, receive the office of heir-apparent,

verses.sanskrit:
कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि
गुणवत्यपि तु स्नेहात्पुत्र वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
verses.transliteration:
kāmatastvaṁ prakṛtyaiva vinīto guṇavānasi
guṇavatyapi tu snehātputra vakṣyāmi te hitam

translations.english: You are by nature crowned with virtues. Notwithstanding your great virtues, I will, O son, from affection tell you what is for your profit. Practising greater humility, do you constantly restrain your senses.

verses.sanskrit:
तुष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम्
तस्य नन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्वामृतमिवामराः
तस्मात्पुत्र त्वमात्मानं नियम्यैव समाचर
verses.transliteration:
tuṣṭānuraktaprakṛtiryaḥ pālayati medinīm
tasya nandanti mitrāṇi labdhvāmṛtamivāmarāḥ
tasmātputra tvamātmānaṁ niyamyaiva samācara

translations.english: Do you renounce the ills that come through anger and lust. Replenishing your exchequer and arsenal do you, acquainting yourself with the state of things personally and otherwise, administer justice and thereby enlist the affection of the courtiers and other subjects; for the friends of him that sway the earth, pleasing the people to his satisfaction, rejoice even as did the immortals on obtaining ambrosia.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः
त्वरिताः शीघ्रमभ्येत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā suhṛdastasya rāmasya priyakāriṇaḥ
tvaritāḥ śīghramabhyetya kausalyāyai nyavedayan

translations.english: Therefore, do you, O son, disciplining yourself thus address you to your task. Hearing this, Rāma's well wishers, ever doing his pleasure, speedily going out, acquainted Kausalyä with everything.

verses.sanskrit:
सा हिरण्यं च गाश्चैव रत्नानि विविधानि च
व्यादिदेश प्रियाख्येभ्यः कौसल्या प्रमदोत्तमा
verses.transliteration:
sā hiraṇyaṁ ca gāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca
vyādideśa priyākhyebhyaḥ kausalyā pramadottamā

translations.english: Thereupon that foremost of her sex Kausalyā ordered gold and kine and various kinds of gems to be given to the tellers of the glad tidings.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः
ययौ स्वं द्युतिमद्वेश्म जनौघैः प्रतिपूजितः
verses.transliteration:
athābhivādya rājānaṁ rathamāruhya rāghavaḥ
yayau svaṁ dyutimadveśma janaughaiḥ pratipūjitaḥ

translations.english: Then Rāghava, having been honoured by the multitude and saluted the sovereign, ascended a car, and repaired to his shining residence.

verses.sanskrit:
ते चापि पौरा नृपतेर्वचस्त;च्छ्रुत्वा तदा लाभमिवेष्टमाप्य
नरेन्द्रमामन्त्य गृहाणि गत्वा; देवान्समानर्चुरतीव हृष्टाः
verses.transliteration:
te cāpi paurā nṛpatervacasta;cchrutvā tadā lābhamiveṣṭamāpya
narendramāmantya gṛhāṇi gatvā; devānsamānarcuratīva hṛṣṭāḥ

translations.english: And the citizens, hearing those words of the monarch, as if fraught with some speedy good fortune to them, made their obeisance to that lord of men, and repairing to their homes, with delighted minds, worshipped the gods. monarch, as if fraught with some speedy good fortune to them, made their obeisance to that lord of men, and repairing to their homes, with delighted minds, worshipped the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः
मन्त्रयित्वा ततश्चक्रे निश्चयज्ञः स निश्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
gateṣvatha nṛpo bhūyaḥ paureṣu saha mantribhiḥ
mantrayitvā tataścakre niścayajñaḥ sa niścayam

translations.english: When the citizens had gone away, the king versed in the time and place of ceremonies, after deliberating with his counsellors fixed the time (of the installation.) And his conclusion was even this: "To-morrow the Pusya will be in; and to-morrow should my son, Rāma of eyes like lotus-leaves be installed as heir-apparent."

verses.sanskrit:
अथान्तर्गृहमाविश्य राजा दशरथस्तदा
सूतमाज्ञापयामास रामं पुनरिहानय
verses.transliteration:
athāntargṛhamāviśya rājā daśarathastadā
sūtamājñāpayāmāsa rāmaṁ punarihānaya

translations.english: Then entering the inner apartment king Dasaratha said to the charioteer Sumantra, "Do you again bring Rāma here.'

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य स तद्वाक्यं सूतः पुनरुपाययौ
रामस्य भवनं शीघ्रं राममानयितुं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya sa tadvākyaṁ sūtaḥ punarupāyayau
rāmasya bhavanaṁ śīghraṁ rāmamānayituṁ punaḥ

translations.english: In response to those words, the charioteer again speedily went to Rāma's residence, for bringing him thither.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वाःस्थैरावेदितं तस्य रामायागमनं पुनः
श्रुत्वैव चापि रामस्तं प्राप्तं शङ्कान्वितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
dvāḥsthairāveditaṁ tasya rāmāyāgamanaṁ punaḥ
śrutvaiva cāpi rāmastaṁ prāptaṁ śaṅkānvito'bhavat

translations.english: His fresh approach having been announced to Rāma by the warders, the latter, filled with apprehension, became anxious.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवेश्य चैनं त्वरितं रामो वचनमब्रवीत्
यदागमनकृत्यं ते भूयस्तद्ब्रूह्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
praveśya cainaṁ tvaritaṁ rāmo vacanamabravīt
yadāgamanakṛtyaṁ te bhūyastadbrūhyaśeṣataḥ

translations.english: And bringing Sumantra in, Ráma with eagerness said "Tell me fully the reason of this your fresh visit."

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच ततः सूतो राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति
श्रुत्वा प्रमाणमत्र त्वं गमनायेतराय वा
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca tataḥ sūto rājā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati
śrutvā pramāṇamatra tvaṁ gamanāyetarāya vā

translations.english: Thereupon, the charioteer told him, "The sovereign wish to behold you. You have known the occasion; and now decide whether you will go thither or not.”

verses.sanskrit:
तं श्रुत्वा समनुप्राप्तं रामं दशरथो नृपः
प्रवेशयामास गृहं विविक्षुः प्रियमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ śrutvā samanuprāptaṁ rāmaṁ daśaratho nṛpaḥ
praveśayāmāsa gṛhaṁ vivikṣuḥ priyamuttamam

translations.english: Hearing the charioteer's speech, Rāma also in haste repaired to the king's palace, with the view of again beholding the lord of Man. And on hearing of Rāma's arrival, king Daſaratha inade him enter his own chamber, with the view of communicating to him something exceedingly agreeable.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविशन्नेव च श्रीमान्राघवो भवनं पितुः
ददर्श पितरं दूरात्प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
praviśanneva ca śrīmānrāghavo bhavanaṁ pituḥ
dadarśa pitaraṁ dūrātpraṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ

translations.english: And immediately on entering his father's residence, the graceful Rāghava seeing his father from a distance, bent low with clasped hands.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणमन्तं समुत्थाप्य तं परिष्वज्य भूमिपः
प्रदिश्य चास्मै रुचिरमासनं पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
praṇamantaṁ samutthāpya taṁ pariṣvajya bhūmipaḥ
pradiśya cāsmai ruciramāsanaṁ punarabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon raising Räma as he was bending down, and embracing him, and pointing out a seat, the protector of the earth again spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit:
राम वृद्धोऽस्मि दीर्घायुर्भुक्ता भोगा मयेप्सिताः
अन्नवद्भिः क्रतुशतैस्तथेष्टं भूरिदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration:
rāma vṛddho'smi dīrghāyurbhuktā bhogā mayepsitāḥ
annavadbhiḥ kratuśataistatheṣṭaṁ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ

translations.english: O Ráma, enjoying at my will the good things of life, I have grown old; and have attained great age. I have worshipped the deities by celebrating hundreds of sacrifices with numerous Dakşiņās and gifts of boiled rice.

verses.sanskrit:
जातमिष्टमपत्यं मे त्वमद्यानुपमं भुवि
दत्तमिष्टमधीतं च मया पुरुषसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
jātamiṣṭamapatyaṁ me tvamadyānupamaṁ bhuvi
dattamiṣṭamadhītaṁ ca mayā puruṣasattama

translations.english: And incomparable on earth, you have been born to me for a son after my heart. I have given whatever had been wanted (by others); I have finished my studies.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुभूतानि चेष्टानि मया वीर सुखानि च
देवर्षि पितृविप्राणामनृणोऽस्मि तथात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
anubhūtāni ceṣṭāni mayā vīra sukhāni ca
devarṣi pitṛviprāṇāmanṛṇo'smi tathātmanaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men. I have, O hero, acted and enjoyed. I have been emancipated from my obligations to the celestials and saints, and the Pitris, and the Vipras, and myself.* *Sacrifice, study, son, gift, enjoyment are the five means of, clearing the debts one owes to the celestials, the saints, the pitrs, the vipras and self.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य प्रकृतयः सर्वास्त्वामिच्छन्ति नराधिपम्
अतस्त्वां युवराजानमभिषेक्ष्यामि पुत्रक
verses.transliteration:
adya prakṛtayaḥ sarvāstvāmicchanti narādhipam
atastvāṁ yuvarājānamabhiṣekṣyāmi putraka

translations.english: And naught now remain to be done by me save the installation. Therefore it behoves you to do even what I say to you. To-day the subjects in a body have expressed their desire of having you for their sovereign. Therefore, O son, I shall install you as the heir-apparent. O Rāghava, tonight I have dreamt inauspicious dreams. Stars with tremendous sounds, shoot by day, accompanied with thunder-claps.

verses.sanskrit:
अवष्टब्धं च मे राम नक्षत्रं दारुणैर्ग्रहैः
आवेदयन्ति दैवज्ञाः सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः
verses.transliteration:
avaṣṭabdhaṁ ca me rāma nakṣatraṁ dāruṇairgrahaiḥ
āvedayanti daivajñāḥ sūryāṅgārakarāhubhiḥ

translations.english: The astrologers say that the star of my life has been invaded by those terrible planets, the Sun, Mars, and Rāhu.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रायेण हि निमित्तानामीदृशानां समुद्भवे
राजा वा मृत्युमाप्नोति घोरां वापदमृच्छति
verses.transliteration:
prāyeṇa hi nimittānāmīdṛśānāṁ samudbhave
rājā vā mṛtyumāpnoti ghorāṁ vāpadamṛcchati

translations.english: It generally happens that when such signs manifest themselves, the king comes by a terrible calamity, and may meet with death itself.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यावदेव मे चेतो न विमुह्यति राघव
तावदेवाभिषिञ्चस्व चला हि प्राणिनां मतिः
verses.transliteration:
tadyāvadeva me ceto na vimuhyati rāghava
tāvadevābhiṣiñcasva calā hi prāṇināṁ matiḥ

translations.english: Therefore, O Raghava, my thoughts change, be you installed (in the kingdom), for fickle is the mind of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य चन्द्रोऽभ्युपगतः पुष्यात्पूर्वं पुनर्वसुम्
श्वः पुष्य योगं नियतं वक्ष्यन्ते दैवचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration:
adya candro'bhyupagataḥ puṣyātpūrvaṁ punarvasum
śvaḥ puṣya yogaṁ niyataṁ vakṣyante daivacintakāḥ

translations.english: To-day, before meeting Pusya, the moon has entered the Punarvasu asterism; and the astrologers say that to-morrow it will certainly be in conjunction with Pușya.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र पुष्येऽभिषिञ्चस्व मनस्त्वरयतीव माम्
श्वस्त्वाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि यौवराज्ये परंतप
verses.transliteration:
tatra puṣye'bhiṣiñcasva manastvarayatīva mām
śvastvāhamabhiṣekṣyāmi yauvarājye paraṁtapa

translations.english: My heart urges me to install you during the Pusya conjunction, so Oh! afflicter of foes, I shall install you to-morrow as heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वयाद्य व्रतिना निशेयं नियतात्मना
सह वध्वोपवस्तव्या दर्भप्रस्तरशायिना
verses.transliteration:
tasmāttvayādya vratinā niśeyaṁ niyatātmanā
saha vadhvopavastavyā darbhaprastaraśāyinā

translations.english: Therefore do you along with my daughter-inlaw, commencing from sun-set, serving the prescribed restrictions, and lying down on a bed of Kusa grass, spend the night in fast.

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः
भवन्ति बहुविघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि
verses.transliteration:
suhṛdaścāpramattāstvāṁ rakṣantvadya samantataḥ
bhavanti bahuvighnāni kāryāṇyevaṁvidhāni hi

translations.english: And let your friends vigilantly protect you all around, for many are the impediments that happen in affairs like this.

verses.sanskrit:
विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः
तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम
verses.transliteration:
viproṣitaśca bharato yāvadeva purāditaḥ
tāvadevābhiṣekaste prāptakālo mato mama

translations.english: In my opinion, during the interval that Bharata is away from the city, should your installation be effected most opportunity.

verses.sanskrit:
कामं खलु सतां वृत्ते भ्राता ते भरतः स्थितः
ज्येष्ठानुवर्ती धर्मात्मा सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
kāmaṁ khalu satāṁ vṛtte bhrātā te bharataḥ sthitaḥ
jyeṣṭhānuvartī dharmātmā sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ

translations.english: Even though your brother Bharata ever stayed entirely by the course of the honest; he followed his elder brother; and is righteous-souled; tenderhearted; and of subdued senses. But in my opinion, the hearts of men are inconstant, and, O Rāghava, the hearts even of the virtuous change by the action of the natural impulses.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तः सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने
व्रजेति रामः पितरमभिवाद्याभ्ययाद्गृहम्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktaḥ so'bhyanujñātaḥ śvobhāvinyabhiṣecane
vrajeti rāmaḥ pitaramabhivādyābhyayādgṛham

translations.english: Having been thus addressed in the matter of his coming installation in the next day, Rāma, with the King's permission embodied in "Go you," greeting his father, repaired to his quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य चात्मनो वेश्म राज्ञोद्दिष्टेऽभिषेचने
तस्मिन्क्षणे विनिर्गत्य मातुरन्तःपुरं ययौ
verses.transliteration:
praviśya cātmano veśma rājñoddiṣṭe'bhiṣecane
tasminkṣaṇe vinirgatya māturantaḥpuraṁ yayau

translations.english: And entering his residence in the interests of the installation ordered by the monarch, he immediately issued out, and went to the inner apartment of his mother.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तां प्रवणामेव मातरं क्षौमवासिनीम्
वाग्यतां देवतागारे ददर्श याचतीं श्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra tāṁ pravaṇāmeva mātaraṁ kṣaumavāsinīm
vāgyatāṁ devatāgāre dadarśa yācatīṁ śriyam

translations.english: There, Rāma found his mother in the temple, clad in silk, adoring the gods, and silently praying for his royal luck.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मणस्तथा
सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम्
verses.transliteration:
prāgeva cāgatā tatra sumitrā lakṣmaṇastathā
sītā cānāyitā śrutvā priyaṁ rāmābhiṣecanam

translations.english: There, hearing of the welcome installation of Råma, had already come Sumitrā, and Lakşmaņa and Sītā summoned (by Kausalyā).

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्काले हि कौसल्या तस्थावामीलितेक्षणा
सुमित्रयान्वास्यमाना सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च
verses.transliteration:
tasminkāle hi kausalyā tasthāvāmīlitekṣaṇā
sumitrayānvāsyamānā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca

translations.english: Hearing of the installation of his son in the office of heir-apparent during the influence of the Puşya at that time, tended by Sumitrā and Sita and Laksmana, there stood Kausalya, meditating the (triune) person Janārdana, through suspension of breath.

verses.sanskrit:
अम्ब पित्रा नियुक्तोऽस्मि प्रजापालनकर्मणि
भविता श्वोऽभिषेको मे यथा मे शासनं पितुः
verses.transliteration:
amba pitrā niyukto'smi prajāpālanakarmaṇi
bhavitā śvo'bhiṣeko me yathā me śāsanaṁ pituḥ

translations.english: Rāma, approaching and saluting her engaged in auspicious observance, addressed her in excellent words, cheering her up, O mother, by my father have I been appointed to the task of governing the people. And, agreeably to the desire of my father, to morrow will take place my installation; To night Sītā will fast along with me, the priests have said thus, and this also has been declared by my father.

verses.sanskrit:
यानि यान्यत्र योग्यानि श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने
तानि मे मङ्गलान्यद्य वैदेह्याश्चैव कारय
verses.transliteration:
yāni yānyatra yogyāni śvobhāvinyabhiṣecane
tāni me maṅgalānyadya vaidehyāścaiva kāraya

translations.english: Do you therefore even today provide those necessary auspicious things that will be required Hur myself and Vaidehi on the occasion of the coming installation.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौसल्या चिरकालाभिकाङ्क्षितम्
हर्षबाष्पकलं वाक्यमिदं राममभाषत
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā tu kausalyā cirakālābhikāṅkṣitam
harṣabāṣpakalaṁ vākyamidaṁ rāmamabhāṣata

translations.english: Hearing of that for which she had ever wished, Kausalya, her voice choking with the vapour begot of delight, addressed Rāma, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
वत्स राम चिरं जीव हतास्ते परिपन्थिनः
ज्ञातीन्मे त्वं श्रिया युक्तः सुमित्रायाश्च नन्दय
verses.transliteration:
vatsa rāma ciraṁ jīva hatāste paripanthinaḥ
jñātīnme tvaṁ śriyā yuktaḥ sumitrāyāśca nandaya

translations.english: Rāma, my child, be you long-lived, and may your enemies find destruction! Furnished with this good fortune, do you gladden Sumitra's as well as my own relatives.

verses.sanskrit:
कल्याणे बत नक्षत्रे मयि जातोऽसि पुत्रक
येन त्वया दशरथो गुणैराराधितः पिता
verses.transliteration:
kalyāṇe bata nakṣatre mayi jāto'si putraka
yena tvayā daśaratho guṇairārādhitaḥ pitā

translations.english: Oh! you was born under an auspicious star: you have, O son, by your virtues gratified your sire Dasaratha.

verses.sanskrit:
अमोघं बत मे क्षान्तं पुरुषे पुष्करेक्षणे
येयमिक्ष्वाकुराज्यश्रीः पुत्र त्वां संश्रयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
amoghaṁ bata me kṣāntaṁ puruṣe puṣkarekṣaṇe
yeyamikṣvākurājyaśrīḥ putra tvāṁ saṁśrayiṣyati

translations.english: Ah! not unfruitful has proved my disinterested observance of vow to the lotus-eyed person, for this royal fortune of the Ikşvāku race shall rest upon you.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्तो मात्रेदं रामो भारतमब्रवीत्
प्राञ्जलिं प्रह्वमासीनमभिवीक्ष्य स्मयन्निव
verses.transliteration:
ityevamukto mātredaṁ rāmo bhāratamabravīt
prāñjaliṁ prahvamāsīnamabhivīkṣya smayanniva

translations.english: Having been thus addressed by his mother, Rāma looking at his brother(Lakşmaņa), seated in humble guise with clasped hands, with smile spoke to him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेमां मया सार्धं प्रशाधि त्वं वसुंधराम्
द्वितीयं मेऽन्तरात्मानं त्वामियं श्रीरुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇemāṁ mayā sārdhaṁ praśādhi tvaṁ vasuṁdharām
dvitīyaṁ me'ntarātmānaṁ tvāmiyaṁ śrīrupasthitā

translations.english: O Lakṣmaṇa, do you together with me rule this earth. You are my second self; and this good fortune has taken possession of you (as well).

verses.sanskrit:
सौमित्रे भुङ्क्ष्व भोगांस्त्वमिष्टान्राज्यफलानि च
जीवितं च हि राज्यं च त्वदर्थमभिकामये
verses.transliteration:
saumitre bhuṅkṣva bhogāṁstvamiṣṭānrājyaphalāni ca
jīvitaṁ ca hi rājyaṁ ca tvadarthamabhikāmaye

translations.english: Do you, O Sumitrā's son, enjoy every desirable thing and the privileges pertaining to royalty. My life and this kingdom I covet for your sake alone.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामो मातरावभिवाद्य च
अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य सीतां च जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṁ rāmo mātarāvabhivādya ca
abhyanujñāpya sītāṁ ca jagāma svaṁ niveśanam

translations.english: Having said this to Lakşmaņa, and paid reverence to his mother, Rāma with their permission went with Sītā to his own quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
संदिश्य रामं नृपतिः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने
पुरोहितं समाहूय वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
saṁdiśya rāmaṁ nṛpatiḥ śvobhāvinyabhiṣecane
purohitaṁ samāhūya vasiṣṭhamidamabravīt

translations.english: Having given his directions to Rāma as to his in coming installation on the morrow, the king, summoning his priest, Vasiştha spoke to him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
गच्छोपवासं काकुत्स्थं कारयाद्य तपोधन
श्रीयशोराज्यलाभाय वध्वा सह यतव्रतम्
verses.transliteration:
gacchopavāsaṁ kākutsthaṁ kārayādya tapodhana
śrīyaśorājyalābhāya vadhvā saha yatavratam

translations.english: O you, having asceticism for your wealth, go, to Kākutstha, and for his welfare and obtaining the kingdom, make him fast along with my daughter-in-law.

verses.sanskrit:
तथेति च स राजानमुक्त्वा वेदविदां वरः
स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान्ययौ रामनिवेशनम्
verses.transliteration:
tatheti ca sa rājānamuktvā vedavidāṁ varaḥ
svayaṁ vasiṣṭho bhagavānyayau rāmaniveśanam

translations.english: Thereupon, saying, “So be it," that best of those versed in the Veda, the worshipful Vasiştha conversant with mantras, that one practising excellent vows, mounting a Brahma car, himself went to the residence of Rāma cognizant of mantra, for the purpose of making him fast.

verses.sanskrit:
स रामभवनं प्राप्य पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम्
तिस्रः कक्ष्या रथेनैव विवेश मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
sa rāmabhavanaṁ prāpya pāṇḍurābhraghanaprabham
tisraḥ kakṣyā rathenaiva viveśa munisattamaḥ

translations.english: And that foremost of ascetics, having reached Rāma's sable hued residence resembling a mass of clouds, passed through three several apartments, mounted on the car.

verses.sanskrit:
तमागतमृषिं रामस्त्वरन्निव ससंभ्रमः
मानयिष्यन्स मानार्हं निश्चक्राम निवेशनात्
verses.transliteration:
tamāgatamṛṣiṁ rāmastvaranniva sasaṁbhramaḥ
mānayiṣyansa mānārhaṁ niścakrāma niveśanāt

translations.english: With the view of honouring the saint worthy of honour, Rāma swiftly issued out of his abode.

verses.sanskrit:
स चैनं प्रश्रितं दृष्ट्वा संभाष्याभिप्रसाद्य च
प्रियार्हं हर्षयन्राममित्युवाच पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration:
sa cainaṁ praśritaṁ dṛṣṭvā saṁbhāṣyābhiprasādya ca
priyārhaṁ harṣayanrāmamityuvāca purohitaḥ

translations.english: And nearing the car of that intelligent one, Rāma, personally taking him by the hand, made him descend. Finding Rämna so humble and dear, the priest addressed him, gratifying and delighting him with words that were acceptable.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसन्नस्ते पिता राम यौवराज्यमवाप्स्यसि
उपवासं भवानद्य करोतु सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
prasannaste pitā rāma yauvarājyamavāpsyasi
upavāsaṁ bhavānadya karotu saha sītayā

translations.english: O Rāma your father has been well pleased with you; since you achieve the kingdom (through him). Do you to-day fast with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रातस्त्वामभिषेक्ता हि यौवराज्ये नराधिपः
पिता दशरथः प्रीत्या ययातिं नहुषो यथा
verses.transliteration:
prātastvāmabhiṣektā hi yauvarājye narādhipaḥ
pitā daśarathaḥ prītyā yayātiṁ nahuṣo yathā

translations.english: And in the morning, the king, your father Dasaratha, will, well-pleased, install you as heirapparent like Nahusa installing Yayāti.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा स तदा राममुपवासं यतव्रतम्
मन्त्रवत्कारयामास वैदेह्या सहितं मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā sa tadā rāmamupavāsaṁ yatavratam
mantravatkārayāmāsa vaidehyā sahitaṁ muniḥ

translations.english: Having said this, that pure spirited one, observing own with mantras, made Rāma fast along with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो यथावद्रामेण स राज्ञो गुरुरर्चितः
अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य काकुत्स्थं ययौ रामनिवेशनात्
verses.transliteration:
tato yathāvadrāmeṇa sa rājño gururarcitaḥ
abhyanujñāpya kākutsthaṁ yayau rāmaniveśanāt

translations.english: Then having been duly worshipped by Rāma, and taken Kākutstha's permission, the spiritual preceptor of the king, went away from Rāma's residence.

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृद्भिस्तत्र रामोऽपि ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः
सभाजितो विवेशाथ ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
suhṛdbhistatra rāmo'pi tānanujñāpya sarvaśaḥ
sabhājito viveśātha tānanujñāpya sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: Rāma, having passed some time with sweetspeeched friends, and been honoured by them, with their permission entered his apartment.

verses.sanskrit:
हृष्टनारी नरयुतं रामवेश्म तदा बभौ
यथा मत्तद्विजगणं प्रफुल्लनलिनं सरः
verses.transliteration:
hṛṣṭanārī narayutaṁ rāmaveśma tadā babhau
yathā mattadvijagaṇaṁ praphullanalinaṁ saraḥ

translations.english: At that time Răma's residence was filled with joyous men and women; and it was like to a lake containing lotuses and graced with maddened birds.

verses.sanskrit:
स राजभवनप्रख्यात्तस्माद्रामनिवेशनात्
निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्गं वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rājabhavanaprakhyāttasmādrāmaniveśanāt
nirgatya dadṛśe mārgaṁ vasiṣṭho janasaṁvṛtam

translations.english: (On the other hand) Vasistha, issuing from the palace of Rāma like to the king's palace itself, found the street filled with people.

verses.sanskrit:
वृन्दवृन्दैरयोध्यायां राजमार्गाः समन्ततः
बभूवुरभिसंबाधाः कुतूहलजनैर्वृताः
verses.transliteration:
vṛndavṛndairayodhyāyāṁ rājamārgāḥ samantataḥ
babhūvurabhisaṁbādhāḥ kutūhalajanairvṛtāḥ

translations.english: On all sides, Ayodhya's high ways were crowded with groups of men full of curiosity.

verses.sanskrit:
जनवृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतस्तदा
बभूव राजमार्गस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
janavṛndormisaṁgharṣaharṣasvanavatastadā
babhūva rājamārgasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ

translations.english: The tumult that arose in the high ways in consequence of the concourse and noise, was like the roaring of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
सिक्तसंमृष्टरथ्या हि तदहर्वनमालिनी
आसीदयोध्या नगरी समुच्छ्रितगृहध्वजा
verses.transliteration:
siktasaṁmṛṣṭarathyā hi tadaharvanamālinī
āsīdayodhyā nagarī samucchritagṛhadhvajā

translations.english: The streets were cleared and washed and hung with garlands, and that day Ayodhya had her dwellings furnished with upraised flagstaffs.

verses.sanskrit:
तदा ह्ययोध्या निलयः सस्त्रीबालाबलो जनः
रामाभिषेकमाकाङ्क्षन्नाकाङ्क्षन्नुदयं रवेः
verses.transliteration:
tadā hyayodhyā nilayaḥ sastrībālābalo janaḥ
rāmābhiṣekamākāṅkṣannākāṅkṣannudayaṁ raveḥ

translations.english: In the city of Ayodhyā men with women and children eagerly expected the rising of the sun (next day), and Răma's installation.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजालंकारभूतं च जनस्यानन्दवर्धनम्
उत्सुकोऽभूज्जनो द्रष्टुं तमयोध्या महोत्सवम्
verses.transliteration:
prajālaṁkārabhūtaṁ ca janasyānandavardhanam
utsuko'bhūjjano draṣṭuṁ tamayodhyā mahotsavam

translations.english: And the people burnt to behold in Ayodhyā the august festivity, that was like to an ornament to the subjects, and that enhanced the joy of the people.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं तं जनसंबाधं राजमार्गं पुरोहितः
व्यूहन्निव जनौघं तं शनै राज कुलं ययौ
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ taṁ janasaṁbādhaṁ rājamārgaṁ purohitaḥ
vyūhanniva janaughaṁ taṁ śanai rāja kulaṁ yayau

translations.english: Dividing the crowd thronging the high way, the priest slowly proceeded to the royal family.

verses.sanskrit:
सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यं प्रासदमधिरुह्य सः
समियाय नरेन्द्रेण शक्रेणेव बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration:
sitābhraśikharaprakhyaṁ prāsadamadhiruhya saḥ
samiyāya narendreṇa śakreṇeva bṛhaspatiḥ

translations.english: And ascending the palace like to a peak of the Himavat, he met with the lord of men, like Bệhaspati meeting with Sakra.

verses.sanskrit:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हित्वा राजासनं नृपः
पप्रच्छ स च तस्मै तत्कृतमित्यभ्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya hitvā rājāsanaṁ nṛpaḥ
papraccha sa ca tasmai tatkṛtamityabhyavedayat

translations.english: Seeing him come, the king rising up from his royal seat, asked Vasiştha whether his intention had been carried out, whereupon Vasiştha answered that it had.

verses.sanskrit:
गुरुणा त्वभ्यनुज्ञातो मनुजौघं विसृज्य तम्
विवेशान्तःपुरं राजा सिंहो गिरिगुहामिव
verses.transliteration:
guruṇā tvabhyanujñāto manujaughaṁ visṛjya tam
viveśāntaḥpuraṁ rājā siṁho giriguhāmiva

translations.english: Then with the permission of his spiritual guide, leaving that assembly of men, the monarch entered his inner apartment like a lion entering his den.

verses.sanskrit:
तदग्र्यवेषप्रमदाजनाकुलं; महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमं निवेशनम्
व्यदीपयंश्चारु विवेश पार्थिवः; शशीव तारागणसंकुलं नभः
verses.transliteration:
tadagryaveṣapramadājanākulaṁ; mahendraveśmapratimaṁ niveśanam
vyadīpayaṁścāru viveśa pārthivaḥ; śaśīva tārāgaṇasaṁkulaṁ nabhaḥ

translations.english: Even as the moon illumines the firmament crowded with stars, the handsome king entered his mansion, like to the abode of the mighty Indra, and thronged with females excellently attired, gracing it (by his presence).

verses.sanskrit:
गते पुरोहिते रामः स्नातो नियतमानसः
सह पत्न्या विशालाक्ष्या नारायणमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
gate purohite rāmaḥ snāto niyatamānasaḥ
saha patnyā viśālākṣyā nārāyaṇamupāgamat

translations.english: When the priest had gone away, Rāma, having bathed and with a collected mind, began to adore Nārāyaṇa, in company with his wife having expansive eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रगृह्य शिरसा पात्रीं हविषो विधिवत्तदा
महते दैवतायाज्यं जुहाव ज्वलितेऽनले
verses.transliteration:
pragṛhya śirasā pātrīṁ haviṣo vidhivattadā
mahate daivatāyājyaṁ juhāva jvalite'nale

translations.english: Then raising the vessel of clarified butter to his head (by way of paying reverence), he in accordance with the ordinance began to offer oblations to the flaming fire on behalf of that mighty deity.

verses.sanskrit:
शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम्
ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे
verses.transliteration:
śeṣaṁ ca haviṣastasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṁ devaṁ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṁstare

translations.english: Then, having partaken of the remaining quantity of the clarified butter, Rāma prayed for his own welfare, and meditated on the god Nārāyaṇa. The son of the best of men with a collected mind, and restraining his speech lay down on a Kuśa bed together with Vaidehī within the graceful dwelling of Vişnu.

verses.sanskrit:
एकयामावशिष्टायां रात्र्यां प्रतिविबुध्य सः
अलंकारविधिं कृत्स्नं कारयामास वेश्मनः
verses.transliteration:
ekayāmāvaśiṣṭāyāṁ rātryāṁ prativibudhya saḥ
alaṁkāravidhiṁ kṛtsnaṁ kārayāmāsa veśmanaḥ

translations.english: When a single watch only remained of the night, Rāma awoke, and made his residence well decorated.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र शृण्वन्सुखा वाचः सूतमागधबन्दिनाम्
पूर्वां संध्यामुपासीनो जजाप यतमानसः
verses.transliteration:
tatra śṛṇvansukhā vācaḥ sūtamāgadhabandinām
pūrvāṁ saṁdhyāmupāsīno jajāpa yatamānasaḥ

translations.english: Now he hearing the melodious utterances of genealogists and panegyrist and Brāhmaṇas versed in the Purāņas, Rāma finished devotions for the prior twilight, and with an intent mind began to recite (Savatri).* *The celebrated hymn to the sun, the most sacred thing in all the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit:
तुष्टाव प्रणतश्चैव शिरसा मधुसूदनम्
विमलक्षौमसंवीतो वाचयामास च द्विजान्
verses.transliteration:
tuṣṭāva praṇataścaiva śirasā madhusūdanam
vimalakṣaumasaṁvīto vācayāmāsa ca dvijān

translations.english: And clad in a clear silk dress, he with bended head hymned the destroyer of Madhu, and made the regenerate ones perform the Svastivácana ceremony.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां पुण्याहघोषोऽथ गम्भीरमधुरस्तदा
अयोध्यां पूरयामास तूर्यघोषानुनादितः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ puṇyāhaghoṣo'tha gambhīramadhurastadā
ayodhyāṁ pūrayāmāsa tūryaghoṣānunāditaḥ

translations.english: Already resounding with the blares of trumpets, Ayodhyā became filled with the sweet and solemn tones of the expressions “Holy day" uttered by them.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतोपवासं तु तदा वैदेह्या सह राघवम्
अयोध्या निलयः श्रुत्वा सर्वः प्रमुदितो जनः
verses.transliteration:
kṛtopavāsaṁ tu tadā vaidehyā saha rāghavam
ayodhyā nilayaḥ śrutvā sarvaḥ pramudito janaḥ

translations.english: The denizens of Ayodhyā, hearing that Rāghava had fasted with Vaidehi, rejoiced exceedingly.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पौरजनः सर्वः श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्
प्रभातां रजनीं दृष्ट्वा चक्रे शोभां परां पुनः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paurajanaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā rāmābhiṣecanam
prabhātāṁ rajanīṁ dṛṣṭvā cakre śobhāṁ parāṁ punaḥ

translations.english: Then the citizens, hearing of the installation of Rāma and seeing that the night had departed, fell to adorning the city.

verses.sanskrit:
नटनर्तकसंघानां गायकानां च गायताम्
मनःकर्णसुखा वाचः शुश्रुवुश्च ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
naṭanartakasaṁghānāṁ gāyakānāṁ ca gāyatām
manaḥkarṇasukhā vācaḥ śuśruvuśca tatastataḥ

translations.english: The multitude then heard the music, soothing to the ear and heart, of stage managers, dancers and singers chanting.

verses.sanskrit:
रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः
रामाभिषेके संप्राप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च
verses.transliteration:
rāmābhiṣekayuktāśca kathāścakrurmitho janāḥ
rāmābhiṣeke saṁprāpte catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca

translations.english: The people began to talk with each other anent the installation of Rāma, and the time for his installation having arrived, on terraces and houses, and doorways boys playing in bodies, conversed with each other concerning the installation of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतपुष्पोपहारश्च धूपगन्धाधिवासितः
राजमार्गः कृतः श्रीमान्पौरै रामाभिषेचने
verses.transliteration:
kṛtapuṣpopahāraśca dhūpagandhādhivāsitaḥ
rājamārgaḥ kṛtaḥ śrīmānpaurai rāmābhiṣecane

translations.english: On the occasion of the investiture of Rāma, the goodly high ways were adorned with garlands, and scented with dhūpa incense, by the citizens.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकाशीकरणार्थं च निशागमनशङ्कया
दीपवृक्षांस्तथा चक्रुरनु रथ्यासु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
prakāśīkaraṇārthaṁ ca niśāgamanaśaṅkayā
dīpavṛkṣāṁstathā cakruranu rathyāsu sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: And fearing lest Rāma should come out over night (to behold the beautified capital), the inhabitants of the city, by way of ornamentation as with the view of beholding Rāma himself, had by the road side reared up lamp-stands in the form of (branched) trees.

verses.sanskrit:
अहो महात्मा राजायमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः
ज्ञात्वा यो वृद्धमात्मानं रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
aho mahātmā rājāyamikṣvākukulanandanaḥ
jñātvā yo vṛddhamātmānaṁ rāmaṁ rājye'bhiṣekṣyati

translations.english: Eagerly expecting the investiture of Rāma as the heir-apparent, all having thus ornamented the city and assembling them selves on terraces and in council-halls, talking with each other, extolled the lord of men, saying, “Ah high-souled is this king, the perpetuator of the Iksvāku race, for, knowing himself as old, he will install Rāma in the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे ह्यनुगृहीताः स्म यन्नो रामो महीपतिः
चिराय भविता गोप्ता दृष्टलोकपरावरः
verses.transliteration:
sarve hyanugṛhītāḥ sma yanno rāmo mahīpatiḥ
cirāya bhavitā goptā dṛṣṭalokaparāvaraḥ

translations.english: Obliged we have been, since good Rāma capable of reading character, will be the lord of earth, and our protector.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुद्धतमना विद्वान्धर्मात्मा भ्रातृवत्सलः
यथा च भ्रातृषु स्निग्धस्तथास्मास्वपि राघवः
verses.transliteration:
anuddhatamanā vidvāndharmātmā bhrātṛvatsalaḥ
yathā ca bhrātṛṣu snigdhastathāsmāsvapi rāghavaḥ

translations.english: He is of a heart devoid of arrogance, and is learned, and righteous-souled, and affectionate to his brothers. Rāghava loves us even as he does his own brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
चिरं जीवतु धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथोऽनघः
यत्प्रसादेनाभिषिक्तं रामं द्रक्ष्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration:
ciraṁ jīvatu dharmātmā rājā daśaratho'naghaḥ
yatprasādenābhiṣiktaṁ rāmaṁ drakṣyāmahe vayam

translations.english: May the sinless and pious king Dasaratha live long; for it is through his grace that we shall behold Rāma installed.

verses.sanskrit:
एवंविधं कथयतां पौराणां शुश्रुवुस्तदा
दिग्भ्योऽपि श्रुतवृत्तान्ताः प्राप्ता जानपदा जनाः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁvidhaṁ kathayatāṁ paurāṇāṁ śuśruvustadā
digbhyo'pi śrutavṛttāntāḥ prāptā jānapadā janāḥ

translations.english: The inhabitants of the provinces, who having heard the tidings, had come from various regions, heard the citizens conversing thus.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु दिग्भ्यः पुरीं प्राप्ता द्रष्टुं रामाभिषेचनम्
रामस्य पूरयामासुः पुरीं जानपदा जनाः
verses.transliteration:
te tu digbhyaḥ purīṁ prāptā draṣṭuṁ rāmābhiṣecanam
rāmasya pūrayāmāsuḥ purīṁ jānapadā janāḥ

translations.english: Desirous of beholding the installation of Rāma, they coming into the city from various directions, filled Rāma's city.

verses.sanskrit:
जनौघैस्तैर्विसर्पद्भिः शुश्रुवे तत्र निःस्वनः
पर्वसूदीर्णवेगस्य सागरस्येव निःस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
janaughaistairvisarpadbhiḥ śuśruve tatra niḥsvanaḥ
parvasūdīrṇavegasya sāgarasyeva niḥsvanaḥ

translations.english: As the vast concourse entered (the city),there was heard an uproar like to the roaring of the heaving ocean during the fullness of the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तदिन्द्रक्षयसंनिभं पुरं; दिदृक्षुभिर्जानपदैरुपागतैः
समन्ततः सस्वनमाकुलं बभौ; समुद्रयादोभिरिवार्णवोदकम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastadindrakṣayasaṁnibhaṁ puraṁ; didṛkṣubhirjānapadairupāgataiḥ
samantataḥ sasvanamākulaṁ babhau; samudrayādobhirivārṇavodakam

translations.english: Then that city resembling the regions of Indra, being filled on all sides with tumult raised by the dwellers of the provinces who had come to behold (the installation), resembled the ocean when its waters are agitated by the aquatic animals inhabiting it.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञातिदासी यतो जाता कैकेय्यास्तु सहोषिता
प्रासादं चन्द्रसंकाशमारुरोह यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration:
jñātidāsī yato jātā kaikeyyāstu sahoṣitā
prāsādaṁ candrasaṁkāśamāruroha yadṛcchayā

translations.english: A woman, brought up with Kaikeyī, who formerly served as a maid-servant the family of her maternal uncle, at her own will, ascended the palace resembling the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
सिक्तराजपथां कृत्स्नां प्रकीर्णकमलोत्पलाम्
अयोध्यां मन्थरा तस्मात्प्रासादादन्ववैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
siktarājapathāṁ kṛtsnāṁ prakīrṇakamalotpalām
ayodhyāṁ mantharā tasmātprāsādādanvavaikṣata

translations.english: Mantharā beheld from the palace the highways of Ayodhyā well watered all round, and strewn with lotuses, and adorned with standards bearing gay pennons.

verses.sanskrit:
अविदूरे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा धात्रीं पप्रच्छ मन्थरा
उत्तमेनाभिसंयुक्ता हर्षेणार्थपरा सती
verses.transliteration:
avidūre sthitāṁ dṛṣṭvā dhātrīṁ papraccha mantharā
uttamenābhisaṁyuktā harṣeṇārthaparā satī

translations.english: Mantharā, seeing a nurse hard by clad in white silk, with her eyes expanded with delight, asked her, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
राममाता धनं किं नु जनेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति
अतिमात्रं प्रहर्षोऽयं किं जनस्य च शंस मे
कारयिष्यति किं वापि संप्रहृष्टो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration:
rāmamātā dhanaṁ kiṁ nu janebhyaḥ saṁprayacchati
atimātraṁ praharṣo'yaṁ kiṁ janasya ca śaṁsa me
kārayiṣyati kiṁ vāpi saṁprahṛṣṭo mahīpatiḥ

translations.english: What for Rāma's mother although closefisted, is cheerfully and with the greatest possible alacrity dispensing wealth to the people? And what for is the general overflow of joy? And what does the delighted monarch purpose to do.

verses.sanskrit:
विदीर्यमाणा हर्षेण धात्री परमया मुदा
आचचक्षेऽथ कुब्जायै भूयसीं राघवे श्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
vidīryamāṇā harṣeṇa dhātrī paramayā mudā
ācacakṣe'tha kubjāyai bhūyasīṁ rāghave śriyam

translations.english: There upon bursting with very great delight, the nurse communicated to the hump-backed woman the high fortune awaiting Rama, saying, To-morrow under Pusya, king Dasaratha will install the sinless Rāghava having his anger under control, as heir-apparent to the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
धात्र्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कुब्जा क्षिप्रममर्षिता
कैलास शिखराकारात्प्रासादादवरोहत
verses.transliteration:
dhātryāstu vacanaṁ śrutvā kubjā kṣipramamarṣitā
kailāsa śikharākārātprāsādādavarohata

translations.english: Hearing the words of the nurse, the humpbacked one, speedily growing angry, descended from the edifice resembling a summit of the Kailasa hill.

verses.sanskrit:
सा दह्यमाना कोपेन मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी
शयानामेत्य कैकेयीमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sā dahyamānā kopena mantharā pāpadarśinī
śayānāmetya kaikeyīmidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Burning in ire, the sin-seeking Mantharā addressed Kaikeyi, lying down, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठ मूढे किं शेषे भयं त्वामभिवर्तते
उपप्लुतमहौघेन किमात्मानं न बुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭha mūḍhe kiṁ śeṣe bhayaṁ tvāmabhivartate
upaplutamahaughena kimātmānaṁ na budhyase

translations.english: Up, you senseless one! What for are you down? A great danger approaches you. You understand not that a mighty grief overflow you.

verses.sanskrit:
अनिष्टे सुभगाकारे सौभाग्येन विकत्थसे
चलं हि तव सौभाग्यं नद्यः स्रोत इवोष्णगे
verses.transliteration:
aniṣṭe subhagākāre saubhāgyena vikatthase
calaṁ hi tava saubhāgyaṁ nadyaḥ srota ivoṣṇage

translations.english: You boast of good fortune while misfortune is yours in the shape of luck. Your good fortune is surely unstable like the tide of a river during summer.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी रुष्टया परुषं वचः
कुब्जया पापदर्शिन्या विषादमगमत्परम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu kaikeyī ruṣṭayā paruṣaṁ vacaḥ
kubjayā pāpadarśinyā viṣādamagamatparam

translations.english: Thus addressed by the sin seeking humpbacked (hag) in exceedingly harsh language, Kaikeyi became afflicted with great grief.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेयी त्वब्रवीत्कुब्जां कच्चित्क्षेमं न मन्थरे
विषण्णवदनां हि त्वां लक्षये भृशदुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyī tvabravītkubjāṁ kaccitkṣemaṁ na manthare
viṣaṇṇavadanāṁ hi tvāṁ lakṣaye bhṛśaduḥkhitām

translations.english: And Kaikeyi said to the hump-backed one, Is any evil present, O Mantharā? I do find you with countenance fallen and sore distressed with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्थरा तु वचः श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या मधुराक्षरम्
उवाच क्रोधसंयुक्ता वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा
verses.transliteration:
mantharā tu vacaḥ śrutvā kaikeyyā madhurākṣaram
uvāca krodhasaṁyuktā vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradā

translations.english: The hump-backed Mantharā, skilled in speech, who really sought Kaikeyi's welfare, hearing the latter's sweet-accented words, displaying sorrow greater than Kaikeyi's own, lamenting, and enlisting Kaikeyi's feelings against Rāma, uttered words inflamed with anger, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षेमं सुमहद्देवि प्रवृत्तं त्वद्विनाशनम्
रामं दशरथो राजा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
akṣemaṁ sumahaddevi pravṛttaṁ tvadvināśanam
rāmaṁ daśaratho rājā yauvarājye'bhiṣekṣyati

translations.english: O worshipful one, an enduring and terrible destruction is imminent to you. King Daśaratha will install;; Rama as heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
सास्म्यगाधे भये मग्ना दुःखशोकसमन्विता
दह्यमानानलेनेव त्वद्धितार्थमिहागता
verses.transliteration:
sāsmyagādhe bhaye magnā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā
dahyamānānaleneva tvaddhitārthamihāgatā

translations.english: I have been sunk in a fathomless fear; and afflicted with grief and heaviness. And as if burning I, seeking your welfare, have come to you.

verses.sanskrit:
तव दुःखेन कैकेयि मम दुःखं महद्भवेत्
त्वद्वृद्धौ मम वृद्धिश्च भवेदत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tava duḥkhena kaikeyi mama duḥkhaṁ mahadbhavet
tvadvṛddhau mama vṛddhiśca bhavedatra na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: For, O Kaikeyi, great wax my grief on witnessing your sorrow; and my advancement progress along with you there is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit:
नराधिपकुले जाता महिषी त्वं महीपतेः
उग्रत्वं राजधर्माणां कथं देवि न बुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
narādhipakule jātā mahiṣī tvaṁ mahīpateḥ
ugratvaṁ rājadharmāṇāṁ kathaṁ devi na budhyase

translations.english: Born in a race of king you are the queen of this lord of earth. Why did not you then realise the sternness of royal morality.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मवादी शठो भर्ता श्लक्ष्णवादी च दारुणः
शुद्धभावे न जानीषे तेनैवमतिसंधिता
verses.transliteration:
dharmavādī śaṭho bhartā ślakṣṇavādī ca dāruṇaḥ
śuddhabhāve na jānīṣe tenaivamatisaṁdhitā

translations.english: Your maintainer speaks most morally; but is crafty for all that: he speaks blandly, but has a crooked heart. Him you take as of blessed condition, and therefore are gulled.

verses.sanskrit:
उपस्थितं प्रयुञ्जानस्त्वयि सान्त्वमनर्थकम्
अर्थेनैवाद्य ते भर्ता कौसल्यां योजयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
upasthitaṁ prayuñjānastvayi sāntvamanarthakam
arthenaivādya te bhartā kausalyāṁ yojayiṣyati

translations.english: Speaking to you soft words bare of substance, he will, his heart on the alert, to-day compass the welfare of Kausalyä.

verses.sanskrit:
अपवाह्य स दुष्टात्मा भरतं तव बन्धुषु
काल्यं स्थापयिता रामं राज्ये निहतकण्टके
verses.transliteration:
apavāhya sa duṣṭātmā bharataṁ tava bandhuṣu
kālyaṁ sthāpayitā rāmaṁ rājye nihatakaṇṭake

translations.english: Having sent Bharata to the home of your relatives, that wicked-minded one will establish Rāma in his ancestral kingdom rid of its thorn.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा हि कुर्यात्सर्पो वा शत्रुर्वा प्रत्युपेक्षितः
राज्ञा दशरथेनाद्य सपुत्रा त्वं तथा कृता
verses.transliteration:
yathā hi kuryātsarpo vā śatrurvā pratyupekṣitaḥ
rājñā daśarathenādya saputrā tvaṁ tathā kṛtā

translations.english: You O girl, in consideration of your welfare, have like to a mother taken to your lap a venomous snake in the form of your husband, Even what is done by an enemy or a serpent left alone, is being done by Dasaratha of wicked ways and false soothing speech, to you and your own son.

verses.sanskrit:
पापेनानृतसान्त्वेन बाले नित्यं सुखोचिते
रामं स्थापयता राज्ये सानुबन्धा हता ह्यसि
verses.transliteration:
pāpenānṛtasāntvena bāle nityaṁ sukhocite
rāmaṁ sthāpayatā rājye sānubandhā hatā hyasi

translations.english: And, O girl, deserving as you are of happiness, the king having established Rāma in the kingdom; you will be annihilated along with your own. The time has come, 'O Kaikeyi, do you on the spur enter upon that which would turn to your advantage. And, O you, influenced by surprise, do you deliver yourself, me and Bharata also.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्थराया वचः श्रुत्वा शयनात्सा शुभानना
एकमाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रददौ शुभम्
verses.transliteration:
mantharāyā vacaḥ śrutvā śayanātsā śubhānanā
ekamābharaṇaṁ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham

translations.english: Hearing Mantharā's words, that one of graceful countenance filled with delight, and looking like the autumnal moon light, rose up from her bed.

verses.sanskrit:
दत्त्वा त्वाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रमदोत्तमा
कैकेयी मन्थरां हृष्टा पुनरेवाब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration:
dattvā tvābharaṇaṁ tasyai kubjāyai pramadottamā
kaikeyī mantharāṁ hṛṣṭā punarevābravīdidam

translations.english: And having given her the ornament, the paragon among the fair Kaikeyi joyfully, addressed Manthara, saying, O Manthara! highly welcome is the that you have communicated to me. And surely you have told me what is dear to my heart, what shall I do for you?

verses.sanskrit:
रामे वा भरते वाहं विशेषं नोपलक्षये
तस्मात्तुष्टास्मि यद्राजा रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
rāme vā bharate vāhaṁ viśeṣaṁ nopalakṣaye
tasmāttuṣṭāsmi yadrājā rāmaṁ rājye'bhiṣekṣyati

translations.english: Difference find I none between Rāma and Bharata. Therefore, delighted am I that the king purposes installing Rāma in the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे परं किंचिदितस्त्वया पुनः; प्रियं प्रियार्हे सुवचं वचो वरम्
तथा ह्यवोचस्त्वमतः प्रियोत्तरं; वरं परं ते प्रददामि तं वृणु
verses.transliteration:
na me paraṁ kiṁciditastvayā punaḥ; priyaṁ priyārhe suvacaṁ vaco varam
tathā hyavocastvamataḥ priyottaraṁ; varaṁ paraṁ te pradadāmi taṁ vṛṇu

translations.english: There is no other ambrosial speech that is excellent and acceptable to me, compared with the installation of Rāma. Therefore do you ask of me whatever reward do you want and I shall give you. news

verses.sanskrit:
मन्थरा त्वभ्यसूय्यैनामुत्सृज्याभरणं च तत्
उवाचेदं ततो वाक्यं कोपदुःखसमन्विता
verses.transliteration:
mantharā tvabhyasūyyaināmutsṛjyābharaṇaṁ ca tat
uvācedaṁ tato vākyaṁ kopaduḥkhasamanvitā

translations.english: Mantharā, making Kaikeyi the object of her wrath, threw off the noble ornament, and spoke these words, in anger and grief.

verses.sanskrit:
हर्षं किमिदमस्थाने कृतवत्यसि बालिशे
शोकसागरमध्यस्थमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
harṣaṁ kimidamasthāne kṛtavatyasi bāliśe
śokasāgaramadhyasthamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase

translations.english: You senseless girl, wherefore do you display your joy on such an unfit occasion. You did not see that you are in the bosom of an ocean of grief. Being grieved at heart do I laugh at you inwardly.

verses.sanskrit:
सुभगा खलु कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते
यौवराज्येन महता श्वः पुष्येण द्विजोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration:
subhagā khalu kausalyā yasyāḥ putro'bhiṣekṣyate
yauvarājyena mahatā śvaḥ puṣyeṇa dvijottamaiḥ

translations.english: Surely Kausalya is of blessed fortune, for tomorrow under Puşya the foremost of the twiceborn ones will install her son as the mighty heir apparent to the empire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्तां सुमहतीं प्रीतिं प्रतीतां तां हतद्विषम्
उपस्थास्यसि कौसल्यां दासीव त्वं कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
prāptāṁ sumahatīṁ prītiṁ pratītāṁ tāṁ hatadviṣam
upasthāsyasi kausalyāṁ dāsīva tvaṁ kṛtāñjaliḥ

translations.english: You will, with clasped hands, serve as a slave the illustrious Kausalyā, mistress of the world, and brimming over with joy, with all her foes discomfited.

verses.sanskrit:
हृष्टाः खलु भविष्यन्ति रामस्य परमाः स्त्रियः
अप्रहृष्टा भविष्यन्ति स्नुषास्ते भरतक्षये
verses.transliteration:
hṛṣṭāḥ khalu bhaviṣyanti rāmasya paramāḥ striyaḥ
aprahṛṣṭā bhaviṣyanti snuṣāste bharatakṣaye

translations.english: And Ráma's wives* together with their handmaids will be filled with delight' and in consequence of Bharata's name, your daughtersin-law will be afflicted with sorrow. *Historically Rāma had but one wife. Manthară here anticipated that Rāma would marry many wives like his father after the installation.

verses.sanskrit:
तां दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतां ब्रुवन्तीं मन्थरां ततः
रामस्यैव गुणान्देवी कैकेयी प्रशशंस ह
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāṁ bruvantīṁ mantharāṁ tataḥ
rāmasyaiva guṇāndevī kaikeyī praśaśaṁsa ha

translations.english: Seeing Manthară dead set against Rāma, and speaking in this wise, the noble Kaikeyi praised the virtues of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मज्ञो गुरुभिर्दान्तः कृतज्ञः सत्यवाक्शुचिः
रामो राज्ञः सुतो ज्येष्ठो यौवराज्यमतोऽर्हति
verses.transliteration:
dharmajño gurubhirdāntaḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyavākśuciḥ
rāmo rājñaḥ suto jyeṣṭho yauvarājyamato'rhati

translations.english: Rāma is cognizant of morality, and filled with perfections, and accomplished, and grateful, and endowed with truth, and pure. And as he is the eldest son of the King, he deserves the Kingdom as heir-apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातॄन्भृत्यांश्च दीर्घायुः पितृवत्पालयिष्यति
संतप्यसे कथं कुब्जे श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्
verses.transliteration:
bhrātṝnbhṛtyāṁśca dīrghāyuḥ pitṛvatpālayiṣyati
saṁtapyase kathaṁ kubje śrutvā rāmābhiṣecanam

translations.english: That long-lived one shall maintain his brothers and his retainers even like a father. Why then, O hump-backed one, do you grieve, hearing Rāma's installation.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतश्चापि रामस्य ध्रुवं वर्षशतात्परम्
पितृपैतामहं राज्यमवाप्स्यति नरर्षभः
verses.transliteration:
bharataścāpi rāmasya dhruvaṁ varṣaśatātparam
pitṛpaitāmahaṁ rājyamavāpsyati nararṣabhaḥ

translations.english: And for certain, that foremost of men, Bharata also, an hundred years after Rāma, will attain the kingdom bequeathed by his father and grandfather.

verses.sanskrit:
सा त्वमभ्युदये प्राप्ते वर्तमाने च मन्थरे
भविष्यति च कल्याणे किमर्थं परितप्यसे
कौसल्यातोऽतिरिक्तं च स तु शुश्रूषते हि माम्
verses.transliteration:
sā tvamabhyudaye prāpte vartamāne ca manthare
bhaviṣyati ca kalyāṇe kimarthaṁ paritapyase
kausalyāto'tiriktaṁ ca sa tu śuśrūṣate hi mām

translations.english: O Mantharā, you burn (with grief) in this auspicious time. Our good fortune will come (after this in the shape of Bharata's installation); why then do you grieve.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेय्या वचनं श्रुत्वा मन्थरा भृशदुःखिता
दीर्घमुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyyā vacanaṁ śrutvā mantharā bhṛśaduḥkhitā
dīrghamuṣṇaṁ viniḥśvasya kaikeyīmidamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing Kaikeyi's words, Mantharā exceedingly aggrieved, sighing hot and hard, thus addressed Kaikeyi, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अनर्थदर्शिनी मौर्ख्यान्नात्मानमवबुध्यसे
शोकव्यसनविस्तीर्णे मज्जन्ती दुःखसागरे
verses.transliteration:
anarthadarśinī maurkhyānnātmānamavabudhyase
śokavyasanavistīrṇe majjantī duḥkhasāgare

translations.english: Regarding that to be evil which is your good, you do not through your want of understanding know that you are going to be drowned in a sea of grief and peril.

verses.sanskrit:
भविता राघवो राजा राघवस्य च यः सुतः
राजवंशात्तु भरतः कैकेयि परिहास्यते
verses.transliteration:
bhavitā rāghavo rājā rāghavasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ
rājavaṁśāttu bharataḥ kaikeyi parihāsyate

translations.english: Rāghava will become king; and after Raghava his son; so that, O Kaikeyi, Bharata will come to be at once cut off from the royal line.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि राज्ञः सुताः सर्वे राज्ये तिष्ठन्ति भामिनि
स्थाप्यमानेषु सर्वेषु सुमहाननयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
na hi rājñaḥ sutāḥ sarve rājye tiṣṭhanti bhāmini
sthāpyamāneṣu sarveṣu sumahānanayo bhavet

translations.english: O emotional one, surely all the sons of the king do not obtain the kingdom. And if all were placed on the throne, mighty would be the disturbance therefrom.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माज्ज्येष्ठे हि कैकेयि राज्यतन्त्राणि पार्थिवाः
स्थापयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गि गुणवत्स्वितरेष्वपि
verses.transliteration:
tasmājjyeṣṭhe hi kaikeyi rājyatantrāṇi pārthivāḥ
sthāpayantyanavadyāṅgi guṇavatsvitareṣvapi

translations.english: Therefore it is that kings, O Kaikeyi, lay the task of Government on the eldest son if worthy, or else upon a younger most meritorious.

verses.sanskrit:
असावत्यन्तनिर्भग्नस्तव पुत्रो भविष्यति
अनाथवत्सुखेभ्यश्च राजवंशाच्च वत्सले
verses.transliteration:
asāvatyantanirbhagnastava putro bhaviṣyati
anāthavatsukhebhyaśca rājavaṁśācca vatsale

translations.english: This your son, O affectionate one, cast off from the royal race, and deprived of happiness, will fare like one forlorn.

verses.sanskrit:
साहं त्वदर्थे संप्राप्ता त्वं तु मां नावबुध्यसे
सपत्निवृद्धौ या मे त्वं प्रदेयं दातुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
sāhaṁ tvadarthe saṁprāptā tvaṁ tu māṁ nāvabudhyase
sapatnivṛddhau yā me tvaṁ pradeyaṁ dātumicchasi

translations.english: You do not understand that I am taking such pains, and it is evident that you does not understand that I have come to you for your good. You are conferring on me rewards on the advancement of your co-wife.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रुवं तु भरतं रामः प्राप्य राज्यमकण्टकम्
देशान्तरं नाययिता लोकान्तरमथापि वा
verses.transliteration:
dhruvaṁ tu bharataṁ rāmaḥ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam
deśāntaraṁ nāyayitā lokāntaramathāpi vā

translations.english: For certain, Rāma having attained the kingdom without let, will send Bharata either to a distant land, or to the other world.

verses.sanskrit:
बाल एव हि मातुल्यं भरतो नायितस्त्वया
संनिकर्षाच्च सौहार्दं जायते स्थावरेष्वपि
verses.transliteration:
bāla eva hi mātulyaṁ bharato nāyitastvayā
saṁnikarṣācca sauhārdaṁ jāyate sthāvareṣvapi

translations.english: Bharata is a mere boy, and by you it is that he has been sent to his maternal uncle's mansion. Even in immobile objects attachment grows by virtue of nearness.

verses.sanskrit:
गोप्ता हि रामं सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणं चापि राघवः
अश्विनोरिव सौभ्रात्रं तयोर्लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
goptā hi rāmaṁ saumitrirlakṣmaṇaṁ cāpi rāghavaḥ
aśvinoriva saubhrātraṁ tayorlokeṣu viśrutam

translations.english: Sumitrā's son protects Rāma and Rāghava protects Lakşmaņa. Their fraternal love like that of the Asvins is celebrated in the world,

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मान्न लक्ष्मणे रामः पापं किंचित्करिष्यति
रामस्तु भरते पापं कुर्यादिति न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tasmānna lakṣmaṇe rāmaḥ pāpaṁ kiṁcitkariṣyati
rāmastu bharate pāpaṁ kuryāditi na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Therefore Rāma will never do any wrong to Lakşmaņa; but he will do wrong to Bharata, there is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्राजगृहादेव वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः
एतद्धि रोचते मह्यं भृशं चापि हितं तव
verses.transliteration:
tasmādrājagṛhādeva vanaṁ gacchatu te sutaḥ
etaddhi rocate mahyaṁ bhṛśaṁ cāpi hitaṁ tava

translations.english: Therefore let that son of Raghu be sent to the woods from the palace. This pleases me; and this also is for your supreme welfare; and in this wise also will be realised the good of your relations.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ते ज्ञातिपक्षस्य श्रेयश्चैव भविष्यति
यदि चेद्भरतो धर्मात्पित्र्यं राज्यमवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ te jñātipakṣasya śreyaścaiva bhaviṣyati
yadi cedbharato dharmātpitryaṁ rājyamavāpsyati

translations.english: But if Bharata can get at his ancestral kingdom by just means, that would also be welcome to your kindred.

verses.sanskrit:
स ते सुखोचितो बालो रामस्य सहजो रिपुः
समृद्धार्थस्य नष्टार्थो जीविष्यति कथं वशे
verses.transliteration:
sa te sukhocito bālo rāmasya sahajo ripuḥ
samṛddhārthasya naṣṭārtho jīviṣyati kathaṁ vaśe

translations.english: That boy deserving of happiness is the natural enemy of Rāma. How can he live under the prosperous Rāma being deprived of all wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिद्रुतमिवारण्ये सिंहेन गजयूथपम्
प्रच्छाद्यमानं रामेण भरतं त्रातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
abhidrutamivāraṇye siṁhena gajayūthapam
pracchādyamānaṁ rāmeṇa bharataṁ trātumarhasi

translations.english: Therefore it behoves you to save Bharata about to be overcome by Rāma, like a lion pursuing the leader of an elephant herd in a forest.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्पान्निराकृता पूर्वं त्वया सौभाग्यवत्तया
राममाता सपत्नी ते कथं वैरं न यातयेत्
verses.transliteration:
darpānnirākṛtā pūrvaṁ tvayā saubhāgyavattayā
rāmamātā sapatnī te kathaṁ vairaṁ na yātayet

translations.english: Your co-wife, Rāma's mother, had formerly through pride and good fortune been slighted by you. Why will not she upon you wreak her revenge now.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति; ध्रुवं प्रनष्टो भरतो भविष्यति
अतो हि संचिन्तय राज्यमात्मजे; परस्य चाद्यैव विवासकारणम्
verses.transliteration:
yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati; dhruvaṁ pranaṣṭo bharato bhaviṣyati
ato hi saṁcintaya rājyamātmaje; parasya cādyaiva vivāsakāraṇam

translations.english: And when Rāma will obtain the earth, Bharata will certainly meet with destruction, therefore do you ponder as to how you can place your son on the throne and banish your enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी क्रोधेन ज्वलितानना
दीर्घमुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य मन्थरामिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu kaikeyī krodhena jvalitānanā
dīrghamuṣṇaṁ viniḥśvasya mantharāmidamabravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed, Kaikeyi, with her countenance flaming in wrath, sighing hot and hard, spoke to Mantharā, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य राममितः क्षिप्रं वनं प्रस्थापयाम्यहम्
यौवराज्येन भरतं क्षिप्रमेवाभिषेचये
verses.transliteration:
adya rāmamitaḥ kṣipraṁ vanaṁ prasthāpayāmyaham
yauvarājyena bharataṁ kṣipramevābhiṣecaye

translations.english: Even this very day will I speedily send Rāma into the forest and without delay install Bharata in the royal heir-apparentship.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं त्विदानीं संपश्य केनोपायेन मन्थरे
भरतः प्राप्नुयाद्राज्यं न तु रामः कथंचन
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ tvidānīṁ saṁpaśya kenopāyena manthare
bharataḥ prāpnuyādrājyaṁ na tu rāmaḥ kathaṁcana

translations.english: Do you now see by what means I can effect this. Bharata must obtain the kingdom and never Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तया देव्या मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी
रामार्थमुपहिंसन्ती कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tayā devyā mantharā pāpadarśinī
rāmārthamupahiṁsantī kaikeyīmidamabravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed by the worshipful one, the wicked minded Mantharā, envying Rāma's interest, thus spoke to Kaikeyi.

verses.sanskrit:
