yāvanmātaramāpṛcche sītāṁ cānunayāmyaham
tato'dyaiva gamiṣyāmi daṇḍakānāṁ mahadvanam

translations.english: Excuse me until I ask my mother, and comfort Sītā; even this very day shall I wend my way to the great forest of Dandaka.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतः पालयेद्राज्यं शुश्रूषेच्च पितुर्यथा
तथा भवत्या कर्तव्यं स हि धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration:
bharataḥ pālayedrājyaṁ śuśrūṣecca pituryathā
tathā bhavatyā kartavyaṁ sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

translations.english: If behoves you to do that by which Bharata may govern the kingdom and tend our father, for this is the virtue eternal.

verses.sanskrit:
स रामस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भृशं दुःखहतः पिता
शोकादशक्नुवन्बाष्पं प्ररुरोद महास्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāmasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhṛśaṁ duḥkhahataḥ pitā
śokādaśaknuvanbāṣpaṁ praruroda mahāsvanam

translations.english: Hearing these words of Rāma, his father, greatly afflicted and incapable of speaking anything on account of sorrow, began to cry aloud.

verses.sanskrit:
वन्दित्वा चरणौ रामो विसंज्ञस्य पितुस्तदा
कैकेय्याश्चाप्यनार्याया निष्पपात महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
vanditvā caraṇau rāmo visaṁjñasya pitustadā
kaikeyyāścāpyanāryāyā niṣpapāta mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: Worshipping the feet of the king lying insensible, and those of vicious Kaikeyi, that greatly effulgent one went out.

verses.sanskrit:
स रामः पितरं कृत्वा कैकेयीं च प्रदक्षिणम्
निष्क्रम्यान्तःपुरात्तस्मात्स्वं ददर्श सुहृज्जनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāmaḥ pitaraṁ kṛtvā kaikeyīṁ ca pradakṣiṇam
niṣkramyāntaḥpurāttasmātsvaṁ dadarśa suhṛjjanam

translations.english: And reverentially going round his father and Kaikeyi, and issuing out of the female apartment, Rāma saw his own friends and relatives.

verses.sanskrit:
तं बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह
लक्ष्मणः परमक्रुद्धः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ bāṣpaparipūrṇākṣaḥ pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma ha
lakṣmaṇaḥ paramakruddhaḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ

translations.english: Then followed him Lakşmaņa, the enhance of Sumitra's joy, greatly angry and with his eyes full of tears.

verses.sanskrit:
आभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम्
शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन्
verses.transliteration:
ābhiṣecanikaṁ bhāṇḍaṁ kṛtvā rāmaḥ pradakṣiṇam
śanairjagāma sāpekṣo dṛṣṭiṁ tatrāvicālayan

translations.english: Going round with reverence the house of installation full of necessary articles, not turning away from it his wistful look, Rāma began to proceed slowly.

verses.sanskrit:
न चास्य महतीं लक्ष्मीं राज्यनाशोऽपकर्षति
लोककान्तस्य कान्तत्वं शीतरश्मेरिव क्षपा
verses.transliteration:
na cāsya mahatīṁ lakṣmīṁ rājyanāśo'pakarṣati
lokakāntasya kāntatvaṁ śītaraśmeriva kṣapā

translations.english: Loss of kingdom could not diminish the great beauty of that beloved of the people on account of its everlasting pleasantness, like to the wane of the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुंधराम्
सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया
verses.transliteration:
na vanaṁ gantukāmasya tyajataśca vasuṁdharām
sarvalokātigasyeva lakṣyate cittavikriyā

translations.english: There was manifest in his no change of mind, who was about to fly as an exile to the forest and leave the world, like to one emancipated while yet living.

verses.sanskrit:
धारयन्मनसा दुःखमिन्द्रियाणि निगृह्य च
प्रविवेशात्मवान्वेश्म मातुरप्रियशंसिवान्
verses.transliteration:
dhārayanmanasā duḥkhamindriyāṇi nigṛhya ca
praviveśātmavānveśma māturapriyaśaṁsivān

translations.english: Leaving aside the excellent umbrella and well adorned chowries, forsaking his relatives, chariot, citizens and other people, calmly bearing the affliction in mind and not manifesting the outward signs of sorrow, Rāma, with a view to communicate this unpleasant news to his mother, entered her abode.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य वेश्मातिभृशं मुदान्वितं; समीक्ष्य तां चार्थविपत्तिमागताम्
न चैव रामोऽत्र जगाम विक्रियां; सुहृज्जनस्यात्मविपत्तिशङ्कया
verses.transliteration:
praviśya veśmātibhṛśaṁ mudānvitaṁ; samīkṣya tāṁ cārthavipattimāgatām
na caiva rāmo'tra jagāma vikriyāṁ; suhṛjjanasyātmavipattiśaṅkayā

translations.english: Saw it filled with all sorts of amusements; and even though his mind was not agitated with any mental disturbance seeing the impending calamity of loss of wealth, he was anxious lest the lives of his dear relatives mighty be in danger.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्तु भृशमायस्तो निःश्वसन्निव कुञ्जरः
जगाम सहितो भ्रात्रा मातुरन्तःपुरं वशी
verses.transliteration:
rāmastu bhṛśamāyasto niḥśvasanniva kuñjaraḥ
jagāma sahito bhrātrā māturantaḥpuraṁ vaśī

translations.english: Rāma too, having control over his own self, experiencing sorrow (for his relatives) and sobbing like an (enchained) elephant, entered into his mother's apartment, together with his brother.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽपश्यत्पुरुषं तत्र वृद्धं परमपूजितम्
उपविष्टं गृहद्वारि तिष्ठतश्चापरान्बहून्
verses.transliteration:
so'paśyatpuruṣaṁ tatra vṛddhaṁ paramapūjitam
upaviṣṭaṁ gṛhadvāri tiṣṭhataścāparānbahūn

translations.english: He saw a venerable old man, sitting at the gate and many other persons.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य प्रथमां कक्ष्यां द्वितीयायां ददर्श सः
ब्राह्मणान्वेदसंपन्नान्वृद्धान्राज्ञाभिसत्कृतान्
verses.transliteration:
praviśya prathamāṁ kakṣyāṁ dvitīyāyāṁ dadarśa saḥ
brāhmaṇānvedasaṁpannānvṛddhānrājñābhisatkṛtān

translations.english: Having passed through the first apartment he saw in the second, many.old Brahmanas, versed in the Vedas and honoured by the king.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणम्य रामस्तान्वृद्धांस्तृतीयायां ददर्श सः
स्त्रियो वृद्धाश्च बालाश्च द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः
verses.transliteration:
praṇamya rāmastānvṛddhāṁstṛtīyāyāṁ dadarśa saḥ
striyo vṛddhāśca bālāśca dvārarakṣaṇatatparāḥ

translations.english: Having bowed down to them, Rāma saw in the third apartment, women, boys, and old men, all engaged in watching the gate.

verses.sanskrit:
वर्धयित्वा प्रहृष्टास्ताः प्रविश्य च गृहं स्त्रियः
न्यवेदयन्त त्वरिता राम मातुः प्रियं तदा
verses.transliteration:
vardhayitvā prahṛṣṭāstāḥ praviśya ca gṛhaṁ striyaḥ
nyavedayanta tvaritā rāma mātuḥ priyaṁ tadā

translations.english: The female warders honoured Rāma rejoicing, and entering his mother's apartment, communicated to her speedily this pleasant news.

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्यापि तदा देवी रात्रिं स्थित्वा समाहिता
प्रभाते त्वकरोत्पूजां विष्णोः पुत्रहितैषिणी
verses.transliteration:
kausalyāpi tadā devī rātriṁ sthitvā samāhitā
prabhāte tvakarotpūjāṁ viṣṇoḥ putrahitaiṣiṇī

translations.english: Worshipful Kausalyā, seeking her son's welfare, kept up the whole night being absorbed in meditation, and was, in the morning, worshipping the God Vişņu.

verses.sanskrit:
सा क्षौमवसना हृष्टा नित्यं व्रतपरायणा
अग्निं जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवत्कृतमङ्गला
verses.transliteration:
sā kṣaumavasanā hṛṣṭā nityaṁ vrataparāyaṇā
agniṁ juhoti sma tadā mantravatkṛtamaṅgalā

translations.english: Wearing silk-cloth, pleased, and accustomed to the performance of religious rites every day, she, performing benedictory ceremonies, was offering oblation to the fire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य च तदा रामो मातुरन्तःपुरं शुभम्
ददर्श मातरं तत्र हावयन्तीं हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration:
praviśya ca tadā rāmo māturantaḥpuraṁ śubham
dadarśa mātaraṁ tatra hāvayantīṁ hutāśanam

translations.english: Rāma entering the auspicious abode of his mother, beheld her thus engaged in the sacrifice to the fire.

verses.sanskrit:
सा चिरस्यात्मजं दृष्ट्वा मातृनन्दनमागतम्
अभिचक्राम संहृष्टा किशोरं वडवा यथा
verses.transliteration:
sā cirasyātmajaṁ dṛṣṭvā mātṛnandanamāgatam
abhicakrāma saṁhṛṣṭā kiśoraṁ vaḍavā yathā

translations.english: He saw his virtuous mother wearing white silk, pulled down by the austere performance of religious rites, and engaged in propitiating the deities with the offering of water. She seeing her son, ever advancing the joy of his mother, approach, became pleased, and stepped forward like unto a mare beholding her young one.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच दुराधर्षं राघवं सुतमात्मनः
कौसल्या पुत्रवात्सल्यादिदं प्रियहितं वचः
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca durādharṣaṁ rāghavaṁ sutamātmanaḥ
kausalyā putravātsalyādidaṁ priyahitaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Kausalya, out of motherly affection, spoke these sweet and beneficent words to her own invincible son, Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
वृद्धानां धर्मशीलानां राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम्
प्राप्नुह्यायुश्च कीर्तिं च धर्मं चोपहितं कुले
verses.transliteration:
vṛddhānāṁ dharmaśīlānāṁ rājarṣīṇāṁ mahātmanām
prāpnuhyāyuśca kīrtiṁ ca dharmaṁ copahitaṁ kule

translations.english: May you obtain the life and fame of the pious, old Rājarşis, and the virtue worthy of your family.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यप्रतिज्ञं पितरं राजानं पश्य राघव
अद्यैव हि त्वां धर्मात्मा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
satyapratijñaṁ pitaraṁ rājānaṁ paśya rāghava
adyaiva hi tvāṁ dharmātmā yauvarājye'bhiṣekṣyati

translations.english: See, Oh Rāghava, how truthful is your father the king! That virtuous-souled one shall install you this day as the heir-apparent of the throne Rāghava, humble by nature, who was offered by his mother a seat and asked by her to eat something, stretching forth a little his clasped hands, and with his head down wards with a view to show respects towards his mother, touched the seat, and began to relate to her the object of his repairing to the Dandaka forest.

verses.sanskrit:
देवि नूनं न जानीषे महद्भयमुपस्थितम्
इदं तव च दुःखाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च
verses.transliteration:
devi nūnaṁ na jānīṣe mahadbhayamupasthitam
idaṁ tava ca duḥkhāya vaidehyā lakṣmaṇasya ca

translations.english: O worshipful one, certain it is that you know not the great impending calamity; It is for the distress of yours, Laksmana and Vaidehi, that shall I wend my way to the Daņdaka forest. What is the use of a seat to me then? Now is the time come when I deserve a seat made of Kusa grass.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने
मधुमूलफलैर्जीवन्हित्वा मुनिवदामिषम्
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane
madhumūlaphalairjīvanhitvā munivadāmiṣam

translations.english: I shall live in the forest for fourteen years abstaining from animal food and living on tuberous roots and fruits like to the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
भरताय महाराजो यौवराज्यं प्रयच्छति
मां पुनर्दण्डकारण्यं विवासयति तापसम्
verses.transliteration:
bharatāya mahārājo yauvarājyaṁ prayacchati
māṁ punardaṇḍakāraṇyaṁ vivāsayati tāpasam

translations.english: The king shall confer upon Bharata the heirapparentship and shall banish me as an ascetic into the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
उपावृत्योत्थितां दीनां वडवामिव वाहिताम्
पांशुगुण्ठितसर्वाग्नीं विममर्श च पाणिना
verses.transliteration:
upāvṛtyotthitāṁ dīnāṁ vaḍavāmiva vāhitām
pāṁśuguṇṭhitasarvāgnīṁ vimamarśa ca pāṇinā

translations.english: Rāma seeing his mother, who deserved no distress, fall down like a plantain tree and insensible, raised her up, and finding her covered with dust all over her body like to a mare risen up after rolling on the ground on account of toil of bearing heavy burden, wiped off (her body) gently with his hand.

verses.sanskrit:
सा राघवमुपासीनमसुखार्ता सुखोचिता
उवाच पुरुषव्याघ्रमुपशृण्वति लक्ष्मणे
verses.transliteration:
sā rāghavamupāsīnamasukhārtā sukhocitā
uvāca puruṣavyāghramupaśṛṇvati lakṣmaṇe

translations.english: She, deserving happiness, being racked with the destruction of her delight, spoke thus to Rāghava, that best of men, in the presence of Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव
न स्म दुःखमतो भूयः पश्येयमहमप्रजा
verses.transliteration:
yadi putra na jāyethā mama śokāya rāghava
na sma duḥkhamato bhūyaḥ paśyeyamahamaprajā

translations.english: Oh! my son, Oh! Rāghava, had you not been born for my grief I would have been sonless only, but would not have been subject to this greater grief.

verses.sanskrit:
एक एव हि वन्ध्यायाः शोको भवति मानवः
अप्रजास्मीति संतापो न ह्यन्यः पुत्र विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
eka eva hi vandhyāyāḥ śoko bhavati mānavaḥ
aprajāsmīti saṁtāpo na hyanyaḥ putra vidyate

translations.english: A sonless woman has only one cause of mental affliction. Her only sorrow is “I have no child" and nothing else my son.

verses.sanskrit:
न दृष्टपूर्वं कल्याणं सुखं वा पतिपौरुषे
अपि पुत्रे विपश्येयमिति रामास्थितं मया
verses.transliteration:
na dṛṣṭapūrvaṁ kalyāṇaṁ sukhaṁ vā patipauruṣe
api putre vipaśyeyamiti rāmāsthitaṁ mayā

translations.english: I have not experienced in my life that blessing and pleasure which women generally feel when their husbands are devoted to them. I have sustained my life so long, O Rāma, only with the hope that I shall witness this and other happiness when I shall have a son.

verses.sanskrit:
सा बहून्यमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि हृदयच्छिदाम्
अहं श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनामवराणां वरा सती
अतो दुःखतरं किं नु प्रमदानां भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sā bahūnyamanojñāni vākyāni hṛdayacchidām
ahaṁ śroṣye sapatnīnāmavarāṇāṁ varā satī
ato duḥkhataraṁ kiṁ nu pramadānāṁ bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Myself, being the eldest of all the queens, shall have to hear unpleasant and heart-rending words from the co-wives who are all younger than I.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वयि संनिहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता
किं पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवं मरणमेव मे
verses.transliteration:
tvayi saṁnihite'pyevamahamāsaṁ nirākṛtā
kiṁ punaḥ proṣite tāta dhruvaṁ maraṇameva me

translations.english: You being present, they have reduced me to this miserable plight, I do not know what else they will do, you being away; there is death certain for me, Oh my darling! Being disregarded by my husband I have been greatly insulted, I am equal to the maid-servants of Kaikeyi or even inferior to them.

verses.sanskrit:
यो हि मां सेवते कश्चिदथ वाप्यनुवर्तते
कैकेय्याः पुत्रमन्वीक्ष्य स जनो नाभिभाषते
verses.transliteration:
yo hi māṁ sevate kaścidatha vāpyanuvartate
kaikeyyāḥ putramanvīkṣya sa jano nābhibhāṣate

translations.english: Those who serve me or are obedient to me, shall not even speak with me when they will see the son of Kaikeyi (installed).

verses.sanskrit:
दश सप्त च वर्षाणि तव जातस्य राघव
अतीतानि प्रकाङ्क्षन्त्या मया दुःखपरिक्षयम्
verses.transliteration:
daśa sapta ca varṣāṇi tava jātasya rāghava
atītāni prakāṅkṣantyā mayā duḥkhaparikṣayam

translations.english: I have spent, Oh Rāghava, ten years and seven from your (second) birth* birth* expecting a termination of my sorrow. Even though worn out, Oh Rāghava, shall not be able to suffer this great misery consequent upon your unending exile and the contempt of the co-wives. *Here the commentators differ in fixing the age of Rāma at the time of his going to the forest Rāma's age was under sixteen at the time of marriage, and after he has married to Sită he enjoyed her company for twelve years, when the proposal of installation was made. This makes totally age of twenty-seven. In the text ‘dasa sapta ca' (ten and seven) ten years fall short which are to be made up by taking into account the age of ten being left out, preceding Rāma's entering into the second birth which begins at maunjibandhana or initiation into the mysteries of the Vedic literature. Following the example of Bhāșyakāra Patañjali, the commentator, Rāmānuju, has in the sentence ‘daśa supta ca' supplied another (dasa) (ten) by means of ellipsis, thus giving an age of twentyseven. This, however, contradicts the statement of Sītā to Rāvana in guise of an anchorite, informing him of the age of her husband being twenty-five. A modern annotator with great ingenuity has devised ways to make up this discrepancy. The age of Rāma was under sixteen, when Visvamitra asked his assistance in destroying Taraka. 'Under sixteen' may mean fifteen or twelve as well. After marriage at twelve, Rāma enjoyed twelve years more the pleasure of home. This giving in total twenty-four, it is to be supposed that when he was exiled he stepped at twenty-five. The text dasa sapta ca' is correct, considering the age of eight being left out preceding his second birth at the initiation into the mysteries of the Veda.

verses.sanskrit:
उपवासैश्च योगैश्च बहुभिश्च परिश्रमैः
दुःखं संवर्धितो मोघं त्वं हि दुर्गतया मया
verses.transliteration:
upavāsaiśca yogaiśca bahubhiśca pariśramaiḥ
duḥkhaṁ saṁvardhito moghaṁ tvaṁ hi durgatayā mayā

translations.english: Wretched as I am, in vain have I brought you up with fasts, contemplation's and many other toilsome austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
स्थिरं तु हृदयं मन्ये ममेदं यन्न दीर्यते
प्रावृषीव महानद्याः स्पृष्टं कूलं नवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration:
sthiraṁ tu hṛdayaṁ manye mamedaṁ yanna dīryate
prāvṛṣīva mahānadyāḥ spṛṣṭaṁ kūlaṁ navāmbhasā

translations.english: Surely, I consider my heart is very hard, as it does not rend like to the bank of a great river in contact with new water in the rainy season.

verses.sanskrit:
ममैव नूनं मरणं न विद्यते; न चावकाशोऽस्ति यमक्षये मम
यदन्तकोऽद्यैव न मां जिहीर्षति; प्रसह्य सिंहो रुदतीं मृगीमिव
verses.transliteration:
mamaiva nūnaṁ maraṇaṁ na vidyate; na cāvakāśo'sti yamakṣaye mama
yadantako'dyaiva na māṁ jihīrṣati; prasahya siṁho rudatīṁ mṛgīmiva

translations.english: There is no death for me, no vacant place in the abode of Yama; otherwise why does not Death take me away like to a lion snatching away a weeping hind; certain it is that my heart is made of iron, as it does not rend nor does my body being pressed down with this sorrow and (falling) down on earth, break into pieces; verily have I no death before time.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं तु दुःखं यदनर्थकानि मे; व्रतानि दानानि च संयमाश्च हि
तपश्च तप्तं यदपत्यकारणा;त्सुनिष्फलं बीजमिवोप्तमूषरे
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ tu duḥkhaṁ yadanarthakāni me; vratāni dānāni ca saṁyamāśca hi
tapaśca taptaṁ yadapatyakāraṇā;tsuniṣphalaṁ bījamivoptamūṣare

translations.english: This distresses me that all my religious vows, alms giving, self-restraint and austerity, performed with a view of obtaining a son, have been fruitless, like to the seeds thrown on a barren soil.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि ह्यकाले मरणं स्वयेच्छया; लभेत कश्चिद्गुरुदुःखकर्शितः
गताहमद्यैव परेत संसदं; विना त्वया धेनुरिवात्मजेन वै
verses.transliteration:
yadi hyakāle maraṇaṁ svayecchayā; labheta kaścidguruduḥkhakarśitaḥ
gatāhamadyaiva pareta saṁsadaṁ; vinā tvayā dhenurivātmajena vai

translations.english: If any body in this life, being pressed down with some great calamity, could meet with death of his own accord, I would have instantly gone to the abode of death, being cut off from you like to a cow from her young one.

verses.sanskrit:
भृशमसुखममर्षिता तदा; बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम्
व्यसनमुपनिशाम्य सा मह;त्सुतमिव बद्धमवेक्ष्य किंनरी
verses.transliteration:
bhṛśamasukhamamarṣitā tadā; bahu vilalāpa samīkṣya rāghavam
vyasanamupaniśāmya sā maha;tsutamiva baddhamavekṣya kiṁnarī

translations.english: Kausalyā like a Kinnarī unable to bear this great calamity, anticipating great misfortune and seeing Rāma bound (with a great vow), began to lament in various ways. some

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तु विलपन्तीं तां कौसल्यां राममातरम्
उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनस्तत्कालसदृशं वचः
verses.transliteration:
tathā tu vilapantīṁ tāṁ kausalyāṁ rāmamātaram
uvāca lakṣmaṇo dīnastatkālasadṛśaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: At this time Laksmana, sorely distressed, addressed the weeping Kausalyā, the mother of Rāma with the following words suitable to that occasion.

verses.sanskrit:
न रोचते ममाप्येतदार्ये यद्राघवो वनम्
त्यक्त्वा राज्यश्रियं गच्छेत्स्त्रिया वाक्यवशं गतः
verses.transliteration:
na rocate mamāpyetadārye yadrāghavo vanam
tyaktvā rājyaśriyaṁ gacchetstriyā vākyavaśaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: I like it not, Oh worshipful one, that Räghava, should repair to the forest, renouncing this grandeur of sovereignty. The king is uxorious, old and therefore of perverted judgement and is addicted to worldly affairs; being under the influence of his wife and passion what could he not speak?

verses.sanskrit:
नास्यापराधं पश्यामि नापि दोषं तथा विधम्
येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्राद्वनवासाय राघवः
verses.transliteration:
nāsyāparādhaṁ paśyāmi nāpi doṣaṁ tathā vidham
yena nirvāsyate rāṣṭrādvanavāsāya rāghavaḥ

translations.english: I do not see any such fault or sin in Rāma that he should be banished from the kingdom to range in the wood.

verses.sanskrit:
न तं पश्याम्यहं लोके परोक्षमपि यो नरः
अमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्य दोषमुदाहरेत्
verses.transliteration:
na taṁ paśyāmyahaṁ loke parokṣamapi yo naraḥ
amitro'pi nirasto'pi yo'sya doṣamudāharet

translations.english: I do not find any such man in this world, even amongst great enemies, who, forsaken for heinous sins, can cite, even in his absence, any fault of him.

verses.sanskrit:
देवकल्पमृजुं दान्तं रिपूणामपि वत्सलम्
अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मं त्यजेत्पुत्रमकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
devakalpamṛjuṁ dāntaṁ ripūṇāmapi vatsalam
avekṣamāṇaḥ ko dharmaṁ tyajetputramakāraṇāt

translations.english: Observing what law of righteousness does the monarch, without any cause, renounce such a son who is like to celestials, simple, well disciplined and beloved even of the enemies?

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदं वचनं राज्ञः पुनर्बाल्यमुपेयुषः
पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्याद्राजवृत्तमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration:
tadidaṁ vacanaṁ rājñaḥ punarbālyamupeyuṣaḥ
putraḥ ko hṛdaye kuryādrājavṛttamanusmaran

translations.english: What son, remembering his father's conduct, shall carry in his heart these words of the king, who has again gone back to childhood?

verses.sanskrit:
यावदेव न जानाति कश्चिदर्थमिमं नरः
तावदेव मया सार्धमात्मस्थं कुरु शासनम्
verses.transliteration:
yāvadeva na jānāti kaścidarthamimaṁ naraḥ
tāvadeva mayā sārdhamātmasthaṁ kuru śāsanam

translations.english: Ere people come to know this proposal of exile, do you secure the government of the kingdom to yourself with me.

verses.sanskrit:
मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव
कः समर्थोऽधिकं कर्तुं कृतान्तस्येव तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration:
mayā pārśve sadhanuṣā tava guptasya rāghava
kaḥ samartho'dhikaṁ kartuṁ kṛtāntasyeva tiṣṭhataḥ

translations.english: Who can disturb the installation, Oh Rāghava, myself protecting you by your side with my bows, like to Death himself.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्मनुष्यामिमां सर्वामयोध्यां मनुजर्षभ
करिष्यामि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्यदि स्थास्यति विप्रिये
verses.transliteration:
nirmanuṣyāmimāṁ sarvāmayodhyāṁ manujarṣabha
kariṣyāmi śaraistīkṣṇairyadi sthāsyati vipriye

translations.english: If any body stands here as an enemy, surely shall I, Oh best of men, depopulate the whole city of Ayodhyā with sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्याथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वास्य हितमिच्छति
सर्वानेतान्वधिष्यामि मृदुर्हि परिभूयते
verses.transliteration:
bharatasyātha pakṣyo vā yo vāsya hitamicchati
sarvānetānvadhiṣyāmi mṛdurhi paribhūyate

translations.english: I shall immolate all who shall stand by Bharata or wish him well, certainly mildness brings about discomfiture.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरमनुत्तमम्
कस्य शक्तिः श्रियं दातुं भरतायारिशासन
verses.transliteration:
tvayā caiva mayā caiva kṛtvā vairamanuttamam
kasya śaktiḥ śriyaṁ dātuṁ bharatāyāriśāsana

translations.english: Who dares conferring on on Bharata the kingdom, carrying hostility with me and you?

verses.sanskrit:
अनुरक्तोऽस्मि भावेन भ्रातरं देवि तत्त्वतः
सत्येन धनुषा चैव दत्तेनेष्टेन ते शपे
verses.transliteration:
anurakto'smi bhāvena bhrātaraṁ devi tattvataḥ
satyena dhanuṣā caiva datteneṣṭena te śape

translations.english: Oh worshipful one, verily am I attached at heart to my brother.

verses.sanskrit:
दीप्तमग्निमरण्यं वा यदि रामः प्रवेक्ष्यते
प्रविष्टं तत्र मां देवि त्वं पूर्वमवधारय
verses.transliteration:
dīptamagnimaraṇyaṁ vā yadi rāmaḥ pravekṣyate
praviṣṭaṁ tatra māṁ devi tvaṁ pūrvamavadhāraya

translations.english: By truth, bow, gifts and things dear to me, do I swear to you; if Rāma shall enter into the wood, know me, Oh worshipful one, to have entered into the fire before that.

verses.sanskrit:
हरामि वीर्याद्दुःखं ते तमः सूर्य इवोदितः
देवी पश्यतु मे वीर्यं राघवश्चैव पश्यतु
verses.transliteration:
harāmi vīryādduḥkhaṁ te tamaḥ sūrya ivoditaḥ
devī paśyatu me vīryaṁ rāghavaścaiva paśyatu

translations.english: Like to the sun dispelling darkness, shall I remove your sorrow by dint of my power; may your worshipful self and Rāghava witness it. Readily shall I despatch my father, whose heart is unduly attached to Kaikeyſ and who is therefore vile and being old contemptibly playing the child.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः
उवाच रामं कौसल्या रुदन्ती शोकलालसा
verses.transliteration:
etattu vacanaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ
uvāca rāmaṁ kausalyā rudantī śokalālasā

translations.english: Hearing these words of the high-souled Laks maņa, Kausaly, weeping and being pressed with sorrow spoke these words to Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातुस्ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतं त्वया
यदत्रानन्तरं तत्त्वं कुरुष्व यदि रोचते
verses.transliteration:
bhrātuste vadataḥ putra lakṣmaṇasya śrutaṁ tvayā
yadatrānantaraṁ tattvaṁ kuruṣva yadi rocate

translations.english: You have heard, Oh my son, what your brother Laksmana said; and if you like, do what seems reasonable to you.

verses.sanskrit:
न चाधर्म्यं वचः श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम्
विहाय शोकसंतप्तां गन्तुमर्हसि मामितः
verses.transliteration:
na cādharmyaṁ vacaḥ śrutvā sapatnyā mama bhāṣitam
vihāya śokasaṁtaptāṁ gantumarhasi māmitaḥ

translations.english: It does not behove you, hearing the sinful words given vent to by the co-wife, to repair hence, leaving me who is sore distressed with sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मज्ञ यदि धर्मिष्ठो धर्मं चरितुमिच्छसि
शुश्रूष मामिहस्थस्त्वं चर धर्ममनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
dharmajña yadi dharmiṣṭho dharmaṁ caritumicchasi
śuśrūṣa māmihasthastvaṁ cara dharmamanuttamam

translations.english: Oh you pious one, having knowledge of religion, if do you wish to acquire righteousness, serve me here and continue practising the best of all virtues.

verses.sanskrit:
शुश्रूषुर्जननीं पुत्र स्वगृहे नियतो वसन्
परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपस्त्रिदिवं गतः
verses.transliteration:
śuśrūṣurjananīṁ putra svagṛhe niyato vasan
pareṇa tapasā yuktaḥ kāśyapastridivaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: Hear, Oh my son, the great ascetic Kasyapa, lived in his house, serving his mother continually and being crowned with best moral merit reached heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैव राजा पूज्यस्ते गौरवेण तथा ह्यहम्
त्वां नाहमनुजानामि न गन्तव्यमितो वनम्
verses.transliteration:
yathaiva rājā pūjyaste gauraveṇa tathā hyaham
tvāṁ nāhamanujānāmi na gantavyamito vanam

translations.english: As the monarch is worshipful to you in veneration so am I. I do not permit you, to repair hence to the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वद्वियोगान्न मे कार्यं जीवितेन सुखेन वा
त्वया सह मम श्रेयस्तृणानामपि भक्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
tvadviyogānna me kāryaṁ jīvitena sukhena vā
tvayā saha mama śreyastṛṇānāmapi bhakṣaṇam

translations.english: Separated from you I do not need life or happiness; with you I would prefer faring on grass.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि त्वं यास्यसि वनं त्यक्त्वा मां शोकलालसाम्
अहं प्रायमिहासिष्ये न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi tvaṁ yāsyasi vanaṁ tyaktvā māṁ śokalālasām
ahaṁ prāyamihāsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum

translations.english: If do you depart to the forest leaving me troubled with sorrow, I shall resort to the vow of fasting and shall not be able to sustain my life.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वं प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयं लोकविश्रुतम्
ब्रह्महत्यामिवाधर्मात्समुद्रः सरितां पतिः
verses.transliteration:
tatastvaṁ prāpsyase putra nirayaṁ lokaviśrutam
brahmahatyāmivādharmātsamudraḥ saritāṁ patiḥ

translations.english: And then you shall receive the penalty of hell, well-known to the people, as did the ocean, the lord of rivers, for like unrighteousness, suffer the agony of Brahmanicide".* *The text has been here a little freely translated to make it compatible with the legend to which it refers. The ocean, thus goes the story, caused the grief of his mother. Upon which, Maharși Pippalāda, through magical power, subjected him to agony of hell. This agony the mother of Rāma relates as the same that follows the sin of Brahminicide.

verses.sanskrit:
विलपन्तीं तथा दीनां कौसल्यां जननीं ततः
उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा वचनं धर्मसंहितम्
verses.transliteration:
vilapantīṁ tathā dīnāṁ kausalyāṁ jananīṁ tataḥ
uvāca rāmo dharmātmā vacanaṁ dharmasaṁhitam

translations.english: Whereupon to his mother Kausalyä, sorrowful and weeping, spoke Răma, virtuous-souled these words of righteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
नास्ति शक्तिः पितुर्वाक्यं समतिक्रमितुं मम
प्रसादये त्वां शिरसा गन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं वनम्
verses.transliteration:
nāsti śaktiḥ piturvākyaṁ samatikramituṁ mama
prasādaye tvāṁ śirasā gantumicchāmyahaṁ vanam

translations.english: There is no power in me to transgress my father's behest's; bend low I my head to you, I want to proceed to the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिणा च पितुर्वाक्यं कुर्वता व्रतचारिणा
गौर्हता जानता धर्मं कण्डुनापि विपश्चिता
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣiṇā ca piturvākyaṁ kurvatā vratacāriṇā
gaurhatā jānatā dharmaṁ kaṇḍunāpi vipaścitā

translations.english: The learned Rși Kandu, who lived in the forest keeping the word of his father, killed a cow, knowing it to be unrighteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं च कुले पूर्वं सगरस्याज्ञया पितुः
खनद्भिः सागरैर्भूतिमवाप्तः सुमहान्वधः
verses.transliteration:
asmākaṁ ca kule pūrvaṁ sagarasyājñayā pituḥ
khanadbhiḥ sāgarairbhūtimavāptaḥ sumahānvadhaḥ

translations.english: In our line the descendants of Sagara, at the command of their father, met with signal destruction, while digging the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण रेणुका जननी स्वयम्
कृत्ता परशुनारण्ये पितुर्वचनकारिणा
verses.transliteration:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa reṇukā jananī svayam
kṛttā paraśunāraṇye piturvacanakāriṇā

translations.english: Rāma the son of Jamadagni, at his father's words, decapitated his mother in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
न खल्वेतन्मयैकेन क्रियते पितृशासनम्
पूर्वैरयमभिप्रेतो गतो मार्गोऽनुगम्यते
verses.transliteration:
na khalvetanmayaikena kriyate pitṛśāsanam
pūrvairayamabhipreto gato mārgo'nugamyate

translations.english: I am not introducing some such righteousness, unfavourable to you, that has been never practised before.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत्तु मया कार्यं क्रियते भुवि नान्यथा
पितुर्हि वचनं कुर्वन्न कश्चिन्नाम हीयते
verses.transliteration:
tadetattu mayā kāryaṁ kriyate bhuvi nānyathā
piturhi vacanaṁ kurvanna kaścinnāma hīyate

translations.english: I am simply treading the path, that has been upheld and followed by worthies gone before. Surely shall I accomplish that which is worthy of being performed in this world and nothing else, one going by his father's behest's is not certainly degraded."

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मो हि परमो लोके धर्मे सत्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्
धर्मसंश्रितमेतच्च पितुर्वचनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
dharmo hi paramo loke dharme satyaṁ pratiṣṭhitam
dharmasaṁśritametacca piturvacanamuttamam

translations.english: Righteousness is the prime object in this world and in righteousness is established truth, and this excellent utterance of my father is in keeping with righteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
संश्रुत्य च पितुर्वाक्यं मातुर्वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा
न कर्तव्यं वृथा वीर धर्ममाश्रित्य तिष्ठता
verses.transliteration:
saṁśrutya ca piturvākyaṁ māturvā brāhmaṇasya vā
na kartavyaṁ vṛthā vīra dharmamāśritya tiṣṭhatā

translations.english: It does not become them, O hero, who abide in righteousness to fail to carry out the commands of father, mother or a Brahmin.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं न शक्ष्यामि पितुर्नियोगमतिवर्तितुम्
पितुर्हि वचनाद्वीर कैकेय्याहं प्रचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ na śakṣyāmi piturniyogamativartitum
piturhi vacanādvīra kaikeyyāhaṁ pracoditaḥ

translations.english: While I have been, Oh warrior, ordered by Kaikeyi at my father's words, I shall not be able to transgress those behest's again.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेनां विसृजानार्यां क्षत्रधर्माश्रितां मतिम्
धर्ममाश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यं मद्बुद्धिरनुगम्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
tadenāṁ visṛjānāryāṁ kṣatradharmāśritāṁ matim
dharmamāśraya mā taikṣṇyaṁ madbuddhiranugamyatām

translations.english: Do you relinquish therefore this unrighteous purpose of your consequent to the virtues of the Kșatriyas; do you abide by righteousness but not cruelty, and follow my decision.

verses.sanskrit:
तमेवमुक्त्वा सौहार्दाद्भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
उवाच भूयः कौसल्यां प्राञ्जलिः शिरसानतः
verses.transliteration:
tamevamuktvā sauhārdādbhrātaraṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
uvāca bhūyaḥ kausalyāṁ prāñjaliḥ śirasānataḥ

translations.english: Saying these words to Lakşmaņa out of fraternal affection, spoke again Rāma to Kausalyā with clasped hands and with his head bending low.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुमन्यस्व मां देवि गमिष्यन्तमितो वनम्
शापितासि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे
तीर्णप्रतिज्ञश्च वनात्पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
anumanyasva māṁ devi gamiṣyantamito vanam
śāpitāsi mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me
tīrṇapratijñaśca vanātpunareṣyāmyahaṁ purīm

translations.english: I do bind you with an oath of my life, Oh venerable one, to allow me to wander away hence into the wood. Do you perform benedictory ceremonies for my welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
यशो ह्यहं केवलराज्यकारणा;न्न पृष्ठतः कर्तुमलं महोदयम्
अदीर्घकाले न तु देवि जीविते; वृणेऽवरामद्य महीमधर्मतः
verses.transliteration:
yaśo hyahaṁ kevalarājyakāraṇā;nna pṛṣṭhataḥ kartumalaṁ mahodayam
adīrghakāle na tu devi jīvite; vṛṇe'varāmadya mahīmadharmataḥ

translations.english: I cannot neglect eminent fame being impelled by avarice for kingdom alone. Life is but of short duration, Oh worshipful one, and as such I do not long for acquiring this nether earth by means unrighteous.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादयन्नरवृषभः स मातरं; पराक्रमाज्जिगमिषुरेव दण्डकान्
अथानुजं भृशमनुशास्य दर्शनं; चकार तां हृदि जननीं प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration:
prasādayannaravṛṣabhaḥ sa mātaraṁ; parākramājjigamiṣureva daṇḍakān
athānujaṁ bhṛśamanuśāsya darśanaṁ; cakāra tāṁ hṛdi jananīṁ pradakṣiṇam

translations.english: Rāma, that foremost of men, with a view to range into the forest Dandaka after patiently propitiating his mother and instructing fully his younger brother the mysteries of righteousness, went round his mother with reverence and made up his mind to repair to the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
आसाद्य रामः सौमित्रिं सुहृदं भ्रातरं प्रियम्
उवाचेदं स धैर्येण धारयन्सत्त्वमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
āsādya rāmaḥ saumitriṁ suhṛdaṁ bhrātaraṁ priyam
uvācedaṁ sa dhairyeṇa dhārayansattvamātmavān

translations.english: Here after holding the equanimity of mind with patience self-possessed Răma spoke thus to the son of Sumitrā, his dear brother, and friend, who was greatly sorry, had lost his patience and was pressed down with this misfortune of Rāma, and had his eyes inflated with anger like to an infuriated elephant.

verses.sanskrit:
सौमित्रे योऽभिषेकार्थे मम संभारसंभ्रमः
अभिषेकनिवृत्त्यर्थे सोऽस्तु संभारसंभ्रमः
verses.transliteration:
saumitre yo'bhiṣekārthe mama saṁbhārasaṁbhramaḥ
abhiṣekanivṛttyarthe so'stu saṁbhārasaṁbhramaḥ

translations.english: Oh son of Sumitrā, do you take that amount of trouble for preventing now the collection of materials for installation, as did you take beforehand for collecting them.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्या मदभिषेकार्थं मानसं परितप्यते
माता नः सा यथा न स्यात्सविशङ्का तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
yasyā madabhiṣekārthaṁ mānasaṁ paritapyate
mātā naḥ sā yathā na syātsaviśaṅkā tathā kuru

translations.english: Do you act therefore in such a way as will remove the apprehension from the mind of our mother (Kaikeyi), who is troubled at heart so greatly on hearing of my installation.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याः शङ्कामयं दुःखं मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे
मनसि प्रतिसंजातं सौमित्रेऽहमुपेक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāḥ śaṅkāmayaṁ duḥkhaṁ muhūrtamapi notsahe
manasi pratisaṁjātaṁ saumitre'hamupekṣitum

translations.english: Oh, son of Sumitra, I cannot neglect for a moment the trouble which has arisen in her mind on account of this fear.

verses.sanskrit:
न बुद्धिपूर्वं नाबुद्धं स्मरामीह कदाचन
मातॄणां वा पितुर्वाहं कृतमल्पं च विप्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
na buddhipūrvaṁ nābuddhaṁ smarāmīha kadācana
mātṝṇāṁ vā piturvāhaṁ kṛtamalpaṁ ca vipriyam

translations.english: I do not remember to have done on any occasion wilfully or unwilfully any thing that is displeasing to my father or mothers.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यः सत्याभिसंधश्च नित्यं सत्यपराक्रमः
परलोकभयाद्भीतो निर्भयोऽस्तु पिता मम
verses.transliteration:
satyaḥ satyābhisaṁdhaśca nityaṁ satyaparākramaḥ
paralokabhayādbhīto nirbhayo'stu pitā mama

translations.english: My father is of truthful words and vows and he has been greatly terrified by the fear of the next world; may his fear disappear now.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यापि हि भवेदस्मिन्कर्मण्यप्रतिसंहृते
सत्यं नेति मनस्तापस्तस्य तापस्तपेच्च माम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāpi hi bhavedasminkarmaṇyapratisaṁhṛte
satyaṁ neti manastāpastasya tāpastapecca mām

translations.english: If this work of installation be not stopped, my father shall be greatly pained at heart thinking that his vows shall not be fulfilled and his sorrow will also ache me.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिषेकविधानं तु तस्मात्संहृत्य लक्ष्मण
अन्वगेवाहमिच्छामि वनं गन्तुमितः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
abhiṣekavidhānaṁ tu tasmātsaṁhṛtya lakṣmaṇa
anvagevāhamicchāmi vanaṁ gantumitaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: And it is for this reason, Oh Laksmana, that I purpose speedily to retire from this city to the forest, renouncing the preparations for my installation.

verses.sanskrit:
मम प्रव्राजनादद्य कृतकृत्या नृपात्मजा
सुतं भरतमव्यग्रमभिषेचयिता ततः
verses.transliteration:
mama pravrājanādadya kṛtakṛtyā nṛpātmajā
sutaṁ bharatamavyagramabhiṣecayitā tataḥ

translations.english: On my wandering away to the forest to-day, the daughter of Kekaya shall have her ends attained and shall install Bharata on the throne without any disturbance whatsoever,

verses.sanskrit:
मयि चीराजिनधरे जटामण्डलधारिणि
गतेऽरण्यं च कैकेय्या भविष्यति मनःसुखम्
verses.transliteration:
mayi cīrājinadhare jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇi
gate'raṇyaṁ ca kaikeyyā bhaviṣyati manaḥsukham

translations.english: Myself going to the forest, wearing. bark, tiger-skin and matted hair, Kaikeyi shall attain the happiness of her mind.

verses.sanskrit:
बुद्धिः प्रणीता येनेयं मनश्च सुसमाहितम्
तत्तु नार्हामि संक्लेष्टुं प्रव्रजिष्यामि माचिरम्
verses.transliteration:
buddhiḥ praṇītā yeneyaṁ manaśca susamāhitam
tattu nārhāmi saṁkleṣṭuṁ pravrajiṣyāmi māciram

translations.english: That great One, who' has inspired Kaikeyi with this mode of mind and has kept it firm, I cannot offend. I shall repair hence without any delay.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतान्तस्त्वेव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत्प्रवासने
राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनरेव निवर्तने
verses.transliteration:
kṛtāntastveva saumitre draṣṭavyo matpravāsane
rājyasya ca vitīrṇasya punareva nivartane

translations.english: Do you regard, Oh Laksmana, destiny as the only cause of this transfer of the kingdom, although attained, and of my banishment.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेय्याः प्रतिपत्तिर्हि कथं स्यान्मम पीडने
यदि भावो न दैवोऽयं कृतान्तविहितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyyāḥ pratipattirhi kathaṁ syānmama pīḍane
yadi bhāvo na daivo'yaṁ kṛtāntavihito bhavet

translations.english: Had not destiny been instrumental; in bringing about this; determination in Kaikeyi, she would not have been so much persevering in the infliction of misery upon me.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिषेकनिवृत्त्यर्थैः प्रवासार्थैश्च दुर्वचैः
उग्रैर्वाक्यैरहं तस्या नान्यद्दैवात्समर्थये
verses.transliteration:
so'bhiṣekanivṛttyarthaiḥ pravāsārthaiśca durvacaiḥ
ugrairvākyairahaṁ tasyā nānyaddaivātsamarthaye

translations.english: Do you know, Oh gentle Laksmana, that I have never made any distinction in my mind between my mothers, nor did Kaikeyi make any such thing before between me and her son; consequently it is destiny only that has made her press for the prevention of my installation and for my exile with harsh and cruel words, or else why should she, a daughter of a king and possessed of an excellent temper and high accomplishments, speak painful words to me in the presence of her husband like to an ordinary woman.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं प्रकृतिसंपन्ना राजपुत्री तथागुणा
ब्रूयात्सा प्राकृतेव स्त्री मत्पीडां भर्तृसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ prakṛtisaṁpannā rājaputrī tathāguṇā
brūyātsā prākṛteva strī matpīḍāṁ bhartṛsaṁnidhau

translations.english: That which is above comprehension is Destiny and it is beyond the power of creatures to avert its consequences; and evidently it is through this Destiny that have sprung up this distemper of Kaikeyi and my loss of kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
कश्चिद्दैवेन सौमित्रे योद्धुमुत्सहते पुमान्
यस्य न ग्रहणं किंचित्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र दृश्यते
verses.transliteration:
kaściddaivena saumitre yoddhumutsahate pumān
yasya na grahaṇaṁ kiṁcitkarmaṇo'nyatra dṛśyate

translations.english: What man dares wiinstand Oh son of Sumitrā, this (terrible) destiny bidden from our view until known by the consequences of action destiny is the prime source of all those inconceivable causes which occur with reference to happiness misery, fear, and anger, profit and loss, birth and deliverance.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखदुःखे भयक्रोधौ लाभालाभौ भवाभवौ
यस्य किंचित्तथाभूतं ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्
verses.transliteration:
sukhaduḥkhe bhayakrodhau lābhālābhau bhavābhavau
yasya kiṁcittathābhūtaṁ nanu daivasya karma tat

translations.english: Seers of great austerity being influenced by this Destiny, succumb to the attack of anger and desire, renouncing all their hard disciplines.

verses.sanskrit:
व्याहतेऽप्यभिषेके मे परितापो न विद्यते
तस्मादपरितापः संस्त्वमप्यनुविधाय माम्
प्रतिसंहारय क्षिप्रमाभिषेचनिकीं क्रियाम्
verses.transliteration:
vyāhate'pyabhiṣeke me paritāpo na vidyate
tasmādaparitāpaḥ saṁstvamapyanuvidhāya mām
pratisaṁhāraya kṣipramābhiṣecanikīṁ kriyām

translations.english: Do you therefore assuage your grief and follow me and intercept speedily the collection of materials for my installation.

verses.sanskrit:
न लक्ष्मणास्मिन्मम राज्यविघ्ने; माता यवीयस्यतिशङ्कनीया
दैवाभिपन्ना हि वदन्त्यनिष्टं; जानासि दैवं च तथाप्रभावम्
verses.transliteration:
na lakṣmaṇāsminmama rājyavighne; mātā yavīyasyatiśaṅkanīyā
daivābhipannā hi vadantyaniṣṭaṁ; jānāsi daivaṁ ca tathāprabhāvam

translations.english: Know you now the mighty power of destiny and do you not blame therefore my younger mother and my father labouring under the influence of Destiny.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्रहस्तं विधुन्वंस्तु हस्ती हस्तमिवात्मनः
तिर्यगूर्ध्वं शरीरे च पातयित्वा शिरोधराम्
verses.transliteration:
agrahastaṁ vidhunvaṁstu hastī hastamivātmanaḥ
tiryagūrdhvaṁ śarīre ca pātayitvā śirodharām

translations.english: Moving the extremities of his hands like to the trunk of an elephant, variously altering the altitude of the neck above his frame, glancing a look awry, thus spoke he to his brother.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकविद्विष्टमारब्धं त्वदन्यस्याभिषेचनम्
येनेयमागता द्वैधं तव बुद्धिर्महीपते
स हि धर्मो मम द्वेष्यः प्रसङ्गाद्यस्य मुह्यसि
verses.transliteration:
lokavidviṣṭamārabdhaṁ tvadanyasyābhiṣecanam
yeneyamāgatā dvaidhaṁ tava buddhirmahīpate
sa hi dharmo mama dveṣyaḥ prasaṅgādyasya muhyasi

translations.english: Even that so called virtue do I loathe, which has, O high-souled one, fascinated you, and made your mind run from one extreme to another. *Formerly the mind was for accepting the kingdom, and now for going to the forest as an exile. These are the two extremes here meant.

verses.sanskrit:
दैवं पुरुषकारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम्
न दैवेन विपन्नार्थः पुरुषः सोऽवसीदति
verses.transliteration:
daivaṁ puruṣakāreṇa yaḥ samarthaḥ prabādhitum
na daivena vipannārthaḥ puruṣaḥ so'vasīdati

translations.english: He, who can avert the consequences of destiny by dint of his manliness, does not lose heart even in the face of his interest being endangered by it.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रक्ष्यन्ति त्वद्य दैवस्य पौरुषं पुरुषस्य च
दैवमानुषयोरद्य व्यक्ता व्यक्तिर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
drakṣyanti tvadya daivasya pauruṣaṁ puruṣasya ca
daivamānuṣayoradya vyaktā vyaktirbhaviṣyati

translations.english: People shall witness to-day the power of destiny and manliness; this day shall appear which of them is more powerful. Those who have witness before the prevention of your installation by the evil agency of destiny, shall see it defeated, even this very day, by my manliness.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्यङ्कुशमिवोद्दामं गजं मदबलोद्धतम्
प्रधावितमहं दैवं पौरुषेण निवर्तये
verses.transliteration:
atyaṅkuśamivoddāmaṁ gajaṁ madabaloddhatam
pradhāvitamahaṁ daivaṁ pauruṣeṇa nivartaye

translations.english: Thwart shall I that assailing destiny by my prowess like to a terrible elephant, freed of its shackles, past the restraining power of a goading hook and inflamed with the juice issuing out of its temples.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकपालाः समस्तास्ते नाद्य रामाभिषेचनम्
न च कृत्स्नास्त्रयो लोका विहन्युः किं पुनः पिता
verses.transliteration:
lokapālāḥ samastāste nādya rāmābhiṣecanam
na ca kṛtsnāstrayo lokā vihanyuḥ kiṁ punaḥ pitā

translations.english: What of the father, not even all the protectors of the regions nor the entire population of the three worlds shall be able to present any obstacle in the way of Rāma's installation.

verses.sanskrit:
यैर्विवासस्तवारण्ये मिथो राजन्समर्थितः
अरण्ये ते विवत्स्यन्ति चतुर्दश समास्तथा
verses.transliteration:
yairvivāsastavāraṇye mitho rājansamarthitaḥ
araṇye te vivatsyanti caturdaśa samāstathā

translations.english: Those who have, with one voice oh king, settled about your exile to the forest, shall be banished to-day for fourteen years.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तदाशां छेत्स्यामि पितुस्तस्याश्च या तव
अभिषेकविघातेन पुत्रराज्याय वर्तते
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tadāśāṁ chetsyāmi pitustasyāśca yā tava
abhiṣekavighātena putrarājyāya vartate

translations.english: Burn shall I down that hope of my father and Kaikeyi that they want to place Bharata on the throne by hindering your installation.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्बलेन विरुद्धाय न स्याद्दैवबलं तथा
प्रभविष्यति दुःखाय यथोग्रं पौरुषं मम
verses.transliteration:
madbalena viruddhāya na syāddaivabalaṁ tathā
prabhaviṣyati duḥkhāya yathograṁ pauruṣaṁ mama

translations.english: Influence of destiny shall not bring my opponents that amount happiness, as the misery inflicted on them by my terrible prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं वर्षसहस्रान्ते प्रजापाल्यमनन्तरम्
आर्यपुत्राः करिष्यन्ति वनवासं गते त्वयि
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvaṁ varṣasahasrānte prajāpālyamanantaram
āryaputrāḥ kariṣyanti vanavāsaṁ gate tvayi

translations.english: Yourself retiring to the forest after governing the people for a thousand years, your sons shall resume the administration.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वराजर्षिवृत्त्या हि वनवासो विधीयते
प्रजा निक्षिप्य पुत्रेषु पुत्रवत्परिपालने
verses.transliteration:
pūrvarājarṣivṛttyā hi vanavāso vidhīyate
prajā nikṣipya putreṣu putravatparipālane

translations.english: Dwelling into the forest is permitted after making over(the charge of) the subjects to (the hands of the) sons, as did the Rājarsis of old.

verses.sanskrit:
स चेद्राजन्यनेकाग्रे राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया
नैवमिच्छसि धर्मात्मन्राज्यं राम त्वमात्मनि
verses.transliteration:
sa cedrājanyanekāgre rājyavibhramaśaṅkayā
naivamicchasi dharmātmanrājyaṁ rāma tvamātmani

translations.english: The monarch changing his mind, the kingdom shall be transferred into another's hands, do you, being afraid of this, want to fly as an exile to the forest? And is it for this, that you Oh virtuous souled Rāma, do not wish to have kingdom for you.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिजाने च ते वीर मा भूवं वीरलोकभाक्
राज्यं च तव रक्षेयमहं वेलेव सागरम्
verses.transliteration:
pratijāne ca te vīra mā bhūvaṁ vīralokabhāk
rājyaṁ ca tava rakṣeyamahaṁ veleva sāgaram

translations.english: I do promise to you, Oh great hero, that I shall protect your kingdom like to shore protecting the sea, or else I shall not attain to the region of heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
मङ्गलैरभिषिञ्चस्व तत्र त्वं व्यापृतो भव
अहमेको महीपालानलं वारयितुं बलात्
verses.transliteration:
maṅgalairabhiṣiñcasva tatra tvaṁ vyāpṛto bhava
ahameko mahīpālānalaṁ vārayituṁ balāt

translations.english: Do you perform the rites of installation with things necessary for benediction, do you engage in these affairs, myself alone shall be able by force to thwart the opposition of the kings.

verses.sanskrit:
असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा
प्रगृहीतेन वै शत्रुं वज्रिणं वा न कल्पये
verses.transliteration:
asinā tīkṣṇadhāreṇa vidyuccalitavarcasā
pragṛhītena vai śatruṁ vajriṇaṁ vā na kalpaye

translations.english: These hands of mine are not intended for enhancing the beauty of my body, this bow is not meant for an ornament only this sword is not for binding woods together with, and these arrows are not for carrying the weight of woods, these four belonging to me are for the use of killing the enemies. Never do I desire that I shall not cut them into pieces with sharp-edged swords, brilliants the lighting, whom I do consider as my enemies, though they be redoubtable as Indra, the wielder of thunder-bolt.

verses.sanskrit:
खड्गनिष्पेषनिष्पिष्टैर्गहना दुश्चरा च मे
हस्त्यश्वनरहस्तोरुशिरोभिर्भविता मही
verses.transliteration:
khaḍganiṣpeṣaniṣpiṣṭairgahanā duścarā ca me
hastyaśvanarahastoruśirobhirbhavitā mahī

translations.english: Cover thick shall I the field of battle and make it impassable by cutting asunder the trunks of the elephants, thighs of the horses and heads of the infantry.

verses.sanskrit:
खड्गधाराहता मेऽद्य दीप्यमाना इवाद्रयः
पतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघा इव सविद्युतः
verses.transliteration:
khaḍgadhārāhatā me'dya dīpyamānā ivādrayaḥ
patiṣyanti dvipā bhūmau meghā iva savidyutaḥ

translations.english: Being beheaded by my swords like to the flaming fire and besmeared with blood resembling the clouds with lightning, my enemies shall fall down to the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणे प्रगृहीतशरासने
कथं पुरुषमानी स्यात्पुरुषाणां मयि स्थिते
verses.transliteration:
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇe pragṛhītaśarāsane
kathaṁ puruṣamānī syātpuruṣāṇāṁ mayi sthite

translations.english: Who is there, proud of his own prowess, that! shall be able to withstand me when I shall appear at the battle field with bows and leathern fences of fingers.

verses.sanskrit:
बहुभिश्चैकमत्यस्यन्नेकेन च बहूञ्जनान्
विनियोक्ष्याम्यहं बाणान्नृवाजिगजमर्मसु
verses.transliteration:
bahubhiścaikamatyasyannekena ca bahūñjanān
viniyokṣyāmyahaṁ bāṇānnṛvājigajamarmasu

translations.english: Killing one with a number of arrows, and sometimes many with a single one, I shall drive shafts into the vital organs of men, horses and elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य मेऽस्त्रप्रभावस्य प्रभावः प्रभविष्यति
राज्ञश्चाप्रभुतां कर्तुं प्रभुत्वं च तव प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
adya me'straprabhāvasya prabhāvaḥ prabhaviṣyati
rājñaścāprabhutāṁ kartuṁ prabhutvaṁ ca tava prabho

translations.english: Today shall I display my skill in arms in destroying the supremacy of the monarch and establishing you.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुरूपाविमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः
अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य कर्तॄणां ते निवारणे
verses.transliteration:
anurūpāvimau bāhū rāma karma kariṣyataḥ
abhiṣecanavighnasya kartṝṇāṁ te nivāraṇe

translations.english: That hand, which is fit for the smearing of the Sandal, for wearing armlets, distributing wealth and maintaining relations, shall be engaged today, Oh Rāma, in performing its worthy action, the discomfiture of them who want to throw obstacles in the way of your installation.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रवीहि कोऽद्यैव मया वियुज्यतां; तवासुहृत्प्राणयशः सुहृज्जनैः
यथा तवेयं वसुधा वशे भवे;त्तथैव मां शाधि तवास्मि किंकरः
verses.transliteration:
bravīhi ko'dyaiva mayā viyujyatāṁ; tavāsuhṛtprāṇayaśaḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ
yathā taveyaṁ vasudhā vaśe bhave;ttathaiva māṁ śādhi tavāsmi kiṁkaraḥ

translations.english: Pray tell me now, which of your enemies shall be cut off by me from wealth, life and relatives? I am your servant: do you give me instruction that the whole earth may be brought under your subjection.

verses.sanskrit:
विमृज्य बाष्पं परिसान्त्व्य चासकृ;त्स लक्ष्मणं राघववंशवर्धनः
उवाच पित्र्ये वचने व्यवस्थितं; निबोध मामेष हि सौम्य सत्पथः
verses.transliteration:
vimṛjya bāṣpaṁ parisāntvya cāsakṛ;tsa lakṣmaṇaṁ rāghavavaṁśavardhanaḥ
uvāca pitrye vacane vyavasthitaṁ; nibodha māmeṣa hi saumya satpathaḥ

translations.english: That descendant of Raghu, wiping tears off the eyes of Lakşmaņa and consoling him repeatedly, spoke to him saying “Oh gentle one, I have thought it to be the best way by all means that I shall abide by my father's orders."

verses.sanskrit:
तं समीक्ष्य त्ववहितं पितुर्निर्देशपालने
कौसल्या बाष्पसंरुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samīkṣya tvavahitaṁ piturnirdeśapālane
kausalyā bāṣpasaṁruddhā vaco dharmiṣṭhamabravīt

translations.english: Seeing Räma determined upon carrying out his father's behest's, Kausalya with her voice choked with vapour begot of tears, spoke to him the following pious words.

verses.sanskrit:
अदृष्टदुःखो धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः
मयि जातो दशरथात्कथमुञ्छेन वर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration:
adṛṣṭaduḥkho dharmātmā sarvabhūtapriyaṁvadaḥ
mayi jāto daśarathātkathamuñchena vartayet

translations.english: How shall this virtuous-souled one, beloved of people and who has never experienced misfortune before, live on grains gleaned, being born of me to Dasaratha?

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य भृत्याश्च दासाश्च मृष्टान्यन्नानि भुञ्जते
कथं स भोक्ष्यते नाथो वने मूलफलान्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
yasya bhṛtyāśca dāsāśca mṛṣṭānyannāni bhuñjate
kathaṁ sa bhokṣyate nātho vane mūlaphalānyayam

translations.english: How shall that Rāma live upon fruits and roots, whose servants and attendants fare on well cooked rice?

verses.sanskrit:
क एतच्छ्रद्दधेच्छ्रुत्वा कस्य वा न भवेद्भयम्
गुणवान्दयितो राज्ञो राघवो यद्विवास्यते
verses.transliteration:
ka etacchraddadhecchrutvā kasya vā na bhavedbhayam
guṇavāndayito rājño rāghavo yadvivāsyate

translations.english: Who shall believe, or believing who shall not be afraid, that his highly accomplished descendant of Kākutstha, favourite of the king, is going to be exiled?

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया विहीनामिह मां शोकाग्निरतुलो महान्
प्रधक्ष्यति यथा कक्षं चित्रभानुर्हिमात्यये
verses.transliteration:
tvayā vihīnāmiha māṁ śokāgniratulo mahān
pradhakṣyati yathā kakṣaṁ citrabhānurhimātyaye

translations.english: This great and incomparable fire of sorrow issuing from my mind, inflamed by the wind of your absence, increased by the fuels of lamentation and pain, and kindled by hard sobs, obtaining the oblations of tears, vomiting the smoke of vapour begotten of anxious thoughts, the result of counting upon the days of your return, shall consume me, making greatly lean, when deprived of your presence, as does the fire burn the dry grass in summer.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं हि धेनुः स्वं वत्सं गच्छन्तं नानुगच्छति
अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि यत्र पुत्र गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ hi dhenuḥ svaṁ vatsaṁ gacchantaṁ nānugacchati
ahaṁ tvānugamiṣyāmi yatra putra gamiṣyasi

translations.english: Like to a cow following its young one shall I follow you, Oh my darling, wherever shall go.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा निगदितं मात्रा तद्वाक्यं पुरुषर्षभः
श्रुत्वा रामोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं मातरं भृशदुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
tathā nigaditaṁ mātrā tadvākyaṁ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
śrutvā rāmo'bravīdvākyaṁ mātaraṁ bhṛśaduḥkhitām

translations.english: Hearing those words of his mother, Rāma that best of men, spoke the following words to her, who was greatly troubled with sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेय्या वञ्चितो राजा मयि चारण्यमाश्रिते
भवत्या च परित्यक्तो न नूनं वर्तयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyyā vañcito rājā mayi cāraṇyamāśrite
bhavatyā ca parityakto na nūnaṁ vartayiṣyati

translations.english: "The monarch has been duped by Kaikeyi” myself resorting to the forest, surely shall he resign his life, if cast off again by you.

verses.sanskrit:
भर्तुः किल परित्यागो नृशंसः केवलं स्त्रियाः
स भवत्या न कर्तव्यो मनसापि विगर्हितः
verses.transliteration:
bhartuḥ kila parityāgo nṛśaṁsaḥ kevalaṁ striyāḥ
sa bhavatyā na kartavyo manasāpi vigarhitaḥ

translations.english: There is nothing more cruel for women than the forsaking of their husband; it does not behove you therefore, to think even of this opprobrious action.

verses.sanskrit:
यावज्जीवति काकुत्स्थः पिता मे जगतीपतिः
शुश्रूषा क्रियतां तावत्स हि धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration:
yāvajjīvati kākutsthaḥ pitā me jagatīpatiḥ
śuśrūṣā kriyatāṁ tāvatsa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

translations.english: Do you serve this descendant of Kākutstha, my father, and the lord of the earth as long as he lives, know you this to be the eternal virtue

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु रामेण कौसल्या शुभ दर्शना
तथेत्युवाच सुप्रीता राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu rāmeṇa kausalyā śubha darśanā
tathetyuvāca suprītā rāmamakliṣṭakāriṇam

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma, Kausalyā of auspicious looks, being gratified greatly, spoke to him, the remover of her sorrows. “Truely it is."

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु वचनं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
भूयस्तामब्रवीद्वाक्यं मातरं भृशदुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu vacanaṁ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ
bhūyastāmabravīdvākyaṁ mātaraṁ bhṛśaduḥkhitām

translations.english: Rāma, the foremost amongst religious men, being spoken thus, said to his mother, who was greatly disturbed with sorrow, again in the following strain.

verses.sanskrit:
मया चैव भवत्या च कर्तव्यं वचनं पितुः
राजा भर्ता गुरुः श्रेष्ठः सर्वेषामीश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
mayā caiva bhavatyā ca kartavyaṁ vacanaṁ pituḥ
rājā bhartā guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ

translations.english: “Proper it is both for you and me to carry out father's words” he is your husband, and my best preceptor and the lord and master of all people.

verses.sanskrit:
इमानि तु महारण्ये विहृत्य नव पञ्च च
वर्षाणि परमप्रीतः स्थास्यामि वचने तव
verses.transliteration:
imāni tu mahāraṇye vihṛtya nava pañca ca
varṣāṇi paramaprītaḥ sthāsyāmi vacane tava

translations.english: With great pleasure shall I abide in your words after passing these nine and five years in the great forest.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता प्रियं पुत्रं बाष्पपूर्णानना तदा
उवाच परमार्ता तु कौसल्या पुत्रवत्सला
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā priyaṁ putraṁ bāṣpapūrṇānanā tadā
uvāca paramārtā tu kausalyā putravatsalā

translations.english: Thus addressed, Kausalyā, bearing great affection for her son, sorely pained and having her eyes full of tears, spoke to her beloved son the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
आसां राम सपत्नीनां वस्तुं मध्ये न मे क्षमम्
नय मामपि काकुत्स्थ वनं वन्यं मृगीं यथा
यदि ते गमने बुद्धिः कृता पितुरपेक्षया
verses.transliteration:
āsāṁ rāma sapatnīnāṁ vastuṁ madhye na me kṣamam
naya māmapi kākutstha vanaṁ vanyaṁ mṛgīṁ yathā
yadi te gamane buddhiḥ kṛtā piturapekṣayā

translations.english: Oh Rāma, I shall not be able to live amongst these co-wives, if are you resolved to go to the forest for the discharge of your father's behest; do you take me with you, Oh Kākutstha, like to a wild hind.

verses.sanskrit:
तां तथा रुदतीं रामो रुदन्वचनमब्रवीत्
जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतं प्रभुरेव च
भवत्या मम चैवाद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ tathā rudatīṁ rāmo rudanvacanamabravīt
jīvantyā hi striyā bhartā daivataṁ prabhureva ca
bhavatyā mama caivādya rājā prabhavati prabhuḥ

translations.english: Rāma, suppressing his feeling, spoke to his mother who was lamenting, thus, saying:, Husband is the deity and master of the wife as long as she lives; so the monarch being the lord can deal with you and me in any way he likes.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतश्चापि धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः
भवतीमनुवर्तेत स हि धर्मरतः सदा
verses.transliteration:
bharataścāpi dharmātmā sarvabhūtapriyaṁvadaḥ
bhavatīmanuvarteta sa hi dharmarataḥ sadā

translations.english: That highly intelligent lord of men living, we should not consider ourselves as without a master. Bharata is also pious and beloved of all people in speech, he, intent on the performance of religious service, shall attend upon you always.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः
श्रमं नावाप्नुयात्किंचिदप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
yathā mayi tu niṣkrānte putraśokena pārthivaḥ
śramaṁ nāvāpnuyātkiṁcidapramattā tathā kuru

translations.english: Do you now take care that on my retiring the monarch does not wear away by the pangs of my separation, that this terrible sorrow may not kill him. Do you look after the welfare of the old king always.

verses.sanskrit:
व्रतोपवासनिरता या नारी परमोत्तमा
भर्तारं नानुवर्तेत सा च पापगतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
vratopavāsaniratā yā nārī paramottamā
bhartāraṁ nānuvarteta sā ca pāpagatirbhavet

translations.english: The woman, who serves not her husband, being engaged in excellent religious rites and fasts, shall fare wretchedly in the life to come; and a woman gets at the excellent abode of the celestials by serving her husband.

verses.sanskrit:
शुश्रूषमेव कुर्वीत भर्तुः प्रियहिते रता
एष धर्मः पुरा दृष्टो लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration:
śuśrūṣameva kurvīta bhartuḥ priyahite ratā
eṣa dharmaḥ purā dṛṣṭo loke vede śrutaḥ smṛtaḥ

translations.english: Even those who do not worship and bow to the celestials should serve their husbands alone being intent upon their welfare. Such is the virtue that should be always pursued by women according to the Vedas and Smſtis.

verses.sanskrit:
पूज्यास्ते मत्कृते देवि ब्राह्मणाश्चैव सुव्रताः
एवं कालं प्रतीक्षस्व ममागमनकाङ्क्षिणी
verses.transliteration:
pūjyāste matkṛte devi brāhmaṇāścaiva suvratāḥ
evaṁ kālaṁ pratīkṣasva mamāgamanakāṅkṣiṇī

translations.english: Do you beguile your time, Oh worshipful one, expecting my return, by worshipping the celestials with flowers and oblations to the fire and serving well the Brahmins.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्स्यसे परमं कामं मयि प्रत्यागते सति
यदि धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो धारयिष्यति जीवितम्
verses.transliteration:
prāpsyase paramaṁ kāmaṁ mayi pratyāgate sati
yadi dharmabhṛtāṁ śreṣṭho dhārayiṣyati jīvitam

translations.english: Engaged in discipline and fasting and devoted to the services of your husband you shall attain your best desire, on my return, if this foremost of pious men lives then.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु रामेण बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा
कौसल्या पुत्रशोकार्ता रामं वचनमब्रवीत्
गच्छ पुत्र त्वमेकाग्रो भद्रं तेऽस्तु सदा विभो
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu rāmeṇa bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā
kausalyā putraśokārtā rāmaṁ vacanamabravīt
gaccha putra tvamekāgro bhadraṁ te'stu sadā vibho

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Kausalyā being distressed with the thought of separation from her son, spoke to him with tears in her eyes the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा हि रामं वनवासनिश्चितं; समीक्ष्य देवी परमेण चेतसा
उवाच रामं शुभलक्षणं वचो; बभूव च स्वस्त्ययनाभिकाङ्क्षिणी
verses.transliteration:
tathā hi rāmaṁ vanavāsaniścitaṁ; samīkṣya devī parameṇa cetasā
uvāca rāmaṁ śubhalakṣaṇaṁ vaco; babhūva ca svastyayanābhikāṅkṣiṇī

translations.english: With great earnestness, the worshipful one began to eye Rāma, determined to go as an exile to the forest and spoke to his auspicious words and became desirous of performing benedictory ceremonies.

verses.sanskrit:
सापनीय तमायासमुपस्पृश्य जलं शुचि
चकार माता रामस्य मङ्गलानि मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration:
sāpanīya tamāyāsamupaspṛśya jalaṁ śuci
cakāra mātā rāmasya maṅgalāni manasvinī

translations.english: Kausalyā subduing her sorrow, and touching holy water, began to perform auspicious ceremonies for Rāma, and spoke to him saying Do you, Oh best amongst the descendants of Raghu, repair now, as I cannot dissuade you, but do you return speedily and, follow the footsteps of great ones.

verses.sanskrit:
स्मृतिर्धृतिश्च धर्मश्च पान्तु त्वां पुत्र सर्वतः
स्कन्दश्च भगवान्देवः सोमश्च सबृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration:
smṛtirdhṛtiśca dharmaśca pāntu tvāṁ putra sarvataḥ
skandaśca bhagavāndevaḥ somaśca sabṛhaspatiḥ

translations.english: May the great deity Skanda, Soma, Brhaspati, Saptarsi, Narada, Moon and other ascetics protect you.

verses.sanskrit:
महाद्विपाश्च सिंहाश्च व्याघ्रा ऋक्षाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः
महिषाः शृङ्गिणो रौद्रा न ते द्रुह्यन्तु पुत्रक
verses.transliteration:
mahādvipāśca siṁhāśca vyāghrā ṛkṣāśca daṁṣṭriṇaḥ
mahiṣāḥ śṛṅgiṇo raudrā na te druhyantu putraka

translations.english: May the apes, scorpions, wild gnats, reptiles and insects make you no harm; may not the elephants, tigers, terrible looking bears, hogs, buffaloes and other horned animals hurt you.

verses.sanskrit:
नृमांसभोजना रौद्रा ये चान्ये सत्त्वजातयः
मा च त्वां हिंसिषुः पुत्र मया संपूजितास्त्विह
verses.transliteration:
nṛmāṁsabhojanā raudrā ye cānye sattvajātayaḥ
mā ca tvāṁ hiṁsiṣuḥ putra mayā saṁpūjitāstviha

translations.english: Being worshipped by me from here may the ferocious cannibal races of all kind bring you no injury.

verses.sanskrit:
आगमास्ते शिवाः सन्तु सिध्यन्तु च पराक्रमाः
सर्वसंपत्तयो राम स्वस्तिमान्गच्छ पुत्रक
verses.transliteration:
āgamāste śivāḥ santu sidhyantu ca parākramāḥ
sarvasaṁpattayo rāma svastimāngaccha putraka

translations.english: May your course be crowned with auspiciousness and your powers with success.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्वान्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यः पुनः पुनः
सर्वेभ्यश्चैव देवेभ्यो ये च ते परिपन्थिनः
verses.transliteration:
svasti te'stvāntarikṣebhyaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
sarvebhyaścaiva devebhyo ye ca te paripanthinaḥ

translations.english: Do you, oh my son, repair to the forest, being profusely provided with fruits, roots and other things. May all the creatures of the sky, all those who breathe on this Earth, and all those deities who are hostile to you, contribute to your welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वलोकप्रभुर्ब्रह्मा भूतभर्ता तथर्षयः
ये च शेषाः सुरास्ते त्वां रक्षन्तु वनवासिनम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvalokaprabhurbrahmā bhūtabhartā tatharṣayaḥ
ye ca śeṣāḥ surāste tvāṁ rakṣantu vanavāsinam

translations.english: May the lord of creation, Rșis and all the remaining deities defend you when dwelling in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
इति माल्यैः सुरगणान्गन्धैश्चापि यशस्विनी
स्तुतिभिश्चानुरूपाभिरानर्चायतलोचना
verses.transliteration:
iti mālyaiḥ suragaṇāngandhaiścāpi yaśasvinī
stutibhiścānurūpābhirānarcāyatalocanā

translations.english: That best of women Kausalyā, of great renown and having expansive eyes, after propitiating the celestials with garlands, fragrant odours and praises, began to offer oblations to the fire by the help of eminent Brahmins for the welfare of Rāma, collecting clarified butter, white garlands, religious fig trees and white mustard seeds for this purpose.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्मङ्गलं सहस्राक्षे सर्वदेवनमस्कृते
वृत्रनाशे समभवत्तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration:
yanmaṅgalaṁ sahasrākṣe sarvadevanamaskṛte
vṛtranāśe samabhavattatte bhavatu maṅgalam

translations.english: May that blessing crown you, which was attained by the thousand eyed Indra, honoured of all the deities on the occasion of killing the mighty Asura Vſtra.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्मङ्गलं सुपर्णस्य विनताकल्पयत्पुरा
अमृतं प्रार्थयानस्य तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration:
yanmaṅgalaṁ suparṇasya vinatākalpayatpurā
amṛtaṁ prārthayānasya tatte bhavatu maṅgalam

translations.english: May that blessing attend you, which was invoked in olden times by Vinatā, for that king of birds Garuda, praying for nectar.

verses.sanskrit:
ओषधीं चापि सिद्धार्थां विशल्यकरणीं शुभाम्
चकार रक्षां कौसल्या मन्त्रैरभिजजाप च
verses.transliteration:
oṣadhīṁ cāpi siddhārthāṁ viśalyakaraṇīṁ śubhām
cakāra rakṣāṁ kausalyā mantrairabhijajāpa ca

translations.english: Saying this Kausalyā, the foremost of all women, having expansive eyes, placed the grains on Rāma's head; sprinkled his body with fragrant substances, and tied to his hands, as amulet, twigs of such auspicious plants as Viśalyakaraṇī, with due mental repetition of mantras.

verses.sanskrit:
आनम्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय परिष्वज्य यशस्विनी
अवदत्पुत्र सिद्धार्थो गच्छ राम यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration:
ānamya mūrdhni cāghrāya pariṣvajya yaśasvinī
avadatputra siddhārtho gaccha rāma yathāsukham

translations.english: Oh my son, Oh Rāma, have your desires attained, and do you go, wherever you like. I shall see you. Oh my darling, with great delight, when shall you, returning Ayodhyā in excellent health and having all your ends satisfied, resume the administration of your kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
मयार्चिता देवगणाः शिवादयो; महर्षयो भूतमहासुरोरगाः
अभिप्रयातस्य वनं चिराय ते; हितानि काङ्क्षन्तु दिशश्च राघव
verses.transliteration:
mayārcitā devagaṇāḥ śivādayo; maharṣayo bhūtamahāsuroragāḥ
abhiprayātasya vanaṁ cirāya te; hitāni kāṅkṣantu diśaśca rāghava

translations.english: Worshipped have I deities headed by Siva and others, the great ascetics, the Bhūtagaņas and the snakes; may they all and the four cardinal points, Oh Rāghava, contribute to your welfare, who are going to the forest for a long time.

verses.sanskrit:
इतीव चाश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचना; समाप्य च स्वस्त्ययनं यथाविधि
प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवं; पुनः पुनश्चापि निपीड्य सस्वजे
verses.transliteration:
itīva cāśrupratipūrṇalocanā; samāpya ca svastyayanaṁ yathāvidhi
pradakṣiṇaṁ caiva cakāra rāghavaṁ; punaḥ punaścāpi nipīḍya sasvaje

translations.english: Kausalya, having her eyes full of tears, and performing the benedictory ceremonies with due rites, went round Rāghava with solemnity, and seeing him again and again sighed hot and hard.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तु देव्या स कृतप्रदक्षिणो; निपीड्य मातुश्चरणौ पुनः पुनः
जगाम सीतानिलयं महायशाः; स राघवः प्रज्वलितः स्वया श्रिया
verses.transliteration:
tathā tu devyā sa kṛtapradakṣiṇo; nipīḍya mātuścaraṇau punaḥ punaḥ
jagāma sītānilayaṁ mahāyaśāḥ; sa rāghavaḥ prajvalitaḥ svayā śriyā

translations.english: Being gone round by his mother thus, Rāghava, of great lame, and resplendent with the splendour of beauty, proceeded towards the abode of Sītā, after bowing down to the feet of his mother repeatedly.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्यां रामः संप्रस्थितो वनम्
कृतस्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya tu kausalyāṁ rāmaḥ saṁprasthito vanam
kṛtasvastyayano mātrā dharmiṣṭhe vartmani sthitaḥ

translations.english: Rāma, intent on repairing to the forest, and treading in pious tracks, after duly saluting Kausalyā and beautifying the royal road, crowded with people, captivated their hearts by means of his high accomplishments.

verses.sanskrit:
वैदेही चापि तत्सर्वं न शुश्राव तपस्विनी
तदेव हृदि तस्याश्च यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्
verses.transliteration:
vaidehī cāpi tatsarvaṁ na śuśrāva tapasvinī
tadeva hṛdi tasyāśca yauvarājyābhiṣecanam

translations.english: Vaidehi, ever engaged in ascetic rites, did not hear of all these affairs; there was in her heart only the thought of Rāma's installation.

verses.sanskrit:
देवकार्यं स्म सा कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्टचेतना
अभिज्ञा राजधर्माणां राजपुत्रं प्रतीक्षते
verses.transliteration:
devakāryaṁ sma sā kṛtvā kṛtajñā hṛṣṭacetanā
abhijñā rājadharmāṇāṁ rājaputraṁ pratīkṣate

translations.english: That daughter of the king, after offering her service to the deities according to the proper royal rites, was eagerly awaiting the approach of Rāma with a grateful and pleased heart.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविवेशाथ रामस्तु स्ववेश्म सुविभूषितम्
प्रहृष्टजनसंपूर्णं ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration:
praviveśātha rāmastu svaveśma suvibhūṣitam
prahṛṣṭajanasaṁpūrṇaṁ hriyā kiṁcidavāṅmukhaḥ

translations.english: Entered Rāma this beautiful abode, excellently furnished and filled with people highly delighted, having his head hanging down a little with shame.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ सीता समुत्पत्य वेपमाना च तं पतिम्
अपश्यच्छोकसंतप्तं चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
atha sītā samutpatya vepamānā ca taṁ patim
apaśyacchokasaṁtaptaṁ cintāvyākulitendriyam

translations.english: Sītā, seeing her husband, racked with sorrow and troubled in mind with anxiety, rose up trembling from her seat.

verses.sanskrit:
विवर्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा तं प्रस्विन्नममर्षणम्
आह दुःखाभिसंतप्ता किमिदानीमिदं प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
vivarṇavadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā taṁ prasvinnamamarṣaṇam
āha duḥkhābhisaṁtaptā kimidānīmidaṁ prabho

translations.english: Finding him with face pale and perspiring, and incapable of containing grief within, Sītā sore distressed with sorrow addressed him, saying, Oh my lord, why do I perceive such a change in you?

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान्युक्तः पुष्यो न राघव
प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वमसि दुर्मनाः
verses.transliteration:
adya bārhaspataḥ śrīmānyuktaḥ puṣyo na rāghava
procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prājñaiḥ kena tvamasi durmanāḥ

translations.english: To day the constellation Puşya is in conjunction with the moon, and planet Bịhaspati is presiding over this conjunction, this day has been declared as the most auspicious one by the learned Brahmins, then why do you cherish such a sorrow in the mind?

verses.sanskrit:
न ते शतशलाकेन जलफेननिभेन च
आवृतं वदनं वल्गु छत्रेणाभिविराजते
verses.transliteration:
na te śataśalākena jalaphenanibhena ca
āvṛtaṁ vadanaṁ valgu chatreṇābhivirājate

translations.english: Why has not your charming face been placed under the shade of an umbrella having hundred ribs and white as a watery foam?

verses.sanskrit:
व्यजनाभ्यां च मुख्याभ्यां शतपत्रनिभेक्षणम्
चन्द्रहंसप्रकाशाभ्यां वीज्यते न तवाननम्
verses.transliteration:
vyajanābhyāṁ ca mukhyābhyāṁ śatapatranibhekṣaṇam
candrahaṁsaprakāśābhyāṁ vījyate na tavānanam

translations.english: Why do not the servants fan you, having eyes like lotus' petals, with chowries white as the moon or a goose?

verses.sanskrit:
वाग्मिनो बन्दिनश्चापि प्रहृष्टास्त्वं नरर्षभ
स्तुवन्तो नाद्य दृश्यन्ते मङ्गलैः सूतमागधाः
verses.transliteration:
vāgmino bandinaścāpi prahṛṣṭāstvaṁ nararṣabha
stuvanto nādya dṛśyante maṅgalaiḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ

translations.english: I do not see you, Oh best of men, eulogised with auspicious songs by the panegyrists, encomiasts and family bards.

verses.sanskrit:
न ते क्षौद्रं च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः
मूर्ध्नि मूर्धावसिक्तस्य दधति स्म विधानतः
verses.transliteration:
na te kṣaudraṁ ca dadhi ca brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
mūrdhni mūrdhāvasiktasya dadhati sma vidhānataḥ

translations.english: Why do not the Brahmins, versed in the Vedas, observing the formal rites, sprinkle on your head honey and curd, after washing it duly?

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वां प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणीमुख्याश्च भूषिताः
अनुव्रजितुमिच्छन्ति पौरजानपदास्तथा
verses.transliteration:
na tvāṁ prakṛtayaḥ sarvā śreṇīmukhyāśca bhūṣitāḥ
anuvrajitumicchanti paurajānapadāstathā

translations.english: Why are not your subjects, citizens urbans, and leading members of society dressed and adorned, willing to follow you?

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्भिर्वेगसंपन्नैर्हयैः काञ्चनभूषणैः
मुख्यः पुष्यरथो युक्तः किं न गच्छति तेऽग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
caturbhirvegasaṁpannairhayaiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ
mukhyaḥ puṣyaratho yuktaḥ kiṁ na gacchati te'grataḥ

translations.english: Why does not that excellent sport-chariot go before you, having four fast going steeds, adorned with golden ornaments tied to it?

verses.sanskrit:
न हस्ती चाग्रतः श्रीमांस्तव लक्षणपूजितः
प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्णमेघगिरि प्रभः
verses.transliteration:
na hastī cāgrataḥ śrīmāṁstava lakṣaṇapūjitaḥ
prayāṇe lakṣyate vīra kṛṣṇameghagiri prabhaḥ

translations.english: Why does not that excellent elephant precede you, Oh great hero, which is gifted with auspicious marks and resembles as mass of dark clouds and a mighty hill?

verses.sanskrit:
न च काञ्चनचित्रं ते पश्यामि प्रियदर्शन
भद्रासनं पुरस्कृत्य यान्तं वीरपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration:
na ca kāñcanacitraṁ te paśyāmi priyadarśana
bhadrāsanaṁ puraskṛtya yāntaṁ vīrapuraḥsaram

translations.english: Why do not the servants run before you, Oh mighty hero, with a pretty looking royal seat embroidered with gold?

verses.sanskrit:
अभिषेको यदा सज्जः किमिदानीमिदं तव
अपूर्वो मुखवर्णश्च न प्रहर्षश्च लक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration:
abhiṣeko yadā sajjaḥ kimidānīmidaṁ tava
apūrvo mukhavarṇaśca na praharṣaśca lakṣyate

translations.english: Why do I perceive your face so pale as never seen before, and why therein is no mark of gladness, when every thing for your installation has been made ready?

verses.sanskrit:
कुले महति संभूते धर्मज्ञे धर्मचारिणि
शृणु जानकि येनेदं क्रमेणाभ्यागतं मम
verses.transliteration:
kule mahati saṁbhūte dharmajñe dharmacāriṇi
śṛṇu jānaki yenedaṁ krameṇābhyāgataṁ mama

translations.english: Whereupon spoke to that weeping Sītā, the descendant of Raghu thus:, Oh Sītā, Oh you born of a great family, versed in the knowledge of religion and intent on the performance of religious rites, my father has banished me to the forest! Do you hear, Oh daughter of Janaka, how has this calamity befallen me.

verses.sanskrit:
राज्ञा सत्यप्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे
कैकेय्यै प्रीतमनसा पुरा दत्तौ महावरौ
verses.transliteration:
rājñā satyapratijñena pitrā daśarathena me
kaikeyyai prītamanasā purā dattau mahāvarau

translations.english: In the days of yore was granted to my mother, Kaikeyi two boons by my father, king Dasaratha of truthful vows.

verses.sanskrit:
तयाद्य मम सज्जेऽस्मिन्नभिषेके नृपोद्यते
प्रचोदितः स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
tayādya mama sajje'sminnabhiṣeke nṛpodyate
pracoditaḥ sa samayo dharmeṇa pratinirjitaḥ

translations.english: When every thing was made ready by my father for my installation, Kaikeyi reminded him of his promise and gained over him for this righteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यं दण्डके मया
पित्रा मे भरतश्चापि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः
सोऽहं त्वामागतो द्रष्टुं प्रस्थितो विजनं वनम्
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vastavyaṁ daṇḍake mayā
pitrā me bharataścāpi yauvarājye niyojitaḥ
so'haṁ tvāmāgato draṣṭuṁ prasthito vijanaṁ vanam

translations.english: I shall live in the forest of Dandaka for fourteen years and Bharata shall be installed by my father as the heir apparent of the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्य समीपे ते नाहं कथ्यः कदाचन
ऋद्धियुक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते परस्तवम्
तस्मान्न ते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्याग्रतो मम
verses.transliteration:
bharatasya samīpe te nāhaṁ kathyaḥ kadācana
ṛddhiyuktā hi puruṣā na sahante parastavam
tasmānna te guṇāḥ kathyā bharatasyāgrato mama

translations.english: And myself bound to fly as an exile to the wood, have come here to see you; do you not praise me ever before Bharata. Those who are crowned with prosperity cannot bear another's praise; is it therefore behoves you not to extol my virtues in the presence of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
नापि त्वं तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचन
अनुकूलतया शक्यं समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम्
verses.transliteration:
nāpi tvaṁ tena bhartavyā viśeṣeṇa kadācana
anukūlatayā śakyaṁ samīpe tasya vartitum

translations.english: You should not extol me even in the company of your friends; you shall be then able to live with Bharata as one favourable to his party.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं चापि प्रतिज्ञां तां गुरोः समनुपालयन्
वनमद्यैव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ cāpi pratijñāṁ tāṁ guroḥ samanupālayan
vanamadyaiva yāsyāmi sthirā bhava manasvini

translations.english: To day shall I repair to the forest for redeeming my father's vows; do you, Oh high minded one, live here in undisturbed mind.

verses.sanskrit:
याते च मयि कल्याणि वनं मुनिनिषेवितम्
व्रतोपवासरतया भवितव्यं त्वयानघे
verses.transliteration:
yāte ca mayi kalyāṇi vanaṁ muniniṣevitam
vratopavāsaratayā bhavitavyaṁ tvayānaghe

translations.english: Do you, Oh sinless and auspicious one, live here engaged in religious rites and fasts, when I shall wend my way to the forest inhabited by the great ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
काल्यमुत्थाय देवानां कृत्वा पूजां यथाविधि
वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
kālyamutthāya devānāṁ kṛtvā pūjāṁ yathāvidhi
vanditavyo daśarathaḥ pitā mama nareśvaraḥ

translations.english: Rising from the bed early in the morning, adore the deities, every day, and then bow down to the feet of my father Dasaratha, the lord of men.

verses.sanskrit:
माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा संतापकर्शिता
धर्ममेवाग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः संमानमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
mātā ca mama kausalyā vṛddhā saṁtāpakarśitā
dharmamevāgrataḥ kṛtvā tvattaḥ saṁmānamarhati

translations.english: My mother Kausalyā is old and much pressed down with sorrow; do you show proper respects to her, considering it to be a pious deed.

verses.sanskrit:
वन्दितव्याश्च ते नित्यं याः शेषा मम मातरः
स्नेहप्रणयसंभोगैः समा हि मम मातरः
verses.transliteration:
vanditavyāśca te nityaṁ yāḥ śeṣā mama mātaraḥ
snehapraṇayasaṁbhogaiḥ samā hi mama mātaraḥ

translations.english: You should then bow down to my other mothers who all minister to me, with equal love and affection.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ चापि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः
त्वया लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम
verses.transliteration:
bhrātṛputrasamau cāpi draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ
