translations.english: If I commit myself to this sin dishonourable and calculated to bring me to perdition, I shall in this world bring disgrace on the race of the Ikşvākus.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्धि मात्रा कृतं पापं नाहं तदभिरोचये
इहस्थो वनदुर्गस्थं नमस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
yaddhi mātrā kṛtaṁ pāpaṁ nāhaṁ tadabhirocaye
ihastho vanadurgasthaṁ namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ

translations.english: I do not at all relish the sin that has been committed by mother. Remaining here with joined hands I bow down to Rāma gone to the forest fastness.

verses.sanskrit:
राममेवानुगच्छामि स राजा द्विपदां वरः
त्रयाणामपि लोकानां राघवो राज्यमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
rāmamevānugacchāmi sa rājā dvipadāṁ varaḥ
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṁ rāghavo rājyamarhati

translations.english: I will follow Rāma. That best of men is the king. Rāghava deserves the dominion of the three worlds themselves.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यं धर्मसंयुक्तं श्रुत्वा सर्वे सभासदः
हर्षान्मुमुचुरश्रूणि रामे निहितचेतसः
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyaṁ dharmasaṁyuktaṁ śrutvā sarve sabhāsadaḥ
harṣānmumucuraśrūṇi rāme nihitacetasaḥ

translations.english: Hearing words informed with those righteousness, the entire assembly with their minds intent upon Rāma, from joy shed tears.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि त्वार्यं न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुं वनात्
वने तत्रैव वत्स्यामि यथार्यो लक्ष्मणस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
yadi tvāryaṁ na śakṣyāmi vinivartayituṁ vanāt
vane tatraiva vatsyāmi yathāryo lakṣmaṇastathā

translations.english: If I fail to bring back the noble one from the forest, I will like the exalted Lakşmaņa remain even in that forest.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वोपायं तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुं बलात्
समक्षमार्य मिश्राणां साधूनां गुणवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvopāyaṁ tu vartiṣye vinivartayituṁ balāt
samakṣamārya miśrāṇāṁ sādhūnāṁ guṇavartinām

translations.english: I will in presence of this mixed assembly of pious and honourable persons following every perfection, adopt every expedient to bring back Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः
समीपस्थमुवाचेदं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu dharmātmā bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ
samīpasthamuvācedaṁ sumantraṁ mantrakovidam

translations.english: Having said this, the virtuous Bharata attached to his brother spoke to Sumantra skilled in counsel, who was by, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
तूर्णमुत्थाय गच्छ त्वं सुमन्त्र मम शासनात्
यात्रामाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं बलं चैव समानय
verses.transliteration:
tūrṇamutthāya gaccha tvaṁ sumantra mama śāsanāt
yātrāmājñāpaya kṣipraṁ balaṁ caiva samānaya

translations.english: Up, and go, O Sumantra at my command. Do you make known this journey and bring the forces.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः सुमन्त्रस्तु भरतेन महात्मना
प्रहृष्टः सोऽदिशत्सर्वं यथा संदिष्टमिष्टवत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ sumantrastu bharatena mahātmanā
prahṛṣṭaḥ so'diśatsarvaṁ yathā saṁdiṣṭamiṣṭavat

translations.english: Thus accosted by the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra with a cheerful heart issued orders concerning everything desirable as he was ordered.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बलाध्यक्षा बलस्य च
श्रुत्वा यात्रां समाज्ञप्तां राघवस्य निवर्तने
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtayo balādhyakṣā balasya ca
śrutvā yātrāṁ samājñaptāṁ rāghavasya nivartane

translations.english: Hearing that the army had been ordered to march forth for bringing back Rāma, the subjects as well as the generals of the forces became exceedingly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो योधाङ्गनाः सर्वा भर्तॄन्सर्वान्गृहेगृहे
यात्रा गमनमाज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
tato yodhāṅganāḥ sarvā bhartṝnsarvāngṛhegṛhe
yātrā gamanamājñāya tvarayanti sma harṣitāḥ

translations.english: Hearing of the journey to Rāma, for bringing him back the wives of the soldiers apprised of the order that had been issued to the latter, being exceedingly delighted, hurried on.

verses.sanskrit:
ते हयैर्गोरथैः शीघ्रैः स्यन्दनैश्च मनोजवैः
सह योधैर्बलाध्यक्षा बलं सर्वमचोदयन्
verses.transliteration:
te hayairgorathaiḥ śīghraiḥ syandanaiśca manojavaiḥ
saha yodhairbalādhyakṣā balaṁ sarvamacodayan

translations.english: And the generals expeditiously despatched their forces with warriors by means of horses and cares and cars fleet as the mind.

verses.sanskrit:
सज्जं तु तद्बलं दृष्ट्वा भरतो गुरुसंनिधौ
रथं मे त्वरयस्वेति सुमन्त्रं पार्श्वतोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sajjaṁ tu tadbalaṁ dṛṣṭvā bharato gurusaṁnidhau
rathaṁ me tvarayasveti sumantraṁ pārśvato'bravīt

translations.english: Seeing those force marshalled, Bharata staying near his preceptor, said to Sumantra who was at his side, “Do you speedily bring my car”

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्य तु तस्याज्ञां प्रतिगृह्य प्रहर्षितः
रथं गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तं परमवाजिभिः
verses.transliteration:
bharatasya tu tasyājñāṁ pratigṛhya praharṣitaḥ
rathaṁ gṛhītvā prayayau yuktaṁ paramavājibhiḥ

translations.english: In obedience to the mandate of Bharata, Sumantra exceedingly rejoiced, appeared with the car yoked with superb steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
स राघवः सत्यधृतिः प्रतापवा;न्ब्रुवन्सुयुक्तं दृढसत्यविक्रमः
गुरुं महारण्यगतं यशस्विनं; प्रसादयिष्यन्भरतोऽब्रवीत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
sa rāghavaḥ satyadhṛtiḥ pratāpavā;nbruvansuyuktaṁ dṛḍhasatyavikramaḥ
guruṁ mahāraṇyagataṁ yaśasvinaṁ; prasādayiṣyanbharato'bravīttadā

translations.english: Then that powerful descendant of Raghu of truthful character, and having unswerving truth for his prowess, Bharata, having said what was fit, spoke words calculated to gladden his illustrious superior gone to the mighty forest.

verses.sanskrit:
तूर्णं समुत्थाय सुमन्त्र गच्छ; बलस्य योगाय बलप्रधानान्
आनेतुमिच्छामि हि तं वनस्थं; प्रसाद्य रामं जगतो हिताय
verses.transliteration:
tūrṇaṁ samutthāya sumantra gaccha; balasya yogāya balapradhānān
ānetumicchāmi hi taṁ vanasthaṁ; prasādya rāmaṁ jagato hitāya

translations.english: O Sumantra, arise you speedily and, your desire fully attained, go by my command, and tell the chiefs of the army, and our principal adherents to array the forces.

verses.sanskrit:
स सूतपुत्रो भरतेन सम्य;गाज्ञापितः संपरिपूर्णकामः
शशास सर्वान्प्रकृतिप्रधाना;न्बलस्य मुख्यांश्च सुहृज्जनं च
verses.transliteration:
sa sūtaputro bharatena samya;gājñāpitaḥ saṁparipūrṇakāmaḥ
śaśāsa sarvānprakṛtipradhānā;nbalasya mukhyāṁśca suhṛjjanaṁ ca

translations.english: Thereat rising, Rājanyas and Vaisyas, and Vņşalas; and Vipras in every house began to yoke camels and cars and mules and elephants and excellent steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः समुत्थाय कुले कुले ते; राजन्यवैश्या वृषलाश्च विप्राः
अयूयुजन्नुष्ट्ररथान्खरांश्च; नागान्हयांश्चैव कुलप्रसूतान्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ samutthāya kule kule te; rājanyavaiśyā vṛṣalāśca viprāḥ
ayūyujannuṣṭrarathānkharāṁśca; nāgānhayāṁścaiva kulaprasūtān

translations.english: Thereat rising, Rājanyas and Vaisyas, and Vņşalas; and Vipras in every house began to yoke camels and cars and mules and elephants and excellent steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः समुत्थितः काल्यमास्थाय स्यन्दनोत्तमम्
प्रययौ भरतः शीघ्रं रामदर्शनकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ samutthitaḥ kālyamāsthāya syandanottamam
prayayau bharataḥ śīghraṁ rāmadarśanakāṅkṣayā

translations.english: Rising with the morrow, Bharata anxious to behold Rāma, speedily set out ascending an excellent car.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्रतः प्रययुस्तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोधसः
अधिरुह्य हयैर्युक्तान्रथान्सूर्यरथोपमान्
verses.transliteration:
agrataḥ prayayustasya sarve mantripurodhasaḥ
adhiruhya hayairyuktānrathānsūryarathopamān

translations.english: Before him went the councillors and priests, ascending cars resembling that of the Sun yoked with steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
नवनागसहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथाविधि
अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तमिक्ष्वाकु कुलनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
navanāgasahasrāṇi kalpitāni yathāvidhi
anvayurbharataṁ yāntamikṣvāku kulanandanam

translations.english: And a thousand elephants duly consecrated went in the wake of that son of the Ikşvāku line as he was proceeding.

verses.sanskrit:
षष्ठी रथसहस्राणि धन्विनो विविधायुधाः
अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तं राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्
verses.transliteration:
ṣaṣṭhī rathasahasrāṇi dhanvino vividhāyudhāḥ
anvayurbharataṁ yāntaṁ rājaputraṁ yaśasvinam

translations.english: And six thousand with bow-men furnished with various weapons followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he was proceeding.

verses.sanskrit:
शतं सहस्राण्यश्वानां समारूढानि राघवम्
अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तं राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्
verses.transliteration:
śataṁ sahasrāṇyaśvānāṁ samārūḍhāni rāghavam
anvayurbharataṁ yāntaṁ rājaputraṁ yaśasvinam

translations.english: And a hundred thousand horses mounted (by riders) went in the wake of that descendant of Raghu intent upon truth and having his senses under control.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी
रामानयनसंहृष्टा ययुर्यानेन भास्वता
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyī ca sumitrā ca kausalyā ca yaśasvinī
rāmānayanasaṁhṛṣṭā yayuryānena bhāsvatā

translations.english: Kaikeyi and Sumitrā and the highly famous Kausalyā rejoicing at the prospect of the bringing of Rāma, went in an effulgent car. cars

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयाताश्चार्यसंघाता रामं द्रष्टुं सलक्ष्मणम्
तस्यैव च कथाश्चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्टमानसाः
verses.transliteration:
prayātāścāryasaṁghātā rāmaṁ draṣṭuṁ salakṣmaṇam
tasyaiva ca kathāścitrāḥ kurvāṇā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ

translations.english: And the honourable persons (belonging to all the three orders) went with the object of beholding Rāma in company with Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
मेघश्यामं महाबाहुं स्थिरसत्त्वं दृढव्रतम्
कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे रामं जगतः शोकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration:
meghaśyāmaṁ mahābāhuṁ sthirasattvaṁ dṛḍhavratam
kadā drakṣyāmahe rāmaṁ jagataḥ śokanāśanam

translations.english: They with glad hearts variously conversed with each other, “When shall we see the mighty armed Rāma sable like to a cloud, of steady strength, firm in vows, the remover of the world's grief?

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट एव हि नः शोकमपनेष्यति राघवः
तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्निव भास्करः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭa eva hi naḥ śokamapaneṣyati rāghavaḥ
tamaḥ sarvasya lokasya samudyanniva bhāskaraḥ

translations.english: As soon as we shall see him, Rāghava will remove our sorrow; even as the Sun arising dispels the darkness of the entire world.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं कथयन्तस्ते संप्रहृष्टाः कथाः शुभाः
परिष्वजानाश्चान्योन्यं ययुर्नागरिकास्तदा
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ kathayantaste saṁprahṛṣṭāḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ
pariṣvajānāścānyonyaṁ yayurnāgarikāstadā

translations.english: Thus cheerfully carrying on an auspicious talk, the citizens embracing each other went along.

verses.sanskrit:
ये च तत्रापरे सर्वे संमता ये च नैगमाः
रामं प्रति ययुर्हृष्टाः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
ye ca tatrāpare sarve saṁmatā ye ca naigamāḥ
rāmaṁ prati yayurhṛṣṭāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayastadā

translations.english: And all other, and the foremost merchants as well as all the principal classes, joyfully went in quest of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहृष्टमुदिता सेना सान्वयात्कैकयीसुतम्
व्यवतिष्ठत सा सेना भरतस्यानुयायिनी
verses.transliteration:
prahṛṣṭamuditā senā sānvayātkaikayīsutam
vyavatiṣṭhata sā senā bharatasyānuyāyinī

translations.english: All these gradually followed Bharata by means of excellent vehicles. And the army delighted and in high spirits went in the wake of Kaikeyi's son attached to his brother, going to bring back his brother.

verses.sanskrit:
निरीक्ष्यानुगतां सेनां तां च गङ्गां शिवोदकाम्
भरतः सचिवान्सर्वानब्रवीद्वाक्यकोविदः
verses.transliteration:
nirīkṣyānugatāṁ senāṁ tāṁ ca gaṅgāṁ śivodakām
bharataḥ sacivānsarvānabravīdvākyakovidaḥ

translations.english: Having come to the banks of the Gangā graced with Cakravākas, the army which was following Bharata halted. Seeing the army inactive as well as the Gangā of sacred waters, Bharata versed in speech spoke to the courtiers.

verses.sanskrit:
निवेशयत मे सैन्यमभिप्रायेण सर्वशः
विश्रान्तः प्रतरिष्यामः श्व इदानीं महानदीम्
verses.transliteration:
niveśayata me sainyamabhiprāyeṇa sarvaśaḥ
viśrāntaḥ pratariṣyāmaḥ śva idānīṁ mahānadīm

translations.english: Do you communicating to all our intentions, encamp the army. Having been fatigued, we shall cross the ocean-going Gangā on the morrow.

verses.sanskrit:
दातुं च तावदिच्छामि स्वर्गतस्य महीपतेः
और्ध्वदेह निमित्तार्थमवतीर्योदकं नदीम्
verses.transliteration:
dātuṁ ca tāvadicchāmi svargatasya mahīpateḥ
aurdhvadeha nimittārthamavatīryodakaṁ nadīm

translations.english: Having crossed the stream, I am anxious to offer its water to the monarch, who has gone to heaven in behalf of his spiritual body.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यैवं ब्रुवतोऽमात्यास्तथेत्युक्त्वा समाहिताः
न्यवेशयंस्तांश्छन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration:
tasyaivaṁ bruvato'mātyāstathetyuktvā samāhitāḥ
nyaveśayaṁstāṁśchandena svena svena pṛthakpṛthak

translations.english: When he had said this, the courtiers with collected minds saying, “Be it so,” disposed their forces, each according to his wish.

verses.sanskrit:
निवेश्य गङ्गामनु तां महानदीं; चमूं विधानैः परिबर्ह शोभिनीम्
उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मनो; विचिन्तयानो भरतो निवर्तनम्
verses.transliteration:
niveśya gaṅgāmanu tāṁ mahānadīṁ; camūṁ vidhānaiḥ paribarha śobhinīm
uvāsa rāmasya tadā mahātmano; vicintayāno bharato nivartanam

translations.english: Having on the mighty stream, Gangā, quartered his forces furnished with all appliances for the journey, Bharata remained there, revolving the means of making the high-souled Rāma turn back.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निविष्टां ध्वजिनीं गङ्गामन्वाश्रितां नदीम्
निषादराजो दृष्ट्वैव ज्ञातीन्संत्वरितोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tato niviṣṭāṁ dhvajinīṁ gaṅgāmanvāśritāṁ nadīm
niṣādarājo dṛṣṭvaiva jñātīnsaṁtvarito'bravīt

translations.english: Seeing the forces with banners flying quartered on the banks of the river Gangā, and engaged in carious occupations, the lord of the Nisadas, Guha, said to his relatives ranged around.

verses.sanskrit:
महतीयमतः सेना सागराभा प्रदृश्यते
नास्यान्तमवगच्छामि मनसापि विचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration:
mahatīyamataḥ senā sāgarābhā pradṛśyate
nāsyāntamavagacchāmi manasāpi vicintayan

translations.english: This mighty host here appears like an ocean. I do not find its end even by thinking of it in my mind.

verses.sanskrit:
स एष हि महाकायः कोविदारध्वजो रथे
बन्धयिष्यति वा दाशानथ वास्मान्वधिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sa eṣa hi mahākāyaḥ kovidāradhvajo rathe
bandhayiṣyati vā dāśānatha vāsmānvadhiṣyati

translations.english: Surely the foolish Bharata has come hither himself: on his car appears the huge Kovidāra banner.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ दाशरथिं रामं पित्रा राज्याद्विवासितम्
भरतः कैकेयीपुत्रो हन्तुं समधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
atha dāśarathiṁ rāmaṁ pitrā rājyādvivāsitam
bharataḥ kaikeyīputro hantuṁ samadhigacchati

translations.english: Desirous of taking complete possession of the rare regal fortune of that sovereign (Rāma), Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, comes to destroy him.

verses.sanskrit:
भर्ता चैव सखा चैव रामो दाशरथिर्मम
तस्यार्थकामाः संनद्धा गङ्गानूपेऽत्र तिष्ठत
verses.transliteration:
bhartā caiva sakhā caiva rāmo dāśarathirmama
tasyārthakāmāḥ saṁnaddhā gaṅgānūpe'tra tiṣṭhata

translations.english: Rāma the son of Daśaratha is both my maintainer and friend. Do you in his interests, donning on your mail, wait on the banks of the river.

verses.sanskrit:
तिष्ठन्तु सर्वदाशाश्च गङ्गामन्वाश्रिता नदीम्
बलयुक्ता नदीरक्षा मांसमूलफलाशनाः
verses.transliteration:
tiṣṭhantu sarvadāśāśca gaṅgāmanvāśritā nadīm
balayuktā nadīrakṣā māṁsamūlaphalāśanāḥ

translations.english: And stationed on the river Gangā, let my powerful retainers subsisting on fruits and roots and meat, be prepared for opposing Bharata's passages over the river.

verses.sanskrit:
नावां शतानां पञ्चानां कैवर्तानां शतं शतम्
संनद्धानां तथा यूनां तिष्ठन्त्वत्यभ्यचोदयत्
verses.transliteration:
nāvāṁ śatānāṁ pañcānāṁ kaivartānāṁ śataṁ śatam
saṁnaddhānāṁ tathā yūnāṁ tiṣṭhantvatyabhyacodayat

translations.english: And let hundreds upon hundreds of Kaivarta youths accoutred in mail remain in each of five hundred barks., Guha issued this order.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा तुष्टस्तु भरतो रामस्येह भविष्यति
सेयं स्वस्तिमयी सेना गङ्गामद्य तरिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yadā tuṣṭastu bharato rāmasyeha bhaviṣyati
seyaṁ svastimayī senā gaṅgāmadya tariṣyati

translations.english: But if Bharata be well disposed towards Rāma, this host shall today safely cross the Ganga.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वोपायनं गृह्य मत्स्यमांसमधूनि च
अभिचक्राम भरतं निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvopāyanaṁ gṛhya matsyamāṁsamadhūni ca
abhicakrāma bharataṁ niṣādādhipatirguhaḥ

translations.english: Having said this, the lord of the Nişādas, Guha, taking a present of flesh, fish and honey, went out for interviewing Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
तमायान्तं तु संप्रेक्ष्य सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान्
भरतायाचचक्षेऽथ विनयज्ञो विनीतवत्
verses.transliteration:
tamāyāntaṁ tu saṁprekṣya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān
bharatāyācacakṣe'tha vinayajño vinītavat

translations.english: Seeing Guha approaching, the powerful son of the charioteer knowing season, humbly informed Bharata of it, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्पश्यतु काकुत्स्थ त्वां निषादाधिपो गुहः
असंशयं विजानीते यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.transliteration:
tasmātpaśyatu kākutstha tvāṁ niṣādādhipo guhaḥ
asaṁśayaṁ vijānīte yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau

translations.english: This lord (that approaches) surrounded by his relatives, is very potent in Dandaka and is an old friend of your brother. Therefore let Guha, the lord of the Nişādas, see you, O Kākutstha. He indubitably knows where Rāma and Lakşmaņa are.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा सुमन्त्राद्भरतः शुभम्
उवाच वचनं शीघ्रं गुहः पश्यतु मामिति
verses.transliteration:
etattu vacanaṁ śrutvā sumantrādbharataḥ śubham
uvāca vacanaṁ śīghraṁ guhaḥ paśyatu māmiti

translations.english: Hearing these wise words of Sumantra, Bharata at once said, "Let Guha see me."

verses.sanskrit:
लब्ध्वाभ्यनुज्ञां संहृष्टो ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः
आगम्य भरतं प्रह्वो गुहो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
labdhvābhyanujñāṁ saṁhṛṣṭo jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ
āgamya bharataṁ prahvo guho vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Receiving permission, Guha, right glad, appeared before Bharata, bending low, and said.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्कुटश्चैव देशोऽयं वञ्चिताश्चापि ते वयम्
निवेदयामस्ते सर्वे स्वके दाशकुले वस
verses.transliteration:
niṣkuṭaścaiva deśo'yaṁ vañcitāścāpi te vayam
nivedayāmaste sarve svake dāśakule vasa

translations.english: This place is your home. But you have stolen a march over us. We dedicate all this to you. Do you reside in the abode of your servant.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्ति मूलं फलं चैव निषादैः समुपाहृतम्
आर्द्रं च मांसं शुष्कं च वन्यं चोच्चावचं महत्
verses.transliteration:
asti mūlaṁ phalaṁ caiva niṣādaiḥ samupāhṛtam
ārdraṁ ca māṁsaṁ śuṣkaṁ ca vanyaṁ coccāvacaṁ mahat

translations.english: Here are fruits and roots gathered by the Nişādas and meat dry and moist and various other produces of the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
आशंसे स्वाशिता सेना वत्स्यतीमां विभावरीम्
अर्चितो विविधैः कामैः श्वः ससैन्यो गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
āśaṁse svāśitā senā vatsyatīmāṁ vibhāvarīm
arcito vividhaiḥ kāmaiḥ śvaḥ sasainyo gamiṣyasi

translations.english: I pray that entertained in various ways and heartily partaking of meats and drinks, this army may spend the night here. Tomorrow morning, you will go along with your forces.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्
प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं हेत्वर्थसंहितम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu bharato niṣādādhipatiṁ guham
pratyuvāca mahāprājño vākyaṁ hetvarthasaṁhitam

translations.english: Thus addressed, the exceedingly wise Bharata answered the lord of the Nişādas, in words fraught with sense and reason.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः कृतो मम गुरोः सखे
यो मे त्वमीदृशीं सेनामेकोऽभ्यर्चितुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
ūrjitaḥ khalu te kāmaḥ kṛto mama guroḥ sakhe
yo me tvamīdṛśīṁ senāmeko'bhyarcitumicchasi

translations.english: Your great desire, O friend of my superior, is surely as good as attained; since you of mighty energy have set your heart on entertaining my army.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा तु महातेजा गुहं वचनमुत्तमम्
अब्रवीद्भरतः श्रीमान्निषादाधिपतिं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā tu mahātejā guhaṁ vacanamuttamam
abravīdbharataḥ śrīmānniṣādādhipatiṁ punaḥ

translations.english: Having said these fair words to Guha, the graceful and highly energetic Bharata again addressed the lord of Nişādas.

verses.sanskrit:
कतरेण गमिष्यामि भरद्वाजाश्रमं गुह
गहनोऽयं भृशं देशो गङ्गानूपो दुरत्ययः
verses.transliteration:
katareṇa gamiṣyāmi bharadvājāśramaṁ guha
gahano'yaṁ bhṛśaṁ deśo gaṅgānūpo duratyayaḥ

translations.english: By what way shall I go to Bharadvāja's hermitage? These lands watered by the Gangā are dense and hard to track.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं गुहो गहनगोचरः
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ
abravītprāñjalirvākyaṁ guho gahanagocaraḥ

translations.english: Hearing these words of the intelligent son of the king, Guha well acquainted with the forest, said with joined hands.

verses.sanskrit:
दाशास्त्वनुगमिष्यन्ति धन्विनः सुसमाहिताः
अहं चानुगमिष्यामि राजपुत्र महायशः
verses.transliteration:
dāśāstvanugamiṣyanti dhanvinaḥ susamāhitāḥ
ahaṁ cānugamiṣyāmi rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: My servant well acquainted with the place shall attentively follow you; and, O prince possessed of mighty strength, I myself will also walk in your wake.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्न दुष्टो व्रजसि रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
इयं ते महती सेना शङ्कां जनयतीव मे
verses.transliteration:
kaccinna duṣṭo vrajasi rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
iyaṁ te mahatī senā śaṅkāṁ janayatīva me

translations.english: But do you go after Rāma of energetic acts with some evil intention? This vast force of yours raise my apprehension/

verses.sanskrit:
तमेवमभिभाषन्तमाकाश इव निर्मलः
भरतः श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tamevamabhibhāṣantamākāśa iva nirmalaḥ
bharataḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā guhaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: When Guha had asked this, Bharata with a presence unclouded like the sky, spoke to Guha these sweet words.

verses.sanskrit:
मा भूत्स कालो यत्कष्टं न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि
राघवः स हि मे भ्राता ज्येष्ठः पितृसमो मम
verses.transliteration:
mā bhūtsa kālo yatkaṣṭaṁ na māṁ śaṅkitumarhasi
rāghavaḥ sa hi me bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛsamo mama

translations.english: May a time never come when I shall do wrong to Rāghava! It behoves you not to fear me. Rāghava is my eldest brother dear to me even as my sire himself.

verses.sanskrit:
तं निवर्तयितुं यामि काकुत्स्थं वनवासिनम्
बुद्धिरन्या न ते कार्या गुह सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration:
taṁ nivartayituṁ yāmi kākutsthaṁ vanavāsinam
buddhiranyā na te kāryā guha satyaṁ bravīmi te

translations.english: I go to make Kākutstha dwelling in the woods, turn back. Other intention cherish I none. O Guha, this I tell you truly.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु संहृष्टवदनः श्रुत्वा भरतभाषितम्
पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वाक्यं भरतं प्रति हर्षितः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu saṁhṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā bharatabhāṣitam
punarevābravīdvākyaṁ bharataṁ prati harṣitaḥ

translations.english: Having heard Bharata's speech, Guha with a countenance lighted up with delight, again cheerfully addressed Bharata, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्यस्त्वं न त्वया तुल्यं पश्यामि जगतीतले
अयत्नादागतं राज्यं यस्त्वं त्यक्तुमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
dhanyastvaṁ na tvayā tulyaṁ paśyāmi jagatītale
ayatnādāgataṁ rājyaṁ yastvaṁ tyaktumihecchasi

translations.english: Blessed are you! Your like find I none on earth, inasmuch as you wish to resign a kingdom that comes to you without search.

verses.sanskrit:
शाश्वती खलु ते कीर्तिर्लोकाननुचरिष्यति
यस्त्वं कृच्छ्रगतं रामं प्रत्यानयितुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
śāśvatī khalu te kīrtirlokānanucariṣyati
yastvaṁ kṛcchragataṁ rāmaṁ pratyānayitumicchasi

translations.english: Your eternal fame will certainly range this world, since you wish to bring back Rāma passing through misfortune.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं संभाषमाणस्य गुहस्य भरतं तदा
बभौ नष्टप्रभः सूर्यो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ saṁbhāṣamāṇasya guhasya bharataṁ tadā
babhau naṣṭaprabhaḥ sūryo rajanī cābhyavartata

translations.english: As Guha was speaking thus to Bharata, the sun became shorn of his splendour and night fell.

verses.sanskrit:
संनिवेश्य स तां सेनां गुहेन परितोषितः
शत्रुघ्नेन सह श्रीमाञ्शयनं पुनरागमत्
verses.transliteration:
saṁniveśya sa tāṁ senāṁ guhena paritoṣitaḥ
śatrughnena saha śrīmāñśayanaṁ punarāgamat

translations.english: Thereupon having disposed his troops, the auspicious Bharata gratified by Guha, went to bed along with Śatrughna.

verses.sanskrit:
रामचिन्तामयः शोको भरतस्य महात्मनः
उपस्थितो ह्यनर्हस्य धर्मप्रेक्षस्य तादृशः
verses.transliteration:
rāmacintāmayaḥ śoko bharatasya mahātmanaḥ
upasthito hyanarhasya dharmaprekṣasya tādṛśaḥ

translations.english: Then arose thoughts of Rāma in the mind of the magnanimous Bharata ever having his gaze fixed on virtue and undeserving (of hardship).

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तर्दाहेन दहनः संतापयति राघवम्
वनदाहाभिसंतप्तं गूढोऽग्निरिव पादपम्
verses.transliteration:
antardāhena dahanaḥ saṁtāpayati rāghavam
vanadāhābhisaṁtaptaṁ gūḍho'gniriva pādapam

translations.english: Then even as a tree already heated by a forestfire burns with a fire hidden in its cavity that descendant of Raghu began to burn with the fire of grief inflamed in his heart.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रस्रुतः सर्वगात्रेभ्यः स्वेदः शोकाग्निसंभवः
यथा सूर्यांशुसंतप्तो हिमवान्प्रस्रुतो हिमम्
verses.transliteration:
prasrutaḥ sarvagātrebhyaḥ svedaḥ śokāgnisaṁbhavaḥ
yathā sūryāṁśusaṁtapto himavānprasruto himam

translations.english: Perspiration produced by the fire of sorrow issued out of all his limbs, as the Himavat heated by the solar warmth generates water.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्याननिर्दरशैलेन विनिःश्वसितधातुना
दैन्यपादपसंघेन शोकायासाधिशृङ्गिणा
verses.transliteration:
dhyānanirdaraśailena viniḥśvasitadhātunā
dainyapādapasaṁghena śokāyāsādhiśṛṅgiṇā

translations.english: And Kaikeyi's son was overpowered and drowned by the mountain of grief, having thoughts (of Rāma) for its entire crags, sighs for its mineral substance, disgust with the avocations of life, for its trees, mental feebleness through grief for its summits, stupor for the animals inhabiting it, and burning for its annual shrubs and bamboos.

verses.sanskrit:
गुहेन सार्धं भरतः समागतो; महानुभावः सजनः समाहितः
सुदुर्मनास्तं भरतं तदा पुन;र्गुहः समाश्वासयदग्रजं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
guhena sārdhaṁ bharataḥ samāgato; mahānubhāvaḥ sajanaḥ samāhitaḥ
sudurmanāstaṁ bharataṁ tadā puna;rguhaḥ samāśvāsayadagrajaṁ prati

translations.english: Meeting with Guha, the magnanimous Bharata accompanied by his people, engrossed with the thoughts of Rāma, became oppressed with grief. (Seeing this), Guha by and by encouraged Bharata concerning his elder brother.

verses.sanskrit:
आचचक्षेऽथ सद्भावं लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः
भरतायाप्रमेयाय गुहो गहनगोचरः
verses.transliteration:
ācacakṣe'tha sadbhāvaṁ lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ
bharatāyāprameyāya guho gahanagocaraḥ

translations.english: Guha, acquainted with the forest, described to Bharata of immeasurable prowess the regard the high-souled Laksmana bore to Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
तं जाग्रतं गुणैर्युक्तं वरचापेषुधारिणम्
भ्रातृ गुप्त्यर्थमत्यन्तमहं लक्ष्मणमब्रवम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ jāgrataṁ guṇairyuktaṁ varacāpeṣudhāriṇam
bhrātṛ guptyarthamatyantamahaṁ lakṣmaṇamabravam

translations.english: To Lakşmaņa crowned with every virtue, waking up, holding the bow with the arrow fixed on it for the purpose of guarding well his brother.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं तात सुखा शय्या त्वदर्थमुपकल्पिता
प्रत्याश्वसिहि शेष्वास्यां सुखं राघवनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ tāta sukhā śayyā tvadarthamupakalpitā
pratyāśvasihi śeṣvāsyāṁ sukhaṁ rāghavanandana

translations.english: I said, “This easeful bed has been prepared for you, my child. O son of Raghu's descendant, cheer up! Do you lie down at ease. All these people can bear hardship; but you are meant for comfort. For protecting him religiously, we shall wake.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि रामात्प्रियतरो ममास्ति भुवि कश्चन
मोत्सुको भूर्ब्रवीम्येतदप्यसत्यं तवाग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
na hi rāmātpriyataro mamāsti bhuvi kaścana
motsuko bhūrbravīmyetadapyasatyaṁ tavāgrataḥ

translations.english: To me also there is none that is dearer on earth than Rāma. Do not be anxious. This I tell you truly, through his grace I expect high fame among men, and immense religious merit, and interest and desire in entirety.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं प्रियसखं रामं शयानं सह सीतया
रक्षिष्यामि धनुष्पाणिः सर्वैः स्वैर्ज्ञातिभिः सह
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ priyasakhaṁ rāmaṁ śayānaṁ saha sītayā
rakṣiṣyāmi dhanuṣpāṇiḥ sarvaiḥ svairjñātibhiḥ saha

translations.english: Bow in hand I shall along with my kin protect Rāma lying down with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मेऽविदितं किंचिद्वनेऽस्मिंश्चरतः सदा
चतुरङ्गं ह्यपि बलं प्रसहेम वयं युधि
verses.transliteration:
na hi me'viditaṁ kiṁcidvane'smiṁścarataḥ sadā
caturaṅgaṁ hyapi balaṁ prasahema vayaṁ yudhi

translations.english: To me always ranging in this forest, nothing whatever is unknown. I can even cope in battle with an army of fourfold forces.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमस्माभिरुक्तेन लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
अनुनीता वयं सर्वे धर्ममेवानुपश्यता
verses.transliteration:
evamasmābhiruktena lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
anunītā vayaṁ sarve dharmamevānupaśyatā

translations.english: Thus accosted by us, the magnanimous Laks maņa with his gaze ever fixed on virtue, humbly observed.

verses.sanskrit:
यो न देवासुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुं युधि
तं पश्य गुह संविष्टं तृणेषु सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
yo na devāsuraiḥ sarvaiḥ śakyaḥ prasahituṁ yudhi
taṁ paśya guha saṁviṣṭaṁ tṛṇeṣu saha sītayā

translations.english: How see him who is capable of bearing in battle the onslaught of the gods and the Asuras combined, sleeping in a cave on grass?

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्प्रव्राजिते राजा न चिरं वर्तयिष्यति
विधवा मेदिनी नूनं क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
asminpravrājite rājā na ciraṁ vartayiṣyati
vidhavā medinī nūnaṁ kṣiprameva bhaviṣyati

translations.english: It is by virtue of mighty austerities and uncommon exertions that Dasaratha has obtained this son of his crowned with every auspicious sign. He being banished, the king shall not live long; and the Earth shall certainly be widowed soon.

verses.sanskrit:
विनद्य सुमहानादं श्रमेणोपरताः स्त्रियः
निर्घोषोपरतं नूनमद्य राजनिवेशनम्
verses.transliteration:
vinadya sumahānādaṁ śrameṇoparatāḥ striyaḥ
nirghoṣoparataṁ nūnamadya rājaniveśanam

translations.english: Having bewailed aloud, by this time have the women got exhausted; and surely the king's mansion is to-day still.

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथैव जननी मम
नाशंसे यदि ते सर्वे जीवेयुः शर्वरीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration:
kausalyā caiva rājā ca tathaiva jananī mama
nāśaṁse yadi te sarve jīveyuḥ śarvarīmimām

translations.english: I do not expect that either Kausalyā or the king or my mother is alive. If they live, it can be for this night only.

verses.sanskrit:
जीवेदपि हि मे माता शत्रुघ्नस्यान्ववेक्षया
दुःखिता या तु कौसल्या वीरसूर्विनशिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
jīvedapi hi me mātā śatrughnasyānvavekṣayā
duḥkhitā yā tu kausalyā vīrasūrvinaśiṣyati

translations.english: Even if my mother live seeing Satrughna, that mother of a hero, the afflicted Kausalyā, will (surely) resign her existence.

verses.sanskrit:
अतिक्रान्तमतिक्रान्तमनवाप्य मनोरथम्
राज्ये राममनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
atikrāntamatikrāntamanavāpya manoratham
rājye rāmamanikṣipya pitā me vinaśiṣyati

translations.english: Saying, All is lost, All is lost, with his desire unattained, my father having failed to install Rāma in the kingdom, will resign his existence.

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धार्थाः पितरं वृत्तं तस्मिन्काले ह्युपस्थिते
प्रेतकार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम्
verses.transliteration:
siddhārthāḥ pitaraṁ vṛttaṁ tasminkāle hyupasthite
pretakāryeṣu sarveṣu saṁskariṣyanti bhūmipam

translations.english: Surely they are blessed that when the time shall come when the king will die, will perform the funeral rites of that descendant of Raghu.

verses.sanskrit:
गजाश्वरथसंबाधां तूर्यनादविनादिताम्
सर्वकल्याणसंपूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम्
verses.transliteration:
gajāśvarathasaṁbādhāṁ tūryanādavināditām
sarvakalyāṇasaṁpūrṇāṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākulām

translations.english: Then shall they with happy hearts range the looking terraces, with the highways laid out orderly, crowned with lordly edifices, adorned with various gems, crowded by cars and elephants and horses, resounding with the notes of trumpets, abounding in auspicious things, filled with fat and contented people, having gardens and pleasure-houses, and possessed of divers classed of men indulging festal mirth.

verses.sanskrit:
आरामोद्यानसंपूर्णां समाजोत्सवशालिनीम्
सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राजधानीं पितुर्मम
verses.transliteration:
ārāmodyānasaṁpūrṇāṁ samājotsavaśālinīm
sukhitā vicariṣyanti rājadhānīṁ piturmama

translations.english: Shall we, on the occasion of Rāma's return, with glad hearts peacefully enter the city in company with that one firm in his promise?

verses.sanskrit:
परिदेवयमानस्य तस्यैवं सुमहात्मनः
तिष्ठतो राजपुत्रस्य शर्वरी सात्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
paridevayamānasya tasyaivaṁ sumahātmanaḥ
tiṣṭhato rājaputrasya śarvarī sātyavartata

translations.english: As the magnanimous son of the king was thus lamenting, the night passed away.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये कारयित्वा जटा उभौ
अस्मिन्भागीरथीतीरे सुखं संतारितौ मया
verses.transliteration:
prabhāte vimale sūrye kārayitvā jaṭā ubhau
asminbhāgīrathītīre sukhaṁ saṁtāritau mayā

translations.english: In the morning, with an unclouded sun, both, having made matted locks on the banks of the Bhāgīrathi, crossed the river along with me.

verses.sanskrit:
जटाधरौ तौ द्रुमचीरवाससौ; महाबलौ कुञ्जरयूथपोपमौ
वरेषुचापासिधरौ परंतपौ; व्यवेक्षमाणौ सह सीतया गतौ
verses.transliteration:
jaṭādharau tau drumacīravāsasau; mahābalau kuñjarayūthapopamau
vareṣucāpāsidharau paraṁtapau; vyavekṣamāṇau saha sītayā gatau

translations.english: Wearing matted locks and clad in barks of trees, those persons possessed of mighty strength, like to leaders of elephant-herds, equipped with excellent arrows and quivers and bows, those repressors of foes, expecting (their return form exile), departed with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
गुहस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भरतो भृशमप्रियम्
ध्यानं जगाम तत्रैव यत्र तच्छ्रुतमप्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
guhasya vacanaṁ śrutvā bharato bhṛśamapriyam
dhyānaṁ jagāma tatraiva yatra tacchrutamapriyam

translations.english: Hearing the words of Guha, exceedingly unpleasant, Bharata as soon as he heard them, became plunged in thought.

verses.sanskrit:
सुकुमारो महासत्त्वः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः
पुण्डरीक विशालाक्षस्तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः
verses.transliteration:
sukumāro mahāsattvaḥ siṁhaskandho mahābhujaḥ
puṇḍarīka viśālākṣastaruṇaḥ priyadarśanaḥ

translations.english: And then taking heart for a while, that tenderfamed one possessed of immense strength, gifted with leonine shoulders and length of arms, having expansive eyes resembling white lotuses, young in years, and endowed with a handsome presence, afflicted with great grief, was overpowered, like an elephant wounded in the heart with a goad.

verses.sanskrit:
तदवस्थं तु भरतं शत्रुघ्नोऽनन्तर स्थितः
परिष्वज्य रुरोदोच्चैर्विसंज्ञः शोककर्शितः
verses.transliteration:
tadavasthaṁ tu bharataṁ śatrughno'nantara sthitaḥ
pariṣvajya rurodoccairvisaṁjñaḥ śokakarśitaḥ

translations.english: Seeing Bharata in that condition, ſatrughna who was near, taking the former on his lap, began to cry, almost deprived of his senses and oppressed with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
ताश्च तं पतितं भूमौ रुदन्त्यः पर्यवारयन्
कौसल्या त्वनुसृत्यैनं दुर्मनाः परिषस्वजे
verses.transliteration:
tāśca taṁ patitaṁ bhūmau rudantyaḥ paryavārayan
kausalyā tvanusṛtyainaṁ durmanāḥ pariṣasvaje

translations.english: Thereat, all the mothers of Bharata, fasting, undergoing distress, and afflicted with the calamity that had befallen their lord, came forward, and surrounding Bharata, began to lament him fallen on the ground. And the distressed Kausalyā drawing nigh embraced him like a cow approaching her calf; and weeping from excess of grief, spoke to Bharata, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रव्याधिर्न ते कच्चिच्छरीरं परिबाधते
अद्य राजकुलस्यास्य त्वदधीनं हि जीवितम्
verses.transliteration:
putravyādhirna te kacciccharīraṁ paribādhate
adya rājakulasyāsya tvadadhīnaṁ hi jīvitam

translations.english: My son, does any malady afflict your body? Now the life of this royal race is, without doubt, in your hands.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वां दृष्ट्वा पुत्र जीवामि रामे सभ्रातृके गते
वृत्ते दशरथे राज्ञि नाथ एकस्त्वमद्य नः
verses.transliteration:
tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā putra jīvāmi rāme sabhrātṛke gate
vṛtte daśarathe rājñi nātha ekastvamadya naḥ

translations.english: Ráma having gone away along with his brother, I shall, O son, live, seeing you. King Dasaratha having departed this life, you alone are our lord.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्न लक्ष्मणे पुत्र श्रुतं ते किंचिदप्रियम्
पुत्र वा ह्येकपुत्रायाः सहभार्ये वनं गते
verses.transliteration:
kaccinna lakṣmaṇe putra śrutaṁ te kiṁcidapriyam
putra vā hyekaputrāyāḥ sahabhārye vanaṁ gate

translations.english: Have you, my son, heard anything unpleasant concerning Lakṣmaṇa; or the son of that one having an only son,* who has gone to the forest along with his wife? *Meaning herself.

verses.sanskrit:
स मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य रुदन्नेव महायशाः
कौसल्यां परिसान्त्व्येदं गुहं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa muhūrtaṁ samāśvasya rudanneva mahāyaśāḥ
kausalyāṁ parisāntvyedaṁ guhaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Having taken comfort for a while, that one of high fame weeping, and solacing Kausalya, spoke to Guha, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्राता मे क्वावसद्रात्रिं क्व सीता क्व च लक्ष्मणः
अस्वपच्छयने कस्मिन्किं भुक्त्वा गुह शंस मे
verses.transliteration:
bhrātā me kvāvasadrātriṁ kva sītā kva ca lakṣmaṇaḥ
asvapacchayane kasminkiṁ bhuktvā guha śaṁsa me

translations.english: Where did my brother pass the night? And where did Sītā? And where did, again, Laks maņa? And in what bed did he sleep, and what did he previously partake of? Do you, O Guha, tell me this.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽब्रवीद्भरतं पृष्टो निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः
यद्विधं प्रतिपेदे च रामे प्रियहितेऽतिथौ
verses.transliteration:
so'bravīdbharataṁ pṛṣṭo niṣādādhipatirguhaḥ
yadvidhaṁ pratipede ca rāme priyahite'tithau

translations.english: Thereat, well pleased, Gulha, the lord of Nişādas, related to Bharata how he had acted in respect of Rāma, his dear guest, studious of his welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नमुच्चावचं भक्ष्याः फलानि विविधानि च
रामायाभ्यवहारार्थं बहुचोपहृतं मया
verses.transliteration:
annamuccāvacaṁ bhakṣyāḥ phalāni vividhāni ca
rāmāyābhyavahārārthaṁ bahucopahṛtaṁ mayā

translations.english: I procured for Rāma's use rice and fruits and roots and various kinds of food.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्सर्वं प्रत्यनुज्ञासीद्रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
न हि तत्प्रत्यगृह्णात्स क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration:
tatsarvaṁ pratyanujñāsīdrāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
na hi tatpratyagṛhṇātsa kṣatradharmamanusmaran

translations.english: All these Rāma having truth for his prowess accepted, but observing Ksatriya morality, he did not take them.

verses.sanskrit:
न ह्यस्माभिः प्रतिग्राह्यं सखे देयं तु सर्वदा
इति तेन वयं राजन्ननुनीता महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
na hyasmābhiḥ pratigrāhyaṁ sakhe deyaṁ tu sarvadā
iti tena vayaṁ rājannanunītā mahātmanā

translations.english: 'O friend, we ought not to take anything: ours is always to give.'

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेन समानीतं पीत्वा वारि महायशाः
औपवास्यं तदाकार्षीद्राघवः सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇena samānītaṁ pītvā vāri mahāyaśāḥ
aupavāsyaṁ tadākārṣīdrāghavaḥ saha sītayā

translations.english: Thus did that magnanimous one beseech us. On the high-souled Lakşmaņa bringing water, Rāghava having drunk it, fasted along with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु जलशेषेण लक्ष्मणोऽप्यकरोत्तदा
वाग्यतास्ते त्रयः संध्यामुपासत समाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
tatastu jalaśeṣeṇa lakṣmaṇo'pyakarottadā
vāgyatāste trayaḥ saṁdhyāmupāsata samāhitāḥ

translations.english: Then Lakşmaņa drank up the water that remained. Then the three with fixed minds silently performed their adorations to the Twilight.

verses.sanskrit:
सौमित्रिस्तु ततः पश्चादकरोत्स्वास्तरं शुभम्
स्वयमानीय बर्हींषि क्षिप्रं राघव कारणात्
verses.transliteration:
saumitristu tataḥ paścādakarotsvāstaraṁ śubham
svayamānīya barhīṁṣi kṣipraṁ rāghava kāraṇāt

translations.english: After that, Sumitrā's son prepared a goodly bed for Rāghava, himself bringing Kuća grass.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्समाविशद्रामः स्वास्तरे सह सीतया
प्रक्षाल्य च तयोः पादावपचक्राम लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
tasminsamāviśadrāmaḥ svāstare saha sītayā
prakṣālya ca tayoḥ pādāvapacakrāma lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: And in that bed lay down Rāma in company with Sītā. Next washing their feet, Lakşmaņa turned away.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तदिङ्गुदीमूलमिदमेव च तत्तृणम्
यस्मिन्रामश्च सीता च रात्रिं तां शयितावुभौ
verses.transliteration:
etattadiṅgudīmūlamidameva ca tattṛṇam
yasminrāmaśca sītā ca rātriṁ tāṁ śayitāvubhau

translations.english: This is the foot of the Ingudī, and this that grass. On it both Rāma and Sītā lay down that night.

verses.sanskrit:
नियम्य पृष्ठे तु तलाङ्गुलित्रवा;ञ्शरैः सुपूर्णाविषुधी परंतपः
महद्धनुः सज्यमुपोह्य लक्ष्मणो; निशामतिष्ठत्परितोऽस्य केवलम्
verses.transliteration:
niyamya pṛṣṭhe tu talāṅgulitravā;ñśaraiḥ supūrṇāviṣudhī paraṁtapaḥ
mahaddhanuḥ sajyamupohya lakṣmaṇo; niśāmatiṣṭhatparito'sya kevalam

translations.english: Fastening on his back a pair of quivers filled with arrows furnished with finger-fences, and taking his mighty bow, Lakşmaņa all night kept watch around.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वहं चोत्तमबाणचापधृ;क्स्थितोऽभवं तत्र स यत्र लक्ष्मणः
अतन्द्रिभिर्ज्ञातिभिरात्तकार्मुकै;र्महेन्द्रकल्पं परिपालयंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tatastvahaṁ cottamabāṇacāpadhṛ;ksthito'bhavaṁ tatra sa yatra lakṣmaṇaḥ
atandribhirjñātibhirāttakārmukai;rmahendrakalpaṁ paripālayaṁstadā

translations.english: I also taking an excellent bow, remained where remained Lakṣmaṇa, and surrounded by my kindred who stayed there vigilantly, equipped with bows, guarded him that resembled the mighty Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा निपुणं सर्वं भरतः सह मन्त्रिभिः
इङ्गुदीमूलमागम्य रामशय्यामवेक्ष्य ताम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā nipuṇaṁ sarvaṁ bharataḥ saha mantribhiḥ
iṅgudīmūlamāgamya rāmaśayyāmavekṣya tām

translations.english: Having heard everything, Bharata in company with the counsellors went to the foot of the Ingudi tree and saw the bed of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीज्जननीः सर्वा इह तेन महात्मना
शर्वरी शयिता भूमाविदमस्य विमर्दितम्
verses.transliteration:
abravījjananīḥ sarvā iha tena mahātmanā
śarvarī śayitā bhūmāvidamasya vimarditam

translations.english: And he said to his mothers, That high-souled one lay down here on the ground during the night, and his limbs pressed this spot.

verses.sanskrit:
महाभागकुलीनेन महाभागेन धीमता
जातो दशरथेनोर्व्यां न रामः स्वप्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
mahābhāgakulīnena mahābhāgena dhīmatā
jāto daśarathenorvyāṁ na rāmaḥ svaptumarhati

translations.english: Begot of that foremost of monarchs, the exalted and intelligent Daſaratha, Rāma does not deserve to sleep on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
अजिनोत्तरसंस्तीर्णे वरास्तरणसंचये
शयित्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रः कथं शेते महीतले
verses.transliteration:
ajinottarasaṁstīrṇe varāstaraṇasaṁcaye
śayitvā puruṣavyāghraḥ kathaṁ śete mahītale

translations.english: How can that chief of men having reposed in beds furnished with pillows made of deer-skins and having superb cloths, have lain down on the earth?

verses.sanskrit:
अश्रद्धेयमिदं लोके न सत्यं प्रतिभाति मा
मुह्यते खलु मे भावः स्वप्नोऽयमिति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration:
aśraddheyamidaṁ loke na satyaṁ pratibhāti mā
muhyate khalu me bhāvaḥ svapno'yamiti me matiḥ

translations.english: It does by no means look to me like truth. Forsooth, I am amazed. I take it, this is a vision.

verses.sanskrit:
विदेहराजस्य सुता सीता च प्रियदर्शना
दयिता शयिता भूमौ स्नुषा दशरथस्य च
verses.transliteration:
videharājasya sutā sītā ca priyadarśanā
dayitā śayitā bhūmau snuṣā daśarathasya ca

translations.english: Verily, no destiny is superior to Time, since Dasaratha's son, Rāma himself, had to repose on the earth, and the beauteous beloved daughter of Videha's king, and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, had to lie down on the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं शय्या मम भ्रातुरिदं हि परिवर्तितम्
स्थण्डिले कठिने सर्वं गात्रैर्विमृदितं तृणम्
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ śayyā mama bhrāturidaṁ hi parivartitam
sthaṇḍile kaṭhine sarvaṁ gātrairvimṛditaṁ tṛṇam

translations.english: This was the bed of my brother; on this hard spot did he turn his lovely limbs, and this grass was pressed by them.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्ये साभरणा सुप्ता सीतास्मिञ्शयने तदा
तत्र तत्र हि दृश्यन्ते सक्ताः कनकबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration:
manye sābharaṇā suptā sītāsmiñśayane tadā
tatra tatra hi dṛśyante saktāḥ kanakabindavaḥ

translations.english: I think that the graceful Sītā adorned with ornaments slept in this bed, for here and there are scattered particles of gold.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरीयमिहासक्तं सुव्यक्तं सीतया तदा
तथा ह्येते प्रकाशन्ते सक्ताः कौशेयतन्तवः
verses.transliteration:
uttarīyamihāsaktaṁ suvyaktaṁ sītayā tadā
tathā hyete prakāśante saktāḥ kauśeyatantavaḥ

translations.english: It is clear that Sītā had spread her sheet at this spot, hence it is that fibres of silk are discoverable here.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्ये भर्तुः सुखा शय्या येन बाला तपस्विनी
सुकुमारी सती दुःखं न विजानाति मैथिली
verses.transliteration:
manye bhartuḥ sukhā śayyā yena bālā tapasvinī
sukumārī satī duḥkhaṁ na vijānāti maithilī

translations.english: I deem that the bed of her lord appears agreeable to a wife, since a girl tender and in affliction, the chaste daughter of Mithilā experienced no inconvenience (in sleeping in one such).

verses.sanskrit:
कथमिन्दीवरश्यामो रक्ताक्षः प्रियदर्शनः
सुखभागी च दुःखार्हः शयितो भुवि राघवः
verses.transliteration:
kathamindīvaraśyāmo raktākṣaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
sukhabhāgī ca duḥkhārhaḥ śayito bhuvi rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Born in the imperial race, and capable of conferring happiness on all, the bringer-about of all good, why did Rāghava of dark blue hue like that of a lotus, graceful, and crowned with red eyes, the inheritor of happiness and undeserving of misery, having left his dear consummate kingdom, lie down on the ground?

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धार्था खलु वैदेही पतिं यानुगता वनम्
वयं संशयिताः सर्वे हीनास्तेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
siddhārthā khalu vaidehī patiṁ yānugatā vanam
vayaṁ saṁśayitāḥ sarve hīnāstena mahātmanā

translations.english: And blessed is Videha's daughter who follows her husband into the woods. Bereft of that magnanimous one, we have all been brought into jeopardy.

verses.sanskrit:
अकर्णधारा पृथिवी शून्येव प्रतिभाति मा
गते दशरथे स्वर्गे रामे चारण्यमाश्रिते
verses.transliteration:
akarṇadhārā pṛthivī śūnyeva pratibhāti mā
gate daśarathe svarge rāme cāraṇyamāśrite

translations.english: The Earth without her helmsman seems to me quite empty, on Dasaratha having ascended the celestial regions and Rāma taken refuge in the wilderness.

verses.sanskrit:
न च प्रार्थयते कश्चिन्मनसापि वसुंधराम्
वनेऽपि वसतस्तस्य बाहुवीर्याभिरक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration:
na ca prārthayate kaścinmanasāpi vasuṁdharām
vane'pi vasatastasya bāhuvīryābhirakṣitām

translations.english: On Rãma having set up his dwelling in the forest, one (like me) does not even mentally covet this earth which had been protected by the immense prowess (of Rāghava).

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रहृष्टबलां न्यूनां विषमस्थामनावृताम्
शत्रवो नाभिमन्यन्ते भक्ष्यान्विषकृतानिव
verses.transliteration:
aprahṛṣṭabalāṁ nyūnāṁ viṣamasthāmanāvṛtām
śatravo nābhimanyante bhakṣyānviṣakṛtāniva

translations.english: With her walls undefined, her horses and elephants unrestrained, and her gates left open, the defenceless metropolis deprived of her power, placed in peril and without any protection, is surely not regarded by the enemies, like food mixed with poison.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य प्रभृति भूमौ तु शयिष्येऽहं तृणेषु वा
फलमूलाशनो नित्यं जटाचीराणि धारयन्
verses.transliteration:
adya prabhṛti bhūmau tu śayiṣye'haṁ tṛṇeṣu vā
phalamūlāśano nityaṁ jaṭācīrāṇi dhārayan

translations.english: From this day forth I will lie down on the ground, or on the grass, daily subsisting on fruits and roots, and bearing matted locks and a cloth of bark.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यार्थमुत्तरं कालं निवत्स्यामि सुखं वने
तं प्रतिश्रवमामुच्य नास्य मिथ्या भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tasyārthamuttaraṁ kālaṁ nivatsyāmi sukhaṁ vane
taṁ pratiśravamāmucya nāsya mithyā bhaviṣyati

translations.english: And for his sake I will in future live happily in the woods. (By my doing so), the promise of that high-minded one shall not be rendered null.

verses.sanskrit:
वसन्तं भ्रातुरर्थाय शत्रुघ्नो मानुवत्स्यति
लक्ष्मणेन सह त्वार्यो अयोध्यां पालयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
vasantaṁ bhrāturarthāya śatrughno mānuvatsyati
lakṣmaṇena saha tvāryo ayodhyāṁ pālayiṣyati

translations.english: Me residing in the forest in the interests of my brother, Satrughna shall bear company; while my noble one will rule Ayodhyā assisted by Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिषेक्ष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थमयोध्यायां द्विजातयः
अपि मे देवताः कुर्युरिमं सत्यं मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration:
abhiṣekṣyanti kākutsthamayodhyāyāṁ dvijātayaḥ
api me devatāḥ kuryurimaṁ satyaṁ manoratham

translations.english: The twice-born ones will sprinkle Kākutstha in Ayodhyā. May the deities realize this desire of mine!

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसाद्यमानः शिरसा मया स्वयं; बहुप्रकारं यदि न प्रपत्स्यते
ततोऽनुवत्स्यामि चिराय राघवं; वने वसन्नार्हति मामुपेक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
prasādyamānaḥ śirasā mayā svayaṁ; bahuprakāraṁ yadi na prapatsyate
tato'nuvatsyāmi cirāya rāghavaṁ; vane vasannārhati māmupekṣitum

translations.english: Propitiated by me personally in various ways with bent head, if he do not consent, then shall I ever stay with Rāghava in the woods. Surely he cannot long persist in putting me off.

verses.sanskrit:
व्युष्य रात्रिं तु तत्रैव गङ्गाकूले स राघवः
भरतः काल्यमुत्थाय शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
vyuṣya rātriṁ tu tatraiva gaṅgākūle sa rāghavaḥ
bharataḥ kālyamutthāya śatrughnamidamabravīt

translations.english: Having spent the night there on the banks of the Gangā, that descendant of Raghu rising early in the morning, said these words to Satrughna.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघोत्तिष्ठ किं शेषे निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्
शीघ्रमानय भद्रं ते तारयिष्यति वाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
śatrughottiṣṭha kiṁ śeṣe niṣādādhipatiṁ guham
śīghramānaya bhadraṁ te tārayiṣyati vāhinīm

translations.english: O Śatrughna, arise! Why sleepest you? Bring you at once that lord of the Nisādhas, Guha, Good betide you! he will take the army (over the stream.)

verses.sanskrit:
जागर्मि नाहं स्वपिमि तथैवार्यं विचिन्तयन्
इत्येवमब्रवीद्भ्रात्रा शत्रुघ्नोऽपि प्रचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
jāgarmi nāhaṁ svapimi tathaivāryaṁ vicintayan
ityevamabravīdbhrātrā śatrughno'pi pracoditaḥ

translations.english: Thus urged by his brother, Śatrughna said, "Thinking of that noble one (Rāma), I have not slept, but have remained awake in a like manner. *i.e., as you have done.

verses.sanskrit:
इति संवदतोरेवमन्योन्यं नरसिंहयोः
आगम्य प्राञ्जलिः काले गुहो भरतमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
iti saṁvadatorevamanyonyaṁ narasiṁhayoḥ
āgamya prāñjaliḥ kāle guho bharatamabravīt

translations.english: As those chiefs of men were thus conversing with each other, Guha appearing in time with joined hands, remarked.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चित्सुखं नदीतीरेऽवात्सीः काकुत्स्थ शर्वरीम्
कच्चिच्च सह सैन्यस्य तव सर्वमनामयम्
verses.transliteration:
kaccitsukhaṁ nadītīre'vātsīḥ kākutstha śarvarīm
kaccicca saha sainyasya tava sarvamanāmayam

translations.english: O Kākutstha, have you spent the night happily on the banks of the river? And is it continuous good fortune with you along with your forces?

verses.sanskrit:
गुहस्य तत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा स्नेहादुदीरितम्
रामस्यानुवशो वाक्यं भरतोऽपीदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
guhasya tattu vacanaṁ śrutvā snehādudīritam
rāmasyānuvaśo vākyaṁ bharato'pīdamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing Guha's speech fraught with affection, Bharata ever obedient to Rāma, spoke on his pare, saying. "Happily have we spent the night; and we have also been well received by you. Now let your servants take us over by means of many boats."

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गुहः संत्वरितः श्रुत्वा भरतशासनम्
प्रतिप्रविश्य नगरं तं ज्ञातिजनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tato guhaḥ saṁtvaritaḥ śrutvā bharataśāsanam
pratipraviśya nagaraṁ taṁ jñātijanamabravīt

translations.english: Thereat, hearing Bharata's mandate, Guha, bestirring himself, re-entered the city and addressed his kinsfolk, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठत प्रबुध्यध्वं भद्रमस्तु हि वः सदा
नावः समनुकर्षध्वं तारयिष्याम वाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭhata prabudhyadhvaṁ bhadramastu hi vaḥ sadā
nāvaḥ samanukarṣadhvaṁ tārayiṣyāma vāhinīm

translations.english: Arise you! Awake! May good always attend you! Do you draw up the boats; I shall ferry the forces over.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तथोक्ताः समुत्थाय त्वरिता राजशासनात्
पञ्च नावां शतान्येव समानिन्युः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
te tathoktāḥ samutthāya tvaritā rājaśāsanāt
pañca nāvāṁ śatānyeva samāninyuḥ samantataḥ

translations.english: Thus asked, they arising and bestirring themselves in consequence of the king's command, brought up five hundred boats around.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्याः स्वस्तिकविज्ञेया महाघण्डा धरा वराः
शोभमानाः पताकिन्यो युक्तवाताः सुसंहताः
verses.transliteration:
anyāḥ svastikavijñeyā mahāghaṇḍā dharā varāḥ
śobhamānāḥ patākinyo yuktavātāḥ susaṁhatāḥ

translations.english: Others also known by the name of Swastika, bearing large bells on their prows, and banners, well decked out, furnished with oars, and manned by bargemen, with their joints firmly constructed, (were brought up).

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स्वस्तिकविज्ञेयां पाण्डुकम्बलसंवृताम्
सनन्दिघोषां कल्याणीं गुहो नावमुपाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ svastikavijñeyāṁ pāṇḍukambalasaṁvṛtām
sanandighoṣāṁ kalyāṇīṁ guho nāvamupāharat

translations.english: And Guha himself brought a graceful barge called Swastika, covered with pale woollen cloth, and resounding with music.

verses.sanskrit:
तामारुरोह भरतः शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलः
कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च याश्चान्या राजयोषितः
verses.transliteration:
tāmāruroha bharataḥ śatrughnaśca mahābalaḥ
kausalyā ca sumitrā ca yāścānyā rājayoṣitaḥ

translations.english: On this boat ascended Bharata, the mighty Śatrughna, Kausalyā, Sumitrā, and other wives of the king. The priests, and preceptors belonging to the Brāhmaṇa order, has already ascended. After (Bharata and others had got up), ascended the wives of auxiliary princes, and cars and provisions were got on board.

verses.sanskrit:
आवासमादीपयतां तीर्थं चाप्यवगाहताम्
भाण्डानि चाददानानां घोषस्त्रिदिवमस्पृशत्
verses.transliteration:
āvāsamādīpayatāṁ tīrthaṁ cāpyavagāhatām
bhāṇḍāni cādadānānāṁ ghoṣastridivamaspṛśat

translations.english: And the uproar consequent of the troops burning down dwellings, pressing down descents to the river, and loading goods, spread on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
पताकिन्यस्तु ता नावः स्वयं दाशैरधिष्ठिताः
वहन्त्यो जनमारूढं तदा संपेतुराशुगाः
verses.transliteration:
patākinyastu tā nāvaḥ svayaṁ dāśairadhiṣṭhitāḥ
vahantyo janamārūḍhaṁ tadā saṁpeturāśugāḥ

translations.english: Then those boats hung with pennons, managed by the kinsfolk (of Guha), set off at speed with the teeming folks that had got on board.

verses.sanskrit:
नारीणामभिपूर्णास्तु काश्चित्काश्चित्तु वाजिनाम्
कश्चित्तत्र वहन्ति स्म यानयुग्यं महाधनम्
verses.transliteration:
nārīṇāmabhipūrṇāstu kāścitkāścittu vājinām
kaścittatra vahanti sma yānayugyaṁ mahādhanam

translations.english: And some of these were filled with women, and some with horses, and some conveyed cars and cattle of great value.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः स्म गत्वा परं तीरमवरोप्य च तं जनम्
निवृत्ताः काण्डचित्राणि क्रियन्ते दाशबन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ sma gatvā paraṁ tīramavaropya ca taṁ janam
nivṛttāḥ kāṇḍacitrāṇi kriyante dāśabandhubhiḥ

translations.english: And going to the other bank and landing the crowds on the shore, the friends and slaves (of Guha) while returning, movements (of the boats).

verses.sanskrit:
सवैजयन्तास्तु गजा गजारोहैः प्रचोदिताः
तरन्तः स्म प्रकाशन्ते सध्वजा इव पर्वताः
verses.transliteration:
savaijayantāstu gajā gajārohaiḥ pracoditāḥ
tarantaḥ sma prakāśante sadhvajā iva parvatāḥ

translations.english: And elephants graced with flags ing spurred on by their riders, began to cross the stream, appearing like (so many) winged hills.

verses.sanskrit:
नावश्चारुरुहुस्त्वन्ये प्लवैस्तेरुस्तथापरे
अन्ये कुम्भघटैस्तेरुरन्ये तेरुश्च बाहुभिः
verses.transliteration:
nāvaścāruruhustvanye plavaisterustathāpare
anye kumbhaghaṭaisteruranye teruśca bāhubhiḥ

translations.english: Others ascended boats, and others crossed on rafts, others crossed by means of reversed pitchers, and others by their arms alone.

verses.sanskrit:
सा पुण्या ध्वजिनी गङ्गां दाशैः संतारिता स्वयम्
मैत्रे मुहूर्ते प्रययौ प्रयागवनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
sā puṇyā dhvajinī gaṅgāṁ dāśaiḥ saṁtāritā svayam
maitre muhūrte prayayau prayāgavanamuttamam

translations.english: Ferried over the Gangā by the servants (of Guha), that beautiful army graced with streamers, at the third Muhurta arrived at the romantic woods of Prayāga.

verses.sanskrit:
आश्वासयित्वा च चमूं महात्मा; निवेशयित्वा च यथोपजोषम्
द्रष्टुं भरद्वाजमृषिप्रवर्य;मृत्विग्वृतः सन्भरतः प्रतस्थे
verses.transliteration:
āśvāsayitvā ca camūṁ mahātmā; niveśayitvā ca yathopajoṣam
draṣṭuṁ bharadvājamṛṣipravarya;mṛtvigvṛtaḥ sanbharataḥ pratasthe

translations.english: Having made the army take rest at its ease, and encamped it (at the woods of Prayāga), that magnanimous one, Bharata, for the purpose of seeing the asylum of the ascetic Bharadvāja, went thither, accompanied by Rtvijas and Sadasyas (members).

verses.sanskrit:
पद्भ्यामेव हि धर्मज्ञो न्यस्तशस्त्रपरिच्छदः
वसानो वाससी क्षौमे पुरोधाय पुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration:
padbhyāmeva hi dharmajño nyastaśastraparicchadaḥ
vasāno vāsasī kṣaume purodhāya purohitam

translations.english: Having arrived at (the neighbourhood of) Bharadvāja's asylum, that foremost of men while it was a krosa (to the destination), left his forces behind and went thither, accompanied by his counsellors alone. And leaving his attire and arms, and clad in a silk cloth, that pious one placing the priest in front, went on foot.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संदर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघवः
मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानु पुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁdarśane tasya bharadvājasya rāghavaḥ
mantriṇastānavasthāpya jagāmānu purohitam

translations.english: Then with the view of seeing Bharadvāja, that descendent of Raghu leaving behind the counsellors also, went in the wake of the priest.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठमथ दृष्ट्वैव भरद्वाजो महातपाः
संचचालासनात्तूर्णं शिष्यानर्घ्यमिति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhamatha dṛṣṭvaiva bharadvājo mahātapāḥ
saṁcacālāsanāttūrṇaṁ śiṣyānarghyamiti bruvan

translations.english: As soon as Bharadvāja of rigid austerities saw Vasiştha, he at once rose from his seat, saying to him disciples "Arghya!"

verses.sanskrit:
समागम्य वसिष्ठेन भरतेनाभिवादितः
अबुध्यत महातेजाः सुतं दशरथस्य तम्
verses.transliteration:
samāgamya vasiṣṭhena bharatenābhivāditaḥ
abudhyata mahātejāḥ sutaṁ daśarathasya tam

translations.english: On being called upon by Vasiştha, that highly energetic one understood that it was Daſaratha's son.

verses.sanskrit:
ताभ्यामर्घ्यं च पाद्यं च दत्त्वा पश्चात्फलानि च
आनुपूर्व्याच्च धर्मज्ञः पप्रच्छ कुशलं कुले
verses.transliteration:
tābhyāmarghyaṁ ca pādyaṁ ca dattvā paścātphalāni ca
ānupūrvyācca dharmajñaḥ papraccha kuśalaṁ kule

translations.english: Having offered them (the guests) water to wash their feet and Arghya, as well as fruits subsequently, that virtuous one (Bharadvāja) successively enquired after the welfare of their (respective) homes; and after that, of the forces, exchequer, friends and counsellors in Ayodhyā. And knowing that Dasaratha had departed this life, he did not ask anything relating to the monarch.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठो भरतश्चैनं पप्रच्छतुरनामयम्
शरीरेऽग्निषु वृक्षेषु शिष्येषु मृगपक्षिषु
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭho bharataścainaṁ papracchaturanāmayam
śarīre'gniṣu vṛkṣeṣu śiṣyeṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu

translations.english: Then Vasiştha and Bharata questioned him as to his welfare, in relation to the body, the (sacrificial) fire, the trees, the beasts and the birds (of the hermitage).

verses.sanskrit:
तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय भरद्वाजो महातपाः
भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं राघवस्नेहबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration:
tatheti ca pratijñāya bharadvājo mahātapāḥ
bharataṁ pratyuvācedaṁ rāghavasnehabandhanāt

translations.english: To all this returning "So it is,” the illustrious Bharadvāja from affection for Rāghava said to Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
किमिहागमने कार्यं तव राज्यं प्रशासतः
एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं न हि मे शुध्यते मनः
verses.transliteration:
kimihāgamane kāryaṁ tava rājyaṁ praśāsataḥ
etadācakṣva me sarvaṁ na hi me śudhyate manaḥ

translations.english: What is the use of your visit here, seeing that you are engaged in the task of governing the kingdom? Do you relate all this to me; my mind is ill at ease.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो भरद्वाजं भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह
पर्यश्रु नयनो दुःखाद्वाचा संसज्जमानया
verses.transliteration:
evamukto bharadvājaṁ bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha
paryaśru nayano duḥkhādvācā saṁsajjamānayā

translations.english: Thus accosted, Bharata replied to Bharadvāja with tears filling his eyes and his words choked with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
हतोऽस्मि यदि मामेवं भगवानपि मन्यते
मत्तो न दोषमाशङ्केर्नैवं मामनुशाधि हि
verses.transliteration:
hato'smi yadi māmevaṁ bhagavānapi manyate
matto na doṣamāśaṅkernaivaṁ māmanuśādhi hi

translations.english: Undone am I if the reverend one also deems me so. Do not apprehend any wrong from me; and do you not reproach me thus.

verses.sanskrit:
न चैतदिष्टं माता मे यदवोचन्मदन्तरे
नाहमेतेन तुष्टश्च न तद्वचनमाददे
verses.transliteration:
na caitadiṣṭaṁ mātā me yadavocanmadantare
nāhametena tuṣṭaśca na tadvacanamādade

translations.english: Whatever my mother has said in relation to me, does not express my wish, I am not satisfied with that, nor do I endorse her speech.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तु तं नरव्याघ्रमुपयातः प्रसादकः
प्रतिनेतुमयोध्यां च पादौ तस्याभिवन्दितुम्
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tu taṁ naravyāghramupayātaḥ prasādakaḥ
pratinetumayodhyāṁ ca pādau tasyābhivanditum

translations.english: I, intending to pacify him, and going to that chief of men, with the view of taking him to Ayodhyā and of paying homage to his feet.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं मामेवंगतं मत्वा प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
शंस मे भगवन्रामः क्व संप्रति महीपतिः
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ māmevaṁgataṁ matvā prasādaṁ kartumarhasi
śaṁsa me bhagavanrāmaḥ kva saṁprati mahīpatiḥ

translations.english: Thinking me as already gone, you should show your favour to me. O reverend Sir, tell me where stay at present Rāma, lord of the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच तं भरद्वाजः प्रसादाद्भरतं वचः
त्वय्येतत्पुरुषव्याघ्र युक्तं राघववंशजे
गुरुवृत्तिर्दमश्चैव साधूनां चानुयायिता
verses.transliteration:
uvāca taṁ bharadvājaḥ prasādādbharataṁ vacaḥ
tvayyetatpuruṣavyāghra yuktaṁ rāghavavaṁśaje
guruvṛttirdamaścaiva sādhūnāṁ cānuyāyitā

translations.english: foremost of men, even this is worthy of you. Serving superiors, restraint of the senses, and following the pious, are ever found in one sprung in the Rāghava line.

verses.sanskrit:
जाने चैतन्मनःस्थं ते दृढीकरणमस्त्विति
अपृच्छं त्वां तवात्यर्थं कीर्तिं समभिवर्धयन्
verses.transliteration:
jāne caitanmanaḥsthaṁ te dṛḍhīkaraṇamastviti
apṛcchaṁ tvāṁ tavātyarthaṁ kīrtiṁ samabhivardhayan

translations.english: I know that even this is your intention, but for the purpose of making your mind all the firmer, I had asked you in this wise; so that your fame might greatly increase.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ वसति ते भ्राता चित्रकूटे महागिरौ
श्वस्तु गन्तासि तं देशं वसाद्य सह मन्त्रिभिः
एतं मे कुरु सुप्राज्ञ कामं कामार्थकोविद
verses.transliteration:
asau vasati te bhrātā citrakūṭe mahāgirau
śvastu gantāsi taṁ deśaṁ vasādya saha mantribhiḥ
etaṁ me kuru suprājña kāmaṁ kāmārthakovida

translations.english: On the morrow you will set out for that region. Do you to-day sojourn here along with your counsellors. O wise one, do this at your pleasure, O you understanding interest and desire.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तथेत्येवमुदारदर्शनः; प्रतीतरूपो भरतोऽब्रवीद्वचः
चकार बुद्धिं च तदा महाश्रमे; निशानिवासाय नराधिपात्मजः
verses.transliteration:
tatastathetyevamudāradarśanaḥ; pratītarūpo bharato'bravīdvacaḥ
cakāra buddhiṁ ca tadā mahāśrame; niśānivāsāya narādhipātmajaḥ

translations.english: Thereat the gently-looking and highly famous one said, “Be it so;" and the king's son made up his mind to spend the night in the great hermitage (of the saint).

verses.sanskrit:
कृतबुद्धिं निवासाय तथैव स मुनिस्तदा
भरतं कैकयी पुत्रमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtabuddhiṁ nivāsāya tathaiva sa munistadā
bharataṁ kaikayī putramātithyena nyamantrayat

translations.english: Then the ascetic asked Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, when he had decided for staying there, to receive his hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीद्भरतस्त्वेनं नन्विदं भवता कृतम्
पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथातिथ्यं वने यदूपपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
abravīdbharatastvenaṁ nanvidaṁ bhavatā kṛtam
pādyamarghyaṁ tathātithyaṁ vane yadūpapadyate

translations.english: Thereat Bharata said, “You have for certain done this, (have offered me) water for washing my feet, Arghya, and hospitality with what can be procured in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
अथोवाच भरद्वाजो भरतं प्रहसन्निव
जाने त्वां प्रीति संयुक्तं तुष्येस्त्वं येन केनचित्
verses.transliteration:
athovāca bharadvājo bharataṁ prahasanniva
jāne tvāṁ prīti saṁyuktaṁ tuṣyestvaṁ yena kenacit

translations.english: Then Bharadvāja as if in jest, said to Bharata, "I know you to be of a complacent disposition; and that you are pleased with anything and everything."

verses.sanskrit:
सेनायास्तु तवैतस्याः कर्तुमिच्छामि भोजनम्
मम प्रितिर्यथा रूपा त्वमर्हो मनुजर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
senāyāstu tavaitasyāḥ kartumicchāmi bhojanam
mama pritiryathā rūpā tvamarho manujarṣabha

translations.english: But I wish to feast your forces. And, O best of men, it behoves you to act in harmony with my desire.

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं चापि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलमिहागतः
कस्मान्नेहोपयातोऽसि सबलः पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ cāpi nikṣipya dūre balamihāgataḥ
kasmānnehopayāto'si sabalaḥ puruṣarṣabha

translations.english: Why did you coming higher, leave your army at a distance:? And, you man of men, why did you not come accompanied with your forces?

verses.sanskrit:
भरतः प्रत्युवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिस्तं तपोधनम्
ससैन्यो नोपयातोऽस्मि भगवन्भगवद्भयात्
verses.transliteration:
bharataḥ pratyuvācedaṁ prāñjalistaṁ tapodhanam
sasainyo nopayāto'smi bhagavanbhagavadbhayāt

translations.english: Bharata replied to him, saying, “I had not come accompanied with my forces, from fear of you, O reverend Sir.”

verses.sanskrit:
वाजि मुख्या मनुष्याश्च मत्ताश्च वर वारणाः
प्रच्छाद्य महतीं भूमिं भगवन्ननुयान्ति माम्
verses.transliteration:
vāji mukhyā manuṣyāśca mattāśca vara vāraṇāḥ
pracchādya mahatīṁ bhūmiṁ bhagavannanuyānti mām

translations.english: Choice steeds, men, and mad elephants of the best kind, covering a spacious tract of country, come in my train, respected Sir.

verses.sanskrit:
ते वृक्षानुदकं भूमिमाश्रमेषूटजांस्तथा
न हिंस्युरिति तेनाहमेक एवागतस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
te vṛkṣānudakaṁ bhūmimāśrameṣūṭajāṁstathā
na hiṁsyuriti tenāhameka evāgatastataḥ

translations.english: That these might not injure trees or water or the grounds of the cottages pertaining to the asylums, have I come hither alone.

verses.sanskrit:
आनीयतामितः सेनेत्याज्ञप्तः परमर्षिणा
तथा तु चक्रे भरतः सेनायाः समुपागमम्
verses.transliteration:
ānīyatāmitaḥ senetyājñaptaḥ paramarṣiṇā
tathā tu cakre bharataḥ senāyāḥ samupāgamam

translations.english: "Bring the forces here,", thus desired by the mighty ascetic, Bharata accordingly caused the troops to be brought in.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निशालां प्रविश्याथ पीत्वापः परिमृज्य च
आतिथ्यस्य क्रियाहेतोर्विश्वकर्माणमाह्वयत्
verses.transliteration:
agniśālāṁ praviśyātha pītvāpaḥ parimṛjya ca
ātithyasya kriyāhetorviśvakarmāṇamāhvayat

translations.english: Then entering the chamber of the sacrificial fire, (Bharadvāja) having sipped water and rubbed his lips therewith, invoked Viśvakarmā for the purpose of entertaining his guest.

verses.sanskrit:
आह्वये विश्वकर्माणमहं त्वष्टारमेव च
आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
āhvaye viśvakarmāṇamahaṁ tvaṣṭārameva ca
ātithyaṁ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṁvidhīyatām

translations.english: I invoke Visvakarmā; even Tvasta himself. I wish to entertain guests. Let him accomplish this for me.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राक्स्रोतसश्च या नद्यः प्रत्यक्स्रोतस एव च
पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च समायान्त्वद्य सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
prāksrotasaśca yā nadyaḥ pratyaksrotasa eva ca
pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca samāyāntvadya sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: Let those rivers that flow westwards, and those that move tortuously on the earth and in the sky, come hither in a body.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्याः स्रवन्तु मैरेयं सुरामन्याः सुनिष्ठिताम्
अपराश्चोदकं शीतमिक्षुकाण्डरसोपमम्
verses.transliteration:
anyāḥ sravantu maireyaṁ surāmanyāḥ suniṣṭhitām
aparāścodakaṁ śītamikṣukāṇḍarasopamam

translations.english: And let others run Maireya, and others refined wine, and others again cool waters resembling the juice of the sugarcane.

verses.sanskrit:
आह्वये देवगन्धर्वान्विश्वावसुहहाहुहून्
तथैवाप्सरसो देवीर्गन्धर्वीश्चापि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
āhvaye devagandharvānviśvāvasuhahāhuhūn
tathaivāpsaraso devīrgandharvīścāpi sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: I invoke the celestials and the Gandharvas and Viśvāvasu and Hahā and Huhu and also the divine Apsaras and Gandharvis all.

verses.sanskrit:
घृताचीमथ विश्वाचीं मिश्रकेशीमलम्बुसाम्
शक्रं याश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणं याश्च भामिनीः
सर्वास्तुम्बुरुणा सार्धमाह्वये सपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtācīmatha viśvācīṁ miśrakeśīmalambusām
śakraṁ yāścopatiṣṭhanti brahmāṇaṁ yāśca bhāminīḥ
sarvāstumburuṇā sārdhamāhvaye saparicchadāḥ

translations.english: And those ladies that attend Sakra, and those that attend Brahmā. I invoke all these females well attired, in company with Tumuru.

verses.sanskrit:
वनं कुरुषु यद्दिव्यं वासो भूषणपत्रवत्
दिव्यनारीफलं शश्वत्तत्कौबेरमिहैव तु
verses.transliteration:
vanaṁ kuruṣu yaddivyaṁ vāso bhūṣaṇapatravat
divyanārīphalaṁ śaśvattatkauberamihaiva tu

translations.english: And let that beautiful forest of Kubera in the north Kuru, having its foliage resembling attires and ornaments, and its fruits debonair damsels, exist even at this very spot.

verses.sanskrit:
विचित्राणि च माल्यानि पादपप्रच्युतानि च
सुरादीनि च पेयानि मांसानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration:
vicitrāṇi ca mālyāni pādapapracyutāni ca
surādīni ca peyāni māṁsāni vividhāni ca

translations.english: And here let the worshipful Soma yield me excellent viands of diverse kinds in plenty; things; that may be eaten or enjoyed, sucked or licked; and variegated blossoms growing in the trees, and wines and (other) drinks, and meats of various kinds.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं समाधिना युक्तस्तेजसाप्रतिमेन च
शिक्षास्वरसमायुक्तं तपसा चाब्रवीन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ samādhinā yuktastejasāpratimena ca
śikṣāsvarasamāyuktaṁ tapasā cābravīnmuniḥ

translations.english: Thus, furnished with unrivalled ascetic energy, did that anchorite observing excellent vows, express himself orthoepically in consonance with Śikṣā.

verses.sanskrit:
मनसा ध्यायतस्तस्य प्राङ्मुखस्य कृताञ्जलेः
आजग्मुस्तानि सर्वाणि दैवतानि पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration:
manasā dhyāyatastasya prāṅmukhasya kṛtāñjaleḥ
ājagmustāni sarvāṇi daivatāni pṛthakpṛthak

translations.english: And as he sat with joined hands facing the west with a rapt mind, there came separately all those deities.

verses.sanskrit:
मलयं दुर्दुरं चैव ततः स्वेदनुदोऽनिलः
उपस्पृश्य ववौ युक्त्या सुप्रियात्मा सुखः शिवः
verses.transliteration:
malayaṁ durduraṁ caiva tataḥ svedanudo'nilaḥ
upaspṛśya vavau yuktyā supriyātmā sukhaḥ śivaḥ

translations.english: And then touching Malaya and Dardura, and laden (with perfumes), a delicious and welcome wind began to blow delightfully, removing sweat.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽभ्यवर्तन्त घना दिव्याः कुसुमवृष्टयः
देवदुन्दुभिघोषश्च दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे
verses.transliteration:
tato'bhyavartanta ghanā divyāḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ
devadundubhighoṣaśca dikṣu sarvāsu śuśruve

translations.english: And the clouds poured down a pleasant shower of blossoms; and from all sides were heard sounds of celestial kettle-drums.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रववुश्चोत्तमा वाता ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः
प्रजगुर्देवगन्धर्वा वीणा प्रमुमुचुः स्वरान्
verses.transliteration:
pravavuścottamā vātā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ
prajagurdevagandharvā vīṇā pramumucuḥ svarān

translations.english: And a rare breeze set in, and the multitudes of Apsaras danced; and the celestials and the Gandharvas sang, and the Vinas let out their notes.

verses.sanskrit:
स शब्दो द्यां च भूमिं च प्राणिनां श्रवणानि च
विवेशोच्चारितः श्लक्ष्णः समो लयगुणान्वितः
verses.transliteration:
sa śabdo dyāṁ ca bhūmiṁ ca prāṇināṁ śravaṇāni ca
viveśoccāritaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ samo layaguṇānvitaḥ

translations.english: And the dulcet sounds high and low furnished with Sama and measure, entered the Earth and the firmament and the ears of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोत्रसुखे नृणाम्
ददर्श भारतं सैन्यं विधानं विश्वकर्मणः
verses.transliteration:
tasminnuparate śabde divye śrotrasukhe nṛṇām
dadarśa bhārataṁ sainyaṁ vidhānaṁ viśvakarmaṇaḥ

translations.english: When that celestial symphony delightful to the ears of men, had thus developed itself, Bharata's forces saw the workmanship of Visvakarman.

verses.sanskrit:
बभूव हि समा भूमिः समन्तात्पञ्चयोजनम्
शाद्वलैर्बहुभिश्छन्ना नीलवैदूर्यसंनिभैः
verses.transliteration:
babhūva hi samā bhūmiḥ samantātpañcayojanam
śādvalairbahubhiśchannā nīlavaidūryasaṁnibhaiḥ

translations.english: That spot widening into a level plain measuring five Yojanas was covered with thick grass resembling blue lapises.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्बिल्वाः कपित्थाश्च पनसा बीजपूरकाः
आमलक्यो बभूवुश्च चूताश्च फलभूषणाः
verses.transliteration:
tasminbilvāḥ kapitthāśca panasā bījapūrakāḥ
āmalakyo babhūvuśca cūtāśca phalabhūṣaṇāḥ

translations.english: And on it stood Bilvas, and Kapitthas, Panasas, citrons, and Amalakas, and mangoes, embellished with fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यश्च वनं दिव्योपभोगवत्
आजगाम नदी दिव्या तीरजैर्बहुभिर्वृता
verses.transliteration:
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyaśca vanaṁ divyopabhogavat
ājagāma nadī divyā tīrajairbahubhirvṛtā

translations.english: From the north Kuru had spread a wood capable of conferring every enjoyment; and a beautiful river coursed through bordered by many a tree.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुजग्मुश्च तं सर्वे मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः
बभूवुश्च मुदा युक्ता तं दृष्ट्वा वेश्म संविधिम्
verses.transliteration:
anujagmuśca taṁ sarve mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ
babhūvuśca mudā yuktā taṁ dṛṣṭvā veśma saṁvidhim

translations.english: Permitted by the Maharsi, Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, entered that mansion abounding in gems. And he was followed by the counsellors and the priests; and the latter beholding the arrangements of the palace, were filled with delight.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र राजासनं दिव्यं व्यजनं छत्रमेव च
भरतो मन्त्रिभिः सार्धमभ्यवर्तत राजवत्
verses.transliteration:
tatra rājāsanaṁ divyaṁ vyajanaṁ chatrameva ca
bharato mantribhiḥ sārdhamabhyavartata rājavat

translations.english: And Bharata in company with the counsellors there went round the august royal seat, the chowri, and the umbrella, worthy of a king. And having bowed down to Rāma, he worshipped that seat.

verses.sanskrit:
आसनं पूजयामास रामायाभिप्रणम्य च
वालव्यजनमादाय न्यषीदत्सचिवासने
verses.transliteration:
āsanaṁ pūjayāmāsa rāmāyābhipraṇamya ca
vālavyajanamādāya nyaṣīdatsacivāsane

translations.english: And then holding the chowri of hair, he sat down on the seat of a minister.

verses.sanskrit:
आनुपूर्व्यान्निषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रपुरोहिताः
ततः सेनापतिः पश्चात्प्रशास्ता च निषेदतुः
verses.transliteration:
ānupūrvyānniṣeduśca sarve mantrapurohitāḥ
tataḥ senāpatiḥ paścātpraśāstā ca niṣedatuḥ

translations.english: Then the counsellors and priests seated themselves according to rank. And thereafter the general and the protector of the encampment (got themselves seated).

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तत्र मुहूर्तेन नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः
उपातिष्ठन्त भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनत्
verses.transliteration:
tatastatra muhūrtena nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ
upātiṣṭhanta bharataṁ bharadvājasya śāsanat

translations.english: Then at Bharadvāja's command, came into being near Bharata streams having Pāyasa for their slime.

verses.sanskrit:
तासामुभयतः कूलं पाण्डुमृत्तिकलेपनाः
रम्याश्चावसथा दिव्या ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रसादजाः
verses.transliteration:
tāsāmubhayataḥ kūlaṁ pāṇḍumṛttikalepanāḥ
ramyāścāvasathā divyā brahmaṇastu prasādajāḥ

translations.english: And at the pleasure of the Brāhmaṇa, on both their banks arose charming dwellings, covered with pale clay.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनैव च मुहूर्तेन दिव्याभरणभूषिताः
आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा ब्रह्मणा प्रहिताः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration:
tenaiva ca muhūrtena divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
āgurviṁśatisāhasrā brahmaṇā prahitāḥ striyaḥ

translations.english: And at that very moment there came twenty thousand women commissioned by Brahma, adorned with divine ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिताः
आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्राः कुबेरप्रहिताः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇamaṇimuktena pravālena ca śobhitāḥ
āgurviṁśatisāhasrāḥ kuberaprahitāḥ striyaḥ

translations.english: And there came also twenty thousand females sent by Kuvera, decked out in gold and gems, pearls and corals. The sight of these was capable of filling men's mind with enchanting ravishment.

verses.sanskrit:
नारदस्तुम्बुरुर्गोपः पर्वतः सूर्यवर्चसः
एते गन्धर्वराजानो भरतस्याग्रतो जगुः
verses.transliteration:
nāradastumbururgopaḥ parvataḥ sūryavarcasaḥ
ete gandharvarājāno bharatasyāgrato jaguḥ

translations.english: And there came from Nandana twenty thousand damsels; and Nārada and Tumburů and Gopa, resembling the sun in splendour. The Gandharba kings began to sing before Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
अलम्बुसा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ वामना
उपानृत्यंस्तु भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration:
alambusā miśrakeśī puṇḍarīkātha vāmanā
upānṛtyaṁstu bharataṁ bharadvājasya śāsanāt

translations.english: And Alambusa, and Misrakesi, and Puņdarīka, and Vāmana danced before Bharata, at the command of Bharadvāja.

verses.sanskrit:
यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने
प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration:
yāni mālyāni deveṣu yāni caitrarathe vane
prayāge tānyadṛśyanta bharadvājasya śāsanāt

translations.english: And those blossoms that are in the celestial regions, and that bloom in the forest of Caitraratha, became visible in Prayāga at the energy of Bharadvāja.

verses.sanskrit:
बिल्वा मार्दङ्गिका आसञ्शम्या ग्राहा बिभीतकाः
अश्वत्था नर्तकाश्चासन्भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा
verses.transliteration:
bilvā mārdaṅgikā āsañśamyā grāhā bibhītakāḥ
aśvatthā nartakāścāsanbharadvājasya tejasā

translations.english: And Vilwas did the office of players of the Mặdanga, and Bibhitakas, that of keepers of Soma, and Asvatthas became dancers, at the energy of Bharadvāja.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सरलतालाश्च तिलका नक्तमालकाः
प्रहृष्टास्तत्र संपेतुः कुब्जाभूताथ वामनाः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saralatālāśca tilakā naktamālakāḥ
prahṛṣṭāstatra saṁpetuḥ kubjābhūtātha vāmanāḥ

translations.english: And Saralas, Tālas, Tilakas, and Tamālas, being delighted, became hump-backed ones and dwarfs.

verses.sanskrit:
शिंशपामलकी जम्बूर्याश्चान्याः कानने लताः
प्रमदा विग्रहं कृत्वा भरद्वाजाश्रमेऽवसन्
verses.transliteration:
śiṁśapāmalakī jambūryāścānyāḥ kānane latāḥ
pramadā vigrahaṁ kṛtvā bharadvājāśrame'vasan

translations.english: And Sinsapās, Āmalakīs, Jambūs and other plants of the forest, wearing the forms of females, stood at the mansion of Bharadvāja.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरां सुरापाः पिबत पायसं च बुभुक्शिताः
मांसनि च सुमेध्यानि भक्ष्यन्तां यावदिच्छथ
