translations.english: O Rāma, this many Brahmanas-this great body of men that have assumed the Vānaprastha mode of life, although having you for their lord, are being sorely troubled by Rákşasas, as if they had none.

verses.sanskrit:
एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्
हतानां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्बहूनां बहुधा वने
verses.transliteration:
ehi paśya śarīrāṇi munīnāṁ bhāvitātmanām
hatānāṁ rākṣasairghorairbahūnāṁ bahudhā vane

translations.english: Come and behold the bodies of innumerable ascetics of pure hearts that have in various ways been slaughtered by Rākşasas in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
पम्पानदीनिवासानामनुमन्दाकिनीमपि
चित्रकूटालयानां च क्रियते कदनं महत्
verses.transliteration:
pampānadīnivāsānāmanumandākinīmapi
citrakūṭālayānāṁ ca kriyate kadanaṁ mahat

translations.english: And great is the worry that is experienced by the dwellers on the river Pampā and the Mandakini as well as those that reside in Citrakūta.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं वयं न मृष्यामो विप्रकारं तपस्विनम्
क्रियमाणं वने घोरं रक्षोभिर्भीमकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vayaṁ na mṛṣyāmo viprakāraṁ tapasvinam
kriyamāṇaṁ vane ghoraṁ rakṣobhirbhīmakarmabhiḥ

translations.english: We cannot bear the terrible affliction of the ascetics in the forest at the hands of Räkşasas of dreadful deeds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वां शरणार्थं च शरण्यं समुपस्थिताः
परिपालय नो राम वध्यमानान्निशाचरैः
verses.transliteration:
tatastvāṁ śaraṇārthaṁ ca śaraṇyaṁ samupasthitāḥ
paripālaya no rāma vadhyamānānniśācaraiḥ

translations.english: Therefore, for obtaining refuge, have we come before you who are the refuge (of all). Do you, O Rāma, deliver us all, who are being exceedingly afflicted by the rangers of the night.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थस्तापसानां तपस्विनाम्
इदं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वानेव तपस्विनः
नैवमर्हथ मां वक्तुमाज्ञाप्योऽहं तपस्विनम्
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā tu kākutsthastāpasānāṁ tapasvinām
idaṁ provāca dharmātmā sarvāneva tapasvinaḥ
naivamarhatha māṁ vaktumājñāpyo'haṁ tapasvinam

translations.english: Hearing these words of the sages and ascetics, that righteous-souled one addressed them.

verses.sanskrit:
भवतामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थमागतोऽहं यदृच्छया
तस्य मेऽयं वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः
तपस्विनां रणे शत्रून्हन्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration:
bhavatāmarthasiddhyarthamāgato'haṁ yadṛcchayā
tasya me'yaṁ vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalaḥ
tapasvināṁ raṇe śatrūnhantumicchāmi rākṣasān

translations.english: I have at my own will come hither for securing your interest. Then shall my stay in the woods be crowned with mighty fruit.

verses.sanskrit:
दत्त्वा वरं चापि तपोधनानां; धर्मे धृतात्मा सहलक्ष्मणेन
तपोधनैश्चापि सहार्य वृत्तः; सुतीष्क्णमेवाभिजगाम वीरः
verses.transliteration:
dattvā varaṁ cāpi tapodhanānāṁ; dharme dhṛtātmā sahalakṣmaṇena
tapodhanaiścāpi sahārya vṛttaḥ; sutīṣkṇamevābhijagāma vīraḥ

translations.english: Having been conferred a boon by the ascetics, that hero entered upon a noble undertaking, and accompanied by the ascetics, in company with Laksmana directed his course to the hermitage of) Sutiksna.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्तु सहितो भ्रात्रा सीतया च परंतपः
सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमपदं जगाम सह तैर्द्विजैः
verses.transliteration:
rāmastu sahito bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṁtapaḥ
sutīkṣṇasyāśramapadaṁ jagāma saha tairdvijaiḥ

translations.english: And Rāma accompanied by his brother as well as Sītā went to the asylum of Sutīksna in company with the twice-born ones.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं नदीस्तीर्त्व बहूदकाः
ददर्श विपुलं शैलं महामेघमिवोन्नतम्
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā dūramadhvānaṁ nadīstīrtva bahūdakāḥ
dadarśa vipulaṁ śailaṁ mahāmeghamivonnatam

translations.english: And having proceeded far, and crossed many a stream of copious waters, Rāma saw a holy peak towering high like the mighty Meru.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तदिक्ष्वाकुवरौ सततं विविधैर्द्रुमैः
काननं तौ विविशतुः सीतया सह राघवौ
verses.transliteration:
tatastadikṣvākuvarau satataṁ vividhairdrumaiḥ
kānanaṁ tau viviśatuḥ sītayā saha rāghavau

translations.english: Then those worthy scions of the Ikşvāku race-descendants of Raghu—with Sītā entered the forest ever furnished with various kinds of trees.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविष्टस्तु वनं घोरं बहुपुष्पफलद्रुमम्
ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते चीरमालापरिष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
praviṣṭastu vanaṁ ghoraṁ bahupuṣpaphaladrumam
dadarśāśramamekānte cīramālāpariṣkṛtam

translations.english: And having entered the dense forest abounding in blossoms and fruits and trees, Rāma saw in a recess an asylum glittering with bark and garlands.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तापसमासीनं मलपङ्कजटाधरम्
रामः सुतीक्ष्णं विधिवत्तपोवृद्धमभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tatra tāpasamāsīnaṁ malapaṅkajaṭādharam
rāmaḥ sutīkṣṇaṁ vidhivattapovṛddhamabhāṣata

translations.english: There Rāma duly addressed an ascetic seated in the lotus-attitude* for warding off evil, even Sutīksna, *The yoya system has many positions for concentrating thought.

verses.sanskrit:
रामोऽहमस्मि भगवन्भवन्तं द्रष्टुमागतः
तन्माभिवद धर्मज्ञ महर्षे सत्यविक्रम
verses.transliteration:
rāmo'hamasmi bhagavanbhavantaṁ draṣṭumāgataḥ
tanmābhivada dharmajña maharṣe satyavikrama

translations.english: O you conversant with righteousness, speak to me, O Maharsi, You that have truth for your prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
स निरीक्ष्य ततो वीरं रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्
समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa nirīkṣya tato vīraṁ rāmaṁ dharmabhṛtāṁ varam
samāśliṣya ca bāhubhyāmidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon eyeing Rāma keenly, that calm (ascetic)-the foremost of those practising righteousness, embracing him with his arms, said,

verses.sanskrit:
स्वागतं खलु ते वीर राम धर्मभृतां वर
आश्रमोऽयं त्वयाक्रान्तः सनाथ इव साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration:
svāgataṁ khalu te vīra rāma dharmabhṛtāṁ vara
āśramo'yaṁ tvayākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāmpratam

translations.english: Welcome, you foremost of the Raghus, O Rāma, you the best of those practising righteousness. This asylum now has been furnished with its master in consequence of your visit.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतीक्षमाणस्त्वामेव नारोहेऽहं महायशः
देवलोकमितो वीर देहं त्यक्त्वा महीतले
verses.transliteration:
pratīkṣamāṇastvāmeva nārohe'haṁ mahāyaśaḥ
devalokamito vīra dehaṁ tyaktvā mahītale

translations.english: O illustrious one, O hero, expecting you, I have not yet ascended heaven, renouncing on earth this body of mine.

verses.sanskrit:
चित्रकूटमुपादाय राज्यभ्रष्टोऽसि मे श्रुतः
इहोपयातः काकुत्स्थो देवराजः शतक्रतुः
सर्वाँल्लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
citrakūṭamupādāya rājyabhraṣṭo'si me śrutaḥ
ihopayātaḥ kākutstho devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
sarvā̐llokāñjitānāha mama puṇyena karmaṇā

translations.english: I had already) heard that, coming to Citrakūta, (you had been staying there), having been deprived of the kingdom. Here came, O Kākutstha, the Sovereign of the celestials of an hundred sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषु देवर्षिजुष्टेषु जितेषु तपसा मया
मत्प्रसादात्सभार्यस्त्वं विहरस्व सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
teṣu devarṣijuṣṭeṣu jiteṣu tapasā mayā
matprasādātsabhāryastvaṁ viharasva salakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Do you, by my grace, in company with your wife and Lakşmaņa, dwell delightfully in those regions won by my asceticism, containing Devarsis.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुग्रतपसं दीप्तं महर्षिं सत्यवादिनम्
प्रत्युवाचात्मवान्रामो ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः
verses.transliteration:
tamugratapasaṁ dīptaṁ maharṣiṁ satyavādinam
pratyuvācātmavānrāmo brahmāṇamiva vāsavaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the self-possessed Rāma answered that blazing and truth-telling Brāhmana of fiery austerities, like Vasava answering Brahma.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेवाहरिष्यामि स्वयं लोकान्महामुने
आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने
verses.transliteration:
ahamevāhariṣyāmi svayaṁ lokānmahāmune
āvāsaṁ tvahamicchāmi pradiṣṭamiha kānane

translations.english: O mighty ascetic, I myself will win those regions. I wish to be directed to a dwelling in this forest.

verses.sanskrit:
भवान्सर्वत्र कुशलः सर्वभूतहिते रतः
आख्यातः शरभङ्गेन गौतमेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
bhavānsarvatra kuśalaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
ākhyātaḥ śarabhaṅgena gautamena mahātmanā

translations.english: You are possessed of ability in respect of everything, and are (at the same time) engaged in the welfare of all beings, this has been told to me by the high-soulcd Sarabhanga of the Gautama race.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः
अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं हर्षेण महताप्लुतः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa maharṣirlokaviśrutaḥ
abravīnmadhuraṁ vākyaṁ harṣeṇa mahatāplutaḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma, that Maharşi known over all the worlds, Spoke sweet words in great joy,

verses.sanskrit:
अयमेवाश्रमो राम गुणवान्रम्यतामिह
ऋषिसंघानुचरितः सदा मूलफलैर्युतः
verses.transliteration:
ayamevāśramo rāma guṇavānramyatāmiha
ṛṣisaṁghānucaritaḥ sadā mūlaphalairyutaḥ

translations.english: O meritorious Rāma, even this is the asylum (for you). Do you live here pleasantly. It is inhabited by numbers of saints and is always provided with fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
इममाश्रममागम्य मृगसंघा महायशाः
अटित्वा प्रतिगच्छन्ति लोभयित्वाकुतोभयाः
verses.transliteration:
imamāśramamāgamya mṛgasaṁghā mahāyaśāḥ
aṭitvā pratigacchanti lobhayitvākutobhayāḥ

translations.english: This forest is haunted by herds of deer that range here without doing harm to any one, although they possess great energy; and go away, having bewitched people (by their beauty).

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य महर्षेर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
उवाच वचनं धीरो विकृष्य सशरं धनुः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasya maharṣerlakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
uvāca vacanaṁ dhīro vikṛṣya saśaraṁ dhanuḥ

translations.english: Save what comes, from these deer, there is no other evil to be encountered here. Hearing those words of the Maharși, the placid elder brother of Lakşınaņa, taking up his bow with the arrow set, said

verses.sanskrit:
तानहं सुमहाभाग मृगसंघान्समागतान्
हन्यां निशितधारेण शरेणाशनिवर्चसा
verses.transliteration:
tānahaṁ sumahābhāga mṛgasaṁghānsamāgatān
hanyāṁ niśitadhāreṇa śareṇāśanivarcasā

translations.english: O exalted one, if by means of sharpened shafts blazing like lightning, I slay those herds of deer when they come, it shall impart pain to you, and what can be more unfortunate than this?

verses.sanskrit:
तमेवमुक्त्वा वरदं रामः संध्यामुपागमत्
अन्वास्य पश्चिमां संध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration:
tamevamuktvā varadaṁ rāmaḥ saṁdhyāmupāgamat
anvāsya paścimāṁ saṁdhyāṁ tatra vāsamakalpayat

translations.english: Therefore I shall not be able to dwell long in this asylum. Having said this, Rāma ceased and became engaged in his evening adorations, and, having finished them, along with Sīta and Lakşmaņa fixed his quarters in the asylum of Sutiksna.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शुभं तापसभोज्यमन्नं; स्वयं सुतीक्ष्णः पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम्
ताभ्यां सुसत्कृत्य ददौ महात्मा; संध्यानिवृत्तौ रजनीं समीक्ष्य
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śubhaṁ tāpasabhojyamannaṁ; svayaṁ sutīkṣṇaḥ puruṣarṣabhābhyām
tābhyāṁ susatkṛtya dadau mahātmā; saṁdhyānivṛttau rajanīṁ samīkṣya

translations.english: Then, when the evening had passed away and night fell, Sutiksna, having done homage to those chiefs of men, offered them excellent fare, suitable to ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्तु सहसौमित्रिः सुतीक्ष्णेनाभिपूजितः
परिणम्य निशां तत्र प्रभाते प्रत्यबुध्यत
verses.transliteration:
rāmastu sahasaumitriḥ sutīkṣṇenābhipūjitaḥ
pariṇamya niśāṁ tatra prabhāte pratyabudhyata

translations.english: Having been well entertained by Sutīksna, Rāma in company with Sumitrā's son, having passed away the night there, awoke in the morning.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तेऽग्निं सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ
काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने
verses.transliteration:
atha te'gniṁ surāṁścaiva vaidehī rāmalakṣmaṇau
kālyaṁ vidhivadabhyarcya tapasviśaraṇe vane

translations.english: And arising in due time, Rāma along with Sītā, bathed in cool waters odorous with the aroma of lotuses; and having in proper time duly worshipped Fire as well as the deities, in that forest containing abodes of ascetics, Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Videha's daughter, their sins purged off, seeing the sun risen, approached Sutīksna and spoke to him these mild words.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखोषिताः स्म भगवंस्त्वया पूज्येन पूजिताः
आपृच्छामः प्रयास्यामो मुनयस्त्वरयन्ति नः
verses.transliteration:
sukhoṣitāḥ sma bhagavaṁstvayā pūjyena pūjitāḥ
āpṛcchāmaḥ prayāsyāmo munayastvarayanti naḥ

translations.english: O Reverend sir, we we have stayed here pleasantly, being excellently ministered to by you. We greet you, and go away. The ascetics urge speed upon us.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वरामहे वयं द्रष्टुं कृत्स्नमाश्रममण्डलम्
ऋषीणां पुण्यशीलानां दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
tvarāmahe vayaṁ draṣṭuṁ kṛtsnamāśramamaṇḍalam
ṛṣīṇāṁ puṇyaśīlānāṁ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinām

translations.english: We hasten to view the collections of asylums that belong to the holy sages inhabiting the forest of Dandaka.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामः सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः
धर्मनित्यैस्तपोदान्तैर्विशिखैरिव पावकैः
verses.transliteration:
abhyanujñātumicchāmaḥ sahaibhirmunipuṅgavaiḥ
dharmanityaistapodāntairviśikhairiva pāvakaiḥ

translations.english: Now we crave your permission along with that of these foremost of anchorites, steady in virtue, crowned with asceticism and selfcontrolled, resembling smokeless flames.

verses.sanskrit:
अविषह्यातपो यावत्सूर्यो नातिविराजिते
अमार्गेणागतां लक्ष्मीं प्राप्येवान्वयवर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
aviṣahyātapo yāvatsūryo nātivirājite
amārgeṇāgatāṁ lakṣmīṁ prāpyevānvayavarjitaḥ

translations.english: And we intend to set out ere the sun like to a low-sprung one that has attained to auspicious fortune through evil ways, with rays incapable of being borne, shines too fiercely.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ संस्पृशन्तौ चरणावुत्थाप्य मुनिपुंगवः
गाढमालिङ्ग्य सस्नेहमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tau saṁspṛśantau caraṇāvutthāpya munipuṁgavaḥ
gāḍhamāliṅgya sasnehamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Having said this, Rāghava along with Sītā and Sumitrā's son bowed down to the ascetic's feet.

verses.sanskrit:
अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं राम सौमित्रिणा सह
सीतया चानया सार्धं छाययेवानुवृत्तया
verses.transliteration:
ariṣṭaṁ gaccha panthānaṁ rāma saumitriṇā saha
sītayā cānayā sārdhaṁ chāyayevānuvṛttayā

translations.english: And as they touched his feet, that best of ascetics, raising Rāma and Lakşmaņa up, embraced them closely and said, O Rāma, go your way safely, in company with Sumitrā's son and this Sītā that follows you like a shadow.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्याश्रमपदं रम्यं दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्
एषां तपस्विनां वीर तपसा भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
paśyāśramapadaṁ ramyaṁ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinām
eṣāṁ tapasvināṁ vīra tapasā bhāvitātmanām

translations.english: Behold the beauteous asylums, O hero. of these pure-spirited ascetics inhabiting the forest of Dandaka.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च
रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च
verses.transliteration:
drakṣyase dṛṣṭiramyāṇi giriprasravaṇāni ca
ramaṇīyānyaraṇyāni mayūrābhirutāni ca

translations.english: You will see blossoming woods garnished with fruits and roots, containing goodly deer, and mild feathered tribes; tanks and pools laughing with blown lotuses, containing pleasant waters, and abounding in Kārandavas; charming mountain-springs; and romantic forests picturesque with peacocks.

verses.sanskrit:
गम्यतां वत्स सौमित्रे भवानपि च गच्छतु
आगन्तव्यं च ते दृष्ट्वा पुनरेवाश्रमं मम
verses.transliteration:
gamyatāṁ vatsa saumitre bhavānapi ca gacchatu
āgantavyaṁ ca te dṛṣṭvā punarevāśramaṁ mama

translations.english: Go, O child; and go you also, O Sumitra's son. And come again to my asylum after having seen these.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः
प्रदक्षिणं मुनिं कृता प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastathetyuktvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
pradakṣiṇaṁ muniṁ kṛtā prasthātumupacakrame

translations.english: Thus addressed, Kākutstha along with Laks maņa, having gone round the ascetic, prepared for departing.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शुभतरे तूणी धनुषी चायतेक्षणा
ददौ सीता तयोर्भ्रात्रोः खड्गौ च विमलौ ततः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śubhatare tūṇī dhanuṣī cāyatekṣaṇā
dadau sītā tayorbhrātroḥ khaḍgau ca vimalau tataḥ

translations.english: Then Sīlā of expansive eyes handed to the brothers excellent quivers bows and shining swords.

verses.sanskrit:
आबध्य च शुभे तूणी चापे चादाय सस्वने
निष्क्रान्तावाश्रमाद्गन्तुमुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.transliteration:
ābadhya ca śubhe tūṇī cāpe cādāya sasvane
niṣkrāntāvāśramādgantumubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau

translations.english: Then fastening the graceful quivers, and taking the sweet-sounding bows, both Rāma and Lakşmaņa issued from the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit:
सुतीक्ष्णेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं प्रस्थितं रघुनन्दनम्
वैदेही स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sutīkṣṇenābhyanujñātaṁ prasthitaṁ raghunandanam
vaidehī snigdhayā vācā bhartāramidamabravīt

translations.english: When the son of Raghu had set out with Sutiksna's permission, SItā addressed him in affectionate words and convincing speech.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं धर्मः सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान्
निवृत्तेन च शक्योऽयं व्यसनात्कामजादिह
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ dharmaḥ susūkṣmeṇa vidhinā prāpyate mahān
nivṛttena ca śakyo'yaṁ vyasanātkāmajādiha

translations.english: Although you are great and follow the narrow way (of righteousness), yet you are on the eve of entering into unrighteousness. But you could by refraining from action, eschew this unrighteousness that springs from an evil begot of desire.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीण्येव व्यसनान्यत्र कामजानि भवन्त्युत
मिथ्या वाक्यं परमकं तस्माद्गुरुतरावुभौ
परदाराभिगमनं विना वैरं च रौद्रता
verses.transliteration:
trīṇyeva vyasanānyatra kāmajāni bhavantyuta
mithyā vākyaṁ paramakaṁ tasmādgurutarāvubhau
paradārābhigamanaṁ vinā vairaṁ ca raudratā

translations.english: This evil begot of desire is threefold. One prominent evil is falsehood, and both the others' are of weightier significance, association with others; wives, and vindictiveness without any (basis of) hostility. Falsehood, O Rāghava, has never been yours nor can it ever be yours (in the future).

verses.sanskrit:
तच्च सर्वं महाबाहो शक्यं वोढुं जितेन्द्रियैः
तव वश्येन्द्रियत्वं च जानामि शुभदर्शन
verses.transliteration:
tacca sarvaṁ mahābāho śakyaṁ voḍhuṁ jitendriyaiḥ
tava vaśyendriyatvaṁ ca jānāmi śubhadarśana

translations.english: O you of a gracious presence, yours is control over sense. The third evil that leads men through ignorance to bear hostility towards others without any (cause of) hostility, is now present (to you).

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिज्ञातस्त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्
ऋषीणां रक्षणार्थाय वधः संयति रक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration:
pratijñātastvayā vīra daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinām
ṛṣīṇāṁ rakṣaṇārthāya vadhaḥ saṁyati rakṣasām

translations.english: You have, O hero, for the protection of the saints dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, Promised the slaughter of Rākṣasas in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
एतन्निमित्तं च वनं दण्डका इति विश्रुतम्
प्रस्थितस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा धृतबाणशरासनः
verses.transliteration:
etannimittaṁ ca vanaṁ daṇḍakā iti viśrutam
prasthitastvaṁ saha bhrātrā dhṛtabāṇaśarāsanaḥ

translations.english: And it is for this reason that equipped with bows and arrows, you have along with your brother set out for the forest known as Dandaka.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वां प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्ताकुलं मनः
त्वद्वृत्तं चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेन्निःश्रेयसं हितम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastvāṁ prasthitaṁ dṛṣṭvā mama cintākulaṁ manaḥ
tvadvṛttaṁ cintayantyā vai bhavenniḥśreyasaṁ hitam

translations.english: Seeing you set out, my mind reflecting on your truthfulness as well as your happiness in this world and welfare in the next, is wrought up with anxiety.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मे रोचते वीर गमनं दण्डकान्प्रति
कारणं तत्र वक्ष्यामि वदन्त्याः श्रूयतां मम
verses.transliteration:
na hi me rocate vīra gamanaṁ daṇḍakānprati
kāraṇaṁ tatra vakṣyāmi vadantyāḥ śrūyatāṁ mama

translations.english: O hero, I do not relish this journey to Dandaka. Thereof I will tell you the reason. Do you listen to me as I tell you.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं हि बाणधनुष्पाणिर्भ्रात्रा सह वनं गतः
दृष्ट्वा वनचरान्सर्वान्कच्चित्कुर्याः शरव्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ hi bāṇadhanuṣpāṇirbhrātrā saha vanaṁ gataḥ
dṛṣṭvā vanacarānsarvānkaccitkuryāḥ śaravyayam

translations.english: Bearing bows and arrows in your hands, you have come to the wood along with your brother; and it may well happen) that seeing grim rangers of the forest, you may discharge your shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षत्रियाणामिह धनुर्हुताशस्येन्धनानि च
समीपतः स्थितं तेजोबलमुच्छ्रयते भृशम्
verses.transliteration:
kṣatriyāṇāmiha dhanurhutāśasyendhanāni ca
samīpataḥ sthitaṁ tejobalamucchrayate bhṛśam

translations.english: Even as the vicinity of faggots increases the energy of fire, the proximity of (the bow) enhances the strength and energy of the Ksatriya.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्वी सत्यवाक्शुचिः
कस्मिंश्चिदभवत्पुण्ये वने रतमृगद्विजे
verses.transliteration:
purā kila mahābāho tapasvī satyavākśuciḥ
kasmiṁścidabhavatpuṇye vane ratamṛgadvije

translations.english: Formerly, O long-armed one, in a sacred wood haunted by beasts and birds, there lived a truthful ascetic of a pure person.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यैव तपसो विघ्नं कर्तुमिन्द्रः शचीपतिः
खड्गपाणिरथागच्छदाश्रमं भट रूपधृक्
verses.transliteration:
tasyaiva tapaso vighnaṁ kartumindraḥ śacīpatiḥ
khaḍgapāṇirathāgacchadāśramaṁ bhaṭa rūpadhṛk

translations.english: Intending to disturb his austerities, Saci's lord, Indra, bearing a sword in his hand, came to the asylum in the guise of a warrior.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तदाश्रमपदे निहितः खड्ग उत्तमः
स न्यासविधिना दत्तः पुण्ये तपसि तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstadāśramapade nihitaḥ khaḍga uttamaḥ
sa nyāsavidhinā dattaḥ puṇye tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ

translations.english: And in that asylum, that excellent scimitar was deposited as a trust with that righteous person practising asceticisin.

verses.sanskrit:
स तच्छस्त्रमनुप्राप्य न्यासरक्षणतत्परः
वने तु विचरत्येव रक्षन्प्रत्ययमात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
sa tacchastramanuprāpya nyāsarakṣaṇatatparaḥ
vane tu vicaratyeva rakṣanpratyayamātmanaḥ

translations.english: Receiving that weapon, that ascetic intent upon preserving his trust, range the forest, maintaining his faith.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र गच्छत्युपादातुं मूलानि च फलानि च
न विना याति तं खड्गं न्यासरक्षणतत्परः
verses.transliteration:
yatra gacchatyupādātuṁ mūlāni ca phalāni ca
na vinā yāti taṁ khaḍgaṁ nyāsarakṣaṇatatparaḥ

translations.english: And intent upon preserving his trust, he goes nowhere for procuring fruits and roots without that sword deposited with him as a trust.

verses.sanskrit:
नित्यं शस्त्रं परिवहन्क्रमेण स तपोधनः
चकार रौद्रीं स्वां बुद्धिं त्यक्त्वा तपसि निश्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
nityaṁ śastraṁ parivahankrameṇa sa tapodhanaḥ
cakāra raudrīṁ svāṁ buddhiṁ tyaktvā tapasi niścayam

translations.english: Constantly carrying the sword, by degrees, the ascetic, foregoing all thoughts about asceticism, had his mind involved in fierce sentiments.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स रौद्राभिरतः प्रमत्तोऽधर्मकर्षितः
तस्य शस्त्रस्य संवासाज्जगाम नरकं मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa raudrābhirataḥ pramatto'dharmakarṣitaḥ
tasya śastrasya saṁvāsājjagāma narakaṁ muniḥ

translations.english: Thus in consequence of bearing that weapon, that ascetic taken up with fierce thoughts, losing his sobriety and led astray from righteousness, went to hell.

verses.sanskrit:
स्नेहाच्च बहुमानाच्च स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये
न कथंचन सा कार्या हृहीतधनुषा त्वया
verses.transliteration:
snehācca bahumānācca smāraye tvāṁ na śikṣaye
na kathaṁcana sā kāryā hṛhītadhanuṣā tvayā

translations.english: From affection and the high honour in which I hold you, I merely remind you of this matter. I do not teach you. Equipped with bows as you are, you should renounce all thoughts of slaying without hostility the Rākṣasas residing in Dandaka. Without offence none should be slain.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षत्रियाणां तु वीराणां वनेषु नियतात्मनाम्
धनुषा कार्यमेतावदार्तानामभिरक्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
kṣatriyāṇāṁ tu vīrāṇāṁ vaneṣu niyatātmanām
dhanuṣā kāryametāvadārtānāmabhirakṣaṇam

translations.english: It is the duty of Kșatriya heroes by means of their bows to protect persons of subdued souls, come by any calamity.

verses.sanskrit:
क्व च शस्त्रं क्व च वनं क्व च क्षात्रं तपः क्व च
व्याविद्धमिदमस्माभिर्देशधर्मस्तु पूज्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
kva ca śastraṁ kva ca vanaṁ kva ca kṣātraṁ tapaḥ kva ca
vyāviddhamidamasmābhirdeśadharmastu pūjyatām

translations.english: Where are arms? And where is the forest? Where is Kaştriya virtue? And where is asceticism? These are opposed to each other, let us, therefore, honour the morality that pertains to this place.

verses.sanskrit:
तदार्यकलुषा बुद्धिर्जायते शस्त्रसेवनात्
पुनर्गत्वा त्वयोध्यायां क्षत्रधर्मं चरिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
tadāryakaluṣā buddhirjāyate śastrasevanāt
punargatvā tvayodhyāyāṁ kṣatradharmaṁ cariṣyasi

translations.english: From following arms, one's sense gets befouled and deformed. Again going to Ayodhyā, You will observe the duties of Kastriyas.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षया तु भवेत्प्रीतिः श्वश्रू श्वशुरयोर्मम
यदि राज्यं हि संन्यस्य भवेस्त्वं निरतो मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
akṣayā tu bhavetprītiḥ śvaśrū śvaśurayormama
yadi rājyaṁ hi saṁnyasya bhavestvaṁ nirato muniḥ

translations.english: Then my mother-in-law and father-in-law shall experience enduring delight, if having renounced the kingdom, you lead the life of an ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मादर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात्प्रभवते सुखम्
धर्मेण लभते सर्वं धर्मसारमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration:
dharmādarthaḥ prabhavati dharmātprabhavate sukham
dharmeṇa labhate sarvaṁ dharmasāramidaṁ jagat

translations.english: Interest springs from righteousness; and happiness also results therefrom. One attains everything through righteousness, in this world the only substantial thing.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मानं नियमैस्तैस्तैः कर्षयित्वा प्रयत्नतः
प्राप्यते निपुणैर्धर्मो न सुखाल्लभ्यते सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
ātmānaṁ niyamaistaistaiḥ karṣayitvā prayatnataḥ
prāpyate nipuṇairdharmo na sukhāllabhyate sukham

translations.english: Repressing self by diverse restrictions, intelligent people attain righteousness; but virtue crowned with felicity, is incapable of being attained by following pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
नित्यं शुचिमतिः सौम्य चर धर्मं तपोवने
सर्वं हि विदितं तुभ्यं त्रैलोक्यमपि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
nityaṁ śucimatiḥ saumya cara dharmaṁ tapovane
sarvaṁ hi viditaṁ tubhyaṁ trailokyamapi tattvataḥ

translations.english: O mild one! ever cherishing your heart in purity, do you practise piety in the wood of asceticism Everything the three worlds are truly known to you.

verses.sanskrit:
स्त्रीचापलादेतदुदाहृतं मे; धर्मं च वक्तुं तव कः समर्थः
विचार्य बुद्ध्या तु सहानुजेन; यद्रोचते तत्कुरु माचिरेण
verses.transliteration:
strīcāpalādetadudāhṛtaṁ me; dharmaṁ ca vaktuṁ tava kaḥ samarthaḥ
vicārya buddhyā tu sahānujena; yadrocate tatkuru mācireṇa

translations.english: I have spoken this through feminine fickleness. Who can speak of righteousness to you? Reflecting on and understanding things, do you along with your younger brother speedily do what you like.

verses.sanskrit:
वाक्यमेतत्तु वैदेह्या व्याहृतं भर्तृभक्तया
श्रुत्वा धर्मे स्थितो रामः प्रत्युवाचाथ मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
vākyametattu vaidehyā vyāhṛtaṁ bhartṛbhaktayā
śrutvā dharme sthito rāmaḥ pratyuvācātha maithilīm

translations.english: Hearing Vaidehi's words spoken through high regard (for her husband), Rāma with his energy enhanced, answered Janaka's daughter.

verses.sanskrit:
हितमुक्तं त्वया देवि स्निग्धया सदृशं वचः
कुलं व्यपदिशन्त्या च धर्मज्ञे जनकात्मजे
verses.transliteration:
hitamuktaṁ tvayā devi snigdhayā sadṛśaṁ vacaḥ
kulaṁ vyapadiśantyā ca dharmajñe janakātmaje

translations.english: O noble lady, you have spoken wild words fraught with worth and profit; and, O Janaka's daughter versed in virtue, you have expounded the duties of Kșatriyas.

verses.sanskrit:
किं तु वक्ष्याम्यहं देवि त्वयैवोक्तमिदं वचः
क्षत्रियैर्धार्यते चापो नार्तशब्दो भवेदिति
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tu vakṣyāmyahaṁ devi tvayaivoktamidaṁ vacaḥ
kṣatriyairdhāryate cāpo nārtaśabdo bhavediti

translations.english: What, O exalted one, shall I say? You have yourself by your words (furnished an answer to what you had said). Kşatriyas wear bows in order that the word 'distressed' may not exist (on earth).

verses.sanskrit:
ते चार्ता दण्डकारण्ये मुनयः संशितव्रताः
मां सीते स्वयमागम्य शरण्याः शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration:
te cārtā daṇḍakāraṇye munayaḥ saṁśitavratāḥ
māṁ sīte svayamāgamya śaraṇyāḥ śaraṇaṁ gatāḥ

translations.english: O Sītā, those ascetics of severe vows that are beset with perils in Dandaka, having personally come to me, who am their refuge, have sought protection at my hands.

verses.sanskrit:
ते भक्ष्यमाणा मुनयो दण्डकारण्यवासिनः
अस्मानभ्यवपद्येति मामूचुर्द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
te bhakṣyamāṇā munayo daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ
asmānabhyavapadyeti māmūcurdvijasattamāḥ

translations.english: Always dwelling in the forest, subsisting on fruits and roots, they on account of Rākṣasas of cruel deeds do not, O timid attain ease. These ascetics are devoured by terrible Rākṣasas living on human flesh. Being eaten up (by the Rākşasas), the anchorites living in the forest of Dandaka, those best of the twice-born ones, said to us-Be you gracious to us.'

verses.sanskrit:
मया तु वचनं श्रुत्वा तेषामेवं मुखाच्च्युतम्
कृत्वा चरणशुश्रूषां वाक्यमेतदुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
mayā tu vacanaṁ śrutvā teṣāmevaṁ mukhāccyutam
kṛtvā caraṇaśuśrūṣāṁ vākyametadudāhṛtam

translations.english: Hearing those words of theirs which fell from their lips, I, resolving to act in accordance with their request, said.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे ह्रीरेषा हि ममातुला
यदीदृशैरहं विप्रैरुपस्थेयैरुपस्थितः
किं करोमीति च मया व्याहृतं द्विजसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
prasīdantu bhavanto me hrīreṣā hi mamātulā
yadīdṛśairahaṁ viprairupastheyairupasthitaḥ
kiṁ karomīti ca mayā vyāhṛtaṁ dvijasaṁnidhau

translations.english: 'Be you propitious.' This is surpassing shame to me that such Vipras who themselves are worthy of being sought, seek me. What shall I do? I said this in the presence of those twiceborn ones.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वैरेव समागम्य वागियं समुदाहृता
राक्षसैर्दण्डकारण्ये बहुभिः कामरूपिभिः
अर्दिताः स्म भृशं राम भवान्नस्त्रातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
sarvaireva samāgamya vāgiyaṁ samudāhṛtā
rākṣasairdaṇḍakāraṇye bahubhiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ
arditāḥ sma bhṛśaṁ rāma bhavānnastrātumarhati

translations.english: Thereat all those that had come, said, We have been, O Rāma, immensely harassed in the forest of Dandaka by Räkşasas wearing shapes at will. Do you deliver us.

verses.sanskrit:
होमकाले तु संप्राप्ते पर्वकालेषु चानघ
धर्षयन्ति स्म दुर्धर्षा राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः
verses.transliteration:
homakāle tu saṁprāpte parvakāleṣu cānagha
dharṣayanti sma durdharṣā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ

translations.english: O sinless one! These irrepressible Rākṣasas living on human flesh vanquish us at the time of Homa, and on the occasions of Parvas.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसैर्धर्षितानां च तापसानां तपस्विनाम्
गतिं मृगयमाणानां भवान्नः परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasairdharṣitānāṁ ca tāpasānāṁ tapasvinām
gatiṁ mṛgayamāṇānāṁ bhavānnaḥ paramā gatiḥ

translations.english: Of the saints and ascetics afflicted by the Rākşasas, who are on the search for their refuge, you are our best refuge. sore

verses.sanskrit:
कामं तपः प्रभावेन शक्ता हन्तुं निशाचरान्
चिरार्जितं तु नेच्छामस्तपः खण्डयितुं वयम्
verses.transliteration:
kāmaṁ tapaḥ prabhāvena śaktā hantuṁ niśācarān
cirārjitaṁ tu necchāmastapaḥ khaṇḍayituṁ vayam

translations.english: We can by virtue of the energy of our asceticism easily destroy the rangers of the night; but we are loath to lose our asceticism earned in a long time. O Rāghava our austerities are constantly disturbed, and we can hardly perform thein.

verses.sanskrit:
तदर्द्यमानान्रक्षोभिर्दण्डकारण्यवासिभिः
रक्षनस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा त्वन्नाथा हि वयं वने
verses.transliteration:
tadardyamānānrakṣobhirdaṇḍakāraṇyavāsibhiḥ
rakṣanastvaṁ saha bhrātrā tvannāthā hi vayaṁ vane

translations.english: Therefore, although afflicted and devoured by the Rākşasas dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, we do not cast our curse on them. You along with your brother are our protector: you are our master in this forest.

verses.sanskrit:
मया चैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा कार्त्स्न्येन परिपालनम्
ऋषीणां दण्डकारण्ये संश्रुतं जनकात्मजे
verses.transliteration:
mayā caitadvacaḥ śrutvā kārtsnyena paripālanam
ṛṣīṇāṁ daṇḍakāraṇye saṁśrutaṁ janakātmaje

translations.english: Having heard these words, I promised my perfect protection to the saints in the forest of Dandaka, O daughter of Janaka.

verses.sanskrit:
संश्रुत्य च न शक्ष्यामि जीवमानः प्रतिश्रवम्
मुनीनामन्यथा कर्तुं सत्यमिष्टं हि मे सदा
verses.transliteration:
saṁśrutya ca na śakṣyāmi jīvamānaḥ pratiśravam
munīnāmanyathā kartuṁ satyamiṣṭaṁ hi me sadā

translations.english: Having promised, I living cannot violate my vow concerning the ascetics; verily truth is ever dear to me.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां त्वां वा सीते सलक्ष्मणाम्
न तु प्रतिज्ञां संश्रुत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
apyahaṁ jīvitaṁ jahyāṁ tvāṁ vā sīte salakṣmaṇām
na tu pratijñāṁ saṁśrutya brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: I had rather renounce my life, or you, O Sītā, along with Lakşmaņa-but by no means my promise made, especially to Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit:
तदवश्यं मया कार्यमृषीणां परिपालनम्
अनुक्तेनापि वैदेहि प्रतिज्ञाय तु किं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
tadavaśyaṁ mayā kāryamṛṣīṇāṁ paripālanam
anuktenāpi vaidehi pratijñāya tu kiṁ punaḥ

translations.english: O Videha's daughter, the protection of the saints is incumbent on me even without any representation, and what (shall I say) when I have promised the same?

verses.sanskrit:
मम स्नेहाच्च सौहार्दादिदमुक्तं त्वया वचः
परितुष्टोऽस्म्यहं सीते न ह्यनिष्टोऽनुशिष्यते
सदृशं चानुरूपं च कुलस्य तव शोभने
verses.transliteration:
mama snehācca sauhārdādidamuktaṁ tvayā vacaḥ
parituṣṭo'smyahaṁ sīte na hyaniṣṭo'nuśiṣyate
sadṛśaṁ cānurūpaṁ ca kulasya tava śobhane

translations.english: You have spoken this to me through affection and friendship. I have been well pleased with you, O Sītā. One did not instruct another that one did not bear affection to.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा; सीतां प्रियां मैथिल राजपुत्रीम्
रामो धनुष्मान्सहलक्ष्मणेन; जगाम रम्याणि तपोवनानि
verses.transliteration:
ityevamuktvā vacanaṁ mahātmā; sītāṁ priyāṁ maithila rājaputrīm
rāmo dhanuṣmānsahalakṣmaṇena; jagāma ramyāṇi tapovanāni

translations.english: Having said these words to Mithila's princess, the, beloved Sītā, the high-souled Răma, equipped with bows, along with Laksmana, directed his steps towards the inviting woods of asceticism.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्रतः प्रययौ रामः सीता मध्ये सुमध्यमा
पृष्ठतस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्लक्ष्मणोऽनुजगाम ह
verses.transliteration:
agrataḥ prayayau rāmaḥ sītā madhye sumadhyamā
pṛṣṭhatastu dhanuṣpāṇirlakṣmaṇo'nujagāma ha

translations.english: Rāma went first; in the middle, Sītā; and bearing a bow in his hand, Laksmana went in their wake.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं लम्बमाने दिवाकरे
ददृशुः सहिता रम्यं तटाकं योजनायतम्
verses.transliteration:
te gatvā dūramadhvānaṁ lambamāne divākare
dadṛśuḥ sahitā ramyaṁ taṭākaṁ yojanāyatam

translations.english: Having proceeded a long way, when the sun was aslant, they together saw a delightful tank measuring a Yojana, filled with red and pale Swans lotuses, graced with herds of elephants, and abounding in aquatic cranes, and Kadambas.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसन्नसलिले रम्यतस्मिन्सरसि शुश्रुवे
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते
verses.transliteration:
prasannasalile ramyatasminsarasi śuśruve
gītavāditranirghoṣo na tu kaścana dṛśyate

translations.english: And in that tank containing charming and pleasant waters, they heard sounds of song and instrumental music; but no one was seen there.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कौतूहलाद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथः
मुनिं धर्मभृतं नाम प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kautūhalādrāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahārathaḥ
muniṁ dharmabhṛtaṁ nāma praṣṭuṁ samupacakrame

translations.english: There at, from curiosity, Rāma and Lakşmana, mighty car warrior, asked an ascetic named Dharmabhrt.

verses.sanskrit:
इदमत्यद्भुतं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां नो महामुने
कौतूहलं महज्जातं किमिदं साधु कथ्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
idamatyadbhutaṁ śrutvā sarveṣāṁ no mahāmune
kautūhalaṁ mahajjātaṁ kimidaṁ sādhu kathyatām

translations.english: Hearing this mighty wonder, we have been worked up with intense curiosity. Do you tell us what this is.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनैवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राघवेण मुनिस्तदा
प्रभावं सरसः कृत्स्नमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tenaivamukto dharmātmā rāghaveṇa munistadā
prabhāvaṁ sarasaḥ kṛtsnamākhyātumupacakrame

translations.english: Thus accosted by Rāghava, the ascetic then at once began to expatiate over the potency of the pool.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं पञ्चाप्सरो नाम तटाकं सार्वकालिकम्
निर्मितं तपसा राम मुनिना माण्डकर्णिना
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ pañcāpsaro nāma taṭākaṁ sārvakālikam
nirmitaṁ tapasā rāma muninā māṇḍakarṇinā

translations.english: This tank goes by the name of Pancāpsara, and is always filled with water. It was made, O Rāma, by the ascetic Măndakarni, by virtue of his asceticism.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि तेपे तपस्तीव्रं माण्डकर्णिर्महामुनिः
दशवर्षसहस्राणि वायुभक्षो जलाश्रय
verses.transliteration:
sa hi tepe tapastīvraṁ māṇḍakarṇirmahāmuniḥ
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi vāyubhakṣo jalāśraya

translations.english: In yonder tank, the mighty ascetic, living on air, performed signal austerities for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रव्यथिताः सर्वे देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः
अब्रुवन्वचनं सर्वे परस्पर समागताः
अस्मकं कस्यचित्स्थानमेष प्रार्थयते मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pravyathitāḥ sarve devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ
abruvanvacanaṁ sarve paraspara samāgatāḥ
asmakaṁ kasyacitsthānameṣa prārthayate muniḥ

translations.english: Thereat, exceedingly agitated, all the deities with Agni at their head assembled together, said, This ascetic wishes to have the position of one of us.' Thus all the deities present there were filled with anxiety.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कर्तुं तपोविघ्नं सर्वैर्देवैर्नियोजिताः
प्रधानाप्सरसः पञ्चविद्युच्चलितवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kartuṁ tapovighnaṁ sarvairdevairniyojitāḥ
pradhānāpsarasaḥ pañcavidyuccalitavarcasaḥ

translations.english: Then with the view of disturbing his austerities, the deities ordered five principal Apsarās, possessed of the splendour of live lighting.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्सरोभिस्ततस्ताभिर्मुनिर्दृष्टपरावरः
नीतो मदनवश्यत्वं सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration:
apsarobhistatastābhirmunirdṛṣṭaparāvaraḥ
nīto madanavaśyatvaṁ surāṇāṁ kāryasiddhaye

translations.english: And for compassing the end of the celestials, that ascetic conversant with the morality and otherwise as well of this life as that to come, was brought by those Apsaras (nymphs) under the sway of Madana.

verses.sanskrit:
ताश्चैवाप्सरसः पञ्चमुनेः पत्नीत्वमागताः
तटाके निर्मितं तासामस्मिन्नन्तर्हितं गृहम्
verses.transliteration:
tāścaivāpsarasaḥ pañcamuneḥ patnītvamāgatāḥ
taṭāke nirmitaṁ tāsāmasminnantarhitaṁ gṛham

translations.english: And those five nymphs (ultimately) became the wives of the ascetic; and their hidden residence was reared in the pool.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैवाप्सरसः पञ्चनिवसन्त्यो यथासुखम्
रमयन्ति तपोयोगान्मुनिं यौवनमास्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tatraivāpsarasaḥ pañcanivasantyo yathāsukham
ramayanti tapoyogānmuniṁ yauvanamāsthitam

translations.english: And there the five nymphs living happily, pleased the anchorite, established in youth through asceticism and yoga.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां संक्रीडमानानामेष वादित्रनिःस्वनः
श्रूयते भूषणोन्मिश्रो गीतशब्दो मनोहरः
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ saṁkrīḍamānānāmeṣa vāditraniḥsvanaḥ
śrūyate bhūṣaṇonmiśro gītaśabdo manoharaḥ

translations.english: As your sport, we hear the sounds of their musical instruments, and the sweet voice of their song mixed with the tinkling of their instruments.

verses.sanskrit:
आश्चर्यमिति तस्यैतद्वचनं भावितात्मनः
राघवः प्रतिजग्राह सह भ्रात्रा महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
āścaryamiti tasyaitadvacanaṁ bhāvitātmanaḥ
rāghavaḥ pratijagrāha saha bhrātrā mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: (Hearing this), the illustrious Rāghava along with his brother declared the story narrated by that one of a pure heart to be wonderful.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं कथयमानस्य ददर्शाश्रममण्डलम्
कुशचीरपरिक्षिप्तं नानावृक्षसमावृतम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ kathayamānasya dadarśāśramamaṇḍalam
kuśacīraparikṣiptaṁ nānāvṛkṣasamāvṛtam

translations.english: Thus conversing, Rāma saw the collection of asylums, strewn with Kusa and bark, and be-girt with energy derived from Brahmā lore.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः
तदा तस्मिन्स काकुत्स्थः श्रीमत्याश्रममण्डले
verses.transliteration:
praviśya saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca rāghavaḥ
tadā tasminsa kākutsthaḥ śrīmatyāśramamaṇḍale

translations.english: Entering (the place) along with Vaidehi and Lakşmaņa, the highly famous Rāghava dwelt there respected by all the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
उषित्वा सुसुखं तत्र पूर्ज्यमानो महर्षिभिः
जगाम चाश्रमांस्तेषां पर्यायेण तपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration:
uṣitvā susukhaṁ tatra pūrjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
jagāma cāśramāṁsteṣāṁ paryāyeṇa tapasvinām

translations.english: Having happily dwelt in those collections of graceful asylums, honoured of the Maharsis, Kākutstha by turns went to the hermitages of those ascetics with whom that one well versed in arms had dwelt before.

verses.sanskrit:
क्वचिच्च चतुरो मासान्पञ्चषट्चापरान्क्वचित्
अपरत्राधिकान्मासानध्यर्धमधिकं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration:
kvacicca caturo māsānpañcaṣaṭcāparānkvacit
aparatrādhikānmāsānadhyardhamadhikaṁ kvacit

translations.english: And Rāghava happily passed his days somewhere for ten months, somewhere for one year, somewhere for four months somewhere for five or six months, somewhere for many months, somewhere for a month and a half, somewhere for more, somewhere for three months, and somewhere for eight.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीन्मासानष्टमासांश्च राघवो न्यवसत्सुखम्
तथा संवसतस्तस्य मुनीनामाश्रमेषु वै
रमतश्चानुकुल्येन ययुः संवत्सरा दश
verses.transliteration:
trīnmāsānaṣṭamāsāṁśca rāghavo nyavasatsukham
tathā saṁvasatastasya munīnāmāśrameṣu vai
ramataścānukulyena yayuḥ saṁvatsarā daśa

translations.english: And as Rāma lived in the asylums of the ascetics and amused himself through their good graces, ten years were passed away (in this way).

verses.sanskrit:
परिसृत्य च धर्मज्ञो राघवः सह सीतया
सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमं श्रीमान्पुनरेवाजगाम ह
verses.transliteration:
parisṛtya ca dharmajño rāghavaḥ saha sītayā
sutīkṣṇasyāśramaṁ śrīmānpunarevājagāma ha

translations.english: Having gone round the asylums of all the ascetics, Rāghava cognizant of righteousness returned to the hermitage of Sutīkşna.

verses.sanskrit:
स तमाश्रममागम्य मुनिभिः प्रतिपूजितः
तत्रापि न्यवसद्रामः कंचित्कालमरिंदमः
verses.transliteration:
sa tamāśramamāgamya munibhiḥ pratipūjitaḥ
tatrāpi nyavasadrāmaḥ kaṁcitkālamariṁdamaḥ

translations.english: Coming to this asylum, respected by the ascetics, that subduer of enemies, Rāma, stayed there for a time.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाश्रमस्थो विनयात्कदाचित्तं महामुनिम्
उपासीनः स काकुत्स्थः सुतीक्ष्णमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
athāśramastho vinayātkadācittaṁ mahāmunim
upāsīnaḥ sa kākutsthaḥ sutīkṣṇamidamabravīt

translations.english: Once upon a time, as Kākutstha dwelling in that asylum was seated, he humbly observed to that great ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्नरण्ये भगवन्नगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः
वसतीति मया नित्यं कथाः कथयतां श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
asminnaraṇye bhagavannagastyo munisattamaḥ
vasatīti mayā nityaṁ kathāḥ kathayatāṁ śrutam

translations.english: I have always heard from men speaking on the subject that that foremost of ascetics, the reverend Agastya, lives in this forest. On account of the vastness of this forest, I do not know that place.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादात्तत्र भवतः सानुजः सह सीतया
अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेयमभिवादयितुं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration:
prasādāttatra bhavataḥ sānujaḥ saha sītayā
agastyamabhigaccheyamabhivādayituṁ munim

translations.english: Where is the hermitage of that intelligent Maharsi? For propitiating that revered one, I, accompanied by my brother and Sītā, will go to Agastya for paying our respects to the ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
इति रामस्य स मुनिः श्रुत्वा धर्मात्मनो वचः
सुतीक्ष्णः प्रत्युवाचेदं प्रीतो दशरथात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
iti rāmasya sa muniḥ śrutvā dharmātmano vacaḥ
sutīkṣṇaḥ pratyuvācedaṁ prīto daśarathātmajam

translations.english: This great desire is burning in my heart, that I should myself minister to that best of anchorets. Hearing these words of the righteous-souled Rama, Sutiksna, well pleased, answered Dasaratha's son.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमप्येतदेव त्वां वक्तुकामः सलक्ष्मणम्
अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेति सीतया सह राघव
verses.transliteration:
ahamapyetadeva tvāṁ vaktukāmaḥ salakṣmaṇam
agastyamabhigaccheti sītayā saha rāghava

translations.english: I also am desirous of telling you this along with Lakşmaņa. Repair to Agastya in company with Sītā, O Rāghava. By luck you have yourself said this to me as to your purpose.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकां रजनीमुष्य प्रभाते राम गम्यताम्
दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय वनखण्डस्य पार्श्वतः
verses.transliteration:
tatraikāṁ rajanīmuṣya prabhāte rāma gamyatām
dakṣiṇāṁ diśamāsthāya vanakhaṇḍasya pārśvataḥ

translations.english: Passing a night there, do you, O Rāma, in the morning, taking a southerly course, go by the skirts of the forest tract. Passing a Yojana, you । shall come upon Agastya's asylum, located at a charming woodland graced with many a tree.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रागस्त्याश्रमपदं गत्वा योजनमन्तरम्
रमणीये वनोद्देशे बहुपादप संवृते
रंस्यते तत्र वैदेही लक्ष्मणश्च त्वया सह
verses.transliteration:
tatrāgastyāśramapadaṁ gatvā yojanamantaram
ramaṇīye vanoddeśe bahupādapa saṁvṛte
raṁsyate tatra vaidehī lakṣmaṇaśca tvayā saha

translations.english: There Videha's daughter and Lakşınana shall experience delight in your company.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो बहुपादपसंकुलः
यदि बुद्धिः कृता द्रष्टुमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्
अद्यैव गमने बुद्धिं रोचयस्व महायशः
verses.transliteration:
sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo bahupādapasaṁkulaḥ
yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā draṣṭumagastyaṁ taṁ mahāmunim
adyaiva gamane buddhiṁ rocayasva mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: O magnanimous one, if you intend to see the mighty ascetic, Agastya, in that charming woodland, containing a great many trees, then do you make up your mind to set out this very day.

verses.sanskrit:
इति रामो मुनेः श्रुत्वा सह भ्रात्राभिवाद्य च
प्रतस्थेऽगस्त्यमुद्दिश्य सानुजः सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
iti rāmo muneḥ śrutvā saha bhrātrābhivādya ca
pratasthe'gastyamuddiśya sānujaḥ saha sītayā

translations.english: Hearing these words of the anchorite, Rāma, saluting him, along with his brother, set off for Agastya's (place) with his younger brother and Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यन्वनानि चित्राणि पर्वपांश्चाभ्रसंनिभान्
सरांसि सरितश्चैव पथि मार्गवशानुगाः
verses.transliteration:
paśyanvanāni citrāṇi parvapāṁścābhrasaṁnibhān
sarāṁsi saritaścaiva pathi mārgavaśānugāḥ

translations.english: And, pleasantly proceeding by the way dire ted by Sutiksna, seeing picturesque woods, hills resembling clouds, watery expanses and streams flowing by their path; Rāma filled with delight said these words to Lakşmana,

verses.sanskrit:
एतदेवाश्रमपदं नूनं तस्य महात्मनः
अगस्त्यस्य मुनेर्भ्रातुर्दृश्यते पुण्यकर्मणः
verses.transliteration:
etadevāśramapadaṁ nūnaṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ
agastyasya munerbhrāturdṛśyate puṇyakarmaṇaḥ

translations.english: 'Surely we see the asylumn of that high-souled one, the ascetic, Agastya's brother of pious acts.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा हीमे वनस्यास्य ज्ञाताः पथि सहस्रशः
संनताः फलभरेण पुष्पभारेण च द्रुमाः
verses.transliteration:
yathā hīme vanasyāsya jñātāḥ pathi sahasraśaḥ
saṁnatāḥ phalabhareṇa puṣpabhāreṇa ca drumāḥ

translations.english: These trees standing by thousands on the way bending beneath the weight of fruits and flowers, bear the signs that had been mentioned to me as belonging to this wood.

verses.sanskrit:
पिप्पलीनां च पक्वानां वनादस्मादुपागतः
गन्धोऽयं पवनोत्क्षिप्तः सहसा कटुकोदयः
verses.transliteration:
pippalīnāṁ ca pakvānāṁ vanādasmādupāgataḥ
gandho'yaṁ pavanotkṣiptaḥ sahasā kaṭukodayaḥ

translations.english: And coming from the wood this scent is wafted by the wind the pungent odour of ripe Pippalis.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तत्र च दृश्यन्ते संक्षिप्ताः काष्ठसंचयाः
लूनाश्च पथि दृश्यन्ते दर्भा वैदूर्यवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
tatra tatra ca dṛśyante saṁkṣiptāḥ kāṣṭhasaṁcayāḥ
lūnāśca pathi dṛśyante darbhā vaidūryavarcasaḥ

translations.english: And here and there are found heaps of firewood, and torn Darbha are seen, of the lustre of lapses.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्च वनमध्यस्थं कृष्णाभ्रशिखरोपमम्
पावकस्याश्रमस्थस्य धूमाग्रं संप्रदृश्यते
verses.transliteration:
etacca vanamadhyasthaṁ kṛṣṇābhraśikharopamam
pāvakasyāśramasthasya dhūmāgraṁ saṁpradṛśyate

translations.english: And the top of the column of smoke belonging to the fire lit in the asylum in this wood, appears like the peak of a dark mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
विविक्तेषु च तीर्थेषु कृतस्नाना द्विजातयः
पुष्पोपहारं कुर्वन्ति कुसुमैः स्वयमार्जितैः
verses.transliteration:
vivikteṣu ca tīrtheṣu kṛtasnānā dvijātayaḥ
puṣpopahāraṁ kurvanti kusumaiḥ svayamārjitaiḥ

translations.english: And twice-born ones, having performed their ablutions in sacred and retired bathing places, are offering flowers gathered by themselves.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्सुतीक्ष्णस्य वचनं यथा सौम्य मया श्रुतम्
अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो भ्रातुर्नूनमेष भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tatsutīkṣṇasya vacanaṁ yathā saumya mayā śrutam
agastyasyāśramo bhrāturnūnameṣa bhaviṣyati

translations.english: O placid one, from what I had heard from Sutiksna, this would appear to be the asylum of Agastya's brother.

verses.sanskrit:
निगृह्य तरसा मृत्युं लोकानां हितकाम्यया
यस्य भ्रात्रा कृतेयं दिक्शरण्या पुण्यकर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
nigṛhya tarasā mṛtyuṁ lokānāṁ hitakāmyayā
yasya bhrātrā kṛteyaṁ dikśaraṇyā puṇyakarmaṇā

translations.english: The righteous Agastya it is who, wishing for the welfare of the worlds, destroying by virtue of his austerities a Daitya resembling Death, has rendered this quarter habitable.

verses.sanskrit:
इहैकदा किल क्रूरो वातापिरपि चेल्वलः
भ्रातरौ सहितावास्तां ब्राह्मणघ्नौ महासुरौ
verses.transliteration:
ihaikadā kila krūro vātāpirapi celvalaḥ
bhrātarau sahitāvāstāṁ brāhmaṇaghnau mahāsurau

translations.english: Once on a time here dwelt together two mighty Asuras, brothers, given to slaughtering Brāhmanas, the wily Vātāpi and Ilvala.

verses.sanskrit:
धारयन्ब्राह्मणं रूपमिल्वलः संस्कृतं वदन्
आमन्त्रयति विप्रान्स श्राद्धमुद्दिश्य निर्घृणः
verses.transliteration:
dhārayanbrāhmaṇaṁ rūpamilvalaḥ saṁskṛtaṁ vadan
āmantrayati viprānsa śrāddhamuddiśya nirghṛṇaḥ

translations.english: Wearing the form of a Brāhmana, and speaking Sanskrit, the cruel one used to invite Vipras to a Śrāddha. And, cooking his brother wearing the shape of a sheep, he used to feed the twice-born ones according to the rites prescribed for Śrāddhas.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां विप्राणामिल्वलोऽब्रवीत्
वातापे निष्क्रमस्वेति स्वरेण महता वदन्
verses.transliteration:
tato bhuktavatāṁ teṣāṁ viprāṇāmilvalo'bravīt
vātāpe niṣkramasveti svareṇa mahatā vadan

translations.english: Then when the Vipras had fed, Ilvala said'uttering a loud sound, O Vātāpi; come out.'

verses.sanskrit:
ततो भ्रातुर्वचः श्रुत्वा वातापिर्मेषवन्नदन्
भित्त्वा भित्वा शरीराणि ब्राह्मणानां विनिष्पतत्
verses.transliteration:
tato bhrāturvacaḥ śrutvā vātāpirmeṣavannadan
bhittvā bhitvā śarīrāṇi brāhmaṇānāṁ viniṣpatat

translations.english: Hearing his brother's words, Vātāpi, bleating like a sheep, came out, riving their bodies.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि तैरेवं कामरूपिभिः
विनाशितानि संहत्य नित्यशः पिशिताशनैः
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇānāṁ sahasrāṇi tairevaṁ kāmarūpibhiḥ
vināśitāni saṁhatya nityaśaḥ piśitāśanaiḥ

translations.english: In this way, thousands of Brāhmaṇas gathered together, were destroyed by flesh eating ones wearing shapes at will.

verses.sanskrit:
अगस्त्येन तदा देवैः प्रार्थितेन महर्षिणा
अनुभूय किल श्राद्धे भक्षितः स महासुरः
verses.transliteration:
agastyena tadā devaiḥ prārthitena maharṣiṇā
anubhūya kila śrāddhe bhakṣitaḥ sa mahāsuraḥ

translations.english: (And it came to pass that once upon a time) the Maharși Agastya, having been invited to a Sraddha, fed on the mighty Asura.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संपन्नमित्युक्त्वा दत्त्वा हस्तावसेचनम्
भ्रातरं निष्क्रमस्वेति इल्वलः सोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁpannamityuktvā dattvā hastāvasecanam
bhrātaraṁ niṣkramasveti ilvalaḥ so'bhyabhāṣata

translations.english: Thereupon uttering Finished' and offering water to wash hands with, Ilvala said to his brother, 'Come out'!

verses.sanskrit:
तं तथा भाषमाणं तु भ्रातरं विप्रघातिनम्
अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्धीमानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tathā bhāṣamāṇaṁ tu bhrātaraṁ vipraghātinam
abravītprahasandhīmānagastyo munisattamaḥ

translations.english: And, as that brother of Vātãpi, given to slaughtering Vipras was speaking thus, that foremost of ascetics, the intelligent Agastya, said with a laugh,

verses.sanskrit:
कुतो निष्क्रमितुं शक्तिर्मया जीर्णस्य रक्षसः
भ्रातुस्ते मेष रूपस्य गतस्य यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration:
kuto niṣkramituṁ śaktirmayā jīrṇasya rakṣasaḥ
bhrātuste meṣa rūpasya gatasya yamasādanam

translations.english: 'Where is the power of coming out, of the Rākṣasa, your brother wearing the shape of a sheep, who has gone to Yama's abode?'

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्निधनसंश्रितम्
प्रधर्षयितुमारेभे मुनिं क्रोधान्निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhrāturnidhanasaṁśritam
pradharṣayitumārebhe muniṁ krodhānniśācaraḥ

translations.english: Hearing his words, from wrath the ranger of the night prepared to assail the ascetic, and he rushed against that foremost of the twice-born ones.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभ्यद्रवद्द्विजेन्द्रं तं मुनिना दीप्ततेजसा
चक्षुषानलकल्पेन निर्दग्धो निधनं गतः
verses.transliteration:
so'bhyadravaddvijendraṁ taṁ muninā dīptatejasā
cakṣuṣānalakalpena nirdagdho nidhanaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: And, being consumed by that ascetic of flaming energy with his eyes resembling fire, the Rākşasa met his end.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यायमाश्रमो भ्रातुस्तटाकवनशोभितः
विप्रानुकम्पया येन कर्मेदं दुष्करं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāyamāśramo bhrātustaṭākavanaśobhitaḥ
viprānukampayā yena karmedaṁ duṣkaraṁ kṛtam

translations.english: This asylum graced with pools and groves belongs to the brother of him who has performed this arduous feat from compassion for the Vipras'.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं कथयमानस्य तस्य सौमित्रिणा सह
रामस्यास्तं गतः सूर्यः संध्याकालोऽभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ kathayamānasya tasya saumitriṇā saha
rāmasyāstaṁ gataḥ sūryaḥ saṁdhyākālo'bhyavartata

translations.english: As Rāma was thus conversing with Sumitra's son, the sun set and evening approached.

verses.sanskrit:
उपास्य पश्चिमां संध्यां सह भ्रात्रा यथाविधि
प्रविवेशाश्रमपदं तमृषिं चाभ्यवादयन्
verses.transliteration:
upāsya paścimāṁ saṁdhyāṁ saha bhrātrā yathāvidhi
praviveśāśramapadaṁ tamṛṣiṁ cābhyavādayan

translations.english: Then, duly performing his afternoon adorations along with his brother, Rāma entered the hermitage, and saluted the ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
सम्यक्प्रतिगृहीतस्तु मुनिना तेन राघवः
न्यवसत्तां निशामेकां प्राश्य मूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration:
samyakpratigṛhītastu muninā tena rāghavaḥ
nyavasattāṁ niśāmekāṁ prāśya mūlaphalāni ca

translations.english: Well received by the ascetic, Rāghava spent there a night, eating fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां विमले सूर्यमण्डले
भ्रातरं तमगस्त्यस्य आमन्त्रयत राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāṁ rātryāṁ vyatītāyāṁ vimale sūryamaṇḍale
bhrātaraṁ tamagastyasya āmantrayata rāghavaḥ

translations.english: When the night had passed away, and solar disc arose, Rāghava greeted Agastya's brother.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवादये त्वा भगवन्सुखमध्युषितो निशाम्
आमन्त्रये त्वां गच्छामि गुरुं ते द्रष्टुमग्रजम्
verses.transliteration:
abhivādaye tvā bhagavansukhamadhyuṣito niśām
āmantraye tvāṁ gacchāmi guruṁ te draṣṭumagrajam

translations.english: O reverend Sir, I salute you. I have pleasantly passed the night. I greet you; I shall go to behold my preceptor, your elder brother.

verses.sanskrit:
गम्यतामिति तेनोक्तो जगाम रघुनन्दनः
यथोद्दिष्टेन मार्गेण वनं तच्चावलोकयन्
verses.transliteration:
gamyatāmiti tenokto jagāma raghunandanaḥ
yathoddiṣṭena mārgeṇa vanaṁ taccāvalokayan

translations.english: Thereat on the ascetic's saying, 'Go you,' the descendant of Raghu went away by the prescribed route.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽब्रवीत्समीपस्थं रामो राजीवलोचनः
पृष्ठतोऽनुगतं वीरं लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration:
tato'bravītsamīpasthaṁ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ
pṛṣṭhato'nugataṁ vīraṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmivardhanam

translations.english: Then the lotus-eyed Rāma said to that enhancer of auspiciousness, the heroic Laks maņa, who was by him, and was following him at his back,

verses.sanskrit:
स्निग्धपत्रा यथा वृक्षा यथा क्षान्ता मृगद्विजाः
आश्रमो नातिदूरस्थो महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
snigdhapatrā yathā vṛkṣā yathā kṣāntā mṛgadvijāḥ
āśramo nātidūrastho maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ

translations.english: The leaves of these trees are glossy, and the beasts and birds are mild, even as (we had been told). This asylum of the pure-hearted Maharsi must not be far.

verses.sanskrit:
अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा
आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्त श्रमापहः
verses.transliteration:
agastya iti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā
āśramo dṛśyate tasya pariśrānta śramāpahaḥ

translations.english: This asylum capable of removing the fatigue of the weary, belonging to him that is known among men as Agastya by his own acts, is seen, with the (neighbouring woods) filled with smoke, and itself decorated with bark and wreaths, containing herds of mild deer, and ringing with the notes of various birds.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्येदमाश्रमपदं प्रभावाद्यस्य राक्षसैः
दिगियं दक्षिणा त्रासाद्दृश्यते नोपभुज्यते
verses.transliteration:
tasyedamāśramapadaṁ prabhāvādyasya rākṣasaiḥ
digiyaṁ dakṣiṇā trāsāddṛśyate nopabhujyate

translations.english: This is the asylum of that pious one, who destroying (the Asura resembling) Death, has, desirous of the welfare of mankind, rendered the Southern quarter habitable, and through whose potency the Rākşasas from fear barely cast their eyes in this direction, but do not approach.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा प्रभृति चाक्रान्ता दिगियं पुण्यकर्मणा
तदा प्रभृति निर्वैराः प्रशान्ता रजनीचराः
verses.transliteration:
yadā prabhṛti cākrāntā digiyaṁ puṇyakarmaṇā
tadā prabhṛti nirvairāḥ praśāntā rajanīcarāḥ

translations.english: Ever since that one of pious ways possessed himself of this quarter, the rangers of the night have foregone their hostility, and assumed a peaceful attitude.

verses.sanskrit:
नाम्ना चेयं भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक्प्रदक्षिणा
प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूरकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
nāmnā ceyaṁ bhagavato dakṣiṇā dikpradakṣiṇā
prathitā triṣu lokeṣu durdharṣā krūrakarmabhiḥ

translations.english: This Southern quarter rendered safe (by Agastya), and incapable of being harassed by those ones of tortuous ways, is created over the three worlds in connection with the name of the reverend ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं दीर्घायुषस्तस्य लोके विश्रुतकर्मणः
अगस्त्यस्याश्रमः श्रीमान्विनीतमृगसेवितः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ dīrghāyuṣastasya loke viśrutakarmaṇaḥ
agastyasyāśramaḥ śrīmānvinītamṛgasevitaḥ

translations.english: This graceful asylum ranged by mild beasts belongs to that long-lived one of renowned achievements, Agastya, in obedience to whose command, the Vindhya mountain-foremost of its kind, which had always obstructed the way of the Sun, does not increase.

verses.sanskrit:
एष लोकार्चितः साधुर्हिते नित्यं रतः सताम्
अस्मानधिगतानेष श्रेयसा योजयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
eṣa lokārcitaḥ sādhurhite nityaṁ rataḥ satām
asmānadhigatāneṣa śreyasā yojayiṣyati

translations.english: This pious one honoured of men, ever engaged in the welfare of the righteous, shall do good to us, who have come to him.

verses.sanskrit:
आराधयिष्याम्यत्राहमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्
शेषं च वनवासस्य सौम्य वत्स्याम्यहं प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
ārādhayiṣyāmyatrāhamagastyaṁ taṁ mahāmunim
śeṣaṁ ca vanavāsasya saumya vatsyāmyahaṁ prabho

translations.english: I shall adore the mighty ascetic, Agastya, and, O mild one, O master, here pass away the remainder of the term of my banishment.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
अगस्त्यं नियताहारं सततं पर्युपासते
verses.transliteration:
atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
agastyaṁ niyatāhāraṁ satataṁ paryupāsate

translations.english: Here celestials with the Gandharvas, and Siddhas and eminent saints, observing restrictions in respect of food, aye adore Agastya.

verses.sanskrit:
नात्र जीवेन्मृषावादी क्रूरो वा यदि वा शठः
नृशंसः कामवृत्तो वा मुनिरेष तथाविधः
verses.transliteration:
nātra jīvenmṛṣāvādī krūro vā yadi vā śaṭhaḥ
nṛśaṁsaḥ kāmavṛtto vā munireṣa tathāvidhaḥ

translations.english: And the ascetic is such that a liar cannot live here, nor a cunning or a crafty person, nor a wicked wight, nor one that is given to unrighteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र देवाश्च यक्षाश्च नागाश्च पतगैः सह
वसन्ति नियताहारा धर्ममाराधयिष्णवः
verses.transliteration:
atra devāśca yakṣāśca nāgāśca patagaiḥ saha
vasanti niyatāhārā dharmamārādhayiṣṇavaḥ

translations.english: And adoring righteousness, celestials, and Yaksas, and Nagas, and birds, live here restricting their fare.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैः सूर्यसंनिभैः
त्यक्त्वा देहान्नवैर्देहैः स्वर्याताः परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration:
atra siddhā mahātmāno vimānaiḥ sūryasaṁnibhaiḥ
tyaktvā dehānnavairdehaiḥ svaryātāḥ paramarṣayaḥ

translations.english: And high-souled Siddhas and eminent saints, renouncing their bodies, repair to the celestial regions in cars resembling the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
यक्षत्वममरत्वं च राज्यानि विविधानि च
अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैराराधिताः शुभैः
verses.transliteration:
yakṣatvamamaratvaṁ ca rājyāni vividhāni ca
atra devāḥ prayacchanti bhūtairārādhitāḥ śubhaiḥ

translations.english: And adored by auspicious individuals, the deities here confer on them the states of Yakşas and celestials, and divers kingdoms.

verses.sanskrit:
आगताः स्माश्रमपदं सौमित्रे प्रविशाग्रतः
निवेदयेह मां प्राप्तमृषये सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
āgatāḥ smāśramapadaṁ saumitre praviśāgrataḥ
nivedayeha māṁ prāptamṛṣaye saha sītayā

translations.english: Sumitra's son, entering the asylum before us, do you announce to the saints that I along with Sītā, have arrived here.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविश्याश्रमपदं लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः
अगस्त्यशिष्यमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
sa praviśyāśramapadaṁ lakṣmaṇo rāghavānujaḥ
agastyaśiṣyamāsādya vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Having entered the asylum, Räghava's younger brother, Lakşmana, coming to a disciple of Agastya, spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit:
राजा दशरथो नाम ज्येष्ठस्तस्य सुतो बली
रामः प्राप्तो मुनिं द्रष्टुं भार्यया सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
rājā daśaratho nāma jyeṣṭhastasya suto balī
rāmaḥ prāpto muniṁ draṣṭuṁ bhāryayā saha sītayā

translations.english: There was a king, named Dasaratha. His eldest son, the strong Rāma, has come (to this asylum) along with his wife, Sītā, for seeing the ascetic. Named Lakşmaņa, I am his younger brother, obedient and devoted to him. you may have heard of it.

verses.sanskrit:
ते वयं वनमत्युग्रं प्रविष्टाः पितृशासनात्
द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे सर्वे भगवन्तं निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
te vayaṁ vanamatyugraṁ praviṣṭāḥ pitṛśāsanāt
draṣṭumicchāmahe sarve bhagavantaṁ nivedyatām

translations.english: Having entered this horrid forest, in consonance with the mandate of our sire, we desire to see the reverend one. Tell this to him.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य तपोधनः
तथेत्युक्त्वाग्निशरणं प्रविवेश निवेदितुम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya tapodhanaḥ
tathetyuktvāgniśaraṇaṁ praviveśa niveditum

translations.english: Hearing Laksmana's words, that ascetic, saying, “So be it," entered the chamber of the sacrificial fire, for the purpose of communicating (the news to Agastya).

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविश्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तपसा दुष्प्रधर्षणम्
कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं रामागमनमञ्जसा
verses.transliteration:
sa praviśya muniśreṣṭhaṁ tapasā duṣpradharṣaṇam
kṛtāñjaliruvācedaṁ rāmāgamanamañjasā

translations.english: Entering in, Agastya's beloved disciple, with joined hands communicated to that foremost of ascetics, incapable of being repressed*, exactly what Laksmana had told him, *Some texts:-Effulgent.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रष्टुं भवन्तमायातौ शुश्रूषार्थमरिंदमौ
यदत्रानन्तरं तत्त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
draṣṭuṁ bhavantamāyātau śuśrūṣārthamariṁdamau
yadatrānantaraṁ tattvamājñāpayitumarhasi

translations.english: For seeing the reverend one, and serving him as well, those subduers of their foes, Dasaratha's sons, Rama and Laksmana, accompanied by Sītā, have entered this asylum. It now behoves you to command what is to be done next.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शिष्यादुपश्रुत्य प्राप्तं रामं सलक्ष्मणम्
वैदेहीं च महाभागामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śiṣyādupaśrutya prāptaṁ rāmaṁ salakṣmaṇam
vaidehīṁ ca mahābhāgāmidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing from his disciple that Rāma had come along with Lakşmaņa and the highly virtuous Vaidehi, Agastya said,

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या रामश्चिरस्याद्य द्रष्टुं मां समुपागतः
मनसा काङ्क्षितं ह्यस्य मयाप्यागमनं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā rāmaścirasyādya draṣṭuṁ māṁ samupāgataḥ
manasā kāṅkṣitaṁ hyasya mayāpyāgamanaṁ prati

translations.english: By luck it is that after a long time, Rāma has come to see me. I had mentally wished for his arrival. Go you; and let Rāma, having been respectfully received, come before me. Why have you not brought himself?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना
अभिवाद्याब्रवीच्छिष्यस्तथेति नियताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu muninā dharmajñena mahātmanā
abhivādyābravīcchiṣyastatheti niyatāñjaliḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed by the high-souled and righteous ascetic, the disciple saluting him, with joined hands, said, So be it.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निष्क्रम्य संभ्रान्तः शिष्यो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
क्वासौ रामो मुनिं द्रष्टुमेतु प्रविशतु स्वयम्
verses.transliteration:
tato niṣkramya saṁbhrāntaḥ śiṣyo lakṣmaṇamabravīt
kvāsau rāmo muniṁ draṣṭumetu praviśatu svayam

translations.english: Then issuing out, the disciple said to Laks mana, Where is Rama? Let him come and enter in.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गत्वाश्रमपदं शिष्येण सह लक्ष्मणः
दर्शयामास काकुत्स्थं सीतां च जनकात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration:
tato gatvāśramapadaṁ śiṣyeṇa saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
darśayāmāsa kākutsthaṁ sītāṁ ca janakātmajām

translations.english: Threat, going to the asylum in company with the disciple (of Agastya), Laksmana showed to him Kākutstha and the daughter of Janaka, Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
तं शिष्यः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमगस्त्यवचनं ब्रुवन्
प्रावेशयद्यथान्यायं सत्कारार्थं सुसत्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ śiṣyaḥ praśritaṁ vākyamagastyavacanaṁ bruvan
prāveśayadyathānyāyaṁ satkārārthaṁ susatkṛtam

translations.english: Then joyfully communicating to Rāma the words of the reverend one, the disciple (of Agastya) duly took in that one worthy of being honoured.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविवेश ततो रामः सीतया सहलक्ष्मणः
प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णमाश्रमं ह्यवलोकयन्
verses.transliteration:
praviveśa tato rāmaḥ sītayā sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
praśāntahariṇākīrṇamāśramaṁ hyavalokayan

translations.english: And seeing the asylum teeming with mild deer, Rama entered in with Laksmana and Sita. And there Rāma beheld the place of Brahmä, and that of Agni,

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिरप्यभिनिष्पतत्
तं ददर्शाग्रतो रामो मुनीनां दीप्ततेजसं
अब्रवीद्वचनं वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munirapyabhiniṣpatat
taṁ dadarśāgrato rāmo munīnāṁ dīptatejasaṁ
abravīdvacanaṁ vīro lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmivardhanam

translations.english: And it came to pass that, surrounded by his disciples, the ascetic came (before Rāma). And Rāma saw that one of flaming energy at the head of the ascetics, and the hero said to Lakşınana, enhancer of auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit:
एष लक्ष्मण निष्क्रामत्यगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः
औदार्येणावगच्छामि निधानं तपसामिमम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣa lakṣmaṇa niṣkrāmatyagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ
audāryeṇāvagacchāmi nidhānaṁ tapasāmimam

translations.english: O Laksmana, the revered saint, Agastya, is coming out. I recognize that mass of asceticism by a certain kind of majesty (that characterises him).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुरगस्त्यं सूर्यवर्चसं
जग्राह परमप्रीतस्तस्य पादौ परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahābāhuragastyaṁ sūryavarcasaṁ
jagrāha paramaprītastasya pādau paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: Having said this touching Agastya of the splendour of the sun, that son of Raghu took hold of his feet.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य तु धर्मात्मा तस्थौ रामः कृताञ्जलिः
सीतया सह वैदेह्या तदा राम सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya tu dharmātmā tasthau rāmaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
sītayā saha vaidehyā tadā rāma salakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Then, having paid him homage, Rama with joined hands stood there in company with Videha's daughter, Sītā, and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थमर्चयित्वासनोदकैः
कुशलप्रश्नमुक्त्वा च आस्यतामिति सोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya ca kākutsthamarcayitvāsanodakaiḥ
kuśalapraśnamuktvā ca āsyatāmiti so'bravīt

translations.english: Thereat, embracing Rāma and honouring him with water and a seat, and asking him questions anent his welfare, the saint said, Welcome!

verses.sanskrit:
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य धर्मचारी महारथः
पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च भवान्प्राप्तः प्रियातिथिः
verses.transliteration:
rājā sarvasya lokasya dharmacārī mahārathaḥ
pūjanīyaśca mānyaśca bhavānprāptaḥ priyātithiḥ

translations.english: The sovereign of all the worlds, righteous, a mighty car warrior, worthy of being honoured and worshipped, you have become our beloved guest.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैश्चान्यैश्च राघवम्
पूजयित्वा यथाकामं पुनरेव ततोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā phalairmūlaiḥ puṣpaiścānyaiśca rāghavam
pūjayitvā yathākāmaṁ punareva tato'bravīt

translations.english: Having said this, Agastya, according to his desire, worshipping Rāghava with fruits, roots and flowers, said to him,

verses.sanskrit:
संपूर्णौ निशितैर्बाणैर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः
महाराजत कोशोऽयमसिर्हेमविभूषितः
verses.transliteration:
saṁpūrṇau niśitairbāṇairjvaladbhiriva pāvakaiḥ
mahārājata kośo'yamasirhemavibhūṣitaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men, this mighty, celestial bow belonging to Vişnu, and constructed by Visvakarma, and this best of arrows (named) Brahmadatta, infallible and resembling the sun and this inexhaustible couple of quivers filled with sharpened shafts, like to flaming fire, were granted to me by the mighly Indra. And here is this mighty golden scabbard, and this sword decked in gold.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेन धनुषा राम हत्वा संख्ये महासुरान्
आजहार श्रियं दीप्तां पुरा विष्णुर्दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration:
anena dhanuṣā rāma hatvā saṁkhye mahāsurān
ājahāra śriyaṁ dīptāṁ purā viṣṇurdivaukasām

translations.english: Having, O Rama, slain the mighty Asuras with this bow, Vişņu in days of yorc in battle secured the effulgent Fortune of the celestials. O bestower of honour, do you for securing victory, take this bow, these quivers, this arrow, and this scimitar, like the holder of the thunderbolt, taking the same.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः समस्तं तद्वरायुधम्
दत्त्वा रामाय भगवानगस्त्यः पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejāḥ samastaṁ tadvarāyudham
dattvā rāmāya bhagavānagastyaḥ punarabravīt

translations.english: Having said this, that highly energetic one, the reverend Agastya, consigning to Rāma all those weapon, again said. SCCTION 13

verses.sanskrit:
राम प्रीतोऽस्मि भद्रं ते परितुष्टोऽस्मि लक्ष्मण
अभिवादयितुं यन्मां प्राप्तौ स्थः सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
rāma prīto'smi bhadraṁ te parituṣṭo'smi lakṣmaṇa
abhivādayituṁ yanmāṁ prāptau sthaḥ saha sītayā

translations.english: 'O Rāma, I am pleased with you; good betide you! And, O Laksmana, I am gratified by you. You are in trouble in consequence of the great fatigue that you have undergone on the way. And Janaka's daughter, the noble Maithili, is evidently cager (for rest).

verses.sanskrit:
एषा हि सुकुमारी च दुःखैश्च न विमानिता
प्राज्यदोषं वनं प्रप्ता भर्तृस्नेहप्रचोदिता
verses.transliteration:
eṣā hi sukumārī ca duḥkhaiśca na vimānitā
prājyadoṣaṁ vanaṁ praptā bhartṛsnehapracoditā

translations.english: Of tender years and unkn wn to hardship, she has come to the forest rife with troubles, being urged by the love she bears to her lord.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैषा रमते राम इह सीता तथा कुरु
दुष्करं कृतवत्येषा वने त्वामनुगच्छती
verses.transliteration:
yathaiṣā ramate rāma iha sītā tathā kuru
duṣkaraṁ kṛtavatyeṣā vane tvāmanugacchatī

translations.english: Do you, O Rāma, conduct yourself so, that Sītā may find a pleasant time of it. By fcllowing you to the forest, it is a hard task that she is performing.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा हि प्रकृतिः स्त्रीणामासृष्टे रघुनन्दन
समस्थमनुरज्यन्ते विषमस्थं त्यजन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
eṣā hi prakṛtiḥ strīṇāmāsṛṣṭe raghunandana
samasthamanurajyante viṣamasthaṁ tyajanti ca

translations.english: O son of Raghu, this has been the nature of the fair sex from the commencement of creation, that they gladden him that is well off, and forsake a person in adversity.

verses.sanskrit:
शतह्रदानां लोलत्वं शस्त्राणां तीक्ष्णतां तथा
गरुडानिलयोः शैघ्र्यमनुगच्छन्ति योषितः
verses.transliteration:
śatahradānāṁ lolatvaṁ śastrāṇāṁ tīkṣṇatāṁ tathā
garuḍānilayoḥ śaighryamanugacchanti yoṣitaḥ

translations.english: And women imitate the instability of lightning, the sharpness of weapons, and the celerity of Garuda and the wind.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं तु भवतो भार्या दोषैरेतैर्विवर्जिताः
श्लाघ्या च व्यपदेश्या च यथा देवी ह्यरुन्धती
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ tu bhavato bhāryā doṣairetairvivarjitāḥ
ślāghyā ca vyapadeśyā ca yathā devī hyarundhatī

translations.english: But this wife of yours is absolutely free from all these defects; she is worthy of being extolled and the foremost of those devoted to their lord, like Arundhati among the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अलंकृतोऽयं देशश्च यत्र सौमित्रिणा सह
वैदेह्या चानया राम वत्स्यसि त्वमरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
alaṁkṛto'yaṁ deśaśca yatra saumitriṇā saha
vaidehyā cānayā rāma vatsyasi tvamariṁdama

translations.english: This region, O Rāma, will be adorned, since, O subduer of enemies, you along with Vaidehī and Sumitra's son, will dwell here.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना राघवः संयताञ्जलिः
उवाच प्रश्रितं वाक्यमृषिं दीप्तमिवानलम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu muninā rāghavaḥ saṁyatāñjaliḥ
uvāca praśritaṁ vākyamṛṣiṁ dīptamivānalam

translations.english: Thus addressed by the ascetic, Rāghava, joining his hands, humbly observed to that saint resembling flaming fire,

verses.sanskrit:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुंगवः
गुणैः सभ्रातृभार्यस्य वरदः परितुष्यति
verses.transliteration:
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yasya me munipuṁgavaḥ
guṇaiḥ sabhrātṛbhāryasya varadaḥ parituṣyati

translations.english: Blessed and beholden am I, since the foremost of ascetics is gratified with my merits as well as with those of my brother and wife.

verses.sanskrit:
किं तु व्यादिश मे देशं सोदकं बहुकाननम्
यत्राश्रमपदं कृत्वा वसेयं निरतः सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tu vyādiśa me deśaṁ sodakaṁ bahukānanam
yatrāśramapadaṁ kṛtvā vaseyaṁ nirataḥ sukham

translations.english: Do you now direct me to a country well watered, and abounding in woods, where rearing an asylum, 1 may dwell delightfully and pleasantly.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽब्रवीन्मुनि श्रेष्ठः श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा धीरो धीरतरं वचः
verses.transliteration:
tato'bravīnmuni śreṣṭhaḥ śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
dhyātvā muhūrtaṁ dharmātmā dhīro dhīrataraṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Hearing Rāma's words, that best of ascetics, reflecting for a while, spoke these excellent words.

verses.sanskrit:
इतो द्वियोजने तात बहुमूलफलोदकः
देशो बहुमृगः श्रीमान्पञ्चवट्यभिविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
ito dviyojane tāta bahumūlaphalodakaḥ
deśo bahumṛgaḥ śrīmānpañcavaṭyabhiviśrutaḥ

translations.english: Two Yojanas hence, my child, is a region abounding in fruits and roots, containing countless deer, and beautiful-known by the name of Pancavați.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र गत्वाश्रमपदं कृत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह
रमस्व त्वं पितुर्वाक्यं यथोक्तमनुपालयन्
verses.transliteration:
tatra gatvāśramapadaṁ kṛtvā saumitriṇā saha
ramasva tvaṁ piturvākyaṁ yathoktamanupālayan

translations.english: Repairing thither, do you, rearing an asylum, pass your time pleasantly in company with Sumitrā's son, duly doing the mandate of your sire.

verses.sanskrit:
विदितो ह्येष वृत्तान्तो मम सर्वस्तवानघ
तपसश्च प्रभावेन स्नेहाद्दशरथस्य च
verses.transliteration:
vidito hyeṣa vṛttānto mama sarvastavānagha
tapasaśca prabhāvena snehāddaśarathasya ca

translations.english: O sinless one, all this news relating to yourself, has from affection been known to me through the potency of my asceticism, as also that relating to Dasaratha.

verses.sanskrit:
हृदयस्थश्च ते छन्दो विज्ञातस्तपसा मया
इह वासं प्रतिज्ञाय मया सह तपोवने
verses.transliteration:
hṛdayasthaśca te chando vijñātastapasā mayā
iha vāsaṁ pratijñāya mayā saha tapovane

translations.english: Although you have promised to dwell with me in this ascetic grove, yet by virtue of my asceticism I know the desire that is in your heart.

verses.sanskrit:
अतश्च त्वामहं ब्रूमि गच्छ पञ्चवटीमिति
स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते
verses.transliteration:
ataśca tvāmahaṁ brūmi gaccha pañcavaṭīmiti
sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo maithilī tatra raṁsyate

translations.english: I therefore tell you, repair to Pancavati. That is a charining woodland, and there Mithila's daughter shall dwell with delight.

verses.sanskrit:
स देशः श्लाघनीयश्च नातिदूरे च राघव
गोदावर्याः समीपे च मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते
verses.transliteration:
sa deśaḥ ślāghanīyaśca nātidūre ca rāghava
godāvaryāḥ samīpe ca maithilī tatra raṁsyate

translations.english: And that tract is worthy of all praise, and, O Rāghava, it is not distant from here. It is in the vicinity of the Godāvarī. Mithilā's daughter shall live there agreeably.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राज्यमूलफलैश्चैव नानाद्विज गणैर्युतः
विविक्तश्च महाबाहो पुण्यो रम्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration:
prājyamūlaphalaiścaiva nānādvija gaṇairyutaḥ
viviktaśca mahābāho puṇyo ramyastathaiva ca

translations.english: And that spot abounds in fruits and roots, is frequented by various fowls, is retired, O mighty-armed one, and is sacred and beautiful.

verses.sanskrit:
भवानपि सदारश्च शक्तश्च परिरक्षणे
अपि चात्र वसन्रामस्तापसान्पालयिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
bhavānapi sadāraśca śaktaśca parirakṣaṇe
api cātra vasanrāmastāpasānpālayiṣyasi

translations.english: And you of pure ways, and competent to protect the ascetics, shall, O Rāma protect them.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स्थलमुपारुह्य पर्वतस्याविदूरतः
ख्यातः पञ्चवटीत्येव नित्यपुष्पितकाननः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sthalamupāruhya parvatasyāvidūrataḥ
khyātaḥ pañcavaṭītyeva nityapuṣpitakānanaḥ

translations.english: O hero, yonder is the mighty wood of Madhūkas. Directing your course to the asylum of Nyagrodha trees, go by the north of this Madhūka wood. Then arriving at a spot hard by a hill, (you will) come upon the celebrated Pañcavați, crowned with blossoming woods.

verses.sanskrit:
अगस्त्येनैवमुक्तस्तु रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
सात्कृत्यामन्त्रयामास तमृषिं सत्यवादिनम्
verses.transliteration:
agastyenaivamuktastu rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
sātkṛtyāmantrayāmāsa tamṛṣiṁ satyavādinam

translations.english: Thus accosted by Agastya, Rāma along with Sumitra's son, honouring the truth-speaking saint, greeted him.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ तु तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ कृतपादाभिवन्दनौ
तदाश्रमात्पञ्चवटीं जग्मतुः सह सीतया
