dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca samayaṁ cāpi laukikam
avijñāya kathaṁ bālyānmāmihādya vigarhase

translations.english: Not cognizant of virtue, knowledge, passion and custom, why did you blame me like a child?

verses.sanskrit:
अपृष्ट्वा बुद्धिसंपन्नान्वृद्धानाचार्यसंमतान्
सौम्य वानरचापल्यात्त्वं मां वक्तुमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
apṛṣṭvā buddhisaṁpannānvṛddhānācāryasaṁmatān
saumya vānaracāpalyāttvaṁ māṁ vaktumihecchasi

translations.english: Why did you purpose to address me thus out of fickleness, consequent upon your monkeyhood not asking your wise elders recognized by the preceptors?

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकूणामियं भूमिः सशैलवनकानना
मृगपक्षिमनुष्याणां निग्रहानुग्रहावपि
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākūṇāmiyaṁ bhūmiḥ saśailavanakānanā
mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāṇāṁ nigrahānugrahāvapi

translations.english: This land, abounding in hills and woods, belongs to the lkşwakus. Along with it was conferred on them the power of administering favour and chastisement to beasts, birds and human beings.

verses.sanskrit:
तां पालयति धर्मात्मा भरतः सत्यवागृजुः
धर्मकामार्थतत्त्वज्ञो निग्रहानुग्रहे रतः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ pālayati dharmātmā bharataḥ satyavāgṛjuḥ
dharmakāmārthatattvajño nigrahānugrahe rataḥ

translations.english: The upright, virtuous and truthful king Bharata, cognizant of virtue, knowledge and passion and ever engaged in administering favour and punisl.ment, governs this kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
नयश्च विनयश्चोभौ यस्मिन्सत्यं च सुस्थितम्
विक्रमश्च यथा दृष्टः स राजा देशकालवित्
verses.transliteration:
nayaśca vinayaścobhau yasminsatyaṁ ca susthitam
vikramaśca yathā dṛṣṭaḥ sa rājā deśakālavit

translations.english: That king is said to be cognizant of time and place; in him dwelleth modesty, truthfulness, prowess and a love for discipline.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य धर्मकृतादेशा वयमन्ये च पार्थिवः
चरामो वसुधां कृत्स्नां धर्मसंतानमिच्छवः
verses.transliteration:
tasya dharmakṛtādeśā vayamanye ca pārthivaḥ
carāmo vasudhāṁ kṛtsnāṁ dharmasaṁtānamicchavaḥ

translations.english: Ourselves and other kings, being commanded by him to practise piety, have been journeying in this wide world desirous of multiplying virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नृपतिशार्दूल भरते धर्मवत्सले
पालयत्यखिलां भूमिं कश्चरेद्धर्मनिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
tasminnṛpatiśārdūla bharate dharmavatsale
pālayatyakhilāṁ bhūmiṁ kaścareddharmanigraham

translations.english: That foremost of monarchs, Bharatalover of virtue, governing this entire earth, who dares perpetrate an iniquity.?

verses.sanskrit:
ते वयं मार्गविभ्रष्टं स्वधर्मे परमे स्थिताः
भरताज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य निगृह्णीमो यथाविधि
verses.transliteration:
te vayaṁ mārgavibhraṣṭaṁ svadharme parame sthitāḥ
bharatājñāṁ puraskṛtya nigṛhṇīmo yathāvidhi

translations.english: Stationed in the excellent virtue of our own and placing Bharata's commandments on our heads, we shall consider how we shall punish them who go astray (from the path of virtue).

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं तु संक्लिष्टधर्मा च कर्मणा च विगर्हितः
कामतन्त्रप्रधानश्च न स्थितो राजवर्त्मनि
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ tu saṁkliṣṭadharmā ca karmaṇā ca vigarhitaḥ
kāmatantrapradhānaśca na sthito rājavartmani

translations.english: You have oppressed virtue and perpetrated a gross iniquity. You have placed yourself under the control of your passions and deviated from the track of royal duties.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पिता चैव यश्च विद्यां प्रयच्छति
त्रयस्ते पितरो ज्ञेया धर्मे च पथि वर्तिनः
verses.transliteration:
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitā caiva yaśca vidyāṁ prayacchati
trayaste pitaro jñeyā dharme ca pathi vartinaḥ

translations.english: The elder brother, father, and the instructor—these three should always be regarded in the light of a father if they tread the paths of virtue and morality,

verses.sanskrit:
यवीयानात्मनः पुत्रः शिष्यश्चापि गुणोदितः
पुत्रवत्ते त्रयश्चिन्त्या धर्मश्चेदत्र कारणम्
verses.transliteration:
yavīyānātmanaḥ putraḥ śiṣyaścāpi guṇoditaḥ
putravatte trayaścintyā dharmaścedatra kāraṇam

translations.english: A younger brother, a son and an accomplished follower should always be regarded as sons. And virtue is always at the bottom of all such considerations.

verses.sanskrit:
सूक्ष्मः परमदुर्ज्ञेयः सतां धर्मः प्लवंगम
हृदिस्थः सर्वभूतानामात्मा वेद शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration:
sūkṣmaḥ paramadurjñeyaḥ satāṁ dharmaḥ plavaṁgama
hṛdisthaḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmā veda śubhāśubham

translations.english: O monkey, the religion of the good is indeed very subtle and can comprehend great things the immortal soul can understand what is good or bad.

verses.sanskrit:
चपलश्चपलैः सार्धं वानरैरकृतात्मभिः
जात्यन्ध इव जात्यन्धैर्मन्त्रयन्द्रक्ष्यसे नु किम्
verses.transliteration:
capalaścapalaiḥ sārdhaṁ vānarairakṛtātmabhiḥ
jātyandha iva jātyandhairmantrayandrakṣyase nu kim

translations.english: Fickle as you are, how canst you comprehend what is proper, consulting with your monkey companions who are equally stupid and lighthearted, like to one, born blind, leading with another such?

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तु व्यक्ततामस्य वचनस्य ब्रवीमि ते
न हि मां केवलं रोषात्त्वं विगर्हितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tu vyaktatāmasya vacanasya bravīmi te
na hi māṁ kevalaṁ roṣāttvaṁ vigarhitumarhasi

translations.english: I do fairly speak to you that it is not anger only that has led me to bring about your destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत्कारणं पश्य यदर्थं त्वं मया हतः
भ्रातुर्वर्तसि भार्यायां त्यक्त्वा धर्मं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration:
tadetatkāraṇaṁ paśya yadarthaṁ tvaṁ mayā hataḥ
bhrāturvartasi bhāryāyāṁ tyaktvā dharmaṁ sanātanam

translations.english: Do you consider why I have killed you-you had ravished your brother's wife renouncing that ever-existing virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्य त्वं धरमाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः
रुमायां वर्तसे कामात्स्नुषायां पापकर्मकृत्
verses.transliteration:
asya tvaṁ dharamāṇasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
rumāyāṁ vartase kāmātsnuṣāyāṁ pāpakarmakṛt

translations.english: You, the perpetrator of many evil deeds, have got by Rumā, the wife of your brother-the high-souled Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्व्यतीतस्य ते धर्मात्कामवृत्तस्य वानर
भ्रातृभार्याभिमर्शेऽस्मिन्दण्डोऽयं प्रतिपादितः
verses.transliteration:
tadvyatītasya te dharmātkāmavṛttasya vānara
bhrātṛbhāryābhimarśe'smindaṇḍo'yaṁ pratipāditaḥ

translations.english: O monkey, you had thus violated the path of virtue. And thus I have punished you who have ravished your elder brother's spouse.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि धर्मविरुद्धस्य लोकवृत्तादपेयुषः
दण्डादन्यत्र पश्यामि निग्रहं हरियूथप
verses.transliteration:
na hi dharmaviruddhasya lokavṛttādapeyuṣaḥ
daṇḍādanyatra paśyāmi nigrahaṁ hariyūthapa

translations.english: o you, the leader of monkey-herds-I find no other alternative than to punish him who act against humanity and violates the sacred sanctions of custom.

verses.sanskrit:
औरसीं भगिनीं वापि भार्यां वाप्यनुजस्य यः
प्रचरेत नरः कामात्तस्य दण्डो वधः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration:
aurasīṁ bhaginīṁ vāpi bhāryāṁ vāpyanujasya yaḥ
pracareta naraḥ kāmāttasya daṇḍo vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ

translations.english: I am a Ksatrya coming of a high pedigree. I cannot put up with your immoral conduct. Šāstras sanction the destruction of one who under the influence of passion ravishes his own daughter, sister and younger brother's wife.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्तु महीपालो वयं त्वादेशवर्तिनः
त्वं च धर्मादतिक्रान्तः कथं शक्यमुपेक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
bharatastu mahīpālo vayaṁ tvādeśavartinaḥ
tvaṁ ca dharmādatikrāntaḥ kathaṁ śakyamupekṣitum

translations.english: This is Bharata's commandment-the lord of earth, and we have been satisfying his orders. You have disregarded virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
गुरुधर्मव्यतिक्रान्तं प्राज्ञो धर्मेण पालयन्
भरतः कामवृत्तानां निग्रहे पर्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
gurudharmavyatikrāntaṁ prājño dharmeṇa pālayan
bharataḥ kāmavṛttānāṁ nigrahe paryavasthitaḥ

translations.english: A wise man, living in virtue, cannot let go one who has passed by the sanctions of morality. Bharata has sanctioned the destruction of the amorous; and we, O lord of monkeys, following his orders, thought proper, to encompass the destruction of one like you who has spoliated virtue and morality.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता तदा वानरसंनिधौ
प्रतिज्ञा च कथं शक्या मद्विधेनानवेक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
pratijñā ca mayā dattā tadā vānarasaṁnidhau
pratijñā ca kathaṁ śakyā madvidhenānavekṣitum

translations.english: Like to Laksmana, I have contracted friendship with Sugrīva. And with a view to regain his wife and kingdom, he resolved to engage in my well-being. I too also promised the same before the monkeys. And how can a man of my position neglect to make good his promise?

verses.sanskrit:
तदेभिः कारणैः सर्वैर्महद्भिर्धर्मसंहितैः
शासनं तव यद्युक्तं तद्भवाननुमन्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
tadebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sarvairmahadbhirdharmasaṁhitaiḥ
śāsanaṁ tava yadyuktaṁ tadbhavānanumanyatām

translations.english: For these causes of very great moment, favoured by virtue, I have adininistered to you this condign punishment. Do you now approve it.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा धर्म इत्येव द्रष्टव्यस्तव निग्रहः
वयस्यस्योपकर्तव्यं धर्ममेवानुपश्यता
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā dharma ityeva draṣṭavyastava nigrahaḥ
vayasyasyopakartavyaṁ dharmamevānupaśyatā

translations.english: Your discomfiture is quite of a piece with the sanctions of morality-and to assist friends in one of the codes of religion.

verses.sanskrit:
राजभिर्धृतदण्डास्तु कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः
निर्मलाः स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा
verses.transliteration:
rājabhirdhṛtadaṇḍāstu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ
nirmalāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā

translations.english: Those who, perpetrating iniquity, bear with fortitude the punishment, inflicted by their sovereign get at the abode of the celestials being purified like to the pious. People are freed from their sins, when they confessing their crimes, are either punished or forgiven. But the monarch who does not punish the perpetrator of an evil deed, is visited by a mighty sin.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्येण मम मान्धात्रा व्यसनं घोरमीप्सितम्
श्रमणेन कृते पापे यथा पापं कृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration:
āryeṇa mama māndhātrā vyasanaṁ ghoramīpsitam
śramaṇena kṛte pāpe yathā pāpaṁ kṛtaṁ tvayā

translations.english: Formerly an iniquity, like one perpetrated by you, was committed by a devotee who was punished severely by my forefather Māndhäta.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्यैरपि कृतं पापं प्रमत्तैर्वसुधाधिपैः
प्रायश्चित्तं च कुर्वन्ति तेन तच्छाम्यते रजः
verses.transliteration:
anyairapi kṛtaṁ pāpaṁ pramattairvasudhādhipaiḥ
prāyaścittaṁ ca kurvanti tena tacchāmyate rajaḥ

translations.english: And other lords of earth punish in the same way the authors of misdeeds. What more, the perpetrators of crime, themselves undergo penances and are thus released from their sins.

verses.sanskrit:
तदलं परितापेन धर्मतः परिकल्पितः
वधो वानरशार्दूल न वयं स्ववशे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
tadalaṁ paritāpena dharmataḥ parikalpitaḥ
vadho vānaraśārdūla na vayaṁ svavaśe sthitāḥ

translations.english: Therefore do not repent any more, O best of monkeys. The punishment, I have inflicted on you, is in consonance with the sanctions of morality. We are not our own masters.

verses.sanskrit:
वागुराभिश्च पाशैश्च कूटैश्च विविधैर्नराः
प्रतिच्छन्नाश्च दृश्याश्च गृह्णन्ति सुबहून्मृगान्
प्रधावितान्वा वित्रस्तान्विस्रब्धानतिविष्ठितान्
verses.transliteration:
vāgurābhiśca pāśaiśca kūṭaiśca vividhairnarāḥ
praticchannāśca dṛśyāśca gṛhṇanti subahūnmṛgān
pradhāvitānvā vitrastānvisrabdhānativiṣṭhitān

translations.english: Many persons living on flesh, either lying in ambush, or openly catch and pierce by means of net, noose and trap, many a deer, terrified and trusted, taking to their heels or quarrelling with their companions, careful or careless. They are not to blame in this and I do not cherish, O best of monkeys, any mortification or ire for this.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रमत्तानप्रमत्तान्वा नरा मांसार्थिनो भृशम्
विध्यन्ति विमुखांश्चापि न च दोषोऽत्र विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
pramattānapramattānvā narā māṁsārthino bhṛśam
vidhyanti vimukhāṁścāpi na ca doṣo'tra vidyate

translations.english: And even many royal ascetics, versed in religious lore, go a-hunting; and hence you had been killed by me with a shaft, O monkey, in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
यान्ति राजर्षयश्चात्र मृगयां धर्मकोविदाः
तस्मात्त्वं निहतो युद्धे मया बाणेन वानर
अयुध्यन्प्रतियुध्यन्वा यस्माच्छाखामृगो ह्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yānti rājarṣayaścātra mṛgayāṁ dharmakovidāḥ
tasmāttvaṁ nihato yuddhe mayā bāṇena vānara
ayudhyanpratiyudhyanvā yasmācchākhāmṛgo hyasi

translations.english: And I am justified in killing you, whether you did fight or not since you are a monkey. There is no doubt, O best monkeys, that the monarchs confer life and piety auspicious and hard to attain. It does not therefore behove any one to injure them, to blame them and to use improper words by them-since they are the celestials ranging on this earth under the semblance of man.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं तु धर्ममविज्ञाय केवलं रोषमास्थितः
प्रदूषयसि मां धर्मे पितृपैतामहे स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ tu dharmamavijñāya kevalaṁ roṣamāsthitaḥ
pradūṣayasi māṁ dharme pitṛpaitāmahe sthitam

translations.english: Not knowing virtue and growing angry why did you blame me who am following the religion of my forefathers?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वाली प्रव्यथितो भृशम्
प्रत्युवाच ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिर्वानरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam
pratyuvāca tato rāmaṁ prāñjalirvānareśvaraḥ

translations.english: Thereupon that lord of monkeys spoke to Răma, with folded hands, saying:-There is not the least doubt, О best of men, in all that you had said.

verses.sanskrit:
यदयुक्तं मया पूर्वं प्रमादाद्वाक्यमप्रियम्
तत्रापि खलु मे दोषं कर्तुं नार्हसि राघव
verses.transliteration:
yadayuktaṁ mayā pūrvaṁ pramādādvākyamapriyam
tatrāpi khalu me doṣaṁ kartuṁ nārhasi rāghava

translations.english: An inferior person can by no means address his superior improperly. It does not behove you, O Rāghava, therefore to blame me for those unpleasant words which I used towards you, out of foolishness. You have acquired a practical mastery over the principles of religion and are ever engaged in the welfare of your subjects. Your eternal power of ascertaining the crime and meeting its condign punishment is perfectly clear.

verses.sanskrit:
मामप्यवगतं धर्माद्व्यतिक्रान्तपुरस्कृतम्
धर्मसंहितया वाचा धर्मज्ञ परिपालय
verses.transliteration:
māmapyavagataṁ dharmādvyatikrāntapuraskṛtam
dharmasaṁhitayā vācā dharmajña paripālaya

translations.english: Do you know me as the foremost of sinners and one who has deviated from the track of imorality. Do you conduct me, with pious words, to a better land.

verses.sanskrit:
बाष्पसंरुद्धकण्ठस्तु वाली सार्तरवः शनैः
उवाच रामं संप्रेक्ष्य पङ्कलग्न इव द्विपः
verses.transliteration:
bāṣpasaṁruddhakaṇṭhastu vālī sārtaravaḥ śanaiḥ
uvāca rāmaṁ saṁprekṣya paṅkalagna iva dvipaḥ

translations.english: Vāli, having his throat choked with vapour, addressed again and again, Rāma, with piteous accents, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वात्मानमहं शोचे न तारां नापि बान्धवान्
यथा पुत्रं गुणश्रेष्ठमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम्
verses.transliteration:
na tvātmānamahaṁ śoce na tārāṁ nāpi bāndhavān
yathā putraṁ guṇaśreṣṭhamaṅgadaṁ kanakāṅgadam

translations.english: I do not mourn so much for me, Tāră, or other friends as for my son Angada, eldest and wearing a golden Angada* *A bracelet worn on the upper arm.

verses.sanskrit:
स ममादर्शनाद्दीनो बाल्यात्प्रभृति लालितः
तटाक इव पीताम्बुरुपशोषं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sa mamādarśanāddīno bālyātprabhṛti lālitaḥ
taṭāka iva pītāmburupaśoṣaṁ gamiṣyati

translations.english: Brought up by me from his very infancy, he shall by my separation, wear away like to a pond having its liquid contents drunk up by an elephant.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवे चाङ्गदे चैव विधत्स्व मतिमुत्तमाम्
त्वं हि शास्ता च गोप्ता च कार्याकार्यविधौ स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
sugrīve cāṅgade caiva vidhatsva matimuttamām
tvaṁ hi śāstā ca goptā ca kāryākāryavidhau sthitaḥ

translations.english: Do you regard favourable Sugrīva and Angada. You are their protector, and chastiser punishing them for their sins.

verses.sanskrit:
या ते नरपते वृत्तिर्भरते लक्ष्मणे च या
सुग्रीवे चाङ्गदे राजंस्तां चिन्तयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yā te narapate vṛttirbharate lakṣmaṇe ca yā
sugrīve cāṅgade rājaṁstāṁ cintayitumarhasi

translations.english: O king, O lord of men, it behoveth you to regard Sugrīva and Angada in the same light in which you regardest Bharata and Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्दोषकृतदोषां तां यथा तारां तपस्विनीम्
सुग्रीवो नावमन्येत तथावस्थातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
maddoṣakṛtadoṣāṁ tāṁ yathā tārāṁ tapasvinīm
sugrīvo nāvamanyeta tathāvasthātumarhasi

translations.english: It behoveth you to so arrange as Sugrīva may not disregard that chaste Tārā who is blameable for my folly only.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया ह्यनुगृहीतेन शक्यं राज्यमुपासितुम्
त्वद्वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्तानुवर्तिना
verses.transliteration:
tvayā hyanugṛhītena śakyaṁ rājyamupāsitum
tvadvaśe vartamānena tava cittānuvartinā

translations.english: He, who is favoured by you, abideth by yourcommandments and acteth after your heart, can acquire kingdom, attain to heaven, and govern the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम
वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः
verses.transliteration:
na vayaṁ bhavatā cintyā nāpyātmā harisattama
vayaṁ bhavadviśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ

translations.english: Having addressed Rāma thus the lord of monkeys stopped. Thereupon Rāma consoled Vāli, of clear understanding with the following moral words, acceptable to the Saints. O best of monkeys, do you not consider ourselves as well as yourself blameable. We are more conversant, than you, with the principles of religion.

verses.sanskrit:
दण्ड्ये यः पातयेद्दण्डं दण्ड्यो यश्चापि दण्ड्यते
कार्यकारणसिद्धार्थावुभौ तौ नावसीदतः
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍye yaḥ pātayeddaṇḍaṁ daṇḍyo yaścāpi daṇḍyate
kāryakāraṇasiddhārthāvubhau tau nāvasīdataḥ

translations.english: They never lose their virtue being proficient in the mode of ascerting crime and punishing it one administering punishment to the criminal and the criminal receiving it. And therefore receiving punishment (from me) you had been released from your sins and acquired a knowledge of religion.

verses.sanskrit:
स तस्य वाक्यं मधुरं महात्मनः; समाहितं धर्मपथानुवर्तिनः
निशम्य रामस्य रणावमर्दिनो; वचः सुयुक्तं निजगाद वानरः
verses.transliteration:
sa tasya vākyaṁ madhuraṁ mahātmanaḥ; samāhitaṁ dharmapathānuvartinaḥ
niśamya rāmasya raṇāvamardino; vacaḥ suyuktaṁ nijagāda vānaraḥ

translations.english: Hearing these sweet, collected and pious words of the high-souled Rāma,-the repressor of the enemies in a battle,-the monkey again addressed him with the following pregnant words.

verses.sanskrit:
शराभितप्तेन विचेतसा मया; प्रदूषितस्त्वं यदजानता प्रभो
इदं महेन्द्रोपमभीमविक्रम; प्रसादितस्त्वं क्षम मे महीश्वर
verses.transliteration:
śarābhitaptena vicetasā mayā; pradūṣitastvaṁ yadajānatā prabho
idaṁ mahendropamabhīmavikrama; prasāditastvaṁ kṣama me mahīśvara

translations.english: O lord, O you having Mahendra's prowess, I do propitiate you for my having insulted you with improper words, senseless as I was being wounded by shafts. Do you forgive me, O lord of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
स वानरमहाराजः शयानः शरविक्षतः
प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद्वाक्यैर्नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
sa vānaramahārājaḥ śayānaḥ śaravikṣataḥ
pratyukto hetumadvākyairnottaraṁ pratyapadyata

translations.english: Being thus accosted with reasonable words, that lord, of monkeys, lying on the ground and wounded with shafts, gave no reply.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्मभिः परिभिन्नाङ्गः पादपैराहतो भृशम्
रामबाणेन चाक्रान्तो जीवितान्ते मुमोह सः
verses.transliteration:
aśmabhiḥ paribhinnāṅgaḥ pādapairāhato bhṛśam
rāmabāṇena cākrānto jīvitānte mumoha saḥ

translations.english: Having his limbs dissevered by stones, being struck with trees and wounded by Rama's shaft, he became senseless at the approach of death.

verses.sanskrit:
तं भार्याबाणमोक्षेण रामदत्तेन संयुगे
हतं प्लवगशार्दूलं तारा शुश्राव वालिनम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ bhāryābāṇamokṣeṇa rāmadattena saṁyuge
hataṁ plavagaśārdūlaṁ tārā śuśrāva vālinam

translations.english: His spouse Tārā heard that Váli, the foremost of monkeys, had been killed in the conflict by Rāma's shaft.

verses.sanskrit:
सा सपुत्राप्रियं श्रुत्वा वधं भर्तुः सुदारुणम्
निष्पपात भृशं त्रस्ता विविधाद्गिरिगह्वरात्
verses.transliteration:
sā saputrāpriyaṁ śrutvā vadhaṁ bhartuḥ sudāruṇam
niṣpapāta bhṛśaṁ trastā vividhādgirigahvarāt

translations.english: Hearing the heart-rending news of her husband's demise, she, big with a child, issued out of the mountain cave with a troubled heart.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वङ्गदपरीवारा वानरा हि महाबलाः
ते सकार्मुकमालोक्य रामं त्रस्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration:
ye tvaṅgadaparīvārā vānarā hi mahābalāḥ
te sakārmukamālokya rāmaṁ trastāḥ pradudruvuḥ

translations.english: And beholding Rāma with a bow in his hand, the mighty monkeys, followers of Angada, fled away, terrified.

verses.sanskrit:
सा ददर्श ततस्त्रस्तान्हरीनापततो द्रुतम्
यूथादिव परिभ्रष्टान्मृगान्निहतयूथपान्
verses.transliteration:
sā dadarśa tatastrastānharīnāpatato drutam
yūthādiva paribhraṣṭānmṛgānnihatayūthapān

translations.english: Thereupon Tārā observed those monkeys flying away terrified like to deer alienated from their herd, having lost their king.

verses.sanskrit:
तानुवाच समासाद्य दुःखितान्दुःखिता सती
राम वित्रासितान्सर्वाननुबद्धानिवेषुभिः
verses.transliteration:
tānuvāca samāsādya duḥkhitānduḥkhitā satī
rāma vitrāsitānsarvānanubaddhāniveṣubhiḥ

translations.english: The chaste lady, racked with sorrow, spoke to those monkeys, afraid of Rāma, wounded with shafts and exercised with grief, saying,

verses.sanskrit:
वानरा राजसिंहस्य यस्य यूयं पुरःसराः
तं विहाय सुवित्रस्ताः कस्माद्द्रवत दुर्गताः
verses.transliteration:
vānarā rājasiṁhasya yasya yūyaṁ puraḥsarāḥ
taṁ vihāya suvitrastāḥ kasmāddravata durgatāḥ

translations.english: O monkeys, why are you flying away, terrified and distressed, leaving behind that foremost of kings before whom you were used to fight?

verses.sanskrit:
राज्यहेतोः स चेद्भ्राता भ्राता रौद्रेण पातितः
रामेण प्रसृतैर्दूरान्मार्गणैर्दूर पातिभिः
verses.transliteration:
rājyahetoḥ sa cedbhrātā bhrātā raudreṇa pātitaḥ
rāmeṇa prasṛtairdūrānmārgaṇairdūra pātibhiḥ

translations.english: Hath Vāli been killed by Rāma, waiting at a distance with fleet and distant-coursing shafts, being requested by Sugrīva for kingdom?

verses.sanskrit:
कपिपत्न्या वचः श्रुत्वा कपयः कामरूपिणः
प्राप्तकालमविश्लिष्टमूचुर्वचनमङ्गनाम्
verses.transliteration:
kapipatnyā vacaḥ śrutvā kapayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
prāptakālamaviśliṣṭamūcurvacanamaṅganām

translations.english: Hearing the words of that wife of the monkey, they, wearing shapes at will, addressed that damsel with words, worthy of being said on that occasion,

verses.sanskrit:
जीव पुत्रे निवर्तस्य पुत्रं रक्षस्व चान्दगम्
अन्तको राम रूपेण हत्वा नयति वालिनम्
verses.transliteration:
jīva putre nivartasya putraṁ rakṣasva cāndagam
antako rāma rūpeṇa hatvā nayati vālinam

translations.english: O you, having your son alive, do you go back and bring up your son Angada. Death himself, under Rāma's semblance, has snatched away Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्तान्वृक्षान्समाविध्य विपुलाश्च शिलास्तथा
वाली वज्रसमैर्बाणैर्वज्रेणेव निपातितः
verses.transliteration:
kṣiptānvṛkṣānsamāvidhya vipulāśca śilāstathā
vālī vajrasamairbāṇairvajreṇeva nipātitaḥ

translations.english: He was killed by (Rāma's) shafts, resembling thunderbolts as if clapped by thunder itself, having bored trees and big stones (hurled by Vali).

verses.sanskrit:
अभिद्रुतमिदं सर्वं विद्रुतं प्रसृतं बलम्
अस्मिन्प्लवगशार्दूले हते शक्रसमप्रभे
verses.transliteration:
abhidrutamidaṁ sarvaṁ vidrutaṁ prasṛtaṁ balam
asminplavagaśārdūle hate śakrasamaprabhe

translations.english: That king of monkeys, having Sakra's prowess, being made away with this host of monkeys have been taking to their heels being overwhelmed with consternation.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्ष्यतां नगरं शूरैरङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्
पदस्थं वालिनः पुत्रं भजिष्यन्ति प्लवंगमाः
verses.transliteration:
rakṣyatāṁ nagaraṁ śūrairaṅgadaścābhiṣicyatām
padasthaṁ vālinaḥ putraṁ bhajiṣyanti plavaṁgamāḥ

translations.english: Let the heroes defend the city and install Angada on the throne. And on his being installed the monkeys shall serve Vāli's son.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा रुचिरं स्थानमिह ते रुचिरानने
आविशन्ति हि दुर्गाणि क्षिप्रमद्यैव वानराः
verses.transliteration:
atha vā ruciraṁ sthānamiha te rucirānane
āviśanti hi durgāṇi kṣipramadyaiva vānarāḥ

translations.english: O you having a fine countenance, the monkeys shall enter this stronghold, although it is a favourite place with you. Herein dwell many forest-rangers, wifeless and having wives. And we are really afraid of them, avaricious, and formerly deprived of their wealth by us.

verses.sanskrit:
अल्पान्तरगतानां तु श्रुत्वा वचनमङ्गना
आत्मनः प्रतिरूपं सा बभाषे चारुहासिनी
verses.transliteration:
alpāntaragatānāṁ tu śrutvā vacanamaṅganā
ātmanaḥ pratirūpaṁ sā babhāṣe cāruhāsinī

translations.english: Hearing those words of the monkeys, lying at a little distance, that lady, smiling sweet, spoke to them, words worthy of herself.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रेण मम किं कार्यं किं राज्येन किमात्मना
कपिसिंहे महाभागे तस्मिन्भर्तरि नश्यति
verses.transliteration:
putreṇa mama kiṁ kāryaṁ kiṁ rājyena kimātmanā
kapisiṁhe mahābhāge tasminbhartari naśyati

translations.english: That great lord of monkeys, my husband, being dead, what shall I do with my son, my kingdom and myself?

verses.sanskrit:
पादमूलं गमिष्यामि तस्यैवाहं महात्मनः
योऽसौ रामप्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः
verses.transliteration:
pādamūlaṁ gamiṣyāmi tasyaivāhaṁ mahātmanaḥ
yo'sau rāmaprayuktena śareṇa vinipātitaḥ

translations.english: I shall place myself at the feet of that highsouled one, who has been killed by Rama's shaft.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदती शोककर्शिता
शिरश्चोरश्च बाहुभ्यां दुःखेन समभिघ्नती
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā pradudrāva rudatī śokakarśitā
śiraścoraśca bāhubhyāṁ duḥkhena samabhighnatī

translations.english: Having said this, (Tara) proceeded, overwhelmed with grief, weeping and striking her head with her hands.

verses.sanskrit:
नागहेतोः सुपर्णेन चैत्यमुन्मथितं यथा
अवष्टभ्यावतिष्ठन्तं ददर्श धनुरूर्जितम्
verses.transliteration:
nāgahetoḥ suparṇena caityamunmathitaṁ yathā
avaṣṭabhyāvatiṣṭhantaṁ dadarśa dhanurūrjitam

translations.english: She espied Rāma reclining his person on a mighty bow, his younger brother and her husband's younger brother.

verses.sanskrit:
रामं रामानुजं चैव भर्तुश्चैवानुजं शुभा
तानतीत्य समासाद्य भर्तारं निहतं रणे
verses.transliteration:
rāmaṁ rāmānujaṁ caiva bhartuścaivānujaṁ śubhā
tānatītya samāsādya bhartāraṁ nihataṁ raṇe

translations.english: Passing them by and getting at her husband and beholding him killed in battle, she, losing her sense, fell down to the ground.

verses.sanskrit: विषादमगमत्कष्टं दृष्ट्वा चाङ्गदमागतम्
verses.transliteration: viṣādamagamatkaṣṭaṁ dṛṣṭvā cāṅgadamāgatam

translations.english: And beholding Tārā like to a she-elephant and Angada, bewailing in this wise, Sugrīva attained to an excess of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
रामचापविसृष्टेन शरेणान्तकरेण तम्
दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भूमौ तारा ताराधिपानना
verses.transliteration:
rāmacāpavisṛṣṭena śareṇāntakareṇa tam
dṛṣṭvā vinihataṁ bhūmau tārā tārādhipānanā

translations.english: Beholding her husband lying dead on the ground with the life-destroying shafts of Rama, Tārā, having a moon-like countenance, approaching, embraced him. And seeing him slain with shafts like to an elephant, resembling a lord mountains and an uprooted tree, Tārā, racked with grief began to bewail.

verses.sanskrit:
रणे दारुणविक्रान्त प्रवीर प्लवतां वर
किं दीनामपुरोभागामद्य त्वं नाभिभाषसे
verses.transliteration:
raṇe dāruṇavikrānta pravīra plavatāṁ vara
kiṁ dīnāmapurobhāgāmadya tvaṁ nābhibhāṣase

translations.english: O hero, O foremost of monkeys, O powerful one, O you terrible in warfare, why did you not welcome me to-day who am guilty of some iniquity by you?

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठ हरिशार्दूल भजस्व शयनोत्तमम्
नैवंविधाः शेरते हि भूमौ नृपतिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭha hariśārdūla bhajasva śayanottamam
naivaṁvidhāḥ śerate hi bhūmau nṛpatisattamāḥ

translations.english: Rise, O best of monkeys, and lie down on a better bed; monarchs do not stretch themselves on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
अतीव खलु ते कान्ता वसुधा वसुधाधिप
गतासुरपि यां गात्रैर्मां विहाय निषेवसे
verses.transliteration:
atīva khalu te kāntā vasudhā vasudhādhipa
gatāsurapi yāṁ gātrairmāṁ vihāya niṣevase

translations.english: O lord of earth, indeed earth is your favourite wife; since renouncing me, you, though dead, are serving her with your body.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यक्तमन्या त्वया वीर धर्मतः संप्रवर्तता
किष्किन्धेव पुरी रम्या स्वर्गमार्गे विनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration:
vyaktamanyā tvayā vīra dharmataḥ saṁpravartatā
kiṣkindheva purī ramyā svargamārge vinirmitā

translations.english: Evident it is, O hero, that while engaged in a lawful conflict, you hadst created another city of Kiskindha, in the region of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
यान्यस्माभिस्त्वया सार्धं वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु
विहृतानि त्वया काले तेषामुपरमः कृतः
verses.transliteration:
yānyasmābhistvayā sārdhaṁ vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu
vihṛtāni tvayā kāle teṣāmuparamaḥ kṛtaḥ

translations.english: All your enjoyments with me in nectarsmelling woods, have been brought to a close.

verses.sanskrit:
निरानन्दा निराशाहं निमग्ना शोकसागरे
त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने महायूथपयूथपे
verses.transliteration:
nirānandā nirāśāhaṁ nimagnā śokasāgare
tvayi pañcatvamāpanne mahāyūthapayūthape

translations.english: You, the lord of monkey-herds, being slain, I am deprived of joy and hope and am sunk in the abyss of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
हृदयं सुस्थिरं मह्यं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भुवि
यन्न शोकाभिसंतप्तं स्फुटतेऽद्य सहस्रधा
verses.transliteration:
hṛdayaṁ susthiraṁ mahyaṁ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṁ bhuvi
yanna śokābhisaṁtaptaṁ sphuṭate'dya sahasradhā

translations.english: Forsooth, my heart is uncommon hard, since beholding you on the ground it has not been sundered into thousand pieces being overwhelmed with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवस्य त्वया भार्या हृता स च विवासितः
यत्तत्तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्तेयं प्लवगाधिप
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvasya tvayā bhāryā hṛtā sa ca vivāsitaḥ
yattattasya tvayā vyuṣṭiḥ prāpteyaṁ plavagādhipa

translations.english: Sugrīva's wife was carried away and banished by you and this is the result of your action, O foremost of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
निःश्रेयसपरा मोहात्त्वया चाहं विगर्हिता
यैषाब्रुवं हितं वाक्यं वानरेन्द्रहितैषिणी
verses.transliteration:
niḥśreyasaparā mohāttvayā cāhaṁ vigarhitā
yaiṣābruvaṁ hitaṁ vākyaṁ vānarendrahitaiṣiṇī

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, out of your ignorance you didst neglect all my well meaning words which I said, being intent on your welfare and benefit.

verses.sanskrit:
कालो निःसंशयो नूनं जीवितान्तकरस्तव
बलाद्येनावपन्नोऽसि सुग्रीवस्यावशो वशम्
verses.transliteration:
kālo niḥsaṁśayo nūnaṁ jīvitāntakarastava
balādyenāvapanno'si sugrīvasyāvaśo vaśam

translations.english: Forsooth, you had been by force brought under the control of Kāla, since you had been discomfited by Sugrīva, albeit you are above the control of others.

verses.sanskrit:
वैधव्यं शोकसंतापं कृपणं कृपणा सती
अदुःखोपचिता पूर्वं वर्तयिष्याम्यनाथवत्
verses.transliteration:
vaidhavyaṁ śokasaṁtāpaṁ kṛpaṇaṁ kṛpaṇā satī
aduḥkhopacitā pūrvaṁ vartayiṣyāmyanāthavat

translations.english: Unused to miseries before how shall I, being an object commiseration, put up like one helpless, with my widow-hood and grief.

verses.sanskrit:
लालितश्चाङ्गदो वीरः सुकुमारः सुखोचितः
वत्स्यते कामवस्थां मे पितृव्ये क्रोधमूर्छिते
verses.transliteration:
lālitaścāṅgado vīraḥ sukumāraḥ sukhocitaḥ
vatsyate kāmavasthāṁ me pitṛvye krodhamūrchite

translations.english: How shall the heroic and youthful Angada, brought up in luxury and happiness, be regarded by his uncle, senseless with wrath?

verses.sanskrit:
कुरुष्व पितरं पुत्र सुदृष्टं धर्मवत्सलम्
दुर्लभं दर्शनं त्वस्य तव वत्स भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
kuruṣva pitaraṁ putra sudṛṣṭaṁ dharmavatsalam
durlabhaṁ darśanaṁ tvasya tava vatsa bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Do you cast for good, O my son, your looks towards your pious sire, for since now it will be hard for you to see him again.

verses.sanskrit:
समाश्वासय पुत्रं त्वं संदेशं संदिशस्व च
मूर्ध्नि चैनं समाघ्राय प्रवासं प्रस्थितो ह्यसि
verses.transliteration:
samāśvāsaya putraṁ tvaṁ saṁdeśaṁ saṁdiśasva ca
mūrdhni cainaṁ samāghrāya pravāsaṁ prasthito hyasi

translations.english: Do you console your son, favour me with orders, smell his head, as you are going to journey in a foreign land.

verses.sanskrit:
रामेण हि महत्कर्म कृतं त्वामभिनिघ्नता
आनृण्यं तु गतं तस्य सुग्रीवस्य प्रतिश्रवे
verses.transliteration:
rāmeṇa hi mahatkarma kṛtaṁ tvāmabhinighnatā
ānṛṇyaṁ tu gataṁ tasya sugrīvasya pratiśrave

translations.english: By destroying you, Rāma, has performed a great action, since by this he has been released from his vow to Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमां त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे
भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमनुद्विग्नः शस्तो भ्राता रिपुस्तव
verses.transliteration:
sakāmo bhava sugrīva rumāṁ tvaṁ pratipatsyase
bhuṅkṣva rājyamanudvignaḥ śasto bhrātā ripustava

translations.english: O Sugrīva, do you gain your ends and get back your Rumā, devoid of anxiety do you govern your kingdom-your enemy, the brother has been slain.

verses.sanskrit:
किं मामेवं विलपतीं प्रेंणा त्वं नाभिभाषसे
इमाः पश्य वरा बह्वीर्भार्यास्ते वानरेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ māmevaṁ vilapatīṁ preṁṇā tvaṁ nābhibhāṣase
imāḥ paśya varā bahvīrbhāryāste vānareśvara

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, why did you not welcome me, your beloved spouse, who am bewailing thus? Behold, your other wives are also mourning in the same wise.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्या विलपितं श्रुत्वा वानर्यः सर्वतश्च ताः
परिगृह्याङ्गदं दीनं दुःखार्ताः परिचुक्रुशुः
verses.transliteration:
tasyā vilapitaṁ śrutvā vānaryaḥ sarvataśca tāḥ
parigṛhyāṅgadaṁ dīnaṁ duḥkhārtāḥ paricukruśuḥ

translations.english: Hearing the bewailings of that she-monkey, others, taking Angada, distressed and overwhelmed with grief, began to cry piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
किमङ्गदं साङ्गद वीर बाहो; विहाय यास्यद्य चिरप्रवासं
न युक्तमेवं गुणसंनिकृष्टं; विहाय पुत्रं प्रियपुत्र गन्तुम्
verses.transliteration:
kimaṅgadaṁ sāṅgada vīra bāho; vihāya yāsyadya cirapravāsaṁ
na yuktamevaṁ guṇasaṁnikṛṣṭaṁ; vihāya putraṁ priyaputra gantum

translations.english: O hero, having Arigada on your arms, why are you proceeding on a journey for good in a foreign land leaving behind (your son) Angada. It does not behove you (to leave aside) your dear son, gifted with diverse accomplishments and wearing a charming and beautiful cloth.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्रियं किंचिदसंप्रधार्य; कृतं मया स्यात्तव दीर्घबाहो
क्षमस्व मे तद्धरिवंश नाथ; व्रजामि मूर्ध्ना तव वीर पादौ
verses.transliteration:
yadyapriyaṁ kiṁcidasaṁpradhārya; kṛtaṁ mayā syāttava dīrghabāho
kṣamasva me taddharivaṁśa nātha; vrajāmi mūrdhnā tava vīra pādau

translations.english: you of long arms, O lord of monkeys, if I have offended you in any way, do you forgive me, after ascertaining my crime.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तु तारा करुणं रुदन्ती; भर्तुः समीपे सह वानरीभिः
व्यवस्यत प्रायमनिन्द्यवर्णा; उपोपवेष्टुं भुवि यत्र वाली
verses.transliteration:
tathā tu tārā karuṇaṁ rudantī; bhartuḥ samīpe saha vānarībhiḥ
vyavasyata prāyamanindyavarṇā; upopaveṣṭuṁ bhuvi yatra vālī

translations.english: O hero, I touch your feet with my head. Bewailing thus piteously with other sbemonkeys, Tārā, having a blameless countenance, stationing herself where Vāli was, resolved to put an end to her being by fastings.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निपतितां तारां च्युतां तारामिवाम्बरात्
शनैराश्वासयामास हनूमान्हरियूथपः
verses.transliteration:
tato nipatitāṁ tārāṁ cyutāṁ tārāmivāmbarāt
śanairāśvāsayāmāsa hanūmānhariyūthapaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon beholding Tārā fallen (on the ground) like to a star dropt down from the sky, Hanumān, the lord of monkey-herds, consoled her again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
गुणदोषकृतं जन्तुः स्वकर्मफलहेतुकम्
अव्यग्रस्तदवाप्नोति सर्वं प्रेत्य शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration:
guṇadoṣakṛtaṁ jantuḥ svakarmaphalahetukam
avyagrastadavāpnoti sarvaṁ pretya śubhāśubham

translations.english: Animals unagitated, attain to happiness or misery, as an outcome of their actions performed (in their previous existence) by merits or demerits.

verses.sanskrit:
शोच्या शोचसि कं शोच्यं दीनं दीनानुकम्पसे
कश्च कस्यानुशोच्योऽस्ति देहेऽस्मिन्बुद्बुदोपमे
verses.transliteration:
śocyā śocasi kaṁ śocyaṁ dīnaṁ dīnānukampase
kaśca kasyānuśocyo'sti dehe'sminbudbudopame

translations.english: Why did you mourn for others, yourself being an object of mourning? Why did you feel commiseration for the poor, yourself being poorly? In this body like to a bubble who is there who mourneth for another?

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदस्तु कुमारोऽयं द्रष्टव्यो जीवपुत्रया
आयत्या च विधेयानि समर्थान्यस्य चिन्तय
verses.transliteration:
aṅgadastu kumāro'yaṁ draṣṭavyo jīvaputrayā
āyatyā ca vidheyāni samarthānyasya cintaya

translations.english: It behoveth you now, O you having your son alive, to look after prince Angada and think of those duties which remain to be executed by you (after the demise of Vāli).

verses.sanskrit:
जानास्यनियतामेवं भूतानामागतिं गतिम्
तस्माच्छुभं हि कर्तव्यं पण्डिते नैहलौकिकम्
verses.transliteration:
jānāsyaniyatāmevaṁ bhūtānāmāgatiṁ gatim
tasmācchubhaṁ hi kartavyaṁ paṇḍite naihalaukikam

translations.english: Do you know that life and death of the animals is very unsettled. It is therefore proper to perform what tends to the welfare of after-life. It does not behove you, O learned damsel, to mourn like others.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मिन्हरिसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च
वर्तयन्ति कृतांशानि सोऽयं दिष्टान्तमागतः
verses.transliteration:
yasminharisahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca
vartayanti kṛtāṁśāni so'yaṁ diṣṭāntamāgataḥ

translations.english: He even, who (while living) was surrounded by thousands of monkeys cherishing hopes, has met his destined end.

verses.sanskrit:
यदयं न्यायदृष्टार्थः सामदानक्षमापरः
गतो धर्मजितां भूमिं नैनं शोचितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yadayaṁ nyāyadṛṣṭārthaḥ sāmadānakṣamāparaḥ
gato dharmajitāṁ bhūmiṁ nainaṁ śocitumarhasi

translations.english: This hero discharged his royal duties in consonance with the sanctions of morality and was gifted with various kingly accomplishments such as conciliation, clarity and forgiveness. He has attained to the land of kings and it becomes you not to mourn for him.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे च हरिशार्दूल पुत्रश्चायं तवाङ्गदः
हर्यृष्कपतिराज्यं च त्वत्सनाथमनिन्दिते
verses.transliteration:
sarve ca hariśārdūla putraścāyaṁ tavāṅgadaḥ
haryṛṣkapatirājyaṁ ca tvatsanāthamanindite

translations.english: O blameless damsel, all these foremost of monkeys, this your son Angada, this kingdom of the monkey chief, do belong to you.

verses.sanskrit:
ताविमौ शोकसंतप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि
त्वया परिगृहीतोऽयमङ्गदः शास्तु मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
tāvimau śokasaṁtaptau śanaiḥ preraya bhāmini
tvayā parigṛhīto'yamaṅgadaḥ śāstu medinīm

translations.english: Do you soon despatch, O passionate lady, these two (Angada and Sugrīva) exercised with grief as they are (for the performance of Vali's funeral rites). And abiding by your commandments let Angada govern the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
संततिश्च यथादृष्टा कृत्यं यच्चापि साम्प्रतम्
राज्ञस्तत्क्रियतां सर्वमेष कालस्य निश्चयः
verses.transliteration:
saṁtatiśca yathādṛṣṭā kṛtyaṁ yaccāpi sāmpratam
rājñastatkriyatāṁ sarvameṣa kālasya niścayaḥ

translations.english: Let Angada perform all those ceremonies, which should be gone through by sons according to the Šāstras and which are for the well-being of the king; this is the time for the performance of those funeral rites.

verses.sanskrit:
संस्कार्यो हरिराजस्तु अङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्
सिंहासनगतं पुत्रं पश्यन्ती शान्तिमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
saṁskāryo harirājastu aṅgadaścābhiṣicyatām
siṁhāsanagataṁ putraṁ paśyantī śāntimeṣyasi

translations.english: Performing the funeral ceremonies of the lord of monkeys do you install Angada. And beholding your son thus established on the throne you shall be able to pacify your grief?

verses.sanskrit:
सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता
अब्रवीदुत्तरं तारा हनूमन्तमवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
sā tasya vacanaṁ śrutvā bhartṛvyasanapīḍitā
abravīduttaraṁ tārā hanūmantamavasthitam

translations.english: Hearing those words of Hanumān, Tārā, racked with grief consequent upon the loss of her lord, bespake him who was standing there:

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गद प्रतिरूपाणां पुत्राणामेकतः शतम्
हतस्याप्यस्य वीरस्य गात्रसंश्लेषणं वरम्
verses.transliteration:
aṅgada pratirūpāṇāṁ putrāṇāmekataḥ śatam
hatasyāpyasya vīrasya gātrasaṁśleṣaṇaṁ varam

translations.english: I would rather die with this hero who has been slain than have hundred sons like Angada.

verses.sanskrit:
न चाहं हरिराजस्य प्रभवाम्यङ्गदस्य वा
पितृव्यस्तस्य सुग्रीवः सर्वकार्येष्वनन्तरः
verses.transliteration:
na cāhaṁ harirājasya prabhavāmyaṅgadasya vā
pitṛvyastasya sugrīvaḥ sarvakāryeṣvanantaraḥ

translations.english: I cannot myself govern this kingdom nor can I confer it upon Angada. Such duty-devolves upon his (Angada's) uncle Sugrīva now.

verses.sanskrit:
न ह्येषा बुद्धिरास्थेया हनूमन्नङ्गदं प्रति
पिता हि बन्धुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरिसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
na hyeṣā buddhirāstheyā hanūmannaṅgadaṁ prati
pitā hi bandhuḥ putrasya na mātā harisattama

translations.english: O Hanumān, do you not consider that I shall confer this kingdom upon Angada-0 best of monkeys, father is son's friend (in this respect) not mother.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मम हरिराजसंश्रया;त्क्षमतरमस्ति परत्र चेह वा
अभिमुखहतवीरसेवितं; शयनमिदं मम सेवितुं क्षमम्
verses.transliteration:
na hi mama harirājasaṁśrayā;tkṣamataramasti paratra ceha vā
abhimukhahatavīrasevitaṁ; śayanamidaṁ mama sevituṁ kṣamam

translations.english: There is no other resource for me tending to my welfare both in this world and the next than taking refuge to this lord of monkeys. It is becoming for me to serve this bed which has been resorted to by the hero, slain (and lying before me.) monkeys, father is son's friend (in this respect) not mother.

verses.sanskrit:
वीक्षमाणस्तु मन्दासुः सर्वतो मन्दमुच्छ्वसन्
आदावेव तु सुग्रीवं ददर्श त्वात्मजाग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
vīkṣamāṇastu mandāsuḥ sarvato mandamucchvasan
ādāveva tu sugrīvaṁ dadarśa tvātmajāgrataḥ

translations.english: Vāli, ranging on the verge of death, casting his looks arounds and sighing faintly, espied his younger brother Sugrīva before him.

verses.sanskrit:
तं प्राप्तविजयं वाली सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्
आभाष्य व्यक्तया वाचा सस्नेहमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ prāptavijayaṁ vālī sugrīvaṁ plavageśvaram
ābhāṣya vyaktayā vācā sasnehamidamabravīt

translations.english: Welcoming that lord of monkeys with clear accents, Vāli addressed him affectionately saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवदोषेण न मां गन्तुमर्हसि किल्बिषात्
कृष्यमाणं भविष्येण बुद्धिमोहेन मां बलात्
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvadoṣeṇa na māṁ gantumarhasi kilbiṣāt
kṛṣyamāṇaṁ bhaviṣyeṇa buddhimohena māṁ balāt

translations.english: O Sugrīva, do you not take to your heart the improper conduct I have shown towards you, being attracted by inevitable foolishness, subject as I was to sin.

verses.sanskrit:
युगपद्विहितं तात न मन्ये सुखमावयोः
सौहार्दं भ्रातृयुक्तं हि तदिदं जातमन्यथा
verses.transliteration:
yugapadvihitaṁ tāta na manye sukhamāvayoḥ
sauhārdaṁ bhrātṛyuktaṁ hi tadidaṁ jātamanyathā

translations.english: Methinks, O brother, it is not our fortune to enjoy at the same time the double bliss of fraternal affection and the enjoyment of kingdom, or else why has it happened otherwise?

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिपद्य त्वमद्यैव राज्यमेषां वनौकसाम्
मामप्यद्यैव गच्छन्तं विद्धि वैवस्वतक्षयम्
verses.transliteration:
pratipadya tvamadyaiva rājyameṣāṁ vanaukasām
māmapyadyaiva gacchantaṁ viddhi vaivasvatakṣayam

translations.english: Do you acquire to-day this kingdom of the forest-ranges and know me as one who has departed to the abode of Death.

verses.sanskrit:
जीवितं च हि राज्यं च श्रियं च विपुलामिमाम्
प्रजहाम्येष वै तूर्णं महच्चागर्हितं यशः
verses.transliteration:
jīvitaṁ ca hi rājyaṁ ca śriyaṁ ca vipulāmimām
prajahāmyeṣa vai tūrṇaṁ mahaccāgarhitaṁ yaśaḥ

translations.english: Soon shall I renounce iny life, kingdom, my exquisite grace and my blameless fame.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्यां त्वहमवस्थायां वीर वक्ष्यामि यद्वचः
यद्यप्यसुकरं राजन्कर्तुमेव तदर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
asyāṁ tvahamavasthāyāṁ vīra vakṣyāmi yadvacaḥ
yadyapyasukaraṁ rājankartumeva tadarhasi

translations.english: It behoveth you, O hero, O king, to perform what I shall speak to you in this plight, however difficult it might be.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखार्हं सुखसंवृद्धं बालमेनमबालिशम्
बाष्पपूर्णमुखं पश्य भूमौ पतितमङ्गदम्
verses.transliteration:
sukhārhaṁ sukhasaṁvṛddhaṁ bālamenamabāliśam
bāṣpapūrṇamukhaṁ paśya bhūmau patitamaṅgadam

translations.english: Do you behold Angada fallen on the ground with tears in his eyes-a little boy, incapable, brought up in luxury and deserving happiness.

verses.sanskrit:
मम प्राणैः प्रियतरं पुत्रं पुत्रमिवौरसं
मया हीनमहीनार्थं सर्वतः परिपालय
verses.transliteration:
mama prāṇaiḥ priyataraṁ putraṁ putramivaurasaṁ
mayā hīnamahīnārthaṁ sarvataḥ paripālaya

translations.english: Do you maintain this my son, dearer than my life, like to your own son, born of your loins, satisfying all his wants in my absence.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमप्यस्य हि दाता च परित्राता च सर्वतः
भयेष्वभयदश्चैव यथाहं प्लवगेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
tvamapyasya hi dātā ca paritrātā ca sarvataḥ
bhayeṣvabhayadaścaiva yathāhaṁ plavageśvara

translations.english: O best of monkeys, like to me, you are his father, protector, conferrer of gifts and remover of fear.

verses.sanskrit:
एष तारात्मजः श्रीमांस्त्वया तुल्यपराक्रमः
रक्षसां तु वधे तेषामग्रतस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
eṣa tārātmajaḥ śrīmāṁstvayā tulyaparākramaḥ
rakṣasāṁ tu vadhe teṣāmagrataste bhaviṣyati

translations.english: This graceful son of Tārā equals you in prowess and shall precede you in the destruction of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि विक्रम्य बलवान्रणे
करिष्यत्येष तारेयस्तरस्वी तरुणोऽङ्गदः
verses.transliteration:
anurūpāṇi karmāṇi vikramya balavānraṇe
kariṣyatyeṣa tāreyastarasvī taruṇo'ṅgadaḥ

translations.english: This youthful Angada, Tārā's son, gifted with energy and strength, shall perform befitting exploits displaying his prowess in the battle.

verses.sanskrit:
सुषेणदुहिता चेयमर्थसूक्ष्मविनिश्चये
औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration:
suṣeṇaduhitā ceyamarthasūkṣmaviniścaye
autpātike ca vividhe sarvataḥ pariniṣṭhitā

translations.english: Surasen's daughter is wonderfully expert in ascertaining sabtle things and giving counsels in the time of danger.

verses.sanskrit:
यदेषा साध्विति ब्रूयात्कार्यं तन्मुक्तसंशयम्
न हि तारामतं किंचिदन्यथा परिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
yadeṣā sādhviti brūyātkāryaṁ tanmuktasaṁśayam
na hi tārāmataṁ kiṁcidanyathā parivartate

translations.english: Do you, without the least doubt perform what shall the chaste lady instruct you to do; for Tārā's advice never goes without effect.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य च ते कार्यं कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया
स्यादधर्मो ह्यकरणे त्वां च हिंस्याद्विमानितः
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya ca te kāryaṁ kartavyamaviśaṅkayā
syādadharmo hyakaraṇe tvāṁ ca hiṁsyādvimānitaḥ

translations.english: It behoveth you to perform Rāghava's service fearlessly or else you shall be visited with sin: on his being insulted you shall be injured.

verses.sanskrit:
इमां च मालामाधत्स्व दिव्यां सुग्रीवकाञ्चनीम्
उदारा श्रीः स्थिता ह्यस्यां संप्रजह्यान्मृते मयि
verses.transliteration:
imāṁ ca mālāmādhatsva divyāṁ sugrīvakāñcanīm
udārā śrīḥ sthitā hyasyāṁ saṁprajahyānmṛte mayi

translations.english: O Sugrīva, do you put on this celestial golden garland-herein dwelleth the bounteous Sree who shall renounce me after my death.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्तः सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृसौहृदात्
हर्षं त्यक्त्वा पुनर्दीनो ग्रहग्रस्त इवोडुराट्
verses.transliteration:
ityevamuktaḥ sugrīvo vālinā bhrātṛsauhṛdāt
harṣaṁ tyaktvā punardīno grahagrasta ivoḍurāṭ

translations.english: Having been accosted thus by Vāli, out of fraternal affection, Sugrīva renouncing joy again became pale like to the Moon possessed by Rahu.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वालिवचनाच्छान्तः कुर्वन्युक्तमतन्द्रितः
जग्राह सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो मालां तां चैव काञ्चनीम्
verses.transliteration:
tadvālivacanācchāntaḥ kurvanyuktamatandritaḥ
jagrāha so'bhyanujñāto mālāṁ tāṁ caiva kāñcanīm

translations.english: Renouncing his inimical feelings, being thus addressed by Vāli and carrying out his words energetically Sugrīva accepted the golden garland as ordered (by him).

verses.sanskrit:
तां मालां काञ्चनीं दत्त्वा वाली दृष्ट्वात्मजं स्थितम्
संसिद्धः प्रेत्य भावाय स्नेहादङ्गदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ mālāṁ kāñcanīṁ dattvā vālī dṛṣṭvātmajaṁ sthitam
saṁsiddhaḥ pretya bhāvāya snehādaṅgadamabravīt

translations.english: And conferring (upon Sugrīva) that golden garland and beholding his son before him, Vāli, resolved upon death, spoke to Angada, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
देशकालौ भजस्वाद्य क्षममाणः प्रियाप्रिये
सुखदुःखसहः काले सुग्रीववशगो भव
verses.transliteration:
deśakālau bhajasvādya kṣamamāṇaḥ priyāpriye
sukhaduḥkhasahaḥ kāle sugrīvavaśago bhava

translations.english: Do you place yourself now under the control of Sugrīva, ascertaining time and place, putting up with misery for your welfare and injury.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा हि त्वं महाबाहो लालितः सततं मया
न तथा वर्तमानं त्वां सुग्रीवो बहु मंस्यते
verses.transliteration:
yathā hi tvaṁ mahābāho lālitaḥ satataṁ mayā
na tathā vartamānaṁ tvāṁ sugrīvo bahu maṁsyate

translations.english: O you having long arms, Sugrīva shall not regard you much, if did you remain in the same wise in which you hadst been brought up by me before*. The significance of the passage is as follows:You wert a mere child while I brought you up. But now you are a grown up young man and this is the time for you to serve your elders. Do you therefore serve Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
मास्यामित्रैर्गतं गच्छेर्मा शत्रुभिररिंदम
भर्तुरर्थपरो दान्तः सुग्रीववशगो भव
verses.transliteration:
māsyāmitrairgataṁ gacchermā śatrubhirariṁdama
bharturarthaparo dāntaḥ sugrīvavaśago bhava

translations.english: O slayer of foes, do you never mix with Sugrīva's enemies, and place yourself always under Sugrīva's control, having subdued your senses and being intent upon your master's (Sugriva's) welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
न चातिप्रणयः कार्यः कर्तव्योऽप्रणयश्च ते
उभयं हि महादोषं तस्मादन्तरदृग्भव
verses.transliteration:
na cātipraṇayaḥ kāryaḥ kartavyo'praṇayaśca te
ubhayaṁ hi mahādoṣaṁ tasmādantaradṛgbhava

translations.english: Do you not cultivate too much of friendship nor be wanting in it-for both of these extremes are sources of disasters. Do you therefore follow the golden mean.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वाथ विवृत्ताक्षः शरसंपीडितो भृशम्
विवृतैर्दशनैर्भीमैर्बभूवोत्क्रान्तजीवितः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvātha vivṛttākṣaḥ śarasaṁpīḍito bhṛśam
vivṛtairdaśanairbhīmairbabhūvotkrāntajīvitaḥ

translations.english: After he had said this, his eyes became expanded, his teeth were opened and his appearance became ghastly. And greatly pained by shafts he breathed his last.

verses.sanskrit:
हते तु वीरे प्लवगाधिपे तदा; प्लवंगमास्तत्र न शर्म लेभिरे
वनेचराः सिंहयुते महावने; यथा हि गावो निहते गवां पतौ
verses.transliteration:
hate tu vīre plavagādhipe tadā; plavaṁgamāstatra na śarma lebhire
vanecarāḥ siṁhayute mahāvane; yathā hi gāvo nihate gavāṁ patau

translations.english: Like to kine, incapable of enjoying peace in a mighty forest filled with lions, their chief being dead, these forest-rangers could not attain to felicity on the demise of that lord of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु तारा व्यसनार्णव प्लुता; मृतस्या भर्तुर्वदनं समीक्ष्य सा
जगाम भूमिं परिरभ्य वालिनं; महाद्रुमं छिन्नमिवाश्रिता लता
verses.transliteration:
tatastu tārā vyasanārṇava plutā; mṛtasyā bharturvadanaṁ samīkṣya sā
jagāma bhūmiṁ parirabhya vālinaṁ; mahādrumaṁ chinnamivāśritā latā

translations.english: Thereupon, Tārā, sunk in the gulf of disaster, eyeing the countenance of her deceased lord, fell down to the ground embracing Vāli like to a creeper clinging for its support to a mighty but broken tree.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः समुपजिघ्रन्ती कपिराजस्य तन्मुखम्
पतिं लोकाच्च्युतं तारा मृतं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ samupajighrantī kapirājasya tanmukham
patiṁ lokāccyutaṁ tārā mṛtaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon smelling the face of that lord of monkeys, Tārā again addressed her deceased lord, known all over the world, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
शेषे त्वं विषमे दुःखमकृत्वा वचनं मम
उपलोपचिते वीर सुदुःखे वसुधातले
verses.transliteration:
śeṣe tvaṁ viṣame duḥkhamakṛtvā vacanaṁ mama
upalopacite vīra suduḥkhe vasudhātale

translations.english: O hero, disregarding my words, you are lying on the uneven earth, hard and filled with gravels.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तः प्रियतरा नूनं वानरेन्द्र मही तव
शेषे हि तां परिष्वज्य मां च न प्रतिभाषसे
verses.transliteration:
mattaḥ priyatarā nūnaṁ vānarendra mahī tava
śeṣe hi tāṁ pariṣvajya māṁ ca na pratibhāṣase

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, the earth is dearer to you than I, since you are lying there embracing her and are not welcoming me.

verses.sanskrit:
एषां विलपितं कृच्छ्रमङ्गदस्य च शोचतः
मम चेमां गिरं श्रुत्वा किं त्वं न प्रतिबुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
eṣāṁ vilapitaṁ kṛcchramaṅgadasya ca śocataḥ
mama cemāṁ giraṁ śrutvā kiṁ tvaṁ na pratibudhyase

translations.english: Why are you not awake, hearing the bewailings of bears and monkeys who used to wait upon you, powerful, as well as that of Angada and myself?

verses.sanskrit:
इदं तच्छूरशयनं यत्र शेषे हतो युधि
शायिता निहता यत्र त्वयैव रिपवः पुरा
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ tacchūraśayanaṁ yatra śeṣe hato yudhi
śāyitā nihatā yatra tvayaiva ripavaḥ purā

translations.english: Alas! you are lying on this bed of the heroes, being slain in the battle, where formerly, your enemies destroyed by you, used to lie down,

verses.sanskrit:
विशुद्धसत्त्वाभिजन प्रिययुद्ध मम प्रिय
मामनाथां विहायैकां गतस्त्वमसि मानद
verses.transliteration:
viśuddhasattvābhijana priyayuddha mama priya
māmanāthāṁ vihāyaikāṁ gatastvamasi mānada

translations.english: O you born of a pure family, O you that are fond of warfare, O my dear, O conferror of honours, whither have you departed making me husbandless?

verses.sanskrit:
शूराय न प्रदातव्या कन्या खलु विपश्चिता
शूरभार्यां हतां पश्य सद्यो मां विधवां कृताम्
verses.transliteration:
śūrāya na pradātavyā kanyā khalu vipaścitā
śūrabhāryāṁ hatāṁ paśya sadyo māṁ vidhavāṁ kṛtām

translations.english: Let not the wise, henceforth, confer their daughters upon the heroes. Alas! behold me, the wife of a hero, made a widow in no time.

verses.sanskrit:
अवभग्नश्च मे मानो भग्ना मे शाश्वती गतिः
अगाधे च निमग्नास्मि विपुले शोकसागरे
verses.transliteration:
avabhagnaśca me māno bhagnā me śāśvatī gatiḥ
agādhe ca nimagnāsmi vipule śokasāgare

translations.english: Shattered is my honour and destroyed is my happiness and I am sunk in the deep abyss of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्मसारमयं नूनमिदं मे हृदयं दृढम्
भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा यन्नाद्य शतधा गतम्
verses.transliteration:
aśmasāramayaṁ nūnamidaṁ me hṛdayaṁ dṛḍham
bhartāraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā yannādya śatadhā gatam

translations.english: Forsooth, this my firm heart is not sundered into hundred pieces, beholding my husband slain!

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृच्चैव हि भर्ता च प्रकृत्या च मम प्रियः
आहवे च पराक्रान्तः शूरः पञ्चत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration:
suhṛccaiva hi bhartā ca prakṛtyā ca mama priyaḥ
āhave ca parākrāntaḥ śūraḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ

translations.english: You are my friend, my dear husband and a great hero-and you had met with destruction, being struck by another man.

verses.sanskrit:
पतिहीना तु या नारी कामं भवतु पुत्रिणी
धनधान्यैः सुपूर्णापि विधवेत्युच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration:
patihīnā tu yā nārī kāmaṁ bhavatu putriṇī
dhanadhānyaiḥ supūrṇāpi vidhavetyucyate budhaiḥ

translations.english: A husbandless woman is always styled by the wise as widow, although she might have a son and enough of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वगात्रप्रभवे वीर शेषे रुधिरमण्डले
कृमिरागपरिस्तोमे त्वमेवं शयने यथा
verses.transliteration:
svagātraprabhave vīra śeṣe rudhiramaṇḍale
kṛmirāgaparistome tvamevaṁ śayane yathā

translations.english: O hero, you are lying down in a pool of blood issuing out of your own person, like to your own bed having a red-dyed bed-sheet.

verses.sanskrit:
रेणुशोणितसंवीतं गात्रं तव समन्ततः
परिरब्धुं न शक्नोमि भुजाभ्यां प्लवगर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
reṇuśoṇitasaṁvītaṁ gātraṁ tava samantataḥ
parirabdhuṁ na śaknomi bhujābhyāṁ plavagarṣabha

translations.english: Your body is on all sides besmeared with blood and dust and I am incapable of embracing you with my arms, O best of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतकृत्योऽद्य सुग्रीवो वैरेऽस्मिन्नतिदारुणे
यस्य रामविमुक्तेन हृतमेकेषुणा भयम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtakṛtyo'dya sugrīvo vaire'sminnatidāruṇe
yasya rāmavimuktena hṛtamekeṣuṇā bhayam

translations.english: Surely has Sugrīva satisfied his hostile intention to-day, whose fear has been removed by one shaft, discharged by Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
शरेण हृदि लग्नेन गात्रसंस्पर्शने तव
वार्यामि त्वां निरीक्षन्ती त्वयि पञ्चत्वमागते
verses.transliteration:
śareṇa hṛdi lagnena gātrasaṁsparśane tava
vāryāmi tvāṁ nirīkṣantī tvayi pañcatvamāgate

translations.english: Thyself departing to the land of the dead. I have been eyeing you simply, being prevented from touching your person by the shaft piercing your heart.* The meaning is:-Lest by my touching that shaft you feelest a greater pain.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्बबर्ह शरं नीलस्तस्य गात्रगतं तदा
गिरिगह्वरसंलीनं दीप्तमाशीविषं यथा
verses.transliteration:
udbabarha śaraṁ nīlastasya gātragataṁ tadā
girigahvarasaṁlīnaṁ dīptamāśīviṣaṁ yathā

translations.english: Thereupon Neela took out that shaft from the person of (Vāli) like to a flaming serpent lurking in a mountain cave.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्य च बभौ द्युतिः
अस्तमस्तकसंरुद्धो रश्मिर्दिनकरादिव
verses.transliteration:
tasya niṣkṛṣyamāṇasya bāṇasya ca babhau dyutiḥ
astamastakasaṁruddho raśmirdinakarādiva

translations.english: There beamed the shaft extracted from his body like to the rays of the Sun, stationed on the summit of the setting hill.

verses.sanskrit:
पेतुः क्षतजधारास्तु व्रणेभ्यस्तस्य सर्वशः
ताम्रगैरिकसंपृक्ता धारा इव धराधरात्
verses.transliteration:
petuḥ kṣatajadhārāstu vraṇebhyastasya sarvaśaḥ
tāmragairikasaṁpṛktā dhārā iva dharādharāt

translations.english: And there poured forth from all his wounds, streams of blood, like to showers of melted copper and other metals falling from a mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
अवकीर्णं विमार्जन्ती भर्तारं रणरेणुना
अस्रैर्नयनजैः शूरं सिषेचास्त्रसमाहतम्
verses.transliteration:
avakīrṇaṁ vimārjantī bhartāraṁ raṇareṇunā
asrairnayanajaiḥ śūraṁ siṣecāstrasamāhatam

translations.english: And (Tārā) washed, with tears, her heroic husband's body covered with dust and wounded with weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं पतिम्
उवाच तारा पिङ्गाक्षं पुत्रमङ्गदमङ्गना
verses.transliteration:
rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgaṁ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṁ patim
uvāca tārā piṅgākṣaṁ putramaṅgadamaṅganā

translations.english: Beholding her husband thus slain and besmeared with blood, she spoke to her son, Angada, having coppery eyes, saying:

verses.sanskrit:
अवस्थां पश्चिमां पश्य पितुः पुत्र सुदारुणाम्
संप्रसक्तस्य वैरस्य गतोऽन्तः पापकर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
avasthāṁ paścimāṁ paśya pituḥ putra sudāruṇām
saṁprasaktasya vairasya gato'ntaḥ pāpakarmaṇā

translations.english: Behold this terrible declining stage of your Sire. Here is the end of his hostilities collected by his impious action.

verses.sanskrit:
बालसूर्योदयतनुं प्रयान्तं यमसादनम्
अभिवादय राजानं पितरं पुत्र मानदम्
verses.transliteration:
bālasūryodayatanuṁ prayāntaṁ yamasādanam
abhivādaya rājānaṁ pitaraṁ putra mānadam

translations.english: O my son, do you how to your kingly father, the conferrer of honours, who has departed to the abode of Death, having a flaming person like to the rising Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणौ पितुः
भुजाभ्यां पीनवृताभ्यामङ्गदोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ samutthāya jagrāha caraṇau pituḥ
bhujābhyāṁ pīnavṛtābhyāmaṅgado'hamiti bruvan

translations.english: Thus accosted, Angada rose up and, saying, I (do touch my Sire's feet), embraced his father's feet with his plump arms.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवादयमानं त्वामङ्गदं त्वं यथापुरा
दीर्घायुर्भव पुत्रेति किमर्थं नाभिभाषसे
verses.transliteration:
abhivādayamānaṁ tvāmaṅgadaṁ tvaṁ yathāpurā
dīrghāyurbhava putreti kimarthaṁ nābhibhāṣase

translations.english: (Thereupon Tāră said)—Saying 'Do you live long' why did you not welcome Angada, to-day as before, who has bowed to you?

verses.sanskrit:
अहं पुत्रसहाया त्वामुपासे गतचेतनम्
सिंहेन निहतं सद्यो गौः सवत्सेव गोवृषम्
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ putrasahāyā tvāmupāse gatacetanam
siṁhena nihataṁ sadyo gauḥ savatseva govṛṣam

translations.english: I am with my son, standing by you who are dead, like to a cow with her calf, having the bull slain by a lion.

verses.sanskrit:
या दत्ता देवराजेन तव तुष्टेन संयुगे
शातकुम्भमयीं मालां तां ते पश्यामि नेह किम्
verses.transliteration:
yā dattā devarājena tava tuṣṭena saṁyuge
śātakumbhamayīṁ mālāṁ tāṁ te paśyāmi neha kim

translations.english: How have you, without me, your wife, bathed in the water of Rāma's shafts, at the end of your battle-like sacrifice? Why do I not behold here that favourite golden garland of thine, which was conferred on you by the lord of celestials, pleased in a battle?

verses.sanskrit:
राजश्रीर्न जहाति त्वां गतासुमपि मानद
सूर्यस्यावर्तमानस्य शैलराजमिव प्रभा
verses.transliteration:
rājaśrīrna jahāti tvāṁ gatāsumapi mānada
sūryasyāvartamānasya śailarājamiva prabhā

translations.english: Royal grace has not renounced you, O conferrer of honours, albeit you are dead, like to the rays not quitting the king of mountains, even after the Sun is set.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे वचः पथ्यमिदं त्वया कृतं; न चास्मि शक्ता हि निवारणे तव
हता सपुत्रास्मि हतेन संयुगे; सह त्वया श्रीर्विजहाति मामिह
verses.transliteration:
na me vacaḥ pathyamidaṁ tvayā kṛtaṁ; na cāsmi śaktā hi nivāraṇe tava
hatā saputrāsmi hatena saṁyuge; saha tvayā śrīrvijahāti māmiha

translations.english: You didst not act by my wholesome words, nor could I prevent you. And I am now destroyed with my son, along with you in the battle. Truly has Sree (goddess of wealth) renounced me.

verses.sanskrit:
न शोकपरितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः
यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं तत्समाधातुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration:
na śokaparitāpena śreyasā yujyate mṛtaḥ
yadatrānantaraṁ kāryaṁ tatsamādhātumarhatha

translations.english: Grief and lamentations do not tend to the welfare of the deceased. It therefore behoveth you to perform the after ceremonies.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकवृत्तमनुष्ठेयं कृतं वो बाष्पमोक्षणम्
न कालादुत्तरं किंचित्कर्म शक्यमुपासितुम्
verses.transliteration:
lokavṛttamanuṣṭheyaṁ kṛtaṁ vo bāṣpamokṣaṇam
na kālāduttaraṁ kiṁcitkarma śakyamupāsitum

translations.english: You have satisfied the worldly practice with a profuse discharge of tears. It is not proper to delay the performance of appointed actions.

verses.sanskrit:
नियतः कारणं लोके नियतिः कर्मसाधनम्
नियतिः सर्वभूतानां नियोगेष्विह कारणम्
verses.transliteration:
niyataḥ kāraṇaṁ loke niyatiḥ karmasādhanam
niyatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ niyogeṣviha kāraṇam

translations.english: Time is the prime cause in this world, and the source of the accomplishment of actions. And Time it is that leads men to actions.

verses.sanskrit:
न कर्ता कस्यचित्कश्चिन्नियोगे चापि नेश्वरः
स्वभावे वर्तते लोकस्तस्य कालः परायणम्
verses.transliteration:
na kartā kasyacitkaścinniyoge cāpi neśvaraḥ
svabhāve vartate lokastasya kālaḥ parāyaṇam

translations.english: No one is the lord of another person, and no one leads him to actions. People are subject to their actions of previous existence and Time aids them.

verses.sanskrit:
न कालः कालमत्येति न कालः परिहीयते
स्वभावं वा समासाद्य न कश्चिदतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
na kālaḥ kālamatyeti na kālaḥ parihīyate
svabhāvaṁ vā samāsādya na kaścidativartate

translations.english: Even the Eternal being cannot withstand the ways of Time. He never decayeth-and no one else can withstand the course of Time.

verses.sanskrit:
न कालस्यास्ति बन्धुत्वं न हेतुर्न पराक्रमः
न मित्रज्ञातिसंबन्धः कारणं नात्मनो वशः
verses.transliteration:
na kālasyāsti bandhutvaṁ na heturna parākramaḥ
na mitrajñātisaṁbandhaḥ kāraṇaṁ nātmano vaśaḥ

translations.english: It has no friend, no cause and no one can overcome it. It has no kinsman, no relation; even it is not subject to itself.

verses.sanskrit:
किं तु काल परीणामो द्रष्टव्यः साधु पश्यता
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च कालक्रमसमाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tu kāla parīṇāmo draṣṭavyaḥ sādhu paśyatā
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca kālakramasamāhitāḥ

translations.english: The wise can perceive the work of Time. Piety, wealth and desire are all subject to it.

verses.sanskrit:
इतः स्वां प्रकृतिं वाली गतः प्राप्तः क्रियाफलम्
धर्मार्थकामसंयोगैः पवित्रं प्लवगेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
itaḥ svāṁ prakṛtiṁ vālī gataḥ prāptaḥ kriyāphalam
dharmārthakāmasaṁyogaiḥ pavitraṁ plavageśvara

translations.english: Vāli, the lord of monkeys, has attained to his own true state, reaping the fruits of his actions, acquired by virtue of his royal accomplishments namely forgiveness and charity.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वधर्मस्य च संयोगाज्जितस्तेन महात्मना
स्वर्गः परिगृहीतश्च प्राणानपरिरक्षता
verses.transliteration:
svadharmasya ca saṁyogājjitastena mahātmanā
svargaḥ parigṛhītaśca prāṇānaparirakṣatā

translations.english: The abode of the celestials, which was conquered by this high-souled one by his former piety, has now been occupied by him after resigning his body.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा वै नियतिः श्रेष्ठा यां गतो हरियूथपः
तदलं परितापेन प्राप्तकालमुपास्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣā vai niyatiḥ śreṣṭhā yāṁ gato hariyūthapaḥ
tadalaṁ paritāpena prāptakālamupāsyatām

translations.english: This is the best course of Time that has been attained to by the lord of monkey-herds. No more with lamentations therefore; do you perform the actions that are worthy of being performed on this occasion.

verses.sanskrit:
वचनान्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
अवदत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीवं गतचेतसं
verses.transliteration:
vacanānte tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
avadatpraśritaṁ vākyaṁ sugrīvaṁ gatacetasaṁ

translations.english: After Rāma had spoken thus, Laksmana, the slayer of foes, addressed Sugrīva, senseless with grief, with the following sound words.

verses.sanskrit:
कुरु त्वमस्य सुग्रीव प्रेतकार्यमनन्तरम्
ताराङ्गदाभ्यां सहितो वालिनो दहनं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
kuru tvamasya sugrīva pretakāryamanantaram
tārāṅgadābhyāṁ sahito vālino dahanaṁ prati

translations.english: Sugrīva, do you perform the funeral ceremonies of Vali along with Tārā and Angada.

verses.sanskrit:
समाज्ञापय काष्ठानि शुष्काणि च बहूनि च
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि वालिसंस्कारकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
samājñāpaya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇi ca bahūni ca
candanāni ca divyāni vālisaṁskārakāraṇāt

translations.english: Do you collect for cremation many a dry fuel and celestial sandal.

verses.sanskrit:
समाश्वासय चैनं त्वमङ्गदं दीनचेतसं
मा भूर्बालिशबुद्धिस्त्वं त्वदधीनमिदं पुरम्
verses.transliteration:
samāśvāsaya cainaṁ tvamaṅgadaṁ dīnacetasaṁ
mā bhūrbāliśabuddhistvaṁ tvadadhīnamidaṁ puram

translations.english: Do you console the unfortunate Angada, who is beside himself with grief. Do not conduct yourself like an ignorant person, for this city is now under you.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदस्त्वानयेन्माल्यं वस्त्राणि विविधानि च
घृतं तैलमथो गन्धान्यच्चात्र समनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
aṅgadastvānayenmālyaṁ vastrāṇi vividhāni ca
ghṛtaṁ tailamatho gandhānyaccātra samanantaram

translations.english: Let Angada bring clothes, garlands, scents, clarified butter, oil and other necessary articles.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं तार शिबिकां शीघ्रमादायागच्छ संभ्रमात्
त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता ह्यस्मिन्काले विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ tāra śibikāṁ śīghramādāyāgaccha saṁbhramāt
tvarā guṇavatī yuktā hyasminkāle viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: O Tārā, do you go and bring soon a conveyance; for speediness is a special virtue on an occasion like this.

verses.sanskrit:
सज्जीभवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिकावाहनोचिताः
समर्था बलिनश्चैव निर्हरिष्यन्ति वालिनम्
verses.transliteration:
sajjībhavantu plavagāḥ śibikāvāhanocitāḥ
samarthā balinaścaiva nirhariṣyanti vālinam

translations.english: Let the monkeys dress themselves who can convey this hearse. The powerful and the capable only shall carry Vali.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः
तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu sugrīvaṁ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ
tasthau bhrātṛsamīpastho lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā

translations.english: Having thus addressed Sugriva, Laksmana, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy and the destroyer of foes, stood before his elder brother.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारः संभ्रान्तमानसः
प्रविवेश गुहां शीघ्रं शिबिकासक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tāraḥ saṁbhrāntamānasaḥ
praviveśa guhāṁ śīghraṁ śibikāsaktamānasaḥ

translations.english: And hearing the words of Laksmana, the counsellor respectfully entered the cave with a view to bring the conveyance.

verses.sanskrit:
आदाय शिबिकां तारः स तु पर्यापयत्पुनः
वानरैरुह्यमानां तां शूरैरुद्वहनोचितैः
verses.transliteration:
ādāya śibikāṁ tāraḥ sa tu paryāpayatpunaḥ
vānarairuhyamānāṁ tāṁ śūrairudvahanocitaiḥ

translations.english: And taking that conveyance carried by the monkeys and worthy of being carried by the heroes, he issued out again of the cave.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वालिनमुद्यम्य सुग्रीवः शिबिकां तदा
आरोपयत विक्रोशन्नङ्गदेन सहैव तु
verses.transliteration:
tato vālinamudyamya sugrīvaḥ śibikāṁ tadā
āropayata vikrośannaṅgadena sahaiva tu

translations.english: Thereupon Sugrīva, long with Angada, placing Väli on the conveyance, began to bewail.

verses.sanskrit:
आरोप्य शिबिकां चैव वालिनं गतजीवितम्
अलंकारैश्च विविधैर्माल्यैर्वस्त्रैश्च भूषितम्
verses.transliteration:
āropya śibikāṁ caiva vālinaṁ gatajīvitam
alaṁkāraiśca vividhairmālyairvastraiśca bhūṣitam

translations.english: And placing the lifeless body of Vāli on it, he covered it with various ornaments, garlands, and clothes.

verses.sanskrit:
आज्ञापयत्तदा राजा सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः
और्ध्वदेहिकमार्यस्य क्रियतामनुरूपतः
verses.transliteration:
ājñāpayattadā rājā sugrīvaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
aurdhvadehikamāryasya kriyatāmanurūpataḥ

translations.english: Thereat Sugrīva, the king of monkeys, ordered for the performance of Vāli's funeral rites.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्राणयन्तो रत्नानि विविधानि बहूनि च
अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
viśrāṇayanto ratnāni vividhāni bahūni ca
agrataḥ plavagā yāntu śibikā tadanantaram

translations.english: Let the monkeys go before, scattering many a precious jewel and let the conveyance follow them.

verses.sanskrit:
राज्ञामृद्धिविशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः
तादृशं वालिनः क्षिप्रं प्राकुर्वन्नौर्ध्वदेहिकम्
verses.transliteration:
rājñāmṛddhiviśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ
tādṛśaṁ vālinaḥ kṣipraṁ prākurvannaurdhvadehikam

translations.english: Let the monkeys perform the obsequies of our master with such grandeur as befits the riches of the kings on this earth, a

verses.sanskrit:
तासां रुदितशब्देन वानरीणां वनान्तरे
वनानि गिरयः सर्वे विक्रोशन्तीव सर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ ruditaśabdena vānarīṇāṁ vanāntare
vanāni girayaḥ sarve vikrośantīva sarvataḥ

translations.english: In response to the bewailings of she-monkeys, hills and forests, as if, bewailed on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
पुलिने गिरिनद्यास्तु विविक्ते जलसंवृते
चितां चक्रुः सुबहवो वानरा वनचारिणः
verses.transliteration:
puline girinadyāstu vivikte jalasaṁvṛte
citāṁ cakruḥ subahavo vānarā vanacāriṇaḥ

translations.english: Monkeys, ranging in the forest, made funeral piles on the banks of the hill-streams and in solitary watery nooks. Thereupon laying down from their shoulders the conveyance, those foremost of monkeys stationed themselves in a corner, being stricken with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तारा पतिं दृष्ट्वा शिबिकातलशायिनम्
आरोप्याङ्के शिरस्तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता
verses.transliteration:
tatastārā patiṁ dṛṣṭvā śibikātalaśāyinam
āropyāṅke śirastasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā

translations.english: And Tārā, beholding her husband's body on the conveyance, placed his head on her lap and bewailed, overwhelmed with griet.

verses.sanskrit:
जनं च पश्यसीमं त्वं कस्माच्छोकाभिपीडितम्
प्रहृष्टमिव ते वक्त्रं गतासोरपि मानद
अस्तार्कसमवर्णं च लक्ष्यते जीवतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
janaṁ ca paśyasīmaṁ tvaṁ kasmācchokābhipīḍitam
prahṛṣṭamiva te vaktraṁ gatāsorapi mānada
astārkasamavarṇaṁ ca lakṣyate jīvato yathā

translations.english: O conferrer of honours, your countenance looks as if beaming with joy; although you are dead, and you appearest as if alive, having the hue of the setting Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
एष त्वां रामरूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर
येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एकेषुणा रणे
verses.transliteration:
eṣa tvāṁ rāmarūpeṇa kālaḥ karṣati vānara
yena sma vidhavāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtā ekeṣuṇā raṇe

translations.english: O monkey, Death himself, under the semblance of Rāma, is attracting you, who with one shaft in the battle, has rendered us all widows.

verses.sanskrit:
इमास्तास्तव राजेन्द्रवानर्यो वल्लभाः सदा
पादैर्विकृष्टमध्वानमागताः किं न बुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
imāstāstava rājendravānaryo vallabhāḥ sadā
pādairvikṛṣṭamadhvānamāgatāḥ kiṁ na budhyase

translations.english: O best of kings, these she-monkeys cannot go by jumping. Did you not perceive that they have travelled so far on foot?

verses.sanskrit:
तवेष्टा ननु नामैता भार्याश्चन्द्रनिभाननाः
इदानीं नेक्षसे कस्मात्सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
taveṣṭā nanu nāmaitā bhāryāścandranibhānanāḥ
idānīṁ nekṣase kasmātsugrīvaṁ plavageśvaram

translations.english: Those your wives, having moon-like countenances, have always your welfare in view. Why did you not, O best of monkeys, cast your looks towards them and Sugrīva?

verses.sanskrit:
एते हि सचिवा राजंस्तारप्रभृतयस्तव
पुरवासिजनश्चायं परिवार्यासतेऽनघ
verses.transliteration:
ete hi sacivā rājaṁstāraprabhṛtayastava
puravāsijanaścāyaṁ parivāryāsate'nagha

translations.english: O king, these your counsellors, your wives headed by Tårā, and all these citizens are bewailing around you.

verses.sanskrit:
विसर्जयैनान्प्रवलान्यथोचितमरिंदम
ततः क्रीडामहे सर्वा वनेषु मदिरोत्कटाः
verses.transliteration:
visarjayainānpravalānyathocitamariṁdama
tataḥ krīḍāmahe sarvā vaneṣu madirotkaṭāḥ

translations.english: O slayer of foes, do you despatch your counsellors to the city and we shall all enjoy in this forest, excited with amour.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं विलपतीं तारां पतिशोकपरिप्लुताम्
उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोककर्शिताः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vilapatīṁ tārāṁ patiśokapariplutām
utthāpayanti sma tadā vānaryaḥ śokakarśitāḥ

translations.english: The other she-monkeys, worked with sorrow, raised up Tārā bewailing thus being exercised with grief consequent upon the demise of her husband.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवेण ततः सार्धमङ्गदः पितरं रुदन्
चितामारोपयामास शोकेनाभिहतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
sugrīveṇa tataḥ sārdhamaṅgadaḥ pitaraṁ rudan
citāmāropayāmāsa śokenābhihatendriyaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Angada along with Sugrīva, overwhelmed with grief, weeping, placed his Sire's body on the funeral pile.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽग्निं विधिवद्दत्त्वा सोऽपसव्यं चकार ह
पितरं दीर्घमध्वानं प्रस्थितं व्याकुलेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
tato'gniṁ vidhivaddattvā so'pasavyaṁ cakāra ha
pitaraṁ dīrghamadhvānaṁ prasthitaṁ vyākulendriyaḥ

translations.english: And putting fire duly, he circumambulated his Sire, bound for a journey for good.

verses.sanskrit:
संस्कृत्य वालिनं ते तु विधिपूर्वं प्लवंगमाः
आजग्मुरुदकं कर्तुं नदीं शीतजलां शुभाम्
verses.transliteration:
saṁskṛtya vālinaṁ te tu vidhipūrvaṁ plavaṁgamāḥ
ājagmurudakaṁ kartuṁ nadīṁ śītajalāṁ śubhām

translations.english: Having duly cremated Vāli's body, the foremost of monkeys arrived at a river of auspicious water with a view to perform the watery ceremony.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते सहितास्तत्र अङ्गदं स्थाप्य चाग्रतः
सुग्रीवतारासहिताः सिषिचुर्वालिने जलम्
verses.transliteration:
tataste sahitāstatra aṅgadaṁ sthāpya cāgrataḥ
sugrīvatārāsahitāḥ siṣicurvāline jalam

translations.english: And all these monkeys along with Sugrīva and Tārā, placing Angada before them, sprinkled water.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवेणैव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः
समानशोकः काकुत्स्थः प्रेतकार्याण्यकारयत्
verses.transliteration:
sugrīveṇaiva dīnena dīno bhūtvā mahābalaḥ
samānaśokaḥ kākutsthaḥ pretakāryāṇyakārayat

translations.english: And the highly powerful Käkutstha, equally aggrieved like Sugriva, being as poorly, conducted duly the obsequious ceremonies of Vali.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शोकाभिसंतप्तं सुग्रीवं क्लिन्नवासनम्
शाखामृगमहामात्राः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śokābhisaṁtaptaṁ sugrīvaṁ klinnavāsanam
śākhāmṛgamahāmātrāḥ parivāryopatasthire

translations.english: And thereupon those foremost of monkeys waited there, surrounding Sugrīva exercised with grief and wearing wetted cloth. And they all, approaching the mighty-armed Rāma of unwearied actions, stationed themselves with folded hands like to the great ascetics around the Grand-Father of the celestials).

verses.sanskrit:
ततः काञ्चनशैलाभस्तरुणार्कनिभाननः
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kāñcanaśailābhastaruṇārkanibhānanaḥ
abravītprāñjalirvākyaṁ hanumānmārutātmajaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Hanuman, the son of Marut, resembling a golden hill and having a countenance resembling the rising Sun, spoke with folded hands, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
भवत्प्रसादात्सुग्रीवः पितृपैतामहं महत्
वानराणां सुदुष्प्रापं प्राप्तो राज्यमिदं प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
bhavatprasādātsugrīvaḥ pitṛpaitāmahaṁ mahat
vānarāṇāṁ suduṣprāpaṁ prāpto rājyamidaṁ prabho

translations.english: By your assistance, O Kākutstha, O lord, this great ancestral kingdom of the highly powerful monkeys, having sharpened teeth, incapable of being acquired by the high-souled ones, has been attained to (by Sugrīva). Being commanded by you, he along with his friends, entering this city, shall perform the royal duties.

verses.sanskrit:
स्नातोऽयं विविधैर्गन्धैरौषधैश्च यथाविधि
अर्चयिष्यति रत्नैश्च माल्यैश्च त्वां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
snāto'yaṁ vividhairgandhairauṣadhaiśca yathāvidhi
arcayiṣyati ratnaiśca mālyaiśca tvāṁ viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: And being duly bathed he shall worship you particularly, with garlands, jewels, scents and os adhis. It behoveth you to enter this pleasant mountain cave and satisfy these monkeys by installing (Sugriva on the throne).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता राघवः परवीरहा
प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तं बुद्धिमान्वाक्यकोविदः
verses.transliteration:
evamukto hanumatā rāghavaḥ paravīrahā
pratyuvāca hanūmantaṁ buddhimānvākyakovidaḥ

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, the highly intelligent Rāghava, skilled in speech and the slayer of foes, replied;

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसमाः सौम्य ग्रामं वा यदि वा पुरम्
न प्रवेक्ष्यामि हनुमन्पितुर्निर्देशपालकः
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśasamāḥ saumya grāmaṁ vā yadi vā puram
na pravekṣyāmi hanumanpiturnirdeśapālakaḥ

translations.english: O gentle Hanuman, abiding by my Sire's mandate, I shall not enter a hamlet or a city for these fourteen years.

verses.sanskrit:
सुसमृद्धां गुहां दिव्यां सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः
प्रविष्टो विधिवद्वीरः क्षिप्रं राज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
susamṛddhāṁ guhāṁ divyāṁ sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ
praviṣṭo vidhivadvīraḥ kṣipraṁ rājye'bhiṣicyatām

translations.english: Let Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, enter this magnificent celestial cave and do you all install him speedily on the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा हनूमन्तं रामः सुग्रीवमब्रवीत्
इममप्यङ्गदं वीर यौवराज्येऽभिषेचय
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā hanūmantaṁ rāmaḥ sugrīvamabravīt
imamapyaṅgadaṁ vīra yauvarājye'bhiṣecaya
