सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं वशे स्थापयितुं जगत्
verses.transliteration:
abhikruddhaḥ samartho hi cāpamudyamya rāghavaḥ
sadevāsuragandharvaṁ vaśe sthāpayituṁ jagat

translations.english: Rāghava, taking up his bow, while enraged, can bring under subjection the entire world, inhabited by by the celestials, Asuras and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
न स क्षमः कोपयितुं यः प्रसाद्य पुनर्भवेत्
पूर्वोपकारं स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
na sa kṣamaḥ kopayituṁ yaḥ prasādya punarbhavet
pūrvopakāraṁ smaratā kṛtajñena viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: Remembering his former service, it does not behove you, grateful as you are, to excite his wrath, who should be pleased again.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रः ससुहृज्जनः
राजंस्तिष्ठ स्वसमये भर्तुर्भार्येव तद्वशे
verses.transliteration:
tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvaṁ saputraḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ
rājaṁstiṣṭha svasamaye bharturbhāryeva tadvaśe

translations.english: Bowing to him, with your children and friends, do you, O king, satisfying your promise, seek his shelter like to a wife placing herself under the control of her husband.

verses.sanskrit:
न रामरामानुजशासनं त्वया; कपीन्द्रयुक्तं मनसाप्यपोहितुम्
मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषं बलं; सराघवस्यास्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
na rāmarāmānujaśāsanaṁ tvayā; kapīndrayuktaṁ manasāpyapohitum
mano hi te jñāsyati mānuṣaṁ balaṁ; sarāghavasyāsya surendravarcasaḥ

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, it does not behove you, to neglect even in thought, the behests of Rāma and his younger brother; for you are fully aware of the prowess of Rāghava like to the lord of celestials, and passing human power.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ प्रतिसमादिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
प्रविवेश गुहां घोरां किष्किन्धां रामशासनात्
verses.transliteration:
atha pratisamādiṣṭo lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
praviveśa guhāṁ ghorāṁ kiṣkindhāṁ rāmaśāsanāt

translations.english: Thereupon, Laksmana, the slayer of foes, commanded, entered, at the behest of Rāma, the pleasant city of Kişkindhā situated in the centre of caves.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वारस्था हरयस्तत्र महाकाया महाबलाः
बभूवुर्लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्राञ्जलयः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
dvārasthā harayastatra mahākāyā mahābalāḥ
babhūvurlakṣmaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā sarve prāñjalayaḥ sthitāḥ

translations.english: Beholding Lakşınaņa, the highly powerful monkeys, having huge persons and waiting at the gate, stood all with folded hands.

verses.sanskrit:
निःश्वसन्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धं दशरथात्मजम्
बभूवुर्हरयस्त्रस्ता न चैनं पर्यवारयन्
verses.transliteration:
niḥśvasantaṁ tu taṁ dṛṣṭvā kruddhaṁ daśarathātmajam
babhūvurharayastrastā na cainaṁ paryavārayan

translations.english: And seeing Dasaratha's son highly enraged and sighing again and again, the monkeys stood silent and did not interrupt him.

verses.sanskrit:
देवगन्धर्वपुत्रैश्च वानरैः कामरूपिभिः
दिव्य माल्याम्बरधारैः शोभितां प्रियदर्शनैः
verses.transliteration:
devagandharvaputraiśca vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ
divya mālyāmbaradhāraiḥ śobhitāṁ priyadarśanaiḥ

translations.english: The graceful Lakşmaņa espied that huge picturesque and celestial cave adorned with jewels and flowery gardens. It was filled with palatial buildings, various jewels and flowery trees, producing at all times wished for fruits. It was beautified with good-looking monkeyschildren of the celestials and Gandharabas wearing celestial garlands and clothes and assuming shapes at will.

verses.sanskrit:
चन्दनागरुपद्मानां गन्धैः सुरभिगन्धिनाम्
मैरेयाणां मधूनां च संमोदितमहापथाम्
verses.transliteration:
candanāgarupadmānāṁ gandhaiḥ surabhigandhinām
maireyāṇāṁ madhūnāṁ ca saṁmoditamahāpathām

translations.english: It was fragrant with the sweet smell of sandal wood, Aguru and lotuses and its highway were equally fragrant with the smell of honey.

verses.sanskrit:
विन्ध्यमेरुगिरिप्रस्थैः प्रासादैर्नैकभूमिभिः
ददर्श गिरिनद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration:
vindhyamerugiriprasthaiḥ prāsādairnaikabhūmibhiḥ
dadarśa girinadyaśca vimalāstatra rāghavaḥ

translations.english: And Lakşmaņa beheld there many spacious buildings like to the hills Vindhya and Meru and rivers of clear water.

verses.sanskrit:
स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा यानासनसमावृताः
प्रविश्य सुमहद्गुप्तं ददर्शान्तःपुरं महत्
verses.transliteration:
sa sapta kakṣyā dharmātmā yānāsanasamāvṛtāḥ
praviśya sumahadguptaṁ dadarśāntaḥpuraṁ mahat

translations.english: And that virtuous-souled one, crossing the seven rooms filled with conveyances and seats beheld the secret apartment (of that monkeychief), having many a gold and silver bed-steads with excellent coverlets and fine seats.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविशन्नेव सततं शुश्राव मधुरस्वरम्
तन्त्रीगीतसमाकीर्णं समगीतपदाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration:
praviśanneva satataṁ śuśrāva madhurasvaram
tantrīgītasamākīrṇaṁ samagītapadākṣaram

translations.english: No sooner had he entered the inner apartment than he heard a musical sound, well-measured and accompanied by the music of the stringed instrument.

verses.sanskrit:
बह्वीश्च विविधाकारा रूपयौवनगर्विताः
स्त्रियः सुग्रीवभवने ददर्श स महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
bahvīśca vividhākārā rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ
striyaḥ sugrīvabhavane dadarśa sa mahābalaḥ

translations.english: And that highly powerful one beheld in the abode of Sugrīva many a beautiful damsel proud of their youth and beauty sprung from respectable families, adorned with splendid ornaments, engaged in stringing excellent garlands.

verses.sanskrit:
नातृप्तान्नाति च व्यग्रान्नानुदात्तपरिच्छदान्
सुग्रीवानुचरांश्चापि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
nātṛptānnāti ca vyagrānnānudāttaparicchadān
sugrīvānucarāṁścāpi lakṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: And he observed Sugrīva's servants, well fed, contented, not hurry in offering their services and without splendid ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने
महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sugrīvamāsīnaṁ kāñcane paramāsane
mahārhāstaraṇopete dadarśādityasaṁnibham

translations.english: There seated on a superb seat spread with a costly carpet, he found Sugrīva resembling the sun himself, his person decked with noble ornaments, of a dignified presence, famous, wearing gay garlands and attire, invincible like to the great Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
रुमां तु वीरः परिरभ्य गाढं; वरासनस्थो वरहेमवर्णः
ददर्श सौमित्रिमदीनसत्त्वं; विशालनेत्रः सुविशालनेत्रम्
verses.transliteration:
rumāṁ tu vīraḥ parirabhya gāḍhaṁ; varāsanastho varahemavarṇaḥ
dadarśa saumitrimadīnasattvaṁ; viśālanetraḥ suviśālanetram

translations.english: Then deeply embracing Umā, the large-eyed hero of the hue of fine gold, seated on an excellent seat, saw the powerful Saumitri having expansive eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्
सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
tamapratihataṁ kruddhaṁ praviṣṭaṁ puruṣarṣabham
sugrīvo lakṣmaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ

translations.english: Seeing that foremost of men, Laksmana, exercised with wrath, as he entered in without let, Sugrīva was seized with sadness.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रुद्धं निःश्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा
भ्रातुर्व्यसनसंतप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
kruddhaṁ niḥśvasamānaṁ taṁ pradīptamiva tejasā
bhrāturvyasanasaṁtaptaṁ dṛṣṭvā daśarathātmajam

translations.english: And seeing Dasaratha's son, wroth, and breathing hard, and flaming up in energy, and burning in consequence of the calamity that had overtaken his brother, that chief of monkeys started up, leaving his golden seat, like to the mighty ornamented standard of the great Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतू रुमाप्रभृतयः स्त्रियः
सुग्रीवं गगने पूर्णं चन्द्रं तारागणा इव
verses.transliteration:
utpatantamanūtpetū rumāprabhṛtayaḥ striyaḥ
sugrīvaṁ gagane pūrṇaṁ candraṁ tārāgaṇā iva

translations.english: And as Sugrīva rose up, Umā and the other females rose up, like to stars appearing in the sky when the full moon has risen.

verses.sanskrit:
संरक्तनयनः श्रीमान्विचचाल कृताञ्जलिः
बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षो महानिव
verses.transliteration:
saṁraktanayanaḥ śrīmānvicacāla kṛtāñjaliḥ
babhūvāvasthitastatra kalpavṛkṣo mahāniva

translations.english: And with eyes reddened, and his hands folded, the graceful Sugrīva came (before Laks maņa) and stood there like a mighty Kalpa tree.

verses.sanskrit:
रुमा द्वितीयं सुग्रीवं नारीमध्यगतं स्थितम्
अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः सतारं शशिनं यथा
verses.transliteration:
rumā dvitīyaṁ sugrīvaṁ nārīmadhyagataṁ sthitam
abravīllakṣmaṇaḥ kruddhaḥ satāraṁ śaśinaṁ yathā

translations.english: And the wrathful Lakşmaņa spoke to Sugrīva stationed among women, having Umā for his second, and resembling the moon with the stars, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वाभिजनसंपन्नः सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः
कृतज्ञः सत्यवादी च राजा लोके महीयते
verses.transliteration:
sattvābhijanasaṁpannaḥ sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ
kṛtajñaḥ satyavādī ca rājā loke mahīyate

translations.english: The king that is nobly endowed by heredily, and is kind, that has subdued his senses, and is grateful and truth telling, obtains renown in this world.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्तु राजा स्थितोऽधर्मे मित्राणामुपकारिणाम्
मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञां कुरुते को नृशंसतरस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
yastu rājā sthito'dharme mitrāṇāmupakāriṇām
mithyāpratijñāṁ kurute ko nṛśaṁsatarastataḥ

translations.english: And who is more wicked than that king who, rooted in unrighteousness, makes false promises to friends intent upon his welfare?

verses.sanskrit:
शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं तु गवानृते
आत्मानं स्वजनं हन्ति पुरुषः पुरुषानृते
verses.transliteration:
śatamaśvānṛte hanti sahasraṁ tu gavānṛte
ātmānaṁ svajanaṁ hanti puruṣaḥ puruṣānṛte

translations.english: He that speaks a falsehood with reference to a horse, becomes guilty of the deaths of an hundred horses: he committing himself to a falsehood relative to a cow, reapeth the demerit of slaying a thousand kine; while he that uttereth an untruth touching a person, destroys self as well as his kindred.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वं कृतार्थो मित्राणां न तत्प्रतिकरोति यः
कृतघ्नः सर्वभूतानां स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
pūrvaṁ kṛtārtho mitrāṇāṁ na tatpratikaroti yaḥ
kṛtaghnaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ sa vadhyaḥ plavageśvara

translations.english: That ungrateful might that having at first attained benefit at the hands of his friends, does not requite it, is, O lord of monkeys, worthy of being slain by all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
गीतोऽयं ब्रह्मणा श्लोकः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः
दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नं क्रुद्धेन तं निबोध प्लवंगम
verses.transliteration:
gīto'yaṁ brahmaṇā ślokaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
dṛṣṭvā kṛtaghnaṁ kruddhena taṁ nibodha plavaṁgama

translations.english: Seeing an ingrate wretch, the wrathful Brahmā sang the (previous) śloka, bowed down to by all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चोरे भग्नव्रते तथा
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ

translations.english: Do you understand that, O monkey. The pious provide deliverance for the cow-killer, the winebiber, the thief, and the violator of vows; but for the ungrateful person there is no deliverance whatever.

verses.sanskrit:
अनार्यस्त्वं कृतघ्नश्च मिथ्यावादी च वानर
पूर्वं कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत्प्रतिकरोषि यत्
verses.transliteration:
anāryastvaṁ kṛtaghnaśca mithyāvādī ca vānara
pūrvaṁ kṛtārtho rāmasya na tatpratikaroṣi yat

translations.english: You are ignoble and ungrateful and lying, O monkey, since, having been formerly benefited by Rāma, you did not requite his services.

verses.sanskrit:
ननु नाम कृतार्थेन त्वया रामस्य वानर
सीताया मार्गणे यत्नः कर्तव्यः कृतमिच्छता
verses.transliteration:
nanu nāma kṛtārthena tvayā rāmasya vānara
sītāyā mārgaṇe yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ kṛtamicchatā

translations.english: Having been benefited by Rāma, you, anxious to repay his kindness, should exert yourself in search of Sita.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्या प्रतिश्रवः
न त्वां रामो विजानीते सर्पं मण्डूकराविणम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu sakto mithyā pratiśravaḥ
na tvāṁ rāmo vijānīte sarpaṁ maṇḍūkarāviṇam

translations.english: But, of false promises, you had been indulging in gross enjoyments,-nor does Rāma know you for a serpent, croaking like a frog*. *Crying through the voice of the frog in its mouth. Another meaning is, croaking like a frog, to allure frog to it.

verses.sanskrit:
महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना
हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
mahābhāgena rāmeṇa pāpaḥ karuṇavedinā
harīṇāṁ prāpito rājyaṁ tvaṁ durātmā mahātmanā

translations.english: A sinful wretch and of wicked soul, you had obtained the kingdom of the monkeys through the agency of the eminently virtuous, kind and high-souled Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं चेन्नाभिजानीषे रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
सद्यस्त्वं निशितैर्बाणैर्हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ cennābhijānīṣe rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
sadyastvaṁ niśitairbāṇairhato drakṣyasi vālinam

translations.english: You did not acknowledge the good offices rendered to you by the high-souled Rāghava; and therefore, slain by means of sharpened shafts, you shall soon see Vali.

verses.sanskrit:
न च संकुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः
समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः
verses.transliteration:
na ca saṁkucitaḥ panthā yena vālī hato gataḥ
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vālipathamanvagāḥ

translations.english: The way that has been wended by the slain Vali, is not yet narrowed. Do you, O Sugriva, desist in time: do not walk in the wake of Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
न नूनमिक्ष्वाकुवरस्य कार्मुका;च्च्युताञ्शरान्पश्यसि वज्रसंनिभान्
ततः सुखं नाम निषेवसे सुखी; न रामकार्यं मनसाप्यवेक्षसे
verses.transliteration:
na nūnamikṣvākuvarasya kārmukā;ccyutāñśarānpaśyasi vajrasaṁnibhān
tataḥ sukhaṁ nāma niṣevase sukhī; na rāmakāryaṁ manasāpyavekṣase

translations.english: Do not behold the shafts resembling thunderbolts shot from the bow of that best of the Ikş wakus. Then, attaining happiness, you shall pass your days in peace. Nor do you mentally neglect Rāma's business.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा
अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना
verses.transliteration:
tathā bruvāṇaṁ saumitriṁ pradīptamiva tejasā
abravīllakṣmaṇaṁ tārā tārādhipanibhānanā

translations.english: When Sumitra's son, Laksmana, had spoken thus, flaming in energy, Tārā of face fair as the moon, said to him,

verses.sanskrit:
नैवं लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो नायं परुषमर्हति
हरीणामीश्वरः श्रोतुं तव वक्त्राद्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
naivaṁ lakṣmaṇa vaktavyo nāyaṁ paruṣamarhati
harīṇāmīśvaraḥ śrotuṁ tava vaktrādviśeṣataḥ

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, you ought not to speak thus: and this lord of monkeys does not deserve to hear this harsh speech from your lips, in especial.

verses.sanskrit:
नैवाकृतज्ञः सुग्रीवो न शठो नापि दारुणः
नैवानृतकथो वीर न जिह्मश्च कपीश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
naivākṛtajñaḥ sugrīvo na śaṭho nāpi dāruṇaḥ
naivānṛtakatho vīra na jihmaśca kapīśvaraḥ

translations.english: Sugrīva is not ungrateful, or cunning, or heartless; nor does he, O hero, deal in falsehood; nor is he deceitful.

verses.sanskrit:
उपकारं कृतं वीरो नाप्ययं विस्मृतः कपिः
रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे
verses.transliteration:
upakāraṁ kṛtaṁ vīro nāpyayaṁ vismṛtaḥ kapiḥ
rāmeṇa vīra sugrīvo yadanyairduṣkaraṁ raṇe

translations.english: Nor has the heroic monkey, O hero, forgotten the good, incapable of being done by others in battle, that the hero; Rāma, has done in his behalf.

verses.sanskrit:
रामप्रसादात्कीर्तिं च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्
प्राप्तवानिह सुग्रीवो रुमां मां च परंतप
verses.transliteration:
rāmaprasādātkīrtiṁ ca kapirājyaṁ ca śāśvatam
prāptavāniha sugrīvo rumāṁ māṁ ca paraṁtapa

translations.english: O afflictor of foes, through Rāma's grace, Sugriva has here attained fame and the enduring empire of the monkeys, as well as Umā and myself.

verses.sanskrit:
सुदुःखं शायितः पूर्वं प्राप्येदं सुखमुत्तमम्
प्राप्तकालं न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः
verses.transliteration:
suduḥkhaṁ śāyitaḥ pūrvaṁ prāpyedaṁ sukhamuttamam
prāptakālaṁ na jānīte viśvāmitro yathā muniḥ

translations.english: Having lain down miserable before, Sugrīva, now that he has attained this supreme happiness, does not heed his urgent duties, like the ascetic Visvamitra.

verses.sanskrit:
घृताच्यां किल संसक्तो दशवर्षाणि लक्ष्मण
अहोऽमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtācyāṁ kila saṁsakto daśavarṣāṇi lakṣmaṇa
aho'manyata dharmātmā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ

translations.english: Attached to Ghrtāci, O Laksmana, the pious and mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra looked upon ten years as one day; and that best of those conversant with time, Viśvāmitra of mighty energy, did not perceive that the time (for doing a certain act) had arrived. What is to be said of other people?

verses.sanskrit:
देहधर्मं गतस्यास्य परिश्रान्तस्य लक्ष्मण
अवितृप्तस्य कामेषु रामः क्षन्तुमिहार्हति
verses.transliteration:
dehadharmaṁ gatasyāsya pariśrāntasya lakṣmaṇa
avitṛptasya kāmeṣu rāmaḥ kṣantumihārhati

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, it behoveth Rāma to forgive one who has all the bodily exigencies, who is fatigued, and who is not satisfied with the pleasures of Kama. Nor, O Laksmana, does it behove you, without ascertaining the exact import of things, to become suddenly subject to wrath, like any inferior person.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वयुक्ता हि पुरुषास्त्वद्विधाः पुरुषर्षभ
अविमृश्य न रोषस्य सहसा यान्ति वश्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
sattvayuktā hi puruṣāstvadvidhāḥ puruṣarṣabha
avimṛśya na roṣasya sahasā yānti vaśyatām

translations.english: O chief of men, persons endowed with the quality of goodness, like to you, do not suffer themselves to come under the sway of passion, without (at first) heedfully revolving matters.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादये त्वां धर्मज्ञ सुग्रीवार्थे समाहिता
महान्रोषसमुत्पन्नः संरम्भस्त्यज्यतामयम्
verses.transliteration:
prasādaye tvāṁ dharmajña sugrīvārthe samāhitā
mahānroṣasamutpannaḥ saṁrambhastyajyatāmayam

translations.english: I crave your favour with concentrated mind, O you that know morality. Renounce the mighty grief that springs from your ire.

verses.sanskrit:
रुमां मां कपिराज्यं च धनधान्यवसूनि च
रामप्रियार्थं सुग्रीवस्त्यजेदिति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration:
rumāṁ māṁ kapirājyaṁ ca dhanadhānyavasūni ca
rāmapriyārthaṁ sugrīvastyajediti matirmama

translations.english: This is my conviction that for compassing Rāma's welfare, Sugrīva can resign Umã and myself, and Angada, and the kingdom and wealth and corn and animals.

verses.sanskrit:
समानेष्व्यति सुग्रीवः सीतया सह राघवम्
शशाङ्कमिव रोहिष्या निहत्वा रावणं रणे
verses.transliteration:
samāneṣvyati sugrīvaḥ sītayā saha rāghavam
śaśāṅkamiva rohiṣyā nihatvā rāvaṇaṁ raṇe

translations.english: Slaying that worst of Rākṣasas, Sugrīva will bring Rāghava with Sītā, like to the moon accompanied by Rohiņi.

verses.sanskrit:
अहत्वा तांश्च दुर्धर्षान्राक्षसान्कामरूपिणः
न शक्यो रावणो हन्तुं येन सा मैथिली हृता
verses.transliteration:
ahatvā tāṁśca durdharṣānrākṣasānkāmarūpiṇaḥ
na śakyo rāvaṇo hantuṁ yena sā maithilī hṛtā

translations.english: Without slaying hundreds of thousands of Kotis, and thirty-six Ayutas, thousands and hundreds of irrepressible Rākṣasas wearing shapes at will, (Rāma) can not slay Rāvana, by whom Maithili has been carried away.

verses.sanskrit:
ते न शक्या रणे हन्तुमसहायेन लक्ष्मण
रावणः क्रूरकर्मा च सुग्रीवेण विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
te na śakyā raṇe hantumasahāyena lakṣmaṇa
rāvaṇaḥ krūrakarmā ca sugrīveṇa viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: They are incapable, O Laksmana, of being slain (by Rāma) in battle, unless he is supported (by others).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमाख्यातवान्वाली स ह्यभिज्ञो हरीश्वरः
आगमस्तु न मे व्यक्तः श्रवात्तस्य ब्रवीम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
evamākhyātavānvālī sa hyabhijño harīśvaraḥ
āgamastu na me vyaktaḥ śravāttasya bravīmyaham

translations.english: Rāvana is a wily warrior, and hence is the special need of Sugrīva. That knowing lord of monkeys, Väli, had told me all this. I do not know how Rāvana had secured this host: I say what I had heard from Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वत्सहायनिमित्तं वै प्रेषिता हरिपुंगवाः
आनेतुं वानरान्युद्धे सुबहून्हरियूथपान्
verses.transliteration:
tvatsahāyanimittaṁ vai preṣitā haripuṁgavāḥ
ānetuṁ vānarānyuddhe subahūnhariyūthapān

translations.english: For rendering you assistance, the foremost monkeys have been despatched in order to summon to the conflict numerous principal monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
तांश्च प्रतीक्षमाणोऽयं विक्रान्तान्सुमहाबलान्
राघवस्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं न निर्याति हरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁśca pratīkṣamāṇo'yaṁ vikrāntānsumahābalān
rāghavasyārthasiddhyarthaṁ na niryāti harīśvaraḥ

translations.english: Expecting these powerful and exceedingly strong ones, for attaining Rāghava's end, this lord of monkeys does not (yet) sally out.

verses.sanskrit:
कृता तु संस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण यथापुरा
अद्य तैर्वानरैर्सर्वैरागन्तव्यं महाबलैः
verses.transliteration:
kṛtā tu saṁsthā saumitre sugrīveṇa yathāpurā
adya tairvānarairsarvairāgantavyaṁ mahābalaiḥ

translations.english: Things, O Saumitri, have beforehand been so satisfactorily arranged by Sugrīva, that this very day the mighty one will be joined with all those monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि गोलाङ्गूलशतानि च
अद्य त्वामुपयास्यन्ति जहि कोपमरिंदम
कोट्योऽनेकास्तु काकुत्स्थ कपीनां दीप्ततेजसाम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣakoṭisahasrāṇi golāṅgūlaśatāni ca
adya tvāmupayāsyanti jahi kopamariṁdama
koṭyo'nekāstu kākutstha kapīnāṁ dīptatejasām

translations.english: This very day billions of bears and thousands of golangulas as well as innumerable Koțis of monkeys flaming in energy shall join you. Therefore, O subduer of enemies, banish your anger.

verses.sanskrit:
तव हि मुखमिदं निरीक्ष्य कोपा;त्क्षतजनिभे नयने निरीक्षमाणाः
हरिवरवनिता न यान्ति शान्तिं; प्रथमभयस्य हि शङ्किताः स्म सर्वाः
verses.transliteration:
tava hi mukhamidaṁ nirīkṣya kopā;tkṣatajanibhe nayane nirīkṣamāṇāḥ
harivaravanitā na yānti śāntiṁ; prathamabhayasya hi śaṅkitāḥ sma sarvāḥ

translations.english: Seeing this your face wrought up with wrath, and your eyes appearing like red sores, the wives of the best of monkeys experience no peace, and they are agitated by the fear that exercised them of late.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तस्तारया वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहितम्
मृदुस्वभावः सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktastārayā vākyaṁ praśritaṁ dharmasaṁhitam
mṛdusvabhāvaḥ saumitriḥ pratijagrāha tadvacaḥ

translations.english: Humbly addressed in these words informed with morality, Sumitra's son, resuming his native mildness, accepted them.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रतिगृहीते तु वाक्ये हरिगणेश्वरः
लक्ष्मणात्सुमहत्त्रासं वस्त्रं क्लिन्नमिवात्यजत्
verses.transliteration:
tasminpratigṛhīte tu vākye harigaṇeśvaraḥ
lakṣmaṇātsumahattrāsaṁ vastraṁ klinnamivātyajat

translations.english: On his accepting the speech, the lord of monkeys like a wet cloth cast off from him the fear he had conceived on account of Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कण्ठगतं माल्यं चित्रं बहुगुणं महत्
चिच्छेद विमदश्चासीत्सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kaṇṭhagataṁ mālyaṁ citraṁ bahuguṇaṁ mahat
ciccheda vimadaścāsītsugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ

translations.english: Then Sugriva-lord of monkeys-tore away the gaudy and variegated garland on his neck-potent with many a virtue, and become deprived of energy.

verses.sanskrit:
स लक्ष्मणं भीमबलं सर्ववानरसत्तमः
अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीवः संप्रहर्षयन्
verses.transliteration:
sa lakṣmaṇaṁ bhīmabalaṁ sarvavānarasattamaḥ
abravītpraśritaṁ vākyaṁ sugrīvaḥ saṁpraharṣayan

translations.english: And that master of all the monkeys, Sugrīva, gladdening Lakşmaņa of dreadful prowess, humbly observed to him,

verses.sanskrit:
प्रनष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्
रामप्रसादात्सौमित्रे पुनः प्राप्तमिदं मया
verses.transliteration:
pranaṣṭā śrīśca kīrtiśca kapirājyaṁ ca śāśvatam
rāmaprasādātsaumitre punaḥ prāptamidaṁ mayā

translations.english: You son to Sumitrā, by the favour of Rāma have I received back my lost luck, my fame, and this eternal monarchy of the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
कः शक्तस्तस्य देवस्य ख्यातस्य स्वेन कर्मणा
तादृशं विक्रमं वीर प्रतिकर्तुमरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
kaḥ śaktastasya devasya khyātasya svena karmaṇā
tādṛśaṁ vikramaṁ vīra pratikartumariṁdama

translations.english: O king's son, who is capable of repaying even in part an action like that of the divine (Rāma) renowned by means of his own acts?

verses.sanskrit:
सीतां प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम्
सहायमात्रेण मया राघवः स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration:
sītāṁ prāpsyati dharmātmā vadhiṣyati ca rāvaṇam
sahāyamātreṇa mayā rāghavaḥ svena tejasā

translations.english: By virtue of native energy, and merely with my help, the righteous Rāghava shall recover Sītā and slay Rāvana to boot.

verses.sanskrit:
सहायकृत्यं हि तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः
शैलश्च वसुधा चैव बाणेनैकेन दारिताः
verses.transliteration:
sahāyakṛtyaṁ hi tasya yena sapta mahādrumāḥ
śailaśca vasudhā caiva bāṇenaikena dāritāḥ

translations.english: What need of assistance to him who with a single shaft rived seven giant trees, a mountain, and the Earth.

verses.sanskrit:
धनुर्विस्फारमाणस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण
सशैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैस्तस्य किं नु वै
verses.transliteration:
dhanurvisphāramāṇasya yasya śabdena lakṣmaṇa
saśailā kampitā bhūmiḥ sahāyaistasya kiṁ nu vai

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, what is the use of help to him the sounds of whose stretching bow made the Earth tremble with her mountains?

verses.sanskrit:
अनुयात्रां नरेन्द्रस्य करिष्येऽहं नरर्षभ
गच्छतो रावणं हन्तुं वैरिणं सपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration:
anuyātrāṁ narendrasya kariṣye'haṁ nararṣabha
gacchato rāvaṇaṁ hantuṁ vairiṇaṁ sapuraḥsaram

translations.english: O best of men, when that foremost of men shall set out for slaying his enemy, Rāvaņa along with those going before him, I will follow him.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि किंचिदतिक्रान्तं विश्वासात्प्रणयेन वा
प्रेष्यस्य क्षमितव्यं मे न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति
verses.transliteration:
yadi kiṁcidatikrāntaṁ viśvāsātpraṇayena vā
preṣyasya kṣamitavyaṁ me na kaścinnāparādhyati

translations.english: I through my confidence, or presuming upon our amity. I have transgressed in any way, (Rāma) ought to excuse his servant,—for there is no servant that does not transgress.

verses.sanskrit:
इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः
अभवल्लक्ष्मणः प्रीतः प्रेंणा चेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
iti tasya bruvāṇasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
abhavallakṣmaṇaḥ prītaḥ preṁṇā cedamuvāca ha

translations.english: When the high-souled Sugrīva had said this, Lakşmaņa became well pleased and he spoke from love,

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा हि मम भ्राता सनाथो वानरेश्वर
त्वया नाथेन सुग्रीव प्रश्रितेन विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā hi mama bhrātā sanātho vānareśvara
tvayā nāthena sugrīva praśritena viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: Having in especial, you endued with humility, my brother, O monarch of monkeys, is every way strong, O Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते प्रभावः सुग्रीव यच्च ते शौचमुत्तमम्
अर्हस्तं कपिराज्यस्य श्रियं भोक्तुमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
yaste prabhāvaḥ sugrīva yacca te śaucamuttamam
arhastaṁ kapirājyasya śriyaṁ bhoktumanuttamām

translations.english: Such is your strength, O Sugriva, and such your self-denial, that you are fully worthy to enjoy the good fortune of the king of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
सहायेन च सुग्रीव त्वया रामः प्रतापवान्
वधिष्यति रणे शत्रूनचिरान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
sahāyena ca sugrīva tvayā rāmaḥ pratāpavān
vadhiṣyati raṇe śatrūnacirānnātra saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: O Sugrīva, by your help, the puissant Rāma shall speedily slay his foe. Of this there is not the least doubt.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः
उपपन्नं च युक्तं च सुग्रीव तव भाषितम्
verses.transliteration:
dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya saṁgrāmeṣvanivartinaḥ
upapannaṁ ca yuktaṁ ca sugrīva tava bhāṣitam

translations.english: O Sugrīva, what you virtuous, grateful and never turning away from fight, have said is fit and proper.

verses.sanskrit:
दोषज्ञः सति सामर्थ्ये कोऽन्यो भाषितुमर्हति
वर्जयित्वा मम ज्येष्ठं त्वां च वानरसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
doṣajñaḥ sati sāmarthye ko'nyo bhāṣitumarhati
varjayitvā mama jyeṣṭhaṁ tvāṁ ca vānarasattama

translations.english: What knowing person, excepting, O foremost of monkeys, yourself and my elder brother, can speak so.

verses.sanskrit:
सदृशश्चासि रामस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च
सहायो दैवतैर्दत्तश्चिराय हरिपुंगव
verses.transliteration:
sadṛśaścāsi rāmasya vikrameṇa balena ca
sahāyo daivatairdattaścirāya haripuṁgava

translations.english: Resembling Rāma himself in strength and prowess, you, O chief of monkeys, have been ordained his help by the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
किं तु शीघ्रमितो वीर निष्क्राम त्वं मया सह
सान्त्वयस्व वयस्यं च भार्याहरणदुःखितम्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tu śīghramito vīra niṣkrāma tvaṁ mayā saha
sāntvayasva vayasyaṁ ca bhāryāharaṇaduḥkhitam

translations.english: But, O hero, do you speedily go out with me and soothe your friend aggrieved for the ravishment of his wife.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्च शोकाभिभूतस्य श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
मया त्वं परुषाण्युक्तस्तच्च त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yacca śokābhibhūtasya śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
mayā tvaṁ paruṣāṇyuktastacca tvaṁ kṣantumarhasi

translations.english: And do you, my frie forgive what rough speech, on hearing the utterances of Rāma sunk in grief, I have given you.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
हनुमन्तं स्थितं पार्श्वे सचिवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
hanumantaṁ sthitaṁ pārśve sacivaṁ vākyamabravīt

translations.english: Thus addressed by the magnanimous Lakşmana Sugrīva said to Hanumān, staying beside him,

verses.sanskrit:
प्रेषिताः प्रथमं ये च मया दूता महाजवाः
त्वरणार्थं तु भूयस्त्वं हरीन्संप्रेषयापरान्
verses.transliteration:
preṣitāḥ prathamaṁ ye ca mayā dūtā mahājavāḥ
tvaraṇārthaṁ tu bhūyastvaṁ harīnsaṁpreṣayāparān

translations.english: I know those monkeys that I have first despatched, to be gifted with great velocity*, yet, for urging speed upon them, do you send other foremost of monkeys. *The commentator slips the sense here. According to him, the meaning is, Those monkeys whom I have first sent, are known to me.

verses.sanskrit:
ये प्रसक्ताश्च कामेषु दीर्घसूत्राश्च वानराः
इहानयस्व तान्सर्वाञ्शीघ्रं तु मम शासनात्
verses.transliteration:
ye prasaktāśca kāmeṣu dīrghasūtrāśca vānarāḥ
ihānayasva tānsarvāñśīghraṁ tu mama śāsanāt

translations.english: Do you directly bring up here those monkeychiefs that are given up to lust or are dilatory.

verses.sanskrit:
अहोभिर्दशभिर्ये च नागच्छन्ति ममाज्ञया
हन्तव्यास्ते दुरात्मानो राजशासनदूषकाः
verses.transliteration:
ahobhirdaśabhirye ca nāgacchanti mamājñayā
hantavyāste durātmāno rājaśāsanadūṣakāḥ

translations.english: Those wicked ones, that finding fault with the royal mandate, do not (come in) at my command within ten days, must be slain.

verses.sanskrit:
शतान्यथ सहस्राणि कोट्यश्च मम शासनात्
प्रयान्तु कपिसिंहानां दिशो मम मते स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
śatānyatha sahasrāṇi koṭyaśca mama śāsanāt
prayāntu kapisiṁhānāṁ diśo mama mate sthitāḥ

translations.english: Let those hundreds and thousands and kotis of leonine monkeys that abide by my mandate, hie (hence) at my behest.

verses.sanskrit:
मेघपर्वतसंकाशाश्छादयन्त इवाम्बरम्
घोररूपाः कपिश्रेष्ठा यान्तु मच्छासनादितः
verses.transliteration:
meghaparvatasaṁkāśāśchādayanta ivāmbaram
ghorarūpāḥ kapiśreṣṭhā yāntu macchāsanāditaḥ

translations.english: Let (monkey) resembling clouds or mountains, cover up the sky; and let the foremost monkeys of dreadful forms march hence at my command.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गतिज्ञा गतिं गत्वा पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः
आनयन्तु हरीन्सर्वांस्त्वरिताः शासनान्मम
verses.transliteration:
te gatijñā gatiṁ gatvā pṛthivyāṁ sarvavānarāḥ
ānayantu harīnsarvāṁstvaritāḥ śāsanānmama

translations.english: Let all the monkeys on earth, acquainted with motion lying themselves and summoning speed at my command, bring all the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य वानरराजस्य श्रुत्वा वायुसुतो वचः
दिक्षु सर्वासु विक्रान्तान्प्रेषयामास वानरान्
verses.transliteration:
tasya vānararājasya śrutvā vāyusuto vacaḥ
dikṣu sarvāsu vikrāntānpreṣayāmāsa vānarān

translations.english: Hearing the words of the monkey-king, the son of the Wind-god despatched powerful monkeys in all directions.

verses.sanskrit:
ते पदं विष्णुविक्रान्तं पतत्रिज्योतिरध्वगाः
प्रयाताः प्रहिता राज्ञा हरयस्तत्क्षणेन वै
verses.transliteration:
te padaṁ viṣṇuvikrāntaṁ patatrijyotiradhvagāḥ
prayātāḥ prahitā rājñā harayastatkṣaṇena vai

translations.english: Despatched by the king, the monkeys, ranging the sphere of birds and stars, immediately went through the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
ते समुद्रेषु गिरिषु वनेषु च सरित्सु च
वानरा वानरान्सर्वान्रामहेतोरचोदयन्
verses.transliteration:
te samudreṣu giriṣu vaneṣu ca saritsu ca
vānarā vānarānsarvānrāmahetoracodayan

translations.english: And on oceans and mountains, in forests and tanks, the monkeys began to send away all the apes on behalf of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युकालोपमस्याज्ञां राजराजस्य वानराः
सुग्रीवस्याययुः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवभयदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration:
mṛtyukālopamasyājñāṁ rājarājasya vānarāḥ
sugrīvasyāyayuḥ śrutvā sugrīvabhayadarśinaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the mandate of that king of kings, Sugriva, resembling the Hour of death, the monkeys, conceiving fear for Sugrīva, set out.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तेऽञ्जनसंकाशा गिरेस्तस्मान्महाजवाः
तिस्रः कोट्यः प्लवंगानां निर्ययुर्यत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tataste'ñjanasaṁkāśā girestasmānmahājavāḥ
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ plavaṁgānāṁ niryayuryatra rāghavaḥ

translations.english: And monkeys resembling collyrium (in hue), numbering three kotis, endued with huge might, set out from the Añjana hill for the place where Rāghava was.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्तं गच्छति यत्रार्कस्तस्मिन्गिरिवरे रताः
तप्तहेमसमाभासास्तस्मात्कोट्यो दशच्युताः
verses.transliteration:
astaṁ gacchati yatrārkastasmingirivare ratāḥ
taptahemasamābhāsāstasmātkoṭyo daśacyutāḥ

translations.english: And ten koțis having the splendour of molten gold inhabiting the mountain where the sun sets, set out.

verses.sanskrit:
कैलास शिखरेभ्यश्च सिंहकेसरवर्चसाम्
ततः कोटिसहस्राणि वानराणामुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
kailāsa śikharebhyaśca siṁhakesaravarcasām
tataḥ koṭisahasrāṇi vānarāṇāmupāgaman

translations.english: And a thousand kotis, hued like the lion's mane, came from the peaks of Kailāsa.

verses.sanskrit:
फलमूलेन जीवन्तो हिमवन्तमुपाश्रिताः
तेषां कोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रं समवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
phalamūlena jīvanto himavantamupāśritāḥ
teṣāṁ koṭisahasrāṇāṁ sahasraṁ samavartata

translations.english: And of those dwelling in Himālaya, subsisting on fruits and roots, numbering a thousand and kotis, a thousand appeared.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गारक समानानां भीमानां भीमकर्मणाम्
विन्ध्याद्वानरकोटीनां सहस्राण्यपतन्द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
aṅgāraka samānānāṁ bhīmānāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām
vindhyādvānarakoṭīnāṁ sahasrāṇyapatandrutam

translations.english: And thousands of dreadful monkeys of terrible deeds, hued like charcoal, numbering kot is, rushed suddenly from Vindhya.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षीरोदवेलानिलयास्तमालवनवासिनः
नारिकेलाशनाश्चैव तेषां संख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
kṣīrodavelānilayāstamālavanavāsinaḥ
nārikelāśanāścaiva teṣāṁ saṁkhyā na vidyate

translations.english: And there exists no record of the number of those inhabiting the shores of the ocean of milk, and the dwellers in the Tamāla forests, as well as those subsisting on coconuts.

verses.sanskrit:
वनेभ्यो गह्वरेभ्यश्च सरिद्भ्यश्च महाजवाः
आगच्छद्वानरी सेना पिबन्तीव दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration:
vanebhyo gahvarebhyaśca saridbhyaśca mahājavāḥ
āgacchadvānarī senā pibantīva divākaram

translations.english: And, as if drinking up the sun, the mighty monkey host came from forests and caves and rivers.

verses.sanskrit:
ये तु त्वरयितुं याता वानराः सर्ववानरान्
ते वीरा हिमवच्छैलं ददृशुस्तं महाद्रुमम्
verses.transliteration:
ye tu tvarayituṁ yātā vānarāḥ sarvavānarān
te vīrā himavacchailaṁ dadṛśustaṁ mahādrumam

translations.english: And it came to pass that those heroic monkeys that had gone away to spur others on, found a mighty tree on Himayat.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्गिरिवरे रम्ये यज्ञो महेश्वरः पुरा
सर्वदेवमनस्तोषो बभौ दिव्यो मनोहरः
verses.transliteration:
tasmingirivare ramye yajño maheśvaraḥ purā
sarvadevamanastoṣo babhau divyo manoharaḥ

translations.english: On that sacred mount in days of yore there took place a pleasing Maheswara* sacrifice. *The celestial horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नविष्यन्दजातानि मूलानि च फलानि च
अमृतस्वादुकल्पानि ददृशुस्तत्र वानराः
verses.transliteration:
annaviṣyandajātāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca
amṛtasvādukalpāni dadṛśustatra vānarāḥ

translations.english: There the monkeys found grateful fruits and roots sprung from the streams of sacrificial oblations, and resembling ambrosia.

verses.sanskrit:
तदन्न संभवं दिव्यं फलं मूलं मनोहरम्
यः कश्चित्सकृदश्नाति मासं भवति तर्पितः
verses.transliteration:
tadanna saṁbhavaṁ divyaṁ phalaṁ mūlaṁ manoharam
yaḥ kaścitsakṛdaśnāti māsaṁ bhavati tarpitaḥ

translations.english: He that partakes of those excellent fruits and roots sprung from the sacrificial ingredients, does not experience hunger for a month.

verses.sanskrit:
तानि मूलानि दिव्यानि फलानि च फलाशनाः
औषधानि च दिव्यानि जगृहुर्हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
tāni mūlāni divyāni phalāni ca phalāśanāḥ
auṣadhāni ca divyāni jagṛhurhariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: Those prime monkeys, feeding on fruits, gathered those sapid fruits and roots and medicinal herbs.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माच्च यज्ञायतनात्पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च
आनिन्युर्वानरा गत्वा सुग्रीवप्रियकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
tasmācca yajñāyatanātpuṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca
āninyurvānarā gatvā sugrīvapriyakāraṇāt

translations.english: And for compassing the good of Sugrīva, repairing thither, the monkeys brought ordorous blossoms from the sacrificial ground.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु सर्वे हरिवराः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्
संचोदयित्वा त्वरितं यूथानां जग्मुरग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
te tu sarve harivarāḥ pṛthivyāṁ sarvavānarān
saṁcodayitvā tvaritaṁ yūthānāṁ jagmuragrataḥ

translations.english: And all those foremost of monkeys, taking all the monkeys of the earth, hastily set off in the van of the herds.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु तेन मुहूर्तेन यूथपाः शीघ्रकारिणः
किष्किन्धां त्वरया प्राप्ताः सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः
verses.transliteration:
te tu tena muhūrtena yūthapāḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ
kiṣkindhāṁ tvarayā prāptāḥ sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ

translations.english: And in a short while, those fast-fleeting apes speedily reached Kişkindhā, where the monkey Sugriva was.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गृहीत्वौषधीः सर्वाः फलं मूलं च वानराः
तं प्रतिग्राहयामासुर्वचनं चेदमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
te gṛhītvauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ phalaṁ mūlaṁ ca vānarāḥ
taṁ pratigrāhayāmāsurvacanaṁ cedamabruvan

translations.english: And taking the healing herbs and the fruits and roots, the monkeys made them over to Sugrīva, and said,

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे परिगताः शैलाः समुद्राश्च वनानि च
पृथिव्यां वानराः सर्वे शासनादुपयान्ति ते
verses.transliteration:
sarve parigatāḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca vanāni ca
pṛthivyāṁ vānarāḥ sarve śāsanādupayānti te

translations.english: Having traversed mountains, rivers and forests, all the monkeys of the earth bend their steps towards you in obedience to your command.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं श्रुत्वा ततो हृष्टः सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः
प्रतिजग्राह च प्रीतस्तेषां सर्वमुपायनम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ śrutvā tato hṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ
pratijagrāha ca prītasteṣāṁ sarvamupāyanam

translations.english: Hearing this, Sugriva-lord of monkeys-was well pleased, and with a glad heart accepted all those present.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य च तत्सर्वमुपानयमुपाहृतम्
वानरान्सान्त्वयित्वा च सर्वानेव व्यसर्जयत्
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya ca tatsarvamupānayamupāhṛtam
vānarānsāntvayitvā ca sarvāneva vyasarjayat

translations.english: Having accepted all those presents, (Sugrīva), after soothing the monkeys, dismissed them.

verses.sanskrit:
विसर्जयित्वा स हरीञ्शूरांस्तान्कृतकर्मणः
मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं राघवं च महाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
visarjayitvā sa harīñśūrāṁstānkṛtakarmaṇaḥ
mene kṛtārthamātmānaṁ rāghavaṁ ca mahābalam

translations.english: Having dismissed the thousands of apes, who had performed their task, he deemed himself as well as the mighty Rāghava as having secured success.

verses.sanskrit:
स लक्ष्मणो भीमबलं सर्ववानरसत्तमम्
अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीवं संप्रहर्षयन्
किष्किन्धाया विनिष्क्राम यदि ते सौम्य रोचते
verses.transliteration:
sa lakṣmaṇo bhīmabalaṁ sarvavānarasattamam
abravītpraśritaṁ vākyaṁ sugrīvaṁ saṁpraharṣayan
kiṣkindhāyā viniṣkrāma yadi te saumya rocate

translations.english: Then Lakşmaņa in sweet words spoke to the exceedingly strong chief of monkeysSugriva-gladdening him,

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य सुभाषितम्
सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya subhāṣitam
sugrīvaḥ paramaprīto vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: If it please you, O placid one, I will go out of Kiskindhā. Hearing Laksmana's soft speech, Sugriva, highly delighted, said,

verses.sanskrit:
एवं भवतु गच्छामः स्थेयं त्वच्छासने मया
तमेवमुक्त्वा सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bhavatu gacchāmaḥ stheyaṁ tvacchāsane mayā
tamevamuktvā sugrīvo lakṣmaṇaṁ śubhalakṣmaṇam

translations.english: Be it so. Let us go. I abide by your behest. Having said this to Lakşmaņa of auspicious marks, Sugrīva dismissed the women with Tārā at their head.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरयः शीघ्रमाययुः
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे ये स्युः स्त्रीदर्शनक्षमाः
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā harayaḥ śīghramāyayuḥ
baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve ye syuḥ strīdarśanakṣamāḥ

translations.english: Then Sugrīva in a loud voice summoned the foremost monkey, saying, Come (hither). hearing his words, those monkeys that could present themselves before the females, did so with joined hands.

verses.sanskrit:
तानुवाच ततः प्राप्तान्राजार्कसदृशप्रभः
उपस्थापयत क्षिप्रं शिबिकां मम वानराः
verses.transliteration:
tānuvāca tataḥ prāptānrājārkasadṛśaprabhaḥ
upasthāpayata kṣipraṁ śibikāṁ mama vānarāḥ

translations.english: To them, who had presented themselves, said the king, of splendour resembling that of the Sun, Do, you monkeys, bring hither a car.8

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य हरयः शीघ्रविक्रमाः
समुपस्थापयामासुः शिबिकां प्रियदर्शनाम्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya harayaḥ śīghravikramāḥ
samupasthāpayāmāsuḥ śibikāṁ priyadarśanām

translations.english: Hearing his words, monkeys uniting vigour with celerity, brought a car lovely to behold.

verses.sanskrit:
तामुपस्थापितां दृष्ट्वा शिबिकां वानराधिपः
लक्ष्मणारुह्यतां शीघ्रमिति सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tāmupasthāpitāṁ dṛṣṭvā śibikāṁ vānarādhipaḥ
lakṣmaṇāruhyatāṁ śīghramiti saumitrimabravīt

translations.english: Seeing the car brought up, the lord of monkeys said to Sumitra's son, O Laksmana, ascend speedily.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा काञ्चनं यानं सुग्रीवः सूर्यसंनिभम्
बृहद्भिर्हरिभिर्युक्तमारुरोह सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā kāñcanaṁ yānaṁ sugrīvaḥ sūryasaṁnibham
bṛhadbhirharibhiryuktamāruroha salakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Having said this, Sugrīva in company with Lakşınana swiftly ascended the golden car resembling the sun, yoked with numerous steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि
शुक्लैश्च बालव्यजनैर्धूयमानैः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
pāṇḍureṇātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani
śuklaiśca bālavyajanairdhūyamānaiḥ samantataḥ

translations.english: With a pale umbrella held over his head, and white chowris waving around, with conchs and trumpets blowing, eulogized by bards, Sugrīva marched out, having obtained supreme regal auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit:
शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च बन्दिभिश्चाभिवन्दितः
निर्ययौ प्राप्य सुग्रीवो राज्यश्रियमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca bandibhiścābhivanditaḥ
niryayau prāpya sugrīvo rājyaśriyamanuttamām

translations.english: And surrounded by hundreds of high-spirited apes and armed people, he proceeded whither Rāma was staying.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं देशमनुप्राप्य श्रेष्ठं रामनिषेवितम्
अवातरन्महातेजाः शिबिकायाः सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ deśamanuprāpya śreṣṭhaṁ rāmaniṣevitam
avātaranmahātejāḥ śibikāyāḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: And having arrived at the excellent spot which was the home of Rāma, that highly energetic one alighted from the car along with Lakşmaņa. And having come to Rāma, Sugrīva (stood) folding his hands.

verses.sanskrit:
तटाकमिव तद्दृष्ट्वा रामः कुड्मलपङ्कजम्
वानराणां महत्सैन्यं सुग्रीवे प्रीतिमानभूत्
verses.transliteration:
taṭākamiva taddṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ kuḍmalapaṅkajam
vānarāṇāṁ mahatsainyaṁ sugrīve prītimānabhūt

translations.english: And when Sugrīva has folded his hands, the monkeys also did so. And beholding the mighty host of the monkeys resembling a tank filled with lotus buds, Rāma was well-pleased with Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
पादयोः पतितं मूर्ध्ना तमुत्थाप्य हरीश्वरम्
प्रेंणा च बहुमानाच्च राघवः परिषस्वजे
verses.transliteration:
pādayoḥ patitaṁ mūrdhnā tamutthāpya harīśvaram
preṁṇā ca bahumānācca rāghavaḥ pariṣasvaje

translations.english: And raising up the monkey-king who had bent his head at Rāma's feet, Rāghava embraced him from love and regard.

verses.sanskrit:
परिष्वज्य च धर्मात्मा निषीदेति ततोऽब्रवीत्
तं निषण्णं ततो दृष्ट्वा क्षितौ रामोऽब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration:
pariṣvajya ca dharmātmā niṣīdeti tato'bravīt
taṁ niṣaṇṇaṁ tato dṛṣṭvā kṣitau rāmo'bravīdvacaḥ

translations.english: Having embraced Sugrīva, that righteous one said to him, Be seated. And seeing Sugrīva seated on the ground, Rāma said,

verses.sanskrit:
हित्वा धर्मं तथार्थं च कामं यस्तु निषेवते
स वृक्षाग्रे यथा सुप्तः पतितः प्रतिबुध्यते
verses.transliteration:
hitvā dharmaṁ tathārthaṁ ca kāmaṁ yastu niṣevate
sa vṛkṣāgre yathā suptaḥ patitaḥ pratibudhyate

translations.english: He, O best of monkeys, is a king who, O hero, in season follows righteousness, pleasure and profit, always dividing the same (among all). He that, renouncing righteousness and the good, devotes himself to pleasure solely, is like a man that falling asleep on the top of a tree, wakes when he has fallen down.

verses.sanskrit:
अमित्राणां वधे युक्तो मित्राणां संग्रहे रतः
त्रिवर्गफलभोक्ता तु राजा धर्मेण युज्यते
verses.transliteration:
amitrāṇāṁ vadhe yukto mitrāṇāṁ saṁgrahe rataḥ
trivargaphalabhoktā tu rājā dharmeṇa yujyate

translations.english: That king is verily virtuous that, engaged in uprooting foes and advancing friends, attends to all the three ends.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्योगसमयस्त्वेष प्राप्तः शत्रुविनाशन
संचिन्त्यतां हि पिङ्गेश हरिभिः सह मन्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration:
udyogasamayastveṣa prāptaḥ śatruvināśana
saṁcintyatāṁ hi piṅgeśa haribhiḥ saha mantribhiḥ

translations.english: O destroyer of foes, the time is come for exertion: do you, O lord of monkeys, bethink yourself along with your monkey ministers.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रनष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्
त्वत्प्रसादान्महाबाहो पुनः प्राप्तमिदं मया
verses.transliteration:
pranaṣṭā śrīśca kīrtiśca kapirājyaṁ ca śāśvatam
tvatprasādānmahābāho punaḥ prāptamidaṁ mayā

translations.english: Thus addressed, Sugrīva said to Räma, O mighty-armed one, my lost luck, and repute, and the entire monkey kingdom I have received back through your gift, owing to thine and your brother's grace, you foremost of victors.

verses.sanskrit:
तव देवप्रसदाच्च भ्रातुश्च जयतां वर
कृतं न प्रतिकुर्याद्यः पुरुषाणां स दूषकः
verses.transliteration:
tava devaprasadācca bhrātuśca jayatāṁ vara
kṛtaṁ na pratikuryādyaḥ puruṣāṇāṁ sa dūṣakaḥ

translations.english: He that, having received a good office, does not requite it, reapeth obloquy among persons.

verses.sanskrit:
एते वानरमुख्याश्च शतशः शत्रुसूदन
प्राप्ताश्चादाय बलिनः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्
verses.transliteration:
ete vānaramukhyāśca śataśaḥ śatrusūdana
prāptāścādāya balinaḥ pṛthivyāṁ sarvavānarān

translations.english: These hundreds of prime monkeys, O destroyer of enemies, have come here, bringing with them all the monkeys of the world.

verses.sanskrit:
ते त्वामभिगमिष्यन्ति राक्षसं ये सबान्धवम्
निहत्य रावणं संख्ये ह्यानयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
te tvāmabhigamiṣyanti rākṣasaṁ ye sabāndhavam
nihatya rāvaṇaṁ saṁkhye hyānayiṣyanti maithilīm

translations.english: They will join you for battling the fiend in the field; and, slaying Ravana in fight, shall bring Mithilā's daughter.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तमुद्योगमवेक्ष्य बुद्धिमा;न्हरिप्रवीरस्य निदेशवर्तिनः
बभूव हर्षाद्वसुधाधिपात्मजः; प्रबुद्धनीलोत्पलतुल्यदर्शनः
verses.transliteration:
tatastamudyogamavekṣya buddhimā;nharipravīrasya nideśavartinaḥ
babhūva harṣādvasudhādhipātmajaḥ; prabuddhanīlotpalatulyadarśanaḥ

translations.english: Thereat the puissant son of the Earth's lord, witnessing the preparations made by the heroic monkey, remaining under his his command, appeared like a blown blue lotus.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
बाहुभ्यां संपरिष्वज्य प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिम्
verses.transliteration:
iti bruvāṇaṁ sugrīvaṁ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ
bāhubhyāṁ saṁpariṣvajya pratyuvāca kṛtāñjalim

translations.english: As Sugrīva was speaking thus with joined hands, that best of the righteous, Rāma, embraced him with his arms, and then replied,

verses.sanskrit:
यदिन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षं न तच्चित्रं भवेद्भुवि
आदित्यो वा सहस्रांशुः कुर्याद्वितिमिरं नभः
verses.transliteration:
yadindro varṣate varṣaṁ na taccitraṁ bhavedbhuvi
ādityo vā sahasrāṁśuḥ kuryādvitimiraṁ nabhaḥ

translations.english: That Indra poureth down showers, is no wonder, nor that this thousand-rayed Sun dispels darkness from the sky; nor yet that, O mild one, the Moon by his rays causes the clear night. (And in a similar way), friends like you bring delight, O subduer of foes. O mild one, that 'whatever is graceful, should be harboured in you is not strange.* *The commentator in his usual way of reading between the lines, says that the sense is—That you had gathered forces for serving your friend, is not strange. O placid one, it is well. I give the sense the śloka naturally yields.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं त्वयि न तच्चित्रं भवेद्यत्सौम्य शोभनम्
जानाम्यहं त्वां सुग्रीव सततं प्रियवादिनम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ tvayi na taccitraṁ bhavedyatsaumya śobhanam
jānāmyahaṁ tvāṁ sugrīva satataṁ priyavādinam

translations.english: I know, O Sugrīva, that you always speakst what is for my good.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वत्सनाथः सखे संख्ये जेतास्मि सकलानरीन्
त्वमेव मे सुहृन्मित्रं साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tvatsanāthaḥ sakhe saṁkhye jetāsmi sakalānarīn
tvameva me suhṛnmitraṁ sāhāyyaṁ kartumarhasi

translations.english: Assisted by you, my friend, I shall in battle vanquish all my foes. You being my friend and my ally, should assist me.

verses.sanskrit:
जहारात्मविनाशाय वैदेहीं राक्षसाधमः
वञ्चयित्वा तु पौलोमीमनुह्लादो यथा शचीम्
verses.transliteration:
jahārātmavināśāya vaidehīṁ rākṣasādhamaḥ
vañcayitvā tu paulomīmanuhlādo yathā śacīm

translations.english: That worst of Rākșasas has carried away Maithilī, to bring down destruction upon himself, even as Anuhlāda ravished Puloma's daughter, Sachi, deceiving her sire.

verses.sanskrit:
नचिरात्तं हनिष्यामि रावणं निशितैः शरैः
पौलोम्याः पितरं दृप्तं शतक्रतुरिवारिहा
verses.transliteration:
nacirāttaṁ haniṣyāmi rāvaṇaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
paulomyāḥ pitaraṁ dṛptaṁ śatakraturivārihā

translations.english: That Rāvana I will at no distant date slay with my sharpened shafts, even as that slayer of enemies, he of an hundred sacrifices-slew the haughty father of Paulomi.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव रजः समभिवर्तत
उष्णां तीव्रां सहस्रांशोश्छादयद्गगने प्रभाम्
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare caiva rajaḥ samabhivartata
uṣṇāṁ tīvrāṁ sahasrāṁśośchādayadgagane prabhām

translations.english: Presently appeared volumes of dust, and the hot and fierce rays of the sun were hid in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
दिशः पर्याकुलाश्चासन्रजसा तेन मूर्छिताः
चचाल च मही सर्वा सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration:
diśaḥ paryākulāścāsanrajasā tena mūrchitāḥ
cacāla ca mahī sarvā saśailavanakānanā

translations.english: And darkened by the gloom, all sides became bewildered. And the entire earth with her mountains, forests, and wocds, trembled.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो नगेन्द्रसंकाशैस्तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः
कृत्स्ना संछादिता भूमिरसंख्येयैः प्लवंगमैः
verses.transliteration:
tato nagendrasaṁkāśaistīkṣṇa daṁṣṭrairmahābalaiḥ
kṛtsnā saṁchāditā bhūmirasaṁkhyeyaiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ

translations.english: Then the whole ground was covered with innumerable monkeys gifted with great strength, and having sharp teeth, and resembling kings of men.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः काञ्चनशैलाभस्ताराया वीर्यवान्पिता
अनेकैर्दशसाहस्रैः कोटिभिः प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kāñcanaśailābhastārāyā vīryavānpitā
anekairdaśasāhasraiḥ koṭibhiḥ pratyadṛśyata

translations.english: Then, having the splendour of the Golden hill, the puissant sire of Tārā was seen at the head of many thousand kotis.

verses.sanskrit:
अनीकैर्बहुसाहस्रैर्वानराणां समन्वितः
पिता हनुमतः श्रीमान्केसरी प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
anīkairbahusāhasrairvānarāṇāṁ samanvitaḥ
pitā hanumataḥ śrīmānkesarī pratyadṛśyata

translations.english: And Hanuman's father, the graceful Kasarī, appeared in company with many thousands of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
गोलाङ्गूलमहाराजो गवाक्षो भीमविक्रमः
वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण वानराणामदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
golāṅgūlamahārājo gavākṣo bhīmavikramaḥ
vṛtaḥ koṭisahasreṇa vānarāṇāmadṛśyata

translations.english: And Gavaksa-sovereign of Golangulas-endowed with dreadful might, appeared, surrounded by thousand koțis of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षाणां भीमवेगानां धूम्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः
वृतः कोटिसहस्राभ्यां द्वाभ्यां समभिवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣāṇāṁ bhīmavegānāṁ dhūmraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
vṛtaḥ koṭisahasrābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ samabhivartata

translations.english: And Dhūmra of bears endowed with terrific speed—destroyer of foes—appeared, surrounded by two thousand kotis.

verses.sanskrit:
महाचलनिभैर्घोरैः पनसो नाम यूथपः
आजगाम महावीर्यस्तिसृभिः कोटिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
mahācalanibhairghoraiḥ panaso nāma yūthapaḥ
ājagāma mahāvīryastisṛbhiḥ koṭibhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: And the leader of herds, named Panasa, of exceeding prowess, came, accompanied with three kotis, mighty and dreadful.

verses.sanskrit:
नीलाञ्जनचयाकारो नीलो नामाथ यूथपः
अदृश्यत महाकायः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
nīlāñjanacayākāro nīlo nāmātha yūthapaḥ
adṛśyata mahākāyaḥ koṭibhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: And the leader of herds, named Nīla, of huge body, resembling a mass of blue collyrium. appeared with ten kotis.

verses.sanskrit:
दरीमुखश्च बलवान्यूथपोऽभ्याययौ तदा
वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण सुग्रीवं समुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
darīmukhaśca balavānyūthapo'bhyāyayau tadā
vṛtaḥ koṭisahasreṇa sugrīvaṁ samupasthitaḥ

translations.english: And that powerful leader of herdsDarimukha, came, sutrounded by thousands of kotis, and took up his post by Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चोभावश्विपुत्रौ महावलौ
कोटिकोटिसहस्रेण वानराणामदृश्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
maindaśca dvividaścobhāvaśviputrau mahāvalau
koṭikoṭisahasreṇa vānarāṇāmadṛśyatām

translations.english: And Mainda and Dvivida-sons of Asvi both-of mighty strength, appeared with kotis upon thousands of koțis of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रेण शतेन च
पृष्ठतोऽनुगतः प्राप्तो हरिभिर्गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ koṭisahasrāṇāṁ sahasreṇa śatena ca
pṛṣṭhato'nugataḥ prāpto haribhirgandhamādanaḥ

translations.english: Then, followed at his back by hundreds and thousands of koțis, came the monkey, Gandhamādana.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पद्मसहस्रेण वृतः शङ्कुशतेन च
युवराजोऽङ्गदः प्राप्तः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ padmasahasreṇa vṛtaḥ śaṅkuśatena ca
yuvarājo'ṅgadaḥ prāptaḥ pitṛtulyaparākramaḥ

translations.english: Then came the young prince Angada, in prowess resembling his sire, accompanied by a thousand padmas and an hundred sankhas.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ताराद्युतिस्तारो हरिर्भीमपराक्रमः
पञ्चभिर्हरिकोटीभिर्दूरतः प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
tatastārādyutistāro harirbhīmaparākramaḥ
pañcabhirharikoṭībhirdūrataḥ pratyadṛśyata

translations.english: Then appeared at a distance, accompanied by five koțis of monkeys endowed with dreadful prowess,-Tārā, having the splendour of a star.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रजानुः कपिर्वीरो यूथपः प्रत्यदृश्यत
एकादशानां कोटीनामीश्वरस्तैश्च संवृतः
verses.transliteration:
indrajānuḥ kapirvīro yūthapaḥ pratyadṛśyata
ekādaśānāṁ koṭīnāmīśvarastaiśca saṁvṛtaḥ

translations.english: And then appeared Indrajāni, the heroic monkey and leader of herds-lord of eleven kotis-surrounded by them.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रम्भस्त्वनुप्राप्तस्तरुणादित्यसंनिभः
अयुतेन वृतश्चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च
verses.transliteration:
tato rambhastvanuprāptastaruṇādityasaṁnibhaḥ
ayutena vṛtaścaiva sahasreṇa śatena ca

translations.english: Then followed Rambha, resembling the infant sun, accompanied by an ayuta, a thousand, and an hundred.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो यूथपतिर्वीरो दुर्मुखो नाम वानरः
प्रत्यदृश्यत कोटिभ्यां द्वाभ्यां परिवृतो बली
verses.transliteration:
tato yūthapatirvīro durmukho nāma vānaraḥ
pratyadṛśyata koṭibhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ parivṛto balī

translations.english: Then appeared to the view the stout monkey, named Durmukha, heroic lord of herds, surrounded by two koțis.

verses.sanskrit:
कैलासशिखराकारैर्वानरैर्भीमविक्रमैः
वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण हनुमान्प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
kailāsaśikharākārairvānarairbhīmavikramaiḥ
vṛtaḥ koṭisahasreṇa hanumānpratyadṛśyata

translations.english: And Hanumān showed himself, surrounded by a thousand koțis of monkeys, resembling peaks of Kailāsa, of dreadful vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
नलश्चापि महावीर्यः संवृतो द्रुमवासिभिः
कोटीशतेन संप्राप्तः सहस्रेण शतेन च
verses.transliteration:
nalaścāpi mahāvīryaḥ saṁvṛto drumavāsibhiḥ
koṭīśatena saṁprāptaḥ sahasreṇa śatena ca

translations.english: And the exceedingly energetic Nala came, attended with an hundred kotis, a thousand, and an hundred monkeys, living in trees.

verses.sanskrit:
शरभः कुमुदो वह्निर्वानरो रम्भ एव च
एते चान्ये च बहवो वानराः कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration:
śarabhaḥ kumudo vahnirvānaro rambha eva ca
ete cānye ca bahavo vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ

translations.english: And Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni, the monkey Rambha,-and many other monkeys-lords of herds-passing ennumeration-wearing shapes at will, came covering the entire earth with her mountains and forests.

verses.sanskrit:
आवृत्य पृथिवीं सर्वां पर्वतांश्च वनानि च
आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः
अभ्यवर्तन्त सुग्रीवं सूर्यमभ्रगणा इव
verses.transliteration:
āvṛtya pṛthivīṁ sarvāṁ parvatāṁśca vanāni ca
āplavantaḥ plavantaśca garjantaśca plavaṁgamāḥ
abhyavartanta sugrīvaṁ sūryamabhragaṇā iva

translations.english: And all the monkeys of the world were some of them coming and others putting up. And monkeys-some of them dripping, and some leaping, and some roaring-gathered round Sugriva, like clouds gathering round the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
कुर्वाणा बहुशब्दांश्च प्रहृष्टा बलशालिनः
शिरोभिर्वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration:
kurvāṇā bahuśabdāṁśca prahṛṣṭā balaśālinaḥ
śirobhirvānarendrāya sugrīvāya nyavedayan

translations.english: And, crying in various tones, prime monkeys furnished with arms, with bent heads spoke humbly to that lord of monkeys—Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
अपरे वानरश्रेष्ठाः संगम्य च यथोचितम्
सुग्रीवेण समागम्य स्थिताः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
apare vānaraśreṣṭhāḥ saṁgamya ca yathocitam
sugrīveṇa samāgamya sthitāḥ prāñjalayastadā

translations.english: And other foremost of monkeys, gathering together duly, came before Sugrīva with joined hands.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा सुखं पर्वतनिर्झरेषु; वनेषु सर्वेषु च वानरेन्द्राः
निवेशयित्वा विधिवद्बलानि; बलं बलज्ञः प्रतिपत्तुमीष्टे
verses.transliteration:
yathā sukhaṁ parvatanirjhareṣu; vaneṣu sarveṣu ca vānarendrāḥ
niveśayitvā vidhivadbalāni; balaṁ balajñaḥ pratipattumīṣṭe

translations.english: Sugrīva standing with joined hands, expeditiously informed Rāma of the arrival of the monkey-leaders in hot haste; and then spoke (to them, saying, O chiefs of monkeys, stationing the forces duly near mountain-rills and all the woods, let him that is conversant with the army, ascertain who have come and who have not.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ राजा समृद्धार्थः सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः
उवाच नरशार्दूलं रामं परबलार्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
atha rājā samṛddhārthaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
uvāca naraśārdūlaṁ rāmaṁ parabalārdanam

translations.english: Then that lord of monkeys, the successful Sugrīva, spoke to Rāma-lion among men and destroyer of hostile hosts-saying,

verses.sanskrit:
आगता विनिविष्टाश्च बलिनः कामरूपिणः
वानरेन्द्रा महेन्द्राभा ये मद्विषयवासिनः
verses.transliteration:
āgatā viniviṣṭāśca balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
vānarendrā mahendrābhā ye madviṣayavāsinaḥ

translations.english: Those foremost monkeys endued strength and capable of wearing any shape at will, and possessed of the splendour of the mishty Indra,-that inhabit my territories, have come and stationed themselves.

verses.sanskrit:
त इमे बहुसाहस्रैर्हरिभिर्भीमविक्रमैः
आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्यदानवसंनिभाः
verses.transliteration:
ta ime bahusāhasrairharibhirbhīmavikramaiḥ
āgatā vānarā ghorā daityadānavasaṁnibhāḥ

translations.english: And in company with many thousands and innumerable ones that have shewn their ability in many a field, have come monkeys dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dänavas.

verses.sanskrit:
ख्यातकर्मापदानाश्च बलवन्तो जितक्लमाः
पराक्रमेषु विख्याता व्यवसायेषु चोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
khyātakarmāpadānāśca balavanto jitaklamāḥ
parākrameṣu vikhyātā vyavasāyeṣu cottamāḥ

translations.english: And these monkeys-dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dānvas are accompanied by powerful monkeys of terrific prowess, who have displayed their virtue in many a field, and are of famed renown in battle and, powerful, and who have mastered languor and are celebrated in prowess and sterling in their profession.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिव्यम्बुचरा राम नानानगनिवासिनः
कोट्यग्रश इमे प्राप्ता वानरास्तव किंकराः
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivyambucarā rāma nānānaganivāsinaḥ
koṭyagraśa ime prāptā vānarāstava kiṁkarāḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, these koțis of apes that have arrived, inhabiting earth and water and various mountainous tracts, are at your service.

verses.sanskrit:
निदेशवर्तिनः सर्वे सर्वे गुरुहिते रताः
अभिप्रेतमनुष्ठातुं तव शक्ष्यन्त्यरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
nideśavartinaḥ sarve sarve guruhite ratāḥ
abhipretamanuṣṭhātuṁ tava śakṣyantyariṁdama

translations.english: All abide by your command all are intent upon the welfare of their master, and, O subduer of foes, they are competent to bring about your end.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्मन्यसे नरव्याघ्र प्राप्तकालं तदुच्यताम्
तत्सैन्यं त्वद्वशे युक्तमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yanmanyase naravyāghra prāptakālaṁ taducyatām
tatsainyaṁ tvadvaśe yuktamājñāpayitumarhasi

translations.english: If, O lion among men, you conceive that the time is ripe, tell it (to me). It behoves you to command those forces, remaining under your sway.

verses.sanskrit:
काममेषामिदं कार्यं विदितं मम तत्त्वतः
तथापि तु यथा तत्त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
kāmameṣāmidaṁ kāryaṁ viditaṁ mama tattvataḥ
tathāpi tu yathā tattvamājñāpayitumarhasi

translations.english: Although I am full well acquainted with the work in which they are to be employed, yet you ought to order them as to what they are to accomplish.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो दशरथात्मजः
बाहुभ्यां संपरिष्वज्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tathā bruvāṇaṁ sugrīvaṁ rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
bāhubhyāṁ saṁpariṣvajya idaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: When Sugriva had spoken thus, Dasaratha's son, Räma, embracing him with his arms, said,

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञायतां सौम्य वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा
स च देशो महाप्राज्ञ यस्मिन्वसति रावणः
verses.transliteration:
jñāyatāṁ saumya vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā
sa ca deśo mahāprājña yasminvasati rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: O placid one, do you learn whether Videha's daughter is alive or not; as well as ascertain the country, where, O you endowed with eminent wisdom,.liveth Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
अधिगम्य च वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च
प्राप्तकालं विधास्यामि तस्मिन्काले सह त्वया
verses.transliteration:
adhigamya ca vaidehīṁ nilayaṁ rāvaṇasya ca
prāptakālaṁ vidhāsyāmi tasminkāle saha tvayā

translations.english: Having come at Vaidehi and Ravana's abode, shall I then appoint the time along with you.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहमस्मिन्प्रभुः कार्ये वानरेश न लक्ष्मणः
त्वमस्य हेतुः कार्यस्य प्रभुश्च प्लवगेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
nāhamasminprabhuḥ kārye vānareśa na lakṣmaṇaḥ
tvamasya hetuḥ kāryasya prabhuśca plavageśvara

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, I am not the master in this matter, nor Lakşmaņa: you are the cause of this undertaking, as well as, O monarch of monkeys, the lord.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमेवाज्ञापय विभो मम कार्यविनिश्चयम्
त्वं हि जानासि यत्कार्यं मम वीर न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tvamevājñāpaya vibho mama kāryaviniścayam
tvaṁ hi jānāsi yatkāryaṁ mama vīra na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Do you therefore, O lord, command these as to what is to be done by them in my behalf. O hero, you certainly know my business.

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृद्द्वितीयो विक्रान्तः प्राज्ञः कालविशेषवित्
भवानस्मद्धिते युक्तः सुकृतार्थोऽर्थवित्तमः
verses.transliteration:
suhṛddvitīyo vikrāntaḥ prājñaḥ kālaviśeṣavit
bhavānasmaddhite yuktaḥ sukṛtārtho'rthavittamaḥ

translations.english: My second friend (Laksmana being first), you potent, wise, conversant with seasonableness, cognisant of profit, and engaged in our welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो विनतं नाम यूथपम्
अब्रवीद्राम साम्निध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः
शैलाभं मेघनिर्घोषमूर्जितं प्लवगेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu sugrīvo vinataṁ nāma yūthapam
abravīdrāma sāmnidhye lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ
śailābhaṁ meghanirghoṣamūrjitaṁ plavageśvaram

translations.english: Thus addressed, Sugrīva in presence of Rāma and the intelligent Lakşmaņa, said to a leader of herds of lord of apes, named Vinata, having the splendour of a hill, blazing and emitting sounds as those of clouds, O foremost of monkeys, accompanied with apes resembling the sun and the moon, you cognizant of time, place and morals, and sagacious in deciding course of action,-surrounded by hundreds and thousands are of active apes, march towards the Estern quarter, furnished with woods, forests and hills. There, in mountain fastnesses, and forests and rivers, do you search Videha's daughter, Sītā, as well as the abode of Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
सुवर्णरूप्यकं चैव सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम्
यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇarūpyakaṁ caiva suvarṇākaramaṇḍitam
yavadvīpamatikramya śiśiro nāma parvataḥ

translations.english: And, going beyond the island of Yava. (one comes upon) the hill called Sisira, which pierceth the heavens by its peaks, and is inhabited by gods and demons.

verses.sanskrit:
दिवं स्पृशति शृङ्गेण देवदानवसेवितः
एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रतापेषु वनेषु च
verses.transliteration:
divaṁ spṛśati śṛṅgeṇa devadānavasevitaḥ
eteṣāṁ giridurgeṣu pratāpeṣu vaneṣu ca

translations.english: In all these mountain fastnesses, cascades and woods, do you together search for the renowned wife of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः
ततः समुद्रद्वीपांश्च सुभीमान्द्रष्टुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyastatastataḥ
tataḥ samudradvīpāṁśca subhīmāndraṣṭumarhatha

translations.english: Then it behoves you to examine horrible ocean islands, heaving with waves, terrific, resounding,-of haughty bearing in consequence of winds.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रासुरा महाकायाश्छायां गृह्णन्ति नित्यशः
ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता दीर्घकालं बुभुक्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
tatrāsurā mahākāyāśchāyāṁ gṛhṇanti nityaśaḥ
brahmaṇā samanujñātā dīrghakālaṁ bubhukṣitāḥ

translations.english: There, huge-bodied Asuras, hungering for a long period, permitted by Brahmā, capture creatures, resorting to shades.

verses.sanskrit:
तं कालमेघप्रतिमं महोरगनिषेवितम्
अभिगम्य महानादं तीर्थेनैव महोदधिम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ kālameghapratimaṁ mahoraganiṣevitam
abhigamya mahānādaṁ tīrthenaiva mahodadhim

translations.english: And adroitly arriving at that great sea, like to clouds at the universal dissolution, inhabited by mighty snakes, sending loud sounds.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र शैलनिभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः
शैलशृङ्गेषु लम्बन्ते नानारूपा भयावहाः
verses.transliteration:
tatra śailanibhā bhīmā mandehā nāma rākṣasāḥ
śailaśṛṅgeṣu lambante nānārūpā bhayāvahāḥ

translations.english: And there, after passing the terrific sea of red waters called Yellow, you will behold a mighty knarled Śālmali. There, built by Viśvakarmā, peak-like, gigantic, resembling Kailāsa, (towere) the mansion of Vinata's offspring. There, grim Raksasas named Mandehas, resembling hills, of diverse shapes, capable of inspiring fear, hang head foremost on the rocks.

verses.sanskrit:
ते पतन्ति जले नित्यं सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति
अभितप्ताश्च सूर्येण लम्बन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
te patanti jale nityaṁ sūryasyodayanaṁ prati
abhitaptāśca sūryeṇa lambante sma punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Day after day at sunrise, these Rākşasas heated (by solar rays) and struck dead by Brahmā energy,* again and again (hang on the crags). *The commentator explains: energy darted from the three orders.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मध्ये महाश्वेत ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः
दिव्यगन्धैः कुसुमितै रजतैश्च नगैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
tasya madhye mahāśveta ṛṣabho nāma parvataḥ
divyagandhaiḥ kusumitai rajataiśca nagairvṛtaḥ

translations.english: In it there are the mighty white mountain going by the name of Rsabha, covered with trees bearing odorous blossoms; as well as the tank known under the name of Sudarśana, swarming with swans and shining silver lotuses having golden filaments.

verses.sanskrit:
विबुधाश्चारणा यक्षाः किंनराः साप्सरोगणाः
हृष्टाः समभिगच्छन्ति नलिनीं तां रिरंसवः
verses.transliteration:
vibudhāścāraṇā yakṣāḥ kiṁnarāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ
hṛṣṭāḥ samabhigacchanti nalinīṁ tāṁ riraṁsavaḥ

translations.english: Desirous of sport, resort to this tank delighted troops of Vivudhas and Charanas, Yaksas, Kinnaras and Apsarās.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र विक्रोशतां नादो भूतानां सागरौकसाम्
श्रूयते चासमर्थानां दृष्ट्वा तद्वडवामुखम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra vikrośatāṁ nādo bhūtānāṁ sāgaraukasām
śrūyate cāsamarthānāṁ dṛṣṭvā tadvaḍavāmukham

translations.english: Leaving behind Ksiroda, O monkeys, you will soon after behold the Jaloda sea, striking terror into all beings. There presideth that mighty ireborn Energy of him*. (embodied in) the mouth of a mule. This wondrous (universe) containing mobile and immobile things and fraught with great impetus, is the aliment of this Energy. There are heard the cries of feeble creatures inhabiting the sea, who began to wail on witnessing the mouth of the mule. *Sage Aurvi.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वादूदस्योत्तरे देशे योजनानि त्रयोदश
जातरूपशिलो नाम महान्कनकपर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
svādūdasyottare deśe yojanāni trayodaśa
jātarūpaśilo nāma mahānkanakaparvataḥ

translations.english: On the north of the Swādu sea, lie thirteen Yojanas (of land), named Jātarūpasila, * exceeding spacious, and of the splendour of gold. Lit. of gold and stone.

verses.sanskrit:
आसीनं पर्वतस्याग्रे सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्
सहस्रशिरसं देवमनन्तं नीलवाससं
verses.transliteration:
āsīnaṁ parvatasyāgre sarvabhūtanamaskṛtam
sahasraśirasaṁ devamanantaṁ nīlavāsasaṁ

translations.english: There, you monkeys, you will behold that serpent, the holder of Earth-resembling the moon, and with expansive eyes like lotuspetals-seated at the summit of the mount,-that one worshipped of all deities, having a thousand heads,-the god Ananta, clad in blue apparel.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिशिराः काञ्चनः केतुस्तालस्तस्य महात्मनः
स्थापितः पर्वतस्याग्रे विराजति सवेदिकः
verses.transliteration:
triśirāḥ kāñcanaḥ ketustālastasya mahātmanaḥ
sthāpitaḥ parvatasyāgre virājati savedikaḥ

translations.english: And by the dais (there) at the top of the mount is the golden palm, planted by that high souled one,—which is like a banner.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि निर्माणं कृतं तत्त्रिदशेश्वरैः
ततः परं हेममयः श्रीमानुदयपर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
pūrvasyāṁ diśi nirmāṇaṁ kṛtaṁ tattridaśeśvaraiḥ
tataḥ paraṁ hemamayaḥ śrīmānudayaparvataḥ

translations.english: The chief of the celestials reared it in the Eastern region. After that is the fair Rising mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः
जातरूपमयैर्दिव्यैः शोभते सूर्यसंनिभैः
verses.transliteration:
sālaistālaistamālaiśca karṇikāraiśca puṣpitaiḥ
jātarūpamayairdivyaiḥ śobhate sūryasaṁnibhaiḥ

translations.english: Its golden peak measuring a hundred Yojanas, reaching to the heavens, rises nobly, with mountains at its base; and looks beautiful with Sālas, palms, Tamālas, and flowering Karnikāras,-golden, splendid and resembling the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र योजनविस्तारमुच्छ्रितं दशयोजनम्
शृङ्गं सौमनसं नाम जातरूपमयं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra yojanavistāramucchritaṁ daśayojanam
śṛṅgaṁ saumanasaṁ nāma jātarūpamayaṁ dhruvam

translations.english: There, spreading a Yojana around, towering up ten, is the peak named Saumanasa-all certainly of gold.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र पूर्वं पदं कृत्वा पुरा विष्णुस्त्रिविक्रमे
द्वितीयं शिखरं मेरोश्चकार पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
tatra pūrvaṁ padaṁ kṛtvā purā viṣṇustrivikrame
dvitīyaṁ śikharaṁ meroścakāra puruṣottamaḥ

translations.english: There, formerly on the occasion of invading the earth with three paces, that foremost of persons, Vişņu, planting his first foot planted the other on the summit of Meru.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरेण परिक्रम्य जम्बूद्वीपं दिवाकरः
दृश्यो भवति भूयिष्ठं शिखरं तन्महोच्छ्रयम्
verses.transliteration:
uttareṇa parikramya jambūdvīpaṁ divākaraḥ
dṛśyo bhavati bhūyiṣṭhaṁ śikharaṁ tanmahocchrayam

translations.english: The sun, having passed by Jambūdwipa on the north, and, arriving at that mighty and eminent summit, (Saumanasa), again becomes visible to the dwellers of Jambūdwipa.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं सुदर्शनो द्वीपः पुरो यस्य प्रकाशते
यस्मिंस्तेजश्च चक्षुश्च सर्वप्रानभृतामपि
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ sudarśano dvīpaḥ puro yasya prakāśate
yasmiṁstejaśca cakṣuśca sarvaprānabhṛtāmapi

translations.english: This is the island of Sudarsana, before which all creatures inspire energy and have their sight granted to them.

verses.sanskrit:
शैलस्य तस्य कुञ्जेषु कन्दरेषु वनेषु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
śailasya tasya kuñjeṣu kandareṣu vaneṣu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyastatastataḥ

translations.english: You should search for Rāvana with Vaidehi all round the top of that mountain as well as in its forests and woods.

verses.sanskrit:
काञ्चनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः
आविष्टा तेजसा संध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration:
kāñcanasya ca śailasya sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ
āviṣṭā tejasā saṁdhyā pūrvā raktā prakāśate

translations.english: (Here) the first twilight enfolded in the glory of the golden hill and that of the high-souled Sun, appeareth roseate.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः परमगम्या स्याद्दिक्पूर्वा त्रिदशावृता
रहिता चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यामदृश्या तिमिरावृता
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paramagamyā syāddikpūrvā tridaśāvṛtā
rahitā candrasūryābhyāmadṛśyā timirāvṛtā

translations.english: Beyond that, is the exceedingly impassable Eastern quarter, thronged by the celestials, covered with darkness and devoid of the sun and the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
शैलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु कन्दरेषु वनेषु च
ये च नोक्ता मया देशा विचेया तेषु जानकी
verses.transliteration:
śaileṣu teṣu sarveṣu kandareṣu vaneṣu ca
ye ca noktā mayā deśā viceyā teṣu jānakī

translations.english: Do you search for Jānaki in all those rocks, woods and streams as well as in such spots as I have not mentioned.

verses.sanskrit:
एतावद्वानरैः शक्यं गन्तुं वानरपुंगवाः
अभास्करममर्यादं न जानीमस्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration:
etāvadvānaraiḥ śakyaṁ gantuṁ vānarapuṁgavāḥ
abhāskaramamaryādaṁ na jānīmastataḥ param

translations.english: You foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are competent to proceed thus far. Beyond this, of the tract without sun and without limit, I know nothing.

verses.sanskrit:
अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च
मासे पूर्णे निवर्तध्वमुदयं प्राप्य पर्वतम्
verses.transliteration:
adhigamya tu vaidehīṁ nilayaṁ rāvaṇasya ca
māse pūrṇe nivartadhvamudayaṁ prāpya parvatam

translations.english: Meeting with Vaidehi and arriving at) Rāvana's mansion, do you, having reached the Rising hill, turn back, when it shall be a full month.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न वस्तव्यं वसन्वध्यो भवेन्मम
सिद्धार्थाः संनिवर्तध्वमधिगम्य च मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvaṁ māsānna vastavyaṁ vasanvadhyo bhavenmama
siddhārthāḥ saṁnivartadhvamadhigamya ca maithilīm

translations.english: Do not stay longer than a month. If you do, you shall be slain by me. Having attained your end, do you turn back, having met with Maithili.

verses.sanskrit:
महेन्द्रकान्तां वनषण्ड मण्डितां; दिशं चरित्वा निपुणेन वानराः
अवाप्य सीतां रघुवंशजप्रियां; ततो निवृत्ताः सुखितो भविष्यथ
verses.transliteration:
mahendrakāntāṁ vanaṣaṇḍa maṇḍitāṁ; diśaṁ caritvā nipuṇena vānarāḥ
avāpya sītāṁ raghuvaṁśajapriyāṁ; tato nivṛttāḥ sukhito bhaviṣyatha

translations.english: Having adroitly explored (the tract) loved of Mahendra, plated with woods, do you, you monkeys, having come at Sītā—the beloved wife of that descendant of Raghu-desist, attaining happiness.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तन्महद्वानरं बलम्
दक्षिणां प्रेषयामास वानरानभिलक्षितान्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvastanmahadvānaraṁ balam
dakṣiṇāṁ preṣayāmāsa vānarānabhilakṣitān

translations.english: Then having sent away that mighty host of monkeys, Sugriva despatched to the South others competent to perform the several tasks entrusted to them.

verses.sanskrit:
विचित्रशिखरः श्रीमांश्चित्रपुष्पितकाननः
सचन्दनवनोद्देशो मार्गितव्यो महागिरिः
verses.transliteration:
vicitraśikharaḥ śrīmāṁścitrapuṣpitakānanaḥ
sacandanavanoddeśo mārgitavyo mahāgiriḥ

translations.english: Then shall you repair to the mountain Ayomukha,* plated with ore, having taking summits, graceful, furnished with picturesque flowering woods,-the mighty mountain having groves of excellent sandal. *Another name of this hill is Malaya.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तामापगां दिव्यां प्रसन्नसलिलां शिवाम्
तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ कावेरीं विहृतामप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration:
tatastāmāpagāṁ divyāṁ prasannasalilāṁ śivām
tatra drakṣyatha kāverīṁ vihṛtāmapsarogaṇaiḥ

translations.english: At the foot of the Malaya mountain endued with exceeding energy, you will behold the noble stream Kāveri, of pleasant waters, where sport troops of Apsarās.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यासीनं नगस्याग्रे मलयस्य महौजसं
द्रक्ष्यथादित्यसंकाशमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāsīnaṁ nagasyāgre malayasya mahaujasaṁ
drakṣyathādityasaṁkāśamagastyamṛṣisattamam

translations.english: (There) you will see that foremost of saints, Agastya, resembling the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रसन्नेन महात्मना
ताम्रपर्णीं ग्राहजुष्टां तरिष्यथ महानदीम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastenābhyanujñātāḥ prasannena mahātmanā
tāmraparṇīṁ grāhajuṣṭāṁ tariṣyatha mahānadīm

translations.english: Permitted by that gratified high-souled one, you will cross over the great river, Tăniraparni, abounding in alligators.

verses.sanskrit:
सा चन्दनवनैर्दिव्यैः प्रच्छन्ना द्वीप शालिनी
कान्तेव युवतिः कान्तं समुद्रमवगाहते
verses.transliteration:
sā candanavanairdivyaiḥ pracchannā dvīpa śālinī
kānteva yuvatiḥ kāntaṁ samudramavagāhate

translations.english: Like a youthful female in relation to her lover, she (Tāmraparni), with both her waters as well as islets concealed under beautiful sandal woods, bathes in the sea.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हेममयं दिव्यं मुक्तामणिविभूषितम्
युक्तं कवाटं पाण्ड्यानां गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः
verses.transliteration:
tato hemamayaṁ divyaṁ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitam
yuktaṁ kavāṭaṁ pāṇḍyānāṁ gatā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ

translations.english: Proceeding (therefrom), the monkeys shall see the grand golden gates belonging to the walls of the capital of the Pāndyas.

verses.sanskrit:
