translations.english: By Sugrīva's decree, I alone have reached here. And I, ranging alone and wearing shapes at will, have come to this southern quarter, to find out your where abouts.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्याहं हरिसैन्यानां त्वन्नाशमनुशोचताम्
अपनेष्यामि संतापं तवाभिगमशंसनात्
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyāhaṁ harisainyānāṁ tvannāśamanuśocatām
apaneṣyāmi saṁtāpaṁ tavābhigamaśaṁsanāt

translations.english: By my good luck I shall be able, with your news, to remove the grief of those monkey hosts who are lamenting for you.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या हि न मम व्यर्थं देवि सागरलङ्घनम्
प्राप्स्याम्यहमिदं दिष्ट्या त्वद्दर्शनकृतं यशः
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā hi na mama vyarthaṁ devi sāgaralaṅghanam
prāpsyāmyahamidaṁ diṣṭyā tvaddarśanakṛtaṁ yaśaḥ

translations.english: By my good fortune, my crossing over the main, has not become fruitless. I shall be praised there, O worshipful dame, for I have been able to see you.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवश्च महावीर्यः क्षिप्रं त्वामभिपत्स्यते
समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavaśca mahāvīryaḥ kṣipraṁ tvāmabhipatsyate
samitrabāndhavaṁ hatvā rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam

translations.english: And the highly powerful Rāghava shall soon regain you, destroying, with all his sons and friends, Ravana the king of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याहं हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि
हनूमानिति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा
विश्वासार्थं तु वैदेहि भर्तुरुक्ता मया गुणाः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāhaṁ hariṇaḥ kṣetre jāto vātena maithili
hanūmāniti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā
viśvāsārthaṁ tu vaidehi bharturuktā mayā guṇāḥ

translations.english: There is a hill, O Vaidehi, named Malyavana, the foremost of all the mountains. There lives my father, the great monkey Kesari. Being commanded by the celestial ascetics, he once repaired thence to the mount Gokarna and at the holy watering place of the lord of the rivers he brought about the destruction of (the Asura) Sammasādana. O Vaidehi, I was bom, on the field, of that monkey. And I am known all over the world as Hanumān by my own actions.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं विश्वासिता सीता हेतुभिः शोककर्शिता
उपपन्नैरभिज्ञानैर्दूतं तमवगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ viśvāsitā sītā hetubhiḥ śokakarśitā
upapannairabhijñānairdūtaṁ tamavagacchati

translations.english: To create your confidence, O Vaidehi, I have related your lord's accomplishments. And forsooth, you shall soon be taken, O worshipful dame, by Rāghava. Having her confidence formed by these reasonings and various marks, Sītā, worn with grief, took him (for Rāma's messenger).

verses.sanskrit:
अतुलं च गता हर्षं प्रहर्षेण तु जानकी
नेत्राभ्यां वक्रपक्ष्माभ्यां मुमोचानन्दजं जलम्
verses.transliteration:
atulaṁ ca gatā harṣaṁ praharṣeṇa tu jānakī
netrābhyāṁ vakrapakṣmābhyāṁ mumocānandajaṁ jalam

translations.english: Jānakī attained an excess of delight and shed tears of joy from her eyes having curling eyelashes.

verses.sanskrit:
चारु तच्चाननं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम्
अशोभत विशालाक्ष्या राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट्
हनूमन्तं कपिं व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा
verses.transliteration:
cāru taccānanaṁ tasyāstāmraśuklāyatekṣaṇam
aśobhata viśālākṣyā rāhumukta ivoḍurāṭ
hanūmantaṁ kapiṁ vyaktaṁ manyate nānyatheti sā

translations.english: The beautiful countenance of that large-eyed dame, having spacious eyes, appeared like the Moon released from the hold of Rāhu.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca hanūmāṁstāmuttaraṁ priyadarśanām

translations.english: She then took him for a real monkey and none else. Thereupon Hanumān again spoke to her, having a comely presence,

verses.sanskrit:
हतेऽसुरे संयति शम्बसादने; कपिप्रवीरेण महर्षिचोदनात्
ततोऽस्मि वायुप्रभवो हि मैथिलि; प्रभावतस्तत्प्रतिमश्च वानरः
verses.transliteration:
hate'sure saṁyati śambasādane; kapipravīreṇa maharṣicodanāt
tato'smi vāyuprabhavo hi maithili; prabhāvatastatpratimaśca vānaraḥ

translations.english: When the Asura Śambasādana was destroyed in conflict by that best of monkeys at the desire of the celestial ascetics, I was born of the Wind, O Maithili. I look like a monkey but am his equa's in prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
भूय एव महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
bhūya eva mahātejā hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
abravītpraśritaṁ vākyaṁ sītāpratyayakāraṇāt

translations.english: The highly effulgent son of the Wind-god, Hanumān, to create Sītā's confidence, again addressed her with the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरोऽहं महाभागे दूतो रामस्य धीमतः
रामनामाङ्कितं चेदं पश्य देव्यङ्गुलीयकम्
समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते क्षीणदुःखफला ह्यसि
verses.transliteration:
vānaro'haṁ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dhīmataḥ
rāmanāmāṅkitaṁ cedaṁ paśya devyaṅgulīyakam
samāśvasihi bhadraṁ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hyasi

translations.english: O great dame, I am a monkey, the messenger of the highly intelligent Rāma. Behold this precious ring with Rāma's name engraven on it, given by your high-souled lord and brought as a token to create your confidence. Do you take heart and may good betide you, there will be an end of your grief soon.

verses.sanskrit:
गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषणम्
भर्तारमिव संप्राप्ता जानकी मुदिताभवत्
verses.transliteration:
gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam
bhartāramiva saṁprāptā jānakī muditābhavat

translations.english: Taking the ring that used to deck her lord's finger and looking at it, Jānaki seemed to have actually got her lord.

verses.sanskrit:
चारु तद्वदनं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम्
बभूव प्रहर्षोदग्रं राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट्
verses.transliteration:
cāru tadvadanaṁ tasyāstāmraśuklāyatekṣaṇam
babhūva praharṣodagraṁ rāhumukta ivoḍurāṭ

translations.english: Her graceful countenance, having large eyes, looked, with delight, like to the Moon released from the possession of Rāhu.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुः संदेशहर्षिता
परितुट्षा प्रियं श्रुत्वा प्राशंसत महाकपिम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bhartuḥ saṁdeśaharṣitā
parituṭṣā priyaṁ śrutvā prāśaṁsata mahākapim

translations.english: And greatly delighted at her husband's news that modest damsel, affectionately welcoming Hanumăn, applauded that great monkey.

verses.sanskrit:
विक्रान्तस्त्वं समर्थस्त्वं प्राज्ञस्त्वं वानरोत्तम
येनेदं राक्षसपदं त्वयैकेन प्रधर्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
vikrāntastvaṁ samarthastvaṁ prājñastvaṁ vānarottama
yenedaṁ rākṣasapadaṁ tvayaikena pradharṣitam

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, you are brave, powerful and wise, since you had alone smitten this abode of the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णः सागरो मकरालयः
विक्रमश्लाघनीयेन क्रमता गोष्पदीकृतः
verses.transliteration:
śatayojanavistīrṇaḥ sāgaro makarālayaḥ
vikramaślāghanīyena kramatā goṣpadīkṛtaḥ

translations.english: You had, with they laudable prowess, leaped, a hundred leagues, across the ocean, the abode of marine mousters, taking it for Gospada. (A measure as much as a cow's foot-step will hold.)

verses.sanskrit:
न हि त्वां प्राकृतं मन्ये वनरं वनरर्षभ
यस्य ते नास्ति संत्रासो रावणान्नापि संभ्रमः
verses.transliteration:
na hi tvāṁ prākṛtaṁ manye vanaraṁ vanararṣabha
yasya te nāsti saṁtrāso rāvaṇānnāpi saṁbhramaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, I do not consider you as an ordinary monkey, since you do not care or fear Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्हसे च कपिश्रेष्ठ मया समभिभाषितुम्
यद्यसि प्रेषितस्तेन रामेण विदितात्मना
verses.transliteration:
arhase ca kapiśreṣṭha mayā samabhibhāṣitum
yadyasi preṣitastena rāmeṇa viditātmanā

translations.english: O best of monkeys, you are worthy of my welcome, since you had been despatched by Rāma, knowing self, Rāma, hard of being got at, has not sent you, specially to me, without a trial of your prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या च कुशली रामो धर्मात्मा धर्मवत्सलः
लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजाः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā ca kuśalī rāmo dharmātmā dharmavatsalaḥ
lakṣmaṇaśca mahātejāḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ

translations.english: By my good luck, is it all well with the virtuous-souled and truthful Rāma and the highly powerful Lakşmaņa the enhancer of Sumitra's joy?

verses.sanskrit:
कुशली यदि काकुत्स्थः किं नु सागरमेखलाम्
महीं दहति कोपेन युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः
verses.transliteration:
kuśalī yadi kākutsthaḥ kiṁ nu sāgaramekhalām
mahīṁ dahati kopena yugāntāgnirivotthitaḥ

translations.english: And if Kākutstha lives untouched by ill, then why does he not burn the earth, encircled by the ocean with his ire like to the fire of dissolution?

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा शक्तिमन्तौ तौ सुराणामपि निग्रहे
ममैव तु न दुःखानामस्ति मन्ये विपर्ययः
verses.transliteration:
atha vā śaktimantau tau surāṇāmapi nigrahe
mamaiva tu na duḥkhānāmasti manye viparyayaḥ

translations.english: Or they are capable of discomfiting the celestials in a battle but me-thinks by my illluck, the end of my miseries has not arrived as yet.

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिच्च व्यथते रामः कच्चिन्न परिपत्यते
उत्तराणि च कार्याणि कुरुते पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
kaccicca vyathate rāmaḥ kaccinna paripatyate
uttarāṇi ca kāryāṇi kurute puruṣottamaḥ

translations.english: Is Rāma greatly pained? Does he grieve? Is that foremost of men making preparations of my rescue?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्न दीनः संभ्रान्तः कार्येषु च न मुह्यति
कच्चिन्पुरुषकार्याणि कुरुते नृपतेः सुतः
verses.transliteration:
kaccinna dīnaḥ saṁbhrāntaḥ kāryeṣu ca na muhyati
kaccinpuruṣakāryāṇi kurute nṛpateḥ sutaḥ

translations.english: Has he forgotten his work being overwhelmed with fear and poorliness of heart? Is that son of the king performing still his manly duties?

verses.sanskrit:
द्विविधं त्रिविधोपायमुपायमपि सेवते
विजिगीषुः सुहृत्कच्चिन्मित्रेषु च परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
dvividhaṁ trividhopāyamupāyamapi sevate
vijigīṣuḥ suhṛtkaccinmitreṣu ca paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: Is that slayer of foes, desirous of acquiring victory, pleasing his friends still with forgiveness and gifts and dealing his enemies with punishment, sowing dassensions among them, and with other expedients?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्मित्राणि लभते मित्रैश्चाप्यभिगम्यते
कच्चित्कल्याणमित्रश्च मित्रैश्चापि पुरस्कृतः
verses.transliteration:
kaccinmitrāṇi labhate mitraiścāpyabhigamyate
kaccitkalyāṇamitraśca mitraiścāpi puraskṛtaḥ

translations.english: Is he still gaining friends and are friends gathering around him? Is he welcoming his friends and are they honouring him the more?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिदाशास्ति देवानां प्रसादं पार्थिवात्मजः
कच्चित्पुरुषकारं च दैवं च प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
kaccidāśāsti devānāṁ prasādaṁ pārthivātmajaḥ
kaccitpuruṣakāraṁ ca daivaṁ ca pratipadyate

translations.english: Is that son of the king invoking the blessings of the celestials? Has he attained manliness and assistance from the celestials?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्न विगतस्नेहो विवासान्मयि राघवः
कच्चिन्मां व्यसनादस्मान्मोक्षयिष्यति वानरः
verses.transliteration:
kaccinna vigatasneho vivāsānmayi rāghavaḥ
kaccinmāṁ vyasanādasmānmokṣayiṣyati vānaraḥ

translations.english: Has Rāghava lost all his affection for me for my living at a distance from him? Will he save me from this disaster?

verses.sanskrit:
सुखानामुचितो नित्यमसुखानामनूचितः
दुःखमुत्तरमासाद्य कच्चिद्रामो न सीदति
verses.transliteration:
sukhānāmucito nityamasukhānāmanūcitaḥ
duḥkhamuttaramāsādya kaccidrāmo na sīdati

translations.english: Has not Rāma, ever used to happiness and unused to misery, been enfeebled by this disaster?

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्यायास्तथा कच्चित्सुमित्रायास्तथैव च
अभीक्ष्णं श्रूयते कच्चित्कुशलं भरतस्य च
verses.transliteration:
kausalyāyāstathā kaccitsumitrāyāstathaiva ca
abhīkṣṇaṁ śrūyate kaccitkuśalaṁ bharatasya ca

translations.english: Is he informed always of the welfare of Kauslyā, Sumitrā and Bharata?

verses.sanskrit:
मन्निमित्तेन मानार्हः कच्चिच्छोकेन राघवः
कच्चिन्नान्यमना रामः कच्चिन्मां तारयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
mannimittena mānārhaḥ kaccicchokena rāghavaḥ
kaccinnānyamanā rāmaḥ kaccinmāṁ tārayiṣyati

translations.english: Is not Rāghava, worthy of honours, beside himself with grief in my absence? Will not Rāma rescue me?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिदक्षौहिणीं भीमां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः
ध्वजिनीं मन्त्रिभिर्गुप्तां प्रेषयिष्यति मत्कृते
verses.transliteration:
kaccidakṣauhiṇīṁ bhīmāṁ bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ
dhvajinīṁ mantribhirguptāṁ preṣayiṣyati matkṛte

translations.english: Will not Bharata, ever devoted to his brother, send out one Akşauhiņī of terrible soldiers under the command of his ministers for my rescue?

verses.sanskrit:
वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान्सुग्रीवः कच्चिदेष्यति
मत्कृते हरिभिर्वीरैर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः
verses.transliteration:
vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmānsugrīvaḥ kaccideṣyati
matkṛte haribhirvīrairvṛto dantanakhāyudhaiḥ

translations.english: Will not the graceful Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys come to help ine with hosts of monkeys having huge teeth and nails?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिच्च लक्ष्मणः शूरः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः
अस्त्रविच्छरजालेन राक्षसान्विधमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
kaccicca lakṣmaṇaḥ śūraḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ
astraviccharajālena rākṣasānvidhamiṣyati

translations.english: Will not the heroic Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy, conversant with the use of weapons, burn down the Rākşasas with this shafts?

verses.sanskrit:
रौद्रेण कच्चिदस्त्रेण रामेण निहतं रणे
द्रक्ष्याम्यल्पेन कालेन रावणं ससुहृज्जनम्
verses.transliteration:
raudreṇa kaccidastreṇa rāmeṇa nihataṁ raṇe
drakṣyāmyalpena kālena rāvaṇaṁ sasuhṛjjanam

translations.english: Shall I not behold soon that Rāvana with his kinsmen has been destroyed in battle by Rāma with terrible weapons?

verses.sanskrit:
कच्चिन्न तद्धेमसमानवर्णं; तस्याननं पद्मसमानगन्धि
मया विना शुष्यति शोकदीनं; जलक्षये पद्ममिवातपेन
verses.transliteration:
kaccinna taddhemasamānavarṇaṁ; tasyānanaṁ padmasamānagandhi
mayā vinā śuṣyati śokadīnaṁ; jalakṣaye padmamivātapena

translations.english: Is not the gold-hued and lotus-smelling countenance (of Rāma) dried up my absence like to lotus dried up by the rays of the sun in shallow water?

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मापदेशात्त्यजतश्च राज्यां; मां चाप्यरण्यं नयतः पदातिम्
नासीद्व्यथा यस्य न भीर्न शोकः; कच्चित्स धैर्यं हृदये करोति
verses.transliteration:
dharmāpadeśāttyajataśca rājyāṁ; māṁ cāpyaraṇyaṁ nayataḥ padātim
nāsīdvyathā yasya na bhīrna śokaḥ; kaccitsa dhairyaṁ hṛdaye karoti

translations.english: Does he still hold patience in his heart, who, renouncing his kingdom for virtue and repairing, on foot with me even to the forest, was not stricken with fear and grief?

verses.sanskrit:
न चास्य माता न पिता न चान्यः; स्नेहाद्विशिष्टोऽस्ति मया समो वा
तावद्ध्यहं दूतजिजीविषेयं; यावत्प्रवृत्तिं शृणुयां प्रियस्य
verses.transliteration:
na cāsya mātā na pitā na cānyaḥ; snehādviśiṣṭo'sti mayā samo vā
tāvaddhyahaṁ dūtajijīviṣeyaṁ; yāvatpravṛttiṁ śṛṇuyāṁ priyasya

translations.english: His love for his mother, father or any other person is not greater than or equal to his love for me. O messenger, I shall keep my life so long I do not hear anything about my dear one.

verses.sanskrit:
इतीव देवी वचनं महार्थं; तं वानरेन्द्रं मधुरार्थमुक्त्वा
श्रोतुं पुनस्तस्य वचोऽभिरामं; रामार्थयुक्तं विरराम रामा
verses.transliteration:
itīva devī vacanaṁ mahārthaṁ; taṁ vānarendraṁ madhurārthamuktvā
śrotuṁ punastasya vaco'bhirāmaṁ; rāmārthayuktaṁ virarāma rāmā

translations.english: Having addressed that lord of monkeys with these highly sound and sweet accents, that graceful and worshipful dame ceased, with a view to hear again from him pleasant tales regarding Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ
śirasyañjalimādhāya vākyamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of Sītā the terribly powerful Măruti, placing his joined palms on his head said,

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वामिहस्थां जानीते रामः कमललोचनः
श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः
verses.transliteration:
na tvāmihasthāṁ jānīte rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ
śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṁ kṣiprameṣyati rāghavaḥ

translations.english: The lotus-eyed Rāma dose not know that you are here, and hence he has not been able to rescue you like to Purandara regaining Saci.

verses.sanskrit:
चमूं प्रकर्षन्महतीं हर्यृष्कगणसंकुलाम्
विष्टम्भयित्वा बाणौघैरक्षोभ्यं वरुणालयम्
करिष्यति पुरीं लङ्कां काकुत्स्थः शान्तराक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration:
camūṁ prakarṣanmahatīṁ haryṛṣkagaṇasaṁkulām
viṣṭambhayitvā bāṇaughairakṣobhyaṁ varuṇālayam
kariṣyati purīṁ laṅkāṁ kākutsthaḥ śāntarākṣasām

translations.english: Impeding the course of the unagitated deep and building by means of his terrible shafts, a bridge across it, Kākutstha, shall divest the city Lankā of all the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र यद्यन्तरा मृत्युर्यदि देवाः सहासुराः
स्थास्यन्ति पथि रामस्य स तानपि वधिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tatra yadyantarā mṛtyuryadi devāḥ sahāsurāḥ
sthāsyanti pathi rāmasya sa tānapi vadhiṣyati

translations.english: And forsooth shall Rāma destroy them, even if the celestials, or Death himself stand in his way.

verses.sanskrit:
तवादर्शनजेनार्ये शोकेन स परिप्लुतः
न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः
verses.transliteration:
tavādarśanajenārye śokena sa pariplutaḥ
na śarma labhate rāmaḥ siṁhārdita iva dvipaḥ

translations.english: O worshipful dame, stricken with grief in your absence, Rāma is restless like to an elephant smitten by a lion.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा सुनयनं वल्गु बिम्बौष्ठं चारुकुण्डलम्
मुखं द्रक्ष्यसि रामस्य पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्
verses.transliteration:
yathā sunayanaṁ valgu bimbauṣṭhaṁ cārukuṇḍalam
mukhaṁ drakṣyasi rāmasya pūrṇacandramivoditam

translations.english: I can swear, O worshipful dame, by the mounts Mandara, Malaya, Vindhya, Sumeru, Dardura and all the fruits and roots, that you shall behold like to the rising of the full moon, the countenance of Rāma having beautiful eyes, graceful, Bimba-like lips and beautified with beautiful kundalas.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि वैदेहि रामं प्रस्रवणे गिरौ
शतक्रतुमिवासीनं नाकपृष्ठस्य मूर्धनि
verses.transliteration:
kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi vaidehi rāmaṁ prasravaṇe girau
śatakratumivāsīnaṁ nākapṛṣṭhasya mūrdhani

translations.english: You shall soon behold, O Vaidehī, Rāma, on the mount Prasravana, like to the performer of hundred sacrifices seated on the back of the elephant (Airăvata).

verses.sanskrit:
न मांसं राघवो भुङ्क्ते न चापि मधुसेवते
वन्यं सुविहितं नित्यं भक्तमश्नाति पञ्चमम्
verses.transliteration:
na māṁsaṁ rāghavo bhuṅkte na cāpi madhusevate
vanyaṁ suvihitaṁ nityaṁ bhaktamaśnāti pañcamam

translations.english: Rāghava dose not take meat nor drink honeyế he takes every day in the evening boiled rice and such wild fruits as are sanctioned by the Sastras.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव दंशान्न मशकान्न कीटान्न सरीसृपान्
राघवोऽपनयेद्गत्रात्त्वद्गतेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
naiva daṁśānna maśakānna kīṭānna sarīsṛpān
rāghavo'panayedgatrāttvadgatenāntarātmanā

translations.english: His heart is so much attached to you, that he does not drive away even flies, insects and snakes from his body.

verses.sanskrit:
नित्यं ध्यानपरो रामो नित्यं शोकपरायणः
नान्यच्चिन्तयते किंचित्स तु कामवशं गतः
verses.transliteration:
nityaṁ dhyānaparo rāmo nityaṁ śokaparāyaṇaḥ
nānyaccintayate kiṁcitsa tu kāmavaśaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: Rāma is always engaged in meditations, overwhelmed with grief, and he has no other thought but seeing you.

verses.sanskrit:
अनिद्रः सततं रामः सुप्तोऽपि च नरोत्तमः
सीतेति मधुरां वाणीं व्याहरन्प्रतिबुध्यते
verses.transliteration:
anidraḥ satataṁ rāmaḥ supto'pi ca narottamaḥ
sīteti madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ vyāharanpratibudhyate

translations.english: Rāma has no sleep and even when asleep that best of men awakes exclaiming in sweep accents, 'O Sītā!'

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा फलं वा पुष्पं वा यच्चान्यत्स्त्रीमनोहरम्
बहुशो हा प्रियेत्येवं श्वसंस्त्वामभिभाषते
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā phalaṁ vā puṣpaṁ vā yaccānyatstrīmanoharam
bahuśo hā priyetyevaṁ śvasaṁstvāmabhibhāṣate

translations.english: He always welcomes you sighing and saying “O my dear love!", whenever he beholds any fruit, flower or any object liked by the ladies.

verses.sanskrit:
स देवि नित्यं परितप्यमान;स्त्वामेव सीतेत्यभिभाषमाणः
धृतव्रतो राजसुतो महात्मा; तवैव लाभाय कृतप्रयत्नः
verses.transliteration:
sa devi nityaṁ paritapyamāna;stvāmeva sītetyabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ
dhṛtavrato rājasuto mahātmā; tavaiva lābhāya kṛtaprayatnaḥ

translations.english: O worshipful dame, he is always lamenting, exclaiming "O Sītā!, and that high-souled son of the king, to regain you, has resorted to ascetic observances."

verses.sanskrit:
सा रामसंकीर्तनवीतशोका; रामस्य शोकेन समानशोका
शरन्मुखेनाम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा; निशेव वैदेहसुता बभूव
verses.transliteration:
sā rāmasaṁkīrtanavītaśokā; rāmasya śokena samānaśokā
śaranmukhenāmbudaśeṣacandrā; niśeva vaidehasutā babhūva

translations.english: On hearing about Rāma, Sītā was greatly delighted and she was equally grieved on hearing of his sorrow. And it appeared like the rising of the moon and the appearance of the clouds at the same time in an autumnal night.

verses.sanskrit:
सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना
हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः
verses.transliteration:
sītā tadvacanaṁ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā
hanūmantamuvācedaṁ dharmārthasahitaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words, Sītā having a moon-like countenance, again spoke to Hanuman, words, sound and pious:

verses.sanskrit:
अमृतं विषसंसृष्टं त्वया वानरभाषितम्
यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः
verses.transliteration:
amṛtaṁ viṣasaṁsṛṣṭaṁ tvayā vānarabhāṣitam
yacca nānyamanā rāmo yacca śokaparāyaṇaḥ

translations.english: O monkey, what you had said that Rāma is not attached to any other thing and is worn with grief, is like nectar mixed with poison.

verses.sanskrit:
ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे
रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति
verses.transliteration:
aiśvarye vā suvistīrṇe vyasane vā sudāruṇe
rajjveva puruṣaṁ baddhvā kṛtāntaḥ parikarṣati

translations.english: Whether in the enjoyment of vast riches, or emerged in the abyss of miseries, Death is pulling a man, binding him roughly with a chord.

verses.sanskrit:
विधिर्नूनमसंहार्यः प्राणिनां प्लवगोत्तम
सौमित्रिं मां च रामं च व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितान्
verses.transliteration:
vidhirnūnamasaṁhāryaḥ prāṇināṁ plavagottama
saumitriṁ māṁ ca rāmaṁ ca vyasanaiḥ paśya mohitān

translations.english: O best of monkey, people cannot thwart the course of de tiny. Behold me, Rāma and Saumitri, therefore sunk in miseries.

verses.sanskrit:
शोकस्यास्य कदा पारं राघवोऽधिगमिष्यति
प्लवमानः परिश्रान्तो हतनौः सागरे यथा
verses.transliteration:
śokasyāsya kadā pāraṁ rāghavo'dhigamiṣyati
plavamānaḥ pariśrānto hatanauḥ sāgare yathā

translations.english: I do not know when shall Rāghava get at the other end of the ocean of grief, by displaying his prowess, like to one, swimming across the ocean when the boat is sunk.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसानां क्षयं कृत्वा सूदयित्वा च रावणम्
लङ्कामुन्मूलितां कृत्वा कदा द्रक्ष्यति मां पतिः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasānāṁ kṣayaṁ kṛtvā sūdayitvā ca rāvaṇam
laṅkāmunmūlitāṁ kṛtvā kadā drakṣyati māṁ patiḥ

translations.english: I do not know when shall my lord see me, destroying the Rākşasas, killing Rāvana and devastating the city of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
स वाच्यः संत्वरस्वेति यावदेव न पूर्यते
अयं संवत्सरः कालस्तावद्धि मम जीवितम्
verses.transliteration:
sa vācyaḥ saṁtvarasveti yāvadeva na pūryate
ayaṁ saṁvatsaraḥ kālastāvaddhi mama jīvitam

translations.english: Do you tell him to come before this year expires for till then I shall live.

verses.sanskrit:
वर्तते दशमो मासो द्वौ तु शेषौ प्लवंगम
रावणेन नृशंसेन समयो यः कृतो मम
verses.transliteration:
vartate daśamo māso dvau tu śeṣau plavaṁgama
rāvaṇena nṛśaṁsena samayo yaḥ kṛto mama

translations.english: This is the tenth month and two months still remain, O monkey and that is the time appointed by the cruel Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणेन च भ्रात्रा मम निर्यातनं प्रति
अनुनीतः प्रयत्नेन न च तत्कुरुते मतिम्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇena ca bhrātrā mama niryātanaṁ prati
anunītaḥ prayatnena na ca tatkurute matim

translations.english: He was entreated very much by his brother Vibhīşaņa to restore me but he paid no need to his requests.

verses.sanskrit:
मम प्रतिप्रदानं हि रावणस्य न रोचते
रावणं मार्गते संख्ये मृत्युः कालवशं गतम्
verses.transliteration:
mama pratipradānaṁ hi rāvaṇasya na rocate
rāvaṇaṁ mārgate saṁkhye mṛtyuḥ kālavaśaṁ gatam

translations.english: Rāvana dose not desire to restore me (to Rāma) for he has been brought under the influence of Death who is seeking him in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्येष्ठा कन्यानला नम विभीषणसुता कपे
तया ममैतदाख्यातं मात्रा प्रहितया स्वयम्
verses.transliteration:
jyeṣṭhā kanyānalā nama vibhīṣaṇasutā kape
tayā mamaitadākhyātaṁ mātrā prahitayā svayam

translations.english: Vibhisana's eldest daughter, O monkey, by name Kalā, has related this to me, being appointed by her mother.

verses.sanskrit:
रामात्क्षयमनुप्राप्तं रक्षसां प्रत्यचोदयत्
न च तस्यापि दुष्टात्मा शृणोति वचनं हितम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmātkṣayamanuprāptaṁ rakṣasāṁ pratyacodayat
na ca tasyāpi duṣṭātmā śṛṇoti vacanaṁ hitam

translations.english: There is a leading, steady, old, intelligent and educated Rākşasa, gifted with a good character, named Avindhya and highly respected of Rāvana who told him that the destruction of the Rākṣasa race would proceed from Rāma, but the vicious-souled one paid no attention to his wellmeaning words. is my

verses.sanskrit:
आशंसेति हरिश्रेष्ठ क्षिप्रं मां प्राप्स्यते पतिः
अन्तरात्मा हि मे शुद्धस्तस्मिंश्च बहवो गुणाः
verses.transliteration:
āśaṁseti hariśreṣṭha kṣipraṁ māṁ prāpsyate patiḥ
antarātmā hi me śuddhastasmiṁśca bahavo guṇāḥ

translations.english: I hope, O foremost of monkeys, that my husband shall soon regain me for pure soul and he is gifted with many accomplishments.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्साहः पौरुषं सत्त्वमानृशंस्यं कृतज्ञता
विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च सन्ति वानरराघवे
verses.transliteration:
utsāhaḥ pauruṣaṁ sattvamānṛśaṁsyaṁ kṛtajñatā
vikramaśca prabhāvaśca santi vānararāghave

translations.english: Rāghava has in him, O monkeys, energy, manliness, strength, kindness, gratitude and prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः
जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत्
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṁ jaghāna yaḥ
janasthāne vinā bhrātrā śatruḥ kastasya nodvijet

translations.english: He brought about without his brother's aid, the destruction of the fourteen thousand Rākṣasas at Janasthāna. What enemy is not troubled at this?

verses.sanskrit:
न स शक्यस्तुलयितुं व्यसनैः पुरुषर्षभः
अहं तस्यानुभावज्ञा शक्रस्येव पुलोमजा
verses.transliteration:
na sa śakyastulayituṁ vyasanaiḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
ahaṁ tasyānubhāvajñā śakrasyeva pulomajā

translations.english: The disaster-creating Rākşasas can never be compared with that best of men. I am cognizant of his prowess as Sacī is of Indra's.

verses.sanskrit:
शरजालांशुमाञ्शूरः कपे रामदिवाकरः
शत्रुरक्षोमयं तोयमुपशोषं नयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
śarajālāṁśumāñśūraḥ kape rāmadivākaraḥ
śatrurakṣomayaṁ toyamupaśoṣaṁ nayiṣyati

translations.english: O monkey, Rāma the Sun, with his arrow-like rays, shall dry up the water-the inimical Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
इति संजल्पमानां तां रामार्थे शोककर्शिताम्
अश्रुसंपूर्णवदनामुवाच हनुमान्कपिः
verses.transliteration:
iti saṁjalpamānāṁ tāṁ rāmārthe śokakarśitām
aśrusaṁpūrṇavadanāmuvāca hanumānkapiḥ

translations.english: Saying this she was overwhelmed with grief on Rāma's account, and Hanumān again spoke to her having her countenance bathed in tears.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः
चमूं प्रकर्षन्महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसंकुलाम्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṁ kṣiprameṣyati rāghavaḥ
camūṁ prakarṣanmahatīṁ haryṛkṣagaṇasaṁkulām

translations.english: No sooner shall Rāghava hear from me than he shall speedily repair hither followed by a huge army of monkeys and bears.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा मोचयिष्यामि तामद्यैव हि राक्षसात्
अस्माद्दुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते
verses.transliteration:
atha vā mocayiṣyāmi tāmadyaiva hi rākṣasāt
asmādduḥkhādupāroha mama pṛṣṭhamanindite

translations.english: Or I shall release you even to-day from the grasp of that Räkşasa and these miseries. Do you place yourself on my back, O you of a blameless person.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं हि पृष्ठगतां कृत्वा संतरिष्यामि सागरम्
शक्तिरस्ति हि मे वोढुं लङ्कामपि सरावणाम्
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ hi pṛṣṭhagatāṁ kṛtvā saṁtariṣyāmi sāgaram
śaktirasti hi me voḍhuṁ laṅkāmapi sarāvaṇām

translations.english: And having you on my back I shall leap over the main. I am capable of carrying the city of Lankā even with Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं प्रस्रवणस्थाय राघवायाद्य मैथिलि
प्रापयिष्यामि शक्राय हव्यं हुतमिवानलः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ prasravaṇasthāya rāghavāyādya maithili
prāpayiṣyāmi śakrāya havyaṁ hutamivānalaḥ

translations.english: I shall restore you to-day, O Maithili, to Rāghava on the mount Prasravaņa, like to fire carrying to Indra, the sacrificial offerings.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्
व्यवसाय समायुक्तं विष्णुं दैत्यवधे यथा
verses.transliteration:
drakṣyasyadyaiva vaidehi rāghavaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam
vyavasāya samāyuktaṁ viṣṇuṁ daityavadhe yathā

translations.english: You shall behold to-day, O Vaidehi, Rama along with Lakşmaņa, making preparations (for the destruction of his enemy) like to Vişņu, engaged in the destruction of demons.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहमाश्रमस्थं महाबलम्
पुरंदरमिवासीनं नागराजस्य मूर्धनि
verses.transliteration:
tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhamāśramasthaṁ mahābalam
puraṁdaramivāsīnaṁ nāgarājasya mūrdhani

translations.english: (And you shall observe) that highly powerful one, anxious to behold you and seated like to Purandara on the summit of that foremost of mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष्ठमारोह मे देवि मा विकाङ्क्षस्व शोभने
योगमन्विच्छ रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣṭhamāroha me devi mā vikāṅkṣasva śobhane
yogamanviccha rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī

translations.english: Do you place yourself on my back, O worshipful dame, do you not neglect it, O beautiful lady, and be thus reconciled to Rāma like to Rohini restored to the Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
कथयन्तीव चन्द्रेण सूर्येणेव सुवर्चला
मत्पृष्ठमधिरुह्य त्वं तराकाशमहार्णवम्
verses.transliteration:
kathayantīva candreṇa sūryeṇeva suvarcalā
matpṛṣṭhamadhiruhya tvaṁ tarākāśamahārṇavam

translations.english: By the time, that we will take in talking thus, you shall reach Rāma like Rohiņi restored to the Moon. Do you therefore place yourself on my back and I shall cross the ocean sailing by the aetherial way.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मे संप्रयातस्य त्वामितो नयतोऽङ्गने
अनुगन्तुं गतिं शक्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः
verses.transliteration:
na hi me saṁprayātasya tvāmito nayato'ṅgane
anugantuṁ gatiṁ śaktāḥ sarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ

translations.english: O fair one, carrying you from this place, none among the inhabitants of Lankä shall be able to follow me.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैवाहमिह प्राप्तस्तथैवाहमसंशयम्
यास्यामि पश्य वैदेहि त्वामुद्यम्य विहायसं
verses.transliteration:
yathaivāhamiha prāptastathaivāhamasaṁśayam
yāsyāmi paśya vaidehi tvāmudyamya vihāyasaṁ

translations.english: In the same way I have come here I shall return by the welkin, O Vaidehī placing three on my back.

verses.sanskrit:
मैथिली तु हरिश्रेष्ठाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनमद्भुतम्
हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
maithilī tu hariśreṣṭhācchrutvā vacanamadbhutam
harṣavismitasarvāṅgī hanūmantamathābravīt

translations.english: Hearing those surprising words from that best of monkeys, Maithilī, having her entire frame worked up with joy, again bespake Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमन्दूरमध्वनं कथं मां वोढुमिच्छसि
तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप
verses.transliteration:
hanūmandūramadhvanaṁ kathaṁ māṁ voḍhumicchasi
tadeva khalu te manye kapitvaṁ hariyūthapa

translations.english: Hanumān, how darest you take me to such a long distance? O lord of monkey hosts, this attests to your monkey-hood.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं वाल्पशरीरस्त्वं मामितो नेतुमिच्छसि
सकाशं मानवेन्द्रस्य भर्तुर्मे प्लवगर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ vālpaśarīrastvaṁ māmito netumicchasi
sakāśaṁ mānavendrasya bharturme plavagarṣabha

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, little-bodied as you are, how do you desire, to take me hence to my husband the lord of men?

verses.sanskrit:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
चिन्तयामास लक्ष्मीवान्नवं परिभवं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
cintayāmāsa lakṣmīvānnavaṁ paribhavaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: Hearing the words of Sītā, the graceful son of the Wind-god Hanumān reflected aside-This is my first insult.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे जानाति सत्त्वं वा प्रभावं वासितेक्षणा
तस्मात्पश्यतु वैदेही यद्रूपं मम कामतः
verses.transliteration:
na me jānāti sattvaṁ vā prabhāvaṁ vāsitekṣaṇā
tasmātpaśyatu vaidehī yadrūpaṁ mama kāmataḥ

translations.english: The lotus-eyed dame is not cognizant of my prowess or strength. Vaidehi should therefore learn that I can assume shapes at will.

verses.sanskrit:
इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः
दर्शयामास वैदेह्याः स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः
verses.transliteration:
iti saṁcintya hanumāṁstadā plavagasattamaḥ
darśayāmāsa vaidehyāḥ svarūpamarimardanaḥ

translations.english: Thinking thus, Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys and the slayer of foes, showed himself to Sītā, in his true shape.

verses.sanskrit:
स तस्मात्पादपाद्धीमानाप्लुत्य प्लवगर्षभः
ततो वर्धितुमारेभे सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्
verses.transliteration:
sa tasmātpādapāddhīmānāplutya plavagarṣabhaḥ
tato vardhitumārebhe sītāpratyayakāraṇāt

translations.english: And leaping down from the tree, that best of monkeys began to increase himself to create Sītā's confidence.

verses.sanskrit:
हरिः पर्वतसंकाशस्ताम्रवक्त्रो महाबलः
वज्रदंष्ट्रनखो भीमो वैदेहीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
hariḥ parvatasaṁkāśastāmravaktro mahābalaḥ
vajradaṁṣṭranakho bhīmo vaidehīmidamabravīt

translations.english: His person appeared like the hill Mandara and the flaming fire. And that best of monkeys having a copper-coloured countenance, thunderlike nails and teeth and mountain-like huge body, appeared before Sītā and said.

verses.sanskrit:
सपर्वतवनोद्देशां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्
लङ्कामिमां सनथां वा नयितुं शक्तिरस्ति मे
verses.transliteration:
saparvatavanoddeśāṁ sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām
laṅkāmimāṁ sanathāṁ vā nayituṁ śaktirasti me

translations.english: I am capable of carrying this Lankā with her lord, the mountains, forests gardens, buildings, walls and gate-ways.

verses.sanskrit:
तदवस्थाप्य तां बुद्धिरलं देवि विकाङ्क्षया
विशोकं कुरु वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
tadavasthāpya tāṁ buddhiralaṁ devi vikāṅkṣayā
viśokaṁ kuru vaidehi rāghavaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam

translations.english: Do you therefore confide in me, O worshipful dame, and be not suspicious. And O Vaidehi, do you remove Rāma's grief as well as Laksmana's.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वाचलसंकाशमुवाच जनकात्मजा
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी मारुतस्यौरसं सुतम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvācalasaṁkāśamuvāca janakātmajā
padmapatraviśālākṣī mārutasyaurasaṁ sutam

translations.english: Beholding the Wind-god's own begotten son, Hanumān, resembling a huge mountain, Sītā, the daughter of Janaka, having eyes resembling lotus-petals, said.

verses.sanskrit:
तव सत्त्वं बलं चैव विजानामि महाकपे
वायोरिव गतिं चापि तेजश्चाग्निरिवाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration:
tava sattvaṁ balaṁ caiva vijānāmi mahākape
vāyoriva gatiṁ cāpi tejaścāgnirivādbhutam

translations.english: O great monkey, I know your strength and bravery, they air-like motion and your wonderful fire-like energy.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राकृतोऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति
उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरपुंगव
verses.transliteration:
prākṛto'nyaḥ kathaṁ cemāṁ bhūmimāgantumarhati
udadheraprameyasya pāraṁ vānarapuṁgava

translations.english: What ordinary man can come here crossing the incomparable ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि गमने शक्तिं नयने चापि ते मम
अवश्यं साम्प्रधार्याशु कार्यसिद्धिरिहात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
jānāmi gamane śaktiṁ nayane cāpi te mama
avaśyaṁ sāmpradhāryāśu kāryasiddhirihātmanaḥ

translations.english: O lord of monkey hosts, I understand that you are capable of returning and you shall be able to carry me. But I should consider now how the work might be accomplished.

verses.sanskrit:
अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मया गन्तुं त्वया सह
वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव
verses.transliteration:
ayuktaṁ tu kapiśreṣṭha mayā gantuṁ tvayā saha
vāyuvegasavegasya vego māṁ mohayettava

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, I should not go with you. Perhaps I might lose my sense with your air-like velocity.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमाकाशमासक्ता उपर्युपरि सागरम्
प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयाद्वेगेन गच्छतः
verses.transliteration:
ahamākāśamāsaktā uparyupari sāgaram
prapateyaṁ hi te pṛṣṭhādbhayādvegena gacchataḥ

translations.english: When moving terribly you shall proceed high up in the welkin, perhaps I shall then fall down.

verses.sanskrit:
पतिता सागरे चाहं तिमिनक्रझषाकुले
भयेयमाशु विवशा यादसामन्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
patitā sāgare cāhaṁ timinakrajhaṣākule
bhayeyamāśu vivaśā yādasāmannamuttamam

translations.english: No sooner I shall fall down into the ocean infested with fish and other animals than I shall be an excellent food to them.

verses.sanskrit:
न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन
कलत्रवति संदेहस्त्वय्यपि स्यादसंशयम्
verses.transliteration:
na ca śakṣye tvayā sārdhaṁ gantuṁ śatruvināśana
kalatravati saṁdehastvayyapi syādasaṁśayam

translations.english: O slayer of foes, I shall not be able to accompany you. For seeing you carry a woman, they shall surely suspect you.

verses.sanskrit:
ह्रियमाणां तु मां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः
अनुगच्छेयुरादिष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
hriyamāṇāṁ tu māṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ
anugaccheyurādiṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā

translations.english: And finding me stolen, those terribly powerful Rākşasas commanded by the vicious-souled Rāvana, shall follow you.

verses.sanskrit:
तैस्त्वं परिवृतः शूरैः शूलमुद्गर पाणिभिः
भवेस्त्वं संशयं प्राप्तो मया वीर कलत्रवान्
verses.transliteration:
taistvaṁ parivṛtaḥ śūraiḥ śūlamudgara pāṇibhiḥ
bhavestvaṁ saṁśayaṁ prāpto mayā vīra kalatravān

translations.english: O hero, carrying me and encircled by those heroic Rākṣasas with maces and darts in their hands, you shall be beset with dangers.

verses.sanskrit:
सायुधा बहवो व्योम्नि राक्षसास्त्वं निरायुधः
कथं शक्ष्यसि संयातुं मां चैव परिरक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
sāyudhā bahavo vyomni rākṣasāstvaṁ nirāyudhaḥ
kathaṁ śakṣyasi saṁyātuṁ māṁ caiva parirakṣitum

translations.english: And on the sky the Rākşasas shall be armed with weapons and you shall be without any. How shall you be able to fight and protect me at the same time.

verses.sanskrit:
युध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्ततस्तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः
प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठद्भयार्ता कपिसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
yudhyamānasya rakṣobhistatastaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ
prapateyaṁ hi te pṛṣṭhadbhayārtā kapisattama

translations.english: When you shall be engaged in conflict with those Rākşasas of terrible deeds, I, O foremost of monkeys, stricken with fear, shall fall down from your back.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा युध्यमानस्य पतेयं विमुखस्य ते
पतितां च गृहीत्वा मां नयेयुः पापराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
atha vā yudhyamānasya pateyaṁ vimukhasya te
patitāṁ ca gṛhītvā māṁ nayeyuḥ pāparākṣasāḥ

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys those terrible and powerful Rākşasas shall be able to defeat you a little. And when you shall be defeated in battle I shall fall down and those vicious Rākṣasas shall carry me away from your hands or destroy me.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं वापि विपद्येयं रक्षोभिरभितर्जिता
त्वत्प्रयत्नो हरिश्रेष्ठ भवेन्निष्फल एव तु
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ vāpi vipadyeyaṁ rakṣobhirabhitarjitā
tvatprayatno hariśreṣṭha bhavenniṣphala eva tu

translations.english: Victory or defeat is uncertain in a battle. I shall thus be distressed by those Rākşasas setting up terrible roars and they endeavours shall be fruitless, O best of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
कामं त्वमपि पर्याप्तो निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्
राघवस्य यशो हीयेत्त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration:
kāmaṁ tvamapi paryāpto nihantuṁ sarvarākṣasān
rāghavasya yaśo hīyettvayā śastaistu rākṣasaiḥ

translations.english: You are capable of destroying the Rākṣasas very easily (I admit)—but Rama's fame shall then be souled if do you bring about their destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वादाय रक्षांसि न्यस्येयुः संवृते हि माम्
यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवः
verses.transliteration:
atha vādāya rakṣāṁsi nyasyeyuḥ saṁvṛte hi mām
yatra te nābhijānīyurharayo nāpi rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Or the Rākşasas taking me away shall keep me in such a secret place, that neither the monkeys nor Rāghava shall be able to ascertain my where abouts.

verses.sanskrit:
आरम्भस्तु मदर्थोऽयं ततस्तव निरर्थकः
त्वया हि सह रामस्य महानागमने गुणः
verses.transliteration:
ārambhastu madartho'yaṁ tatastava nirarthakaḥ
tvayā hi saha rāmasya mahānāgamane guṇaḥ

translations.english: All your preparations for me, shall thus be useless. And mighty shall be the result of Rāma's coming with you.

verses.sanskrit:
मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः
भ्रातॄणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च
verses.transliteration:
mayi jīvitamāyattaṁ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
bhrātṝṇāṁ ca mahābāho tava rājakulasya ca

translations.english: O large armed one, the life of Rāghava of unmitigated prowess, those of his brothers and of your royal race are all subject to me.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ निराशौ मदर्थे तु शोकसंतापकर्शितौ
सह सर्वर्क्षहरिभिस्त्यक्ष्यतः प्राणसंग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
tau nirāśau madarthe tu śokasaṁtāpakarśitau
saha sarvarkṣaharibhistyakṣyataḥ prāṇasaṁgraham

translations.english: When they shall give up their hopes of releasing me, they, worn out with grief and anxiety shall renounce their lives along with the monkeys and bears.

verses.sanskrit:
भर्तुर्भक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर
नाहं स्प्रष्टुं पदा गात्रमिच्छेयं वानरोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
bharturbhaktiṁ puraskṛtya rāmādanyasya vānara
nāhaṁ spraṣṭuṁ padā gātramiccheyaṁ vānarottama

translations.english: O monkey, being guided by my love for my husband, I do not like willingly to touch any body's person but Rāma's.

verses.sanskrit:
यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं रावणस्य गता बलात्
अनीशा किं करिष्यामि विनाथा विवशा सती
verses.transliteration:
yadahaṁ gātrasaṁsparśaṁ rāvaṇasya gatā balāt
anīśā kiṁ kariṣyāmi vināthā vivaśā satī

translations.english: When Rāvaņa, by force touched my person, I had no other help, for I was then without me lord and therefore was subject to another person.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्वा सराक्षसं
मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
yadi rāmo daśagrīvamiha hatvā sarākṣasaṁ
māmito gṛhya gaccheta tattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet

translations.english: If Rāma can take me away from here, destroying the Ten-necked one with all the Rākşasas-he shall then perform the worthy action.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुता हि दृष्टाश्च मया पराक्रमा; महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः
न देवगन्धर्वभुजंगराक्षसा; भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
śrutā hi dṛṣṭāśca mayā parākramā; mahātmanastasya raṇāvamardinaḥ
na devagandharvabhujaṁgarākṣasā; bhavanti rāmeṇa samā hi saṁyuge

translations.english: I have heard of and myself seen the prowess of the highly-souled (Rāma) unconquerable in a battle. There is none among the celestials, Gandharvas, Nāgas and the Rākşasas who can match him in a conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकं; महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम्
सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं; हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम्
verses.transliteration:
samīkṣya taṁ saṁyati citrakārmukaṁ; mahābalaṁ vāsavatulyavikramam
salakṣmaṇaṁ ko viṣaheta rāghavaṁ; hutāśanaṁ dīptamivānileritam

translations.english: Beholding that highly powerful Rāghava, in a conflict, like to Vāsava in prowess, holding a wonderful bow and followed by Lakşmaņa, who can withstand his prowess resembling the flaming fire?

verses.sanskrit:
सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं; दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम्
सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे; युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम्
verses.transliteration:
salakṣmaṇaṁ rāghavamājimardanaṁ; diśāgajaṁ mattamiva vyavasthitam
saheta ko vānaramukhya saṁyuge; yugāntasūryapratimaṁ śarārciṣam

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, who can withstand Rāghava in a conflict, followed by Lakşmaņa moving like infuriated an elephant and showering shafts like to the rays of the sun at the time of Dissolution?

verses.sanskrit:
स मे हरिश्रेष्ठ सलक्ष्मणं पतिं; सयूथपं क्षिप्रमिहोपपादय
चिराय रामं प्रति शोककर्शितां; कुरुष्व मां वानरमुख्य हर्षिताम्
verses.transliteration:
sa me hariśreṣṭha salakṣmaṇaṁ patiṁ; sayūthapaṁ kṣipramihopapādaya
cirāya rāmaṁ prati śokakarśitāṁ; kuruṣva māṁ vānaramukhya harṣitām

translations.english: O best of monkeys do you speedily bring here my dear one along with Lakşmaņa and the lord of monkey hosts. O heroic monkey, do you soon satisfy me, who am stricken with grief in consequence of my long separation from Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स कपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः
सीतामुवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlastena vākyena harṣitaḥ
sītāmuvāca tacchrutvā vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words, that foremost of monkeys, skilled in speech, was greatly delighted and again addressed Sītā in the following words,

verses.sanskrit:
युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने
सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च
verses.transliteration:
yuktarūpaṁ tvayā devi bhāṣitaṁ śubhadarśane
sadṛśaṁ strīsvabhāvasya sādhvīnāṁ vinayasya ca

translations.english: O worshipful lady, O you of an auspicious presence, what you had said, speaks well for a feminine nature and the modesty of a chaste damsel.

verses.sanskrit:
स्त्रीत्वं न तु समर्थं हि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम्
मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्
verses.transliteration:
strītvaṁ na tu samarthaṁ hi sāgaraṁ vyativartitum
māmadhiṣṭhāya vistīrṇaṁ śatayojanamāyatam

translations.english: And because you are a female, you are not capable of crossing on my back, the main extending over a thousand leagues.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्ते देवि सदृशं पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः
का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration:
etatte devi sadṛśaṁ patnyāstasya mahātmanaḥ
kā hyanyā tvāmṛte devi brūyādvacanamīdṛśam

translations.english: The second argument—I shall not touch any other person's body than Rāma's, which you have produced, O Janaki! O you gifted with modesty! truely become you, who are the spouse of that high-souled one. Who else than you, O worshipful one, can give expression to such words?

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थः सर्वं निरवशेषतः
चेष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
śroṣyate caiva kākutsthaḥ sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ
ceṣṭitaṁ yattvayā devi bhāṣitaṁ mama cāgrataḥ

translations.english: Truly shall Kākutstha hear from the beginning to the end, O worshipful dame, of your actions before me, and all you had said.

verses.sanskrit:
कारणैर्बहुभिर्देवि राम प्रियचिकीर्षया
स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा मयैतत्समुदीरितम्
verses.transliteration:
kāraṇairbahubhirdevi rāma priyacikīrṣayā
snehapraskannamanasā mayaitatsamudīritam

translations.english: For many reason, I gave vent to such words, O lady, I am anxious to compass Rāma's end, and my heart is melted with affection.

verses.sanskrit:
लङ्काया दुष्प्रवेशत्वाद्दुस्तरत्वान्महोदधेः
सामर्थ्यादात्मनश्चैव मयैतत्समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
laṅkāyā duṣpraveśatvāddustaratvānmahodadheḥ
sāmarthyādātmanaścaiva mayaitatsamudāhṛtam

translations.english: It is very difficult to enter this city of Lankā, it is equally hard to cross over the main—but I am capable of doing all these, and hence I gave utterance to all those words.

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना
गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथा तदुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration:
icchāmi tvāṁ samānetumadyaiva raghubandhunā
gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathā tadudāhṛtam

translations.english: I wish to take you even to-day to the descendant of Raghu. It is for my devotion to him and regard for you that I said so and for nothing else.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्धमनिन्दिते
अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि यत्
verses.transliteration:
yadi notsahase yātuṁ mayā sārdhamanindite
abhijñānaṁ prayaccha tvaṁ jānīyādrāghavo hi yat

translations.english: If you do not wish to go with me, O you of a blameless person, do you give me such a token as might create Rāghava's confidence.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा
उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā hanumatā sītā surasutopamā
uvāca vacanaṁ mandaṁ bāṣpapragrathitākṣaram

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Sītā resembling the daughter of a celestial, spoke, gently, words with their letters strung on the vapour of grief,

verses.sanskrit: पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः
verses.transliteration: paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ

translations.english: O Rāghava, I slept for sometime, at your lap, out of exhaustion, and yourself in turn, slept at mine, O elder brother of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
दारयन्स च मां काकस्तत्रैव परिलीयते
न चाप्युपरमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थी बलिभोजनः
verses.transliteration:
dārayansa ca māṁ kākastatraiva parilīyate
na cāpyuparamanmāṁsādbhakṣārthī balibhojanaḥ

translations.english: A crow, at that time, longing to feed on my flesh, tore my breast with its beak. And I threatened it with a pebble. But it continued tearing my breast as if it sat there to feed on my flesh and therefore did not fly off.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया विहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा
भक्ष्य गृद्धेन कालेन दारिता त्वामुपागता
verses.transliteration:
tvayā vihasitā cāhaṁ kruddhā saṁlajjitā tadā
bhakṣya gṛddhena kālena dāritā tvāmupāgatā

translations.english: Being enraged with that bird, as I tried to tighten the cloth around my waist, it gave way a little, and you, rising up from your seat and looking at me, did laugh over it. And I was greatly enraged with your laughter and ashamed, and, being wounded by the crow, I approached you.

verses.sanskrit:
आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम्
क्रुध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वयाहं परिसान्त्विता
verses.transliteration:
āsīnasya ca te śrāntā punarutsaṅgamāviśam
krudhyantī ca prahṛṣṭena tvayāhaṁ parisāntvitā

translations.english: Thereupon, tired as I was, I sat on your lap, and, exercised with ire, I was consoled by you laughing.

verses.sanskrit:
बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती
लक्षिताहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता
verses.transliteration:
bāṣpapūrṇamukhī mandaṁ cakṣuṣī parimārjatī
lakṣitāhaṁ tvayā nātha vāyasena prakopitā

translations.english: Now I, having my countenance bathed in tears, gently rubbed my eyes. And I was seen by you, O my lord, in that wise, greatly enraged with the crow.

verses.sanskrit:
आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः श्वसान्वाक्यमभाषथाः
केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम्
कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना
verses.transliteration:
āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasānvākyamabhāṣathāḥ
kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṁ vai stanāntaram
kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā

translations.english: O you having thighs like the trunk of an elephant, by whom has your breast been wounded? Who wants to play with an angry five-hooded serpent?

verses.sanskrit:
वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समवैक्षथाः
नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
vīkṣamāṇastatastaṁ vai vāyasaṁ samavaikṣathāḥ
nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇairmāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam

translations.english: Thereupon, casting his looks around, he espied the crow, sitting in my front with its claws besmeared with blood.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः
धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः
verses.transliteration:
putraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ
dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ

translations.english: That crow, best of birds, was the son of the lord of the celestials in disguise. And gifted with air-like velocity, he speedily entered inside the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः
वायसे कृतवान्क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर
verses.transliteration:
tatastasminmahābāhuḥ kopasaṁvartitekṣaṇaḥ
vāyase kṛtavānkrūrāṁ matiṁ matimatāṁ vara

translations.english: Thereupon that large-eyed hero, best of the intelligent, with his eyes whirling with ire, resolving to destroy that crow.

verses.sanskrit:
स दर्भसंस्तराद्गृह्य ब्रह्मणोऽस्त्रेण योजयः
स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखो द्विजम्
verses.transliteration:
sa darbhasaṁstarādgṛhya brahmaṇo'streṇa yojayaḥ
sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukho dvijam

translations.english: And taking a blade of Kusa off his seat, he tied it to a Brahma weapon. And that blade, facing the bird, appeared with its flaming face, like the fire that would destroy the world.

verses.sanskrit:
चिक्षेपिथ प्रदीप्तां तामिषीकां वायसं प्रति
अनुसृष्टस्तदा कालो जगाम विविधां गतिम्
त्राणकाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह
verses.transliteration:
cikṣepitha pradīptāṁ tāmiṣīkāṁ vāyasaṁ prati
anusṛṣṭastadā kālo jagāma vividhāṁ gatim
trāṇakāma imaṁ lokaṁ sarvaṁ vai vicacāra ha

translations.english: Being thus pursued, that crow, in order to save himself, traversed various regions.

verses.sanskrit:
स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैः सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः
त्रीँल्लोकान्संपरिक्रम्य त्वामेव शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration:
sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ
trī̐llokānsaṁparikramya tvāmeva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: And being then renounced by his father (Indra) and the great ascetics, he, ranging the three worlds, at last resorted to his (Rāma's) shelter.

verses.sanskrit:
तं त्वं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम्
वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया पर्यपालयः
न शर्म लब्ध्वा लोकेषु त्वामेव शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tvaṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam
vadhārhamapi kākutstha kṛpayā paryapālayaḥ
na śarma labdhvā lokeṣu tvāmeva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: Thereupon it again came to you, O subduer of foes. And seeking your shelter it laid itself low on the ground. And O Kākutstha, you didst save it albeit it was worthy of being slain.

verses.sanskrit:
परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स त्वमायान्तमुक्तवान्
मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
paridyūnaṁ viṣaṇṇaṁ ca sa tvamāyāntamuktavān
moghaṁ kartuṁ na śakyaṁ tu brāhmamastraṁ taducyatām

translations.english: And he spoke to him, greatly famished, of a pale countenance and lying on the earth, It is impossible to render this Brahma weapon fruitless. Therefore, do you speak (as to what is to be done).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: tatastasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam

translations.english: He then destroyed the right eye of the crow. Having given up his eye, he saved himself.

verses.sanskrit:
स ते तदा नमस्कृत्वा राज्ञे दशरथाय च
त्वया वीर विसृष्टस्तु प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम्
verses.transliteration:
sa te tadā namaskṛtvā rājñe daśarathāya ca
tvayā vīra visṛṣṭastu pratipede svamālayam

translations.english: Then bowing to Rāma as well as king Dasaratha, the crow, liberated by that hero, went to his own abode.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्कृते काकमात्रेऽपि ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम्
कस्माद्यो मां हरत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते
verses.transliteration:
matkṛte kākamātre'pi brahmāstraṁ samudīritam
kasmādyo māṁ harattvattaḥ kṣamase taṁ mahīpate

translations.english: You hadston my behalf discharged the Brahma weapon even at a crow. Why then, O lord of earth, do you forbear him who had carried me off from you?

verses.sanskrit:
स कुरुष्व महोत्साहं कृपां मयि नरर्षभ
आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्त्वत्त एव मया श्रुतः
verses.transliteration:
sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaṁ kṛpāṁ mayi nararṣabha
ānṛśaṁsyaṁ paro dharmastvatta eva mayā śrutaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men, do you dispense to me your kindness capable of inspiring hope. O lord, possessing a lord in you, I (now) appear as if I had none.

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम्
अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात्सागरोपमम्
भर्तारं ससमुद्राया धरण्या वासवोपमम्
verses.transliteration:
jānāmi tvāṁ mahāvīryaṁ mahotsāhaṁ mahābalam
apārapāramakṣobhyaṁ gāmbhīryātsāgaropamam
bhartāraṁ sasamudrāyā dharaṇyā vāsavopamam

translations.english: That kindness in a prime virtue I have heard even from you; and I know that you are exceedingly energetic and possessed of great strength an high courage, unfettered by considerations of time and space, incapable of being agitated, you in gravity resemblest the ocean, and like to that lord of the earth furnished with seas-Vasava.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्त्ववान्बलवानपि
किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षःसु न योजयसि राघव
verses.transliteration:
evamastravidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sattvavānbalavānapi
kimarthamastraṁ rakṣaḥsu na yojayasi rāghava

translations.english: O Rāghava, being thus the foremost of those acquainted with weapons, powerful, and possessed of strength, wherefore do you not direct your weapon against the Rākşasas'?

verses.sanskrit:
न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः
रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रति समाधितुम्
verses.transliteration:
na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ
rāmasya samare vegaṁ śaktāḥ prati samādhitum

translations.english: Neither Nāgas, nor Gandharvas, nor the gods, nor the Maruts, are competent to resist the onset of Rāma in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्या वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि संभ्रमः
किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षयं नयति राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration:
tasyā vīryavataḥ kaścidyadyasti mayi saṁbhramaḥ
kimarthaṁ na śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣayaṁ nayati rākṣasān

translations.english: If that puissant one still retains any regard for me, why dose he not by means of sharpened shafts make roots and branch work with the Raksasas?

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परंतपः
कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
bhrāturādeśamādāya lakṣmaṇo vā paraṁtapaḥ
kasya hetorna māṁ vīraḥ paritrāti mahābalaḥ

translations.english: And why, taking the permission of his brother, that repressor of foes, the heroic Laks maņa gifted with great strength, dose not deliver me?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्विन्द्रसमतेजसौ
सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षो किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः
verses.transliteration:
yadi tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvindrasamatejasau
surāṇāmapi durdharṣo kimarthaṁ māmupekṣataḥ

translations.english: If those foremost of men be indeed equal to Indra and the Wind, and incapable of being repressed even by the celestials, wherefore do they disregard me?

verses.sanskrit:
ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः
समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परंतपौ
verses.transliteration:
mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ
samarthāvapi tau yanmāṁ nāvekṣete paraṁtapau

translations.english: Surely I must be guilty of some great crime, since although capable, those subduers of enemies do not look at me.

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी
तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय
verses.transliteration:
kausalyā lokabhartāraṁ suṣuve yaṁ manasvinī
taṁ mamārthe sukhaṁ pṛccha śirasā cābhivādaya

translations.english: Thus addressed, Sītā again spoke to him, saying, Do you on my behalf, bowing down the head, enquire after the welfare of that protector of men whom Kausalyā has brought forth.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः
जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज
ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ brūyāśca me nāthaṁ śūraṁ rāmaṁ punaḥ punaḥ
jīvitaṁ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṁ daśarathātmaja
ūrdhvaṁ māsānna jīveyaṁ satyenāhaṁ bravīmi te

translations.english: This also shall you say again and again to that hero— my lord, 'O son of Dasaratha, I shall keep on this life for another month; and this I swear to you by truth that I will not live beyond this month.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्या पापकर्मणा
त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇenoparuddhāṁ māṁ nikṛtyā pāpakarmaṇā
trātumarhasi vīra tvaṁ pātālādiva kauśikīm

translations.english: O hero, even as Vişnu rescued Kausikī from the nether regions, (According to Kataka, Kausikī is Earth, who was rescued by Narāyaṇa from the subterranean regions. According to Tīrtha, Kausikī is Indra's Auspiciousness, who on the occasion of the destruction of the Asura, Vritrā, took refuge in the nether regions, and was brought back by Vişņu) it behove you to rescue me, who have ignominiously been confined by the impious Rāvana,

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम्
प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ
verses.transliteration:
tato vastragataṁ muktvā divyaṁ cūḍāmaṇiṁ śubham
pradeyo rāghavāyeti sītā hanumate dadau

translations.english: Thereupon, saying, "Hand this to Rāghava,” Sītā gave to Hanumān a noble and excellent jewel for the head, (Cudamani. According to the commentator, the word means a gem worn in the head) which was tied up in her attire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम्
अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्या प्राभवद्भुजः
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya tato vīro maṇiratnamanuttamam
aṅgulyā yojayāmāsa na hyasyā prābhavadbhujaḥ

translations.english: Then taking that best of gems, the hero tried to fix it on this finger, but it did not enter into it. (Another meaning is, “But fearing discovery on account of the brilliance of the jewel, he desisted").

verses.sanskrit:
मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवाद्य च
सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्श्वतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
maṇiratnaṁ kapivaraḥ pratigṛhyābhivādya ca
sītāṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā praṇataḥ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ

translations.english: And taking the gem, and bowing to Sītā and going round her, that foremost of monkeys remained by her side in humble guise.

verses.sanskrit:
हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः
हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः
verses.transliteration:
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ
hṛdayena gato rāmaṁ śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ

translations.english: And experiencing rapture in consequence of his seeing Sītä, he mentally presented himself before Rāma, and Lakşmaņa graced with auspicious marks.

verses.sanskrit:
मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं; जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात्
गिरिवरपवनावधूतमुक्तः; सुखितमनाः प्रतिसंक्रमं प्रपेदे
verses.transliteration:
maṇivaramupagṛhya taṁ mahārhaṁ; janakanṛpātmajayā dhṛtaṁ prabhāvāt
girivarapavanāvadhūtamuktaḥ; sukhitamanāḥ pratisaṁkramaṁ prapede

translations.english: Taking that costly and superb gem, which by virtue of some power, king Janaka's daughter had managed to hide (from the gaze of the Raksasis), Hanumān, feeling delighted like one, shaken by the wind blowing on the top of the foremost of mountains, and then getting away from it, prepared to set out.

verses.sanskrit:
मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्
अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
maṇiṁ dattvā tataḥ sītā hanūmantamathābravīt
abhijñānamabhijñātametadrāmasya tattvataḥ

translations.english: Having made over the gem, Sītā said to Hanumān, This sign is very well known to Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
मणिं तु दृष्ट्वा रामो वै त्रयाणां संस्मरिष्यति
वीरो जनन्या मम च राज्ञो दशरथस्य च
verses.transliteration:
maṇiṁ tu dṛṣṭvā rāmo vai trayāṇāṁ saṁsmariṣyati
vīro jananyā mama ca rājño daśarathasya ca

translations.english: Seeing this gem, that hero, Rāma, shall recollect three persons, his mother, myself, and king Dasaratha, You, O foremost of monkeys, will again be commissioned on this business.

verses.sanskrit:
स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहे चोदितो हरिसत्तम
अस्मिन्कार्यसमारम्भे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
sa bhūyastvaṁ samutsāhe codito harisattama
asminkāryasamārambhe pracintaya yaduttaram

translations.english: Do you bethink you as to what you will do afterwards, when you had been entrusted with this task.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम
तस्य चिन्तय यो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
tvamasminkāryaniryoge pramāṇaṁ harisattama
tasya cintaya yo yatno duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, you are capable of compassing this work. Therefore, think as to what course of his (Rāma's) shall remove (my) misery.

verses.sanskrit:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः
शिरसावन्द्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
sa tatheti pratijñāya mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ
śirasāvandya vaidehīṁ gamanāyopacakrame

translations.english: O Hanumān, undergoing toils, be you instrumental in removing my misery. Saying, "So be it,” the Wind-god's offspring of terrible prowess, bowing down the head, prepared to depart.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञात्वा संप्रस्थितं देवी वानरं मारुतात्मजम्
बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
jñātvā saṁprasthitaṁ devī vānaraṁ mārutātmajam
bāṣpagadgadayā vācā maithilī vākyamabravīt

translations.english: Seeing that (Hanumān) was about to set out, that exalted one, Mithila's daughter, addressed that monkey, son to the Wind-god, in words choked by the vapour of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
कुशलं हनुमन्ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान्सर्वांश्च वानरान्
verses.transliteration:
kuśalaṁ hanumanbrūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau
sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātyaṁ vṛddhānsarvāṁśca vānarān

translations.english: O Hanumān, do you communicate good news to both Rāma and Lakşmaņa, to Sugrīva with his counsellors, and to all the aged monkeys. And, O best of monkeys, in consonance with righteousness, communicate good tidings (to Rāma).

verses.sanskrit:
यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः
अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yathā ca sa mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ
asmādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttvaṁ samādhātumarhasi

translations.english: And it behove you to strive so that the mighty-armed Rāghava may rescues me from this sea of sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः संभावयति कीर्तिमान्
तत्त्वया हनुमन्वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि
verses.transliteration:
jīvantīṁ māṁ yathā rāmaḥ saṁbhāvayati kīrtimān
tattvayā hanumanvācyaṁ vācā dharmamavāpnuhi

translations.english: O Hanumān, do you speak so that the illustrious Rāma may deliver me while I am still alive; and thereby do you reap righteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचः श्रुत्वा मयेरिताः
वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये
verses.transliteration:
nityamutsāhayuktāśca vācaḥ śrutvā mayeritāḥ
vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṁ madavāptaye

translations.english: Ever breathing high spirits, Dasarathi, (Dasaratha's son) hearing my words, shall attain an access of manliness for my deliverance.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्संदेशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तः श्रुत्वैव राघवः
पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत्संविधास्यति
verses.transliteration:
matsaṁdeśayutā vācastvattaḥ śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ
parākramavidhiṁ vīro vidhivatsaṁvidhāsyati

translations.english: Soon as Rāghava shall hear words couching tidings of me, that hero shall duly resolve on displaying his prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
सीतायास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sītāyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ
śirasyañjalimādhāya vākyamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing this speech of Sītā, Hanumān, son to the Wind-good, with his joined hands raised to his head, said.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हर्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः
यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीञ्शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
kṣiprameṣyati kākutstho haryṛkṣapravarairvṛtaḥ
yaste yudhi vijityārīñśokaṁ vyapanayiṣyati

translations.english: Soon shall Käkutstha come, surrounded by the foremost monkeys and bears; and, vanquishing the foe in fight, shall remove your grief.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नामरेष्वसुरेषु वा
यस्तस्य वमतो बाणान्स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
na hi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāmareṣvasureṣu vā
yastasya vamato bāṇānsthātumutsahate'grataḥ

translations.english: Find I none either among men, or Asuras, or celestials, that dares remain before him as he discharges his shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्यर्कमपि पर्जन्यमपि वैवस्वतं यमम्
स हि सोढुं रणे शक्तस्तवहेतोर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
apyarkamapi parjanyamapi vaivasvataṁ yamam
sa hi soḍhuṁ raṇe śaktastavahetorviśeṣataḥ

translations.english: For you, in especial, he can stand in conflict even the Sun, Indra, nay-Yama himself, that offspring of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं शासितुमीहते
त्वन्निमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि
verses.transliteration:
sa hi sāgaraparyantāṁ mahīṁ śāsitumīhate
tvannimitto hi rāmasya jayo janakanandini

translations.english: For you, he prepare himself to conquer the Earth bounded by the main; and victory, you daughter of Janaka, shall be Rāma's.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्सत्यं सुभाषितम्
जानकी बहु मेनेऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā samyaksatyaṁ subhāṣitam
jānakī bahu mene'tha vacanaṁ cedamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing his words excellently spoken and thoroughly true, Jānaki honoured them highly, and spoke (as follows).

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः
भर्तुः स्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत्
verses.transliteration:
tatastaṁ prasthitaṁ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ
bhartuḥ snehānvitaṁ vākyaṁ sauhārdādanumānayat

translations.english: And gazing at him once and again as he prepared to go away, Sītā froin affection honoured the speech which had been uttered (by Hanuman) out of attachment to his master.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिंदम
कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamariṁdama
kasmiṁścitsaṁvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi

translations.english: If you wish it, O hero, do you, O subduer of enemies, stay here for one day. Having rested in some hidden nook, you will depart tomorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
मम चेदल्पभाग्यायाः साम्निध्यात्तव वीर्यवान्
अस्य शोकस्य महतो मुहूर्तं मोक्षणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
mama cedalpabhāgyāyāḥ sāmnidhyāttava vīryavān
asya śokasya mahato muhūrtaṁ mokṣaṇaṁ bhavet

translations.english: O monkey, (if you do remain), your vicinity shall for a moment remove the huge grief of me of slender luck.

verses.sanskrit:
गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु
प्राणानामपि संदेहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
gate hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu
prāṇānāmapi saṁdeho mama syānnātra saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: But even if you go (passing today here), I have, O tiger-like monkey, doubts as to your return; and, accordingly, doubt, certainly, as to my life.

verses.sanskrit:
तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत्
दुःखाद्दुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर
verses.transliteration:
tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṁ paritāpayet
duḥkhādduḥkhaparāmṛṣṭāṁ dīpayanniva vānara

translations.english: And the grief incident to my not seeing you shall burn me greatly, even, O monkey, as grief burn one that is already consumed by sorrow over and over again.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं च वीर संदेहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः
सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ ca vīra saṁdehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ
sumahāṁstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara

translations.english: O hero, besides, I entertain a grave doubt about your assistants, the monkeys and bears. I do not know how shall the host of monkeys and bears and those two princes cross over the mighty main?

verses.sanskrit:
कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम्
तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ nu khalu duṣpāraṁ tariṣyanti mahodadhim
tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau

translations.english: And, O hero, O lord of monkeys, this doubt is also before me. How, alas! shall the mighty lord of monkeys, albeit backed by the monkeys and bears, cross over the mighty main hard to cross, and (how shall) those forces consisting of bears and monkeys or those sons of the best of men (cross over the same)?

verses.sanskrit:
त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्येह लङ्घने
शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा
verses.transliteration:
trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ sāgarasyeha laṅghane
śaktiḥ syādvainateyasya tava vā mārutasya vā

translations.english: In all the three worlds, Vinata's offspring, your self, and the Wind-god, have talone the power of crossing over the deep.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे
किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः
verses.transliteration:
tadasminkāryaniryoge vīraivaṁ duratikrame
kiṁ paśyasi samādhānaṁ tvaṁ hi kāryavidāṁ varaḥ

translations.english: Then, for the accomplishment of this work, difficult to compass, what, O hero, O you best of those conversant with business, what way do you see as to its success?

verses.sanskrit:
काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने
पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः
verses.transliteration:
kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane
paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ

translations.english: O slayer of hostile heroes, you alone are quite competent to perform this task; and you shall attain fame through your rising prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्य संयुगे
विजयी स्वपुरं यायात्तत्तु मे स्याद्यशस्करम्
verses.transliteration:
balaiḥ samagrairyadi māṁ rāvaṇaṁ jitya saṁyuge
vijayī svapuraṁ yāyāttattu me syādyaśaskaram

translations.english: But if (Rāma) himself together with all his forces, conquering Ravana and (recovering me) in battle, returned victorious to his own city, this would be worthy of himself.

verses.sanskrit:
बलैस्तु संकुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः
मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
balaistu saṁkulāṁ kṛtvā laṅkāṁ parabalārdanaḥ
māṁ nayedyadi kākutsthastattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet

translations.english: If blocking up Lankā with his army, that afflictor of hostile hosts, Kākutstha took me (hence), that would be worthy of him.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः
भवेदाहव शूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय
verses.transliteration:
tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ
bhavedāhava śūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya

translations.english: Do you, therefore, adopt such means that the high-souled heroic warrior may have an opportunity of putting forth prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं सहितं हेतुसंहितम्
निशम्य हनुमाञ्शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ sahitaṁ hetusaṁhitam
niśamya hanumāñśeṣaṁ vākyamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing her reasonable, affectionate and pregnant speech, that hero, Hanumān, answered,

verses.sanskrit:
देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः
सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसंपन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration:
devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ
sugrīvaḥ sattvasaṁpannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ

translations.english: O noble lady, that lord and foremost of monkeys, Sugrīva gifted with strength, is determined on your behalf.

verses.sanskrit:
स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः
क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः
verses.transliteration:
sa vānarasahasrāṇāṁ koṭībhirabhisaṁvṛtaḥ
kṣiprameṣyati vaidehi rākṣasānāṁ nibarhaṇaḥ

translations.english: That destroyer of Rākşasas, O daughter of Vaidehi, environed by thousands of millions of monkeys, will come hither without delay.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य विक्रमसंपन्नाः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः
मनःसंकल्पसंपाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
tasya vikramasaṁpannāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ
manaḥsaṁkalpasaṁpātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ

translations.english: He has under his command a number of mighty and courageous monkeys gifted with great prowess and quick-coursing like imagination.

verses.sanskrit:
येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक्सज्जते गतिः
न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration:
yeṣāṁ nopari nādhastānna tiryaksajjate gatiḥ
na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ

translations.english: Their course is never thwarted-whether going upwards or downwardsor moving tortuously. They are never exhausted in their actions—highly courageous and of measureless prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
असकृत्तैर्महोत्सहैः ससागरधराधरा
प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः
verses.transliteration:
asakṛttairmahotsahaiḥ sasāgaradharādharā
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmirvāyumārgānusāribhiḥ

translations.english: Braced by their exalted spirits, these, resorting to the aerial way have many a time and oft circumambulated the Earth containing mountains and meads.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः
मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ
mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasaṁnidhau

translations.english: There are (in that army) rangers of woods, some equal and some superior to me. And near Sugrīva there are none who are inferior to me.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः
न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṁ punaste mahābalāḥ
na hi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ

translations.english: And since even I have reached this place, what shall I say of those ones endowed with immense might? Nor are superior (monkeys) sent on errands; it is only the inferior ones that are sent.

verses.sanskrit:
तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते
एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
tadalaṁ paritāpena devi śoko vyapaitu te
ekotpātena te laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: Then, O exalted one. you need not grieve: let your sorrow depart. Those leaders of monkey herds will come to Lankā by one bound; and, like to the risen Sun and Moon, those leonine men, having large numbers to back them, will come to your side, riding my back.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ हि वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः
verses.transliteration:
tau hi vīrau naravarau sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau
āgamya nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ sāyakairvidhamiṣyataḥ

translations.english: Those heroes and foremost of men, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa both, coming to the city of Lankā, shall destroy her by means of their shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
सगणं रावणं हत्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः
त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरं प्रतियास्यति
verses.transliteration:
sagaṇaṁ rāvaṇaṁ hatvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ
tvāmādāya varārohe svapuraṁ pratiyāsyati

translations.english: And slaying Rāvaņa together with his adherents, Raghu's son, taking you, O paragon among women, shall return to his own city.

verses.sanskrit:
तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी
नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वजन्तमिवानिलम्
verses.transliteration:
tadāśvasihi bhadraṁ te bhava tvaṁ kālakāṅkṣiṇī
nacirāddrakṣyase rāmaṁ prajvajantamivānilam

translations.english: Therefore, do you take heart, good betide you! Do you remain, eagerly wishing for the time. It will not be long before you shall behold Rāma resembling flaming fire.

verses.sanskrit:
निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे च सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे
त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी
verses.transliteration:
nihate rākṣasendre ca saputrāmātyabāndhave
tvaṁ sameṣyasi rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī

translations.english: On the lord of Rākṣasas being slain along with his counsellors and friends, you shall meet with Rāma, even as Rohinī meet with the Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि
रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसेऽचिरात्
verses.transliteration:
kṣipraṁ tvaṁ devi śokasya pāraṁ yāsyasi maithili
rāvaṇaṁ caiva rāmeṇa nihataṁ drakṣyase'cirāt

translations.english: O worshipful one, speedily shall you behold the other shore of your misery, O Maithili; and you shall see Rāvana slain by Rāma by might of arm.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमाश्वस्य वैदेहीं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
evamāśvasya vaidehīṁ hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
gamanāya matiṁ kṛtvā vaidehīṁ punarabravīt

translations.english: Having thus solaced Vaidehi's daughter, Hanumān, son to the Wind-god again spoke to Vaidehi, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्
लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tamarighnaṁ kṛtātmānaṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam
lakṣmaṇaṁ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṁ laṅkādvāramupasthitam

translations.english: Soon shall you behold that destroyer of foes, Rāghava of subdued soul, and the bow-bearing Laksmana also, come to the gate of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
नखदंष्ट्रायुधान्वीरान्सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्
वानरान्वारणेन्द्राभान्क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि संगतान्
verses.transliteration:
nakhadaṁṣṭrāyudhānvīrānsiṁhaśārdūlavikramān
vānarānvāraṇendrābhānkṣipraṁ drakṣyasi saṁgatān
