tatastu śiṁśapāmūle jānakīṁ paryavasthitām
abhivādyābravīddiṣṭyā paśyāmi tvāmihākṣatām

translations.english: Then seeing Jānakī seated at the foot of the Śinsapa tree, (Hanumān) saluting her said, “By luck it is that I see you unhurt."

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः
भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं हनूमन्तमभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tatastaṁ prasthitaṁ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ
bhartṛsnehānvitaṁ vākyaṁ hanūmantamabhāṣata

translations.english: Then eying him again and again as he was on the point of departing, Sītā said to Hanumān in words informed with affection for her husband. "If, my child, it like you, do you, O stainless one, stay here today in some retired spot. Tomorrow having refreshed yourself, you shall set out."

verses.sanskrit:
काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने
पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः
verses.transliteration:
kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane
paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ

translations.english: True it is that you are alone qualified to accomplish this work, you the slayer of inimical heroes-but such manifestation of your prowess shall increase your glory only.

verses.sanskrit:
बलैस्तु संकुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः
मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तस्य तत्सादृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
balaistu saṁkulāṁ kṛtvā laṅkāṁ parabalārdanaḥ
māṁ nayedyadi kākutsthastasya tatsādṛśaṁ bhavet

translations.english: Truly it shall be his becoming work, if Kākutstha, the repressor of enemy's host, can take me away, enveloping the city Lankā with his army.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः
भवत्याहवशूरस्य तत्त्वमेवोपपादय
verses.transliteration:
tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ
bhavatyāhavaśūrasya tattvamevopapādaya

translations.english: Do you therefore initiate that work as become that high-souled hero and may display his prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम्
निशम्य हनुमांस्तस्या वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ praśritaṁ hetusaṁhitam
niśamya hanumāṁstasyā vākyamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those words fraught with sense and reason and informed with affection, Hanumān, by way of reply said mildly.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हर्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः
यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीञ्शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
kṣiprameṣyati kākutstho haryṛkṣapravarairvṛtaḥ
yaste yudhi vijityārīñśokaṁ vyapanayiṣyati

translations.english: At once shall Käkutstha come, accompanied by the foremost of monkeys, who, conquering (Ravana) in conflict, shall remove your grief.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीमभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration:
evamāśvāsya vaidehīṁ hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
gamanāya matiṁ kṛtvā vaidehīmabhyavādayat

translations.english: Having thus consoled Vaidehi's daughter, Hanumān, son to the Wind-god, setting his heart upon departure, saluted Vaidehi.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन पादतलाक्रान्ता रम्येषु गिरिसानुषु
सघोषाः समशीर्यन्त शिलाश्चूर्णीकृतास्ततः
verses.transliteration:
tena pādatalākrāntā ramyeṣu girisānuṣu
saghoṣāḥ samaśīryanta śilāścūrṇīkṛtāstataḥ

translations.english: And on the lovely level of that mountain, the crags, crushed with sounds under the tread of that one burning to behold Rāma and wrought up with excess of joy, were scattered all round.

verses.sanskrit:
स तमारुह्य शैलेन्द्रं व्यवर्धत महाकपिः
दक्षिणादुत्तरं पारं प्रार्थयँल्लवणाम्भसः
verses.transliteration:
sa tamāruhya śailendraṁ vyavardhata mahākapiḥ
dakṣiṇāduttaraṁ pāraṁ prārthaya̐llavaṇāmbhasaḥ

translations.english: And ascending that lordly hill, the mighty monkey magnified himself, desirous of going from the southern to the northern shore of the salt waters.

verses.sanskrit:
अधिरुह्य ततो वीरः पर्वतं पवनात्मजः
ददर्श सागरं भीमं मीनोरगनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration:
adhiruhya tato vīraḥ parvataṁ pavanātmajaḥ
dadarśa sāgaraṁ bhīmaṁ mīnoraganiṣevitam

translations.english: And getting to the top of the mountain, that hero, son to the Wind-god, cast his eyes upon the dreadful main inhabited by terrible snakes.

verses.sanskrit:
स मारुत इवाकाशं मारुतस्यात्मसंभवः
प्रपेदे हरिशार्दूलो दक्षिणादुत्तरां दिशम्
verses.transliteration:
sa māruta ivākāśaṁ mārutasyātmasaṁbhavaḥ
prapede hariśārdūlo dakṣiṇāduttarāṁ diśam

translations.english: And that foremost of monkeys, offspring of the Wind-god, (Māruta—this term is used twice in this Sloka, once for Hanumān, and next for the Wind-god. One of these is left out on the score of redundency) (mentally) went from the south to the north, as if it were the air.

verses.sanskrit:
स तदा पीडितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः
ररास सह तैर्भूतैः प्राविशद्वसुधातलम्
कम्पमानैश्च शिखरैः पतद्भिरपि च द्रुमैः
verses.transliteration:
sa tadā pīḍitastena kapinā parvatottamaḥ
rarāsa saha tairbhūtaiḥ prāviśadvasudhātalam
kampamānaiśca śikharaiḥ patadbhirapi ca drumaiḥ

translations.english: Then that best of mountains, sore pressed by the monkey, began to emit cries, and with various creatures (on it), entered under the Earth, with its peaks tottering and its trees toppling.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्योरुवेगान्मथिताः पादपाः पुष्पशालिनः
निपेतुर्भूतले रुग्णाः शक्रायुधहता इव
verses.transliteration:
tasyoruvegānmathitāḥ pādapāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ
nipeturbhūtale rugṇāḥ śakrāyudhahatā iva

translations.english: And borne down by the violence of his thighs, trees bearing flowers, being shattered, as if destroyed by Sakra's weapon, fell to the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
स्रस्तव्याविद्धवसना व्याकुलीकृतभूषणा
विद्याधर्यः समुत्पेतुः सहसा धरणीधरात्
verses.transliteration:
srastavyāviddhavasanā vyākulīkṛtabhūṣaṇā
vidyādharyaḥ samutpetuḥ sahasā dharaṇīdharāt

translations.english: The dreadful yells of mighty lions in pain, inhabiting caves, entered the car, piercing the heavens. And Vidyādharis with their attires falling off and their ornaments disordered, suddenly rose from the mountain to the sky. (Dharanidharāt-at-from the holder of the Earth, the latter being supposed to rest on a mountain)

verses.sanskrit:
अतिप्रमाणा बलिनो दीप्तजिह्वा महाविषाः
निपीडितशिरोग्रीवा व्यवेष्टन्त महाहयः
verses.transliteration:
atipramāṇā balino dīptajihvā mahāviṣāḥ
nipīḍitaśirogrīvā vyaveṣṭanta mahāhayaḥ

translations.english: And exceedingly powerful and mighty snakes of virulent venom, having flaming tongues, with their hoods and necks tortured, began to roll (on the earth).

verses.sanskrit:
किंनरोरगगन्धर्वयक्षविद्याधरास्तथा
पीडितं तं नगवरं त्यक्त्वा गगनमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁnaroragagandharvayakṣavidyādharāstathā
pīḍitaṁ taṁ nagavaraṁ tyaktvā gaganamāsthitāḥ

translations.english: And Kinnar and serpents, Gandharvas, Yaksas and Vidyadharas, forsaking that foremost of mountains in affliction, took refuge in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
स च भूमिधरः श्रीमान्बलिना तेन पीडितः
सवृक्षशिखरोदग्राः प्रविवेश रसातलम्
verses.transliteration:
sa ca bhūmidharaḥ śrīmānbalinā tena pīḍitaḥ
savṛkṣaśikharodagrāḥ praviveśa rasātalam

translations.english: And that graceful mountain also, tormented by that powerful one, entered the nether regions with its tall trees and summits.

verses.sanskrit:
दशयोजनविस्तारस्त्रिंशद्योजनमुच्छ्रितः
धरण्यां समतां यातः स बभूव धराधरः
verses.transliteration:
daśayojanavistārastriṁśadyojanamucchritaḥ
dharaṇyāṁ samatāṁ yātaḥ sa babhūva dharādharaḥ

translations.english: That mountain, which (heretofore) had measured ten Yojanas in area and thirty in height, became level with the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ग्रसमान इवाकाशं ताराधिपमिवालिखन्
हरन्निव सनक्षत्रं गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration:
grasamāna ivākāśaṁ tārādhipamivālikhan
haranniva sanakṣatraṁ gaganaṁ sārkamaṇḍalam

translations.english: As if swallowing up the welkin and touching the lord of stars, abolishing the sky decorated with stars and the solar disc, and cleaving the clouds, the unfatigued Hanuman began to cross over that sea.

verses.sanskrit:
पाण्डुरारुणवर्णानि नीलमाञ्जिष्ठकानि च
हरितारुणवर्णानि महाभ्राणि चकाशिरे
verses.transliteration:
pāṇḍurāruṇavarṇāni nīlamāñjiṣṭhakāni ca
haritāruṇavarṇāni mahābhrāṇi cakāśire

translations.english: And (on all sides) mighty masses of clouds, sable, crimson, blue, Manjistha-hued, and greenred, looked exceedingly beautiful.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्क्रमंश्च पुनः पुनः
प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration:
praviśannabhrajālāni niṣkramaṁśca punaḥ punaḥ
pracchannaśca prakāśaśca candramā iva lakṣyate

translations.english: And now entering into the clouds, and now emerging from them, he looked like the moon, sometimes hid and sometimes visible.

verses.sanskrit:
नदन्नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः
आजगाम महातेजाः पुनर्मध्येन सागरम्
verses.transliteration:
nadannādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ
ājagāma mahātejāḥ punarmadhyena sāgaram

translations.english: And sending up mighty sounds, that exceedingly energetic one gifted with a powerful voice like that of the clouds, having slain the foremost Rākşasas and rendered his name famous, having filled the city with lamentations and afflicted Rāvana, having distressed the mighty heroes and paid obeisance to Vaidehī, again held his course along the mid-ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
पर्वतेन्द्रं सुनाभं च समुपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान्
ज्यामुक्त इव नाराचो महावेगोऽभ्युपागतः
verses.transliteration:
parvatendraṁ sunābhaṁ ca samupaspṛśya vīryavān
jyāmukta iva nārāco mahāvego'bhyupāgataḥ

translations.english: And touching Mainaka-foremost of mountains-that one endowed with prowess proceeded amain like an iron dart let go from a string.

verses.sanskrit:
स किंचिदनुसंप्राप्तः समालोक्य महागिरिम्
महेन्द्रमेघसंकाशं ननाद हरिपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
sa kiṁcidanusaṁprāptaḥ samālokya mahāgirim
mahendrameghasaṁkāśaṁ nanāda haripuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: And from a distance approaching and beholding that mighty mountain, Mahendra, resembling clouds, that redoubted monkey began to roar.

verses.sanskrit:
निशम्य नदतो नादं वानरास्ते समन्ततः
बभूवुरुत्सुकाः सर्वे सुहृद्दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
niśamya nadato nādaṁ vānarāste samantataḥ
babhūvurutsukāḥ sarve suhṛddarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those sounds as he kept crying, those monkeys (sitting) around, eager to see their friend, became extremely anxious.

verses.sanskrit:
जाम्बवान्स हरिश्रेष्ठः प्रीतिसंहृष्टमानसः
उपामन्त्र्य हरीन्सर्वानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
jāmbavānsa hariśreṣṭhaḥ prītisaṁhṛṣṭamānasaḥ
upāmantrya harīnsarvānidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: And that best of monkeys, Jambavan, with a joyful heart addressing all the monkeys, said.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽसौ हनूमान्नात्र संशयः
न ह्यस्याकृतकार्यस्य नाद एवंविधो भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā kṛtakāryo'sau hanūmānnātra saṁśayaḥ
na hyasyākṛtakāryasya nāda evaṁvidho bhavet

translations.english: Hanumān has succeeded completely. There is no doubt about this. If he were unsuccessful, he would not utter shouts as these.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्या बाहूरुवेगं च निनादं च महात्मनः
निशम्य हरयो हृष्टाः समुत्पेतुस्ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
tasyā bāhūruvegaṁ ca ninādaṁ ca mahātmanaḥ
niśamya harayo hṛṣṭāḥ samutpetustatastataḥ

translations.english: And hearing the sounds produced by the violent movements of the arms of that highsouled (hero), as well as the shouts of that magnanimous one, the monkeys, filled with delight, leapt up on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च
प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिदृक्षवः
verses.transliteration:
te nagāgrānnagāgrāṇi śikharācchikharāṇi ca
prahṛṣṭāḥ samapadyanta hanūmantaṁ didṛkṣavaḥ

translations.english: And they, eager to have a sight of Hanumān, joyfully went from mountain-top to mountaintop and from peak on to peak.

verses.sanskrit:
ते प्रीताः पादपाग्रेषु गृह्य शाखाः सुपुष्पिताः
वासांसीव प्रकाशानि समाविध्यन्त वानराः
verses.transliteration:
te prītāḥ pādapāgreṣu gṛhya śākhāḥ supuṣpitāḥ
vāsāṁsīva prakāśāni samāvidhyanta vānarāḥ

translations.english: And influenced by joy, the monkeys remained holding a bough at the top of a tree, and waving their clean apparels.

verses.sanskrit:
तमभ्रघनसंकाशमापतन्तं महाकपिम्
दृष्ट्वा ते वानराः सर्वे तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tamabhraghanasaṁkāśamāpatantaṁ mahākapim
dṛṣṭvā te vānarāḥ sarve tasthuḥ prāñjalayastadā

translations.english: And seeing that mighty monkey resembling a mass of clouds, alighting, those monkeys stood joining their hands.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु वेगवांस्तस्य गिरेर्गिरिनिभः कपिः
निपपात महेन्द्रस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले
verses.transliteration:
tatastu vegavāṁstasya girergirinibhaḥ kapiḥ
nipapāta mahendrasya śikhare pādapākule

translations.english: Then the vehement monkey resembling a hill, having leapt up from that mountain, alighted on the top of that (other) mountain (Mahendra) filled with trees.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते प्रीतमनसः सर्वे वानरपुंगवाः
हनूमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration:
tataste prītamanasaḥ sarve vānarapuṁgavāḥ
hanūmantaṁ mahātmānaṁ parivāryopatasthire

translations.english: Then with joyful hearts, all the principal monkeys stood encircling the high-souled Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
उपायनानि चादाय मूलानि च फलानि च
प्रत्यर्चयन्हरिश्रेष्ठं हरयो मारुतात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
upāyanāni cādāya mūlāni ca phalāni ca
pratyarcayanhariśreṣṭhaṁ harayo mārutātmajam

translations.english: And surrounding him, they experienced excess of delight, and drew near the newcomer with joyful faces. And bringing fruits and roots, the monkeys honoured that chief of monkeys, the offspring of the Wind-god.

verses.sanskrit:
विनेदुर्मुदिताः केचिच्चक्रुः किल किलां तथा
हृष्टाः पादपशाखाश्च आनिन्युर्वानरर्षभाः
verses.transliteration:
vinedurmuditāḥ keciccakruḥ kila kilāṁ tathā
hṛṣṭāḥ pādapaśākhāśca āninyurvānararṣabhāḥ

translations.english: And some, filled with delight, sent shouts, and some raised ululations; and the foremost monkeys fetched branches of trees. (To serve for a seat for Hanuman)

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमांस्तु गुरून्वृद्धाञ्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्तदा
कुमारमङ्गदं चैव सोऽवन्दत महाकपिः
verses.transliteration:
hanūmāṁstu gurūnvṛddhāñjāmbavatpramukhāṁstadā
kumāramaṅgadaṁ caiva so'vandata mahākapiḥ

translations.english: And that mighty monkey, Hanumān, saluted his superiors an the aged, headed by Jāmbavan, as well as Prince Angada.

verses.sanskrit:
स ताभ्यां पूजितः पूज्यः कपिभिश्च प्रसादितः
दृष्टा देवीति विक्रान्तः संक्षेपेण न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tābhyāṁ pūjitaḥ pūjyaḥ kapibhiśca prasāditaḥ
dṛṣṭā devīti vikrāntaḥ saṁkṣepeṇa nyavedayat

translations.english: And honoured by the monkeys as he very well deserved to be, and gratified by them, (he) briefly said—“Seen have I the exalted lady."

verses.sanskrit:
निषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनः सुतम्
रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
niṣasāda ca hastena gṛhītvā vālinaḥ sutam
ramaṇīye vanoddeśe mahendrasya girestadā

translations.english: Taking Vāli's son by the hand, he sat him down in a charming tract of the woodland belonging to the mountain Mahendra. Then asked (by them), Hanumān addressed those foremost monkeys, "I have seen Janaka's daughter in the Asoka woods."

verses.sanskrit:
रक्ष्यमाणा सुघोराभी राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता
एकवेणीधरा बाला रामदर्शनलालसा
उपवासपरिश्रान्ता मलिना जटिला कृशा
verses.transliteration:
rakṣyamāṇā sughorābhī rākṣasībhiraninditā
ekaveṇīdharā bālā rāmadarśanalālasā
upavāsapariśrāntā malinā jaṭilā kṛśā

translations.english: That blameless one is guarded by dreadful Räkşasīs. The girl wear a single braid of hair, and burn to attain a sight of Rāma. She is faint in consequence of fasting, and dirty, wear matted locks and is emaciated.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो दृष्टेति वचनं महार्थममृतोपमम्
निशम्य मारुतेः सर्वे मुदिता वानरा भवन्
verses.transliteration:
tato dṛṣṭeti vacanaṁ mahārthamamṛtopamam
niśamya māruteḥ sarve muditā vānarā bhavan

translations.english: Hearing the words, "I have seen" from the Wind-god's offspring resembling ambrosia, all the monkeys were filled with rejoicing.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष्वेडन्त्यन्ये नदन्त्यन्ये गर्जन्त्यन्ये महाबलाः
चक्रुः किल किलामन्ये प्रतिगर्जन्ति चापरे
verses.transliteration:
kṣveḍantyanye nadantyanye garjantyanye mahābalāḥ
cakruḥ kila kilāmanye pratigarjanti cāpare

translations.english: And thereupon, some of mighty ones roared, and some shouted, and some blustered, and some raised ululations, and others stormed (in return).

verses.sanskrit:
केचिदुच्छ्रितलाङ्गूलाः प्रहृष्टाः कपिकुञ्जराः
अञ्चितायतदीर्घाणि लाङ्गूलानि प्रविव्यधुः
verses.transliteration:
keciducchritalāṅgūlāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapikuñjarāḥ
añcitāyatadīrghāṇi lāṅgūlāni pravivyadhuḥ

translations.english: And some elephantine monkeys in joy upraised their tails, and some lashed with their long and broad tails.

verses.sanskrit:
अपरे तु हनूमन्तं वानरा वारणोपमम्
आप्लुत्य गिरिशृङ्गेभ्यः संस्पृशन्ति स्म हर्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
apare tu hanūmantaṁ vānarā vāraṇopamam
āplutya giriśṛṅgebhyaḥ saṁspṛśanti sma harṣitāḥ

translations.english: And others, transported with joy, bounding up to the mountain-summit, touched that foremost of monkeys, the handsome Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
उक्तवाक्यं हनूमन्तमङ्गदस्तु तदाब्रवीत्
सर्वेषां हरिवीराणां मध्ये वाचमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
uktavākyaṁ hanūmantamaṅgadastu tadābravīt
sarveṣāṁ harivīrāṇāṁ madhye vācamanuttamām

translations.english: When Hanumān had ended, Angada said these excellent words in the midst of the heroic monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्त्वे वीर्ये न ते कश्चित्समो वानरविद्यते
यदवप्लुत्य विस्तीर्णं सागरं पुनरागतः
verses.transliteration:
sattve vīrye na te kaścitsamo vānaravidyate
yadavaplutya vistīrṇaṁ sāgaraṁ punarāgataḥ

translations.english: There is none, O monkey, that is like to you in strength and prowess. As having bounded over the spacious main, you had come back (here), you are, O excellent monkey, the only giver of our lives. By your grace it is that, our end attained, we shall meet with Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या दृष्टा त्वया देवी रामपत्नी यशस्विनी
दिष्ट्या त्यक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थः शोकं सीता वियोगजम्
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī
diṣṭyā tyakṣyati kākutsthaḥ śokaṁ sītā viyogajam

translations.english: Oh for your fidelity! Oh for your prowess! Oh for your fortitude! By luck had you seen that exalted one, the illustrious wife of Rāma, by luck it is that Kākutstha shall forego his sorrow in consequence of separation from Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोतुकामाः समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः
दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायाः सीताया रावणस्य च
तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे हनूमद्वदनोन्मुखाः
verses.transliteration:
śrotukāmāḥ samudrasya laṅghanaṁ vānarottamāḥ
darśanaṁ cāpi laṅkāyāḥ sītāyā rāvaṇasya ca
tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve hanūmadvadanonmukhāḥ

translations.english: Then surrounding Angada, Hanumān, and Jāmbavan, the monkeys, exceedingly rejoiced, sat down upon a spacious stone. And having sat them down on the spacious rock, the monkeys became eager to hear of the bounding of the main and of (Hanuān's) seeing Larkā, Sītā and Rāvaņa And they stood with joined hands looking wistfully into Hanumān's face.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्थौ तत्राङ्गदः श्रीमान्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
उपास्यमानो विबुधैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा
verses.transliteration:
tasthau tatrāṅgadaḥ śrīmānvānarairbahubhirvṛtaḥ
upāsyamāno vibudhairdivi devapatiryathā

translations.english: The graceful Angada was there, surrounded by many monkeys, and honoured by them, even as the lord of celestials is honoured in heaven by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमता कीर्तिमता यशस्विना; तथाङ्गदेनाङ्गदबद्धबाहुना
मुदा तदाध्यासितमुन्नतं मह;न्महीधराग्रं ज्वलितं श्रियाभवत्
verses.transliteration:
hanūmatā kīrtimatā yaśasvinā; tathāṅgadenāṅgadabaddhabāhunā
mudā tadādhyāsitamunnataṁ maha;nmahīdharāgraṁ jvalitaṁ śriyābhavat

translations.english: When the famous and renowned Hanumān, and Angada with bracelets on his arms, had sat down, the elevated and mighty mountain-summit was illuminated with splendour.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे महेन्द्रस्य महाबलाः
हनुमत्प्रमुखाः प्रीतिं हरयो जग्मुरुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastasya gireḥ śṛṅge mahendrasya mahābalāḥ
hanumatpramukhāḥ prītiṁ harayo jagmuruttamām

translations.english: Then on the summit of the mountain, Mahendra, those powerful monkeys, headed by Hanumān, rejoiced exceedingly.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वतः सर्वमेतन्नः प्रब्रूहि त्वं महाकपे
श्रुतार्थाश्चिन्तयिष्यामो भूयः कार्यविनिश्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
tattvataḥ sarvametannaḥ prabrūhi tvaṁ mahākape
śrutārthāścintayiṣyāmo bhūyaḥ kāryaviniścayam

translations.english: How could you track the exalted lady? And what did she say in reply (to your querries)?, Having learnt the real state of things, we shall decide what is to be done.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चार्थस्तत्र वक्तव्यो गतैरस्माभिरात्मवान्
रक्षितव्यं च यत्तत्र तद्भवान्व्याकरोतु नः
verses.transliteration:
yaścārthastatra vaktavyo gatairasmābhirātmavān
rakṣitavyaṁ ca yattatra tadbhavānvyākarotu naḥ

translations.english: And do you also tell us what we, repairing there, shall unfold to that one of controlled self and what we shall keep to ourselves.

verses.sanskrit:
स नियुक्तस्ततस्तेन संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः
नमस्यञ्शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
sa niyuktastatastena saṁprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ
namasyañśirasā devyai sītāyai pratyabhāṣata

translations.english: Thus directed by him, that one (Hanumān) with his down standing on end, bowing down the head to that revered one, Sītā, replied.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्यक्षमेव भवतां महेन्द्राग्रात्खमाप्लुतः
उदधेर्दक्षिणं पारं काङ्क्षमाणः समाहितः
verses.transliteration:
pratyakṣameva bhavatāṁ mahendrāgrātkhamāplutaḥ
udadherdakṣiṇaṁ pāraṁ kāṅkṣamāṇaḥ samāhitaḥ

translations.english: In your sight, I bounded up with concentrated mind, eager to reach the southern shore of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
गच्छतश्च हि मे घोरं विघ्नरूपमिवाभवत्
काञ्चनं शिखरं दिव्यं पश्यामि सुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration:
gacchataśca hi me ghoraṁ vighnarūpamivābhavat
kāñcanaṁ śikharaṁ divyaṁ paśyāmi sumanoharam

translations.english: As I voyaged on, a great impediment occurred in the way. I saw a goodly and noble golden peak, standing, obstructing my way. I found the mountain as an obstacle to my course.

verses.sanskrit:
उपसंगम्य तं दिव्यं काञ्चनं नगसत्तमम्
कृता मे मनसा बुद्धिर्भेत्तव्योऽयं मयेति च
verses.transliteration:
upasaṁgamya taṁ divyaṁ kāñcanaṁ nagasattamam
kṛtā me manasā buddhirbhettavyo'yaṁ mayeti ca

translations.english: Nearing the grand and splendid golden mount, I thought within myself, 'I will rive this.'

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहतं च मया तस्य लाङ्गूलेन महागिरेः
शिखरं सूर्यसंकाशं व्यशीर्यत सहस्रधा
verses.transliteration:
prahataṁ ca mayā tasya lāṅgūlena mahāgireḥ
śikharaṁ sūryasaṁkāśaṁ vyaśīryata sahasradhā

translations.english: And the sun-like summit of that mighty mountain, Prahasta, was cleft in a thousand fragments by my tail.

verses.sanskrit:
पितृव्यं चापि मां विद्धि सखायं मातरिश्वनः
मैनाकमिति विख्यातं निवसन्तं महोदधौ
verses.transliteration:
pitṛvyaṁ cāpi māṁ viddhi sakhāyaṁ mātariśvanaḥ
mainākamiti vikhyātaṁ nivasantaṁ mahodadhau

translations.english: Seeing his own condition, that mighty mountain, gladdening my heart, addressed me with the sweet speech, 'O son, know me for your uncle. I am a friend to the Wind, famed as Maināka, and living in the great deep. Formerly all the foremost mountains were furnished with wings.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा मया तस्य मैनाकस्य महात्मनः
कार्यमावेद्य तु गिरेरुद्धतं च मनो मम
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā mayā tasya mainākasya mahātmanaḥ
kāryamāvedya tu gireruddhataṁ ca mano mama

translations.english: Having heard this from the magnanimous Maināka, I apprised the mountain of my mission, and my thought held their course. Having given me his permission, the magnanimous Maināka, the mountain that had put on the forın of a man, vanished, and, assuming his mountain-form, went into the vast sea.

verses.sanskrit:
समुद्रमध्ये सा देवी वचनं मामभाषत
मम भक्ष्यः प्रदिष्टस्त्वममारैर्हरिसत्तमम्
ततस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि विहितस्त्वं चिरस्य मे
verses.transliteration:
samudramadhye sā devī vacanaṁ māmabhāṣata
mama bhakṣyaḥ pradiṣṭastvamamārairharisattamam
tatastvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi vihitastvaṁ cirasya me

translations.english: I, summoning my best celerity, began to journey the remainder of my way. And having swiftly proceeded long in the path, I saw the exalted lady, Surasā, mother of the serpents. And that worshipful one stationed in the sea, said, 'By the celestials had you, O best of monkeys, been assigned as my food. Therefore shall I eat you up. You had been ordained as mine by the gods.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतः स्थितः
विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा वाक्यं चेदमुदीरयम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ surasayā prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ
vivarṇavadano bhūtvā vākyaṁ cedamudīrayam

translations.english: Thus addressed by Surasā, I, remaining in humble guise with joined hands, and with my countenance turned pale, I uttered these words,

verses.sanskrit:
रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान्प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया च परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmānpraviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: “Rāma, the graceful son of Dasaratha, repressor of foes—has entered the woods of Dandaka, in company with his brother Lakşmaņa and Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना
तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्
verses.transliteration:
tasya sītā hṛtā bhāryā rāvaṇena durātmanā
tasyāḥ sakāśaṁ dūto'haṁ gamiṣye rāmaśāsanāt

translations.english: His wife Sītā has been carried off by the wicked Rāvana. At Rāma's mandate I go to her as an envoy.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्
आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोति मे
verses.transliteration:
atha vā maithilīṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṁ cākliṣṭakāriṇam
āgamiṣyāmi te vaktraṁ satyaṁ pratiśṛṇoti me

translations.english: In this business, you, O chaste one, should help Rāma. Or having seen Mithila's daughter, as well as Rāma of untiring deeds, I shall come to your mouth, this I promise to you truly.'

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी
अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā mayā sā tu surasā kāmarūpiṇī
abravīnnātivarteta kaścideṣa varo mama

translations.english: Thus accosted by me, Surasā, wearing forms at her will, said, 'None is able to escape me. Even this is the boon that I have received.'

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीत्सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण मां पुनः
अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration:
abravītsurasā devī svena rūpeṇa māṁ punaḥ
arthasiddhyai hariśreṣṭha gaccha saumya yathāsukham

translations.english: Your end having been attained, go, O mild one, O foremost of monkeys, according to your pleasure. Bring about the meeting of Vaidehī with the high-souled Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽहं साधु साध्वीति सर्वभूतैः प्रशंसितः
ततोऽन्तरिक्षं विपुलं प्लुतोऽहं गरुडो यथा
verses.transliteration:
tato'haṁ sādhu sādhvīti sarvabhūtaiḥ praśaṁsitaḥ
tato'ntarikṣaṁ vipulaṁ pluto'haṁ garuḍo yathā

translations.english: Then like to Garuda I again sprang up into the air. But now my shadow was overtaken by somebody, though I saw no one.

verses.sanskrit:
छाया मे निगृहीता च न च पश्यामि किंचन
सोऽहं विगतवेगस्तु दिशो दश विलोकयन्
न किंचित्तत्र पश्यामि येन मेऽपहृता गतिः
verses.transliteration:
chāyā me nigṛhītā ca na ca paśyāmi kiṁcana
so'haṁ vigatavegastu diśo daśa vilokayan
na kiṁcittatra paśyāmi yena me'pahṛtā gatiḥ

translations.english: And my velocity being deprived, I looked at the ten cardinal points; but I found there naught which could deprive me of my speed.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना किं नाम गमने मम
ईदृशो विघ्न उत्पन्नो रूपं यत्र न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration:
tato me buddhirutpannā kiṁ nāma gamane mama
īdṛśo vighna utpanno rūpaṁ yatra na dṛśyate

translations.english: Then I thought, 'What is this obstacle that has suddenly arisen in respect of my course? No form find I here?'

verses.sanskrit:
अधो भागेन मे दृष्टिः शोचता पातिता मया
ततोऽद्राक्षमहं भीमां राक्षसीं सलिले शयाम्
verses.transliteration:
adho bhāgena me dṛṣṭiḥ śocatā pātitā mayā
tato'drākṣamahaṁ bhīmāṁ rākṣasīṁ salile śayām

translations.english: And as I stood aggrieved, my glance fell downwards. Then I saw there a dreadful Räksasī supine on the flood.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहस्य च महानादमुक्तोऽहं भीमया तया
अवस्थितमसंभ्रान्तमिदं वाक्यमशोभनम्
verses.transliteration:
prahasya ca mahānādamukto'haṁ bhīmayā tayā
avasthitamasaṁbhrāntamidaṁ vākyamaśobhanam

translations.english: And laughing (scornfully), that grim one said these inauspicious words to me, who was inert, although undaunted,

verses.sanskrit:
क्वासि गन्ता महाकाय क्षुधिताया ममेप्सितः
भक्षः प्रीणय मे देहं चिरमाहारवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration:
kvāsi gantā mahākāya kṣudhitāyā mamepsitaḥ
bhakṣaḥ prīṇaya me dehaṁ ciramāhāravarjitam

translations.english: Whither are you bound, O you of a gigantic body? Desired by me, who am hungry, do you becoming my food, gratify this body deprived of diet for a long time.

verses.sanskrit:
बाढमित्येव तां वाणीं प्रत्यगृह्णामहं ततः
आस्य प्रमाणादधिकं तस्याः कायमपूरयम्
verses.transliteration:
bāḍhamityeva tāṁ vāṇīṁ pratyagṛhṇāmahaṁ tataḥ
āsya pramāṇādadhikaṁ tasyāḥ kāyamapūrayam

translations.english: Saying, Well,' I accepted her speech, increasing my body at will more than the capacity or her mouth;

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याश्चास्यं महद्भीमं वर्धते मम भक्षणे
न च मां सा तु बुबुधे मम वा विकृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāścāsyaṁ mahadbhīmaṁ vardhate mama bhakṣaṇe
na ca māṁ sā tu bubudhe mama vā vikṛtaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: And her huge and dreadful mouth extended wide to eat me up. She did not understand me, (Understand that I was able to assume any shape at pleasure) nor that I had altered my shape.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽहं विपुलं रूपं संक्षिप्य निमिषान्तरात्
तस्या हृदयमादाय प्रपतामि नभस्तलम्
verses.transliteration:
tato'haṁ vipulaṁ rūpaṁ saṁkṣipya nimiṣāntarāt
tasyā hṛdayamādāya prapatāmi nabhastalam

translations.english: Then in the twinkling of an eye contracting my vasty shape, I, extracting her heart, darted into the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
सा विसृष्टभुजा भीमा पपात लवणाम्भसि
मया पर्वतसंकाशा निकृत्तहृदया सती
verses.transliteration:
sā visṛṣṭabhujā bhīmā papāta lavaṇāmbhasi
mayā parvatasaṁkāśā nikṛttahṛdayā satī

translations.english: Thereat, throwing about her arms, that terrific one dropped into the salt waters. On that chaste one, resembling a hill, having her heart torn, I heard the meet speech of magnanimous persons, who had come there of themselves, 'This dreadful Rākşasi, Sinhikā, has been swiftly slain by Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन्
गत्वा च महदध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम्
दक्षिणं तीरमुदधेर्लङ्का यत्र च सा पुरी
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ hatvā punarevāhaṁ kṛtyamātyayikaṁ smaran
gatvā ca mahadadhvānaṁ paśyāmi nagamaṇḍitam
dakṣiṇaṁ tīramudadherlaṅkā yatra ca sā purī

translations.english: Having slain her, I again remembering the delay that had occurred touching my work, set out on the great road, and at length saw the southern shore of the sea, covered with mountains, where is situated the city of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्तं दिनकरे याते रक्षसां निलयं पुरीम्
प्रविष्टोऽहमविज्ञातो रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः
verses.transliteration:
astaṁ dinakare yāte rakṣasāṁ nilayaṁ purīm
praviṣṭo'hamavijñāto rakṣobhirbhīmavikramaiḥ

translations.english: On the sun having set, I entered the city of the Raksasas-their home-unnoticed by the Rākṣasas of terrific vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सीतामपश्यंस्तु रावणस्य निवेशने
शोकसागरमासाद्य न पारमुपलक्षये
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sītāmapaśyaṁstu rāvaṇasya niveśane
śokasāgaramāsādya na pāramupalakṣaye

translations.english: There I wandered all the night (seeking for Janaka's daughter) and (at length) entered Rāvana's inner apartment; but that one of a Deity waist I found not. And not finding Sītā in Ravana's abode, I was cast in a sea of sorrow; nor found I how to cross over it.

verses.sanskrit:
शोचता च मया दृष्टं प्राकारेण समावृतम्
काञ्चनेन विकृष्टेन गृहोपवनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
śocatā ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ prākāreṇa samāvṛtam
kāñcanena vikṛṣṭena gṛhopavanamuttamam

translations.english: As I was sorrowing, I saw as mansion with a charming grove encircled by a wall of excellent gold.

verses.sanskrit: स प्राकारमवप्लुत्य पश्यामि बहुपादपम्
verses.transliteration: sa prākāramavaplutya paśyāmi bahupādapam

translations.english: And leaping over the wall, I saw a grove rife with trees; and (at last) saw in the midst of an aśoka wood a great ſinsapā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हलहलाशब्दं काञ्चीनूपुरमिश्रितम्
शृणोम्यधिकगम्भीरं रावणस्य निवेशने
verses.transliteration:
tato halahalāśabdaṁ kāñcīnūpuramiśritam
śṛṇomyadhikagambhīraṁ rāvaṇasya niveśane

translations.english: Seeing that lady the illustrious wife of Rāma in that condition, I seeing her remained even on that Sinsapa tree. Then I heard in Ravana's mansion loud and solemn sounds mixed with the tinklings of zones and bangles.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽहं परमोद्विग्नः स्वरूपं प्रत्यसंहरम्
अहं च शिंशपावृक्षे पक्षीव गहने स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tato'haṁ paramodvignaḥ svarūpaṁ pratyasaṁharam
ahaṁ ca śiṁśapāvṛkṣe pakṣīva gahane sthitaḥ

translations.english: Thereat exceedingly agitated, I changed my proper shape; and remained like a bird in a dark part of the Sinsapā tree.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रावणदाराश्च रावणश्च महाबलः
तं देशं समनुप्राप्ता यत्र सीताभवत्स्थिता
verses.transliteration:
tato rāvaṇadārāśca rāvaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
taṁ deśaṁ samanuprāptā yatra sītābhavatsthitā

translations.english: Then the wives of Rāvana along with Rāvana himself of exceeding strength came to that place where Sītā was.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वाथ वरारोहा सीता रक्षोगणेश्वरम्
संकुच्योरू स्तनौ पीनौ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvātha varārohā sītā rakṣogaṇeśvaram
saṁkucyorū stanau pīnau bāhubhyāṁ parirabhya ca

translations.english: And seeing the lord of Rākşasas the exceedingly beauteous Sītā contracted her thighs and covered her full breasts with her arms.

verses.sanskrit:
तामुवाच दशग्रीवः सीतां परमदुःखिताम्
अवाक्शिराः प्रपतितो बहु मन्यस्व मामिति
verses.transliteration:
tāmuvāca daśagrīvaḥ sītāṁ paramaduḥkhitām
avākśirāḥ prapatito bahu manyasva māmiti

translations.english: Seeing Sītā flurried and extremely excited and casting about her gladness up and down, not finding any relief and trembling forlorn, the Tennecked one said to her undergoing extreme anguish, “Without saying anything, I fall down (here). O fair one, do you regard me.”

verses.sanskrit:
यदि चेत्त्वं तु मां दर्पान्नाभिनन्दसि गर्विते
द्विमासानन्तरं सीते पास्यामि रुधिरं तव
verses.transliteration:
yadi cettvaṁ tu māṁ darpānnābhinandasi garvite
dvimāsānantaraṁ sīte pāsyāmi rudhiraṁ tava

translations.english: If, O haughty one, you do not honour me from pride of heart, I shall, O Sītā, two months hence, see your blood.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
उवाच परमक्रुद्धा सीता वचनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā vacastasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
uvāca paramakruddhā sītā vacanamuttamam

translations.english: Hearing these words of the wicked Rāvana, Sītā, growing exceeding wroth, spoke these excellent words.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः
इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च
अवाच्यं वदतो जिह्वा कथं न पतिता तव
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryāmamitatejasaḥ
ikṣvākukulanāthasya snuṣāṁ daśarathasya ca
avācyaṁ vadato jihvā kathaṁ na patitā tava

translations.english: O worst of Rākşasas, having used improper speech towards the wife of Rāma of measureless prowess, and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, lord of the Ikşvāku line, why had you not your tongue fallen off?

verses.sanskrit:
किंस्विद्वीर्यं तवानार्य यो मां भर्तुरसंनिधौ
अपहृत्यागतः पाप तेनादृष्टो महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
kiṁsvidvīryaṁ tavānārya yo māṁ bharturasaṁnidhau
apahṛtyāgataḥ pāpa tenādṛṣṭo mahātmanā

translations.english: Fie upon the prowess of you that, O wretch, had carried me off while my husband was away; and not being seen of that high-souled one.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वं रामस्य सदृशो दास्येऽप्यस्या न युज्यसे
यज्ञीयः सत्यवाक्चैव रणश्लाघी च राघवः
verses.transliteration:
na tvaṁ rāmasya sadṛśo dāsye'pyasyā na yujyase
yajñīyaḥ satyavākcaiva raṇaślāghī ca rāghavaḥ

translations.english: You are never like Rama, you are not even fit to be his slave. Rāghava is invincible, truthful, heroic and (even) hungering for warfare.

verses.sanskrit:
उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदनार्दितः
सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रम
मया सह रमस्वाद्य मद्विशिष्टा न जानकी
verses.transliteration:
uktaśca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ tayā sa madanārditaḥ
sītayā tava kiṁ kāryaṁ mahendrasamavikrama
mayā saha ramasvādya madviśiṣṭā na jānakī

translations.english: O you that resemblest Indra the Great in prowess. Do you to-day sport with me. Janaki is not superior to me.

verses.sanskrit:
देवगन्धर्वकन्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च
सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेह सीतया किं करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
devagandharvakanyābhiryakṣakanyābhireva ca
sārdhaṁ prabho ramasveha sītayā kiṁ kariṣyasi

translations.english: And, O lord, do you sport with the daughters of celestials and Gandharvas, and with the daughters themselves of Yakşas. What will you do with Sītā?

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ताभिः समेताभिर्नारीभिः स महाबलः
उत्थाप्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
tatastābhiḥ sametābhirnārībhiḥ sa mahābalaḥ
utthāpya sahasā nīto bhavanaṁ svaṁ niśācaraḥ

translations.english: Then that exceedingly powerful ranger of the night was speedily raised up and taken (back) to his residence.

verses.sanskrit:
याते तस्मिन्दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः
सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सुदारुणैः
verses.transliteration:
yāte tasmindaśagrīve rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ
sītāṁ nirbhartsayāmāsurvākyaiḥ krūraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ

translations.english: On the Ten-necked one having departed, the Rákşasis of fearful faces fell to railing at Sītā in cruel and rough words.

verses.sanskrit:
तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी
तर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम्
verses.transliteration:
tṛṇavadbhāṣitaṁ tāsāṁ gaṇayāmāsa jānakī
tarjitaṁ ca tadā tāsāṁ sītāṁ prāpya nirarthakam

translations.english: But Jänakī heeded their speech as a straw; and their fury was lost upon Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
वृथागर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः
रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताव्यवसितं महत्
verses.transliteration:
vṛthāgarjitaniśceṣṭā rākṣasyaḥ piśitāśanāḥ
rāvaṇāya śaśaṁsustāḥ sītāvyavasitaṁ mahat

translations.english: Desisting from their unavailing railing, the flesh-feasting Rākṣasi imparted to Rivaņa the mighty intent of Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ताः सहिताः सर्वा विहताशा निरुद्यमाः
परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः
verses.transliteration:
tatastāḥ sahitāḥ sarvā vihatāśā nirudyamāḥ
parikṣipya samantāttāṁ nidrāvaśamupāgatāḥ

translations.english: Then, they all failing in their hope and deprived of energy, and tired, caine under the sway of sleep.

verses.sanskrit:
तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता
विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता
verses.transliteration:
tāsu caiva prasuptāsu sītā bhartṛhite ratā
vilapya karuṇaṁ dīnā praśuśoca suduḥkhitā

translations.english: And on their sleeping, Sītā intent on the welfare of her lord, lamenting piteously, in forlorn guise, and stricken with extreme sorrow, mourned profusely.

verses.sanskrit:
तां चाहं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा सीताया दारुणां दशाम्
चिन्तयामास विश्रान्तो न च मे निर्वृतं मनः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ cāhaṁ tādṛśīṁ dṛṣṭvā sītāyā dāruṇāṁ daśām
cintayāmāsa viśrānto na ca me nirvṛtaṁ manaḥ

translations.english: Witnessing such a hard condition of Sītā I began to reflect; nor did my mind attain ease or freedom from thought. And I cast about for finding means of addressing Jānaki.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम्
प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu gaditāṁ vācaṁ rājarṣigaṇapūjitām
pratyabhāṣata māṁ devī bāṣpaiḥ pihitalocanā

translations.english: I began by extolling the Ikşvāku race. Hearing the words that I uttered, embellished with descriptions of the virtues of Rajarşis, that exalted lady replied with her eyes covered with tears.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुंगव
का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
kastvaṁ kena kathaṁ ceha prāpto vānarapuṁgava
kā ca rāmeṇa te prītistanme śaṁsitumarhasi

translations.english: Who are you? And how had you, O foremost of monkeys, found they way here? And what is your delight in Rāma? This it behove you to relate to me.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अहमप्यब्रुवं वचः
देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः
सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्दो महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā ahamapyabruvaṁ vacaḥ
devi rāmasya bhartuste sahāyo bhīmavikramaḥ
sugrīvo nāma vikrānto vānarendo mahābalaḥ

translations.english: Hearing her speech, I too said, O revered one, your husband, Rāma, has found a helpmate in a one endowed with terrific strength, named Sugrīva— redoubtable, the highly powerful lord of the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मां विद्धि भृत्यं त्वं हनूमन्तमिहागतम्
भर्त्राहं प्रहितस्तुभ्यं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
tasya māṁ viddhi bhṛtyaṁ tvaṁ hanūmantamihāgatam
bhartrāhaṁ prahitastubhyaṁ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā

translations.english: Do you know me as Hanumăn his servant despatched here by your spouse-Räma of unwearied actions.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं च पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रीमान्दाशरथिः स्वयम्
अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानमदात्तुभ्यं यशस्विनि
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ ca puruṣavyāghraḥ śrīmāndāśarathiḥ svayam
aṅgulīyamabhijñānamadāttubhyaṁ yaśasvini

translations.english: O famed damsel, that highly effulgent son of Dasaratha-the foremost of men, has sent as a token this ring.

verses.sanskrit:
तदिच्छामि त्वयाज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम्
रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्वं नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
tadicchāmi tvayājñaptaṁ devi kiṁ karavāṇyaham
rāmalakṣmaṇayoḥ pārśvaṁ nayāmi tvāṁ kimuttaram

translations.english: I desire to know, O worshipful dame, what behest of yours may I obey now. Shall I carry you to Rāma and Lakşmaņa on the northern shore of the Ocean?”

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी
आह रावणमुत्साद्य राघवो मां नयत्विति
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā viditvā ca sītā janakanandinī
āha rāvaṇamutsādya rāghavo māṁ nayatviti

translations.english: Hearing this and revolving within herself Sītā, Janaka's daughter, replied.-Discomfiting Rāvaņa, may Rāghava himself carry me hence,' And bowing my head to that worshipful and blameless dame, I wanted of her a token as might conduce to Rāghava's pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमुत्तमम्
प्रायच्छत्परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां संदिदेश ह
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā varārohā maṇipravaramuttamam
prāyacchatparamodvignā vācā māṁ saṁdideśa ha

translations.english: Having said this, that best of fair ones gave me the excellent jewel, and wrought up with anxiety, related to me the story of crow (for Rāma's information).

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्यै प्रणम्याहं राजपुत्र्यै समाहितः
प्रदक्षिणं परिक्राममिहाभ्युद्गतमानसः
verses.transliteration:
tatastasyai praṇamyāhaṁ rājaputryai samāhitaḥ
pradakṣiṇaṁ parikrāmamihābhyudgatamānasaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon bent on returning here I, with a fixed mind, circumambulated and bowed to that worshipful dame.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा श्रुत्वैव नचिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
yathā śrutvaiva nacirāttāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau
sugrīvasahitau vīrāvupeyātāṁ tathā kuru

translations.english: And revolving within herself she again replied 'Hanumān, do you relate this to Rāghava in such a wise that the heroes Rāma and Lakşmaņa, along with Sugrīva might instantly come here.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यन्यथा भवेदेतद्द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम
न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये साहमनाथवत्
verses.transliteration:
yadyanyathā bhavedetaddvau māsau jīvitaṁ mama
na māṁ drakṣyati kākutstho mriye sāhamanāthavat

translations.english: Or else there remain two months more of my me. Rāghava shall not see me and I shall quit my life like one having no husband.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं क्रोधो मामभ्यवर्तत
उत्तरं च मया दृष्टं कार्यशेषमनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā karuṇaṁ vākyaṁ krodho māmabhyavartata
uttaraṁ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ kāryaśeṣamanantaram

translations.english: Hearing those piteous accents I was worked up with ire and at once resolved upon destroying the city of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसंनिभः
युद्धकाङ्क्षी वनं तच्च विनाशयितुमारभे
verses.transliteration:
tato'vardhata me kāyastadā parvatasaṁnibhaḥ
yuddhakāṅkṣī vanaṁ tacca vināśayitumārabhe

translations.english: Thereupon my body increased like to a mountain and desirous of entering into conflict I began to lay waste the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्भग्नं वनषण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम्
प्रतिबुद्धा निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः
verses.transliteration:
tadbhagnaṁ vanaṣaṇḍaṁ tu bhrāntatrastamṛgadvijam
pratibuddhā nirīkṣante rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ

translations.english: The whole forest was devastated the birds and deer strayed away in fear and the Rākşasīs, having terrible faces, awaking, beheld all that.

verses.sanskrit:
मां च दृष्ट्वा वने तस्मिन्समागम्य ततस्ततः
ताः समभ्यागताः क्षिप्रं रावणायाचचक्षिरे
verses.transliteration:
māṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vane tasminsamāgamya tatastataḥ
tāḥ samabhyāgatāḥ kṣipraṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire

translations.english: And beholding me in the forest, they all, gathering, instantly conveyed the message to Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
राजन्वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना
वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल
verses.transliteration:
rājanvanamidaṁ durgaṁ tava bhagnaṁ durātmanā
vānareṇa hyavijñāya tava vīryaṁ mahābala

translations.english: O king, O you of mighty prowess, this your forest and castle has been broken down by the vicious-souled monkey not knowing your strength.

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः
वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथासौ विलयं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration:
durbuddhestasya rājendra tava vipriyakāriṇaḥ
vadhamājñāpaya kṣipraṁ yathāsau vilayaṁ vrajet

translations.english: O king, he has been impelled by his vicious sense, to do they mischief. Do you order for his head so that he might not return.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा भृशदुर्जयाः
राक्षसाः किंकरा नाम रावणस्य मनोऽनुगाः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā rākṣasendreṇa visṛṣṭā bhṛśadurjayāḥ
rākṣasāḥ kiṁkarā nāma rāvaṇasya mano'nugāḥ

translations.english: Hearing this the lord of the Rākşasas despatched a chosen band of demons named Kinkaras. (Literally it means servants—hero it means his own personal attendants who were brave and heroic.)

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम्
मया तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे परिघेण निषूदितम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmaśītisāhasraṁ śūlamudgarapāṇinām
mayā tasminvanoddeśe parigheṇa niṣūditam

translations.english: I despatched with my inace in no time eighty thousand of them no sooner than they entered the forest with darts and maces.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गता लघुविक्रमाः
निहतं च मया सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tu hataśeṣā ye te gatā laghuvikramāḥ
nihataṁ ca mayā sainyaṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire

translations.english: And the few, who were saved, proceeded very quickly to Rāvana and related to him the destruction of the soldiers by me.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रस्थान्राक्षसान्हत्वा शतं स्तम्भेन वै पुनः
ललाम भूतो लङ्काया मया विध्वंसितो रुषा
verses.transliteration:
tatrasthānrākṣasānhatvā śataṁ stambhena vai punaḥ
lalāma bhūto laṅkāyā mayā vidhvaṁsito ruṣā

translations.english: Thereupon I thought of destroying the Caitya (A place of sacrifice or religious worship) palace and destroyed with the pillar, all the Rākşasas stationed there. Excited with wrath I destroyed that palace the best in the whole city of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहस्तस्य सुतं जम्बुमालिनमादिशत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṁ jambumālinamādiśat

translations.english: Thereupon (Rāvana) despatched Jambumāli, the son of Prahasta.

verses.sanskrit:
तमहं बलसंपन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम्
परिघेणातिघोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम्
verses.transliteration:
tamahaṁ balasaṁpannaṁ rākṣasaṁ raṇakovidam
parigheṇātighoreṇa sūdayāmi sahānugam

translations.english: With my fierce mace I destroyed that mighty Rākşasa, versed in the art of war, along with his retinue and surrounded by a band of terrible and grim-visaged demons.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रिपुत्रान्महाबलान्
पदातिबलसंपन्नान्प्रेषयामास रावणः
परिघेणैव तान्सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā rākṣasendrastu mantriputrānmahābalān
padātibalasaṁpannānpreṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ
parigheṇaiva tānsarvānnayāmi yamasādanam

translations.english: Hearing this, Ravana, the lord of Raksasas sent the highly powerful sons of the ministers followed by a regiment of infantry. But I despatched them to the abode of Death by means of my dart.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रिपुत्रान्हताञ्श्रुत्वा समरे लघुविक्रमान्
पञ्चसेनाग्रगाञ्शूरान्प्रेषयामास रावणः
तानहं सह सैन्यान्वै सर्वानेवाभ्यसूदयम्
verses.transliteration:
mantriputrānhatāñśrutvā samare laghuvikramān
pañcasenāgragāñśūrānpreṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ
tānahaṁ saha sainyānvai sarvānevābhyasūdayam

translations.english: Hearing of the destruction in battle of the ministers' sons of feeble prowess Rāvana sent five heroic commanders,

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पुनर्दशग्रीवः पुत्रमक्षं महाबलम्
बहुभी राकसैः सार्धं प्रेषयामास संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ punardaśagrīvaḥ putramakṣaṁ mahābalam
bahubhī rākasaiḥ sārdhaṁ preṣayāmāsa saṁyuge

translations.english: But I slew all of them along with their hosts. Thereupon the Ten necked demon sent his highly powerful son Aksa in the battle followed by a number of Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु मन्दोदरी पुत्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्
सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्
चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu mandodarī putraṁ kumāraṁ raṇapaṇḍitam
sahasā khaṁ samutkrāntaṁ pādayośca gṛhītavān
carmāsinaṁ śataguṇaṁ bhrāmayitvā vyapeṣayam

translations.english: No sooner the princely son of Mandodarī, versed in the art of war, rose high up in the welkin than I got hold of his legs and whirling him for hundred times ground him to the dust.

verses.sanskrit:
तमक्षमागतं भग्नं निशम्य स दशाननः
तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणः सुतम्
व्यादिदेश सुसंक्रुद्धो बलिनं युद्धदुर्मदम्
verses.transliteration:
tamakṣamāgataṁ bhagnaṁ niśamya sa daśānanaḥ
tata indrajitaṁ nāma dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaḥ sutam
vyādideśa susaṁkruddho balinaṁ yuddhadurmadam

translations.english: Hearing of the discomfiture of Aksa, Ravana, exercised with ire sent his second son, the highly a rope and powerful Indrajit incapable of being repressed in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याप्यहं बलं सर्वं तं च राक्षसपुंगवम्
नष्टौजसं रणे कृत्वा परं हर्षमुपागमम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāpyahaṁ balaṁ sarvaṁ taṁ ca rākṣasapuṁgavam
naṣṭaujasaṁ raṇe kṛtvā paraṁ harṣamupāgamam

translations.english: And discomfiting that best of Rākşasas, with his host I attained to an excess of delight.

verses.sanskrit:
महता हि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः
प्रेषितो रावणेनैष सह वीरैर्मदोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration:
mahatā hi mahābāhuḥ pratyayena mahābalaḥ
preṣito rāvaṇenaiṣa saha vīrairmadotkaṭaiḥ

translations.english: That hero of great prowess and mighty-arms with a number of other proud heroes was despatched by Rāvana in great confidence.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण स तु मां प्रबध्नाच्चातिवेगतः
रज्जूभिरभिबध्नन्ति ततो मां तत्र राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṁ prabadhnāccātivegataḥ
rajjūbhirabhibadhnanti tato māṁ tatra rākṣasāḥ

translations.english: Beholding my unbearable prowess and his own soldiers slain, speedily he went away fettering me with his Brahma weapon. Thereat the other Rākşasas bound me up with carried me to Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य समीपं च गृहीत्वा मामुपानयन्
दृष्ट्वा संभाषितश्चाहं रावणेन दुरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya samīpaṁ ca gṛhītvā māmupānayan
dṛṣṭvā saṁbhāṣitaścāhaṁ rāvaṇena durātmanā

translations.english: Thereupon I was welcomed by the vicioussouled Rāvana and was asked why I did come to Lankă and slay the Rākşasas. Whereto I replied, "I have done all this for Sītā."

verses.sanskrit:
अस्याहं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो
मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्
verses.transliteration:
asyāhaṁ darśanākāṅkṣī prāptastvadbhavanaṁ vibho
mārutasyaurasaḥ putro vānaro hanumānaham

translations.english: To behold her I have come here, O hero. I am the monkey Hanumān, the own begotten son of Māruta. Do you know me as Rāma's ambassador and the minister of Sugrīva. And on Rāma's embassy have I come here before you.

verses.sanskrit:
शृणु चापि समादेशं यदहं प्रब्रवीमि ते
राक्षसेश हरीशस्त्वां वाक्यमाह समाहितम्
धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमिवाशनम्
verses.transliteration:
śṛṇu cāpi samādeśaṁ yadahaṁ prabravīmi te
rākṣaseśa harīśastvāṁ vākyamāha samāhitam
dharmārthakāmasahitaṁ hitaṁ pathyamivāśanam

translations.english: Do you hear of my mission-I do relate to you, O lord of Räkşasas, the message which the monkey chief has commanded me to communicate to you.

verses.sanskrit:
वसतो ऋष्यमूके मे पर्वते विपुलद्रुमे
राघवो रणविक्रान्तो मित्रत्वं समुपागतः
verses.transliteration:
vasato ṛṣyamūke me parvate vipuladrume
rāghavo raṇavikrānto mitratvaṁ samupāgataḥ

translations.english: While I lived on the mount Rşyamūka covered with huge trees I made friends with Rāghava dreadful in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन मे कथितं राजन्भार्या मे रक्षसा हृता
तत्र साहाय्यहेतोर्मे समयं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tena me kathitaṁ rājanbhāryā me rakṣasā hṛtā
tatra sāhāyyahetorme samayaṁ kartumarhasi

translations.english: He has spoken to me, O king, ‘My spouse has been taken away by a Rākşasa. It behove you to promise me your help in this.'

verses.sanskrit:
वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण सह प्रभुः
चक्रेऽग्निसाक्षिकं सक्यं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
vālinā hṛtarājyena sugrīveṇa saha prabhuḥ
cakre'gnisākṣikaṁ sakyaṁ rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: And in the presence of fire, Rāma, along wi Lakşmaņa, contracted friendship with me who had been deprived of his kingdom by Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन वालिनमुत्साद्य शरेणैकेन संयुगे
वानराणां महाराजः कृतः संप्लवतां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
tena vālinamutsādya śareṇaikena saṁyuge
vānarāṇāṁ mahārājaḥ kṛtaḥ saṁplavatāṁ prabhuḥ

translations.english: And he has made me lord over all the monkeys after slaying Vāli in conflict with a single shaft.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य साहाय्यमस्माभिः कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्विह
तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः
verses.transliteration:
tasya sāhāyyamasmābhiḥ kāryaṁ sarvātmanā tviha
tena prasthāpitastubhyaṁ samīpamiha dharmataḥ

translations.english: It therefore behove us to assist him by all means. And by virtue of this contract I have despatched Hanumān to you as an envoy.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमानीयतां सीता दीयतां राघवस्य च
यावन्न हरयो वीरा विधमन्ति बलं तव
verses.transliteration:
kṣipramānīyatāṁ sītā dīyatāṁ rāghavasya ca
yāvanna harayo vīrā vidhamanti balaṁ tava

translations.english: Do you therefore speedily bring back Sīta and return her to Rāghava before the heroic monkeys discomfit you.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणां प्रभवो हि न केन विदितः पुरा
देवतानां सकाशं च ये गच्छन्ति निमन्त्रिताः
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāṁ prabhavo hi na kena viditaḥ purā
devatānāṁ sakāśaṁ ca ye gacchanti nimantritāḥ

translations.english: Who know not the prowess of the monkeys who in the days of yore used to visit the celestials invited?

verses.sanskrit:
इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया
मामैक्षत ततो रुष्टश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव
verses.transliteration:
iti vānararājastvāmāhetyabhihito mayā
māmaikṣata tato ruṣṭaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva

translations.english: With these words the king of the monkeys has despatched me to you. And thereupon he eyed me as if burning me with the looks of his angry eyes.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वध्योऽहमाज्ञप्तो रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: tena vadhyo'hamājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā

translations.english: And the vicious-souled demon-Rāvana, of terrible deeds, ordered for my destruction, not knowing my prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विभीषणो नाम तस्य भ्राता महामतिः
तेन राक्षसराजोऽसौ याचितो मम कारणात्
verses.transliteration:
tato vibhīṣaṇo nāma tasya bhrātā mahāmatiḥ
tena rākṣasarājo'sau yācito mama kāraṇāt

translations.english: thereupon Vibhīşaņa, the high-souled brother of that lord of the Räkşasas interceded on my behalf in the following strain

verses.sanskrit:
दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस
दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथार्थं हितवादिना
verses.transliteration:
dūtavadhyā na dṛṣṭā hi rājaśāstreṣu rākṣasa
dūtena veditavyaṁ ca yathārthaṁ hitavādinā

translations.english: The destruction of an envoy is not sanctioned by the royal morality, O Raksasa. They communicate simply the mandate of their masters.

verses.sanskrit:
सुमहत्यपराधेऽपि दूतस्यातुलविक्रमः
विरूपकरणं दृष्टं न वधोऽस्तीह शास्त्रतः
verses.transliteration:
sumahatyaparādhe'pi dūtasyātulavikramaḥ
virūpakaraṇaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ na vadho'stīha śāstrataḥ

translations.english: O you of incomparable prowess, there is no sanction for the destruction of a messenger albeit he prepare a mighty iniquity Sometimes they have however been disfigured.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणेनैवमुक्तो रावणः संदिदेश तान्
राक्षसानेतदेवाद्य लाङ्गूलं दह्यतामिति
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇenaivamukto rāvaṇaḥ saṁdideśa tān
rākṣasānetadevādya lāṅgūlaṁ dahyatāmiti

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Vibhīșana, Rāvana ordered all the demons, saying "Burn down this monkey's tail.”

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसाः सिद्धसंनाहास्ततस्ते चण्डविक्रमाः
तदादीप्यन्त मे पुच्छं हनन्तः काष्ठमुष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasāḥ siddhasaṁnāhāstataste caṇḍavikramāḥ
tadādīpyanta me pucchaṁ hanantaḥ kāṣṭhamuṣṭibhiḥ

translations.english: Hearing his mandate, the Raksasas, of wellprotected armour and terrible prowess, enveloped my tail with the fibres of cotton, silk and jute. And then striking me with their clenched fists they put fire to my tail.

verses.sanskrit:
बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः
न मे पीडा भवेत्काचिद्दिदृक्षोर्नगरीं दिवा
verses.transliteration:
baddhasya bahubhiḥ pāśairyantritasya ca rākṣasaiḥ
na me pīḍā bhavetkāciddidṛkṣornagarīṁ divā

translations.english: Although bound and fettered with many ropes I did not feel the least anguish for I was very much anxious to behold the city during the day.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते राक्षसाः शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम्
अघोषयन्राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः
verses.transliteration:
tataste rākṣasāḥ śūrā baddhaṁ māmagnisaṁvṛtam
aghoṣayanrājamārge nagaradvāramāgatāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon fettering me and putting fire to my tail and announcing me in the public streets those heroic Rākșasas got at the city gate.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः
विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिष्ठः स्थितः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
tato'haṁ sumahadrūpaṁ saṁkṣipya punarātmanaḥ
vimocayitvā taṁ bandhaṁ prakṛtiṣṭhaḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon contracting again my huge person and relieving myself of the fetters I stood again in my pristine state.

verses.sanskrit:
पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम्
दहाम्यहमसंभ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः
verses.transliteration:
pucchena ca pradīptena tāṁ purīṁ sāṭṭagopurām
dahāmyahamasaṁbhrānto yugāntāgniriva prajāḥ

translations.english: Taking up iron darts I slew all the Rāks asas there. And leaping over with great velocity the city gate, I, with my burning tail, burnt down the whole city from the palace to its outer gate like to the fire of dissolution devastating the entire creation.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्
जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
athāhaṁ vācamaśrauṣaṁ cāraṇānāṁ śubhākṣarām
jānakī na ca dagdheti vismayodantabhāṣiṇām

translations.english: While I reflecting thus, being overwhelmed with grief, I heard the auspicious was accents of the Caranas, exciting my wonder, Jänaki has not been burnt down.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य प्रभावेन भवतां चैव तेजसा
सुग्रीवस्य च कार्यार्थं मया सर्वमनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya prabhāvena bhavatāṁ caiva tejasā
sugrīvasya ca kāryārthaṁ mayā sarvamanuṣṭhitam

translations.english: By virtue of Rāma's grace and your prowess I have satisfied the charge of Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्सर्वं मया तत्र यथावदुपपादितम्
अत्र यन्न कृतं शेषं तत्सर्वं क्रियतामिति
verses.transliteration:
etatsarvaṁ mayā tatra yathāvadupapāditam
atra yanna kṛtaṁ śeṣaṁ tatsarvaṁ kriyatāmiti

translations.english: I have thus related to you, what I had performed in Lankā, and it now remains with you to fulfill the rest.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदाख्यानं तत्सर्वं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
भूयः समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
etadākhyānaṁ tatsarvaṁ hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
bhūyaḥ samupacakrāma vacanaṁ vaktumuttaram

translations.english: Having related all, Hanuman, the wind-god's son began again, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सफलो राघवोद्योगः सुग्रीवस्य च संभ्रमः
शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्लवनं महत्
verses.transliteration:
saphalo rāghavodyogaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṁbhramaḥ
śīlamāsādya sītāyā mama ca plavanaṁ mahat

translations.english: Fruitful is Rāghava's endeavour and Sugrīva's energy, for greatly pleased have I been with Sita's conduct.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्यायाः सदृशं शीलं सीतायाः प्लवगर्षभाः
तपसा धारयेल्लोकान्क्रुद्धा वा निर्दहेदपि
verses.transliteration:
āryāyāḥ sadṛśaṁ śīlaṁ sītāyāḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ
tapasā dhārayellokānkruddhā vā nirdahedapi

translations.english: O heroic monkeys, Sītā has been keeping the life of a highly chaste damsel. She can maintain the animated creation by virtue of her asceticism and burn it with her ire.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथातिप्रवृद्धोऽसौ रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
यस्य तां स्पृशतो गात्रं तपसा न विनाशितम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvathātipravṛddho'sau rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
yasya tāṁ spṛśato gātraṁ tapasā na vināśitam

translations.english: Rāvana, the lord of the Rākşasas is also highly advanced in asceticism by virtue whereof he has not been ruined albeit he has touched Sītā's person.

verses.sanskrit:
न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात्संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती
जनकस्यात्मजा कुर्यादुत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता
verses.transliteration:
na tadagniśikhā kuryātsaṁspṛṣṭā pāṇinā satī
janakasyātmajā kuryādutkrodhakaluṣīkṛtā

translations.english: Even the flame of fire cannot do, although touched by the hands, what Janaka's daughter can bring about by her ire.

verses.sanskrit:
अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
अधस्ताच्छिंशपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता
verses.transliteration:
aśokavanikāmadhye rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
adhastācchiṁśapāvṛkṣe sādhvī karuṇamāsthitā

translations.english: (And I beheld there) in the Asoka forest of the vicious-souled Rāvana, at the foot of a ſingśapā tree, the chaste Sītā waiting very poorly.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसंतापकर्शिता
मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasībhiḥ parivṛtā śokasaṁtāpakarśitā
meghalekhāparivṛtā candralekheva niṣprabhā

translations.english: She was encircled by the Rākṣasīs, worn out with grief and anxiety and was like to the rays of the Moon shorn of their brilliance being enveloped with clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम्
पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी
verses.transliteration:
acintayantī vaidehī rāvaṇaṁ baladarpitam
pativratā ca suśroṇī avaṣṭabdhā ca jānakī

translations.english: And Vaidehi, having a beautiful waist and devoted to her husband, did not care for Rāvana proud of his prowess and was accordingly confined by him.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा
अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरंदरे
verses.transliteration:
anuraktā hi vaidehī rāmaṁ sarvātmanā śubhā
ananyacittā rāme ca paulomīva puraṁdare

translations.english: And that graceful daughter of the king of Vaidehī was by all means devoted to her lord and had all her thoughts centred in him like to Paulomi (The wife of Indra the lord of the celestials who was confined by the king Nahușa) devoted to her lord Purandara.

verses.sanskrit:
सा मया राक्षसी मध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः
राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदा वने
verses.transliteration:
sā mayā rākṣasī madhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ
rākṣasībhirvirūpābhirdṛṣṭā hi pramadā vane

translations.english: And I saw her in that garden, wearing a single piece of cloth soiled with dirt, surrounded by the Rākşasīs and remonstrated with now and then by those ugly demons. Having a single braid of hair, poorly, engaged in thoughts touching her lord, she was lying on the earth shorn of all grace like to a lotus on the appearance of the winter. She had not the least attachment for Rāvana and was resolved upon putting an end to her existence.

verses.sanskrit:
एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा
अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे
verses.transliteration:
ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā
adhaḥśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame

translations.english: I managed too swiftly to present myself before that one, menaced momentarily in the midst of the Raksasi, wearing a single braid of hair; woebegone, ever thinking of her lord; her limbs discoloured by lying down on the ground, like to a lotus on the approach of winter, having eyes resembling those of a young deer, who had turned her face away from all the enjoyments offered by Rāvaņa, and who had resolved to put a period to her existence.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं स महात्मा दशाननः
निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yanna hanti daśagrīvaṁ sa mahātmā daśānanaḥ
nimittamātraṁ rāmastu vadhe tasya bhaviṣyati

translations.english: And hearing of the friendship between Rāma and Sugrīva she attained to an excess of delight. She is well behaved and devoted to her lord per excellence and blessed is the high-souled and ten-necked demon that she has not destroyed him (yet). And Rama shall become an instrument only in in bringing about his destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा
यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपाद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
evamāste mahābhāgā sītā śokaparāyaṇā
yadatra pratikartavyaṁ tatsarvamupapādyatām

translations.english: Thus live there the great Sītă worn out with grief. Do you now perform what you think proper.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत
जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान्सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाकपीन्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vālisūnurabhāṣata
jāmbavatpramukhānsarvānanujñāpya mahākapīn

translations.english: Hearing his words, Vali's son Angada spoke, saying, “These two monkeys, the sons of Aśvi, are very powerful and gifted with great velocity and are specially proud in consequence of the boon cornered on them by the Great Grandfather."

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते
न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ
verses.transliteration:
asminnevaṁgate kārye bhavatāṁ ca nivedite
nyāyyaṁ sma saha vaidehyā draṣṭuṁ tau pārthivātmajau

translations.english: I have related to you what had happened. It now behove us to behold Vaidehi along with those two sons of a king, after commanding all the monkeys headed by Jambavan and others.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेकोऽपि पर्याप्तः सराक्षसगणां पुरीम्
तां लङ्कां तरसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
ahameko'pi paryāptaḥ sarākṣasagaṇāṁ purīm
tāṁ laṅkāṁ tarasā hantuṁ rāvaṇaṁ ca mahābalam

translations.english: I am alone capable of destroying the city of Lankā along with the Rākşasas and their lord Rāvana. What more can I achieve if I am accompanied by the heroic monkeys like ye, powerful, having control over their own minds, well-arıned, able and desirous of winning victory!

verses.sanskrit:
किं पुनः सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः
कृतास्त्रैः प्लवगैः शक्तैर्भवद्भिर्विजयैषिभिः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ punaḥ sahito vīrairbalavadbhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ
kṛtāstraiḥ plavagaiḥ śaktairbhavadbhirvijayaiṣibhiḥ

translations.english: What of other monkeys, I, myself, am capable of destroying soon the city along with the Rākşasa and the mighty Rāvana! And there is not the least wonder about it if I am aided by powerful monkey heroes like you, having control over themselves, well armed, capable and desirous of winning victory.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरःसरम्
सपुत्रं विधमिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tu rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe sasainyaṁ sapuraḥsaram
saputraṁ vidhamiṣyāmi sahodarayutaṁ yudhi

translations.english: I shall slay Răvaņa in conflict along with his sons, brothers army and retinue.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारुणं तथा
यदि शक्रजितोऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्ष्याणि संयुगे
तान्यहं विधमिष्यामि निहनिष्यामि राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration:
brāhmamaindraṁ ca raudraṁ ca vāyavyaṁ vāruṇaṁ tathā
yadi śakrajito'strāṇi durnirīkṣyāṇi saṁyuge
tānyahaṁ vidhamiṣyāmi nihaniṣyāmi rākṣasān

translations.english: I shall destroy all the Rākşasas and baffle all the weapons of Indrajit conferred on him by Brahmā, Rudra, wind and Varuņa albeit they are invisible in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
मयातुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा
देवानपि रणे हन्यात्किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान्
verses.transliteration:
mayātulā visṛṣṭā hi śailavṛṣṭirnirantarā
devānapi raṇe hanyātkiṁ punastānniśācarān

translations.english: Without your perinission my prowess has been bought to a stand still. Hills and mountains, uprooted and discharged by me continually, can destroy even the celestials, what of those nightrangers?

verses.sanskrit:
सागरोऽप्यतियाद्वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि
न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी
verses.transliteration:
sāgaro'pyatiyādvelāṁ mandaraḥ pracaledapi
na jāmbavantaṁ samare kampayedarivāhinī

translations.english: Without your permission my prowess has been bought to a stand still. Even if the ocean overflow its banks, the Mount Mandara move off its place, the enemy's host cannot frighten Jāmbavăn in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वराक्षससंघानां राक्षसा ये च पूर्वकाः
अलमेको विनाशाय वीरो वायुसुतः कपिः
verses.transliteration:
sarvarākṣasasaṁghānāṁ rākṣasā ye ca pūrvakāḥ
alameko vināśāya vīro vāyusutaḥ kapiḥ

translations.english: And specially the heroic monkey, Vali's son, is alone capable of destroying the whole host of the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
पनसस्योरुवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः
मन्दरोऽप्यवशीर्येत किं पुनर्युधि राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
panasasyoruvegena nīlasya ca mahātmanaḥ
mandaro'pyavaśīryeta kiṁ punaryudhi rākṣasāḥ

translations.english: Even the mount Mandra is weakened by the velocity of the thighs of the high-souled monkey Nīla-what of the Rākşasas in conflict?

verses.sanskrit:
सदेवासुरयुद्धेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु
मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा
verses.transliteration:
sadevāsurayuddheṣu gandharvoragapakṣiṣu
maindasya pratiyoddhāraṁ śaṁsata dvividasya vā

translations.english: What hero is there among the celestials, Asuras, Yaksas, Gandharvas, serpents and birds who can equal Manida or Dvivida in battle?

verses.sanskrit:
अश्विपुत्रौ महावेगावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ
पितामहवरोत्सेकात्परमं दर्पमास्थितौ
verses.transliteration:
aśviputrau mahāvegāvetau plavagasattamau
pitāmahavarotsekātparamaṁ darpamāsthitau

translations.english: I do not find any one who can oppose in the battle field the two best monkeys, the sons of Asvi gifted with great velocity.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः
सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान्पुरा
verses.transliteration:
aśvinormānanārthaṁ hi sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
sarvāvadhyatvamatulamanayordattavānpurā

translations.english: Formerly to honour Asvi the Frand-father, of all the worlds, made these two monkeys incapable of being slain by any. And crushing the mighty host of the celestials, these two heroes gifted with great prowess, and maddened with haughtiness in consequence of the boon, drank up nectar.

verses.sanskrit:
एतावेव हि संक्रुद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्
लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः
verses.transliteration:
etāveva hi saṁkruddhau savājirathakuñjarām
laṅkāṁ nāśayituṁ śaktau sarve tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ

translations.english: And these two, if worked up with ire, are capable of destroying the whole city of Lankā with her horses, chariots and elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्टा देवी न चानीता इति तत्र निवेदनम्
अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि भवद्भिः ख्यातविक्रमैः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭā devī na cānītā iti tatra nivedanam
ayuktamiva paśyāmi bhavadbhiḥ khyātavikramaiḥ

translations.english: I have heard, that, by Wind-god's son alone Lankā was burnt. You are all famed for your manliness, it dose not behove you to speak before Rāma. “We have seen the worshipful dame but have not been able to bring her.'

verses.sanskrit:
न हि वः प्लवते कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित्पराक्रमे
तुल्यः सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
na hi vaḥ plavate kaścinnāpi kaścitparākrame
tulyaḥ sāmaradaityeṣu lokeṣu harisattamāḥ

translations.english: You foremost of monkeys, there is none among the celestials or Asuras who can equal you either in leaping or in prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
तेष्वेवं हतवीरेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता
किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣvevaṁ hatavīreṣu rākṣaseṣu hanūmatā
kimanyadatra kartavyaṁ gṛhītvā yāma jānakīm

translations.english: What else is there for us to perforin than brining the daughter of the king Janaka when the Rākşasa crew shall be slain by Hanumān?

verses.sanskrit:
तमेवं कृतसंकल्पं जाम्बवान्हरिसत्तमः
उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित्
verses.transliteration:
tamevaṁ kṛtasaṁkalpaṁ jāmbavānharisattamaḥ
uvāca paramaprīto vākyamarthavadarthavit

translations.english: Thereupon Jāmbavāna, the foremost of the monkeys, greatly delighted spoke to Angada, who was thus resolved, the following pregnant words.

verses.sanskrit:
न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो; यथा भवान्पश्यति राजपुत्र
यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा; तथा भवान्पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धिम्
verses.transliteration:
na tāvadeṣā matirakṣamā no; yathā bhavānpaśyati rājaputra
yathā tu rāmasya matirniviṣṭā; tathā bhavānpaśyatu kāryasiddhim

translations.english: What you had judged, O prince, is liked by us. And still you should look to Rāma's resolution and bring about his end.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः
अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः
verses.transliteration:
tato jāmbavato vākyamagṛhṇanta vanaukasaḥ
aṅgadapramukhā vīrā hanūmāṁśca mahākapiḥ

translations.english: All the heroic monkeys, headed by Angada and the great monkey Hanumān, approved highly of the words of Jāmbavān.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपुरःसराः
महेन्द्राग्रं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः
verses.transliteration:
prītimantastataḥ sarve vāyuputrapuraḥsarāḥ
mahendrāgraṁ parityajya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ

translations.english: And these leading monkeys headed by the Wind-god's son proceeded leading from the summit of the Mount Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit:
मेरुमन्दरसंकाशा मत्ता इव महागजाः
छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
merumandarasaṁkāśā mattā iva mahāgajāḥ
chādayanta ivākāśaṁ mahākāyā mahābalāḥ

translations.english: And there highly powerful ones, having huge persons, resembling the Mount Mandara, covered the welkin as if like so many mad elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्
हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration:
sabhājyamānaṁ bhūtaistamātmavantaṁ mahābalam
hanūmantaṁ mahāvegaṁ vahanta iva dṛṣṭibhiḥ

translations.english: They carried, as it were with their own looks, the highly powerful Hanumān, gifted with great velocity, having control over his own self, and adored by the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः
सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्विनः
verses.transliteration:
priyākhyānonmukhāḥ sarve sarve yuddhābhinandinaḥ
sarve rāmapratīkāre niścitārthā manasvinaḥ

translations.english: They were resolved upon satisfying Rāma's end and acquiring glory for themselves. Their desires were satisfied and mind elevated in consequence of their beholding Sitã and burning down Lankā. All of them were anxious to communicate this pleasant news. to enter into conflict and were resolved upon bringing about Rāma's wellbeing.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तन्मधुवनं नाम सुग्रीवस्याभिरक्षितम्
अधृष्यं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration:
yattanmadhuvanaṁ nāma sugrīvasyābhirakṣitam
adhṛṣyaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ sarvabhūtamanoharam

translations.english: And leaping and ascending the sky they got at the Madhuvana, (An orchard teeming with various trees bearing delicious and sweet fruits) preserved by Sugrīva, resembling the celestial garden, covered with many trees, picturesque and incapable of being divastated by any.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्रक्षति महावीर्यः सदा दधिमुखः कपिः
मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
yadrakṣati mahāvīryaḥ sadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ
mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: The monkey-chief Sugrīva's maternal uncle, the heroic and high-souled Dadhimukha always guard that picturesque and spacious garden of the lord of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तद्वनमुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः
वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मनःकान्ततमं महत्
verses.transliteration:
te tadvanamupāgamya babhūvuḥ paramotkaṭāḥ
vānarā vānarendrasya manaḥkāntatamaṁ mahat

translations.english: They were greatly worked up with anxiety. And beholding that large orchard, those yellowcoloured monkeys were greatly delighted and begged honey of the prince.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते वानरा हृष्टा दृष्ट्वा मधुवनं महत्
कुमारमभ्ययाचन्त मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः
verses.transliteration:
tataste vānarā hṛṣṭā dṛṣṭvā madhuvanaṁ mahat
kumāramabhyayācanta madhūni madhupiṅgalāḥ

translations.english: And the prince respectfully allowed these elderly monkeys headed by Jāmbavān to drink honey.

verses.sanskrit:
ततश्चानुमताः सर्वे संप्रहृष्टा वनौकसः
मुदिताश्च ततस्ते च प्रनृत्यन्ति ततस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
tataścānumatāḥ sarve saṁprahṛṣṭā vanaukasaḥ
muditāśca tataste ca pranṛtyanti tatastataḥ

translations.english: And thereupon those monkeys, beside themselves with joy for being allowed to drink honey began to dance hither and thither.

verses.sanskrit:
गायन्ति केचित्प्रणमन्ति केचि;न्नृत्यन्ति केचित्प्रहसन्ति केचित्
पतन्ति केचिद्विचरन्ति केचि;त्प्लवन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित्
verses.transliteration:
gāyanti kecitpraṇamanti keci;nnṛtyanti kecitprahasanti kecit
patanti kecidvicaranti keci;tplavanti kecitpralapanti kecit

translations.english: Some sang, some laughed, some danced, some bowed down, some read, some walked hither, some leaped and some talked at random.

verses.sanskrit:
परस्परं केचिदुपाश्रयन्ते; परस्परं केचिदतिब्रुवन्ते
द्रुमाद्द्रुमं केचिदभिप्लवन्ते; क्षितौ नगाग्रान्निपतन्ति केचित्
verses.transliteration:
parasparaṁ kecidupāśrayante; parasparaṁ kecidatibruvante
drumāddrumaṁ kecidabhiplavante; kṣitau nagāgrānnipatanti kecit

translations.english: Some sprang upon one one another, some quarrelled with one another, some leaped from one tree to another, and some jumped down on the earth from the tops of the trees.

verses.sanskrit:
महीतलात्केचिदुदीर्णवेगा; महाद्रुमाग्राण्यभिसंपतन्ते
गायन्तमन्यः प्रहसन्नुपैति; हसन्तमन्यः प्रहसन्नुपैति
verses.transliteration:
mahītalātkecidudīrṇavegā; mahādrumāgrāṇyabhisaṁpatante
gāyantamanyaḥ prahasannupaiti; hasantamanyaḥ prahasannupaiti

translations.english: Some rose up with great velocity from the earth to the tops of the huge trees-some sang, other approached them laughing—some wept and others approached them weeping.

verses.sanskrit:
रुदन्तमन्यः प्ररुदन्नुपैति; नुदन्तमन्यः प्रणुदन्नुपैति
समाकुलं तत्कपिसैन्यमासी;न्मधुप्रपानोत्कट सत्त्वचेष्टम्
न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव मत्तो; न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तृप्तो
verses.transliteration:
rudantamanyaḥ prarudannupaiti; nudantamanyaḥ praṇudannupaiti
samākulaṁ tatkapisainyamāsī;nmadhuprapānotkaṭa sattvaceṣṭam
na cātra kaścinna babhūva matto; na cātra kaścinna babhūva tṛpto

translations.english: Some were stricking with their nails and others struck them in return. And thus the entire monkey host were bewildered with intoxication. There was none among them who was not drunk and none who was not excited with pride.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वनं तत्परिभक्ष्यमाणं; द्रुमांश्च विध्वंसितपत्रपुष्पान्
समीक्ष्य कोपाद्दधिवक्त्रनामा; निवारयामास कपिः कपींस्तान्
verses.transliteration:
tato vanaṁ tatparibhakṣyamāṇaṁ; drumāṁśca vidhvaṁsitapatrapuṣpān
