samīkṣya kopāddadhivaktranāmā; nivārayāmāsa kapiḥ kapīṁstān

translations.english: Thereupon beholding all the fruits eaten up and the trees divested of leaves and flowers, the monkey Dadhimukha and worked up with ire and attempted to prevent them.

verses.sanskrit:
स तैः प्रवृद्धैः परिभर्त्स्यमानो; वनस्य गोप्ता हरिवीरवृद्धः
चकार भूयो मतिमुग्रतेजा; वनस्य रक्षां प्रति वानरेभ्यः
verses.transliteration:
sa taiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ paribhartsyamāno; vanasya goptā harivīravṛddhaḥ
cakāra bhūyo matimugratejā; vanasya rakṣāṁ prati vānarebhyaḥ

translations.english: And that heroic, elderly monkey, the guard of the garden, was in return remonstrated with by them who were greatly intoxicated. Thereat the highly spirited monkey again made up his mind to protect the garden from their devastations.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच कांश्चित्परुषाणि धृष्ट;मसक्तमन्यांश्च तलैर्जघान
समेत्य कैश्चित्कलहं चकार; तथैव साम्नोपजगाम कांश्चित्
verses.transliteration:
uvāca kāṁścitparuṣāṇi dhṛṣṭa;masaktamanyāṁśca talairjaghāna
sametya kaiścitkalahaṁ cakāra; tathaiva sāmnopajagāma kāṁścit

translations.english: He used harsh words, undauntedly towards some, struck the weak with his palm, quarrelled with some, and consoled others with soothing words.

verses.sanskrit:
स तैर्मदाच्चाप्रतिवार्य वेगै;र्बलाच्च तेनाप्रतिवार्यमाणैः
प्रधर्षितस्त्यक्तभयैः समेत्य; प्रकृष्यते चाप्यनवेक्ष्य दोषम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tairmadāccāprativārya vegai;rbalācca tenāprativāryamāṇaiḥ
pradharṣitastyaktabhayaiḥ sametya; prakṛṣyate cāpyanavekṣya doṣam

translations.english: They were greatly excited with drink, and being prevented forcibly by Dadhimukha, they giving up all fear, began to pull him.

verses.sanskrit:
नखैस्तुदन्तो दशनैर्दशन्त;स्तलैश्च पादैश्च समाप्नुवन्तः
मदात्कपिं तं कपयः समग्रा; महावनं निर्विषयं च चक्रुः
verses.transliteration:
nakhaistudanto daśanairdaśanta;stalaiśca pādaiśca samāpnuvantaḥ
madātkapiṁ taṁ kapayaḥ samagrā; mahāvanaṁ nirviṣayaṁ ca cakruḥ

translations.english: And striking him with their nails, biting him with teeth, crushing him with their palms and feel, they being drunk, almost reduced him to death and devastated the mangoe forest.

verses.sanskrit:
तानुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठो हनूमान्वानरर्षभः
अव्यग्रमनसो यूयं मधु सेवत वानराः
verses.transliteration:
tānuvāca hariśreṣṭho hanūmānvānararṣabhaḥ
avyagramanaso yūyaṁ madhu sevata vānarāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys, spoke to them, saying.-"O monkeys, do youundisturbed drink honey. I shall myself thwart them who will obstruct you."

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं हरीणां प्रवरोऽङ्गदः
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पिबन्तु हरयो मधु
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ harīṇāṁ pravaro'ṅgadaḥ
pratyuvāca prasannātmā pibantu harayo madhu

translations.english: Hearing his works, Angada, the best of the monkeys, delighted, said-'Drink honey, O monkeys, we must follow Hanumān's advice, who has already been crowned with success. We must follow him even if he lead us to an unworthy action, what of this which is most becoming?"

verses.sanskrit:
अन्दगस्य मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं वानरर्षभाः
साधु साध्विति संहृष्टा वानराः प्रत्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
andagasya mukhācchrutvā vacanaṁ vānararṣabhāḥ
sādhu sādhviti saṁhṛṣṭā vānarāḥ pratyapūjayan

translations.english: Hearing these words from Angada, the leading monkeys attained to an excess of delight and eulogized him again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
पूजयित्वाङ्गदं सर्वे वानरा वानरर्षभम्
जग्मुर्मधुवनं यत्र नदीवेग इव द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
pūjayitvāṅgadaṁ sarve vānarā vānararṣabham
jagmurmadhuvanaṁ yatra nadīvega iva drutam

translations.english: saw And adoring Angada-their prince, those monkeys proceeded by the way leading to the Madhuvana like to trees carried by a stream.

verses.sanskrit:
ते प्रहृष्टा मधुवनं पालानाक्रम्य वीर्यतः
अतिसर्गाच्च पटवो दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
te prahṛṣṭā madhuvanaṁ pālānākramya vīryataḥ
atisargācca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm

translations.english: And entering that orchard they forcibly attacked the waiters there. Hanuman Maithili, and others heard of her from him-and those monkeys,-renouncing all fear in consequence and obtaining permission, drank honey and feasted on various sweet fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
मधूनि द्रोणमात्राणि बहुभिः परिगृह्य ते
घ्नन्ति स्म सहिताः सर्वे भक्षयन्ति तथापरे
verses.transliteration:
madhūni droṇamātrāṇi bahubhiḥ parigṛhya te
ghnanti sma sahitāḥ sarve bhakṣayanti tathāpare

translations.english: And they, given to the drinking of honey, attacking the guards who were approaching by hundreds gave them a sound beating. Some monkeys, collecting honey with their hands measuring a Droņa, (In common use a measure of thirty-two seers of rather more than sixty four Ibs. quadrupeds) drank it; others collecting themselves delightedly into a band spoiled it; while other yellow-coloured monkeys drank and sprinkled it And some, being beside themselves with intoxication, struck others with the remaining quantity, while others waited at the foot of the trees, holding their boughs.

verses.sanskrit:
केचित्क्ष्वेडान्प्रकुर्वन्ति केचित्कूजन्ति हृष्टवत्
हरयो मधुना मत्ताः केचित्सुप्ता महीतले
verses.transliteration:
kecitkṣveḍānprakurvanti kecitkūjanti hṛṣṭavat
harayo madhunā mattāḥ kecitsuptā mahītale

translations.english: Some of the monkeys, inebriate with honey, slept on the earth; some laughed at others impudently and some cried aloud.

verses.sanskrit:
येऽप्यत्र मधुपालाः स्युः प्रेष्या दधिमुखस्य तु
तेऽपि तैर्वानरैर्भीमैः प्रतिषिद्धा दिशो गताः
verses.transliteration:
ye'pyatra madhupālāḥ syuḥ preṣyā dadhimukhasya tu
te'pi tairvānarairbhīmaiḥ pratiṣiddhā diśo gatāḥ

translations.english: Some spoke contrary to what they had doneand others put a different construction thereon. And all the waiters of the garden and the servants of Dadhimukha, were repressed by those terrible monkeys with censure and thrown up in the shy by their Knee-joints. And terrified, they fled to different directions.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमता दत्तवरैर्हतं मधुवनं बलात्
वयं च जानुभिः कृष्टा देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः
verses.transliteration:
hanūmatā dattavarairhataṁ madhuvanaṁ balāt
vayaṁ ca jānubhiḥ kṛṣṭā devamārgaṁ ca darśitāḥ

translations.english: And being worked up with anxiety, they approached Dadhimukha and said "Commanded by Hanumān the monkeys have forcibly devastated the Madhuvana and we were thrown high up by them in the sky.”

verses.sanskrit:
ततो दधिमुखः क्रुद्धो वनपस्तत्र वानरः
हतं मधुवनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वयामास तान्हरीन्
verses.transliteration:
tato dadhimukhaḥ kruddho vanapastatra vānaraḥ
hataṁ madhuvanaṁ śrutvā sāntvayāmāsa tānharīn

translations.english: Hearing of the destruction of the orchard, Dadhimukha, being greatly enraged, consoled all the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
एतागच्छत गच्छामो वानरानतिदर्पितान्
बलेनावारयिष्यामो मधु भक्षयतो वयम्
verses.transliteration:
etāgacchata gacchāmo vānarānatidarpitān
balenāvārayiṣyāmo madhu bhakṣayato vayam

translations.english: Proceed you before, I shall soon follow you and repress by force all those monkeys, greatly excited with pride and the drinking of the excellent honey.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं वानरर्षभाः
पुनर्वीरा मधुवनं तेनैव सहिता ययुः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṁ vacanaṁ vānararṣabhāḥ
punarvīrā madhuvanaṁ tenaiva sahitā yayuḥ

translations.english: Hearing these works from Dadhimukha those leading and heroic monkeys proceeded with him towards Madhuvana.

verses.sanskrit:
ते शिलाः पादपांश्चापि पाषाणांश्चापि वानराः
गृहीत्वाभ्यागमन्क्रुद्धा यत्र ते कपिकुञ्जराः
verses.transliteration:
te śilāḥ pādapāṁścāpi pāṣāṇāṁścāpi vānarāḥ
gṛhītvābhyāgamankruddhā yatra te kapikuñjarāḥ

translations.english: And Dadhimukha proceeded with great velocity in their midst taking up a huge tree in his hand. And all his attendants, taking trees, mountain crags, proceeded, wroth, where those leading monkeys were.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ दृष्ट्वा दधिमुखं क्रुद्धं वानरपुंगवाः
अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन हनूमत्प्रमुखास्तदा
verses.transliteration:
atha dṛṣṭvā dadhimukhaṁ kruddhaṁ vānarapuṁgavāḥ
abhyadhāvanta vegena hanūmatpramukhāstadā

translations.english: And beholding Dadhimukha greatly enraged, all the monkeys, headed by Hanumān, approached him with great vehemence.

verses.sanskrit:
तं सवृक्षं महाबाहुमापतन्तं महाबलम्
आर्यकं प्राहरत्तत्र बाहुभ्यां कुपितोऽङ्गदः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ savṛkṣaṁ mahābāhumāpatantaṁ mahābalam
āryakaṁ prāharattatra bāhubhyāṁ kupito'ṅgadaḥ

translations.english: And as the mighty Dadhimukha of huge arms, was proceeding towards them vehemently with a huge tree, Angada, wroth, caught him by the hand.

verses.sanskrit:
मदान्धश न वेदैनमार्यकोऽयं ममेति सः
अथैनं निष्पिपेषाशु वेगवद्वसुधातले
verses.transliteration:
madāndhaśa na vedainamāryako'yaṁ mameti saḥ
athainaṁ niṣpipeṣāśu vegavadvasudhātale

translations.english: He was beside himself with intoxication and therefore did not show him the least mercy, albeit he (Dadhimukha) was worshipful to him. And accordingly with great vehemence he ground him to the dust.

verses.sanskrit:
स भग्नबाहुर्विमुखो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः
मुमोह सहसा वीरो मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः
verses.transliteration:
sa bhagnabāhurvimukho vihvalaḥ śoṇitokṣitaḥ
mumoha sahasā vīro muhūrtaṁ kapikuñjaraḥ

translations.english: His arms and thighs were broken and his countenance was disfigured and that great hero, the foremost of the monkeys, bathed in a pool of blood, remained senseless for sometime.

verses.sanskrit:
स कथंचिद्विमुक्तस्तैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभः
उवाचैकान्तमागम्य भृत्यांस्तान्समुपागतान्
verses.transliteration:
sa kathaṁcidvimuktastairvānarairvānararṣabhaḥ
uvācaikāntamāgamya bhṛtyāṁstānsamupāgatān

translations.english: And thereupon releasing himself from them by some device that leading monkey, proceeded to a nook, and addressed his attendants, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
एते तिष्ठन्तु गच्छामो भर्ता नो यत्र वानरः
सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सह रामेण तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration:
ete tiṣṭhantu gacchāmo bhartā no yatra vānaraḥ
sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ saha rāmeṇa tiṣṭhati

translations.english: Let us all proceed there where our lord, the spacious-necked Sugrīva live with Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वं चैवाङ्गदे दोषं श्रावयिष्यामि पार्थिव
अमर्षी वचनं श्रुत्वा घातयिष्यति वानरान्
verses.transliteration:
sarvaṁ caivāṅgade doṣaṁ śrāvayiṣyāmi pārthiva
amarṣī vacanaṁ śrutvā ghātayiṣyati vānarān

translations.english: I shall relate to him all the unfair dealings of Angada and forsooth shall that wrathful king punish all these monkeys

verses.sanskrit:
इष्टं मधुवनं ह्येतत्सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः
पितृपैतामहं दिव्यं देवैरपि दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration:
iṣṭaṁ madhuvanaṁ hyetatsugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
pitṛpaitāmahaṁ divyaṁ devairapi durāsadam

translations.english: The picturesque Madhuvana is the most favourite orchard of the high-souled Sugrīva. It was enjoyed by his forefathers and is not even approached by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
स वानरानिमान्सर्वान्मधुलुब्धान्गतायुषः
घातयिष्यति दण्डेन सुग्रीवः ससुहृज्जनान्
verses.transliteration:
sa vānarānimānsarvānmadhulubdhāngatāyuṣaḥ
ghātayiṣyati daṇḍena sugrīvaḥ sasuhṛjjanān

translations.english: And meting out punishment to these monkeys, eager to drink honey and almost half dead, Sugrīva shall slay them as will as their friends and relatives.

verses.sanskrit:
वध्या ह्येते दुरात्मानो नृपाज्ञा परिभाविनः
अमर्षप्रभवो रोषः सफलो नो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
vadhyā hyete durātmāno nṛpājñā paribhāvinaḥ
amarṣaprabhavo roṣaḥ saphalo no bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Those vicious-souled ones are worthy of being slain since they have transgressed the royal mandate. And then shall my wrath, arising out of impatience, bear fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा दधिमुखो वनपालान्महाबलः
जगाम सहसोत्पत्य वनपालैः समन्वितः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā dadhimukho vanapālānmahābalaḥ
jagāma sahasotpatya vanapālaiḥ samanvitaḥ

translations.english: Having thus spoken to the guards of the forest the highly powerful Dadhimukha leaped high up in the welkin and went away with them.

verses.sanskrit:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण स हि प्राप्तो वनालयः
सहस्रांशुसुतो धीमान्सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः
verses.transliteration:
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa sa hi prāpto vanālayaḥ
sahasrāṁśusuto dhīmānsugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ

translations.english: And in no time he reached where the highly intelligent "Niether monkey/Sugriva, the offspring of the sun, was."

verses.sanskrit:
रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवमेव च
समप्रतिष्ठां जगतीमाकाशान्निपपात ह
verses.transliteration:
rāmaṁ ca lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva dṛṣṭvā sugrīvameva ca
samapratiṣṭhāṁ jagatīmākāśānnipapāta ha

translations.english: And beholding Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, and Sugrīva and the level ground he descended from the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
स दीनवदनो भूत्वा कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम्
सुग्रीवस्य शुभौ मूर्ध्ना चरणौ प्रत्यपीडयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa dīnavadano bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim
sugrīvasya śubhau mūrdhnā caraṇau pratyapīḍayat

translations.english: And descending from the sky that great and heroic Dabhimukha,lord over all the monkeys engaged in protecting the forest, placing his folded palms on his forehead and with a poorly countenance, laid low his crown at Sugrīva's feet.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मूर्ध्ना निपतितं वानरं वानरर्षभः
दृष्ट्वैवोद्विग्नहृदयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tato mūrdhnā nipatitaṁ vānaraṁ vānararṣabhaḥ
dṛṣṭvaivodvignahṛdayo vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: And beholding that monkey place his crown at his feet the monkey-chief, with an anxious mind, accosted him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ कस्मात्त्वं पादयोः पतितो मम
अभयं ते भवेद्वीर सत्यमेवाभिधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kasmāttvaṁ pādayoḥ patito mama
abhayaṁ te bhavedvīra satyamevābhidhīyatām

translations.english: Rise up, rise up, why had you lain yourself at my feet? I declare you had you come here? It behove you to suggest the becoming procedure. Is it all well with my orchard Madhuvana? I long to know everything, O monkey.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु विश्वासितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना
उत्थाय च महाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं दधिमुखोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu viśvāsitastena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā
utthāya ca mahāprājño vākyaṁ dadhimukho'bravīt

translations.english: Being thus addressed hopefully by the highsouled Sugrīva, Dadhimukha, gifted with an intelligence of a very high order, rose up and spoke.

verses.sanskrit:
नैवर्क्षरजसा राजन्न त्वया नापि वालिना
वनं निसृष्टपूर्वं हि भक्षितं तत्तु वानरैः
verses.transliteration:
naivarkṣarajasā rājanna tvayā nāpi vālinā
vanaṁ nisṛṣṭapūrvaṁ hi bhakṣitaṁ tattu vānaraiḥ

translations.english: Neither yourself, nor Vāli, the lord of the monkeys, O king, allowed that orchard to be freely used by the monkeys but that has been now laid waste by them.

verses.sanskrit:
एभिः प्रधर्षिताश्चैव वारिता वनरक्षिभिः
मधून्यचिन्तयित्वेमान्भक्षयन्ति पिबन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
ebhiḥ pradharṣitāścaiva vāritā vanarakṣibhiḥ
madhūnyacintayitvemānbhakṣayanti pibanti ca

translations.english: I prevented them along with these attendants, but disregarding me, they drank and feasted there at their pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
शिष्टमत्रापविध्यन्ति भक्षयन्ति तथापरे
निवार्यमाणास्ते सर्वे भ्रुवौ वै दर्शयन्ति हि
verses.transliteration:
śiṣṭamatrāpavidhyanti bhakṣayanti tathāpare
nivāryamāṇāste sarve bhruvau vai darśayanti hi

translations.english: Some of them went beyond the pale of food conduct, others ate at their pleasure, and all frowned (at us).

verses.sanskrit:
इमे हि संरब्धतरास्तथा तैः संप्रधर्षिताः
वारयन्तो वनात्तस्मात्क्रुद्धैर्वानरपुंगवैः
verses.transliteration:
ime hi saṁrabdhatarāstathā taiḥ saṁpradharṣitāḥ
vārayanto vanāttasmātkruddhairvānarapuṁgavaiḥ

translations.english: When these attendants, being insulted by them, were greatly wroth, they were driven out of the garden, by those powerful and enraged monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तैर्बहुभिर्वीरैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभाः
संरक्तनयनैः क्रोधाद्धरयः संप्रचालिताः
verses.transliteration:
tatastairbahubhirvīrairvānarairvānararṣabhāḥ
saṁraktanayanaiḥ krodhāddharayaḥ saṁpracālitāḥ

translations.english: They were greatly assailed by those many thousand heroic monkeys, worked up with ire and having reddened eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
पाणिभिर्निहताः केचित्केचिज्जानुभिराहताः
प्रकृष्टाश्च यथाकामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः
verses.transliteration:
pāṇibhirnihatāḥ kecitkecijjānubhirāhatāḥ
prakṛṣṭāśca yathākāmaṁ devamārgaṁ ca darśitāḥ

translations.english: Some had their arins broken, some had their knee-joints crushed and some of them were thrown up in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेते हताः शूरास्त्वयि तिष्ठति भर्तरि
कृत्स्नं मधुवनं चैव प्रकामं तैः प्रभक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration:
evamete hatāḥ śūrāstvayi tiṣṭhati bhartari
kṛtsnaṁ madhuvanaṁ caiva prakāmaṁ taiḥ prabhakṣyate

translations.english: Yourself their lord living, these heroes are beaten, and the entire Madhuvana is being freely enjoyed by them.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं विज्ञाप्यमानं तु सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्
अपृच्छत्तं महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vijñāpyamānaṁ tu sugrīvaṁ vānararṣabham
apṛcchattaṁ mahāprājño lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā

translations.english: The highly intelligent Lakşmaņa, the slayer of foes, addressed Sugriva, the foremost O the monkeys, while he was thus being informed, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
किमयं वानरो राजन्वनपः प्रत्युपस्थितः
कं चार्थमभिनिर्दिश्य दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
kimayaṁ vānaro rājanvanapaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ
kaṁ cārthamabhinirdiśya duḥkhito vākyamabravīt

translations.english: O king, why has this monkey, the guard over the forest, come to you, and what sorrow has led him to give vent to these expressions?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
lakṣmaṇaṁ pratyuvācedaṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Laksmana, Sugriva, skilled in the art of speech, replied.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्य लक्ष्मण संप्राह वीरो दधिमुखः कपिः
अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्भक्षितं मधुवानरैः
verses.transliteration:
ārya lakṣmaṇa saṁprāha vīro dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ
aṅgadapramukhairvīrairbhakṣitaṁ madhuvānaraiḥ

translations.english: O worshipful Lakşmaņa, the heroic monkey Dadhimukha speaks that the war-like monkeys headed by Angada have drunk honey.

verses.sanskrit:
नैषामकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः
वनं यथाभिपन्नं तैः साधितं कर्म वानरैः
verses.transliteration:
naiṣāmakṛtakṛtyānāmīdṛśaḥ syādupakramaḥ
vanaṁ yathābhipannaṁ taiḥ sādhitaṁ karma vānaraiḥ

translations.english: They would not have engaged in such an unfair proceeding had they been unsuccessful in their mission. They have surely achieved success while they have thus been bent upon devastating the orchard.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्यसिद्धिर्हनुमति मतिश्च हरिपुंगव
व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च श्रुतं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
kāryasiddhirhanumati matiśca haripuṁgava
vyavasāyaśca vīryaṁ ca śrutaṁ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam

translations.english: There is none else but Hanumān who is the instrumental of this work, for that best of monkeys has in him a high intellect, know the art of success, is gifted with courage, strength and prowess and is conversant with Śāstras.

verses.sanskrit:
आगतैश्च प्रविष्टं तद्यथा मधुवनं हि तैः
धर्षितं च वनं कृत्स्नमुपयुक्तं च वानरैः
वारिताः सहिताः पालास्तथा जानुभिराहताः
verses.transliteration:
āgataiśca praviṣṭaṁ tadyathā madhuvanaṁ hi taiḥ
dharṣitaṁ ca vanaṁ kṛtsnamupayuktaṁ ca vānaraiḥ
vāritāḥ sahitāḥ pālāstathā jānubhirāhatāḥ

translations.english: Forsooth that orchard has been laid waste by these heroes headed by Angada. And ransacking the southern quarter, those leading monkeys have come back and delightedly entered the Madhuvana. And the whole orchard has been explored and enjoyed by those monkeys and the attendants beaten and wounded on their kneejoints. To communicate to me this intelligence, this monkey of known prowess, and sweet accents, named Dhadimukha, has come here.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्टा सीता महाबाहो सौमित्रे पश्य तत्त्वतः
अभिगम्य यथा सर्वे पिबन्ति मधु वानराः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭā sītā mahābāho saumitre paśya tattvataḥ
abhigamya yathā sarve pibanti madhu vānarāḥ

translations.english: O you of mighty arms, O son of Sumitra, forsooth they have beheld Sītā, since the monkeys, just on their return, have engaged in drinking honey.

verses.sanskrit:
न चाप्यदृष्ट्वा वैदेहीं विश्रुताः पुरुषर्षभ
वनं दात्त वरं दिव्यं धर्षयेयुर्वनौकसः
verses.transliteration:
na cāpyadṛṣṭvā vaidehīṁ viśrutāḥ puruṣarṣabha
vanaṁ dātta varaṁ divyaṁ dharṣayeyurvanaukasaḥ

translations.english: O best of men, they are all well-known monkeys and without espying Vaidehī they would not have engaged in the destruction of that orchard conferred on us as a gift by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणः सहराघवः
श्रुत्वा कर्णसुखां वाणीं सुग्रीववदनाच्च्युताम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā lakṣmaṇaḥ saharāghavaḥ
śrutvā karṇasukhāṁ vāṇīṁ sugrīvavadanāccyutām

translations.english: Hearing these words from Sugrīva, pleasant to ears, the virtuous-souled Lakşmaņa along with Rāghava, was greatly pleased.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राहृष्यत भृशं रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महायशाः
श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं सुग्रीवस्तु प्रहृष्य च
वनपालं पुनर्वाक्यं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṁ rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahāyaśāḥ
śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṁ sugrīvastu prahṛṣya ca
vanapālaṁ punarvākyaṁ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata

translations.english: And hearing this from Dadhimukha, Sugrīva, greatly gratified; addressed that lord of the for st, gain, Saying.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतोऽस्मि सौम्य यद्भुक्तं वनं तैः कृतकर्मभिः
मर्षितं मर्षणीयं च चेष्टितं कृतकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration:
prīto'smi saumya yadbhuktaṁ vanaṁ taiḥ kṛtakarmabhiḥ
marṣitaṁ marṣaṇīyaṁ ca ceṣṭitaṁ kṛtakarmaṇām

translations.english: Greatly pleased I am, since, they, being successful, have explored this forest. And the insulting procedure of the successful is also pardonable. Do you soon go there and protect that orchards, and send here all those monkeys headed by Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
इच्छामि शीघ्रं हनुमत्प्रधाना;न्शाखामृगांस्तान्मृगराजदर्पान्
द्रष्टुं कृतार्थान्सह राघवाभ्यां; श्रोतुं च सीताधिगमे प्रयत्नम्
verses.transliteration:
icchāmi śīghraṁ hanumatpradhānā;nśākhāmṛgāṁstānmṛgarājadarpān
draṣṭuṁ kṛtārthānsaha rāghavābhyāṁ; śrotuṁ ca sītādhigame prayatnam

translations.english: Along with these two descendants of Raghu, I long to know soon from these monkeys headed by Hanumān, and proud like lions, what they have settled for the regaining of Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हृष्टो दधिमुखः कपिः
राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं चाभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration:
sugrīveṇaivamuktastu hṛṣṭo dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ
rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva sugrīvaṁ cābhyavādayat

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Sugrīva, the monkey Dadhimuklia, delighted, bowed to him, Rāghava and Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ
वानरैः सहितैः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह
verses.transliteration:
sa praṇamya ca sugrīvaṁ rāghavau ca mahābalau
vānaraiḥ sahitaiḥ śūrairdivamevotpapāta ha

translations.english: And adoring Sugrīva and the highly powerful descendants of Raghu, he along with other heroic monkeys, leaped up in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
स यथैवागतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितो गतः
निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौ तद्वनं प्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
sa yathaivāgataḥ pūrvaṁ tathaiva tvarito gataḥ
nipatya gaganādbhūmau tadvanaṁ praviveśa ha

translations.english: He went away with the same speed with which he came and leaping down on the earth from the sky, entered the orchard.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान्
विमदानुद्धतान्सर्वान्मेहमानान्मधूदकम्
verses.transliteration:
sa praviṣṭo madhuvanaṁ dadarśa hariyūthapān
vimadānuddhatānsarvānmehamānānmadhūdakam

translations.english: And entering that forest he beheld all the leaders of the monkeys spending the hours delightedly, having passed urine, the outcome of honey.

verses.sanskrit:
स तानुपागमद्वीरो बद्ध्वा करपुटाञ्जलिम्
उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमिदं हृष्टवदङ्गदम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tānupāgamadvīro baddhvā karapuṭāñjalim
uvāca vacanaṁ ślakṣṇamidaṁ hṛṣṭavadaṅgadam

translations.english: And approaching them, the hero, with folded hands and delighted, addressed Angada, with the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यदेभिरभिवारितः
अज्ञानाद्रक्षिभिः क्रोधाद्भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः
verses.transliteration:
saumya roṣo na kartavyo yadebhirabhivāritaḥ
ajñānādrakṣibhiḥ krodhādbhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ

translations.english: O gentle one, do you not take offence, for these monkeys, protecting the garden enraged, unwittingly prevented you.

verses.sanskrit:
युवराजस्त्वमीशश्च वनस्यास्य महाबल
मौर्ख्यात्पूर्वं कृतो दोषस्तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
yuvarājastvamīśaśca vanasyāsya mahābala
maurkhyātpūrvaṁ kṛto doṣastadbhavānkṣantumarhati

translations.english: O you of great strength, you are worn out with your long journey, do you drink your own honey, you are our prince and the master of this garden.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैव हि पिता तेऽभूत्पूर्वं हरिगणेश्वरः
तथा त्वमपि सुग्रीवो नान्यस्तु हरिसत्तम
verses.transliteration:
yathaiva hi pitā te'bhūtpūrvaṁ harigaṇeśvaraḥ
tathā tvamapi sugrīvo nānyastu harisattama

translations.english: It behove you to forgive us for our wrath arising out of ignorance. Like to your sire before, yourself and Sugrīva are the lords of these monkey hosts, O you foremost of them and none else.

verses.sanskrit:
आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ
इहोपयानं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
ākhyātaṁ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha
ihopayānaṁ sarveṣāmeteṣāṁ vanacāriṇām

translations.english: O innocent prince, I have related all about this to your uncle. When I described to him, the arrival of all these forest rangers, as well as of yours accompanied by them, and the destruction of this garden by you all, he was not the least offended, rather delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहृष्टो मां पितृव्यस्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तानिति होवाच पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration:
prahṛṣṭo māṁ pitṛvyaste sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
śīghraṁ preṣaya sarvāṁstāniti hovāca pārthivaḥ

translations.english: And worked up with joy your uncle Sugrīva, the lord of earth and monkeys, said “Send them all here speedily."

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्यैतद्वचनं श्लक्ष्णमङ्गदः
अब्रवीत्तान्हरिश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā dadhimukhasyaitadvacanaṁ ślakṣṇamaṅgadaḥ
abravīttānhariśreṣṭho vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words from Dadhimukha, Angada, the foremost of the monkeys and skilled in speech, addressed them all, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
शङ्के श्रुतोऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः
तत्क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परंतपाः
verses.transliteration:
śaṅke śruto'yaṁ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ
tatkṣamaṁ neha naḥ sthātuṁ kṛte kārye paraṁtapāḥ

translations.english: O you leaders of the monkey hosts, I fear, Rāma has heard all about this. Dadhimukha relates everything joyfully and hence I infer this. And our work finished, O slayer of foes, it dose not behove us to remain here (any longer).

verses.sanskrit:
पीत्वा मधु यथाकामं विश्रान्ता वनचारिणः
किं शेषं गमनं तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः
verses.transliteration:
pītvā madhu yathākāmaṁ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ
kiṁ śeṣaṁ gamanaṁ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ

translations.english: You have all drunk honey at your pleasure and there is nothing left and you should now go where the monkey king Sugrīva is.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे यथा मां वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरियूथपाः
तथास्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवानहम्
verses.transliteration:
sarve yathā māṁ vakṣyanti sametya hariyūthapāḥ
tathāsmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravānaham

translations.english: O leading monkeys, I shall follow what you will in a band desire me to do. In action I am subordinate to you all.

verses.sanskrit:
नाज्ञापयितुमीशोऽहं युवराजोऽस्मि यद्यपि
अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं मया
verses.transliteration:
nājñāpayitumīśo'haṁ yuvarājo'smi yadyapi
ayuktaṁ kṛtakarmāṇo yūyaṁ dharṣayituṁ mayā

translations.english: I am not justified to command although I am a prince. You are all of accomplished actions, it is not proper to repress you forcibly.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रुवतश्चाङ्गदश्चैवं श्रुत्वा वचनमव्ययम्
प्रहृष्टमनसो वाक्यमिदमूचुर्वनौकसः
verses.transliteration:
bruvataścāṅgadaścaivaṁ śrutvā vacanamavyayam
prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyamidamūcurvanaukasaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those sweet words of the prince Angada, the monkeys delightedly replied, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं वक्ष्यति को राजन्प्रभुः सन्वानरर्षभ
ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तो हि सर्वोऽहमिति मन्यते
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vakṣyati ko rājanprabhuḥ sanvānararṣabha
aiśvaryamadamatto hi sarvo'hamiti manyate

translations.english: O king, O foremost of monkeys, who else can speak thus being a master? Any one else, we think, is proud of his wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
तव चेदं सुसदृशं वाक्यं नान्यस्य कस्यचित्
संनतिर्हि तवाख्याति भविष्यच्छुभभाग्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
tava cedaṁ susadṛśaṁ vākyaṁ nānyasya kasyacit
saṁnatirhi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyacchubhabhāgyatām

translations.english: Such like words become you only and none else. Your humility speaks of your future greatness.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे वयमपि प्राप्तास्तत्र गन्तुं कृतक्षणाः
स यत्र हरिवीराणां सुग्रीवः पतिरव्ययः
verses.transliteration:
sarve vayamapi prāptāstatra gantuṁ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ
sa yatra harivīrāṇāṁ sugrīvaḥ patiravyayaḥ

translations.english: We are all anxious to go there, where Sugriva, the king of the monkeys, is.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभिर्नैव शक्यं पदात्पदम्
क्वचिद्गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते
verses.transliteration:
tvayā hyanuktairharibhirnaiva śakyaṁ padātpadam
kvacidgantuṁ hariśreṣṭha brūmaḥ satyamidaṁ tu te

translations.english: Verily we speak to you, O foremost of monkeys, that without your permission, none among us, is capable of advancing a single step.”

verses.sanskrit:
उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतुः सर्वे ते हरियूथपाः
कृत्वाकाशं निराकाशं यज्ञोत्क्षिप्ता इवानलाः
verses.transliteration:
utpatantamanūtpetuḥ sarve te hariyūthapāḥ
kṛtvākāśaṁ nirākāśaṁ yajñotkṣiptā ivānalāḥ

translations.english: They addressing him thus, Angada replied"All right, let us all go.” Saying this he leaped up in the sky and was followed by all those monkeys, clouding the welkin as if with stones thrown up by a tool.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽम्बरं सहसोत्पत्य वेगवन्तः प्लवंगमाः
विनदन्तो महानादं घना वातेरिता यथा
verses.transliteration:
te'mbaraṁ sahasotpatya vegavantaḥ plavaṁgamāḥ
vinadanto mahānādaṁ ghanā vāteritā yathā

translations.english: And placing before them Angada and Hanumān, the monkeys leaping vehemently up in the sky roared like to clouds driven by the wind.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदे ह्यननुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः
उवाच शोकोपहतं रामं कमललोचनम्
verses.transliteration:
aṅgade hyananuprāpte sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ
uvāca śokopahataṁ rāmaṁ kamalalocanam

translations.english: And Angada nearing, Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys, spoke to the lotus-eyed Rāma, stricken with grief, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते दृष्टा देवी न संशयः
नागन्तुमिह शक्यं तैरतीते समये हि नः
verses.transliteration:
samāśvasihi bhadraṁ te dṛṣṭā devī na saṁśayaḥ
nāgantumiha śakyaṁ tairatīte samaye hi naḥ

translations.english: May good betide you. Do you console yourself. The worshipful dame has been found out; there is not the least doubt about it. Or else they would not have come as the time is already past.

verses.sanskrit:
न मत्सकाशमागच्छेत्कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते
युवराजो महाबाहुः प्लवतां प्रवरोऽङ्गदः
verses.transliteration:
na matsakāśamāgacchetkṛtye hi vinipātite
yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatāṁ pravaro'ṅgadaḥ

translations.english: I (further more) infer this from Angada's joy, O you of auspicious presence. Without being successful in his mission, the large-armed prince, Angada, the foremost of the monkeys, would not have come to me.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्यकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः
भवेत्तु दीनवदनो भ्रान्तविप्लुतमानसः
verses.transliteration:
yadyapyakṛtakṛtyānāmīdṛśaḥ syādupakramaḥ
bhavettu dīnavadano bhrāntaviplutamānasaḥ

translations.english: If the monkeys had engaged in such an unfair proceeding without being successful in their mission, Angada would have looked poorly and his mind would have been overwhelmed with grief and forgetfulness.

verses.sanskrit:
पितृपैतामहं चैतत्पूर्वकैरभिरक्षितम्
न मे मधुवनं हन्यादहृष्टः प्लवगेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
pitṛpaitāmahaṁ caitatpūrvakairabhirakṣitam
na me madhuvanaṁ hanyādahṛṣṭaḥ plavageśvaraḥ

translations.english: Without beholding the daughter of the king Janaka they would not have dared to destroy Madhuvana obtained and preserved by my forefathers.

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत
दृष्टा देवी न संदेहो न चान्येन हनूमता
न ह्यन्यः कर्मणो हेतुः साधने तद्विधो भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
kausalyā suprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata
dṛṣṭā devī na saṁdeho na cānyena hanūmatā
na hyanyaḥ karmaṇo hetuḥ sādhane tadvidho bhavet

translations.english: Do you console yourself, O Räma, by whom Kausalyā has become the mother of a good son. O you, rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation, forsooth has Hanumān behold the worshipful dame and none else.

verses.sanskrit:
जाम्बवान्यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च बलेश्वरः
हनूमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा
verses.transliteration:
jāmbavānyatra netā syādaṅgadaśca baleśvaraḥ
hanūmāṁścāpyadhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatiranyathā

translations.english: That work is sure to succeed whose leading spirits are the mighty Jāmbavāna and Angada, and worker is Hanumăn.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः किल किला शब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे
हनूमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नर्दतां काननौकसाम्
किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kila kilā śabdaṁ śuśrāvāsannamambare
hanūmatkarmadṛptānāṁ nardatāṁ kānanaukasām
kiṣkindhāmupayātānāṁ siddhiṁ kathayatāmiva

translations.english: Thereupon he heard in the sky the joyous sounds of the monkeys proud on account of Hanuman's work, proceeding towards Kişkindhā and as if announcing their success.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः
आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः सोऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śrutvā ninādaṁ taṁ kapīnāṁ kapisattamaḥ
āyatāñcitalāṅgūlaḥ so'bhavaddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon hearing the noise of these monkeys Sugriva, their chief, being greatly delighted, uplifted his tail.

verses.sanskrit:
आजग्मुस्तेऽपि हरयो रामदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
अङ्गदं पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तं च वानरम्
verses.transliteration:
ājagmuste'pi harayo rāmadarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
aṅgadaṁ purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantaṁ ca vānaram

translations.english: And placing Angada and Hanumān before them those monkeys proceeded to behold Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदान्विताः
निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च
verses.transliteration:
te'ṅgadapramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca mudānvitāḥ
nipeturharirājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca

translations.english: Those heroes headed by Angada, delighted and intoxicated, descended before Rāghava and the lord of the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमांश्च महाबहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः
नियतामक्षतां देवीं राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
hanūmāṁśca mahābahuḥ praṇamya śirasā tataḥ
niyatāmakṣatāṁ devīṁ rāghavāya nyavedayat

translations.english: And the mighty-armed Hanumān, lowering his head, related to Rāghava, Sītā's spiritual and physical well-being.

verses.sanskrit:
निश्चितार्थं ततस्तस्मिन्सुग्रीवं पवनात्मजे
लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान्प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
niścitārthaṁ tatastasminsugrīvaṁ pavanātmaje
lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimānprītaṁ bahumānādavaikṣata

translations.english: And being confirmed thus by the Wind-god's son, Laksmana, greatly pleased, respectfully looked towards Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीत्या च रममाणोऽथ राघवः परवीरहा
बहु मानेन महता हनूमन्तमवैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
prītyā ca ramamāṇo'tha rāghavaḥ paravīrahā
bahu mānena mahatā hanūmantamavaikṣata

translations.english: And Rāghava too, the slayer of foes, worked up with joy, cast respectful looks towards Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च
प्रवृत्तमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः
verses.transliteration:
yuvarājaṁ puraskṛtya sugrīvamabhivādya ca
pravṛttamatha sītāyāḥ pravaktumupacakramuḥ

translations.english: Thereupon getting at the Mount Prasravana surrounded by a variegated forest, lowering their heads to the mighty Rāma and Lakşmaņa, placing before them their prince (Angada) and bowing to Sugrīva, the monkeys began to relate the story of Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदाख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो राम संनिधौ
वैदेहीमक्षतां श्रुत्वा रामस्तूत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
etadākhyānti te sarve harayo rāma saṁnidhau
vaidehīmakṣatāṁ śrutvā rāmastūttaramabravīt

translations.english: And they described to Ráma, the confinement of Sītā in Rāvana's seraglio, the remonstrances of the she-demons, her unflinching attachment in her lord and the time appointed (by the Rākṣasa for her destruction). And hearing of Vaidehi's well-being Rāma said.

verses.sanskrit:
क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते
एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः
verses.transliteration:
kva sītā vartate devī kathaṁ ca mayi vartate
etanme sarvamākhyāta vaidehīṁ prati vānarāḥ

translations.english: O monkeys where live the worshipful Sītā? And how is her attachment to me? Do you relate everything to me.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्व हरयो रामसंनिधौ
चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya gaditaṁ śrutva harayo rāmasaṁnidhau
codayanti hanūmantaṁ sītāvṛttāntakovidam

translations.english: Hearing those painful words of Răma, the monkeys desired Hanumān, conversant with the whereabouts of Sītā, to describe every thing to him.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu vacanaṁ teṣāṁ hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
uvāca vākyaṁ vākyajñaḥ sītāyā darśanaṁ yathā

translations.english: Hearing their words, Hanuman, the Windgod's son, versed in the art of speech, lowering his head in Sītā's name and towards the southern direction (where she lives) began to relate how he succeeded in beholding Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्टा मे राक्षसी मध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः
राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदावने
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭā me rākṣasī madhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ
rākṣasībhirvirūpābhī rakṣitā pramadāvane

translations.english: And I saw there Sītā, in the inner appartment of Ravana. Centring all her thoughts in you, breathes that damsel, O Rama. I saw her reviled by the she demons again and again. She is being guarded in that garden by the grim-visaged Raksasis.

verses.sanskrit:
दुःखमापद्यते देवी तवादुःखोचिता सती
रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्ध्वा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता
verses.transliteration:
duḥkhamāpadyate devī tavāduḥkhocitā satī
rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhvā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā

translations.english: And that worshipful came, O hero, ever used to happiness, is now stricken with grief in your absence. Confined in Ravana's inner apartment, well protected by those she-demons, wearing a single braid of hair and poorly, she is engaged only in thoughts touching you.

verses.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयतानघ
स मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता
verses.transliteration:
ikṣvākuvaṁśavikhyātiṁ śanaiḥ kīrtayatānagha
sa mayā naraśārdūla viśvāsamupapāditā

translations.english: O Kākutstha, O innocent prince, after enquiring for sometime, I found that worshipful dame devoted to you, and narrating the glories of the Ikşvāku race, O foremost of men, I created her confidence by and by, and addressing her I related everything.

verses.sanskrit:
नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्यास्तथा त्वयि
एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी
उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktiścāsyāstathā tvayi
evaṁ mayā mahābhāgā dṛṣṭā janakanandinī
ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvadbhaktyā puruṣarṣabha

translations.english: O great man, O you best of men, I beheld the daughter of Janaka in this plight, engaged in hard austerities and ever devoted to you.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथावृत्तं तवान्तिके
चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव
verses.transliteration:
abhijñānaṁ ca me dattaṁ yathāvṛttaṁ tavāntike
citrakūṭe mahāprājña vāyasaṁ prati rāghava

translations.english: O you of great intelligence, O Raghava, offering me (this jewel) as a token, she wanted me to relate to you, the occurrence at the mount Citrakūța regarding the crow.

verses.sanskrit:
विज्ञाप्यश्च नर व्याघ्रो रामो वायुसुत त्वया
अखिलेनेह यद्दृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी
verses.transliteration:
vijñāpyaśca nara vyāghro rāmo vāyusuta tvayā
akhileneha yaddṛṣṭamiti māmāha jānakī

translations.english: And Jānakī addressing me said'O Windgod's son, do you describe everything of what you have seen here, to Rāma. And relating everything before Sugrīva, do you present him with this jewel which has been preserved by me with great care.

verses.sanskrit:
एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान्मया ते वारिसंभवः
एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रमोदिष्ये व्यसने त्वामिवानघ
verses.transliteration:
eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmānmayā te vārisaṁbhavaḥ
etaṁ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvāmivānagha

translations.english: I have kept with great care this excellent jewel of great effulgence. Do you remind him of the mark which he made on my forehead with red arsenic. O innocent monkey, greatly delighted am I on beholding the brilliant jewel which he has sent through you.

verses.sanskrit:
जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज
ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं रक्षसां वशमागता
verses.transliteration:
jīvitaṁ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṁ daśarathātmaja
ūrdhvaṁ māsānna jīveyaṁ rakṣasāṁ vaśamāgatā

translations.english: Breathe shall I only for a month, beyond that I shall never live, subject as I am to the demons.'

verses.sanskrit:
इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्म चारिणी
रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना
verses.transliteration:
iti māmabravītsītā kṛśāṅgī dharma cāriṇī
rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā

translations.english: Thus was I accosted by Sītā, reduced to a skeleton, observing pious observances, shut up in Rāvana's inner apartment and having eyes like those of a hind.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदेव मयाख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा
सर्वथा सागरजले संतारः प्रविधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
etadeva mayākhyātaṁ sarvaṁ rāghava yadyathā
sarvathā sāgarajale saṁtāraḥ pravidhīyatām

translations.english: I have described to you everything, O Rāghava, do you make arrangements for bridging over the ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ जाताश्वासौ राजपुत्रौ विदित्वा; तच्चाभिज्ञानं राघवाय प्रदाय
देव्या चाख्यातं सर्वमेवानुपूर्व्या;द्वाचा संपूर्णं वायुपुत्रः शशंस
verses.transliteration:
tau jātāśvāsau rājaputrau viditvā; taccābhijñānaṁ rāghavāya pradāya
devyā cākhyātaṁ sarvamevānupūrvyā;dvācā saṁpūrṇaṁ vāyuputraḥ śaśaṁsa

translations.english: And considering those two princes greatly consoled, the Wind-god's son handed over that token to Rāghava and described everything from the beginning to the end.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मजः
तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
evamukto hanumatā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
taṁ maṇiṁ hṛdaye kṛtvā praruroda salakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, placing that jewel on his breast, wept with Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघवः शोककर्शितः
नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṁ rāghavaḥ śokakarśitaḥ
netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṁ sugrīvamidamabravīt

translations.english: Beholding that excellent jewel, Rāghava, stricken with grief, with eyes full of tears, spake to Sugriva, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला
तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration:
yathaiva dhenuḥ sravati snehādvatsasya vatsalā
tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṁ maṇiratnasya darśanāt

translations.english: Forsooth my heart melt on beholding this jewel as milk trickle down from the udders of a cow on beholding its calf.

verses.sanskrit:
मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याः श्वशुरेण मे
वधूकाले यथा बद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते
verses.transliteration:
maṇiratnamidaṁ dattaṁ vaidehyāḥ śvaśureṇa me
vadhūkāle yathā baddhamadhikaṁ mūrdhni śobhate

translations.english: This jewel was conferred on Sītā by my father-in-law at the time of our wedding, and to enhance its beauty, she wore it on her head.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं हि जलसंभूतो मणिः प्रवरपूजितः
यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ hi jalasaṁbhūto maṇiḥ pravarapūjitaḥ
yajñe paramatuṣṭena dattaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā

translations.english: And this jewel, obtained from the bed of the ocean, was conferred on him (Janaka) by the intelligent Sakra, greatly delighted for being adored in a sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
इमं दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं तथा तातस्य दर्शनम्
अद्यास्म्यवगतः सौम्य वैदेहस्य तथा विभोः
verses.transliteration:
imaṁ dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṁ tathā tātasya darśanam
adyāsmyavagataḥ saumya vaidehasya tathā vibhoḥ

translations.english: O gentle one, this bring back to my mind, the memory of my father, and father-in-law the king of Videha.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं हि शोभते तस्याः प्रियाया मूर्ध्नि मे मणिः
अद्यास्य दर्शनेनाहं प्राप्तां तामिव चिन्तये
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ hi śobhate tasyāḥ priyāyā mūrdhni me maṇiḥ
adyāsya darśanenāhaṁ prāptāṁ tāmiva cintaye

translations.english: This excellent jewel appeared beautiful on the crown of my dear one, and methinks, on beholding it, I have as if got back my beloved spouse.

verses.sanskrit:
किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः
परासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ती वाक्यवारिणा
verses.transliteration:
kimāha sītā vaidehī brūhi saumya punaḥ punaḥ
parāsumiva toyena siñcantī vākyavāriṇā

translations.english: Do you relate to me again and again, O gentle one what Vaidehi has said, as if sprinkling me with the water of her words like to one rendered senseless.

verses.sanskrit:
इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसंभवम्
मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतं विना
verses.transliteration:
itastu kiṁ duḥkhataraṁ yadimaṁ vārisaṁbhavam
maṇiṁ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīmāgataṁ vinā

translations.english: What greater grief can there be, O Saumitri, that I behold the jewel obtained from the ocean but not Vaidehi.?

verses.sanskrit:
चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति
क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम्
verses.transliteration:
ciraṁ jīvati vaidehī yadi māsaṁ dhariṣyati
kṣaṇaṁ saumya na jīveyaṁ vinā tāmasitekṣaṇām

translations.english: Truly dose Vaidehī live for a long time if she breathes for a month. But O hero, I cannot live blue eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया
न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च
verses.transliteration:
naya māmapi taṁ deśaṁ yatra dṛṣṭā mama priyā
na tiṣṭheyaṁ kṣaṇamapi pravṛttimupalabhya ca

translations.english: Do you take me there where you had beheld iny dear spouse. I cannot live for a moment while I have received intelligence about her.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं सा मम सुश्रोणि भीरु भीरुः सती तदा
भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ sā mama suśroṇi bhīru bhīruḥ satī tadā
bhayāvahānāṁ ghorāṇāṁ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām

translations.english: How live that timid damsel, having a beautiful waist, being terrified, amidst the terrible and grim Raksasis?

verses.sanskrit:
शारदस्तिमिरोन्मुखो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः
आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration:
śāradastimironmukho nūnaṁ candra ivāmbudaiḥ
āvṛtaṁ vadanaṁ tasyā na virājati rākṣasaiḥ

translations.english: Truly her countenance is not appearing beautiful like to the autumnal moon, enveloped with clouds, although cleared off the darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
किमाह सीता हनुमंस्तत्त्वतः कथयस्व मे
एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा
verses.transliteration:
kimāha sītā hanumaṁstattvataḥ kathayasva me
etena khalu jīviṣye bheṣajenāturo yathā

translations.english: Do you relate to me in sooth, O Hanuman, what Şītā has spoken to you. I shall live by these words, as the sick are cured by medicine.

verses.sanskrit:
मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी
मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन्कथयस्व मे
दुःखाद्दुःखतरं प्राप्य कथं जीवति जानकी
verses.transliteration:
madhurā madhurālāpā kimāha mama bhāminī
madvihīnā varārohā hanumankathayasva me
duḥkhādduḥkhataraṁ prāpya kathaṁ jīvati jānakī

translations.english: O Hanumān, what has my dear wife, sweetspeeched, and highly beautiful, spoken to you, being separated form me? How breathes she going through a series of calamities?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्राघवेण महात्मना
सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu hanumānrāghaveṇa mahātmanā
sītāyā bhāṣitaṁ sarvaṁ nyavedayata rāghave

translations.english: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Rāghava, Hanumān, related to him all of what Sita had said,

verses.sanskrit:
इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ
पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथा तथम्
verses.transliteration:
idamuktavatī devī jānakī puruṣarṣabha
pūrvavṛttamabhijñānaṁ citrakūṭe yathā tatham

translations.english: O foremost of men, the worshipful Jānaki, related as a token, all the incidents at the Mount Citrakūta from the beginning to the end.

verses.sanskrit:
सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता
वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विरराद स्तनान्तरे
verses.transliteration:
sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṁ jānakī pūrvamutthitā
vāyasaḥ sahasotpatya virarāda stanāntare

translations.english: Sleeping happily with you, Janaki one day awoke before, and in the meantime, a crow wounded her breast with its beaks.

verses.sanskrit:
पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज
पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम्
verses.transliteration:
paryāyeṇa ca suptastvaṁ devyaṅke bharatāgraja
punaśca kila pakṣī sa devyā janayati vyathām

translations.english: O Rāma, you wert then asleep on Sītā's lap and that crow again afflicted the worshipful dame.

verses.sanskrit:
वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया
बोधितः किल देव्यास्त्वं सुखसुप्तः परंतप
verses.transliteration:
vāyasena ca tenaiva satataṁ bādhyamānayā
bodhitaḥ kila devyāstvaṁ sukhasuptaḥ paraṁtapa

translations.english: And it again wounded her. And being bathed in blood and suffering terrible pangs, that worshipful dame aroused you.

verses.sanskrit:
तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो रादितां च स्तनान्तरे
आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho rāditāṁ ca stanāntare
āśīviṣa iva kruddho niḥśvasannabhyabhāṣathāḥ

translations.english: O slayer of foes, O you of mighty-arms, seeing her breast wounded, you, wroth like a serpent, didst speak saying.

verses.sanskrit:
नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम्
कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना
verses.transliteration:
nakhāgraiḥ kena te bhīru dāritaṁ tu stanāntaram
kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā

translations.english: O timid damsel, who, with his nails, has wounded your breast? Who has played with an angry serpent having five faces?

verses.sanskrit:
निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षताः
नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā vāyasaṁ samavaikṣatāḥ
nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇairmāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam

translations.english: Casting your looks around you didst behold a crow facing the worshipful dame with sharpened nails besmeared with blood.

verses.sanskrit:
सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः
धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः
verses.transliteration:
sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ
dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ

translations.english: That crow, the best of the birds, was Sakra's son. And it entered speedily into the earth with the velocity of the wind,

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः
वायसे त्वं कृत्वाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर
verses.transliteration:
tatastasminmahābāho kopasaṁvartitekṣaṇaḥ
vāyase tvaṁ kṛtvāḥ krūrāṁ matiṁ matimatāṁ vara

translations.english: Thereupon, your eyes rolling with ire, you, O mighty armed hero, O foremost of the intelligent, did resolve to destroy that crow.

verses.sanskrit:
स दर्भं संस्तराद्गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण न्ययोजयः
स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम्
verses.transliteration:
sa darbhaṁ saṁstarādgṛhya brahmāstreṇa nyayojayaḥ
sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam

translations.english: Taking a kusa off your seat you did set it on Brahma weapon. And it flamed like to the fire of desolation before that crow.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति
ततस्तु वायसं दीप्तः स दर्भोऽनुजगाम ह
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ pradīptaṁ cikṣepa darbhaṁ taṁ vāyasaṁ prati
tatastu vāyasaṁ dīptaḥ sa darbho'nujagāma ha

translations.english: You did let off that burning Kuśa towards that birds. And there upon that burning Kuća followed the crow.

verses.sanskrit:
स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैः सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः
त्रीँल्लोकान्संपरिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ
trī̐llokānsaṁparikramya trātāraṁ nādhigacchati

translations.english: And being forsaken even by the celestials, who were terrified, and ransacking the three worlds it did not get a refuge.

verses.sanskrit:
तं त्वं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम्
वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया परिपालयः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tvaṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam
vadhārhamapi kākutstha kṛpayā paripālayaḥ

translations.english: And, placing himself on the earth, he sought his shelter, and Kākutstha, out of mercy, saved him, albeit worthy of being killed.

verses.sanskrit:
मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव
ततस्तस्याक्षिकाकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration:
moghamastraṁ na śakyaṁ tu kartumityeva rāghava
tatastasyākṣikākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam

translations.english: And thinking if improper to baffle the aim of the weapon, you didst, O Rāghava, destroy the right eye of the crow.

verses.sanskrit:
राम त्वां स नमस्कृत्वा राज्ञो दशरथस्य च
विसृष्टस्तु तदा काकः प्रतिपेदे खमालयम्
verses.transliteration:
rāma tvāṁ sa namaskṛtvā rājño daśarathasya ca
visṛṣṭastu tadā kākaḥ pratipede khamālayam

translations.english: Thereupon bowing to you and the king Dasaratha, that crow, bidding adieu, went to its quarter.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्त्ववाञ्शीलवानपि
किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षःसु न योजयसि राघव
verses.transliteration:
evamastravidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sattvavāñśīlavānapi
kimarthamastraṁ rakṣaḥsu na yojayasi rāghava

translations.english: O Rāghava, you are the foremost of those skilled in the use of weapons, powerful and gifted with an excellent character, why do you not discharge weapons towards the Rākşasas?

verses.sanskrit:
न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः
तव राम मुखे स्थातुं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुम्
verses.transliteration:
na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ
tava rāma mukhe sthātuṁ śaktāḥ pratisamādhitum

translations.english: The celestials, the Gandharvas, the Asuras, the Marutas-none of them is qualified, O Rāma, to equal you in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
तव वीर्यवतः कच्चिन्मयि यद्यस्ति संभ्रमः
क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः
verses.transliteration:
tava vīryavataḥ kaccinmayi yadyasti saṁbhramaḥ
kṣipraṁ suniśitairbāṇairhanyatāṁ yudhi rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: If you, gifted with great prowess, had any armed shafts, destroy Rāvana in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परंतपः
स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः
verses.transliteration:
bhrāturādeśamādāya lakṣmaṇo vā paraṁtapaḥ
sa kimarthaṁ naravaro na māṁ rakṣati rāghavaḥ

translations.english: And obtaining the behests of his brother, why dose not Lakşmaņa, the subduer of foes and best of men, protect me, O Rāghava?

verses.sanskrit:
शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ
सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः
verses.transliteration:
śaktau tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau
surāṇāmapi durdharṣau kimarthaṁ māmupekṣataḥ

translations.english: Those two best of men, gifted with the effulgence of Wind and Fire, and incapable of being repressed even by the celestials, are disregarding me.

verses.sanskrit:
ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः
समर्थौ सहितौ यन्मां नापेक्षेते परंतपौ
verses.transliteration:
mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ
samarthau sahitau yanmāṁ nāpekṣete paraṁtapau

translations.english: Forsooth have I perpetrated a mighty iniquity since those two slayers of foes, being capable, do not protect me.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे
रामे दुःखाभिभूते च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते
verses.transliteration:
tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape
rāme duḥkhābhibhūte ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate

translations.english: O exalted one, I swear by truth, Rāma turn away he countenance (from every work) in consequence of grief for you. And Rāma being seized with sorrow, Laksmana burns in grief.

verses.sanskrit:
कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम्
इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum
imaṁ muhūrtaṁ duḥkhānāmantaṁ drakṣyasi bhāmini

translations.english: It dose not behove you to relent any more as I have succeeded in finding you out. You shall at this very moment behold the end of your grief.

verses.sanskrit:
तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ
त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः
verses.transliteration:
tāvubhau naraśārdūlau rājaputrāvariṁdamau
tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṁ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ

translations.english: And those two princes, the foremost of men and slayers of foes, actuated with energy on hearing that I have seen you, shall reduce Lankā to ashes.

verses.sanskrit:
हत्वा च समरे रौद्रं रावणं सह बान्धवम्
राघवस्त्वां महाबाहुः स्वां पुरीं नयते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration:
hatvā ca samare raudraṁ rāvaṇaṁ saha bāndhavam
rāghavastvāṁ mahābāhuḥ svāṁ purīṁ nayate dhruvam

translations.english: And slaying in conflict the terrible Rāvaņa, with his kith and kin, Rāghava, in sooth, O excellent damsel, shall take you back to his own city.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते
प्रीतिसंजननं तस्य प्रदातुं तत्त्वमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yattu rāmo vijānīyādabhijñānamanindite
prītisaṁjananaṁ tasya pradātuṁ tattvamarhasi

translations.english: O you of a blameless person, do you confer on me such a token, as might be recognized by Ráma and conduce to his pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
साभिवीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा वेण्युद्ग्रथनमुत्तमम्
मुक्त्वा वस्त्राद्ददौ मह्यं मणिमेतं महाबल
verses.transliteration:
sābhivīkṣya diśaḥ sarvā veṇyudgrathanamuttamam
muktvā vastrāddadau mahyaṁ maṇimetaṁ mahābala

translations.english: Thereat, casting her looks around, she took out an excellent jewel from her cloth, worthy of being set on her braid and conferred it on me, O you of great strength.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दिव्यं तव हेतो रघूत्तम
शिरसा संप्रणम्यैनामहमागमने त्वरे
verses.transliteration:
pratigṛhya maṇiṁ divyaṁ tava heto raghūttama
śirasā saṁpraṇamyaināmahamāgamane tvare

translations.english: O you, the most favourite of the Raghu race, taking for you that gem with my hands and bowing to her, I addressed myself speedily for departure.

verses.sanskrit:
गमने च कृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य वरवर्णिनी
विवर्धमानं च हि मामुवाच जनकात्मजा
अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पसंदिग्धभाषिणी
verses.transliteration:
gamane ca kṛtotsāhamavekṣya varavarṇinī
vivardhamānaṁ ca hi māmuvāca janakātmajā
aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpasaṁdigdhabhāṣiṇī

translations.english: Thereupon beholding me ready to depart and increase in bulk and about to leap up in the welkin, Sītā, the daughter of the king Janaka, poorly, bathed in tears, overwhelmed with sorrow and having her voice choked with grief, saying 'Blessed are you O great monkey, since you shall behold the large-armed and the lotuseyed Ráma and the highly famed Lakşmaņa, my lord's younger brother.

verses.sanskrit:
हनुमन्सिंहसंकाशौ तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं सर्वान्ब्रूया अनामयम्
verses.transliteration:
hanumansiṁhasaṁkāśau tāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau
sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātyaṁ sarvānbrūyā anāmayam

translations.english: Addressing me with these words she again said-O Hanuman, do you relate my well-being to Rāma and Lakshamana of leonine prowess, and Sugrīva accompanied by his followers.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः
अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्तत्समाधातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yathā ca sa mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ
asmādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttatsamādhātumarhasi

translations.english: Do you so describe as the large-armed Rāghava may save me from this ocean of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं; रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च
ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं; शिवश्च तेऽध्वास्तु हरिप्रवीर
verses.transliteration:
imaṁ ca tīvraṁ mama śokavegaṁ; rakṣobhirebhiḥ paribhartsanaṁ ca
brūyāstu rāmasya gataḥ samīpaṁ; śivaśca te'dhvāstu haripravīra

translations.english: Do you narrate to Rāma this my terrible sorrow and the affliction by the she-demons. May good betide you, on your way, O foremost of the monkeys.'

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तवार्या नृपराजसिंह; सीता वचः प्राह विषादपूर्वम्
एतच्च बुद्ध्वा गदितं मया त्वं; श्रद्धत्स्व सीतां कुशलां समग्राम्
verses.transliteration:
etattavāryā nṛparājasiṁha; sītā vacaḥ prāha viṣādapūrvam
etacca buddhvā gaditaṁ mayā tvaṁ; śraddhatsva sītāṁ kuśalāṁ samagrām

translations.english: Thus the worshipful Sítă gave vent to these piteous accents. Hearing these words do you believe that it is all well with her.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्तः ससंभ्रमम्
तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्यादनुमान्य च
verses.transliteration:
athāhamuttaraṁ devyā punaruktaḥ sasaṁbhramam
tava snehānnaravyāghra sauhāryādanumānya ca

translations.english: Thereupon, O foremost of men, out of your love and adoring me for your friendship, that worshipful dame-addressed me again, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया
यथा मामाप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ vācyo rāmo dāśarathistvayā
yathā māmāpnuyācchīghraṁ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave

translations.english: Do you thus speak every thing to Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, so that he might soon take me hence, slaying Ravana in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिंदम
कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamariṁdama
kasmiṁścitsaṁvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi

translations.english: O hero, O slayer of foes, if it please you, you may relieve yourself of the toil by living in a secret nook and then proceed to-morrow.

verses.sanskrit:
मम चाप्यल्पभाग्यायाः साम्निध्यात्तव वानर
अस्य शोकविपाकस्य मुहूर्तं स्याद्विमोक्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
mama cāpyalpabhāgyāyāḥ sāmnidhyāttava vānara
asya śokavipākasya muhūrtaṁ syādvimokṣaṇam

translations.english: O monkey, in your company, I do momentarily forget the weight of my grief, unfortunate as I am.

verses.sanskrit:
गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै
प्राणानामपि संदेहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
gate hi tvayi vikrānte punarāgamanāya vai
prāṇānāmapi saṁdeho mama syānnātra saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: O you gifted with great prowess, yourself departing, I shall wait for your return, but doubt I very much whether I shall live till then.

verses.sanskrit:
तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत्
दुःखाद्दुःखपराभूतां दुर्गतां दुःखभागिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṁ paritāpayet
duḥkhādduḥkhaparābhūtāṁ durgatāṁ duḥkhabhāginīm

translations.english: Burnt I shall be with the fear of not beholding you again, wretched and stricken with grief as I am. And so I shall be, hereafter, overwhelmed with a mightier grief.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने
शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य वायोर्वा तव वानघ
verses.transliteration:
trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane
śaktiḥ syādvainateyasya vāyorvā tava vānagha

translations.english: O innocent monkey of all the creatures three only are qualified to cross over the ocean, yourself, Garuda and the Wind.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्मिन्कार्यनियोगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे
किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वर
verses.transliteration:
tadasminkāryaniyoge vīraivaṁ duratikrame
kiṁ paśyasi samādhānaṁ brūhi kāryavidāṁ vara

translations.english: O you foremost of those skilled in speech, what had you settled about the accomplishment of this hard work?

verses.sanskrit:
काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने
पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः
verses.transliteration:
kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane
paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ

translations.english: Or you alone, O destroyer of hostile heroes, are quite enough for the fulfilment of this purpose; and you shall reap, in the shape of fame, the fruit of your achievement.

verses.sanskrit:
बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां हत्वा रावणमाहवे
विजयी स्वां पुरीं रामो नयेत्तत्स्याद्यशस्करम्
verses.transliteration:
balaiḥ samagrairyadi māṁ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave
vijayī svāṁ purīṁ rāmo nayettatsyādyaśaskaram

translations.english: But if Rāma, obtaining victory, can take me hence to his own city, it shall redound to his glory.

verses.sanskrit:
यथाहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता
रक्षसा तद्भयादेव तथा नार्हति राघवः
verses.transliteration:
yathāhaṁ tasya vīrasya vanādupadhinā hṛtā
rakṣasā tadbhayādeva tathā nārhati rāghavaḥ

translations.english: It dose not behove the heroic Rāghava, to take me away by steal, like to Rāvaņa capturing me from the forest under a disguise.

verses.sanskrit:
बलैस्तु संकुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः
मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
balaistu saṁkulāṁ kṛtvā laṅkāṁ parabalārdanaḥ
māṁ nayedyadi kākutsthastattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet

translations.english: But if blocking up Lankā with his forces, that afflictor of enemies, Kākutstha, take me (from hence), then that shall be worthy of him.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः
भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय
verses.transliteration:
tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ
bhavatyāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya

translations.english: Therefore do you so order things that powerful and high-souled hero in conflict, may act as becomes himself.

verses.sanskrit:
तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम्
निशम्याहं ततः शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रुवम्
verses.transliteration:
tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ praśritaṁ hetusaṁhitam
niśamyāhaṁ tataḥ śeṣaṁ vākyamuttaramabruvam

translations.english: Hearing these sound reasonable and affectionate words I gave her the last reply, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः
सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसंपन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration:
devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ
sugrīvaḥ sattvasaṁpannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ

translations.english: O revered lady, that foremost of monkeysthe lord of bears and monkeys-Sugrīva, possessed of truth, has made up his mind on your behalf.

verses.sanskrit:
येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक्सज्जते गतिः
न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration:
yeṣāṁ nopari nādhastānna tiryaksajjate gatiḥ
na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ

translations.english: And exceedingly powerful and mighty monkeys possessed of prowess, and speeding far with the rapidity of thought, are in his command. Nothing can impede their courses, either upward, or downward, or tending in both directions, and those ones of measureless energy never experience depression in the most arduous undertakings.

verses.sanskrit:
असकृत्तैर्महाभागैर्वानरैर्बलसंयुतैः
प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः
verses.transliteration:
asakṛttairmahābhāgairvānarairbalasaṁyutaiḥ
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmirvāyumārgānusāribhiḥ

translations.english: And those great and powerful monkeys, coursing in the air, have again and again circumambulated the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः
मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ
mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasaṁnidhau

translations.english: Sugriva has many monkeys-my equal-and greater than I but none of inferior strength.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः
न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṁ punaste mahābalāḥ
na hi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ

translations.english: While I have crossed over the main-what of these mighty heroes? The leading heroes are never sent on a mission but only those of inferior merit.

verses.sanskrit:
तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युर्व्यपैतु ते
एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
tadalaṁ paritāpena devi manyurvyapaitu te
ekotpātena te laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: No more of bewailing, O worshipful dame. Do you remove your grief. And with one leap these leaders of monkey-hosts shall reach Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ
त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः
verses.transliteration:
mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau
tvatsakāśaṁ mahābhāge nṛsiṁhāvāgamiṣyataḥ

translations.english: O great damsel, these two princes, placing themselves on my back shall come to you like to the rising Sun and Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
अरिघ्नं सिंहसंकाशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्
लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्का द्वारमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
arighnaṁ siṁhasaṁkāśaṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam
lakṣmaṇaṁ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṁ laṅkā dvāramupasthitam

translations.english: You shall soon behold before Lanka's gate Rāghava the slayer of foes resembling a lion and Lakşmana with a bow in his hand.

verses.sanskrit:
नखदंष्ट्रायुधान्वीरान्सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्
वानरान्वानरेन्द्राभान्क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि संगतान्
verses.transliteration:
nakhadaṁṣṭrāyudhānvīrānsiṁhaśārdūlavikramān
vānarānvānarendrābhānkṣipraṁ drakṣyasi saṁgatān

translations.english: You shall soon observe in a band the heroic monkeys, gifted with the strength of lions and tigers, and having nails and teeth for their weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
शैलाम्बुदन्निकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु
नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामचिराच्छोष्यसे स्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
śailāmbudannikāśānāṁ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu
nardatāṁ kapimukhyānāmacirācchoṣyase svanam

translations.english: You shall soon bear the roaring of the leading monkeys on the summit of mount Malaya, resembling the muttering of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिंदमम्
अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
nivṛttavanavāsaṁ ca tvayā sārdhamariṁdamam
abhiṣiktamayodhyāyāṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam

translations.english: You shall soon behold Rāghava, the slayer of foes, installed along with you on the throne of Ayodhya after returning from the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मया वाग्भिरदीनभाषिणी; शिवाभिरिष्टाभिरभिप्रसादिता
जगाम शान्तिं मम मैथिलात्मजा; तवापि शोकेन तथाभिपीडिता
verses.transliteration:
tato mayā vāgbhiradīnabhāṣiṇī; śivābhiriṣṭābhirabhiprasāditā
jagāma śāntiṁ mama maithilātmajā; tavāpi śokena tathābhipīḍitā

translations.english: That daughter of the king of Mithilā although heavily laden with sorrow in your absence was greatly comforted and pleased by my auspicious words boding the fulfilment of her desire.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं यथावदभिभाषितम्
रामः प्रीतिसमायुक्तो वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ yathāvadabhibhāṣitam
rāmaḥ prītisamāyukto vākyamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of Hanumän rehearsed properly, Rāma, exceedingly delighted, said.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं हनुमता कार्यं सुमहद्भुवि दुष्करम्
मनसापि यदन्येन न शक्यं धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ hanumatā kāryaṁ sumahadbhuvi duṣkaram
manasāpi yadanyena na śakyaṁ dharaṇītale

translations.english: By Hanumān has been performed a very great deed, rare on earth, and one incapable of being even conceived by any other in the world.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि तं परिपश्यामि यस्तरेत महार्णवम्
अन्यत्र गरुणाद्वायोरन्यत्र च हनूमतः
verses.transliteration:
na hi taṁ paripaśyāmi yastareta mahārṇavam
anyatra garuṇādvāyoranyatra ca hanūmataḥ

translations.english: Save Garuda and the Wind-god, and save also Hanumān, him find I not who cross the wide ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्
अप्रधृष्यां पुरीं लङ्कां रावणेन सुरक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration:
devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ gandharvoragarakṣasām
apradhṛṣyāṁ purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇena surakṣitām

translations.english: Entering by main force the city of Larkā, incapable of being subjugated by the gods and Dänavas and Yaksas, the Gandharvas, serpents or Raksasas, and well protected by Ravana, who, living, come out (of it)?

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविष्टः सत्त्वमाश्रित्य जीवन्को नाम निष्क्रमेत्
को विशेत्सुदुराधर्षां राक्षसैश्च सुरक्षिताम्
यो वीर्यबलसंपन्नो न समः स्याद्धनूमतः
verses.transliteration:
praviṣṭaḥ sattvamāśritya jīvanko nāma niṣkramet
ko viśetsudurādharṣāṁ rākṣasaiśca surakṣitām
yo vīryabalasaṁpanno na samaḥ syāddhanūmataḥ

translations.english: Who that is not the compeer of Hanuman in strength and prowess, even enters into (Lankā) hard to subdue, and carefully guarded by the Raksasas?

verses.sanskrit:
भृत्यकार्यं हनुमता सुग्रीवस्य कृतं महत्
एवं विधाय स्वबलं सदृशं विक्रमस्य च
verses.transliteration:
bhṛtyakāryaṁ hanumatā sugrīvasya kṛtaṁ mahat
evaṁ vidhāya svabalaṁ sadṛśaṁ vikramasya ca

translations.english: Having put forth his strength commensurate with his prowess, Hanuman has also performed a great act befitting a servant on behold of Sugriva.* SO *Having seen Sītā, which was all that he had been commissioned to do by Sugrīva, Hanumān has destroyed Räkşasas and burnt Lankā; and this he did of himself like a good servant.

verses.sanskrit:
यो हि भृत्यो नियुक्तः सन्भर्त्रा कर्मणि दुष्करे
कुर्यात्तदनुरागेण तमाहुः पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
yo hi bhṛtyo niyuktaḥ sanbhartrā karmaṇi duṣkare
kuryāttadanurāgeṇa tamāhuḥ puruṣottamam

translations.english: That servant who, being entrusted with a hard task, after having accomplished it, do another work in pursuance of (the prescribed business), is the best of men.

verses.sanskrit:
नियुक्तो नृपतेः कार्यं न कुर्याद्यः समाहितः
भृत्यो युक्तः समर्थश्च तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम्
verses.transliteration:
niyukto nṛpateḥ kāryaṁ na kuryādyaḥ samāhitaḥ
bhṛtyo yuktaḥ samarthaśca tamāhuḥ puruṣādhamam

translations.english: That servant who, entrusted with any work of the king do not, although competent, heedfully accomplish the same, has been called the worst.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्नियोगे नियुक्तेन कृतं कृत्यं हनूमता
न चात्मा लघुतां नीतः सुग्रीवश्चापि तोषितः
verses.transliteration:
tanniyoge niyuktena kṛtaṁ kṛtyaṁ hanūmatā
na cātmā laghutāṁ nītaḥ sugrīvaścāpi toṣitaḥ

translations.english: Anent the order (which he had received), Hanuman has done the work (and more). He has not been humbled,* and, further, he has pleased Sugriva. *By the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं च रघुवंशश्च लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः
वैदेह्या दर्शनेनाद्य धर्मतः परिरक्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ ca raghuvaṁśaśca lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
vaidehyā darśanenādya dharmataḥ parirakṣitāḥ

translations.english: And by seeing Vaidehī, (Hanumān) has, while reaping righteousness, saved me, the Raghu race, and the highly powerful Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं तु मम दीनस्या मनो भूयः प्रकर्षति
यदिहास्य प्रियाख्यातुर्न कुर्मि सदृशं प्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ tu mama dīnasyā mano bhūyaḥ prakarṣati
yadihāsya priyākhyāturna kurmi sadṛśaṁ priyam

translations.english: This pain my mind sore, that I cannot do a like benefit, returning this dear office of his.

verses.sanskrit:
एष सर्वस्वभूतस्तु परिष्वङ्गो हनूमतः
मया कालमिमं प्राप्य दत्तस्तस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa sarvasvabhūtastu pariṣvaṅgo hanūmataḥ
mayā kālamimaṁ prāpya dattastasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Embrace express the all (of the Deicy),* and, finding this occasion, I extend my embrace to the high-souled Hanumān. *The commentator explains this obscure passage after his own orthodox fashion. The gist is this. Delight is the essence of the Deity, and all His incarnations body forth this. Embrace is typical of this emotion.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा सुकृतं तावत्सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्
सागरं तु समासाद्य पुनर्नष्टं मनो मम
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā sukṛtaṁ tāvatsītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam
sāgaraṁ tu samāsādya punarnaṣṭaṁ mano mama

translations.english: Complete success has been attained anent the search of Sītā. But when I think of the ocean, my mind is again sunk in dejection.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं नाम समुद्रस्य दुष्पारस्य महाम्भसः
हरयो दक्षिणं पारं गमिष्यन्ति समाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ nāma samudrasya duṣpārasya mahāmbhasaḥ
harayo dakṣiṇaṁ pāraṁ gamiṣyanti samāhitāḥ

translations.english: How can the assembled monkeys go over to the southern shore of the vastly deep, difficult to cross?

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्येष तु वृत्तान्तो वैदेह्या गदितो मम
समुद्रपारगमने हरीणां किमिवोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
yadyapyeṣa tu vṛttānto vaidehyā gadito mama
samudrapāragamane harīṇāṁ kimivottaram

translations.english: This tidings you have related to me touching Vaidehī; but what are the monkeys to do next avout crossing the sea?

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा शोकसंभ्रान्तो रामः शत्रुनिबर्हणः
हनूमन्तं महाबाहुस्ततो ध्यानमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā śokasaṁbhrānto rāmaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
hanūmantaṁ mahābāhustato dhyānamupāgamat

translations.english: Having said this to Hanumān, that slayer of foes, the mighty-armed Rāma, agitated by anxiety, was then plunged in thought.

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु शोकपरिद्यूनं रामं दशरथात्मजम्
उवाच वचनं श्रीमान्सुग्रीवः शोकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu śokaparidyūnaṁ rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam
uvāca vacanaṁ śrīmānsugrīvaḥ śokanāśanam

translations.english: Then the graceful Sugrīva spoke words capable of soothing sorrow, to Dasaratha's son, Rāma, who was wrought up with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
किं त्वं संतप्यसे वीर यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा
मैवं भूस्त्यज संतापं कृतघ्न इव सौहृदम्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tvaṁ saṁtapyase vīra yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā
maivaṁ bhūstyaja saṁtāpaṁ kṛtaghna iva sauhṛdam

translations.english: Why, O hero, does you grieve, like one that is base? Let not this be so. Chase away you grief, even as an ingrate resign amity.

verses.sanskrit:
संतापस्य च ते स्थानं न हि पश्यामि राघव
प्रवृत्तावुपलब्धायां ज्ञाते च निलये रिपोः
verses.transliteration:
saṁtāpasya ca te sthānaṁ na hi paśyāmi rāghava
pravṛttāvupalabdhāyāṁ jñāte ca nilaye ripoḥ

translations.english: Nor, O Rāghava, when the whereabouts of Sītă has been discovered, and when too the abode itself of the foe has been known, do I perceive the reason of your sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतिमाञ्शास्त्रवित्प्राज्ञः पण्डितश्चासि राघव
त्यजेमां पापिकां बुद्धिं कृत्वात्मेवार्थदूषणीम्
verses.transliteration:
dhṛtimāñśāstravitprājñaḥ paṇḍitaścāsi rāghava
tyajemāṁ pāpikāṁ buddhiṁ kṛtvātmevārthadūṣaṇīm

translations.english: You, O Raghava, are intelligent, conversant with learning, wise, and judicious. Do you cast away this sorry way of thinking, even as a selfcontrolled (ascetic) caste away any course of thought interfering with the attainment of his purpose.

verses.sanskrit:
समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा तु महानक्रसमाकुलम्
लङ्कामारोहयिष्यामो हनिष्यामश्च ते रिपुम्
verses.transliteration:
samudraṁ laṅghayitvā tu mahānakrasamākulam
laṅkāmārohayiṣyāmo haniṣyāmaśca te ripum

translations.english: Crossing over the ocean swarming with gigantic alligators, we shall enter Lankā and slay the enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
निरुत्साहस्य दीनस्य शोकपर्याकुलात्मनः
सर्वार्था व्यवसीदन्ति व्यसनं चाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
nirutsāhasya dīnasya śokaparyākulātmanaḥ
sarvārthā vyavasīdanti vyasanaṁ cādhigacchati

translations.english: Of a person that is dispirited and poor in pluck and that has his soul overwhelmed with grief, every interest droops, and he comes by misfortunes (one after another).

verses.sanskrit:
इमे शूराः समर्थाश्च सर्वे नो हरियूथपाः
त्वत्प्रियार्थं कृतोत्साहाः प्रवेष्टुमपि पावकम्
verses.transliteration:
ime śūrāḥ samarthāśca sarve no hariyūthapāḥ
tvatpriyārthaṁ kṛtotsāhāḥ praveṣṭumapi pāvakam

translations.english: All these heroes, these leaders of monkeyhordes, who are ardent for they welfare, are competent to enter into fire itself. From their cheerful attitude I know this, and firm is my faith.

verses.sanskrit:
एषां हर्षेण जानामि तर्कश्चास्मिन्दृढो मम
विक्रमेण समानेष्ये सीतां हत्वा यथा रिपुम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣāṁ harṣeṇa jānāmi tarkaścāsmindṛḍho mama
vikrameṇa samāneṣye sītāṁ hatvā yathā ripum

translations.english: It behove you so to arrange things that, slaying the foe, Rāvana of impious acts, we may bring higher Sītā by our own prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
