translations.english: All the Devarsis and Gandharvas wish for (Rāma's) victory. Therefore, do not enter into hostilities with him; but do you bend your mind to the conclusion of peace with him.

verses.sanskrit:
असृजद्भगवान्पक्षौ द्वावेव हि पितामहः
सुराणामसुराणां च धर्माधर्मौ तदाश्रयौ
verses.transliteration:
asṛjadbhagavānpakṣau dvāveva hi pitāmahaḥ
surāṇāmasurāṇāṁ ca dharmādharmau tadāśrayau

translations.english: That possessor of the six attributes, the Greatfather, has appointed two courses, (respectively) for the Asuras and the celestials, having for their eousness.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मो हि श्रूयते पक्षः सुराणां च महात्मनाम्
अधर्मो रक्षसं पक्षो ह्यसुराणां च रावण
verses.transliteration:
dharmo hi śrūyate pakṣaḥ surāṇāṁ ca mahātmanām
adharmo rakṣasaṁ pakṣo hyasurāṇāṁ ca rāvaṇa

translations.english: Righteousness, we hear, is the course of the high-souled celestials, as, O. Rākşasa, unrighteousness is that of Rākşasa and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मो वै ग्रसतेऽधर्मं ततः कृतमभूद्युगम्
अधर्मो ग्रसते धर्मं ततस्तिष्यः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
dharmo vai grasate'dharmaṁ tataḥ kṛtamabhūdyugam
adharmo grasate dharmaṁ tatastiṣyaḥ pravartate

translations.english: During the Kţta Yuga, righteousness swallow up sin; and during Tisya,* unrighteousness swallow up virtue. *The Kali Yuga.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वया चरता लोकान्धर्मो विनिहतो महान्
अधर्मः प्रगृहीतश्च तेनास्मद्बलिनः परे
verses.transliteration:
tattvayā caratā lokāndharmo vinihato mahān
adharmaḥ pragṛhītaśca tenāsmadbalinaḥ pare

translations.english: You, ranging the three worlds, worlds, had extinguished pregnant piety, and reaped unrighteousness; and it is for this that your foes have waxed potent. *While ranging the three worlds on a career of conquest, you didst, disturbing sacrifices, etc., wrong righteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रमादाद्विवृद्धस्तेऽधर्मोऽहिर्ग्रसते हि नः
विवर्धयति पक्षं च सुराणां सुरभावनः
verses.transliteration:
sa pramādādvivṛddhaste'dharmo'hirgrasate hi naḥ
vivardhayati pakṣaṁ ca surāṇāṁ surabhāvanaḥ

translations.english: Having grown through through your your neglect, unrighteousness devour us, and that protector of the gods, (righteousness), is strengthening the side of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
विषयेषु प्रसक्तेन यत्किंचित्कारिणा त्वया
ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामुद्वेगो जनितो महान्
तेषां प्रभावो दुर्धर्षः प्रदीप्त इव पावकः
verses.transliteration:
viṣayeṣu prasaktena yatkiṁcitkāriṇā tvayā
ṛṣīṇāmagnikalpānāmudvego janito mahān
teṣāṁ prabhāvo durdharṣaḥ pradīpta iva pāvakaḥ

translations.english: You, addicted to carnal pleasures and acting in defiance of duty, had aroused the high wrath of the saints resembling fire.

verses.sanskrit:
तपसा भावितात्मानो धर्मस्यानुग्रहे रताः
मुख्यैर्यज्ञैर्यजन्त्येते नित्यं तैस्तैर्द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration:
tapasā bhāvitātmāno dharmasyānugrahe ratāḥ
mukhyairyajñairyajantyete nityaṁ taistairdvijātayaḥ

translations.english: The power of these possessed of souls sanctified through asceticism, and ever engaged in invoking the aid of righteousness, is incapable of being resisted and is like flaming fire.

verses.sanskrit:
जुह्वत्यग्नींश्च विधिवद्वेदांश्चोच्चैरधीयते
अभिभूय च रक्षांसि ब्रह्मघोषानुदैरयन्
दिशो विप्रद्रुताः सर्वे स्तनयित्नुरिवोष्णगे
verses.transliteration:
juhvatyagnīṁśca vidhivadvedāṁścoccairadhīyate
abhibhūya ca rakṣāṁsi brahmaghoṣānudairayan
diśo vipradrutāḥ sarve stanayitnurivoṣṇage

translations.english: The twice-born ones engage in contemplation with intent minds, offer oblations into the fire according to the ordinance, and loudly recite the Vedas. They overpower the Rākşasa, uttering the Vedas; and thereat they fly in all directions like clouds scattered in summer.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामग्निहोत्रसमुत्थितः
आदत्ते रक्षसां तेजो धूमो व्याप्य दिशो दश
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣīṇāmagnikalpānāmagnihotrasamutthitaḥ
ādatte rakṣasāṁ tejo dhūmo vyāpya diśo daśa

translations.english: The smoke that arise from the Agnihotra sacrifices of saints resembling fire, enveloping the energy of the Räkşasas, spreads over the ten cardinal quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषु तेषु च देशेषु पुण्येषु च दृढव्रतैः
चर्यमाणं तपस्तीव्रं संतापयति राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration:
teṣu teṣu ca deśeṣu puṇyeṣu ca dṛḍhavrataiḥ
caryamāṇaṁ tapastīvraṁ saṁtāpayati rākṣasān

translations.english: The fierce austerities of vow-observing saints, performed at particular sacred spots, try the Rākş asas sore.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्पातान्विविधान्दृष्ट्वा घोरान्बहुविधांस्तथा
विनाशमनुपश्यामि सर्वेषां रक्षसामहम्
verses.transliteration:
utpātānvividhāndṛṣṭvā ghorānbahuvidhāṁstathā
vināśamanupaśyāmi sarveṣāṁ rakṣasāmaham

translations.english: Witnessing various and many dire portents, I perceive the destruction of all the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
खराभिस्तनिता घोरा मेघाः प्रतिभयंकरः
शोणितेनाभिवर्षन्ति लङ्कामुष्णेन सर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
kharābhistanitā ghorā meghāḥ pratibhayaṁkaraḥ
śoṇitenābhivarṣanti laṅkāmuṣṇena sarvataḥ

translations.english: Dreadful and terrific clouds, uttering harsh sounds, are showering blood all around Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
रुदतां वाहनानां च प्रपतन्त्यस्रबिन्दवः
ध्वजा ध्वस्ता विवर्णाश्च न प्रभान्ति यथापुरम्
verses.transliteration:
rudatāṁ vāhanānāṁ ca prapatantyasrabindavaḥ
dhvajā dhvastā vivarṇāśca na prabhānti yathāpuram

translations.english: And (live) vehicles are dropping profuse tears. And all sides, covered with dust, do not appear bright as formerly.

verses.sanskrit:
व्याला गोमायवो गृध्रा वाशन्ति च सुभैरवम्
प्रविश्य लङ्कामनिशं समवायांश्च कुर्वते
verses.transliteration:
vyālā gomāyavo gṛdhrā vāśanti ca subhairavam
praviśya laṅkāmaniśaṁ samavāyāṁśca kurvate

translations.english: And beasts of prey, jackals and vultures, are emitting frightful cries, and, entering into the garden of Lankā, form themselves into bands.

verses.sanskrit:
कालिकाः पाण्डुरैर्दन्तैः प्रहसन्त्यग्रतः स्थिताः
स्त्रियः स्वप्नेषु मुष्णन्त्यो गृहाणि प्रतिभाष्य च
verses.transliteration:
kālikāḥ pāṇḍurairdantaiḥ prahasantyagrataḥ sthitāḥ
striyaḥ svapneṣu muṣṇantyo gṛhāṇi pratibhāṣya ca

translations.english: In dreams mighty dark-hued women in front of dwellings, seizing at (the furniture) thereof, and speaking inauspiciously, laugh displaying their sable teeth.

verses.sanskrit:
गृहाणां बलिकर्माणि श्वानः पर्युपभुञ्जते
खरा गोषु प्रजायन्ते मूषिका नकुलैः सह
verses.transliteration:
gṛhāṇāṁ balikarmāṇi śvānaḥ paryupabhuñjate
kharā goṣu prajāyante mūṣikā nakulaiḥ saha

translations.english: In houses dogs are feasting on the articles of worship. And cows bring forth asses, and mungooses, mice.

verses.sanskrit:
मार्जारा द्वीपिभिः सार्धं सूकराः शुनकैः सह
किंनरा राक्षसैश्चापि समेयुर्मानुषैः सह
verses.transliteration:
mārjārā dvīpibhiḥ sārdhaṁ sūkarāḥ śunakaiḥ saha
kiṁnarā rākṣasaiścāpi sameyurmānuṣaiḥ saha

translations.english: And cats are pairing with leopards, and swine with dogs, and Kinnaras with Rākşasas and human being.

verses.sanskrit:
पाण्डुरा रक्तपादाश्च विहगाः कालचोदिताः
राक्षसानां विनाशाय कपोता विचरन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
pāṇḍurā raktapādāśca vihagāḥ kālacoditāḥ
rākṣasānāṁ vināśāya kapotā vicaranti ca

translations.english: are And red-footed white sky-coursing pigeons, urged on by Doom, are going about for the destruction of the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
चीकी कूचीति वाशन्त्यः शारिका वेश्मसु स्थिताः
पतन्ति ग्रथिताश्चापि निर्जिताः कलहैषिणः
verses.transliteration:
cīkī kūcīti vāśantyaḥ śārikā veśmasu sthitāḥ
patanti grathitāścāpi nirjitāḥ kalahaiṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: And female-parrots in houses, wounded and worsted by other birds delighting in discord, are dropping down, emitting indistinct notes.

verses.sanskrit:
करालो विकटो मुण्डः पुरुषः कृष्णपिङ्गलः
कालो गृहाणि सर्वेषां काले कालेऽन्ववेक्षते
एतान्यन्यानि दुष्टानि निमित्तान्युत्पतन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
karālo vikaṭo muṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ
kālo gṛhāṇi sarveṣāṁ kāle kāle'nvavekṣate
etānyanyāni duṣṭāni nimittānyutpatanti ca

translations.english: All the birds and beasts crying (distressfully) with their faces turned towards the sun. And at dusk a frightful, withered, tawnyhued male figure, looking like Death himself, with his head shaven, peer into the houses (of people).

verses.sanskrit:
इदं वचस्तत्र निगद्य माल्यव;न्परीक्ष्य रक्षोऽधिपतेर्मनः पुनः
अनुत्तमेषूत्तमपौरुषो बली; बभूव तूष्णीं समवेक्ष्य रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ vacastatra nigadya mālyava;nparīkṣya rakṣo'dhipatermanaḥ punaḥ
anuttameṣūttamapauruṣo balī; babhūva tūṣṇīṁ samavekṣya rāvaṇam

translations.english: Having said this to that vile one, and known the intention of the lord of Rākşasa, that strong Mālyavān, of exceeding prowess, became silent, eying Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्तु माल्यवतो वाक्यं हितमुक्तं दशाननः
न मर्षयति दुष्टात्मा कालस्य वशमागतः
verses.transliteration:
tattu mālyavato vākyaṁ hitamuktaṁ daśānanaḥ
na marṣayati duṣṭātmā kālasya vaśamāgataḥ

translations.english: The Ten-necked one, come under the control of Time, did not brook the beneficial speech, spoken by Mālyavān.

verses.sanskrit:
स बद्ध्वा भ्रुकुटिं वक्त्रे क्रोधस्य वशमागतः
अमर्षात्परिवृत्ताक्षो माल्यवन्तमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa baddhvā bhrukuṭiṁ vaktre krodhasya vaśamāgataḥ
amarṣātparivṛttākṣo mālyavantamathābravīt

translations.english: Contracting his face into a frown, he, coming under the masterdom of passion, with his eyes rolling in wrath, addressed Mayavān, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
हितबुद्ध्या यदहितं वचः परुषमुच्यते
परपक्षं प्रविश्यैव नैतच्छ्रोत्रगतं मम
verses.transliteration:
hitabuddhyā yadahitaṁ vacaḥ paruṣamucyate
parapakṣaṁ praviśyaiva naitacchrotragataṁ mama

translations.english: The words which, deeming the strength of the enemy as superior, you have harshly spoken, considering it as beneficial, had never before entered my ears.

verses.sanskrit:
मानुषं कृपणं राममेकं शाखामृगाश्रयम्
समर्थं मन्यसे केन त्यक्तं पित्रा वनालयम्
verses.transliteration:
mānuṣaṁ kṛpaṇaṁ rāmamekaṁ śākhāmṛgāśrayam
samarthaṁ manyase kena tyaktaṁ pitrā vanālayam

translations.english: A (mere) man, and feeble, and alone, and having monkeys for his support, why do you deem Rāma, who has (further) been cast off by his sire, and has in consequence taken refuge in the woods, as competent (to cope with me)?

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षसामीश्वरं मां च देवतानां भयंकरम्
हीनं मां मन्यसे केन अहीनं सर्वविक्रमैः
verses.transliteration:
rakṣasāmīśvaraṁ māṁ ca devatānāṁ bhayaṁkaram
hīnaṁ māṁ manyase kena ahīnaṁ sarvavikramaiḥ

translations.english: Why do you consider me, who am the lord of the Räksasa, and feared even by the immortals, as weak and reft of all power?

verses.sanskrit:
वीरद्वेषेण वा शङ्के पक्षपातेन वा रिपोः
त्वयाहं परुषाण्युक्तः परप्रोत्साहनेन वा
verses.transliteration:
vīradveṣeṇa vā śaṅke pakṣapātena vā ripoḥ
tvayāhaṁ paruṣāṇyuktaḥ paraprotsāhanena vā

translations.english: You, I suspect, speak (thus) roughly either from jealousy of my heroism, or for inciting me.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभवन्तं पदस्थं हि परुषं कोऽभिधास्यति
पण्डितः शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञो विना प्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः
verses.transliteration:
prabhavantaṁ padasthaṁ hi paruṣaṁ ko'bhidhāsyati
paṇḍitaḥ śāstratattvajño vinā protsāhanādripoḥ

translations.english: Who that is wise and learned, ever address him roughly that is at once puissant and of (high) station, if not to spur him on?

verses.sanskrit:
आनीय च वनात्सीतां पद्महीनामिव श्रियम्
किमर्थं प्रतिदास्यामि राघवस्य भयादहम्
verses.transliteration:
ānīya ca vanātsītāṁ padmahīnāmiva śriyam
kimarthaṁ pratidāsyāmi rāghavasya bhayādaham

translations.english: Why, having brought Sītā like a Sri shorn of her lotus, shall I give her up, from fear of Rāghava?

verses.sanskrit:
वृतं वानरकोटीभिः ससुग्रीवं सलक्ष्मणम्
पश्य कैश्चिदहोभिस्त्वं राघवं निहतं मया
verses.transliteration:
vṛtaṁ vānarakoṭībhiḥ sasugrīvaṁ salakṣmaṇam
paśya kaiścidahobhistvaṁ rāghavaṁ nihataṁ mayā

translations.english: Behold Rāghava, environed by Koțis of monkeys, with Sugrīva and Lakşmaņa, slain on of these days!

verses.sanskrit:
द्वन्द्वे यस्य न तिष्ठन्ति दैवतान्यपि संयुगे
स कस्माद्रावणो युद्धे भयमाहारयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
dvandve yasya na tiṣṭhanti daivatānyapi saṁyuge
sa kasmādrāvaṇo yuddhe bhayamāhārayiṣyati

translations.english: He before whom even the gods cannot stay in the battle field, how can that Råvaņa ever come by fear?

verses.sanskrit:
द्विधा भज्येयमप्येवं न नमेयं तु कस्यचित्
एष मे सहजो दोषः स्वभावो दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
dvidhā bhajyeyamapyevaṁ na nameyaṁ tu kasyacit
eṣa me sahajo doṣaḥ svabhāvo duratikramaḥ

translations.english: Better that I should be riven in twain, but bend I never will. This is my native fault; and nature is incapable of being overcome.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि तावत्समुद्रे तु सेतुर्बद्धो यदृच्छया
रामेण विस्मयः कोऽत्र येन ते भयमागतम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi tāvatsamudre tu seturbaddho yadṛcchayā
rāmeṇa vismayaḥ ko'tra yena te bhayamāgatam

translations.english: If Rāma bath at his pleasure constructed a bridge over the ocean, what is the wonder in this that you have conceived such a fear?

verses.sanskrit:
स तु तीर्त्वार्णवं रामः सह वानरसेनया
प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यं न जीवन्प्रतियास्यति
verses.transliteration:
sa tu tīrtvārṇavaṁ rāmaḥ saha vānarasenayā
pratijānāmi te satyaṁ na jīvanpratiyāsyati

translations.english: And although Rāma has crossed the ocean along with the monkey-army, yet I swear to you truly, living, he shall not back hence.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं रुष्टं विज्ञाय रावणम्
व्रीडितो माल्यवान्वाक्यं नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ saṁrabdhaṁ ruṣṭaṁ vijñāya rāvaṇam
vrīḍito mālyavānvākyaṁ nottaraṁ pratyapadyata

translations.english: When Ravana, wrought up with passion, had spoken thus, Malyavan, knowing him wroth, did not return a reply.

verses.sanskrit:
जयाशिषा च राजानं वर्धयित्वा यथोचितम्
माल्यवानभ्यनुज्ञातो जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration:
jayāśiṣā ca rājānaṁ vardhayitvā yathocitam
mālyavānabhyanujñāto jagāma svaṁ niveśanam

translations.english: And, duly tendering blessings to the king, Mālyavān, taking his permission, went to his own abode.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्तु सहामात्यो मन्त्रयित्वा विमृश्य च
लङ्कायामतुलां गुप्तिं कारयामास राक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastu sahāmātyo mantrayitvā vimṛśya ca
laṅkāyāmatulāṁ guptiṁ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ

translations.english: The Räkşasa, Rāvaņa, along with his courtiers, having consulted together as to what was fit to be done, set about the defence of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यादिदेश च पूर्वस्यां प्रहस्तं द्वारि राक्षसं
दक्षिणस्यां महावीर्यौ महापार्श्व महोदरौ
verses.transliteration:
vyādideśa ca pūrvasyāṁ prahastaṁ dvāri rākṣasaṁ
dakṣiṇasyāṁ mahāvīryau mahāpārśva mahodarau

translations.english: He commanded the Raksasa Prahasta (to guard) the Eastern gate; and the exceedingly powerful Mahaparsva and Mahodara (to guard) the Southern gate; and he ordered his son Indrajit, possessing mighty powers of illusion, girt by innumerable Räkșasas, to guard the Western gate.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरस्यां पुरद्वारि व्यादिश्य शुकसारणौ
स्वयं चात्र भविष्यामि मन्त्रिणस्तानुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
uttarasyāṁ puradvāri vyādiśya śukasāraṇau
svayaṁ cātra bhaviṣyāmi mantriṇastānuvāca ha

translations.english: He commanded Suka and Sārana to defend the Northern gate. But he said to the counsellors, I will myself go thither.* *i.e. to defend the Northerm gate.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसं तु विरूपाक्षं महावीर्यपराक्रमम्
मध्यमेऽस्थापयद्गुल्मे बहुभिः सह राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasaṁ tu virūpākṣaṁ mahāvīryaparākramam
madhyame'sthāpayadgulme bahubhiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ

translations.english: And he posted in the middle in the garrison the Raksasa, Virupaksa, endowed with exceeding prowess and energy, backed by countless rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
एवंविधानं लङ्कायां कृत्वा राक्षसपुंगवः
मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं कृतान्तवशमागतः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁvidhānaṁ laṅkāyāṁ kṛtvā rākṣasapuṁgavaḥ
mene kṛtārthamātmānaṁ kṛtāntavaśamāgataḥ

translations.english: Having taken these measures in Lankā, the raksasa-chief, urged by Fate, deemed himself as having achieved success.

verses.sanskrit:
विसर्जयामास ततः स मन्त्रिणो; विधानमाज्ञाप्य पुरस्य पुष्कलम्
जयाशिषा मन्त्रगणेन पूजितो; विवेश सोऽन्तःपुरमृद्धिमन्महत्
verses.transliteration:
visarjayāmāsa tataḥ sa mantriṇo; vidhānamājñāpya purasya puṣkalam
jayāśiṣā mantragaṇena pūjito; viveśa so'ntaḥpuramṛddhimanmahat

translations.english: Having thus completely provided for the defence of the city, he dismissed the ministers; and, honoured by the counsellors with blessings of victory, (then) entered his magnificent and splendid inner apartment.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रश्च सौमित्रिः शरभः कपिः
सुषेणः सहदायादो मैन्दो द्विविद एव च
verses.transliteration:
aṅgado vāliputraśca saumitriḥ śarabhaḥ kapiḥ
suṣeṇaḥ sahadāyādo maindo dvivida eva ca

translations.english: Those, kings, man and monkey, that monkey the Wind-god's son, Jāmbavān-sovereign of bears—the Rākşasa, Vibhīşaņa, the son of Vālī, Angada, Sumitrā's son, the monkey, Sarabha, Susena along with his friends, Kumuda, Nala, and Panasa, arriving at the dominions of the enemy, assembled together, began to deliberate.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं सा लक्ष्यते लङ्का पुरी रावणपालिता
सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैरमरैरपि दुर्जया
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ sā lakṣyate laṅkā purī rāvaṇapālitā
sāsuroragagandharvairamarairapi durjayā

translations.english: Yonder is that Lankā ruled by Rāvana, invincible even to the celestials, serpents and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्यसिद्धिं पुरस्कृत्य मन्त्रयध्वं विनिर्णये
नित्यं संनिहितो ह्यत्र रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
verses.transliteration:
kāryasiddhiṁ puraskṛtya mantrayadhvaṁ vinirṇaye
nityaṁ saṁnihito hyatra rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ

translations.english: Let us, keeping before us success in the enterprise, consult together for the purpose of arriving at a decision.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु रावणावरजोऽब्रवीत्
वाक्यमग्राम्यपदवत्पुष्कलार्थं विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
tathā teṣu bruvāṇeṣu rāvaṇāvarajo'bravīt
vākyamagrāmyapadavatpuṣkalārthaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: We are here daily nearing Răvaņa, lord of Raksasas. As they were speaking thus, Ravana's younger brother, Vibhīşaņa, said in a pregnant speech free from provinicialism.

verses.sanskrit:
अनलः शरभश्चैव संपातिः प्रघसस्तथा
गत्वा लङ्कां ममामात्याः पुरीं पुनरिहागताः
verses.transliteration:
analaḥ śarabhaścaiva saṁpātiḥ praghasastathā
gatvā laṅkāṁ mamāmātyāḥ purīṁ punarihāgatāḥ

translations.english: Anala, Panasa, Sampāti and Pramāti— all courtiers of mine-having gone up to Lanka, have come back here.

verses.sanskrit:
भूत्वा शकुनयः सर्वे प्रविष्टाश्च रिपोर्बलम्
विधानं विहितं यच्च तद्दृष्ट्वा समुपस्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
bhūtvā śakunayaḥ sarve praviṣṭāśca riporbalam
vidhānaṁ vihitaṁ yacca taddṛṣṭvā samupasthitāḥ

translations.english: Wearing the forms of birds, they entered into the hostile forces; and, having seen the measures that had been adopted (by them, have come (back).

verses.sanskrit:
संविधानं यथाहुस्ते रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
राम तद्ब्रुवतः सर्वं यथातथ्येन मे शृणु
verses.transliteration:
saṁvidhānaṁ yathāhuste rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
rāma tadbruvataḥ sarvaṁ yathātathyena me śṛṇu

translations.english: O Rāma, hearken to me as I tell you truly anent the provisions which they have related, made by the wicked-minded Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रजित्पश्चिमद्वारं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिः शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः
verses.transliteration:
indrajitpaścimadvāraṁ rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ
paṭṭasāsidhanuṣmadbhiḥ śūlamudgarapāṇibhiḥ

translations.english: In the Eastern gate stay Prahasta along with his forces; in the Southern, the exceedingly powerful Mahāpārsva and Mahodara, and in the Western. Ravana's son, Indrajit, supported by innumerable Räkşasas, equipped with pattiśas, swords and bows, and bearing darts and maces in their hands, surrounded by heroes carrying various weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्तः परमसंविग्नो राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
उत्तरं नगरद्वारं रावणः स्वयमास्थितः
verses.transliteration:
yuktaḥ paramasaṁvigno rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ
uttaraṁ nagaradvāraṁ rāvaṇaḥ svayamāsthitaḥ

translations.english: And, backed by many thousands of Räkşasas wielding weapons, and accompanied by Rākşasas conversant with counsel, Rāvana himself, his heart agitated to the height, gaurd the Northern gate of the city.

verses.sanskrit:
विरूपाक्षस्तु महता शूलखड्गधनुष्मता
बलेन राक्षसैः सार्धं मध्यमं गुल्ममास्थितः
verses.transliteration:
virūpākṣastu mahatā śūlakhaḍgadhanuṣmatā
balena rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṁ madhyamaṁ gulmamāsthitaḥ

translations.english: Virüpākṣa with a powerful force accoutred in javelins, clubs and bows, protects the garrison in the centre.

verses.sanskrit:
एतानेवंविधान्गुल्माँल्लङ्कायां समुदीक्ष्य ते
मामकाः सचिवाः सर्वे शीघ्रं पुनरिहागताः
verses.transliteration:
etānevaṁvidhāngulmā̐llaṅkāyāṁ samudīkṣya te
māmakāḥ sacivāḥ sarve śīghraṁ punarihāgatāḥ

translations.english: Having seen these hosts thus disposed in Lankä, my counsellors have speedily come back here.

verses.sanskrit:
गजानां च सहस्रं च रथानामयुतं पुरे
हयानामयुते द्वे च साग्रकोटी च रक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration:
gajānāṁ ca sahasraṁ ca rathānāmayutaṁ pure
hayānāmayute dve ca sāgrakoṭī ca rakṣasām

translations.english: There are ten thousand elephants, an Ayuta cars, two of horses, and abouta koti of Raksasas, powerful and strong, and equipped with arms in conflict.* *These are, remarks the commentator, the leader.

verses.sanskrit:
विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च संयुगेष्वाततायिनः
इष्टा राक्षसराजस्य नित्यमेते निशाचराः
verses.transliteration:
vikrāntā balavantaśca saṁyugeṣvātatāyinaḥ
iṣṭā rākṣasarājasya nityamete niśācarāḥ

translations.english: These night-rangers are ever the favourites of the Raksasa ruler. And, O kine, a koti of forces accompany each of these Rākşasas in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
एतां प्रवृत्तिं लङ्कायां मन्त्रिप्रोक्तं विभीषणः
रामं कमलपत्राक्षमिदमुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
etāṁ pravṛttiṁ laṅkāyāṁ mantriproktaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
rāmaṁ kamalapatrākṣamidamuttaramabravīt

translations.english: In company with his counsellors, Ravana's graceful younger brother, ever striving for the welfare of Rama, by way of answer communicated everything that was going forward in Lankā to Räma, having eyes resembling lotus leaves.

verses.sanskrit:
कुबेरं तु यदा राम रावणः प्रत्ययुध्यत
षष्टिः शतसहस्राणि तदा निर्यान्ति राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
kuberaṁ tu yadā rāma rāvaṇaḥ pratyayudhyata
ṣaṣṭiḥ śatasahasrāṇi tadā niryānti rākṣasāḥ

translations.english: O Răma, when Rāvana battled with Kuvera, sixty lacs of Raksasas marched forth (to meet him). In prowess, energy, vigour, exceeding fortitude, and hauteur, they resembled the wicked-minded Ravana himself.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र मन्युर्न कर्तव्यो रोषये त्वां न भीषये
समर्थो ह्यसि वीर्येण सुराणामपि निग्रहे
verses.transliteration:
atra manyurna kartavyo roṣaye tvāṁ na bhīṣaye
samartho hyasi vīryeṇa surāṇāmapi nigrahe

translations.english: In this matter, you ought not to grow wroth, I only arouse your wrath, and do not endeavour to frighten you. You can subdue even the celestials by your prowess. *i.e. You ought not to be angry with me; for I do not frighten you, but rouse your wrath against Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्भवांश्चतुरङ्गेण बलेन महता वृतः
व्यूह्येदं वानरानीकं निर्मथिष्यसि रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
tadbhavāṁścaturaṅgeṇa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
vyūhyedaṁ vānarānīkaṁ nirmathiṣyasi rāvaṇam

translations.english: Therefore you, environed by a mighty army, having arrayed the monkey-forces in order of battle, shall thrash Ravana (in battle)

verses.sanskrit:
रावणावरजे वाक्यमेवं ब्रुवति राघवः
शत्रूणां प्रतिघातार्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇāvaraje vākyamevaṁ bruvati rāghavaḥ
śatrūṇāṁ pratighātārthamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: When Rāvana's younger brother had spoken thus, Rāghava, said these words with reference to his beating the foe.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वद्वारे तु लङ्काया नीलो वानरपुंगवः
प्रहस्तं प्रतियोद्धा स्याद्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
pūrvadvāre tu laṅkāyā nīlo vānarapuṁgavaḥ
prahastaṁ pratiyoddhā syādvānarairbahubhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: Let that foremost of monkey, Nila, surrounded to by an immense number of monkeys, cope with Prahasta at the Eastern gate of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रस्तु बलेन महता वृतः
दक्षिणे बाधतां द्वारे महापार्श्वमहोदरौ
verses.transliteration:
aṅgado vāliputrastu balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
dakṣiṇe bādhatāṁ dvāre mahāpārśvamahodarau

translations.english: And, engirt by a mighty force, let Angada, son of Válī, resist Mahăpărśva and Mahodara at the Southern gate (thereof).

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमान्पश्चिमद्वारं निपीड्य पवनात्मजः
प्रविशत्वप्रमेयात्मा बहुभिः कपिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
hanūmānpaścimadvāraṁ nipīḍya pavanātmajaḥ
praviśatvaprameyātmā bahubhiḥ kapibhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: And let that son of the Wind-god, Hanuman, backed by innumerable monkeys, (beating the host stationed) at the Western gate, find entrance (into the city).

verses.sanskrit:
दैत्यदानवसंघानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्
विप्रकारप्रियः क्षुद्रो वरदानबलान्वितः
verses.transliteration:
daityadānavasaṁghānāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca mahātmanām
viprakārapriyaḥ kṣudro varadānabalānvitaḥ

translations.english: I myself, determined compass the destruction of the lord of Räkşasas, who, waxing powerful in consequence of the boon he has received, has brought about the destruction of high-souled saints resembling gods and Dänavas, and who goes round all regions, oppressing people, will, along with Sumitra's son, smiting (the foe), occupy the Northern entiuile., where Rāvana with his army is stationed.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरेन्द्रश्च बलवानृक्षराजश्च जाम्बवान्
राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव गुल्मे भवतु मध्यमे
verses.transliteration:
vānarendraśca balavānṛkṣarājaśca jāmbavān
rākṣasendrānujaścaiva gulme bhavatu madhyame

translations.english: And let the powerful king of monkeys, and the puissant sovereign of bears, and the younger brother of the Raksasa-chief, manage the soldiery posted in the centre.

verses.sanskrit:
न चैव मानुषं रूपं कार्यं हरिभिराहवे
एषा भवतु नः संज्ञा युद्धेऽस्मिन्वानरे बले
verses.transliteration:
na caiva mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ kāryaṁ haribhirāhave
eṣā bhavatu naḥ saṁjñā yuddhe'sminvānare bale

translations.english: In this battle, the monkeys need not assume the forms of human being. And let this serve for a sign that the monkeys, in order to the recognition of our own forces, appear with their proper monkey-marks. We seven only shall battle with the foe in human shapes, viz.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेव सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसा
आत्मना पञ्चमश्चायं सखा मम विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
ahameva saha bhrātrā lakṣmaṇena mahaujasā
ātmanā pañcamaścāyaṁ sakhā mama vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: I along with my brother, the exceedingly energetic Lakşmaņa, and my friend Vibhīşaņa counting for the fifth in company with his own following.

verses.sanskrit:
स रामः कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थमेवमुक्त्वा विभीषणम्
सुवेलारोहणे बुद्धिं चकार मतिमान्मतिम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāmaḥ kāryasiddhyarthamevamuktvā vibhīṣaṇam
suvelārohaṇe buddhiṁ cakāra matimānmatim

translations.english: Having said this to Vibhísaņa for attaining success in the enterprise, that lord, the intelligent Rāma, seeing the sides of Suvela more beautiful (than other places), intended to ascend it.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु रामो महता बलेन; प्रच्छाद्य सर्वां पृथिवीं महात्मा
प्रहृष्टरूपोऽभिजगाम लङ्कां; कृत्वा मतिं सोऽरिवधे महात्मा
verses.transliteration:
tatastu rāmo mahatā balena; pracchādya sarvāṁ pṛthivīṁ mahātmā
prahṛṣṭarūpo'bhijagāma laṅkāṁ; kṛtvā matiṁ so'rivadhe mahātmā

translations.english: Then, environed by a mighty host, the highsouled and magnanimous Rāma, his features mirroring forth high exultation, overshadowing the entire Earth (with his forces), set out for Lankā, determined upon destroying the enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु कृत्वा सुवेलस्य मतिमारोहणं प्रति
लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu kṛtvā suvelasya matimārohaṇaṁ prati
lakṣmaṇānugato rāmaḥ sugrīvamidamabravīt

translations.english: Having been bent upon mounting Suvela, Rāma, followed by Lakşmaņa, addressed in sweet and excellent words, Sugriva, and that righteous night-ranger, Vibhisana, versed in। counsel and conversant with precepts, who was devoted to him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सुवेलं साधु शैलेन्द्रमिमं धातुशतैश्चितम्
अध्यारोहामहे सर्वे वत्स्यामोऽत्र निशामिमाम्
verses.transliteration:
suvelaṁ sādhu śailendramimaṁ dhātuśataiścitam
adhyārohāmahe sarve vatsyāmo'tra niśāmimām

translations.english: We shall all ascend this mount Suvela, be dight with metals; and pass this night even here.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं संमन्त्रयन्नेव सक्रोधो रावणं प्रति
रामः सुवेलं वासाय चित्रसानुमुपारुहत्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ saṁmantrayanneva sakrodho rāvaṇaṁ prati
rāmaḥ suvelaṁ vāsāya citrasānumupāruhat

translations.english: Having decided thus, Rāma, filled with wrath at Ravana, coming to Suvela, ascended its variegated plateau.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष्ठतो लक्ष्मण चैनमन्वगच्छत्समाहितः
सशरं चापमुद्यम्य सुमहद्विक्रमे रतः
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣṭhato lakṣmaṇa cainamanvagacchatsamāhitaḥ
saśaraṁ cāpamudyamya sumahadvikrame rataḥ

translations.english: And Laksmana, collected, went in his wake. And, upraising bow and arrow, Sugriva, (ever) engaged in valorous acts, accompanied with Vibhişaņa as well as his counsellors, following him, also ascended (the mountain).

verses.sanskrit:
ते त्वदीर्घेण कालेन गिरिमारुह्य सर्वतः
ददृशुः शिखरे तस्य विषक्तामिव खे पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
te tvadīrgheṇa kālena girimāruhya sarvataḥ
dadṛśuḥ śikhare tasya viṣaktāmiva khe purīm

translations.english: And all those rangers of mountains, gifted with the vehemence of the Wind in hundreds ascended mount Suvela, where Rāghava was stationed.

verses.sanskrit:
तां शुभां प्रवरद्वारां प्राकारवरशोभिताम्
लङ्कां राक्षससंपूर्णां ददृशुर्हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ śubhāṁ pravaradvārāṁ prākāravaraśobhitām
laṅkāṁ rākṣasasaṁpūrṇāṁ dadṛśurhariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: Ascending the mountain in a short time, they all beheld from its summit the city, appearing to be built on the air. And the monkey-leaders beheld Lankā, exceedingly splendid with noble gateways; gracefully enclosed with a wall; thronging with Rakşasas; and defended by sable Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राकारचयसंस्थैश्च तथा नीलैर्निशाचरैः
ददृशुस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठाः प्राकारमपरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
prākāracayasaṁsthaiśca tathā nīlairniśācaraiḥ
dadṛśuste hariśreṣṭhāḥ prākāramaparaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: The foremost of monkeys saw these appearing like another wall (overtopping the one beneath).

verses.sanskrit:
ते दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे राक्षसान्युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः
मुमुचुर्विपुलान्नादांस्तत्र रामस्य पश्यतः
verses.transliteration:
te dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasānyuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
mumucurvipulānnādāṁstatra rāmasya paśyataḥ

translations.english: On seeing the Rākşasas, the monkeys burning for battle set up various roars in the presence of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽस्तमगमत्सूर्यः संध्यया प्रतिरञ्जितः
पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीपा च क्षपा समभिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
tato'stamagamatsūryaḥ saṁdhyayā pratirañjitaḥ
pūrṇacandrapradīpā ca kṣapā samabhivartate

translations.english: Then the Sun, crimsoned with Eve, ascended the Setting-hill; and Night came, illumined by the Moon at his full.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स रामो हरिवाहिनीपति;र्विभीषणेन प्रतिनन्द्य सत्कृतः
सलक्ष्मणो यूथपयूथसंवृतः; सुवेल पृष्ठे न्यवसद्यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa rāmo harivāhinīpati;rvibhīṣaṇena pratinandya satkṛtaḥ
salakṣmaṇo yūthapayūthasaṁvṛtaḥ; suvela pṛṣṭhe nyavasadyathāsukham

translations.english: Then the master of the monkey-army, Rāma, saluted and honoured by Vibhisana, accompanied by Lakşmaņa as well as the leaders of the monkeys, sojourned happily on the beast of Suvela.

verses.sanskrit:
तां रात्रिमुषितास्तत्र सुवेले हरिपुंगवाः
लङ्कायां ददृशुर्वीरा वनान्युपवनानि च
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ rātrimuṣitāstatra suvele haripuṁgavāḥ
laṅkāyāṁ dadṛśurvīrā vanānyupavanāni ca

translations.english: Having passed the night in Suvela, the heroic monkey-leaders surveyed woods and forests in Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
समसौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्यायतानि च
दृष्टिरम्याणि ते दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर्जातविस्मयाः
verses.transliteration:
samasaumyāni ramyāṇi viśālānyāyatāni ca
dṛṣṭiramyāṇi te dṛṣṭvā babhūvurjātavismayāḥ

translations.english: Seeing those extensive (woods and forests), mild, and charming, and beautiful to behold, they were seized with wonderment.

verses.sanskrit:
विचित्रकुसुमोपेतै रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः
शाद्वलैश्च तथा नीलैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः
verses.transliteration:
vicitrakusumopetai raktakomalapallavaiḥ
śādvalaiśca tathā nīlaiścitrābhirvanarājibhiḥ

translations.english: And trees there, furnished with variegated flowers having tender rosy leaves, and blue lawns, and rows of woods; and bearing odorous and charming blossoms and fruits, looked like men adorned with ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्चैत्ररथसंकाशं मनोज्ञं नन्दनोपमम्
वनं सर्वर्तुकं रम्यं शुशुभे षट्पदायुतम्
verses.transliteration:
taccaitrarathasaṁkāśaṁ manojñaṁ nandanopamam
vanaṁ sarvartukaṁ ramyaṁ śuśubhe ṣaṭpadāyutam

translations.english: There a delightful and pleasant wood resembling Caitraratha, and like to Nandana itself, having all the seasons present, appeared beauteous to the view, with black bees all around.

verses.sanskrit:
नत्यूहकोयष्टिभकैर्नृत्यमानैश्च बर्हिभिः
रुतं परभृतानां च शुश्रुवे वननिर्झरे
verses.transliteration:
natyūhakoyaṣṭibhakairnṛtyamānaiśca barhibhiḥ
rutaṁ parabhṛtānāṁ ca śuśruve vananirjhare

translations.english: And it had Dātyühas, and Koyașthivas, and peacocks dancing; and the strains of the coels were heard at the woodland rills.

verses.sanskrit:
नित्यमत्तविहंगानि भ्रमराचरितानि च
कोकिलाकुलषण्डानि विहगाभिरुतानि च
verses.transliteration:
nityamattavihaṁgāni bhramarācaritāni ca
kokilākulaṣaṇḍāni vihagābhirutāni ca

translations.english: The heroic and exhilarated monkeys, capable of wearing forms at pleasure, entered those woods and groves frequented by maddened birds and ranged by Bhramaras, tracts overflowing with the lays of coels, and ringing with the voices of songsters, resonant with the notes of Bhramaras, sovereigns of their species and eloquent with the cries of ospreys.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये तु हरिवीराणां यूथान्निष्क्रम्य यूथपाः
सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता लङ्कां जग्मुः पताकिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
anye tu harivīrāṇāṁ yūthānniṣkramya yūthapāḥ
sugrīveṇābhyanujñātā laṅkāṁ jagmuḥ patākinīm

translations.english: As the exceedingly energetic monkeys entered, there blew upon them the breeze-like to life-redolent of perfume obtained from contact with the blossoms. And others of the leaders among the heroic monkeys, coming out from the bands, ordered by Sugriva, made in the direction of Lankā crowned with ensigns.

verses.sanskrit:
वित्रासयन्तो विहगांस्त्रासयन्तो मृगद्विपान्
कम्पयन्तश्च तां लङ्कां नादैः स्वैर्नदतां वराः
verses.transliteration:
vitrāsayanto vihagāṁstrāsayanto mṛgadvipān
kampayantaśca tāṁ laṅkāṁ nādaiḥ svairnadatāṁ varāḥ

translations.english: And, terrifying the fowls and dispiriting beasts and birds and shaking Lankā with their roars, those foremost monkeys set up shouts.

verses.sanskrit:
कुर्वन्तस्ते महावेगा महीं चारणपीडिताम्
रजश्च सहसैवोर्ध्वं जगाम चरणोद्धतम्
verses.transliteration:
kurvantaste mahāvegā mahīṁ cāraṇapīḍitām
rajaśca sahasaivordhvaṁ jagāma caraṇoddhatam

translations.english: They, endowed with great impetuosity, went on, oppressing the earth with their battle-array; and clouds of dust suddenly arose from the march of the soldiery.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षाः सिंहा वराहाश्च महिषा वारणा मृगाः
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता जग्मुर्भीता दिशो दश
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣāḥ siṁhā varāhāśca mahiṣā vāraṇā mṛgāḥ
tena śabdena vitrastā jagmurbhītā diśo daśa

translations.english: And bears, and lions, and buffaloes, and elephants, and deer, and birds, overwhelmed with affright, made for the t en cardinal points.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्यां स्तम्भसहस्रेण प्रासादः समलंकृतः
कैलासशिखराकारो दृश्यते खमिवोल्लिखन्
verses.transliteration:
yasyāṁ stambhasahasreṇa prāsādaḥ samalaṁkṛtaḥ
kailāsaśikharākāro dṛśyate khamivollikhan

translations.english: That palace, which was adorned with thousands of pillars, and which, as if piercing the heavens, looked like a peak of Kailasa—was the residence of the Sovereign of the Rākşasas—the ornament of the city, (ever guarded by full hundreds of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तां रत्नपूर्णां बहुसंविधानां; प्रासादमालाभिरलंकृतां च
पुरीं महायन्त्रकवाटमुख्यां; ददर्श रामो महता बलेन
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ ratnapūrṇāṁ bahusaṁvidhānāṁ; prāsādamālābhiralaṁkṛtāṁ ca
purīṁ mahāyantrakavāṭamukhyāṁ; dadarśa rāmo mahatā balena

translations.english: Rāma, surrounded by his mighty forces, saw that palace, filled with diverse kinds of gems, adorned with rows of edifices, and having huge engines and gateways.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तस्मिन्निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः
लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिसंपन्नमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha tasminnimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ
lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmisaṁpannamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Seeing those ominous signs, Lakşmaņa's elder brother, Ramā, embracing Sugrīva, said.

verses.sanskrit:
परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च
बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण
verses.transliteration:
parigṛhyodakaṁ śītaṁ vanāni phalavanti ca
balaughaṁ saṁvibhajyemaṁ vyūhya tiṣṭhema lakṣmaṇa

translations.english: O Laksmana, occupying (this tract) of cool waters and woods affluent with fruits, will we, dividing and arranging our forces, stay here.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकक्षयकरं भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम्
निबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration:
lokakṣayakaraṁ bhīmaṁ bhayaṁ paśyāmyupasthitam
nibarhaṇaṁ pravīrāṇāmṛkṣavānararakṣasām

translations.english: I see a mighty fear present, destructive of people, and boding destruction to the foremost heroes among the bears, monkeys and Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
वाताश्च परुषं वान्ति कम्पते च वसुंधरा
पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीधराः
verses.transliteration:
vātāśca paruṣaṁ vānti kampate ca vasuṁdharā
parvatāgrāṇi vepante patanti dharaṇīdharāḥ

translations.english: The winds ruffle; and the earth is tremulous. And the tops of mountains tremble, and the mountains themselves send up loud sounds.

verses.sanskrit:
मेघाः क्रव्यादसंकाशाः परुषाः परुषस्वनाः
क्रूराः क्रूरं प्रवर्षन्ति मिश्रं शोणितबिन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration:
meghāḥ kravyādasaṁkāśāḥ paruṣāḥ paruṣasvanāḥ
krūrāḥ krūraṁ pravarṣanti miśraṁ śoṇitabindubhiḥ

translations.english: The clouds are ashen and roistering, and roar roughly. And lowering, they shower portentous drops of blood.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्तचन्दनसंकाशा संध्यापरमदारुणा
ज्वलच्च निपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration:
raktacandanasaṁkāśā saṁdhyāparamadāruṇā
jvalacca nipatatyetadādityādagnimaṇḍalam

translations.english: The Evening resembles the red sandal, and is fearful. And a flaming circle dropped from the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ते जनयन्तो महद्भयम्
दीना दीनस्वरा घोरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः
verses.transliteration:
ādityamabhivāśyante janayanto mahadbhayam
dīnā dīnasvarā ghorā apraśastā mṛgadvijāḥ

translations.english: And exciting great fear, inauspicious birds and beasts, wearing cruel looks, and in distressful guise, cry in piteous accents, facing the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
रजन्यामप्रकाशश्च संतापयति चन्द्रमाः
कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य संक्षये
verses.transliteration:
rajanyāmaprakāśaśca saṁtāpayati candramāḥ
kṛṣṇaraktāṁśuparyanto yathā lokasya saṁkṣaye

translations.english: At night, the ominous Moon with a black-red brim as at the time of universal wreck, burn.

verses.sanskrit:
ह्रस्वो रूक्षोऽप्रशस्तश्च परिवेषः सुलोहितः
आदित्यमण्डले नीलं लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते
verses.transliteration:
hrasvo rūkṣo'praśastaśca pariveṣaḥ sulohitaḥ
ādityamaṇḍale nīlaṁ lakṣma lakṣmaṇa dṛśyate

translations.english: O Laksmana, there is a crimson, rough, slight, and graceful rim round the Sun; and a blue mark is visible on his disc.

verses.sanskrit:
दृश्यन्ते न यथावच्च नक्षत्राण्यभिवर्तते
युगान्तमिव लोकस्य पश्य लक्ष्मण शंसति
verses.transliteration:
dṛśyante na yathāvacca nakṣatrāṇyabhivartate
yugāntamiva lokasya paśya lakṣmaṇa śaṁsati

translations.english: The stars do not course as formerly. Behold, O Laksmana, all these, prefiguring the Doom.

verses.sanskrit:
काकाः श्येनास्तथा गृध्रा नीचैः परिपतन्ति च
शिवाश्चाप्यशिवा वाचः प्रवदन्ति महास्वनाः
verses.transliteration:
kākāḥ śyenāstathā gṛdhrā nīcaiḥ paripatanti ca
śivāścāpyaśivā vācaḥ pravadanti mahāsvanāḥ

translations.english: And crows and hawks and vultures drop down. And jackals yell loud inauspicious notes.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षां पुरीं रावणपालिताम्
अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः
verses.transliteration:
kṣipramadya durādharṣāṁ purīṁ rāvaṇapālitām
abhiyāma javenaiva sarvato haribhirvṛtāḥ

translations.english: This very day with all expedition shall we surrounded on all sides by the monkeys, march towards the city governed by Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं तु वदन्वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
तस्मादवातरच्छीघ्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ tu vadanvīro lakṣmaṇaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
tasmādavātaracchīghraṁ parvatāgrānmahābalaḥ

translations.english: Having said this to Laksmana, Laksmana's elder brother possessed of exceeding strength, hastily descended from the top of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
अवतीर्य तु धर्मात्मा तस्माच्छैलात्स राघवः
परैः परमदुर्धर्षं ददर्श बलमात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
avatīrya tu dharmātmā tasmācchailātsa rāghavaḥ
paraiḥ paramadurdharṣaṁ dadarśa balamātmanaḥ

translations.english: And descending from the mountain, the righteous Rāghava surveyed his troops, incapable of being beaten by enemies.

verses.sanskrit:
संनह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत्
कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत्
verses.transliteration:
saṁnahya tu sasugrīvaḥ kapirājabalaṁ mahat
kālajño rāghavaḥ kāle saṁyugāyābhyacodayat

translations.english: After making the mighty host of the monkeysking equip itself, Raghava versed in season, along with Sugrīva, at the proper hour, issued orders for battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महता वृतः
प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kāle mahābāhurbalena mahatā vṛtaḥ
prasthitaḥ purato dhanvī laṅkāmabhimukhaḥ purīm

translations.english: Then in due time that one, accoutred with his bow, surrounded by a mighty army, set out, with the intention of entering the city of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
तं विभीषण सुग्रीवौ हनूमाञ्जाम्बवान्नलः
ऋक्षराजस्तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश्चान्ययुस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
taṁ vibhīṣaṇa sugrīvau hanūmāñjāmbavānnalaḥ
ṛkṣarājastathā nīlo lakṣmaṇaścānyayustadā

translations.english: Those two-Vibhisana and Sugriva-~-and Hanumān, and jāmbavăn, and Nala, and the bear-king Nila, and Laksmana, followed (Rama).

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पश्चात्सुमहती पृतनर्क्षवनौकसाम्
प्रच्छाद्य महतीं भूमिमनुयाति स्म राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paścātsumahatī pṛtanarkṣavanaukasām
pracchādya mahatīṁ bhūmimanuyāti sma rāghavam

translations.english: Behind them, the mighty array of bears and monkeys followed Rāghava, severing a wide surface of land.

verses.sanskrit:
शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहाम्
जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः परवारणाः
verses.transliteration:
śailaśṛṅgāṇi śataśaḥ pravṛddhāṁśca mahīruhām
jagṛhuḥ kuñjaraprakhyā vānarāḥ paravāraṇāḥ

translations.english: The monkeys, resembling elephants, capable of resisting foes, took mountain-peaks and tall trees by hundreds.

verses.sanskrit:
पताकामालिनीं रम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम्
चित्रवप्रां सुदुष्प्रापामुच्चप्राकारतोरणाम्
verses.transliteration:
patākāmālinīṁ ramyāmudyānavanaśobhitām
citravaprāṁ suduṣprāpāmuccaprākāratoraṇām

translations.english: In a short time those repressors of foes— two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa-arrived at the city of Răvaņa; with pennons streaming over her; charming; garnished with groves and woods, having variegated gateways; inaccessible; and having walls and gates.

verses.sanskrit:
तां सुरैरपि दुर्धर्षां रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः
यथानिदेशं संपीड्य न्यविशन्त वनौकसः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ surairapi durdharṣāṁ rāmavākyapracoditāḥ
yathānideśaṁ saṁpīḍya nyaviśanta vanaukasaḥ

translations.english: And urged on by Rāma's command, the wood-raingers,* as commanded, blocking up (Lankā) incapable of being subdued even by the gods, stationed themselves. *Monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वं तु द्वारमासाद्य नीलो हरिचमूपतिः
अतिष्ठत्सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvaṁ tu dvāramāsādya nīlo haricamūpatiḥ
atiṣṭhatsaha maindena dvividena ca vīryavān

translations.english: And coming to the Eastern gate, that leader of the monkeys-army, the powerful Nila, along with Mainda and Dvivida, took up his post there.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदो दक्षिणद्वारं जग्राह सुमहाबलः
ऋषभेण गवाक्षेण गजेन गवयेन च
verses.transliteration:
aṅgado dakṣiṇadvāraṁ jagrāha sumahābalaḥ
ṛṣabheṇa gavākṣeṇa gajena gavayena ca

translations.english: The exceedingly strong Angada, accompanied by Risabha, Gavaksa, Gaya, and Gavaya, occupied the Southern gate. And the mighty monkey Hanumān protected the Western entrance.

verses.sanskrit:
मध्यमे च स्वयं गुल्मे सुग्रीवः समतिष्ठत
सह सर्वैर्हरिश्रेष्ठैः सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः
verses.transliteration:
madhyame ca svayaṁ gulme sugrīvaḥ samatiṣṭhata
saha sarvairhariśreṣṭhaiḥ suparṇaśvasanopamaiḥ

translations.english: And Sugrīva himself, with Prajangha, Tarasa and other heroes, was quartered near the garrison in the centre.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत्कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः
निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāṁ tu ṣaṭtriṁśatkoṭyaḥ prakhyātayūthapāḥ
nipīḍyopaniviṣṭāśca sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ

translations.english: And accompanied by all the foremost monkeys resembling Suparņa or the Wind, twenty kotis of renowned monkey-leaders, blocking up all sides, stationed themselves near the monkeys, Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः
द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration:
śāsanena tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ
dvāre dvāre harīṇāṁ tu koṭiṁ koṭiṁ nyaveśayat

translations.english: At Rama's command, Laksmana along with Vibhisana, went from door to door, issuing instructions to kotis of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवः सह जाम्बवान्
अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः
verses.transliteration:
paścimena tu rāmasya sugrīvaḥ saha jāmbavān
adūrānmadhyame gulme tasthau bahubalānugaḥ

translations.english: On the west of Rāma, Jāmbavän along with Susena, followed by innumerable troops, remained hard by at the garrison in the minddle.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः
गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान्हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे
verses.transliteration:
te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śārdūlā iva daṁṣṭriṇaḥ
gṛhītvā drumaśailāgrānhṛṣṭā yuddhāya tasthire

translations.english: And those tiger-like monkeys, furnished with teeth like to tigers, wielding trees and mountaintops, stood ready for fight.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे विकृतलाङ्गूलाः सर्वे दंष्ट्रानखायुधाः
सर्वे विकृतचित्राङ्गाः सर्वे च विकृताननाः
verses.transliteration:
sarve vikṛtalāṅgūlāḥ sarve daṁṣṭrānakhāyudhāḥ
sarve vikṛtacitrāṅgāḥ sarve ca vikṛtānanāḥ

translations.english: All had their tails curled up, and all were armed with teeth and nails, and all had chequered bodies, and all had frightful faces.

verses.sanskrit:
दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः
केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः
verses.transliteration:
daśanāgabalāḥ kecitkeciddaśaguṇottarāḥ
kecinnāgasahasrasya babhūvustulyavikramāḥ

translations.english: Some had the strength of ten elephants; and some had strength ten times as much; and some of the monkeys-leaders there had the strength of a thousand elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
सन्ति चौघा बलाः केचित्केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः
अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन्हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
santi caughā balāḥ kecitkecicchataguṇottarāḥ
aprameyabalāścānye tatrāsanhariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: Some had the strength of numbers (of elephants); and some had strength hundred times as much. And others had immeasurable might.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत्समागमः
तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्गमः
verses.transliteration:
adbhutaśca vicitraśca teṣāmāsītsamāgamaḥ
tatra vānarasainyānāṁ śalabhānāmivodgamaḥ

translations.english: And wonderful and astonishing was their meeting. And the concourse at that place of the monkey-forces was like the concourse of locusts.

verses.sanskrit:
परिपूर्णमिवाकाशं संछन्नेव च मेदिनी
लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च संपतद्भिश्च वानरैः
verses.transliteration:
paripūrṇamivākāśaṁ saṁchanneva ca medinī
laṅkāmupaniviṣṭaiśca saṁpatadbhiśca vānaraiḥ

translations.english: The air was filled up, and the earth was covered quite with the monkeys coursing towards Lankā and dropping down into it.

verses.sanskrit:
शतं शतसहस्राणां पृथगृक्षवनौकसाम्
लङ्का द्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धुं समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
śataṁ śatasahasrāṇāṁ pṛthagṛkṣavanaukasām
laṅkā dvārāṇyupājagmuranye yoddhuṁ samantataḥ

translations.english: And hundreds and thousands making up the army of monkeys, arrived at the gate of Lanka; while others were pouring in from all sides for encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
आवृतः स गिरिः सर्वैस्तैः समन्तात्प्लवंगमैः
अयुतानां सहस्रं च पुरीं तामभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
āvṛtaḥ sa giriḥ sarvaistaiḥ samantātplavaṁgamaiḥ
ayutānāṁ sahasraṁ ca purīṁ tāmabhyavartata

translations.english: That mount was covered with monkeys by all sides and a thousand ayutas were going round the city.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्च बभूव द्रुमपाणिभिः
सर्वतः संवृता लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशापि वायुना
verses.transliteration:
vānarairbalavadbhiśca babhūva drumapāṇibhiḥ
sarvataḥ saṁvṛtā laṅkā duṣpraveśāpi vāyunā

translations.english: And Larkā, blocked up everywhere with powerful monkeys bearing trees in their hands, was incapable of being entered even by the Wind.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुः सहसाभिनिपीडिताः
वानरैर्मेघसंकाशैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasā vismayaṁ jagmuḥ sahasābhinipīḍitāḥ
vānarairmeghasaṁkāśaiḥ śakratulyaparākramaiḥ

translations.english: The Rākşasas, sore pressed by thousands of monkeys resembling masses of clouds, and like to Śakra himself in battle, were seized with amazement.

verses.sanskrit:
महाञ्शब्दोऽभवत्तत्र बलौघस्याभिवर्ततः
सागरस्येव भिन्नस्य यथा स्यात्सलिलस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
mahāñśabdo'bhavattatra balaughasyābhivartataḥ
sāgarasyeva bhinnasya yathā syātsalilasvanaḥ

translations.english: Like to the roar of water on the ocean being riven, there arose a mighty tumult in consequence of the forces surging hither and thither.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा
लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration:
tena śabdena mahatā saprākārā satoraṇā
laṅkā pracalitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā

translations.english: With that sound the entire Lankā, with her wall and gateways, her mountains, woods, and forests, began to shake.

verses.sanskrit:
रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी
बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration:
rāmalakṣmaṇaguptā sā sugrīveṇa ca vāhinī
babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ

translations.english: That army, protected by Rāma and Lakşmaņa as well as Sugrīva, became and the more invincible even by the Asuras and celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुः क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित्
विभीषणस्यानुमते राजधर्ममनुस्मरन्
अङ्गदं वालितनयं समाहूयेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
ānantaryamabhiprepsuḥ kramayogārthatattvavit
vibhīṣaṇasyānumate rājadharmamanusmaran
aṅgadaṁ vālitanayaṁ samāhūyedamabravīt

translations.english: Having arraigned his forces with the view of destroying the Räkşasa, Rāghava, versed in the resources of war, taking counsel of the counsellors, and deciding again and again his course of action, intending to adopt further measures, resolved to abide by the advice of Vibhīşaņa, remembering the morality regulating monarchs. And then, calling Vāli's son, Angada, (Rāma) said.

verses.sanskrit:
गत्वा सौम्य दशग्रीवं ब्रूहि मद्वचनात्कपे
लङ्घयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां भयं त्यक्त्वा गतव्यथः
verses.transliteration:
gatvā saumya daśagrīvaṁ brūhi madvacanātkape
laṅghayitvā purīṁ laṅkāṁ bhayaṁ tyaktvā gatavyathaḥ

translations.english: O mild one, going to the Ten-necked one, tell him in my words, Bounding over the deep and casting off fear and dejection, I have laid siege to the city of Lankā; and have reft you of your prosperity and your wealth; and rendered you moribund and senseless.

verses.sanskrit:
नूनमद्य गतो दर्पः स्वयम्भू वरदानजः
यस्य दण्डधरस्तेऽहं दाराहरणकर्शितः
दण्डं धारयमाणस्तु लङ्काद्वरे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
nūnamadya gato darpaḥ svayambhū varadānajaḥ
yasya daṇḍadharaste'haṁ dārāharaṇakarśitaḥ
daṇḍaṁ dhārayamāṇastu laṅkādvare vyavasthitaḥ

translations.english: You have, O night-ranger, through delusion and pride injured saints and celestials, and Gandharvas and Apsaras, and Serpents, and Yaksas, and crowned heads. But, O Raksasa, your pride begot of the boon received from the Self-create has gone from you, whose destroyer I, afflicted in consequence of my wife having been carried off, wielding the rod, have sat down at the door of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
पदवीं देवतानां च महर्षीणां च राक्षस
राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां गमिष्यसि मया हतः
verses.transliteration:
padavīṁ devatānāṁ ca maharṣīṇāṁ ca rākṣasa
rājarṣīṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ gamiṣyasi mayā hataḥ

translations.english: O Rākşasa, you shall, remaining steady in fight, attain the state of celestials and Maharsis and Rājarşis.

verses.sanskrit:
बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम
मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तद्विदर्शय
verses.transliteration:
balena yena vai sītāṁ māyayā rākṣasādhama
māmatikrāmayitvā tvaṁ hṛtavāṁstadvidarśaya

translations.english: O worst of Rākşasas, do you display that prowess of your by which, aided by your power of illusion, you have forcible carried off Sītā, disregarding me.

verses.sanskrit:
अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः
न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि मामुपादाय मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
arākṣasamimaṁ lokaṁ kartāsmi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
na ceccharaṇamabhyeṣi māmupādāya maithilīm

translations.english: I shall with my sharpened shafts render this world free from Rākşasas, unless rendering back Mitbila's daughter, you throw yourself on my mercy.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मात्मा रक्षसां श्रेष्ठः संप्राप्तोऽयं विभीषणः
लङ्कैश्वर्यं ध्रुवं श्रीमानयं प्राप्नोत्यकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration:
dharmātmā rakṣasāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ saṁprāpto'yaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
laṅkaiśvaryaṁ dhruvaṁ śrīmānayaṁ prāpnotyakaṇṭakam

translations.english: And, for certain, that foremost of Rākşasas, the righteous and graceful Vibhīşaņa, who has joined us, shall obtain, without having a thorn in his side, all this wealth of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया
शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविजितात्मना
verses.transliteration:
na hi rājyamadharmeṇa bhoktuṁ kṣaṇamapi tvayā
śakyaṁ mūrkhasahāyena pāpenāvijitātmanā

translations.english: For you, foolish, wicked, ignorant of selfknowledge, and having dolts for councillors, are not competent to unrighteously exercise kingship for a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
युध्यस्व वा धृतिं कृत्वा शौर्यमालम्ब्य राक्षस
मच्छरैस्त्वं रणे शान्तस्ततः पूतो भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yudhyasva vā dhṛtiṁ kṛtvā śauryamālambya rākṣasa
maccharaistvaṁ raṇe śāntastataḥ pūto bhaviṣyasi

translations.english: Fight you, O Rāksasa, summoning fortitude and heroism. On being slain with my shafts, you shall attain peace.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्याविशसि लोकांस्त्रीन्पक्षिभूतो मनोजवः
मम चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य न जीवन्प्रतियास्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yadyāviśasi lokāṁstrīnpakṣibhūto manojavaḥ
mama cakṣuṣpathaṁ prāpya na jīvanpratiyāsyasi

translations.english: O night-ranger, if you should range the three worlds in the shape of a bird, you, coming in my ken, shall not be able to preserve your life.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रवीमि त्वां हितं वाक्यं क्रियतामौर्ध्वदेकिकम्
सुदृष्टा क्रियतां लङ्का जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
bravīmi tvāṁ hitaṁ vākyaṁ kriyatāmaurdhvadekikam
sudṛṣṭā kriyatāṁ laṅkā jīvitaṁ te mayi sthitam

translations.english: It is all this for your good; do you perform acts for the good of your body surviving death; and do you see Lankā well; for your life is in my keeping.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktaḥ sa tu tāreyo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
jagāmākāśamāviśya mūrtimāniva havyavāṭ

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma of untiring deeds, Tara's son went through the welkin like the embodied bearer of sacrificial offerings.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम्
ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह
verses.transliteration:
so'tipatya muhūrtena śrīmānrāvaṇamandiram
dadarśāsīnamavyagraṁ rāvaṇaṁ sacivaiḥ saha

translations.english: Arriving near that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, in a moment, that graceful one saw Rāvana, sitting calmly in the midst of his ministers.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्याविदूरेण निपत्य हरिपुंगवः
दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदः कनकाङ्गदः
verses.transliteration:
tatastasyāvidūreṇa nipatya haripuṁgavaḥ
dīptāgnisadṛśastasthāvaṅgadaḥ kanakāṅgadaḥ

translations.english: And dropping down in his vicinity like a flaming fire, that best of monkeys, Augada, resembling a golden bracelet, stood there.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्रामवचनं सर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम्
सामात्यं श्रावयामास निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना
verses.transliteration:
tadrāmavacanaṁ sarvamanyūnādhikamuttamam
sāmātyaṁ śrāvayāmāsa nivedyātmānamātmanā

translations.english: Then introducing himself, Angada delivered to Rāvana along with his ministers all that Rama had excellently spoken to him, neither extenuating nor setting down aught of himself.

verses.sanskrit:
दूतोऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
वालिपुत्रोऽङ्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः
verses.transliteration:
dūto'haṁ kosalendrasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
vāliputro'ṅgado nāma yadi te śrotramāgataḥ

translations.english: I am the envoy of the king of Kosala, Rāma of untiring deeds; and I am the son of Vāli I do not know whether you have heard of me.

verses.sanskrit:
आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः
निष्पत्य प्रतियुध्यस्व नृशंसं पुरुषाधम
verses.transliteration:
āha tvāṁ rāghavo rāmaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ
niṣpatya pratiyudhyasva nṛśaṁsaṁ puruṣādhama

translations.english: Raghu's son, Rāma-enhancer of Kausaiya's joy-has said to you, 'Do you, O fell one, coming out, give me battle and prove your prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम्
निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि
verses.transliteration:
hantāsmi tvāṁ sahāmātyaṁ saputrajñātibāndhavam
nirudvignāstrayo lokā bhaviṣyanti hate tvayi

translations.english: I shall slay you together with your ministers, and with your sons and relations and friends. And you being slain, the three worlds shall attain peace.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्
शत्रुमद्योद्धरिष्यामि त्वामृषीणां च कण्टकम्
verses.transliteration:
devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ gandharvoragarakṣasām
śatrumadyoddhariṣyāmi tvāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca kaṇṭakam

translations.english: Today shall I destroy the enemy of the gods and Dänavas, and Yakşas, of the Gandharvas serpents and Rākṣasas, and the thorn (in the side of the Saints).

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि
न चेत्सत्कृत्य वैदेहीं प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇasya caiśvaryaṁ bhaviṣyati hate tvayi
na cetsatkṛtya vaidehīṁ praṇipatya pradāsyasi

translations.english: On you being slain, all the wealth shall be Vibhisana's; unless, bowing down (to me) and paying me homage, you render back Maithilī.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुंगवे
अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ bruvāṇe haripuṁgave
amarṣavaśamāpanno niśācaragaṇeśvaraḥ

translations.english: When that monkey-chief had spoken thus, the lord of the night-rangers was wrought up with wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स रोषताम्राक्षः शशास सचिवांस्तदा
गृह्यतामेष दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa roṣatāmrākṣaḥ śaśāsa sacivāṁstadā
gṛhyatāmeṣa durmedhā vadhyatāmiti cāsakṛt

translations.english: And coming under the sway of passion, he commanded his counsellors, saying, "Take this one of perverse understanding, and slay him at once.”

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसः
जगृहुस्तं ततो घोराश्चत्वारो रजनीचराः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dīptāgnisamatejasaḥ
jagṛhustaṁ tato ghorāścatvāro rajanīcarāḥ

translations.english: Hearing Råvaņa's speech, four grim-visaged night rangers seized (Angada) flaming in energy like fire itself,

verses.sanskrit:
ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मना
बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा
verses.transliteration:
grāhayāmāsa tāreyaḥ svayamātmānamātmanā
balaṁ darśayituṁ vīro yātudhānagaṇe tadā

translations.english: Tara's son suffered himself to be taken, in order that the hero might then display his prowess before the Yātudhānas.

verses.sanskrit:
स तान्बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव
प्रासादं शैलसंकाशमुत्पापाताङ्गदस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
sa tānbāhudvaye saktānādāya patagāniva
prāsādaṁ śailasaṁkāśamutpāpātāṅgadastadā

translations.english: Then Angada, taking them up, who were pressed against his arms, like insects, leapt up on a palace resembling a hill.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्य वेगेन राक्षसाः
भुमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः
verses.transliteration:
te'ntarikṣādvinirdhūtāstasya vegena rākṣasāḥ
bhumau nipatitāḥ sarve rākṣasendrasya paśyataḥ

translations.english: Thereat, in consequence of the impetuosity of his bound, the Raksasas, slipping off, fell on to the ground in the very sight of the Rākṣasa king.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्
तत्पफाल तदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṁ śailaśṛṅgamivonnatam
tatpaphāla tadākrāntaṁ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ

translations.english: Then the powerful son of Vāli with his legs attacked the top of that palace, elevated like a hill, of the lord of Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः
विनद्य सुमहानादमुत्पपात विहायसा
verses.transliteration:
bhaṅktvā prāsādaśikharaṁ nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ
vinadya sumahānādamutpapāta vihāyasā

translations.english: Having reft the top of the edifice, and proclaimed his name, Angada, setting up a mighty roar, sprang into the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्तु परं चक्रे क्रोधं प्रासादधर्षणात्
विनाशं चात्मनः पश्यन्निःश्वासपरमोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastu paraṁ cakre krodhaṁ prāsādadharṣaṇāt
vināśaṁ cātmanaḥ paśyanniḥśvāsaparamo'bhavat

translations.english: Rāvana was transported with wrath in consequence of the breaking down of the palace. And, finding his destruction (at hand), he began to heave sighs.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्तु बहुभिर्हृष्टैर्निनदद्भिः प्लवंगमैः
वृतो रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
rāmastu bahubhirhṛṣṭairninadadbhiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ
vṛto ripuvadhākāṅkṣī yuddhāyaivābhyavartata

translations.english: Rāma, surrounded by innumerable delighted monkeys setting up shouts, anxious for slaying his foe, prepared for battle.

verses.sanskrit:
सुषेणस्तु महावीर्यो गिरिकूटोपमो हरिः
बहुभिः संवृतस्तत्र वानरैः कामरूपिभिः
verses.transliteration:
suṣeṇastu mahāvīryo girikūṭopamo hariḥ
bahubhiḥ saṁvṛtastatra vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ

translations.english: At the command of Sugrīva, the exceedingly powerful monkey-Susena, resembling a mountain-summit, surrounded by a large number of monkeys capable of assuming shapes at pleasure, began to range from door to door; like the Moon ranging the stars.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामक्षौहिणिशतं समवेक्ष्य वनौकसाम्
लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानां सागरं चातिवर्तताम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmakṣauhiṇiśataṁ samavekṣya vanaukasām
laṅkāmupaniviṣṭānāṁ sāgaraṁ cātivartatām

translations.english: Seeing the hundred Akşauhinis of the woodrangers, stationed in Lankā, extending down to the sea, some of the Rākşasas were struck with astonishment, while some came under the influence of fear; and some experienced delight from the (anticipated) delight of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
कृत्स्नं हि कपिभिर्व्याप्तं प्राकारपरिखान्तरम्
ददृशू राक्षसा दीनाः प्राकारं वानरीकृतम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtsnaṁ hi kapibhirvyāptaṁ prākāraparikhāntaram
dadṛśū rākṣasā dīnāḥ prākāraṁ vānarīkṛtam

translations.english: The space between the well and the moat all was flooded with monkeys. And the distressed Rākşasas saw the wall thronging with monkeys; and thereat exclaiming “Alas” “Alas,” the Rāks asa were extremely terrified. *A translator cannot help feeling of disappointment at the difference, to the disadvantage of English-between Sanskrit and English. The original for 'thronging with monkeys' is a verbal attributivevanarikrita-lit. monkeyed.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्महाभीषणके प्रवृत्ते; कोलाहले राक्षसराजधान्याम्
प्रगृह्य रक्षांसि महायुधानि; युगान्तवाता इव संविचेरुः
verses.transliteration:
tasminmahābhīṣaṇake pravṛtte; kolāhale rākṣasarājadhānyām
pragṛhya rakṣāṁsi mahāyudhāni; yugāntavātā iva saṁviceruḥ

translations.english: On that frightful uproar arising, the warriors of the Rākşasa monarch, Raksasa-seizing mighty arms, began to patrol about, like to winds blowing at the time to the universal dissolution. a

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र गत्वा रावणमन्दिरम्
न्यवेदयन्पुरीं रुद्धां रामेण सह वानरैः
verses.transliteration:
tataste rākṣasāstatra gatvā rāvaṇamandiram
nyavedayanpurīṁ ruddhāṁ rāmeṇa saha vānaraiḥ

translations.english: Then those Rākşasas, going to that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, informed him that Rāma along with the monkeys had laid siege to the city.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्धां तु नगरीं श्रुत्वा जातक्रोधो निशाचरः
विधानं द्विगुणं श्रुत्वा प्रासादं सोऽध्यरोहत
verses.transliteration:
ruddhāṁ tu nagarīṁ śrutvā jātakrodho niśācaraḥ
vidhānaṁ dviguṇaṁ śrutvā prāsādaṁ so'dhyarohata

translations.english: Hearing the city besieged, the night-ranger was enraged. And, hearing that double arrangements had been made (by Rāma) in guarding the gateways (Råvaņa) ascended the palace.

verses.sanskrit:
स ददर्शावृतां लङ्कां सशैलवनकाननाम्
असंख्येयैर्हरिगणैः सर्वतो युद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः
verses.transliteration:
sa dadarśāvṛtāṁ laṅkāṁ saśailavanakānanām
asaṁkhyeyairharigaṇaiḥ sarvato yuddhakāṅkṣibhiḥ

translations.english: He saw Lanka with her hills, woods, and forests, covered everywhere with innumerable monkeys eager for encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
स दृष्ट्वा वानरैः सर्वां वसुधां कवलीकृताम्
कथं क्षपयितव्याः स्युरिति चिन्तापरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
sa dṛṣṭvā vānaraiḥ sarvāṁ vasudhāṁ kavalīkṛtām
kathaṁ kṣapayitavyāḥ syuriti cintāparo'bhavat

translations.english: He saw the entire Earth tawneyed with the monkeys; and he reflected within himself how he could destroy these.

verses.sanskrit:
स चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं धैर्यमालम्ब्य रावणः
राघवं हरियूथांश्च ददर्शायतलोचनः
verses.transliteration:
sa cintayitvā suciraṁ dhairyamālambya rāvaṇaḥ
rāghavaṁ hariyūthāṁśca dadarśāyatalocanaḥ

translations.english: And reflecting for long, Rāvana having expansive eyes, Assuming patience, gazed at Rāghava and the leader of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रेक्षतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तान्यनीकानि भागशः
राघवप्रियकामार्थं लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
prekṣato rākṣasendrasya tānyanīkāni bhāgaśaḥ
rāghavapriyakāmārthaṁ laṅkāmāruruhustadā

translations.english: And for doing what was dear to Rāma, that army, divided into separate parties, in the presence of the Raksasa chief commenced scaling Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
ते ताम्रवक्त्रा हेमाभा रामार्थे त्यक्तजीविताः
लङ्कामेवाह्यवर्तन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः
verses.transliteration:
te tāmravaktrā hemābhā rāmārthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
laṅkāmevāhyavartanta sālatālaśilāyudhāḥ

translations.english: Those copper-faced once of golden sheen, who had consecrated their lives to the service of Rāma, equipped with trees and rocks, began to throng upon Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
पारिखाः पूरयन्ति स्म प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः
पांसुभिः पर्वताग्रैश्च तृणैः काष्ठैश्च वानराः
verses.transliteration:
pārikhāḥ pūrayanti sma prasannasalilāyutāḥ
pāṁsubhiḥ parvatāgraiśca tṛṇaiḥ kāṣṭhaiśca vānarāḥ

translations.english: The monkeys with trees and hill-tops and blows crushed countless gates and tops of walls; and they filled the moat containing crystal water with dust, tops of crags, straw, and wood.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सहस्रयूथाश्च कोटियूथाश्च यूथपाः
कोटीशतयुताश्चान्ये लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sahasrayūthāśca koṭiyūthāśca yūthapāḥ
koṭīśatayutāścānye laṅkāmāruruhustadā

translations.english: Then leader of thousands and koțis and hundreds of koțis began to scale Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
काञ्चनानि प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि प्लवंगमाः
कैलासशिखराभानि गोपुराणि प्रमथ्य च
verses.transliteration:
kāñcanāni pramṛdnantastoraṇāni plavaṁgamāḥ
kailāsaśikharābhāni gopurāṇi pramathya ca

translations.english: The monkeys crushed golden gateways; and, breaking down gates resembling the tops of the summits of Kailasa, bounded roaring, some towards the wall and some all around. And resembling gigantic elephants, they rushed towards Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः
राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः
verses.transliteration:
jayatyatibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ

translations.english: Victory to the mighty Rāma, and victory to the exceedingly powerful Lakşmaņa, and Victory to king Sugriva, who is protected by Rāghava.' Thus shouting, those monkeys, wearing forms at will, sending up roars, rushed amain towards the wall of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
वीरबाहुः सुबाहुश्च नलश्च वनगोचरः
निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्ते प्राकारं हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
vīrabāhuḥ subāhuśca nalaśca vanagocaraḥ
nipīḍyopaniviṣṭāste prākāraṁ hariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: And Virabăhu, Subāhu, Nala and Panasaleader of monkeys-breaking (a portion of) the wall, took up their post there. In the meantime, (they) arranged the forces in order of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वद्वारं तु कुमुदः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः
आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः
verses.transliteration:
pūrvadvāraṁ tu kumudaḥ koṭibhirdaśabhirvṛtaḥ
āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau haribhirjitakāśibhiḥ

translations.english: The strong Kumuda, surrounded by ten kotis of victorious monkeys, stood obstruction the Estern gate.

verses.sanskrit:
दक्षिणद्वारमागम्य वीरः शतबलिः कपिः
आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ विंशत्या कोटिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
dakṣiṇadvāramāgamya vīraḥ śatabaliḥ kapiḥ
āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau viṁśatyā koṭibhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: And obstruction the Southern entrance stood the strong and gallant monkey, Śatabali surrounded by twenty koțis.

verses.sanskrit:
सुषेणः पश्चिमद्वारं गतस्तारा पिता हरिः
आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ षष्टि कोटिभिरावृतः
verses.transliteration:
suṣeṇaḥ paścimadvāraṁ gatastārā pitā hariḥ
āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau ṣaṣṭi koṭibhirāvṛtaḥ

translations.english: The strong sire of Tārā the powerful Sus ena, obstructed the Western gate, backed by kot is upon kotis (of monkeys).

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ सुग्रीवश्च हरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
uttaradvāramāsādya rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau sugrīvaśca harīśvaraḥ

translations.english: Obstructing the Northern gate, remained the puissant Răma himself along with Sumitrā's son, as well as the king of monkeys-Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
गोलाङ्गूलो महाकायो गवाक्षो भीमदर्शनः
वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थौ रामस्य पार्वतः
verses.transliteration:
golāṅgūlo mahākāyo gavākṣo bhīmadarśanaḥ
vṛtaḥ koṭyā mahāvīryastasthau rāmasya pārvataḥ

translations.english: That huge-bodied and dreadful Golangula-the mighty and powerful Gavākşa-surrounded by a koti, remained by the side of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
संनद्धस्तु महावीर्यो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः
वृतो यस्तैस्तु सचिवैस्तस्थौ तत्र महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
saṁnaddhastu mahāvīryo gadāpāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ
vṛto yastaistu sacivaistasthau tatra mahābalaḥ

translations.english: That destroyer of foes-the exceedingly mighty Dhūmra of the bears of terrific wrath, remained by the side of Rāma-where, surrounded by vigilant counsellors, and bearing a mace in his hand stood the exceedingly strong Vibhīşana, endowed with wonderful powers, in complete panoply.

verses.sanskrit:
गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः
समन्तात्परिघावन्तो ररक्षुर्हरिवाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ
samantātparighāvanto rarakṣurharivāhinīm

translations.english: And Gaya, and Gavāksa, and Gavaya, and Śarabha, and Gandhamādana, protected the monkey-army, coursing all around.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
निर्याणं सर्वसैन्यानां द्रुतमाज्ञापयत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
niryāṇaṁ sarvasainyānāṁ drutamājñāpayattadā

translations.english: Then, his soul wrought up with wrath, Rāvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-speedily ordered the whole host to sally out.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्पतन्ति ततः सैन्या हृष्टा रावणचोदिताः
समये पूर्यमाणस्य वेगा इव महोदधेः
verses.transliteration:
niṣpatanti tataḥ sainyā hṛṣṭā rāvaṇacoditāḥ
samaye pūryamāṇasya vegā iva mahodadheḥ

translations.english: And commanded by Råvana, the troops cheerfully issued forth like the onrushing of the mighty main filling all at the time of the universal dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरः संग्रामः समपद्यत
रक्षसां वानराणां च यथा देवासुरे पुरा
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare ghoraḥ saṁgrāmaḥ samapadyata
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca yathā devāsure purā

translations.english: In the meantime there commenced a mighty a encounter between the Raksasas and the monkey, like that which took place of yore between the gods and the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गदाभिः प्रदीप्ताभिः शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः
निजघ्नुर्वानरान्घोराः कथयन्तः स्वविक्रमान्
verses.transliteration:
te gadābhiḥ pradīptābhiḥ śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ
nijaghnurvānarānghorāḥ kathayantaḥ svavikramān

translations.english: And displaying their prowess, They* began to slaughter monkeys with maces, and darts, and adzes. *Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा वृक्षैर्महाकायाः पर्वताग्रैश्च वानराः
राक्षसास्तानि रक्षांसि नखैर्दन्तैश्च वेगिताः
verses.transliteration:
tathā vṛkṣairmahākāyāḥ parvatāgraiśca vānarāḥ
rākṣasāstāni rakṣāṁsi nakhairdantaiśca vegitāḥ

translations.english: The vehement monkeys (on their side) slaughtered Rākşasa with trees and tops of crags as well as with their nails and teeth.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसास्त्वपरे भीमाः प्राकारस्था महीगतान्
भिण्डिपालैश्च खड्गैश्च शूलैश्चैव व्यदारयन्
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasāstvapare bhīmāḥ prākārasthā mahīgatān
bhiṇḍipālaiśca khaḍgaiśca śūlaiścaiva vyadārayan

translations.english: Then other dreadful Rākṣasa that were stationed upon the wall, dropping down, pierced the monkeys with darts and bhindipālas.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराश्चापि संक्रुद्धाः प्राकारस्थान्महीगताः
राक्षसान्पातयामासुः समाप्लुत्य प्लवंगमाः
verses.transliteration:
vānarāścāpi saṁkruddhāḥ prākārasthānmahīgatāḥ
rākṣasānpātayāmāsuḥ samāplutya plavaṁgamāḥ

translations.english: And (thereat) the monkeys, flying into fury, descending to the earth and bounding, brought down the Rākşasas with their arms.

verses.sanskrit:
स संप्रहारस्तुमुलो मांसशोणितकर्दमः
रक्षसां वानराणां च संबभूवाद्भुतोपमाः
verses.transliteration:
sa saṁprahārastumulo māṁsaśoṇitakardamaḥ
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca saṁbabhūvādbhutopamāḥ

translations.english: That encounter of the Rākşasas and the monkeys was mighty and wonderful, and the ground became wet with flesh and gore.

verses.sanskrit:
युध्यतां तु ततस्तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम्
रक्षसां संबभूवाथ बलकोपः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration:
yudhyatāṁ tu tatasteṣāṁ vānarāṇāṁ mahātmanām
rakṣasāṁ saṁbabhūvātha balakopaḥ sudāruṇaḥ

translations.english: As the high-soulcd monkeys and Raksasas taught on, their wrath vastly increase at sight of each other's forces.

verses.sanskrit:
ते हयैः काञ्चनापीडैर्ध्वजैश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः
रथैश्चादित्यसंकाशैः कवचैश्च मनोरमैः
verses.transliteration:
te hayaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍairdhvajaiścāgniśikhopamaiḥ
rathaiścādityasaṁkāśaiḥ kavacaiśca manoramaiḥ

translations.english: And furnished with steeds in golden trappings, and elephants resembling flames of fire; and cars appearing like (so many) suns; and shining armour, the valiant Räkşasas issued, making the ten cardinal points resound. The Rākşasas of terrific exploits were burning for victory on behalf of Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणामपि चमूर्महती जयमिच्चताम्
अभ्यधावत तां सेनां रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāmapi camūrmahatī jayamiccatām
abhyadhāvata tāṁ senāṁ rakṣasāṁ kāmarūpiṇām

translations.english: The mighty monkey-army also, eager for victory, darted against the host of the Rākşasa of dreadful deeds.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामन्योन्यमभिधावताम्
रक्षसां वानराणां च द्वन्द्वयुद्धमवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare teṣāmanyonyamabhidhāvatām
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca dvandvayuddhamavartata

translations.english: In the meanwhile, as either party assailed the other, there took place single combats between the Raksasas and the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदेनेन्द्रजित्सार्धं वालिपुत्रेण राक्षसः
अयुध्यत महातेजास्त्र्यम्बकेण यथान्धकः
verses.transliteration:
aṅgadenendrajitsārdhaṁ vāliputreṇa rākṣasaḥ
ayudhyata mahātejāstryambakeṇa yathāndhakaḥ

translations.english: And as Andhaka had combated with the Three-eyed (deity), That Raksasas, the exceedingly energetic Indrajit, faught with Angada, Son to Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजङ्घेन च संपातिर्नित्यं दुर्मर्षणो रणे
जम्बूमालिनमारब्धो हनूमानपि वानरः
verses.transliteration:
prajaṅghena ca saṁpātirnityaṁ durmarṣaṇo raṇe
jambūmālinamārabdho hanūmānapi vānaraḥ

translations.english: Sampāti, hard to to bear, engaged with Prajangha; and the monkey, Hanumān, entered into conflict with Jambumālī.

verses.sanskrit:
संगतः सुमहाक्रोधो राक्षसो रावणानुजः
समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन मित्रघ्नेन विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
saṁgataḥ sumahākrodho rākṣaso rāvaṇānujaḥ
samare tīkṣṇavegena mitraghnena vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: And Ravana's younger brother, Vibhisana, fired with wrath, encountered Śatrughna, endowed with exceeding impetuosity.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरेन्द्रस्तु सुग्रीवः प्रघसेन समागतः
संगतः समरे श्रीमान्विरूपाक्षेण लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
vānarendrastu sugrīvaḥ praghasena samāgataḥ
saṁgataḥ samare śrīmānvirūpākṣeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: The highly powerful Nīla engaged with undertook Praghasa, and the graceful Lakşmaņa was engaged with Virüpākşa.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसः
सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च रामेण सह संगताः
verses.transliteration:
agniketuśca durdharṣo raśmiketuśca rākṣasaḥ
suptaghno yajñakopaśca rāmeṇa saha saṁgatāḥ

translations.english: The exceedingly irrepressible Agniketu and the Raksasa Rasmiketu-and Mitraghna and Yajñakopa, were engaged with Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
वज्रमुष्टिस्तु मैन्देन द्विविदेनाशनिप्रभः
राक्षसाभ्यां सुघोराभ्यां कपिमुख्यौ समागतौ
verses.transliteration:
vajramuṣṭistu maindena dvividenāśaniprabhaḥ
rākṣasābhyāṁ sughorābhyāṁ kapimukhyau samāgatau

translations.english: Vajramuștti encountered Mainda, and Asaniprabha Dvivida. And those foremost of monkeys faught with those dreadful Rākşasas, the heroic and terrible Pratapana, incapable of being overcome in battle, was combating with Nala of terrific force; and that lusty son of Righteousness, well-known as Susena, a mighty monkey-battled with Vidyunmāli.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराश्चापरे भीमा राक्षसैरपरैः सह
द्वन्द्वं समीयुर्बहुधा युद्धाय बहुभिः सह
verses.transliteration:
vānarāścāpare bhīmā rākṣasairaparaiḥ saha
dvandvaṁ samīyurbahudhā yuddhāya bahubhiḥ saha

translations.english: And other fearful monkeys encountered other Rākşasas; and many were the encounters the took place.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रासीत्सुमहद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्
रक्षसां वानराणां च वीराणां जयमिच्छताम्
verses.transliteration:
tatrāsītsumahadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ lomaharṣaṇam
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca vīrāṇāṁ jayamicchatām

translations.english: And great and fierce was the engagement that took place between the heroic Rakşasas and monkeys burning for victory, capable of making people's hair stand on end.

verses.sanskrit:
हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यः प्रसृताः केशशाड्वलाः
शरीरसंघाटवहाः प्रसुस्रुः शोणितापगाः
verses.transliteration:
harirākṣasadehebhyaḥ prasṛtāḥ keśaśāḍvalāḥ
śarīrasaṁghāṭavahāḥ prasusruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ
