शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धुकामाः प्लवंगमाः
verses.transliteration:
jagṛhuḥ pādapāṁścāpi puṣpitānvānararṣabhāḥ
śilāśca vipulā dīrghā yoddhukāmāḥ plavaṁgamāḥ

translations.english: The monkeys on their part, eager for encounter, took up flowing trees and hills and huge and broad crags.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्
बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवृष्टिं च वर्षताम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmanyonyamāsādya saṁgrāmaḥ sumahānabhūt
bahūnāmaśmavṛṣṭiṁ ca śaravṛṣṭiṁ ca varṣatām

translations.english: And each party approaching the other, great was the encounter that took place. And innumerable (monkeys and Rākṣasas) kept showering rocks and arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून्वानरयूथपान्
वानरा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुर्बहवो बहून्
verses.transliteration:
bahavo rākṣasā yuddhe bahūnvānarayūthapān
vānarā rākṣasāṁścāpi nijaghnurbahavo bahūn

translations.english: And many Rākşasas in conflict slew many a powerful monkey, and the monkeys on their part slaughtered many a Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
शूलैः प्रमथिताः केचित्केचित्तु परमायुधैः
परिघैराहताः केचित्केचिच्छिन्नाः परश्वधैः
verses.transliteration:
śūlaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecitkecittu paramāyudhaiḥ
parighairāhatāḥ kecitkecicchinnāḥ paraśvadhaiḥ

translations.english: Some were pierced with darts and with (other) powerful weapons; and some were wounded with bludgeons; and some were hewn with axes.

verses.sanskrit:
निरुच्छ्वासाः पुनः केचित्पतिता धरणीतले
विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदिषुसंतानसंदिताः
verses.transliteration:
nirucchvāsāḥ punaḥ kecitpatitā dharaṇītale
vibhinnahṛdayāḥ kecidiṣusaṁtānasaṁditāḥ

translations.english: Some rendered senseless, dropped down to the earth, and some hit with weapons, had their breasts riven.

verses.sanskrit:
केचिद्द्विधाकृताः खड्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि
वानरा राक्षसैः शूलैः पार्श्वतश्च विदारिताः
verses.transliteration:
keciddvidhākṛtāḥ khaḍgaiḥ sphurantaḥ patitā bhuvi
vānarā rākṣasaiḥ śūlaiḥ pārśvataśca vidāritāḥ

translations.english: Some, severed in twain with swords, dropped to the earth lifeless, and monkeys were hewn in their sides by heroic Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरैश्चापि संक्रुद्धै राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः
पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च संपिष्टा वसुधातले
verses.transliteration:
vānaraiścāpi saṁkruddhai rākṣasaughāḥ samantataḥ
pādapairgiriśṛṅgaiśca saṁpiṣṭā vasudhātale

translations.english: Numbers of Rākşasas all around were beaten to the ground by infuriated monkeys with trees and mountain-peaks.

verses.sanskrit:
वज्रस्पर्शतलैर्हस्तैर्मुष्टिभिश्च हता भृशम्
वेमुः शोणितमास्येभ्यो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः
verses.transliteration:
vajrasparśatalairhastairmuṣṭibhiśca hatā bhṛśam
vemuḥ śoṇitamāsyebhyo viśīrṇadaśanekṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Some smitten sore with slaps having the touch of the thunder-bolt, began to vomit blood from their mouths, with faces and eyes turned pale.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्तस्वरं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम्
बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसां युधि
verses.transliteration:
ārtasvaraṁ ca svanatāṁ siṁhanādaṁ ca nardatām
babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo harīṇāṁ rakṣasāṁ yudhi

translations.english: And great was the uproar that arose in consequence of Rākṣasas and monkeys emitting distressful cries and sending forth leonine roars.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरा राक्षसाः क्रुद्धा वीरमार्गमनुव्रताः
विवृत्तनयनाः क्रूराश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत्
verses.transliteration:
vānarā rākṣasāḥ kruddhā vīramārgamanuvratāḥ
vivṛttanayanāḥ krūrāścakruḥ karmāṇyabhītavat

translations.english: Monkeys and Rākṣasas wrought up with wrath, engaged in treading the path of heroes, looking terrific with their faces moving about, performed deeds of intrepid courage.

verses.sanskrit:
नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः
एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः
verses.transliteration:
narāntakaḥ kumbhahanurmahānādaḥ samunnataḥ
ete prahastasacivāḥ sarve jaghnurvanaukasaḥ

translations.english: Narāntaka and Kambhahanu and Mahānand and Samunnata-all counsellors of Prahasta-set about slaughtering the rangers of the woods.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामापततां शीघ्रं निघ्नतां चापि वानरान्
द्विविदो गिरिशृङ्गेण जघानैकं नरान्तकम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmāpatatāṁ śīghraṁ nighnatāṁ cāpi vānarān
dvivido giriśṛṅgeṇa jaghānaikaṁ narāntakam

translations.english: Of these doing swift execution among the monkeys, Dvivida, taking up a mountain-peak, slew one-namely Narāntaka.

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्मुखः पुनरुत्पाट्य कपिः स विपुलद्रुमम्
राक्षसं क्षिप्रहस्तस्तु समुन्नतमपोथयत्
verses.transliteration:
durmukhaḥ punarutpāṭya kapiḥ sa vipuladrumam
rākṣasaṁ kṣiprahastastu samunnatamapothayat

translations.english: Then the monkey, Durmaukha, rising up afresh, armed with a mighty tree, killed the lighthanded Räksasa-Samunnata.

verses.sanskrit:
जाम्बवांस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम्
पातयामास तेजस्वी महानादस्य वक्षसि
verses.transliteration:
jāmbavāṁstu susaṁkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṁ śilām
pātayāmāsa tejasvī mahānādasya vakṣasi

translations.english: Jāmbavān endowed with energy, waxing enraged, uplifting a giant crag brought the same down on Mahananda's breast.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ कुम्भहनुस्तत्र तारेणासाद्य वीर्यवान्
वृक्षेणाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि प्राणांस्तत्याज राक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
atha kumbhahanustatra tāreṇāsādya vīryavān
vṛkṣeṇābhihato mūrdhni prāṇāṁstatyāja rākṣasaḥ

translations.english: There speedily assailed by Tārā, with a mighty tree, the powerful Kumbhahanu gave up the ghost in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्म प्रहस्तो रथमास्थितः
चकार कदनं घोरं धनुष्पाणिर्वनौकसाम्
verses.transliteration:
amṛṣyamāṇastatkarma prahasto rathamāsthitaḥ
cakāra kadanaṁ ghoraṁ dhanuṣpāṇirvanaukasām

translations.english: And not brooking that feat, Prahasta, mounted on a car, taking a bow in his hand, fell to spreading a dreadful havoc among the rangers of the woods.

verses.sanskrit:
आवर्त इव संजज्ञे उभयोः सेनयोस्तदा
क्षुभितस्याप्रमेयस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
āvarta iva saṁjajñe ubhayoḥ senayostadā
kṣubhitasyāprameyasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ

translations.english: Then there the two hosts mingled into almost a vortex; and the sounds that arose from those infuriated once of immeasurable might, resembled the roar of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
महता हि शरौघेण प्रहस्तो युद्धकोविदः
अर्दयामास संक्रुद्धो वानरान्परमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
mahatā hi śaraugheṇa prahasto yuddhakovidaḥ
ardayāmāsa saṁkruddho vānarānparamāhave

translations.english: In terrific encounter the enraged Rākşasa irresistible in battle drove the monkeys to sore straits with showers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणां शरीरैस्तु राक्षसानां च मेदिनी
बभूव निचिता घोरा पतितैरिव पर्वतैः
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāṁ śarīraistu rākṣasānāṁ ca medinī
babhūva nicitā ghorā patitairiva parvataiḥ

translations.english: The earth was covered quite with the terrible bodies of monkeys and Rākşasas; and it looked as if covered with mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
सा महीरुधिरौघेण प्रच्छन्ना संप्रकाशते
संछन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैरिव पुष्पितैः
verses.transliteration:
sā mahīrudhiraugheṇa pracchannā saṁprakāśate
saṁchannā mādhave māsi palāśairiva puṣpitaiḥ

translations.english: The earth drenched with streams of gore looked as if swarming with blossoming palāśas in the month of spring.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सृजन्तं बाणौघान्प्रहस्तं स्यन्दने स्थितम्
ददर्श तरसा नीलो विनिघ्नन्तं प्लवंगमान्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sṛjantaṁ bāṇaughānprahastaṁ syandane sthitam
dadarśa tarasā nīlo vinighnantaṁ plavaṁgamān

translations.english: Then all of a sudden Nila saw Prahasta stationed on his car, discharging vollies of shafts and harassing the monkeys therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं परमदुर्धर्षमापतन्तं महाकपिः
प्रहस्तं ताडयामास वृक्षमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ paramadurdharṣamāpatantaṁ mahākapiḥ
prahastaṁ tāḍayāmāsa vṛkṣamutpāṭya vīryavān

translations.english: That mighty monkey-Nila-endowed with energy, struck with those sharpened shafts resembling flames, uprooting a tree, assailed therewith the irrepressible Prahasta-who was rushing against him.

verses.sanskrit:
स तेनाभिहतः क्रुद्धो नदन्राक्षसपुंगवः
ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि प्लवगानां चमूपतौ
verses.transliteration:
sa tenābhihataḥ kruddho nadanrākṣasapuṁgavaḥ
vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi plavagānāṁ camūpatau

translations.english: Thereat, that foremost of Raksasas, on being attacked, flaming up into fury and uttering roars, poured showers of arrows on the monkeyleader.

verses.sanskrit:
अपारयन्वारयितुं प्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः
यथैव गोवृषो वर्षं शारदं शीघ्रमागतम्
verses.transliteration:
apārayanvārayituṁ pratyagṛhṇānnimīlitaḥ
yathaiva govṛṣo varṣaṁ śāradaṁ śīghramāgatam

translations.english: And not being able to resist the arrowy vollies of that wicked-minded Raksasas, (Nila) bore them, even as a bull bear with closed eyes a fastdescending autumnal shower. And in the very same way did Nila with his eyes closed suddenly stand the mighty arrowy buffet of Prahasta incapable of being withstood.

verses.sanskrit:
रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान्
प्रजघान हयान्नीलः प्रहस्तस्य मनोजवान्
verses.transliteration:
roṣitaḥ śaravarṣeṇa sālena mahatā mahān
prajaghāna hayānnīlaḥ prahastasya manojavān

translations.english: And wrought up with rage, the exceedingly strong and mighty Nila with a giant Sala slew the steeds of Prahasta.

verses.sanskrit:
विधनुस्तु कृतस्तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः
प्रगृह्य मुसलं घोरं स्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे
verses.transliteration:
vidhanustu kṛtastena prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ
pragṛhya musalaṁ ghoraṁ syandanādavapupluve

translations.english: On being bereft of his bow, Prahasta, general of forces, taking a terrible mace, leapt down from his car.

verses.sanskrit:
तावुभौ वाहिनीमुख्यौ जातरोषौ तरस्विनौ
स्थितौ क्षतजदिग्धाङ्गौ प्रभिन्नाविव कुञ्जरौ
verses.transliteration:
tāvubhau vāhinīmukhyau jātaroṣau tarasvinau
sthitau kṣatajadigdhāṅgau prabhinnāviva kuñjarau

translations.english: The redoubtable leaders endowed with activity, bearing hostility to each other, their persons bathed in blood, stood (on the ground) like two elephants (with their temples) riven,

verses.sanskrit:
उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम्
सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ
verses.transliteration:
ullikhantau sutīkṣṇābhirdaṁṣṭrābhiritaretaram
siṁhaśārdūlasadṛśau siṁhaśārdūlaceṣṭitau

translations.english: They kept tearing each other with their teeth like a lion and a tiger, and alsò striving like a lion and a tiger.

verses.sanskrit:
विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ
काङ्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोः समौ
verses.transliteration:
vikrāntavijayau vīrau samareṣvanivartinau
kāṅkṣamāṇau yaśaḥ prāptuṁ vṛtravāsavayoḥ samau

translations.english: Endowed with victorious vigour, those heroes, never knowing to desist from fight, were eager for fame, even like Vrtra and Vasava (fighting).

verses.sanskrit:
आजघान तदा नीलं ललाटे मुसलेन सः
प्रहस्तः परमायस्तस्तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम्
verses.transliteration:
ājaghāna tadā nīlaṁ lalāṭe musalena saḥ
prahastaḥ paramāyastastasya susrāva śoṇitam

translations.english: Then Prahasta putting forth his dearest effort, hit Nila on the temples with a mace; and the blood began to flow.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रगृह्य सुमहातरुम्
प्रहस्तस्योरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महाकपिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śoṇitadigdhāṅgaḥ pragṛhya sumahātarum
prahastasyorasi kruddho visasarja mahākapiḥ

translations.english: Then the mighty monkey, with his person drenched in blood, wrought up with passion, discharged a tall tree at Prahasta's breast.

verses.sanskrit:
तमचिन्त्यप्रहारं स प्रगृह्य मुसलं महत्
अभिदुद्राव बलिनं बली नीलं प्लवंगमम्
verses.transliteration:
tamacintyaprahāraṁ sa pragṛhya musalaṁ mahat
abhidudrāva balinaṁ balī nīlaṁ plavaṁgamam

translations.english: Without caring for that hit, he, taking up a mighty mace, furiously rushed against the monkey-Nila.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः
ततः संप्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम्
verses.transliteration:
tamugravegaṁ saṁrabdhamāpatantaṁ mahākapiḥ
tataḥ saṁprekṣya jagrāha mahāvego mahāśilām

translations.english: Witnessing that enraged (hero) rushing against him with exceeding impetuosity, that redoubted monkey endowed with vehemence, took up a tremendous crag.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य युद्धाभिकामस्य मृधे मुसलयोधिनः
प्रहस्तस्य शिलां नीलो मूर्ध्नि तूर्णमपातयत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya yuddhābhikāmasya mṛdhe musalayodhinaḥ
prahastasya śilāṁ nīlo mūrdhni tūrṇamapātayat

translations.english: In the encounter Nila at once let that crag alight right on the head of Prahasta, eager for encounter and fighting with the mace. And hurled by that foremost of monkeys, that huge and terrific crag then shattered Prahasta's head in pieces.

verses.sanskrit:
स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः
पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration:
sa gatāsurgataśrīko gatasattvo gatendriyaḥ
papāta sahasā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ

translations.english: Then bereft of life and shorn of nerve and devoid of sense he suddenly dropped down to the earth like a tree whose roots have been severed.

verses.sanskrit:
विभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्रावशोणितम्
शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा
verses.transliteration:
vibhinnaśirasastasya bahu susrāvaśoṇitam
śarīrādapi susrāva gireḥ prasravaṇaṁ yathā

translations.english: Even as fountains flow from the sides of a hill, blood flowed profusely from the person of that one, whose head had been riven.

verses.sanskrit:
हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महद्बलम्
रक्षसामप्रहृष्टानां लङ्कामभिजगाम ह
verses.transliteration:
hate prahaste nīlena tadakampyaṁ mahadbalam
rakṣasāmaprahṛṣṭānāṁ laṅkāmabhijagāma ha

translations.english: On Prahasta being slain by Nila, that mighty army of Raksasas never trembling (from fear). retreated towards Larikā.

verses.sanskrit:
हते तस्मिंश्चमूमुख्ये राक्षसस्ते निरुद्यमाः
रक्षःपतिगृहं गत्वा ध्यानमूकत्वमागताः
verses.transliteration:
hate tasmiṁścamūmukhye rākṣasaste nirudyamāḥ
rakṣaḥpatigṛhaṁ gatvā dhyānamūkatvamāgatāḥ

translations.english: And like waters rushing (through a breach in) a dyke, the Rākşasas could not stand their ground, on their leader being slain. And on that head of the hosts being killed, the Rākşasas, growing dispirited, repairing to the residence of the lord of Rākşasa, remained plunged in thought, without speaking anything. And plunged in that sea of sorrow, they seemed as if they had been bereft of their senses.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु नीलो विजयी महाबलः; प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा
समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन; प्रहृष्टरूपस्तु बभूव यूथपः
verses.transliteration:
tatastu nīlo vijayī mahābalaḥ; praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā
sametya rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena; prahṛṣṭarūpastu babhūva yūthapaḥ

translations.english: Then the highly powerful and victorious Nila, leader of forces, on being extolled with gracious offices, and on being joined by Rāma and Laks maņa looked exceedingly exhilarated.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्हते राक्षससैन्यपाले; प्लवंगमानामृषभेण युद्धे
भीमायुधं सागरतुल्यवेगं; प्रदुद्रुवे राक्षसराजसैन्यम्
verses.transliteration:
tasminhate rākṣasasainyapāle; plavaṁgamānāmṛṣabheṇa yuddhe
bhīmāyudhaṁ sāgaratulyavegaṁ; pradudruve rākṣasarājasainyam

translations.english: On the leader of the Rākşasa host being slain in battle by the foremost of monkeys, that army of the Rākşasas monarch, resembling the ocean in violence, furnished with dreadful weapons, began to scamper away.

verses.sanskrit:
गत्वा तु रक्षोऽधिपतेः शशंसुः; सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम्
तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य; रक्षोऽधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम
verses.transliteration:
gatvā tu rakṣo'dhipateḥ śaśaṁsuḥ; senāpatiṁ pāvakasūnuśastam
taccāpi teṣāṁ vacanaṁ niśamya; rakṣo'dhipaḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma

translations.english: Going to the lord of the Rākşasas, they ar prised hin, of the dealth of his general at the hands of the Fire-god's offspring. And hearing those words of theirs, the Rākşasas lord was overcome with rage.

verses.sanskrit:
संख्ये प्रहस्तं निहतं निशम्य; शोकार्दितः क्रोधपरीतचेताः
उवाच तान्नैरृतयोधमुख्या;निन्द्रो यथा चामरयोधमुख्यान्
verses.transliteration:
saṁkhye prahastaṁ nihataṁ niśamya; śokārditaḥ krodhaparītacetāḥ
uvāca tānnairṛtayodhamukhyā;nindro yathā cāmarayodhamukhyān

translations.english: And hearing that Prahasta had been killed in battle (he), exercised with passion, with his heart influenced with grief, addressed those foremost of the Raksasas host, even as Indra addressed the chiefs among the celestials, saying

verses.sanskrit:
नावज्ञा रिपवे कार्या यैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः
सूदितः सैन्यपालो मे सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः
verses.transliteration:
nāvajñā ripave kāryā yairindrabalasūdanaḥ
sūditaḥ sainyapālo me sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ

translations.english: That foe should no longer be disregarded that has slain along with his followers and elephants that leader of my host that had destroyed the forces of Indra himself.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन्
स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ ripuvināśāya vijayāyāvicārayan
svayameva gamiṣyāmi raṇaśīrṣaṁ tadadbhutam

translations.english: Therefore, without taking thought, will I, for compassing the destruction of the foe myself march to that marvellous field of fight.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य तद्वानरानीकं रामं च सहलक्ष्मणम्
निर्दहिष्यामि बाणौघैर्वनं दीप्तैरिवाग्निभिः
verses.transliteration:
adya tadvānarānīkaṁ rāmaṁ ca sahalakṣmaṇam
nirdahiṣyāmi bāṇaughairvanaṁ dīptairivāgnibhiḥ

translations.english: Today, even as a flaming fire burn down a forest, will I with showers of shafts burn up that monkey-army, and Rama and Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
स एवमुक्त्वा ज्वलनप्रकाशं; रथं तुरंगोत्तमराजियुक्तम्
प्रकाशमानं वपुषा ज्वलन्तं; समारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः
verses.transliteration:
sa evamuktvā jvalanaprakāśaṁ; rathaṁ turaṁgottamarājiyuktam
prakāśamānaṁ vapuṣā jvalantaṁ; samārurohāmararājaśatruḥ

translations.english: Saying this, that enemy of the sovereign of the immortals ascended a flaming vehicle of dazzling sheen yoked to rows of excellent steeds, displaying itself gloriously and having a glowing body.

verses.sanskrit:
स शङ्खभेरीपटह प्रणादै;रास्फोटितक्ष्वेडितसिंहनादैः
पुण्यैः स्तवैश्चाप्यभिपूज्यमान;स्तदा ययौ राक्षसराजमुख्यः
verses.transliteration:
sa śaṅkhabherīpaṭaha praṇādai;rāsphoṭitakṣveḍitasiṁhanādaiḥ
puṇyaiḥ stavaiścāpyabhipūjyamāna;stadā yayau rākṣasarājamukhyaḥ

translations.english: And eulogized with sacred hymns, the sovereign of the Rākşasa rulers then set out to the sounds of conchs and trumpets and Panavas; and in the midst of those produced by persons striking at their arms, with their hands, and of the sounds defiance, and leonine roars.

verses.sanskrit:
स शैलजीमूतनिकाश रूपै;र्मांसाशनैः पावकदीप्तनेत्रैः
बभौ वृतो राक्षसराजमुख्यै;र्भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवामरेशः
verses.transliteration:
sa śailajīmūtanikāśa rūpai;rmāṁsāśanaiḥ pāvakadīptanetraiḥ
babhau vṛto rākṣasarājamukhyai;rbhūtairvṛto rudra ivāmareśaḥ

translations.english: Like that lord of the immortals-Rudrasurrounded by ghosts, the foremost of the Rākṣsa monarchs was surrounded by bands of flesh-feeding (Raksasa) resembling cliffs and clouds-with eyes glowing like fire.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो नगर्याः सहसा महौजा; निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्
महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितं ददर्श; समुद्यतं पादपशैलहस्तम्
verses.transliteration:
tato nagaryāḥ sahasā mahaujā; niṣkramya tadvānarasainyamugram
mahārṇavābhrastanitaṁ dadarśa; samudyataṁ pādapaśailahastam

translations.english: At once issuing from the city, that one endowed with high energy saw that fierce array of monkeys, extended as the ocean or a mighty mass of clouds, with arms upraised with rocks and stones.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्ड;मालोक्य रामो भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः
विभीषणं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठ;मुवाच सेनानुगतः पृथुश्रीः
verses.transliteration:
tadrākṣasānīkamatipracaṇḍa;mālokya rāmo bhujagendrabāhuḥ
vibhīṣaṇaṁ śastrabhṛtāṁ variṣṭha;muvāca senānugataḥ pṛthuśrīḥ

translations.english: Seeing that terrific host of Räkşasas, that eminently auspicious one, followed by the forces, having arms resembling the lord of serpents-Rama-spoke to Vibhişana foremost of those bearing arms.

verses.sanskrit:
नानापताकाध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टं; प्रासासिशूलायुधचक्रजुष्टम्
सैन्यं नगेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टं; कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टम्
verses.transliteration:
nānāpatākādhvajaśastrajuṣṭaṁ; prāsāsiśūlāyudhacakrajuṣṭam
sainyaṁ nagendropamanāgajuṣṭaṁ; kasyedamakṣobhyamabhīrujuṣṭam

translations.english: Whose is this force furnished with various ensigns and standards-and equipped with pracas and swords and darts and other arms, consisting of intrepid (Rakşasas), and having, elephants resembling Mahendra* itself. *The mountain so named.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं; विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः
शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं; महात्मनां राक्षसपुंगवानाम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastu rāmasya niśamya vākyaṁ; vibhīṣaṇaḥ śakrasamānavīryaḥ
śaśaṁsa rāmasya balapravekaṁ; mahātmanāṁ rākṣasapuṁgavānām

translations.english: Then hearing Rama's speech, Vibhisana, possessed of the prowess of Sakra himself, informed Råma anent that foremost of hosts consisting of that flower of high souled Räkş asas, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
योऽसौ गजस्कन्धगतो महात्मा; नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः
प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरोऽभ्युपैति; ह्यकम्पनं त्वेनमवेहि राजन्
verses.transliteration:
yo'sau gajaskandhagato mahātmā; navoditārkopamatāmravaktraḥ
prakampayannāgaśiro'bhyupaiti; hyakampanaṁ tvenamavehi rājan

translations.english: O king, him do you know to be Akampana, who, possessed of a high soul, is on the back of that elephant, whose face looks like the sun new risen, and who approach making the head of his elephant tremble (with the splendour of his person).* *This meaning is the commentator's.

verses.sanskrit:
योऽसौ रथस्थो मृगराजकेतु;र्धून्वन्धनुः शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम्
करीव भात्युग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः; स इन्द्रजिन्नाम वरप्रधानः
verses.transliteration:
yo'sau rathastho mṛgarājaketu;rdhūnvandhanuḥ śakradhanuḥprakāśam
karīva bhātyugravivṛttadaṁṣṭraḥ; sa indrajinnāma varapradhānaḥ

translations.english: That one is named Indrajit-foremost by virtue of the boon (that he has obtained), who ascending a car and having a lion for his ensign, twange his bow like the very bow of Sakra displayed, and who with his terrific round teeth appear like an elephant.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चैष विन्ध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पो; धन्वी रथस्थोऽतिरथोऽतिवीर्यः
विस्फारयंश्चापमतुल्यमानं; नाम्नातिकायोऽतिविवृद्धकायः
verses.transliteration:
yaścaiṣa vindhyāstamahendrakalpo; dhanvī rathastho'tiratho'tivīryaḥ
visphārayaṁścāpamatulyamānaṁ; nāmnātikāyo'tivivṛddhakāyaḥ

translations.english: That one of a gigantic person is named Atikāya, that, like to the Setting-hill of Vindhya, furnished with the bow and stationed on a car, highly heroic, stretch his bow of unparalleled proportions.

verses.sanskrit:
योऽसौ नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षु;रारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम्
गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा; महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः
verses.transliteration:
yo'sau navārkoditatāmracakṣu;rāruhya ghaṇṭāninadapraṇādam
gajaṁ kharaṁ garjati vai mahātmā; mahodaro nāma sa eṣa vīraḥ

translations.english: That high souled hero is named Mahodara that, furnished with right coppery eyes resembling the sun new risen, and ascending a car resonant with the sound of bells, shout shrill.

verses.sanskrit:
योऽसौ हयं काञ्चनचित्रभाण्ड;मारुह्य संध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम्
प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं; पिशाच एषाशनितुल्यवेगः
verses.transliteration:
yo'sau hayaṁ kāñcanacitrabhāṇḍa;māruhya saṁdhyābhragiriprakāśam
prāsaṁ samudyamya marīcinaddhaṁ; piśāca eṣāśanitulyavegaḥ

translations.english: That one having the vehemence of the thunder-bolt is Pisacha, that, mounted on a steed in variegated golden trappings, and having the aspect of a mass of evening clouds, or a mountain, (appear) with a prāsa furnished with effulgence.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य; विद्युत्प्रभं किंकरवज्रवेगम्
वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाश;मायाति सोऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी
verses.transliteration:
yaścaiṣa śūlaṁ niśitaṁ pragṛhya; vidyutprabhaṁ kiṁkaravajravegam
vṛṣendramāsthāya giriprakāśa;māyāti so'sau triśirā yaśasvī

translations.english: That one is the famed Trisiras, that grasping a whetted dart endowed with the splendour of lightning and having the speed of the thunder for its minister, approach, riding a bull-the best of his species-and having the appearance of the Moon himself.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ च जीमूतनिकाश रूपः; कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः
समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतु;र्विस्फारयन्भाति धनुर्विधून्वन्
verses.transliteration:
asau ca jīmūtanikāśa rūpaḥ; kumbhaḥ pṛthuvyūḍhasujātavakṣāḥ
samāhitaḥ pannagarājaketu;rvisphārayanbhāti dhanurvidhūnvan

translations.english: That one looking like a mass of clouds, that, having a broad and beautiful breast and a banner surmounted with the king of serpents, goes in collected carriage, stretching his bow is Kumbha.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं; दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य
आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतः; सोऽसौ निकुम्भोऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा
verses.transliteration:
yaścaiṣa jāmbūnadavajrajuṣṭaṁ; dīptaṁ sadhūmaṁ parighaṁ pragṛhya
āyāti rakṣobalaketubhūtaḥ; so'sau nikumbho'dbhutaghorakarmā

translations.english: That one is Nikumbha of wondrous valorous deeds (in battle) that, grasping a flaming and smoky bludgeon embellished with gold and diamonds, come-a very banner of the entire Rāksasa host.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं; पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम्
रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो; नरान्तकोऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी
verses.transliteration:
yaścaiṣa cāpāsiśaraughajuṣṭaṁ; patākinaṁ pāvakadīptarūpam
rathaṁ samāsthāya vibhātyudagro; narāntako'sau nagaśṛṅgayodhī

translations.english: That one is Narāntaka, fighting with mountain-peaks, that appear before us, mounted on a car flaming like fire, furnished with pennons and equipped with bows and swords and shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः
सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजःसमावृतम्
verses.transliteration:
āditya iva duṣprekṣyo raśmibhirbhāti rāvaṇaḥ
suvyaktaṁ lakṣaye hyasya rūpaṁ tejaḥsamāvṛtam

translations.english: Then Rāma-repressor of foes-answered Vibhisana, saying, “Alas! Ravana-lord of the Rākşasas-is of exceeding glowing splendour; and Rāvana shine in glory, and is incapable of being gazed at like the Sun himself. And his grace, being enshrouded in his own splendour, I cannot view plainly.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत्
यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत्प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration:
devadānavavīrāṇāṁ vapurnaivaṁvidhaṁ bhavet
yādṛśaṁ rākṣasendrasya vapuretatprakāśate

translations.english: The persons of celestials appear splendid as does the person of the Raksasa-chief.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे पर्वतसंकाशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः
सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधश्चास्य महौजसः
verses.transliteration:
sarve parvatasaṁkāśāḥ sarve parvatayodhinaḥ
sarve dīptāyudhadharā yodhaścāsya mahaujasaḥ

translations.english: All the warriors of the high-souled one are like mountain and fight with crags; and all are equipped with flaming weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
भाति राक्षसराजोऽसौ प्रदीप्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः
भूतैः परिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः
verses.transliteration:
bhāti rākṣasarājo'sau pradīptairbhīmavikramaiḥ
bhūtaiḥ parivṛtastīkṣṇairdehavadbhirivāntakaḥ

translations.english: And environed by glowing ghosts of dreadful forms and fierce-looking and furnished with material tenements the king of Räkşasas appear imposing like the Destroyer himself.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्
लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tato rāmo dhanurādāya vīryavān
lakṣmaṇānucarastasthau samuddhṛtya śarottamam

translations.english: Having said this, Rāma endowed with prowess, eve followed by Laksmana, stood, taking up his bow and pulling out a powerful shaft.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स रक्षोऽधिपतिर्महात्मा; रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि
द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु; सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa rakṣo'dhipatirmahātmā; rakṣāṁsi tānyāha mahābalāni
dvāreṣu caryāgṛhagopureṣu; sunirvṛtāstiṣṭhata nirviśaṅkāḥ

translations.english: Then that high-souled lord of Rākşasas addressed that mighty host, saying, "Do you casting off fear stay at ease, at the gateways, high ways, and the edifices (in Lankā).

verses.sanskrit:
विसर्जयित्वा सहसा ततस्ता;न्गतेषु रक्षःसु यथानियोगम्
व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौघं; महाझषः पूर्ममिवार्णवौघम्
verses.transliteration:
visarjayitvā sahasā tatastā;ngateṣu rakṣaḥsu yathāniyogam
vyadārayadvānarasāgaraughaṁ; mahājhaṣaḥ pūrmamivārṇavaugham

translations.english: Then leaving those counsellors, (Ravana) on the Raksasa having departed agreeably to his injunction, dived into that ocean of monkeys, like a mighty fish diving into the waves of over brimming deep.

verses.sanskrit:
तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य; दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम्
महत्समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं; दुद्राव रक्षोऽधिपतिं हरीशः
verses.transliteration:
tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya; dīpteṣucāpaṁ yudhi rākṣasendram
mahatsamutpāṭya mahīdharāgraṁ; dudrāva rakṣo'dhipatiṁ harīśaḥ

translations.english: Seeing the lord of Rākşasas, furnished with flaming deep. And seeing the lord of Rākşasas, furnished with flaming a bow and arrows, suddenly rushing, the king of monkeys uprooting a mighty mountain-top, darted against the sovereign of the Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं; प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय
तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य; बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः
verses.transliteration:
tacchailaśṛṅgaṁ bahuvṛkṣasānuṁ; pragṛhya cikṣepa niśācarāya
tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya; bibheda bāṇaistapanīyapuṅkhaiḥ

translations.english: Taking up that mountain-peak having its sides covered with innumerable trees, he hurled it at the night ranger. And seeing it descend swiftly, (Rāvana) in battle severed the same by means of gold-knobbed shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे; शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम्
महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं; समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः
verses.transliteration:
tasminpravṛddhottamasānuvṛkṣe; śṛṅge vikīrṇe patite pṛthivyām
mahāhikalpaṁ śaramantakābhaṁ; samādade rākṣasalokanāthaḥ

translations.english: On that gigantic peak furnished with fair sides filled with trees, falling to the earth, severed in pieces, the lord of Råkşasas took up an arrow, resembling a mighty serpent and having the splendour of the Destroyer himself.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं गृहीत्वानिलतुल्यवेगं; सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम्
बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं; चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ gṛhītvānilatulyavegaṁ; savisphuliṅgajvalanaprakāśam
bāṇaṁ mahendrāśanitulyavegaṁ; cikṣepa sugrīvavadhāya ruṣṭaḥ

translations.english: Taking that shaft endowed with the vehemence of the wind, flaming like a fire aglow, and having the impetuosity of the great Indra's thunder-bolt, (Ravana) hurled it in rage to compass the destruction of Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः; शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः
सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगा;द्गुहेरिता क्रौचमिवोग्रशक्तिः
verses.transliteration:
sa sāyako rāvaṇabāhumuktaḥ; śakrāśaniprakhyavapuḥ śitāgraḥ
sugrīvamāsādya bibheda vegā;dguheritā kraucamivograśaktiḥ

translations.english: Even as the fierce dart discharged by Guha' had pierced Krauñca, that shaft shot by Rāvana, rushing in violence at Sugrīva possessed of a person having the touch of Sakra's thunder-bolt, pierced it.

verses.sanskrit:
स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः; कूजन्पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः
तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसंज्मं; नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः
verses.transliteration:
sa sāyakārto viparītacetāḥ; kūjanpṛthivyāṁ nipapāta vīraḥ
taṁ prekṣya bhūmau patitaṁ visaṁjmaṁ; neduḥ prahṛṣṭā yudhi yātudhānāḥ

translations.english: Thereat, agonised by the shaft, that hero, with his senses bewildered, dropped down to the ground with shrieks. And seeing him down on the earth bereft of his senses, the Yātudhānas were filled with rejoicing.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्र;स्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नलश्च
शैलान्समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः; प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration:
tato gavākṣo gavayaḥ sudaṁṣṭra;statharṣabho jyotimukho nalaśca
śailānsamudyamya vivṛddhakāyāḥ; pradudruvustaṁ prati rākṣasendram

translations.english: Then Gavaksa and Gavaya, Susena, Rsabha, Jyotimukha and Nala, uprooting crags and magnifying their bodies, rushed against the lord of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणै;र्भिन्ना निपेतुर्भुवि भीमरूपाः
ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं; प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः
verses.transliteration:
te vānarendrāstridaśāribāṇai;rbhinnā nipeturbhuvi bhīmarūpāḥ
tatastu tadvānarasainyamugraṁ; pracchādayāmāsa sa bāṇajālaiḥ

translations.english: The lord of Rākşasas with hundreds of shafts having sharpened heads, rendered their strokes fruitless. And then he rived those foremost of monkeys with showers of arrows having variegated golden knobs, and covered those fierce monkey-ranks with networks of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
ते वध्यमानाः पतिताग्र्यवीरा; नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः
शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता; जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम्
verses.transliteration:
te vadhyamānāḥ patitāgryavīrā; nānadyamānā bhayaśalyaviddhāḥ
śākhāmṛgā rāvaṇasāyakārtā; jagmuḥ śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ sma rāmam

translations.english: On being sore assailed and falling in consequence, those heroes, the monkeys, pierced with terrific arrows, and distressed with the shafts of Rāvana, emitting cries, sought the shelter of Rāma worthy of being sought. Then the high-souled and excellent bowman-Rāma, taking his bow, at once sallied forth. And thereat, Laksmana, approaching Rama, with joined hands addressed him words couching prime import.

verses.sanskrit:
काममार्यः सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः
विधमिष्याम्यहं नीचमनुजानीहि मां विभो
verses.transliteration:
kāmamāryaḥ suparyāpto vadhāyāsya durātmanaḥ
vidhamiṣyāmyahaṁ nīcamanujānīhi māṁ vibho

translations.english: O noble one, I alone am fit to compass the destruction of this wicked-minded one. I will slay him. Do you, O master, permit me.

verses.sanskrit:
तमब्रवीन्महातेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
tamabravīnmahātejā rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
gaccha yatnaparaścāpi bhava lakṣmaṇa saṁyuge

translations.english: To him replied Rāma of exceeding energy, having truth for his prowess, “Go then O Lakşmaņa, and put forth your utmost exertions in the encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणेऽद्भुतपराक्रमः
त्रैलोक्येनापि संक्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo hi mahāvīryo raṇe'dbhutaparākramaḥ
trailokyenāpi saṁkruddho duṣprasahyo na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Rāvana is forsooth endowed with mighty energy, and his prowess in battle is wonderful. Without doubt, when enraged, he is incapable of being borne by this triple world.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च गोपय
चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः
verses.transliteration:
tasya cchidrāṇi mārgasva svacchidrāṇi ca gopaya
cakṣuṣā dhanuṣā yatnādrakṣātmānaṁ samāhitaḥ

translations.english: Do you keep an eye on his shortcomings as you should watch your own failings. Being always on the alert, you must with your eyes as much as your bow protect yourself.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संपरिष्वज्य पूज्य च
अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā saṁpariṣvajya pūjya ca
abhivādya tato rāmaṁ yayau saumitrirāhavam

translations.english: Hearing Rāghava's speech, Sumitrā's son, embracing Rāma, and saluting him and paying him his respect, went forth to battle.

verses.sanskrit:
स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहु;र्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम्
प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालै;स्तान्वानरान्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāvaṇaṁ vāraṇahastabāhu;rdadarśa dīptodyatabhīmacāpam
pracchādayantaṁ śaravṛṣṭijālai;stānvānarānbhinnavikīrṇadehān

translations.english: And (going to the field), he found Ravana, endowed with arms resembling the trunks of elephants, wielding his dreadful and flaming bow, and covering with showers of arrows those monkeys, whose bodies had been swarming with shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
तमालोक्य महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजा
निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुद्राव स रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
tamālokya mahātejā hanūmānmārutātmajā
nivārya śarajālāni pradudrāva sa rāvaṇam

translations.english: Seeing Răvaņa, the exceedingly powerful Hanuman-son to the Wind-god, resisting that downpour of arrows, charged him vehemently.

verses.sanskrit:
रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्
त्रासयन्रावणं धीमान्हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
rathaṁ tasya samāsādya bhujamudyamya dakṣiṇam
trāsayanrāvaṇaṁ dhīmānhanūmānvākyamabravīt

translations.english: Coming at his car, the intelligent Hanumān, uplifting his right arm and terrifying Rāvana, said.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षाश्च सह राक्षसैः
अवध्यत्वात्त्वया भग्ना वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम्
verses.transliteration:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣāśca saha rākṣasaiḥ
avadhyatvāttvayā bhagnā vānarebhyastu te bhayam

translations.english: Incapable of being slain by gods, Dānavas or Gandharvas, Yaksas or Raksasas, Fear has (at last), found you, coming even from monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
एष मे दक्षिणो बाहुः पञ्चशाखः समुद्यतः
विधमिष्यति ते देहाद्भूतात्मानं चिरोषितम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣa me dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ pañcaśākhaḥ samudyataḥ
vidhamiṣyati te dehādbhūtātmānaṁ ciroṣitam

translations.english: This my upraised right arm furnished with five fingers shall rod you of your soul long resident (in your body).

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः
संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā hanūmato vākyaṁ rāvaṇo bhīmavikramaḥ
saṁraktanayanaḥ krodhādidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing Hanuman's words, Ravana possessed of dreadful prowess, with his eyes reddened in wrath, said these words.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं प्रहर निःशङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि
ततस्त्वां ज्ञातिविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर
verses.transliteration:
kṣipraṁ prahara niḥśaṅkaṁ sthirāṁ kīrtimavāpnuhi
tatastvāṁ jñātivikrāntaṁ nāśayiṣyāmi vānara

translations.english: Strike you swift maugre fear; and acquire lasting renown. And, O monkey, having (at first) taken the measure of your might, will I finish you.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचोऽब्रवीत्
प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāyusūnurvaco'bravīt
prahṛtaṁ hi mayā pūrvamakṣaṁ smara sutaṁ tava

translations.english: Hearing Rāvana's words, the offspring of the Wind-god said, "(First) remember you your sonAkşa-slaughtered by me!"

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
evamukto mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
ājaghānānilasutaṁ talenorasi vīryavān

translations.english: Thus addressed, the exceedingly energetic lord of the Rākṣasas possessed of prowess dealt a slap to the offspring of the Wind-god. Struck with his slap, he shook momentarily.

verses.sanskrit:
स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः
आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम्
verses.transliteration:
sa talābhihatastena cacāla ca muhurmuhuḥ
ājaghānābhisaṁkruddhastalenaivāmaradviṣam

translations.english: And staying for a moment and calling up fortitude, that magnanimous one administered a slap to the foe of the immortals.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तलेनाभिहतो वानरेण महात्मना
दशग्रीवः समाधूतो यथा भूमिचलेऽचलः
verses.transliteration:
tatastalenābhihato vānareṇa mahātmanā
daśagrīvaḥ samādhūto yathā bhūmicale'calaḥ

translations.english: Hit by the high souled monkey, the Tennecked one trembled, as tremble a mountain during an earthquake.

verses.sanskrit:
संग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्व रावणं तलताडितम्
ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुराः
verses.transliteration:
saṁgrāme taṁ tathā dṛṣṭva rāvaṇaṁ talatāḍitam
ṛṣayo vānarāḥ siddhā nedurdevāḥ sahāsurāḥ

translations.english: Witnessing Răvaņa struck with a slap (by Hanumān saints and Siddhas and celestials and the Asuras shouted in glee.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाश्वस्य महातेजा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
साधु वानरवीर्येण श्लाघनीयोऽसि मे रिपुः
verses.transliteration:
athāśvasya mahātejā rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt
sādhu vānaravīryeṇa ślāghanīyo'si me ripuḥ

translations.english: Then attaining a little respite, Ravana said, “Well done, O monkey. In prowess you are a foe I pride in."

verses.sanskrit:
रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु मारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
धिगस्तु मम वीर्यं तु यत्त्वं जीवसि रावण
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇenaivamuktastu mārutirvākyamabravīt
dhigastu mama vīryaṁ tu yattvaṁ jīvasi rāvaṇa

translations.english: Thus addressed by Ravana, the Wind-god's son said, "Fie on my prowess seeing that you breath yet, O Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे
ततस्त्वां मामको मुष्टिर्नयिष्यामि यथाक्षयम्
ततो मारुतिवाक्येन क्रोधस्तस्य तदाज्वलत्
verses.transliteration:
sakṛttu praharedānīṁ durbuddhe kiṁ vikatthase
tatastvāṁ māmako muṣṭirnayiṣyāmi yathākṣayam
tato mārutivākyena krodhastasya tadājvalat

translations.english: Strike at the same time, O perverse one. Why did you bluster? And then my blow shall despatch you to the mansions of Yama.

verses.sanskrit:
संरक्तनयनो यत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्
पातयामास वेगेन वानरोरसि वीर्यवान्
हनूमान्वक्षसि व्यूधे संचचाल हतः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
saṁraktanayano yatnānmuṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam
pātayāmāsa vegena vānarorasi vīryavān
hanūmānvakṣasi vyūdhe saṁcacāla hataḥ punaḥ

translations.english: At the speech of the Wind-god's son, his ire flamed up. And then that one endowed with prowess clenching his right fist carefully, let it alight a main on the monkey's chest.

verses.sanskrit:
विह्वलं तं तदा दृष्ट्वा हनूमन्तं महाबलम्
रथेनातिरथः शीघ्रं नीलं प्रति समभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration:
vihvalaṁ taṁ tadā dṛṣṭvā hanūmantaṁ mahābalam
rathenātirathaḥ śīghraṁ nīlaṁ prati samabhyagāt

translations.english: Hit at his spacious chest, Hanumān shook over and over again. And seeing the mighty Hanumān overwhelmed, that powerful carwarrior ascended on his car, approached Nīla.

verses.sanskrit:
पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैः परमर्मातिभेदिभिः
शरैरादीपयामास नीलं हरिचमूपतिम्
verses.transliteration:
pannagapratimairbhīmaiḥ paramarmātibhedibhiḥ
śarairādīpayāmāsa nīlaṁ haricamūpatim

translations.english: The powerful lord of Raksasas-the Tennecked one-made that general of forces-Nilaaflame with dreadful shafts entering into the vitals, resembling snakes.

verses.sanskrit:
स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः
करेणैकेन शैलाग्रं रक्षोऽधिपतयेऽसृजत्
verses.transliteration:
sa śaraughasamāyasto nīlaḥ kapicamūpatiḥ
kareṇaikena śailāgraṁ rakṣo'dhipataye'sṛjat

translations.english: Assailed with shafts, Nila-leader of monkeyswith one arm took up a mountain-top and hurled it at the lord of Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमानपि तेजस्वी समाश्वस्तो महामनाः
विप्रेक्षमाणो युद्धेप्सुः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
hanūmānapi tejasvī samāśvasto mahāmanāḥ
viprekṣamāṇo yuddhepsuḥ saroṣamidamabravīt

translations.english: The energetic and high-minded Hanumăn, attaining respite, eager for encounter, seeing (the fight between the Raksasa and the monkey), wrought up with rage said, “It is not meet for me to attack Rāvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-engaged with Nila."

verses.sanskrit:
रावणोऽपि महातेजास्तच्छृङ्गं सप्तभिः शरैः
आजघान सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्विकीर्णं पपात ह
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo'pi mahātejāstacchṛṅgaṁ saptabhiḥ śaraiḥ
ājaghāna sutīkṣṇāgraistadvikīrṇaṁ papāta ha

translations.english: The highly powerful Rāvana, by means of seven shafts with sharpened points, hit at the mountain-top; and shivered in pieces, it fell (to the earth).

verses.sanskrit:
तद्विकीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः
कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल क्रोधेन परवीरहा
verses.transliteration:
tadvikīrṇaṁ gireḥ śṛṅgaṁ dṛṣṭvā haricamūpatiḥ
kālāgniriva jajvāla krodhena paravīrahā

translations.english: Seeing that mountain peak shattered, that general of the monkey-forces-slayer of hostile heroes-flamed up in wrath like the fire at the universal wreck.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽश्वकर्णान्धवान्सालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान्
अन्यांश्च विविधान्वृक्षान्नीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
so'śvakarṇāndhavānsālāṁścūtāṁścāpi supuṣpitān
anyāṁśca vividhānvṛkṣānnīlaścikṣepa saṁyuge

translations.english: In that encounter Nīla discharged Aśvakarņa trees, and sālas, and mangoes in full flower, and also various other trees.

verses.sanskrit:
स तान्वृक्षान्समासाद्य प्रतिचिच्छेद रावणः
अभ्यवर्षत्सुघोरेण शरवर्षेण पावकिम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tānvṛkṣānsamāsādya praticiccheda rāvaṇaḥ
abhyavarṣatsughoreṇa śaravarṣeṇa pāvakim

translations.english: Ravana, getting at the trees, severed them (by means of his arrows), and poured on the Firegod's son terrific showers of shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाचलः
ह्रस्वं कृत्वा तदा रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह
verses.transliteration:
abhivṛṣṭaḥ śaraugheṇa megheneva mahācalaḥ
hrasvaṁ kṛtvā tadā rūpaṁ dhvajāgre nipapāta ha

translations.english: Assailed with fearful showers of arrows as with a mass of clouds, that one endowed with eminent strength, decreasing his dimensions, dropped on the top of Ravana's banner.

verses.sanskrit:
पावकात्मजमालोक्य ध्वजाग्रे समवस्थितम्
जज्वाल रावणः क्रोधात्ततो नीलो ननाद ह
verses.transliteration:
pāvakātmajamālokya dhvajāgre samavasthitam
jajvāla rāvaṇaḥ krodhāttato nīlo nanāda ha

translations.english: Seeing the son of the Fire-god descend on the top of his banner. Råvana was fired with ire, and Nila shouted (thereat).

verses.sanskrit:
ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम्
लक्ष्मणोऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः
verses.transliteration:
dhvajāgre dhanuṣaścāgre kirīṭāgre ca taṁ harim
lakṣmaṇo'tha hanūmāṁśca dṛṣṭvā rāmaśca vismitāḥ

translations.english: Seeing the monkey (now) at the top of the banner, and (now) at the end of his bow, and (now) at the crest of his tiara, Laksmana and Hanuman and Rāma were stuck with astonishment.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणोऽपि महातेजाः कपिलाघवविस्मितः
अस्त्रमाहारयामास दीप्तमाग्नेयमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo'pi mahātejāḥ kapilāghavavismitaḥ
astramāhārayāmāsa dīptamāgneyamadbhutam

translations.english: Rāvana also endowed with exceeding energy, astonished at the lightness of the monkey, took up a wonderful flaming fiery weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते चुक्रुशुर्हृष्टा लब्धलक्ष्याः प्लवंगमाः
नीललाघवसंभ्रान्तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
tataste cukruśurhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣyāḥ plavaṁgamāḥ
nīlalāghavasaṁbhrāntaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇamāhave

translations.english: The monkeys seeing Rāvana bewildered, and delighted thereat, set up shouts.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा
संभ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किंचित्प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāṁ ca nādena saṁrabdho rāvaṇastadā
saṁbhramāviṣṭahṛdayo na kiṁcitpratyapadyata

translations.english: Rāvana enraged at the shouts of the monkeys, with his heart overwhelmed with agitation, could not address himself to any affort.

verses.sanskrit:
आग्नेयेनाथ संयुक्तं गृहीत्वा रावणः शरम्
ध्वजशीर्षस्थितं नीलमुदैक्षत निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
āgneyenātha saṁyuktaṁ gṛhītvā rāvaṇaḥ śaram
dhvajaśīrṣasthitaṁ nīlamudaikṣata niśācaraḥ

translations.english: Then taking a fiery shaft and setting the same on his bow, that night-ranger Rāvaņa gazed at Nila who was on the tip of his banner.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
कपे लाघवयुक्तोऽसि मायया परयानया
verses.transliteration:
tato'bravīnmahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
kape lāghavayukto'si māyayā parayānayā

translations.english: Then exceedingly energetic lord of the Rākşasas said, O monkey, by virtue of your skill in illusion, you are furnished with lightness.

verses.sanskrit:
तथापि त्वां मया मुक्तः सायकोऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः
जीवितं परिरक्षन्तं जीविताद्भ्रंशयिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tathāpi tvāṁ mayā muktaḥ sāyako'straprayojitaḥ
jīvitaṁ parirakṣantaṁ jīvitādbhraṁśayiṣyati

translations.english: But O monkey, if you can, preserve your life. You transform yourself into many shapes. Yet this shaft of mine discharged from my weapon, shall deprive of your life you that are preserving it.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
संधाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahābāhū rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
saṁdhāya bāṇamastreṇa camūpatimatāḍayat

translations.english: Having said this, the mighty-armed Ravanalord of the Rākşasas-fixing his shaft on his bow, shot it at the general.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः
निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले
verses.transliteration:
so'strayuktena bāṇena nīlo vakṣasi tāḍitaḥ
nirdahyamānaḥ sahasā nipapāta mahītale

translations.english: Nila, struck at the chest with that arrow, which had been shot (by Ravana), burning, suddenly fell down to the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
पितृमाहात्म्य संयोगादात्मनश्चापि तेजसा
जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत
verses.transliteration:
pitṛmāhātmya saṁyogādātmanaścāpi tejasā
jānubhyāmapatadbhūmau na ca prāṇairvyayujyata

translations.english: And by virtue of the greatness of his sire and also of his own energy, he went to the earth on his knees, but was not utterly deprived of life.

verses.sanskrit:
विसंज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः
रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे
verses.transliteration:
visaṁjñaṁ vānaraṁ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvo raṇotsukaḥ
rathenāmbudanādena saumitrimabhidudruve

translations.english: Seeing the monkey deprived of his senses, the Ten-necked one, eager for encounter, riding a car emitting a rattle resembling the rumbling of clouds, darted against Sumitra's son.

verses.sanskrit:
तमाह सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो; विस्फारयन्तं धनुरप्रमेयम्
अन्वेहि मामेव निशाचरेन्द्र; न वानरांस्त्वं प्रति योद्धुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tamāha saumitriradīnasattvo; visphārayantaṁ dhanuraprameyam
anvehi māmeva niśācarendra; na vānarāṁstvaṁ prati yoddhumarhasi

translations.english: As that one of immeasurable prowess kept stretching his bow. And as that one of immeasurable prowess kept stretching his bow, Sumitrā's son of unflagging mettle, addressed him saying, “O lord of night-rangers, do you today try me in encounter. You ought not to strive with the monkeys."

verses.sanskrit:
स तस्य वाक्यं परिपूर्णघोषं; ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा
आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं; कोपान्वितं वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः
verses.transliteration:
sa tasya vākyaṁ paripūrṇaghoṣaṁ; jyāśabdamugraṁ ca niśamya rājā
āsādya saumitrimavasthitaṁ taṁ; kopānvitaṁ vākyamuvāca rakṣaḥ

translations.english: Hearing Saumitri's speech uttered in a full voice, as well as the terrific twangs of his bowstring, that Raksasa-the king-approaching Sumitrā son staying in the field, spoke to him wrathfully.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्यासि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं; प्राप्तोऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः
अस्मिन्क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं; संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyāsi me rāghava dṛṣṭimārgaṁ; prāpto'ntagāmī viparītabuddhiḥ
asminkṣaṇe yāsyasi mṛtyudeśaṁ; saṁsādyamāno mama bāṇajālaiḥ

translations.english: O Raghu's son, by my luck have you of perverse sense, finding your fate come within the range of my ken. This very instant, tormented with the springs of my shafts, you will repair to the regions of Death.

verses.sanskrit:
तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो; गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम्
राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा; विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ
verses.transliteration:
tamāha saumitriravismayāno; garjantamudvṛttasitāgradaṁṣṭram
rājanna garjanti mahāprabhāvā; vikatthase pāpakṛtāṁ variṣṭha

translations.english: Thereat Sumitra's son, without being overwhelmed with wonder (on witnessing Rāvana's prowess), addressed that one furnished with large and sharp teeth, setting up roars, “O king, those who are (really) endowed with prowess, do no storm. O prince of sinners, in vain you vauntest.

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र; बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च
अवस्थितोऽहं शरचापपाणि;रागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन
verses.transliteration:
jānāmi vīryaṁ tava rākṣasendra; balaṁ pratāpaṁ ca parākramaṁ ca
avasthito'haṁ śaracāpapāṇi;rāgaccha kiṁ moghavikatthanena

translations.english: O lord of Raksasas, I know your prowess and strength and energy and vigour. Here am I stationed, bow and shafts in hand. Come you. What is the use of vain-glorious self-laudation?

verses.sanskrit:
स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज; रक्षोऽधिपः सप्तशरान्सुपुङ्खान्
ताँल्लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खै;श्चिच्छेद बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः
verses.transliteration:
sa evamuktaḥ kupitaḥ sasarja; rakṣo'dhipaḥ saptaśarānsupuṅkhān
tā̐llakṣmaṇaḥ kāñcanacitrapuṅkhai;ściccheda bāṇairniśitāgradhāraiḥ

translations.english: Thus accosted, the Raksasa monarch, growing wroth, discharged seven shafts furnished with knobs. Thereupon Lakşmaņa split them up with sharp-pointed arrows having variegated golden knobs.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्ता;न्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान्
लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम; ससर्ज चान्यान्निशितान्पृषत्कान्
verses.transliteration:
tānprekṣamāṇaḥ sahasā nikṛttā;nnikṛttabhogāniva pannagendrān
laṅkeśvaraḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma; sasarja cānyānniśitānpṛṣatkān

translations.english: They suddenly severed like powerful serpents cut.off, Lanka's lord came under the away of passion, and discharged other whetted arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीव्रं; रामानुजः कार्मुकसंप्रयुक्तम्
क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः; शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च
verses.transliteration:
sa bāṇavarṣaṁ tu vavarṣa tīvraṁ; rāmānujaḥ kārmukasaṁprayuktam
kṣurārdhacandrottamakarṇibhallaiḥ; śarāṁśca ciccheda na cukṣubhe ca

translations.english: Rāma's younger brother poured showers of arrows from his bow; and, planting himself at his post, cut off those arrows (of his adversary) by means of.razors, and crescents, and excellent karnas and darts.

verses.sanskrit:
स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शराञ्शिताग्रा;न्महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान्
संधाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशा;न्ससर्ज रक्षोऽधिपतेर्वधाय
verses.transliteration:
sa lakṣmaṇaścāśu śarāñśitāgrā;nmahendravajrāśanitulyavegān
saṁdhāya cāpe jvalanaprakāśā;nsasarja rakṣo'dhipatervadhāya

translations.english: Laksmana also, resembling Indra the Great, setting on his bow sharpened, sharp-pointed, flaming, and luminous shafts, endowed with the dreadful vehement impetus of the thunder-bolt, discharged (them) to compass the destruction of the lord of Räkşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
स तान्प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्र;श्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान
शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण; स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे
verses.transliteration:
sa tānpraciccheda hi rākṣasendra;śchittvā ca tā̐llakṣmaṇamājaghāna
śareṇa kālāgnisamaprabheṇa; svayambhudattena lalāṭadeśe

translations.english: Thereat the Rākşasa sovereign cut off those whetted arrows; and smote Lakşmaņa in the foreheads with an arrow resembling the Fire of Dooms-day in energy, which had been conferred on him by the Self-create.

verses.sanskrit:
स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्त;श्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य
पुनश्च संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्रा;च्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः
verses.transliteration:
sa lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇasāyakārta;ścacāla cāpaṁ śithilaṁ pragṛhya
punaśca saṁjñāṁ pratilabhya kṛcchrā;cciccheda cāpaṁ tridaśendraśatroḥ

translations.english: Laksmana, tortured with Ravan's arrow, shook, loosely holding his bow; and then recovering his consciousness after undergoing extreme agony he severed the bow of the foe of the foremost of celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
निकृत्तचापं त्रिभिराजघान; बाणैस्तदा दाशरथिः शिताग्रैः
स सायकार्तो विचचाल राजा; कृच्छ्राच्च संज्ञां पुनराससाद
verses.transliteration:
nikṛttacāpaṁ tribhirājaghāna; bāṇaistadā dāśarathiḥ śitāgraiḥ
sa sāyakārto vicacāla rājā; kṛcchrācca saṁjñāṁ punarāsasāda

translations.english: Having cut off Ravana's bow, Dasaratha's son hit (him) with three sharp-pointed arrows. And the king smarting under the shafts, with much ado regained his consciousness.

verses.sanskrit:
स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च; स्वेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः
जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः; स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः
verses.transliteration:
sa kṛttacāpaḥ śaratāḍitaśca; svedārdragātro rudhirāvasiktaḥ
jagrāha śaktiṁ samudagraśaktiḥ; svayambhudattāṁ yudhi devaśatruḥ

translations.english: The enemy of the immortals of terrific power with his bow severed, and himself hit with shafts, and his body covered with fat, and himself washed in blood, took up a dart conferred on him by the Self-create.

verses.sanskrit:
स तां विधूमानलसंनिकाशां; वित्रासनीं वानरवाहिनीनाम्
चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसा ज्वलन्तीं; सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः
verses.transliteration:
sa tāṁ vidhūmānalasaṁnikāśāṁ; vitrāsanīṁ vānaravāhinīnām
cikṣepa śaktiṁ tarasā jvalantīṁ; saumitraye rākṣasarāṣṭranāthaḥ

translations.english: The sovereign of the Rākşasas and their lord in that encounter hurled at Sumitrā's son the dart resembling smoking fire, sending up living flames, and striking terror into the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोऽस्त्रै;र्जघान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः
तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्ति;र्भुजान्तरं दाशरथेर्विशालम्
verses.transliteration:
tāmāpatantīṁ bharatānujo'strai;rjaghāna bāṇaiśca hutāgnikalpaiḥ
tathāpi sā tasya viveśa śakti;rbhujāntaraṁ dāśaratherviśālam

translations.english: As it coursed on, Bharata's younger brother resisted it with arrows resembling a sacrificial flame. Yet the dart pierced into the broad arm of Dasaratha's son.

verses.sanskrit:
शक्त्या ब्राम्या तु सौमित्रिस्ताडितस्तु स्तनान्तरे
विष्णोरचिन्त्यं स्वं भागमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरत्
verses.transliteration:
śaktyā brāmyā tu saumitristāḍitastu stanāntare
viṣṇoracintyaṁ svaṁ bhāgamātmānaṁ pratyanusmarat

translations.english: And hit at his chest by the dart of Brahmā, Sumitrā's son remembered that he was verily a portion of Vişņu himself.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः
तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यामप्रभुर्लङ्घनेऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
tato dānavadarpaghnaṁ saumitriṁ devakaṇṭakaḥ
taṁ pīḍayitvā bāhubhyāmaprabhurlaṅghane'bhavat

translations.english: Then pressing hard Sumitrā's son-that humbler of the hauteur of the Daityas, that thorn in the sides of the celestials-could not move him (from his place).

verses.sanskrit:
हिमवान्मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः
शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तुं न संख्ये भरतानुजः
verses.transliteration:
himavānmandaro merustrailokyaṁ vā sahāmaraiḥ
śakyaṁ bhujābhyāmuddhartuṁ na saṁkhye bharatānujaḥ

translations.english: But he that could with his arms wield Himavan or Mandara or Meru or the triple world itself along with the immortals, could not (for all his strength) lift up Bharata's younger brother.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वायुसुतः क्रुद्धो रावणं समभिद्रवत्
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना
verses.transliteration:
atha vāyusutaḥ kruddho rāvaṇaṁ samabhidravat
ājaghānorasi kruddho vajrakalpena muṣṭinā

translations.english: Then the Wind-god's offspring waxing wroth rushed at Rāvana, and overwhelmed with rage smote at his chest with his clenched fist resembling the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च
verses.transliteration:
tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
jānubhyāmapatadbhūmau cacāla ca papāta ca

translations.english: And boxed (by Hanumāna), Ravana-lord of the Rākşasas-went down to the ground on his knees, and shook and dropped to the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
विसंज्ञं रावणं दृष्ट्वा समरे भीमविक्रमम्
ऋषयो वानराश्चैव नेदुर्देवाः सवासवाः
verses.transliteration:
visaṁjñaṁ rāvaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā samare bhīmavikramam
ṛṣayo vānarāścaiva nedurdevāḥ savāsavāḥ

translations.english: He was rendered insensible with his senses lost; and he knew no where he was. And seeing Rāvana endued with terrific prowess, rendered insensible in the encounter, saints and monkeys and gods with the Asuras set up shouts.

verses.sanskrit:
वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः
शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्योऽपि लघुत्वमगमत्कपेः
verses.transliteration:
vāyusūnoḥ suhṛttvena bhaktyā paramayā ca saḥ
śatrūṇāmaprakampyo'pi laghutvamagamatkapeḥ

translations.english: Then energetic Hanumān taking Lakşmaņa racked by Rävaņa, with his arms brought him before Rāghava. And albeit incapable of being moved by the foes, (Laksmana), on account of the friendship of the Wind-god's offspring as well as the high reverence in which he was held by Hanumān, became extremely light to the monkey.

verses.sanskrit:
तं समुत्सृज्य सा शक्तिः सौमित्रिं युधि दुर्जयम्
रावणस्य रथे तस्मिन्स्थानं पुनरुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samutsṛjya sā śaktiḥ saumitriṁ yudhi durjayam
rāvaṇasya rathe tasminsthānaṁ punarupāgamat

translations.english: Then that dart, renouncing Sumitra's son vanquished in fight, again sought its place in Ravana's car.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणोऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य संज्ञां महाहवे
आददे निशितान्बाणाञ्जग्राह च महद्धनुः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo'pi mahātejāḥ prāpya saṁjñāṁ mahāhave
ādade niśitānbāṇāñjagrāha ca mahaddhanuḥ

translations.english: The exceedingly powerful Răvaņa recovering his consciousness in the dread encounter, took up whetted shafts and seized a mighty bow.

verses.sanskrit:
आश्वस्तश्च विशल्यश्च लक्ष्मणः शत्रुसूदनः
विष्णोर्भागममीमांस्यमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration:
āśvastaśca viśalyaśca lakṣmaṇaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ
viṣṇorbhāgamamīmāṁsyamātmānaṁ pratyanusmaran

translations.english: That finisher of foes-Lakşmaņa-recovered the exercise of his senses, and had his entire person perfectly healed, on his recalling that he verily was a part and parcel of Vişņu himself.

verses.sanskrit:
निपातितमहावीरां वानराणां महाचमूम्
राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत्
verses.transliteration:
nipātitamahāvīrāṁ vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūm
rāghavastu raṇe dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṁ samabhidravat

translations.english: Witnessing the mighty army of the monkeys and the redoubted heroes brought down in the conflict, Rāghava rushed at Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
अथैनमुपसंगम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
मम पृष्ठं समारुह्य रक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
athainamupasaṁgamya hanūmānvākyamabravīt
mama pṛṣṭhaṁ samāruhya rakṣasaṁ śāstumarhasi

translations.english: Thereat drawing near to him, Hanuman said to him, "It behove you to chastise the foe ascending my back, even as Vişņu chastise the enemies of the immortals, riding Garutmān."

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम्
आरोहत्सहसा शूरो हनूमन्तं महाकपिम्
रथस्थं रावणं संख्ये ददर्श मनुजाधिपः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā rāghavo vākyaṁ vāyuputreṇa bhāṣitam
ārohatsahasā śūro hanūmantaṁ mahākapim
rathasthaṁ rāvaṇaṁ saṁkhye dadarśa manujādhipaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words spoken by Hanumān, Rāghava at once got up on that gigantic monkey; and that master of men beheld Rāvana in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तमालोक्य महातेजाः प्रदुद्राव स राघवः
वैरोचनमिव क्रुद्धो विष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः
verses.transliteration:
tamālokya mahātejāḥ pradudrāva sa rāghavaḥ
vairocanamiva kruddho viṣṇurabhyudyatāyudhaḥ

translations.english: Seeing him, that highly powerful one darted against Rāvaņa, even as the enraged Vişnu had rushed against Virocana's son, upraising his weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीव्रं वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम्
गिरा गम्भीरया रामो राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
jyāśabdamakarottīvraṁ vajraniṣpeṣanisvanam
girā gambhīrayā rāmo rākṣasendramuvāca ha

translations.english: He sharply twanged his bow-string sounding like the terrific crash of thunder, and then in solemn tones, Rāma addressed the lord of Răks asas, Saying.

verses.sanskrit:
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ मम त्वं हि कृत्वा विप्रियमीदृशम्
क्व नु राक्षसशार्दूल गतो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration:
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mama tvaṁ hi kṛtvā vipriyamīdṛśam
kva nu rākṣasaśārdūla gato mokṣamavāpsyasi

translations.english: Stay, stay, having done me such wrong. Repairing whither, shall you, O powerful Raksasa, attain respite?

verses.sanskrit:
यदीन्द्रवैवस्वत भास्करान्वा; स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा
गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो वा; तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration:
yadīndravaivasvata bhāskarānvā; svayambhuvaiśvānaraśaṁkarānvā
gamiṣyasi tvaṁ daśa vā diśo vā; tathāpi me nādya gato vimokṣyase

translations.english: Even if you should seek Yama or Indra or the Sun-son to Vivaśvăn-or the Self-sprung or the Fire-god or Sankara himself, or go to the ten cardinal points in ten portions, yet shall you not, so resorting attain deliverance.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चैष शक्त्याभिहतस्त्वयाद्य; इच्छन्विषादं सहसाभ्युपेतः
स एष रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः; सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्य युद्धे
verses.transliteration:
yaścaiṣa śaktyābhihatastvayādya; icchanviṣādaṁ sahasābhyupetaḥ
sa eṣa rakṣogaṇarāja mṛtyuḥ; saputradārasya tavādya yuddhe

translations.english: And (Laksmana), going forth to the fight, has been wounded with the dart and has suddenly been stupefied. But, o king of the Rākşasa today in conflict Death shall claim for his own you and your sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाकपिम्
आजघान शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालानलशिखोपमैः
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendro mahākapim
ājaghāna śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kālānalaśikhopamaiḥ

translations.english: Hearing Rāghava's words, the exceedingly strong lord of the Rākşasas, overwhelmed with a mighty wrath, recalling enmity a gone, with burning shafts resembling the fire of Doom hit in encounter the exceedingly impetuous offspring of the Wind-god, who was bearing Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसेनाहवे तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः
स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजो व्यवर्धत
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasenāhave tasya tāḍitasyāpi sāyakaiḥ
svabhāvatejoyuktasya bhūyastejo vyavardhata

translations.english: Although struck and resisted by the Rākşasa with arrows, the energy of that one, endowed by nature with prowess-increased greatly.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामो महातेजा रावणेन कृतव्रणम्
दृष्ट्वा प्लवगशार्दूलं क्रोधस्य वशमेयिवान्
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmo mahātejā rāvaṇena kṛtavraṇam
dṛṣṭvā plavagaśārdūlaṁ krodhasya vaśameyivān

translations.english: The exceedingly energetic Rāma, on seeing that foremost of the monkeys wounded by Ravana, was mastered by wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याभिसंक्रम्य रथं सचक्रं; साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम्
ससारथिं साशनिशूलखड्गं; रामः प्रचिच्छेद शरैः सुपुङ्खैः
verses.transliteration:
tasyābhisaṁkramya rathaṁ sacakraṁ; sāśvadhvajacchatramahāpatākam
sasārathiṁ sāśaniśūlakhaḍgaṁ; rāmaḥ praciccheda śaraiḥ supuṅkhaiḥ

translations.english: Rāma, closing with his enemy, by means of whetted arrow-points severed in pieces his car together with the wheels and the steeds, the banner, the umbrella, and the majestic streamer, as well as with the charioteers and the thunderbolts and darts and swords.

verses.sanskrit:
अथेन्द्रशत्रुं तरसा जघान; बाणेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन
भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे; वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः
verses.transliteration:
athendraśatruṁ tarasā jaghāna; bāṇena vajrāśanisaṁnibhena
bhujāntare vyūḍhasujātarūpe; vajreṇa meruṁ bhagavānivendraḥ

translations.english: Then as the reverend Indra cleave Meru with his thunder-bolt, (Raghava) swiftly smote on Rāvaņa's spacious and shapely chest with a shaft resembling Vajra and the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit:
यो वज्रपाताशनिसंनिपाता;न्न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा
स रामबाणाभिहतो भृशार्त;श्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः
verses.transliteration:
yo vajrapātāśanisaṁnipātā;nna cukṣubhe nāpi cacāla rājā
sa rāmabāṇābhihato bhṛśārta;ścacāla cāpaṁ ca mumoca vīraḥ

translations.english: That the king hero-who had not smarted nor shaken under the impetus of Vajra and the thunder-bolt, assailed with the arrows of Răma and agonised in consequence, shock and lost hold of his bow.

verses.sanskrit:
तं विह्वलन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य रामः; समाददे दीप्तमथार्धचन्द्रम्
तेनार्कवर्णं सहसा किरीटं; चिच्छेद रक्षोऽधिपतेर्महात्माः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ vihvalantaṁ prasamīkṣya rāmaḥ; samādade dīptamathārdhacandram
tenārkavarṇaṁ sahasā kirīṭaṁ; ciccheda rakṣo'dhipatermahātmāḥ

translations.english: Seeing him overwhelmed, Ráma took up a flaming half-moon and with the same at once severed the sun-bright tiara of the high-souled sovereign of the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तं निर्विषाशीविषसंनिकाशं; शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम्
गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूट;मुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ nirviṣāśīviṣasaṁnikāśaṁ; śāntārciṣaṁ sūryamivāprakāśam
gataśriyaṁ kṛttakirīṭakūṭa;muvāca rāmo yudhi rākṣasendram

translations.english: Rāma in the encounter addressed the lord of Rākşasas, resembling a serpent bereft of venom, shorn of his splendour, like to the sun shrouded (in mist), without his wonted grace, and having his entire tiara riven-saying.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं त्वया कर्म महत्सुभीमं; हतप्रवीरश्च कृतस्त्वयाहम्
तस्मात्परिश्रान्त इति व्यवस्य; न त्वं शरैर्मृत्युवशं नयामि
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ tvayā karma mahatsubhīmaṁ; hatapravīraśca kṛtastvayāham
tasmātpariśrānta iti vyavasya; na tvaṁ śarairmṛtyuvaśaṁ nayāmi

translations.english: You have in battle) performed high and dreadful deeds, and have also (in-the conflict) slain my foremost heroes. And therefore I know you are fatigued. And for this reason it is that I will not with my shafts bring you to the door of Death.

verses.sanskrit:
स एवमुक्तो हतदर्पहर्षो; निकृत्तचापः स हताश्वसूतः
शरार्दितः कृत्तमहाकिरीटो; विवेश लङ्कां सहसा स्म राजा
verses.transliteration:
sa evamukto hatadarpaharṣo; nikṛttacāpaḥ sa hatāśvasūtaḥ
śarārditaḥ kṛttamahākirīṭo; viveśa laṅkāṁ sahasā sma rājā

translations.english: Thus addressed, the king, with his pride and joy defeated, with his bow severed, and his steeds and charioteer killed himself smarting under. shafts, and having his crown splintered, speedily entered Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे; महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ
हरीन्विशल्यान्सहलक्ष्मणेन; चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे
verses.transliteration:
tasminpraviṣṭe rajanīcarendre; mahābale dānavadevaśatrau
harīnviśalyānsahalakṣmaṇena; cakāra rāmaḥ paramāhavāgre

translations.english: On that foe of the deities and the Dănavas-the puissant lord of the night-rangers-entering (into Lankā), Rāma rendered the monkeys along with Lakşmaņa hale in that fierce conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रभग्ने त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ; सुरासुरा भूतगणा दिशश्च
ससागराः सर्षिमहोरगाश्च; तथैव भूम्यम्बुचराश्च हृष्टाः
verses.transliteration:
tasminprabhagne tridaśendraśatrau; surāsurā bhūtagaṇā diśaśca
sasāgarāḥ sarṣimahoragāśca; tathaiva bhūmyambucarāśca hṛṣṭāḥ

translations.english: At the break-down of that foe of the immortals, the celestials and the Asuras, the ghosts and the Cardinal points, and all the mighty serpents together with the oceans and the creatures inhabiting earth and water, felt exceedingly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयार्दितः
भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
sa praviśya purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāmabāṇabhayārditaḥ
bhagnadarpastadā rājā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ

translations.english: Entering the city of Larkā, the king afflicted with the fear of Rāma's arrows, with his pride humbled, was undergoing great torments:

verses.sanskrit:
मातंग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः
अभिभूतोऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
mātaṁga iva siṁhena garuḍeneva pannagaḥ
abhibhūto'bhavadrājā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā

translations.english: Overpowered by the high souled Rāghava, the king resembled an elephant defeated by a lion or a serpent defeated by Garuda.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मदण्डप्रकाशानां विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम्
स्मरन्राघवबाणानां विव्यथे राक्षसेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
brahmadaṇḍaprakāśānāṁ vidyutsadṛśavarcasām
smaranrāghavabāṇānāṁ vivyathe rākṣaseśvaraḥ

translations.english: Remembering Råghava's arrows resembling a comet risen at the universal wreck, and of the splendour of live lightning, the Raksasa chief was aggrieved.

verses.sanskrit:
स काञ्चनमयं दिव्यमाश्रित्य परमासनम्
विक्प्रेक्षमाणो रक्षांसि रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa kāñcanamayaṁ divyamāśritya paramāsanam
vikprekṣamāṇo rakṣāṁsi rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt

translations.english: Rāma, seated on a superb golden seat and eyeing the Raksasas, spoke this word.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वं तत्खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः
यत्समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेणास्मि निर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
sarvaṁ tatkhalu me moghaṁ yattaptaṁ paramaṁ tapaḥ
yatsamāno mahendreṇa mānuṣeṇāsmi nirjitaḥ

translations.english: Forsooth all the austere asceticism I have performed go go for nothing, for although resembling the redoubtable Indra, I have been overcome by a mortal.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं तद्ब्रह्मणो घोरं वाक्यं मामभ्युपस्थितम्
मानुषेभ्यो विजानीहि भयं त्वमिति तत्तथा
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ tadbrahmaṇo ghoraṁ vākyaṁ māmabhyupasthitam
mānuṣebhyo vijānīhi bhayaṁ tvamiti tattathā

translations.english: This dire speech of Brahmā also reverts to my remembrance, Know you that the fear come from a human being.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः
अवध्यत्वं मया प्राप्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम्
verses.transliteration:
devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ
avadhyatvaṁ mayā prāptaṁ mānuṣebhyo na yācitam

translations.english: You are incapable of being slain by deities and Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and serpents. But you have not asked for immunity from men.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ
राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु
verses.transliteration:
etadevābhyupāgamya yatnaṁ kartumihārhatha
rākṣasāścāpi tiṣṭhantu caryāgopuramūrdhasu

translations.english: Taking note of this, you should strive (to the uttermost.) And let the Räkşasas be posted at the gateways, highways, and the walls.

verses.sanskrit:
स चाप्रतिमगम्भीरो देवदानवदर्पहा
ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
sa cāpratimagambhīro devadānavadarpahā
brahmaśāpābhibhūtastu kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām

translations.english: Do you wake up that destroyer of the pride of the deities and then Danavas-Kumbhakarma, endowed with unparalleled gravity, overwhelmed with the curse of Brahmā.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियतां प्राकाराश्चाधिरुह्यताम्
निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
dvāreṣu yatnaḥ kriyatāṁ prākārāścādhiruhyatām
nidrāvaśasamāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām

translations.english: Seeing himself worsted and Prahasta also slain, that Rākşasa endowed with dreadful power issued his orders to the fearful force. “Do you vigilantly guard the gates and mount the wall. And do you wake up Kumbhakarņa come under the sway of slumber.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि संख्ये महाबाहुः ककुदं सर्वरक्षसाम्
वानरान्राजपुत्रौ च क्षिप्रमेव वधिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sa hi saṁkhye mahābāhuḥ kakudaṁ sarvarakṣasām
vānarānrājaputrau ca kṣiprameva vadhiṣyati

translations.english: Therefore, speedily rouse very powerful Kumbhakarņa. Foremost of all the Rākşasas in fight, that long armed one shall speedily slay the monkeys as well as the princes.

verses.sanskrit:
कुम्भकर्णः सदा शेते मूढो ग्राम्यसुखे रतः
रामेणाभिनिरस्तस्य संग्रामोऽस्मिन्सुदारुणे
verses.transliteration:
kumbhakarṇaḥ sadā śete mūḍho grāmyasukhe rataḥ
rāmeṇābhinirastasya saṁgrāmo'sminsudāruṇe

translations.english: I have been worsted in fierce fight by Rāma; but on Kumbhakarņa being awakened, my grief shall go.

verses.sanskrit:
भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते
किं करिष्याम्यहं तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि
verses.transliteration:
bhaviṣyati na me śokaḥ kumbhakarṇe vibodhite
kiṁ kariṣyāmyahaṁ tena śakratulyabalena hi

translations.english: If he does not help me in such high peril, what shall I do with his strength resembling the strength of Sakra himself?

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशे व्यसने प्राप्ते यो न साह्याय कल्पते
ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
īdṛśe vyasane prāpte yo na sāhyāya kalpate
te tu tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of the lord of the Rākşasas, the Rākşasas, bestirring themselves, went to the abode of Kumbhakarņa.

verses.sanskrit:
जग्मुः परमसंभ्रान्ताः कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम्
ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः
verses.transliteration:
jagmuḥ paramasaṁbhrāntāḥ kumbhakarṇaniveśanam
te rāvaṇasamādiṣṭā māṁsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ

translations.english: And desired by Rāvana, those feeding on flesh and blood went off hurriedly taking perfumes and wreaths and a mass of food.

verses.sanskrit:
कुम्भकर्णगुहां रम्यां सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम्
प्रतिष्ठमानाः कृच्छ्रेण यत्नात्प्रविविशुर्गुहाम्
verses.transliteration:
kumbhakarṇaguhāṁ ramyāṁ sarvagandhapravāhinīm
pratiṣṭhamānāḥ kṛcchreṇa yatnātpraviviśurguhām

translations.english: And entering Kumbhakarņa's charming cave having a wide gateway, measuring a yojana breathing around perfumes of flowers, those highly powerful ones, pushed off by Kumbhakarna's breath, with the utmost energy they could summon up stood their ground and entered the cave.

verses.sanskrit:
तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां शुभां काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम्
ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रं शयानं भीमदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ praviśya guhāṁ ramyāṁ śubhāṁ kāñcanakuṭṭimām
dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghraṁ śayānaṁ bhīmadarśanam

translations.english: Then entering that charming cave having floors paved with gold and gems. those Naiſtas endowed with great strength, saw that one of dreadful prowess, lying down.

verses.sanskrit:
मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च संचयान्
चक्रुर्नैरृतशार्दूला राशिमन्नस्य चाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration:
mṛgāṇāṁ mahiṣāṇāṁ ca varāhāṇāṁ ca saṁcayān
cakrurnairṛtaśārdūlā rāśimannasya cādbhutam

translations.english: Then they huge bodied Rākșasas piled up before Kumbhakarma, Meru-like animals for conferring rare gratification and heaps of deer and buffaloes and boars. And the Rākşasas made an astounding heap of rice.

verses.sanskrit:
शङ्खानापूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान्
तुमुलं युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
śaṅkhānāpūrayāmāsuḥ śaśāṅkasadṛśaprabhān
tumulaṁ yugapaccāpi vineduścāpyamarṣitāḥ

translations.english: They winded conchs beaming moon-like. And they incapable of being beaten shouted in full chorus.

verses.sanskrit:
नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः
कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
nedurāsphoṭayāmāsuścikṣipuste niśācarāḥ
kumbhakarṇavibodhārthaṁ cakruste vipulaṁ svanam

translations.english: The night-rangers shouted and struck at their arms with their hands and began to pull him. And for rousing Kumbhakarņa, mighty was the din that they raised.

verses.sanskrit:
सशङ्खभेरीपटहप्रणाद;मास्फोटितक्ष्वेडितसिंहनादम्
दिशो द्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवं किरन्तः; श्रुत्वा विहंगाः सहसा निपेतुः
verses.transliteration:
saśaṅkhabherīpaṭahapraṇāda;māsphoṭitakṣveḍitasiṁhanādam
diśo dravantastridivaṁ kirantaḥ; śrutvā vihaṁgāḥ sahasā nipetuḥ

translations.english: Hearing those loud sounds of conchs and drums and Papavas; and those proceeding from persons striking at their arms with their hands; and leonine roars, rushing on all sides and riving the very heavens, birds suddenly dropped down.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा भृशं तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा; न कुम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः
ततो मुसुण्डीमुसलानि सर्वे; रक्षोगणास्ते जगृहुर्गदाश्च
verses.transliteration:
yadā bhṛśaṁ tairninadairmahātmā; na kumbhakarṇo bubudhe prasuptaḥ
tato musuṇḍīmusalāni sarve; rakṣogaṇāste jagṛhurgadāśca

translations.english: When the high-souled Kumbhakarņa sleeping soundly did not awake at that terrific tumult, the Raksasas took up Bhusundis and maces.

verses.sanskrit:
तं शैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभि;र्वृक्षैस्तलैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च
सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्णं; रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ śailaśṛṅgairmusalairgadābhi;rvṛkṣaistalairmudgaramuṣṭibhiśca
sukhaprasuptaṁ bhuvi kumbhakarṇaṁ; rakṣāṁsyudagrāṇi tadā nijaghnuḥ

translations.english: Then the Raksasas, drawing near, smote Kumbhakarņa sleeping sweetly in the chest with mountain-peaks, maces and clubs.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य निश्वासवातेन कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः
राक्षसा बलवन्तोऽपि स्थातुं नाशक्नुवन्पुरः
verses.transliteration:
tasya niśvāsavātena kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ
rākṣasā balavanto'pi sthātuṁ nāśaknuvanpuraḥ

translations.english: But the Rākşasas could not stay before Kumbhakarņa owing to the hurricane heaving at his breath.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽस्य पुरतो गाढं राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः
मृदङ्गपणवान्भेरीः शङ्खकुम्भगणांस्तथा
दशराक्षससाहस्रं युगपत्पर्यवादयन्
verses.transliteration:
tato'sya purato gāḍhaṁ rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ
mṛdaṅgapaṇavānbherīḥ śaṅkhakumbhagaṇāṁstathā
daśarākṣasasāhasraṁ yugapatparyavādayan

translations.english: Then tightening their cloth (about their waist), those Rākşasas of dreadful prowess sounded Mşdangas and Paņavas, conchs and kumbhas. And ten thousand Rākṣasas together surrounded that one resembling a heap of darkblue collyrium and fell to rousing him.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा चैनं न शेकुस्ते प्रतिबोधयितुं तदा
ततो गुरुतरं यत्नं दारुणं समुपाक्रमन्
verses.transliteration:
yadā cainaṁ na śekuste pratibodhayituṁ tadā
tato gurutaraṁ yatnaṁ dāruṇaṁ samupākraman

translations.english: But albeit assailed with shouts and smite with weapons, he did not wake up. And when they succeeded not in rousing him, they more than ever exerted themselves.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सहस्रं भेरीणां युगपत्समहन्यत
मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामसक्तानां समन्ततः
