translations.english: Saints and Pitrs and deities and Gandharvas and birds and serpents, placing Satakratu in their front, protected Laksmana in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छिरः सशिरस्त्राणं श्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम्
प्रमथ्येन्द्रजितः कायात्पपात धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
tacchiraḥ saśirastrāṇaṁ śrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam
pramathyendrajitaḥ kāyātpapāta dharaṇītale

translations.english: And shooting the Aindra Hearon, that destroyer of hostile heroes-Laksmana-severing from its trunk the head of Indrajit with its corslet, graced with burning ear-rings, brought it down to the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्राक्षसतनूजस्य छिन्नस्कन्धं शिरो महत्
तपनीयनिभं भूमौ ददृशे रुधिरोक्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
tadrākṣasatanūjasya chinnaskandhaṁ śiro mahat
tapanīyanibhaṁ bhūmau dadṛśe rudhirokṣitam

translations.english: The mighty severed head of the Rākşasas son, resembling one made of gold, was seen covered with blood.

verses.sanskrit:
हतस्तु निपपाताशु धरण्यां रावणात्मजः
कवची सशिरस्त्राणो विध्वस्तः सशरासनः
verses.transliteration:
hatastu nipapātāśu dharaṇyāṁ rāvaṇātmajaḥ
kavacī saśirastrāṇo vidhvastaḥ saśarāsanaḥ

translations.english: And slain, Ravana's son dropped to the earth, with his armour and corslet on, and his bow fallen (from his grasp).

verses.sanskrit:
चुक्रुशुस्ते ततः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः
हृष्यन्तो निहते तस्मिन्देवा वृत्रवधे यथा
verses.transliteration:
cukruśuste tataḥ sarve vānarāḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ
hṛṣyanto nihate tasmindevā vṛtravadhe yathā

translations.english: Then all the monkeys with Vibhīşaņa set up cheers, even as the immortals cheered at the destruction of Vrtra.

verses.sanskrit:
अथान्तरिक्षे भूतानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्
अभिजज्ञे च संनादो गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि
verses.transliteration:
athāntarikṣe bhūtānāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca mahātmanām
abhijajñe ca saṁnādo gandharvāpsarasāmapi

translations.english: And in the sky there arose the victorious shouts of all beings and high souled saints, and also of Gandharvas and Apsarās.

verses.sanskrit:
पतितं समभिज्ञाय राक्षसी सा महाचमूः
वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः
verses.transliteration:
patitaṁ samabhijñāya rākṣasī sā mahācamūḥ
vadhyamānā diśo bheje haribhirjitakāśibhiḥ

translations.english: And knowing (Indrajit) fallen (in fight), the mighty army of Rākşasas, attacked by monkeys burning for victory, fled in the ten cardinal directions.

verses.sanskrit:
वनरैर्वध्यमानास्ते शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्य राक्षसाः
लङ्कामभिमुखाः सर्वे नष्टसंज्ञाः प्रधाविताः
verses.transliteration:
vanarairvadhyamānāste śastrāṇyutsṛjya rākṣasāḥ
laṅkāmabhimukhāḥ sarve naṣṭasaṁjñāḥ pradhāvitāḥ

translations.english: And assailed by the monkeys, the Raksasas, pursued (by their foes), with their senses lost, rushed towards Lankā, leaving their arms behind.

verses.sanskrit:
दुद्रुवुर्बहुधा भीता राक्षसाः शतशो दिशः
त्यक्त्वा प्रहरणान्सर्वे पट्टसासिपरश्वधान्
verses.transliteration:
dudruvurbahudhā bhītā rākṣasāḥ śataśo diśaḥ
tyaktvā praharaṇānsarve paṭṭasāsiparaśvadhān

translations.english: And overwhelmed with fright, Rākṣasas fled in an hundred directions, all renouncing their arms-bearded darts, and swords, and axes.

verses.sanskrit:
केचिल्लङ्कां परित्रस्ताः प्रविष्टा वानरार्दिताः
समुद्रे पतिताः केचित्केचित्पर्वतमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration:
kecillaṅkāṁ paritrastāḥ praviṣṭā vānarārditāḥ
samudre patitāḥ kecitkecitparvatamāśritāḥ

translations.english: And harassed by the monkeys, some hurriedly entered, Lankā, and some plunged into the sea, and some saught shelter in the mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा शयानं समरक्षितौ
राक्षसानां सहस्रेषु न कश्चित्प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
hatamindrajitaṁ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṁ samarakṣitau
rākṣasānāṁ sahasreṣu na kaścitpratyadṛśyata

translations.english: Seeing Indrajit slain and lying down on the field of battle, thousands of Raksasas fled away.

verses.sanskrit:
यथास्तं गत आदित्ये नावतिष्ठन्ति रश्मयः
तथा तस्मिन्निपतिते राक्षसास्ते गता दिशः
verses.transliteration:
yathāstaṁ gata āditye nāvatiṣṭhanti raśmayaḥ
tathā tasminnipatite rākṣasāste gatā diśaḥ

translations.english: As when the Sun sets, his rays remain no longer, on that Raksasas having fallen, the Raks asas dispersed in the ten cardinal quarters, like to the sun when his rays have been rendered mild, or fire which has been extinguished.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तपीडा बहुलो विनष्टारिः प्रहर्षवान्
बभूव लोकः पतिते राक्षसेन्द्रसुते तदा
verses.transliteration:
praśāntapīḍā bahulo vinaṣṭāriḥ praharṣavān
babhūva lokaḥ patite rākṣasendrasute tadā

translations.english: The mighty-armed (Indrajit) was utterly shorn of life. And on the son of the Raksasa-chief falling, the world, having its foe slain, with its huge affliction gone off, experienced the height of joy.

verses.sanskrit:
हर्षं च शक्रो भगवान्सह सर्वैः सुरर्षभैः
जगाम निहते तस्मिन्राक्षसे पापकर्मणि
verses.transliteration:
harṣaṁ ca śakro bhagavānsaha sarvaiḥ surarṣabhaiḥ
jagāma nihate tasminrākṣase pāpakarmaṇi

translations.english: On that unrighteous Raksasa having been slain, the reverend Sakra together with the Maharsis was filled with delight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽभ्यनन्दन्संहृष्टाः समरे हरियूथपाः
तमप्रतिबलं दृष्ट्वा हतं नैरृतपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration:
tato'bhyanandansaṁhṛṣṭāḥ samare hariyūthapāḥ
tamapratibalaṁ dṛṣṭvā hataṁ nairṛtapuṁgavam

translations.english: Then the monkey-leaders, seeing that foremost of Naiſtas of unparalleled prowess slain in battle, began to gladly pay homage (to Lakş mana).

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणो हनूमांश्च जाम्बवांश्चर्क्षयूथपः
विजयेनाभिनन्दन्तस्तुष्टुवुश्चापि लक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇo hanūmāṁśca jāmbavāṁścarkṣayūthapaḥ
vijayenābhinandantastuṣṭuvuścāpi lakṣmaṇam

translations.english: And Vibhīşaņa and Hanumān and Jāmabavān, leader of bears-saluted and hymned Lakşmaņa on the score of his victory.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष्वेडन्तश्च नदन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः
लब्धलक्षा रघुसुतं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration:
kṣveḍantaśca nadantaśca garjantaśca plavaṁgamāḥ
labdhalakṣā raghusutaṁ parivāryopatasthire

translations.english: And shouting and bounding and roaring, the monkeys at this hour of high joy stood surrounding Raghu's son.* *Descendant, that is.

verses.sanskrit:
लाङ्गूलानि प्रविध्यन्तः स्फोटयन्तश्च वानराः
लक्ष्मणो जयतीत्येवं वाक्यं व्यश्रावयंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
lāṅgūlāni pravidhyantaḥ sphoṭayantaśca vānarāḥ
lakṣmaṇo jayatītyevaṁ vākyaṁ vyaśrāvayaṁstadā

translations.english: And flourishing their tails and striking the earth (with them), the monkeys shouted, 'Victory to Laksmana!'

verses.sanskrit:
अन्योन्यं च समाश्लिष्य कपयो हृष्टमानसाः
चक्रुरुच्चावचगुणा राघवाश्रयजाः कथाः
verses.transliteration:
anyonyaṁ ca samāśliṣya kapayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ
cakruruccāvacaguṇā rāghavāśrayajāḥ kathāḥ

translations.english: And embracing each other, the monkeys with delighted spirits began to converse in various ways touching Raghava's welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
तदसुकरमथाभिवीक्ष्य हृष्टाः; प्रियसुहृदो युधि लक्ष्मणस्य कर्म
परममुपलभन्मनःप्रहर्षं; विनिहतमिन्द्ररिपुं निशम्य देवाः
verses.transliteration:
tadasukaramathābhivīkṣya hṛṣṭāḥ; priyasuhṛdo yudhi lakṣmaṇasya karma
paramamupalabhanmanaḥpraharṣaṁ; vinihatamindraripuṁ niśamya devāḥ

translations.english: Beholding that deed, difficult of being done, performed by their beloved friend, Laks mana, and hearing their foe, Indrajit, slain (in battle), the celestials attained the summit of joy.

verses.sanskrit:
रुधिरक्लिन्नगात्रस्तु लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः
बभूव हृष्टस्तं हत्वा शक्रजेतारमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
rudhiraklinnagātrastu lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
babhūva hṛṣṭastaṁ hatvā śakrajetāramāhave

translations.english: Having in the conflict slain that conqueror of enemies, Lakşmaņa graced with auspicious marks, with his body bathed in blood, experienced delight.

verses.sanskrit:
आजगाम ततः शीघ्रं यत्र सुग्रीवराघवौ
विभीषणमवष्टभ्य हनूमन्तं च लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
ājagāma tataḥ śīghraṁ yatra sugrīvarāghavau
vibhīṣaṇamavaṣṭabhya hanūmantaṁ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Then supporting himself on Vibhīşana and Hanuman, the exceedingly powerful Lakşmaņa endowed with prowess, taking Jambavan, Hanuman and all the monkeys with him, speedily went to the place where Sugrīva and Raghava were.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो राममभिक्रम्य सौमित्रिरभिवाद्य च
तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थः शक्रस्येन्द्रानुजो यथा
आचचक्षे तदा वीरो घोरमिन्द्रजितो वधम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmamabhikramya saumitrirabhivādya ca
tasthau bhrātṛsamīpasthaḥ śakrasyendrānujo yathā
ācacakṣe tadā vīro ghoramindrajito vadham

translations.english: Then going round Rāma and saluted him, Sumitra's son stood before his brother, like Indra's brother staying before Sakra.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्तु शिरश्छिन्नं लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
न्यवेदयत रामाय तदा हृष्टो विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastu śiraśchinnaṁ lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
nyavedayata rāmāya tadā hṛṣṭo vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Then the delighted Vibhişaņa related to Rāma how the high-souled Lakşmaņa had cut off the head of Ravana's son.

verses.sanskrit:
उपवेश्य तमुत्सङ्गे परिष्वज्यावपीडितम्
मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय भूयः संस्पृश्य च त्वरन्
उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यमाश्वास्य पुरुषर्षभः
verses.transliteration:
upaveśya tamutsaṅge pariṣvajyāvapīḍitam
mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya bhūyaḥ saṁspṛśya ca tvaran
uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ vākyamāśvāsya puruṣarṣabhaḥ

translations.english: And moved with grief, that best of persons, Rama, smelling head of Laksmana, wounded with darts and having his person pierced (with salms, sighing and breathing hard-and nursing ms body with his hand, addressed Laksmana, soothing him.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं परमकल्याणं कर्म दुष्करकारिणा
निरमित्रः कृतोऽस्म्यद्य निर्यास्यति हि रावणः
बलव्यूहेन महता श्रुत्वा पुत्रं निपातितम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ paramakalyāṇaṁ karma duṣkarakāriṇā
niramitraḥ kṛto'smyadya niryāsyati hi rāvaṇaḥ
balavyūhena mahatā śrutvā putraṁ nipātitam

translations.english: Both Vibhīşaņa and Hanumān have done mighty deeds in battle. In three days and nights, (my enemy) has been brought down. To-day have I been made foeless. Now Rāvana will for certain march forth, backed by a mighty phalanx.

verses.sanskrit:
तं पुत्रवधसंतप्तं निर्यान्तं राक्षसाधिपम्
बलेनावृत्य महता निहनिष्यामि दुर्जयम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ putravadhasaṁtaptaṁ niryāntaṁ rākṣasādhipam
balenāvṛtya mahatā nihaniṣyāmi durjayam

translations.english: Rāvana will for certain sally out, hearing his son brought down. That unconquerable lord of Rakşasas, aggrieved for the destruction of his son, marching out, shall I slay, environed with a mighty force.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया लक्ष्मण नाथेन सीता च पृथिवी च मे
न दुष्प्रापा हते त्वद्य शक्रजेतरि चाहवे
verses.transliteration:
tvayā lakṣmaṇa nāthena sītā ca pṛthivī ca me
na duṣprāpā hate tvadya śakrajetari cāhave

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, the conqueror of Sakra having in battle been slain by you-who are my lord-Sītā and the entire) earth are not incapable of being obtained by me.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं भ्रातरमाश्वास्य पारिष्वज्य च राघवः
रामः सुषेणं मुदितः समाभाष्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ bhrātaramāśvāsya pāriṣvajya ca rāghavaḥ
rāmaḥ suṣeṇaṁ muditaḥ samābhāṣyedamabravīt

translations.english: Having thus soothed and embraced his brother, Raghu's son Rama highly rejoiced calling Suşeņa said.

verses.sanskrit:
सशल्योऽयं महाप्राज्ञः सौमित्रिर्मित्रवत्सलः
यथा भवति सुस्वस्थस्तथा त्वं समुपाचर
विशल्यः क्रियतां क्षिप्रं सौमित्रिः सविभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
saśalyo'yaṁ mahāprājñaḥ saumitrirmitravatsalaḥ
yathā bhavati susvasthastathā tvaṁ samupācara
viśalyaḥ kriyatāṁ kṣipraṁ saumitriḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Do you so act that this highly wise son of Sumitrā, devoted to his friends, may be healed and be eased.

verses.sanskrit:
कृष वानरसैन्यानां शूराणां द्रुमयोधिनाम्
ये चान्येऽत्र च युध्यन्तः सशल्या व्रणिनस्तथा
तेऽपि सर्वे प्रयत्नेन क्रियन्तां सुखिनस्त्वया
verses.transliteration:
kṛṣa vānarasainyānāṁ śūrāṇāṁ drumayodhinām
ye cānye'tra ca yudhyantaḥ saśalyā vraṇinastathā
te'pi sarve prayatnena kriyantāṁ sukhinastvayā

translations.english: Do you without delay heal Sumitra's son, attached to his friends, of his wounds. And do you also carefully relieve all those heroes in the army of bears and monkeys fighting with trees, as well as others, who have been wounded and have got sores (in consequence).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः स रामेण महात्मा हरियूथपः
लक्ष्मणाय ददौ नस्तः सुषेणः परमौषधम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ sa rāmeṇa mahātmā hariyūthapaḥ
lakṣmaṇāya dadau nastaḥ suṣeṇaḥ paramauṣadham

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rāma, the high-souled monkey-leader administered a potent medicine to the nose of Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
स तस्य गन्धमाघ्राय विशल्यः समपद्यत
तदा निर्वेदनश्चैव संरूढव्रण एव च
verses.transliteration:
sa tasya gandhamāghrāya viśalyaḥ samapadyata
tadā nirvedanaścaiva saṁrūḍhavraṇa eva ca

translations.english: And smelling the same, he got healed; he was relieved of his pain and his outgoing vitality was shut up.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषण मुखानां च सुहृदां राघवाज्ञया
सर्ववानरमुख्यानां चिकित्सां स तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇa mukhānāṁ ca suhṛdāṁ rāghavājñayā
sarvavānaramukhyānāṁ cikitsāṁ sa tadākarot

translations.english: At the mandate of Rāghava he likewise treated his friends headed by Vibhișaņa and all the principal monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रकृतिमापन्नो हृतशल्यो गतव्यथः
सौमित्रिर्मुदितस्तत्र क्षणेन विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prakṛtimāpanno hṛtaśalyo gatavyathaḥ
saumitrirmuditastatra kṣaṇena vigatajvaraḥ

translations.english: And restored to his natural condition, Sumitrā's son, healed, and with his exhaustion removed, and his suffering gone off in a moment, experienced exhilaration of spirits.

verses.sanskrit:
तथैव रामः प्लवगाधिपस्तदा; विभीषणश्चर्क्षपतिश्च जाम्बवान्
अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमरोगमुत्थितं; मुदा ससैन्यः सुचिरं जहर्षिरे
verses.transliteration:
tathaiva rāmaḥ plavagādhipastadā; vibhīṣaṇaścarkṣapatiśca jāmbavān
avekṣya saumitrimarogamutthitaṁ; mudā sasainyaḥ suciraṁ jaharṣire

translations.english: Rāma and the monkey-king and Vibhīşaņa! and the powerful lord of bears along with their hosts, seeing Sumitrā's son risen hale, rejoiced greatly in delight.

verses.sanskrit:
अपूजयत्कर्म स लक्ष्मणस्य; सुदुष्करं दाशरथिर्महात्मा
हृष्टा बभूवुर्युधि यूथपेन्द्रा; निशम्य तं शक्रजितं निपातितम्
verses.transliteration:
apūjayatkarma sa lakṣmaṇasya; suduṣkaraṁ dāśarathirmahātmā
hṛṣṭā babhūvuryudhi yūthapendrā; niśamya taṁ śakrajitaṁ nipātitam

translations.english: The high-souled son of Dasaratha honoured exceedingly that exceedingly hard feat of Laks amana; and the monkey-king, hearing that the conqueror of Sakra had fallen in fight, was filled with joy.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पौलस्त्य सचिवाः श्रुत्वा चेन्द्रजितं हतम्
आचचक्षुरभिज्ञाय दशग्रीवाय सव्यथाः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paulastya sacivāḥ śrutvā cendrajitaṁ hatam
ācacakṣurabhijñāya daśagrīvāya savyathāḥ

translations.english: Then the counsellors of Pulastya's son, hearing of Indrajit having been slain, speedily conveyed the tidings to the Ten-necked one, who was ignorant* of the same.

verses.sanskrit:
युद्धे हतो महाराज लक्ष्मणेन तवात्मजः
विभीषणसहायेन मिषतां नो महाद्युते
verses.transliteration:
yuddhe hato mahārāja lakṣmaṇena tavātmajaḥ
vibhīṣaṇasahāyena miṣatāṁ no mahādyute

translations.english: O mighty monarch, in our very sight your exceedingly effulgent son has been slain by Lakş maņa with the help of Vibhīşaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
शूरः शूरेण संगम्य संयुगेष्वपराजितः
लक्ष्णनेन हतः शूरः पुत्रस्ते विबुधेन्द्रजित्
verses.transliteration:
śūraḥ śūreṇa saṁgamya saṁyugeṣvaparājitaḥ
lakṣṇanena hataḥ śūraḥ putraste vibudhendrajit

translations.english: That hero confronted by the (other) heros, has been vanquished in fight. And the hero, you son, the conqueror of the celestial chief, has also been slain by Lakşmaņa. And having gratified Lakş maņa with his shafts, he has repaired to the supreme regions.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं प्रतिभयं श्रुत्वा वधं पुत्रस्य दारुणम्
घोरमिन्द्रजितः संख्ये कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत्
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ pratibhayaṁ śrutvā vadhaṁ putrasya dāruṇam
ghoramindrajitaḥ saṁkhye kaśmalaṁ prāviśanmahat

translations.english: Hearing of that mighty terror, viz., the rueful and dreadful destruction of his son, "Indrajit, in battle, he straightway swooned away.

verses.sanskrit:
उपलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां राजा राक्षसपुंगवः
पुत्रशोकार्दितो दीनो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
upalabhya cirātsaṁjñāṁ rājā rākṣasapuṁgavaḥ
putraśokārdito dīno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ

translations.english: Then regaining his consciousness after a long while, that foremost of Räkşasas-the kingover-whelmed with grief for his son, and distressed, burst into lamentations, with his senses wildered, thus.

verses.sanskrit:
हा राक्षसचमूमुख्य मम वत्स महारथ
जित्वेन्द्रं कथमद्य त्वं लक्ष्मणस्य वशं गतः
verses.transliteration:
hā rākṣasacamūmukhya mama vatsa mahāratha
jitvendraṁ kathamadya tvaṁ lakṣmaṇasya vaśaṁ gataḥ

translations.english: O foremost in the Räkşasa army! O my child endowed with high might! Having conquered Indra himself, wherefore today have you come under the sway of Lakşmaņa?

verses.sanskrit:
ननु त्वमिषुभिः क्रुद्धो भिन्द्याः कालान्तकावपि
मन्दरस्यापि शृङ्गाणि किं पुनर्लक्ष्मणं रणे
verses.transliteration:
nanu tvamiṣubhiḥ kruddho bhindyāḥ kālāntakāvapi
mandarasyāpi śṛṅgāṇi kiṁ punarlakṣmaṇaṁ raṇe

translations.english: Doubtless, you enraged could pierce with you arrows the Destroyer of Time himself, and the summit of Mandāra, what shall I say of Laks mana in encounted?

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य वैवस्वतो राजा भूयो बहुमतो मम
येनाद्य त्वं महाबाहो संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
adya vaivasvato rājā bhūyo bahumato mama
yenādya tvaṁ mahābāho saṁyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā

translations.english: Today king Vivasvata has raised himself immensely in my estimation, for today he, O mighty-armed one, has brought you under the law of Time.

verses.sanskrit:
एष पन्थाः सुयोधानां सर्वामरगणेष्वपि
यः कृते हन्यते भर्तुः स पुमान्स्वर्गमृच्छति
verses.transliteration:
eṣa panthāḥ suyodhānāṁ sarvāmaragaṇeṣvapi
yaḥ kṛte hanyate bhartuḥ sa pumānsvargamṛcchati

translations.english: But this is the way of capable warriors as well as celestials. He that lay down his life for his lord, repair to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य देवगणाः सर्वे लोकपालास्तथर्षयः
हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा सुखं स्वप्स्यन्ति निर्भयाः
verses.transliteration:
adya devagaṇāḥ sarve lokapālāstatharṣayaḥ
hatamindrajitaṁ dṛṣṭvā sukhaṁ svapsyanti nirbhayāḥ

translations.english: To-day seeing Indrajit slain, the deities and the guardians of the worlds, and the mighty saints, their fear gone off, shall sleep peacefully.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य लोकास्त्रयः कृत्स्नाः पृथिवी च सकानना
एकेनेन्द्रजिता हीना शूण्येव प्रतिभाति मे
verses.transliteration:
adya lokāstrayaḥ kṛtsnāḥ pṛthivī ca sakānanā
ekenendrajitā hīnā śūṇyeva pratibhāti me

translations.english: This triple world and this entire earth with her woods, reft of one—Indrajit—appear to me as vacant.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य नैरृतकन्यायां श्रोष्याम्यन्तःपुरे रवम्
करेणुसंघस्य यथा निनादं गिरिगह्वरे
verses.transliteration:
adya nairṛtakanyāyāṁ śroṣyāmyantaḥpure ravam
kareṇusaṁghasya yathā ninādaṁ girigahvare

translations.english: To-day shall I hear the cries of the daughters of the Naiſtas in my inner apartment, like to the roars of she-elephants in a mountain-cavern.

verses.sanskrit:
यौवराज्यं च लङ्कां च रक्षांसि च परंतप
मातरं मां च भार्यां च क्व गतोऽसि विहाय नः
verses.transliteration:
yauvarājyaṁ ca laṅkāṁ ca rakṣāṁsi ca paraṁtapa
mātaraṁ māṁ ca bhāryāṁ ca kva gato'si vihāya naḥ

translations.english: Renouncing your state of an heir-apparent, and Lanka and Raksasas, O subduer of enemies, and your mother, and me, and your wifewhither have you gone, (leaving) us all?

verses.sanskrit:
मम नाम त्वया वीर गतस्य यमसादनम्
प्रेतकार्याणि कार्याणि विपरीते हि वर्तसे
verses.transliteration:
mama nāma tvayā vīra gatasya yamasādanam
pretakāryāṇi kāryāṇi viparīte hi vartase

translations.english: O hero, I having gone to the region of Yama, you ought to have performed my last rites, but you stand in a relation the very reverse of this.* *i.e. I have to perform your last rites, you having fallen in fight while I am alive.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं जीवति सुग्रीवे राघवे च सलक्ष्मणे
मम शल्यमनुद्धृत्य क्व गतोऽसि विहाय नः
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ jīvati sugrīve rāghave ca salakṣmaṇe
mama śalyamanuddhṛtya kva gato'si vihāya naḥ

translations.english: And Sugriva living and Lakşmana and Raghava, without extracting my dart, whither have you gone, leaving us all?

verses.sanskrit:
एवमादिविलापार्तं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
आविवेश महान्कोपः पुत्रव्यसनसंभवः
verses.transliteration:
evamādivilāpārtaṁ rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam
āviveśa mahānkopaḥ putravyasanasaṁbhavaḥ

translations.english: Then arising from the disaster that had befallen his son, a mighty wrath overcame the lord of Räkşasas-Rāvaņa, as he was thus indulging in lamentations. And even as in summer, the (Solar) rays flame up the Sun, the destruction of his son flamed up all the fiercer, him, who was naturally irascible.

verses.sanskrit:
घोरं प्रकृत्या रूपं तत्तस्य क्रोधाग्निमूर्छितम्
बभूव रूपं रुद्रस्य क्रुद्धस्येव दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration:
ghoraṁ prakṛtyā rūpaṁ tattasya krodhāgnimūrchitam
babhūva rūpaṁ rudrasya kruddhasyeva durāsadam

translations.english: And his form, terrific by nature, in consequence of the fire of his wrath having possessed it entirely, resembled the form of the enraged Rudra.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नस्रबिन्दवः
दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration:
tasya kruddhasya netrābhyāṁ prāpatannasrabindavaḥ
dīptābhyāmiva dīpābhyāṁ sārciṣaḥ snehabindavaḥ

translations.english: And from the eyes of that infuriated one fell drops of tears as drop from a flaming lamp drops of burning oil.

verses.sanskrit:
दन्तान्विदशतस्तस्य श्रूयते दशनस्वनः
यन्त्रस्यावेष्ट्यमानस्य महतो दानवैरिव
verses.transliteration:
dantānvidaśatastasya śrūyate daśanasvanaḥ
yantrasyāveṣṭyamānasya mahato dānavairiva

translations.english: As the grinded his teeth, the gnashing resembled the sounds sent by the machine* drawn by the Dänavas and churing the deep. *Meaning the mountain Mandara.

verses.sanskrit:
कालाग्निरिव संक्रुद्धो यां यां दिशमवैक्षत
तस्यां तस्यां भयत्रस्ता राक्षसाः संनिलिल्यिरे
verses.transliteration:
kālāgniriva saṁkruddho yāṁ yāṁ diśamavaikṣata
tasyāṁ tasyāṁ bhayatrastā rākṣasāḥ saṁnililyire

translations.english: The Rakşasas durst not approach that one eyeing round and resembling the Destroyer himself, intent on devouring both mobile and immobile.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः परमसंक्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये संस्तम्भयिषुराहवे
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ paramasaṁkruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
abravīdrakṣasāṁ madhye saṁstambhayiṣurāhave

translations.english: Then exceedingly enraged, Ravana-lord of Rākşasas-spoke in the midst of the Räkşasas, inciting them to battle.

verses.sanskrit:
मया वर्षसहस्राणि चरित्वा दुश्चरं तपः
तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु स्वयम्भूः परितोषितः
verses.transliteration:
mayā varṣasahasrāṇi caritvā duścaraṁ tapaḥ
teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu svayambhūḥ paritoṣitaḥ

translations.english: I practised severe austerities for thousands of years; and gratified the Self-sprung at times.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यैव तपसो व्युष्ट्या प्रसादाच्च स्वयम्भुवः
नासुरेभ्यो न देवेभ्यो भयं मम कदाचन
verses.transliteration:
tasyaiva tapaso vyuṣṭyā prasādācca svayambhuvaḥ
nāsurebhyo na devebhyo bhayaṁ mama kadācana

translations.english: Neither from Asuras nor from celestials can any fear spring to me.

verses.sanskrit:
कवचं ब्रह्मदत्तं मे यदादित्यसमप्रभम्
देवासुरविमर्देषु न भिन्नं वज्रशक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration:
kavacaṁ brahmadattaṁ me yadādityasamaprabham
devāsuravimardeṣu na bhinnaṁ vajraśaktibhiḥ

translations.english: My mail conferred on me by Brahma, which in effulgence resembles the Sun himself, was not broken by blows like to thunder-bolt at the war between the deities and demons.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन मामद्य संयुक्तं रथस्थमिह संयुगे
प्रतीयात्कोऽद्य मामाजौ साक्षादपि पुरंदरः
verses.transliteration:
tena māmadya saṁyuktaṁ rathasthamiha saṁyuge
pratīyātko'dya māmājau sākṣādapi puraṁdaraḥ

translations.english: Today who will come forward against me in battle accoutred in that and mounted on a car in the conflict? Not even Purandara himself.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य तूर्यशतैर्भीमं धनुरुत्थाप्यतां महत्
रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव वधाय परमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
adya tūryaśatairbhīmaṁ dhanurutthāpyatāṁ mahat
rāmalakṣmaṇayoreva vadhāya paramāhave

translations.english: Do you, beating hundreds of drums, today raise that mighty and dreadful bow of mine which, with arrows, had been bestowed on one by the gratified Self-sprung at the war of the gods and Asuras, so that I may therewith compass the destruction of Rama and Lakşmaņa in mighty battle.

verses.sanskrit:
स पुत्रवधसंतप्तः शूरः क्रोधवशं गतः
समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या सीतां हन्तुं व्यवस्यत
verses.transliteration:
sa putravadhasaṁtaptaḥ śūraḥ krodhavaśaṁ gataḥ
samīkṣya rāvaṇo buddhyā sītāṁ hantuṁ vyavasyata

translations.english: Burning (in grief) for the destruction of his son, the fell Råvana. coming under the influence of anger, reflection (in his mind), resolved to slay Sīta.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्यवेक्ष्य तु ताम्राक्षः सुघोरो घोरदर्शनान्
दीनो दीनस्वरान्सर्वांस्तानुवाच निशाचरान्
verses.transliteration:
pratyavekṣya tu tāmrākṣaḥ sughoro ghoradarśanān
dīno dīnasvarānsarvāṁstānuvāca niśācarān

translations.english: And eyeing round, that copper-eyed and dreadful one of a terrific aspect, distressed, in a piteous voice addressed all the night-rangers, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
मायया मम वत्सेन वञ्चनार्थं वनौकसाम्
किंचिदेव हतं तत्र सीतेयमिति दर्शितम्
verses.transliteration:
māyayā mama vatsena vañcanārthaṁ vanaukasām
kiṁcideva hataṁ tatra sīteyamiti darśitam

translations.english: By his power of illusion, my beloved child, for deceiving the wood-rangers, slaying something (else), had shown it to them as Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदं सत्यमेवाहं करिष्ये प्रियमात्मनः
वैदेहीं नाशयिष्यामि क्षत्रबन्धुमनुव्रताम्
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सचिवान्खड्गमाशु परामृशत्
verses.transliteration:
tadidaṁ satyamevāhaṁ kariṣye priyamātmanaḥ
vaidehīṁ nāśayiṣyāmi kṣatrabandhumanuvratām
ityevamuktvā sacivānkhaḍgamāśu parāmṛśat

translations.english: Now will I do that good office myself, Vaidehi will I slay-even her that is devoted to that friend of Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणः पुत्रशोकेन भृशमाकुलचेतनः
संक्रुद्धः खड्गमादाय सहसा यत्र मैथिली
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaḥ putraśokena bhṛśamākulacetanaḥ
saṁkruddhaḥ khaḍgamādāya sahasā yatra maithilī

translations.english: Having spoken thus to his counsellors he swiftly took up a sword; and raising it, of excellent temper and of cerulean hue, he rushed out vehemently, surrounded by his wives and counsellors. From grief for his son. Råvana with his consciousness wilderd, taking up a sword; in rage, rushed towards the place where Mithila's daughter was.

verses.sanskrit:
व्रजन्तं राक्षसं प्रेक्ष्य सिंहनादं प्रचुक्रुशुः
ऊचुश्चान्योन्यमाश्लिष्य संक्रुद्धं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
vrajantaṁ rākṣasaṁ prekṣya siṁhanādaṁ pracukruśuḥ
ūcuścānyonyamāśliṣya saṁkruddhaṁ prekṣya rākṣasāḥ

translations.english: Seeing the Räksasa rising on, some, emitted leonine roars, and seeing the Räkşasa enraged, embracing each other, said-"To-day those two brothers, seeing this one, will be exceedingly pained.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्यैनं तावुभौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ प्रव्यथिष्यतः
लोकपाला हि चत्वारः क्रुद्धेनानेन निर्जिताः
बहवः शत्रवश्चान्ये संयुगेष्वभिपातिताः
verses.transliteration:
adyainaṁ tāvubhau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau pravyathiṣyataḥ
lokapālā hi catvāraḥ kruddhenānena nirjitāḥ
bahavaḥ śatravaścānye saṁyugeṣvabhipātitāḥ

translations.english: By this one influenced with passion were the four guardians of the worlds conquered; and many other foes were brought down in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां संजल्पमानानामशोकवनिकां गताम्
अभिदुद्राव वैदेहीं रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ saṁjalpamānānāmaśokavanikāṁ gatām
abhidudrāva vaidehīṁ rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ

translations.english: As they were speaking thus, Ravana, reft of his senses by wrath, rushed against Vaidehi, who had taken up her abode in the Asoka wood.

verses.sanskrit:
वार्यमाणः सुसंक्रुद्धः सुहृद्भिर्हितबुद्धिभिः
अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धः खे ग्रहो रोहिणीमिव
verses.transliteration:
vāryamāṇaḥ susaṁkruddhaḥ suhṛdbhirhitabuddhibhiḥ
abhyadhāvata saṁkruddhaḥ khe graho rohiṇīmiva

translations.english: And dissuaded by his friends endowed with good intelligence, he wrought up with high wrath, darted (against Sītā), even as an enraged planet' rush against Rohinr in the firmament. 1. Kuja etc. 2. Hesperus.

verses.sanskrit:
बहुशश्चोदयामास भर्तारं मामनुव्रताम्
भार्या भव रमस्येति प्रत्याख्यातोऽभवन्मया
verses.transliteration:
bahuśaścodayāmāsa bhartāraṁ māmanuvratām
bhāryā bhava ramasyeti pratyākhyāto'bhavanmayā

translations.english: He did urge me much ever devoted to my lord saying Be you my wife; but forsooth I disregarded him.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽयं मामनुपस्थानाद्व्यक्तं नैराश्यमागतः
क्रोधमोहसमाविष्टो निहन्तुं मां समुद्यतः
verses.transliteration:
so'yaṁ māmanupasthānādvyaktaṁ nairāśyamāgataḥ
krodhamohasamāviṣṭo nihantuṁ māṁ samudyataḥ

translations.english: And plainly in consequence of my refusal, he has given way to despair. And overcome by anger and passion, he is ready to slay me.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा तौ नरव्याघ्रौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
मन्निमित्तमनार्येण समरेऽद्य निपातितौ
अहो धिन्मन्निमित्तोऽयं विनाशो राजपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration:
atha vā tau naravyāghrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau
mannimittamanāryeṇa samare'dya nipātitau
aho dhinmannimitto'yaṁ vināśo rājaputrayoḥ

translations.english: Or it may be that today for me those foremost of men, the brothers-Rama and Laksmana-have been slain in encounter by this inglorious one.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमतो हि तद्वाक्यं न कृतं क्षुद्रया मया
यद्यहं तस्य पृष्ठेन तदायासमनिन्दिता
नाद्यैवमनुशोचेयं भर्तुरङ्कगता सती
verses.transliteration:
hanūmato hi tadvākyaṁ na kṛtaṁ kṣudrayā mayā
yadyahaṁ tasya pṛṣṭhena tadāyāsamaninditā
nādyaivamanuśoceyaṁ bharturaṅkagatā satī

translations.english: Fool that I am I did not then act agreeably to Hanumān's words. If I had gone away seated on his back, without waiting for the victory (of my lord). I devoted to him placed on his lap, should not have come by this repentance.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्ये तु हृदयं तस्याः कौसल्यायाः फलिष्यति
एकपुत्रा यदा पुत्रं विनष्टं श्रोष्यते युधि
verses.transliteration:
manye tu hṛdayaṁ tasyāḥ kausalyāyāḥ phaliṣyati
ekaputrā yadā putraṁ vinaṣṭaṁ śroṣyate yudhi

translations.english: When Kausalya, having an only son, will hear of her son slain in battle, I fancy, her heart shall burst.

verses.sanskrit:
सा हि जन्म च बाल्यं च यौवनं च महात्मनः
धर्मकार्याणि रूपं च रुदती संस्रमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sā hi janma ca bālyaṁ ca yauvanaṁ ca mahātmanaḥ
dharmakāryāṇi rūpaṁ ca rudatī saṁsramiṣyati

translations.english: And weeping she will remember that highsouled one's birth and weeping, she will remember that high-souled one's birth and boyhood, and youth and pious acts and loveliness.

verses.sanskrit:
निराशा निहते पुत्रे दत्त्वा श्राद्धमचेतना
अग्निमारोक्ष्यते नूनमपो वापि प्रवेक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration:
nirāśā nihate putre dattvā śrāddhamacetanā
agnimārokṣyate nūnamapo vāpi pravekṣyati

translations.english: That one bereft of her consciousness, filled with despair, after having performed his srāddha,* will doubtless enter into fire or water. *Funereal rites performed in accordance with the injunctions of the Hindu Scriptures.

verses.sanskrit:
धिगस्तु कुब्जामसतीं मन्थरां पापनिश्चयाम्
यन्निमित्तमिदं दुःखं कौसल्या प्रतिपत्स्यते
verses.transliteration:
dhigastu kubjāmasatīṁ mantharāṁ pāpaniścayām
yannimittamidaṁ duḥkhaṁ kausalyā pratipatsyate

translations.english: Shame on the unchaste and hump-backed Manthara, having her heart fixed in sin, for whose sake this grief shat Rāvana's exercise Kausalya!

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा विलपन्तीं तपस्विनीम्
रोहिणीमिव चन्द्रेण विना ग्रहवशं गताम्
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ maithilīṁ dṛṣṭvā vilapantīṁ tapasvinīm
rohiṇīmiva candreṇa vinā grahavaśaṁ gatām

translations.english: Seeing the distressed daughter of Mithila lament thus, like to Rohiņi come under the sway of a planet in the absence of the Moon, in the meanwhile his (Rāvana's) pure and good courtier, named Suparsva, endowed with intelligence, albeit prevented by other courtiers, spoke to Rāvana, foremost of Räkșasa.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं नाम दशग्रीव साक्षाद्वैश्रवणानुज
हन्तुमिच्छसि वैदेहीं क्रोधाद्धर्ममपास्य हि
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ nāma daśagrīva sākṣādvaiśravaṇānuja
hantumicchasi vaidehīṁ krodhāddharmamapāsya hi

translations.english: Wherefore, O Ten-necked one, O you who are the very younger brother of Vaiśravaņa himself, Did you desire to slay Vaidehī, forsaking righteousness?

verses.sanskrit:
वेद विद्याव्रत स्नातः स्वधर्मनिरतः सदा
स्त्रियाः कस्माद्वधं वीर मन्यसे राक्षसेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
veda vidyāvrata snātaḥ svadharmanirataḥ sadā
striyāḥ kasmādvadhaṁ vīra manyase rākṣaseśvara

translations.english: Why O hero! O lord of Rākşasas! having led the Brahmacarya mode of life, studied the Vedas, and returned from the house of your spiritual guide, and ever engaged in religious acts, today did you intend to slay a woman?

verses.sanskrit:
मैथिलीं रूपसंपन्नां प्रत्यवेक्षस्व पार्थिव
त्वमेव तु सहास्माभी राघवे क्रोधमुत्सृज
verses.transliteration:
maithilīṁ rūpasaṁpannāṁ pratyavekṣasva pārthiva
tvameva tu sahāsmābhī rāghave krodhamutsṛja

translations.english: Do you, O king, now stay expecting Mithila's daughter' endowed with loveliness; and do you along with us vent your wrath on him." 1. Explains the commentator: till you slay Rāma in battle. 2. Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्युत्थानं त्वमद्यैव कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दशीम्
कृत्वा निर्याह्यमावास्यां विजयाय बलैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
abhyutthānaṁ tvamadyaiva kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśīm
kṛtvā niryāhyamāvāsyāṁ vijayāya balairvṛtaḥ

translations.english: To-day being the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, do you this very day prepare for conflict; at amăvāsyā,* environed with your forces do you march for victory. *i.e. tomorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
शूरो धीमान्रथी खड्गी रथप्रवरमास्थितः
हत्वा दाशरथिं रामं भवान्प्राप्स्यति मैथिलीम्
verses.transliteration:
śūro dhīmānrathī khaḍgī rathapravaramāsthitaḥ
hatvā dāśarathiṁ rāmaṁ bhavānprāpsyati maithilīm

translations.english: Heroic, and intelligent, a mighty car-warrior and swordsman, you, mounted on a car, slay the redoubtable son of Dasaratha, will obtain Mithilā's daughter.

verses.sanskrit:
स तद्दुरात्मा सुहृदा निवेदितं; वचः सुधर्म्यं प्रतिगृह्य रावणः
गृहं जगामाथ ततश्च वीर्यवा;न्पुनः सभां च प्रययौ सुहृद्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
sa taddurātmā suhṛdā niveditaṁ; vacaḥ sudharmyaṁ pratigṛhya rāvaṇaḥ
gṛhaṁ jagāmātha tataśca vīryavā;npunaḥ sabhāṁ ca prayayau suhṛdvṛtaḥ

translations.english: Thus exhorted by his friend, the untighteous Rāvana accepted his virtuous speech; and then that powerful one went (back) to his house, and, surrounded by his friends, entered the court.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविश्य सभां राजा दीनः परमदुःखितः
निषसादासने मुख्ये सिंहः क्रुद्ध इव श्वसन्
verses.transliteration:
sa praviśya sabhāṁ rājā dīnaḥ paramaduḥkhitaḥ
niṣasādāsane mukhye siṁhaḥ kruddha iva śvasan

translations.english: Entering his court, the king, distressed, and exceeding aggrieved sat him down on the foremost seat sighing like an enraged lion.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च तदा सर्वान्बलमुख्यान्महाबलः
रावणः प्राञ्जलीन्वाक्यं पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca tadā sarvānbalamukhyānmahābalaḥ
rāvaṇaḥ prāñjalīnvākyaṁ putravyasanakarśitaḥ

translations.english: And stricken with grief in consequence of his son's death, that highly powerful Ravana, with folded hands, addressed all the heroic Rākşasas saying.

verses.sanskrit:
एकं रामं परिक्षिप्य समरे हन्तुमर्हथ
प्रहृष्टा शरवर्षेण प्रावृट्काल इवाम्बुदाः
verses.transliteration:
ekaṁ rāmaṁ parikṣipya samare hantumarhatha
prahṛṣṭā śaravarṣeṇa prāvṛṭkāla ivāmbudāḥ

translations.english: Do you all proceed to battle with elephants, horses and cars. And encircling Rāma only and discharging shafts at him, delightedly, like to clouds, in the rainy season, poring water, do you slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वाहं शरैर्तीक्ष्णैर्भिन्नगात्रं महारणे
भवद्भिः श्वो निहन्तास्मि रामं लोकस्य पश्यतः
verses.transliteration:
atha vāhaṁ śarairtīkṣṇairbhinnagātraṁ mahāraṇe
bhavadbhiḥ śvo nihantāsmi rāmaṁ lokasya paśyataḥ

translations.english: Or I shall slay him to morrow in the presence of all, wounded by you in the mighty encounter with sharpened arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यमादाय राक्षसाः
निर्ययुस्ते रथैः शीघ्रं नागानीकैश्च संवृताः
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ rākṣasendrasya vākyamādāya rākṣasāḥ
niryayuste rathaiḥ śīghraṁ nāgānīkaiśca saṁvṛtāḥ

translations.english: Hearing the speech of their lord the Rākṣasas, with a huge army and a host of cars, speedily issued out for battle.

verses.sanskrit:
स संग्रामो महाभीमः सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति
रक्षसां वानराणां च तुमुलः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
sa saṁgrāmo mahābhīmaḥ sūryasyodayanaṁ prati
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca tumulaḥ samapadyata

translations.english: Thus on the eve of sun set there arose a terrible conflict between the Rakşasas and the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः
अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तदा वानरराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
te gadābhirvicitrābhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ
anyonyaṁ samare jaghnustadā vānararākṣasāḥ

translations.english: They struck each other in the conflict with clubs chitras, Prasas daggers and Parasvadha.

verses.sanskrit:
मातंगरथकूलस्य वाजिमत्स्या ध्वजद्रुमाः
शरीरसंघाटवहाः प्रसस्रुः शोणितापगाः
verses.transliteration:
mātaṁgarathakūlasya vājimatsyā dhvajadrumāḥ
śarīrasaṁghāṭavahāḥ prasasruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ

translations.english: Elephants and cars were like the banks of that river of blood, the arrows were like the fishes, and the flags were the trees on their banks and the corpses were like planks afloat there.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्वजवर्मरथानश्वान्नानाप्रहरणानि च
आप्लुत्याप्लुत्य समरे वानरेन्द्रा बभञ्जिरे
verses.transliteration:
dhvajavarmarathānaśvānnānāpraharaṇāni ca
āplutyāplutya samare vānarendrā babhañjire

translations.english: Being thus wounded and assailed by the Rākşasas, those heroic monkeys leaped and broke down the flags, armours, cars, horses and other weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
केशान्कर्णललाटांश्च नासिकाश्च प्लवंगमाः
रक्षसां दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नखैश्चापि व्यकर्तयन्
verses.transliteration:
keśānkarṇalalāṭāṁśca nāsikāśca plavaṁgamāḥ
rakṣasāṁ daśanaistīkṣṇairnakhaiścāpi vyakartayan

translations.english: With their sharp teeth and nails they scratched the hair, ears, foreheads and the noses of the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
एकैकं राक्षसं संख्ये शतं वानरपुंगवाः
अभ्यधावन्त फलिनं वृक्षं शकुनयो यथा
verses.transliteration:
ekaikaṁ rākṣasaṁ saṁkhye śataṁ vānarapuṁgavāḥ
abhyadhāvanta phalinaṁ vṛkṣaṁ śakunayo yathā

translations.english: Like to vultures falling upon a felled tree, hundreds of monkeys fell upon one Räkşasas in that encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा गदाभिर्गुर्वीभिः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः
निर्जघ्नुर्वानरान्घोरान्राक्षसाः पर्वतोपमाः
verses.transliteration:
tathā gadābhirgurvībhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ
nirjaghnurvānarānghorānrākṣasāḥ parvatopamāḥ

translations.english: The Rákşasas resembling mountains, with huge clubs, prasas, daggers and Parasvādhas, struck the monkeys (in their turn).

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसैर्वध्यमानानां वानराणां महाचमूः
शरण्यं शरणं याता रामं दशरथात्मजम्
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasairvadhyamānānāṁ vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūḥ
śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ yātā rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam

translations.english: Being thus assailed by the Räkşasas, the mighty host of monkeys took refuge of Răma, the son of Dasaratha, the worthy refuge of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामो महातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्
प्रविश्य राक्षसं सैन्यं शरवर्षं ववर्ष ह
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmo mahātejā dhanurādāya vīryavān
praviśya rākṣasaṁ sainyaṁ śaravarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent and powerful Rāma, taking up his bow, entered the Rākşasa host and began to make a downpour of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविष्टं तु तदा रामं मेघाः सूर्यमिवाम्बरे
नाभिजग्मुर्महाघोरं निर्दहन्तं शराग्निना
verses.transliteration:
praviṣṭaṁ tu tadā rāmaṁ meghāḥ sūryamivāmbare
nābhijagmurmahāghoraṁ nirdahantaṁ śarāgninā

translations.english: Rama entering the field, those terrible Rakş asas, being burnt with the fire of his arrows, could not stand before him like to clouds disappearing before the Sun in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतान्येव सुघोराणि रामेण रजनीचराः
रणे रामस्य ददृशुः कर्माण्यसुकराणि च
verses.transliteration:
kṛtānyeva sughorāṇi rāmeṇa rajanīcarāḥ
raṇe rāmasya dadṛśuḥ karmāṇyasukarāṇi ca

translations.english: The night-rangers only espied the dreadful feats performed by Råma and which were above the power of others.

verses.sanskrit:
चालयन्तं महानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान्
ददृशुस्ते न वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा
verses.transliteration:
cālayantaṁ mahānīkaṁ vidhamantaṁ mahārathān
dadṛśuste na vai rāmaṁ vātaṁ vanagataṁ yathā

translations.english: Except when guiding the huge army or driving the cars they could not see Rama like to the wind invisible in a forest.

verses.sanskrit:
छिन्नं भिन्नं शरैर्दग्धं प्रभग्नं शस्त्रपीडितम्
बलं रामेण ददृशुर्न रमं शीघ्रकारिणम्
verses.transliteration:
chinnaṁ bhinnaṁ śarairdagdhaṁ prabhagnaṁ śastrapīḍitam
balaṁ rāmeṇa dadṛśurna ramaṁ śīghrakāriṇam

translations.english: The all beheld the Råkşasas force scattered, wounded, burnt down with arrows, broken and assailed with weapons by Rāma But none could see the quick moving Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहरन्तं शरीरेषु न ते पश्यन्ति राघवम्
इन्द्रियार्थेषु तिष्ठन्तं भूतात्मानमिव प्रजाः
verses.transliteration:
praharantaṁ śarīreṣu na te paśyanti rāghavam
indriyārtheṣu tiṣṭhantaṁ bhūtātmānamiva prajāḥ

translations.english: As people cannot see the soul which governs all objects of sense so they could not see Rāma, who was thus inflicting wounds on them.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ते राक्षसाः सर्वे रामस्य सदृशान्रणे
अन्योन्यकुपिता जघ्नुः सादृश्याद्राघवस्य ते
verses.transliteration:
iti te rākṣasāḥ sarve rāmasya sadṛśānraṇe
anyonyakupitā jaghnuḥ sādṛśyādrāghavasya te

translations.english: It is he who is destroying the soldiers riding the elephants, it he who is breaking down the mighty cars, and it is he who with sharp arrows is slaying the cavalry-rider and horse. "Thus saying those Räkşasas, in that conflict and in the very presence of Rāma, highly enraged began to slay each other.

verses.sanskrit:
न ते ददृशिरे रामं दहन्तमरिवाहिनीम्
मोहिताः परमास्त्रेण गान्धर्वेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
na te dadṛśire rāmaṁ dahantamarivāhinīm
mohitāḥ paramāstreṇa gāndharveṇa mahātmanā

translations.english: They were all bewildered by the huge Gandharva weapon discharged by the high souled Rama and so they could not see Rama, whose was thus burning down their force.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु रामसहस्राणि रणे पश्यन्ति राक्षसाः
पुनः पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थमेकमेव महाहवे
verses.transliteration:
te tu rāmasahasrāṇi raṇe paśyanti rākṣasāḥ
punaḥ paśyanti kākutsthamekameva mahāhave

translations.english: The Rákşasas sometimes beheld thousands of Rāma in the battle field and again saw one Rāma only.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रमन्तीं काञ्चनीं कोटिं कार्मुकस्य महात्मनः
अलातचक्रप्रतिमां ददृशुस्ते न राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
bhramantīṁ kāñcanīṁ koṭiṁ kārmukasya mahātmanaḥ
alātacakrapratimāṁ dadṛśuste na rāghavam

translations.english: They at times saw the quick-moving golden end of the bow of that high-souled one, resembling a circular fire brand but they did not behold Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
शरीरनाभि सत्त्वार्चिः शरीरं नेमिकार्मुकम्
ज्याघोषतलनिर्घोषं तेजोबुद्धिगुणप्रभम्
verses.transliteration:
śarīranābhi sattvārciḥ śarīraṁ nemikārmukam
jyāghoṣatalanirghoṣaṁ tejobuddhiguṇaprabham

translations.english: He looked like kālacakra, having his middle body as its navel, his own strength as its lustre, the arrow for its radius or spoke, the bow for the circumference, the twang of the bow for its sound, his power and intelligence for its brightness, and the aim of the celestial Weapons for its limit.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि सारोहाणां च वाजिनाम्
पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे राक्षसानां पदातिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi sārohāṇāṁ ca vājinām
pūrṇe śatasahasre dve rākṣasānāṁ padātinām

translations.english: In the eighth division of the time by Rāma alone with arrows resembling the flame of fire were destroyed ten thousands swift-coursing cars, eighteen thousand elephants fourteen thousand horses and riders and tow million Rākṣasas infantry assuming shapes at will.

verses.sanskrit:
ते हताश्वा हतरथाः श्रान्ता विमथितध्वजाः
अभिपेतुः पुरीं लङ्कां हतशेषा निशाचराः
verses.transliteration:
te hatāśvā hatarathāḥ śrāntā vimathitadhvajāḥ
abhipetuḥ purīṁ laṅkāṁ hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ

translations.english: And those night rangers, who were still left, having their horses killed, cars and flags broken fled in fear of life to the city of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
हतैर्गजपदात्यश्वैस्तद्बभूव रणाजिरम्
आक्रीडभूमी रुद्रस्य क्रुद्धस्येव पिनाकिनः
verses.transliteration:
hatairgajapadātyaśvaistadbabhūva raṇājiram
ākrīḍabhūmī rudrasya kruddhasyeva pinākinaḥ

translations.english: The battle field, filled with slain horses, elephants and infantry, looked like the high-souled and enraged Rudra's arena of sports.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
साधु साध्विति रामस्य तत्कर्म समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
sādhu sādhviti rāmasya tatkarma samapūjayan

translations.english: Thereupon the celestials with Gandarbas, Siddhas and the great ascetics glorified the wonderful feat of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च तदा रामः सुग्रीवं प्रत्यनन्तरम्
एतदस्त्रबलं दिव्यं मम वा त्र्यम्बकस्य वा
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca tadā rāmaḥ sugrīvaṁ pratyanantaram
etadastrabalaṁ divyaṁ mama vā tryambakasya vā

translations.english: The virtuous-souled Rāma addressed Sugrīva, Vibhīşaņa the monkey Hanumān, the leading monkeys Jämbavān, Mainda and Divada who were near him, saying, This is the power of my weapons and as well as that of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य तां राक्षसवाहिनीं तु; रामस्तदा शक्रसमो महात्मा
अस्त्रेषु शस्त्रेषु जितक्लमश्च; संस्तूयते देवगणैः प्रहृष्टैः
verses.transliteration:
nihatya tāṁ rākṣasavāhinīṁ tu; rāmastadā śakrasamo mahātmā
astreṣu śastreṣu jitaklamaśca; saṁstūyate devagaṇaiḥ prahṛṣṭaiḥ

translations.english: The high-souled Rāma, equalling Śakra in prowess, thus slaying the huge host of the lord of Rākşasas and assailing them with shafts and weapons-the celestials, delighted, saying his praises.

verses.sanskrit:
विधवा हतपुत्राश्च क्रोशन्त्यो हतबान्धवाः
राक्षस्यः सह संगम्य दुःखार्ताः पर्यदेवयन्
verses.transliteration:
vidhavā hataputrāśca krośantyo hatabāndhavāḥ
rākṣasyaḥ saha saṁgamya duḥkhārtāḥ paryadevayan

translations.english: The widows and those who had lost their children or kinsmen approached those Rākşasas and overwhelmed with grief bewailed piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं शूर्पणखा वृद्धा कराला निर्णतोदरी
आससाद वने रामं कन्दर्पमिव रूपिणम्
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ śūrpaṇakhā vṛddhā karālā nirṇatodarī
āsasāda vane rāmaṁ kandarpamiva rūpiṇam

translations.english: Alas! why did the aged and grim-visaged Śūrpanakhă, having her belly extending down ward, behold in the forest Rāma graceful like Kandarpa.

verses.sanskrit:
सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्
तं दृष्ट्वा लोकवध्या सा हीनरूपा प्रकामिता
verses.transliteration:
sukumāraṁ mahāsattvaṁ sarvabhūtahite ratam
taṁ dṛṣṭvā lokavadhyā sā hīnarūpā prakāmitā

translations.english: Beholding him of great beauty and prowess, ever engaged in the welfare of all creatures, that ugly one, worthy of being slain by people, was excited with lust.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं सर्वगुणैर्हीना गुणवन्तं महौजसं
सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं कामयामास राक्षसी
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ sarvaguṇairhīnā guṇavantaṁ mahaujasaṁ
sumukhaṁ durmukhī rāmaṁ kāmayāmāsa rākṣasī

translations.english: Why did that ugly-faced she-demon, devoid of all qualities, address Räma, having a beautiful countenance, gifted with many virtues and great effulgence?

verses.sanskrit:
जनस्यास्याल्पभाग्यत्वात्पलिनी श्वेतमूर्धजा
अकार्यमपहास्यं च सर्वलोकविगर्हितम्
verses.transliteration:
janasyāsyālpabhāgyatvātpalinī śvetamūrdhajā
akāryamapahāsyaṁ ca sarvalokavigarhitam

translations.english: Alas for the misfortune of the Rākşasas, the aged Rākşasaee brought before him such a vile proposal, hated of all and worthy of creating laughter. for the destruction of Khara, Düşaņa and other Räksasas that ugly one approached Rāghava with such a vile intention.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्निमित्तमिदं वैरं रावणेन कृतं महत्
वधाय नीता सा सीता दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा
verses.transliteration:
tannimittamidaṁ vairaṁ rāvaṇena kṛtaṁ mahat
vadhāya nītā sā sītā daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā

translations.english: It was for her that Rāvana created enmity (with Răma) and Sītä was carried away by the Ten-necked Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
न च सीतां दशग्रीवः प्राप्नोति जनकात्मजाम्
बद्धं बलवता वैरमक्षयं राघवेण ह
verses.transliteration:
na ca sītāṁ daśagrīvaḥ prāpnoti janakātmajām
baddhaṁ balavatā vairamakṣayaṁ rāghaveṇa ha

translations.english: But he could not spread his influence upon Sitā the daughter of king Jannak and deep rooted and eternal became the enmity with the highly powerful Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
वैदेहीं प्रार्थयानं तं विराधं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसं
हतमेकेन रामेण पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
vaidehīṁ prārthayānaṁ taṁ virādhaṁ prekṣya rākṣasaṁ
hatamekena rāmeṇa paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam

translations.english: Beholding the Rākşasa Virādha slain by Rāma alone (Rāvana) wishing Vaidehỉ should have regarded that as a sufficient proof of his prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
खरश्च निहतः संख्ये दूषणस्त्रिशिरास्तथा
शरैरादित्यसंकाशैः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
kharaśca nihataḥ saṁkhye dūṣaṇastriśirāstathā
śarairādityasaṁkāśaiḥ paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam

translations.english: And fourteen thousand Rākşasas of terrible deeds were slain by him in janasthāna with shafts resembling the flame of fire. Khara Düş aņa as well as Tricira were slain by him in conflict with arrows resembling the Sun-this was a sufficient proof (of his power).

verses.sanskrit:
हतो योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो रुधिराशनः
क्रोधार्तो विनदन्सोऽथ पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
hato yojanabāhuśca kabandho rudhirāśanaḥ
krodhārto vinadanso'tha paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam

translations.english: Yojanabāhu and Kabandha, drinking blood, were slain by him, roaring with wrath-this too was a sufficient proof of his power.

verses.sanskrit:
जघान बलिनं रामः सहस्रनयनात्मजम्
बालिनं मेघसंकाशं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
jaghāna balinaṁ rāmaḥ sahasranayanātmajam
bālinaṁ meghasaṁkāśaṁ paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam

translations.english: Rāma slew the powerful Vāli, the son of the thousand eyed one, resembling the cloud-that too was the sufficient proof of his prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋश्यमूके वसञ्शैले दीनो भग्नमनोरथः
सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛśyamūke vasañśaile dīno bhagnamanorathaḥ
sugrīvaḥ sthāpito rājye paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam

translations.english: By him Sugriva, poorly and living in the mount Rșyamūka, having all his desires frustrated, was placed on the throne-that too even was the sufficient proof of his power.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मार्थसहितं वाक्यं सर्वेषां रक्षसां हितम्
युक्तं विभीषणेनोक्तं मोहात्तस्य न रोचते
verses.transliteration:
dharmārthasahitaṁ vākyaṁ sarveṣāṁ rakṣasāṁ hitam
yuktaṁ vibhīṣaṇenoktaṁ mohāttasya na rocate

translations.english: He (Rāvana) from foolishness did not like the becoming speech of Vibhīşaņa conducive to the acquirement of piety and wealth and securing the welfare of the Rakşasas. Had the younger brother of the lord of wealth (Rāvana) observed the words of Vibhīşaņa, Lanka would not have been overwhelmed with grief and reduced to the state of a cremation ground.

verses.sanskrit:
कुम्भकर्णं हतं श्रुत्वा राघवेण महाबलम्
प्रियं चेन्द्रजितं पुत्रं रावणो नावबुध्यते
verses.transliteration:
kumbhakarṇaṁ hataṁ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahābalam
priyaṁ cendrajitaṁ putraṁ rāvaṇo nāvabudhyate

translations.english: Hearing of the destruction of the highly powerful Kumbhakarņa by Rāma of the irrepressible Atikay by Lakşmaņa as well as of his beloved son Indrajit, Rāvana did not come to his senses.* *One śloka has been omitted here by some of the editors which when translated stands thus; When one monkey only Hanumān killed the prince Akşaya and reduced the whole city to ashes with the fire of his tail Rāvana should have come to his senses.

verses.sanskrit:
मम पुत्रो मम भ्राता मम भर्ता रणे हतः
इत्येवं श्रूयते शब्दो राक्षसानां कुले कुले
verses.transliteration:
mama putro mama bhrātā mama bhartā raṇe hataḥ
ityevaṁ śrūyate śabdo rākṣasānāṁ kule kule

translations.english: There is audible in every house of the Rāks sas, the cry-My son, my brother, my husband is slain in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
रथाश्चाश्वाश्च नागाश्च हताः शतसहस्रशः
रणे रामेण शूरेण राक्षसाश्च पदातयः
verses.transliteration:
rathāścāśvāśca nāgāśca hatāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
raṇe rāmeṇa śūreṇa rākṣasāśca padātayaḥ

translations.english: In conflict have been destroyed by the heroic Rāma, thousand cars, horses, serpents and infantry.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रो वा यदि वा विष्णुर्महेन्द्रो वा शतक्रतुः
हन्ति नो रामरूपेण यदि वा स्वयमन्तकः
verses.transliteration:
rudro vā yadi vā viṣṇurmahendro vā śatakratuḥ
hanti no rāmarūpeṇa yadi vā svayamantakaḥ

translations.english: Perhaps Rudra, Visnu, Mehendra or the performer of hundred sacrifices, or even Death, in the shape of Rāma, is slaying us.

verses.sanskrit:
हतप्रवीरा रामेण निराशा जीविते वयम्
अपश्यन्त्यो भयस्यान्तमनाथा विलपामहे
verses.transliteration:
hatapravīrā rāmeṇa nirāśā jīvite vayam
apaśyantyo bhayasyāntamanāthā vilapāmahe

translations.english: By Rāma all the heroes have been slaindespair has taken possession of our minds-we do not behold the end of our terror and are bewailing being deprived of our lords.

verses.sanskrit:
रामहस्ताद्दशग्रीवः शूरो दत्तवरो युधि
इदं भयं महाघोरमुत्पन्नं नावबुध्यते
verses.transliteration:
rāmahastāddaśagrīvaḥ śūro dattavaro yudhi
idaṁ bhayaṁ mahāghoramutpannaṁ nāvabudhyate

translations.english: Does not the Ten-necked hero, who has obtained boons (from Brahmă) perceive that a mighty disaster shall befall him from Råma?

verses.sanskrit:
न देवा न च गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः
उपसृष्टं परित्रातुं शक्ता रामेण संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
na devā na ca gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ
upasṛṣṭaṁ paritrātuṁ śaktā rāmeṇa saṁyuge

translations.english: Neither the celestials Gandharvas, Piśācas nor Rāksasas shall be able to save him from Rāma in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्पाताश्चापि दृश्यन्ते रावणस्य रणे रणे
कथयिष्यन्ति रामेण रावणस्य निबर्हणम्
verses.transliteration:
utpātāścāpi dṛśyante rāvaṇasya raṇe raṇe
kathayiṣyanti rāmeṇa rāvaṇasya nibarhaṇam

translations.english: In very battle many an accident befalls Rāvaņa, this bespeaks of his destruction at the hands of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहेन प्रीतेन देवदानवराक्षसैः
रावणस्याभयं दत्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम्
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahena prītena devadānavarākṣasaiḥ
rāvaṇasyābhayaṁ dattaṁ mānuṣebhyo na yācitam

translations.english: The great Patriarch, being pleased conferred upon Rāvaņa the boon that no fear would proceed to him from the celestials, the Dānavas or the Rākşasas-but he did not beg of him, security from men.

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदं मानुषान्मन्ये प्राप्तं निःसंशयं भयम्
जीवितान्तकरं घोरं रक्षसां रावणस्य च
verses.transliteration:
tadidaṁ mānuṣānmanye prāptaṁ niḥsaṁśayaṁ bhayam
jīvitāntakaraṁ ghoraṁ rakṣasāṁ rāvaṇasya ca

translations.english: Forsooth, he is that fearful man who shall slay Rāvana and the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
पीड्यमानास्तु बलिना वरदानेन रक्षसा
दीप्तैस्तपोभिर्विबुधाः पितामहमपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
pīḍyamānāstu balinā varadānena rakṣasā
dīptaistapobhirvibudhāḥ pitāmahamapūjayan

translations.english: The celestials being thus oppressed by Ravana, who had obtained the boon, worshipped the great Patriachs with sever austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
देवतानां हितार्थाय महात्मा वै पितामहः
उवाच देवताः सर्वा इदं तुष्टो महद्वचः
verses.transliteration:
devatānāṁ hitārthāya mahātmā vai pitāmahaḥ
uvāca devatāḥ sarvā idaṁ tuṣṭo mahadvacaḥ

translations.english: Being propitiated with them, the high-souled Patriarch, for their welfare, addressed the celestials, with the following pregnant speech.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य प्रभृति लोकांस्त्रीन्सर्वे दानवराक्षसाः
भयेन प्रावृता नित्यं विचरिष्यन्ति शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration:
adya prabhṛti lokāṁstrīnsarve dānavarākṣasāḥ
bhayena prāvṛtā nityaṁ vicariṣyanti śāśvatam

translations.english: From today shall the Rākṣasas and Dänavas roam for ever afraid of the celestials in three worlds,

verses.sanskrit:
दैवतैस्तु समागम्य सर्वैश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमैः
वृषध्वजस्त्रिपुरहा महादेवः प्रसादितः
verses.transliteration:
daivataistu samāgamya sarvaiścendrapurogamaiḥ
vṛṣadhvajastripurahā mahādevaḥ prasāditaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the celestials headed by Indra engaged in propitiating Mahādeva, the slayer of Tripura, and who rides upon a bull.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसन्नस्तु महादेवो देवानेतद्वचोऽब्रवीत्
उत्पत्स्यति हितार्थं वो नारी रक्षःक्षयावहा
verses.transliteration:
prasannastu mahādevo devānetadvaco'bravīt
utpatsyati hitārthaṁ vo nārī rakṣaḥkṣayāvahā

translations.english: And being pleased, Mahädeva addressed them saying, For your welfare there will be born a woman who shall be the cause of the destruction of the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा देवैः प्रयुक्ता तु क्षुद्यथा दानवान्पुरा
भक्षयिष्यति नः सीता राक्षसघ्नी सरावणान्
verses.transliteration:
eṣā devaiḥ prayuktā tu kṣudyathā dānavānpurā
bhakṣayiṣyati naḥ sītā rākṣasaghnī sarāvaṇān

translations.english: As hunger, being engaged by the celestials, did destroy in olden time, all the Dānvas, so shall she (Sītā) the root of the extinction of Rāksasa race destroy us all with Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्यापनीतेन दुर्विनीतस्य दुर्मतेः
अयं निष्टानको घोरः शोकेन समभिप्लुतः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasyāpanītena durvinītasya durmateḥ
ayaṁ niṣṭānako ghoraḥ śokena samabhiplutaḥ

translations.english: Alas! for the foolishness of the vicious minded and insolent Răvaņa destruction has faced us and we are overwhelmed with grief.

verses.sanskrit:
तं न पश्यामहे लोके यो नः शरणदो भवेत्
राघवेणोपसृष्टानां कालेनेव युगक्षये
verses.transliteration:
taṁ na paśyāmahe loke yo naḥ śaraṇado bhavet
rāghaveṇopasṛṣṭānāṁ kāleneva yugakṣaye

translations.english: We do not see any such being in the world who can afford us shelter. Rāghava has attacked us like to the fire of dissolution. There is no refuge for who have been stricken with fear as no help re.. hes the elephants in a forest best with fire.

verses.sanskrit:
इतीव सर्वा रजनीचरस्त्रियः; परस्परं संपरिरभ्य बाहुभिः
विषेदुरार्तातिभयाभिपीडिता; विनेदुरुच्चैश्च तदा सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
itīva sarvā rajanīcarastriyaḥ; parasparaṁ saṁparirabhya bāhubhiḥ
viṣedurārtātibhayābhipīḍitā; vineduruccaiśca tadā sudāruṇam

translations.english: Thus bewailed piteously and loudly-the she demons holding each other by neck and being stricken with fear and grief.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्तानां राक्षसीनां तु लङ्कायां वै कुले कुले
रावणः करुणं शब्दं शुश्राव परिवेदितम्
verses.transliteration:
ārtānāṁ rākṣasīnāṁ tu laṅkāyāṁ vai kule kule
rāvaṇaḥ karuṇaṁ śabdaṁ śuśrāva pariveditam

translations.english: Thereupon Rāvana heard in every house of Lankā the piteous cries of the she-demons possessed by sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु दीर्घं विनिश्वस्य मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थितः
बभूव परमक्रुद्धो रावणो भीमदर्शनः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu dīrghaṁ viniśvasya muhūrtaṁ dhyānamāsthitaḥ
babhūva paramakruddho rāvaṇo bhīmadarśanaḥ

translations.english: And sighing hard he engaged in mediations for some time. And terrible-looking as he was greatly worked up with ire.

verses.sanskrit:
संदश्य दशनैरोष्ठं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
राक्षसैरपि दुर्दर्शः कालाग्निरिव मूर्छितः
verses.transliteration:
saṁdaśya daśanairoṣṭhaṁ krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ
rākṣasairapi durdarśaḥ kālāgniriva mūrchitaḥ

translations.english: Having his eyes reddened with anger and gnashing his teeth and biting the lips, that one, irrepressible by other Raksasas, looked like the fire of dissolution incarnate.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच च समीपस्थान्राक्षसान्राक्षसेश्वरः
भयाव्यक्तकथांस्तत्र निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration:
uvāca ca samīpasthānrākṣasānrākṣaseśvaraḥ
bhayāvyaktakathāṁstatra nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā

translations.english: There upon the lord of Rākşasas, in anger as if burning down everything with his look addressed the Rākşasas who were near him.

verses.sanskrit:
महोदरं महापार्श्वं विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसं
शीघ्रं वदत सैन्यानि निर्यातेति ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration:
mahodaraṁ mahāpārśvaṁ virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasaṁ
śīghraṁ vadata sainyāni niryāteti mamājñayā

translations.english: Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, Virāpāksa "Do you speedily speak to the soldiers that they should sally out for battle at my command.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते भयार्दिताः
चोदयामासुरव्यग्रान्राक्षसांस्तान्नृपाज्ञया
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasāste bhayārditāḥ
codayāmāsuravyagrānrākṣasāṁstānnṛpājñayā

translations.english: Hearing his speech-those Raksasa, possessed by fear, asked by the command of the king, the Rākşasa soldiers to be ready.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः
कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे रावणाभिमुखा ययुः
verses.transliteration:
te tu sarve tathetyuktvā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ
kṛtasvastyayanāḥ sarve rāvaṇābhimukhā yayuḥ

translations.english: Thereat all those grim-visaged Rākṣasas saying 'so be it' and performing benedictory ceremonies proceeded to the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिपूज्य यथान्यायं रावणं ते महारथाः
तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
pratipūjya yathānyāyaṁ rāvaṇaṁ te mahārathāḥ
tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: Those mighty car-warrior, worshipping Rāvana, and desiring the victory of their lord, stood before them with folded hands.

verses.sanskrit:
अथोवाच प्रहस्यैतान्रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः
महोदरमहापार्श्वौ विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसं
verses.transliteration:
athovāca prahasyaitānrāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
mahodaramahāpārśvau virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasaṁ

translations.english: Thereupon Ravana, beside himself with anger, laughing, addressed those Raksasas, Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, and Virūpākşa, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य बाणैर्धनुर्मुक्तैर्युगान्तादित्यसंनिभैः
राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव नेष्यामि यमसाधनम्
verses.transliteration:
adya bāṇairdhanurmuktairyugāntādityasaṁnibhaiḥ
rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva neṣyāmi yamasādhanam

translations.english: Today shall I despatch both Rāma and Lakşmaņa to the abode of Death with arrows resembling the sun at the time of dissolution, discharged off my bow.

verses.sanskrit:
खरस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य प्रहस्तेन्द्रजितोस्तथा
करिष्यामि प्रतीकारमद्य शत्रुवधादहम्
verses.transliteration:
kharasya kumbhakarṇasya prahastendrajitostathā
kariṣyāmi pratīkāramadya śatruvadhādaham

translations.english: And slaying the enemies I shall repair the loss of Khara, Kumbhakarna, Prahasta and Indrajit.

verses.sanskrit:
नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न नद्यो नापि सागरः
प्रकाशत्वं गमिष्यन्ति मद्बाणजलदावृताः
verses.transliteration:
naivāntarikṣaṁ na diśo na nadyo nāpi sāgaraḥ
prakāśatvaṁ gamiṣyanti madbāṇajaladāvṛtāḥ

translations.english: The atmosphere, the quarters the sky and the deep being enveloped with the cloud of arrows shall become invisible.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य वानरयूथानां तानि यूथानि भागशः
धनुःसमुद्रादुद्भूतैर्मथिष्यामि शरोर्मिभिः
verses.transliteration:
adya vānarayūthānāṁ tāni yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ
dhanuḥsamudrādudbhūtairmathiṣyāmi śarormibhiḥ

translations.english: Ascending my car gifted with the velocity of the wind shall I churn today the monkey host with arrow-like waves coming from the oceanlike bow.

verses.sanskrit:
व्याकोशपद्मचक्राणि पद्मकेसरवर्चसाम्
अद्य यूथतटाकानि गजवत्प्रमथाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
vyākośapadmacakrāṇi padmakesaravarcasām
adya yūthataṭākāni gajavatpramathāmyaham

translations.english: I shall like an elephant distress today the monkey-like pools having their countenances for the blown lotuses, and the lustre of their bodies for the filaments.

verses.sanskrit:
सशरैरद्य वदनैः संख्ये वानरयूथपाः
मण्डयिष्यन्ति वसुधां सनालैरिव पङ्कलैः
verses.transliteration:
saśarairadya vadanaiḥ saṁkhye vānarayūthapāḥ
maṇḍayiṣyanti vasudhāṁ sanālairiva paṅkalaiḥ

translations.english: To-day in the encounter, the leaders of the monkey hosts, with their heads transfixed with arrows, shall cover the earth, like to Ictuses with their stalks.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य युद्धप्रचण्डानां हरीणां द्रुमयोधिनाम्
मुक्तेनैकेषुणा युद्धे भेत्स्यामि च शतंशतम्
verses.transliteration:
adya yuddhapracaṇḍānāṁ harīṇāṁ drumayodhinām
muktenaikeṣuṇā yuddhe bhetsyāmi ca śataṁśatam

translations.english: I shall today with a single arrow, cleave hundreds of heroic monkeys fighting with trees in their hands.

verses.sanskrit:
हतो भर्ता हतो भ्राता यासां च तनया हताः
वधेनाद्य रिपोस्तासां कर्मोम्यस्रप्रमार्जनम्
verses.transliteration:
hato bhartā hato bhrātā yāsāṁ ca tanayā hatāḥ
vadhenādya ripostāsāṁ karmomyasrapramārjanam

translations.english: I shall wipe today the tears of those whose brother or son has been slain by destroying their goe.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नैः प्रकीर्णैर्गतचेतनैः
करोमि वानरैर्युद्धे यत्नावेक्ष्यतलां महीम्
verses.transliteration:
adya madbāṇanirbhinnaiḥ prakīrṇairgatacetanaiḥ
karomi vānarairyuddhe yatnāvekṣyatalāṁ mahīm

translations.english: In the encounter today I shall, with the monkeys deprived of their breath and clept with my arrows, so cover the earth that it may not be seen by any.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य गोमायवो गृध्रा ये च मांसाशिनोऽपरे
सर्वांस्तांस्तर्पयिष्यामि शत्रुमांसैः शरार्दितैः
verses.transliteration:
adya gomāyavo gṛdhrā ye ca māṁsāśino'pare
sarvāṁstāṁstarpayiṣyāmi śatrumāṁsaiḥ śarārditaiḥ

translations.english: I shall satisfy today with the flesh of the enemies slain by my shafts, the crows, vultures and others who live upon flesh.

verses.sanskrit:
कल्प्यतां मे रथशीघ्रं क्षिप्रमानीयतां धनुः
अनुप्रयान्तु मां युद्धे येऽवशिष्टा निशाचराः
verses.transliteration:
kalpyatāṁ me rathaśīghraṁ kṣipramānīyatāṁ dhanuḥ
anuprayāntu māṁ yuddhe ye'vaśiṣṭā niśācarāḥ

translations.english: Get ready soon my car and bring my bow. And let the remaining night-rangers follow me in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महापार्श्वोऽब्रवीद्वचः
बलाध्यक्षान्स्थितांस्तत्र बलं संत्वर्यतामिति
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā mahāpārśvo'bravīdvacaḥ
balādhyakṣānsthitāṁstatra balaṁ saṁtvaryatāmiti

translations.english: Hearing his words Mahāpārsva addressed the leaders of the army who were near him, saying, "Get your soldiers ready."

verses.sanskrit:
बलाध्यक्षास्तु संरब्धा राक्षसांस्तान्गृहाद्गृहात्
चोदयन्तः परिययुर्लङ्कां लघुपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration:
balādhyakṣāstu saṁrabdhā rākṣasāṁstāngṛhādgṛhāt
codayantaḥ pariyayurlaṅkāṁ laghuparākramāḥ

translations.english: The commanders too quickly went round all the houses in Lankā and asked the Rākşasas to be ready soun.

verses.sanskrit:
आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
āruroha rathaṁ divyaṁ dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā
rāvaṇaḥ sattvagāmbhīryāddārayanniva medinīm

translations.english: Thereupon proceeded Råvana, encircled by many a Raksasa as if rending the earth with the excess of his prowess. arose was

verses.sanskrit:
रावणेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ महापार्श्वमहोदरौ
विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो रथानारुरुहुस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇenābhyanujñātau mahāpārśvamahodarau
virūpākṣaśca durdharṣo rathānāruruhustadā

translations.english: Being commanded by Ravana, Mahāparrsha, Mahodara and the irrepressible Virupaksa ascended the car.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु हृष्टा विनर्दन्तो भिन्दन्त इव मेदिनीम्
नादं घोरं विमुञ्चन्तो निर्ययुर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
te tu hṛṣṭā vinardanto bhindanta iva medinīm
nādaṁ ghoraṁ vimuñcanto niryayurjayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: They, desirous of winning victory, issued out emitting dreadful roars in delight and as if rending the earth therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो युद्धाय तेजस्वी रक्षोगणबलैर्वृतः
निर्ययावुद्यतधनुः कालान्तकयमोमपः
verses.transliteration:
tato yuddhāya tejasvī rakṣogaṇabalairvṛtaḥ
niryayāvudyatadhanuḥ kālāntakayamomapaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent (Ravana) resembling Death, with uplifted bow, sallied out for battle along with the army of Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रजवनाश्वेन रथेन स महारथः
द्वारेण निर्ययौ तेन यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prajavanāśvena rathena sa mahārathaḥ
dvāreṇa niryayau tena yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau

translations.english: That mighty car-warrior, went out in his chariot drawn by quick coursing steeds by that gate which led to where Rāma and Lakşmaņa were.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो नष्टप्रभः सूर्यो दिशश्च तिमिरावृताः
द्विजाश्च नेदुर्घोराश्च संचचाल च मेदिनी
verses.transliteration:
tato naṣṭaprabhaḥ sūryo diśaśca timirāvṛtāḥ
dvijāśca nedurghorāśca saṁcacāla ca medinī

translations.english: Thereat the sun lost its brilliance the quarters were enshrouded with darkness; the birds sent forth dreadful cried and the earth shook.

verses.sanskrit:
ववर्ष रुधिरं देवश्चस्खलुश्च तुरंगमाः
ध्वजाग्रे न्यपतद्गृध्रो विनेदुश्चाशिवं शिवाः
verses.transliteration:
vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devaścaskhaluśca turaṁgamāḥ
dhvajāgre nyapatadgṛdhro vineduścāśivaṁ śivāḥ

translations.english: The celestial poured down bloody rains-the course of the horses was slackened-the vultures sat on the banners and jackals emitted inauspicious cries.

verses.sanskrit:
नयनं चास्फुरद्वामं सव्यो बाहुरकम्पत
विवर्णवदनश्चासीत्किंचिदभ्रश्यत स्वरः
verses.transliteration:
nayanaṁ cāsphuradvāmaṁ savyo bāhurakampata
vivarṇavadanaścāsītkiṁcidabhraśyata svaraḥ

translations.english: His left eye and the left arm began to shakehis countenance became pale and his voice grew harsher.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निष्पततो युद्धे दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः
रणे निधनशंसीनि रूपाण्येतानि जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration:
tato niṣpatato yuddhe daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ
raṇe nidhanaśaṁsīni rūpāṇyetāni jajñire

translations.english: The Ten-necked Rākşasa thus going out for battle there appeared many bad omens indicating his destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तरिक्षात्पपातोल्का निर्घातसमनिस्वना
विनेदुरशिवं गृध्रा वायसैरनुनादिताः
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣātpapātolkā nirghātasamanisvanā
vineduraśivaṁ gṛdhrā vāyasairanunāditāḥ

translations.english: From the sky fell a fire-brand accompanied with the sound of thunder; vultures and crows emitted inauspicious cries.

verses.sanskrit:
एतानचिन्तयन्घोरानुत्पातान्समुपस्थितान्
निर्ययौ रावणो मोहाद्वधार्थी कालचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
etānacintayanghorānutpātānsamupasthitān
niryayau rāvaṇo mohādvadhārthī kālacoditaḥ

translations.english: Disregarding these dreadful omens which appeared then, Ravana, incited by death, foolishly went out to slay his (enemies).

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तु रथघोषेण राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्
वानराणामपि चमूर्युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tu rathaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṁ mahātmanām
vānarāṇāmapi camūryuddhāyaivābhyavartata

translations.english: By the wheel-sound of the chariots of the great Raksasas the host of monkeys calling each other, excited with anger and willing to gain victory, addressed themselves for fight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः
वानराणामनीकेषु चकार कदनं महत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ
vānarāṇāmanīkeṣu cakāra kadanaṁ mahat

translations.english: Thereupon the Ten-necked one, enraged, with his arrows feathered in gold, made a dreadful slaughter of the army of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
निकृत्तशिरसः केचिद्रावणेन वलीमुखाः
निरुच्छ्वासा हताः केचित्केचित्पार्श्वेषु दारिताः
केचिद्विभिन्नशिरसः केचिच्चक्षुर्विवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration:
nikṛttaśirasaḥ kecidrāvaṇena valīmukhāḥ
nirucchvāsā hatāḥ kecitkecitpārśveṣu dāritāḥ
kecidvibhinnaśirasaḥ keciccakṣurvivarjitāḥ

translations.english: Some had their breath choked, some were killed and others had their sides broken. Some had their hands cut off and others had their eyes put out.

verses.sanskrit:
दशाननः क्रोधविवृत्तनेत्रो; यतो यतोऽभ्येति रथेन संख्ये
ततस्ततस्तस्य शरप्रवेगं; सोढुं न शेकुर्हरियूथपास्ते
verses.transliteration:
daśānanaḥ krodhavivṛttanetro; yato yato'bhyeti rathena saṁkhye
tatastatastasya śarapravegaṁ; soḍhuṁ na śekurhariyūthapāste

translations.english: Wherever in the encounter, the Ten-headed Räksasa, whirling his eyes in ire, went in his car the monkey leaders could not stand the vehemence of his arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तैः कृत्तगात्रैस्तु दशग्रीवेण मार्गणैः
बभूव वसुधा तत्र प्रकीर्णा हरिभिर्वृता
verses.transliteration:
tathā taiḥ kṛttagātraistu daśagrīveṇa mārgaṇaiḥ
babhūva vasudhā tatra prakīrṇā haribhirvṛtā

translations.english: There the earth was covered with monkeys whose bodies were rent with the arrows of the Ten-necked (Ravana).

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्याप्रसह्यं तं शरसंपातमेकतः
न शेकुः सहितुं दीप्तं पतंगा इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasyāprasahyaṁ taṁ śarasaṁpātamekataḥ
na śekuḥ sahituṁ dīptaṁ pataṁgā iva pāvakam

translations.english: As the flies cannot stand before the flaming fire so they could not bear the vehemence of Ravana's shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽर्दिता निशितैर्बाणैः क्रोशन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः
पावकार्चिःसमाविष्टा दह्यमाना यथा गजाः
verses.transliteration:
te'rditā niśitairbāṇaiḥ krośanto vipradudruvuḥ
pāvakārciḥsamāviṣṭā dahyamānā yathā gajāḥ

translations.english: Being thus assailed with pointed arrows they fled away crying, like to elephants being burnt by fire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्लवंगानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः
स ययौ समरे तस्मिन्विधमन्रावणः शरैः
verses.transliteration:
plavaṁgānāmanīkāni mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ
sa yayau samare tasminvidhamanrāvaṇaḥ śaraiḥ

translations.english: Rävaņa with his arrows pursued in conflict destroying the army of monkey as wind dissipate the large clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
कदनं तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम्
आससाद ततो युद्धे राघवं त्वरितस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
kadanaṁ tarasā kṛtvā rākṣasendro vanaukasām
āsasāda tato yuddhe rāghavaṁ tvaritastadā

translations.english: Thus slaughtering the monkeys the lords of Räkşasas speedily reached in the encounter where Raghava was.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवस्तान्कपीन्दृष्ट्वा भग्नान्विद्रवतो रणे
गुल्मे सुषेणं निक्षिप्य चक्रे युद्धे द्रुतं मनः
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvastānkapīndṛṣṭvā bhagnānvidravato raṇe
gulme suṣeṇaṁ nikṣipya cakre yuddhe drutaṁ manaḥ

translations.english: Beholding the monkeys assailed and afraid Sugrīva placing Sușeņa in charge of a gulma*addressed himself for the battle. *The division of an army; a body of troops consisting of nine platoons or nine elephants, nine chariots; twenty-seven horses and forty five foot.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मनः सदृशं वीरं स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम्
सुग्रीवोऽभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः
verses.transliteration:
ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṁ vīraṁ sa taṁ nikṣipya vānaram
sugrīvo'bhimukhaḥ śatruṁ pratasthe pādapāyudhaḥ

translations.english: Placing that heroic monkey, his equal in prowess, in that command Sugrīva sallied out with a tree in his hand to meet the enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चास्य सर्वे यूथाधिपाः स्वयम्
अनुजह्रुर्महाशैलान्विविधांश्च महाद्रुमान्
verses.transliteration:
pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāsya sarve yūthādhipāḥ svayam
anujahrurmahāśailānvividhāṁśca mahādrumān

translations.english: And followed him on all sides the leaders of the monkeys with huge crags and various trees.

verses.sanskrit:
ममर्द च महाकायो राक्षसान्वानरेश्वरः
युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव
verses.transliteration:
mamarda ca mahākāyo rākṣasānvānareśvaraḥ
yugāntasamaye vāyuḥ pravṛddhānagamāniva

translations.english: The heroic Sugrīva emitted terrible roars in the conflict and assailed the heroic Rakşasas and many others. The huge-bodied monkey-chief crushed the Rakşasas like to the wind uprooting the trees at the time of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्षं ववर्ष ह
अश्मवर्षं यथा मेघः पक्षिसंघेषु कानने
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasānāmanīkeṣu śailavarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha
aśmavarṣaṁ yathā meghaḥ pakṣisaṁgheṣu kānane

translations.english: He began to make a downpour of crags at the Rakşasas host like to the cloud pouring down hailstorms at the bird in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवर्षैस्तु राक्षसाः
विकीर्णशिरसः पेतुर्निकृत्ता इव पर्वताः
verses.transliteration:
kapirājavimuktaistaiḥ śailavarṣaistu rākṣasāḥ
vikīrṇaśirasaḥ peturnikṛttā iva parvatāḥ

translations.english: Being beheaded by the crags discharged by that monkeys chief the Rākşasas fell down like to mountains cleft.

verses.sanskrit:
विरूपाक्षः स्वकं नाम धन्वी विश्राव्य राक्षसः
रथादाप्लुत्य दुर्धर्षो गजस्कन्धमुपारुहत्
verses.transliteration:
virūpākṣaḥ svakaṁ nāma dhanvī viśrāvya rākṣasaḥ
rathādāplutya durdharṣo gajaskandhamupāruhat

translations.english: The Rākṣasas being thus attacked and shattered by Sugriva and roaring and falling down on all sides, an irrepressible Raksasa, skilled in archery, in archery, by name by name Virūpākṣa, pronouncing his own name, got down from the car and mounted an elephant.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं द्विरदमारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महारथः
विनदन्भीमनिर्ह्रालं वानरानभ्यधावत
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ dviradamāruhya virūpākṣo mahārathaḥ
vinadanbhīmanirhrālaṁ vānarānabhyadhāvata

translations.english: And mounted on the elephant that highly powerful Virūpākṣa sent forth leonine roars and dashed against the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवे स शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे
स्थापयामासा चोद्विग्नान्राक्षसान्संप्रहर्षयन्
verses.transliteration:
sugrīve sa śarānghorānvisasarja camūmukhe
sthāpayāmāsā codvignānrākṣasānsaṁpraharṣayan

translations.english: Exciting the joy of the Răkşasas and removing their anxiety he discharged dreadful shafts at Sugrīva and his army.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽतिविद्धः शितैर्बाणैः कपीन्द्रस्तेन रक्षसा
चुक्रोध च महाक्रोधो वधे चास्य मनो दधे
verses.transliteration:
so'tividdhaḥ śitairbāṇaiḥ kapīndrastena rakṣasā
cukrodha ca mahākrodho vadhe cāsya mano dadhe

translations.english: Being assailed by the pointed arrows of the Räksasa that lord of monkeys roared in anger and made up his mind to destroy him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः संप्रधने हरिः
अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तं महागजम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pādapamuddhṛtya śūraḥ saṁpradhane hariḥ
abhipatya jaghānāsya pramukhe taṁ mahāgajam

translations.english: Thereupon uprooting a tree the heroic monkeys, skilled in warfare leaped and struck that huge elephant down in his presence.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः
अपासर्पद्धनुर्मात्रं निषसाद ननाद च
verses.transliteration:
sa tu prahārābhihataḥ sugrīveṇa mahāgajaḥ
apāsarpaddhanurmātraṁ niṣasāda nanāda ca

translations.english: Being assailed greatly by Sugrīva that huge elephant proceeded a little within the range of the bow and roared and died.

verses.sanskrit:
गजात्तु मथितात्तूर्णमपक्रम्य स वीर्यवान्
राक्षसोऽभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रत्युद्गम्य ततः कपिम्
verses.transliteration:
gajāttu mathitāttūrṇamapakramya sa vīryavān
rākṣaso'bhimukhaḥ śatruṁ pratyudgamya tataḥ kapim

translations.english: Being greatly enraged on the destruction of the elephant the highly powerful Rākşasa dashed forward to face the enemy. That one of quick monuments took up his dagger and armour and viling, approached Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि तस्याभिसंक्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम्
विरूपाक्षाय चिक्षेप सुग्रीवो जलदोपमाम्
verses.transliteration:
sa hi tasyābhisaṁkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṁ śilām
virūpākṣāya cikṣepa sugrīvo jaladopamām

translations.english: Beholding his movement Sugrīva took up a huge crag resembling cloud and hurled it against Virüpākşa.

verses.sanskrit:
स तां शिलामापतन्तीं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसपुंगवः
अपक्रम्य सुविक्रान्तः खड्गेन प्राहरत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
sa tāṁ śilāmāpatantīṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuṁgavaḥ
apakramya suvikrāntaḥ khaḍgena prāharattadā
