translations.english: That highly powerful leading Rākṣasa, finding the crag about to fall, turned a little away and struck the monkey with his dagger.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन खड्गेन संक्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे
कवचं पातयामास स खड्गाभिहतोऽपतत्
verses.transliteration:
tena khaḍgena saṁkruddhaḥ sugrīvasya camūmukhe
kavacaṁ pātayāmāsa sa khaḍgābhihato'patat

translations.english: Being struck with the fist the night-ranger Virūpākṣa greatly enraged cut down with his dagger Sugriva's armour and tumbled him down with his feet.

verses.sanskrit:
स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्
तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनिस्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa samutthāya patitaḥ kapistasya vyasarjayat
talaprahāramaśaneḥ samānaṁ bhīmanisvanam

translations.english: The monkey rising up again was about to deal him a blow, hard as a thunder-bolt, with a dreadful sound.

verses.sanskrit:
तलप्रहारं तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम्
नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरस्यताडयत्
verses.transliteration:
talaprahāraṁ tadrakṣaḥ sugrīveṇa samudyatam
naipuṇyānmocayitvainaṁ muṣṭinorasyatāḍayat

translations.english: And receding a little, he baffled its aim and returned one on Sugriva's breast.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु संक्रुद्धतरः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
मोक्षितं चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा प्रहारं तेन रक्षसा
verses.transliteration:
tatastu saṁkruddhataraḥ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
mokṣitaṁ cātmano dṛṣṭvā prahāraṁ tena rakṣasā

translations.english: Finding his aim baffled and himself struck in return by the Rākşasa, Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, was excited with anger. And the monkey-chief was now on the look-out for an opportunity to strike Virüpākşa.

verses.sanskrit:
महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ
पपात रुधिरक्लिन्नः शोणितं स समुद्वमन्
verses.transliteration:
mahendrāśanikalpena talenābhihataḥ kṣitau
papāta rudhiraklinnaḥ śoṇitaṁ sa samudvaman

translations.english: Immediately in anger he struck him down with a blow on his forehead. And being thus assailed with the fist resembling the thunder-bolt of Mahendra, he fell down on the earth bathed in a pool of blood.

verses.sanskrit:
विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात्सफेनरुधिराप्लुतम्
ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
vivṛttanayanaṁ krodhātsaphenarudhirāplutam
dadṛśuste virūpākṣaṁ virūpākṣataraṁ kṛtam

translations.english: Blood gushed out of the person of Virūpākșa like to water issuing out of a fountain. And the monkeys beheld their enemy (Virūpākṣa) with his eyes disfigured in anger, bathed in a foam of blood, his whole body discoloured, trembling, rolling and crying piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तु तौ संयति संप्रयुक्तौ; तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम्
बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुः सभीमं; महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नवेलौ
verses.transliteration:
tathā tu tau saṁyati saṁprayuktau; tarasvinau vānararākṣasānām
balārṇavau sasvanatuḥ sabhīmaṁ; mahārṇavau dvāviva bhinnavelau

translations.english: There upon those too armies of the monkeys and Räkşasas, being ready to engage in the encounter, began to roar like to two mighty oceans having their banks broken.

verses.sanskrit:
विनाशितं प्रेक्ष्य विरूपनेत्रं; महाबलं तं हरिपार्थिवेन
बलं समस्तं कपिराक्षसाना;मुन्मत्तगङ्गाप्रतिमं बभूव
verses.transliteration:
vināśitaṁ prekṣya virūpanetraṁ; mahābalaṁ taṁ haripārthivena
balaṁ samastaṁ kapirākṣasānā;munmattagaṅgāpratimaṁ babhūva

translations.english: Observing that highly powerful Räkşasa, of discoloured eyes, slain by the king of monkeys, the monkeys and Rakşasa forces engaged in fight and looked like the rising Ganges.

verses.sanskrit:
हन्यमाने बले तूर्णमन्योन्यं ते महामृधे
सरसीव महाघर्मे सूपक्षीणे बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration:
hanyamāne bale tūrṇamanyonyaṁ te mahāmṛdhe
sarasīva mahāgharme sūpakṣīṇe babhūvatuḥ

translations.english: Like to a pond in the summer both the armies became gradually reduce.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वबलस्य विघातेन विरूपाक्षवधेन च
बभूव द्विगुणं क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
verses.transliteration:
svabalasya vighātena virūpākṣavadhena ca
babhūva dviguṇaṁ kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ

translations.english: Beholding his own army and Virupaksa slain Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, was doubly excited with ire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रक्षीणं तु बलं दृष्ट्वा वध्यमानं वलीमुखैः
बभूवास्य व्यथा युद्धे प्रेक्ष्य दैवविपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
prakṣīṇaṁ tu balaṁ dṛṣṭvā vadhyamānaṁ valīmukhaiḥ
babhūvāsya vyathā yuddhe prekṣya daivaviparyayam

translations.english: Observing his army reduced and slain by the heroic (monkeys) he perceived ill omens in the fight and was accordingly pained at heart,

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच च समीपस्थं महोदरमरिंदमम्
अस्मिन्काले महाबाहो जयाशा त्वयि मे स्थिता
verses.transliteration:
uvāca ca samīpasthaṁ mahodaramariṁdamam
asminkāle mahābāho jayāśā tvayi me sthitā

translations.english: He addressed Mahodara who was near him saying, you of great arms, all my hopes of success are now centred in you.

verses.sanskrit:
जहि शत्रुचमूं वीर दर्शयाद्य पराक्रमम्
भर्तृपिण्डस्य कालोऽयं निर्वेष्टुं साधु युध्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
jahi śatrucamūṁ vīra darśayādya parākramam
bhartṛpiṇḍasya kālo'yaṁ nirveṣṭuṁ sādhu yudhyatām

translations.english: Do you slay the enemy's force, O hero, and display your prowess. Now has come the time of returning the favours of your master. Do you fight bravely.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं महोदरः
प्रविवेशारिसेनां स पतंग इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastathetyuktvā rākṣasendraṁ mahodaraḥ
praviveśārisenāṁ sa pataṁga iva pāvakam

translations.english: Being thus accosted that Räkşasa chief Mahodara saying "so be it” entered the enemy's army like to a fly entering into a flame.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स कदनं चक्रे वानराणां महाबलः
भर्तृवाक्येन तेजस्वी स्वेन वीर्येण चोदितः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa kadanaṁ cakre vānarāṇāṁ mahābalaḥ
bhartṛvākyena tejasvī svena vīryeṇa coditaḥ

translations.english: Excited by his master's command and empowered by his won prowess that (Rākşasa) gifted with great strength began to assail the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभग्नां समरे दृष्ट्वा वानराणां महाचमूम्
अभिदुद्राव सुग्रीवो महोदरमनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
prabhagnāṁ samare dṛṣṭvā vānarāṇāṁ mahācamūm
abhidudrāva sugrīvo mahodaramanantaram

translations.english: And beholding his powerful monkeys force thus assailed in the conflict, Sugrīva dashed for ward and fronted Mahodara.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रगृह्य विपुलां घोरां महीधरसमां शिलाम्
चिक्षेप च महातेजास्तद्वधाय हरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
pragṛhya vipulāṁ ghorāṁ mahīdharasamāṁ śilām
cikṣepa ca mahātejāstadvadhāya harīśvaraḥ

translations.english: And taking up a huge and dreadful crag resembling a mountain, the monkeys-king hurled it with great vehemence to slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा शिलां दृष्ट्वा महोदरः
असंभ्रान्तस्ततो बाणैर्निर्बिभेद दुरासदाम्
verses.transliteration:
tāmāpatantīṁ sahasā śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā mahodaraḥ
asaṁbhrāntastato bāṇairnirbibheda durāsadām

translations.english: Thereupon finding that crag about to fall, Mahodara fearlessly severed it with his arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षसा तेन बाणौघैर्निकृत्ता सा सहस्रधा
निपपात शिला भूमौ गृध्रचक्रमिवाकुलम्
verses.transliteration:
rakṣasā tena bāṇaughairnikṛttā sā sahasradhā
nipapāta śilā bhūmau gṛdhracakramivākulam

translations.english: And being sundered into a thousand pieces by the arrow of that Rākşasa, it fell down on the earth like to a band of vultures.

verses.sanskrit:
तां तु भिन्नां शिलां दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवः क्रोधमूर्छितः
सालमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप रक्षसे रणमूर्धनि
शरैश्च विददारैनं शूरः परपुरंजयः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ tu bhinnāṁ śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
sālamutpāṭya cikṣepa rakṣase raṇamūrdhani
śaraiśca vidadārainaṁ śūraḥ parapuraṁjayaḥ

translations.english: Beholding that crag thus severed, Sugrīva was beside himself with ire; and uplifting a Sála tree hurled it; and the heroic Räkşasa the slayer of enemy's force, severed it into several pieces with his arrows. Thereupon excited with wrath he saw a parigha on the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्धतहयाद्वीरः सोऽवप्लुत्य महारथात्
गदां जग्राह संक्रुद्धो राक्षसोऽथ महोदरः
verses.transliteration:
tasmāddhatahayādvīraḥ so'vaplutya mahārathāt
gadāṁ jagrāha saṁkruddho rākṣaso'tha mahodaraḥ

translations.english: And hurling that flaming Parigha and displaying his (light-handedness) he stuck his excellent horse there with. And having his horse slain, that hero the Rakşasa Mahodara, ascended his car, and in great anger took up his club.

verses.sanskrit:
गदापरिघहस्तौ तौ युधि वीरौ समीयतुः
नर्दन्तौ गोवृषप्रख्यौ घनाविव सविद्युतौ
verses.transliteration:
gadāparighahastau tau yudhi vīrau samīyatuḥ
nardantau govṛṣaprakhyau ghanāviva savidyutau

translations.english: Those two heroes, with club and parigha in their hands, engaged in battle, roaring like two bulls or clouds accompanied with lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
आजघान गदां तस्य परिघेण हरीश्वरः
पपात स गदोद्भिन्नः परिघस्तस्य भूतले
verses.transliteration:
ājaghāna gadāṁ tasya parigheṇa harīśvaraḥ
papāta sa gadodbhinnaḥ parighastasya bhūtale

translations.english: Beholding that dreadful club about to fall the highly powerful Sugrīva-the lord of monkeys, uplifting his parigha struck it there with. And parigha, being sundered, fell quickly down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो जग्राह तेजस्वी सुग्रीवो वसुधातलात्
आयसं मुसलं घोरं सर्वतो हेमभूषितम्
verses.transliteration:
tato jagrāha tejasvī sugrīvo vasudhātalāt
āyasaṁ musalaṁ ghoraṁ sarvato hemabhūṣitam

translations.english: Thereupon the effulgent Sugrīva picked up from the ground musala made of iron and ornamented with gold.

verses.sanskrit:
तं समुद्यम्य चिक्षेप सोऽप्यन्यां व्याक्षिपद्गदाम्
भिन्नावन्योन्यमासाद्य पेततुर्धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samudyamya cikṣepa so'pyanyāṁ vyākṣipadgadām
bhinnāvanyonyamāsādya petaturdharaṇītale

translations.english: Taking that musala up he hurled it at the Räkşasa and who again hurled a club; and both of them being severed fell down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो भग्नप्रहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः
तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ
verses.transliteration:
tato bhagnapraharaṇau muṣṭibhyāṁ tau samīyatuḥ
tejobalasamāviṣṭau dīptāviva hutāśanau

translations.english: Having their weapons baffled thus, those two heroes, gifted with great prowess and effulgence and resembling the burning fire, were ready to interchange blows.

verses.sanskrit:
जघ्नतुस्तौ तदान्योन्यं नेदतुश्च पुनः पुनः
तलैश्चान्योन्यमाहत्य पेततुर्धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
jaghnatustau tadānyonyaṁ nedatuśca punaḥ punaḥ
talaiścānyonyamāhatya petaturdharaṇītale

translations.english: They emitting roars again and again, stuck each other down on the earth with their clenched fists.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्पेततुस्ततस्तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम्
भुजैश्चिक्षेपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ
verses.transliteration:
utpetatustatastūrṇaṁ jaghnatuśca parasparam
bhujaiścikṣepaturvīrāvanyonyamaparājitau

translations.english: Then rising up speedily they again assailed each other. Thus those two heroes unsubdued, struck each other with their arms.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ तु रोषपरीताङ्गौ नर्दन्तावभ्यधावताम्
उद्यतासी रणे हृष्टौ युधि शस्त्रविशारदौ
verses.transliteration:
tau tu roṣaparītāṅgau nardantāvabhyadhāvatām
udyatāsī raṇe hṛṣṭau yudhi śastraviśāradau

translations.english: Then uplifting them (those two heroes) with their persons trembling in ire, proficient in fighting and skilled in the use of weapons dashed on roaring.

verses.sanskrit:
दक्षिणं मण्डलं चोभौ तौ तूर्णं संपरीयतुः
अन्योन्यमभिसंक्रुद्धौ जये प्रणिहितावुभौ
verses.transliteration:
dakṣiṇaṁ maṇḍalaṁ cobhau tau tūrṇaṁ saṁparīyatuḥ
anyonyamabhisaṁkruddhau jaye praṇihitāvubhau

translations.english: The both of them enraged with each other and anxious to score success, moving in circle on each other's right side, addressed themselves for action.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु शूरो महावेगो वीर्यश्लाघी महोदरः
महाचर्मणि तं खड्गं पातयामास दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu śūro mahāvego vīryaślāghī mahodaraḥ
mahācarmaṇi taṁ khaḍgaṁ pātayāmāsa durmatiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the vicious-minded, heroic Mahodara, gifted with great vehemence and proud of his own heroism flung his dagger at (the monkey's) armour.

verses.sanskrit:
लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खड्गं खड्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः
जहार सशिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपहितं शिरः
verses.transliteration:
lagnamutkarṣataḥ khaḍgaṁ khaḍgena kapikuñjaraḥ
jahāra saśirastrāṇaṁ kuṇḍalopahitaṁ śiraḥ

translations.english: And as he was about to extricate his dagger from the armour, that foremost of monkeys severed with his dagger that Rākşasa's head with helmet and kundalas.

verses.sanskrit:
निकृत्तशिरसस्तस्य पतितस्य महीतले
तद्बलं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र न तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration:
nikṛttaśirasastasya patitasya mahītale
tadbalaṁ rākṣasendrasya dṛṣṭvā tatra na tiṣṭhati

translations.english: Beholding the Rākşasa chief fall down on the earth with his head off, his forces fled away from the field.

verses.sanskrit:
हत्वा तं वानरैः सार्धं ननाद मुदितो हरिः
चुक्रोध च दशग्रीवो बभौ हृष्टश्च राघवः
verses.transliteration:
hatvā taṁ vānaraiḥ sārdhaṁ nanāda mudito hariḥ
cukrodha ca daśagrīvo babhau hṛṣṭaśca rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Slaying him that monkey-chief, delighted, began to roar along with other monkeys. There upon the Ten-necked one became highly enraged and Rāghava greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि सर्वशः
पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः
verses.transliteration:
sa vānarāṇāṁ mukhyānāmuttamāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ
pātayāmāsa kāyebhyaḥ phalaṁ vṛntādivānilaḥ

translations.english: The Rākşasa, with his weapons assailed the dreadful army of Angada as well as the leading monkeys. The Rākşasa severed the heads from the bodies of the monkeys like to the wind throwing away the fruits from trees. were

verses.sanskrit:
केषांचिदिषुभिर्बाहून्स्कन्धांश्चिछेद राक्षसः
वानराणां सुसंक्रुद्धः पार्श्वं केषां व्यदारयत्
verses.transliteration:
keṣāṁcidiṣubhirbāhūnskandhāṁścicheda rākṣasaḥ
vānarāṇāṁ susaṁkruddhaḥ pārśvaṁ keṣāṁ vyadārayat

translations.english: He cut off, with his arrows, the arms of some and some were deprived of their sides.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण महापार्श्वेन वानराः
विषादविमुखाः सर्वे बभूवुर्गतचेतसः
verses.transliteration:
te'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa mahāpārśvena vānarāḥ
viṣādavimukhāḥ sarve babhūvurgatacetasaḥ

translations.english: The monkeys thus assailed by Mahāpārsva with a shower of shafts. All the monkeys were thus stricken with grief and rendered senseless.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्क्षराजस्तु तेजस्वी नीलाञ्जनचयोपमः
निष्पत्य सुमहावीर्यः स्वाद्यूथान्मेघसंनिभात्
verses.transliteration:
sarkṣarājastu tejasvī nīlāñjanacayopamaḥ
niṣpatya sumahāvīryaḥ svādyūthānmeghasaṁnibhāt

translations.english: Thereupon leaped on the battle-field the! highly powerful and effulgent lord of bears, having the hue of red collyrium, with his army resembling the cloud. And excited with ire, he, taking up a huge crag resembling the summit of a mountain, speedily struck down his horses and broke down his car.

verses.sanskrit:
मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञस्तु महापार्श्वो महाबलः
अङ्गदं बहुभिर्बाणैर्भूयस्तं प्रत्यविध्यत
verses.transliteration:
muhūrtāllabdhasaṁjñastu mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ
aṅgadaṁ bahubhirbāṇairbhūyastaṁ pratyavidhyata

translations.english: And regaining his senses in a moment the highly powerful Mahāpārsva, again assailed Angada with many arrows. He struck Jambavan, the lord of bears, on his breast with three-arrows and assailed Gavākṣa with many shafts. And beholding Jämbavān and Gavākṣa overwhelmed with arrows, Angada, beside himself with ire, took up a dreadful parigha.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां संगृह्य भ्रामयित्वा च वेगवान्
महापार्श्वाय चिक्षेप वधार्थं वालिनः सुतः
verses.transliteration:
dvābhyāṁ bhujābhyāṁ saṁgṛhya bhrāmayitvā ca vegavān
mahāpārśvāya cikṣepa vadhārthaṁ vālinaḥ sutaḥ

translations.english: Holding with two hands that parigha made of iron and bright like the rays of the sun, Angada, the son of Vāli, with his eyes reddened in wrath, hurled it at Mahāpārsva who was stationed at a distance, to slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु क्षिप्तो बलवता परिघस्तस्य रक्षसः
धनुश्च सशरं हस्ताच्छिरस्त्रं चाप्यपातयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu kṣipto balavatā parighastasya rakṣasaḥ
dhanuśca saśaraṁ hastācchirastraṁ cāpyapātayat

translations.english: Being hurled by the highly powerful (Angada) the parigha, struck down from his hands the bow with arrows and the helmet of the Rākşasa.

verses.sanskrit:
तं समासाद्य वेगेन वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्
तलेनाभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः कर्णमूले सकुण्डले
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samāsādya vegena vāliputraḥ pratāpavān
talenābhyahanatkruddhaḥ karṇamūle sakuṇḍale

translations.english: Approaching him vehemently, Vali's son, gifted with great prowess, in anger struck him, with clenched fist, on his ears having excellent kundalas.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु क्रुद्धो महावेगो महापार्श्वो महाद्युतिः
करेणैकेन जग्राह सुमहान्तं परश्वधम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu kruddho mahāvego mahāpārśvo mahādyutiḥ
kareṇaikena jagrāha sumahāntaṁ paraśvadham

translations.english: Thereupon Mahāpārsva gifted with great vehemence and effulgence, highly angered, took up in his hands a huge paraśvadha, sharpened with oil, bright and hard as iron and discharged it at Vali's son, and struck him therewith on his left shoulder. And Angada baffled that parasvadha.

verses.sanskrit:
आविवेश महान्क्रोधो रावणं तु महामृधे
सूतं संचोदयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
āviveśa mahānkrodho rāvaṇaṁ tu mahāmṛdhe
sūtaṁ saṁcodayāmāsa vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha

translations.english: Beholding Mahodara, Mahāpäráva and the highly powerful Virūpåksa slain in the encounter Rāvaņa attained to an excess of ire. And ordering his charioteer to hurry on he gave went to the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
निहतानाममात्यानां रुद्धस्य नगरस्य च
दुःखमेषोऽपनेष्यामि हत्वा तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.transliteration:
nihatānāmamātyānāṁ ruddhasya nagarasya ca
duḥkhameṣo'paneṣyāmi hatvā tau rāmalakṣmaṇau

translations.english: All my courtiers have been slain and my city is shut up-I shall remove my grief consequent on all these by slaying Răma and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
रामवृक्षं रणे हन्मि सीतापुष्पफलप्रदम्
प्रशाखा यस्य सुग्रीवो जाम्बवान्कुमुदो नलः
verses.transliteration:
rāmavṛkṣaṁ raṇe hanmi sītāpuṣpaphalapradam
praśākhā yasya sugrīvo jāmbavānkumudo nalaḥ

translations.english: I shall destroy Rāma-like tree in the conflict whose flower is Sītā and whose branches are Sugrīva, Jāmbavān, Kumuda, Nala, Divida, Mainda, Angada Gandhamadana, Hanuman and all other leading monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
स दिशो दश घोषेण रथस्यातिरथो महान्
नादयन्प्रययौ तूर्णं राघवं चाभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
sa diśo daśa ghoṣeṇa rathasyātiratho mahān
nādayanprayayau tūrṇaṁ rāghavaṁ cābhyavartata

translations.english: And resounding the ten quarters with the sound of his chariot wheels that mighty carwarrior proceeded quickly towards Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
पूरिता तेन शब्देन सनदीगिरिकानना
संचचाल मही सर्वा सवराहमृगद्विपा
verses.transliteration:
pūritā tena śabdena sanadīgirikānanā
saṁcacāla mahī sarvā savarāhamṛgadvipā

translations.english: With that sound all quarters were filled, and the earth, will rivers, mountains and forests shook and all the lions, deer and birds were terrified.

verses.sanskrit:
तामसं सुमहाघोरं चकारास्त्रं सुदारुणम्
निर्ददाह कपीन्सर्वांस्ते प्रपेतुः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
tāmasaṁ sumahāghoraṁ cakārāstraṁ sudāruṇam
nirdadāha kapīnsarvāṁste prapetuḥ samantataḥ

translations.english: He created a dreadful darkness with the discharge of his sharp weapons and burnt down the monkeys who fled away to different directions. Dust was raised on the ground by those monkeys assailed and flying to various directions. They were unable to withstand the power of the weapon made by Brahmå himself.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः
दृष्ट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tānyanīkānyanekāni rāvaṇasya śarottamaiḥ
dṛṣṭvā bhagnāni śataśo rāghavaḥ paryavasthitaḥ

translations.english: Beholding his own army, assailed and cut into hundred pieces by the excellent weapons of Rāvana Råghava dashed forward. a

verses.sanskrit:
आलिखन्तमिवाकाशमवष्टभ्य महद्धनुः
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षं दीर्घबाहुमरिंदमम्
verses.transliteration:
ālikhantamivākāśamavaṣṭabhya mahaddhanuḥ
padmapatraviśālākṣaṁ dīrghabāhumariṁdamam

translations.english: Assailing the monkey-host, that foremost of Rākşasas espied Rāma, unconquered at distance with his brother Lakşmaņa like to Basava with Vişņu, holding a huge bow like one painted on the sky, having expansive eyes like lotus-petals, long arms, and always subduing the enemies.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरांश्च रणे भग्नानापतन्तं च रावणम्
समीक्ष्य राघवो हृष्टो मध्ये जग्राह कार्मुकम्
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṁśca raṇe bhagnānāpatantaṁ ca rāvaṇam
samīkṣya rāghavo hṛṣṭo madhye jagrāha kārmukam

translations.english: Beholding the monkeys slain in the encounter and Rāvaņa approach, the heroic and highly powerful Rāma, with Sumitra's son in his company, delightedly set arrows on his bow.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्फारयितुमारेभे ततः स धनुरुत्तमम्
महावेगं महानादं निर्भिन्दन्निव मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
visphārayitumārebhe tataḥ sa dhanuruttamam
mahāvegaṁ mahānādaṁ nirbhindanniva medinīm

translations.english: As if rending the whole earth with that dreadful sound he began to draw the string of his excellent bow.

verses.sanskrit:
तयोः शरपथं प्राप्य रावणो राजपुत्रयोः
स बभूव यथा राहुः समीपे शशिसूर्ययोः
verses.transliteration:
tayoḥ śarapathaṁ prāpya rāvaṇo rājaputrayoḥ
sa babhūva yathā rāhuḥ samīpe śaśisūryayoḥ

translations.english: Coming within the range of the arrows of those two Princes, Rāvaņa appeared like Rahu in presence of the sun and the moon.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य च बाणौघै रामविस्फरितेन च
शब्देन राक्षसास्तेन पेतुश्च शतशस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya ca bāṇaughai rāmavispharitena ca
śabdena rākṣasāstena petuśca śataśastadā

translations.english: With the sound of Ravan's arrows and the twang of Rāma's bow hundreds of Rākşasas fell down on earth..

verses.sanskrit:
तमिच्छन्प्रथमं योद्धुं लक्ष्मणो निशितैः शरैः
मुमोच धनुरायम्य शरानग्निशिखोपमान्
verses.transliteration:
tamicchanprathamaṁ yoddhuṁ lakṣmaṇo niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
mumoca dhanurāyamya śarānagniśikhopamān

translations.english: And desiring to fight with him first Lakşmana setting sharp arrows on his bow, discharged shafts at him resembling the flame of fire.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्मुक्तमात्रानाकाशे लक्ष्मणेन धनुष्मता
बाणान्बाणैर्महातेजा रावणः प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration:
tānmuktamātrānākāśe lakṣmaṇena dhanuṣmatā
bāṇānbāṇairmahātejā rāvaṇaḥ pratyavārayat

translations.english: The highly powerful Ravana too with his arrows stopped the course of those shafts in the sky as soon as they were discharged by Laksmana, skilled in archery.

verses.sanskrit:
एकमेकेन बाणेन त्रिभिस्त्रीन्दशभिर्दश
लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्
verses.transliteration:
ekamekena bāṇena tribhistrīndaśabhirdaśa
lakṣmaṇasya praciccheda darśayanpāṇilāghavam

translations.english: And displaying his light-handedness, he with one arrow, severed Laksmana's one, with three his three and with ten his ten.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यतिक्रम्य सौमित्रिं रावणः समितिंजयः
आससाद ततो रामं स्थितं शैलमिवाचलम्
verses.transliteration:
abhyatikramya saumitriṁ rāvaṇaḥ samitiṁjayaḥ
āsasāda tato rāmaṁ sthitaṁ śailamivācalam

translations.english: Surpassing thus the son of Sumitrā Rāvana, ever victorious in battle, confronted Rāma in the encounter, standing like another hill.

verses.sanskrit:
स संख्ये राममासाद्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
व्यसृजच्छरवर्षानि रावणो राघवोपरि
verses.transliteration:
sa saṁkhye rāmamāsādya krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ
vyasṛjaccharavarṣāni rāvaṇo rāghavopari

translations.english: Approaching Rāghava, Rāvana the lord of Rakşasas, with his eyes reddened in ire, began to make a shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
शरधारास्ततो रामो रावणस्य धनुश्च्युताः
दृष्ट्वैवापतिताः शीघ्रं भल्लाञ्जग्राह सत्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
śaradhārāstato rāmo rāvaṇasya dhanuścyutāḥ
dṛṣṭvaivāpatitāḥ śīghraṁ bhallāñjagrāha satvaram

translations.english: Thereupon beholding the arrows shot off Ravana's bow fall on all sides, Rāma speedily took up a Bhalla.* *An arrow with a crescent shaped head.

verses.sanskrit:
ताञ्शरौघांस्ततो भल्लैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद राघवः
दीप्यमानान्महावेगान्क्रुद्धानाशीविषानिव
verses.transliteration:
tāñśaraughāṁstato bhallaistīkṣṇaiściccheda rāghavaḥ
dīpyamānānmahāvegānkruddhānāśīviṣāniva

translations.english: Rāghava sundered with his sharp Bhalla his dreadful flaming and resembling poisonous serpents.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवो रावणं तूर्णं रावणो राघवं तथा
अन्योन्यं विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः शरैरभिववर्षतुः
verses.transliteration:
rāghavo rāvaṇaṁ tūrṇaṁ rāvaṇo rāghavaṁ tathā
anyonyaṁ vividhaistīkṣṇaiḥ śarairabhivavarṣatuḥ

translations.english: With various sharpened arrows Rāghava assailed Rävaņa, and he again assailed Rāma in return.

verses.sanskrit:
तयोर्भूतानि वित्रेषुर्युगपत्संप्रयुध्यतोः
रौद्रयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः
verses.transliteration:
tayorbhūtāni vitreṣuryugapatsaṁprayudhyatoḥ
raudrayoḥ sāyakamucoryamāntakanikāśayoḥ

translations.english: And forming a circle, they passed each other by the right side. Uprooting the earth with the vehemence of their arrows, irrepressible by each other, fighting equally discharging arrows, they arrows looked dreadful like Death himself-and created terror in all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
संततं विविधैर्बाणैर्बभूव गगनं तदा
घनैरिवातपापाये विद्युन्मालासमाकुलैः
verses.transliteration:
saṁtataṁ vividhairbāṇairbabhūva gaganaṁ tadā
ghanairivātapāpāye vidyunmālāsamākulaiḥ

translations.english: The sky was filled with their various weapons like to clouds in the rainy season accompanied with lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
गवाक्षितमिवाकाशं बभूव शूरवृष्टिभिः
महावेगैः सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैर्गृध्रपत्रैः सुवाजितैः
verses.transliteration:
gavākṣitamivākāśaṁ babhūva śūravṛṣṭibhiḥ
mahāvegaiḥ sutīkṣṇāgrairgṛdhrapatraiḥ suvājitaiḥ

translations.english: The welkin appeared full of windows with that shower of arrows, shot with great vehemence and winged like vultures.

verses.sanskrit:
शरान्धकारं तौ भीमं चक्रतुः परमं तदा
गतेऽस्तं तपने चापि महामेघाविवोत्थितौ
verses.transliteration:
śarāndhakāraṁ tau bhīmaṁ cakratuḥ paramaṁ tadā
gate'staṁ tapane cāpi mahāmeghāvivotthitau

translations.english: The earth was stricken with darkness caused by these arrows like to clouds appearing after sunset.

verses.sanskrit:
बभूव तुमुलं युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः
अनासाद्यमचिन्त्यं च वृत्रवासवयोरिव
verses.transliteration:
babhūva tumulaṁ yuddhamanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ
anāsādyamacintyaṁ ca vṛtravāsavayoriva

translations.english: There took place a dreadful conflict between them desiring to slay each other, having their prowess unknown and fighting like Vitra and Vasava.

verses.sanskrit:
उभौ हि परमेष्वासावुभौ शस्त्रविशारदौ
उभौ चास्त्रविदां मुख्यावुभौ युद्धे विचेरतुः
verses.transliteration:
ubhau hi parameṣvāsāvubhau śastraviśāradau
ubhau cāstravidāṁ mukhyāvubhau yuddhe viceratuḥ

translations.english: Both of them were proficient in archery, skilled in the art of conflict and foremost of those conversant with the use of weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
उभौ हि येन व्रजतस्तेन तेन शरोर्मयः
ऊर्मयो वायुना विद्धा जग्मुः सागरयोरिव
verses.transliteration:
ubhau hi yena vrajatastena tena śarormayaḥ
ūrmayo vāyunā viddhā jagmuḥ sāgarayoriva

translations.english: They began to veer round the battle-field. And wherever they went, there appeared arrows like to waves of the deep roused by the winds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संसक्तहस्तस्तु रावणो लोकरावणः
नाराचमालां रामस्य ललाटे प्रत्यमुञ्चत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁsaktahastastu rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ
nārācamālāṁ rāmasya lalāṭe pratyamuñcata

translations.english: Then that destroyer of creatures-Ravana, with his hand engaged in discharging shafts, shot at Rāma's forehead a network of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
रौद्रचापप्रयुक्तां तां नीलोत्पलदलप्रभाम्
शिरसा धारयन्रामो न व्यथां प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
raudracāpaprayuktāṁ tāṁ nīlotpaladalaprabhām
śirasā dhārayanrāmo na vyathāṁ pratyapadyata

translations.english: Thereat Rāma on his head bore that shower of shafts shot from his terrific bow, having the lustre of the petals of blue lotuses; nor did he experience any pain.

verses.sanskrit:
मुमोच च महातेजाश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान्
ताञ्शरान्राक्षसेन्द्राय चिक्षेपाच्छिन्नसायकः
verses.transliteration:
mumoca ca mahātejāścāpamāyamya vīryavān
tāñśarānrākṣasendrāya cikṣepācchinnasāyakaḥ

translations.english: Then reciting a formula, the exceedingly energetic Rāma endowed with prowess, wrought up with wrath, engaged in incessantly shooting his shafts, taking his Rudra weapon and again seizing his arrows, discharged them at that lord of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
ते महामेघसंकाशे कवचे पतिताः शराः
अवध्ये राक्षसेन्द्रस्य न व्यथां जनयंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
te mahāmeghasaṁkāśe kavace patitāḥ śarāḥ
avadhye rākṣasendrasya na vyathāṁ janayaṁstadā

translations.english: Alighting at the impenetrable mail of the Rākşasa-chief, resembling a mass of mighty clouds, those arrows did not then occasion him any pain.

verses.sanskrit:
पुनरेवाथ तं रामो रथस्थं राक्षसाधिपम्
ललाटे परमास्त्रेण सर्वास्त्रकुशलोऽभिनत्
verses.transliteration:
punarevātha taṁ rāmo rathasthaṁ rākṣasādhipam
lalāṭe paramāstreṇa sarvāstrakuśalo'bhinat

translations.english: Again Rāma skilled in all weapons, from a powerful weapon discharged arrows at the sovereign of the Raksasas mounted on his car.

verses.sanskrit:
ते भित्त्वा बाणरूपाणि पञ्चशीर्षा इवोरगाः
श्वसन्तो विविशुर्भूमिं रावणप्रतिकूलताः
verses.transliteration:
te bhittvā bāṇarūpāṇi pañcaśīrṣā ivoragāḥ
śvasanto viviśurbhūmiṁ rāvaṇapratikūlatāḥ

translations.english: And piercing Ravana, those like to fivehooded serpents, resisted by him, entered the earth, hissing.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निदीप्तमुखान्बाणांस्तथा सूर्यमुखानपि
चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रवक्त्रांश्च धूमकेतुमुखानपि
verses.transliteration:
agnidīptamukhānbāṇāṁstathā sūryamukhānapi
candrārdhacandravaktrāṁśca dhūmaketumukhānapi

translations.english: Covered with that Asura weapon that foremost of the Raghus, himself resembling fire, discharged an exceedingly vigorous weapon informed with fire; and shot various shafts having faces filled with live flames, and faces like to suns, and hued like to planets and stars, and furnished with faces resembling mighty meteors or resembling tongues of lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
ते रावणशरा घोरा राघवास्त्रसमाहताः
विलयं जग्मुराकाशे जग्मुश्चैव सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration:
te rāvaṇaśarā ghorā rāghavāstrasamāhatāḥ
vilayaṁ jagmurākāśe jagmuścaiva sahasraśaḥ

translations.english: Those terrific shafts of Răvana, resisted by Rāghava's weapon, were annihilated in the sky, and destroyed (monkeys) by thousands.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्त्रं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
हृष्टा नेदुस्ततः सर्वे कपयः कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration:
tadastraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
hṛṣṭā nedustataḥ sarve kapayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ

translations.english: Seeing that weapon (of Rāvaņa) destroyed by Rāma of untiring deeds, all those heroes, the monkeys, headed by Sugrīva, capable of wearing forms at will shouted, surrounding Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रे तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
क्रोधं च द्विगुणं चक्रे क्रोधाच्चास्त्रमनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
tasminpratihate'stre tu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
krodhaṁ ca dviguṇaṁ cakre krodhāccāstramanantaram

translations.english: On that weapon of his hvaing been baffled, Rāvaņa lord of the Rākṣasas-was fired with double fury, and the highly effuigent Rāvaņa from wrath set about discharging at Rāghava a dreadful Rudra weapon, which had been। conferred on him by Maya.

verses.sanskrit:
कूटमुद्गरपाशाश्च दीप्ताश्चाशनयस्तथा
निष्पेतुर्विविधास्तीक्ष्णा वाता इव युगक्षये
verses.transliteration:
kūṭamudgarapāśāśca dīptāścāśanayastathā
niṣpeturvividhāstīkṣṇā vātā iva yugakṣaye

translations.english: And from his bow began to issue forth in large numbers darts and maces and clubs, flaming and having the might of thunder; and various kinds of sharp clubs and diggers and nooses and flaming thunderbolts began to i descend like to the winds at the universal tumbling.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्त्रं राघवः श्रीमानुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः
जघान परमास्त्रेण गन्धर्वेण महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
tadastraṁ rāghavaḥ śrīmānuttamāstravidāṁ varaḥ
jaghāna paramāstreṇa gandharveṇa mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the graceful and exceedingly effulgent Rāghava-foremost of those accomplished in noble arms-resisted that weapon with a powerful Gandharva weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रे तु राघवेण महात्मना
रावणः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सौरमस्त्रमुदीरयत्
verses.transliteration:
tasminpratihate'stre tu rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
rāvaṇaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ sauramastramudīrayat

translations.english: On that weapon being baffled by the highsouled Raghava, Rävaņa, with his eyes rendered coppery with passion took up a Solar weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
ततश्चक्राणि निष्पेतुर्भास्वराणि महान्ति च
कार्मुकाद्भीमवेगस्य दशग्रीवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration:
tataścakrāṇi niṣpeturbhāsvarāṇi mahānti ca
kārmukādbhīmavegasya daśagrīvasya dhīmataḥ

translations.english: Thereupon from the bow of the wondrous vehement and intelligent Ten-necked one rushed out discuses flaming and mighty.

verses.sanskrit:
तैरासीद्गगनं दीप्तं संपतद्भिरितस्ततः
पतद्भिश्च दिशो दीप्तैश्चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहैरिव
verses.transliteration:
tairāsīdgaganaṁ dīptaṁ saṁpatadbhiritastataḥ
patadbhiśca diśo dīptaiścandrasūryagrahairiva

translations.english: The firmament all round blazed up with those impendent (arms) as blaze up the cardinal quarters on the Sun and the Moon and the planets dropping down.

verses.sanskrit:
तानि चिच्छेद बाणौघैश्चक्राणि तु स राघवः
आयुधानि विचित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे
verses.transliteration:
tāni ciccheda bāṇaughaiścakrāṇi tu sa rāghavaḥ
āyudhāni vicitrāṇi rāvaṇasya camūmukhe

translations.english: Thereat Rāghava in the van of that army by means of vollies of shafts cut off Rāvana's wonderful weapons and discuses.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्त्रं तु हतं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
विव्याध दशभिर्बाणै रामं सर्वेषु मर्मसु
verses.transliteration:
tadastraṁ tu hataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
vivyādha daśabhirbāṇai rāmaṁ sarveṣu marmasu

translations.english: Seeing that weapon destroyed, Ravana-lord of Rakşasas-with ten arrows pierced Rāma all through his vitals.

verses.sanskrit:
स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैर्महाकार्मुकनिःसृतैः
रावणेन महातेजा न प्राकम्पत राघवः
verses.transliteration:
sa viddho daśabhirbāṇairmahākārmukaniḥsṛtaiḥ
rāvaṇena mahātejā na prākampata rāghavaḥ

translations.english: And pierced by Rāyaṇa with those ten shafts discharged from his mighty bow the exceedingly powerful Rāghava did not so much shake.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विव्याध गात्रेषु सर्वेषु समितिंजयः
राघवस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धो रावणं बहुभिः शरैः
verses.transliteration:
tato vivyādha gātreṣu sarveṣu samitiṁjayaḥ
rāghavastu susaṁkruddho rāvaṇaṁ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ

translations.english: Then Rāghava-victor fight-waxing wondrous wroth, with countless shafts pierced Ravaņa all over his person.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राघवस्यानुजो बली
लक्ष्मणः सायकान्सप्त जग्राह परवीरहा
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare kruddho rāghavasyānujo balī
lakṣmaṇaḥ sāyakānsapta jagrāha paravīrahā

translations.english: In the meanwhile Raghava's younger brother, the mighty Lakşmaņa-destroyer of foes-growing enraged, took up seven arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
तैः सायकैर्महावेगै रावणस्य महाद्युतिः
ध्वजं मनुष्यशीर्षं तु तस्य चिच्छेद नैकधा
verses.transliteration:
taiḥ sāyakairmahāvegai rāvaṇasya mahādyutiḥ
dhvajaṁ manuṣyaśīrṣaṁ tu tasya ciccheda naikadhā

translations.english: With those highly impetuous arrows that exceedingly effulgent one severed the humanheaded standard of Råvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
सारथेश्चापि बाणेन शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्
जहार लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान्नैरृतस्य महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
sāratheścāpi bāṇena śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam
jahāra lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīmānnairṛtasya mahābalaḥ

translations.english: The mighty and graceful Lakşmaņa with a shafts cut off the head of the Nairta's charioteer, illumined with ear-rings.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य बाणैश्च चिच्छेद धनुर्गजकरोपमम्
लक्ष्मणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः
verses.transliteration:
tasya bāṇaiśca ciccheda dhanurgajakaropamam
lakṣmaṇo rākṣasendrasya pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

translations.english: Then with five sharpened arrows Lakşmaņa severed the bow the bow of the Räkşasa-chief, resembling the trunk of an elephant.

verses.sanskrit:
नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्य सदश्वान्पर्वतोपमान्
जघानाप्लुत्य गदया रावणस्य विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
nīlameghanibhāṁścāsya sadaśvānparvatopamān
jaghānāplutya gadayā rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Vibhīşaņa, bounding up, with his mace despatched Ravana's excellent steeds, resembling hills or dark-blue clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
हताश्वाद्वेगवान्वेगादवप्लुत्य महारथात्
क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं भ्रातरं प्रति रावणः
verses.transliteration:
hatāśvādvegavānvegādavaplutya mahārathāt
krodhamāhārayattīvraṁ bhrātaraṁ prati rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: Thereat leaping down from his mighty car, whose horses had been slain, Råvana was fired with high wrath against his brother.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिर्दीप्तां दीप्ताशनीमिव
विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śaktiṁ mahāśaktirdīptāṁ dīptāśanīmiva
vibhīṣaṇāya cikṣepa rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān

translations.english: The powerful lord of Raksasas endowed with immense strength, hurled at Vibhīşaņa a dart resembling the flaming thunder-bolt.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्राप्तामेव तां बाणैस्त्रिभिश्चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः
अथोदतिष्ठत्संनादो वानराणां तदा रणे
verses.transliteration:
aprāptāmeva tāṁ bāṇaistribhiściccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ
athodatiṣṭhatsaṁnādo vānarāṇāṁ tadā raṇe

translations.english: Ere the dart had reached its destination, Laks mana severed it with three shafts; and thereat in that mighty conflict there arose a mighty uproar from the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
सा पपात त्रिधा छिन्ना शक्तिः काञ्चनमालिनी
सविस्फुलिङ्गा ज्वलिता महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता
verses.transliteration:
sā papāta tridhā chinnā śaktiḥ kāñcanamālinī
savisphuliṅgā jvalitā maholkeva divaścyutā

translations.english: The dart dight with networks of gold fell down in three fragments, as dropped a mighty meteor from the firmament, flaming and shooting out scintillations.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संभाविततरां कालेनापि दुरासदाम्
जग्राह विपुलां शक्तिं दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁbhāvitatarāṁ kālenāpi durāsadām
jagrāha vipulāṁ śaktiṁ dīpyamānāṁ svatejasā

translations.english: Then (Ravana) took up a huge dart, glowing in its own energy, celebrated as being irresistible, and incapable of being borne by the Destroyer himself.

verses.sanskrit:
सा वेगिना बलवता रावणेन दुरात्मना
जज्वाल सुमहाघोरा शक्राशनिसमप्रभा
verses.transliteration:
sā veginā balavatā rāvaṇena durātmanā
jajvāla sumahāghorā śakrāśanisamaprabhā

translations.english: On being whirled by the impious and strong Rāvana, the dart possessed of exceeding energy, flamed up

verses.sanskrit:
कीर्यमाणः शरौघेण विसृष्टेन महात्मना
न प्रहर्तुं मनश्चक्रे विमुखीकृतविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
kīryamāṇaḥ śaraugheṇa visṛṣṭena mahātmanā
na prahartuṁ manaścakre vimukhīkṛtavikramaḥ

translations.english: In the mean while the heroic Lakşmaņa swiftly come to the side of Vibhīsaņa, * whose life was placed in peril. And in order to save him that hero-Lakşmaņa drawing his bow, covered the dart, handed Rāvana with showers of shafts. On being covered with arrows shot by that high souled one, Rāvaņa with his prowess baffled, make up his mind to let (his brother) go. *The commentator explains; Himself coming before the dart Lakşmaņa saved Vibhîşaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
मोक्षितं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणेन स रावणः
लक्ष्मणाभिमुखस्तिष्ठन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
mokṣitaṁ bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇena sa rāvaṇaḥ
lakṣmaṇābhimukhastiṣṭhannidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Seeing his brother delivered by Lakşmana, Ravana, facing Laksmana spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit:
मोक्षितस्ते बलश्लाघिन्यस्मादेवं विभीषणः
विमुच्य राक्षसं शक्तिस्त्वयीयं विनिपात्यते
verses.transliteration:
mokṣitaste balaślāghinyasmādevaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
vimucya rākṣasaṁ śaktistvayīyaṁ vinipātyate

translations.english: O you proud of your prowess! as Vibhīşana has this wise been delivered by you, passing by the Raksasa, this dart, discharged from my bludgeon of an arms, will depart depriving you of your life.

verses.sanskrit:
तामनुव्याहरच्छक्तिमापतन्तीं स राघवः
स्वस्त्यस्तु लक्ष्मणायेति मोघा भव हतोद्यमा
verses.transliteration:
tāmanuvyāharacchaktimāpatantīṁ sa rāghavaḥ
svastyastu lakṣmaṇāyeti moghā bhava hatodyamā

translations.english: Thereat as the dart descended, Raghava addressed it, saying-peace be to Laksmana! Be you frustrated; and let your energy go out of you. *i.e. as Rāmānuja remarks, addressed the deity presiding over it.

verses.sanskrit:
न्यपतत्सा महावेगा लक्ष्मणस्य महोरसि
जिह्वेवोरगराजस्य दीप्यमाना महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
nyapatatsā mahāvegā lakṣmaṇasya mahorasi
jihvevoragarājasya dīpyamānā mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: But the dart discharged in the encounter by the enraged Rāvana, resembling a venomous serpent, dived into the dauntless and heroic Laks maņa; and (the dart) exceedingly splendid and blazing, possessed of dreadful impetuosity and resembling the tongue of the king of serpents, smote Lakşmaņa in his mighty chest. And with his breast riven by the dart driving deep through the force of Rāvana, Lakşmaņa fell down to the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तदवस्थं समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः
भ्रातृस्नेहान्महातेजा विषण्णहृदयोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
tadavasthaṁ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaṁ prekṣya rāghavaḥ
bhrātṛsnehānmahātejā viṣaṇṇahṛdayo'bhavat

translations.english: Rāghava, standing by seeing Lakşmaņa in that plight, had his heart overspread with sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
स मुहूर्तमनुध्याय बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः
बभूव संरब्धतरो युगान्त इव पावकः
verses.transliteration:
sa muhūrtamanudhyāya bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ
babhūva saṁrabdhataro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ

translations.english: But reflecting only for a while, he with his eyes surcharged with tears was filled with greater martial ardour, and resembled the fire risen at the universal dissolution. Then thinking.

verses.sanskrit:
न विषादस्य कालोऽयमिति संचिन्त्य राघवः
चक्रे सुतुमुलं युद्धं रावणस्य वधे धृतः
verses.transliteration:
na viṣādasya kālo'yamiti saṁcintya rāghavaḥ
cakre sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ rāvaṇasya vadhe dhṛtaḥ

translations.english: This is not the time to indulge in grief he, gazing at Lakşmaņa, entered into a terrific encounter resolved upon slaying Rāvaņa, laying under contribution his dearest energies.

verses.sanskrit:
स ददर्श ततो रामः शक्त्या भिन्नं महाहवे
लक्ष्मणं रुधिरादिग्धं सपन्नगमिवाचलम्
verses.transliteration:
sa dadarśa tato rāmaḥ śaktyā bhinnaṁ mahāhave
lakṣmaṇaṁ rudhirādigdhaṁ sapannagamivācalam

translations.english: Rāma saw Lakşmaņa with his chest riven by the dart in the mighty conflict lying drenched in blood, and resembling a hill with serpents present in it.

verses.sanskrit:
तामपि प्रहितां शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा
यत्नतस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम्
अर्दिताश्चैव बाणौघैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा
verses.transliteration:
tāmapi prahitāṁ śaktiṁ rāvaṇena balīyasā
yatnataste hariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum
arditāścaiva bāṇaughaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā

translations.english: In spite of all their efforts, the foremost monkeys failed to extract the dart which had been hurled by the powerful Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
सौमित्रिं सा विनिर्भिद्य प्रविष्टा धरणीतलम्
तां कराभ्यां परामृश्य रामः शक्तिं भयावहाम्
बभञ्ज समरे क्रुद्धो बलवद्विचकर्ष च
verses.transliteration:
saumitriṁ sā vinirbhidya praviṣṭā dharaṇītalam
tāṁ karābhyāṁ parāmṛśya rāmaḥ śaktiṁ bhayāvahām
babhañja samare kruddho balavadvicakarṣa ca

translations.english: In the encounter the mighty Rāma grasping the dreadful dart with his hands, extracted the same the wrathfully snapped it* *The commentator has a characteristic note. This dart, having pierced the foe, used always to return to Ravana. But Rama, whose was the Lord himself, having spoken to it as he did, it could not this time go back; and Rāma snapped it, which none else could do.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य निष्कर्षतः शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा
शराः सर्वेषु गात्रेषु पातिता मर्मभेदिनः
verses.transliteration:
tasya niṣkarṣataḥ śaktiṁ rāvaṇena balīyasā
śarāḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu pātitā marmabhedinaḥ

translations.english: As he (Rāma) was engaged in pulling the dart out, the mighty Ravana kept pouring marrowpiercing shafts all over his person.

verses.sanskrit:
अचिन्तयित्वा तान्बाणान्समाश्लिष्य च लक्ष्मणम्
अब्रवीच्च हनूमन्तं सुग्रीवं चैव राघवः
लक्ष्मणं परिवार्येह तिष्ठध्वं वानरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration:
acintayitvā tānbāṇānsamāśliṣya ca lakṣmaṇam
abravīcca hanūmantaṁ sugrīvaṁ caiva rāghavaḥ
lakṣmaṇaṁ parivāryeha tiṣṭhadhvaṁ vānarottamāḥ

translations.english: Thinking nothing of those arrows. Rāma embracing Lakşmaņa, spoke to Hanuman and the mighty monkey, Sugriva.

verses.sanskrit:
पराक्रमस्य कालोऽयं संप्राप्तो मे चिरेप्सितः
पापात्मायं दशग्रीवो वध्यतां पापनिश्चयः
काङ्क्षितः स्तोककस्येव घर्मान्ते मेघदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
parākramasya kālo'yaṁ saṁprāpto me cirepsitaḥ
pāpātmāyaṁ daśagrīvo vadhyatāṁ pāpaniścayaḥ
kāṅkṣitaḥ stokakasyeva gharmānte meghadarśanam

translations.english: I shall slay this wicked minded Ten-necked one, who is resolved to pursue the course of unrighteousness. Even as on the expire of summer the Cătaka is eager for the sight of clouds, I had long been eager to obtain a sight of (Ravana).

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते नचिरात्सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि वः
अरावणमरामं वा जगद्द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः
verses.transliteration:
asminmuhūrte nacirātsatyaṁ pratiśṛṇomi vaḥ
arāvaṇamarāmaṁ vā jagaddrakṣyatha vānarāḥ

translations.english: You monkeys, this I swear to you-this very hour not long after you will see this world without Rāvaņa or Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
राज्यनाशं वने वासं दण्डके परिधावनम्
वैदेह्याश्च परामर्शं रक्षोभिश्च समागमम्
verses.transliteration:
rājyanāśaṁ vane vāsaṁ daṇḍake paridhāvanam
vaidehyāśca parāmarśaṁ rakṣobhiśca samāgamam

translations.english: To-day having slain Rāvaņa in battle, I shall renounce all sorrow arising from the loss of my kingdom, from my sojourn in the woods, from my wandering in Daņdaka, from the ravishment of Vaidehi, from encounter with the Raksasa, all the terrible evils that I have suffered and all the troubles resembling hell.

verses.sanskrit:
यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया
सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे
verses.transliteration:
yadarthaṁ vānaraṁ sainyaṁ samānītamidaṁ mayā
sugrīvaśca kṛto rājye nihatvā vālinaṁ raṇe

translations.english: He for whom I have brought over the monkey-forces, made Sugriva king, slaying Vali in battle, for whom I have crossed the ocean and constructed a bridge over the deep-the same has been come at by me in conflict, and the same has come within the range of my vision.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्थाः पश्यत दुर्धर्षा युद्धं वानरपुंगवाः
आसीनाः पर्वताग्रेषु ममेदं रावणस्य च
verses.transliteration:
svasthāḥ paśyata durdharṣā yuddhaṁ vānarapuṁgavāḥ
āsīnāḥ parvatāgreṣu mamedaṁ rāvaṇasya ca

translations.english: Do you, you irrepressible ones, you foremost of monkeys, seated at the brow of the mountain, behold the battle between me and Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य रामस्य रामत्वं पश्यन्तु मम संयुगे
त्रयो लोकाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवाः सर्षिचारणाः
verses.transliteration:
adya rāmasya rāmatvaṁ paśyantu mama saṁyuge
trayo lokāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāḥ sarṣicāraṇāḥ

translations.english: Today let the three worlds with the Gandharvas, and the Siddhas, and the Caranas, see that for which Rāma is Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य कर्म करिष्यामि यल्लोकाः सचराचराः
सदेवाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
adya karma kariṣyāmi yallokāḥ sacarācarāḥ
sadevāḥ kathayiṣyanti yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati

translations.english: Today I shall do a deed of which the worlds with the mobile and the immobile and the gods, shall speak as long as the Earth sustain (creatures.)

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः
आजघान दशग्रीवं रणे रामः समाहितः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā śitairbāṇaistaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ
ājaghāna daśagrīvaṁ raṇe rāmaḥ samāhitaḥ

translations.english: Having delivered himself thus, Rama, concentrating his attention, began to charge the Ten-necked one in encounter with whetted arrows decked with burnished gold.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ प्रदीप्तैर्नाराचैर्मुसलैश्चापि रावणः
अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं धाराभिरिव तोयदः
verses.transliteration:
atha pradīptairnārācairmusalaiścāpi rāvaṇaḥ
abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ dhārābhiriva toyadaḥ

translations.english: In the same way Rāvana showered on Rama great Nárācas and clubs, even as clouds pour down showers.

verses.sanskrit:
रामरावणमुक्तानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम्
शराणां च शराणां च बभूव तुमुलः स्वनः
verses.transliteration:
rāmarāvaṇamuktānāmanyonyamabhinighnatām
śarāṇāṁ ca śarāṇāṁ ca babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ

translations.english: There arose a tremendous uproar of mighty arrows discharged by Rama and Ravana, smiting one another.

verses.sanskrit:
ते भिन्नाश्च विकीर्णाश्च रामरावणयोः शराः
अन्तरिक्षात्प्रदीप्ताग्रा निपेतुर्धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
te bhinnāśca vikīrṇāśca rāmarāvaṇayoḥ śarāḥ
antarikṣātpradīptāgrā nipeturdharaṇītale

translations.english: The shafts shot by Rama and Rāvana, severed and scattered, with flaming heads dropped to the Earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तयोर्ज्यातलनिर्घोषो रामरावणयोर्महान्
त्रासनः सर्वबूतानां स बभूवाद्भुतोपमः
verses.transliteration:
tayorjyātalanirghoṣo rāmarāvaṇayormahān
trāsanaḥ sarvabūtānāṁ sa babhūvādbhutopamaḥ

translations.english: The mighty twangs of the bow strings of both, terrifying all creatures, were wonderful to behold.* *Adbhutadarśana-wonderful to behold, wonderful to witness is the sense.

verses.sanskrit:
स कीर्यमाणः शरजालवृष्टिभि;र्महात्मना दीप्तधनुष्मतार्दितः
भयात्प्रदुद्राव समेत्य रावणो; यथानिलेनाभिहतो बलाहकः
verses.transliteration:
sa kīryamāṇaḥ śarajālavṛṣṭibhi;rmahātmanā dīptadhanuṣmatārditaḥ
bhayātpradudrāva sametya rāvaṇo; yathānilenābhihato balāhakaḥ

translations.english: Then even as clouds disperse on being trampled by the Winds, Ravana, covered with showers of arrowy networks by that high souled one and reduced to sore straits by that one (Rāma) of a glowing bow, fled away in fear.

verses.sanskrit:
स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्धं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
विसृजन्नेव बाणौघान्सुषेणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa dattvā tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
visṛjanneva bāṇaughānsuṣeṇaṁ vākyamabravīt

translations.english: Seeing the heroic Lakşmaņa brought down by the dart discharged by the powerful Rāvana and lying drenched in blood, he (Rama) after having fought furiously with the wicked-minded Ravana-and having showered vollies of shafts, addressed Susena, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
एष रावणवेगेन लक्ष्मणः पतितः क्षितौ
सर्पवद्वेष्टते वीरो मम शोकमुदीरयन्
verses.transliteration:
eṣa rāvaṇavegena lakṣmaṇaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau
sarpavadveṣṭate vīro mama śokamudīrayan

translations.english: This heroic Lakşmaņa brought down to the earth by the prowess of Rāvana, Leith like a serpent, enhancing my sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
शोणितार्द्रमिमं वीरं प्राणैरिष्टतरं मम
पश्यतो मम का शक्तिर्योद्धुं पर्याकुलात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
śoṇitārdramimaṁ vīraṁ prāṇairiṣṭataraṁ mama
paśyato mama kā śaktiryoddhuṁ paryākulātmanaḥ

translations.english: Seeing this hero dearer to me that life, what power have I, with my soul overwhelmed with dole, to fight?

verses.sanskrit:
अयं स समरश्लाघी भ्राता मे शुभलक्षणः
यदि पञ्चत्वमापन्नः प्राणैर्मे किं सुखेन वा
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ sa samaraślāghī bhrātā me śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
yadi pañcatvamāpannaḥ prāṇairme kiṁ sukhena vā

translations.english: If this brother of mine graced with auspicious marks, delighting in battle, breathe his last, what shall life avail me or happiness?

verses.sanskrit:
लज्जतीव हि मे वीर्यं भ्रश्यतीव कराद्धनुः
सायका व्यवसीदन्ति दृष्टिर्बाष्पवशं गता
चिन्ता मे वर्धते तीव्रा मुमूर्षा चोपजायते
verses.transliteration:
lajjatīva hi me vīryaṁ bhraśyatīva karāddhanuḥ
sāyakā vyavasīdanti dṛṣṭirbāṣpavaśaṁ gatā
cintā me vardhate tīvrā mumūrṣā copajāyate

translations.english: My prowess is ashamed; my bow fall off from my hand; my arrows droop; my sight is dimmed with tears; my limbs weaken as do those of men in a dream; thought racks me; and I even desire death.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन दुरात्मना
परं विषादमापन्नो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
bhrātaraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena durātmanā
paraṁ viṣādamāpanno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ

translations.english: Seeming his brother wounded by the wickedminded Rāvana, crying in preternatural accents and sore stricken in his vitals, (Rāma) overcome by a mighty sorrow, lamented with his senses wildered.

verses.sanskrit:
किं मे राज्येन किं प्राणैर्युद्धे कार्यं न विद्यते
यत्रायं निहतः शेते रणमूर्धनि लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ me rājyena kiṁ prāṇairyuddhe kāryaṁ na vidyate
yatrāyaṁ nihataḥ śete raṇamūrdhani lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: What have I to do with battle? What have I to do with life? I have no more to do anything with fighting, seeing that this Laksmana wounded, Leith in the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
न चास्य विकृतं वक्त्रं नापि श्यामं न निष्प्रभम्
सुप्रभं च प्रसन्नं च मुखमस्याभिलक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration:
na cāsya vikṛtaṁ vaktraṁ nāpi śyāmaṁ na niṣprabham
suprabhaṁ ca prasannaṁ ca mukhamasyābhilakṣyate

translations.english: Lakşmaņa enhancer of auspiciousness is not dead. His face is not distorted or blackened. Do you look at his countenance, which is beautifully bright and cheerful.

verses.sanskrit:
पद्मरक्ततलौ हस्तौ सुप्रसन्ने च लोचने
एवं न विद्यते रूपं गतासूनां विशां पते
मां विषादं कृथा वीर सप्राणोऽयमरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
padmaraktatalau hastau suprasanne ca locane
evaṁ na vidyate rūpaṁ gatāsūnāṁ viśāṁ pate
māṁ viṣādaṁ kṛthā vīra saprāṇo'yamariṁdama

translations.english: His hands have palms resembling lotus-petals, and his eyes are pleasant. O king, one dead does not look thus.

verses.sanskrit:
आख्यास्यते प्रसुप्तस्य स्रस्तगात्रस्य भूतले
सोच्छ्वासं हृदयं वीर कम्पमानं मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration:
ākhyāsyate prasuptasya srastagātrasya bhūtale
socchvāsaṁ hṛdayaṁ vīra kampamānaṁ muhurmuhuḥ

translations.english: (Therefore,) O hero, do not grieve. O subduer of enemies this one is instinct with life. As he is lying down on the ground, stretched at length, his respiration.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वाक्यज्ञः सुषेणो राघवं वचः
समीपस्थमुवाचेदं हनूमन्तमभित्वरन्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu vākyajñaḥ suṣeṇo rāghavaṁ vacaḥ
samīpasthamuvācedaṁ hanūmantamabhitvaran

translations.english: Having spoken thus to Răghava, the highly wise Suşeņa thus addressed the mighty monkeys, Hanumān, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सौवर्णकरणीं चापि तथा संजीवनीमपि
संधानकरणीं चापि गत्वा शीघ्रमिहानय
संजीवनार्थं वीरस्य लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
sauvarṇakaraṇīṁ cāpi tathā saṁjīvanīmapi
saṁdhānakaraṇīṁ cāpi gatvā śīghramihānaya
saṁjīvanārthaṁ vīrasya lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: O placid one hieing hence to the mountain, Mahodaya, which, O hero had formerly been mentioned to you by Jāmbavan bring hither the mighty drug sprung at it right summitVisalyakarani by name, and Savarnyakarani.* and Sañjīvakaraņi O hero, and the potent medicine-Sandhāni. Do you bring (these) in order that the hero-Laksmana-May be revived. *Lit.-that which restores the former complexion.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवमुक्तो हनुमान्गत्वा चौषधिपर्वतम्
चिन्तामभ्यगमच्छ्रीमानजानंस्ता महौषधीः
verses.transliteration:
ityevamukto hanumāngatvā cauṣadhiparvatam
cintāmabhyagamacchrīmānajānaṁstā mahauṣadhīḥ

translations.english: Having been thus in strutted, Hanuman, repairing to the medicinal mountain, was wrought up with anxiety not knowing the drugs.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना मारुतेरमितौजसः
इदमेव गमिष्यामि गृहीत्वा शिखरं गिरेः
verses.transliteration:
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā māruteramitaujasaḥ
idameva gamiṣyāmi gṛhītvā śikharaṁ gireḥ

translations.english: Then the thought sprang up in the mind of the Wind-god's offspring of immeasurabie prowess, I shall go, even taking this (entire) summit of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
अगृह्य यदि गच्छामि विशल्यकरणीमहम्
कालात्ययेन दोषः स्याद्वैक्लव्यं च महद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
agṛhya yadi gacchāmi viśalyakaraṇīmaham
kālātyayena doṣaḥ syādvaiklavyaṁ ca mahadbhavet

translations.english: If I fail to take Visalyakaraṇī, I shall come by disgrace, and if I spend much time (in thought), that would be fraught with evil.)* *Explains the commentator: 'If I take any other medicine by mistake, I shall make a fool of myself; if I spend much time in though, Laksmana may die.

verses.sanskrit:
इति संचिन्त्य हनुमान्गत्वा क्षिप्रं महाबलः
उत्पपात गृहीत्वा तु हनूमाञ्शिखरं गिरेः
verses.transliteration:
iti saṁcintya hanumāngatvā kṣipraṁ mahābalaḥ
utpapāta gṛhītvā tu hanūmāñśikharaṁ gireḥ

translations.english: And taking that summit of the mountain resembling dark-blue clouds charged with rain, Hanumān from the earth bounded up in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
ओषधीर्नावगछामि ता अहं हरिपुंगव
तदिदं शिखरं कृत्स्नं गिरेस्तस्याहृतं मया
verses.transliteration:
oṣadhīrnāvagachāmi tā ahaṁ haripuṁgava
tadidaṁ śikharaṁ kṛtsnaṁ girestasyāhṛtaṁ mayā

translations.english: I did not find the drug, O best of monkeys; and therefore have I brought this entire summit of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं कथयमानं तं प्रशस्य पवनात्मजम्
सुषेणो वानरश्रेष्ठो जग्राहोत्पाट्य चौषधीः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ kathayamānaṁ taṁ praśasya pavanātmajam
suṣeṇo vānaraśreṣṭho jagrāhotpāṭya cauṣadhīḥ

translations.english: When the Wind-god's offspring had spoken thus, that foremost of monkeys-Susena-praising him uprooted the herb and secured it.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संक्षोदयित्वा तामोषधिं वानरोत्तमः
लक्ष्मणस्य ददौ नस्तः सुषेणः सुमहाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁkṣodayitvā tāmoṣadhiṁ vānarottamaḥ
lakṣmaṇasya dadau nastaḥ suṣeṇaḥ sumahādyutiḥ

translations.english: Then crushing the healing herb, that best of monkeys-the exceedingly effulgent Sușeņa, made Laksmana smell the same.

verses.sanskrit:
सशल्यः स समाघ्राय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
विशल्यो विरुजः शीघ्रमुदतिष्ठन्महीतलात्
verses.transliteration:
saśalyaḥ sa samāghrāya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
viśalyo virujaḥ śīghramudatiṣṭhanmahītalāt

translations.english: Thereupon the wounded Lakşmana, slayer of hostile heroes-smelling it, curd of his wound and ailments, speedily rose up from the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
समुत्थितं ते हरयो भूतलात्प्रेक्ष्य लक्ष्मणम्
साधु साध्विति सुप्रीताः सुषेणं प्रत्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
samutthitaṁ te harayo bhūtalātprekṣya lakṣmaṇam
sādhu sādhviti suprītāḥ suṣeṇaṁ pratyapūjayan

translations.english: Seeing Lakşmaņa rise up from the earth, the monkeys, exceedingly rejoiced, honouring Laks mana, exclaimed, “Excellent! Excellent!"

verses.sanskrit:
एह्येहीत्यब्रवीद्रामो लक्ष्मणं परवीरहा
सस्वजे स्नेहगाढं च बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः
verses.transliteration:
ehyehītyabravīdrāmo lakṣmaṇaṁ paravīrahā
sasvaje snehagāḍhaṁ ca bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: “Come!” said that slayer of hostile heroesRāma and with his eyes filled with tears, he deeply embraced Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च परिष्वज्य सौमित्रिं राघवस्तदा
दिष्ट्या त्वां वीर पश्यामि मरणात्पुनरागतम्
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca pariṣvajya saumitriṁ rāghavastadā
diṣṭyā tvāṁ vīra paśyāmi maraṇātpunarāgatam

translations.english: Having embraced Sumitra's son, Raghava then addressed him saying, “By good fortune it is that, O hero, I see you returned from (the mansion of ) Death.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मे जीवितेनार्थः सीतया च जयेन वा
को हि मे जीवितेनार्थस्त्वयि पञ्चत्वमागते
verses.transliteration:
na hi me jīvitenārthaḥ sītayā ca jayena vā
ko hi me jīvitenārthastvayi pañcatvamāgate

translations.english: Verily my life, or Sită, or Victory is worthless (without you). And you being dead what is my life worth?

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं वदतस्तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः
खिन्नः शिथिलया वाचा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ vadatastasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
khinnaḥ śithilayā vācā lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt

translations.english: When the high-souled Raghava had spoken thus, Lakşmaņa, aggrieved on account of the words (of Rāghava) expressive of infirmity of purpose, said.

verses.sanskrit:
तां प्रतिज्ञां प्रतिज्ञाय पुरा सत्यपराक्रम
लघुः कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो नैवं वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ pratijñāṁ pratijñāya purā satyaparākrama
laghuḥ kaścidivāsattvo naivaṁ vaktumihārhasi

translations.english: Having bound yourself by that vow, it does not, O you having truth for prowess, behove you to speak like one fickle and feeble.

verses.sanskrit:
नैराश्यमुपगन्तुं ते तदलं मत्कृतेऽनघ
वधेन रावणस्याद्य प्रतिज्ञामनुपालय
verses.transliteration:
nairāśyamupagantuṁ te tadalaṁ matkṛte'nagha
vadhena rāvaṇasyādya pratijñāmanupālaya

translations.english: Those speaking the truth, never falsify their promise: the mark of a great one is even observance of vow. O sinless one, do not suffer yourself to be overcome by despair on my account. Do you today by slaying Rāvaņa, make your promise good.

verses.sanskrit:
न जीवन्यास्यते शत्रुस्तव बाणपथं गतः
नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य सिंहस्येव महागजः
verses.transliteration:
na jīvanyāsyate śatrustava bāṇapathaṁ gataḥ
nardatastīkṣṇadaṁṣṭrasya siṁhasyeva mahāgajaḥ

translations.english: Your foe coming within the sway of your shafts will not hence, living, even like a mighty elephant coming before a sharp-toothed roaring lion.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं तु वधमिच्छामि शीघ्रमस्य दुरात्मनः
यावदस्तं न यात्येष कृतकर्मा दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ tu vadhamicchāmi śīghramasya durātmanaḥ
yāvadastaṁ na yātyeṣa kṛtakarmā divākaraḥ

translations.english: I wish the speedy destruction of this impious one, ere the maker of day, having performed his work, has ascended the Setting-hill.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेन तु तद्वाक्यमुक्तं श्रुत्वा स राघवः
रावणाय शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇena tu tadvākyamuktaṁ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ
rāvaṇāya śarānghorānvisasarja camūmukhe

translations.english: Hearing the words uttered by Lakşmaņa, that slayer of hostile heroes-Raghava-endued with prowess, taking his bow, set shafts on it, and in the brunt of battle began to discharge dreadful arrows at Ravana. And mounted on another car, Rāvana-lord of Rakşasas-rushed against Käkutstha, even as Svarbhānu rush against the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
दशग्रीवो रथस्थस्तु रामं वज्रोपमैः शरैः
आजघान महाघोरैर्धाराभिरिव तोयदः
verses.transliteration:
daśagrīvo rathasthastu rāmaṁ vajropamaiḥ śaraiḥ
ājaghāna mahāghorairdhārābhiriva toyadaḥ

translations.english: Even as a mass of clouds poured down torrents on a mighty mountain, the Ten-necked one, mounted on his car, smote Rāma with shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

verses.sanskrit:
दीप्तपावकसंकाशैः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः
निर्बिभेद रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितः
verses.transliteration:
dīptapāvakasaṁkāśaiḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ
nirbibheda raṇe rāmo daśagrīvaṁ samāhitaḥ

translations.english: In the encounter Rāma, concentrating his thoughts, showered on the Ten-necked one arrows embellished with gold and looking like living fire.

verses.sanskrit:
भूमिस्थितस्य रामस्य रथस्थस्य च रक्षसः
न समं युद्धमित्याहुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः
verses.transliteration:
bhūmisthitasya rāmasya rathasthasya ca rakṣasaḥ
na samaṁ yuddhamityāhurdevagandharvadānavāḥ

translations.english: And celestials and Gandharvas and Kinnaras declared that there had been no other battle like to the encounter of Rāma stationed on the ground and the Rākṣasa mounted on his car.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं सप्रतोदो रथे स्थितः
प्राञ्जलिर्मातलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिः
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca tadā rāmaṁ sapratodo rathe sthitaḥ
prāñjalirmātalirvākyaṁ sahasrākṣasya sārathiḥ

translations.english: With his hand holding the reins, the charioteer car, of the thousand-eyed (Deity) with joined hands addressed Rāma: saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्राक्षेण काकुत्स्थ रथोऽयं विजयाय ते
दत्तस्तव महासत्त्व श्रीमाञ्शत्रुनिबर्हणः
verses.transliteration:
sahasrākṣeṇa kākutstha ratho'yaṁ vijayāya te
dattastava mahāsattva śrīmāñśatrunibarhaṇaḥ

translations.english: O Kākutstha, in order that you may obtain the victory, the thousand-eyed (god) has sent you his car. O exceedingly powerful one! O graceful (hero)! O you that slays your foes! this is the redoubtable bow of Indra, and this is the mail resembling fire, and these are the arrows looking like the very Sun; and this is the dart shining and fraught with fair fortune.

verses.sanskrit:
आरुह्येमं रथं वीर राक्षसं जहि रावणम्
मया सारथिना राम महेन्द्र इव दानवान्
verses.transliteration:
āruhyemaṁ rathaṁ vīra rākṣasaṁ jahi rāvaṇam
mayā sārathinā rāma mahendra iva dānavān

translations.english: Ascend you this O hero Slay the RākşasaRāvaņa, with me as your charioteer, even as the lord of the celestials slay Dānavas.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तः स परिक्रम्य रथं तमभिवाद्य च
आरुरोह तदा रामो लोकाँल्लक्ष्म्या विराजयन्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktaḥ sa parikramya rathaṁ tamabhivādya ca
āruroha tadā rāmo lokā̐llakṣmyā virājayan

translations.english: Thus addressed, Rāma, going round the car and saluting it, ascended the same, illumining the worlds with his splendour.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं द्वैरथं लोमहर्षणम्
रामस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च रक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
tadbabhūvādbhutaṁ yuddhaṁ dvairathaṁ lomaharṣaṇam
rāmasya ca mahābāho rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ

translations.english: The encounter that took place between the two cars with the mighty-armed Rāma (on one side) and the Rākşasa-Rāvana (on the other) was wonderful to behold.

verses.sanskrit:
स गान्धर्वेण गान्धर्वं दैवं दैवेन राघवः
अस्त्रं राक्षसराजस्य जघान परमास्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration:
sa gāndharveṇa gāndharvaṁ daivaṁ daivena rāghavaḥ
astraṁ rākṣasarājasya jaghāna paramāstravit

translations.english: Rāghava highly proficient in weapons with a Gândharva weapon resisted the Gandharva weapons of the Rākşasa king and with a celestial weapon, his celestial weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्त्रं तु परमं घोरं राक्षसं राकसाधिपः
ससर्ज परमक्रुद्धः पुनरेव निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
astraṁ tu paramaṁ ghoraṁ rākṣasaṁ rākasādhipaḥ
sasarja paramakruddhaḥ punareva niśācaraḥ

translations.english: Then that lord of Raksasas-the night-rangerfired with high rage, again discharged an exceedingly dreadful Rākṣasa, weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
ते रावणधनुर्मुक्ताः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः
अभ्यवर्तन्त काकुत्स्थं सर्पा भूत्वा महाविषाः
verses.transliteration:
te rāvaṇadhanurmuktāḥ śarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ
abhyavartanta kākutsthaṁ sarpā bhūtvā mahāviṣāḥ

translations.english: The gold-decked shafts shot from Ravana's bow, becoming furiously venomous serpents covered Kakutstha.

verses.sanskrit:
ते दीप्तवदना दीप्तं वमन्तो ज्वलनं मुखैः
राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त व्यादितास्या भयानकाः
verses.transliteration:
te dīptavadanā dīptaṁ vamanto jvalanaṁ mukhaiḥ
rāmamevābhyavartanta vyāditāsyā bhayānakāḥ

translations.english: And vomiting living flames they of terrific aspect, having flaming faces, showered over Rāma with gaping mouths.

verses.sanskrit:
तैर्वासुकिसमस्पर्शैर्दीप्तभोगैर्महाविषैः
दिशश्च संतताः सर्वाः प्रदिशश्च समावृताः
verses.transliteration:
tairvāsukisamasparśairdīptabhogairmahāviṣaiḥ
diśaśca saṁtatāḥ sarvāḥ pradiśaśca samāvṛtāḥ

translations.english: Those flaming venomous serpents having the feel of Vāsuki himself, covered all sides and enveloped all quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्दृष्ट्वा पन्नगान्रामः समापतत आहवे
अस्त्रं गारुत्मतं घोरं प्रादुश्चक्रे भयावहम्
verses.transliteration:
tāndṛṣṭvā pannagānrāmaḥ samāpatata āhave
astraṁ gārutmataṁ ghoraṁ prāduścakre bhayāvaham

translations.english: Seeing those serpents descending in the encounter, Rāma employed a dreadful Garuda weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
ते राघवधनुर्मुक्ता रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिखिप्रभाः
सुपर्णाः काञ्चना भूत्वा विचेरुः सर्पशत्रवः
verses.transliteration:
te rāghavadhanurmuktā rukmapuṅkhāḥ śikhiprabhāḥ
suparṇāḥ kāñcanā bhūtvā viceruḥ sarpaśatravaḥ

translations.english: Discharged from Rāghava's bow, those arrows plated with gold at the feathered parts and furnished with the splendour of peacocks, becoming golden birds-began to range (the field of battle) as the enemies of the serpents.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तान्सर्वाञ्शराञ्जघ्नुः सर्परूपान्महाजवान्
सुपर्णरूपा रामस्य विशिखाः कामरूपिणः
verses.transliteration:
te tānsarvāñśarāñjaghnuḥ sarparūpānmahājavān
suparṇarūpā rāmasya viśikhāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ

translations.english: The shafts of Rāma capable of wearing forms at will, turned into birds, destroyed all the exceedingly swift coursing arrows having the forms of serpents.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्त्रे प्रतिहते क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं घोराभिः शरवृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration:
astre pratihate kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ ghorābhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ

translations.english: On his weapon having been baffle, Ravanalord of Rākşasas waxing wroth poured tremendous showers of shafts on Räma.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शरसहस्रेण राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्
अर्दयित्वा शरौघेण मातलिं प्रत्यविध्यत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa rāmamakliṣṭakāriṇam
ardayitvā śaraugheṇa mātaliṁ pratyavidhyata

translations.english: Smiting Rama of untiring deeds with thousands of shafts, (Ravana) pierced Matali with vollies of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
पातयित्वा रथोपस्थे रथात्केतुं च काञ्चनम्
ऐन्द्रानभिजघानाश्वाञ्शरजालेन रावणः
verses.transliteration:
pātayitvā rathopasthe rathātketuṁ ca kāñcanam
aindrānabhijaghānāśvāñśarajālena rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: And with an arrow, Rāvana severed the standard; and having brought down the golden standard on the floor of the car, Rāvaņa wounded even Indra's steeds with a net-work of arrows. were

verses.sanskrit:
विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वा दानवाश्चारणैः सह
राममार्तं तदा दृष्ट्वा सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration:
viṣedurdevagandharvā dānavāścāraṇaiḥ saha
rāmamārtaṁ tadā dṛṣṭvā siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ

translations.english: Seeing Rāma hard pressed, celestials and Gandharvas and Carañas along with Dänavas, and Sidhas, and the supreme saints were overcome with sadness; and the foremost monkeys together with Vibhīşaņa aggrieved.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राजापत्यं च नक्षत्रं रोहिणीं शशिनः प्रियाम्
समाक्रम्य बुधस्तस्थौ प्रजानामशुभावहः
verses.transliteration:
prājāpatyaṁ ca nakṣatraṁ rohiṇīṁ śaśinaḥ priyām
samākramya budhastasthau prajānāmaśubhāvahaḥ

translations.english: Seeing a moon of Rāmacandra in the grasp of a Rāhu of Rāvana that bringer of evil to creatures-Buddha-stood, assailing the Prājāpatya star-Rohini-beloved of the Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः प्रज्वलन्निव सागरः
उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धः स्पृशन्निव दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration:
sadhūmaparivṛttormiḥ prajvalanniva sāgaraḥ
utpapāta tadā kruddhaḥ spṛśanniva divākaram

translations.english: The enraged Ocean, heaving with smoking surges and flaming as it were swelled up seeming to the touch the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
शस्त्रवर्णः सुपरुषो मन्दरश्मिर्दिवाकरः
अदृश्यत कबन्धाङ्गः संसक्तो धूमकेतुना
verses.transliteration:
śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmirdivākaraḥ
adṛśyata kabandhāṅgaḥ saṁsakto dhūmaketunā

translations.english: The Sun was blackened and assumed a stern aspect, with his rays dimmed. And he was seen with a head-less trunk on his lap and he was in conjunction with a comet.

verses.sanskrit:
कोसलानां च नक्षत्रं व्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम्
आक्रम्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौ विशाखामपि चाम्बरे
verses.transliteration:
kosalānāṁ ca nakṣatraṁ vyaktamindrāgnidaivatam
ākramyāṅgārakastasthau viśākhāmapi cāmbare

translations.english: That star of the Kośalas, relating to the deities-Indra and Agni-Angaraka-stood in the sky, attacking Visakha.

verses.sanskrit:
दशास्यो विंशतिभुजः प्रगृहीतशरासनः
अदृश्यत दशग्रीवो मैनाक इव पर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
daśāsyo viṁśatibhujaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ
adṛśyata daśagrīvo maināka iva parvataḥ

translations.english: The Ten-necked one having ten faces and twenty arms, equipped with his bow, looked like the mountain-Mainaka.

verses.sanskrit:
निरस्यमानो रामस्तु दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा
नाशकदभिसंधातुं सायकान्रणमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration:
nirasyamāno rāmastu daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā
nāśakadabhisaṁdhātuṁ sāyakānraṇamūrdhani

translations.english: Rāma reduced to sore straits by the Tennecked Rākṣasa, could not discharge his arrows in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
स कृत्वा भ्रुकुटीं क्रुद्धः किंचित्संरक्तलोचनः
जगाम सुमहाक्रोधं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration:
sa kṛtvā bhrukuṭīṁ kruddhaḥ kiṁcitsaṁraktalocanaḥ
jagāma sumahākrodhaṁ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā

translations.english: Then the enraged Rāma with his eyes slightly red flew into a tremendous passion as if burning up the Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा रामस्य धीमतः
सर्वभूतानि वित्रेषुः प्राकम्पत च मेदिनी
verses.transliteration:
tasya kruddhasya vadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya dhīmataḥ
sarvabhūtāni vitreṣuḥ prākampata ca medinī

translations.english: Seeing the face of the enraged Rāma endued with under standing all the creatures were overwhelmed with fear and the Earth herself shook.

verses.sanskrit:
सिंहशार्दूलवाञ्शैलः संचचालाचलद्रुमः
बभूव चापि क्षुभितः समुद्रः सरितां पतिः
verses.transliteration:
siṁhaśārdūlavāñśailaḥ saṁcacālācaladrumaḥ
babhūva cāpi kṣubhitaḥ samudraḥ saritāṁ patiḥ

translations.english: And mountains abounding with lions and tigers began to tremble, and trees to shiver. And even the deep-lord of streams-was wrought up wondrously.

verses.sanskrit:
खगाश्च खरनिर्घोषा गगने परुषस्वनाः
औत्पातिका विनर्दन्तः समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः
verses.transliteration:
khagāśca kharanirghoṣā gagane paruṣasvanāḥ
autpātikā vinardantaḥ samantātparicakramuḥ

translations.english: And rough and terrific clouds in the sky sent forth fierce roars. And stormy clouds rumbling went about the heavens.

verses.sanskrit:
रामं दृष्ट्वा सुसंक्रुद्धमुत्पातांश्च सुदारुणान्
वित्रेषुः सर्वभूतानि रावणस्याविशद्भयम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmaṁ dṛṣṭvā susaṁkruddhamutpātāṁśca sudāruṇān
vitreṣuḥ sarvabhūtāni rāvaṇasyāviśadbhayam

translations.english: Seeing Rāma wrought up with a mighty passion, and the fearful disastrous omens, all creatures were possessed by fright and Rāvana was stuck with dismay.

verses.sanskrit:
विमानस्थास्तदा देवा गन्धर्वाश्च महोरगाः
ऋषिदानवदैत्याश्च गरुत्मन्तश्च खेचराः
verses.transliteration:
vimānasthāstadā devā gandharvāśca mahoragāḥ
ṛṣidānavadaityāśca garutmantaśca khecarāḥ

translations.english: Then stationed in the sky celestials and Gandharvas and mighty serpents and saints and Dānavas and Daityas and those related to Garuda-fowls-beheld that conflict like to the universal tumbling as the two heroes faught on with various dire arms.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊचुः सुरासुराः सर्वे तदा विग्रहमागताः
प्रेक्षमाणा महायुद्धं वाक्यं भक्त्या प्रहृष्टवत्
verses.transliteration:
ūcuḥ surāsurāḥ sarve tadā vigrahamāgatāḥ
prekṣamāṇā mahāyuddhaṁ vākyaṁ bhaktyā prahṛṣṭavat

translations.english: As they looked on the mighty encounter, the celestials and the Asuras, who had come to the conflict, from feeling of regard,* Cheerfully spoke (these words). *i.e. each party out of regard for the warrior to whom it wished well.

verses.sanskrit:
दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः
देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
daśagrīvaṁ jayetyāhurasurāḥ samavasthitāḥ
devā rāmamathocuste tvaṁ jayeti punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: The Asuras staying there said to the Tennecked one, Be victorious and the celestials again and again said to Rāma, 'Be victorious'!

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा
प्राकम्पयत्तदा शब्दो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दारुणः
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca diśaśca pradiśastathā
prākampayattadā śabdo rākṣasendrasya dāruṇaḥ

translations.english: And fired with furious wrath, that powerful one took the dart in the encounter, surrounded in that contest by many heroic Rākşasas. And uplifting (the dart), the huge-bodied Ravana, with his eyes reddened in passion, emitted mighty roars. And the shouts ofd the Rākşasa sovereign made the earth and the sky and the cardinal quarters and all sides tremble.

verses.sanskrit:
अतिनादस्य नादेन तेन तस्य दुरात्मनः
सर्वभूतानि वित्रेषुः सागरश्च प्रचुक्षुभे
verses.transliteration:
atinādasya nādena tena tasya durātmanaḥ
sarvabhūtāni vitreṣuḥ sāgaraśca pracukṣubhe

translations.english: And at the roars of that wicked-minded and huge-bodied one, all creatures were struck with terror, and the sea was vexed.* *The still-vexed Bermoothes.'-Tempest.

verses.sanskrit:
स गृहीत्वा महावीर्यः शूलं तद्रावणो महत्
विनद्य सुमहानादं रामं परुषमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa gṛhītvā mahāvīryaḥ śūlaṁ tadrāvaṇo mahat
vinadya sumahānādaṁ rāmaṁ paruṣamabravīt

translations.english: The exceedingly energetic Rävaņa, taking that mighty dart, and sending up furious shouts, addressed Rāma in a harsh speech, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
शूलोऽयं वज्रसारस्ते राम रोषान्मयोद्यतः
तव भ्रातृसहायस्य सद्यः प्राणान्हरिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
śūlo'yaṁ vajrasāraste rāma roṣānmayodyataḥ
tava bhrātṛsahāyasya sadyaḥ prāṇānhariṣyati

translations.english: O Rāma, I in wrath uplift this dart having the strength of the levin. This will utterly deprive of life you who are assisted by your brother.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षसामद्य शूराणां निहतानां चमूमुखे
त्वां निहत्य रणश्लाघिन्करोमि तरसा समम्
verses.transliteration:
rakṣasāmadya śūrāṇāṁ nihatānāṁ camūmukhe
tvāṁ nihatya raṇaślāghinkaromi tarasā samam

translations.english: O you, that delight in battle, today swiftly slaying you, I shall make you even with those heroic Rākşasa slain in the van of the forces.

verses.sanskrit:
तिष्ठेदानीं निहन्मि त्वामेष शूलेन राघव
एवमुक्त्वा स चिक्षेप तच्छूलं राक्षसाधिपः
verses.transliteration:
tiṣṭhedānīṁ nihanmi tvāmeṣa śūlena rāghava
evamuktvā sa cikṣepa tacchūlaṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ

translations.english: Stay now, O Raghava, you shall I slay with this dart. Saying this, the lord of the Rākşasas hurled the dart.

verses.sanskrit:
आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघवः
उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्निं जलौघैरिव वासवः
verses.transliteration:
āpatantaṁ śaraugheṇa vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
utpatantaṁ yugāntāgniṁ jalaughairiva vāsavaḥ

translations.english: And with vollies of shafts Räghava resisted the descending (dart), even as Vāsava extinguish the fire of doomsday with his showers.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्ददाह स तान्बाणान्रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान्
रावणस्य महाशूलः पतंगानिव पावकः
verses.transliteration:
nirdadāha sa tānbāṇānrāmakārmukaniḥsṛtān
rāvaṇasya mahāśūlaḥ pataṁgāniva pāvakaḥ

translations.english: Then even as a flame consume insects, the mighty dart of Rāvana burnt up those shafts shot from the bow of Råma.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्दृष्ट्वा भस्मसाद्भूताञ्शूलसंस्पर्शचूर्णितान्
सायकानन्तरिक्षस्थान्राघवः क्रोधमाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
tāndṛṣṭvā bhasmasādbhūtāñśūlasaṁsparśacūrṇitān
sāyakānantarikṣasthānrāghavaḥ krodhamāharat

translations.english: Seeing those shafts reduced to ashes and crushed on coming in contact with the dart, as they were coursing in the sky, Rāghava was transported with passion.

verses.sanskrit:
स तां मातलिनानीतां शक्तिं वासवनिर्मिताम्
जग्राह परमक्रुद्धो राघवो रघुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
sa tāṁ mātalinānītāṁ śaktiṁ vāsavanirmitām
jagrāha paramakruddho rāghavo raghunandanaḥ

translations.english: Then waxing wondrous wroth, Raghu's sonRāghava-took up a javelin, liked by Vāsava himself, brought by Matali.

verses.sanskrit:
सा तोलिता बलवता शक्तिर्घण्टाकृतस्वना
नभः प्रज्वालयामास युगान्तोल्केव सप्रभा
verses.transliteration:
sā tolitā balavatā śaktirghaṇṭākṛtasvanā
nabhaḥ prajvālayāmāsa yugāntolkeva saprabhā

translations.english: On being wielded by that strong one, the javelin, resonant with bells, made the welkin blaze up, like a burning meteor on the occasion of universal rack.

verses.sanskrit:
सा क्षिप्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तस्मिञ्शूले पपात ह
भिन्नः शक्त्या महाञ्शूलो निपपात गतद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
sā kṣiptā rākṣasendrasya tasmiñśūle papāta ha
bhinnaḥ śaktyā mahāñśūlo nipapāta gatadyutiḥ

translations.english: And when hurled, it alighted on that same dart of the Raksasa chief. And thereat, with its splendour lost, the mighty dart, riven, dropped (to the earth.)

verses.sanskrit:
निर्बिभेद ततो बाणैर्हयानस्य महाजवान्
रामस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्वज्रकल्पैः शितैः शरैः
verses.transliteration:
nirbibheda tato bāṇairhayānasya mahājavān
rāmastīkṣṇairmahāvegairvajrakalpaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
