translations.english: Then Rama, shooting straight-speeding arrows, pierced his (Ravana's) exceedingly fleet steeds.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्बिभेदोरसि तदा रावणं निशितैः शरैः
राघवः परमायत्तो ललाटे पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration:
nirbibhedorasi tadā rāvaṇaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
rāghavaḥ paramāyatto lalāṭe patribhistribhiḥ

translations.english: Then he pierced Rāvana in the chest with whetted arrows. And the energetic Rāghava hit (Rāvaņa) in the temples with three feathered shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
स शरैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो गात्रप्रस्रुतशोणितः
राक्षसेन्द्रः समूहस्थः फुल्लाशोक इवाबभौ
verses.transliteration:
sa śarairbhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ
rākṣasendraḥ samūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau

translations.english: Thereat with all his limbs pierced (with arrows), and his body laved in blood, the lord of Räkşasas furnished with many limbs, looked like a flowering Asoka.

verses.sanskrit:
स रामबाणैरतिविद्धगात्रो; निशाचरेन्द्रः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः
जगाम खेदं च समाजमध्ये; क्रोधं च चक्रे सुभृशं तदानीम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāmabāṇairatividdhagātro; niśācarendraḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ
jagāma khedaṁ ca samājamadhye; krodhaṁ ca cakre subhṛśaṁ tadānīm

translations.english: With his person pierced with the shafts of Rāma, the lord of night-rangers having his body drenched with blood, was stricken with sadness in the midst of his forces, and was also overwhelmed with terrific wrath.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु तेन तदा क्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनार्दितो रणे
रावणः समरश्लाघी महाक्रोधमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu tena tadā krodhātkākutsthenārdito raṇe
rāvaṇaḥ samaraślāghī mahākrodhamupāgamat

translations.english: On being greatly harassed by Käkutstha in anger, Ravana, delighting in battle, came under the sway of a towering passion.

verses.sanskrit:
स दीप्तनयनो रोषाच्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान्
अभ्यर्दयत्सुसंक्रुद्धो राघवं परमाहवे
verses.transliteration:
sa dīptanayano roṣāccāpamāyamya vīryavān
abhyardayatsusaṁkruddho rāghavaṁ paramāhave

translations.english: And with his eyes aglow, that powerful one from wrath and fury assailed Raghava in mighty encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
बाणधारासहस्रैस्तु स तोयद इवाम्बरात्
राघवं रावणो बाणैस्तटाकमिव पूरयत्
verses.transliteration:
bāṇadhārāsahasraistu sa toyada ivāmbarāt
rāghavaṁ rāvaṇo bāṇaistaṭākamiva pūrayat

translations.english: And even as clouds pour down from the sky on a pool, Råvaņa showered thousands of arrows of Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
पूरितः शरजालेन धनुर्मुक्तेन संयुगे
महागिरिरिवाकम्प्यः काकुस्थो न प्रकम्पते
verses.transliteration:
pūritaḥ śarajālena dhanurmuktena saṁyuge
mahāgiririvākampyaḥ kākustho na prakampate

translations.english: And covered with vollies of shafts discharged from (Ravana's) bow in the conflict, Kākutstha like to a mighty mountain did not shake.

verses.sanskrit:
स शरैः शरजालानि वारयन्समरे स्थितः
गभस्तीनिव सूर्यस्य प्रतिजग्राह वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
sa śaraiḥ śarajālāni vārayansamare sthitaḥ
gabhastīniva sūryasya pratijagrāha vīryavān

translations.english: That one endowed with prowess stood in the field, resisting those networks of arrows, and took up shafts resembling the rays of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शरसहस्राणि क्षिप्रहस्तो निशाचरः
निजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो राघवस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi kṣiprahasto niśācaraḥ
nijaghānorasi kruddho rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Then the fleet-handed night-ranger, fired with rage, discharged a thousand arrows at the chest of the high souled Raghava.

verses.sanskrit:
स शोणितसमादिग्धः समरे लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
दृष्टः फुल्ल इवारण्ये सुमहान्किंशुकद्रुमः
verses.transliteration:
sa śoṇitasamādigdhaḥ samare lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
dṛṣṭaḥ phulla ivāraṇye sumahānkiṁśukadrumaḥ

translations.english: Thereat in that encounter Lakşmaņa's elder brother, with his body bathed in blood, appeared like a mighty Kinśuka tree in a forest.

verses.sanskrit:
शराभिघातसंरब्धः सोऽपि जग्राह सायकान्
काकुत्स्थः सुमहातेजा युगान्तादित्यवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
śarābhighātasaṁrabdhaḥ so'pi jagrāha sāyakān
kākutsthaḥ sumahātejā yugāntādityavarcasaḥ

translations.english: With his ire aroused by the blows he received the exceedingly energetic Kākutstha took up arrows resembling the sur risen at the time of the universal dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽन्योन्यं सुसंरब्धावुभौ तौ रामरावणौ
शरान्धकारे समरे नोपालक्षयतां तदा
verses.transliteration:
tato'nyonyaṁ susaṁrabdhāvubhau tau rāmarāvaṇau
śarāndhakāre samare nopālakṣayatāṁ tadā

translations.english: In the darkness spread by the arrows (discharged), Rama and Ravana both fired with wrath could not be discovered of each other.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो रामो दशरथात्मजः
उवाच रावणं वीरः प्रहस्य परुषं वचः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
uvāca rāvaṇaṁ vīraḥ prahasya paruṣaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Then that hero-Dasaratha's son, Rāma, Overcome with wrath, addressed Ravana, laughing, in a harsh speech, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
मम भार्या जनस्थानादज्ञानाद्राक्षसाधम
हृता ते विवशा यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं नासि वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
mama bhāryā janasthānādajñānādrākṣasādhama
hṛtā te vivaśā yasmāttasmāttvaṁ nāsi vīryavān

translations.english: You vile of Räkşasas, in consequence of having through lack of sense carried off my wife from Janasthana and brought her under your subjection, you have been deprived of your prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
मया विरहितां दीनां वर्तमानां महावने
वैदेहीं प्रसभं हृत्वा शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे
verses.transliteration:
mayā virahitāṁ dīnāṁ vartamānāṁ mahāvane
vaidehīṁ prasabhaṁ hṛtvā śūro'hamiti manyase

translations.english: Having forcibly carried away Vaidehi staying in that mighty forest, forlorn and without me, you think, 'I am hero.'

verses.sanskrit:
स्त्रीषु शूर विनाथासु परदाराभिमर्शके
कृत्वा कापुरुषं कर्म शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे
verses.transliteration:
strīṣu śūra vināthāsu paradārābhimarśake
kṛtvā kāpuruṣaṁ karma śūro'hamiti manyase

translations.english: Outraging the helpless wives of others, doing this craven deed, you thinkest, 'I am a hero.'

verses.sanskrit:
भिन्नमर्याद निर्लज्ज चारित्रेष्वनवस्थित
दर्पान्मृत्युमुपादाय शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे
verses.transliteration:
bhinnamaryāda nirlajja cāritreṣvanavasthita
darpānmṛtyumupādāya śūro'hamiti manyase

translations.english: O you having your dignity destroyed! O shameless Wight! O you of volatile character, having through your violence brought destruction on yourself, you think, 'I am a hero.'

verses.sanskrit:
शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च
श्लाघनीयं यशस्यं च कृतं कर्म महत्त्वया
verses.transliteration:
śūreṇa dhanadabhrātrā balaiḥ samuditena ca
ślāghanīyaṁ yaśasyaṁ ca kṛtaṁ karma mahattvayā

translations.english: A great and famous act has been performed by you, a hero, and the brother of the Bestower of riches, surrounded with your forces!

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सेकेनाभिपन्नस्य गर्हितस्याहितस्य च
कर्मणः प्राप्नुहीदानीं तस्याद्य सुमहत्फलम्
verses.transliteration:
utsekenābhipannasya garhitasyāhitasya ca
karmaṇaḥ prāpnuhīdānīṁ tasyādya sumahatphalam

translations.english: Today receive the mighty fruit of that infamous act done through pride, productive of evil.* *Remarks Rāmānuja, 'here and in the next world.'

verses.sanskrit:
शूरोऽहमिति चात्मानमवगच्छसि दुर्मते
नैव लज्जास्ति ते सीतां चोरवद्व्यपकर्षतः
verses.transliteration:
śūro'hamiti cātmānamavagacchasi durmate
naiva lajjāsti te sītāṁ coravadvyapakarṣataḥ

translations.english: O wicked-minded one, you think of yourself, 'I am a hero; but you that have taken way Sītā like a thief, have no feeling of shame.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि मत्संनिधौ सीता धर्षिता स्यात्त्वया बलात्
भ्रातरं तु खरं पश्येस्तदा मत्सायकैर्हतः
verses.transliteration:
yadi matsaṁnidhau sītā dharṣitā syāttvayā balāt
bhrātaraṁ tu kharaṁ paśyestadā matsāyakairhataḥ

translations.english: Had you forcibly outraged Sità in my very presence, you, slain by my Shafts, would have seen your brother-Khara.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्यासि मम दुष्टात्मंश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः
अद्य त्वां सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyāsi mama duṣṭātmaṁścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ
adya tvāṁ sāyakaistīkṣṇairnayāmi yamasādanam

translations.english: By luck, O you of an evil soul, you have come within the range of my vision. Today by means of sharp shafts shall I bring you to death's door.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य ते मच्छरैश्छिन्नं शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्
क्रव्यादा व्यपकर्षन्तु विकीर्णं रणपांसुषु
verses.transliteration:
adya te maccharaiśchinnaṁ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam
kravyādā vyapakarṣantu vikīrṇaṁ raṇapāṁsuṣu

translations.english: Today beasts of pray will drag your head having burning ear-rings, severed by my shafts and covered with the dust of the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit:
निपत्योरसि गृध्रास्ते क्षितौ क्षिप्तस्य रावण
पिबन्तु रुधिरं तर्षाद्बाणशल्यान्तरोथितम्
verses.transliteration:
nipatyorasi gṛdhrāste kṣitau kṣiptasya rāvaṇa
pibantu rudhiraṁ tarṣādbāṇaśalyāntarothitam

translations.english: O Ravana, vultures will alight on your breast, as you will lie low on the ground; and, athirst, they will drink the blood gushing out from your wounds.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य मद्बाणाभिन्नस्य गतासोः पतितस्य ते
कर्षन्त्वन्त्राणि पतगा गरुत्मन्त इवोरगान्
verses.transliteration:
adya madbāṇābhinnasya gatāsoḥ patitasya te
karṣantvantrāṇi patagā garutmanta ivoragān

translations.english: To-day fowls of the air will keep pulling at you pierced with my shafts, and lying lifeless, as birds do serpents.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं स वदन्वीरो रामः शत्रुनिबर्हणः
राक्षसेन्द्रं समीपस्थं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ sa vadanvīro rāmaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
rākṣasendraṁ samīpasthaṁ śaravarṣairavākirat

translations.english: Having spoken thus, that slayer of foes-Rāmashowered arrows on the lord of Rākşasas, staying before.

verses.sanskrit:
बभूव द्विगुणं वीर्यं बलं हर्षश्च संयुगे
रामस्यास्त्रबलं चैव शत्रोर्निधनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
babhūva dviguṇaṁ vīryaṁ balaṁ harṣaśca saṁyuge
rāmasyāstrabalaṁ caiva śatrornidhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: The prowess and strength and spirits and force of arms of Rāma burning for the destruction of his foe, were doubled.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रादुर्बभूवुरस्त्राणि सर्वाणि विदितात्मनः
प्रहर्षाच्च महातेजाः शीघ्रहस्ततरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
prādurbabhūvurastrāṇi sarvāṇi viditātmanaḥ
praharṣācca mahātejāḥ śīghrahastataro'bhavat

translations.english: All the Weapons* presented themselves before that one cognisant of self; and the fleethandedness of that exceedingly powerful one increased immensely from exhilaration of spirits. *i.e. the presiding deities of them.

verses.sanskrit:
शुभान्येतानि चिह्नानि विज्ञायात्मगतानि सः
भूय एवार्दयद्रामो रावणं राक्षसान्तकृत्
verses.transliteration:
śubhānyetāni cihnāni vijñāyātmagatāni saḥ
bhūya evārdayadrāmo rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasāntakṛt

translations.english: Seeing all these auspicious omens coming of themselves, Rama, finisher of Raksasas, set about smiting his foe more energetically than ever.

verses.sanskrit:
हरीणां चाश्मनिकरैः शरवर्षैश्च राघवात्
हन्यमानो दशग्रीवो विघूर्णहृदयोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
harīṇāṁ cāśmanikaraiḥ śaravarṣaiśca rāghavāt
hanyamāno daśagrīvo vighūrṇahṛdayo'bhavat

translations.english: Assailed with stones by the monkeys and showers of shafts by Rāghava, the Ten-necked one felt his heart undergoing a revolution.* *Vighurnahrdayah: had his heart paralysed, according to the commentator. I prefer the sense given as more graphic.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु मोहात्सुसंक्रुद्धः कृतान्तबलचोदितः
क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो रावणो सूतमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu mohātsusaṁkruddhaḥ kṛtāntabalacoditaḥ
krodhasaṁraktanayano rāvaṇo sūtamabravīt

translations.english: After gradually regaining his senses, Rāvana, urged on by the force of the Finisher, getting into a furious passion, with his eyes reddened in wrath, addressed the charioteer, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
विमुक्तमिव मायाभिरस्त्रैरिव बहिष्कृतम्
मामवज्ञाय दुर्बुद्धे स्वया बुद्ध्या विचेष्टसे
verses.transliteration:
vimuktamiva māyābhirastrairiva bahiṣkṛtam
māmavajñāya durbuddhe svayā buddhyā viceṣṭase

translations.english: perverse sense, disregarding me as devoid of prowess, and incompetent, and bereft of vigour-as cowardly, light, nerveless and shorn of energy, and as divorced by the power of illusion and debarred by arms, you act on your own understanding.

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं मामवज्ञाय मच्छन्दमनवेक्ष्य च
त्वया शत्रुसमक्षं मे रथोऽयमपवाहितः
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ māmavajñāya macchandamanavekṣya ca
tvayā śatrusamakṣaṁ me ratho'yamapavāhitaḥ

translations.english: Wherefore disregarding me, and not minding O you of my purpose, have you taken away my car from before the presence of the enemy?

verses.sanskrit:
त्वयाद्य हि ममानार्य चिरकालसमार्जितम्
यशो वीर्यं च तेजश्च प्रत्ययश्च विनाशितः
verses.transliteration:
tvayādya hi mamānārya cirakālasamārjitam
yaśo vīryaṁ ca tejaśca pratyayaśca vināśitaḥ

translations.english: O abject one! by you have my long earned renown and energy and prowess and credit been brought to naught.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः
पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धोऽहं कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया
verses.transliteration:
śatroḥ prakhyātavīryasya rañjanīyasya vikramaiḥ
paśyato yuddhalubdho'haṁ kṛtaḥ kāpuruṣastvayā

translations.english: In the very sight of an enemy of renowned prowess, and one capable of being gratified with valorous deeds, have you made me, burning for battle, look as if I were a coward.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वं रथमिमं मोहान्न चोद्वहसि दुर्मते
सत्योऽयं प्रतितर्को मे परेण त्वमुपस्कृतः
verses.transliteration:
yastvaṁ rathamimaṁ mohānna codvahasi durmate
satyo'yaṁ pratitarko me pareṇa tvamupaskṛtaḥ

translations.english: As, O wicked minded one, you did not even through heedlessness, take the car to the field of batile, I infer for certain that you have been bribed by the foe.

verses.sanskrit:
न हीदं विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकाङ्क्षिणः
रिपूणां सदृशं चैतन्न त्वयैतत्स्वनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration:
na hīdaṁ vidyate karma suhṛdo hitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
ripūṇāṁ sadṛśaṁ caitanna tvayaitatsvanuṣṭhitam

translations.english: The act that you have done, does not appear as that of a friend seeking our welfare; but today you have acted like an enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
निवर्तय रथं शीघ्रं यावन्नापैति मे रिपुः
यदि वाप्युषितोऽसि त्वं स्मर्यन्ते यदि वा गुणाः
verses.transliteration:
nivartaya rathaṁ śīghraṁ yāvannāpaiti me ripuḥ
yadi vāpyuṣito'si tvaṁ smaryante yadi vā guṇāḥ

translations.english: If you have been maintained by me, if you remember my merit, do you swiftly turn the car before my enemy has departed.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना
अब्रवीद्रावणं सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ paruṣamuktastu hitabuddhirabuddhinā
abravīdrāvaṇaṁ sūto hitaṁ sānunayaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Thus admonished by him of slender sense, the charioteer possessed of intelligence, humbly spoke to Råvaņa words fraught with good.

verses.sanskrit:
न भीतोऽस्मि न मूढोऽस्मि नोपजप्तोऽस्मि शत्रुभिः
न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहो विस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया
verses.transliteration:
na bhīto'smi na mūḍho'smi nopajapto'smi śatrubhiḥ
na pramatto na niḥsneho vismṛtā na ca satkriyā

translations.english: I am not afraid, nor stupefied, nor have I been bribed by the foe, nor am I negligent. And I have not forgotten your affection or your good offices.

verses.sanskrit:
मया तु हितकामेन यशश्च परिरक्षता
स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा प्रियमित्यप्रियं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
mayā tu hitakāmena yaśaśca parirakṣatā
snehapraskannamanasā priyamityapriyaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: And studious of your welfare, I have saved your fame; and with a mind overflowing with affection I have done (to you) this unpalatable good.

verses.sanskrit:
नास्मिन्नर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम्
कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
nāsminnarthe mahārāja tvaṁ māṁ priyahite ratam
kaścillaghurivānāryo doṣato gantumarhasi

translations.english: O mighty monarch, for this, you should not, like a frivolous and base one, criminate me that am ever engaged in what is good and dear to you.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि यन्निमित्तं मया रथः
नदीवेग इवाम्भोभिः संयुगे विनिवर्तितः
verses.transliteration:
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi yannimittaṁ mayā rathaḥ
nadīvega ivāmbhobhiḥ saṁyuge vinivartitaḥ

translations.english: Listen! I shall render you reason why I turned away from the field the car, rushing like a river when the sea is swelled up* *On the ascension of the Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रमं तवावगच्छामि महता रणकर्मणा
न हि ते वीर सौमुख्यं प्रहर्षं वोपधारये
verses.transliteration:
śramaṁ tavāvagacchāmi mahatā raṇakarmaṇā
na hi te vīra saumukhyaṁ praharṣaṁ vopadhāraye

translations.english: I knew that you had been fatigued in consequence of your mighty exertions in the fight. And I could not perceive that your prowess then stood superior (to that of the foe).* *Two negatives in this verse amounting to an affirmative. This is the only instance of double negatives in Valmiki.

verses.sanskrit:
रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्च त इमे रथवाजिनः
दीना घर्मपरिश्रान्ता गावो वर्षहता इव
verses.transliteration:
rathodvahanakhinnāśca ta ime rathavājinaḥ
dīnā gharmapariśrāntā gāvo varṣahatā iva

translations.english: The steeds of my car were worn out by-carrying it; and they were battered, and helpless and perspired like kine in a shower.

verses.sanskrit:
निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठं यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति नः
तेषु तेष्वभिपन्नेषु लक्षयाम्यप्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration:
nimittāni ca bhūyiṣṭhaṁ yāni prādurbhavanti naḥ
teṣu teṣvabhipanneṣu lakṣayāmyapradakṣiṇam

translations.english: And bad omens fast sprang up before us. And on these occurring, I perceived that things would go against us.

verses.sanskrit:
देशकालौ च विज्ञेयौ लक्षणानीङ्गितानि च
दैन्यं हर्षश्च खेदश्च रथिनश्च बलाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
deśakālau ca vijñeyau lakṣaṇānīṅgitāni ca
dainyaṁ harṣaśca khedaśca rathinaśca balābalam

translations.english: O you endowed with exceeding might, a charioteer should be conversant with season and place, with omens, and the expressions of emotions; as also with depression of spirits, exhilaration, and grief.

verses.sanskrit:
स्थलनिम्नानि भूमेश्च समानि विषमाणि च
युद्धकालश्च विज्ञेयः परस्यान्तरदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
sthalanimnāni bhūmeśca samāni viṣamāṇi ca
yuddhakālaśca vijñeyaḥ parasyāntaradarśanam

translations.english: And he should have a knowledge of low, lever and uneven grounds, and the time for conflict, and he should be able to perceive the shortcomings of the enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम्
सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयं रथकुटुम्बिना
verses.transliteration:
upayānāpayāne ca sthānaṁ pratyapasarpaṇam
sarvametadrathasthena jñeyaṁ rathakuṭumbinā

translations.english: And a charioteer mounted on a car, should know when to draw near an enemy, when to turn away from him when to stay; and when to turn round from before the foe-all these (he should know).

verses.sanskrit:
तव विश्रामहेतोस्तु तथैषां रथवाजिनाम्
रौद्रं वर्जयता खेदं क्षमं कृतमिदं मया
verses.transliteration:
tava viśrāmahetostu tathaiṣāṁ rathavājinām
raudraṁ varjayatā khedaṁ kṣamaṁ kṛtamidaṁ mayā

translations.english: What I, for bringing respite to you as well as the horses of the car, have done by way of removing the terrific exhaustion, is proper.

verses.sanskrit:
न मया स्वेच्छया वीर रथोऽयमपवाहितः
भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेन मयेदं यत्कृतं विभो
verses.transliteration:
na mayā svecchayā vīra ratho'yamapavāhitaḥ
bhartṛsnehaparītena mayedaṁ yatkṛtaṁ vibho

translations.english: I did not, O hero, turn away the car of my own sheer will. What I have done, O lord, had been dictated by my affection for you.

verses.sanskrit:
आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन
तत्करिष्याम्यहं वीरं गतानृण्येन चेतसा
verses.transliteration:
ājñāpaya yathātattvaṁ vakṣyasyariniṣūdana
tatkariṣyāmyahaṁ vīraṁ gatānṛṇyena cetasā

translations.english: Command me. What you say, O destroyer of foes. I will do every way, O hero with my whole soul.

verses.sanskrit:
संतुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः
प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधं युद्धलुब्धोऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration:
saṁtuṣṭastena vākyena rāvaṇastasya sāratheḥ
praśasyainaṁ bahuvidhaṁ yuddhalubdho'bravīdidam

translations.english: Thereat, well pleased with the speech of the charioteer, Ravana, eager for encounter, after praising him in various ways said.

verses.sanskrit:
रथं शीघ्रमिमं सूत राघवाभिमुखं कुरु
नाहत्वा समरे शत्रून्निवर्तिष्यति रावणः
verses.transliteration:
rathaṁ śīghramimaṁ sūta rāghavābhimukhaṁ kuru
nāhatvā samare śatrūnnivartiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: O charioteer, do you swiftly take the car towards Rāghava. Without slaying his foe in fight, Ravana turn not away (from the field).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
ददौ तस्य शुभं ह्येकं हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tatastuṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
dadau tasya śubhaṁ hyekaṁ hastābharaṇamuttamam

translations.english: Speaking thus Råvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-gave the charioteer on the car an excellent ornament for the hand. Hearing Ravana's words, the charioteer drove the car.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो द्रुतं रावणवाक्यचोदितः; प्रचोदयामास हयान्स सारथिः
स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य ततो महारथः; क्षणेन रामस्य रणाग्रतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
tato drutaṁ rāvaṇavākyacoditaḥ; pracodayāmāsa hayānsa sārathiḥ
sa rākṣasendrasya tato mahārathaḥ; kṣaṇena rāmasya raṇāgrato'bhavat

translations.english: And urged on by the speech of Rāvana, the charioteer drove on the steeds, and in a moment the mighty chariot of the Rākşasa-chief appeared before Rāma in the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं रौद्रेण वर्चसा
तडित्पताकागहनं दर्शितेन्द्रायुधायुधम्
शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धारासारमिवान्बुदम्
verses.transliteration:
kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṁ yuktaṁ raudreṇa varcasā
taḍitpatākāgahanaṁ darśitendrāyudhāyudham
śaradhārā vimuñcantaṁ dhārāsāramivānbudam

translations.english: And as it speedily descended, the monarch of men beheld that Raksasa-king's resounding car, having huge standards, yoked with black chargers, and endowed with fierce splendour; as if flaming in the firmament; having the resplendance of the Sun himself; with thronging lightning pennons; displaying the glow of Indra's weapon* showering arms; and resembling rain-charged clouds. *The rain-blow.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा मेघसंकाशमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः
गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्य दीर्यतः सदृशस्वनम्
उवाच मातलिं रामः सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā meghasaṁkāśamāpatantaṁ rathaṁ ripoḥ
girervajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam
uvāca mātaliṁ rāmaḥ sahasrākṣasya sārathim

translations.english: Seeing the enemy's car resembling a mass of clouds having a chatter resembling the sounds sent by a cleaving mountain riven by the thunder, Rāma, vehemently drawing his bow curved like the infant moon, addressed Mătalicharioteer to the thousand-eyed (deity) saying. *Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
मातले पश्य संरब्धमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः
यथापसव्यं पतता वेगेन महता पुनः
समरे हन्तुमात्मानं तथानेन कृता मतिः
verses.transliteration:
mātale paśya saṁrabdhamāpatantaṁ rathaṁ ripoḥ
yathāpasavyaṁ patatā vegena mahatā punaḥ
samare hantumātmānaṁ tathānena kṛtā matiḥ

translations.english: O Mătalī, behold the enraged chariot of my foe as it course on. From the furious speed with which he is again wheeling at my right, it appear that he has set his heart of slaying me in encouter.

verses.sanskrit:
तदप्रमादमातिष्ठ प्रत्युद्गच्छ रथं रिपोः
विध्वंसयितुमिच्छामि वायुर्मेघमिवोत्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tadapramādamātiṣṭha pratyudgaccha rathaṁ ripoḥ
vidhvaṁsayitumicchāmi vāyurmeghamivotthitam

translations.english: Do you therefore heedfully drive the car right against the vehicle of my foe. I wish to destroy this one even as the wind scatter clouds that have appeared.

verses.sanskrit:
अविक्लवमसंभ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम्
रश्मिसंचारनियतं प्रचोदय रथं द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
aviklavamasaṁbhrāntamavyagrahṛdayekṣaṇam
raśmisaṁcāraniyataṁ pracodaya rathaṁ drutam

translations.english: Do you with all your wits about you, without trepidation, and holding your heart as will as your eye in calmness, swiftly drive the chariot ruled by the reins.

verses.sanskrit:
कामं न त्वं समाधेयः पुरंदररथोचितः
युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रः स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये
verses.transliteration:
kāmaṁ na tvaṁ samādheyaḥ puraṁdararathocitaḥ
yuyutsurahamekāgraḥ smāraye tvāṁ na śikṣaye

translations.english: Worthy of Purandara's car, you ought not to be taught by me. Desirous of encounter and my whole soul bent on fight, I simply remind younot teach you.

verses.sanskrit:
परितुष्टः स रामस्य तेन वाक्येन मातलिः
प्रचोदयामास रथं सुरसारथिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration:
parituṣṭaḥ sa rāmasya tena vākyena mātaliḥ
pracodayāmāsa rathaṁ surasārathisattamaḥ

translations.english: Pleased with these words of Rāma, the excellent celestial charioteer-Mātalī-drove the car. Then leaving Ravana's mighty car on the right, he enveloped Rāvana with the dust raised by the wheels.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः
रथप्रतिमुखं रामं सायकैरवधूनयत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvastāmravisphāritekṣaṇaḥ
rathapratimukhaṁ rāmaṁ sāyakairavadhūnayat

translations.english: Thereat the Ten-necked one, enraged, with his eyes coppery and dilated (in passion), covered with arrows Rāma staying in front of his car.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्षणामर्षितो रामो धैर्यं रोषेण लङ्घयन्
जग्राह सुमहावेगमैन्द्रं युधि शरासनम्
शरांश्च सुमहातेजाः सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान्
verses.transliteration:
dharṣaṇāmarṣito rāmo dhairyaṁ roṣeṇa laṅghayan
jagrāha sumahāvegamaindraṁ yudhi śarāsanam
śarāṁśca sumahātejāḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhān

translations.english: Enraged at the smiting. Rāma, with his ire aroused, but summoning up patience, took up in the encounter the bow of Indra endowed with exceeding vehemence; well as highly impetuous shafts having the resplendence of the solar rays. And then there began a furious encounter between those (two) eager for slaying each other confronting each other like to flaming lions.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
समीयुर्द्वैरथं द्रष्टुं रावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
samīyurdvairathaṁ draṣṭuṁ rāvaṇakṣayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: Then desirous of destruction of Rāvana, celestials with Gandharvas, and Siddhas and supersaints assembled to go to behold the encounter taking place between the two cars.

verses.sanskrit:
समुत्पेतुरथोत्पाता दारुणा लोमहर्षणाः
रावणस्य विनाशाय राघवस्य जयाय च
verses.transliteration:
samutpeturathotpātā dāruṇā lomaharṣaṇāḥ
rāvaṇasya vināśāya rāghavasya jayāya ca

translations.english: For the destruction of Råvana and the success of Rāghava, there occurred round about the cars terrible bodements capable of making people's down stand on end. as

verses.sanskrit:
ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो रावणस्य रथोपरि
वाता मण्डलिनस्तीव्रा अपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः
verses.transliteration:
vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devo rāvaṇasya rathopari
vātā maṇḍalinastīvrā apasavyaṁ pracakramuḥ

translations.english: The god poured down showers of blood on the car of Rāvana; and a violent tornado eddied on his right.

verses.sanskrit:
महद्गृध्रकुलं चास्य भ्रममाणं नभस्तले
येन येन रथो याति तेन तेन प्रधावति
verses.transliteration:
mahadgṛdhrakulaṁ cāsya bhramamāṇaṁ nabhastale
yena yena ratho yāti tena tena pradhāvati

translations.english: And a mighty swarm of vultures, wheeling in the heavens, pursued the car wherever it moved.

verses.sanskrit:
संध्यया चावृता लङ्का जपापुष्पनिकाशया
दृश्यते संप्रदीतेव दिवसेऽपि वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration:
saṁdhyayā cāvṛtā laṅkā japāpuṣpanikāśayā
dṛśyate saṁpradīteva divase'pi vasuṁdharā

translations.english: And Lankā was enveloped with evening resembling the red Japā flowers and even in day appeared ablaze.

verses.sanskrit:
सनिर्घाता महोल्काश्च संप्रचेतुर्महास्वनाः
विषादयन्त्यो रक्षांसि रावणस्य तदाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
sanirghātā maholkāśca saṁpraceturmahāsvanāḥ
viṣādayantyo rakṣāṁsi rāvaṇasya tadāhitāḥ

translations.english: Lightnings and firebrands accompanied by a terrible sound began to fall down on all sides. And beholding these omens inauspicious to Rāvana all the Rākşasas were greatly sorry.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणश्च यतस्तत्र प्रचचाल वसुंधरा
रक्षसां च प्रहरतां गृहीता इव बाहवः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaśca yatastatra pracacāla vasuṁdharā
rakṣasāṁ ca praharatāṁ gṛhītā iva bāhavaḥ

translations.english: And wherever Rāvana moved the earth shook an the hands of all the Rākşasas fighting were as if paralysed.

verses.sanskrit:
ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः पतिताः सूर्यरश्मयः
दृश्यन्ते रावणस्याङ्गे पर्वतस्येव धातवः
verses.transliteration:
tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śvetāḥ patitāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ
dṛśyante rāvaṇasyāṅge parvatasyeva dhātavaḥ

translations.english: The copper coloured, the yellow, the red, and the white rays of the sun falling before Rāvaņa appeared like melted metals of a mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
गृध्रैरनुगताश्चास्य वमन्त्यो ज्वलनं मुखैः
प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यः संरब्धमशिवं शिवाः
verses.transliteration:
gṛdhrairanugatāścāsya vamantyo jvalanaṁ mukhaiḥ
praṇedurmukhamīkṣantyaḥ saṁrabdhamaśivaṁ śivāḥ

translations.english: The jackals followed by vultures, vomiting forth fire and casting their looks at him, began to emit inauspicious cries.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिकूलं ववौ वायू रणे पांसून्समुत्किरन्
तस्य राक्षसराजस्य कुर्वन्दृष्टिविलोपनम्
verses.transliteration:
pratikūlaṁ vavau vāyū raṇe pāṁsūnsamutkiran
tasya rākṣasarājasya kurvandṛṣṭivilopanam

translations.english: And in that battle-field the unfavourable wind began to blow raising dust and obstruction the vision of the king of Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयः सैन्ये चास्य समन्ततः
दुर्विषह्य स्वना घोरा विना जलधरस्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
nipeturindrāśanayaḥ sainye cāsya samantataḥ
durviṣahya svanā ghorā vinā jaladharasvanam

translations.english: On the Raksasa host on all sides dreadful lightnings were showered without the sound of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
दिशश्च प्रदिशः सर्वा बभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः
पांसुवर्षेण महता दुर्दर्शं च नभोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
diśaśca pradiśaḥ sarvā babhūvustimirāvṛtāḥ
pāṁsuvarṣeṇa mahatā durdarśaṁ ca nabho'bhavat

translations.english: All the quarters were enshrouded with darkness and the welkin became invisible being covered with darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
कुर्वन्त्यः कलहं घोरं सारिकास्तद्रथं प्रति
निपेतुः शतशस्तत्र दारुणा दारुणस्वनाः
verses.transliteration:
kurvantyaḥ kalahaṁ ghoraṁ sārikāstadrathaṁ prati
nipetuḥ śataśastatra dāruṇā dāruṇasvanāḥ

translations.english: Setting up a dreadful quarrel hundreds of terrible Särikās* began to fall down on his chariot. *A kind of bird (Turdus Salica, Buch).

verses.sanskrit:
जघनेभ्यः स्फुलिङ्गांश्च नेत्रेभ्योऽश्रूणि संततम्
मुमुचुस्तस्य तुरगास्तुल्यमग्निं च वारि च
verses.transliteration:
jaghanebhyaḥ sphuliṅgāṁśca netrebhyo'śrūṇi saṁtatam
mumucustasya turagāstulyamagniṁ ca vāri ca

translations.english: The horses emitted forth sparks of fire from their hips and tears from their eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं प्रकारा बहवः समुत्पाता भयावहाः
रावणस्य विनाशाय दारुणाः संप्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ prakārā bahavaḥ samutpātā bhayāvahāḥ
rāvaṇasya vināśāya dāruṇāḥ saṁprajajñire

translations.english: These and various other dreadful omens arose there announcing the destruction of Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्यापि निमित्तानि सौम्यानि च शिवानि च
बभूवुर्जयशंसीनि प्रादुर्भूतानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
rāmasyāpi nimittāni saumyāni ca śivāni ca
babhūvurjayaśaṁsīni prādurbhūtāni sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: There appeared on all sides many an auspicious and good sign intimating the approach of Rāma's victory.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निरीक्ष्यात्मगतानि राघवो; रणे निमित्तानि निमित्तकोविदः
जगाम हर्षं च परां च निर्वृतिं; चकार युद्धेऽभ्यधिकं च विक्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
tato nirīkṣyātmagatāni rāghavo; raṇe nimittāni nimittakovidaḥ
jagāma harṣaṁ ca parāṁ ca nirvṛtiṁ; cakāra yuddhe'bhyadhikaṁ ca vikramam

translations.english: Thereupon beholding all those auspicious signs, Raghava, well qualified to decipher them attained an excess of delight an became anxious to display a greater prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रवृत्तं सुक्रूरं रामरावणयोस्तदा
सुमहद्द्वैरथं युद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pravṛttaṁ sukrūraṁ rāmarāvaṇayostadā
sumahaddvairathaṁ yuddhaṁ sarvalokabhayāvaham

translations.english: Thereupon there ensued a mighty and dreadful encounter of two cars between Rāma and Ravana, creating terror to all people.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम्
प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration:
tato rākṣasasainyaṁ ca harīṇāṁ ca mahadbalam
pragṛhītapraharaṇaṁ niśceṣṭaṁ samatiṣṭhata

translations.english: The army of Räkşasas and the mighty host of the monkeys although they had weapons in their hands, became stupefied (for the time being).

verses.sanskrit:
संप्रयुद्धौ ततो दृष्ट्वा बलवन्नरराक्षसौ
व्याक्षिप्तहृदयाः सर्वे परं विस्मयमागताः
verses.transliteration:
saṁprayuddhau tato dṛṣṭvā balavannararākṣasau
vyākṣiptahṛdayāḥ sarve paraṁ vismayamāgatāḥ

translations.english: And beholding them (Răma and Rāvana) fight, all the Rākşasas and monkeys, having their minds agitated, were greatly surprised.

verses.sanskrit:
नानाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः
तस्थुः प्रेक्ष्य च संग्रामं नाभिजघ्नुः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration:
nānāpraharaṇairvyagrairbhujairvismitabuddhayaḥ
tasthuḥ prekṣya ca saṁgrāmaṁ nābhijaghnuḥ parasparam

translations.english: With various weapons and hands uplifted for fight, they, greatly wondered, stood there beholding them and did not address themselves to fight with each other.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षसां रावणं चापि वानराणां च राघवम्
पश्यतां विस्मिताक्षाणां सैन्यं चित्रमिवाबभौ
verses.transliteration:
rakṣasāṁ rāvaṇaṁ cāpi vānarāṇāṁ ca rāghavam
paśyatāṁ vismitākṣāṇāṁ sainyaṁ citramivābabhau

translations.english: The Rakşasas beholding Rāvana, and the monkeys beholding Rāma with wonder-stricken eyes, the whole army appeared like a picture.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ तु तत्र निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा राघवरावणौ
कृतबुद्धी स्थिरामर्षौ युयुधाते अभीतवत्
verses.transliteration:
tau tu tatra nimittāni dṛṣṭvā rāghavarāvaṇau
kṛtabuddhī sthirāmarṣau yuyudhāte abhītavat

translations.english: And expieing all omens Rāghava and Rāvaņa began to fight undaunted, firm, resolute and unagitated by anger.

verses.sanskrit:
जेतव्यमिति काकुत्स्थो मर्तव्यमिति रावणः
धृतौ स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वं युद्धेऽदर्शयतां तदा
verses.transliteration:
jetavyamiti kākutstho martavyamiti rāvaṇaḥ
dhṛtau svavīryasarvasvaṁ yuddhe'darśayatāṁ tadā

translations.english: And determining that Käkutstha would win victory and Răvana would died, they began to display their own prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रोधाद्दशग्रीवः शरान्संधाय वीर्यवान्
मुमोच ध्वजमुद्दिश्य राघवस्य रथे स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ krodhāddaśagrīvaḥ śarānsaṁdhāya vīryavān
mumoca dhvajamuddiśya rāghavasya rathe sthitam

translations.english: Thereupon the highly powerful Rāvana, setting his arrows in anger, discharged then at the pennon stationed on Rāghava's car.

verses.sanskrit:
ते शरास्तमनासाद्य पुरंदररथध्वजम्
रक्तशक्तिं परामृश्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले
verses.transliteration:
te śarāstamanāsādya puraṁdararathadhvajam
raktaśaktiṁ parāmṛśya nipeturdharaṇītale

translations.english: Those arrows reaching the flag staff of the Purandara chariot and perceiving its might fell down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामोऽभिसंक्रुद्धश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान्
कृतप्रतिकृतं कर्तुं मनसा संप्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmo'bhisaṁkruddhaścāpamāyamya vīryavān
kṛtapratikṛtaṁ kartuṁ manasā saṁpracakrame

translations.english: Thereupon the highly powerful Rama, wroth, stretching his bow, made up his mind to return the blow, And aiming at Rāvana's flag staff he discharged a sharpened shaft flaming unbearably by its own lustre like a huge serpent....

verses.sanskrit:
जगाम स महीं भित्त्वा दशग्रीवध्वजं शरः
स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौ रावणस्य रथध्वजः
verses.transliteration:
jagāma sa mahīṁ bhittvā daśagrīvadhvajaṁ śaraḥ
sa nikṛtto'patadbhūmau rāvaṇasya rathadhvajaḥ

translations.english: The effulgent Rāma discharged a shaft aiming at (Ravana's) banner which, piercing the Tennecked demon's flag fell, down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ते विद्धा हरयस्तस्य नास्खलन्नापि बभ्रमुः
बभूवुः स्वस्थहृदयाः पद्मनालैरिवाहताः
verses.transliteration:
te viddhā harayastasya nāskhalannāpi babhramuḥ
babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālairivāhatāḥ

translations.english: Ravana then, with flaming arrows, pierced Rāma's steeds. The celestial horses were not bewildered thereby nor their course was slackened. And they remained thoroughly unagitated as if they were stricken with lotus stalks.

verses.sanskrit:
गदाश्च परिघांश्चैव चक्राणि मुसलानि च
गिरिशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च तथा शूलपरश्वधान्
verses.transliteration:
gadāśca parighāṁścaiva cakrāṇi musalāni ca
giriśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṁśca tathā śūlaparaśvadhān

translations.english: Beholding the steeds thus unmoved Rāvana was again exercise with wrath and began to discharged afresh his various weapons-gadás parighas, chakras and musalas, mountain tops trees, darts and parashus and thousands of other shafts by virtue of his illusive powers. And unmoved was his energy.

verses.sanskrit:
तुमुलं त्रासजननं भीमं भीमप्रतिस्वनम्
दुर्धर्षमभवद्युद्धे नैकशस्त्रमयं महत्
verses.transliteration:
tumulaṁ trāsajananaṁ bhīmaṁ bhīmapratisvanam
durdharṣamabhavadyuddhe naikaśastramayaṁ mahat

translations.english: That downpour of various weapons became huge and terrible in the conflict creating terror and making a dreadful noise.

verses.sanskrit:
विमुच्य राघवरथं समन्ताद्वानरे बले
सायकैरन्तरिक्षं च चकाराशु निरन्तरम्
मुमोच च दशग्रीवो निःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
vimucya rāghavarathaṁ samantādvānare bale
sāyakairantarikṣaṁ ca cakārāśu nirantaram
mumoca ca daśagrīvo niḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā

translations.english: Thereupon leaving aside Rāghava's car he began to assail the monkey-host and enveloped the sky with a continual discharge of arrows. The Ten-necked demon let loose many a weapon even at the risk of his own life.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यायच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा तत्परं रावणं रणे
प्रहसन्निव काकुत्स्थः संदधे सायकाञ्शितान्
verses.transliteration:
vyāyacchamānaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā tatparaṁ rāvaṇaṁ raṇe
prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ saṁdadhe sāyakāñśitān

translations.english: Beholding Rāvana in the encounter thus actively engaged in the discharged of arrows, Kakuthstha, smiling set up pointed shafts, and discharged them by hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ताभ्यां प्रयुक्तेन शरवर्षेण भास्वता
शरबद्धमिवाभाति द्वितीयं भास्वदम्बरम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastābhyāṁ prayuktena śaravarṣeṇa bhāsvatā
śarabaddhamivābhāti dvitīyaṁ bhāsvadambaram

translations.english: Beholding them Rāvaņa again filled the welkin with arrows-and thus with shafts discharged by them both another flaming sky was crated.

verses.sanskrit:
नानिमित्तोऽभवद्बाणो नातिभेत्ता न निष्फलः
तथा विसृजतोर्बाणान्रामरावणयोर्मृधे
verses.transliteration:
nānimitto'bhavadbāṇo nātibhettā na niṣphalaḥ
tathā visṛjatorbāṇānrāmarāvaṇayormṛdhe

translations.english: None (of the arrows) missed the aim, none of them failed to pierce another and none of them was fruitless. And the arrows discharged by Rāma and Rāvana striking each other fell down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रायुध्येतामविच्छिन्नमस्यन्तौ सव्यदक्षिणम्
चक्रतुस्तौ शरौघैस्तु निरुच्छ्वासमिवाम्बरम्
verses.transliteration:
prāyudhyetāmavicchinnamasyantau savyadakṣiṇam
cakratustau śaraughaistu nirucchvāsamivāmbaram

translations.english: They standing on their right and left began to make a continued downpour of Arrows and enveloped the sky entirely.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य हयान्रामो हयान्रामस्य रावणः
जघ्नतुस्तौ तदान्योन्यं कृतानुकृतकारिणौ
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya hayānrāmo hayānrāmasya rāvaṇaḥ
jaghnatustau tadānyonyaṁ kṛtānukṛtakāriṇau

translations.english: They opposing each other, Rāvana slew Rāma's steeds and Rāma in his turn slew Rāvana's.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शयित्वा तदा तौ तु गतिं बहुविधां रणे
परस्परस्याभिमुखौ पुनरेव च तस्थतुः
verses.transliteration:
darśayitvā tadā tau tu gatiṁ bahuvidhāṁ raṇe
parasparasyābhimukhau punareva ca tasthatuḥ

translations.english: Displaying many a movement in the conflict they again stood facing each other, the forepart of one car touching that of the other and the heads of the steeds touching each other; and then pennons stationed on one touched those of the other.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य ततो रामो धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैः शरैः
चतुर्भिश्चतुरो दीप्तान्हयान्प्रत्यपसर्पयत्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya tato rāmo dhanurmuktaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
caturbhiścaturo dīptānhayānpratyapasarpayat

translations.english: Rāma with four sharpened arrows shot off his bow, removed the flaming horses of Rāvana to some distance.

verses.sanskrit:
स क्रोधवशमापन्नो हयानामपसर्पणे
मुमोच निशितान्बाणान्राघवाय निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
sa krodhavaśamāpanno hayānāmapasarpaṇe
mumoca niśitānbāṇānrāghavāya niśācaraḥ

translations.english: And finding his steeds thus removed he was exercised with wrath. And the Ten-necked one discharged sharpened arrows at Raghava.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता दशग्रीवेण राघवः
जगाम न विकारं च न चापि व्यथितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
so'tividdho balavatā daśagrīveṇa rāghavaḥ
jagāma na vikāraṁ ca na cāpi vyathito'bhavat

translations.english: And he was pierced by those arrows coming from the powerful Ten-necked demon. He was neither overwhelmed nor pained therewith and he again discharged arrows resembling the thunder-bolts.

verses.sanskrit:
मातलेस्तु महावेगाः शरीरे पतिताः शराः
न सूक्ष्ममपि संमोहं व्यथां वा प्रददुर्युधि
verses.transliteration:
mātalestu mahāvegāḥ śarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ
na sūkṣmamapi saṁmohaṁ vyathāṁ vā pradaduryudhi

translations.english: The Ten-necked demon again discharged arrows at the charioteer, which fell with great vehemence on the person of Mātalī. Mātali was not the least pained or overwhelmed in that encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
तया धर्षणया क्रोद्धो मातलेर्न तथात्मनः
चकार शरजालेन राघवो विमुखं रिपुम्
verses.transliteration:
tayā dharṣaṇayā kroddho mātalerna tathātmanaḥ
cakāra śarajālena rāghavo vimukhaṁ ripum

translations.english: Beholding his charioteer thus assailed Rāma was excited with wrath and overwhelmed his foe with a net of arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
विंशतिं त्रिंशतं षष्टिं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
मुमोच राघवो वीरः सायकान्स्यन्दने रिपोः
verses.transliteration:
viṁśatiṁ triṁśataṁ ṣaṣṭiṁ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
mumoca rāghavo vīraḥ sāyakānsyandane ripoḥ

translations.english: The heroic Rāghava showered on his enemy's chariot shafts by twentys, thirtys, sixtys, hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit:
गदानां मुसलानां च परिघाणां च निस्वनैः
शराणां पुङ्खवातैश्च क्षुभिताः सप्तसागराः
verses.transliteration:
gadānāṁ musalānāṁ ca parighāṇāṁ ca nisvanaiḥ
śarāṇāṁ puṅkhavātaiśca kṣubhitāḥ saptasāgarāḥ

translations.english: There again ensued a terrible conflict capable of making one's down stand on end. And the seven oceans were overwhelmed with the sound of maces, Musalas, Paraighas and gold feathered arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षुब्धानां सागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः
व्यथिताः पन्नगाः सर्वे दानवाश्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration:
kṣubdhānāṁ sāgarāṇāṁ ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ
vyathitāḥ pannagāḥ sarve dānavāśca sahasraśaḥ

translations.english: Those inhabiting the regions under the agitated oceans, all the Dănvas and thousands of Pannagas were greatly pained.

verses.sanskrit:
चकम्पे मेदिनी कृत्स्ना सशैलवनकानना
भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चाभून्न ववौ चापि मारुतः
verses.transliteration:
cakampe medinī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā
bhāskaro niṣprabhaścābhūnna vavau cāpi mārutaḥ

translations.english: Greatly shook the earth with her mountains, forests and gardens. The Sun was shorn of its resplendence and the wind blew very rough.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
चिन्तामापेदिरे सर्वे सकिंनरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
cintāmāpedire sarve sakiṁnaramahoragāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the celestials with Gandharvas, Siddhas, great saints, Kinnaras and serpents, were all worked up with anxiety.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तु लोकास्तिष्ठन्तु शाश्वताः
जयतां राघवः संख्ये रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyo'stu lokāstiṣṭhantu śāśvatāḥ
jayatāṁ rāghavaḥ saṁkhye rāvaṇaṁ rākṣaseśvaram

translations.english: Beholding the dreadful encounter between Rāma and Rāvaņa capable of making people's down stand on end, the celestials with ascetics began to pray, May good betide the Brahmins and cows, may people live in peace and may Rāghava defeat Rāvana, the lord of Räkşasas, in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहू रघूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः
संधाय धनुषा रामः क्षुरमाशीविषोपमम्
रावणस्य शिरोऽच्छिन्दच्छ्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kruddho mahābāhū raghūṇāṁ kīrtivardhanaḥ
saṁdhāya dhanuṣā rāmaḥ kṣuramāśīviṣopamam
rāvaṇasya śiro'cchindacchrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam

translations.english: Thereupon Råma of long arms, the enhancer of the glory of Raghu's race, enraged, set his arrow, resembling a serpent, on his bow, and cut asunder Rāvana's head wearing shinning Kundalas. And that head in the presence of the inhabitants of the three regions fell down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्क्षिप्रं क्षिप्रहस्तेन रामेण क्षिप्रकारिणा
द्वितीयं रावणशिरश्छिन्नं संयति सायकैः
verses.transliteration:
tatkṣipraṁ kṣiprahastena rāmeṇa kṣiprakāriṇā
dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaśiraśchinnaṁ saṁyati sāyakaiḥ

translations.english: Instantly there arose another head resembling the former; and it was speedily cut off by the light-handed Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
छिन्नमात्रं च तच्छीर्षं पुनरन्यत्स्म दृश्यते
तदप्यशनिसंकाशैश्छिन्नं रामेण सायकैः
verses.transliteration:
chinnamātraṁ ca tacchīrṣaṁ punaranyatsma dṛśyate
tadapyaśanisaṁkāśaiśchinnaṁ rāmeṇa sāyakaiḥ

translations.english: As soon as the second head was chopped off in the encounter by means of shafts another appeared again. And that was again severed by Rāma's shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेव शतं छिन्नं शिरसां तुल्यवर्चसाम्
न चैव रावणस्यान्तो दृश्यते जीवितक्षये
verses.transliteration:
evameva śataṁ chinnaṁ śirasāṁ tulyavarcasām
na caiva rāvaṇasyānto dṛśyate jīvitakṣaye

translations.english: Thus were severed hundred heads all equal in brilliance. But the end of Ravana's life was not seen by him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सर्वास्त्रविद्वीरः कौसल्यानन्दिवर्धनः
मार्गणैर्बहुभिर्युक्तश्चिन्तयामास राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sarvāstravidvīraḥ kausalyānandivardhanaḥ
mārgaṇairbahubhiryuktaścintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the heroic Rāghava conversant with the use of all weapons, the enhancer of Kausalya's joy, began to reason within himself in various ways.

verses.sanskrit:
मारीचो निहतो यैस्तु खरो यैस्तु सुदूषणः
क्रञ्चारण्ये विराधस्तु कबन्धो दण्डका वने
verses.transliteration:
mārīco nihato yaistu kharo yaistu sudūṣaṇaḥ
krañcāraṇye virādhastu kabandho daṇḍakā vane

translations.english: Verily these are the arrows by which Mārīca was killed and Khara with Dūşaņa was slainVirādaha was destroyed in the forest of Krauñcathe headless demon in the forest of DandakaSālas and mountains were broken the ocean was agitated-and Vāli was killed; I do not perceive the reason, why they were becoming fruitless when discharged at Răvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
इति चिन्तापरश्चासीदप्रमत्तश्च संयुगे
ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि राघवो रावणोरसि
verses.transliteration:
iti cintāparaścāsīdapramattaśca saṁyuge
vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi rāghavo rāvaṇorasi

translations.english: Thinking thus Rāghava made himself ready in the conflict and began to shower arrows on Rāvana's breast.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः
गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo'pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ
gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṁ pratyardayadraṇe

translations.english: The lord of Raksasas, Ravana, who was stationed on the car wroth, attacked Rāma in the conflict with maces and Musalas.

verses.sanskrit:
देवदानवयक्षाणां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम्
पश्यतां तन्महद्युद्धं सर्वरात्रमवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ piśācoragarakṣasām
paśyatāṁ tanmahadyuddhaṁ sarvarātramavartata

translations.english: That dreadful and huge conflict, capable of making hairs stand on end, continued for seven nights before the eyes of the celestials, Dānavas, Yaksas, Piśācas, Uragas and serpents stationed in the sky, on the earth or on the mountain-tops.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव रत्रिं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न चक्षणम्
रामरावणयोर्युद्धं विराममुपगच्छति
verses.transliteration:
naiva ratriṁ na divasaṁ na muhūrtaṁ na cakṣaṇam
rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṁ virāmamupagacchati

translations.english: Neither for the night nor for the day, nor for a moment did the fight between Rāma and Rāvaņa cease.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ संस्मारयामास राघवं मातलिस्तदा
अजानन्निव किं वीर त्वमेनमनुवर्तसे
verses.transliteration:
atha saṁsmārayāmāsa rāghavaṁ mātalistadā
ajānanniva kiṁ vīra tvamenamanuvartase

translations.english: Thereupon Mätali reminding him, spoke to Rāghava, Why did you, o hero, as if not knowing, fear him?

verses.sanskrit:
विसृजास्मै वधाय त्वमस्त्रं पैतामहं प्रभो
विनाशकालः कथितो यः सुरैः सोऽद्य वर्तते
verses.transliteration:
visṛjāsmai vadhāya tvamastraṁ paitāmahaṁ prabho
vināśakālaḥ kathito yaḥ suraiḥ so'dya vartate

translations.english: Do you, O lord, discharge at him the weapon obtained from the great Patriarch. The time for (his) destruction, as described by the celestials, has arrived.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः संस्मारितो रामस्तेन वाक्येन मातलेः
जग्राह स शरं दीप्तं निश्वसन्तमिवोरगम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ saṁsmārito rāmastena vākyena mātaleḥ
jagrāha sa śaraṁ dīptaṁ niśvasantamivoragam

translations.english: Being reminded by those words of Mätali, Rāma took up the flaming shaft breathing as if like a serpent.

verses.sanskrit:
यमस्मै प्रथमं प्रादादगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः
ब्रह्मदत्तं महद्बाणममोघं युधि वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
yamasmai prathamaṁ prādādagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ
brahmadattaṁ mahadbāṇamamoghaṁ yudhi vīryavān

translations.english: The great Rși Agastya first conferred this upon him. This is a huge and dreadful shaft given by Brahma and highly useful in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा
दत्तं सुरपतेः पूर्वं त्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ pūrvamindrārthamamitaujasā
dattaṁ surapateḥ pūrvaṁ trilokajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: It was made by Brahmä of undecaying prowess for Indra and conferred by him upon the lord of celestials desirous of acquiring victory.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य वाजेषु पवनः फले पावकभास्करौ
शरीरमाकाशमयं गौरवे मेरुमन्दरौ
verses.transliteration:
yasya vājeṣu pavanaḥ phale pāvakabhāskarau
śarīramākāśamayaṁ gaurave merumandarau

translations.english: In its wings there is wind, in its head there is fire and the Sun, in its body there is the sky and in its weight there are the Chill) Meru and Mandara.

verses.sanskrit:
जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा सुपुङ्खं हेमभूषितम्
तेजसा सर्वभूतानां कृतं भास्करवर्चसं
verses.transliteration:
jājvalyamānaṁ vapuṣā supuṅkhaṁ hemabhūṣitam
tejasā sarvabhūtānāṁ kṛtaṁ bhāskaravarcasaṁ

translations.english: It is resplendent by its own lustre, well feathered and adorned with gold-made of the essence of all objects and bright as the rays of the Sun. It is like the fire of dissolution enveloped in smoke-like the flaming serpent, capable of piercing men, serpents and horses and was swift-coursing.

verses.sanskrit:
नन्दनं वानरेन्द्राणां रक्षसामवसादनम्
वाजितं विविधैर्वाजैश्चारुचित्रैर्गरुत्मतः
verses.transliteration:
nandanaṁ vānarendrāṇāṁ rakṣasāmavasādanam
vājitaṁ vividhairvājaiścārucitrairgarutmataḥ

translations.english: It is the enhancer of the monkey-leaders, joy and the repressor of the Rakşasas and is feathered like to a bird with many a picturesque wing.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुत्तमेषुं लोकानामिक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम्
द्विषतां कीर्तिहरणं प्रहर्षकरमात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
tamuttameṣuṁ lokānāmikṣvākubhayanāśanam
dviṣatāṁ kīrtiharaṇaṁ praharṣakaramātmanaḥ

translations.english: The highly powerful Rāma, consecrating in accordance with the mantras laid down in the Vedas, that huge shaft-the foremost of all in the world, removing the fear of the Ikşvaku race, destroying the fame of the enemies and conduction to the joy of its own party, set it on his bow.

verses.sanskrit:
स रावणाय संक्रुद्धो भृशमायम्य कार्मुकम्
चिक्षेप परमायत्तस्तं शरं मर्मघातिनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa rāvaṇāya saṁkruddho bhṛśamāyamya kārmukam
cikṣepa paramāyattastaṁ śaraṁ marmaghātinam

translations.english: And (Rāma) highly enraged, and greatly wary, suppressing (his breath) discharged that shaft at Ravana-piercing to the vitals.

verses.sanskrit:
स वज्र इव दुर्धर्षो वज्रबाहुविसर्जितः
कृतान्त इव चावार्यो न्यपतद्रावणोरसि
verses.transliteration:
sa vajra iva durdharṣo vajrabāhuvisarjitaḥ
kṛtānta iva cāvāryo nyapatadrāvaṇorasi

translations.english: (That Brahma weapon) irrepressible as the thunder, dreadful as the Death and discharged by Rama, fell down on Ravana's breast.

verses.sanskrit:
स विसृष्टो महावेगः शरीरान्तकरः शरः
बिभेद हृदयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
sa visṛṣṭo mahāvegaḥ śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ
bibheda hṛdayaṁ tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ

translations.english: That shaft, capable of bringing about death and gifted with velocity, when discharged, cleft the breast of the vicious-souled Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
रुधिराक्तः स वेगेन जीवितान्तकरः शरः
रावणस्य हरन्प्राणान्विवेश धरणीतलम्
verses.transliteration:
rudhirāktaḥ sa vegena jīvitāntakaraḥ śaraḥ
rāvaṇasya haranprāṇānviveśa dharaṇītalam

translations.english: That body-ending arrow bathed in blood stealing away the life of Råvana entered the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्द्रकृतच्छविः
कृतकर्मा निभृतवत्स्वतूणीं पुनराविशत्
verses.transliteration:
sa śaro rāvaṇaṁ hatvā rudhirārdrakṛtacchaviḥ
kṛtakarmā nibhṛtavatsvatūṇīṁ punarāviśat

translations.english: That shaft, slaying Răvaņa soaked in blood and successful, again entered the quiver* humbly. *In some texts there is "na punaravisat" i.e. did not enter the quiver.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य हस्ताद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं तत्ससायकम्
निपपात सह प्राणैर्भ्रश्यमानस्य जीवितात्
verses.transliteration:
tasya hastāddhatasyāśu kārmukaṁ tatsasāyakam
nipapāta saha prāṇairbhraśyamānasya jīvitāt

translations.english: And from his hand who was deprived of his life fell down instantly on earth his shafts and bow. v

verses.sanskrit:
गतासुर्भीमवेगस्तु नैरृतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः
पपात स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
gatāsurbhīmavegastu nairṛtendro mahādyutiḥ
papāta syandanādbhūmau vṛtro vajrahato yathā

translations.english: And fell down on the earth from the chariot, the highly effulgent Rāvaņa, gifted with dreadful velocity and shom of his life.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ हतशेषा निशाचराः
हतनाथा भयत्रस्ताः सर्वतः संप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā patitaṁ bhūmau hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ
hatanāthā bhayatrastāḥ sarvataḥ saṁpradudruvuḥ

translations.english: Beholding him thus fallen down, the remaining night-rangers, deprived of their lord and stricken with terror fled away to various quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
नर्दन्तश्चाभिपेतुस्तान्वानरा द्रुमयोधिनः
दशग्रीववधं दृष्ट्वा विजयं राघवस्य च
verses.transliteration:
nardantaścābhipetustānvānarā drumayodhinaḥ
daśagrīvavadhaṁ dṛṣṭvā vijayaṁ rāghavasya ca

translations.english: Beholding the destruction of the Ten-necked (demon) and the victory of Raghava, the monkeys fighting with trees, pursued them on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्दिता वानरैर्हृष्टैर्लङ्कामभ्यपतन्भयात्
हताश्रयत्वात्करुणैर्बाष्पप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः
verses.transliteration:
arditā vānarairhṛṣṭairlaṅkāmabhyapatanbhayāt
hatāśrayatvātkaruṇairbāṣpaprasravaṇairmukhaiḥ

translations.english: Being assailed by the monkeys and having their countenances full of tears in consequence of their lord being slain they fled away to Lankā in fear.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विनेदुः संहृष्टा वानरा जितकाशिनः
वदन्तो राघवजयं रावणस्य च तं वधम्
verses.transliteration:
tato vineduḥ saṁhṛṣṭā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ
vadanto rāghavajayaṁ rāvaṇasya ca taṁ vadham

translations.english: Thereupon the monkeys being greatly delighted roared out the victory of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदत्सौम्यस्त्रिदशदुन्दुभिः
दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुसुखो ववौ
verses.transliteration:
athāntarikṣe vyanadatsaumyastridaśadundubhiḥ
divyagandhavahastatra mārutaḥ susukho vavau

translations.english: The celestial bugle was sounded in the sky and there blew the excellent air carrying the celestial fragrance.

verses.sanskrit:
निपपातान्तरिक्षाच्च पुष्पवृष्टिस्तदा भुवि
किरन्ती राघवरथं दुरवापा मनोहराः
verses.transliteration:
nipapātāntarikṣācca puṣpavṛṣṭistadā bhuvi
kirantī rāghavarathaṁ duravāpā manoharāḥ

translations.english: Flowers were showered upon Rama's car which was covered therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता गगने च विशुश्रुवे
साधु साध्विति वागग्र्या देवतानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavastavasaṁyuktā gagane ca viśuśruve
sādhu sādhviti vāgagryā devatānāṁ mahātmanām

translations.english: The celestials in the sky began to chaunt the glory of Rāma and praise him.

verses.sanskrit:
आविवेश महान्हर्षो देवानां चारणैः सह
रावणे निहते रौद्रे सर्वलोकभयंकरे
verses.transliteration:
āviveśa mahānharṣo devānāṁ cāraṇaiḥ saha
rāvaṇe nihate raudre sarvalokabhayaṁkare

translations.english: And Ravana, the dread of all people, being slain, the celestials with the Cäraņas were greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च महाबलम्
चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sakāmaṁ sugrīvamaṅgadaṁ ca mahābalam
cakāra rāghavaḥ prīto hatvā rākṣasapuṁgavam

translations.english: And slaying that foremost of the Rākşasas Rāma satisfied the desire of Sugriva, Angada and Vibhisana.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा; दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभोऽभवत्
मही चकम्पे न च मारुता ववुः; स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prajagmuḥ praśamaṁ marudgaṇā; diśaḥ prasedurvimalaṁ nabho'bhavat
mahī cakampe na ca mārutā vavuḥ; sthiraprabhaścāpyabhavaddivākaraḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the celestials attained their peace, the quarters were delighted, the atmosphere was clear, calm air began to prevail all over the earth, and the Sun appeared in its full rays.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु सुग्रीवविभीषणादयः; सुहृद्विशेषाः सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा
समेत्य हृष्टा विजयेन राघवं; रणेऽभिरामं विधिनाभ्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
tatastu sugrīvavibhīṣaṇādayaḥ; suhṛdviśeṣāḥ sahalakṣmaṇāstadā
sametya hṛṣṭā vijayena rāghavaṁ; raṇe'bhirāmaṁ vidhinābhyapūjayan

translations.english: Thereupon Sugrīva Vibhișana and Lakşmaņa, welcomed Rāma, of unmitigated prowess singing his glory.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु निहतरिपुः स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः; स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे रराज
रघुकुलनृपनन्दनो महौजा;स्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो यथेन्द्रः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu nihataripuḥ sthirapratijñaḥ; svajanabalābhivṛto raṇe rarāja
raghukulanṛpanandano mahaujā;stridaśagaṇairabhisaṁvṛto yathendraḥ

translations.english: There appeared beautiful at the battle-field Rāma of firm promise, slaying his enemy and encircled by his army and friends like to the lord of the celestials surrounded by the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणं निहतं श्रुत्वा राघवेण महात्मना
अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतू राक्षस्यः शोककर्शिताः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
antaḥpurādviniṣpetū rākṣasyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ

translations.english: Beholding Rävaņa Slain by the high-souled Rāghava Räksasaees, stricken with grief, issued out of the inner appartments.

verses.sanskrit:
वार्यमाणाः सुबहुशो वृष्टन्त्यः क्षितिपांसुषु
विमुक्तकेश्यो दुःखार्ता गावो वत्सहता यथा
verses.transliteration:
vāryamāṇāḥ subahuśo vṛṣṭantyaḥ kṣitipāṁsuṣu
vimuktakeśyo duḥkhārtā gāvo vatsahatā yathā

translations.english: Stricken with grief and with dishevelled hairs they rolled in the dust albeit prevented again and again like to cows separated from their calves,

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरेण विनिष्क्रम्य द्वारेण सह राक्षसैः
प्रविश्यायोधनं घोरं विचिन्वन्त्यो हतं पतिम्
verses.transliteration:
uttareṇa viniṣkramya dvāreṇa saha rākṣasaiḥ
praviśyāyodhanaṁ ghoraṁ vicinvantyo hataṁ patim

translations.english: And coming out by the northern gate along with the Rakssas entering the dreadful arena of battle and searching their slain lord the shedemons cried piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
आर्यपुत्रेति वादिन्यो हा नाथेति च सर्वशः
परिपेतुः कबन्धाङ्कां महीं शोणितकर्दमाम्
verses.transliteration:
āryaputreti vādinyo hā nātheti ca sarvaśaḥ
paripetuḥ kabandhāṅkāṁ mahīṁ śoṇitakardamām

translations.english: O lord, O husband, O our all" and moved along the battle field soaked in blood and filled with headless corpses.

verses.sanskrit:
ता बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यो भर्तृशोकपराजिताः
करेण्व इव नर्दन्त्यो विनेदुर्हतयूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
tā bāṣpaparipūrṇākṣyo bhartṛśokaparājitāḥ
kareṇva iva nardantyo vinedurhatayūthapāḥ

translations.english: With eyes full of tears and overwhelmed with the grief of their husband they began to move about like she-elephants without the lord of their herd.

verses.sanskrit:
ददृशुस्ता महाकायं महावीर्यं महाद्युतिम्
रावणं निहतं भूमौ नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्
verses.transliteration:
dadṛśustā mahākāyaṁ mahāvīryaṁ mahādyutim
rāvaṇaṁ nihataṁ bhūmau nīlāñjanacayopamam

translations.english: Thereupon they beheld there on the earth the huge-bodied and the highly powerful and effulgent Rävaņa slain like red collyrium.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः पतिं सहसा दृष्ट्वा शयानं रणपांसुषु
निपेतुस्तस्य गात्रेषु छिन्ना वनलता इव
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ patiṁ sahasā dṛṣṭvā śayānaṁ raṇapāṁsuṣu
nipetustasya gātreṣu chinnā vanalatā iva

translations.english: Beholding their lord lying down on the battlefield they all fell on his body like creepers tom assunder.

verses.sanskrit:
बहुमानात्परिष्वज्य काचिदेनं रुरोद ह
चरणौ काचिदालिङ्ग्य काचित्कण्ठेऽवलम्ब्य च
verses.transliteration:
bahumānātpariṣvajya kācidenaṁ ruroda ha
caraṇau kācidāliṅgya kācitkaṇṭhe'valambya ca

translations.english: Some wept embracing him respectfullysome holding his feet and some placing themselves around his neck.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्धृत्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ स्म परिवर्तते
हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
uddhṛtya ca bhujau kācidbhūmau sma parivartate
hatasya vadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā kācinmohamupāgamat

translations.english: And some taking up his hand rolled on the ground and some were beside themselves (with grief) beholding the slain (Ravana's) countenance.

verses.sanskrit:
काचिदङ्के शिरः कृत्वा रुरोद मुखमीक्षती
स्नापयन्ती मुखं बाष्पैस्तुषारैरिव पङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration:
kācidaṅke śiraḥ kṛtvā ruroda mukhamīkṣatī
snāpayantī mukhaṁ bāṣpaistuṣārairiva paṅkajam

translations.english: And some placing her head on his lap, and beholding his face, wept, bathing it with tears like a lotus enveloped with snow.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमार्ताः पतिं दृष्ट्वा रावणं निहतं भुवि
चुक्रुशुर्बहुधा शोकाद्भूयस्ताः पर्यदेवयन्
verses.transliteration:
evamārtāḥ patiṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṁ nihataṁ bhuvi
cukruśurbahudhā śokādbhūyastāḥ paryadevayan

translations.english: Seeing their husband Rāvaņa thus slain on the earth, they stricken with grief bewailing again and again in sorrow, wept profusely.

verses.sanskrit:
येन वित्रासितः शक्रो येन वित्रासितो यमः
येन वैश्रवणो राजा पुष्पकेण वियोजितः
verses.transliteration:
yena vitrāsitaḥ śakro yena vitrāsito yamaḥ
yena vaiśravaṇo rājā puṣpakeṇa viyojitaḥ

translations.english: He by whom the king Vaisrabana was deprived of his flower car, who terrified the high-souled Gandharvas, ascetics and the celestials in battle field, who did not know of any fear from the Asuras, celestials, and the Pannagas, has now been overpowered by a man.

verses.sanskrit:
अवध्यो देवतानां यस्तथा दानवरक्षसाम्
हतः सोऽयं रणे शेते मानुषेण पदातिना
verses.transliteration:
avadhyo devatānāṁ yastathā dānavarakṣasām
hataḥ so'yaṁ raṇe śete mānuṣeṇa padātinā

translations.english: He whom the celestials, the Dānvas and the Rākşasa could not slay, has been slain in conflict by a man walking on foot.

verses.sanskrit:
यो न शक्यः सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा
सोऽयं कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो मृत्युं मर्त्येन लम्भितः
verses.transliteration:
yo na śakyaḥ surairhantuṁ na yakṣairnāsuraistathā
so'yaṁ kaścidivāsattvo mṛtyuṁ martyena lambhitaḥ

translations.english: He, who was incapable of being killed by the celestials, Yaksas and Asuras, has met with death like one devoid of prowess at the hands of a mortal.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं वदन्त्यो बहुधा रुरुदुस्तस्य ताः स्त्रियः
भूय एव च दुःखार्ता विलेपुश्च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vadantyo bahudhā rurudustasya tāḥ striyaḥ
bhūya eva ca duḥkhārtā vilepuśca punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Speaking in this wise, the she-demons, over powered with sorrow wept and bewailed again and again (saying).

verses.sanskrit:
अशृण्वता तु सुहृदां सततं हितवादिनाम्
एताः सममिदानीं ते वयमात्मा च पातिताः
verses.transliteration:
aśṛṇvatā tu suhṛdāṁ satataṁ hitavādinām
etāḥ samamidānīṁ te vayamātmā ca pātitāḥ

translations.english: Not hearing (the counsels) of your friends, always pointing out your welfare, you did bring Sītā, for your destruction as well as that of the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रुवाणोऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विभीषणः
धृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वयात्मवधकाङ्क्षिणा
verses.transliteration:
bruvāṇo'pi hitaṁ vākyamiṣṭo bhrātā vibhīṣaṇaḥ
dhṛṣṭaṁ paruṣito mohāttvayātmavadhakāṅkṣiṇā

translations.english: Although your brother Vibhīşana addressed you with words pregnant with your welfare-you, for your own destruction, out of your misgivings, did excite his anger and have (now) seen (the result thereof).

verses.sanskrit:
यदि निर्यातिता ते स्यात्सीता रामाय मैथिली
न नः स्याद्व्यसनं घोरमिदं मूलहरं महत्
verses.transliteration:
yadi niryātitā te syātsītā rāmāya maithilī
na naḥ syādvyasanaṁ ghoramidaṁ mūlaharaṁ mahat

translations.english: Have you returned Sītā the daughter of the king of Mithilā to Råma, this mighty and dreadful disaster, destroying the very root, would not have befallen us.

verses.sanskrit:
वृत्तकामो भवेद्भ्राता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत्
वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः
verses.transliteration:
vṛttakāmo bhavedbhrātā rāmo mitrakulaṁ bhavet
vayaṁ cāvidhavāḥ sarvāḥ sakāmā na ca śatravaḥ

translations.english: Rāma's desire would have been encompassed his friends would have been successful (through Vibhīşaņa) we would not been widowed and out enemies would not have got their desires fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया पुनर्नृशंसेन सीतां संरुन्धता बलात्
राक्षसा वयमात्मा च त्रयं तुलं निपातितम्
verses.transliteration:
tvayā punarnṛśaṁsena sītāṁ saṁrundhatā balāt
rākṣasā vayamātmā ca trayaṁ tulaṁ nipātitam

translations.english: By there, Sītā was kept by force in captivity in a ruthless manner, and the Rākşasas, ourselves and yourself-all three equally have been slain.

verses.sanskrit:
न कामकारः कामं वा तव राक्षसपुंगव
दैवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतं दैवेन हन्यते
verses.transliteration:
na kāmakāraḥ kāmaṁ vā tava rākṣasapuṁgava
daivaṁ ceṣṭayate sarvaṁ hataṁ daivena hanyate

translations.english: O foremost of the Rākşasas, forsooth this is not your own folly-it is Accident that unite all things and it is accident again that bring about destrucion.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराणां विनाशोऽयं राक्षसानां च ते रणे
तव चैव महाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः
verses.transliteration:
vānarāṇāṁ vināśo'yaṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca te raṇe
tava caiva mahābāho daivayogādupāgataḥ

translations.english: O you of huge arms-the destruction of the monkeys and the Rākşasas as well as that of yourself has been brought about by Accident.

verses.sanskrit:
नैवार्थेन न कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया
शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता
verses.transliteration:
naivārthena na kāmena vikrameṇa na cājñayā
śakyā daivagatirloke nivartayitumudyatā

translations.english: When the course of accident is about to bring about result-wealth, desire, prowess or command-nothing is capable of with standing it.

verses.sanskrit:
विलेपुरेवं दीनास्ता राक्षसाधिपयोषितः
कुरर्य इव दुःखार्ता बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः
verses.transliteration:
vilepurevaṁ dīnāstā rākṣasādhipayoṣitaḥ
kurarya iva duḥkhārtā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ

translations.english: Thus wept piteously the wives of the lord of Rakşasas like to so many she-elephants-rendered poorly, stricken with grief and with tears in their eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां विलपमानानां तथा राक्षसयोषिताम्
ज्येष्ठा पत्नी प्रिया दीना भर्तारं समुदैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ vilapamānānāṁ tathā rākṣasayoṣitām
jyeṣṭhā patnī priyā dīnā bhartāraṁ samudaikṣata

translations.english: The foremost of the wives of the Rākşasas (king) bewailing piteously cast her looks poorly towards her husband. And beholding her Tennecked husband slain by Rāma of Inconceivable actions Mandodarī bewailed there piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
ननु नाम महाबाहो तव वैश्रवणानुज
क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं त्रस्यत्यपि पुरंदरः
verses.transliteration:
nanu nāma mahābāho tava vaiśravaṇānuja
kruddhasya pramukhe sthātuṁ trasyatyapi puraṁdaraḥ

translations.english: O you of huge arms! O younger brother of Baishravana! Even Purandara feared to stand before you when enraged.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषयश्च महीदेवा गन्धर्वाश्च यशस्विनः
ननु नाम तवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्च दिशो गताः
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣayaśca mahīdevā gandharvāśca yaśasvinaḥ
nanu nāma tavodvegāccāraṇāśca diśo gatāḥ

translations.english: The great Rşis-the far-famed Gandharvas and the charanas, fled away to different quarters in your fear.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं मानुषमात्रेण रामेण युधि निर्जितः
न व्यपत्रपसे राजन्किमिदं राक्षसर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ mānuṣamātreṇa rāmeṇa yudhi nirjitaḥ
na vyapatrapase rājankimidaṁ rākṣasarṣabha

translations.english: Then (how) have you been overpowered in battle by Rāma who is a mere man? Why is it that you are not ashamed of it, О king, O lord of the Raksasas?

verses.sanskrit:
कथं त्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्य श्रिया वीर्येण चान्वितम्
अविषह्यं जघान त्वां मानुषो वनगोचरः
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ trailokyamākramya śriyā vīryeṇa cānvitam
aviṣahyaṁ jaghāna tvāṁ mānuṣo vanagocaraḥ

translations.english: Conquering the three worlds with your prowess you did attain your glory; and it is unbearable, that a man, ranging in the forest, has slain you.

verses.sanskrit:
मानुषाणामविषये चरतः कामरूपिणः
विनाशस्तव रामेण संयुगे नोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration:
mānuṣāṇāmaviṣaye carataḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
vināśastava rāmeṇa saṁyuge nopapadyate

translations.english: You who are capable of assuming shapes at will have been slain in conflict by Rāma, in the city of Lankā unapproachable by men.

verses.sanskrit:
न चैतत्कर्म रामस्य श्रद्दधामि चमूमुखे
सर्वतः समुपेतस्य तव तेनाभिमर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
na caitatkarma rāmasya śraddadhāmi camūmukhe
sarvataḥ samupetasya tava tenābhimarśanam

translations.english: I do not believe that your destruction, who had always been crowned with success, before the forces, is work of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रियाणि पुरा जित्वा जितं त्रिभुवणं त्वया
स्मरद्भिरिव तद्वैरमिन्द्रियैरेव निर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
indriyāṇi purā jitvā jitaṁ tribhuvaṇaṁ tvayā
smaradbhiriva tadvairamindriyaireva nirjitaḥ

translations.english: Subduing all your passions, you did conquer the three worlds-remembering their grudge they have now over powered you.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा रामरूपेण वासवः स्वयमागतः
मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम्
verses.transliteration:
atha vā rāmarūpeṇa vāsavaḥ svayamāgataḥ
māyāṁ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām

translations.english: (Methinks) Death (himself) came there in the shape of Rāma and spread illusions unconsciously for your destruction, O you of great strength.

verses.sanskrit:
यदैव हि जनस्थाने राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
खरस्तव हतो भ्राता तदैवासौ न मानुषः
verses.transliteration:
yadaiva hi janasthāne rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ
kharastava hato bhrātā tadaivāsau na mānuṣaḥ

translations.english: Rāma is not a man since he slew at Janasthāna your brother Khara encircied by many a Rāks asas.

verses.sanskrit:
यदैव नगरीं लङ्कां दुष्प्रवेषां सुरैरपि
प्रविष्टो हनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम्
verses.transliteration:
yadaiva nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ duṣpraveṣāṁ surairapi
praviṣṭo hanumānvīryāttadaiva vyathitā vayam

translations.english: We were sore-distressed when Hanuman, by his own prowess, entered the city of Lanka incapable of being approached even by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रियतामविरोधश्च राघवेणेति यन्मया
उच्यमानो न गृह्णासि तस्येयं व्युष्टिरागता
verses.transliteration:
kriyatāmavirodhaśca rāghaveṇeti yanmayā
ucyamāno na gṛhṇāsi tasyeyaṁ vyuṣṭirāgatā

translations.english: I prevented you from creating enmity with Rāghava but you did not pay heed to my words and this is the result (thereof).

verses.sanskrit:
अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टां तां रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते
सीतां धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
arundhatyā viśiṣṭāṁ tāṁ rohiṇyāścāpi durmate
sītāṁ dharṣayatā mānyāṁ tvayā hyasadṛśaṁ kṛtam

translations.english: O foremost of Rākşasas-0 you of a vicious understanding, for the destruction of your wealth yourself and your relatives, you did suddenly cherish amour for Sitā, greater than-Yeven) Arundhati and Rohiņi. Forsooth you did perpetrated an unbecoming deed by distressing the adorable Sitā ever devoted to her lord, an earth* even to Earth herself and a Śrī (Śrt is the goddess of wealth and good fortune-but Sitā is more fortunate than fortune herself-) even to Śrī herself. *The Earth is an emblem of patience but Sítā is more patient than the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येन मैथिली
मयाधिका वा तुल्या वा त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
na kulena na rūpeṇa na dākṣiṇyena maithilī
mayādhikā vā tulyā vā tvaṁ tu mohānna budhyase

translations.english: Maithili is not my equal nor superior either in birth, beauty or accomplishments, but you did not perceive this by your misgivings.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः
तव तावदयं मृत्युर्मैथिलीकृतलक्षणः
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā sarvabhūtānāṁ nāsti mṛtyuralakṣaṇaḥ
tava tāvadayaṁ mṛtyurmaithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Death does not always visit all men without any cause-and Maithili is the cause of the death.

verses.sanskrit:
मैथिली सह रामेण विशोका विहरिष्यति
अल्पपुण्या त्वहं घोरे पतिता शोकसागरे
verses.transliteration:
maithilī saha rāmeṇa viśokā vihariṣyati
alpapuṇyā tvahaṁ ghore patitā śokasāgare

translations.english: And death, in consequence of Maithili, has taken you far away. And she, shorn of all sorrow, shall enjoy in the company of Rāma, and I, of limited piety, am now sunk in the ocean of grief.

verses.sanskrit:
विमानेनानुरूपेण या याम्यतुलया श्रिया
पश्यन्ती विविधान्देशांस्तांस्तांश्चित्रस्रगम्बरा
भ्रंशिता कामभोगेभ्यः सास्मि वीरवधात्तव
verses.transliteration:
vimānenānurūpeṇa yā yāmyatulayā śriyā
paśyantī vividhāndeśāṁstāṁstāṁścitrasragambarā
bhraṁśitā kāmabhogebhyaḥ sāsmi vīravadhāttava

translations.english: Roaming at large with you in a car unequalled in beauty on the hill Kailāsa Mandara, Meru, in the garden of Caitraratha and all other celestial gardens, beholding many a country, wearing variegated clothes and garlands, I have been deprived of all pleasures and enjoyments, O hero, by your death.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यवाक्स महाभागो देवरो मे यदब्रवीत्
अयं राक्षसमुख्यानां विनाशः पर्युपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
satyavāksa mahābhāgo devaro me yadabravīt
ayaṁ rākṣasamukhyānāṁ vināśaḥ paryupasthitaḥ

translations.english: Beholding the daughter of the king of Mithila brought (in the city of Lanka) what, your younger brother Vibhīşaņa, thinking and sighing, said has now proved true, O you of long-arms.

verses.sanskrit:
कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन व्यसनेन प्रसङ्गिना
त्वया कृतमिदं सर्वमनाथं रक्षसां कुलम्
verses.transliteration:
kāmakrodhasamutthena vyasanena prasaṅginā
tvayā kṛtamidaṁ sarvamanāthaṁ rakṣasāṁ kulam

translations.english: This destruction of the leading Rākṣasas has proceeded from the disaster arising from your anger and lust. For your (vicious) deeds all our good fortune is lost-(and from them) has proceeded the great disaster exterminating the race. And by you all the Raksasa families have been deprived of their lords.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि त्वं शोचितव्यो मे प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः
स्त्रीस्वभावात्तु मे बुद्धिः कारुण्ये परिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
na hi tvaṁ śocitavyo me prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ
strīsvabhāvāttu me buddhiḥ kāruṇye parivartate

translations.english: You well-known for your strength and manliness, are not worthy of being grieved by me. On account of my effeminate nature my understanding is possessed by sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः
आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration:
sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ ca tvaṁ gṛhītvā svāṁ gatiṁ gataḥ
ātmānamanuśocāmi tvadviyogena duḥkhitām

translations.english: Carrying your pious and iniquitous deeds you have attained to your own state-I am only lamenting for me who have been sorry for your destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
नीलजीमूतसंकाशः पीताम्बरशुभाङ्गदः
सर्वगात्राणि विक्षिप्य किं शेषे रुधिराप्लुतः
प्रसुप्त इव शोकार्तां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे
verses.transliteration:
nīlajīmūtasaṁkāśaḥ pītāmbaraśubhāṅgadaḥ
sarvagātrāṇi vikṣipya kiṁ śeṣe rudhirāplutaḥ
prasupta iva śokārtāṁ kiṁ māṁ na pratibhāṣase

translations.english: O you resembling the red clouds O you wearing yellow cloth and excellent Angada, stretching your person on the ground why are you in the long run bathed in blood? Why did you not like one asleep welcome me who am stricken with grief?

verses.sanskrit:
महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः
यातुधानस्य दौहित्रीं किं त्वं मां नाभ्युदीक्षसे
verses.transliteration:
mahāvīryasya dakṣasya saṁyugeṣvapalāyinaḥ
yātudhānasya dauhitrīṁ kiṁ tvaṁ māṁ nābhyudīkṣase

translations.english: I am the grand-daughter of the highly powerful Rākşasa Sumālī who never flies away from the field of battle; why did you not welcome me.

verses.sanskrit:
धिगस्तु हृदयं यस्या ममेदं न सहस्रधा
त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने फलते शोकपीडितम्
verses.transliteration:
dhigastu hṛdayaṁ yasyā mamedaṁ na sahasradhā
tvayi pañcatvamāpanne phalate śokapīḍitam

translations.english: Why did you lie on the battle-field embracing her like your beloved spouse? Why did you not wish tr welcome me like one not beloved to you? Ok fie on this heart of mine which is not sundered into thousand (pieces) albeit distressed with the grief of your death!

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह
संस्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रियश्चैता निवर्तय
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha
saṁskāraḥ kriyatāṁ bhrātuḥ striyaścaitā nivartaya

translations.english: In the meantime Rama said to Vibhrsana, “Do you perform the funeral ceremonies of your brother and console his wives."

verses.sanskrit:
तं प्रश्रितस्ततो रामं श्रुतवाक्यो विभीषणः
विमृश्य बुद्ध्या धर्मज्ञो धर्मार्थसहितं वचः
रामस्यैवानुवृत्त्यर्थमुत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
taṁ praśritastato rāmaṁ śrutavākyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
vimṛśya buddhyā dharmajño dharmārthasahitaṁ vacaḥ
rāmasyaivānuvṛttyarthamuttaraṁ pratyabhāṣata

translations.english: Where to the intelligent Vibhīşaņa replied with the following words-pointing out wealth and Piety, and judging by his understanding what is proper.

verses.sanskrit:
त्यक्तधर्मव्रतं क्रूरं नृशंसमनृतं तथा
नाहमर्होऽस्मि संस्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शकम्
verses.transliteration:
tyaktadharmavrataṁ krūraṁ nṛśaṁsamanṛtaṁ tathā
nāhamarho'smi saṁskartuṁ paradārābhimarśakam

translations.english: "I do not think it proper to perform his cremation ceremony who had renounced all pious deeds was wicked cruel, liar and who had ravished others' wives.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातृरूपो हि मे शत्रुरेष सर्वाहिते रतः
रावणो नार्हते पूजां पूज्योऽपि गुरुगौरवात्
verses.transliteration:
bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrureṣa sarvāhite rataḥ
rāvaṇo nārhate pūjāṁ pūjyo'pi gurugauravāt

translations.english: He is my enemy in the shape of a brother ever engaged in doing injury to others and Rāvana is not worthy of my adoration albeit he is adorable by virtue of his being my elder brother.

verses.sanskrit:
नृशंस इति मां राम वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि
श्रुत्वा तस्य गुणान्सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
nṛśaṁsa iti māṁ rāma vakṣyanti manujā bhuvi
śrutvā tasya guṇānsarve vakṣyanti sukṛtaṁ punaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, perhaps people of this earth will call me cruel but they will again recognise my act as good when they will hear of his vicious deeds.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
विभीषणमुवाचेदं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्
