verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā paramaprīto rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ
vibhīṣaṇamuvācedaṁ vākyajño vākyakovidam

translations.english: Hearing those words, Rāma, the foremost of the pious and conversant with the skill of speech greatly delighted, spoke to Vibhisana (equally) skilled in speech.

verses.sanskrit:
तवापि मे प्रियं कार्यं त्वत्प्रभवाच्च मे जितम्
अवश्यं तु क्षमं वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
tavāpi me priyaṁ kāryaṁ tvatprabhavācca me jitam
avaśyaṁ tu kṣamaṁ vācyo mayā tvaṁ rākṣaseśvara

translations.english: It behove me to encompass your welfare since by your help I have gained the victory. I lord of Räkșasas, forsooth, you should hear my wellmeaning words.

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्मानृतसंयुक्तः काममेष निशाचरः
तेजस्वी बलवाञ्शूरः संग्रामेषु च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration:
adharmānṛtasaṁyuktaḥ kāmameṣa niśācaraḥ
tejasvī balavāñśūraḥ saṁgrāmeṣu ca nityaśaḥ

translations.english: Although this night-ranger perpetrated many vicious and impious deeds still he was ever powerful, heroic and strong in warfare.

verses.sanskrit:
शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः
महात्मा बलसंपन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः
verses.transliteration:
śatakratumukhairdevaiḥ śrūyate na parājitaḥ
mahātmā balasaṁpanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: I have heard that this high-souled Ravana, gifted with strength and a dread to all people was not defeated (even) by the celestials headed by the performer of hundred sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम्
क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव
verses.transliteration:
maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṁ naḥ prayojanam
kriyatāmasya saṁskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava

translations.english: With death our enmity has terminated and our object has been accomplished: he is as dear to me as to you: perform (therefore) his funeral rites.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वत्सकाशान्महाबाहो संस्कारं विधिपूर्वकम्
क्षिप्रमर्हति धर्मज्ञ त्वं यशोभाग्भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
tvatsakāśānmahābāho saṁskāraṁ vidhipūrvakam
kṣipramarhati dharmajña tvaṁ yaśobhāgbhaviṣyasi

translations.english: O you of long-arms it behove the to perform speedily with due rites and religious ceremonies his funeral ceremony-you shall be the object of praise (to people).

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः
संस्कारेणानुरूपेण योजयामास रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
saṁskāreṇānurūpeṇa yojayāmāsa rāvaṇam

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāghava, Vibhīşaņa hastened on and began to make arrangements for the cremation of his slain brother Råvana.

verses.sanskrit:
स ददौ पावकं तस्य विधियुक्तं विभीषणः
ताः स्त्रियोऽनुनयामास सान्त्वमुक्त्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
sa dadau pāvakaṁ tasya vidhiyuktaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
tāḥ striyo'nunayāmāsa sāntvamuktvā punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Vibhīşaņa according to due rites put fire to his (funeral pyre). Bathing and with wetted cloth, offering duly linseed and sacrificial grass mixed with water and consoling (Ravana's) wives again and again, he entreated them to go back.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविष्टासु च सर्वासु राक्षसीषु विभीषणः
रामपार्श्वमुपागम्य तदातिष्ठद्विनीतवत्
verses.transliteration:
praviṣṭāsu ca sarvāsu rākṣasīṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ
rāmapārśvamupāgamya tadātiṣṭhadvinītavat

translations.english: They then entered the city. And those damsels having entered the city, Vibhisana, the lord of Rākşasas, approaching Rāma, stood by his side gently.

verses.sanskrit:
रामोऽपि सह सैन्येन ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः
हर्षं लेभे रिपुं हत्वा यथा वृत्रं शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration:
rāmo'pi saha sainyena sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ
harṣaṁ lebhe ripuṁ hatvā yathā vṛtraṁ śatakratuḥ

translations.english: Rāma too, along with his army, Sugrīva and Lakşmana, was greatly delighted after slaying (the demon) Vitra.

verses.sanskrit:
ते रावणवधं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वदानवाः
जग्मुस्तैस्तैर्विमानैः स्वैः कथयन्तः शुभाः कथाः
verses.transliteration:
te rāvaṇavadhaṁ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvadānavāḥ
jagmustaistairvimānaiḥ svaiḥ kathayantaḥ śubhāḥ kathāḥ

translations.english: Beholding the destruction of Rāvaņa the celestials, Gandharvas and Dänavas ascending their respective cars went away chanting this excellent theme.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य वधं घोरं राघवस्य पराक्रमम्
सुयुद्धं वानराणां च सुग्रीवस्य च मन्त्रितम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya vadhaṁ ghoraṁ rāghavasya parākramam
suyuddhaṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sugrīvasya ca mantritam

translations.english: Talking of Rāvana's dreadful destruction, Raghava's prowess, the excellent warfare of the monkeys, the counsels of Sugrīva, the devotion and prowess of the Wind-God's son and Lakşmaņa and Sītā's devotion to her husband, those high souled ones, delighted, repaired to their respective quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्तु रथं दिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तं शिखिप्रभम्
अनुज्ञाय महाभागो मातलिं प्रत्यपूजयत्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavastu rathaṁ divyamindradattaṁ śikhiprabham
anujñāya mahābhāgo mātaliṁ pratyapūjayat

translations.english: Rāghava, having long arms, permitting the charioteer Mātali to take back the celestial car bright as the sky sent by Indra, honoured him greatly.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः
दिव्यं तं रथमास्थाय दिवमेवारुरोह सः
verses.transliteration:
rāghaveṇābhyanujñāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ
divyaṁ taṁ rathamāsthāya divamevāruroha saḥ

translations.english: And being commanded by Rāghava Mātali, the charioteer of Sakra taking the celestial car, rose up in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तु दिवमारूढे सुरसारथिसत्तमे
राघवः परमप्रीतः सुग्रीवं परिषस्वजे
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstu divamārūḍhe surasārathisattame
rāghavaḥ paramaprītaḥ sugrīvaṁ pariṣasvaje

translations.english: That charioteer rising up into the celestial region, Rāghava, the foremost of car-warriors, greatly delighted, embraced Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
परिष्वज्य च सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणेनाभिवादितः
पूज्यमानो हरिश्रेष्ठैराजगाम बलालयम्
verses.transliteration:
pariṣvajya ca sugrīvaṁ lakṣmaṇenābhivāditaḥ
pūjyamāno hariśreṣṭhairājagāma balālayam

translations.english: Embracing Sugrīva, bowed to by Lakşmaņa and worshipped by the monkey he repaired to the camp of his soldiers.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणमिमं सौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय
अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च मम चैवोपकारिणम्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇamimaṁ saumya laṅkāyāmabhiṣecaya
anuraktaṁ ca bhaktaṁ ca mama caivopakāriṇam

translations.english: Thereupon Kakuthsha spoke to Lakşmaņa-the son of Sumitrā gifted with auspicious marks who was near him, "O gentle one, take this Vibhīşaņa to the city of Lankä ever devoted and attached to us, and who had done us good.

verses.sanskrit:
एष मे परमः कामो यदिमं रावणानुजम्
लङ्कायां सौम्य पश्येयमभिषिक्तं विभीषणम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo yadimaṁ rāvaṇānujam
laṅkāyāṁ saumya paśyeyamabhiṣiktaṁ vibhīṣaṇam

translations.english: This is my great desire that I may behold Vibhīşaņa the younger brother of Rāvana installed on the throne of Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राघवेण महात्मना
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु संहृष्टः सौवर्णं घटमाददे
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu saumitrī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
tathetyuktvā tu saṁhṛṣṭaḥ sauvarṇaṁ ghaṭamādade

translations.english: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Raghava, the son of Sumitra, saying, “So be it" and greatly delighted, brought a golden jar. And placing that jar at the hands of the lord of monkeys, that one, gifted with great energy, ordered them to bring water from the Ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
घटेन तेन सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम्
लङ्कायां रक्षसां मध्ये राजानं रामशासनात्
verses.transliteration:
ghaṭena tena saumitrirabhyaṣiñcadvibhīṣaṇam
laṅkāyāṁ rakṣasāṁ madhye rājānaṁ rāmaśāsanāt

translations.english: Taking that jar and placing him on an excellent seat Saumitri with that water sprinkled Vibhīşaņa as king of Lankā in the presence of all the Raksasas, at Rama' command. And (Laks maņa) encircled by friends sprinkling him according to rites laid down in the Vedas, all the Rākşasas, devoted to him, his counsellors and the monkeys attaining incomparable delight, sang the glory of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वाभिषिक्तं लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम्
राघवः परमां प्रीतिं जगाम सहलक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvābhiṣiktaṁ laṅkāyāṁ rākṣasendraṁ vibhīṣaṇam
rāghavaḥ paramāṁ prītiṁ jagāma sahalakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Beholding Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas installed in the city of Lankä, Räghava along with Lakşmaņa attained to an excess of delight.

verses.sanskrit:
स तद्राज्यं महत्प्राप्य रामदत्तं विभीषणः
प्रकृतीः सान्त्वयित्वा च ततो राममुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tadrājyaṁ mahatprāpya rāmadattaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
prakṛtīḥ sāntvayitvā ca tato rāmamupāgamat

translations.english: And consoling his subjects he went to Rāma. And the monkey citizens, delighted, brought him curd, fried grain, sweetmeats, fried paddy and flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षतान्मोदकाँल्लाजान्दिव्याः सुमनसस्तथा
आजह्रुरथ संहृष्टाः पौरास्तस्मै निशाचराः
verses.transliteration:
akṣatānmodakā̐llājāndivyāḥ sumanasastathā
ājahruratha saṁhṛṣṭāḥ paurāstasmai niśācarāḥ

translations.english: Taking all those things indicating auspiciousness, he, irrepressible and gifted with energy, conferred them upon Råghava and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतकार्यं समृद्धार्थं दृष्ट्वा रामो विभीषणम्
प्रतिजग्राह तत्सर्वं तस्यैव प्रियकाम्यया
verses.transliteration:
kṛtakāryaṁ samṛddhārthaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmo vibhīṣaṇam
pratijagrāha tatsarvaṁ tasyaiva priyakāmyayā

translations.english: Beholding Vibhīşaņa crowned with prosperity and success, Rāma accepted them all for his satisfaction.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शैलोपमं वीरं प्राञ्जलिं पार्श्वतः स्थितम्
अब्रवीद्राघवो वाक्यं हनूमन्तं प्लवंगमम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śailopamaṁ vīraṁ prāñjaliṁ pārśvataḥ sthitam
abravīdrāghavo vākyaṁ hanūmantaṁ plavaṁgamam

translations.english: Thereupon Rāma spoke to the heroic monkey Hanumān, resembling a mountain and standing before him humbly with folded hands saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुमान्य महाराजमिमं सौम्य विभीषणम्
प्रविश्य रावणगृहं विनयेनोपसृत्य च
verses.transliteration:
anumānya mahārājamimaṁ saumya vibhīṣaṇam
praviśya rāvaṇagṛhaṁ vinayenopasṛtya ca

translations.english: O gentle on obtaining permission from the king Bibhshana, do you enter the city of Lankā and enquire after Maithili's welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियमेतदुदाहृत्य मैथिल्यास्त्वं हरीश्वर
प्रतिगृह्य च संदेशमुपावर्तितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
priyametadudāhṛtya maithilyāstvaṁ harīśvara
pratigṛhya ca saṁdeśamupāvartitumarhasi

translations.english: Do you, O foremost of monkeys, inform Vaidehr of the destruction of Rāvana in conflict after communicating to her mine health as well as that of Lakşmaņa and Sugrīva. O lord of monkeys, it behove you to return with the tidings of Vaidehi after informing her of this pleasant news.

verses.sanskrit:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः
verses.transliteration:
iti pratisamādiṣṭo hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ

translations.english: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Maruta, worshipped of the night-rangers, entered the city of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
निभृतः प्रणतः प्रह्वः सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च
रामस्य वचनं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
nibhṛtaḥ praṇataḥ prahvaḥ so'bhigamyābhivādya ca
rāmasya vacanaṁ sarvamākhyātumupacakrame

translations.english: And beholding her gentle countenance, Hanumān, the best of monkeys, began to relate to her what Räma had said.

verses.sanskrit:
वैदेहि कुशली रामः ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः
कुशलं चाह सिद्धार्थो हतशत्रुररिंदमः
verses.transliteration:
vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ
kuśalaṁ cāha siddhārtho hataśatrurariṁdamaḥ

translations.english: O Vaidehī, it is all well with Rāma Sugrīva and Lakşmaņa. He has enquire after your welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणसहायेन रामेण हरिभिः सह
निहतो रावणो देवि लक्ष्मणस्य नयेन च
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇasahāyena rāmeṇa haribhiḥ saha
nihato rāvaṇo devi lakṣmaṇasya nayena ca

translations.english: He has accomplished his end subdving his enemies and his enemy is slain. O worshipful dame, the powerful Răvaņa has been slain by Rāma, helped by Vibhīşaņa and accompanied by the monkeys and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
मया ह्यलब्धनिद्रेण धृतेन तव निर्जये
प्रतिज्ञैषा विनिस्तीर्णा बद्ध्वा सेतुं महोदधौ
verses.transliteration:
mayā hyalabdhanidreṇa dhṛtena tava nirjaye
pratijñaiṣā vinistīrṇā baddhvā setuṁ mahodadhau

translations.english: (Rāma said), "For discomfiting your enemy a bridge was constructed over the sea by me who was determined and who didnot sleep (for days) and thus my promise has been fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit:
तदाश्वसिहि विश्वस्ता स्वगृहे परिवर्तसे
अयं चाभ्येति संहृष्टस्त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration:
tadāśvasihi viśvastā svagṛhe parivartase
ayaṁ cābhyeti saṁhṛṣṭastvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ

translations.english: Do you not be afraid for living in Rāvana's abode for I have placed at Vibhīşana's hands the sovereignty of Lanka. Do you be consoled thinking as if that you are living in your own house. To behold you, Vibhisana, delighted, shall soon proceed.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता समुत्पत्य सीता शशिनिभानना
प्रहर्षेणावरुद्धा सा व्याजहार न किंचन
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā samutpatya sītā śaśinibhānanā
praharṣeṇāvaruddhā sā vyājahāra na kiṁcana

translations.english: Being thus accosted the worshipful Sītā, having a moon-like countenance, and her voice choked in delight, could not utter any thing.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च हरिश्रेष्ठः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम्
किं त्वं चिन्तयसे देवि किं च मां नाभिभाषसे
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāmapratijalpatīm
kiṁ tvaṁ cintayase devi kiṁ ca māṁ nābhibhāṣase

translations.english: Beholding Sītā incapable of replying the foremost of monkeys said, “What are you thinking of O worshipful dame? Why are you not welcoming me?"

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता धर्मे व्यवस्थिता
अब्रवीत्परमप्रीता हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā hanumatā sītā dharme vyavasthitā
abravītparamaprītā harṣagadgadayā girā

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Hanuman Sītā, ever treading the paths of monkey, greatly delighted, replied with words suppressed by tears.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियमेतदुपश्रुत्य भर्तुर्विजयसंश्रितम्
प्रहर्षवशमापन्ना निर्वाक्यास्मि क्षणान्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
priyametadupaśrutya bharturvijayasaṁśritam
praharṣavaśamāpannā nirvākyāsmi kṣaṇāntaram

translations.english: Hearing this pleasant new concerning the victory of my husband-and being brought under the control of joy I am speechless for sometime.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि पश्यामि सदृशं चिन्तयन्ती प्लवंगम
मत्प्रियाख्यानकस्येह तव प्रत्यभिनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
na hi paśyāmi sadṛśaṁ cintayantī plavaṁgama
matpriyākhyānakasyeha tava pratyabhinandanam

translations.english: O monkey I do not perceive any such thing which I can confer upon you in return, for this pleasant news.

verses.sanskrit:
न च पश्यामि तत्सौम्य पृथिव्यामपि वानर
सदृशं मत्प्रियाख्याने तव दातुं भवेत्समम्
verses.transliteration:
na ca paśyāmi tatsaumya pṛthivyāmapi vānara
sadṛśaṁ matpriyākhyāne tava dātuṁ bhavetsamam

translations.english: I do see any such thing on this earth which can match your pleasant tidings and bestowing which upon you I may be happy.

verses.sanskrit:
हिरण्यं वा सुवर्णं वा रत्नानि विविधानि च
राज्यं वा त्रिषु लोकेषु नैतदर्हति भाषितुम्
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyaṁ vā suvarṇaṁ vā ratnāni vividhāni ca
rājyaṁ vā triṣu lokeṣu naitadarhati bhāṣitum

translations.english: Silver, gold, or diverse jewels or the kingdom of the three worlds-nothing is a becoming return for your speech.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवंगमः
प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu vaidehyā pratyuvāca plavaṁgamaḥ
pragṛhītāñjalirvākyaṁ sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi the monkeys replied-folding his hands with delight and stationed before Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
भर्तुः प्रियहिते युक्ते भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणि
स्निग्धमेवंविधं वाक्यं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम्
verses.transliteration:
bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇi
snigdhamevaṁvidhaṁ vākyaṁ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum

translations.english: O blameless damsel forsooth this excellent speech become you, who is ever engaged in the welfare of your husband and ever desirous of his victory. I do consider, O worshipful dame, these words of your, far greater than the wealth, jewels or even the sovereignty over the celestials. Forsooth I have gained the kingdom of the celestials and other things since I have beheld Rāma, slay his enemy. victorious and peaceful. Hearing those words of (Hanuman) Maithili the daughter of king Janaka spoke to the Wind-god's son far more excellent words.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षस्यो दारुणकथा वरमेतं प्रयच्छ मे
इच्छामि विविधैर्घातैर्हन्तुमेताः सुदारुणाः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varametaṁ prayaccha me
icchāmi vividhairghātairhantumetāḥ sudāruṇāḥ

translations.english: I desire to slay all these dreadful crooked, ugly she-demons having fearful eyes, meting out to them various punishment.

verses.sanskrit:
राजसंश्रयवश्यानां कुर्वतीनां पराज्ञया
विधेयानां च दासीनां कः कुप्येद्वानरोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
rājasaṁśrayavaśyānāṁ kurvatīnāṁ parājñayā
vidheyānāṁ ca dāsīnāṁ kaḥ kupyedvānarottama

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, why are you angry with these she-slaves, who subject as they are to the command of their lord, have done this in accordance with another's order. I or my adverse fortune and vicious deeds perpetrated in another birth I have been subject to such a plight and been suffering the consequence thereof. Do yon not speak thus, O you of huge arms. Such is the course of Fortune. Forsooth by my ill-luck I have met with (this misfortune).

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम्
दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला
verses.transliteration:
prāptavyaṁ tu daśāyogānmayaitaditi niścitam
dāsīnāṁ rāvaṇasyāhaṁ marṣayāmīha durbalā

translations.english: I forgive, out of pity, all these she-servants of Rāvaņa; they used to torture me at the command of that Raksasa.

verses.sanskrit:
आज्ञप्ता रावणेनैता राक्षस्यो मामतर्जयन्
हते तस्मिन्न कुर्युर्हि तर्जनं वानरोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
ājñaptā rāvaṇenaitā rākṣasyo māmatarjayan
hate tasminna kuryurhi tarjanaṁ vānarottama

translations.english: And he being slain they shall not repress me any longer, O son of the Wind-god.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं व्याघ्रसमीपे तु पुराणो धर्मसंहितः
ऋक्षेण गीतः श्लोको मे तं निबोध प्लवंगम
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṁhitaḥ
ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko me taṁ nibodha plavaṁgama

translations.english: Do you, O monkey, hear of a śloka, related in a Purana and pregnant with religious import, which was uttered by a boar to a tiger.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्सीतया वाक्यकोविदः
प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu hanumānsītayā vākyakovidaḥ
pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṁ rāmapatnīṁ yaśasvinīm

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Sītā, Hanumān, skilled in speech, spoke to the blameless Rama's spouse, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी
प्रतिसंदिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration:
yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī
pratisaṁdiśa māṁ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ

translations.english: You are the worthy spouse of Răma, religiously wedded and crowned with many qualities. Permit me, O worshipful dame, to proceed where Rāghava is.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा
अब्रवीद्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं वानरोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā
abravīddraṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ vānarottama

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Vaidehi, the daughter of king Janaka, said, “I wish to see my lord, ever fond of those who are devoted to him."

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्पवनात्मजः
हर्षयन्मैथिलीं वाक्यमुवाचेदं महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā hanumānpavanātmajaḥ
harṣayanmaithilīṁ vākyamuvācedaṁ mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: Hearing these words, the high-minded Hanumăn, the son of Maruta, pleasing Maithili said.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्णचन्द्राननं रामं द्रक्ष्यस्यार्ये सलक्ष्मणम्
स्थिरमित्रं हतामित्रं शचीव त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
pūrṇacandrānanaṁ rāmaṁ drakṣyasyārye salakṣmaṇam
sthiramitraṁ hatāmitraṁ śacīva tridaśeśvaram

translations.english: You shall behold Rama, having a countenance like the full moon, with Laksmana, surrounded by his friends and having his enemies slain as ſaci behold Indra the king of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
तामेवमुक्त्वा राजन्तीं सीतां साक्षादिव श्रियम्
आजगाम महावेगो हनूमान्यत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tāmevamuktvā rājantīṁ sītāṁ sākṣādiva śriyam
ājagāma mahāvego hanūmānyatra rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Addressing these words to Sītă appearing like Sree herself the highly effulgent Hanuman returned where Rāghava was.

verses.sanskrit:
स उवाच महाप्रज्ञमभिगम्य प्लवंगमः
रामं वचनमर्थज्ञो वरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्
verses.transliteration:
sa uvāca mahāprajñamabhigamya plavaṁgamaḥ
rāmaṁ vacanamarthajño varaṁ sarvadhanuṣmatām

translations.english: Thereupon bowing to Rāma, the foremost of bowmen, having eyes, resembling lotus-petals, the highly wise monkey said.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्निमित्तोऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां च फलोदयः
तां देवीं शोकसंतप्तां मैथिलीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
yannimitto'yamārambhaḥ karmaṇāṁ ca phalodayaḥ
tāṁ devīṁ śokasaṁtaptāṁ maithilīṁ draṣṭumarhasi

translations.english: It behove you now to see Maithili, stricken with grief for whom you did initiate all these works and the fruit whereof has now been attained.

verses.sanskrit:
सा हि शोकसमाविष्टा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा
मैथिली विजयं श्रुत्वा तव हर्षमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā
maithilī vijayaṁ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat

translations.english: Hearing of your victory Maithilī, possessed by grief and having eyes full of tears, expressed her desire to see you.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वकात्प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तो विश्वस्तया तया
भर्तारं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि कृतार्थं सहलक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvakātpratyayāccāhamukto viśvastayā tayā
bhartāraṁ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛtārthaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam

translations.english: I was told by her, confident of her previous trust, with profuse tears in her eyes, “I wish to see my husband."

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
अगच्छत्सहसा ध्यानमासीद्बाष्पपरिप्लुतः
verses.transliteration:
evamukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ
agacchatsahasā dhyānamāsīdbāṣpapariplutaḥ

translations.english: Being addressed by Hanuman Rāma the foremost of the pious being bathed in tears, engaged instantly in meditation. Thereupon sighing hard and casting his looks upon the ground he spoke to Vibhīşaņa resembling clouds, who was near him.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्याङ्गरागां वैदेहीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम्
इह सीतां शिरःस्नातामुपस्थापय माचिरम्
verses.transliteration:
divyāṅgarāgāṁ vaidehīṁ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām
iha sītāṁ śiraḥsnātāmupasthāpaya māciram

translations.english: Do you speedily bring Sītā here-the daughter of the king of Mithila-bathed, sprinkled with celestial pasted and adorned with celestial ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः
प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्त्रीभिः स्वाभिरचोदयत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
praviśyāntaḥpuraṁ sītāṁ strībhiḥ svābhiracodayat

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhişaņa hastened on and entering the inner apartment sent information to Sītă through the female attendants.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेही दिव्याभरणभूषिता
यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration:
divyāṅgarāgā vaidehī divyābharaṇabhūṣitā
yānamāroha bhadraṁ te bhartā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati

translations.english: O Vaidehi, may good betide you; sprinkled with celestial paste and adorned with celestials ornaments do you ascend this car: your husband wish to see you.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्
अस्नाता द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसाधिप
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu vaidehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam
asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ rākṣasādhipa

translations.english: Being thus addressed Vaidehi replied to Vibhisana, “O lord of Raksasas, without bathing even I wish to see my husband."

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः
यथाह रामो भर्ता ते तत्तथा कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
yathāha rāmo bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi

translations.english: Hearing those words VibhIşaņa replied, "It behove you to do what your lord Rama has said." on a

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली भर्तृदेवता
भर्तृभक्तिव्रता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā maithilī bhartṛdevatā
bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvī tatheti pratyabhāṣata

translations.english: Whereto the chaste maithilee, regarding her husband as God and filled with devotion to her husband, replied saying "so be it."

verses.sanskrit:
आरोप्य शिबिकां दीप्तां परार्ध्याम्बरसंवृताम्
रक्षोभिर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
āropya śibikāṁ dīptāṁ parārdhyāmbarasaṁvṛtām
rakṣobhirbahubhirguptāmājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon placing Sta, bathed, performing the due rites wearing valuable clothes and adorned with valuable ornaments, palanquin, carried by many a capable Rākşasa, brought her (to Rama).

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं ज्ञात्वाभिध्यानमास्थितम्
प्रणतश्च प्रहृष्टश्च प्राप्तां सीतां न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
so'bhigamya mahātmānaṁ jñātvābhidhyānamāsthitam
praṇataśca prahṛṣṭaśca prāptāṁ sītāṁ nyavedayat

translations.english: Thereupon approaching the high-souled Rama, who, bearing informed of (Vibhisana's approach) was engaged in meditation, Vibhīşaņa bowing down and delighted communicated to him the arrival of Sită.

verses.sanskrit:
तामागतामुपश्रुत्य रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम्
हर्षो दैन्यं च रोषश्च त्रयं राघवमाविशत्
verses.transliteration:
tāmāgatāmupaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām
harṣo dainyaṁ ca roṣaśca trayaṁ rāghavamāviśat

translations.english: Hearing of her arrival who had lived long in the abode of the Raksasas Rāghava, the slayer of enemies attained (simultaneously) to anger, delight and depression.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पार्श्वगतं दृष्ट्वा सविमर्शं विचारयन्
विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहृष्टो राघवोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pārśvagataṁ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṁ vicārayan
vibhīṣaṇamidaṁ vākyamahṛṣṭo rāghavo'bravīt

translations.english: Considering Sīta who was in the palanquin, over whelmed with grief, Raghava delighted addressed Vibhīşaņa with the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत
वैदेही संनिकर्षं मे शीघ्रं समुपगच्छतु
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasādhipate saumya nityaṁ madvijaye rata
vaidehī saṁnikarṣaṁ me śīghraṁ samupagacchatu

translations.english: O lord of Rakşasas, O gentle (king) O you ever engaged in encompassing my success, do you speedily bring Vaidehī nearer to me.

verses.sanskrit:
स तद्वचनमाज्ञाय राघवस्य विभीषणः
तूर्णमुत्सारणे यत्नं कारयामास सर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
sa tadvacanamājñāya rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ
tūrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṁ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ

translations.english: Hearing these words of Raghava, Vibhīşaña, conversant with piety speedily cleared (the people out of that place).

verses.sanskrit:
कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणस्तत्र वेत्रझर्झरपाणयः
उत्सारयन्तः पुरुषाः समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः
verses.transliteration:
kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇastatra vetrajharjharapāṇayaḥ
utsārayantaḥ puruṣāḥ samantātparicakramuḥ

translations.english: Attendants with armours and head-dresses on and with cane and drums in their hands began to move about driving away the crowed thereform.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वतः
वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्ससृजुस्ततः
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣāṇāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rākṣasānāṁ ca sarvataḥ
vṛndānyutsāryamāṇāni dūramutsasṛjustataḥ

translations.english: The crowds of bears, monkeys and Rākṣasas being driven on all sides began to fly at a distance.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां सर्वेषां ध्वनिरुत्थितः
वायुनोद्वर्तमानस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṁ sarveṣāṁ dhvanirutthitaḥ
vāyunodvartamānasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ

translations.english: They being thus driven there arose a huge noise resembling that of the ocean when agitated by the wind.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सार्यमाणांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा समन्ताज्जातसंभ्रमान्
दाक्षिण्यात्तदमर्षाच्च वारयामास राघवः
verses.transliteration:
utsāryamāṇāṁstāndṛṣṭvā samantājjātasaṁbhramān
dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣācca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Beholding the monkeys driven on all sides and troubled Rāghava out of anger and compassion prevented him.

verses.sanskrit:
संरब्धश्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव
विभीषणं महाप्राज्ञं सोपालम्भमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration:
saṁrabdhaścābravīdrāmaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva
vibhīṣaṇaṁ mahāprājñaṁ sopālambhamidaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon as if burning (ever thing) with his angry eyes Rāma addressed the highly intelligent Vibhīşaņa with the following angry words.

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं मामनादृत्य कृश्यतेऽयं त्वया जनः
निवर्तयैनमुद्योगं जनोऽयं स्वजनो मम
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ māmanādṛtya kṛśyate'yaṁ tvayā janaḥ
nivartayainamudyogaṁ jano'yaṁ svajano mama

translations.english: Why did you insult' me by destroying all these? Do you remove their anxiety-they are all my own men.

verses.sanskrit:
न गृहाणि न वस्त्राणि न प्राकारास्तिरस्क्रियाः
नेदृशा राजसत्कारा वृत्तमावरणं स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration:
na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyāḥ
nedṛśā rājasatkārā vṛttamāvaraṇaṁ striyaḥ

translations.english: Neither the houses, clothes, walls nor reception like these are the veils of women.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धे न स्वयंवरे
न क्रतौ नो विवाहे च दर्शनं दुष्यते स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration:
vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddhe na svayaṁvare
na kratau no vivāhe ca darśanaṁ duṣyate striyaḥ

translations.english: There is no sin consequent uponi seeing women in danger, difficulty, war, Svayamvara* sacrifice and marriage. *It is a form of marriage in which the bride selects a bridegroom foe herself.

verses.sanskrit:
सैषा युद्धगता चैव कृच्छ्रे महति च स्थिता
दर्शनेऽस्या न दोषः स्यान्मत्समीपे विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchre mahati ca sthitā
darśane'syā na doṣaḥ syānmatsamīpe viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: She is now in great danger and difficultythere is no sin in seeing her specially in my presence.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सविमर्शो विभीषणः
रामस्योपानयत्सीतां संनिकर्षं विनीतवत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa savimarśo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
rāmasyopānayatsītāṁ saṁnikarṣaṁ vinītavat

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa, being sorry, humbly brought Sītă near him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ हनूमांश्च प्लवंगमः
निशम्य वाक्यं रामस्य बभूवुर्व्यथिता भृशम्
verses.transliteration:
tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanūmāṁśca plavaṁgamaḥ
niśamya vākyaṁ rāmasya babhūvurvyathitā bhṛśam

translations.english: There upon hearing Rāma's accents Lakşmaņa, Sugrīva and the monkey Hanuman were greatly sorry.

verses.sanskrit:
लज्जया त्ववलीयन्ती स्वेषु गात्रेषु मैथिली
विभीषणेनानुगता भर्तारं साभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
lajjayā tvavalīyantī sveṣu gātreṣu maithilī
vibhīṣaṇenānugatā bhartāraṁ sābhyavartata

translations.english: As if hiding herself in her own person in shame Maithili, following Vibhisana, approached her husband.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च परिदेवता
उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सौम्यतरानना
verses.transliteration:
vismayācca praharṣācca snehācca paridevatā
udaikṣata mukhaṁ bhartuḥ saumyaṁ saumyatarānanā

translations.english: She, having a gentle countenance and always regarding her husband as her god, fixed her looks upon her lord's face out of surprise, joy and love.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ समपनुदन्मनःक्लमं सा; सुचिरमदृष्टमुदीक्ष्य वै प्रियस्य
वदनमुदितपूर्णचन्द्रकान्तं; विमलशशाङ्कनिभानना तदासीत्
verses.transliteration:
atha samapanudanmanaḥklamaṁ sā; suciramadṛṣṭamudīkṣya vai priyasya
vadanamuditapūrṇacandrakāntaṁ; vimalaśaśāṅkanibhānanā tadāsīt

translations.english: Beholding the gentle countenance of her dearest lord, resembling the full moon the removed her mental distress. Thereupon she appeared (beautiful) having the countenance of the clear moon.

verses.sanskrit:
तां तु पार्श्वे स्थितां प्रह्वां रामः संप्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्
हृदयान्तर्गतक्रोधो व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ tu pārśve sthitāṁ prahvāṁ rāmaḥ saṁprekṣya maithilīm
hṛdayāntargatakrodho vyāhartumupacakrame

translations.english: Beholding Maithili standing humbly by him, Räma began to give vent to his pent-up feelings.

verses.sanskrit:
एषासि निर्जिता भद्रे शत्रुं जित्वा मया रणे
पौरुषाद्यदनुष्ठेयं तदेतदुपपादितम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣāsi nirjitā bhadre śatruṁ jitvā mayā raṇe
pauruṣādyadanuṣṭheyaṁ tadetadupapāditam

translations.english: O gentle one, destroying all the enemies in the arena of battle I have subdued your enemy-I have done all that can be accomplished by manliness.

verses.sanskrit:
गतोऽस्म्यन्तममर्षस्य धर्षणा संप्रमार्जिता
अवमानश्च शत्रुश्च मया युगपदुद्धृतौ
verses.transliteration:
gato'smyantamamarṣasya dharṣaṇā saṁpramārjitā
avamānaśca śatruśca mayā yugapaduddhṛtau

translations.english: I have reached the other end of my anger, rubbed off (the insult) for my spouse being taken away by the enemy and have killed simultaneously my disgrace and enemy.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य मे पौरुषं दृष्टमद्य मे सफलः श्रमः
अद्य तीर्णप्रतिज्ञत्वात्प्रभवामीह चात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
adya me pauruṣaṁ dṛṣṭamadya me saphalaḥ śramaḥ
adya tīrṇapratijñatvātprabhavāmīha cātmanaḥ

translations.english: My manliness has been displayed today, my laboúr has been crowned with success and today I have fulfilled my promise by my own prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
या त्वं विरहिता नीता चलचित्तेन रक्षसा
दैवसंपादितो दोषो मानुषेण मया जितः
verses.transliteration:
yā tvaṁ virahitā nītā calacittena rakṣasā
daivasaṁpādito doṣo mānuṣeṇa mayā jitaḥ

translations.english: That accidental misfortune, under the influence where of you were carried away by the fickle-minded Räksasa in my absence, has been subdued today by me, a man.

verses.sanskrit:
संप्राप्तमवमानं यस्तेजसा न प्रमार्जति
कस्तस्य पुरुषार्थोऽस्ति पुरुषस्याल्पतेजसः
verses.transliteration:
saṁprāptamavamānaṁ yastejasā na pramārjati
kastasya puruṣārtho'sti puruṣasyālpatejasaḥ

translations.english: What is the use of his manliness, who when insulted, cannot remove it? Even if he be a great man he may be called mean.

verses.sanskrit:
लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य लङ्कायाश्चावमर्दनम्
सफलं तस्य तच्छ्लाघ्यमद्य कर्म हनूमतः
verses.transliteration:
laṅghanaṁ ca samudrasya laṅkāyāścāvamardanam
saphalaṁ tasya tacchlāghyamadya karma hanūmataḥ

translations.english: The praise-worthy works of Hanumān-the crossing of the deep and the devastation of Lankā, have been crowned with success today.

verses.sanskrit:
युद्धे विक्रमतश्चैव हितं मन्त्रयतश्च मे
सुग्रीवस्य ससैन्यस्य सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः
verses.transliteration:
yuddhe vikramataścaiva hitaṁ mantrayataśca me
sugrīvasya sasainyasya saphalo'dya pariśramaḥ

translations.english: The labour of Sugrīva with his army, who displayed valour in the encounter and gave me good counsels, has borne fruit today.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्गुणं भ्रातरं त्यक्त्वा यो मां स्वयमुपस्थितः
विभीषणस्य भक्तस्य सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः
verses.transliteration:
nirguṇaṁ bhrātaraṁ tyaktvā yo māṁ svayamupasthitaḥ
vibhīṣaṇasya bhaktasya saphalo'dya pariśramaḥ

translations.english: Today also the labour of Vibhişaņa has borne fruit-who renouncing his brother, devoid of all good Qualities, came to my side.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य सीता रामस्य तद्वचः
मृगीवोत्फुल्लनयना बभूवाश्रुपरिप्लुता
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ bruvatastasya sītā rāmasya tadvacaḥ
mṛgīvotphullanayanā babhūvāśrupariplutā

translations.english: Hearing those words of Rāma, Sītā began to look wistfully like a hind, with eyes full of tears.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्जिता जीवलोकस्य तपसा भावितात्मना
अगस्त्येन दुराधर्षा मुनिना दक्षिणेव दिक्
verses.transliteration:
nirjitā jīvalokasya tapasā bhāvitātmanā
agastyena durādharṣā muninā dakṣiṇeva dik

translations.english: As the southern quarter, incapable of being got at by the people, was conquered by the selfcontrolled great ascetic Agasty, so for you slaying Ravana, I (always) anxious to have honour, have removed my insult-as is the duty of a man.

verses.sanskrit:
विदितश्चास्तु भद्रं ते योऽयं रणपरिश्रमः
स तीर्णः सुहृदां वीर्यान्न त्वदर्थं मया कृतः
verses.transliteration:
viditaścāstu bhadraṁ te yo'yaṁ raṇapariśramaḥ
sa tīrṇaḥ suhṛdāṁ vīryānna tvadarthaṁ mayā kṛtaḥ

translations.english: May good betide you-do you know that all my labour in the battle-field, backed by the prowess of my friends, is for you.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षता तु मया वृत्तमपवादं च सर्वशः
प्रख्यातस्यात्मवंशस्य न्यङ्गं च परिमार्जता
verses.transliteration:
rakṣatā tu mayā vṛttamapavādaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ
prakhyātasyātmavaṁśasya nyaṅgaṁ ca parimārjatā

translations.english: To uphold the dignity of my well-known family, to remove the ignominy consequent upon your being stolen away as well as to wipe off my own insult I have encompassed this.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्तचारित्रसंदेहा मम प्रतिमुखे स्थिता
दीपो नेत्रातुरस्येव प्रतिकूलासि मे दृढम्
verses.transliteration:
prāptacāritrasaṁdehā mama pratimukhe sthitā
dīpo netrāturasyeva pratikūlāsi me dṛḍham

translations.english: I have suspected your character; you, (Therefore) standing before me, are distressing me like to a lamp before one who is subject to an eye-desease.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्गच्छ ह्यभ्यनुज्ञाता यतेष्टं जनकात्मजे
एता दश दिशो भद्रे कार्यमस्ति न मे त्वया
verses.transliteration:
tadgaccha hyabhyanujñātā yateṣṭaṁ janakātmaje
etā daśa diśo bhadre kāryamasti na me tvayā

translations.english: Do you therefore proceed, O daughter of king Janaka, wherever you like to one of these ten quarters. I permit you, O gentle one. I have nothing to do with you.

verses.sanskrit:
कः पुमान्हि कुले जातः स्त्रियं परगृहोषिताम्
तेजस्वि पुनरादद्यात्सुहृल्लेखेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration:
kaḥ pumānhi kule jātaḥ striyaṁ paragṛhoṣitām
tejasvi punarādadyātsuhṛllekhena cetasā

translations.english: What powerful man, born in a high family, take back his wife considering her as friend out of lust, who has lived long in another's house?

verses.sanskrit:
रावणाङ्कपरिभ्रष्टां दृष्टां दुष्टेन चक्षुषा
कथं त्वां पुनरादद्यां कुलं व्यपदिशन्महत्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇāṅkaparibhraṣṭāṁ dṛṣṭāṁ duṣṭena cakṣuṣā
kathaṁ tvāṁ punarādadyāṁ kulaṁ vyapadiśanmahat

translations.english: You were taken by Rāvana on his lap, beheld by him with sinful eyes; how can I, taking you back, bring disgrace upon my great family?

verses.sanskrit:
तदर्थं निर्जिता मे त्वं यशः प्रत्याहृतं मया
नास्ति मे त्वय्यभिष्वङ्गो यथेष्टं गम्यतामितः
verses.transliteration:
tadarthaṁ nirjitā me tvaṁ yaśaḥ pratyāhṛtaṁ mayā
nāsti me tvayyabhiṣvaṅgo yatheṣṭaṁ gamyatāmitaḥ

translations.english: The object, with which I have gained you back, has been accomplished. I have got no attachment for you-do you go wherever you wish, O gentle one.

verses.sanskrit:
इति प्रव्याहृतं भद्रे मयैतत्कृतबुद्धिना
लक्ष्मणे भरते वा त्वं कुरु बुद्धिं यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration:
iti pravyāhṛtaṁ bhadre mayaitatkṛtabuddhinā
lakṣmaṇe bharate vā tvaṁ kuru buddhiṁ yathāsukham

translations.english: I speak these to you impelled by my sense of duty. If you wish you may live with Laksmana, Bharatga or Satrughna or with Sugrīva or Räkş asa Vibhisana. Do you settle, O Sita, where you may find your own pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि त्वां रावणो दृष्ट्वा दिव्यरूपां मनोरमाम्
मर्षयते चिरं सीते स्वगृहे परिवर्तिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
na hi tvāṁ rāvaṇo dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāṁ manoramām
marṣayate ciraṁ sīte svagṛhe parivartinīm

translations.english: O Sita, (I do not think) Ravana has overlooked you, who lived in his house, beholding you so graceful and beautiful.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रियार्हश्वरणा तदप्रियं; प्रियादुपश्रुत्य चिरस्य मैथिली
मुमोच बाष्पं सुभृशं प्रवेपिता; गजेन्द्रहस्ताभिहतेव वल्लरी
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ priyārhaśvaraṇā tadapriyaṁ; priyādupaśrutya cirasya maithilī
mumoca bāṣpaṁ subhṛśaṁ pravepitā; gajendrahastābhihateva vallarī

translations.english: Thereupon hearing those unpleasant words from her beloved (husband) Sītā, always sensitive and who had never heard such unpleasant words, trembling like a creeper torn by the trunk of an elephant, began to weep shedding tears profusely.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही परुषं लोमहर्षणम्
राघवेण सरोषेण भृशं प्रव्यथिताभवत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā tu vaidehī paruṣaṁ lomaharṣaṇam
rāghaveṇa saroṣeṇa bhṛśaṁ pravyathitābhavat

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Rāghava, enraged, with those harsh words Sīta was greatly pained.

verses.sanskrit:
सा तदश्रुतपूर्वं हि जने महति मैथिली
श्रुत्वा भर्तृवचो रूक्षं लज्जया व्रीडिताभवत्
verses.transliteration:
sā tadaśrutapūrvaṁ hi jane mahati maithilī
śrutvā bhartṛvaco rūkṣaṁ lajjayā vrīḍitābhavat

translations.english: Hearing those words of her lord, unheard of, before the great assembly Maithili was greatly humiliated with shame.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रविशन्तीव गात्राणि स्वान्येव जनकात्मजा
वाक्शल्यैस्तैः सशल्येव भृशमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्
verses.transliteration:
praviśantīva gātrāṇi svānyeva janakātmajā
vākśalyaistaiḥ saśalyeva bhṛśamaśrūṇyavartayat

translations.english: As if entering to her own person (with shame) and greatly pained with these arrow like words the daughter of king Janaka began to shed tears.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो बाष्पपरिक्लिष्टं प्रमार्जन्ती स्वमाननम्
शनैर्गद्गदया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tato bāṣpaparikliṣṭaṁ pramārjantī svamānanam
śanairgadgadayā vācā bhartāramidamabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon wiping the tears off her countenance, she with sorrowful words, addressed her husband.

verses.sanskrit:
किं मामसदृशं वाक्यमीदृशं श्रोत्रदारुणम्
रूक्षं श्रावयसे वीर प्राकृतः प्राकृतामिव
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ māmasadṛśaṁ vākyamīdṛśaṁ śrotradāruṇam
rūkṣaṁ śrāvayase vīra prākṛtaḥ prākṛtāmiva

translations.english: Why did you, O hero, like a common man addressing an ordinary woman, make me hear these, harsh and unbecoming words painful to ears?

verses.sanskrit:
न तथास्मि महाबाहो यथा त्वमवगच्छसि
प्रत्ययं गच्छ मे स्वेन चारित्रेणैव ते शपे
verses.transliteration:
na tathāsmi mahābāho yathā tvamavagacchasi
pratyayaṁ gaccha me svena cāritreṇaiva te śape

translations.english: O you of long arms, I am not what you have taken me to be. Do you believe me-I do swear by my own character.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथक्स्त्रीणां प्रचारेण जातिं त्वं परिशङ्कसे
परित्यजेमां शङ्कां तु यदि तेऽहं परीक्षिता
verses.transliteration:
pṛthakstrīṇāṁ pracāreṇa jātiṁ tvaṁ pariśaṅkase
parityajemāṁ śaṅkāṁ tu yadi te'haṁ parīkṣitā

translations.english: Seeing the ordinary women you are distrusting the whole sex. Do you renounce this suspicion since you have tried me.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं गतास्मि विवशा प्रभो
कामकारो न मे तत्र दैवं तत्रापराध्यति
verses.transliteration:
yadyahaṁ gātrasaṁsparśaṁ gatāsmi vivaśā prabho
kāmakāro na me tatra daivaṁ tatrāparādhyati

translations.english: O lord, though my person was touched by another-but it was not in my power; nor was it an wilful act (of mine); accident is to blame in this.

verses.sanskrit:
मदधीनं तु यत्तन्मे हृदयं त्वयि वर्तते
पराधीनेषु गात्रेषु किं करिष्याम्यनीश्वरा
verses.transliteration:
madadhīnaṁ tu yattanme hṛdayaṁ tvayi vartate
parādhīneṣu gātreṣu kiṁ kariṣyāmyanīśvarā

translations.english: My heart is under my control and that is in you;-and what could I do of my body which was subject to another and of which I was not the mistress.

verses.sanskrit:
सहसंवृद्धभावाच्च संसर्गेण च मानद
यद्यहं ते न विज्ञाता हता तेनास्मि शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration:
sahasaṁvṛddhabhāvācca saṁsargeṇa ca mānada
yadyahaṁ te na vijñātā hatā tenāsmi śāśvatam

translations.english: O you the conferrer of honour-our affection towards one another was increased by our living continually for a long time; even then if you have not been able to understand me I am ruined for ever.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रेषितस्ते यदा वीरो हनूमानवलोककः
लङ्कास्थाहं त्वया वीर किं तदा न विसर्जिता
verses.transliteration:
preṣitaste yadā vīro hanūmānavalokakaḥ
laṅkāsthāhaṁ tvayā vīra kiṁ tadā na visarjitā

translations.english: O king, when the great hero Hanumān was despatched by you of Lankā to see me why did you not renounce me then?

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्यक्षं वानरेन्द्रस्य त्वद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम्
त्वया संत्यक्तया वीर त्यक्तं स्याज्जीवितं मया
verses.transliteration:
pratyakṣaṁ vānarendrasya tvadvākyasamanantaram
tvayā saṁtyaktayā vīra tyaktaṁ syājjīvitaṁ mayā

translations.english: Had you deputed the monkey with that message I would have renounced my life there and then, O hero.

verses.sanskrit:
न वृथा ते श्रमोऽयं स्यात्संशये न्यस्य जीवितम्
सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायं निष्फलस्तव
verses.transliteration:
na vṛthā te śramo'yaṁ syātsaṁśaye nyasya jīvitam
suhṛjjanaparikleśo na cāyaṁ niṣphalastava

translations.english: You would not have been required to undergo this toil at the risk of your own life and giving unnecessary trouble to your friends.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया तु नरशार्दूल क्रोधमेवानुवर्तता
लघुनेव मनुष्येण स्त्रीत्वमेव पुरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
tvayā tu naraśārdūla krodhamevānuvartatā
laghuneva manuṣyeṇa strītvameva puraskṛtam

translations.english: O foremost of kings, being subject to ire-you did not perceive anything but womanhood in me, like an ordinary man.

verses.sanskrit:
अपदेशेन जनकान्नोत्पत्तिर्वसुधातलात्
मम वृत्तं च वृत्तज्ञ बहु ते न पुरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
apadeśena janakānnotpattirvasudhātalāt
mama vṛttaṁ ca vṛttajña bahu te na puraskṛtam

translations.english: Although I am known to have a father but in fact I am born of the earth. You did not sufficiently honour my character, O you conversant with character. are

verses.sanskrit:
न प्रमाणीकृतः पाणिर्बाल्ये बालेन पीडितः
मम भक्तिश्च शीलं च सर्वं ते पृष्ठतः कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
na pramāṇīkṛtaḥ pāṇirbālye bālena pīḍitaḥ
mama bhaktiśca śīlaṁ ca sarvaṁ te pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtam

translations.english: Your marriage with me in boyhood shall be disproved and you not sufficiently considering all my devotion and good conduct to you.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणा रुदती बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी
अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं सीता दीनं ध्यानपरं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇā rudatī bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī
abravīllakṣmaṇaṁ sītā dīnaṁ dhyānaparaṁ sthitam

translations.english: Saying thus with accents choked in tears and weeping Sītā spoke to Lakşmaņa, poorly and engaged in meditation.

verses.sanskrit:
चितां मे कुरु सौमित्रे व्यसनस्यास्य भेषजम्
मिथ्यापवादोपहता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration:
citāṁ me kuru saumitre vyasanasyāsya bheṣajam
mithyāpavādopahatā nāhaṁ jīvitumutsahe

translations.english: Make a funeral pyre for me, O Saumitri, that is the only remedy for this disaster. Being thus branded with an unfounded stigma I do not like to keep my life.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रीतस्य गुणैर्भर्तुस्त्यक्तया जनसंसदि
या क्षमा मे गतिर्गन्तुं प्रवेक्ष्ये हव्यवाहनम्
verses.transliteration:
aprītasya guṇairbhartustyaktayā janasaṁsadi
yā kṣamā me gatirgantuṁ pravekṣye havyavāhanam

translations.english: To adopt the proper course for me who had been renounced before this assembly by my disaffected husband I shall enter this.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
अमर्षवशमापन्नो राघवाननमैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu vaidehyā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
amarṣavaśamāpanno rāghavānanamaikṣata

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Vaidehī, Lakşmaņa, the slayer of enemies, being possessed by anger, looked towards Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
स विज्ञाय मनश्छन्दं रामस्याकारसूचितम्
चितां चकार सौमित्रिर्मते रामस्य वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
sa vijñāya manaśchandaṁ rāmasyākārasūcitam
citāṁ cakāra saumitrirmate rāmasya vīryavān

translations.english: And understanding Rāmas intention by gestures and at his command the powerful Saumitri prepared a funeral pyre.

verses.sanskrit:
अधोमुखं ततो रामं शनैः कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्
उपासर्पत वैदेही दीप्यमानं हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration:
adhomukhaṁ tato rāmaṁ śanaiḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam
upāsarpata vaidehī dīpyamānaṁ hutāśanam

translations.english: Thereupon circumambulating Rāma, standing with his head down, Vaidehi approached the burning fire.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणम्य देवताभ्यश्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मैथिली
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा चेदमुवाचाग्निसमीपतः
verses.transliteration:
praṇamya devatābhyaśca brāhmaṇebhyaśca maithilī
baddhāñjalipuṭā cedamuvācāgnisamīpataḥ

translations.english: Bowing to the celestials and Brāhmaṇas, Maithilī, with folded hands, spoke before the fire.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा मे हृदयं नित्यं नापसर्पति राघवात्
तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः
verses.transliteration:
yathā me hṛdayaṁ nityaṁ nāpasarpati rāghavāt
tathā lokasya sākṣī māṁ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ

translations.english: As my heart has never gone away from Rāghava, may you protect me, O fire, the witness of the people.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही परिक्रम्य हुताशनम्
विवेश ज्वलनं दीप्तं निःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu vaidehī parikramya hutāśanam
viveśa jvalanaṁ dīptaṁ niḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā

translations.english: Saying this and going round the fire, Vaidehi, with undaunted heart, entered the flaming fire.

verses.sanskrit:
जनः स सुमहांस्तत्र बालवृद्धसमाकुलः
ददर्श मैथिलीं तत्र प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration:
janaḥ sa sumahāṁstatra bālavṛddhasamākulaḥ
dadarśa maithilīṁ tatra praviśantīṁ hutāśanam

translations.english: The great assembly there, young and old, overwhelmed with grief, saw Maithili enter the flaming fire.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यामग्निं विशन्त्यां तु हाहेति विपुलः स्वनः
रक्षसां वानराणां च संबभूवाद्भुतोपमः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāmagniṁ viśantyāṁ tu hāheti vipulaḥ svanaḥ
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca saṁbabhūvādbhutopamaḥ

translations.english: She having entered the fire, lamentations, unheard of before, rose from all sides from the Rākşasas and monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
षडर्धनयनः श्रीमान्महादेवो वृषध्वजः
कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः
verses.transliteration:
ṣaḍardhanayanaḥ śrīmānmahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ
kartā sarvasya lokasya brahmā brahmavidāṁ varaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the king Vaiśravaņa, Yama with his progenitors, the thousand-eyed lord of the celestials, Varuna, the lord of water, the threeeyed graceful Mahădeva-the rider of bull, Brahmă the creator of the world and the foremost of those conversant with the knowledge of Brahmā-all these arriving at the city of Lankă in their cars bright as the rays of the sun, approached Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सहस्ताभरणान्प्रगृह्य विपुलान्भुजान्
अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठाः प्राञ्जलिं राघवं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sahastābharaṇānpragṛhya vipulānbhujān
abruvaṁstridaśaśreṣṭhāḥ prāñjaliṁ rāghavaṁ sthitam

translations.english: Thereupon raising up their huge hands, decked with various ornaments and folding them, those foremost of the celestials said to Raghava.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानवतां वरः
उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्तीं हव्यवाहने
कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे
verses.transliteration:
kartā sarvasya lokasya śreṣṭho jñānavatāṁ varaḥ
upekṣase kathaṁ sītāṁ patantīṁ havyavāhane
kathaṁ devagaṇaśreṣṭhamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase

translations.english: O lord, you are the preserver of all the worlds and the foremost of the wise, why did you neglect Sītā entering into fire? Why did you not understand yourself the foremost of the celestials?

verses.sanskrit:
ऋतधामा वसुः पूर्वं वसूनां च प्रजापतिः
त्वं त्रयाणां हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयंप्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
ṛtadhāmā vasuḥ pūrvaṁ vasūnāṁ ca prajāpatiḥ
tvaṁ trayāṇāṁ hi lokānāmādikartā svayaṁprabhuḥ

translations.english: You were before the Patriarch of all Vasus, by the name of Rtadhāmā. And you are yourself, O lord, the creator of the three worlds. *A kind of demi-god of whom eight are enumerated.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्राणामष्टमो रुद्रः साध्यानामपि पञ्चमः
अश्विनौ चापि ते कर्णौ चन्द्रसूर्यौ च चक्षुषी
verses.transliteration:
rudrāṇāmaṣṭamo rudraḥ sādhyānāmapi pañcamaḥ
aśvinau cāpi te karṇau candrasūryau ca cakṣuṣī

translations.english: You are the eighth of the Rudras and the fifth of the Sādhyas;-the Asvinis are your two ears and the sun and the moon are your eyes. 1. A demi-god-an inferior manifestation of Śiva: they are eleven in number. 2. An inferior deity or demi-god, one of a class of twelve.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ते चादौ च लोकानां दृश्यसे त्वं परंतप
उपेक्षसे च वैदेहीं मानुषः प्राकृतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
ante cādau ca lokānāṁ dṛśyase tvaṁ paraṁtapa
upekṣase ca vaidehīṁ mānuṣaḥ prākṛto yathā

translations.english: O slayer of enemies, you appear at the beginning and the end of the creation. Why did you neglect Vaidehī like an ordinary man?

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः
अब्रवीत्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठान्रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration:
ityukto lokapālaistaiḥ svāmī lokasya rāghavaḥ
abravīttridaśaśreṣṭhānrāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by the deities presiding over quarters, Rāghava, the lord of people and the foremost of the pious, spoke to those leading celestials, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मानं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम्
योऽहं यस्य यतश्चाहं भगवांस्तद्ब्रवीतु मे
verses.transliteration:
ātmānaṁ mānuṣaṁ manye rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam
yo'haṁ yasya yataścāhaṁ bhagavāṁstadbravītu me

translations.english: I know myself to be man-Rama, the son of Dasaratha. Let the great Patriarch tell me, who I am and whence I have come.

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतजिह्वो महर्षभः
त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारः परंतप
verses.transliteration:
sahasraśṛṅgo vedātmā śatajihvo maharṣabhaḥ
tvaṁ yajñastvaṁ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṁkāraḥ paraṁtapa

translations.english: You are the foremost of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred regulations. You are yourself the creator of the three worlds, O lord.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभवं निधनं वा ते न विदुः को भवानिति
दृश्यसे सर्वभूतेषु ब्राह्मणेषु च गोषु च
verses.transliteration:
prabhavaṁ nidhanaṁ vā te na viduḥ ko bhavāniti
dṛśyase sarvabhūteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca

translations.english: No one is conversant with your birth and destruction-you are manifest in all creaturescows and Brahmins-an all quarters, in the sky, in the mountain, and in the river. You are gifted with thousand legs, thousand heads and thousand eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं धारयसि भूतानि वसुधां च सपर्वताम्
अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ dhārayasi bhūtāni vasudhāṁ ca saparvatām
ante pṛthivyāḥ salile dṛśyase tvaṁ mahoragaḥ

translations.english: You did uphold all creatures, the earth and all the mountains. You appear like the great serpent in the water underneath the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीँल्लोकान्धारयन्राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान्
अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती
verses.transliteration:
trī̐llokāndhārayanrāma devagandharvadānavān
ahaṁ te hṛdayaṁ rāma jihvā devī sarasvatī

translations.english: O Rāma, you did uphold three creations-the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Dănvas. O Rāma I am your heart, the worshipful Sarasvati (Goddess of learning) is your tongue and all other celestials, O lord, created by Brahmă are your down. The closing of your eye is the night and the opening is the day.

verses.sanskrit:
वधार्थं रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम्
तदिदं नः कृतं कार्यं त्वया धर्मभृतां वर
verses.transliteration:
vadhārthaṁ rāvaṇasyeha praviṣṭo mānuṣīṁ tanum
tadidaṁ naḥ kṛtaṁ kāryaṁ tvayā dharmabhṛtāṁ vara

translations.english: For Rāvana's destruction you have assumed the human shape. You have accomplished that work of ours, O you the foremost of the pious.

verses.sanskrit:
निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम
अमोघं बलवीर्यं ते अमोघस्ते पराक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
nihato rāvaṇo rāma prahṛṣṭo divamākrama
amoghaṁ balavīryaṁ te amoghaste parākramaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, Răvaşa has been slain. Do you go up to heaven delighted. Sure is your godly energy and never goes for nothing your prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तश्च ये नराः
ये त्वां देवं ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
amoghāste bhaviṣyanti bhaktimantaśca ye narāḥ
ye tvāṁ devaṁ dhruvaṁ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṁ puruṣottamam

translations.english: Those who shall be devoted to you at one with Purana and the excellent Purasha, shall attain all their desires both in this worlds and the next. 1. A class of writings considered seared by the Hindus. 2. Great or supreme spirit-Purusa meaning that which abides or is quiescent in body.

verses.sanskrit: ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः
verses.transliteration: ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṁ parābhavaḥ

translations.english: Those persons shall never be unsuccessful both in this world and the next who shall chant this theme-excellent, instinct with the knowledge of Brahmă and describing the old history.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पितामहसमीरितम्
अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विभावसुः
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā śubhaṁ vākyaṁ pitāmahasamīritam
aṅkenādāya vaidehīmutpapāta vibhāvasuḥ

translations.english: Hearing those excellent words uttered by the great Patriarch rose up Vibhāvasu (The deity of Fire) with Vaidehi on his lap shaking the funeral pyre.

verses.sanskrit:
तरुणादित्यसंकाशां तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाम्
रक्ताम्बरधरां बालां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्
verses.transliteration:
taruṇādityasaṁkāśāṁ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇām
raktāmbaradharāṁ bālāṁ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām

translations.english: And carrying on his lap Vaidehī, wearing a red cloth, resembling the newly risen sun, adorned with ornaments of burning gold-having black curling hairs and decked with fresh garments, Vibhāvasu gave her to Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं साक्षी लोकस्य पावकः
एषा ते राम वैदेही पापमस्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca tadā rāmaṁ sākṣī lokasya pāvakaḥ
eṣā te rāma vaidehī pāpamasyā na vidyate

translations.english: Thereupon the Deity of Fire, the witness of the people, spoke to Rāma, saying, O Rāma, here is your Vaidehi-no sin has visited her.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव वाचा न मनसा नानुध्यानान्न चक्षुषा
सुवृत्ता वृत्तशौण्डीरा न त्वामतिचचार ह
verses.transliteration:
naiva vācā na manasā nānudhyānānna cakṣuṣā
suvṛttā vṛttaśauṇḍīrā na tvāmaticacāra ha

translations.english: Neither by words, mind, understanding nor eyes, she, good-natured and beautiful-has deviated from you who has got a good character and is heroic.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणेनापनीतैषा वीर्योत्सिक्तेन रक्षसा
त्वया विरहिता दीना विवशा निर्जनाद्वनात्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇenāpanītaiṣā vīryotsiktena rakṣasā
tvayā virahitā dīnā vivaśā nirjanādvanāt

translations.english: She was in the solitary forest separated from you, poorly and having no control over herself and hence she was carried away by the Raksasa Rāvana having enough prowess in him.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा धृतिमान्दृढविक्रमः
अब्रवीत्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration:
evamukto mahātejā dhṛtimāndṛḍhavikramaḥ
abravīttridaśaśreṣṭhaṁ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed, the highly effulgent and intelligent Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the foremost of the pious, spoke to that best of celestials saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अवश्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु सीता पावनमर्हति
दीर्घकालोषिता चेयं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा
verses.transliteration:
avaśyaṁ triṣu lokeṣu sītā pāvanamarhati
dīrghakāloṣitā ceyaṁ rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhā

translations.english: Beautiful (Sītā) lived in the inner apartment of Rāvana for a long time so she needs this purification in the presence of all people.

verses.sanskrit:
बालिशः खलु कामात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः
इति वक्ष्यन्ति मां सन्तो जानकीमविशोध्य हि
verses.transliteration:
bāliśaḥ khalu kāmātmā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
iti vakṣyanti māṁ santo jānakīmaviśodhya hi

translations.english: If I would take the daughter of Janaka without purifying her, people would say that Rāma the son of king Dasaratha is lustful and ignorant of the morality of the people.

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्यहृदयां भक्तां मच्चित्तपरिरक्षणीम्
अहमप्यवगच्छामि मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration:
ananyahṛdayāṁ bhaktāṁ maccittaparirakṣaṇīm
ahamapyavagacchāmi maithilīṁ janakātmajām

translations.english: I know it full well that Maithili, the daughter of king Janaka, has her mind devoted to me and has not given it to any one (else).

verses.sanskrit:
इमामपि विशालाक्षीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा
रावणो नातिवर्तेत वेलामिव महोदधिः
verses.transliteration:
imāmapi viśālākṣīṁ rakṣitāṁ svena tejasā
rāvaṇo nātivarteta velāmiva mahodadhiḥ

translations.english: As the ocean cannot go beyond its banks so Răvaņa could not approach her having expansive eyes protected by virtue of her own chastity.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि शक्तः स दुष्टात्मा मनसापि हि मैथिलीम्
प्रधर्षयितुमप्राप्तां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव
verses.transliteration:
na hi śaktaḥ sa duṣṭātmā manasāpi hi maithilīm
pradharṣayitumaprāptāṁ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva

translations.english: The greatly vicious-souled one could not even by his mind get Maithili, who was beyond his reach like to the burning flame of fire.

verses.sanskrit:
नेयमर्हति चैश्वर्यं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा
अनन्या हि मया सीतां भास्करेण प्रभा यथा
verses.transliteration:
neyamarhati caiśvaryaṁ rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhā
ananyā hi mayā sītāṁ bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā

translations.english: Her mind could not have been moved although she lived in the inner apartment of Rāvaņa-she belongs to none else; Sītā is mine as the rays belong to the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
विशुद्धा त्रिषु लोकेषु मैथिली जनकात्मजा
न हि हातुमियं शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा
verses.transliteration:
viśuddhā triṣu lokeṣu maithilī janakātmajā
na hi hātumiyaṁ śakyā kīrtirātmavatā yathā

translations.english: Maithili-the daughter of Janaka has been purified before the three worlds-So I am incapable of renouncing her as a self controlled person cannot forsake his (own ) reputation.

verses.sanskrit:
अवश्यं च मया कार्यं सर्वेषां वो वचो हितम्
स्निग्धानां लोकमान्यानामेवं च ब्रुवतां हितम्
verses.transliteration:
avaśyaṁ ca mayā kāryaṁ sarveṣāṁ vo vaco hitam
snigdhānāṁ lokamānyānāmevaṁ ca bruvatāṁ hitam

translations.english: It behove me to carry out the well meaning words of you all the lords of people who have spoken them out of affection.

verses.sanskrit:
इतीदमुक्त्वा वचनं महाबलैः; प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा
समेत्य रामः प्रियया महाबलः; सुखं सुखार्होऽनुबभूव राघवः
verses.transliteration:
itīdamuktvā vacanaṁ mahābalaiḥ; praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā
sametya rāmaḥ priyayā mahābalaḥ; sukhaṁ sukhārho'nubabhūva rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Saying this, the victorious, highly powerful, well renowned Rāghava, worthy of enjoying happiness, and having his praise chanted in consequence of his noble action, regaining his spouse, attained to happiness.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं राघवेण सुभाषितम्
इदं शुभतरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā śubhaṁ vākyaṁ rāghaveṇa subhāṣitam
idaṁ śubhataraṁ vākyaṁ vyājahāra maheśvaraḥ

translations.english: Hearing those excellent words uttered by Raghava, Mahesvara (Siva) spoke far more important words.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्कराक्ष महाबाहो महावक्षः परंतप
दिष्ट्या कृतमिदं कर्म त्वया शस्त्रभृतां वर
verses.transliteration:
puṣkarākṣa mahābāho mahāvakṣaḥ paraṁtapa
diṣṭyā kṛtamidaṁ karma tvayā śastrabhṛtāṁ vara

translations.english: O you having lotus-eyes, O you having huge arms and a spacious breast, O you the slayer of enemies, O you the foremost of the pious-it is a good fortune that this has been done by you.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः
अपावृत्तं त्वया संख्ये राम रावणजं भयम्
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṁ dāruṇaṁ tamaḥ
apāvṛttaṁ tvayā saṁkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṁ bhayam

translations.english: It is by good fortune, O Rama, the dreadful Rāghava, has been removed by you in the encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
इष्ट्वा तुरगमेधेन प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा त्रिदिवं गन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṁ yaśaḥ
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṁ dattvā tridivaṁ gantumarhasi

translations.english: Consoling the poor Bharata and the famed Kausalyā, beholding Kaikeyi and Sumitrā the mother of Lakşmaņa, obtaining the kingdom of Ayodhyā, pleasing all your friends, establishing the prestige of your family, you of great strength, performing horse-sacrifices, attaining fair fame and conferring riches upon the Brāhmaṇas do you repair to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
एष राजा विमानस्थः पिता दशरथस्तव
काकुत्स्थ मानुषे लोके गुरुस्तव महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa rājā vimānasthaḥ pitā daśarathastava
kākutstha mānuṣe loke gurustava mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: This king Dasaratha stationed on the car is your father. He was your superior on this earth, OKakutstha.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय
verses.transliteration:
indralokaṁ gataḥ śrīmāṁstvayā putreṇa tāritaḥ
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā tvamenamabhivādaya

translations.english: Obtaining you as his son, that graceful (king) has repaired to the region of Indra. Do you bow to him with your brother Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः
विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः
verses.transliteration:
mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmamakarotpituḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Mahadeva, Raghava, along with Laksmana, bowed to their father who was seated on the top of the car.

verses.sanskrit:
दीप्यमानं स्वयां लक्ष्म्या विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration:
dīpyamānaṁ svayāṁ lakṣmyā virajo'mbaradhāriṇam
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dadarśa pitaraṁ prabhuḥ

translations.english: He with Lakşmaņa beheld their father shining in his own effulgence and wearing an unsullied cloth.

verses.sanskrit:
हर्षेण महताविष्टो विमानस्थो महीपतिः
प्राणैः प्रियतरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं दशरथस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo vimānastho mahīpatiḥ
prāṇaiḥ priyataraṁ dṛṣṭvā putraṁ daśarathastadā

translations.english: Thereupon beholding his son dearer than his life, attaining great delight (in consequence thereof) placing him on his lap and embracing him with his arms, the great king Dasaratha, having long arms and seated on an excellent seat in the car, said.

verses.sanskrit:
न मे स्वर्गो बहुमतः संमानश्च सुरर्षिभिः
त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते
verses.transliteration:
na me svargo bahumataḥ saṁmānaśca surarṣibhiḥ
tvayā rāma vihīnasya satyaṁ pratiśṛṇomi te

translations.english: I am now in heaven and am equal with the celestials, but without you, O Rāma, I do not like it-this is true-I do swear by you.

verses.sanskrit:
कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर
तव प्रव्राजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम
verses.transliteration:
kaikeyyā yāni coktāni vākyāni vadatāṁ vara
tava pravrājanārthāni sthitāni hṛdaye mama

translations.english: O you the foremost of those skilled in speech, I have still in my mind the words which were uttered by Kaikeyi for sending you away to the woods.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम्
अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तोऽस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः
verses.transliteration:
tvāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṁ pariṣvajya salakṣmaṇam
adya duḥkhādvimukto'smi nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ

translations.english: Beholding you all well and embracing you with Lakşmaņa I am now shorn of grief like to the Sun, devoid of dues.

verses.sanskrit:
तारितोऽहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना
अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा तारितो ब्राह्मणो यथा
verses.transliteration:
tārito'haṁ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā
aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā tārito brāhmaṇo yathā

translations.english: I have been emancipated, O my son, through you-a good and high-souled son, as the virtuoussouled Brāhmaṇa Kahola was by Aștāvakra.

verses.sanskrit:
इदानीं च विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः
वधार्थं रावणस्येह विहितं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
idānīṁ ca vijānāmi yathā saumya sureśvaraiḥ
vadhārthaṁ rāvaṇasyeha vihitaṁ puruṣottamam

translations.english: O gentle one, I have heard from the celestials, (that you are) the excellent Puruşa in the guise (of a man) for the destruction of Rävaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम्
वनान्निवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यते शत्रुसूदन
verses.transliteration:
siddhārthā khalu kausalyā yā tvāṁ rāma gṛhaṁ gatam
vanānnivṛttaṁ saṁhṛṣṭā drakṣyate śatrusūdana

translations.english: Blessed is Kausalyā, O Rāma, who shall be greatly delighted, on beholding you, the slayer of enemies, gone home from the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम्
जलार्द्रमभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ति वसुधाधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṁ purīṁ gatam
jalārdramabhiṣiktaṁ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam

translations.english: Blessed are those men, O Rama, who shall behold you installed in the city as the king of the world.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुरक्तेन बलिना शुचिना धर्मचारिणा
इच्छेयं त्वामहं द्रष्टुं भरतेन समागतम्
verses.transliteration:
anuraktena balinā śucinā dharmacāriṇā
iccheyaṁ tvāmahaṁ draṣṭuṁ bharatena samāgatam

translations.english: I wish to behold you reconciled with Bharata, devoted powerful, pure and performing pious observances.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसमाः सौम्य वने निर्यापितास्त्वया
वसता सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśasamāḥ saumya vane niryāpitāstvayā
vasatā sītayā sārdhaṁ lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā

translations.english: O gentle one, you have spent fourteen years in the forest with Sītā and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
निवृत्तवनवासोऽसि प्रतिज्ञा सफला कृता
रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवास्ते परितोषिताः
verses.transliteration:
nivṛttavanavāso'si pratijñā saphalā kṛtā
rāvaṇaṁ ca raṇe hatvā devāste paritoṣitāḥ

translations.english: The term of your exile is over-your promise has been fulfilled; and slaying Ravana, in the conflict you have pleased the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाघ्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन
भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ karma yaśaḥ ślāghyaṁ prāptaṁ te śatrusūdana
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājyastho dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi

translations.english: You have performed a mighty deed and attained to excellent fame, O slayer of enemies; and placed in charge of your kingdom do you with your brothers attain a long life.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्
कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च
verses.transliteration:
iti bruvāṇaṁ rājānaṁ rāmaḥ prāñjalirabravīt
kuru prasādaṁ dharmajña kaikeyyā bharatasya ca

translations.english: The king speaking thus Rāma spoke to him with folded hands saying, “O you conversant with piety, do you be propitiated with Bharata and Kaikeyi.

verses.sanskrit:
सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया
स शापः कैकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत्प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
saputrāṁ tvāṁ tyajāmīti yaduktā kaikayī tvayā
sa śāpaḥ kaikayīṁ ghoraḥ saputrāṁ na spṛśetprabho

translations.english: You did imprecate Kaikeyi, saying, I renounce you with your son, may not that dreadful curse visit her and her son.

verses.sanskrit:
स तथेति महाराजो राममुक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिम्
लक्ष्मणं च परिष्वज्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
sa tatheti mahārājo rāmamuktvā kṛtāñjalim
lakṣmaṇaṁ ca pariṣvajya punarvākyamuvāca ha

translations.english: Saying "so be it" to Rāma with folded hands and embracing Lakşmaņa the great king said to him.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि
रामे प्रसन्ने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration:
dharmaṁ prāpsyasi dharmajña yaśaśca vipulaṁ bhuvi
rāme prasanne svargaṁ ca mahimānaṁ tathaiva ca

translations.english: O you conversant with piety and fame on this earth, you shall attain to heaven and excellent state there.

verses.sanskrit:
रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन
रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शुभेष्वभिरतः सदा
verses.transliteration:
rāmaṁ śuśrūṣa bhadraṁ te sumitrānandavardhana
rāmaḥ sarvasya lokasya śubheṣvabhirataḥ sadā

translations.english: O you the enhancer of Sumitra's joy-do you attend upon Rāma; may good betide you; Rāma is ever engaged in the welfare of all beings.

verses.sanskrit:
एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
अभिगम्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
ete sendrāstrayo lokāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
abhigamya mahātmānamarcanti puruṣottamam

translations.english: All these celestials headed by Indra, Siddhas and Great saints, bowing to this high-souled and excellent Purusa, worship him.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम्
देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
etattaduktamavyaktamakṣaraṁ brahmanirmitam
devānāṁ hṛdayaṁ saumya guhyaṁ rāmaḥ paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: Rāma, the subduer of foes, is the indescribable and undecaying letter Brahmā, which has been described in the Vedas) as the heart and secret of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
अवाप्तं धर्मचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया
रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया
verses.transliteration:
avāptaṁ dharmacaraṇaṁ yaśaśca vipulaṁ tvayā
rāmaṁ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā

translations.english: For serving him along with Sītā, the daughter of king Videha, you have attained piety and excellent fame.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति
रामेण त्वद्विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतमेतद्धितैषिणा
verses.transliteration:
kartavyo na tu vaidehi manyustyāgamimaṁ prati
rāmeṇa tvadviśuddhyarthaṁ kṛtametaddhitaiṣiṇā

translations.english: It does not behove you, O Vaidehi, to be enraged (with Rāma) for renouncing you; for purifying you this was done by him ever wishing your welfare.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वं सुभ्रु समाधेया पतिशुश्रूवणं प्रति
अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम्
verses.transliteration:
na tvaṁ subhru samādheyā patiśuśrūvaṇaṁ prati
avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyameṣa te daivataṁ param

translations.english: Though there is no necessity for giving you any instruction as regards your duty towards your husband-still I should say that he is your great god.

verses.sanskrit:
इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम्
इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन्
verses.transliteration:
iti pratisamādiśya putrau sītāṁ tathā snuṣām
indralokaṁ vimānena yayau daśaratho jvalan

translations.english: Having thus instructed his two sons and Sītā, he repaired, in his car, to the region of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्स्थे महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः
अब्रवीत्परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
pratiprayāte kākutsthe mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ
abravītparamaprīto rāghavaṁ prāñjaliṁ sthitam

translations.english: Dasaratha having repaired, Mahendra greatly delighted spoke to Rāghava, stationed there with folded hands, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अमोघं दर्शनं राम तवास्माकं परंतप
प्रीतियुक्तोऽस्मि तेन त्वं ब्रूहि यन्मनसेच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
amoghaṁ darśanaṁ rāma tavāsmākaṁ paraṁtapa
prītiyukto'smi tena tvaṁ brūhi yanmanasecchasi

translations.english: O Rama,Oforemost of men, this our presence here, must not be fruitless, we are pleased-do you ask for what you wish.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना मयि सर्वसुरेश्वर
वक्ष्यामि कुरु मे सत्यं वचनं वदतां वर
verses.transliteration:
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā mayi sarvasureśvara
vakṣyāmi kuru me satyaṁ vacanaṁ vadatāṁ vara

translations.english: O lord of the celestials, O you the foremost of those skilled in speech, if you are propitiated with me, I shall pray for (my wished for object); do you grant it.

verses.sanskrit:
मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम्
ते सर्वे जीवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः
verses.transliteration:
mama hetoḥ parākrāntā ye gatā yamasādanam
te sarve jīvitaṁ prāpya samuttiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ

translations.english: Let all these highly powerful monkeys, who have been despatched to the abode of Death, on my account, regaining their life, stand up.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्प्रियेष्वभिरक्ताश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति च
त्वत्प्रसादात्समेयुस्ते वरमेतदहं वृणे
verses.transliteration:
matpriyeṣvabhiraktāśca na mṛtyuṁ gaṇayanti ca
tvatprasādātsameyuste varametadahaṁ vṛṇe

translations.english: May all those, by your favour, who were ever devoted to me and did not care for death (even) regain their life-this is the boon I pray for.

verses.sanskrit:
नीरुजान्निर्व्रणांश्चैव संपन्नबलपौरुषान्
गोलाङ्गूलांस्तथैवर्क्षान्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद
verses.transliteration:
nīrujānnirvraṇāṁścaiva saṁpannabalapauruṣān
golāṅgūlāṁstathaivarkṣāndraṣṭumicchāmi mānada

translations.english: O conferror of honour, I wish to see all these monkeys, Golarigālas and bears, pale and hurt, unheart and gifted with strength and prowess like before.

verses.sanskrit:
अकाले चापि मुख्यानि मूलानि च फलानि च
नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः
verses.transliteration:
akāle cāpi mukhyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca
nadyaśca vimalāstatra tiṣṭheyuryatra vānarāḥ

translations.english: Let there be flowers, fruits and roots, even out of season wherever these monkeys shall live and let rivers there be full of clear water.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः
महेन्द्रः प्रत्युवाचेदं वचनं प्रीतिलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
mahendraḥ pratyuvācedaṁ vacanaṁ prītilakṣaṇam

translations.english: Hearing those words of the high-souled Rāghava Mehendra replied with words instinct with delight.

verses.sanskrit:
महानयं वरस्तात त्वयोक्तो रघुनन्दन
समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयः सुप्ता निद्राक्षये यथा
verses.transliteration:
mahānayaṁ varastāta tvayokto raghunandana
samutthāsyanti harayaḥ suptā nidrākṣaye yathā

translations.english: Let the monkeys gifted with their pristine strength and prowess rise up unhurt and healthy as if after the end of sleep.

verses.sanskrit:
सुहृद्भिर्बान्धवैश्चैव ज्ञातिभिः स्वजनेन च
सर्व एव समेष्यन्ति संयुक्ताः परया मुदा
verses.transliteration:
suhṛdbhirbāndhavaiścaiva jñātibhiḥ svajanena ca
sarva eva sameṣyanti saṁyuktāḥ parayā mudā

translations.english: Being reconciled with their friends, relatives and kinsmen let them attain to excellent joy.

verses.sanskrit:
अकाले पुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश्च पादपाः
भविष्यन्ति महेष्वास नद्यश्च सलिलायुताः
verses.transliteration:
akāle puṣpaśabalāḥ phalavantaśca pādapāḥ
bhaviṣyanti maheṣvāsa nadyaśca salilāyutāḥ

translations.english: O you the wielder of a huge bow, all the trees shall be filled with flowers and fruits and all the rivers shall be filled with water even out of season (wherever they shall live).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तमामन्त्र्य रामं सौमित्रिणा सह
विमानैः सूर्यसंकाशैर्हृष्टा जग्मुः सुरा दिवम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tamāmantrya rāmaṁ saumitriṇā saha
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṁkāśairhṛṣṭā jagmuḥ surā divam

translations.english: Having thus addressed Rāma along with Laksmana, the thousand eyed Deity, delighted, went away along with the celestials, in their cars resembling the Sun (in brilliance.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य च काकुत्स्थः सर्वांस्तांस्त्रिदशोत्तमान्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya ca kākutsthaḥ sarvāṁstāṁstridaśottamān
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vāsamājñāpayattadā

translations.english: Saluting all the celestials, Kākutstha, with his brother Lakşmaņa, ordered the encampment of the army.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु सा लक्ष्मणरामपालिता; महाचमूर्हृष्टजना यशस्विनी
श्रिया ज्वलन्ती विरराज सर्वतो; निशाप्रणीतेव हि शीतरश्मिना
verses.transliteration:
tatastu sā lakṣmaṇarāmapālitā; mahācamūrhṛṣṭajanā yaśasvinī
śriyā jvalantī virarāja sarvato; niśāpraṇīteva hi śītaraśminā

translations.english: Thereupon that famous and well-pleased huge army of the monkeys protected by Råma and Lakşmaņa, appeared resplendent on all sides like to a night beautified with the rays of the Moon.

verses.sanskrit:
तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोत्थितमरिंदमम्
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयं पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ rātrimuṣitaṁ rāmaṁ sukhotthitamariṁdamam
abravītprāñjalirvākyaṁ jayaṁ pṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Rāma having spent that night happily and risen up the next morning, Vibhisana, chanting his victory, spoke to that slayer of foes, with folded hands, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
स्नानानि चाङ्गरागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि माल्यानि विविधानि च
