verses.transliteration:
snānāni cāṅgarāgāṇi vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca
candanāni ca divyāni mālyāni vividhāni ca

translations.english: Here are various articles for bathing, pastes, clothes, ornaments, sandal and various excellent garlands.

verses.sanskrit:
अलंकारविदश्चेमा नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः
उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत्स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव
verses.transliteration:
alaṁkāravidaścemā nāryaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇāḥ
upasthitāstvāṁ vidhivatsnāpayiṣyanti rāghava

translations.english: Here are present women having eyes like lotuses and conversant with the are of decking, Let them perform their duty, O Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्
हरीन्सुग्रीवमुख्यांस्त्वं स्नानेनोपनिमन्त्रय
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam
harīnsugrīvamukhyāṁstvaṁ snānenopanimantraya

translations.english: Being thus accosted Kākutstha replied to Vibhīşaņa, saying: Do you invite all these monkeys headed by Sugrīva to bath.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु ताम्यति धर्मात्मा ममहेतोः सुखोचितः
सुकुमारो महाबाहुः कुमारः सत्यसंश्रवः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu tāmyati dharmātmā mamahetoḥ sukhocitaḥ
sukumāro mahābāhuḥ kumāraḥ satyasaṁśravaḥ

translations.english: The virtuous-souled Bharata, having huge arms and ever used to comforts, is greatly distressed on my account.

verses.sanskrit:
तं विना कैकेयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणम्
न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration:
taṁ vinā kaikeyīputraṁ bharataṁ dharmacāriṇam
na me snānaṁ bahumataṁ vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca

translations.english: Without Bharata the son of Kaikeyi, ever performing pious rites, I do not value bathing or these clothes and ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
इत एव पथा क्षिप्रं प्रतिगच्छाम तां पुरीम्
अयोध्यामायतो ह्येष पन्थाः परमदुर्गमः
verses.transliteration:
ita eva pathā kṣipraṁ pratigacchāma tāṁ purīm
ayodhyāmāyato hyeṣa panthāḥ paramadurgamaḥ

translations.english: Do you so manage that we may go to the city of Ayodhyă speedity. For difficult is the way leading to Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः
अह्ना त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि तां पुरीं पार्थिवात्मज
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu kākutsthaṁ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
ahnā tvāṁ prāpayiṣyāmi tāṁ purīṁ pārthivātmaja

translations.english: Being thus accosted Vibhīşaņa relied to Kākutstha, O son of the lord of earth, may good betide you, I shall soon take you to that city.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्पकं नाम भद्रं ते विमानं सूर्यसंनिभम्
मम भ्रातुः कुबेरस्य रावणेनाहृतं बलात्
verses.transliteration:
puṣpakaṁ nāma bhadraṁ te vimānaṁ sūryasaṁnibham
mama bhrātuḥ kuberasya rāvaṇenāhṛtaṁ balāt

translations.english: The car Pușpaka resembling the Sun, belonging to my brother Kuvera, was brought by the powerful Răvaņa. you of unequalled prowess, that celestial and excellent car, going everywhere at will, since the destruction of Rāvana in battle, is ready for you.

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदं मेघसंकाशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति
तेन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गजज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tadidaṁ meghasaṁkāśaṁ vimānamiha tiṣṭhati
tena yāsyasi yānena tvamayodhyāṁ gajajvaraḥ

translations.english: That car resembling the cloud is in the city of Lanka, in which you shaft, relieved of your anxiety, repair to Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान्
वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदम्
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ te yadyanugrāhyo yadi smarasi me guṇān
vasa tāvadiha prājña yadyasti mayi sauhṛdam

translations.english: If I am worthy of being favoured by you, if remember any accomplishment of mineif you have any friendship for me, do you, o wise one, wait here with your brother Lakşmaņa and spouse Vaidehi till I accomplish all my desires by worshipping you. And then you shall go (to Ayodhyā).

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतियुक्तस्तु मे राम ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः
सत्क्रियां विहितां तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
prītiyuktastu me rāma sasainyaḥ sasuhṛdgaṇaḥ
satkriyāṁ vihitāṁ tāvadgṛhāṇa tvaṁ mayodyatām

translations.english: O Rāma, I shall worship you with great delight and do your, O Rama, with your friends and army, accept that adoration. did you

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणयाद्बहुमानाच्च सौहृदेन च राघव
प्रसादयामि प्रेष्योऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते
verses.transliteration:
praṇayādbahumānācca sauhṛdena ca rāghava
prasādayāmi preṣyo'haṁ na khalvājñāpayāmi te

translations.english: O Rāma, out of love, honour, and brotherly feeling, I do crave your premising. I am a servant I cannot command you.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्ततो रामः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्
रक्षसां वानराणां च सर्वेषां चोपशृण्वताम्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastato rāmaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam
rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ copaśṛṇvatām

translations.english: Being thus addressed, Rāma replied to Vibhīşaņa in the presence of all the Rākşasas and monkeys, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पूजितोऽहं त्वया वीर साचिव्येन परंतप
सर्वात्मना च चेष्टिभिः सौहृदेनोत्तमेन च
verses.transliteration:
pūjito'haṁ tvayā vīra sācivyena paraṁtapa
sarvātmanā ca ceṣṭibhiḥ sauhṛdenottamena ca

translations.english: I have been worshipped by you, O hero, with your excellent counsels, with your earnest endeavours and with your great friendship.

verses.sanskrit:
मां निवर्तयितुं योऽसौ चित्रकूटमुपागतः
शिरसा याचतो यस्य वचनं न कृतं मया
verses.transliteration:
māṁ nivartayituṁ yo'sau citrakūṭamupāgataḥ
śirasā yācato yasya vacanaṁ na kṛtaṁ mayā

translations.english: Do not think,O lord of Raksasas, that I do not comply with your request-my heart hastens me to behold my brother Bharata, who, to take me back, did come to the mount Citrakūța, who laid low his crown at my feet and whose words I did not keep.

verses.sanskrit:
कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम्
गुरूंश्च सुहृदश्चैव पौरांश्च तनयैः सह
verses.transliteration:
kausalyāṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīṁ ca yaśasvinīm
gurūṁśca suhṛdaścaiva paurāṁśca tanayaiḥ saha

translations.english: (I am anxious to see) Kausalyā, Sumitrā, Kaikeyi, with my friends, citizens and villagers.

verses.sanskrit:
उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर
कृतकार्यस्य मे वासः कथंचिदिह संमतः
verses.transliteration:
upasthāpaya me kṣipraṁ vimānaṁ rākṣaseśvara
kṛtakāryasya me vāsaḥ kathaṁcidiha saṁmataḥ

translations.english: Do you speedily bring the car for me, O lord of Räkşasas my work is done-how can I wish to live here long.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितोऽस्मि विभीषण
मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यस्त्वरितस्त्वानुमानये
verses.transliteration:
anujānīhi māṁ saumya pūjito'smi vibhīṣaṇa
manyurna khalu kartavyastvaritastvānumānaye

translations.english: Do you regard me, O Vibhīşaņa, O gentle one, as worshipped. O friend do you be not angry-I request you.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु बद्धाञ्जलिः प्रह्वो विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः
अब्रवीत्त्वरयोपेतः किं करोमीति राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu baddhāñjaliḥ prahvo vinīto rākṣaseśvaraḥ
abravīttvarayopetaḥ kiṁ karomīti rāghavam

translations.english: Having brought that car Puşpaka, adorned with flowers and having stationed himself at a distance, Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas, being incited to hurry on, humbly and with folded hands, spoke to Rama, saying, "What shall I do, O Rāghava?

verses.sanskrit:
तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः
विमृश्य राघवो वाक्यमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
tamabravīnmahātejā lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
vimṛśya rāghavo vākyamidaṁ snehapuraskṛtam

translations.english: Hearing those words the highly powerful Rāghava, in the presence of Lakşmaņa, gave vent to the following accents out of affection.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणो विभीषण वनौकसः
रत्नैरर्थैश्च विविभैर्भूषणैश्चाभिपूजय
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaprayatnakarmāṇo vibhīṣaṇa vanaukasaḥ
ratnairarthaiśca vivibhairbhūṣaṇaiścābhipūjaya

translations.english: All these monkeys and bears have brought about the accomplishment of my work with great care. Do you, satisfy them, O Vibhisana, with diverse jewels and riches.

verses.sanskrit:
सहैभिरर्दिता लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर
हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration:
sahaibhirarditā laṅkā nirjitā rākṣaseśvara
hṛṣṭaiḥ prāṇabhayaṁ tyaktvā saṁgrāmeṣvanivartibhiḥ

translations.english: With these and you, I conquered the city of Lanka, O lord of Raksasas. They all fought with a delighted heart, having renounced all fear of life and who did never go away from the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं संमानिताश्चेमे मानार्हा मानद त्वया
भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निर्वृता हरियूथपाः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ saṁmānitāśceme mānārhā mānada tvayā
bhaviṣyanti kṛtajñena nirvṛtā hariyūthapāḥ

translations.english: Being honoured and delighted by you grateful, all these leading monkeys shall repair (to their, respective quarters).

verses.sanskrit:
त्यागिनं संग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं यशस्विनम्
यतस्त्वामवगच्छन्ति ततः संबोधयामि ते
verses.transliteration:
tyāginaṁ saṁgrahītāraṁ sānukrośaṁ yaśasvinam
yatastvāmavagacchanti tataḥ saṁbodhayāmi te

translations.english: (If you are found to be) sacrificing, self-controlled, compassionate and (the just) collector of revenues, all shall be attached to you. For this I do address you (thus).

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वानरांस्तान्विभीषणः
रत्नार्थैः संविभागेन सर्वानेवान्वपूजयत्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa vānarāṁstānvibhīṣaṇaḥ
ratnārthaiḥ saṁvibhāgena sarvānevānvapūjayat

translations.english: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa with a distribution of jewels and riches, honoured all those monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं लज्जमानां यशस्विनीम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता
verses.transliteration:
aṅkenādāya vaidehīṁ lajjamānāṁ yaśasvinīm
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vikrāntena dhanuṣmatā

translations.english: Beholding all those leading monkeys worshipped with jewels and riches Rāma ascended that excellent car, taking the bashful, and high-minded Vaidehi on his lap and accompanied by his powerful brother Laksmana, a skilled bowman.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च विमानस्थः काकुत्स्थः सर्ववानरान्
सुग्रीवं च महावीर्यं राक्षसं च विभीषणम्
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca vimānasthaḥ kākutsthaḥ sarvavānarān
sugrīvaṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ rākṣasaṁ ca vibhīṣaṇam

translations.english: Being stationed the Kakutstha honouring all the monkeys, the highly powerful Sugriva and Vibhisana, said.

verses.sanskrit:
मित्रकार्यं कृतमिदं भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमाः
अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं प्रतिगच्छत
verses.transliteration:
mitrakāryaṁ kṛtamidaṁ bhavadbhirvānarottamāḥ
anujñātā mayā sarve yatheṣṭaṁ pratigacchata

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, you have performed a friendly service-it has been appreciated by medo you repair to your wished-for quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तु कार्यं वयस्येन सुहृदा वा परंतप
कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवता धर्मभीरुणा
किष्किन्धां प्रतियाह्याशु स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः
verses.transliteration:
yattu kāryaṁ vayasyena suhṛdā vā paraṁtapa
kṛtaṁ sugrīva tatsarvaṁ bhavatā dharmabhīruṇā
kiṣkindhāṁ pratiyāhyāśu svasainyenābhisaṁvṛtaḥ

translations.english: O Sugrīva, you, ever afraid of impiety, have performed all that a loving and well wishing friend should do.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण
न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्द्रा अपि दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration:
svarājye vasa laṅkāyāṁ mayā datte vibhīṣaṇa
na tvāṁ dharṣayituṁ śaktāḥ sendrā api divaukasaḥ

translations.english: on car Do you, encircled by your army, proceed towards Kiskindhā. Do you, O Vibhisana live in your kingdom, Lankā, conferred upon you, by me. Not even the celestials, headed by Indra shall be able to assail you.

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यां प्रतियास्यामि राजधानीं पितुर्मम
अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वानामन्त्रयामि वः
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāṁ pratiyāsyāmi rājadhānīṁ piturmama
abhyanujñātumicchāmi sarvānāmantrayāmi vaḥ

translations.english: I wish to return to Ayodhyā, the capital of my father's (Kingdom). I wish to obtain your permission (and for this, I have invited you all.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण वानरास्ते महाबलाः
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो रामं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः
अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वान्नयतु नो भवान्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktāstu rāmeṇa vānarāste mahābalāḥ
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo rāmaṁ rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
ayodhyāṁ gantumicchāmaḥ sarvānnayatu no bhavān

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Rāma, all the leading monkeys bears as well as the Rākşasa Vibhīşaņa said with folded hands.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकार्द्रं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च
अचिरेणागमिष्यामः स्वान्गृहान्नृपतेः सुत
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tvāmabhiṣekārdraṁ kausalyāmabhivādya ca
acireṇāgamiṣyāmaḥ svāngṛhānnṛpateḥ suta

translations.english: Beholding you installed and bowing to Kausalya, we shall soon return to our respective homes, O foremost of kings.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः
अब्रवीद्राघवः श्रीमान्ससुग्रीवविभीषणान्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu dharmātmā vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ
abravīdrāghavaḥ śrīmānsasugrīvavibhīṣaṇān

translations.english: Being thus accosted by the monkeys with Vibhisana, the virtuous-souled Rama, spoke to them and Sugriva and Vibhisana, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियात्प्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः
सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः
verses.transliteration:
priyātpriyataraṁ labdhaṁ yadahaṁ sasuhṛjjanaḥ
sarvairbhavadbhiḥ sahitaḥ prītiṁ lapsye purīṁ gataḥ

translations.english: Dearer than the dear, I shall attain to, when returning my city, along with you all, I shall enjoy in the company of all my friends and relatives.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं वानरैः सह
त्वमध्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्रविभीषण
verses.transliteration:
kṣipramāroha sugrīva vimānaṁ vānaraiḥ saha
tvamadhyāroha sāmātyo rākṣasendravibhīṣaṇa

translations.english: O Sugrīva, do you soon ascend the car along with the monkeys. Do you ascend too, O Vibhisana, lord of Raksasas, with all your courtiers.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तत्पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह सेनया
अध्यारोहत्त्वरञ्शीघ्रं सामात्यश्च विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
tatastatpuṣpakaṁ divyaṁ sugrīvaḥ saha senayā
adhyārohattvarañśīghraṁ sāmātyaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon ascended that celestial car Puş paka, Sugriva, greatly delighted with the monkeys and Vibhisana, with his courtiers.

verses.sanskrit:
तेष्वारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरं परमासनम्
राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसं
verses.transliteration:
teṣvārūḍheṣu sarveṣu kauberaṁ paramāsanam
rāghaveṇābhyanujñātamutpapāta vihāyasaṁ

translations.english: They all having got up, the excellent car, of Kuvera at the command of Raghava, rose up in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
ययौ तेन विमानेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता
प्रहृष्टश्च प्रतीतश्च बभौ रामः कुबेरवत्
verses.transliteration:
yayau tena vimānena haṁsayuktena bhāsvatā
prahṛṣṭaśca pratītaśca babhau rāmaḥ kuberavat

translations.english: And in that car coursing at will land drawn by effulgent ganders, Rāma greatly delighted appeared like Kuvera (himself).

verses.sanskrit:
अनुज्ञातं तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्
उत्पपात महामेघः श्वसनेनोद्धतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
anujñātaṁ tu rāmeṇa tadvimānamanuttamam
utpapāta mahāmeghaḥ śvasanenoddhato yathā

translations.english: Being commanded by Räma, that excellent car, drawn by ganders, with a huge noise, rose high up in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः
अब्रवीन्मैथिलीं सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम्
verses.transliteration:
pātayitvā tataścakṣuḥ sarvato raghunandanaḥ
abravīnmaithilīṁ sītāṁ rāmaḥ śaśinibhānanām

translations.english: Casting his looks on all sides, Rama, the descendant of Raghus, spoke to Sītā, the daughter of the kind of Mithila, having a moonlike countenance, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्
लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
kailāsaśikharākāre trikūṭaśikhare sthitām
laṅkāmīkṣasva vaidehi nirmitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā

translations.english: O Vaidehi, do you behold Lanka, situate on the summit of the mount Citrakūta, resembling that of Kailasa and constructed by Viswakarma.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदायोधनं पश्य मांसशोणितकर्दमम्
हरीणां राक्षसानां च सीते विशसनं महत्
verses.transliteration:
etadāyodhanaṁ paśya māṁsaśoṇitakardamam
harīṇāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca sīte viśasanaṁ mahat

translations.english: Behold, O Sītā, that huge arena of battle, bathed in the blood and flesh of the monkeys and Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
तवहेतोर्विशालाक्षि रावणो निहतो मया
कुम्भकर्णोऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
tavahetorviśālākṣi rāvaṇo nihato mayā
kumbhakarṇo'tra nihataḥ prahastaśca niśācaraḥ

translations.english: Kumbhakarna was slain there, the night ranger Prahasta, as well, and Dumraksa, were slain by the monkey Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिर्निहतो रणे
विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇenendrajiccātra rāvaṇirnihato raṇe
virūpākṣaśca duṣprekṣyo mahāpārśvamahodarau

translations.english: The Rākşasa named Vikața was slain there by Angada-and Virūpākșa, hard to look at and Mahāpārśva and Mahodara.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र मन्दोदरी नाम भार्या तं पर्यदेवयत्
सपत्नीनां सहस्रेण सास्रेण परिवारिता
verses.transliteration:
atra mandodarī nāma bhāryā taṁ paryadevayat
sapatnīnāṁ sahasreṇa sāsreṇa parivāritā

translations.english: (And there was slain) Suryaśatru and Brahmaśatru (And there bewailed for Rāvana) his spouse Mandodarī, surrounded by his thousand other wives.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थं समुद्रस्य वरानने
यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम्
verses.transliteration:
etattu dṛśyate tīrthaṁ samudrasya varānane
yatra sāgaramuttīrya tāṁ rātrimuṣitā vayam

translations.english: O you having an excellent countenance, do you behold the descending place of the ocean, where I spent the night after crossing the deep for you.

verses.sanskrit:
एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे सलिलार्णवे
तवहेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa seturmayā baddhaḥ sāgare salilārṇave
tavahetorviśālākṣi nalasetuḥ suduṣkaraḥ

translations.english: O you having expansive eyes, for you, this difficult construction of the bridge was made by me over the deep by the help of Nala.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्य सागरमक्षोभ्यं वैदेहि वरुणालयम्
अपारमभिगर्जन्तं शङ्खशुक्तिनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration:
paśya sāgaramakṣobhyaṁ vaidehi varuṇālayam
apāramabhigarjantaṁ śaṅkhaśuktiniṣevitam

translations.english: Do you O Vaidehī, behold the unagitated deep-the abode of Varuņa, appearing as if without the other end, roaring and abounding in conchs and pearl oysters.

verses.sanskrit:
हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि
विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyanābhaṁ śailendraṁ kāñcanaṁ paśya maithili
viśramārthaṁ hanumato bhittvā sāgaramutthitam

translations.english: O Maithili, do you behold the golden mount, which rose above the deep for affording a resting place to Hanumăn.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यते सीते किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना
सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या यत्र वाली मया हतः
verses.transliteration:
eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte kiṣkindhā citrakānanā
sugrīvasya purī ramyā yatra vālī mayā hataḥ

translations.english: Do you behold, O Sita, Kiskindha, having beautiful gardens, the pleasant city of Sugrīva, where Vālī was slain by me.

verses.sanskrit:
दृश्यतेऽसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः
ऋश्यमूको गिरिश्रेष्ठः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
dṛśyate'sau mahānsīte savidyudiva toyadaḥ
ṛśyamūko giriśreṣṭhaḥ kāñcanairdhātubhirvṛtaḥ

translations.english: Do you behold there, O Sītā, the huge and foremost mount Rishyamuka abounding in gold and various metals, like to clouds accompanied with lightnings.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः
समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थं वालिनो मया
verses.transliteration:
atrāhaṁ vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ
samayaśca kṛtaḥ sīte vadhārthaṁ vālino mayā

translations.english: There I was joined by Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys. And there I entered into an agreement, O Sita, for the destruction of Vali.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनी चित्रकानना
त्वया विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः
verses.transliteration:
eṣā sā dṛśyate pampā nalinī citrakānanā
tvayā vihīno yatrāhaṁ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ

translations.english: There is (the lake) Pampa abounding in lilies and skirted by picturesque forest where separated from you, I bewailed piteously.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्यास्तीरे मया दृष्टा शबरी धर्मचारिणी
अत्र योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो निहतो मया
verses.transliteration:
asyāstīre mayā dṛṣṭā śabarī dharmacāriṇī
atra yojanabāhuśca kabandho nihato mayā

translations.english: And on its bank I beheld the pious Savari. And you I slew Kabandha and Yojanabāhu.

verses.sanskrit:
दृश्यतेऽसौ जनस्थाने सीते श्रीमान्वनस्पतिः
यत्र युद्धं महद्वृत्तं तवहेतोर्विलासिनि
रावणस्य नृशंसस्य जटायोश्च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
dṛśyate'sau janasthāne sīte śrīmānvanaspatiḥ
yatra yuddhaṁ mahadvṛttaṁ tavahetorvilāsini
rāvaṇasya nṛśaṁsasya jaṭāyośca mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Behold there, O Sítā, a beautiful tree, in janasthāna, where, O you ever used to luxuries, for you, the highly powerful and energetic Jag ayu, the foremost of birds, was slain by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शना
यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात्
verses.transliteration:
parṇaśālā tathā citrā dṛśyate śubhadarśanā
yatra tvaṁ rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt

translations.english: Do you behold there, O you of a beautiful person, O you of auspicious looks, our hermitage and the beautiful cottage of leaves, where from you had been carried away by force by the lord of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शिवा
अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो ह्येष दृश्यते पश्य मैथिलि
verses.transliteration:
eṣā godāvarī ramyā prasannasalilā śivā
agastyasyāśramo hyeṣa dṛśyate paśya maithili

translations.english: Do you behold there the beautiful and sacred river Godāvarī having clear water and the hermitage of Agastya, surrounded by plantain trees.

verses.sanskrit:
वैदेहि दृश्यते चात्र शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान्
उपयातः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरंदरः
verses.transliteration:
vaidehi dṛśyate cātra śarabhaṅgāśramo mahān
upayātaḥ sahasrākṣo yatra śakraḥ puraṁdaraḥ

translations.english: Do you behold there, O Vaidehi, the great hermitage of Sarabhanga, where came the thousand-eyed, Sakra, the subduer of enemies cities.

verses.sanskrit:
एते ते तापसावासा दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे
अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानरप्रभः
अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी
verses.transliteration:
ete te tāpasāvāsā dṛśyante tanumadhyame
atriḥ kulapatiryatra sūryavaiśvānaraprabhaḥ
atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharmacāriṇī

translations.english: O worshipful dame, O you having a middle stature-among all those ascetics you behold, there lived Atri, the lord of our familyresembling the fire of the Sun. There was slain the huge bodied Biradha by me. There you did behold, O Sītā, the female astectic (the wife of Attri) ever performing pious observances.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ सुतनुशैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते
यत्र मां कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः
verses.transliteration:
asau sutanuśailendraścitrakūṭaḥ prakāśate
yatra māṁ kaikayīputraḥ prasādayitumāgataḥ

translations.english: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा सा यमुना दूराद्दृश्यते चित्रकानना
भरद्वाजाश्रमो यत्र श्रीमानेष प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration:
eṣā sā yamunā dūrāddṛśyate citrakānanā
bharadvājāśramo yatra śrīmāneṣa prakāśate

translations.english: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा सा दृश्यतेऽयोध्या राजधानी पितुर्मम
अयोध्यां कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता
verses.transliteration:
eṣā sā dṛśyate'yodhyā rājadhānī piturmama
ayodhyāṁ kuru vaidehi praṇāmaṁ punarāgatā

translations.english: Behold there the city of ſîngavera, where I made friendship with Guha. Behold there, O Sītā, the capital of my father. Do you bow to Ayodhya, O Vaidehi.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः
उत्पत्योत्पत्य ददृशुस्तां पुरीं शुभदर्शनाम्
verses.transliteration:
tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
utpatyotpatya dadṛśustāṁ purīṁ śubhadarśanām

translations.english: Thereupon all the monkeys and Rākşasas along with Vibhīşaņa rose up delightedly and saw the city.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्म्यमालिनीं; विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिसंकुलाम्
पुरीमयोध्यां ददृशुः प्लवंगमाः; पुरीं महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastu tāṁ pāṇḍuraharmyamālinīṁ; viśālakakṣyāṁ gajavājisaṁkulām
purīmayodhyāṁ dadṛśuḥ plavaṁgamāḥ; purīṁ mahendrasya yathāmarāvatīm

translations.english: Thereupon the monkeys and Rākşasas beheld the city abounding in white houses having spacious compartments, filled with elephants and horses and looking like Amarāvati, the capital of Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यां तु समालोक्य चिन्तयामास राघवः
चिन्तयित्वा ततो दृष्टिं वानरेषु न्यपातयत्
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāṁ tu samālokya cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
cintayitvā tato dṛṣṭiṁ vānareṣu nyapātayat

translations.english: Thinking thus the intelligent and effulgent (Rāma) cast his looks towards the monkeys and spoke to Hanumān, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियकामः प्रियं रामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमम्
उवाच धीमांस्तेजस्वी हनूमन्तं प्लवंगमम्
verses.transliteration:
priyakāmaḥ priyaṁ rāmastatastvaritavikramam
uvāca dhīmāṁstejasvī hanūmantaṁ plavaṁgamam

translations.english: Thereupon beholding Ayodhyā, Råma, the descendant of Raghu, of light movements and desirous of affording delight to others, thought of welcoming (them).

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यां त्वरितो गच्छ क्षिप्रं त्वं प्लवगोत्तम
जानीहि कच्चित्कुशली जनो नृपतिमन्दिरे
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāṁ tvarito gaccha kṣipraṁ tvaṁ plavagottama
jānīhi kaccitkuśalī jano nṛpatimandire

translations.english: O foremost of monkeys, speedily repairing to Ayodhyā do you learn of the welfare of all people in the palace of the king.

verses.sanskrit:
शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहं गहनगोचरम्
निषादाधिपतिं ब्रूहि कुशलं वचनान्मम
verses.transliteration:
śṛṅgaverapuraṁ prāpya guhaṁ gahanagocaram
niṣādādhipatiṁ brūhi kuśalaṁ vacanānmama

translations.english: Arriving at the city of Śộngavera, do you communicate to Guha, the king of Nişādas* having the forest as his kingdom, my well-being, at my command. *A low cast aboriginal Hindu corresponding to our Cāņdālas always living in the forest. The Raja of Ramnud in the district of Madura in Madras traces his descent from this Guha.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु मां कुशलिनमरोगं विगतज्वरम्
भविष्यति गुहः प्रीतः स ममात्मसमः सखा
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu māṁ kuśalinamarogaṁ vigatajvaram
bhaviṣyati guhaḥ prītaḥ sa mamātmasamaḥ sakhā

translations.english: Hearing that I am hale and hearty and relieved of all troubles, Guha, my friend like my own self, shall attain to delight.

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यायाश्च ते मार्गं प्रवृत्तिं भरतस्य च
निवेदयिष्यति प्रीतो निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāyāśca te mārgaṁ pravṛttiṁ bharatasya ca
nivedayiṣyati prīto niṣādādhipatirguhaḥ

translations.english: Guha, the lord of Nişādhas, delighted, shall inform you of the way to Ayodhyā and the well being of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
जित्वा शत्रुगणान्रामः प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः
उपयाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
jitvā śatrugaṇānrāmaḥ prāpya cānuttamaṁ yaśaḥ
upayāti samṛddhārthaḥ saha mitrairmahābalaḥ

translations.english: Do you, O gentle one, communicate to Bharata, my arrival here with the lord of Räks and king of monkeys. (Tell him) ‘vanquishing his foes and attaining to excellent fame Rāma has arrived at the gate of the city with his valiant friends, having satisfied the vow (of his sire).

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा यमाकारं भजते भरतस्ततः
स च ते वेदितव्यः स्यात्सर्वं यच्चापि मां प्रति
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā yamākāraṁ bhajate bharatastataḥ
sa ca te veditavyaḥ syātsarvaṁ yaccāpi māṁ prati

translations.english: You should read the signs expressive of joy or asas sorrow that Bharata shall display on hearing this and infer therefrom his attitude towards me.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञेयाः सर्वे च वृत्तान्ता भरतस्येङ्गितानि च
तत्त्वेन मुखवर्णेन दृष्ट्या व्याभाषणेन च
verses.transliteration:
jñeyāḥ sarve ca vṛttāntā bharatasyeṅgitāni ca
tattvena mukhavarṇena dṛṣṭyā vyābhāṣaṇena ca

translations.english: You should know, from the colour of his countenance, his looks and his words, all the movements and actions of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वकामसमृद्धं हि हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुलम्
पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कस्य नावर्तयेन्मनः
verses.transliteration:
sarvakāmasamṛddhaṁ hi hastyaśvarathasaṁkulam
pitṛpaitāmahaṁ rājyaṁ kasya nāvartayenmanaḥ

translations.english: Whose mind does not change obtaining such an ancestral kingdom, filled with all prosperity and abounding in elephants, horses and chariots?

verses.sanskrit:
संगत्या भरतः श्रीमान्राज्येनार्थी स्वयं भवेत्
प्रशास्तु वसुधां सर्वामखिलां रघुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
saṁgatyā bharataḥ śrīmānrājyenārthī svayaṁ bhavet
praśāstu vasudhāṁ sarvāmakhilāṁ raghunandanaḥ

translations.english: If the effulgent Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, ruling over it, wish the kingdom for himself, let him lord over the entire earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य बुद्धिं च विज्ञाय व्यवसायं च वानर
यावन्न दूरं याताः स्मः क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tasya buddhiṁ ca vijñāya vyavasāyaṁ ca vānara
yāvanna dūraṁ yātāḥ smaḥ kṣipramāgantumarhasi

translations.english: Therefore, O monkey, it behove you to come back speedily apprised of his intention and movements, before we proceed further.

verses.sanskrit:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
मानुषं धारयन्रूपमयोध्यां त्वरितो ययौ
verses.transliteration:
iti pratisamādiṣṭo hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ
mānuṣaṁ dhārayanrūpamayodhyāṁ tvarito yayau

translations.english: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Wind-god, assuming a human shape speedily proceeded towards Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहमासाद्य वीर्यवान्
स वाचा शुभया हृष्टो हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
śṛṅgaverapuraṁ prāpya guhamāsādya vīryavān
sa vācā śubhayā hṛṣṭo hanūmānidamabravīt

translations.english: Then crossing the Wind-path and the abode of the birds, getting over the terrible confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā, reaching the city of Śțrgavera and meeting Guha, the energetic Hanumān, delighted (addressed him) with the following excellent words.

verses.sanskrit:
सखा तु तव काकुत्स्थो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
ससीतः सह सौमित्रिः स त्वां कुशलमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
sakhā tu tava kākutstho rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
sasītaḥ saha saumitriḥ sa tvāṁ kuśalamabravīt

translations.english: Your friend Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha, having truth for his prowess, with Sītā and son of Sumitrā, has enquired of your welfare. Having spent five nights* till today, he, having obtained permission from the ascetic Bharadvāja, shall proceed to-morrow. *Having spent five nights after the expire of fourteen years old exile be is living at the hermitage of Varadwaja. He shall leave that place tomorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः
उत्पपात महावेगो वेगवानविचारयन्
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā mahātejāḥ saṁprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ
utpapāta mahāvego vegavānavicārayan

translations.english: Having said this the highly energetic monkey, not caring for the exhaustion of travel, greatly delighted and with hairs erect, rose up with great velocity.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि ते राजपुत्रं तं चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्
परिमोक्तुं व्यवस्यन्ति पौरा वै धर्मवत्सलाः
verses.transliteration:
na hi te rājaputraṁ taṁ cīrakṛṣṇājināmbaram
parimoktuṁ vyavasyanti paurā vai dharmavatsalāḥ

translations.english: All those citizens, fond of piety, did not like to use good clothes beholding the prince use bark and deer skin.

verses.sanskrit:
तं धर्ममिव धर्मज्ञं देववन्तमिवापरम्
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dharmamiva dharmajñaṁ devavantamivāparam
uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Hanumān, the son of Māruta spoke with folded hands to him, conversant with piety like virtue incarnate, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रियमाख्यामि ते देव शोकं त्यक्ष्यसि दारुणम्
अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते भ्रात्रा त्वं रामेण सह संगतः
verses.transliteration:
priyamākhyāmi te deva śokaṁ tyakṣyasi dāruṇam
asminmuhūrte bhrātrā tvaṁ rāmeṇa saha saṁgataḥ

translations.english: (He was then sprinkled by) the Rittigas, Brāhmaṇas, maidens enquired after your welfare. Do you, O worshipful sire speak out your welfare and renounce the dreadful grief. You shall in this moment be reconciled to your brother Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य रावणं रामः प्रतिलभ्य च मैथिलीम्
उपयाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलैः
verses.transliteration:
nihatya rāvaṇaṁ rāmaḥ pratilabhya ca maithilīm
upayāti samṛddhārthaḥ saha mitrairmahābalaiḥ

translations.english: Slaying Ravana, and regaining Maithili, Rāma, having accomplished his end, has arrived here with his valiant friends. The highly effulgent Lakşmaņa and the famed Vaidehi (have also come). Sītā fare well with Rāma like to Sacī in the company of Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता भरतः कैकयीसुतः
पपात सहसा हृष्टो हर्षान्मोहं जगाम ह
verses.transliteration:
evamukto hanumatā bharataḥ kaikayīsutaḥ
papāta sahasā hṛṣṭo harṣānmohaṁ jagāma ha

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Hanumān, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, delighted, fell down all on a sudden in a swoon of joy.

verses.sanskrit:
अशोकजैः प्रीतिमयैः कपिमालिङ्ग्य संभ्रमात्
सिषेच भरतः श्रीमान्विपुलैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration:
aśokajaiḥ prītimayaiḥ kapimāliṅgya saṁbhramāt
siṣeca bharataḥ śrīmānvipulairaśrubindubhiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon rising up in no time, and welcoming him, Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, spoke to Hanuman communicating the pleasant tidings, the following words. And embracing the monkey respectfully the graceful Bharata sprinkled him with profuse tears not out of grief but of joy.

verses.sanskrit:
देवो वा मानुषो वा त्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः
प्रियाख्यानस्य ते सौम्य ददामि ब्रुवतः प्रियम्
verses.transliteration:
devo vā mānuṣo vā tvamanukrośādihāgataḥ
priyākhyānasya te saumya dadāmi bruvataḥ priyam

translations.english: He said, Are you a man or god who have kindly come here? O gentle one, I shall confer upon you, who have communicated to me this pleasant tidings, hundreds and thousands of kine, hundreds of prosperous villages, sixteen young wives, pious, wearing excellent Kundalas, golden-hued, having beautiful noses and breast, having mor i like countenances, decked with all ornaments and born of respectable families.

verses.sanskrit:
निशम्य रामागमनं नृपात्मजः; कपिप्रवीरस्य तदाद्भुतोपमम्
प्रहर्षितो रामदिदृक्षयाभव;त्पुनश्च हर्षादिदमब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration:
niśamya rāmāgamanaṁ nṛpātmajaḥ; kapipravīrasya tadādbhutopamam
praharṣito rāmadidṛkṣayābhava;tpunaśca harṣādidamabravīdvacaḥ

translations.english: And hearing from that leading monkey of that wonderful return of Rāma, the son of the king, delighted became anxious to behold him and again addressed joyously Hanuman with the following words.

verses.sanskrit:
बहूनि नाम वर्षाणि गतस्य सुमहद्वनम्
शृणोम्यहं प्रीतिकरं मम नाथस्य कीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration:
bahūni nāma varṣāṇi gatasya sumahadvanam
śṛṇomyahaṁ prītikaraṁ mama nāthasya kīrtanam

translations.english: I hear the tidings of my brother affording me great delight who has been living in the huge forest for many a year.

verses.sanskrit:
कल्याणी बत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मे
एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि
verses.transliteration:
kalyāṇī bata gātheyaṁ laukikī pratibhāti me
eti jīvantamānando naraṁ varṣaśatādapi

translations.english: The saying of the people appear to me as instinct with well meaning that a man, if alive, may attain to joy even after a century.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य हरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः
कस्मिन्देशे किमाश्रित्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya harīṇāṁ ca kathamāsītsamāgamaḥ
kasmindeśe kimāśritya tattvamākhyāhi pṛcchataḥ

translations.english: Do you relate truly to me, how and in what country the union between Rāghava and the monkeys was brought about.

verses.sanskrit:
स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण बृस्यां समुपवेशितः
आचचक्षे ततः सर्वं रामस्य चरितं वने
verses.transliteration:
sa pṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa bṛsyāṁ samupaveśitaḥ
ācacakṣe tataḥ sarvaṁ rāmasya caritaṁ vane

translations.english: Being thus accosted by the prince and seated on Kusa, he, thereupon, began to describe Rama's life in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
अपयाते त्वयि तदा समुद्भ्रान्तमृगद्विजम्
प्रविवेशाथ विजनं सुमहद्दण्डकावनम्
verses.transliteration:
apayāte tvayi tadā samudbhrāntamṛgadvijam
praviveśātha vijanaṁ sumahaddaṇḍakāvanam

translations.english: Yourself having returned thence, all the bird and animals were overwhelmed with terror and that forest appeared as if distressed. Thereupon he entered the solitary and huge and dreadful forest Daņdaka distressed by the elephants and abounding in lion, tigers and deer.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां पुरस्ताद्बलवान्गच्छतां गहने वने
विनदन्सुमहानादं विराधः प्रत्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ purastādbalavāngacchatāṁ gahane vane
vinadansumahānādaṁ virādhaḥ pratyadṛśyata

translations.english: Your entering the dense forest there appeared before them the powerful Virādha* emitting a dreadful sound. *A demon of that name.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुत्क्षिप्य महानादमूर्ध्वबाहुमधोमुखम्
निखाते प्रक्षिपन्ति स्म नदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम्
verses.transliteration:
tamutkṣipya mahānādamūrdhvabāhumadhomukham
nikhāte prakṣipanti sma nadantamiva kuñjaram

translations.english: Taking him up roaring aloud like an elephant Rāma threw him with his arms upwards and face downwards into a pit.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
सायाह्ने शरभङ्गस्य रम्यमाश्रममीयतुः
verses.transliteration:
tatkṛtvā duṣkaraṁ karma bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau
sāyāhne śarabhaṅgasya ramyamāśramamīyatuḥ

translations.english: Having accomplished that difficult work the two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, arrived in the evening at the pleasant hermitage of Sarabhanga.

verses.sanskrit:
शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
अभिवाद्य मुनीन्सर्वाञ्जनस्थानमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
śarabhaṅge divaṁ prāpte rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ
abhivādya munīnsarvāñjanasthānamupāgamat

translations.english: Śarabhanga having attained to heaven, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, saluting all the ascetics, repaired to Janasthāna.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्
हतानि वसता तत्र राघवेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām
hatāni vasatā tatra rāghaveṇa mahātmanā

translations.english: And by the high-souled Rāghava, living there, fourteen thousand inhabitants of janasthāna were slain.

verses.sanskrit:
सा राममब्रवीद्दृष्ट्वा वैदेही गृह्यतामिति
अहो मनोहरः कान्त आश्रमे नो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sā rāmamabravīddṛṣṭvā vaidehī gṛhyatāmiti
aho manoharaḥ kānta āśrame no bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Beholding it, Vaidehī spoke to Rāma, saying, 'Do you catch it; with it when caught our hermitage shall be more charming'

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिर्धावन्तमनुधावति
स तं जघान धावन्तं शरेणानतपर्वणा
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmo dhanuṣpāṇirdhāvantamanudhāvati
sa taṁ jaghāna dhāvantaṁ śareṇānataparvaṇā

translations.english: Thereupon Rāma, with bow in his hand, pursued that deer and with one shaft destroyed it.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ सौम्या दशग्रीवो मृगं याते तु राघवे
लक्ष्मणे चापि निष्क्रान्ते प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा
जग्राह तरसा सीतां ग्रहः खे रोहिणीमिव
verses.transliteration:
atha saumyā daśagrīvo mṛgaṁ yāte tu rāghave
lakṣmaṇe cāpi niṣkrānte praviveśāśramaṁ tadā
jagrāha tarasā sītāṁ grahaḥ khe rohiṇīmiva

translations.english: O gentle one, Räghava going out on hunting, and Lakṣmaṇa having issued out of the hermitage, the Ten-necked (demon) entered therein.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रातुकामं ततो युद्धे हत्वा गृध्रं जटायुषम्
प्रगृह्य सीतां सहसा जगामाशु स रावणः
verses.transliteration:
trātukāmaṁ tato yuddhe hatvā gṛdhraṁ jaṭāyuṣam
pragṛhya sītāṁ sahasā jagāmāśu sa rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: And he speedily got hold of Sītā, like to Rohiņi possessed by the planet in the sky. Thereupon slaying the vulture Jatayu in the conflict desirous of rescuing her and getting hold of Sītā that Rākşasa speedily repaired (to his capital).

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वद्भुतसंकाशाः स्थिताः पर्वतमूर्धनि
सीतां गृहीत्वा गच्छन्तं वानराः पर्वतोपमाः
ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastvadbhutasaṁkāśāḥ sthitāḥ parvatamūrdhani
sītāṁ gṛhītvā gacchantaṁ vānarāḥ parvatopamāḥ
dadṛśurvismitāstatra rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam

translations.english: Thereupon some monkeys resembling mountains, stationed on the summit of a mountain, stricken with wondrous fear and astonishment, beheld Ravana, the lord of Rākşasas proceed with Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
तां सुवर्णपरिक्रान्ते शुभे महति वेश्मनि
प्रवेश्य मैथिलीं वाक्यैः सान्त्वयामास रावणः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ suvarṇaparikrānte śubhe mahati veśmani
praveśya maithilīṁ vākyaiḥ sāntvayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: Entering the huge and excellent golden palace Ravana consoled Maithili with (diverse) words.

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तमानः काकुत्स्थो दृष्ट्वा गृध्रं प्रविव्यथे
verses.transliteration: nivartamānaḥ kākutstho dṛṣṭvā gṛdhraṁ pravivyathe

translations.english: Thereupon returned Rāma after having slain the deer in the forest. Having returned and seen the vulture, dearer than his father, slain, Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha was pained.

verses.sanskrit:
गृध्रं हतं तदा दग्ध्वा रामः प्रियसखं पितुः
गोदावरीमनुचरन्वनोद्देशांश्च पुष्पितान्
आसेदतुर्महारण्ये कबन्धं नाम राक्षसं
verses.transliteration:
gṛdhraṁ hataṁ tadā dagdhvā rāmaḥ priyasakhaṁ pituḥ
godāvarīmanucaranvanoddeśāṁśca puṣpitān
āsedaturmahāraṇye kabandhaṁ nāma rākṣasaṁ

translations.english: And searching Vaidehi and ranging at the banks of Godaveri and forest-lands covered with flowers, Rāma with Laksmana, met in that huge forest a Rākşasa named Kabandha. Thereupon at the words of Kabandha, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, repairing to the mount Rishyamuka, was united with Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
तयोः समागमः पूर्वं प्रीत्या हार्दो व्यजायत
इतरेतर संवादात्प्रगाढः प्रणयस्तयोः
verses.transliteration:
tayoḥ samāgamaḥ pūrvaṁ prītyā hārdo vyajāyata
itaretara saṁvādātpragāḍhaḥ praṇayastayoḥ

translations.english: There had grown mutual love in them before they were known to each other. Sugrīva was driven away by his angry brother Váli. And informed of each other's affairs their friendship grew closer.

verses.sanskrit:
रामः स्वबाहुवीर्येण स्वराज्यं प्रत्यपादयत्
वालिनं समरे हत्वा महाकायं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmaḥ svabāhuvīryeṇa svarājyaṁ pratyapādayat
vālinaṁ samare hatvā mahākāyaṁ mahābalam

translations.english: Thereupon slaying the huge-bodied and highly powerful Vāli in the conflict by virtue of the strength of his own arms Rāma obtained (for Sugriva) his own kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये सहितः सर्ववानरैः
रामाय प्रतिजानीते राजपुत्र्यास्तु मार्गणम्
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvaḥ sthāpito rājye sahitaḥ sarvavānaraiḥ
rāmāya pratijānīte rājaputryāstu mārgaṇam

translations.english: Being placed on the throne with all the monkeys, Sugrīva promised to Rāma the enquiry of the Princess (Sītā).

verses.sanskrit:
आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महात्मना
दशकोट्यः प्लवंगानां सर्वाः प्रस्थापिता दिशः
verses.transliteration:
ādiṣṭā vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa mahātmanā
daśakoṭyaḥ plavaṁgānāṁ sarvāḥ prasthāpitā diśaḥ

translations.english: Being commanded by the high-souled Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, ten koțis of monkeys repaired to (various) quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां नो विप्रनष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे
भृशं शोकाभितप्तानां महान्कालोऽत्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ no vipranaṣṭānāṁ vindhye parvatasattame
bhṛśaṁ śokābhitaptānāṁ mahānkālo'tyavartata

translations.english: Among them some of us lost our way in a cavity of the Vindhya mountain, and were stricken with great terror-and accordingly much time was lost.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्राता तु गृध्रराजस्य संपातिर्नाम वीर्यवान्
समाख्याति स्म वसतिं सीताया रावणालये
verses.transliteration:
bhrātā tu gṛdhrarājasya saṁpātirnāma vīryavān
samākhyāti sma vasatiṁ sītāyā rāvaṇālaye

translations.english: The powerful brother of the king of vultures named Sampāti communicated to us the residence of Sītā in the palace of Rāvaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
मया च पुनरागम्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
अभिज्ञानं मया दत्तमर्चिष्मान्स महामणिः
verses.transliteration:
mayā ca punarāgamya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
abhijñānaṁ mayā dattamarciṣmānsa mahāmaṇiḥ

translations.english: Having returned I presented Råma of unwearied actions with that ensign of a brilliant gem.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तां मैथिलीं हृष्टस्त्वाशशंसे स जीवितम्
जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तः पीत्वामृतमिवातुरः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tāṁ maithilīṁ hṛṣṭastvāśaśaṁse sa jīvitam
jīvitāntamanuprāptaḥ pītvāmṛtamivāturaḥ

translations.english: Hearing (of the news of Vaidehi) Rama regained his life like one on the verge of death regaining his being after drinking nectar.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्योजयिष्यन्नुद्योगं दध्रे लङ्कावधे मनः
जिघांसुरिव लोकांस्ते सर्वाँल्लोकान्विभावसुः
verses.transliteration:
udyojayiṣyannudyogaṁ dadhre laṅkāvadhe manaḥ
jighāṁsuriva lokāṁste sarvā̐llokānvibhāvasuḥ

translations.english: And exciting (his soldiers) for making preparations like to Fire about to destroy all people he made up his mind for the devastation of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः समुद्रमासाद्य नलं सेतुमकारयत्
अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ samudramāsādya nalaṁ setumakārayat
ataratkapivīrāṇāṁ vāhinī tena setunā

translations.english: Thereupon arriving at the banks of the ocean he had a bridge constructed by Nala by which the army of monkey heroes crossed (the deep).

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहस्तमवधीन्नीलः कुम्भकर्णं तु राघवः
लक्ष्मणो रावणसुतं स्वयं रामस्तु रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
prahastamavadhīnnīlaḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ tu rāghavaḥ
lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇasutaṁ svayaṁ rāmastu rāvaṇam

translations.english: Nala destroyed Prahasta, Rāghava slew Kumbhakarņa, Lakşmaņa killed the son of Rāvana and Rāma himself slew Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
स शक्रेण समागम्य यमेन वरुणेन च
सुरर्षिभिश्च काकुत्स्थो वराँल्लेभे परंतपः
verses.transliteration:
sa śakreṇa samāgamya yamena varuṇena ca
surarṣibhiśca kākutstho varā̐llebhe paraṁtapaḥ

translations.english: That graceful descendant of Kākutstha, the slayer of foes, obtained the boon from them as well as from the saints assembled there (celestial and otherwise).

verses.sanskrit:
स तु दत्तवरः प्रीत्या वानरैश्च समागतः
पुष्पकेण विमानेन किष्किन्धामभ्युपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu dattavaraḥ prītyā vānaraiśca samāgataḥ
puṣpakeṇa vimānena kiṣkindhāmabhyupāgamat

translations.english: Having obtained the boon he, delighted, met the monkeys and in the car Puspaka reached Kiskindha.

verses.sanskrit:
तं गङ्गां पुनरासाद्य वसन्तं मुनिसंनिधौ
अविघ्नं पुष्ययोगेन श्वो रामं द्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
taṁ gaṅgāṁ punarāsādya vasantaṁ munisaṁnidhau
avighnaṁ puṣyayogena śvo rāmaṁ draṣṭumarhasi

translations.english: Again reaching the Ganges he is living with the ascetic; it become you to behold him tomorrow under the auspices of Pushya, without any hindrance.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स सत्यं हनुमद्वचो मह;न्निशम्य हृष्टो भरतः कृताञ्जलिः
उवाच वाणीं मनसः प्रहर्षिणी; चिरस्य पूर्णः खलु मे मनोरथः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa satyaṁ hanumadvaco maha;nniśamya hṛṣṭo bharataḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
uvāca vāṇīṁ manasaḥ praharṣiṇī; cirasya pūrṇaḥ khalu me manorathaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon being delighted with the sweet accents of Hanumān, Bharata addressed him, with folded hands, with words affording delight, saying, "After a long time my desire has been fulfilled.”

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु परमानन्दं भरतः सत्यविक्रमः
हृष्टमाज्ञापयामास शत्रुघ्नं परवीरहा
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu paramānandaṁ bharataḥ satyavikramaḥ
hṛṣṭamājñāpayāmāsa śatrughnaṁ paravīrahā

translations.english: Hearing those words affording great delight, Bharata, the slayer of enemies, having truth for his prowess, delighted, ordered Satrughna, (saying).

verses.sanskrit:
दैवतानि च सर्वाणि चैत्यानि नगरस्य च
सुगन्धमाल्यैर्वादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः
verses.transliteration:
daivatāni ca sarvāṇi caityāni nagarasya ca
sugandhamālyairvāditrairarcantu śucayo narāḥ

translations.english: Let all people being purified worship all the deities and altars of the city with fragrant garlands and diverse music.

verses.sanskrit:
राजदारास्तथामात्याः सैन्याः सेनागणाङ्गनाः
अभिनिर्यान्तु रामस्य द्रष्टुं शशिनिभं मुखम्
verses.transliteration:
rājadārāstathāmātyāḥ sainyāḥ senāgaṇāṅganāḥ
abhiniryāntu rāmasya draṣṭuṁ śaśinibhaṁ mukham

translations.english: Let all the bards conversant with the chanting of the pedigree, the flatterers, all those conversant with music, the dancing girls, the queens, the courtiers, the soldiers with their wives, Brāhmaṇas, Kşaatryas, and people of all other castes, issue out to behold the moon-like countenance of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
समीकुरुत निम्नानि विषमाणि समानि च
स्थानानि च निरस्यन्तां नन्दिग्रामादितः परम्
verses.transliteration:
samīkuruta nimnāni viṣamāṇi samāni ca
sthānāni ca nirasyantāṁ nandigrāmāditaḥ param

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bharata, Śatrughna, the slayer of enemies, divided the work among the servants, (saying), "Do you level the high and low ground from nandigram to (Ayodhyā). Do you perfectly water the ground with cold water.

verses.sanskrit:
समुच्छ्रितपताकास्तु रथ्याः पुरवरोत्तमे
शोभयन्तु च वेश्मानि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
samucchritapatākāstu rathyāḥ puravarottame
śobhayantu ca veśmāni sūryasyodayanaṁ prati

translations.english: Thereafter sprinkle all the places with flowers and dried paddy; hoist up flags all over the city; decorate all the houses, before the rising of the moon with garlands, jewels, flowers of gold and things of five other colours.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तैर्नागसहस्रैश्च शातकुम्भविभूषितः
अपरे हेमकक्ष्याभिः सगजाभिः करेणुभिः
निर्ययुस्त्वरया युक्ता रथैश्च सुमहारथाः
verses.transliteration:
mattairnāgasahasraiśca śātakumbhavibhūṣitaḥ
apare hemakakṣyābhiḥ sagajābhiḥ kareṇubhiḥ
niryayustvarayā yuktā rathaiśca sumahārathāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon issued out men on horse back and in cars with thousands of mad elephants welldecked with pennons and she-elephants with golden seats (on their back).

verses.sanskrit:
समीक्ष्य भरतो वाक्यमुवाच पवनात्मजम्
कच्चिन्न खलु कापेयी सेव्यते चलचित्तता
न हि पश्यामि काकुत्स्थं राममार्यं परंतपम्
verses.transliteration:
samīkṣya bharato vākyamuvāca pavanātmajam
kaccinna khalu kāpeyī sevyate calacittatā
na hi paśyāmi kākutsthaṁ rāmamāryaṁ paraṁtapam

translations.english: Did you not resort to the usual fickleness of the monkeys? We do not behold the worshipful Răma, the descendant of Kākutstha the slayer of foes. Nor do we behold the monkeys assuming shapes at will.

verses.sanskrit:
अथैवमुक्ते वचने हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्
अर्थं विज्ञापयन्नेव भरतं सत्यविक्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
athaivamukte vacane hanūmānidamabravīt
arthaṁ vijñāpayanneva bharataṁ satyavikramam

translations.english: Having been addressed with those words, Hanumăn replied, communicating to Bharata, having truth for his prowess, the truth.

verses.sanskrit:
सदा फलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान्प्राप्य मधुस्रवान्
भरद्वाजप्रसादेन मत्तभ्रमरनादितान्
verses.transliteration:
sadā phalānkusumitānvṛkṣānprāpya madhusravān
bharadvājaprasādena mattabhramaranāditān

translations.english: Having reached the trees, covered by the favour of Bhardvaja, with fruits and flowers and pouring honey, the monkeys are emitting noise like maddened black bees. O slayer of foes, this boon was granted him (Rama ) by Vasava (Bharadvāja) is treating him with his army with all hospitality.

verses.sanskrit:
निस्वनः श्रूयते भीमः प्रहृष्टानां वनौकसाम्
मन्ये वानरसेना सा नदीं तरति गोमतीम्
verses.transliteration:
nisvanaḥ śrūyate bhīmaḥ prahṛṣṭānāṁ vanaukasām
manye vānarasenā sā nadīṁ tarati gomatīm

translations.english: Hear the dreadful noise of the delighted monkeys. Methinks the monkey host has crossed the river Gomati.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतद्दृश्यते दूराद्विमलं चन्द्रसंनिभम्
विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं मनसा ब्रह्मनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration:
tadetaddṛśyate dūrādvimalaṁ candrasaṁnibham
vimānaṁ puṣpakaṁ divyaṁ manasā brahmanirmitam

translations.english: Behold the huge upheaval of dust towards the Sala forest. Methinks the monkeys are agitating the graceful Săla forest. Behold there at the distance the car resembling the Sun. This celestial car Puspaka, constructed by Brahma's mind, was obtained by the high-souled (Rāma) after having slain Rāvana with his friends.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणं बान्धवैः सार्धं हत्वा लब्धं महात्मना
धनदस्य प्रसादेन दिव्यमेतन्मनोजवम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaṁ bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṁ hatvā labdhaṁ mahātmanā
dhanadasya prasādena divyametanmanojavam

translations.english: This celestial car, resembling the newly risen Sun, coursing at will and carrying Rāma (was gained) by the favour of the Giver of wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्भ्रातरौ वीरौ वैदेह्या सह राघवौ
सुग्रीवश्च महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
etasminbhrātarau vīrau vaidehyā saha rāghavau
sugrīvaśca mahātejā rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: (There are) the two heroic brothers-the descendants of Raghu with Vaidehi, the highly effulgent Sugriva and the Räkşasa Vibhīşana.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हर्षसमुद्भूतो निस्वनो दिवमस्पृशत्
स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानां रामोऽयमिति कीर्तितः
verses.transliteration:
tato harṣasamudbhūto nisvano divamaspṛśat
strībālayuvavṛddhānāṁ rāmo'yamiti kīrtitaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon with the sound of there is Rama' there arose a joyous noise reaching the abode of the celestials from among women, children, the young and the old.

verses.sanskrit:
रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यस्तेऽवतीर्य महीं गताः
ददृशुस्तं विमानस्थं नराः सोममिवाम्बरे
verses.transliteration:
rathakuñjaravājibhyaste'vatīrya mahīṁ gatāḥ
dadṛśustaṁ vimānasthaṁ narāḥ somamivāmbare

translations.english: Thereupon descending upon the earth from chariots, elephants and horses all people beheld him (Rāma) stationed on the car like to the moon in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राञ्जलिर्भरतो भूत्वा प्रहृष्टो राघवोन्मुखः
स्वागतेन यथार्थेन ततो राममपूजयत्
verses.transliteration:
prāñjalirbharato bhūtvā prahṛṣṭo rāghavonmukhaḥ
svāgatena yathārthena tato rāmamapūjayat

translations.english: Facing Rāghava and with folded hands Bharata delightedly worshipped him with agreeable words, Arghya and water to wash his feet.

verses.sanskrit:
मनसा ब्रह्मणा सृष्टे विमाने लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
रराज पृथुदीर्घाक्षो वज्रपाणिरिवापरः
verses.transliteration:
manasā brahmaṇā sṛṣṭe vimāne lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
rarāja pṛthudīrghākṣo vajrapāṇirivāparaḥ

translations.english: There appeared in the car constructed by Brahmā's mind the elder brother of Bharata having expansive eyes like the immortal wielder of thunder-bolt.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विमानाग्रगतं भरतो भ्रातरं तदा
ववन्दे प्रणतो रामं मेरुस्थमिव भास्करम्
verses.transliteration:
tato vimānāgragataṁ bharato bhrātaraṁ tadā
vavande praṇato rāmaṁ merusthamiva bhāskaram

translations.english: Thereupon Bharata humbly saluted his brother Rāma seated on the top of the car like to the Sun on the summit (of the mount Meru).

verses.sanskrit:
आरोपितो विमानं तद्भरतः सत्यविक्रमः
राममासाद्य मुदितः पुनरेवाभ्यवादयत्
verses.transliteration:
āropito vimānaṁ tadbharataḥ satyavikramaḥ
rāmamāsādya muditaḥ punarevābhyavādayat

translations.english: Ascending that car, Bharata, having truth for his prowess, reaching Rāma, delighted, again bowed to him.

verses.sanskrit:
तं समुत्थाप्य काकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिपथं गतम्
अङ्के भरतमारोप्य मुदितः परिषष्वजे
verses.transliteration:
taṁ samutthāpya kākutsthaścirasyākṣipathaṁ gatam
aṅke bharatamāropya muditaḥ pariṣaṣvaje

translations.english: Raising Bharata up who had been seen after a long time and placing him on his lap Kākutstha, delighted, embraced him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो लक्ष्मणमासाद्य वैदेहीं च परंतपः
अभ्यवादयत प्रीतो भरतो नाम चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tato lakṣmaṇamāsādya vaidehīṁ ca paraṁtapaḥ
abhyavādayata prīto bharato nāma cābravīt

translations.english: Thereupon Bharata, the slayer of foes, bowed to Vaidehī and welcomed Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवं कैकयी पुत्रो जाम्बवन्तं तथाङ्गदम्
मैन्दं च द्विविदं नीलमृषभं चैव सस्वजे
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvaṁ kaikayī putro jāmbavantaṁ tathāṅgadam
maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ nīlamṛṣabhaṁ caiva sasvaje

translations.english: The son of Kaikeyi (then in turn) embraced Sugrīva, Jāmbavān, Angada, Mainda, Dvivida, Nīla and Rşabha.

verses.sanskrit:
ते कृत्वा मानुषं रूपं वानराः कामरूपिणः
कुशलं पर्यपृच्छन्त प्रहृष्टा भरतं तदा
verses.transliteration:
te kṛtvā mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
kuśalaṁ paryapṛcchanta prahṛṣṭā bharataṁ tadā

translations.english: He then embraced Sușeņa, Nala, Gavākşa, Gandhamadana, Sarabha, and Panasa. And assuming human shapes, those monkeys, assuming shapes at will, delightedly enquired after Bharata's well being.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणं च भरतः सान्त्वयन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
दिष्ट्या त्वया सहायेन कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇaṁ ca bharataḥ sāntvayanvākyamabravīt
diṣṭyā tvayā sahāyena kṛtaṁ karma suduṣkaram

translations.english: Bharata then addressed Vibhiṣaṇa with soothing words, “It is by fortune that through your help he has accomplished such a difficult work."

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघ्नश्च तदा राममभिवाद्य सलक्ष्मणम्
सीतायाश्चरणौ पश्चाद्ववन्दे विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration:
śatrughnaśca tadā rāmamabhivādya salakṣmaṇam
sītāyāścaraṇau paścādvavande vinayānvitaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the heroic Satrughna saluting Rāma and Lakşmaņa, respectfully bowed to Sitā.

verses.sanskrit:
रामो मातरमासाद्य विषण्णं शोककर्शिताम्
जग्राह प्रणतः पादौ मनो मातुः प्रसादयन्
verses.transliteration:
rāmo mātaramāsādya viṣaṇṇaṁ śokakarśitām
jagrāha praṇataḥ pādau mano mātuḥ prasādayan

translations.english: Having approached his mother, pale and pulled down with grief, Rāma humbly touched her feet and enhanced her delight.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम्
स मातॄश्च तदा सर्वाः पुरोहितमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīṁ ca yaśasvinīm
sa mātṝśca tadā sarvāḥ purohitamupāgamat

translations.english: Thereupon saluting Sumitrā, famed Kaikeyi and all his mothers he approached the priests.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वागतं ते महाबाहो कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन
इति प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे नागरा राममब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
svāgataṁ te mahābāho kausalyānandavardhana
iti prāñjalayaḥ sarve nāgarā rāmamabruvan

translations.english: Thereupon all the citizens with folded hands welcomed him saying, “Welcome are you, O you of long arms! O you the enhancer of Kausalya's joy!"

verses.sanskrit:
तन्यञ्जलिसहस्राणि प्रगृहीतानि नागरैः
आकोशानीव पद्मानि ददर्श भरताग्रजः
verses.transliteration:
tanyañjalisahasrāṇi pragṛhītāni nāgaraiḥ
ākośānīva padmāni dadarśa bharatāgrajaḥ

translations.english: The elder brother of Bharata observed the folded hands of the citizens like so many blown lotuses.

verses.sanskrit:
पादुके ते तु रामस्य गृहीत्वा भरतः स्वयम्
चरणाभ्यां नरेन्द्रस्य योजयामास धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration:
pāduke te tu rāmasya gṛhītvā bharataḥ svayam
caraṇābhyāṁ narendrasya yojayāmāsa dharmavit

translations.english: And himself taking the sandals of Rāma, Bharata, conversant with piety, placed them at the feet of that lord of men. Thereupon Bharata with folded hands spoke to Rāma, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य जन्म कृतार्थं मे संवृत्तश्च मनोरथः
यस्त्वां पश्यामि राजानमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्
verses.transliteration:
adya janma kṛtārthaṁ me saṁvṛttaśca manorathaḥ
yastvāṁ paśyāmi rājānamayodhyāṁ punarāgatam

translations.english: This all your kingdom, which you did leave to my care, I return you. Blessed is my birth today and accomplished is my desire, since I behold you again as king in Ayodhyā after your return.

verses.sanskrit:
अवेक्षतां भवान्कोशं कोष्ठागारं पुरं बलम्
भवतस्तेजसा सर्वं कृतं दशगुणं मया
verses.transliteration:
avekṣatāṁ bhavānkośaṁ koṣṭhāgāraṁ puraṁ balam
bhavatastejasā sarvaṁ kṛtaṁ daśaguṇaṁ mayā

translations.english: Do you examine your wealth treasury, palace and army. By your favour I have increased all these ten fold.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं दृष्ट्वा तं भ्रातृवत्सलम्
मुमुचुर्वानरा बाष्पं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
tathā bruvāṇaṁ bharataṁ dṛṣṭvā taṁ bhrātṛvatsalam
mumucurvānarā bāṣpaṁ rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Hearing Bharata speak in that wise and beholding him devoted to his brother all the monkeys and the Rākşasa Vibhîşana shed tears.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः
ययौ तेन विमानेन ससैन्यो भरताश्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ praharṣādbharatamaṅkamāropya rāghavaḥ
yayau tena vimānena sasainyo bharatāśramam

translations.english: Thereupon placing Bharata, in delight, on his lap, Raghava, with his army in that car, proceeded towards Bharata's abode.

verses.sanskrit:
भरताश्रममासाद्य ससैन्यो राघवस्तदा
अवतीर्य विमानाग्रादवतस्थे महीतले
verses.transliteration:
bharatāśramamāsādya sasainyo rāghavastadā
avatīrya vimānāgrādavatasthe mahītale

translations.english: That time reaching Bharata's palace Räghava from the top of the aerial car with his army descended upon the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीच्च तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्
वह वैश्रवणं देवमनुजानामि गम्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
abravīcca tadā rāmastadvimānamanuttamam
vaha vaiśravaṇaṁ devamanujānāmi gamyatām

translations.english: Thereupon Rāma said to the excellent car, Do you (now) go to Vaisravana, I do permit you.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्
उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य जगाम धनदालयम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmābhyanujñātaṁ tadvimānamanuttamam
uttarāṁ diśamuddiśya jagāma dhanadālayam

translations.english: Thereupon being thus commanded by Rāma, that excellent car, proceeding towards the north, reached the abode of the Giver of wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरोहितस्यात्मसमस्य राघवो; बृहस्पतेः शक्र इवामराधिपः
निपीड्य पादौ पृथगासने शुभे; सहैव तेनोपविवेश वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
purohitasyātmasamasya rāghavo; bṛhaspateḥ śakra ivāmarādhipaḥ
nipīḍya pādau pṛthagāsane śubhe; sahaiva tenopaviveśa vīryavān

translations.english: And touching the feet of his priest the powerful Rāghava sat on a separate and excellent seat like to Sakra, the lord of immortals (by the side of) Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit:
शिरस्यञ्जलिमादाय कैकेयीनन्दिवर्धनः
बभाषे भरतो ज्येष्ठं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
śirasyañjalimādāya kaikeyīnandivardhanaḥ
babhāṣe bharato jyeṣṭhaṁ rāmaṁ satyaparākramam

translations.english: Thereupon having placed her palms on his head Bharata, the enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy spoke to his elder brother Rāma, having truth for his prowess, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
पूजिता मामिका माता दत्तं राज्यमिदं मम
तद्ददामि पुनस्तुभ्यं यथा त्वमददा मम
verses.transliteration:
pūjitā māmikā mātā dattaṁ rājyamidaṁ mama
taddadāmi punastubhyaṁ yathā tvamadadā mama

translations.english: Abiding by my mother's request you did confer this kingdom upon me; I do return you the kingdom you did give me.

verses.sanskrit:
धुरमेकाकिना न्यस्तामृषभेण बलीयसा
किशोरवद्गुरुं भारं न वोढुमहमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration:
dhuramekākinā nyastāmṛṣabheṇa balīyasā
kiśoravadguruṁ bhāraṁ na voḍhumahamutsahe

translations.english: Like to a young one unable to carry a heavy burden thrown off by a powerful bull I am unable to carry this huge burden of the kingdom).

verses.sanskrit:
वारिवेगेन महता भिन्नः सेतुरिव क्षरन्
दुर्बन्धनमिदं मन्ये राज्यच्छिद्रमसंवृतम्
verses.transliteration:
vārivegena mahatā bhinnaḥ seturiva kṣaran
durbandhanamidaṁ manye rājyacchidramasaṁvṛtam

translations.english: I do consider this kingdom infested with thieves, difficult to govern, as it is difficult to reconstruct a bridge broken down by a powerful current of water.

verses.sanskrit:
गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य हंसस्येव च वायसः
नान्वेतुमुत्सहे देव तव मार्गमरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
gatiṁ khara ivāśvasya haṁsasyeva ca vāyasaḥ
nānvetumutsahe deva tava mārgamariṁdama

translations.english: As an ass cannot follow the course of a horse and a crow cannot follow that of a gander, so I am unable, O hero, O slayer of foes, to follow your footsteps.

verses.sanskrit:
जगदद्याभिषिक्तं त्वामनुपश्यतु सर्वतः
प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं मध्याह्ने दीप्ततेजसं
verses.transliteration:
jagadadyābhiṣiktaṁ tvāmanupaśyatu sarvataḥ
pratapantamivādityaṁ madhyāhne dīptatejasaṁ

translations.english: Let the world, O Raghava, behold you installed (today) liku to the powerful midday Sun burning in effulgence.

verses.sanskrit:
तूर्यसंघातनिर्घोषैः काञ्चीनूपुरनिस्वनैः
मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्च प्रतिबुध्यस्व शेष्व च
verses.transliteration:
tūryasaṁghātanirghoṣaiḥ kāñcīnūpuranisvanaiḥ
madhurairgītaśabdaiśca pratibudhyasva śeṣva ca

translations.english: Do you sleep and rise up with the sound of stringed instruments, women's girdles and Nupuras and charming songs.

verses.sanskrit:
यावदावर्तते चक्रं यावती च वसुंधरा
तावत्त्वमिह सर्वस्य स्वामित्वमभिवर्तय
verses.transliteration:
yāvadāvartate cakraṁ yāvatī ca vasuṁdharā
tāvattvamiha sarvasya svāmitvamabhivartaya

translations.english: Do you govern the people as long as the solar system exists and as far as the earth extends.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः परपुरंजयः
तथेति प्रतिजग्राह निषसादासने शुभे
verses.transliteration:
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ parapuraṁjayaḥ
tatheti pratijagrāha niṣasādāsane śubhe

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bharata, Rāma the conqueror of enemies cities, saying, “So be it" sat on an excellent seat.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शत्रुघ्नवचनान्निपुणाः श्मश्रुवर्धकाः
सुखहस्ताः सुशीघ्राश्च राघवं पर्युपासत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śatrughnavacanānnipuṇāḥ śmaśruvardhakāḥ
sukhahastāḥ suśīghrāśca rāghavaṁ paryupāsata

translations.english: Thereupon at the command of Satrughna, expert, skilful and quick-handed barbers gathered round Rāghava.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वं तु भरते स्नाते लक्ष्मणे च महाबले
सुग्रीवे वानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रे विभीषणे
verses.transliteration:
pūrvaṁ tu bharate snāte lakṣmaṇe ca mahābale
sugrīve vānarendre ca rākṣasendre vibhīṣaṇe

translations.english: At first, Bharata, the highly powerful Laks maņa, Sugrīva the lord of monkeys, and Vibhīs aņa the lord of Rākşasas bathed. Thereupon shorn of his matted hairs, bathed, with paste excellent garlands and precious clothes on, he appeared there shining in grace.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिकर्म च रामस्य कारयामास वीर्यवान्
लक्ष्मणस्य च लक्ष्मीवानिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः
verses.transliteration:
pratikarma ca rāmasya kārayāmāsa vīryavān
lakṣmaṇasya ca lakṣmīvānikṣvākukulavardhanaḥ

translations.english: The valiant and graceful Śatrughna the upholder of the dignity of Ikşvāku race, himself got ready the dresses for Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिकर्म च सीतायाः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः
आत्मनैव तदा चक्रुर्मनस्विन्यो मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration:
pratikarma ca sītāyāḥ sarvā daśarathastriyaḥ
ātmanaiva tadā cakrurmanasvinyo manoharam

translations.english: All the high-minded wives of Dasaratha with their own hands decked Sītă with various charming (ornaments).

verses.sanskrit:
ततो राघवपत्नीनां सर्वासामेव शोभनम्
चकार यत्नात्कौसल्या प्रहृष्टा पुत्रवत्सला
verses.transliteration:
tato rāghavapatnīnāṁ sarvāsāmeva śobhanam
cakāra yatnātkausalyā prahṛṣṭā putravatsalā

translations.english: Thereupon Kausalyā, delighted and fond of her son, herself with great care, decorated the wives of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शत्रुघ्नवचनात्सुमन्त्रो नाम सारथिः
योजयित्वाभिचक्राम रथं सर्वाङ्गशोभनम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śatrughnavacanātsumantro nāma sārathiḥ
yojayitvābhicakrāma rathaṁ sarvāṅgaśobhanam

translations.english: Thereupon at the words of ſatrughna, the charioteer by name Sumantra got ready the perfectly beautiful car.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्कमण्डलसंकाशं दिव्यं दृष्ट्वा रथं स्थितम्
आरुरोह महाबाहू रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
arkamaṇḍalasaṁkāśaṁ divyaṁ dṛṣṭvā rathaṁ sthitam
āruroha mahābāhū rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ

translations.english: Beholding that celestial car, bright as the fire of the sun, stationed before him, Rama, having long arms, the conqueror of enemies cities, ascended it.

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यायां तु सचिवा राज्ञो दशरथस्य ये
पुरोहितं पुरस्कृत्य मन्त्रयामासुरर्थवत्
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāyāṁ tu sacivā rājño daśarathasya ye
purohitaṁ puraskṛtya mantrayāmāsurarthavat

translations.english: All the ministers of king Dasaratha in Ayodhyā began to hold consultation respectfully with the priest.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रयन्रामवृद्ध्यर्थं वृत्त्यर्थं नगरस्य च
सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थं जयार्हस्य महात्मनः
कर्तुमर्हथ रामस्य यद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration:
mantrayanrāmavṛddhyarthaṁ vṛttyarthaṁ nagarasya ca
sarvamevābhiṣekārthaṁ jayārhasya mahātmanaḥ
kartumarhatha rāmasya yadyanmaṅgalapūrvakam

translations.english: (Thereupon they ordered the servants) saying, Do you collect materials necessary for the auspicious installation of the high-souled (Rama) worthy of being crowned with victory.

verses.sanskrit:
इति ते मन्त्रिणः सर्वे संदिश्य तु पुरोहितम्
नगरान्निर्ययुस्तूर्णं रामदर्शनबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration:
iti te mantriṇaḥ sarve saṁdiśya tu purohitam
nagarānniryayustūrṇaṁ rāmadarśanabuddhayaḥ

translations.english: The priest and the ministers having ordered thus all speedily issued out of the city to behold Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवानघः
प्रययौ रथमास्थाय रामो नगरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
hariyuktaṁ sahasrākṣo rathamindra ivānaghaḥ
prayayau rathamāsthāya rāmo nagaramuttamam

translations.english: Like to the thousand-eyed Indra in his car, drawn by horses the blameless Rāma; seated in his car, proceeded towards the excellent city.

verses.sanskrit:
जग्राह भरतो रश्मीञ्शत्रुघ्नश्छत्रमाददे
लक्ष्मणो व्यजनं तस्य मूर्ध्नि संपर्यवीजयत्
verses.transliteration:
jagrāha bharato raśmīñśatrughnaśchatramādade
lakṣmaṇo vyajanaṁ tasya mūrdhni saṁparyavījayat

translations.english: Bharata took up the reins, ſatrughna held the umbrella and Lakşmaņa began to fan him on the head with Chowries.

verses.sanskrit:
श्वेतं च वालव्यजनं सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
अपरं चन्द्रसंकाशं राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः
verses.transliteration:
śvetaṁ ca vālavyajanaṁ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
aparaṁ candrasaṁkāśaṁ rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ

translations.english: Vibhīşaņa, the lord of Rākşasas standing on one side, took up the white Chowrie shining like the second moon.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिसंघैर्तदाकाशे देवैश्च समरुद्गणैः
स्तूयमानस्य रामस्य शुश्रुवे मधुरध्वनिः
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣisaṁghairtadākāśe devaiśca samarudgaṇaiḥ
stūyamānasya rāmasya śuśruve madhuradhvaniḥ

translations.english: There was audible the sweet encomium of Rāma chanted by the crowd of ascetics in the sky, the celestials and the Marutas.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शत्रुंजयं नाम कुञ्जरं पर्वतोपमम्
आरुरोह महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śatruṁjayaṁ nāma kuñjaraṁ parvatopamam
āruroha mahātejāḥ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, got up upon an elephant named Śatruñjaya resembling a mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
नवनागसहस्राणि ययुरास्थाय वानराः
मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration:
navanāgasahasrāṇi yayurāsthāya vānarāḥ
mānuṣaṁ vigrahaṁ kṛtvā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ

translations.english: And riding nine thousand elephants proceeded the monkeys assuming human shapes and adorned with various ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्च दुन्दुभीनां च निस्वनैः
प्रययू पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तां पुरीं हर्म्यमालिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
śaṅkhaśabdapraṇādaiśca dundubhīnāṁ ca nisvanaiḥ
prayayū puruṣavyāghrastāṁ purīṁ harmyamālinīm

translations.english: And with the music of conches and bugles that foremost of men entered the city abounding in houses.

verses.sanskrit:
ददृशुस्ते समायान्तं राघवं सपुरःसरम्
विराजमानं वपुषा रथेनातिरथं तदा
verses.transliteration:
dadṛśuste samāyāntaṁ rāghavaṁ sapuraḥsaram
virājamānaṁ vapuṣā rathenātirathaṁ tadā

translations.english: They (citizens) beheld Raghava enter the city with a graceful person and seated in the car.

verses.sanskrit:
ते वर्धयित्वा काकुत्स्थं रामेण प्रतिनन्दिताः
अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम्
verses.transliteration:
te vardhayitvā kākutsthaṁ rāmeṇa pratinanditāḥ
anujagmurmahātmānaṁ bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritam

translations.english: They having bowed to that descendant of Kākutstha were welcomed by him. And they followed that high souled one encircled by his brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
अमात्यैर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैव तथा प्रकृतिभिर्वृतः
श्रिया विरुरुचे रामो नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration:
amātyairbrāhmaṇaiścaiva tathā prakṛtibhirvṛtaḥ
śriyā viruruce rāmo nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ

translations.english: And surrounded by his courtiers, Brāhmaṇas and subjects Rāma appeared beautiful like to the Moon encircled by stars.

verses.sanskrit:
स पुरोगामिभिस्तूर्यैस्तालस्वस्तिकपाणिभिः
प्रव्याहरद्भिर्मुदितैर्मङ्गलानि ययौ वृतः
verses.transliteration:
sa purogāmibhistūryaistālasvastikapāṇibhiḥ
pravyāharadbhirmuditairmaṅgalāni yayau vṛtaḥ

translations.english: He went preceded by men who play on stringed instruments, by people with Karatal and Sustika in their hands and by men chanting delightedly auspicious songs.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षतं जातरूपं च गावः कन्यास्तथा द्विजाः
नरा मोदकहस्ताश्च रामस्य पुरतो ययुः
verses.transliteration:
akṣataṁ jātarūpaṁ ca gāvaḥ kanyāstathā dvijāḥ
narā modakahastāśca rāmasya purato yayuḥ

translations.english: Persons with Aksata and gold in their hands, kine, girls, Brāhmaṇas and persons with Modaka in their hands went before Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
सख्यं च रामः सुग्रीवे प्रभावं चानिलात्मजे
वानराणां च तत्कर्म व्याचचक्षेऽथ मन्त्रिणाम्
श्रुत्वा च विस्मयं जग्मुरयोध्यापुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration:
sakhyaṁ ca rāmaḥ sugrīve prabhāvaṁ cānilātmaje
vānarāṇāṁ ca tatkarma vyācacakṣe'tha mantriṇām
śrutvā ca vismayaṁ jagmurayodhyāpuravāsinaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon before the ministers Rāma began to describe the friendship of Sugrīva, the prowess of the Wind-gods son and the works accomplished by the monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
द्युतिमानेतदाख्याय रामो वानरसंवृतः
हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णामयोध्यां प्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
dyutimānetadākhyāya rāmo vānarasaṁvṛtaḥ
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇāmayodhyāṁ praviveśa ha

translations.english: Having related thus (the works of the monkeys) the graceful Rāma encircled by the monkeys entered (the city of) Ayodhya abounding in delighted and plump persons.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो ह्यभ्युच्छ्रयन्पौराः पताकास्ते गृहे गृहे
ऐक्ष्वाकाध्युषितं रम्यमाससाद पितुर्गृहम्
verses.transliteration:
tato hyabhyucchrayanpaurāḥ patākāste gṛhe gṛhe
aikṣvākādhyuṣitaṁ ramyamāsasāda piturgṛham

translations.english: Thereupon the citizens hoisted up flags upon every house and he reached the picturesque abode of his ancestors inhabited by the descendants of Ikşvāku.

verses.sanskrit:
अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रो भरतं धर्मिणां वरम्
अथोपहितया वाचा मधुरं रघुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
athābravīdrājaputro bharataṁ dharmiṇāṁ varam
athopahitayā vācā madhuraṁ raghunandanaḥ

translations.english: Having reached and entered his ancestral palace and bowed to Kausalyä, Sumitra and Kaikeyī, the high-souled prince, the enhancer of the joy of the descendants of Raghu, addressed Bharata the foremost of the pious, with sweet words instinct with meaning, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्च मद्भवनं श्रेष्ठं साशोकवनिकं महत्
मुक्तावैदूर्यसंकीर्णं सुग्रीवस्य निवेदय
verses.transliteration:
yacca madbhavanaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ sāśokavanikaṁ mahat
muktāvaidūryasaṁkīrṇaṁ sugrīvasya nivedaya

translations.english: Kākutstha, living in the forest of Dandaka with bark and matted hairs, for whom you are lamenting, has, “Do you set apart for Sugrīva my huge and excellent palace abounding in pearls and Vaiduryas."

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भरतः सत्यविक्रमः
पाणौ गृहीत्वा सुग्रीवं प्रविवेश तमालयम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā bharataḥ satyavikramaḥ
pāṇau gṛhītvā sugrīvaṁ praviveśa tamālayam

translations.english: Hearing those words, Bharata, having truth for his prowess, taking Sugrīva by the hand, conducted him to the palace.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तैलप्रदीपांश्च पर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च
गृहीत्वा विविशुः क्षिप्रं शत्रुघ्नेन प्रचोदिताः
verses.transliteration:
tatastailapradīpāṁśca paryaṅkāstaraṇāni ca
gṛhītvā viviśuḥ kṣipraṁ śatrughnena pracoditāḥ

translations.english: And commanded by Śatrughna, (servants) speedily entered (that palace) with oil, lamps, bedsteads and beddings.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच च महातेजाः सुग्रीवं राघवानुजः
अभिषेकाय रामस्य दूतानाज्ञापय प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
uvāca ca mahātejāḥ sugrīvaṁ rāghavānujaḥ
abhiṣekāya rāmasya dūtānājñāpaya prabho

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent younger brother of Raghava spoke to Sugriva, saying, "Do you, O lord, order some (to bring water) for Rama's installation."

verses.sanskrit:
सौवर्णान्वानरेन्द्राणां चतुर्णां चतुरो घटान्
ददौ क्षिप्रं स सुग्रीवः सर्वरत्नविभूषितान्
verses.transliteration:
sauvarṇānvānarendrāṇāṁ caturṇāṁ caturo ghaṭān
dadau kṣipraṁ sa sugrīvaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitān

translations.english: Sugrīva conferred upon four leading monkeys four golden jars crested with diverse jewels and said to them.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रत्यूषसमये चतुर्णां सागराम्भसाम्
पूर्णैर्घटैः प्रतीक्षध्वं तथा कुरुत वानराः
verses.transliteration:
yathā pratyūṣasamaye caturṇāṁ sāgarāmbhasām
pūrṇairghaṭaiḥ pratīkṣadhvaṁ tathā kuruta vānarāḥ

translations.english: "Do you so conduct, O monkeys, that you may return by the dawn with the jars filled with the water of the four oceans."

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ता महात्मानो वानरा वारणोपमाः
उत्पेतुर्गगनं शीघ्रं गरुडा इव शीघ्रगाः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktā mahātmāno vānarā vāraṇopamāḥ
utpeturgaganaṁ śīghraṁ garuḍā iva śīghragāḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by the high-souled (Sugrīva) the monkeys resembling the elephants speedily rose up in the welkin like to quick coursing vultures.

verses.sanskrit:
जाम्बवांश्च हनूमांश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः
ऋषभश्चैव कलशाञ्जलपूर्णानथानयन्
नदीशतानां पञ्चानां जले कुम्भैरुपाहरन्
verses.transliteration:
jāmbavāṁśca hanūmāṁśca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ
ṛṣabhaścaiva kalaśāñjalapūrṇānathānayan
nadīśatānāṁ pañcānāṁ jale kumbhairupāharan

translations.english: Jambavan, Hanumān, the monkey Vegadarsi and Rşabha brought the jars filled with water and another monkeys brought the water in jars from five hundred rivers.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशं जलपूर्णमथानयत्
सुषेणः सत्त्वसंपन्नः सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvātsamudrātkalaśaṁ jalapūrṇamathānayat
suṣeṇaḥ sattvasaṁpannaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam

translations.english: Suşeņa, gifted with prowess, brought that jar crested with gems, filled with water from the Eastern Ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्तचन्दनकर्पूरैः संवृतं काञ्चनं घटम्
गवयः पश्चिमात्तोयमाजहार महार्णवात्
verses.transliteration:
raktacandanakarpūraiḥ saṁvṛtaṁ kāñcanaṁ ghaṭam
gavayaḥ paścimāttoyamājahāra mahārṇavāt

translations.english: Rşabha speedily brought water from the southern Ocean. Gavaya brought from the great Western Ocean in that golden jar, water perfumed with the fragrance of red sandal and camphor.

verses.sanskrit:
रत्नकुम्भेन महता शीतं मारुतविक्रमः
उत्तराच्च जलं शीघ्रं गरुडानिलविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
ratnakumbhena mahatā śītaṁ mārutavikramaḥ
uttarācca jalaṁ śīghraṁ garuḍānilavikramaḥ

translations.english: The virtuous-souled Wind-gods son, gifted with all accomplishments and the prowess of Garuda and Wind-god, brought, speedily from the Northern Ocean, water in that large jewelled jar.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिषेकाय रामस्य शत्रुघ्नः सचिवैः सह
पुरोहिताय श्रेष्ठाय सुहृद्भ्यश्च न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
abhiṣekāya rāmasya śatrughnaḥ sacivaiḥ saha
purohitāya śreṣṭhāya suhṛdbhyaśca nyavedayat

translations.english: Beholding water thus brought by the leading monkeys for the installation of Rāma, Satrughna, with his ministers, communicated that to the leading priests and friends.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स प्रयतो वृद्धो वसिष्ठो ब्राह्मणैः सह
रामं रत्नमयो पीठे सहसीतं न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa prayato vṛddho vasiṣṭho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
rāmaṁ ratnamayo pīṭhe sahasītaṁ nyaveśayat

translations.english: Thereupon the self-controlled Vasistha, stricken in years, along with other Brāhmaṇas placed Rāma with Sītā on a jewelled seat.

verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यषिञ्चन्नरव्याघ्रं प्रसन्नेन सुगन्धिना
सलिलेन सहस्राक्षं वसवो वासवं यथा
