translations.english: Then on beholding Kāla, infuriated, tending to strike terror into all creatures, was agitated the triune universe, and trembling over took the denizens of heaven. The charioteer urged on the steeds possessed of graceful splendour; and arrived where the lord of Rākşasas was posted.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तु ते तं विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम्
सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सर्वलोकभयावहम्
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tu te taṁ vikṛtaṁ rathaṁ mṛtyusamanvitam
sacivā rākṣasendrasya sarvalokabhayāvaham

translations.english: In a moment those horses like to thought (in celerity,) and resembling the steeds themselves of Hari, took Yama where the warfare had already begun. Seeing the frightful car in that aspect with Death present in it, the ministers of the Rākşasa monarch at once took to their heels.

verses.sanskrit:
लघुसत्त्वतया सर्वे नष्टसंज्ञा भयार्दिताः
नात्र योद्धुं समर्थाः स्म इत्युक्त्वा विप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration:
laghusattvatayā sarve naṣṭasaṁjñā bhayārditāḥ
nātra yoddhuṁ samarthāḥ sma ityuktvā vipradudruvuḥ

translations.english: In vonsequence of their being comparatively inferior in point of strength they were deprived of their senses, and afficted with fear; and saying, 'Here we are not equal to fighting' they went their way.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु रावणमासाद्य विसृजञ्शक्तितोमरान्
यमो मर्माणि संक्रुद्धो राक्षसस्य न्यकृन्तत
verses.transliteration:
sa tu rāvaṇamāsādya visṛjañśaktitomarān
yamo marmāṇi saṁkruddho rākṣasasya nyakṛntata

translations.english: But seeing that car capable of striking terror into folks, the Ten-necked did not experience any agitation, nor did fear enter his heart. And approaching Ravana, Yama, enraged, discharged spears and tomaras, and began to pierce Rāvana's marrow.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्तु स्थितः स्वस्थः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह
तस्मिन्वैवस्वतरथे तोयवर्षमिवाम्बुदः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastu sthitaḥ svasthaḥ śaravarṣaṁ mumoca ha
tasminvaivasvatarathe toyavarṣamivāmbudaḥ

translations.english: But Rāvana, without at all feeling any smart, began to shower arrows on Vaivasvata's vehicle, resembling a downpour caused by clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो महाशक्तिशतैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि
प्रतिकर्तुं स नाशक्नोद्राक्षसः शल्यपीडितः
verses.transliteration:
tato mahāśaktiśataiḥ pātyamānairmahorasi
pratikartuṁ sa nāśaknodrākṣasaḥ śalyapīḍitaḥ

translations.english: Again at his spacious breast, that Raksasa who had undergone slender injury, could not resist, (Yama's arms) with hundreds of mighty darts hurled.

verses.sanskrit:
नानाप्रहरणैरेवं यमेनामित्रकर्शिना
सप्तरात्रं कृते संख्ये न भग्नो विजितोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration:
nānāpraharaṇairevaṁ yamenāmitrakarśinā
saptarātraṁ kṛte saṁkhye na bhagno vijito'pi vā

translations.english: And in this way that destroyer of foes Yama fought for seven nights with various arms; until at length his enemy was driven back and deprived of his senses.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽभवत्पुनर्युद्धं यमराक्षसयोस्तदा
विजयाकाङ्क्षिणोस्तत्र समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः
verses.transliteration:
tato'bhavatpunaryuddhaṁ yamarākṣasayostadā
vijayākāṅkṣiṇostatra samareṣvanivartinoḥ

translations.english: Then, O hero, there took place nighty onset between Yama and the Rākşasas both eager for victory and both never tiring of fight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः
प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य ददृशुस्तद्रणाजिरम्
verses.transliteration:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ
prajāpatiṁ puraskṛtya dadṛśustadraṇājiram

translations.english: And celestials and Gandharvas and Siddhas, and the supreme saints, placing Prajāpati at their head, presented themselves at the fight.

verses.sanskrit:
संवर्त इव लोकानामभवद्युध्यतोस्तयोः
राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य प्रेतानामीश्वरस्य च
verses.transliteration:
saṁvarta iva lokānāmabhavadyudhyatostayoḥ
rākṣasānāṁ ca mukhyasya pretānāmīśvarasya ca

translations.english: The encounter that then took place between that foremost of Rākşasas and the lord of the Dead was like the universal upheaval.

verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युं चतुर्भिर्विशिखैः सूतं सप्तभिरर्दयत्
यमं शरसहस्रेण शीघ्रं मर्मस्वताडयत्
verses.transliteration:
mṛtyuṁ caturbhirviśikhaiḥ sūtaṁ saptabhirardayat
yamaṁ śarasahasreṇa śīghraṁ marmasvatāḍayat

translations.english: And he smote Death with four, the (Yama's), charioteer with seven, and swiftly struck Yama in the marrow with hundreds and thousands of shafts.:

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रुद्धस्य सहसा यमस्याभिविनिःसृतः
ज्वालामालो विनिश्वासो वदनात्क्रोधपावकः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kruddhasya sahasā yamasyābhiviniḥsṛtaḥ
jvālāmālo viniśvāso vadanātkrodhapāvakaḥ

translations.english: Then from forth Yama's mouth there issued darted flames with his teeth mixed with smoke, the fire of his fury.

verses.sanskrit:
मुञ्च मां साधु धर्मज्ञ यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम्
न हि कश्चिन्मया दृष्टो मुहूर्तमपि जीवति
verses.transliteration:
muñca māṁ sādhu dharmajña yāvadenaṁ nihanmyaham
na hi kaścinmayā dṛṣṭo muhūrtamapi jīvati

translations.english: Let me go. O you cognisant of righteousness, I shall slay this one. There is none that, albeit strong, can survive after having been seen by me.

verses.sanskrit:
बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः
संस्पृष्टो हि मया कश्चिन्न जीवेदिति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration:
balaṁ mama na khalvetanmaryādaiṣā nisargataḥ
saṁspṛṣṭo hi mayā kaścinna jīvediti niścayaḥ

translations.english: Verily this is not mine strength, this might pertain to me by nature. O Time, if seen by me, he won't live for a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य पार्श्वेषु निश्छिद्राः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः
पावकस्पर्शसंकाशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
yasya pārśveṣu niśchidrāḥ kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
pāvakasparśasaṁkāśo mudgaro mūrtimānsthitaḥ

translations.english: Hearing these words of his, the puissant king of righteousness spoke there to death, 'Do you stay. I myself shall slay him.' Then with his eyes reddened that lord, Vaivasvata, wielded with his hand the infallible dart of time; while by him lay the redoubtable noose of time and the mace in its native shape resembling fire and the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शनादेव यः प्राणान्प्राणिनामुपरुध्यति
किं पुनस्ताडनाद्वापि पीडनाद्वापि देहिनः
verses.transliteration:
darśanādeva yaḥ prāṇānprāṇināmuparudhyati
kiṁ punastāḍanādvāpi pīḍanādvāpi dehinaḥ

translations.english: He, who by his very sight draw away the lives of creatures, what should be said of its touching and being hurled at people?

verses.sanskrit:
स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु पिबन्निव निशाचरम्
करस्पृष्टो बलवता दण्डः क्रुद्धः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration:
sa jvālāparivārastu pibanniva niśācaram
karaspṛṣṭo balavatā daṇḍaḥ kruddhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ

translations.english: And touched by that powerful one, that mighty weapon, engist with flames, attained access of energy, and seemed to consume the Raksasa.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे सत्त्वास्तस्माद्रणाजिरात्
सुराश्च क्षुभिता दृष्ट्वा कालदण्डोद्यतं यमम्
verses.transliteration:
tato vidudruvuḥ sarve sattvāstasmādraṇājirāt
surāśca kṣubhitā dṛṣṭvā kāladaṇḍodyataṁ yamam

translations.english: In the field of battle, everyone afficted with fear, ran away from it. And beholding Yama with his rod uplifted, the celestials were agitated.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु दण्डमुद्यम्य रावणम्
यमं पितामहः साक्षाद्दर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasminprahartukāme tu daṇḍamudyamya rāvaṇam
yamaṁ pitāmahaḥ sākṣāddarśayitvedamabravīt

translations.english: On Yama being desirous of slaying Rāvana, by his rod, the great-father manifesting himself spoke to Yama.

verses.sanskrit:
वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वतुलविक्रम
प्रहर्तव्यं त्वयैतेन दण्डेनास्मिन्निशाचरे
verses.transliteration:
vaivasvata mahābāho na khalvatulavikrama
prahartavyaṁ tvayaitena daṇḍenāsminniśācare

translations.english: O Vaivasvata, O mighty-armed one, O you of immeasurable prowess, this certainly must not be. You should not with your rod slay the nightranger.

verses.sanskrit:
वरः खलु मया दत्तस्तस्य त्रिदशपुंगव
तत्त्वया नानृतं कार्यं यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः
verses.transliteration:
varaḥ khalu mayā dattastasya tridaśapuṁgava
tattvayā nānṛtaṁ kāryaṁ yanmayā vyāhṛtaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: For, O foremost of celestials, I have conferred a boon on him; and you should not render false the words that I have uttered.

verses.sanskrit:
अमोघो ह्येष सर्वासां प्रजानां विनिपातने
कालदण्डो मया सृष्टः पूर्वं मृत्युपुरस्कृतः
verses.transliteration:
amogho hyeṣa sarvāsāṁ prajānāṁ vinipātane
kāladaṇḍo mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṁ mṛtyupuraskṛtaḥ

translations.english: This rod of Kāla, of immeasurable might and incapable of being resisted by creatures, was created by me as having the power of compassing th: death of all beings.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो राक्षसमूर्धनि
न ह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति
verses.transliteration:
tanna khalveṣa te saumya pātyo rākṣasamūrdhani
na hyasminpatite kaścinmuhūrtamapi jīvati

translations.english: Therefore, O mild one, you forsooth should not bring it down on Rāvana's head. If this alights on any one, he does not live for a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि ह्यस्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः
म्रियेत वा दशग्रीवस्तथाप्युभयतोऽनृतम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi hyasminnipatite na mriyetaiṣa rākṣasaḥ
mriyeta vā daśagrīvastathāpyubhayato'nṛtam

translations.english: Whether on this weapon alighting, the tennecked does not die, or if he does do either way falsehood is the consequence.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसेन्द्रान्नियच्छाद्य दण्डमेनं वधोद्यतम्
सत्यं मम कुरुष्वेदं लोकांस्त्वं समवेक्ष्य च
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasendrānniyacchādya daṇḍamenaṁ vadhodyatam
satyaṁ mama kuruṣvedaṁ lokāṁstvaṁ samavekṣya ca

translations.english: Therefore do you keep your uplifted weapon off Larkā's lord. If you have any care for these worlds do you establish my truth.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच यमस्तदा
एष व्यावर्तितो दण्डः प्रभविष्णुर्भवान्हि नः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastu dharmātmā pratyuvāca yamastadā
eṣa vyāvartito daṇḍaḥ prabhaviṣṇurbhavānhi naḥ

translations.english: Thus addressed, Yama then answered, I restrain this rod. You are our lord.

verses.sanskrit:
किं त्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं रणगतेन हि
यन्मया यन्न हन्तव्यो राक्षसो वरदर्पितः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ tvidānīṁ mayā śakyaṁ kartuṁ raṇagatena hi
yanmayā yanna hantavyo rākṣaso varadarpitaḥ

translations.english: But as I can not slay this one, who has obtained a boon, what then shall I do now in the field?

verses.sanskrit:
एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः
इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration:
eṣa tasmātpraṇaśyāmi darśanādasya rakṣasaḥ
ityuktvā sarathaḥ sāśvastatraivāntaradhīyata

translations.english: Therefore shall I disappear from the sight of this Rākşasa.' Having said this, even there did he vanish with his car and horses.

verses.sanskrit:
दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः
पुष्पकेण तु संहृष्टो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात्
verses.transliteration:
daśagrīvastu taṁ jitvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ
puṣpakeṇa tu saṁhṛṣṭo niṣkrānto yamasādanāt

translations.english: Having vanquished him and distinguished his name, Rāvaņa again ascended his Puşpaka and went out of the abode of Yama.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः
जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः
verses.transliteration:
tato vaivasvato devaiḥ saha brahmapurogamaiḥ
jagāma tridivaṁ hṛṣṭo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ

translations.english: With a delighted heart Vaivasvata along with the deities headed by Brahmā as well as that mighty ascetic-Narada, went to the celestial regions.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु जित्वा दशग्रीवो यमं त्रिदशपुंगवम्
रावणस्तु जयश्लाघी स्वसहायान्ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration:
sa tu jitvā daśagrīvo yamaṁ tridaśapuṁgavam
rāvaṇastu jayaślāghī svasahāyāndadarśa ha

translations.english: Having vanquished Yama, the foremost of celestials, Rāvana delighting in warfare, saw his adherents.

verses.sanskrit:
जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः
पुष्पकं भेजिरे सर्वे सान्त्विता रवणेन ह
verses.transliteration:
jayena vardhayitvā ca mārīcapramukhāstataḥ
puṣpakaṁ bhejire sarve sāntvitā ravaṇena ha

translations.english: And hailing him with victory, the councillors headed by Mārīca, having been encouraged by Ravana, ascended Puspaka.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रसातलं हृष्टः प्रविष्टः पयसो निधिम्
दैत्योरग गणाध्युष्टं वरुणेन सुरक्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rasātalaṁ hṛṣṭaḥ praviṣṭaḥ payaso nidhim
daityoraga gaṇādhyuṣṭaṁ varuṇena surakṣitam

translations.english: Then the Rākṣasa entered the region of waters the abode of Daityas and serpents, well protected by Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु भोगवतीं गत्वा पुरीं वासुकिपालिताम्
स्थाप्य नागान्वशे कृत्वा ययौ मणिमतीं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu bhogavatīṁ gatvā purīṁ vāsukipālitām
sthāpya nāgānvaśe kṛtvā yayau maṇimatīṁ purīm

translations.english: Arriving at Bhogavati the city governed by Vāsuki, he brought the serpents under subjection and then, delighted, bent his course to the palace Manimayi.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पितामहस्तत्र त्रैलोक्यगतिरव्ययः
आजगाम द्रुतं देवो विमानवरमास्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pitāmahastatra trailokyagatiravyayaḥ
ājagāma drutaṁ devo vimānavaramāsthitaḥ

translations.english: Then that way of the triune sphere, that God, the undeteriorating Great-father, swiftly presented himself on the scene mounted on his excellent car.

verses.sanskrit:
निवातकवचानां तु निवार्य रणकर्म तत्
वृद्धः पितामहो वाक्यमुवाच विदितार्थवत्
verses.transliteration:
nivātakavacānāṁ tu nivārya raṇakarma tat
vṛddhaḥ pitāmaho vākyamuvāca viditārthavat

translations.english: Making the Nivātakavacas desist from battle the ancient great-father spoke in clear words.

verses.sanskrit:
न ह्ययं रावणो युद्धे शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः
न भवन्तः क्षयं नेतुं शक्याः सेन्द्रैः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration:
na hyayaṁ rāvaṇo yuddhe śakyo jetuṁ surāsuraiḥ
na bhavantaḥ kṣayaṁ netuṁ śakyāḥ sendraiḥ surāsuraiḥ

translations.english: Even the celestials and the Asuras are not able to vanquish this Rāvaņa in battle; nor can the Dänavas backed by the gods can destroy you.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसस्य सखित्वं वै भवद्भिः सह रोचते
अविभक्ता हि सर्वार्थाः सुहृदां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasasya sakhitvaṁ vai bhavadbhiḥ saha rocate
avibhaktā hi sarvārthāḥ suhṛdāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Do you therefore turn your minds to making friendship with the Rākşasas. All interests are forsooth the common possession of friends.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं कृतवांस्तत्र रावणः
निवातकवचैः सार्धं प्रीतिमानभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tato'gnisākṣikaṁ sakhyaṁ kṛtavāṁstatra rāvaṇaḥ
nivātakavacaiḥ sārdhaṁ prītimānabhavattadā

translations.english: Thereat Rāvaņa made friendship with the Nivātakavacas in the presence of Fire; and then rejoiced greatly.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्चितस्तैर्यथान्यायं संवत्सरसुखोषितः
स्वपुरान्निर्विशेषं च पूजां प्राप्तो दशाननः
verses.transliteration:
arcitastairyathānyāyaṁ saṁvatsarasukhoṣitaḥ
svapurānnirviśeṣaṁ ca pūjāṁ prāpto daśānanaḥ

translations.english: And duly honoured (by then) Daśānana passed there a year, without any feeling of that place being different from his own home: and spent his time agreeably.

verses.sanskrit:
स तूपधार्य मायानां शतमेकोनमात्मवान्
सलिलेन्द्रपुरान्वेषी स बभ्राम रसातलम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tūpadhārya māyānāṁ śatamekonamātmavān
salilendrapurānveṣī sa babhrāma rasātalam

translations.english: Having learnt there a hundred sorts of illusion, he directed his course to Rasātala, searching for the city of the lord of waters.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षरन्तीं च पयो नित्यं सुरभिं गामवस्थिताम्
यस्याः पयोविनिष्यन्दात्क्षीरोदो नाम सागरः
verses.transliteration:
kṣarantīṁ ca payo nityaṁ surabhiṁ gāmavasthitām
yasyāḥ payoviniṣyandātkṣīrodo nāma sāgaraḥ

translations.english: Having vanquished him, he, in a moment, destroyed four hundred Daityas. And then the lord of Rākṣasas saw the grand abode of Varuņa resembling a mass of white clouds, and effulgent like to Kailāśa itself;—and also saw the milkconserving Surabhi stationed there; from the streams of whose milk was produced the ocean named Ksiroda.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्माच्चन्द्रः प्रभवति शीतरश्मिः प्रजाहितः
यं समासाद्य जीवन्ति फेनपाः परमर्षयः
अमृतं यत्र चोत्पन्नं सुरा चापि सुराशिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
yasmāccandraḥ prabhavati śītaraśmiḥ prajāhitaḥ
yaṁ samāsādya jīvanti phenapāḥ paramarṣayaḥ
amṛtaṁ yatra cotpannaṁ surā cāpi surāśinām

translations.english: There Ravana saw the mother of kine and the foremost of bulls; from whom spring that maker of night the mild-beaming-moon; taking refuge under whom subsist the prime saints and those living on froth, the froth' (of milk): and wherefrom sprang ambrosia as well as the Svadha of Svădhă-subsisting ones,' even her that go with human beings under the name of Surabhi. 1. A typical instance of the lengths which the selfdenial of the Hindu sages went is furnished by the case of a certain class of ascetics, who, abstaining from every other kind of food, lived solely on the froth of milk, falling off from the udders after the calf had drunk it. This froth-drinking, in preference to drinking the milk itself was dictated by a motive of charity viz., not to deprive the calf of her legitimate fare. 2. The ancestral manes.

verses.sanskrit:
यां ब्रुवन्ति नरा लोके सुरभिं नाम नामतः
प्रदक्षिणं तु तां कृत्वा रावणः परमाद्भुताम्
प्रविवेश महाघोरं गुप्तं बहुविधैर्बलैः
verses.transliteration:
yāṁ bruvanti narā loke surabhiṁ nāma nāmataḥ
pradakṣiṇaṁ tu tāṁ kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ paramādbhutām
praviveśa mahāghoraṁ guptaṁ bahuvidhairbalaiḥ

translations.english: Having gone round this wonderful (cow), Rāvaņa entered the exceedingly dreadful abode of Varuna) guarded by various kinds of forces.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो धाराशताकीर्णं शारदाभ्रनिभं तदा
नित्यप्रहृष्टं ददृशे वरुणस्य गृहोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tato dhārāśatākīrṇaṁ śāradābhranibhaṁ tadā
nityaprahṛṣṭaṁ dadṛśe varuṇasya gṛhottamam

translations.english: Then he beheld Varuna's splendid mansion, streaming with hundreds of torrents, resembling a mass of autumnal clouds, and always wearing a delightful aspect.

verses.sanskrit:
युद्धार्थी रावणः प्राप्तस्तस्य युद्धं प्रदीयताम्
वद वा न भयं तेऽस्ति निर्जितोऽस्मीति साञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration:
yuddhārthī rāvaṇaḥ prāptastasya yuddhaṁ pradīyatām
vada vā na bhayaṁ te'sti nirjito'smīti sāñjaliḥ

translations.english: And killing the generals of the forces, after having been resisted by them, he addressed the warriors, saying, 'Do you speedily acquaint your king with this "Rāvana has come here seeking battle." Do you give him fight, or say with joined hands. 'I have been defeated by you, and then you have no fear whatever?'

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धा वरुणस्य महात्मनः
पुत्राः पौत्राश्च निष्क्रामन्गौश्च पुष्कर एव च
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare kruddhā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ
putrāḥ pautrāśca niṣkrāmangauśca puṣkara eva ca

translations.english: In the meantime the sons and grandsons of the high-souled Varuņa, as well as those of Puskara issued forth.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु वीर्यगुणोपेता बलैः परिवृताः स्वकैः
युक्त्वा रथान्कामगमानुद्यद्भास्करवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
te tu vīryaguṇopetā balaiḥ parivṛtāḥ svakaiḥ
yuktvā rathānkāmagamānudyadbhāskaravarcasaḥ

translations.english: They, endowed with every virtue, accompanied by their own forces, yoked cars furnished with the effulgence of the rising Sun, and coursing at the desire of their riders.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो युद्धं समभवद्दारुणं लोमहर्षणम्
सलिलेन्द्रस्य पुत्राणां रावणस्य च रक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
tato yuddhaṁ samabhavaddāruṇaṁ lomaharṣaṇam
salilendrasya putrāṇāṁ rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ

translations.english: Then there took place a mighty encounter capable of making people's down stand on end, between the sons of the lord of waters, and those of the intelligent Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
अमात्यैस्तु महावीर्यैर्दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः
वारुणं तद्बलं कृत्स्नं क्षणेन विनिपातितम्
verses.transliteration:
amātyaistu mahāvīryairdaśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ
vāruṇaṁ tadbalaṁ kṛtsnaṁ kṣaṇena vinipātitam

translations.english: And in a short while that entire host of Varuņa was brought down by the highly powerful councillor of that Raksasa Daśagrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
महीतलगतास्ते तु रावणं दृश्य पुष्पके
आकाशमाशु विविशुः स्यन्दनैः शीघ्रगामिभिः
verses.transliteration:
mahītalagatāste tu rāvaṇaṁ dṛśya puṣpake
ākāśamāśu viviśuḥ syandanaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ

translations.english: Seeing their own forces brought to straits in the conflict and driven back in the fight with networks of shafts, and down on the ground and seeing Rävaņa in Puspaka, Varuņa's sons swiftly shot into the welkin with their fleet-footing cars.

verses.sanskrit:
महदासीत्ततस्तेषां तुल्यं स्थानमवाप्य तत्
आकाशयुद्धं तुमुलं देवदानवयोरिव
verses.transliteration:
mahadāsīttatasteṣāṁ tulyaṁ sthānamavāpya tat
ākāśayuddhaṁ tumulaṁ devadānavayoriva

translations.english: After they had attained a station of equal vantage (with Ravana) in the sky,* great was the encounter that then took place in the sky, resembling the encounter of the deities and the Dānavas. *Ere the Rāvana was fighting on Puspaka, while Varuna's sons fought on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते रावणं युद्धे शरैः पावकसंनिभैः
विमुखीकृत्य संहृष्टा विनेदुर्विविधान्रवान्
verses.transliteration:
tataste rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe śaraiḥ pāvakasaṁnibhaiḥ
vimukhīkṛtya saṁhṛṣṭā vinedurvividhānravān

translations.english: And turning away Rāvana in the conflict by means of shafts resembling fire, they, exceedingly rejoiced, emitted various shouts.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो महोदरः क्रुद्धो राजानं दृश्य धर्षितम्
त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं वीरो युद्धकाङ्क्षी व्यलोकयत्
verses.transliteration:
tato mahodaraḥ kruddho rājānaṁ dṛśya dharṣitam
tyaktvā mṛtyubhayaṁ vīro yuddhakāṅkṣī vyalokayat

translations.english: Then Mahodara, enraged on seeing the king sore pressed, casting off fear, and wrought up with rage, began to go around, eager for fight.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन तेषां हया ये च कामगाः पवनोपमाः
महोदरेण गदया हतास्ते प्रययुः क्षितिम्
verses.transliteration:
tena teṣāṁ hayā ye ca kāmagāḥ pavanopamāḥ
mahodareṇa gadayā hatāste prayayuḥ kṣitim

translations.english: And smit with his mace by Mahodara, Varuna's sons coursing at will and resembling the wind in velocity) dropped down to the ground.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां वरुणसूनूनां हत्वा योधान्हयांश्च तान्
मुमोचाशु महानादं विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य तान्स्थितान्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ varuṇasūnūnāṁ hatvā yodhānhayāṁśca tān
mumocāśu mahānādaṁ virathānprekṣya tānsthitān

translations.english: Having slain those warriors and also those horses of Varuna's sons (Mahodara) seeing them lying down deprived of their cars swiftly sent up a tremendous cheer.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु तेषां रथाः साश्वाः सह सारथिभिर्वरैः
महोदरेण निहताः पतिताः पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration:
te tu teṣāṁ rathāḥ sāśvāḥ saha sārathibhirvaraiḥ
mahodareṇa nihatāḥ patitāḥ pṛthivītale

translations.english: And destroyed by Mahodara, their cars and horses together with their foremost charioteers, lay down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु त्यक्त्वा रथान्पुत्रा वरुणस्य महात्मनः
आकाशे विष्ठिताः शूराः स्वप्रभावान्न विव्यथुः
verses.transliteration:
te tu tyaktvā rathānputrā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ
ākāśe viṣṭhitāḥ śūrāḥ svaprabhāvānna vivyathuḥ

translations.english: Then forsaking their cars, the sons of highsouled Varuna, stationed in the sky, did not experience any pain* by virtue of their native power. *By virtue of their immortal origin.

verses.sanskrit:
धनूंषि कृत्वा सज्यानि विनिर्भिद्य महोदरम्
रावणं समरे क्रुद्धाः सहिताः समभिद्रवन्
verses.transliteration:
dhanūṁṣi kṛtvā sajyāni vinirbhidya mahodaram
rāvaṇaṁ samare kruddhāḥ sahitāḥ samabhidravan

translations.english: Having stretched their bows they pierced Mahodara, and then, all together they greatly angered prevented Rāvana.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः कालाग्निरिव विष्ठितः
शरवर्षं महावेगं तेषां मर्मस्वपातयत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ kālāgniriva viṣṭhitaḥ
śaravarṣaṁ mahāvegaṁ teṣāṁ marmasvapātayat

translations.english: Thereupon the Ten-necked (demon), excited with wrath like the fire of dissolution, pierced them to their very vitals with highly dreadful arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
मुसलानि विचित्राणि ततो भल्लशतानि च
पट्टसांश्चैव शक्तीश्च शतघ्नीस्तोमरांस्तथा
पातयामास दुर्धर्षस्तेषामुपरि विष्ठितः
verses.transliteration:
musalāni vicitrāṇi tato bhallaśatāni ca
paṭṭasāṁścaiva śaktīśca śataghnīstomarāṁstathā
pātayāmāsa durdharṣasteṣāmupari viṣṭhitaḥ

translations.english: And stationed above, he showered on them variegated maces, Bhallas* Pattisas, Saktis and huge ſataghnis. Though pierced through and through these valiant foot-soldiers rushed forth. *An arrow with a crescent-shaped head.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रक्षो महानादं मुक्त्वा हन्ति स्म वारुणान्
नानाप्रहरणैर्घोरैर्धारापातैरिवाम्बुदः
verses.transliteration:
tato rakṣo mahānādaṁ muktvā hanti sma vāruṇān
nānāpraharaṇairghorairdhārāpātairivāmbudaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon emitting loud cries the Rākşasa, like to a cloud, with a downpour of diverse shafts, destroyed the offspring of Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते विमुखाः सर्वे पतिता धरणीतले
रणात्स्वपुरुषैः शीघ्रं गृहाण्येव प्रवेशिताः
verses.transliteration:
tataste vimukhāḥ sarve patitā dharaṇītale
raṇātsvapuruṣaiḥ śīghraṁ gṛhāṇyeva praveśitāḥ

translations.english: There upon they were all defeated and fell dead on the ground and all their followers fled away from the field of battle to their homes.

verses.sanskrit:
तानब्रवीत्ततो रक्षो वरुणाय निवेद्यताम्
रावणं चाब्रवीन्मन्त्री प्रभासो नाम वारुणः
verses.transliteration:
tānabravīttato rakṣo varuṇāya nivedyatām
rāvaṇaṁ cābravīnmantrī prabhāso nāma vāruṇaḥ

translations.english: Răvaņa spoke to them. “Do you communicate this to Varuņa.” Whereto his minister Prahasta replied to Rävana.

verses.sanskrit:
गतः खलु महातेजा ब्रह्मलोकं जलेश्वरः
गान्धर्वं वरुणः श्रोतुं यं त्वमाह्वयसे युधि
verses.transliteration:
gataḥ khalu mahātejā brahmalokaṁ jaleśvaraḥ
gāndharvaṁ varuṇaḥ śrotuṁ yaṁ tvamāhvayase yudhi

translations.english: O great king Varuņa's sons are slain and the lord of waters, whom you are inviting for battle, has gone to the region of Brahma, to hear songs.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्किं तव वृथा वीर परिश्राम्य गते नृपे
ये तु संनिहिता वीराः कुमारास्ते पराजिताः
verses.transliteration:
tatkiṁ tava vṛthā vīra pariśrāmya gate nṛpe
ye tu saṁnihitā vīrāḥ kumārāste parājitāḥ

translations.english: While the king is away, what is the use of taking trouble, O hero? And all these heroic sons (of Varuna) have been vanquished.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः
हर्षान्नादं विमुञ्चन्वै निष्क्रान्तो वरुणालयात्
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasendrastu tacchrutvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ
harṣānnādaṁ vimuñcanvai niṣkrānto varuṇālayāt

translations.english: Hearing these words and spreading his own name the lord of Rākṣasas expressing sign of joy, issued out of Varuna's abode.

verses.sanskrit:
आगतस्तु पथा येन तेनैव विनिवृत्य सः
लङ्कामभिमुखो रक्षो नभस्तलगतो ययौ
verses.transliteration:
āgatastu pathā yena tenaiva vinivṛtya saḥ
laṅkāmabhimukho rakṣo nabhastalagato yayau

translations.english: And returning by the way by which he had come the Raksasa, stationed in the welkin, proceeded towards Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
निवर्तमानः संहृष्टो रावणः स दुरात्मवान्
जह्रे पथि नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः
verses.transliteration:
nivartamānaḥ saṁhṛṣṭo rāvaṇaḥ sa durātmavān
jahre pathi narendrarṣidevagandharvakanyakāḥ

translations.english: While thus returning the vicious-souled Rāvana, with delight, carried away stealthily, on his way, the daughters of the royal saints, celestials and Dänavas.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शनीयां हि यां रक्षः कन्यां स्त्रीं वाथ पश्यति
हत्वा बन्धुजनं तस्या विमाने संन्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration:
darśanīyāṁ hi yāṁ rakṣaḥ kanyāṁ strīṁ vātha paśyati
hatvā bandhujanaṁ tasyā vimāne saṁnyaveśayat

translations.english: And whatever beautiful damsel he saw, married or unmarried, that demon held them captive in his car, having slain all their friends and relatives.

verses.sanskrit:
तुल्यमग्न्यर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसंभवम्
प्रवेपमाना दुःखार्ता मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम्
verses.transliteration:
tulyamagnyarciṣāṁ tatra śokāgnibhayasaṁbhavam
pravepamānā duḥkhārtā mumucurbāṣpajaṁ jalam

translations.english: They, all afflicted, shed tears, hot as fiery flames, caused by fear and fire of grief. As the ocean is filled with the currents of the rivers so that car was flooded with their tears originating from fear and sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
शप्तः स्त्रीभिः स तु तदा हततेजाः सुनिष्प्रभ
पतिव्रताभिः साध्वीभिः स्थिताभिः साधुवर्त्मनि
verses.transliteration:
śaptaḥ strībhiḥ sa tu tadā hatatejāḥ suniṣprabha
pativratābhiḥ sādhvībhiḥ sthitābhiḥ sādhuvartmani

translations.english: Being thus imprecated by those chaste females, devoted to their husbands, he became shorn of energy and effulgence and appeared like one divested of mind.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं विलपमानासु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ vilapamānāsu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ

translations.english: Hearing their lamentations thus and being honoured by the night-rangers that foremost of Raksasas entered his city Lankā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स्वसारमुत्थाप्य रावणः परिसान्त्वयन्
अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे वक्तुमर्हसि मे द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ svasāramutthāpya rāvaṇaḥ parisāntvayan
abravītkimidaṁ bhadre vaktumarhasi me drutam

translations.english: Having raised up his sister and consoled her Rāvana said, “Tell me speedily, O good sister, what you wish to say.” Thereat that she-demon, having blood-red eyes, closed with tears, said.

verses.sanskrit:
ननु नाम त्वया रक्ष्यो जामाता समरेष्वपि
तं निहत्य रणे राजन्स्वयमेव न लज्जसे
verses.transliteration:
nanu nāma tvayā rakṣyo jāmātā samareṣvapi
taṁ nihatya raṇe rājansvayameva na lajjase

translations.english: For you, O king, I shall enjoy the word 'widow!' My husband? should have been saved by you in the battle. But he was slain by your ownself in the battle; are you not ashamed of this?" 1. This is the literal translation of the passage-i.e. for you, I shall for ever be known as widow. 2. The word in the text is Tāmata, which literally means son-in-law-but here perhaps it must mean husband for she was his sister.)

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तस्तया रक्षो भगिन्या क्रोशमानया
अब्रवीत्सान्त्वयित्वा तां सामपूर्वमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktastayā rakṣo bhaginyā krośamānayā
abravītsāntvayitvā tāṁ sāmapūrvamidaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by his bewailing sister, the Ten-necked demon, consoling her in sweet words, said.

verses.sanskrit:
अलं वत्से विषादेन न भेतव्यं च सर्वशः
मानदानविशेषैस्त्वां तोषयिष्यामि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration:
alaṁ vatse viṣādena na bhetavyaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ
mānadānaviśeṣaistvāṁ toṣayiṣyāmi nityaśaḥ

translations.english: Of no avail is your lamentation, dear sister; you need not be afraid of any of your of relatives. I shall please you studiously by gifts, honours and favours.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्काले तु यत्प्राप्तं तत्करिष्यामि ते हितम्
भ्रातुरैश्वर्यसंस्थस्य खरस्य भव पार्श्वतः
verses.transliteration:
asminkāle tu yatprāptaṁ tatkariṣyāmi te hitam
bhrāturaiśvaryasaṁsthasya kharasya bhava pārśvataḥ

translations.english: And thus, sister, your husband was slain by me in the conflict; I shall now do whatever shall conduce to your well-being.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्दशानां भ्राता ते सहस्राणां भविष्यति
प्रभुः प्रयाणे दाने च राक्षसानां महौजसाम्
verses.transliteration:
caturdaśānāṁ bhrātā te sahasrāṇāṁ bhaviṣyati
prabhuḥ prayāṇe dāne ca rākṣasānāṁ mahaujasām

translations.english: Do you ever reside by the side of your rich brother Khara he shall be the lord of fourteen thousand Räkşasas. That highly powerful one shall give food and clothes to all those Rākşasas. He is your cousin and that night-ranger shall always carry out your orders.

verses.sanskrit:
शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं शूरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम्
दूषणोऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः
verses.transliteration:
śīghraṁ gacchatvayaṁ śūro daṇḍakānparirakṣitum
dūṣaṇo'sya balādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ

translations.english: Let that hero now speedily go to protect the Dandaka forest and the highly powerful Duşana shall be the commander of his forces.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु दत्त्वा दशग्रीवो वनं घोरं खरस्य तत्
भगिनीं च समाश्वास्य हृष्टः स्वस्थतरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṁ ghoraṁ kharasya tat
bhaginīṁ ca samāśvāsya hṛṣṭaḥ svasthataro'bhavat

translations.english: Having thus given the command of a huge and dreadful army to Khara and consoled his sister the Ten-necked demon was satisfied and freed from anxiety.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निकुम्भिला नाम लङ्कायाः काननं महत्
महात्मा राक्षसेन्द्रस्तत्प्रविवेश सहानुगः
verses.transliteration:
tato nikumbhilā nāma laṅkāyāḥ kānanaṁ mahat
mahātmā rākṣasendrastatpraviveśa sahānugaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon that highly powerful lord of Rāksasas with his followers entered an excellent garden in Larkā named Nikumbhilā.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र यूपशताकीर्णं सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम्
ददर्श विष्ठितं यज्ञं संप्रदीप्तमिव श्रिया
verses.transliteration:
tatra yūpaśatākīrṇaṁ saumyacaityopaśobhitam
dadarśa viṣṭhitaṁ yajñaṁ saṁpradīptamiva śriyā

translations.english: There, he saw, filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts and altars, a sacrifice being celebrated, as if burning in its lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कृष्णाजिनधरं कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम्
ददर्श स्वसुतं तत्र मेघनादमरिंदमम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kṛṣṇājinadharaṁ kamaṇḍaluśikhādhvajam
dadarśa svasutaṁ tatra meghanādamariṁdamam

translations.english: He beheld his fearful son Meghanāda too, clad in an antelope skin and holding Sikhă and Kamandalu.

verses.sanskrit:
रक्षःपतिः समासाद्य समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभिः
अब्रवीत्किमिदं वत्स वर्तते तद्ब्रवीहि मे
verses.transliteration:
rakṣaḥpatiḥ samāsādya samāśliṣya ca bāhubhiḥ
abravītkimidaṁ vatsa vartate tadbravīhi me

translations.english: Having seen him (there) and embraced him by his arms the lord of Lankā said: “What are you after, O my child? Tell me the truth."

verses.sanskrit:
उशना त्वब्रवीत्तत्र गुरुर्यज्ञसमृद्धये
रावणं राक्षसश्रेष्ठं द्विजश्रेष्ठो महातपाः
verses.transliteration:
uśanā tvabravīttatra gururyajñasamṛddhaye
rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ dvijaśreṣṭho mahātapāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon that foremost of twice-born ones Usanas* of austere penances, wishing the prosperity of the sacrifice, said to Rāvana, the Raksasa chief. *Another name of Sukra. Indrajit took the vow of silence so he thought it improper to disturb him.

verses.sanskrit:
माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुम्भिः सुदुर्लभे
वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह
verses.transliteration:
māheśvare pravṛtte tu yajñe pumbhiḥ sudurlabhe
varāṁste labdhavānputraḥ sākṣātpaśupateriha

translations.english: Hear, I shall relate to you everything, O king; your son has met with the fruits of many a sacrifice, Agnistoma, Asvamedha, Bahusuvarņaka, Rājsūya, Gomedha and Vaisnava. And being engaged in this Maheśvara sacrifice, which is incapable of being celebrated by men, your son has obtained boon from Pasupati’ himself.

verses.sanskrit:
कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम्
मायां च तामसीं नाम यया संपद्यते तमः
verses.transliteration:
kāmagaṁ syandanaṁ divyamantarikṣacaraṁ dhruvam
māyāṁ ca tāmasīṁ nāma yayā saṁpadyate tamaḥ

translations.english: He has also obtained illusory powers, which create darkness or ignorance, namely of ranging in the sky, of being eternal, of ascending a celestial car which curses at will and of creating darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
एतया किल संग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर
प्रयुद्धस्य गतिः शक्या न हि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration:
etayā kila saṁgrāme māyayā rākṣaseśvara
prayuddhasya gatiḥ śakyā na hi jñātuṁ surāsuraiḥ

translations.english: O lord of Rākşasas, these illusory powers being used in a conflict, even the celestials and Asuras shall not be able to perceive his course.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षयाविषुधी बाणैश्चापं चापि सुदुर्जयम्
अस्त्रं च बलवत्सौम्य शत्रुविध्वंसनं रणे
verses.transliteration:
akṣayāviṣudhī bāṇaiścāpaṁ cāpi sudurjayam
astraṁ ca balavatsaumya śatruvidhvaṁsanaṁ raṇe

translations.english: Besides he has obtained a quiver, the arrows whereof shall never be exhausted, a bow, which is hard of being got by and a dreadful weapon which destroys enemies in a conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
एतान्सर्वान्वराँल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रस्तेऽयं दशानन
अद्य यज्ञसमाप्तौ च त्वत्प्रतीक्षः स्थितो अहम्
verses.transliteration:
etānsarvānvarā̐llabdhvā putraste'yaṁ daśānana
adya yajñasamāptau ca tvatpratīkṣaḥ sthito aham

translations.english: Having obtained these boons your son, O you having ten faces, and myself, the sacrifice being finished, have been waiting to behold you.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम्
पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्द्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
tato'bravīddaśagrīvo na śobhanamidaṁ kṛtam
pūjitāḥ śatravo yasmāddravyairindrapurogamāḥ

translations.english: Whereto the Ten-necked demon replied, You have not done well as you have worshipped, with diverse articles my enemies, Indra and others.

verses.sanskrit:
एहीदानीं कृतं यद्धि तदकर्तुं न शक्यते
आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
ehīdānīṁ kṛtaṁ yaddhi tadakartuṁ na śakyate
āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svameva bhavanaṁ prati

translations.english: However, what is done is done, there is virtue in this, no doubt; come, o gentle one, we shall go to our house.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवः सपुत्रः सविभीषणः
स्त्रियोऽवतारयामास सर्वास्ता बाष्पविक्लवाः
verses.transliteration:
tato gatvā daśagrīvaḥ saputraḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ
striyo'vatārayāmāsa sarvāstā bāṣpaviklavāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon going there with his son and Vibhișana, the Ten-necked demon got down all those damsels, speechless with tears, gifted with auspicious marks, the precious females of the celestials, Dānavas and Räkşasas. Perceiving his vicious desire for those damsels, the virtuoussouled (Vibhisana) said.

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशैस्तैः समाचारैर्यशोऽर्थकुलनाशनैः
धर्षणं प्राणिनां दत्त्वा स्वमतेन विचेष्टसे
verses.transliteration:
īdṛśaistaiḥ samācārairyaśo'rthakulanāśanaiḥ
dharṣaṇaṁ prāṇināṁ dattvā svamatena viceṣṭase

translations.english: You do (still) follow your own whims, knowing that people are injured by these actions which destroy piety, wealth and fame.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञातीन्वै धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वयानीता वराङ्गनाः
त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता
verses.transliteration:
jñātīnvai dharṣayitvemāstvayānītā varāṅganāḥ
tvāmatikramya madhunā rājankumbhīnasī hṛtā

translations.english: Having slain their kinsmen you past brought these beautiful damsels hither, but disregarding you, O King, Madhu has carried away Kumbhīnasī.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं नावगच्छामि किं त्विदम्
को वायं यस्त्वयाख्यातो मधुरित्येव नामतः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastvabravīdvākyaṁ nāvagacchāmi kiṁ tvidam
ko vāyaṁ yastvayākhyāto madhurityeva nāmataḥ

translations.english: Ravana said:-“I do not understand all this. Who is that Madhu, who has been named by you?"

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणस्तु संक्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम्
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇastu saṁkruddho bhrātaraṁ vākyamabravīt
śrūyatāmasya pāpasya karmaṇaḥ phalamāgatam

translations.english: Worked up with ire Vibhîşana said to his brother: "Hear, the fruit of your vicious actions has arrived.

verses.sanskrit:
मातामहस्य योऽस्माकं ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः
माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धप्राज्ञो निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
mātāmahasya yo'smākaṁ jyeṣṭho bhrātā sumālinaḥ
mālyavāniti vikhyāto vṛddhaprājño niśācaraḥ

translations.english: There was an old Räkşasas, celebrated for his wisdom, named Mālyavān, the elder brother of Sumālin, our maternal grandfather. His granddaughter is Kumbhinaşi and is born of our maternal aunt Analā.; so she is virtually our sister.

verses.sanskrit:
सा हृता मधुना राजन्राक्षसेन बलीयसा
यज्ञप्रवृत्ते पुत्रे ते मयि चान्तर्जलोषिते
verses.transliteration:
sā hṛtā madhunā rājanrākṣasena balīyasā
yajñapravṛtte putre te mayi cāntarjaloṣite

translations.english: Your son being engaged in the sacrifice and myself being under waters she was stolen away, Oking, by the powerful Rākşasa Madhu. Kumbhakarma, ogreat king, was then asleep. Having slain all the powerful Rākşasas and your councillors, he had stolen her away, O king, who was in your inner apartments.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा त्वेतन्महाराज क्षान्तमेव हतो न सः
यस्मादवश्यं दातव्या कन्या भर्त्रे हि दातृभिः
अस्मिन्नेवाभिसंप्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tvetanmahārāja kṣāntameva hato na saḥ
yasmādavaśyaṁ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi dātṛbhiḥ
asminnevābhisaṁprāptaṁ loke viditamastu te

translations.english: Hearing this even, O great king, we have pardoned and not slain him; an unmarried girl should be given away to her husband by her brothers, but that has not been the case, this is merely the result of your vicious actions, wicked-minded as you are. And this you have met with instantly, so the people say.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्राता मे कुम्भकर्णश्च ये च मुख्या निशाचराः
वाहनान्यधिरोहन्तु नानाप्रहरणायुधाः
verses.transliteration:
bhrātā me kumbhakarṇaśca ye ca mukhyā niśācarāḥ
vāhanānyadhirohantu nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ

translations.english: Get my chariot ready soon and let all the heroes of our party be prepared. Let my brother Kumbhakarņa and other leading night-rangers, armed with various weapons, ascend their conveyances. Having slain today in the encounter that Madhu, who is not afraid of Ravana, I shall, encircled by my friends, and desirous of battle, proceed to the region of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि चत्वार्युग्राणि रक्षसाम्
नानाप्रहरणान्याशु निर्ययुर्युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇi catvāryugrāṇi rakṣasām
nānāpraharaṇānyāśu niryayuryuddhakāṅkṣiṇām

translations.english: Thereupon issued out for battle leading Rākşasas four thousand Akşauhiņi strong taking various weapons. Commanding them Indrajit proceeded the army, Răvaņa went in the middle and Kumbhakarna was in the rear; the virtuoussouled Vibhīşaņa remained in Lankā, being engaged in pious observances. And the rest of the leading Rākşasas proceeded towards the city of Madhu.

verses.sanskrit:
रथैर्नागैः खरैरुष्ट्रैर्हयैर्दीप्तैर्महोरगैः
राक्षसाः प्रययुः सर्वे कृत्वाकाशं निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
rathairnāgaiḥ kharairuṣṭrairhayairdīptairmahoragaiḥ
rākṣasāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kṛtvākāśaṁ nirantaram

translations.english: All the Rākşasas went covering the sky, some on asses, some on camels, some on horses, some on quick-coursing porpoises and some on huge serpents.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु गत्वा मधुपुरं प्रविश्य च दशाननः
न ददर्श मधुं तत्र भगिनीं तत्र दृष्टवान्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu gatvā madhupuraṁ praviśya ca daśānanaḥ
na dadarśa madhuṁ tatra bhaginīṁ tatra dṛṣṭavān

translations.english: And beholding Rävaņa proceed, hundreds of Daityas, inimical to the celestials, followed him. Having arrived at the city of Madhu and entered there the ten-necked demon did not behold Madhu but espied his sister.

verses.sanskrit:
सा प्रह्वा प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा शिरसा पादयोर्गता
तस्य राक्षसराजस्य त्रस्ता कुम्भीनसी स्वसा
verses.transliteration:
sā prahvā prāñjalirbhūtvā śirasā pādayorgatā
tasya rākṣasarājasya trastā kumbhīnasī svasā

translations.english: Thereupon being afraid of the king of Raksasas, Kumbhinasi, with folded palms, touched his feet with her crown.

verses.sanskrit:
तां समुत्थापयामास न भेतव्यमिति ब्रुवन्
रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठः किं चापि करवाणि ते
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ samutthāpayāmāsa na bhetavyamiti bruvan
rāvaṇo rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ kiṁ cāpi karavāṇi te

translations.english: Having raised her up the Rākşasa-chief Ravana said “No fear, what can I do for you?

verses.sanskrit:
साब्रवीद्यदि मे राजन्प्रसन्नस्त्वं महाबल
भर्तारं न ममेहाद्य हन्तुमर्हसि मानद
verses.transliteration:
sābravīdyadi me rājanprasannastvaṁ mahābala
bhartāraṁ na mamehādya hantumarhasi mānada

translations.english: Where to she replied “O King, O you having long arms, if you are pleased with me, do not slay my husband today, Oconfrere of honours. It is said there is no other fear like this for damsels of high pedigree. The greatest of fears is that of being a widow.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम्
त्वया ह्युक्तं महाबाहो न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम्
verses.transliteration:
satyavāgbhava rājendra māmavekṣasva yācatīm
tvayā hyuktaṁ mahābāho na bhetavyamiti svayam

translations.english: Be you truthful, O king of Kings, do you look towards me, who am thus begging. You have yourself said, O king, "no fear.”

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टः स्वसारं तत्र संस्थिताम्
क्व चासौ तव भर्ता वै मम शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭaḥ svasāraṁ tatra saṁsthitām
kva cāsau tava bhartā vai mama śīghraṁ nivedyatām

translations.english: Being thus addressed Råvana said to his sister there: "Do you tell me speedily where is your husband. I shall go with him for conquests to the region of the celestials."

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्ता सा प्रसुप्तं तं समुत्थाप्य निशाचरम्
अब्रवीत्संप्रहृष्टेव राक्षसी सुविपश्चितम्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktā sā prasuptaṁ taṁ samutthāpya niśācaram
abravītsaṁprahṛṣṭeva rākṣasī suvipaścitam

translations.english: Out of pity and love for you I refrain from slaying Madhu. Being thus accosted, that Raksasi, being pleased, got her sleeping husband, the night-ranger, up and said.

verses.sanskrit:
एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता निशाचरः
सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च
verses.transliteration:
eṣa prāpto daśagrīvo mama bhrātā niśācaraḥ
suralokajayākāṅkṣī sāhāyye tvāṁ vṛṇoti ca

translations.english: Here is my brother, the highly power Dasagrīva. Being desirous of conquering the region of the celestials he prays for your help. Do you therefore proceed to his help, O Raksasa, with all they friends.

verses.sanskrit:
तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस
स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम्
verses.transliteration:
tadasya tvaṁ sahāyārthaṁ sabandhurgaccha rākṣasa
snigdhasya bhajamānasya yuktamarthāya kalpitum

translations.english: It behoves you to help him, who out of affection for me, has prayed for your help.” Hearing those words Madhu said:-"So be it."

verses.sanskrit:
पूजयामास धर्मेण रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
प्राप्तपूजो दशग्रीवो मधुवेश्मनि वीर्यवान्
तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य गमनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
pūjayāmāsa dharmeṇa rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam
prāptapūjo daśagrīvo madhuveśmani vīryavān
tatra caikāṁ niśāmuṣya gamanāyopacakrame

translations.english: Being thus honoured the highly power Dasagrīva spent one night in Madhu's house and then, addressed himself for departure.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कैलासमासाद्य शैलं वैश्रवणालयम्
राक्षसेन्द्रो महेन्द्राभः सेनामुपनिवेशयत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kailāsamāsādya śailaṁ vaiśravaṇālayam
rākṣasendro mahendrābhaḥ senāmupaniveśayat

translations.english: Thereupon reaching the hill Kailāsa, the abode of Vaisravana, the lord of Raksasas, resembling Mahendra, encamped his army.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान्
अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu tatra daśagrīvaḥ saha sainyena vīryavān
astaṁ prāpte dinakare nivāsaṁ samarocayat

translations.english: After sunset the highly power Rāvaņa encamped his army there. And the clear moon, brilliant as the mountain, having risen, that huge army, armed with diverse weapons, became asleep.

verses.sanskrit:
घण्टानामिव संनादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वनः
अप्सरोगणसंघनां गायतां धनदालये
verses.transliteration:
ghaṇṭānāmiva saṁnādaḥ śuśruve madhurasvanaḥ
apsarogaṇasaṁghanāṁ gāyatāṁ dhanadālaye

translations.english: There was audible in the house of the lord of riches, the sweet music of the assembled Apsarās like to the sound of the bell.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्पवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः
शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः
verses.transliteration:
puṣpavarṣāṇi muñcanto nagāḥ pavanatāḍitāḥ
śailaṁ taṁ vāsayantīva madhumādhavagandhinaḥ

translations.english: Being shaken by the wind the nectar-smelling trees made the hill fragrant with the shower of flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धमादाय पुष्कलम्
प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखोऽनिलः
verses.transliteration:
madhupuṣparajaḥpṛktaṁ gandhamādāya puṣkalam
pravavau vardhayankāmaṁ rāvaṇasya sukho'nilaḥ

translations.english: And carrying the fragrance rendered salutary with honey and filaments of flowers, the excellent wind blew enhancing Ravana's desire.

verses.sanskrit:
गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोर्गुणैर्गिरेः
प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च
verses.transliteration:
geyātpuṣpasamṛddhyā ca śaityādvāyorguṇairgireḥ
pravṛttāyāṁ rajanyāṁ ca candrasyodayanena ca

translations.english: Being possessed by desire through songs, richness of flowers, coldness of air, beauty of the hills, and the rising of the moon is night, the highly powerful Rāvana espied again and again the moon with heavy sighs.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता
सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare tatra divyapuṣpavibhūṣitā
sarvāpsarovarā rambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā

translations.english: At this time passed by that way the foremost of Apsarās, Rambhā, adorned with excellent ornaments and having a countenance like the full moon.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे
ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ
सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपलक्षिता
verses.transliteration:
yasya vaktraṁ śaśinibhaṁ bhruvau cāpanibhe śubhe
ūrū karikarākārau karau pallavakomalau
sainyamadhyena gacchantī rāvaṇenopalakṣitā

translations.english: Rambhā appeared like the second tree, in grace and beauty, natural and artificial. She wore green clothes resembling the clouds; her face was like the moon, eye brows like the excellent bows, thighs like the trunks of elephants and palms soft as leaves. She was seen by Rāvana as proceeding in the midst of soldiers.

verses.sanskrit:
तां समुत्थाय रक्षेन्द्रः कामबाणबलार्दितः
करे गृहीत्वा गच्छन्तीं स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ samutthāya rakṣendraḥ kāmabāṇabalārditaḥ
kare gṛhītvā gacchantīṁ smayamāno'bhyabhāṣata

translations.english: Having got up and been influenced by lust he took her, shameful as she was, by the hand and smiling said.

verses.sanskrit:
क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम्
कस्याभ्युदयकालोऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration:
kva gacchasi varārohe kāṁ siddhiṁ bhajase svayam
kasyābhyudayakālo'yaṁ yastvāṁ samupabhokṣyate

translations.english: Where are you going, O beautiful damsel? Whom are you going of your own accord to satisfy? Whose prosperous time has appeared, with whom you shall enjoy?

verses.sanskrit:
तवाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः
सुधामृतरसस्येव कोऽद्य तृप्तिं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tavānanarasasyādya padmotpalasugandhinaḥ
sudhāmṛtarasasyeva ko'dya tṛptiṁ gamiṣyati

translations.english: Who shall be satisfied with drinking the nectar of your mouth smelling like lotus?

verses.sanskrit:
स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ
कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्शं दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ
verses.transliteration:
svarṇakumbhanibhau pīnau śubhau bhīru nirantarau
kasyorasthalasaṁsparśaṁ dāsyataste kucāvimau

translations.english: Whose breast, O fare damsel, your rising breast beautiful like two golden pots closely placed, shall touch?

verses.sanskrit:
सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु
अध्यारोक्ष्यति कस्तेऽद्य स्वर्गं जघनरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇacakrapratimaṁ svarṇadāmacitaṁ pṛthu
adhyārokṣyati kaste'dya svargaṁ jaghanarūpiṇam

translations.english: Who will go to bestride today your large thigh resembling a disc of gold, encircled by a golden chain and which was like the form of a heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्कोऽन्यः शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ
मामतीत्य हि यस्य त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम्
verses.transliteration:
madviśiṣṭaḥ pumānko'nyaḥ śakro viṣṇurathāśvinau
māmatītya hi yasya tvaṁ yāsi bhīru na śobhanam

translations.english: Who is there so beautiful as I-Indra, Visnu, or two Asvins that you are passing by me?

verses.sanskrit:
विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम्
त्रैलोक्ये यः प्रभुश्चैव तुल्यो मम न विद्यते
verses.transliteration:
viśrama tvaṁ pṛthuśroṇi śilātalamidaṁ śubham
trailokye yaḥ prabhuścaiva tulyo mama na vidyate

translations.english: Do you take rest upon this excellent rock, O you having charming waist. There is no other lord, save me, in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेष प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वो याचते त्वां दशाननः
यः प्रभुश्चापि भर्ता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम्
verses.transliteration:
tadeṣa prāñjaliḥ prahvo yācate tvāṁ daśānanaḥ
yaḥ prabhuścāpi bhartā ca trailokyasya bhajasva mām

translations.english: And Daśānana, the lord of the lords of the three worlds, thus begs you, with folded palms. Do you therefore seek me.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ताब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः
प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktābravīdrambhā vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ
prasīda nārhase vaktumīdṛśaṁ tvaṁ hi me guruḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed, Rambhā, trembling, with folded palms, said:-Be you propitiated; it does not behave you to speak thus, who are my superior.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्येभ्योऽपि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि
धर्मतश्च स्नुषा तेऽहं तत्त्वमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration:
anyebhyo'pi tvayā rakṣyā prāpnuyāṁ dharṣaṇaṁ yadi
dharmataśca snuṣā te'haṁ tattvametadbravīmi te

translations.english: Rather should you protect me if any body else try to oppress me. Virtually I am your daughterin-law. I speak to you the truth.

verses.sanskrit:
अब्रवीत्तां दशग्रीवश्चरणाधोमुखीं स्थिताम्
सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं मे स्नुषा भवेः
verses.transliteration:
abravīttāṁ daśagrīvaścaraṇādhomukhīṁ sthitām
sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatastvaṁ me snuṣā bhaveḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the Ten-necked demon said to her, standing with her face downwards, and her down standing erect at his very sight,

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य तस्य हि नान्यस्य भावो मां प्रति तिष्ठति
तेन सत्येन मां राजन्मोक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
yasya tasya hi nānyasya bhāvo māṁ prati tiṣṭhati
tena satyena māṁ rājanmoktumarhasyariṁdama

translations.english: For him I have adorned my person with these ornaments. I am not attached to any body else but him. O king, O slayer of foes, by virtue of (this relation) is behove you to save me. And that virtuous-souled one is anxiously expecting me.

verses.sanskrit:
सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः
नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोर्निपपात ह
verses.transliteration:
sā vepamānā lajjantī bhītā karakṛtāñjaliḥ
nalakūbaramāsādya pādayornipapāta ha

translations.english: Her hairs were dishevelled and her hands were trembling. Like to a blossoming creeper shaken by the wind, she, trembling and bashful and with folded hands, went to Nalakubara and fell down at his feet.

verses.sanskrit:
तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः
अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतितासि मे
verses.transliteration:
tadavasthāṁ ca tāṁ dṛṣṭvā mahātmā nalakūbaraḥ
abravītkimidaṁ bhadre pādayoḥ patitāsi me

translations.english: Having seen her in that plight the high-souled Nalakubara said-"O fair one, what is this? Why have you placed yourself at my feet?”

verses.sanskrit:
सा तु निश्वसमाना च वेपमानाथ साञ्जलिः
तस्मै सर्वं यथातथ्यमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
sā tu niśvasamānā ca vepamānātha sāñjaliḥ
tasmai sarvaṁ yathātathyamākhyātumupacakrame

translations.english: Sighing heavily and trembling she with folded palms, related to him everything from the beginning to the end.

verses.sanskrit:
आयान्ती तेन दृष्टास्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम
गृहीत्वा तेन पृष्टास्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा
verses.transliteration:
āyāntī tena dṛṣṭāsmi tvatsakāśamariṁdama
gṛhītvā tena pṛṣṭāsmi kasya tvamiti rakṣasā

translations.english: O lord, on his way to heaven, Dasagrīva has arrived here and has spent the night with his army. While I was coming to you, O slayer of foes, I was seen by him. Then holding me he said-“Where are you going?"

verses.sanskrit:
मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तद्धि तस्मै निवेदितम्
काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषीत्तद्वचो मम
verses.transliteration:
mayā tu sarvaṁ yatsatyaṁ taddhi tasmai niveditam
kāmamohābhibhūtātmā nāśrauṣīttadvaco mama

translations.english: I related to him everything truly. But being possessed by lust he did not pay heed to my, words.

verses.sanskrit:
याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा तेऽहमिति प्रभो
तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता
verses.transliteration:
yācyamāno mayā deva snuṣā te'hamiti prabho
tatsarvaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā balāttenāsmi dharṣitā

translations.english: He was again prayed by me, O lord, saying “I am your daughter-in-law." But neglecting that he ravished me.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि मानद
न हि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य च
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ tvamaparādhaṁ me kṣantumarhasi mānada
na hi tulyaṁ balaṁ saumya striyāśca puruṣasya ca

translations.english: O you of firm vows, it behove you to forgive me for this folly. O gentle one, a woman's strength can never equal that of a man.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं श्रुत्वा तु संक्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्वरणात्मजः
धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं संप्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ śrutvā tu saṁkruddhastadā vaiśvaraṇātmajaḥ
dharṣaṇāṁ tāṁ parāṁ śrutvā dhyānaṁ saṁpraviveśa ha

translations.english: Hearing of this ravishment Vaisravana's son was greatly enraged and entered into meditation.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः
मुहूर्ताद्रोषताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना
verses.transliteration:
tasya tatkarma vijñāya tadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ
muhūrtādroṣatāmrākṣastoyaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā

translations.english: Having ascertained the truth within a moment Vaisravana's son, with eyes reddened with ire, took water in his palms.

verses.sanskrit:
गृहीत्वा सलिलं दिव्यमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि
उत्ससर्ज तदा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
gṛhītvā salilaṁ divyamupaspṛśya yathāvidhi
utsasarja tadā śāpaṁ rākṣasendrāya dāruṇam

translations.english: Having taken this and rinsed his mouth duly, he imprecated a dreadful curse upon that lord of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता
तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति
verses.transliteration:
akāmā tena yasmāttvaṁ balādbhadre pradharṣitā
tasmātsa yuvatīmanyāṁ nākāmāmupayāsyati

translations.english: O fair one, since you have been ravished by him despite your unwillingness he shall never be able to get by an unwilling damsel.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता
verses.transliteration:
tasminnudāhṛte śāpe jvalitāgnisamaprabhe
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca khāccyutā

translations.english: Whenever he shall, stricken by lust, ravish a reluctant damsel, his head shall be sundered into seven pieces. As soon as this curse, like to a burning flame, was uttered, the celestials bugles were sounded and a shower of flowers fell from heavens.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजापतिमुखाश्चापि सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः
ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatimukhāścāpi sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ
jñātvā lokagatiṁ sarvāṁ tasya mṛtyuṁ ca rakṣasaḥ

translations.english: Being apprised of the plight of people (brought about by him) and of the death of that Rākşasa the patriarch Brahmă and other gods were greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम्
नारीषु मैथुनं भावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu sa daśagrīvastaṁ śāpaṁ romaharṣaṇam
nārīṣu maithunaṁ bhāvaṁ nākāmāsvabhyarocayat

translations.english: Hearing of that curse capable of making the down erect, Daśagrīva abstained from entertaining lust for unwilling females. And hearing of the curse imprecated by Nalakübara all the chaste damsels, that were kept captive, attained to great delight.

verses.sanskrit:
कैलासं लङ्घयित्वाथ दशग्रीवः सराक्षसः
आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं निशाचरः
verses.transliteration:
kailāsaṁ laṅghayitvātha daśagrīvaḥ sarākṣasaḥ
āsasāda mahātejā indralokaṁ niśācaraḥ

translations.english: Having crossed the mount Kailāsa, the highiy powerful Ten-necked demon, with his army, reached the region of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य राक्षससैन्यस्य समन्तादुपयास्यतः
देवलोकं ययौ शब्दो भिद्यमानार्णवोपमः
verses.transliteration:
tasya rākṣasasainyasya samantādupayāsyataḥ
devalokaṁ yayau śabdo bhidyamānārṇavopamaḥ

translations.english: There arose in the region of celestials an uproar from the Rākṣasa army, like to the sound of the agitated deep.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान्
सज्जीभवत युद्धार्थं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān
sajjībhavata yuddhārthaṁ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing of the arrival of Rāvana, Indra shook on his throne and said to the assembled gods, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sadhyas and Maruts"Prepare yourselves, for fighting with the vicious-souled Ravana."

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तास्तु शक्रेण देवाः शक्रसमा युधि
संनह्यन्त महासत्त्वा युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktāstu śakreṇa devāḥ śakrasamā yudhi
saṁnahyanta mahāsattvā yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Sakra, the celestials, his equals in the encounter and gifted with great prowess, armed themselves for fight. some

verses.sanskrit:
स तु दीनः परित्रस्तो महेन्द्रो रावणं प्रति
विष्णोः समीपमागत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
sa tu dīnaḥ paritrasto mahendro rāvaṇaṁ prati
viṣṇoḥ samīpamāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Mahendra, afraid of Ravana, poorly went to: Vişnu and gave vent to the following accents.

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णो कथं करिष्यामो महावीर्यपराक्रम
असौ हि बलवान्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
viṣṇo kathaṁ kariṣyāmo mahāvīryaparākrama
asau hi balavānrakṣo yuddhārthamabhivartate

translations.english: “How shall I, O Vişņu, withstand, the Rákş asa Rāvaņa? The highly powerful Rākṣasa has come here for battle. It is by virtue of the boon that he is powerful, not for any thing else. It is proper to make the words uttered by Brahmă, truthful.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यथा नमुचिर्वृत्रो बलिर्नरकशम्बरौ
त्वन्मतं समवष्टभ्य यथा दग्धास्तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
tadyathā namucirvṛtro balirnarakaśambarau
tvanmataṁ samavaṣṭabhya yathā dagdhāstathā kuru

translations.english: As resorting to your prowess I destroyed Namuci, Vrtra, Bali, Naraka and Sambara, so do you make arrangements (for his destruction).

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमान्पद्मनाभः सनातनः
त्वयाहं स्थापितश्चैव देवराज्ये सनातने
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānpadmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ
tvayāhaṁ sthāpitaścaiva devarājye sanātane

translations.english: There is no other excellent refuge but you in the three worlds, mobile and immobile, O lord, O gods of gods, O slayer of Madhu. You are the graceful, ever-existing Nārāyaṇa, having a lotus naval. By you the worlds have been settled and myself and Sakra, the lord of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
तदाख्याहि यथातत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम्
असिचक्रसहायस्त्वं युध्यसे संयुगे रिपुम्
verses.transliteration:
tadākhyāhi yathātattvaṁ devadeva mama svayam
asicakrasahāyastvaṁ yudhyase saṁyuge ripum

translations.english: Do you tell me, the truth, O god of gods, that I may myself fight; or do you, with your sword and discus, vanquish Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण देवो नारायणः प्रभुः
अब्रवीन्न परित्रासः कार्यस्ते श्रूयतां च मे
verses.transliteration:
evamuktaḥ sa śakreṇa devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
abravīnna paritrāsaḥ kāryaste śrūyatāṁ ca me

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Śakra the lord Narayana; said, "Do not fear, hear what I say. He is invincible by virtue of the boon, and that vicious-souled one is incapable of being vanquished even by the celestials and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वथा तु महत्कर्म करिष्यति बलोत्कटः
रक्षः पुत्रसहायोऽसौ दृष्टमेतन्निसर्गतः
verses.transliteration:
sarvathā tu mahatkarma kariṣyati balotkaṭaḥ
rakṣaḥ putrasahāyo'sau dṛṣṭametannisargataḥ

translations.english: Irrepressible by virtue of his prowess, that Raksasa, with his son, shall accomplish a mighty object. It seems to be real.

verses.sanskrit:
अनिहत्य रिपुं विष्णुर्न हि प्रतिनिवर्तते
दुर्लभश्चैष कामोऽद्य वरमासाद्य राक्षसे
verses.transliteration:
anihatya ripuṁ viṣṇurna hi pratinivartate
durlabhaścaiṣa kāmo'dya varamāsādya rākṣase

translations.english: Without slaying the enemies in the encounter, Vişņu does never go black, but it is hard to fulfil my desire from Rāvaņa, well protected by the boon.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रतिजानामि देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपं शतक्रतो
राक्षसस्याहमेवास्य भविता मृत्युकारणम्
verses.transliteration:
pratijānāmi devendra tvatsamīpaṁ śatakrato
rākṣasasyāhamevāsya bhavitā mṛtyukāraṇam

translations.english: However I do promise before you, O lord of the celestials, O performer of hundred sacrifices, I shall, soon become the cause of this Räkşasa's death.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादः शुश्रुवे रजनीक्षये
तस्य रावणसैन्यस्य प्रयुद्धस्य समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare nādaḥ śuśruve rajanīkṣaye
tasya rāvaṇasainyasya prayuddhasya samantataḥ

translations.english: Meanwhile at the latter part of the night there was audible the uproar of Rāvana's army fighting on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ युद्धं समभवद्देवराक्षसयोस्तदा
घोरं तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं नानाप्रहरणायुधम्
verses.transliteration:
atha yuddhaṁ samabhavaddevarākṣasayostadā
ghoraṁ tumulanirhrādaṁ nānāpraharaṇāyudham

translations.english: Thereupon there ensued a conflict, setting up a terrible sound, with various weapons between the Räksasas and gods.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः
युद्धार्थमभ्यधावन्त सचिवा रावणाज्ञया
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śūrā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ
yuddhārthamabhyadhāvanta sacivā rāvaṇājñayā

translations.english: In the interval issued out for another encounter the heroic and grim-visaged Räksasas, Rāvana's councillors.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो वसूनामष्टमो वसुः
सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश महारणम्
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śūro vasūnāmaṣṭamo vasuḥ
sāvitra iti vikhyātaḥ praviveśa mahāraṇam

translations.english: Being thus distressed by the night-rangers the hoist of the gods fled away into diverse directions like a herd of deer attacked by a lion. In the meantime, entered the battle-field, the heroic and brave Såvitra, the eight Vasu, encircled by soldiers and striking terror into the hearts of the enemies.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो युद्धं समभवत्सुराणां राक्षसैः सह
क्रुद्धानां रक्षसां कीर्तिं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
tato yuddhaṁ samabhavatsurāṇāṁ rākṣasaiḥ saha
kruddhānāṁ rakṣasāṁ kīrtiṁ samareṣvanivartinām

translations.english: Thereupon there arose with Rākşasas a terrible encounter of the celestials unable to bear their fame in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते राक्षसाः शूरा देवांस्तान्समरे स्थितान्
नानाप्रहरणैर्घोरैर्जघ्नुः शतसहस्रशः
verses.transliteration:
tataste rākṣasāḥ śūrā devāṁstānsamare sthitān
nānāpraharaṇairghorairjaghnuḥ śatasahasraśaḥ

translations.english: Then the Rākşasas, with thousands of terrible weapons, began to belabour the deities in the encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरः सुमाली नाम राक्षसः
नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धो रणमेवाभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śūraḥ sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ
nānāpraharaṇaiḥ kruddho raṇamevābhyavartata

translations.english: In the interim, O Rāma, a Rākşasa, Sumāli, by name, getting enraged, and with diverse weapons, ran amok of the soldiery. As the winds scatter clouds, so he, under the influence of rage, with various sharpened weapons, committed a havoc among the celestial soldiers.

verses.sanskrit:
ते महाबाणवर्षैश्च शूलैः प्रासैश्च दारुणैः
पीड्यमानाः सुराः सर्वे न व्यतिष्ठन्समाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
te mahābāṇavarṣaiśca śūlaiḥ prāsaiśca dāruṇaiḥ
pīḍyamānāḥ surāḥ sarve na vyatiṣṭhansamāhitāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon being assailed by a downpour of huge shafts, maces, Prāsas and diverse dreadful weapons, the celestials could not keep their ground upon the field of warfare.

verses.sanskrit:
संवृतः स्वैरनीकैस्तु प्रहरन्तं निशाचरम्
विक्रमेण महातेजा वारयामास संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
saṁvṛtaḥ svairanīkaistu praharantaṁ niśācaram
vikrameṇa mahātejā vārayāmāsa saṁyuge

translations.english: The celestials being thus distressed by Sumāli the eighth of Vasu, Savitra stood there enraged. And encircled by his own car-warriors that highly powerful one, with his prowess, repulsed the striking night-rangers.

verses.sanskrit:
सुमत्तयोस्तयोरासीद्युद्धं लोके सुदारुणम्
सुमालिनो वसोश्चैव समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः
verses.transliteration:
sumattayostayorāsīdyuddhaṁ loke sudāruṇam
sumālino vasoścaiva samareṣvanivartinoḥ

translations.english: Thereupon there arose a terrible encounter, capable of making down erect, between Sumālin and the Vasu, who did not retire from the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना
महान्स पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः
verses.transliteration:
tatastasya mahābāṇairvasunā sumahātmanā
mahānsa pannagarathaḥ kṣaṇena vinipātitaḥ

translations.english: His chariot drawn by serpents was pulled down and destroyed by the high-souled Vasu by means of his huge shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
हत्वा तु संयुगे तस्य रथं बाणशतैः शितैः
गदां तस्य वधार्थाय वसुर्जग्राह पाणिना
verses.transliteration:
hatvā tu saṁyuge tasya rathaṁ bāṇaśataiḥ śitaiḥ
gadāṁ tasya vadhārthāya vasurjagrāha pāṇinā

translations.english: Having destroyed his car in the warfare with hundreds of arrows Vasu took up mace in his hands for his destruction. Having taken up that mace having a burning head and resembling the rod of Death Sāvitra struck Sumálin on his head there with.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य नैवास्थि कायो वा न मांसं ददृशे तदा
गदया भस्मसाद्भूतो रणे तस्मिन्निपातितः
verses.transliteration:
tasya naivāsthi kāyo vā na māṁsaṁ dadṛśe tadā
gadayā bhasmasādbhūto raṇe tasminnipātitaḥ

translations.english: By the stroke of that mace his person was reduced to ashes and therefore, there was not seen in the battle field either his bone, head or flesh.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं संख्ये राक्षसास्ते समन्ततः
दुद्रुवुः सहिताः सर्वे क्रोशमाना महास्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā nihataṁ saṁkhye rākṣasāste samantataḥ
dudruvuḥ sahitāḥ sarve krośamānā mahāsvanam

translations.english: Having beheld him slain in the warfare the Räkşasas bewailing ran about on all sides and being distressed by Vasu they could not stay in the battle field.

verses.sanskrit:
सुमालिनं हतं दृष्ट्वा वसुना भस्मसात्कृतम्
विद्रुतं चापि स्वं सैन्यं लक्षयित्वार्दितं शरैः
verses.transliteration:
sumālinaṁ hataṁ dṛṣṭvā vasunā bhasmasātkṛtam
vidrutaṁ cāpi svaṁ sainyaṁ lakṣayitvārditaṁ śaraiḥ

translations.english: Beholding Sumali slain and reduced to ashes by Vasu and being assailed by the deities the Räksasa host fled into diverse directions. And collecting all the Rākşasas stood there the highly powerful Meghanāda, enraged, the son of Ravana.

verses.sanskrit:
स रथेनाग्निवर्णेन कामगेन महारथः
अभिदुद्राव सेनां तां वनान्यग्निरिव ज्वलन्
verses.transliteration:
sa rathenāgnivarṇena kāmagena mahārathaḥ
abhidudrāva senāṁ tāṁ vanānyagniriva jvalan

translations.english: Like to flaming fire approaching towards forest that great car-warrior encountered the enemies in a precious car coursing at will.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रविशतस्तस्य विविधायुधधारिणः
विदुद्रुवुर्दिशः सर्वा देवास्तस्य च दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ praviśatastasya vividhāyudhadhāriṇaḥ
vidudruvurdiśaḥ sarvā devāstasya ca darśanāt

translations.english: As soon as he, armed with various weapons, entered the field the celestials, at his very sight. And away to all directions.

verses.sanskrit:
न भेतव्यं न गन्तव्यं निवर्तध्वं रणं प्रति
एष गच्छति मे पुत्रो युद्धार्थमपराजितः
verses.transliteration:
na bhetavyaṁ na gantavyaṁ nivartadhvaṁ raṇaṁ prati
eṣa gacchati me putro yuddhārthamaparājitaḥ

translations.english: Be not afraid, O you celestials; do not fly away; come back to the battle; this my son, who has never been vanquished, goes to battle.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शक्रसुतो देवो जयन्त इति विश्रुतः
रथेनाद्भुतकल्पेन संग्राममभिवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śakrasuto devo jayanta iti viśrutaḥ
rathenādbhutakalpena saṁgrāmamabhivartata

translations.english: Thereupon Sakra's son, known as divine Jayanta, proceeded towards the field of action by a wondrous car.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे परिवार्य शचीसुतम्
रावणस्य सुतं युद्धे समासाद्य व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
tataste tridaśāḥ sarve parivārya śacīsutam
rāvaṇasya sutaṁ yuddhe samāsādya vyavasthitāḥ

translations.english: Having encircled Saci's son and encountered Rāvana's son, the deities began to assail him.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां युद्धं महदभूत्सदृशं देवरक्षसाम्
कृते महेन्द्रपुत्रस्य राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य च
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ yuddhaṁ mahadabhūtsadṛśaṁ devarakṣasām
kṛte mahendraputrasya rākṣasendrasutasya ca

translations.english: The encounter between Mahendra's son Jayanta and Rāvana's son Meghanāda was like one between gods and demons.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मातलिपुत्रे तु गोमुखे राक्षसात्मजः
सारथौ पातयामास शरान्काञ्चनभूषणान्
verses.transliteration:
tato mātaliputre tu gomukhe rākṣasātmajaḥ
sārathau pātayāmāsa śarānkāñcanabhūṣaṇān

translations.english: Thereupon Rāvana's son began to assail, with shafts feathered in gold, his (Jayanta's) charioteer Gomukha, Mātali's son.

verses.sanskrit:
शचीसुतस्त्वपि तथा जयन्तस्तस्य सारथिम्
तं चैव रावणिं क्रुद्धः प्रत्यविध्यद्रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration:
śacīsutastvapi tathā jayantastasya sārathim
taṁ caiva rāvaṇiṁ kruddhaḥ pratyavidhyadraṇājire

translations.english: Sacīs son too, enraged, assailed on all sides, Rāvana's son and his charioteer. And the powerful Rāvani, stricken with ire and with eyes expanded, covered Sakra's son with arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रगृह्य शस्त्राणि सारवन्ति महान्ति च
शतघ्नीस्तोमरान्प्रासान्गदाखड्गपरश्वधान्
सुमहान्त्यद्रिशृङ्गाणि पातयामास रावणिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pragṛhya śastrāṇi sāravanti mahānti ca
śataghnīstomarānprāsāngadākhaḍgaparaśvadhān
sumahāntyadriśṛṅgāṇi pātayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Rāvana's son struck the celestial host with thousands of huge mountain summits, Śataghnīs, maces, Prāsas, Prāsas, clubs, daggers, Paraśus and various other sharp pointed weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रव्यथिता लोकाः संजज्ञे च तमो महत्
तस्य रावणपुत्रस्य तदा शत्रूनभिघ्नतः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pravyathitā lokāḥ saṁjajñe ca tamo mahat
tasya rāvaṇaputrasya tadā śatrūnabhighnataḥ

translations.english: Rāvana's son thus striking Indra's army the quarters were enshrouded with darkness by his illusory power.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तद्दैवतबलं समन्तात्तं शचीसुतम्
बहुप्रकारमस्वस्थं तत्र तत्र स्म धावति
verses.transliteration:
tatastaddaivatabalaṁ samantāttaṁ śacīsutam
bahuprakāramasvasthaṁ tatra tatra sma dhāvati

translations.english: Being overpowered with arrows on all sides the celestial army, leaving aside Jayanta, became restless.

verses.sanskrit:
नाभ्यजानंस्तदान्योन्यं शत्रून्वा दैवतानि वा
तत्र तत्र विपर्यस्तं समन्तात्परिधावितम्
verses.transliteration:
nābhyajānaṁstadānyonyaṁ śatrūnvā daivatāni vā
tatra tatra viparyastaṁ samantātparidhāvitam

translations.english: The deities or the Rākşasas, they could not recognise one another. And being distressed they ran about on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरः पुलोमा नाम वीर्यवान्
दैतेयस्तेन संगृह्य शचीपुत्रोऽपवाहितः
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śūraḥ pulomā nāma vīryavān
daiteyastena saṁgṛhya śacīputro'pavāhitaḥ

translations.english: In the interim a heroic and powerful Daityachief, Pulomā, be name, taking ſacī's son disappeared.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणाशं दृश्य तु सुरा जयन्तस्यातिदारुणम्
व्यथिताश्चाप्रहृष्टाश्च समन्ताद्विप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration:
praṇāśaṁ dṛśya tu surā jayantasyātidāruṇam
vyathitāścāprahṛṣṭāśca samantādvipradudruvuḥ

translations.english: Thinking that Jayanta was slain all the deities greatly sorry and distressed fled away on all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणिस्त्वथ संहृष्टो बलैः परिवृतः स्वकैः
अभ्यधावत देवांस्तान्मुमोच च महास्वनम्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇistvatha saṁhṛṣṭo balaiḥ parivṛtaḥ svakaiḥ
abhyadhāvata devāṁstānmumoca ca mahāsvanam

translations.english: Thereupon Rāvana's son, enraged and encircled by his own powerful followers, pursued the celestials emitting loud cries.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा प्रणाशं पुत्रस्य रावणेश्चापि विक्रमम्
मातलिं प्राह देवेन्द्रो रथः समुपनीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā praṇāśaṁ putrasya rāvaṇeścāpi vikramam
mātaliṁ prāha devendro rathaḥ samupanīyatām

translations.english: Not beholding his son and observing the flight of the deities the king of the celestials said to Mātali, “Bring the car."

verses.sanskrit:
स तु दिव्यो महाभीमः सज्ज एव महारथः
उपस्थितो मातलिना वाह्यमानो मनोजवः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu divyo mahābhīmaḥ sajja eva mahārathaḥ
upasthito mātalinā vāhyamāno manojavaḥ

translations.english: By Mātali was brought, the celestial, highly dreadful, huge and quick-coursing chariot, that was ready.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मेघा रथे तस्मिंस्तडिद्वन्तो महास्वनाः
अग्रतो वायुचपला गच्छन्तो व्यनदंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
tato meghā rathe tasmiṁstaḍidvanto mahāsvanāḥ
agrato vāyucapalā gacchanto vyanadaṁstadā

translations.english: (And he having) ascended the car, the huge clouds, with lightening, being driven by winds, began to emit forth loud mutterings before the chariot.

verses.sanskrit:
नानावाद्यानि वाद्यन्त स्तुतयश्च समाहिताः
ननृतुश्चाप्सरःसंघाः प्रयाते वासवे रणम्
verses.transliteration:
nānāvādyāni vādyanta stutayaśca samāhitāḥ
nanṛtuścāpsaraḥsaṁghāḥ prayāte vāsave raṇam

translations.english: The Gandharvas began to play on various instruments and the Apsarās began to dance.

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैः साध्यैश्च समरुद्गणैः
वृतो नानाप्रहरणैर्निर्ययौ त्रिदशाधिपः
verses.transliteration:
rudrairvasubhirādityaiḥ sādhyaiśca samarudgaṇaiḥ
vṛto nānāpraharaṇairniryayau tridaśādhipaḥ

translations.english: Taking up various weapons, Indra, the king of divinities, set out for the field of action, in the company of Rudras, Vasus, Adityas, the two Asvins and Maruts.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषं पवनो ववौ
भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्महोल्काश्च प्रपेदिरे
verses.transliteration:
nirgacchatastu śakrasya paruṣaṁ pavano vavau
bhāskaro niṣprabhaścāsīnmaholkāśca prapedire

translations.english: He, having set out for battle, the winds began to blow high, the sun was divested of its brilliance and the huge fire-brands began to send out flames.

verses.sanskrit:
पन्नगैः सुमहाकायैर्वेष्टितं लोमहर्षणैः
येषां निश्वासवातेन प्रदीप्तमिव संयुगम्
verses.transliteration:
pannagaiḥ sumahākāyairveṣṭitaṁ lomaharṣaṇaiḥ
yeṣāṁ niśvāsavātena pradīptamiva saṁyugam

translations.english: In the interval the heroic and the highly powerful Daśagrīva ascended the celestial car, constructed by the Architect of the deities, encircled by the huge-bodied serpents capable of making down erect and by whose breath the battle-field was ablaze.

verses.sanskrit:
दैत्यैर्निशाचरैः शूरै रथः संपरिवारितः
समराभिमुखो दिव्यो महेन्द्रमभिवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
daityairniśācaraiḥ śūrai rathaḥ saṁparivāritaḥ
samarābhimukho divyo mahendramabhivartata

translations.english: Surrounded by demons and night-rangers and with the celestial car he encountered Mahendra in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रं तं वारयित्वासौ स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः
सोऽपि युद्धाद्विनिष्क्रम्य रावणिः समुपाविशत्
verses.transliteration:
putraṁ taṁ vārayitvāsau svayameva vyavasthitaḥ
so'pi yuddhādviniṣkramya rāvaṇiḥ samupāviśat

translations.english: Having desisted his son he himself stood there. And having coming out from the field of action Ravana's son too stood silent.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो युद्धं प्रवृत्तं तु सुराणां राक्षसैः सह
शस्त्राभिवर्षणं घोरं मेघानामिव संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
tato yuddhaṁ pravṛttaṁ tu surāṇāṁ rākṣasaiḥ saha
śastrābhivarṣaṇaṁ ghoraṁ meghānāmiva saṁyuge

translations.english: Thereupon there arose an encounter between the Räkşasas and the deities and there began a downpour of weapons in the conflict like clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुष्टात्मा नानाप्रहरणोद्यतः
नाज्ञायत तदा युद्धे सह केनाप्ययुध्यत
verses.transliteration:
kumbhakarṇastu duṣṭātmā nānāpraharaṇodyataḥ
nājñāyata tadā yuddhe saha kenāpyayudhyata
