translations.english: The vicious-souled Kumbhakarņa armed with various weapons came you, but he did not know,* O king, with whom the conflict was going on. *For he was asleep till then so he was not acquainted with the particulars war-fare. He used to sleep for six months at a time.

verses.sanskrit:
दन्तैर्भुजाभ्यां पद्भ्यां च शक्तितोमरसायकैः
येन केनैव संरब्धस्ताडयामास वै सुरान्
verses.transliteration:
dantairbhujābhyāṁ padbhyāṁ ca śaktitomarasāyakaiḥ
yena kenaiva saṁrabdhastāḍayāmāsa vai surān

translations.english: And by him enraged, the celestials were assailed with his teeth, feet, arms, hands, Saktis, Tomaras and clubs or any weapon whatsoever.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रुद्रैर्महाभागैः सहादित्यैर्निशाचरः
प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च संग्रामे कृत्तः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rudrairmahābhāgaiḥ sahādityairniśācaraḥ
prayuddhastaiśca saṁgrāme kṛttaḥ śastrairnirantaram

translations.english: Thereupon the night-ranger engaged with the highly powerful Rudra and was wounded, in the conflict, with incessant strokes of weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तद्राक्षसं सैन्यं त्रिदशैः समरुद्गणैः
रणे विद्रावितं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः
verses.transliteration:
tatastadrākṣasaṁ sainyaṁ tridaśaiḥ samarudgaṇaiḥ
raṇe vidrāvitaṁ sarvaṁ nānāpraharaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the Rākşasas army began to fight with Maruts and they were overwhelmed in the encounter with the stroke of various weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
शोणितोदक निष्यन्दाकङ्कगृध्रसमाकुला
प्रवृत्ता संयुगमुखे शस्त्रग्राहवती नदी
verses.transliteration:
śoṇitodaka niṣyandākaṅkagṛdhrasamākulā
pravṛttā saṁyugamukhe śastragrāhavatī nadī

translations.english: There issued out in the battle-field a river from weapons, having blood for its silent waters and infested with crows and vultures.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्
निरीक्ष्य तद्बलं सर्वं दैवतैर्विनिपातितम्
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare kruddho daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān
nirīkṣya tadbalaṁ sarvaṁ daivatairvinipātitam

translations.english: Having beheld his own army slain by the deities the highly powerful Daśänana, enraged beholding the army slain by gods, entered the ocean of celestial army and slaying the deities in the conflict confronted Sakra.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शक्रो महच्चापं विस्फार्य सुमहास्वनम्
यस्य विस्फारघोषेण स्वनन्ति स्म दिशो दश
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śakro mahaccāpaṁ visphārya sumahāsvanam
yasya visphāraghoṣeṇa svananti sma diśo daśa

translations.english: Thereupon Śakra took up his huge bow by the twang where-of the ten quarters were filled.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्विकृष्य महच्चापमिन्द्रो रावणमूर्धनि
निपातयामास शरान्पावकादित्यवर्चसः
verses.transliteration:
tadvikṛṣya mahaccāpamindro rāvaṇamūrdhani
nipātayāmāsa śarānpāvakādityavarcasaḥ

translations.english: Having unstrung his huge bow Indra struck Răvaņa, on his head, with arrows resembling the flame of fire and the rays of the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
तथैव च महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो व्यवस्थितः
शक्रं कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration:
tathaiva ca mahābāhurdaśagrīvo vyavasthitaḥ
śakraṁ kārmukavibhraṣṭaiḥ śaravarṣairavākirat

translations.english: And the Rākşasa-chief Daśānana, having long arms, also assailed Indra with hundreds of shafts discharged off his bow.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयुध्यतोरथ तयोर्बाणवर्षैः समन्ततः
नाज्ञायत तदा किंचित्सर्वं हि तमसा वृतम्
verses.transliteration:
prayudhyatoratha tayorbāṇavarṣaiḥ samantataḥ
nājñāyata tadā kiṁcitsarvaṁ hi tamasā vṛtam

translations.english: They having been thus engaged with each other with the downpour of dreadful shafts, all the quarters were filled with darkness and in consequence thereof nothing was visible.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तमसि संजाते राक्षसा दैवतैः सह
अयुध्यन्त बलोन्मत्ताः सूदयन्तः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastamasi saṁjāte rākṣasā daivataiḥ saha
ayudhyanta balonmattāḥ sūdayantaḥ parasparam

translations.english: Thereupon darkness having set in all the celestials and Rākşasas, maddened with their strength, began to fight rushing one another.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रश्च रावणश्चैव रावणिश्च महाबलः
तस्मिंस्तमोजालवृते मोहमीयुर्न ते त्रयः
verses.transliteration:
indraśca rāvaṇaścaiva rāvaṇiśca mahābalaḥ
tasmiṁstamojālavṛte mohamīyurna te trayaḥ

translations.english: And in that darkness-Indra, Ravana and Meghanāda— these three were not possessed by the influence of illusion. Beholding his whole army slain in a moment, Ravana, worked up with dreadful ire, sent out terrible roars.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रोधात्सूतं च दुर्धर्षः स्यन्दनस्थमुवाच ह
परसैन्यस्य मध्येन यावदन्तं नयस्व माम्
verses.transliteration:
krodhātsūtaṁ ca durdharṣaḥ syandanasthamuvāca ha
parasainyasya madhyena yāvadantaṁ nayasva mām

translations.english: And in anger, that irrepressible one said to the charioteer, stationed on the car, “Do you take me to the other end of the enemies' host."

verses.sanskrit:
अद्यैतांस्त्रिदशान्सर्वान्विक्रमैः समरे स्वयम्
नानाशस्त्रैर्महासारैर्नाशयामि नभस्तलात्
verses.transliteration:
adyaitāṁstridaśānsarvānvikramaiḥ samare svayam
nānāśastrairmahāsārairnāśayāmi nabhastalāt

translations.english: I shall soon in the field of battle, with the stroke of various weapons despatch all the deities to the abode of Death,

verses.sanskrit:
अहमिन्द्रं वधिष्यामि वरुणं धनदं यमम्
त्रिदशान्विनिहत्याशु स्वयं स्थास्याम्यथोपरि
verses.transliteration:
ahamindraṁ vadhiṣyāmi varuṇaṁ dhanadaṁ yamam
tridaśānvinihatyāśu svayaṁ sthāsyāmyathopari

translations.english: I shall slay Indra, Kubera, Varuna and Yama, what to speak of more, I shall soon destroy all the deities and place myself above them.

verses.sanskrit:
विषादो न च कर्तव्यः शीघ्रं वाहय मे रथम्
द्विः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यद्य यावदन्तं नयस्व माम्
verses.transliteration:
viṣādo na ca kartavyaḥ śīghraṁ vāhaya me ratham
dviḥ khalu tvāṁ bravīmyadya yāvadantaṁ nayasva mām

translations.english: Be not sorry; do you soon drive my chariot. To-day I have told you twice to take me to the end of the enemy's army.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं स नन्दनोद्देशो यत्र वर्तामहे वयम्
नय मामद्य तत्र त्वमुदयो यत्र पर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ sa nandanoddeśo yatra vartāmahe vayam
naya māmadya tatra tvamudayo yatra parvataḥ

translations.english: We are now waiting near the Nandana grove, do you take me to the hill when the sun rises.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तुरगान्स मनोजवान्
आदिदेशाथ शत्रूणां मध्येनैव च सारथिः
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā turagānsa manojavān
ādideśātha śatrūṇāṁ madhyenaiva ca sārathiḥ

translations.english: Hearing his words the charioteer drove the steeds, coursing at will through the enemies' host.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा शक्रो देवेश्वरस्तदा
रथस्थः समरस्थांस्तान्देवान्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya taṁ niścayaṁ jñātvā śakro deveśvarastadā
rathasthaḥ samarasthāṁstāndevānvākyamathābravīt

translations.english: Thereupon being apprised of his intention, Śakra, the king of the celestials, stationed on car, said to the deities, in the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
सुराः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यत्तावन्मम रोचते
जीवन्नेव दशग्रीवः साधु रक्षो निगृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
surāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṁ yattāvanmama rocate
jīvanneva daśagrīvaḥ sādhu rakṣo nigṛhyatām

translations.english: O you deities-bear my words, what appear to me best. This Ten-necked demon must be vanquished by us while alive.

verses.sanskrit:
एष ह्यतिबलः सैन्ये रथेन पवनौजसा
गमिष्यति प्रवृद्धोर्मिः समुद्र इव पर्वणि
verses.transliteration:
eṣa hyatibalaḥ sainye rathena pavanaujasā
gamiṣyati pravṛddhormiḥ samudra iva parvaṇi

translations.english: Ascending his car, gifted with the velocity of the wind, the highly powerful one is proceeding among the army like to the deep with waves rising during Parva.

verses.sanskrit:
न ह्येष हन्तुं शक्योऽद्य वरदानात्सुनिर्भयः
तद्ग्रहीष्यामहे रक्षो यत्ता भवत संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
na hyeṣa hantuṁ śakyo'dya varadānātsunirbhayaḥ
tadgrahīṣyāmahe rakṣo yattā bhavata saṁyuge

translations.english: It is not possible to slay him now, for he shall not meet with death in consequence of the boon. So let us make him captive-and we should all exert to that end.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा बलिं निगृह्यैतत्त्रैलोक्यं भुज्यते मया
एवमेतस्य पापस्य निग्रहो मम रोचते
verses.transliteration:
yathā baliṁ nigṛhyaitattrailokyaṁ bhujyate mayā
evametasya pāpasya nigraho mama rocate

translations.english: Bali being held captive, I am enjoying the three worlds-and I think proper to obstruct the course of this vicious-souled one.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽन्यं देशमास्थाय शक्रः संत्यज्य रावणम्
अयुध्यत महातेजा राक्षसान्नाशयन्रणे
verses.transliteration:
tato'nyaṁ deśamāsthāya śakraḥ saṁtyajya rāvaṇam
ayudhyata mahātejā rākṣasānnāśayanraṇe

translations.english: Having said this and left aside Råvaņa, Sakra went to another side, O King, and fought terrifying the Rākşasas in the conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरेण दशग्रीवः प्रविवेशानिवर्तितः
दक्षिणेन तु पार्श्वेन प्रविवेश शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration:
uttareṇa daśagrīvaḥ praviveśānivartitaḥ
dakṣiṇena tu pārśvena praviveśa śatakratuḥ

translations.english: Dasagriva, incapable of being thwarted, entered by the northern route and the performer of hundred sacrifices by the southern.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स योजनशतं प्रविष्टो राक्षसाधिपः
देवतानां बलं कृत्स्नं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa yojanaśataṁ praviṣṭo rākṣasādhipaḥ
devatānāṁ balaṁ kṛtsnaṁ śaravarṣairavākirat

translations.english: Thereupon having entered into the army up to a hundred leagues the lord of Rākşasas overpowered the celestial host with a downpour of shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शक्रो निरीक्ष्याथ प्रविष्टं तं बलं स्वकम्
न्यवर्तयदसंभ्रान्तः समावृत्य दशाननम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śakro nirīkṣyātha praviṣṭaṁ taṁ balaṁ svakam
nyavartayadasaṁbhrāntaḥ samāvṛtya daśānanam

translations.english: Thereupon beholding his own army slain Sakra, returned fearlessly and obstructed the Ten-necked demon.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादो मुक्तो दानवराक्षसैः
हा हताः स्मेति तं दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं शक्रेण रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare nādo mukto dānavarākṣasaiḥ
hā hatāḥ smeti taṁ dṛṣṭvā grastaṁ śakreṇa rāvaṇam

translations.english: In the interim beholding Rāvaņa brought under his grasp by Śakra the demons and Raksasas cried aloud, “Alas we are slain."

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रथं समारुह्य रावणिः क्रोधमूर्छितः
तत्सैन्यमतिसंक्रुद्धः प्रविवेश सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rathaṁ samāruhya rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
tatsainyamatisaṁkruddhaḥ praviveśa sudāruṇam

translations.english: Thereupon ascending his car Ravana's son, became senseless by his wrath and beside himself with rage, entered the dreadful flank.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स देवान्संत्यज्य शक्रमेवाभ्ययाद्द्रुतम्
महेन्द्रश्च महातेजा न ददर्श सुतं रिपोः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa devānsaṁtyajya śakramevābhyayāddrutam
mahendraśca mahātejā na dadarśa sutaṁ ripoḥ

translations.english: Having left behind all other deities he pursued Indra and the highly effulgent Mahendra too espied his enemy's son.

verses.sanskrit:
स मातलिं हयांश्चैव ताडयित्वा शरोत्तमैः
महेन्द्रं बाणवर्षेण शीघ्रहस्तो ह्यवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration:
sa mātaliṁ hayāṁścaiva tāḍayitvā śarottamaiḥ
mahendraṁ bāṇavarṣeṇa śīghrahasto hyavākirat

translations.english: Having overpowered the approaching charioteer Måtalt, with many excellent arrows he covered Mahendra with a downpour of shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शक्रो रथं त्यक्त्व विसृज्य च स मातलिम्
ऐरावतं समारुह्य मृगयामास रावणिम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śakro rathaṁ tyaktva visṛjya ca sa mātalim
airāvataṁ samāruhya mṛgayāmāsa rāvaṇim

translations.english: Thereat having left his car and charioteer Indra mounted his elephant Airāvata and ran about in search of Ravana's son.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं यदा परिश्रान्तमिन्द्रं मेनेऽथ रावणिः
तदैनं मायया बद्ध्वा स्वसैन्यमभितोऽनयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ yadā pariśrāntamindraṁ mene'tha rāvaṇiḥ
tadainaṁ māyayā baddhvā svasainyamabhito'nayat

translations.english: When Råvaņa's son came to know that Indra was exhausted he, having bound him up by virtue of illusion, proceeded towards his army.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चापि सर्वे सुरगणास्तदा
अभ्यद्रवन्सुसंक्रुद्धा रावणं शस्त्रवृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare cāpi sarve suragaṇāstadā
abhyadravansusaṁkruddhā rāvaṇaṁ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ

translations.english: In the meantime, the celestials, all enraged, covered Rāvana with a downpour of shafts and belaboured him.

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा परिश्रान्तं प्रहारैर्जर्जरच्छविम्
रावणिः पितरं युद्धेऽदर्शनस्थोऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu dṛṣṭvā pariśrāntaṁ prahārairjarjaracchavim
rāvaṇiḥ pitaraṁ yuddhe'darśanastho'bravīdidam

translations.english: Beholding his father thus distressed and assailed in warfare with strokes, Ravana's son, although invisible, said.

verses.sanskrit:
आगच्छ तात गच्छावो निवृत्तं रणकर्म तत्
जितं ते विदितं भोऽस्तु स्वस्थो भव गतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
āgaccha tāta gacchāvo nivṛttaṁ raṇakarma tat
jitaṁ te viditaṁ bho'stu svastho bhava gatajvaraḥ

translations.english: Do you come, O father, our work in the battle field is finished; know, we have achieved victory; be you consoled and divested of agonies.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं हि सुरसैन्यस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य च यः प्रभुः
स गृहीतो मया शक्रो भग्नमानाः सुराः कृताः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ hi surasainyasya trailokyasya ca yaḥ prabhuḥ
sa gṛhīto mayā śakro bhagnamānāḥ surāḥ kṛtāḥ

translations.english: By virtue of my illusory powers I have made Mahendra captive the lord of the three worlds and of the celestial host and have crushed down the pride of the deities.

verses.sanskrit:
यथेष्टं भुङ्क्ष्व त्रैलोक्यं निगृह्य रिपुमोजसा
वृथा ते किं श्रमं कृत्वा युद्धं हि तव निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration:
yatheṣṭaṁ bhuṅkṣva trailokyaṁ nigṛhya ripumojasā
vṛthā te kiṁ śramaṁ kṛtvā yuddhaṁ hi tava niṣphalam

translations.english: Having subdued your enemy by virtue of your prowess do you enjoy the three worlds at your pleasure. What is the use of labouring again? And useless it is to fight again.

verses.sanskrit:
स दैवतबलात्तस्मान्निवृत्तो रणकर्मणः
तच्छ्रुत्वा रावणेर्वाक्यं स्वस्थचेता दशाननः
verses.transliteration:
sa daivatabalāttasmānnivṛtto raṇakarmaṇaḥ
tacchrutvā rāvaṇervākyaṁ svasthacetā daśānanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāvana's son the deities retired from the battle field, and went away without Sakra.

verses.sanskrit:
अतिबलसदृशैः पराक्रमैस्तै;र्मम कुलमानविवर्धनं कृतम्
यदमरसमविक्रम त्वया; त्रिदशपतिस्त्रिदशाश्च निर्जिताः
verses.transliteration:
atibalasadṛśaiḥ parākramaistai;rmama kulamānavivardhanaṁ kṛtam
yadamarasamavikrama tvayā; tridaśapatistridaśāśca nirjitāḥ

translations.english: You have enhanced the glory of our race displaying the prowess like a highly powerful man. You have vanquished the celestials and their king of unequalled might.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वरितमुपनयस्व वासवं; नगरमितो व्रज सैन्यसंवृतः
अहमपि तव गच्छतो द्रुतं; सह सचिवैरनुयामि पृष्ठतः
verses.transliteration:
tvaritamupanayasva vāsavaṁ; nagaramito vraja sainyasaṁvṛtaḥ
ahamapi tava gacchato drutaṁ; saha sacivairanuyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ

translations.english: Do you set out hence for the city, taking Indra on your chariot and surrounded by soldiers. I shall, soon, delighted, follow you with my councillors.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ स बलवृतः सवाहन;स्त्रिदशपतिं परिगृह्य रावणिः
स्वभवनमुपगम्य राक्षसो; मुदितमना विससर्ज राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration:
atha sa balavṛtaḥ savāhana;stridaśapatiṁ parigṛhya rāvaṇiḥ
svabhavanamupagamya rākṣaso; muditamanā visasarja rākṣasān

translations.english: Thereupon having returned home with his army and chariots and taking the king of the celestials, the powerful son of Rāvana dismissed the victorious warriors.

verses.sanskrit:
जिते महेन्द्रेऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै
प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य गता लङ्कां सुरास्तदा
verses.transliteration:
jite mahendre'tibale rāvaṇasya sutena vai
prajāpatiṁ puraskṛtya gatā laṅkāṁ surāstadā

translations.english: The highly powerful Mahendra being thus defeated by Ravana's son, all the celestials, taking the patriarch Brahmä before them, went to Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
तं रावणं समासाद्य पुत्रभ्रातृभिरावृतम्
अब्रवीद्गगने तिष्ठन्सान्त्वपूर्वं प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ rāvaṇaṁ samāsādya putrabhrātṛbhirāvṛtam
abravīdgagane tiṣṭhansāntvapūrvaṁ prajāpatiḥ

translations.english: Having obtained Rāvana encircled by his sons and brothers the Patriarch, stationed in the welkin, calmly said.

verses.sanskrit:
वत्स रावण तुष्टोऽस्मि तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे
अहोऽस्य विक्रमौदार्यं तव तुल्योऽधिकोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration:
vatsa rāvaṇa tuṣṭo'smi tava putrasya saṁyuge
aho'sya vikramaudāryaṁ tava tulyo'dhiko'pi vā

translations.english: My son, Ravana, I have been pleased with your son in the conflict. Oh! what wonderful prowess, what strength-equal or greater than your.

verses.sanskrit:
जितं हि भवता सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा
कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतोऽस्मि स्वसुतेन वै
verses.transliteration:
jitaṁ hi bhavatā sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ svena tejasā
kṛtā pratijñā saphalā prīto'smi svasutena vai

translations.english: You have, by your own prowess, conquered the three worlds — your promise has borne fruits-I have been pleased with you-both the father and son.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं च पुत्रोऽतिबलस्तव रावण रावणिः
इन्द्रजित्त्विति विख्यातो जगत्येष भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ ca putro'tibalastava rāvaṇa rāvaṇiḥ
indrajittviti vikhyāto jagatyeṣa bhaviṣyati

translations.english: O Rāvana, this your son is highly powerful and gifted with great strength and he shall be celebrated in the world under the appellation of 'Indrajit' or the conqueror of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
बलवाञ्शत्रुनिर्जेता भविष्यत्येष राक्षसः
यमाश्रित्य त्वया राजन्स्थापितास्त्रिदशा वशे
verses.transliteration:
balavāñśatrunirjetā bhaviṣyatyeṣa rākṣasaḥ
yamāśritya tvayā rājansthāpitāstridaśā vaśe

translations.english: The Raksasa shall be powerful and irrepressible, by those help, O King, the celestials have been brought under your subjection.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः
किं चास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्ति दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration:
tanmucyatāṁ mahābāho mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ
kiṁ cāsya mokṣaṇārthāya prayacchanti divaukasaḥ

translations.english: Do you therefore, O you having long arms, release Mahendra, she chastiser of Pāka and for setting him free what do you want from the celestials?

verses.sanskrit:
अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिंजयः
अमरत्वमहं देव वृणोमीहास्य मोक्षणे
verses.transliteration:
athābravīnmahātejā indrajitsamitiṁjayaḥ
amaratvamahaṁ deva vṛṇomīhāsya mokṣaṇe

translations.english: Thereupon the highly powerful Indrajit-the subduer of enemies, said: "If do you say so, O god, I pray for immortality."

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंश्चेदसमाप्ते तु जप्यहोमे विभावसोः
युध्येयं देव संग्रामे तदा मे स्याद्विनाशनम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁścedasamāpte tu japyahome vibhāvasoḥ
yudhyeyaṁ deva saṁgrāme tadā me syādvināśanam

translations.english: May I meet with destruction, O deity, whenever I shall engage in fight without finishing my offerings to fire.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वो हि तपसा चैव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान्
विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvo hi tapasā caiva vṛṇotyamaratāṁ pumān
vikrameṇa mayā tvetadamaratvaṁ pravartitam

translations.english: All others, O god, attain to immortality by virtue of devout penances but I shall acquire that by dint of my own prowess.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमस्त्विति तं प्राह वाक्यं देवः प्रजापतिः
मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः
verses.transliteration:
evamastviti taṁ prāha vākyaṁ devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
muktaścendrajitā śakro gatāśca tridivaṁ surāḥ

translations.english: Where to the grand-father replied saying "so be it." Thereupon Meghanäda released Indra and the celestials returned to their own abode.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शक्रो दीनो भ्रष्टाम्बरस्रजः
राम चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śakro dīno bhraṣṭāmbarasrajaḥ
rāma cintāparītātmā dhyānatatparatāṁ gataḥ

translations.english: In the interval, O Rāma, Indra became poorly, divested of his immortal brilliance, stricken with anxiety and pensive.

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः प्रजापतिः
शतक्रतो किमुत्कण्ठां करोषि स्मर दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṁ prāha devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
śatakrato kimutkaṇṭhāṁ karoṣi smara duṣkṛtam

translations.english: Beholding him in that plight the grand-father of the deities said:-O performer of hundred sacrifices, why did you formerly perpetrate that mighty iniquity?

verses.sanskrit:
अमरेन्द्र मया बह्व्यः प्रजाः सृष्टाः पुरा प्रभो
एकवर्णाः समाभाषा एकरूपाश्च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
amarendra mayā bahvyaḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ purā prabho
ekavarṇāḥ samābhāṣā ekarūpāśca sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: O Chief of the immortals! O lord!, some creatures were all of the same colour, same speech, and same appearance.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां नास्ति विशेषो हि दर्शने लक्षणेऽपि वा
ततोऽहमेकाग्रमनास्ताः प्रजाः पर्यचिन्तयम्
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ nāsti viśeṣo hi darśane lakṣaṇe'pi vā
tato'hamekāgramanāstāḥ prajāḥ paryacintayam

translations.english: There was no difference visible in their appearance or marks. Thereupon, with wholeminded-ness, I began to think of these created beings.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं तासां विशेषार्थं स्त्रियमेकां विनिर्ममे
यद्यत्प्रजानां प्रत्यङ्गं विशिष्टं तत्तदुद्धृतम्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ tāsāṁ viśeṣārthaṁ striyamekāṁ vinirmame
yadyatprajānāṁ pratyaṅgaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ tattaduddhṛtam

translations.english: And I created a female distinct from them. Collecting all those limbs that were most excellent among the created, I made a female under the name of Ahalyä. Hal means uglinessone born from Hal is called Halya. That female was known as Ahalyā because she had nothing blameable in her, I gave her that name.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्मितायां तु देवेन्द्र तस्यां नार्यां सुरर्षभ
भविष्यतीति कस्यैषा मम चिन्ता ततोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
nirmitāyāṁ tu devendra tasyāṁ nāryāṁ surarṣabha
bhaviṣyatīti kasyaiṣā mama cintā tato'bhavat

translations.english: Having created that female I was thinking, O king of the celestials! O foremost of the deities!, on whom I should confer her.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारीं जानीषे मनसा प्रभो
स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरंदर
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ tu śakra tadā nārīṁ jānīṣe manasā prabho
sthānādhikatayā patnī mamaiṣeti puraṁdara

translations.english: Being proud of dignity, O Sakra, O lord, O Purandara you did regard her in your mind as your spouse.

verses.sanskrit:
सा मया न्यासभूता तु गौतमस्य महात्मनः
न्यस्ता बहूनि वर्षाणि तेन निर्यातिता च सा
verses.transliteration:
sā mayā nyāsabhūtā tu gautamasya mahātmanaḥ
nyastā bahūni varṣāṇi tena niryātitā ca sā

translations.english: I placed her under the care of the high-souled Gautama and he rendered her back after many long years.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तस्य परिज्ञाय मया स्थैर्यं महामुनेः
ज्ञात्वा तपसि सिद्धिं च पत्न्यर्थं स्पर्शिता तदा
verses.transliteration:
tatastasya parijñāya mayā sthairyaṁ mahāmuneḥ
jñātvā tapasi siddhiṁ ca patnyarthaṁ sparśitā tadā

translations.english: Thereupon considering the patience and accomplished asceticism of Gautama I married her with him.

verses.sanskrit:
स तया सह धर्मात्मा रमते स्म महामुनिः
आसन्निराशा देवास्तु गौतमे दत्तया तया
verses.transliteration:
sa tayā saha dharmātmā ramate sma mahāmuniḥ
āsannirāśā devāstu gautame dattayā tayā

translations.english: That virtuous-souled, great ascetic enjoyed her company; and for my thus conferring her upon Gautama alll the celestials disappointed.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं क्रुद्धस्त्विह कामात्मा गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः
दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्रीं दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ kruddhastviha kāmātmā gatvā tasyāśramaṁ muneḥ
dṛṣṭavāṁśca tadā tāṁ strīṁ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva

translations.english: But being enraged and possessed by lust you did repair to the hermitage of the ascetic and see her resplendent like the flaming fire.

verses.sanskrit:
सा त्वया धर्षिता शक्र कामार्तेन समन्युना
दृष्टस्त्वं च तदा तेन आश्रमे परमर्षिणा
verses.transliteration:
sā tvayā dharṣitā śakra kāmārtena samanyunā
dṛṣṭastvaṁ ca tadā tena āśrame paramarṣiṇā

translations.english: Maddened with lust and ire you did ravish her and you was seen in that hermitage by the great ascetic. were

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयम्
तस्मात्त्वं समरे राजञ्शत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
yasmānme dharṣitā patnī tvayā vāsava nirbhayam
tasmāttvaṁ samare rājañśatruhastaṁ gamiṣyasi

translations.english: You were then imprecated by him, enraged and gifted with great effulgence saying, 'O lord of the celestials, you have attained to a change of circumstances-for which, O Vásava, you have fearlessly ravished my spouse. You shall, therefore, O Sakra, go under the arms of the enemies, in conflict.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः
मानुषेष्वपि सर्वेषु भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ tu bhāvo durbuddhe yastvayeha pravartitaḥ
mānuṣeṣvapi sarveṣu bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: And this vile desire, O you having a vicious intellect, which you have first created, shall undoubtedly spread in the world of mortals.

verses.sanskrit:
यश्च यश्च सुरेन्द्रः स्याद्ध्रुवः स न भविष्यति
एष शापो मया मुक्त इत्यसौ त्वां तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
yaśca yaśca surendraḥ syāddhruvaḥ sa na bhaviṣyati
eṣa śāpo mayā mukta ityasau tvāṁ tadābravīt

translations.english: Whoever shall be the lord of the celestials, shall not have his position secure. This is the curse I give, which I have communicated to you.

verses.sanskrit:
तां तु भार्यां विनिर्भर्त्स्य सोऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः
दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ tu bhāryāṁ vinirbhartsya so'bravītsumahātapāḥ
durvinīte vinidhvaṁsa mamāśramasamīpataḥ

translations.english: Having remonstrated with his wife that one of devout penances said to her-'O vicious one, let your beauty be spoiled in the vicinity of the hermitage. You are gifted with beauty and youth but your mind is fickle; so you shall not continue as the single beautiful damsel in the world.

verses.sanskrit:
रूपं च तत्प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति सुदुर्लभम्
यत्तवेदं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमेऽयमुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
rūpaṁ ca tatprajāḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti sudurlabham
yattavedaṁ samāśritya vibhrame'yamupasthitaḥ

translations.english: All created beings shall participate your beauty; your matchless beauty has brought about this mischief.' Thenceforward all created beings were gifted with beauty.

verses.sanskrit:
तदा प्रभृति भूयिष्ठं प्रजा रूपसमन्विताः
शापोत्सर्गाद्धि तस्येदं मुनेः सर्वमुपागतम्
verses.transliteration:
tadā prabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṁ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ
śāpotsargāddhi tasyedaṁ muneḥ sarvamupāgatam

translations.english: You have met with all this in consequence of the imprecation of that ascetic. Therefore, O you having long arms, do you think of your past iniquity.

verses.sanskrit:
शीघ्रं यजस्व यज्ञं त्वं वैष्णवं सुसमाहितः
पावितस्तेन यज्ञेन यास्यसि त्रिदिवं ततः
verses.transliteration:
śīghraṁ yajasva yajñaṁ tvaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ susamāhitaḥ
pāvitastena yajñena yāsyasi tridivaṁ tataḥ

translations.english: For that curse and nothing else, O Vasava, you have been brought under the grasp of enemies. Having controlled your senses, do you soon undertake a sacrifice in honour of Vişņu.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे
नीतः संनिहितश्चैव अर्यकेण महोदधौ
verses.transliteration:
putraśca tava devendra na vinaṣṭo mahāraṇe
nītaḥ saṁnihitaścaiva aryakeṇa mahodadhau

translations.english: You shall be purified by that sacrifice and go to heaven; and your son, O lord of celestials, has not been destroyed in the conflict. He has been taken into the ocean by his grand father.

verses.sanskrit:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु यज्ञमिष्ट्वा च वैष्णवम्
पुनस्त्रिदिवमाक्रामदन्वशासच्च देवताः
verses.transliteration:
etacchrutvā mahendrastu yajñamiṣṭvā ca vaiṣṇavam
punastridivamākrāmadanvaśāsacca devatāḥ

translations.english: Hearing this and having celebrated the sacrifice in honour of Vişnu he again went to the region of celestials and reigned there as their king.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदिन्द्रजितो राम बलं यत्कीर्तितं मया
निर्जितस्तेन देवेन्द्रः प्राणिनोऽन्ये च किं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
etadindrajito rāma balaṁ yatkīrtitaṁ mayā
nirjitastena devendraḥ prāṇino'nye ca kiṁ punaḥ

translations.english: I have thus described to you the strength of Indrajit-what to speak of others he vanquished even Indra-the king of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामो महातेजा विस्मयात्पुनरेव हि
उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmo mahātejā vismayātpunareva hi
uvāca praṇato vākyamagastyamṛṣisattamam

translations.english: Thereupon having bowed to Agastya the foremost of ascetics, the highly effulgent Rāma again surprisingly said.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्किं तदा लोकाः शून्या आसन्द्विजोत्तम
धर्षणां यत्र न प्राप्तो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
bhagavankiṁ tadā lokāḥ śūnyā āsandvijottama
dharṣaṇāṁ yatra na prāpto rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ

translations.english: "O Brāhmaṇa, O foremost of twice-born ones, when that cruel Rāvana journeyed over the earth, was it void of people? Was there no king, or prince on earth to administer punishment to him?

verses.sanskrit:
उताहो हीनवीर्यास्ते बभुवुः पृथिवीक्षितः
बहिष्कृता वरास्त्रैश्च बहवो निर्जिता नृपाः
verses.transliteration:
utāho hīnavīryāste babhuvuḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ
bahiṣkṛtā varāstraiśca bahavo nirjitā nṛpāḥ

translations.english: Were all the kings then shorn of their strength and prowess? And many kings I (hear) were vanquished an driven out by him with various excellent weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः
उवाच रामं प्रहसन्पितामह इवेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā agastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ
uvāca rāmaṁ prahasanpitāmaha iveśvaram

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāghava, the ascetic Agastya, having six sorts of wealth, laughing said, like to Brahmā, speaking to Rudra

verses.sanskrit:
तमेव दिवसं सोऽथ हैहयाधिपतिर्बली
अर्जुनो नर्मदां रन्तुं गतः स्त्रीभिः सहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
tameva divasaṁ so'tha haihayādhipatirbalī
arjuno narmadāṁ rantuṁ gataḥ strībhiḥ saheśvaraḥ

translations.english: One day the highly powerful Arjuna, the king of Haihayas, repaired to the river Narmadā, with his wives to sport.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत
क्वार्जुनो वो नृपः सोऽद्य शीघ्रमाख्यातुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇo rākṣasendrastu tasyāmātyānapṛcchata
kvārjuno vo nṛpaḥ so'dya śīghramākhyātumarhatha

translations.english: At the very same day, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, arrived there and asked his councillors saying.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं रावणेनोक्तास्तेऽमात्याः सुविपश्चितः
अब्रुवन्राक्षसपतिमसाम्निध्यं महीपतेः
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ rāvaṇenoktāste'mātyāḥ suvipaścitaḥ
abruvanrākṣasapatimasāmnidhyaṁ mahīpateḥ

translations.english: Do you, at first, communicate to him the news of my arrival. Being thus addressed by Ravana, the learned ministers informed the lord of Raksasas, of the absence of the king.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा विश्रवसः पुत्रः पौराणामर्जुनं गतम्
अपसृत्यागतो विन्ध्यं हिमवत्संनिभं गिरिम्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā viśravasaḥ putraḥ paurāṇāmarjunaṁ gatam
apasṛtyāgato vindhyaṁ himavatsaṁnibhaṁ girim

translations.english: Hearing of the absence of the king from the citizens Viśravasa's son came out of the city and reached the Vindhya mountain resembling the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit:
चक्रवाकैः सकारण्डैः सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः
सारसैश्च सदामत्तैः कोकूजद्भिः समावृताम्
verses.transliteration:
cakravākaiḥ sakāraṇḍaiḥ sahaṁsajalakukkuṭaiḥ
sārasaiśca sadāmattaiḥ kokūjadbhiḥ samāvṛtām

translations.english: Having covered her, Cakravakas, Karandavas, swans, water-cocks and Sārasas, maddened, were emitting notes.

verses.sanskrit:
एष रश्मिसहस्रेण जगत्कृत्वेव काञ्चनम्
तीक्ष्णतापकरः सूर्यो नभसो मध्यमास्थितः
मामासीनं विदित्वेह चन्द्रायाति दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa raśmisahasreṇa jagatkṛtveva kāñcanam
tīkṣṇatāpakaraḥ sūryo nabhaso madhyamāsthitaḥ
māmāsīnaṁ viditveha candrāyāti divākaraḥ

translations.english: Delighted at her beauty and having spoken highly of Narmadā like to Gangă he addressed his ministers Suka and Sāraṇa with gestures, saying:-“Behold, having rendered the earth pale, with his many rays, the sun, emitting parching heat, is in the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
नर्मदा जलशीतश्च सुगन्धिः श्रमनाशनः
मद्भयादनिलो ह्येष वात्यसौ सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
narmadā jalaśītaśca sugandhiḥ śramanāśanaḥ
madbhayādanilo hyeṣa vātyasau susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: But seeing me here seated, his rays have become cool like those of the moon. At my fear, even the wind is blowing carefully, being cold and fragrant by the touch of the waters of the Narmadā and removing our toil.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं चापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नर्मदा नर्म वर्धिनी
लीनमीनविहंगोर्मिः सभयेवाङ्गना स्थिता
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ cāpi saricchreṣṭhā narmadā narma vardhinī
līnamīnavihaṁgormiḥ sabhayevāṅganā sthitā

translations.english: This charming Narmadā, abounding in crocodiles, fishes and birds, though a natural stream, is standing still like a terrified damsel.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्भवन्तः क्षताः शस्त्रैर्नृपैरिन्द्रसमैर्युधि
चन्दनस्य रसेनेव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः
verses.transliteration:
tadbhavantaḥ kṣatāḥ śastrairnṛpairindrasamairyudhi
candanasya raseneva rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ

translations.english: Being wounded in conflicts with many a king your persons have been pasted with blood.

verses.sanskrit:
ते यूयमवगाहध्वं नर्मदां शर्मदां नृणाम्
महापद्ममुखा मत्ता गङ्गामिव महागजाः
verses.transliteration:
te yūyamavagāhadhvaṁ narmadāṁ śarmadāṁ nṛṇām
mahāpadmamukhā mattā gaṅgāmiva mahāgajāḥ

translations.english: Therefore like to Särvabhauma and other infuriated elephants going down into the water of the Ganges, do you descend into the water of Narmadā conferring auspiciousness and health.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमप्यत्र पुलिने शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे
पुष्पोपहरं शनकैः करिष्यामि उमापतेः
verses.transliteration:
ahamapyatra puline śaradindusamaprabhe
puṣpopaharaṁ śanakaiḥ kariṣyāmi umāpateḥ

translations.english: Bathing in this stream you shall be cleansed from sins. I shall, also on the coast of this river, like the rays of the autumnal moon, reverentially worship with flowers Mahādeva, holding Pināka in his hands.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणेनैवमुक्तास्तु मारीचशुकसारणाः
समहोदरधूम्राक्षा नर्मदामवगाहिरे
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇenaivamuktāstu mārīcaśukasāraṇāḥ
samahodaradhūmrākṣā narmadāmavagāhire

translations.english: Hearing the words of Ravana, Prahasta, Suka, Sarana, Mahodara, Dhumraksa and other councillors descended into the waters of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसेन्द्रगजैस्तैस्तु क्षोभ्यते नर्मदा नदी
वामनाञ्जनपद्माद्यैर्गङ्गा इव महागजैः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasendragajaistaistu kṣobhyate narmadā nadī
vāmanāñjanapadmādyairgaṅgā iva mahāgajaiḥ

translations.english: She was agitated by those elephant like leading Rākşasas like to the Gargā by Vămana, Anjana, Padma and other elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते राक्षसाः स्नात्वा नर्मदाया वराम्भसि
उत्तीर्य पुष्पाण्याजह्रुर्बल्यर्थं रावणस्य तु
verses.transliteration:
tataste rākṣasāḥ snātvā narmadāyā varāmbhasi
uttīrya puṣpāṇyājahrurbalyarthaṁ rāvaṇasya tu

translations.english: Thereupon having got up from the waters the highly powerful Rākşasas culled flowers for Ravana's offerings.

verses.sanskrit:
नर्मदा पुलिने रम्ये शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे
राक्षसेन्द्रैर्मुहूर्तेन कृतः पुष्पमयो गिरिः
verses.transliteration:
narmadā puline ramye śubhrābhrasadṛśaprabhe
rākṣasendrairmuhūrtena kṛtaḥ puṣpamayo giriḥ

translations.english: In a moment the Rākṣasas collected heaps of flowers on the picturesque banks of Narmadā, resembling the white clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्पेषूपहृतेष्वेव रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः
अवतीर्णो नदीं स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः
verses.transliteration:
puṣpeṣūpahṛteṣveva rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ
avatīrṇo nadīṁ snātuṁ gaṅgāmiva mahāgajaḥ

translations.english: Flowers being thus collected, Rāvana, the king of Rākşasas descended into the Narmadā for bathing like a huge elephant into the Gangā. And having bathed he got up, reciting excellent incantations.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणं प्राञ्जलिं यान्तमन्वयुः सप्तराक्षसाः
यत्र यत्र स याति स्म रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
जाम्बूनदमयं लिङ्गं तत्र तत्र स्म नीयते
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaṁ prāñjaliṁ yāntamanvayuḥ saptarākṣasāḥ
yatra yatra sa yāti sma rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
jāmbūnadamayaṁ liṅgaṁ tatra tatra sma nīyate

translations.english: Wherever Rāvana went the golden Siva Linga was brought.

verses.sanskrit:
वालुकवेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः
अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः
verses.transliteration:
vālukavedimadhye tu talliṅgaṁ sthāpya rāvaṇaḥ
arcayāmāsa gandhaiśca puṣpaiścāmṛtagandhibhiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon Rāvaņa placed that upon a heap of sands and began to worship it with various nectar-smelling flowers and sandal.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सतामार्तिहरं हरं परं; वरप्रदं चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम्
समर्चयित्वा स निशाचरो जगौ; प्रसार्य हस्तान्प्रणनर्त चायतान्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ satāmārtiharaṁ haraṁ paraṁ; varapradaṁ candramayūkhabhūṣaṇam
samarcayitvā sa niśācaro jagau; prasārya hastānpraṇanarta cāyatān

translations.english: Having finished the worship of Siva, the foremost of deities, having ww moon on his crown, the conferrer of boons and the remover of miseries, the night-ranger danced with uplifted hands and sang before it.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो माहिष्मत्याः पतिः प्रभुः
क्रीडिते सह नारीभिर्नर्मदातोयमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration:
arjuno jayatāṁ śreṣṭho māhiṣmatyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ
krīḍite saha nārībhirnarmadātoyamāśritaḥ

translations.english: At no distance from where on the banks of the river Narmadā, that dreadful lord of Rākşasas collected the flowers, Arjuna, the King of Māhismatī, and the foremost of the victorious, was sporting with his wives in the water.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां मध्यगतो राज रराज स ततोऽर्जुनः
करेणूनां सहस्रस्य मध्यस्थ इव कुञ्जरः
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ madhyagato rāja rarāja sa tato'rjunaḥ
kareṇūnāṁ sahasrasya madhyastha iva kuñjaraḥ

translations.english: And being encircled by them the king Arjuna appeared like a leading elephant surrounded by a thousands of she elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
जिज्ञासुः स तु बाहूनां सहस्रस्योत्तमं बलम्
रुरोध नर्मदा वेगं बाहुभिः स तदार्जुनः
verses.transliteration:
jijñāsuḥ sa tu bāhūnāṁ sahasrasyottamaṁ balam
rurodha narmadā vegaṁ bāhubhiḥ sa tadārjunaḥ

translations.english: In order to measure the strength of his thousand arms the King of Haihayas obstructed the course of Narmadă.

verses.sanskrit:
कार्तवीर्यभुजासेतुं तज्जलं प्राप्य निर्मलम्
कूलापहारं कुर्वाणं प्रतिस्रोतः प्रधावति
verses.transliteration:
kārtavīryabhujāsetuṁ tajjalaṁ prāpya nirmalam
kūlāpahāraṁ kurvāṇaṁ pratisrotaḥ pradhāvati

translations.english: Being obstructed by the arms of Kārtavīryarjuna and having flooded the banks with her pure waters, Narmadā flowed in an opposite direction.

verses.sanskrit:
समीननक्रमकरः सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः
स नर्मदाम्भसो वेगः प्रावृट्काल इवाबभौ
verses.transliteration:
samīnanakramakaraḥ sapuṣpakuśasaṁstaraḥ
sa narmadāmbhaso vegaḥ prāvṛṭkāla ivābabhau

translations.english: The currents of Narmadā, rising high as during the rainy season flowed with fishes, and crocodiles.

verses.sanskrit:
स वेगः कार्तवीर्येण संप्रेषिट इवाम्भसः
पुष्पोपहारं तत्सर्वं रावणस्य जहार ह
verses.transliteration:
sa vegaḥ kārtavīryeṇa saṁpreṣiṭa ivāmbhasaḥ
puṣpopahāraṁ tatsarvaṁ rāvaṇasya jahāra ha

translations.english: That stream, as if driven against Rävaņa by Kārtavīryarjuna, carried away his collection of flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
सव्येतरकराङ्गुल्या सशब्दं च दशाननः
वेगप्रभवमन्वेष्टुं सोऽदिशच्छुकसारणौ
verses.transliteration:
savyetarakarāṅgulyā saśabdaṁ ca daśānanaḥ
vegaprabhavamanveṣṭuṁ so'diśacchukasāraṇau

translations.english: Thereupon being anxious to learn the cause of the rise of the river, the Ten-necked demon, with his right finger, hinted Suka and Sarana.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ तु रावणसंदिष्टौ भ्रातरौ शुकसारणौ
व्योमान्तरचरौ वीरौ प्रस्थितौ पश्चिमोन्मुखौ
verses.transliteration:
tau tu rāvaṇasaṁdiṣṭau bhrātarau śukasāraṇau
vyomāntaracarau vīrau prasthitau paścimonmukhau

translations.english: Being commanded by Rāvana, the two brothers, the heroic Suka and Sāraņa proceeded towards the west by the aerial way.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्धयोजनमात्रं तु गत्वा तौ तु निशाचरौ
पश्येतां पुरुषं तोये क्रीडन्तं सहयोषितम्
verses.transliteration:
ardhayojanamātraṁ tu gatvā tau tu niśācarau
paśyetāṁ puruṣaṁ toye krīḍantaṁ sahayoṣitam

translations.english: And going half a league, the two night-rangers espied a man sporting in the waters with some females.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्सालप्रतीकशं तोयव्याकुलमूर्धजम्
मदरक्तान्तनयनं मदनाकारवर्चसं
verses.transliteration:
bṛhatsālapratīkaśaṁ toyavyākulamūrdhajam
madaraktāntanayanaṁ madanākāravarcasaṁ

translations.english: He was huge as a Sāla tree, his hairs were floating on the water, he was inebriate and his eyes were reddened in consequence thereof.

verses.sanskrit:
नदीं बाहुसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमरिमर्दनम्
गिरिं पादसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमिव मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
nadīṁ bāhusahasreṇa rundhantamarimardanam
giriṁ pādasahasreṇa rundhantamiva medinīm

translations.english: Like to Sumeru holding the earth with his thousand feet he obstructed the current of the river with his thousand arms.

verses.sanskrit:
बालानां वरनारीणां सहस्रेणाभिसंवृतम्
समदानां करेणूनां सहस्रेणेव कुञ्जरम्
verses.transliteration:
bālānāṁ varanārīṇāṁ sahasreṇābhisaṁvṛtam
samadānāṁ kareṇūnāṁ sahasreṇeva kuñjaram

translations.english: He was surrounded by a thousands of beautiful damsels like an elephant by a thousands of she-elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
तमद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसौ शुकसारणौ
संनिवृत्तावुपागम्य रावणं तमथोचतुः
verses.transliteration:
tamadbhutatamaṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasau śukasāraṇau
saṁnivṛttāvupāgamya rāvaṇaṁ tamathocatuḥ

translations.english: Beholding that dreadful spectacle, the Rākṣasas-Śuka and Sāraṇa came back and approaching Rāvaņa communicated (all) to him.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशः कोऽप्यसौ राक्षसेश्वर
नर्मदां रोधवद्रुद्ध्वा क्रीडापयति योषितः
verses.transliteration:
bṛhatsālapratīkāśaḥ ko'pyasau rākṣaseśvara
narmadāṁ rodhavadruddhvā krīḍāpayati yoṣitaḥ

translations.english: O lord of Rākşasas, an unknown person, huge as a Sāla tree, is sporting with females obstructing the course of Narmadā like to a dam.

verses.sanskrit:
तेन बाहुसहस्रेण संनिरुद्धजला नदी
सागरोद्गारसंकाशानुद्गारान्सृजते मुहुः
verses.transliteration:
tena bāhusahasreṇa saṁniruddhajalā nadī
sāgarodgārasaṁkāśānudgārānsṛjate muhuḥ

translations.english: Being withheld by the thousand arms of that man the waters of Narmadā were continually throwing up high waves.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं भाषमाणौ तौ निशम्य शुकसारणौ
रावणोऽर्जुन इत्युक्त्वा उत्तस्थौ युद्धलालसः
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ bhāṣamāṇau tau niśamya śukasāraṇau
rāvaṇo'rjuna ityuktvā uttasthau yuddhalālasaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of śuka and Sarana, Ravana exclaimed “This is Arjuna' and proceeded to fight with him.

verses.sanskrit:
महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः
संवृतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तत्रागाद्यत्र सोऽर्जुनः
verses.transliteration:
mahodaramahāpārśvadhūmrākṣaśukasāraṇaiḥ
saṁvṛto rākṣasendrastu tatrāgādyatra so'rjunaḥ

translations.english: The clouds began to mutter with a downpour of rain. And the lord of Räkşasas proceeded against Arjuna with Mahodara. Mahāparáva, Dhumraksa, Suka and Sarana.

verses.sanskrit:
स तत्र स्त्रीपरिवृतं वाशिताभिरिव द्विपम्
नरेन्द्रं पश्यते राजा राक्षसानां तदार्जुनम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tatra strīparivṛtaṁ vāśitābhiriva dvipam
narendraṁ paśyate rājā rākṣasānāṁ tadārjunam

translations.english: Within a short time the dreadful Raksasa, powerful as the elephant Arjuna, reached the banks of Narmada and espied there Arjuna encircled by females as an elephant surrounded by she-elephants.

verses.sanskrit:
स रोषाद्रक्तनयनो राक्षसेन्द्रो बलोद्धतः
इत्येवमर्जुनामात्यानाह गम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
sa roṣādraktanayano rākṣasendro baloddhataḥ
ityevamarjunāmātyānāha gambhīrayā girā

translations.english: At the very sight the eyes of the lord of Raksasas, proud of his prowess, grew red and addressing the councillors of the king Arjuna he said.

verses.sanskrit:
अमात्याः क्षिप्रमाख्यात हैहयस्य नृपस्य वै
युद्धार्थं समनुप्राप्तो रावणो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration:
amātyāḥ kṣipramākhyāta haihayasya nṛpasya vai
yuddhārthaṁ samanuprāpto rāvaṇo nāma nāmataḥ

translations.english: Do you communicate to the king of Haihayas that Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas, has come to fight with him.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणोऽथार्जुनस्य ते
उत्तस्थुः सायुधास्तं च रावणं वाक्यमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā mantriṇo'thārjunasya te
uttasthuḥ sāyudhāstaṁ ca rāvaṇaṁ vākyamabruvan

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāvana, the ministers of Arjuna stood up with arms and said.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्ते रावणामात्यैरमात्याः पार्थिवस्य तु
सूदिताश्चापि ते युद्धे भक्षिताश्च बुभुक्षितैः
verses.transliteration:
tataste rāvaṇāmātyairamātyāḥ pārthivasya tu
sūditāścāpi te yuddhe bhakṣitāśca bubhukṣitaiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the hungry councillors of Rāvana, slew some of the ministers of the king and devoured some.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हलहलाशब्दो नर्मदा तिर आबभौ
अर्जुनस्यानुयात्राणां रावणस्य च मन्त्रिणाम्
verses.transliteration:
tato halahalāśabdo narmadā tira ābabhau
arjunasyānuyātrāṇāṁ rāvaṇasya ca mantriṇām

translations.english: There arose a dreadful uproar on the banks of Narmada, of the councillors of Răvana and Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit:
इषुभिस्तोमरैः शूलैर्वज्रकल्पैः सकर्षणैः
सरावणानर्दयन्तः समन्तात्समभिद्रुताः
verses.transliteration:
iṣubhistomaraiḥ śūlairvajrakalpaiḥ sakarṣaṇaiḥ
sarāvaṇānardayantaḥ samantātsamabhidrutāḥ

translations.english: The warriors of Arjuna assailed Rāvana and his ministers with hundreds of arrows, Prāsas, darts, Tomaras, thunder-bolts and Karsanas.

verses.sanskrit:
हैहयाधिपयोधानां वेग आसीत्सुदारुणः
सनक्रमीनमकरसमुद्रस्येव निस्वनः
verses.transliteration:
haihayādhipayodhānāṁ vega āsītsudāruṇaḥ
sanakramīnamakarasamudrasyeva nisvanaḥ

translations.english: The warriors of Arjuna became dreadfully furious and emitted cries like the roaring of the deep infested with crocodiles, fishes and other marine monsters.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणस्य तु तेऽमात्याः प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः
कार्तवीर्यबलं क्रुद्धा निर्दहन्त्यग्नितेजसः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇasya tu te'mātyāḥ prahastaśukasāraṇāḥ
kārtavīryabalaṁ kruddhā nirdahantyagnitejasaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon being enraged and displaying their own prowess Suka, Sāraṇa and other ministers of Ravana began to destroy Arjuna's soldiers.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुनाय तु तत्कर्म रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः
क्रीडमानाय कथितं पुरुषैर्द्वाररक्षिभिः
verses.transliteration:
arjunāya tu tatkarma rāvaṇasya samantriṇaḥ
krīḍamānāya kathitaṁ puruṣairdvārarakṣibhiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the emissaries, stricken with fear, went to the sporting king and communicated to him the proceedings of Rāvana and his iministers.

verses.sanskrit:
उक्त्वा न भेतव्यमिति स्त्रीजनं स ततोऽर्जुनः
उत्ततार जलात्तस्माद्गङ्गातोयादिवाञ्जनः
verses.transliteration:
uktvā na bhetavyamiti strījanaṁ sa tato'rjunaḥ
uttatāra jalāttasmādgaṅgātoyādivāñjanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words and saying to the females-"Do not fear” he rose up from the waters like an elephante

verses.sanskrit:
क्रोधदूषितनेत्रस्तु स ततोऽर्जुन पावकः
प्रजज्वाल महाघोरो युगान्त इव पावकः
verses.transliteration:
krodhadūṣitanetrastu sa tato'rjuna pāvakaḥ
prajajvāla mahāghoro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ

translations.english: The eyes of that fire-like Arjuna were reddened with ire and he shone dreadfully like the fire of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
स तूर्णतरमादाय वरहेमाङ्गदो गदाम्
अभिद्रवति रक्षांसि तमांसीव दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration:
sa tūrṇataramādāya varahemāṅgado gadām
abhidravati rakṣāṁsi tamāṁsīva divākaraḥ

translations.english: And taking up speedily his club, that one, always using golden clubs, pursued the Rakşasas like to darkness following the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
बाहुविक्षेपकरणां समुद्यम्य महागदाम्
गारुडं वेगमास्थाय आपपातैव सोऽर्जुनः
verses.transliteration:
bāhuvikṣepakaraṇāṁ samudyamya mahāgadām
gāruḍaṁ vegamāsthāya āpapātaiva so'rjunaḥ

translations.english: Holding up the huge club and hurling it with his arms, Arjuna, resorting to the velocity of Garuda, went on

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मर्गं समावृत्य विन्ध्योऽर्कस्येव पर्वतः
स्थितो विन्ध्य इवाकम्प्यः प्रहस्तो मुसलायुधः
verses.transliteration:
tasya margaṁ samāvṛtya vindhyo'rkasyeva parvataḥ
sthito vindhya ivākampyaḥ prahasto musalāyudhaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon stood there obstructing his course Raksasa, worked up with anger and with a mace in his hand, like to the Vindhya range standing in the way of the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽस्य मुसलं घोरं लोहबद्धं मदोद्धतः
प्रहस्तः प्रेषयन्क्रुद्धो ररास च यथाम्बुदः
verses.transliteration:
tato'sya musalaṁ ghoraṁ lohabaddhaṁ madoddhataḥ
prahastaḥ preṣayankruddho rarāsa ca yathāmbudaḥ

translations.english: And throwing down off his hand the iron mace, he, in anger, began to roar, like Yama.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याग्रे मुसलस्याग्निरशोकापीडसंनिभः
प्रहस्तकरमुक्तस्य बभूव प्रदहन्निव
verses.transliteration:
tasyāgre musalasyāgniraśokāpīḍasaṁnibhaḥ
prahastakaramuktasya babhūva pradahanniva

translations.english: And the top of the mace freed from the hand of Prahasta, was ablaze like the tips of Asoka flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
आधावमानं मुसलं कार्तवीर्यस्तदार्जुनः
निपुणं वञ्चयामास सगदो गजविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
ādhāvamānaṁ musalaṁ kārtavīryastadārjunaḥ
nipuṇaṁ vañcayāmāsa sagado gajavikramaḥ

translations.english: Not the least agitated on beholding that mace, the king Arjuna, by his club, baffled its action.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तमभिदुद्राव प्रहस्तं हैहयाधिपः
भ्रामयाणो गदां गुर्वीं पञ्चबाहुशतोच्छ्रयाम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastamabhidudrāva prahastaṁ haihayādhipaḥ
bhrāmayāṇo gadāṁ gurvīṁ pañcabāhuśatocchrayām

translations.english: Thereupon uplifting the huge club, five hundred hands long, the king of Haihayas pursued Prahasta.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनाहतोऽतिवेगेन प्रहस्तो गदया तदा
निपपात स्थितः शैलो वज्रिवज्रहतो यथा
verses.transliteration:
tenāhato'tivegena prahasto gadayā tadā
nipapāta sthitaḥ śailo vajrivajrahato yathā

translations.english: And within a short time being struck down by that club gifted with great velocity Prahasta fell down on earth like to the summit of a mountain clapped down by the thunder-bolt of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहस्तं पतितं दृष्ट्वा मारीचशुकसारणाः
समहोदरधूम्राक्षा अपसृप्ता रणाजिरात्
verses.transliteration:
prahastaṁ patitaṁ dṛṣṭvā mārīcaśukasāraṇāḥ
samahodaradhūmrākṣā apasṛptā raṇājirāt

translations.english: Beholding Prahasta fallen, Marica, Suka, Säraņa, Mahodara and Dhumrākṣa fled away from the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit:
अपक्रान्तेष्वमात्येषु प्रहस्ते च निपातिते
रावणोऽभ्यद्रवत्तूर्णमर्जुनं नृपसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
apakrānteṣvamātyeṣu prahaste ca nipātite
rāvaṇo'bhyadravattūrṇamarjunaṁ nṛpasattamam

translations.english: All the councillors having thus fled away and Prahasta being slain, Rāvaņa speedily proceeded towards Arjuna, the foremost of kings.

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्रबाहोस्तद्युद्धं विंशद्बाहोश्च दारुणम्
नृपराक्षसयोस्तत्र आरब्धं लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration:
sahasrabāhostadyuddhaṁ viṁśadbāhośca dāruṇam
nṛparākṣasayostatra ārabdhaṁ lomaharṣaṇam

translations.english: Thereupon there ensued a terrible encounter capable of making down erect between the thousand-armed Arjuna, the king of men, and the twenty-armed Ravana, the king of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit:
सागराविव संक्षुब्धौ चलमूलाविवाचलौ
तेजोयुक्ताविवादित्यौ प्रदहन्ताविवानलौ
verses.transliteration:
sāgarāviva saṁkṣubdhau calamūlāvivācalau
tejoyuktāvivādityau pradahantāvivānalau

translations.english: And taking up their clubs Arjuna and Råvaņa began to fight with one another emitting cries like the mutterings of clouds, like to two huge balls fighting for a cow, two agitated oceans, two moving mountains, two effulgent Adityas, two burning flames, two proud elephants, two proud lions and like the very Rudra and Kāla.

verses.sanskrit:
वज्रप्रहारानचला यथा घोरान्विषेहिरे
गदाप्रहारांस्तद्वत्तौ सहेते नरराक्षसौ
verses.transliteration:
vajraprahārānacalā yathā ghorānviṣehire
gadāprahārāṁstadvattau sahete nararākṣasau

translations.english: As the mountains suffer many clappings of thunder-bolts so did they bear many strokes.

verses.sanskrit:
यथाशनिरवेभ्यस्तु जायते वै प्रतिश्रुतिः
तथा ताभ्यां गदापातैर्दिशः सर्वाः प्रतिश्रुताः
verses.transliteration:
yathāśaniravebhyastu jāyate vai pratiśrutiḥ
tathā tābhyāṁ gadāpātairdiśaḥ sarvāḥ pratiśrutāḥ

translations.english: And all the quarters were resounded with the sound proceeding from the stroke of their clubs like to the sound of thunder-bolts.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुनस्य गदा सा तु पात्यमानाहितोरसि
काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा
verses.transliteration:
arjunasya gadā sā tu pātyamānāhitorasi
kāñcanābhaṁ nabhaścakre vidyutsaudāmanī yathā

translations.english: Being placed against the breast of Rāvaņa Arjuna's club rendered, for a moment, the welkin look like the burning gold as does the lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
तथैव रावणेनापि पात्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः
अर्जुनोरसि निर्भाति गदोल्केव महागिरौ
verses.transliteration:
tathaiva rāvaṇenāpi pātyamānā muhurmuhuḥ
arjunorasi nirbhāti gadolkeva mahāgirau

translations.english: And striking again and again against Arjuna's breast Ravana's club looked like a huge firebrand.

verses.sanskrit:
नार्जुनः खेदमाप्नोति न राक्षसगणेश्वरः
सममासीत्तयोर्युद्धं यथा पूर्वं बलीन्द्रयोः
verses.transliteration:
nārjunaḥ khedamāpnoti na rākṣasagaṇeśvaraḥ
samamāsīttayoryuddhaṁ yathā pūrvaṁ balīndrayoḥ

translations.english: Neither Arjuna was worn out nor was Rāvaņa. And the conflict went on between them like the encounter between Bali and Våsava in the days of yore.

verses.sanskrit:
शृङ्गैर्महर्षभौ यद्वद्दन्ताग्रैरिव कुञ्जरौ
परस्परं विनिघ्नन्तौ नरराक्षससत्तमौ
verses.transliteration:
śṛṅgairmaharṣabhau yadvaddantāgrairiva kuñjarau
parasparaṁ vinighnantau nararākṣasasattamau

translations.english: The King of men and the King of Rākşasas assailed and wounded one another with their clubs like to two bulls striking one another with their horns and two elephants with their tusks.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽर्जुनेन क्रुद्धेन सर्वप्राणेन सा गदा
स्तनयोरन्तरे मुक्ता रावणस्य महाहवे
verses.transliteration:
tato'rjunena kruddhena sarvaprāṇena sā gadā
stanayorantare muktā rāvaṇasya mahāhave

translations.english: Thereupon worked up with rage, Arjuna, with his full might, smote Răvaņa on his breast, with his club.

verses.sanskrit:
वरदानकृतत्राणे सा गदा रावणोरसि
दुर्बलेव यथा सेना द्विधाभूतापतत्क्षितौ
verses.transliteration:
varadānakṛtatrāṇe sā gadā rāvaṇorasi
durbaleva yathā senā dvidhābhūtāpatatkṣitau

translations.english: But Rāvana was well protected by the boon of the celestial, so the club fell on earth sundered into two pieces like one hurled by a weak wight.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वर्जुनप्रमुक्तेन गदापातेन रावणः
अपासर्पद्धनुर्मात्रं निषसाद च निष्टनन्
verses.transliteration:
sa tvarjunapramuktena gadāpātena rāvaṇaḥ
apāsarpaddhanurmātraṁ niṣasāda ca niṣṭanan

translations.english: Still wounded by the mace of Arjuna, Rāvana, shedding tears, ran away at a distance of four feet and sat there.

verses.sanskrit:
बध्यमाने दशग्रीवे सिद्धचारणदेवताः
साध्वीति वादिनः पुष्पैः किरन्त्यर्जुनमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration:
badhyamāne daśagrīve siddhacāraṇadevatāḥ
sādhvīti vādinaḥ puṣpaiḥ kirantyarjunamūrdhani

translations.english: Beholding Răvaņa thus over-whelmed Arjuna sprang up and caught him like Garuda holding a serpent and Vişņu binding Bali. Daśagrīva being thus bound, the Siddhas, Caranas and the celestials exclaiming "Well done! Well done!!” showered flowers upon Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit:
व्याघ्रो मृगमिवादाय सिंहराडिव दन्तिनम्
ररास हैहयो राजा हर्षादम्बुदवन्मुहुः
verses.transliteration:
vyāghro mṛgamivādāya siṁharāḍiva dantinam
rarāsa haihayo rājā harṣādambudavanmuhuḥ

translations.english: And the king emitted leonine roars again and again as a tiger joyous roars like a cloud, holding a deer under his grasp.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रहस्तस्तु समाश्वस्तो दृष्ट्वा बद्धं दशाननम्
सह तै राकसैः क्रुद्ध अभिदुद्राव पार्थिवम्
verses.transliteration:
prahastastu samāśvasto dṛṣṭvā baddhaṁ daśānanam
saha tai rākasaiḥ kruddha abhidudrāva pārthivam

translations.english: Regaining his sense and beholding Rāvana bound, Prahasta, in great anger, pursued, the King of Haihaya.

verses.sanskrit:
नक्तंचराणां वेगस्तु तेषामापततां बभौ
उद्धृत आतपापाये समुद्राणामिवाद्भुतः
verses.transliteration:
naktaṁcarāṇāṁ vegastu teṣāmāpatatāṁ babhau
uddhṛta ātapāpāye samudrāṇāmivādbhutaḥ

translations.english: And the Rākşasa force grew tempestuous like to the rising of the ocean during rains.

verses.sanskrit:
मुञ्च मुञ्चेति भाषन्तस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चासकृत्
मुसलानि च शूलानि उत्ससर्जुस्तदार्जुने
verses.transliteration:
muñca muñceti bhāṣantastiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cāsakṛt
musalāni ca śūlāni utsasarjustadārjune

translations.english: Thereupon exclaiming repeatedly “Leave him off! Leave him off Wait! Wait!!" The Raksasa host hurled hundreds of Musalas and darts in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्राप्तान्येव तान्याशु असंभ्रान्तस्तदार्जुनः
आयुधान्यमरारीणां जग्राह रिपुसूदनः
verses.transliteration:
aprāptānyeva tānyāśu asaṁbhrāntastadārjunaḥ
āyudhānyamarārīṇāṁ jagrāha ripusūdanaḥ

translations.english: Not the least moved thereby the king Arjuna, the slayer of enemies, bore those weapons of the enemies of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तैरेव रक्षांसि दुर्धरैः प्रवरायुधैः
भित्त्वा विद्रावयामास वायुरम्बुधरानिव
verses.transliteration:
tatastaireva rakṣāṁsi durdharaiḥ pravarāyudhaiḥ
bhittvā vidrāvayāmāsa vāyurambudharāniva

translations.english: Thereupon baffling the weapons of the Räkşasas by means of many a dreadful and excellent one, Arjuna, the king of Haihayas, drove them away · like winds scattering the clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
स कीर्यमाणः कुसुमाक्षतोत्करै;र्द्विजैः सपौरैः पुरुहूतसंनिभः
तदार्जुनः संप्रविवेश तां पुरीं; बलिं निगृह्यैव सहस्रलोचनः
verses.transliteration:
sa kīryamāṇaḥ kusumākṣatotkarai;rdvijaiḥ sapauraiḥ puruhūtasaṁnibhaḥ
tadārjunaḥ saṁpraviveśa tāṁ purīṁ; baliṁ nigṛhyaiva sahasralocanaḥ

translations.english: Having thus struck terror to the night-rangers, he, encircled by his own kinsmen, repaired to his own city with Ravana, carrying him bound like to Indra carrying Bali bound. Thereupon flowers and fried paddy were showered upon him by the Brāhmaṇas and citizens.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणग्रहणं तत्तु वायुग्रहणसंनिभम्
ऋषिः पुलस्त्यः शुश्राव कथितं दिवि दैवतैः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇagrahaṇaṁ tattu vāyugrahaṇasaṁnibham
ṛṣiḥ pulastyaḥ śuśrāva kathitaṁ divi daivataiḥ

translations.english: Thereupor Pulastya heard from the celestials ot the capture of Råvana like to the holding of the.wind.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पुत्रसुतस्नेहात्कम्प्यमानो महाधृतिः
माहिष्मतीपतिं द्रष्टुमाजगाम महानृषिः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ putrasutasnehātkampyamāno mahādhṛtiḥ
māhiṣmatīpatiṁ draṣṭumājagāma mahānṛṣiḥ

translations.english: Having seen moved by the love for his son, the highly effulgent, great ascetic, proceeded to see the king of Māhismati.

verses.sanskrit:
स वायुमार्गमास्थाय वायुतुल्यगतिर्द्विजः
पुरीं माहिष्मतीं प्राप्तो मनःसंतापविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
sa vāyumārgamāsthāya vāyutulyagatirdvijaḥ
purīṁ māhiṣmatīṁ prāpto manaḥsaṁtāpavikramaḥ

translations.english: Proceeding by the aerial way, that twice-born one, gifted with the velocity of wind and the flight of wind, reached the city of Māhismati.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽमरावतिसंकाशां हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम्
प्रविवेश पुरीं ब्रह्मा इन्द्रस्येवामरावतीम्
verses.transliteration:
so'marāvatisaṁkāśāṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtām
praviveśa purīṁ brahmā indrasyevāmarāvatīm

translations.english: Like to Brahma entering Indra's Amaravati, he entered the city resembling the capital of Indr and filled with delighted and plump citizens.

verses.sanskrit:
पादचारमिवादित्यं निष्पतन्तं सुदुर्दृशम्
ततस्ते प्रत्यभिज्ञाय अर्जुनाय न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration:
pādacāramivādityaṁ niṣpatantaṁ sudurdṛśam
tataste pratyabhijñāya arjunāya nyavedayan

translations.english: Beholding that dreadful Rșis approach like to Āditya walking on foot, the warders communicated the intelligence to the king Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit:
पुलस्त्य इति तं श्रुत्वा वचनं हैहयाधिपः
शिरस्यञ्जलिमुद्धृत्य प्रत्युद्गच्छद्द्विजोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
pulastya iti taṁ śrutvā vacanaṁ haihayādhipaḥ
śirasyañjalimuddhṛtya pratyudgacchaddvijottamam

translations.english: Understanding from their words that Pulastya was coming, the king of Haihayas, placing his folded palms on his crown, proceeded to welcome him.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरोहितोऽस्य गृह्यार्घ्यं मधुपर्कं तथैव च
पुरस्तात्प्रययौ राज्ञ इन्द्रस्येव बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration:
purohito'sya gṛhyārghyaṁ madhuparkaṁ tathaiva ca
purastātprayayau rājña indrasyeva bṛhaspatiḥ

translations.english: Like, to Brhaspati preceding Purandara, the royal priests went before him carrying, Madhuparka and water to wash feet.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तमृषिमायान्तमुद्यन्तमिव भास्करम्
अर्जुनो दृश्य संप्राप्तं ववन्देन्द्र इवेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastamṛṣimāyāntamudyantamiva bhāskaram
arjuno dṛśya saṁprāptaṁ vavandendra iveśvaram

translations.english: And beholding the ascetic resembling the rising sun arrived, the King Arjuna bowed to him reverentially like Indra saluting Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit:
स तस्य मधुपर्कं च पाद्यमर्घ्यं च दापयन्
पुलस्त्यमाह राजेन्द्रो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
sa tasya madhuparkaṁ ca pādyamarghyaṁ ca dāpayan
pulastyamāha rājendro harṣagadgadayā girā

translations.english: Thereupon offering him Madhuparka, cow and water to wash feet, the king of Haihayas, in accents obstructed with delight, addressed the ascetic saying

verses.sanskrit:
अद्येयममरावत्या तुल्या माहिष्मती कृता
अद्याहं तु द्विजेन्द्रेन्द्र यस्मात्पश्यामि दुर्दृशम्
verses.transliteration:
adyeyamamarāvatyā tulyā māhiṣmatī kṛtā
adyāhaṁ tu dvijendrendra yasmātpaśyāmi durdṛśam

translations.english: Reverend Sir, your visit, it is hard to obtain. On beholding you my city Mahişmati has been turned into Amaravati.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं राज्यमिमे पुत्रा इमे दारा इमे वयम्
ब्रह्मन्किं कुर्म किं कार्यमाज्ञापयतु नो भवान्
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ rājyamime putrā ime dārā ime vayam
brahmankiṁ kurma kiṁ kāryamājñāpayatu no bhavān

translations.english: Today have I obtained all auspiciousness, O lord; today has my religious observance been fruitful; today has my birth proved blessed and today has my devout penance been crowned with success, for I bow to your feet, which have been worshipped by the celestials. This my kingdom, these my sons, this my wife and myself are all at your disposal do you order me, O Brahmaņa, what I may do for you.

verses.sanskrit:
तं धर्मेऽग्निषु भृत्येषु शिवं पृष्ट्वाथ पार्थिवम्
पुलस्त्योवाच राजानं हैहयानां तदार्जुनम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dharme'gniṣu bhṛtyeṣu śivaṁ pṛṣṭvātha pārthivam
pulastyovāca rājānaṁ haihayānāṁ tadārjunam

translations.english: Thereupon having enquired of the king about his piety, offerings and the well-being of his sons, Pulastya said to Arjuna, the king of Haihayas.

verses.sanskrit:
राजेन्द्रामलपद्माक्षपूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन
अतुलं ते बलं येन दशग्रीवस्त्वया जितः
verses.transliteration:
rājendrāmalapadmākṣapūrṇacandranibhānana
atulaṁ te balaṁ yena daśagrīvastvayā jitaḥ

translations.english: O foremost of kings, O you having eyes like lotus-petals! O you having a countenance like the full moon! When you have vanquished Ravaņa, your prowess is matchless in the triple world.

verses.sanskrit:
भयाद्यस्यावतिष्ठेतां निष्पन्दौ सागरानिलौ
सोऽयमद्य त्वया बद्धः पौत्रो मेऽतीवदुर्जयः
verses.transliteration:
bhayādyasyāvatiṣṭhetāṁ niṣpandau sāgarānilau
so'yamadya tvayā baddhaḥ pautro me'tīvadurjayaḥ

translations.english: You have bound up my invincible son in the conflict at whose fear the wind and the ocean stand still.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्पुत्रक यशः स्फीतं नाम विश्रावितं त्वया
मद्वाक्याद्याच्यमानोऽद्य मुञ्च वत्स दशाननम्
verses.transliteration:
tatputraka yaśaḥ sphītaṁ nāma viśrāvitaṁ tvayā
madvākyādyācyamāno'dya muñca vatsa daśānanam

translations.english: Having drunk up the glories of my son you have announced your own; so I do say, O my son, do you release Dasanana.

verses.sanskrit:
पुलस्त्याज्ञां स गृह्याथ अकिंचनवचोऽर्जुनः
मुमोच पार्थिवेन्द्रेन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रं प्रहृष्टवत्
verses.transliteration:
pulastyājñāṁ sa gṛhyātha akiṁcanavaco'rjunaḥ
mumoca pārthivendrendro rākṣasendraṁ prahṛṣṭavat

translations.english: Hearing this command of Pulastya, the king Arjuna did not utter a single world and set, most delightedly the king of Räkşasas, free.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं प्रमुक्त्वा त्रिदशारिमर्जुनः; प्रपूज्य दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः
अहिंसाकं सख्यमुपेत्य साग्निकं; प्रणम्य स ब्रह्मसुतं गृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ pramuktvā tridaśārimarjunaḥ; prapūjya divyābharaṇasragambaraiḥ
ahiṁsākaṁ sakhyamupetya sāgnikaṁ; praṇamya sa brahmasutaṁ gṛhaṁ yayau

translations.english: Having released that foe of the celestials, worshipped him with celestials ornaments and garlands and established friendship removing all enmities with Ravana before fire, and bowed to Pulastya, the son of Brahmā, he repaired to his own house.

verses.sanskrit:
पुलस्त्येनापि संगम्य राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्
परिष्वङ्गकृतातिथ्यो लज्जमानो विसर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
pulastyenāpi saṁgamya rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān
pariṣvaṅgakṛtātithyo lajjamāno visarjitaḥ

translations.english: And being released by the influence of Pulastya, the highly powerful Daśānana, the king of Raksasas, accepted his hospitality and being embraced by him, returned home ashamed.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहसुतश्चापि पुलस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः
मोचयित्वा दशग्रीवं ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम सः
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahasutaścāpi pulastyo munisattamaḥ
mocayitvā daśagrīvaṁ brahmalokaṁ jagāma saḥ

translations.english: And having set Daśagriva at liberty Pulastya, the son of Brahma and the foremost of Munis repaired to the celestial region.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं स रावणः प्राप्तः कार्तवीर्यात्तु धर्षणात्
पुलस्त्यवचनाच्चापि पुनर्मोक्षमवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sa rāvaṇaḥ prāptaḥ kārtavīryāttu dharṣaṇāt
pulastyavacanāccāpi punarmokṣamavāptavān

translations.english: O Rāma, in this wise, the highly powerful Ravana was defeated by Arjuna and released by Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बलिभ्यो बलिनः सन्ति राघवनन्दन
नावज्ञा परतः कार्या य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ balibhyo balinaḥ santi rāghavanandana
nāvajñā parataḥ kāryā ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ

translations.english: Observe therefore, O descendant of Raghu, there is a mightier man than the mighty; therefore, one, desirous of his own well-being, should not disregard another.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स राजा पिशिताशनानां; सहस्रबाहोरुपलभ्य मैत्रीम्
पुनर्नराणां कदनं चकार; चचार सर्वां पृथिवीं च दर्पात्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa rājā piśitāśanānāṁ; sahasrabāhorupalabhya maitrīm
punarnarāṇāṁ kadanaṁ cakāra; cacāra sarvāṁ pṛthivīṁ ca darpāt

translations.english: Having acquired friendship with thousandarmed Arjuna, Daśānana, the king of Rākşasas, the world began again to journey over distressing the kings.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुनेन विमुक्तस्तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
चचार पृथिवीं सर्वामनिर्विण्णस्तथा कृतः
verses.transliteration:
arjunena vimuktastu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
cacāra pṛthivīṁ sarvāmanirviṇṇastathā kṛtaḥ

translations.english: Released by Arjuna, and yet not conceiving any shame, Rāvana, the king of Räkşasas again began to transverse the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसं वा मनुष्यं वा शृणुते यं बलाधिकम्
रावणस्तं समासाद्य युद्धे ह्वयति दर्पितः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasaṁ vā manuṣyaṁ vā śṛṇute yaṁ balādhikam
rāvaṇastaṁ samāsādya yuddhe hvayati darpitaḥ

translations.english: Rākşasas or men, of whom the proud Rävaņa heard to be powerful he used to approach and summon them for fight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कदाचित्किष्किन्धां नगरीं वालिपालिताम्
गत्वाह्वयति युद्धाय वालिनं हेममालिनम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kadācitkiṣkindhāṁ nagarīṁ vālipālitām
gatvāhvayati yuddhāya vālinaṁ hemamālinam

translations.english: After some time he arrived at the city of Kişkindhā reared by Vāli and invited him, wearing golden garland, to fight.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तं वानरामात्यस्तारस्तारापिता प्रभुः
उवाच रावणं वाक्यं युद्धप्रेप्सुमुपागतम्
verses.transliteration:
tatastaṁ vānarāmātyastārastārāpitā prabhuḥ
uvāca rāvaṇaṁ vākyaṁ yuddhaprepsumupāgatam

translations.english: Thereat, Tara, her father Susena and the Prince Sugrīva said to the king of Rākşasas.

verses.sanskrit:
राक्षसेन्द्र गतो वाली यस्ते प्रतिबलो भवेत्
नान्यः प्रमुखतः स्थातुं तव शक्तः प्लवंगमः
verses.transliteration:
rākṣasendra gato vālī yaste pratibalo bhavet
nānyaḥ pramukhataḥ sthātuṁ tava śaktaḥ plavaṁgamaḥ

translations.english: O lord of Rākşasas, he is not present here, who shall be able to withstand you. What monkey else is capable of standing before you?

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्भ्योऽपि समुद्रेभ्यः संध्यामन्वास्य रावण
इमं मुहूर्तमायाति वाली तिष्ठ मुहूर्तकम्
verses.transliteration:
caturbhyo'pi samudrebhyaḥ saṁdhyāmanvāsya rāvaṇa
imaṁ muhūrtamāyāti vālī tiṣṭha muhūrtakam

translations.english: However, O Ravana, Vali shall soon return after performing the Sandhya rites at the confluence of the four oceans; therefore wait here for a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
एतानस्थिचयान्पश्य य एते शङ्खपाण्डुराः
युद्धार्थिनामिमे राजन्वानराधिपतेजसा
verses.transliteration:
etānasthicayānpaśya ya ete śaṅkhapāṇḍurāḥ
yuddhārthināmime rājanvānarādhipatejasā

translations.english: Behold, O Dasanana, there lie the bones of all those, like conch, who came ere this to fight with the powerful king of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्वामृतरसः पीतस्त्वया रावणराक्षस
तथा वालिनमासाद्य तदन्तं तव जीवितम्
verses.transliteration:
yadvāmṛtarasaḥ pītastvayā rāvaṇarākṣasa
tathā vālinamāsādya tadantaṁ tava jīvitam

translations.english: O Ravana, O Raksasa, ever if you have drunk nectar, you shall at this very moment loose your life, when the encounter with Vāli shall take place.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा त्वरसे मर्तुं गच्छ दक्षिणसागरम्
वालिनं द्रक्ष्यसे तत्र भूमिष्ठमिव भास्करम्
verses.transliteration:
atha vā tvarase martuṁ gaccha dakṣiṇasāgaram
vālinaṁ drakṣyase tatra bhūmiṣṭhamiva bhāskaram

translations.english: Or if you do wish to meet with death do you speedily repair to the southern ocean and you shall behold there Vali like to fire placed on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र हेमगिरिप्रख्यं तरुणार्कनिभाननम्
रावणो वालिनं दृष्ट्वा संध्योपासनतत्परम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra hemagiriprakhyaṁ taruṇārkanibhānanam
rāvaṇo vālinaṁ dṛṣṭvā saṁdhyopāsanatatparam

translations.english: Hearing those words, Rāvana, the aggrandiser of the triple world, remonstrated with Tāra and ascending his flowery car went to the southern ocean and espied Vali, having red countenance like the rising sun, engaged in Sandhyā rites with whole-mindedness.

verses.sanskrit:
पुष्पकादवरुह्याथ रावणोऽञ्जनसंनिभः
ग्रहीतुं वालिनं तूर्णं निःशब्दपदमाद्रवत्
verses.transliteration:
puṣpakādavaruhyātha rāvaṇo'ñjanasaṁnibhaḥ
grahītuṁ vālinaṁ tūrṇaṁ niḥśabdapadamādravat

translations.english: Thereupon having descended from his Puşpaka car he with silent approached Vāli to bring him under his grasp.

verses.sanskrit:
शशमालक्ष्य सिंहो वा पन्नगं गरुडो यथा
न चिन्तयति तं वाली रावणं पापनिश्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
śaśamālakṣya siṁho vā pannagaṁ garuḍo yathā
na cintayati taṁ vālī rāvaṇaṁ pāpaniścayam

translations.english: Casting his looks at pleasure, Vali saw him. Albeit apprised of his evil intention, he was not the least moved. And he did not care for him as a lion is not moved on beholding a hare and Garuda on beholding a serpent.

verses.sanskrit:
जिघृक्षमाणमद्यैनं रावणं पापबुद्धिनम्
कक्षावलम्बिनं कृत्वा गमिष्यामि महार्णवान्
verses.transliteration:
jighṛkṣamāṇamadyainaṁ rāvaṇaṁ pāpabuddhinam
kakṣāvalambinaṁ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi mahārṇavān

translations.english: He then thought within himself-“This vicious-souled Răvaņa is approaching to catch me; holding him under my arm pit I shall journey over the three great oceans.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रक्ष्यन्त्यरिं ममाङ्कस्थं स्रंसितोरुकराम्बरम्
लम्बमानं दशग्रीवं गरुडस्येव पन्नगम्
verses.transliteration:
drakṣyantyariṁ mamāṅkasthaṁ sraṁsitorukarāmbaram
lambamānaṁ daśagrīvaṁ garuḍasyeva pannagam

translations.english: Everyone will behold the enemy Rāvana, under my arm pit as a serpent possessed by Garuda, with his thighs, arms and clothes loosened.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं मतिमास्थाय वाली कर्णमुपाश्रितः
जपन्वै नैगमान्मन्त्रांस्तस्थौ पर्वतराडिव
verses.transliteration:
ityevaṁ matimāsthāya vālī karṇamupāśritaḥ
japanvai naigamānmantrāṁstasthau parvatarāḍiva

translations.english: Having thought thus Vāli remained silent for sometime and reciting incantations he waited there like a mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
तावन्योन्यं जिघृक्षन्तौ हरिराक्षसपार्थिवौ
प्रयत्नवन्तौ तत्कर्म ईहतुर्बलदर्पितौ
verses.transliteration:
tāvanyonyaṁ jighṛkṣantau harirākṣasapārthivau
prayatnavantau tatkarma īhaturbaladarpitau

translations.english: Thereupon the king of monkeys and the lord of Rākşasas, proud of strength, essayed to catch one another.

verses.sanskrit:
हस्तग्राह्यं तु तं मत्वा पादशब्देन रावणम्
पराङ्मुखोऽपि जग्राह वाली सर्पमिवाण्डजः
verses.transliteration:
hastagrāhyaṁ tu taṁ matvā pādaśabdena rāvaṇam
parāṅmukho'pi jagrāha vālī sarpamivāṇḍajaḥ

translations.english: Vāli was seated with his back (towards Rāvaņa); still from his footsteps he perceived that he had come within the grasp of Råvaņa's army and he at once caught hold of him like to Garuda holding a serpent.

verses.sanskrit:
ग्रहीतुकामं तं गृह्य रक्षसामीश्वरं हरिः
खमुत्पपात वेगेन कृत्वा कक्षावलम्बिनम्
verses.transliteration:
grahītukāmaṁ taṁ gṛhya rakṣasāmīśvaraṁ hariḥ
khamutpapāta vegena kṛtvā kakṣāvalambinam

translations.english: Getting hold of Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, desirous of catching him, (Vāli) and placing him under his arm-pit Vāli vehemently rose high up in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
स तं पीड्दयमानस्तु वितुदन्तं नखैर्मुहुः
जहार रावणं वाली पवनस्तोयदं यथा
verses.transliteration:
sa taṁ pīḍdayamānastu vitudantaṁ nakhairmuhuḥ
jahāra rāvaṇaṁ vālī pavanastoyadaṁ yathā

translations.english: And he went away carrying him, scratching him again and again with his snails like to winds scattering clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ ते राक्षसामात्या ह्रियमाणे दशानने
मुमोक्षयिषवो घोरा रवमाणा ह्यभिद्रवन्
verses.transliteration:
atha te rākṣasāmātyā hriyamāṇe daśānane
mumokṣayiṣavo ghorā ravamāṇā hyabhidravan

translations.english: The Ten-necked demon being thus carried away, his councillors, to release him, pursued, exclaiming, Vali, in the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्वीयमानस्तैर्वाली भ्राजतेऽम्बरमध्यगः
अन्वीयमानो मेघौघैरम्बरस्थ इवांशुमान्
verses.transliteration:
anvīyamānastairvālī bhrājate'mbaramadhyagaḥ
anvīyamāno meghaughairambarastha ivāṁśumān

translations.english: They thus following him, Vali, appeared in the sky like the sun in the midst of clouds.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽशक्नुवन्तः संप्राप्तं वालिनं राक्षसोत्तमाः
तस्य बाहूरुवेगेन परिश्रान्तः पतन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
te'śaknuvantaḥ saṁprāptaṁ vālinaṁ rākṣasottamāḥ
tasya bāhūruvegena pariśrāntaḥ patanti ca

translations.english: The Rākşasas could not catch Vāli but were rather exhausted by the stroke of his arms and thighs.

verses.sanskrit: वालिमार्गादपाक्रामन्पर्वतेन्द्रा हि गच्छतः
verses.transliteration: vālimārgādapākrāmanparvatendrā hi gacchataḥ

translations.english: What to speak of animals made of flesh and blood anxious for their lives even the mountains make way when Vāli goes.

verses.sanskrit:
अपक्षिगणसंपातो वानरेन्द्रो महाजवः
क्रमशः सागरान्सर्वान्संध्याकालमवन्दत
verses.transliteration:
apakṣigaṇasaṁpāto vānarendro mahājavaḥ
kramaśaḥ sāgarānsarvānsaṁdhyākālamavandata

translations.english: Rising high up into the sky where even the birds cannot reach, Vali, the lord of monkeys and gifted with great velocity, by and by finished his Sandhyā rites above the oceans.

verses.sanskrit:
सभाज्यमानो भूतैस्तु खेचरैः खेचरो हरिः
पश्चिमं सागरं वाली आजगाम सरावणः
verses.transliteration:
sabhājyamāno bhūtaistu khecaraiḥ khecaro hariḥ
paścimaṁ sāgaraṁ vālī ājagāma sarāvaṇaḥ

translations.english: Being worshipped by the aerials their lord, with Rāvaņa, first proceeded to the western ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र संध्यामुपासित्वा स्नात्वा जप्त्वा च वानरः
उत्तरं सागरं प्रायाद्वहमानो दशाननम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra saṁdhyāmupāsitvā snātvā japtvā ca vānaraḥ
uttaraṁ sāgaraṁ prāyādvahamāno daśānanam

translations.english: Having finished there Sandhyā prayers and recited incantations he, with Daśānana, went to the northern ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तरे सागरे संध्यामुपासित्वा दशाननम्
वहमानोऽगमद्वाली पूर्वमम्बुमहानिधिम्
verses.transliteration:
uttare sāgare saṁdhyāmupāsitvā daśānanam
vahamāno'gamadvālī pūrvamambumahānidhim

translations.english: And having journeyed over many thousand leagues like the wind and mind, that huge monkey, with his enemy, finished his prayers at the northern ocean and then proceeded to the eastern ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापि संध्यामन्वास्य वासविः स हरीश्वरः
किष्किन्धाभिमुखो गृह्य रावणं पुनरागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tatrāpi saṁdhyāmanvāsya vāsaviḥ sa harīśvaraḥ
kiṣkindhābhimukho gṛhya rāvaṇaṁ punarāgamat

translations.english: And having recited his prayers there also, Vali, the son of Indra, and the king of monkeys, carrying Rāvana, returned to the city of Kişikindhā.

verses.sanskrit:
चतुर्ष्वपि समुद्रेषु संध्यामन्वास्य वानरः
रावणोद्वहनश्रान्तः किष्किन्धोपवनेऽपतत्
verses.transliteration:
caturṣvapi samudreṣu saṁdhyāmanvāsya vānaraḥ
rāvaṇodvahanaśrāntaḥ kiṣkindhopavane'patat

translations.english: Having gone through his Sandhyā rites at the four oceans and carrying Răvaņa, that monkeychief was greatly exhausted and (therefore) descended into the gardens of Kişkindhā.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणं तु मुमोचाथ स्वकक्षात्कपिसत्तमः
कुतस्त्वमिति चोवाच प्रहसन्रावणं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaṁ tu mumocātha svakakṣātkapisattamaḥ
kutastvamiti covāca prahasanrāvaṇaṁ prati

translations.english: Having got out Răvaņa from his arm-pit, the foremost of monkeys, laughing again and again said:-"Where are you coming?"

verses.sanskrit:
विस्मयं तु महद्गत्वा श्रमलोकनिरीक्षणः
राक्षसेशो हरीशं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
vismayaṁ tu mahadgatvā śramalokanirīkṣaṇaḥ
rākṣaseśo harīśaṁ tamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon being surprised greatly, Daśānana, the king of Rākşasas, with eyes, shaking with exhaustion, said to the king of monkeys.

verses.sanskrit:
वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभ राक्षसेन्द्रोऽस्मि रावणः
युद्धेप्सुरहं संप्राप्तः स चाद्यासादितस्त्वया
verses.transliteration:
vānarendra mahendrābha rākṣasendro'smi rāvaṇaḥ
yuddhepsurahaṁ saṁprāptaḥ sa cādyāsāditastvayā

translations.english: O king of monkeys, resembling Mahendra, I am Rāvaņa, the king of Rākşasas; I came here to fight: but I have been defeated by you. Alas!

verses.sanskrit:
अहो बलमहो वीर्यमहो गम्भीरता च ते
येनाहं पशुवद्गृह्य भ्रामितश्चतुरोऽर्णवान्
verses.transliteration:
aho balamaho vīryamaho gambhīratā ca te
yenāhaṁ paśuvadgṛhya bhrāmitaścaturo'rṇavān

translations.english: What strength is your! what prowess! What gravity! Holding me like a beast you have journeyed over the four oceans.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमश्रान्तवद्वीर शीघ्रमेव च वानर
मां चैवोद्वहमानस्तु कोऽन्यो वीरः क्रमिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
evamaśrāntavadvīra śīghrameva ca vānara
māṁ caivodvahamānastu ko'nyo vīraḥ kramiṣyati

translations.english: O hero! What heroic wight is there who is not exhausted by carrying me so vehemently?

verses.sanskrit:
त्रयाणामेव भूतानां गतिरेषा प्लवंगम
मनोऽनिलसुपर्णानां तव वा नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration:
trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ gatireṣā plavaṁgama
mano'nilasuparṇānāṁ tava vā nātra saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: O monkey, mind, wind and Garuda-these three are gifted with the velocity. Undoubtedly you have got the same velocity.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं दृष्टबलस्तुभ्यमिच्छामि हरिपुंगव
त्वया सह चिरं सख्यं सुस्निग्धं पावकाग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ dṛṣṭabalastubhyamicchāmi haripuṁgava
