tvayā saha ciraṁ sakhyaṁ susnigdhaṁ pāvakāgrataḥ

translations.english: Your prowess has been sufficiently displayed. But bow I wish, O king of monkeys, to make friends with you for ever before fire.

verses.sanskrit:
दाराः पुत्राः पुरं राष्ट्रं भोगाच्छादनभोजनम्
सर्वमेवाविभक्तं नौ भविष्यति हरीश्वर
verses.transliteration:
dārāḥ putrāḥ puraṁ rāṣṭraṁ bhogācchādanabhojanam
sarvamevāvibhaktaṁ nau bhaviṣyati harīśvara

translations.english: O king of monkeys, from today, wife sons, city, kingdom, enjoyment, cloth and food shall be our common,

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रज्वालयित्वाग्निं तावुभौ हरिराक्षसौ
भ्रातृत्वमुपसंपन्नौ परिष्वज्य परस्परम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prajvālayitvāgniṁ tāvubhau harirākṣasau
bhrātṛtvamupasaṁpannau pariṣvajya parasparam

translations.english: Thereupon having lighted up fire the king of monkeys and the king of Rākşasas, embracing each other, became friends.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्योन्यं लम्बितकरौ ततस्तौ हरिराक्षसौ
किष्किन्धां विशतुर्हृष्टौ सिंहौ गिरिगुहामिव
verses.transliteration:
anyonyaṁ lambitakarau tatastau harirākṣasau
kiṣkindhāṁ viśaturhṛṣṭau siṁhau giriguhāmiva

translations.english: Thereupon holding each other by the arms they entered the city of Kiskindha like to two lions, entering delightedly a cave.

verses.sanskrit:
स तत्र मासमुषितः सुग्रीव इव रावणः
अमात्यैरागतैर्नीचस्त्रैलोक्योत्सादनार्थिभिः
verses.transliteration:
sa tatra māsamuṣitaḥ sugrīva iva rāvaṇaḥ
amātyairāgatairnīcastrailokyotsādanārthibhiḥ

translations.english: There like Sugrīva Răvaņa spent a month. Afterwards his councillors, desirous of destroying the triple world, took him away.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तं वालिना रावणः प्रभो
धर्षितश्च कृतश्चापि भ्राता पावकसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration:
evametatpurāvṛttaṁ vālinā rāvaṇaḥ prabho
dharṣitaśca kṛtaścāpi bhrātā pāvakasaṁnidhau

translations.english: O lord Răma, I have thus related to you the previous history. Having thus belaboured Rāvaņa Vālī at last made friends with him before fire.

verses.sanskrit:
बलमप्रतिमं राम वालिनोऽभवदुत्तमम्
सोऽपि तया विनिर्दग्धः शलभो वह्निना यथा
verses.transliteration:
balamapratimaṁ rāma vālino'bhavaduttamam
so'pi tayā vinirdagdhaḥ śalabho vahninā yathā

translations.english: O Rama, Vali and unequalled and great strength. Like to fire burning down locusts you did burn down Vali.

verses.sanskrit:
अपृच्छत ततो रामो दक्षिणाशालयं मुनिम्
प्राञ्जलिर्विनयोपेत इदमाह वचोऽर्थवत्
verses.transliteration:
apṛcchata tato rāmo dakṣiṇāśālayaṁ munim
prāñjalirvinayopeta idamāha vaco'rthavat

translations.english: Thereupon Rāma, being stricken with curiosity, with folded palms and humbly accosted Agastya, residing in the southern quarter, with pregnant accents, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
अतुलं बलमेताभ्यां वालिनो रावणस्य च
न त्वेतौ हनुमद्वीर्यैः समाविति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration:
atulaṁ balametābhyāṁ vālino rāvaṇasya ca
na tvetau hanumadvīryaiḥ samāviti matirmama

translations.english: You say that Rávaņa and Vāli had unequalled strength but I think their can not equal that of Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
शौर्यं दाक्ष्यं बलं धैर्यं प्राज्ञता नयसाधनम्
विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च हनूमति कृतालयाः
verses.transliteration:
śauryaṁ dākṣyaṁ balaṁ dhairyaṁ prājñatā nayasādhanam
vikramaśca prabhāvaśca hanūmati kṛtālayāḥ

translations.english: Heroism, liberality, strength, patience, intellect, knowledge of lawn and means, prowess and energy all exist together in Hanuman. on

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वोदधिं विषीदन्तीं तदैष कपिवाहिनीम्
समाश्वास्य कपीन्भूयो योजनानां शतं प्लुतः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvodadhiṁ viṣīdantīṁ tadaiṣa kapivāhinīm
samāśvāsya kapīnbhūyo yojanānāṁ śataṁ plutaḥ

translations.english: When the monkey host lost heart beholding the ocean, Hanumān, consoling crossed over the deep extending over a hundred leagues.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्षयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां रावणान्तःपुरं तथा
दृष्ट्वा संभाषिता चापि सीता विश्वासिता तथा
verses.transliteration:
dharṣayitvā purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṁ tathā
dṛṣṭvā saṁbhāṣitā cāpi sītā viśvāsitā tathā

translations.english: Having discarded the presiding goddess of Lanka he went to the mansion of Rāvana and on beholding Sita there, he consoled her.

verses.sanskrit:
सेनाग्रगा मन्त्रिसुताः किंकरा रावणात्मजः
एते हनुमता तत्र एकेन विनिपातिताः
verses.transliteration:
senāgragā mantrisutāḥ kiṁkarā rāvaṇātmajaḥ
ete hanumatā tatra ekena vinipātitāḥ

translations.english: What to speak of more, Hanuman, singlehanded, slew Ravana's commander-in-chief, the minister's son, his servants and his one son.

verses.sanskrit:
भूयो बन्धाद्विमुक्तेन संभाषित्वा दशाननम्
लङ्का भस्मीकृता तेन पावकेनेव मेदिनी
verses.transliteration:
bhūyo bandhādvimuktena saṁbhāṣitvā daśānanam
laṅkā bhasmīkṛtā tena pāvakeneva medinī

translations.english: Being released from the Brahma weapon Hanuman remonstrated with Rāvaņa, and reduced Larkā into ashes like to fire burning down earth.

verses.sanskrit:
न कालस्य न शक्रस्य न विष्णोर्वित्तपस्य च
कर्माणि तानि श्रूयन्ते यानि युद्धे हनूमतः
verses.transliteration:
na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇorvittapasya ca
karmāṇi tāni śrūyante yāni yuddhe hanūmataḥ

translations.english: What I have seen myself performed by Hanumān in the conflict is above the power of Kala, Vasava and even the lord of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्य बाहुवीर्येण लङ्का सीता च लक्ष्मणः
प्राप्तो मया जयश्चैव राज्यं मित्राणि बान्धवाः
verses.transliteration:
etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṅkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ
prāpto mayā jayaścaiva rājyaṁ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ

translations.english: It is by the strength of the arms of that Windgod's son I ave obtained Lanka, Sita, Lakşmaņa, Victory, kingdom and my friends.

verses.sanskrit:
हनूमान्यदि मे न स्याद्वानराधिपतेः सखा
प्रवृत्तमपि को वेत्तुं जानक्याः शक्तिमान्भवेत्
verses.transliteration:
hanūmānyadi me na syādvānarādhipateḥ sakhā
pravṛttamapi ko vettuṁ jānakyāḥ śaktimānbhavet

translations.english: What more, had not Hanumăn, the friend of the king of monkeys-Sugrīva, been in my company who could have brought Sītā intelligence?

verses.sanskrit:
किमर्थं वाली चैतेन सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया
तदा वैरे समुत्पन्ने न दग्धो वीरुधो यथा
verses.transliteration:
kimarthaṁ vālī caitena sugrīvapriyakāmyayā
tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdho vīrudho yathā

translations.english: Why did not Hanumän, although wishing welfare to Sugrīva, reduce Vāli to ashes like so many creepers on the occasion of his quarrel with Sugriva?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि वेदितवान्मन्ये हनूमानात्मनो बलम्
यद्दृष्टवाञ्जीवितेष्टं क्लिश्यन्तं वानराधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
na hi veditavānmanye hanūmānātmano balam
yaddṛṣṭavāñjīviteṣṭaṁ kliśyantaṁ vānarādhipam

translations.english: Methinks, Hanuman was not cognisant of his own prowess then? And therefore he did stood to witness the miseries of Sugrīva— the king of monkeys who was dearer than his life.

verses.sanskrit:
एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामुने
विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित
verses.transliteration:
etanme bhagavansarvaṁ hanūmati mahāmune
vistareṇa yathātattvaṁ kathayāmarapūjita

translations.english: O you worshipped of the immortals, do you truly describe to me in detail this action of Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुयुक्तमृषिस्ततः
हनूमतः समक्षं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetuyuktamṛṣistataḥ
hanūmataḥ samakṣaṁ tamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those well-meaning words of Rāghava, the ascetic Agastya said to him in the presence of Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमतः
न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः
verses.transliteration:
satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ
na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matau paraḥ

translations.english: O foremost of Raghus, what, you have said regarding Hanumān, is all true. As regards, strength, velocity and intellect there is none who can equal Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
अमोघशापैः शापस्तु दत्तोऽस्य ऋषिभिः पुरा
न वेदिता बलं येन बली सन्नरिमर्दनः
verses.transliteration:
amoghaśāpaiḥ śāpastu datto'sya ṛṣibhiḥ purā
na veditā balaṁ yena balī sannarimardanaḥ

translations.english: O repressor of enemies, in the days of yore Hanumān was imprecated by the ascetics, whose curses never become fruitless, to the effect that he would never be conscious of his whole strength.

verses.sanskrit:
बाल्येऽप्येतेन यत्कर्म कृतं राम महाबल
तन्न वर्णयितुं शक्यमतिबालतयास्य ते
verses.transliteration:
bālye'pyetena yatkarma kṛtaṁ rāma mahābala
tanna varṇayituṁ śakyamatibālatayāsya te

translations.english: I am not capable of describing to you the wondrous childish feat which Hanuman did perform in his boyhood.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वास्ति त्वभिप्रायस्तच्छ्रोतुं तव राघव
समाधाय मतिं राम निशामय वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi vāsti tvabhiprāyastacchrotuṁ tava rāghava
samādhāya matiṁ rāma niśāmaya vadāmyaham

translations.english: But if you are, O Raghava, greatly anxious to hear it, I shall relate do you hear with a quiescent mind.

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः सुमेरुर्नाम पर्वतः
यत्र राज्यं प्रशास्त्यस्य केसरी नाम वै पिता
verses.transliteration:
sūryadattavarasvarṇaḥ sumerurnāma parvataḥ
yatra rājyaṁ praśāstyasya kesarī nāma vai pitā

translations.english: Hanuman's father Keśarī reigned in the mountain Sumeru which resembles gold by the influence of the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य भार्या बभूवेष्टा ह्यञ्जनेति परिश्रुता
जनयामास तस्यां वै वायुरात्मजमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya bhāryā babhūveṣṭā hyañjaneti pariśrutā
janayāmāsa tasyāṁ vai vāyurātmajamuttamam

translations.english: Kesari had a well-known wife by the name of Añjanā to whom he was greatly attached. The deity Wind begot on Añjană an excellent son.

verses.sanskrit:
शालिशूकसमाभासं प्रासूतेमं तदाञ्जना
फलान्याहर्तुकामा वै निष्क्रान्ता गहने चरा
verses.transliteration:
śāliśūkasamābhāsaṁ prāsūtemaṁ tadāñjanā
phalānyāhartukāmā vai niṣkrāntā gahane carā

translations.english: Repairing to a dense forest for collecting fruits, the excellent damsel gave birth to Hanumān resembling the tip of a ſala tree and went away.

verses.sanskrit:
एष मातुर्वियोगाच्च क्षुधया च भृशार्दितः
रुरोद शिशुरत्यर्थं शिशुः शरभराडिव
verses.transliteration:
eṣa māturviyogācca kṣudhayā ca bhṛśārditaḥ
ruroda śiśuratyarthaṁ śiśuḥ śarabharāḍiva

translations.english: Being distressed with hunger on account of the absence of the mother, Hanuman, just born, cried like Kartikeya, the commander-in-chief of the celestials, in the forest of Saras.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोद्यन्तं विवस्वन्तं जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम्
ददृशे फललोभाच्च उत्पपात रविं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
tatodyantaṁ vivasvantaṁ japāpuṣpotkaropamam
dadṛśe phalalobhācca utpapāta raviṁ prati

translations.english: At this time the sun resembling Japā flowers, having risen, Hanumān, to get a fruit, sprang up.

verses.sanskrit:
बालार्काभिमुखो बालो बालार्क इव मूर्तिमान्
ग्रहीतुकामो बालार्कं प्लवतेऽम्बरमध्यगः
verses.transliteration:
bālārkābhimukho bālo bālārka iva mūrtimān
grahītukāmo bālārkaṁ plavate'mbaramadhyagaḥ

translations.english: Being desirous of holding the newly risen sun, Hanumān, resembling it, began to leap in the middle of the welkin.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्प्लवमाने तु शिशुभावे हनूमति
देवदानवसिद्धानां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत्
verses.transliteration:
etasminplavamāne tu śiśubhāve hanūmati
devadānavasiddhānāṁ vismayaḥ sumahānabhūt

translations.english: The child Hanuman having thus ascended the sky, celestials, Dānavas and Yakşas surprisingly exclaimed.

verses.sanskrit:
नाप्येवं वेगवान्वायुर्गरुडो न मनस्तथा
यथायं वायुपुत्रस्तु क्रमतेऽम्बरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
nāpyevaṁ vegavānvāyurgaruḍo na manastathā
yathāyaṁ vāyuputrastu kramate'mbaramuttamam

translations.english: The velocity, with which Marut's son is going, is not possessed even by the Wind, Garuda and mind.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि तावच्छिशोरस्य ईदृशौ गतिविक्रमौ
यौवनं बलमासाद्य कथं वेगो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yadi tāvacchiśorasya īdṛśau gativikramau
yauvanaṁ balamāsādya kathaṁ vego bhaviṣyati

translations.english: If he has got such vehemence in his boyhood what great strength he shall have in his youth.

verses.sanskrit:
तमनुप्लवते वायुः प्लवन्तं पुत्रमात्मनः
सूर्यदाहभयाद्रक्षंस्तुषारचयशीतलः
verses.transliteration:
tamanuplavate vāyuḥ plavantaṁ putramātmanaḥ
sūryadāhabhayādrakṣaṁstuṣāracayaśītalaḥ

translations.english: His own son thus leaping, the wind, becoming cool by the touch of snow, began to follow him proceeding in the sky lest the rays of the sun might scorch him.

verses.sanskrit:
बहुयोजनसाहस्रं क्रमत्येष ततोऽम्बरम्
पितुर्बलाच्च बाल्याच्च भास्कराभ्याशमागतः
verses.transliteration:
bahuyojanasāhasraṁ kramatyeṣa tato'mbaram
piturbalācca bālyācca bhāskarābhyāśamāgataḥ

translations.english: Rising high up in the sky on account of childish freaks and traversed many thousand leagues by the help of his father Hanuman neared the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
शिशुरेष त्वदोषज्ञ इति मत्वा दिवाकरः
कार्यं चात्र समायत्तमित्येवं न ददाह सः
verses.transliteration:
śiśureṣa tvadoṣajña iti matvā divākaraḥ
kāryaṁ cātra samāyattamityevaṁ na dadāha saḥ

translations.english: Considering that he was a mere child and therefore not tarnished by any sin and that a great divine work would be accomplished by him in future the sun did not burn Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
यमेव दिवसं ह्येष ग्रहीतुं भास्करं प्लुतः
तमेव दिवसं राहुर्जिघृक्षति दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration:
yameva divasaṁ hyeṣa grahītuṁ bhāskaraṁ plutaḥ
tameva divasaṁ rāhurjighṛkṣati divākaram

translations.english: At the every day when Hanuman sprang up to hold the sun, Rāhu too essayed to possess him.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेन च परामृष्टो राम सूर्यरथोपरि
अपक्रान्तस्ततस्त्रस्तो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः
verses.transliteration:
anena ca parāmṛṣṭo rāma sūryarathopari
apakrāntastatastrasto rāhuścandrārkamardanaḥ

translations.english: Having reached the top of the sun's car Hanuman touched Rāhu; so he, the repressor of the moon's rays, accordingly went back on beholding the sun thus possessed.

verses.sanskrit:
स इन्द्रभवनं गत्वा सरोषः सिंहिकासुतः
अब्रवीद्भ्रुकुटीं कृत्वा देवं देवगणैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration:
sa indrabhavanaṁ gatvā saroṣaḥ siṁhikāsutaḥ
abravīdbhrukuṭīṁ kṛtvā devaṁ devagaṇairvṛtam

translations.english: And repairing to the house of Indra, Sinhika's son, in wrath and with frowns, said to him encircled by the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
बुभुक्षापनयं दत्त्वा चन्द्रार्कौ मम वासव
किमिदं तत्त्वया दत्तमन्यस्य बलवृत्रहन्
verses.transliteration:
bubhukṣāpanayaṁ dattvā candrārkau mama vāsava
kimidaṁ tattvayā dattamanyasya balavṛtrahan

translations.english: O Vasava! O slayer of Bala and Vrtra-to remove my hunger you did give me both the sun and moon; why you have then given them to another?

verses.sanskrit:
अद्याहं पर्वकाले तु जिघृक्षुः सूर्यमागतः
अथान्यो राहुरासाद्य जग्राह सहसा रविम्
verses.transliteration:
adyāhaṁ parvakāle tu jighṛkṣuḥ sūryamāgataḥ
athānyo rāhurāsādya jagrāha sahasā ravim

translations.english: On account of the Parva I came to devour the sun but another Rahu came and possessed him.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रः करीन्द्रमारुह्य राहुं कृत्वा पुरःसरम्
प्रायाद्यत्राभवत्सूर्यः सहानेन हनूमता
verses.transliteration:
indraḥ karīndramāruhya rāhuṁ kṛtvā puraḥsaram
prāyādyatrābhavatsūryaḥ sahānena hanūmatā

translations.english: Hearing the words of Råhu, the King of the deities, wearing a golden garland, having his understanding bewildered, proceeded, on the back of his elephant-chief Airavata, huge like the summit of the Kailäsa hill, with temporal juice always trickling, having four tasks, roaring, and adorned with golden bells, towards Hanumān and the sun with Rāhu before him.

verses.sanskrit:
अथातिरभसेनागाद्राहुरुत्सृज्य वासवम्
अनेन च स वै दृष्ट आधावञ्शैलकूटवत्
verses.transliteration:
athātirabhasenāgādrāhurutsṛjya vāsavam
anena ca sa vai dṛṣṭa ādhāvañśailakūṭavat

translations.english: Having left behind Indra, Rāhu, quickly went there but fled away on beholding the hugebodied Hanumān resembling a mountain summit.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सूर्यं समुत्सृज्य राहुमेवमवेक्ष्य च
उत्पपात पुनर्व्योम ग्रहीतुं सिंहिकासुतम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sūryaṁ samutsṛjya rāhumevamavekṣya ca
utpapāta punarvyoma grahītuṁ siṁhikāsutam

translations.english: Thereupon leaving aside the sun and being desirous of holding Rāhu, the son of Siṁhikā considering him as a fruit, Hanumān again sprang up into the sky.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सृज्यार्कमिमं राम आधावन्तं प्लवंगमम्
दृष्ट्वा राहुः परावृत्य मुखशेषः पराङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration:
utsṛjyārkamimaṁ rāma ādhāvantaṁ plavaṁgamam
dṛṣṭvā rāhuḥ parāvṛtya mukhaśeṣaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ

translations.english: Beholding Hanuman approach renouncing the sun, Rāhu with his countenance only visible, desisted and went back.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रमाशंसमानस्तु त्रातारं सिंहिकासुतः
इन्द्र इन्द्रेति संत्रासान्मुहुर्मुहुरभाषत
verses.transliteration:
indramāśaṁsamānastu trātāraṁ siṁhikāsutaḥ
indra indreti saṁtrāsānmuhurmuhurabhāṣata

translations.english: And considering Indra as the saviour the son of Simhikā, stricken with fear, again and again cried aloud "Indra! Indra!!"

verses.sanskrit:
राहोर्विक्रोशमानस्य प्रागेवालक्षितः स्वरः
श्रुत्वेन्द्रोवाच मा भैषीरयमेनं निहन्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
rāhorvikrośamānasya prāgevālakṣitaḥ svaraḥ
śrutvendrovāca mā bhaiṣīrayamenaṁ nihanmyaham

translations.english: Understanding everything by the piteous accents of Rāhu Indra said, “No fear, I shall soon slay him.”

verses.sanskrit:
ऐरावतं ततो दृष्ट्वा महत्तदिदमित्यपि
फलं तं हस्तिराजानमभिदुद्राव मारुतिः
verses.transliteration:
airāvataṁ tato dṛṣṭvā mahattadidamityapi
phalaṁ taṁ hastirājānamabhidudrāva mārutiḥ

translations.english: Thereupon beholding the huge-bodied Airāvat and considering him as a bigger fruit Măruti ran towards him.

verses.sanskrit:
तदास्य धावतो रूपमैरावतजिघृक्षया
मुहूर्तमभवद्घोरमिन्द्राग्न्योरिव भास्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
tadāsya dhāvato rūpamairāvatajighṛkṣayā
muhūrtamabhavadghoramindrāgnyoriva bhāsvaram

translations.english: Proceeding thus tempestuously when he rose above the head of Indra, Hanuman, looked in a moment dreadful like the fire of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमाधावमानं तु नातिक्रुद्धः शचीपतिः
हस्तान्तेनातिमुक्तेन कुलिशेनाभ्यताडयत्
verses.transliteration:
evamādhāvamānaṁ tu nātikruddhaḥ śacīpatiḥ
hastāntenātimuktena kuliśenābhyatāḍayat

translations.english: But not greatly enraged the thousand-eyed lord of Saci, with the thunder bolt in his hand, struck the running Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो गिरौ पपातैष इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः
पतमानस्य चैतस्य वामो हनुरभज्यत
verses.transliteration:
tato girau papātaiṣa indravajrābhitāḍitaḥ
patamānasya caitasya vāmo hanurabhajyata

translations.english: Belaboured by the thunder-bolt of Indra Hanuman fell down on a summit and broke his left jaw.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तु पतिते बाले वज्रताडनविह्वले
चुक्रोधेन्द्राय पवनः प्रजानामशिवाय च
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstu patite bāle vajratāḍanavihvale
cukrodhendrāya pavanaḥ prajānāmaśivāya ca

translations.english: He being thus overwhelmed by the stoke of Indra's thunder-bolt, the Wind-god became displeased with the king of celestials and was determined upon bringing about mischief to all created beings.

verses.sanskrit:
विण्मूत्राशयमावृत्य प्रजास्वन्तर्गतः प्रभुः
रुरोध सर्वभूतानि यथा वर्षाणि वासवः
verses.transliteration:
viṇmūtrāśayamāvṛtya prajāsvantargataḥ prabhuḥ
rurodha sarvabhūtāni yathā varṣāṇi vāsavaḥ

translations.english: The all-comprehending wind, not spreading himself, entered into a cave with his son. Like to Väsava distressing all creatures by putting a stop to the showers, the wind too put all animals into unbearable suffering by obstructing all execrations.

verses.sanskrit:
वायुप्रकोपाद्भूतानि निरुच्छ्वासानि सर्वतः
संधिभिर्भज्यमानानि काष्ठभूतानि जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration:
vāyuprakopādbhūtāni nirucchvāsāni sarvataḥ
saṁdhibhirbhajyamānāni kāṣṭhabhūtāni jajñire

translations.english: On account of the anger of the Wind-god their breath was completely obstructed, and the joints-as if pierced, became hard as wood.

verses.sanskrit:
निःस्वधं निर्वषट्कारं निष्क्रियं धर्मवर्जितम्
वायुप्रकोपात्त्रैलोक्यं निरयस्थमिवाबभौ
verses.transliteration:
niḥsvadhaṁ nirvaṣaṭkāraṁ niṣkriyaṁ dharmavarjitam
vāyuprakopāttrailokyaṁ nirayasthamivābabhau

translations.english: Svādhyāya Vaşațkāra and all the religious observances of the triple world were put a stop to by the anger of the Wind-god. So the three world appeared as if stricken with sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः
प्रजापतिं समाधावन्नसुखार्ताः सुखैषिणः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prajāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ
prajāpatiṁ samādhāvannasukhārtāḥ sukhaiṣiṇaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the affixed celestials, Gandharvas, Asuras and men repaired to the Patriarch Brahmă with a view to bring about the wellbeing of created beings.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया दत्तोऽयमस्माकमायुषः पवनः पतिः
सोऽस्मान्प्राणेश्वरो भूत्वा कस्मादेषोऽद्य सत्तम
verses.transliteration:
tvayā datto'yamasmākamāyuṣaḥ pavanaḥ patiḥ
so'smānprāṇeśvaro bhūtvā kasmādeṣo'dya sattama

translations.english: With their bellies swollen for the obstruction of the wind the celestials with folded hands said: "O lord of created beings, you have created four classes of beings and you have given us wind to preserve our lives. But we do not know, why the wind, the lord of our beings, is distressing us, by obstructing our movements like to females confined in an inner apartment.

verses.sanskrit: वायुसंरोधजं दुःखमिदं नो नुद शत्रुहन्
verses.transliteration: vāyusaṁrodhajaṁ duḥkhamidaṁ no nuda śatruhan

translations.english: Being thus distressed by the wind we have come to seek your shelter. O you the remover of miseries-do you remove our affictions consequent upon the obstruction of the wind..

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्प्रजानां श्रुत्वा तु प्रजानाथः प्रजापतिः
कारणादिति तानुक्त्वा प्रजाः पुनरभाषत
verses.transliteration:
etatprajānāṁ śrutvā tu prajānāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ
kāraṇāditi tānuktvā prajāḥ punarabhāṣata

translations.english: Hearing those words of the created beings, and saying the reason of that the lord of creation (the Patriarch Brahma) again said.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मिन्वः कारणे वायुश्चुक्रोध च रुरोध च
प्रजाः शृणुध्वं तत्सर्वं श्रोतव्यं चात्मनः क्षमम्
verses.transliteration:
yasminvaḥ kāraṇe vāyuścukrodha ca rurodha ca
prajāḥ śṛṇudhvaṁ tatsarvaṁ śrotavyaṁ cātmanaḥ kṣamam

translations.english: Hear, O created beings, why the wind, being enraged, has obstructed the course of all beings. All that deserves to be listened and it is right too.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रस्तस्यामरेशेन इन्द्रेणाद्य निपातितः
राहोर्वचनमाज्ञाय राज्ञा वः कोपितोऽनिलः
verses.transliteration:
putrastasyāmareśena indreṇādya nipātitaḥ
rāhorvacanamājñāya rājñā vaḥ kopito'nilaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāhu, Indra, the king of ION 35 RĀMĀYAŅAM the celestials, has belaboured the Wind-god's son. It is for this that he has been offended.

verses.sanskrit:
अशरीरः शरीरेषु वायुश्चरति पालयन्
शरीरं हि विना वायुं समतां याति रेणुभिः
verses.transliteration:
aśarīraḥ śarīreṣu vāyuścarati pālayan
śarīraṁ hi vinā vāyuṁ samatāṁ yāti reṇubhiḥ

translations.english: Preserving the bodies, the wind, having no persons, passes through them all. Without wind the body becomes like wood.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्यैव च परित्यक्तं वायुना जगदायुषा
अद्यैवेमे निरुच्छ्वासाः काष्ठकुड्योपमाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration:
adyaiva ca parityaktaṁ vāyunā jagadāyuṣā
adyaiveme nirucchvāsāḥ kāṣṭhakuḍyopamāḥ sthitāḥ

translations.english: Therefore the wind constitutes the life, the happiness and the whole universe. Renouncing the wind the world cannot attain to happiness. Being cast off by the wind and having their breaths obstructed, behold, the world, today appear like dried wood.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्यामस्तत्र यत्रास्ते मारुतो रुक्प्रदो हि वः
मा विनाशं गमिष्याम अप्रसाद्यादितेः सुतम्
verses.transliteration:
tadyāmastatra yatrāste māruto rukprado hi vaḥ
mā vināśaṁ gamiṣyāma aprasādyāditeḥ sutam

translations.english: Let us therefore go there where the wind, the giver of our afflictions, wait. If we do not please the son of Aditi we shall all meet with destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रजाभिः सहितः प्रजापतिः; सदेवगन्धर्वभुजंगगुह्यकः
जगाम तत्रास्यति यत्र मारुतः; सुतं सुरेन्द्राभिहतं प्रगृह्य सः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prajābhiḥ sahitaḥ prajāpatiḥ; sadevagandharvabhujaṁgaguhyakaḥ
jagāma tatrāsyati yatra mārutaḥ; sutaṁ surendrābhihataṁ pragṛhya saḥ

translations.english: Thereupon the Patriarch Brahmā, the celestials, Gandharvas, serpents, Guhyakas and other created beings went where the wind was waiting with his own son belaboured by the king of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभं; सुतं तदोत्सङ्गगतं सदागतेः
चतुर्मुखो वीक्ष्य कृपामथाकरो;त्सदेवसिद्धर्षिभुजंगराक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
tato'rkavaiśvānarakāñcanaprabhaṁ; sutaṁ tadotsaṅgagataṁ sadāgateḥ
caturmukho vīkṣya kṛpāmathākaro;tsadevasiddharṣibhujaṁgarākṣasaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon beholding that boy, on the lap of the Wind-God, resembling gold and Baiśvānara, the four-mouthed Brahmā, the celestials, Gandharvas, Rșis, Yakşas and Rākşasas were all moved with pity.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पितामहं दृष्ट्वा वायुः पुत्रवधार्दितः
शिशुकं तं समादाय उत्तस्थौ धातुरग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pitāmahaṁ dṛṣṭvā vāyuḥ putravadhārditaḥ
śiśukaṁ taṁ samādāya uttasthau dhāturagrataḥ

translations.english: Seeing Brahmā the Vāyu troubled with the death of his son, stood in front of the sustainer of the world.

verses.sanskrit:
चलत्कुण्डलमौलिस्रक्तपनीयविभूषणः
पादयोर्न्यपतद्वायुस्तिस्रोऽवस्थाय वेधसे
verses.transliteration:
calatkuṇḍalamaulisraktapanīyavibhūṣaṇaḥ
pādayornyapatadvāyustisro'vasthāya vedhase

translations.english: Thrice the Vāyu prostrated before the Brahma with swinging ear-rings, illustrious diadem, garland and ornament of the gold,

verses.sanskrit:
तं तु वेदविदाद्यस्तु लम्बाभरणशोभिना
वायुमुत्थाप्य हस्तेन शिशुं तं परिमृष्टवान्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ tu vedavidādyastu lambābharaṇaśobhinā
vāyumutthāpya hastena śiśuṁ taṁ parimṛṣṭavān

translations.english: The knower of the Vedas lifted up the Vāyu with his outstretched and adorned hands and embraced the child.

verses.sanskrit:
स्पृष्टमात्रस्ततः सोऽथ सलीलं पद्मजन्मना
जलसिक्तं यथा सस्यं पुनर्जीवितमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration:
spṛṣṭamātrastataḥ so'tha salīlaṁ padmajanmanā
jalasiktaṁ yathā sasyaṁ punarjīvitamāptavān

translations.english: With the touch of lotusborn Brahma, the child (Hanumān) came back to life just like the crop irrigated with water.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राणवन्तमिमं दृष्ट्वा प्राणो गन्धवहो मुदा
चचार सर्वभूतेषु संनिरुद्धं यथापुरा
verses.transliteration:
prāṇavantamimaṁ dṛṣṭvā prāṇo gandhavaho mudā
cacāra sarvabhūteṣu saṁniruddhaṁ yathāpurā

translations.english: Seeing the child alive, the Vayu. started blowing happily through all the lokas in the form of vital air.

verses.sanskrit:
मरुद्रोगविनिर्मुक्ताः प्रजा वै मुदिताभवन्
शीतवातविनिर्मुक्ताः पद्मिन्य इव साम्बुजाः
verses.transliteration:
marudrogavinirmuktāḥ prajā vai muditābhavan
śītavātavinirmuktāḥ padminya iva sāmbujāḥ

translations.english: Having released from the confinement of Vāyu, all the creatures became happy like lotus flowers when rid of cold winds.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्रियुग्मस्त्रिककुत्त्रिधामा त्रिदशार्चितः
उवाच देवता ब्रह्मा मारुतप्रियकाम्यया
verses.transliteration:
tatastriyugmastrikakuttridhāmā tridaśārcitaḥ
uvāca devatā brahmā mārutapriyakāmyayā

translations.english: Then Brahmå keeping the well being of Väyu in his mind spoke to the Gods. Brahmā is endowed with three attributive epithets, viz. Triyugma; (three paired) Tridhāma (three formed). Tridaśarcita (worshipped by three and ten Gods).

verses.sanskrit:
भो महेन्द्राग्निवरुणधनेश्वरमहेश्वराः
जानतामपि तत्सर्वं हितं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयताम्
verses.transliteration:
bho mahendrāgnivaruṇadhaneśvaramaheśvarāḥ
jānatāmapi tatsarvaṁ hitaṁ vakṣyāmi śrūyatām

translations.english: O powerful Indra, Agni, Varuna, Mahesvara and Kubera although you know it well, I will relate it for your well being.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेन शिशुना कार्यं कर्तव्यं वो भविष्यति
ददतास्य वरान्सर्वे मारुतस्यास्य तुष्टिदान्
verses.transliteration:
anena śiśunā kāryaṁ kartavyaṁ vo bhaviṣyati
dadatāsya varānsarve mārutasyāsya tuṣṭidān

translations.english: This child will carry out your intentions, so offer him boons to please the God Vāyu.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सहस्रनयनः प्रीतिरक्तः शुभाननः
कुशे शयमयीं मालां समुत्क्षिप्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sahasranayanaḥ prītiraktaḥ śubhānanaḥ
kuśe śayamayīṁ mālāṁ samutkṣipyedamabravīt

translations.english: Thereupon the thousand eyed, charming Indra setting aside the garland of lotus flowers spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्करोत्सृष्टवज्रेण हनुरस्य यथा क्षतः
नाम्नैष कपिशार्दूलो भविता हनुमानिति
verses.transliteration:
matkarotsṛṣṭavajreṇa hanurasya yathā kṣataḥ
nāmnaiṣa kapiśārdūlo bhavitā hanumāniti

translations.english: Since his chin got wounded by the thunderbolt released by me, so this tiger among Mongoloids will be known as Hanuniãn.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेवास्य दास्यामि परमं वरमुत्तमम्
अतः प्रभृति वज्रस्य ममावध्यो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
ahamevāsya dāsyāmi paramaṁ varamuttamam
ataḥ prabhṛti vajrasya mamāvadhyo bhaviṣyati

translations.english: I will offer him a unique boon. He will not be killed hereafter with the help of my Vajra (or a weapon made of thunderbolt).

verses.sanskrit:
मार्ताण्डस्त्वब्रवीत्तत्र भगवांस्तिमिरापहः
तेजसोऽस्य मदीयस्य ददामि शतिकां कलाम्
verses.transliteration:
mārtāṇḍastvabravīttatra bhagavāṁstimirāpahaḥ
tejaso'sya madīyasya dadāmi śatikāṁ kalām

translations.english: The god Mārtanda, the dispeller of darkness, on that occasion told that I will bestow upon him the hundredth part of my brilliance,

verses.sanskrit:
यदा तु शास्त्राण्यध्येतुं शक्तिरस्य भविष्यति
तदास्य शास्त्रं दास्यामि येन वाग्मी भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
yadā tu śāstrāṇyadhyetuṁ śaktirasya bhaviṣyati
tadāsya śāstraṁ dāsyāmi yena vāgmī bhaviṣyati

translations.english: When he will be capable of learning Śástras, I will transmit in him the knowledge of all the Sastras, so that he may become a good orater. Now shall be able to vie with him in the knowledge of Śăstras.

verses.sanskrit:
वरुणश्च वरं प्रादान्नास्य मृत्युर्भविष्यति
वर्षायुतशतेनापि मत्पाशादुदकादपि
verses.transliteration:
varuṇaśca varaṁ prādānnāsya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati
varṣāyutaśatenāpi matpāśādudakādapi

translations.english: Varuņa bestowed upon him the boon that he well not die for hundred ayuta years even from the my noose (Pasa) or waters either.

verses.sanskrit:
यमोऽपि दण्डावध्यत्वमरोगत्वं च नित्यशः
दिशतेऽस्य वरं तुष्ट अविषादं च संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
yamo'pi daṇḍāvadhyatvamarogatvaṁ ca nityaśaḥ
diśate'sya varaṁ tuṣṭa aviṣādaṁ ca saṁyuge

translations.english: Yama granted invulnerability to his Danda and diseases. The Kuber told he will ever remain happy and satisfied even at the time adversary.

verses.sanskrit:
गदेयं मामिका नैनं संयुगेषु वधिष्यति
इत्येवं वरदः प्राह तदा ह्येकाक्षिपिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration:
gadeyaṁ māmikā nainaṁ saṁyugeṣu vadhiṣyati
ityevaṁ varadaḥ prāha tadā hyekākṣipiṅgalaḥ

translations.english: This mace of mine will not cause his death. So was said by Kubera endowed with one brown eye.

verses.sanskrit:
मत्तो मदायुधानां च न वध्योऽयं भविष्यति
इत्येवं शंकरेणापि दत्तोऽस्य परमो वरः
verses.transliteration:
matto madāyudhānāṁ ca na vadhyo'yaṁ bhaviṣyati
ityevaṁ śaṁkareṇāpi datto'sya paramo varaḥ

translations.english: Sankara also bestowed upon him a great boon that this cannot be killed even by my weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वेषां ब्रह्मदण्डानामवध्योऽयं भविष्यति
दीर्घायुश्च महात्मा च इति ब्रह्माब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration:
sarveṣāṁ brahmadaṇḍānāmavadhyo'yaṁ bhaviṣyati
dīrghāyuśca mahātmā ca iti brahmābravīdvacaḥ

translations.english: And Brahmă bestowed his blessings upon him saying that he will live long and will be invulnerable to all the weapons invented by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सुराणां तु वरैर्दृष्ट्वा ह्येनमलंकृतम्
चतुर्मुखस्तुष्टमुखो वायुमाह जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ surāṇāṁ tu varairdṛṣṭvā hyenamalaṁkṛtam
caturmukhastuṣṭamukho vāyumāha jagadguruḥ

translations.english: Afterwards seeing him equipped with the blessings of Gods. Caturmukha Brahmā, the teacher of the whole world told Väyu happily.

verses.sanskrit:
अमित्राणां भयकरो मित्राणामभयंकरः
अजेयो भविता तेऽत्र पुत्रो मारुतमारुतिः
verses.transliteration:
amitrāṇāṁ bhayakaro mitrāṇāmabhayaṁkaraḥ
ajeyo bhavitā te'tra putro mārutamārutiḥ

translations.english: Your son Hanuman, O Marut, will terrorise the foes and safeguard the friends. He will be in conquerable.

verses.sanskrit:
रावणोत्सादनार्थानि रामप्रीतिकराणि च
रोमहर्षकराण्येष कर्ता कर्माणि संयुगे
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇotsādanārthāni rāmaprītikarāṇi ca
romaharṣakarāṇyeṣa kartā karmāṇi saṁyuge

translations.english: In the war he will kill do such bewildering deeds as will destroy Råvana and please Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तमामन्त्र्य मारुतं तेऽमरैः सह
यथागतं ययुः सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tamāmantrya mārutaṁ te'maraiḥ saha
yathāgataṁ yayuḥ sarve pitāmahapurogamāḥ

translations.english: Having thus said all the Gods followed by Pitāmaha Brahmă went to the directions they came from with the permission of Vāyu.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽपि गन्धवहः पुत्रं प्रगृह्य गृहमानयत्
अञ्जनायास्तमाख्याय वरं दत्तं विनिःसृतः
verses.transliteration:
so'pi gandhavahaḥ putraṁ pragṛhya gṛhamānayat
añjanāyāstamākhyāya varaṁ dattaṁ viniḥsṛtaḥ

translations.english: The Vāyu also brought his son at his house. He went out having told Añjanā about it all.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राप्य राम वरानेष वरदानबलान्वितः
बलेनात्मनि संस्थेन सोऽपूर्यत यथार्णवः
verses.transliteration:
prāpya rāma varāneṣa varadānabalānvitaḥ
balenātmani saṁsthena so'pūryata yathārṇavaḥ

translations.english: Having obtained boons Hanumān became highly and powerful and accelerated in himself. He became full like ocean, O' Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
बलेनापूर्यमाणो हि एष वानरपुंगवः
आश्रमेषु महर्षीणामपराध्यति निर्भयः
verses.transliteration:
balenāpūryamāṇo hi eṣa vānarapuṁgavaḥ
āśrameṣu maharṣīṇāmaparādhyati nirbhayaḥ

translations.english: Having become powerful, the best of Mongoloids, started committing offences against Maharsis in their hermitages.

verses.sanskrit:
स्रुग्भाण्डानग्निहोत्रं च वल्कलानां च संचयान्
भग्नविच्छिन्नविध्वस्तान्सुशान्तानां करोत्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
srugbhāṇḍānagnihotraṁ ca valkalānāṁ ca saṁcayān
bhagnavicchinnavidhvastānsuśāntānāṁ karotyayam

translations.english: He broke the sacrificial ladles and vessels and also the heaps of banks belonging to the ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो महर्षयः क्रुद्धा भृग्वङ्गिरसवंशजाः
शेपुरेनं रघुश्रेष्ठ नातिक्रुद्धातिमन्यवः
verses.transliteration:
tato maharṣayaḥ kruddhā bhṛgvaṅgirasavaṁśajāḥ
śepurenaṁ raghuśreṣṭha nātikruddhātimanyavaḥ

translations.english: Even though prohibited by his father, Hanuman crossed the limits which enraged the Rșis of the lines of Bhțgu and Angirā and bestowed curse upon him. O best of the Raghus.

verses.sanskrit:
बाधसे यत्समाश्रित्य बलमस्मान्प्लवंगम
तद्दीर्घकालं वेत्तासि नास्माकं शापमोहितः
verses.transliteration:
bādhase yatsamāśritya balamasmānplavaṁgama
taddīrghakālaṁ vettāsi nāsmākaṁ śāpamohitaḥ

translations.english: That you will be unconscious of the prowess endowed with which you torment us. You will be conscious of your power only after being reminded of it.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्तु हृततेजौजा महर्षिवचनौजसा
एषो श्रमाणि नात्येति मृदुभावगतश्चरन्
verses.transliteration:
tatastu hṛtatejaujā maharṣivacanaujasā
eṣo śramāṇi nātyeti mṛdubhāvagataścaran

translations.english: Thereupon, having devoid of prowess and glory, he used to wander in the hermitages silently and decently.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ ऋक्षरजा नाम वालिसुग्रीवयोः पिता
सर्ववानरराजासीत्तेजसा इव भास्करः
verses.transliteration:
atha ṛkṣarajā nāma vālisugrīvayoḥ pitā
sarvavānararājāsīttejasā iva bhāskaraḥ

translations.english: There was a king of all Mongoloids named as Rkşarajā; the father of Vāli and Sugrīva. He was as glorious as the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु राज्यं चिरं कृत्वा वानराणां हरीश्वरः
ततस्त्वर्क्षरजा नाम कालधर्मेण संगतः
verses.transliteration:
sa tu rājyaṁ ciraṁ kṛtvā vānarāṇāṁ harīśvaraḥ
tatastvarkṣarajā nāma kāladharmeṇa saṁgataḥ

translations.english: The Śiva having ruled the country of Mongoloids for a long time, offered to Rkşarajā with the passage of time.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्नस्तमिते वाली मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रकोविदैः
पित्र्ये पदे कृतो राजा सुग्रीवो वालिनः पदे
verses.transliteration:
tasminnastamite vālī mantribhirmantrakovidaiḥ
pitrye pade kṛto rājā sugrīvo vālinaḥ pade

translations.english: After the death of Rkṣarāja, the ministers and the counsellors installed Väli at the place of his father and Sugrīva at the place of Vāli (the crown prince).

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवेण समं त्वस्य अद्वैधं छिद्रवर्जितम्
अहार्यं सख्यमभवदनिलस्य यथाग्निना
verses.transliteration:
sugrīveṇa samaṁ tvasya advaidhaṁ chidravarjitam
ahāryaṁ sakhyamabhavadanilasya yathāgninā

translations.english: From the childhood onward he developed an unbrokeable friendship with Sugrīva like air with the fire.

verses.sanskrit:
एष शापवशादेव न वेदबलमात्मनः
वालिसुग्रीवयोर्वैरं यदा राम समुत्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
eṣa śāpavaśādeva na vedabalamātmanaḥ
vālisugrīvayorvairaṁ yadā rāma samutthitam

translations.english: O Rāma! Hanuman could not be conscious of his power due to the curse at the time of altercations between Sugrīva and Vāli.

verses.sanskrit:
न ह्येष राम सुग्रीवो भ्राम्यमाणोऽपि वालिना
वेदयानो न च ह्येष बलमात्मनि मारुतिः
verses.transliteration:
na hyeṣa rāma sugrīvo bhrāmyamāṇo'pi vālinā
vedayāno na ca hyeṣa balamātmani mārutiḥ

translations.english: In fact, O Rama! wondering Sugriva also did not know about the might of Hanumān.

verses.sanskrit:
पराक्रमोत्साहमतिप्रतापैः; सौशील्यमाधुर्यनयानयैश्च
गाम्भीर्यचातुर्यसुवीर्यधैर्यै;र्हनूमतः कोऽप्यधिकोऽस्ति लोके
verses.transliteration:
parākramotsāhamatipratāpaiḥ; sauśīlyamādhuryanayānayaiśca
gāmbhīryacāturyasuvīryadhairyai;rhanūmataḥ ko'pyadhiko'sti loke

translations.english: Who is there in the world superior to Hanumān in respect of prowess, enthusiasm, intelligence, glory, well behavedness, sweetness, diplomacy or otherwise profundity, shrewdness, virility and patience.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ पुरा व्याकरणं ग्रहीष्य;न्सूर्योन्मुखः पृष्ठगमः कपीन्द्रः
उद्यद्गिरेरस्तगिरिं जगाम; ग्रन्थं महद्धारयदप्रमेयः
verses.transliteration:
asau purā vyākaraṇaṁ grahīṣya;nsūryonmukhaḥ pṛṣṭhagamaḥ kapīndraḥ
udyadgirerastagiriṁ jagāma; granthaṁ mahaddhārayadaprameyaḥ

translations.english: Having curiosity to learn grammar, the best of Mongols of immeasurable power went towards the hill of rising Sun facing Sunward with the view to ask queries and to master the great work.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवीविविक्षोरिव सागरस्य; लोकान्दिधक्षोरिव पावकस्य
लोकक्षयेष्वेव यथान्तकस्य; हनूमतः स्थास्यति कः पुरस्तात्
verses.transliteration:
pravīvivikṣoriva sāgarasya; lokāndidhakṣoriva pāvakasya
lokakṣayeṣveva yathāntakasya; hanūmataḥ sthāsyati kaḥ purastāt

translations.english: He actually rivals the teacher of gods, i.e. Bșhaspati in all the branches of learning and austerities. Who can stand before Hanuman who resembled like ocean likely to engulf the worlds and like fire likely to burn the worlds at the time of decreation of universo.

verses.sanskrit:
एषोऽपि चान्ये च महाकपीन्द्राः; सुग्रीवमैन्दद्विविदाः सनीलाः
सतारतारेयनलाः सरम्भा;स्त्वत्कारणाद्राम सुरैर्हि सृष्टाः
verses.transliteration:
eṣo'pi cānye ca mahākapīndrāḥ; sugrīvamaindadvividāḥ sanīlāḥ
satāratāreyanalāḥ sarambhā;stvatkāraṇādrāma surairhi sṛṣṭāḥ

translations.english: He and other chiefs of Mongols like Sugriva, Mainda, Dvivida, including Nīla, Tāra, Tāreya (son of Tara i.e. Angada), Nala as also Rambha were created by God for the sake of you O' Rāma!

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत्कथितं सर्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि
हनूमतो बालभावे कर्मैतत्कथितं मया
verses.transliteration:
tadetatkathitaṁ sarvaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripṛcchasi
hanūmato bālabhāve karmaitatkathitaṁ mayā

translations.english: All what was asked by you has been said. The facts of Hanumān performed in childhood has also been related by me.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्टः संभाषितश्चासि राम गच्छमहे वयम्
एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे ऋषयस्ते यथागतम्
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭaḥ saṁbhāṣitaścāsi rāma gacchamahe vayam
evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve ṛṣayaste yathāgatam

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent Agastya said to Rama: "O Rāma, we have all seen you and been honoured; now we shall depart.” Saying this, they, being honoured, repaired to their respective habitations.

verses.sanskrit:
विमृश्य च ततो रामो वयस्यमकुतोभयम्
प्रतर्दनं काशिपतिं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
vimṛśya ca tato rāmo vayasyamakutobhayam
pratardanaṁ kāśipatiṁ pariṣvajyedamabravīt

translations.english: Having bade adieu to his maternal uncle Rāma embraced his friend Pratardana, the undaunted king of Käśī and said.

verses.sanskrit:
दर्शिता भवता प्रीतिर्दर्शितं सौहृदं परम्
उद्योगश्च कृतो राजन्भरतेन त्वया सह
verses.transliteration:
darśitā bhavatā prītirdarśitaṁ sauhṛdaṁ param
udyogaśca kṛto rājanbharatena tvayā saha

translations.english: You have displayed your brotherly feelings and delight by making arrangements for my installation in the company of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्भवानद्य काशेयीं पुरीं वाराणसीं व्रज
रमणीयां त्वया गुप्तां सुप्राकारां सुतोरणाम्
verses.transliteration:
tadbhavānadya kāśeyīṁ purīṁ vārāṇasīṁ vraja
ramaṇīyāṁ tvayā guptāṁ suprākārāṁ sutoraṇām

translations.english: O king, do you now leave for your city Varanasi, highly picturesque, well-guarded, girt by strong walls on all sides and having welldecorated gateways.

verses.sanskrit:
एतावदुक्त्वा उत्थाय काकुत्स्थः परमासनात्
पर्यष्वजत धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतम्
verses.transliteration:
etāvaduktvā utthāya kākutsthaḥ paramāsanāt
paryaṣvajata dharmātmā nirantaramurogatam

translations.english: Saying this, Rama, the descendant of Kākutstha rose up from his seat and embraced him cordially.

verses.sanskrit:
विसृज्य तं वयस्यं स स्वागतान्पृथिवीपतीन्
प्रहसन्राघवो वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम्
verses.transliteration:
visṛjya taṁ vayasyaṁ sa svāgatānpṛthivīpatīn
prahasanrāghavo vākyamuvāca madhurākṣaram

translations.english: Having bade adieu to the king of Kasi, Rama, with a smiling countenance and sweet accents, said to the three hundred assembled kings.

verses.sanskrit:
भवतां प्रीतिरव्यग्रा तेजसा परिरक्षिता
धर्मश्च नियतो नित्यं सत्यं च भवतां सदा
verses.transliteration:
bhavatāṁ prītiravyagrā tejasā parirakṣitā
dharmaśca niyato nityaṁ satyaṁ ca bhavatāṁ sadā

translations.english: Being well protected by your own prowess, you have all displayed your great love for me. By your piety, truthfulness, sagacity and strength, the vicious-souled Rāvana has been slain. Forsooth, I am merely the instrument in the destruction of Rāvana-he has been slain by your strength.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्युक्तानां च सर्वेषां पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम्
कालो ह्यतीतः सुमहान्गमने रोचतां मतिः
verses.transliteration:
udyuktānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ pārthivānāṁ mahātmanām
kālo hyatītaḥ sumahāngamane rocatāṁ matiḥ

translations.english: Hearing that Sitā, the daughter of Janaka, had been stolen away from the forest the highminded Bharata did bring you all-but fortunately you were not constrained to go through miseries. High-minded as you are, you were all prepared for this work. Long since you have here. I think it better that you should proceed to your respective habitations.

verses.sanskrit:
ते प्रयाता महात्मानः पार्थिवाः सर्वतो दिशम्
कम्पयन्तो महीं वीराः स्वपुराणि प्रहृष्टवत्
verses.transliteration:
te prayātā mahātmānaḥ pārthivāḥ sarvato diśam
kampayanto mahīṁ vīrāḥ svapurāṇi prahṛṣṭavat

translations.english: Having agitated the earth with thousands of elephants and horses the kings proceeded to various quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतेन वयं पश्चात्समानीता निरर्थकम्
हता हि राक्षसास्तत्र पार्थिवैः स्युर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
bharatena vayaṁ paścātsamānītā nirarthakam
hatā hi rākṣasāstatra pārthivaiḥ syurna saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Those kings, proud and powerful, spoke to one another-We did not face Ravana~ the enemy of Răma; Bharata did uselessly invite us after the destruction of Rāvana. Had they brought us earlier, we would, forsooth, have slain him,

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य बाहुवीर्येण पालिता लक्ष्मणस्य च
सुखं पारे समुद्रस्य युध्येम विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya bāhuvīryeṇa pālitā lakṣmaṇasya ca
sukhaṁ pāre samudrasya yudhyema vigatajvarāḥ

translations.english: We would have, on the other side of the Ocean, well protected by the prowess of Rāma and Lakşmaņa, and freed from all disturbances, fought at pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
एताश्चान्याश्च राजानः कथास्तत्र सहस्रशः
कथयन्तः स्वराष्ट्राणि विविशुस्ते महारथाः
verses.transliteration:
etāścānyāśca rājānaḥ kathāstatra sahasraśaḥ
kathayantaḥ svarāṣṭrāṇi viviśuste mahārathāḥ

translations.english: Being thus delighted, all those assembled princes proceeded to their respective kingdoms, dwelling on these and various other topics.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महारथः
आदाय तानि रत्नानि अयोध्यामगमन्पुनः
verses.transliteration:
bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahārathaḥ
ādāya tāni ratnāni ayodhyāmagamanpunaḥ

translations.english: And taking all those jewels, the highly powerful Bharata, Lakşmaņa and ſatrughna returned to their own city. Having arrived at the picturesque city Ayodhyà those foremost of men, made presents of various jewels to Räma.

verses.sanskrit:
ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसो रामदत्तानि तान्यथ
शिरोभिर्धारयामासुर्बाहुभिश्च महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
te sarve hṛṣṭamanaso rāmadattāni tānyatha
śirobhirdhārayāmāsurbāhubhiśca mahābalāḥ

translations.english: And those highly powerful monkeys and night-rangers wore on their heads and arms those jewels conferred on them by Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
पपुश्चैव सुगन्धीनि मधूनि विविधानि च
मांसानि च सुमृष्टानि फलान्यास्वादयन्ति च
verses.transliteration:
papuścaiva sugandhīni madhūni vividhāni ca
māṁsāni ca sumṛṣṭāni phalānyāsvādayanti ca

translations.english: The monkeys lived there all happily feasting on fragrant honey, well-cooked meat and various fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं तेषां निवसतां मासः साग्रो गतस्तदा
मुहूर्तमिव तत्सर्वं रामभक्त्या समर्थयन्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ teṣāṁ nivasatāṁ māsaḥ sāgro gatastadā
muhūrtamiva tatsarvaṁ rāmabhaktyā samarthayan

translations.english: In this way they spent more than a month—but it appeared to them as a moment on account of their devotion to Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
रेमे रामः स तैः सार्धं वानरैः कामरूपिभिः
राजभिश्च महावीर्यै राक्षसैश्च महाबलैः
verses.transliteration:
reme rāmaḥ sa taiḥ sārdhaṁ vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ
rājabhiśca mahāvīryai rākṣasaiśca mahābalaiḥ

translations.english: He, too also spent his time happily with monkeys assuming shapes at will, the highly powerful Rakşasas and the mighty bears.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं तेषां ययौ मासो द्वितीयः शैशिरः सुखम्
वानराणां प्रहृष्टानां राक्षसानां च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ teṣāṁ yayau māso dvitīyaḥ śaiśiraḥ sukham
vānarāṇāṁ prahṛṣṭānāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: In this way, the delighted monkeys and Rāks asas spent the second winter month. Enjoying delight they thus spent their days happily in the city of Ayodhyā working to the welfare of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा स्म तेषां वसतामृक्षवानररक्षसाम्
राघवस्तु महातेजाः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tathā sma teṣāṁ vasatāmṛkṣavānararakṣasām
rāghavastu mahātejāḥ sugrīvamidamabravīt

translations.english: In this wise, the monkeys, bears and Rākşasas spent their days in Ayodhyä. Thereupon the highly effulgent Rāma, the descendant of Raghu said to Sugrīva.

verses.sanskrit:
गम्यतां सौम्य किष्किन्धां दुराधर्षां सुरासुरैः
पालयस्व सहामात्यै राज्यं निहतकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration:
gamyatāṁ saumya kiṣkindhāṁ durādharṣāṁ surāsuraiḥ
pālayasva sahāmātyai rājyaṁ nihatakaṇṭakam

translations.english: "O gentle one, proceeding to the city of Kiş kindhă, hard to be got at by the celestials and Asuras, do you reign there undisturbed with your councillors.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा च सुग्रीवं प्रशस्य च पुनः पुनः
विभीषणमथोवाच रामो मधुरया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā ca sugrīvaṁ praśasya ca punaḥ punaḥ
vibhīṣaṇamathovāca rāmo madhurayā girā

translations.english: Having said this and embraced Sugrīva again and again Rāma addressed Vibhișana with sweet accents.

verses.sanskrit:
मा च बुद्धिमधर्मे त्वं कुर्या राजन्कथंचन
बुद्धिमन्तो हि राजानो ध्रुवमश्नन्ति मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
mā ca buddhimadharme tvaṁ kuryā rājankathaṁcana
buddhimanto hi rājāno dhruvamaśnanti medinīm

translations.english: I know, you are cognisant of piety; the citizens, your councillors and your brother Kubera also love you; do you therefore go and govern Lankā piously, O king; never cherish any vile intention; the honest kings always enjoy the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं च नित्यशो राजन्सुग्रीवसहितस्त्वया
स्मर्तव्यः परया प्रीत्या गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ ca nityaśo rājansugrīvasahitastvayā
smartavyaḥ parayā prītyā gaccha tvaṁ vigatajvaraḥ

translations.english: And my only request to you, O king, is that you may with love remember me and Sugriva. Do you now proceed, divested of sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः
साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं प्रशशंसुः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā ṛkṣavānararākṣasāḥ
sādhu sādhviti kākutsthaṁ praśaśaṁsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rama, the bears, monkeys and Rākşasas repeatedly exclaimed glory to Rāma and said. 'O Rāma, having long arms, your understanding resemble that of the Self-Sprung, your prowess is equally wonderful and your beauty is also par excellence.”

verses.sanskrit:
तेषामेवं ब्रुवाणानां वानराणां च रक्षसाम्
हनूमान्प्रणतो भूत्वा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāmevaṁ bruvāṇānāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rakṣasām
hanūmānpraṇato bhūtvā rāghavaṁ vākyamabravīt

translations.english: The monkeys and Rakşasas having said this, Hanuman bowing, said to Rama "May my loving reverence be always in you, O king; may my devotion to you remain unshaken, O hero; and may my mind be not attached to any other thing. May my life remain in my body as long as the stories of Rama shall be in currency on earth. Let not this prove otherwise.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणं राजेन्द्रो हनूमन्तमथासनात्
उत्थाय च परिष्वज्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ rājendro hanūmantamathāsanāt
utthāya ca pariṣvajya vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: After Hanumān had said this, Rāma rose up from his throne and having embraced Hanumān affectionately said.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽस्य हारं चन्द्राभं मुच्य कण्ठात्स राघवः
वैदूर्यतरलं स्नेहादाबबन्धे हनूमति
verses.transliteration:
tato'sya hāraṁ candrābhaṁ mucya kaṇṭhātsa rāghavaḥ
vaidūryataralaṁ snehādābabandhe hanūmati

translations.english: Having said this, Rāma took off from his neck a chain 'set with sapphires brilliant as the rays of the moon and placed it round the neck of Hanuman.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनोरसि निबद्धेन हारेण स महाकपिः
रराज हेमशैलेन्द्रश्चन्द्रेणाक्रान्तमस्तकः
verses.transliteration:
tenorasi nibaddhena hāreṇa sa mahākapiḥ
rarāja hemaśailendraścandreṇākrāntamastakaḥ

translations.english: Like to the mountain Sumeru beautified by the rising of the moon on its summit, Hanumān, the foremost of monkeys, appeared graceful with the chain placed on his breast.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतदुत्थायोत्थाय वानराः
प्रणम्य शिरसा पादौ प्रजग्मुस्ते महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadutthāyotthāya vānarāḥ
praṇamya śirasā pādau prajagmuste mahābalāḥ

translations.english: And hearing the words of Rāghava, the highly powerful monkeys, one by one, saluted Rāma, touching his feet and went away.

verses.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवश्चैव रामेण परिष्वक्तो महाभुजः
विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतः
verses.transliteration:
sugrīvaścaiva rāmeṇa pariṣvakto mahābhujaḥ
vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā nirantaramurogataḥ

translations.english: Both Sugrīva and the virtuous-souled Vibhīşaņa embraced Rāma and three of them were beside themselves with tears.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे च ते बाष्पगलाः साश्रुनेत्रा विचेतसः
संमूढा इव दुःखेन त्यजन्ते राघवं तदा
verses.transliteration:
sarve ca te bāṣpagalāḥ sāśrunetrā vicetasaḥ
saṁmūḍhā iva duḥkhena tyajante rāghavaṁ tadā

translations.english: And other monkeys and Rākşasas were all moved with tears and sorrow to take leave of Rāma,

verses.sanskrit:
विसृज्य च महाबाहुरृक्षवानरराक्षसान्
भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखी सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
visṛjya ca mahābāhurṛkṣavānararākṣasān
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ pramumoda sukhī sukham

translations.english: Having bade adieu to bears, monkeys and Rākşasas the long-armed Rāma began to live happily in the company of his brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
अथापराह्णसमये भ्रातृभिः सह राघवः
शुश्राव मधुरां वाणीमन्तरिक्षात्प्रभाषिताम्
verses.transliteration:
athāparāhṇasamaye bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rāghavaḥ
śuśrāva madhurāṁ vāṇīmantarikṣātprabhāṣitām

translations.english: Thereupon afternoon, Lord Rāghava along with his brothers heard from the air the following sweet accents.

verses.sanskrit:
सौम्य राम निरीक्षस्व सौम्येन वदनेन माम्
कैलासशिखरात्प्राप्तं विद्धि मां पुष्करं प्रभो
verses.transliteration:
saumya rāma nirīkṣasva saumyena vadanena mām
kailāsaśikharātprāptaṁ viddhi māṁ puṣkaraṁ prabho

translations.english: O gentle Rāma, do you with a delighted countenance behold me. O lord, know me as Puşpaka coming from the abode of Kuberu.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्जितस्त्वं नरेन्द्रेण राघवेण महात्मना
निहत्य युधि दुर्धर्षं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
nirjitastvaṁ narendreṇa rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
nihatya yudhi durdharṣaṁ rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam

translations.english: O foremost of men, at your command I did go there to carry him. But he said to me. “Having slain the irrepressible Rāvaņa in battle the highsouled Rama, the foremost of men, has conquered you.

verses.sanskrit:
ममापि परमा प्रीतिर्हते तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि
रावणे सगणे सौम्य सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे
verses.transliteration:
mamāpi paramā prītirhate tasmindurātmani
rāvaṇe sagaṇe saumya saputrāmātyabāndhave

translations.english: I have greatly been delighted on the destruction of the vicious-souled Rāvana, with his relatives, sons and friends.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं रामेण लङ्कायां निर्जितः परमात्मना
वह सौम्य तमेव त्वमहमाज्ञापयामि ते
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ rāmeṇa laṅkāyāṁ nirjitaḥ paramātmanā
vaha saumya tameva tvamahamājñāpayāmi te

translations.english: O gentle one, the great Rāma has conquered you in Lanka. I permit you, therefore to convey him.

verses.sanskrit:
एष मे परमः कामो यत्त्वं राघवनन्दनम्
वहेर्लोकस्य संयानं गच्छस्व विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo yattvaṁ rāghavanandanam
vaherlokasya saṁyānaṁ gacchasva vigatajvaraḥ

translations.english: You are the fit conveyance for traversing all regions. But my earnest desire is that you should take Rāma, the descendant of Raghu. Do, you therefore go there at pleasure without any sorrow.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छासनमहं ज्ञात्वा धनदस्य महात्मनः
त्वत्सकाशं पुनः प्राप्तः स एवं प्रतिगृह्ण माम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchāsanamahaṁ jñātvā dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ
tvatsakāśaṁ punaḥ prāptaḥ sa evaṁ pratigṛhṇa mām

translations.english: Hearing this command of the high-souled Kubera I have come to you. Do you fearlessly accept me..

verses.sanskrit:
गम्यतां च यथाकाममागच्छेस्त्वं यदा स्मरे
एवमस्त्विति रामेण विसृष्टः पुष्पकः पुनः
अभिप्रेतां दिशं प्रायात्पुष्पकः पुष्पभूषितः
verses.transliteration:
gamyatāṁ ca yathākāmamāgacchestvaṁ yadā smare
evamastviti rāmeṇa visṛṣṭaḥ puṣpakaḥ punaḥ
abhipretāṁ diśaṁ prāyātpuṣpakaḥ puṣpabhūṣitaḥ

translations.english: Having been adored by Rāma and saying ‘so be it' Pușpaka L.oceeded towards its wished for direction.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमन्तर्हिते तस्मिन्पुष्पके विविधात्मनि
भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
evamantarhite tasminpuṣpake vividhātmani
bharataḥ prāñjalirvākyamuvāca raghunandanam

translations.english: And the holy Puşpaka car having thus vanquished, Bharata with folded palms, said to Rama, the delight of Raghu.

verses.sanskrit:
अनामयाच्च मर्त्यानां साग्रो मासो गतो ह्ययम्
जीर्णानामपि सत्त्वानां मृत्युर्नायाति राघव
verses.transliteration:
anāmayācca martyānāṁ sāgro māso gato hyayam
jīrṇānāmapi sattvānāṁ mṛtyurnāyāti rāghava

translations.english: O hero, during your divine administration, we have seen many inhuman creatures and objects speak like men. During all these months since your installation subjects have not suffered from any disease. Even the most aged animals have not met with death. The female, without any risk, have been giving birth to children and all people are plump and delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
एता वाचः सुमधुरा भरतेन समीरिताः
श्रुत्वा रामो मुदा युक्तः प्रमुमोद सुखी सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
etā vācaḥ sumadhurā bharatena samīritāḥ
śrutvā rāmo mudā yuktaḥ pramumoda sukhī sukham

translations.english: Hearing those sweet accents given vent to by Bharata, Rāma, the foremost of kings was greatly delighted

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र तत्र वनोद्देशे वैदूर्यमणिसंनिभैः
शाद्वलैः परमोपेताः पुष्पितद्रुमसंयुताः
verses.transliteration:
tatra tatra vanoddeśe vaidūryamaṇisaṁnibhaiḥ
śādvalaiḥ paramopetāḥ puṣpitadrumasaṁyutāḥ

translations.english: And the forest was encompassed by stone walls and in the-irtside were dwelling many a Sárdula bird resembling Vaiduryas. All the trees in the forest were filled with flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
मांसानि च विचित्राणि फलानि विविधानि च
रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं किंकरास्तूर्णमाहरन्
verses.transliteration:
māṁsāni ca vicitrāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca
rāmasyābhyavahārārthaṁ kiṁkarāstūrṇamāharan

translations.english: And in rio time the servants brought for him well-cooked meat and various fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
उपनृत्यन्ति राजानं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः
बालाश्च रूपवत्यश्च स्त्रियः पानवशं गताः
verses.transliteration:
upanṛtyanti rājānaṁ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ
bālāśca rūpavatyaśca striyaḥ pānavaśaṁ gatāḥ

translations.english: The intelligent and beautiful females being intoxicated after taking wine, and well-skilled in the art of singing and dancing, began to dance before Råma. The virtuous-souled Rāma, the foremost of those who know how to please, satisfied those beautiful damsels adorned with various ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं रामो मुदा युक्तः सीतां सुरुचिराननाम्
रमयामास वैदेहीमहन्यहनि देववत्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ rāmo mudā yuktaḥ sītāṁ surucirānanām
ramayāmāsa vaidehīmahanyahani devavat

translations.english: Being greatly delighted the celestial-like Rama pleased everyday Sītā resembling a celestial damsel.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वाह्णे पौरकृत्यानि कृत्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित्
शेषं दिवसभागार्धमन्तःपुरगतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvāhṇe paurakṛtyāni kṛtvā dharmeṇa dharmavit
śeṣaṁ divasabhāgārdhamantaḥpuragato'bhavat

translations.english: Once on a morning time, having performed all the religious ceremonies, in the fore part of the day, Rāma, to spend the evening, entered the inner apartment.

verses.sanskrit:
सीता च देवकार्याणि कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकानि तु
श्वश्रूणामविशेषेण सर्वासां प्राञ्जलिः स्थिता
verses.transliteration:
sītā ca devakāryāṇi kṛtvā paurvāhṇikāni tu
śvaśrūṇāmaviśeṣeṇa sarvāsāṁ prāñjaliḥ sthitā

translations.english: Sītā, too, having performed all religious ceremonies of morning, first in all, attended to the service of her mother-in-law.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो राममुपागच्छद्विचित्रबहुभूषणा
त्रिविष्टपे सहस्राक्षमुपविष्टं यथा शची
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmamupāgacchadvicitrabahubhūṣaṇā
triviṣṭape sahasrākṣamupaviṣṭaṁ yathā śacī

translations.english: Thereupon wearing a beautifully coloured cloth and being adorned with various ornaments Sītā appeared before Rāma like to ſací approaching the king of celestials in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः पत्नीं कल्याणेन समन्विताम्
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ patnīṁ kalyāṇena samanvitām
praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe sādhu sādhviti cābravīt

translations.english: And beholding the auspicious signs of pregnancy in his souse Rāma attained to excessive delight.

verses.sanskrit:
अपत्यलाभो वैदेहि ममायं समुपस्थितः
किमिच्छसि हि तद्ब्रूहि कः कामः क्रियतां तव
verses.transliteration:
apatyalābho vaidehi mamāyaṁ samupasthitaḥ
kimicchasi hi tadbrūhi kaḥ kāmaḥ kriyatāṁ tava

translations.english: Thereupon he said to the beautiful Sītā resembling a celestial damsel:-"0 Vaidehi, signs of pregnancy are manifest in you. What desires of your can we satisfy?"

verses.sanskrit:
तथेति च प्रतिज्ञातं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
विस्रब्धा भव वैदेहि श्वो गमिष्यस्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration:
tatheti ca pratijñātaṁ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
visrabdhā bhava vaidehi śvo gamiṣyasyasaṁśayam

translations.english: Whereto replied Rāma of unwearied actions, saying 'so be it.' Believe me, O Vaidehi, that you shall undoubtedly go there to-morrow.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम्
मध्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम सुहृद्वृतः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu kākutstho maithilīṁ janakātmajām
madhyakakṣāntaraṁ rāmo nirjagāma suhṛdvṛtaḥ

translations.english: Having thus addressed Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, then issued out of the inner apartment and entered the middle one filled with his friends.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रोपविष्टं राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः
कथानां बहुरूपाणां हास्यकाराः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
tatropaviṣṭaṁ rājānamupāsante vicakṣaṇāḥ
kathānāṁ bahurūpāṇāṁ hāsyakārāḥ samantataḥ

translations.english: Rāma having taken his seat there, the experienced councillors encircling him began to dwell upon many amusing stories.

verses.sanskrit:
एते कथा बहुविधा परिहाससमन्विताः
कथयन्ति स्म संहृष्टा राघवस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
ete kathā bahuvidhā parihāsasamanvitāḥ
kathayanti sma saṁhṛṣṭā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Vijaya, Madhumatta, Kasyapa, Mangala, Kula, Surajin, Kaliya, Bhadra Dantavaktra, Sumāgadha-all delightedly began to introduce many amusing talks before the high-souled Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
मामाश्रितानि कान्याहुः पौरजानपदा जनाः
किं च सीतां समाश्रित्य भरतं किं नु लक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
māmāśritāni kānyāhuḥ paurajānapadā janāḥ
kiṁ ca sītāṁ samāśritya bharataṁ kiṁ nu lakṣmaṇam

translations.english: Thereupon Räma incidentally addressed them saying, “O Bhadra, how do the inhabitants of the city and provinces talk about Sītā, Bharata, Laksmana, Satrughna and the mother Kaikeyi? The kings, when they deviate from the paths of justice, become objects of censure in the houses of men and even in the forests as well.”

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्ते तु रामेण भद्रः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्
स्थिताः कथाः शुभा राजन्वर्तन्ते पुरवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
evamukte tu rāmeṇa bhadraḥ prāñjalirabravīt
sthitāḥ kathāḥ śubhā rājanvartante puravāsinām

translations.english: Rāma having said this, Bhadra with folded hands replied: "O king, the citizens speak many good things about you; besides they dilate upon many things in their own houses regarding your conquest acquired by the destruction of the Ten-necked demon."

verses.sanskrit:
शुभाशुभानि वाक्यानि यान्याहुः पुरवासिनः
श्रुत्वेदानीं शुभं कुर्यां न कुर्यामशुभानि च
verses.transliteration:
śubhāśubhāni vākyāni yānyāhuḥ puravāsinaḥ
śrutvedānīṁ śubhaṁ kuryāṁ na kuryāmaśubhāni ca

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bhadra, Rama said:“Without hiding anything, do you relate every thing from the beginning vent to by the citizens. Hearing the good and bad opinions of the citizens I shall desist from bad actions and engage in good ones.

verses.sanskrit:
कथयस्व च विस्रब्धो निर्भयो विगतज्वरः
कथयन्ते यथा पौरा जना जनपदेषु च
verses.transliteration:
kathayasva ca visrabdho nirbhayo vigatajvaraḥ
kathayante yathā paurā janā janapadeṣu ca

translations.english: Whatever citizens say the vicious actions of mine in the city, relate to me confidently and fearlessly.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु भद्रः सुरुचिरं वचः
प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुं प्राञ्जलिः सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
rāghaveṇaivamuktastu bhadraḥ suruciraṁ vacaḥ
pratyuvāca mahābāhuṁ prāñjaliḥ susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the sweet accents of Rama, Bhadra, with a quiescent mind and folded palms, said.

verses.sanskrit:
शृणु राजन्यथा पौराः कथयन्ति शुभाशुभम्
चत्वरापणरथ्यासु वनेषूपवनेषु च
verses.transliteration:
śṛṇu rājanyathā paurāḥ kathayanti śubhāśubham
catvarāpaṇarathyāsu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca

translations.english: Hear, o king, I shall relate to you all those unpleasant things frequently dwelt upon by people in court-yards, markets, public roads, forests and gardens.

verses.sanskrit:
दुष्करं कृतवान्रामः समुद्रे सेतुबन्धनम्
अकृतं पूर्वकैः कैश्चिद्देवैरपि सदानवैः
verses.transliteration:
duṣkaraṁ kṛtavānrāmaḥ samudre setubandhanam
akṛtaṁ pūrvakaiḥ kaiściddevairapi sadānavaiḥ

translations.english: Indeed Rāma has accomplished a wonderfully hard work; our ancestors, the celestials, the Dānavas none heard of constructing a bridge over the ocean?

verses.sanskrit:
रावणश्च दुराधर्षो हतः सबलवाहनः
वानराश्च वशं नीता ऋक्षाश्च सह राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration:
rāvaṇaśca durādharṣo hataḥ sabalavāhanaḥ
vānarāśca vaśaṁ nītā ṛkṣāśca saha rākṣasaiḥ

translations.english: Rāma has slain the irrepressible Rāvana with his army and brought over the monkeys, bears and Rākşasas to his own side.

verses.sanskrit:
हत्वा च रावणं युद्धे सीतामाहृत्य राघवः
अमर्षं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा स्ववेश्म पुनरानयत्
verses.transliteration:
hatvā ca rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe sītāmāhṛtya rāghavaḥ
amarṣaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā svaveśma punarānayat

translations.english: Having discomfitted Rāvana, in the encounter Rāma has released Şītā, but not being the least enraged on account of her being touched by Rāvaņa he has brought to her his own city.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा वाचो वदन्ति पुरवासिनः
नगरेषु च सर्वेषु राजञ्जनपदेषु च
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bahuvidhā vāco vadanti puravāsinaḥ
nagareṣu ca sarveṣu rājañjanapadeṣu ca

translations.english: O King, the citizens thus talk of many types in every corner of cities and provinces.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यैतद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा राघवः परमार्तवत्
उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदः कथमेतन्निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyaitadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā rāghavaḥ paramārtavat
uvāca sarvānsuhṛdaḥ kathametannivedyatām

translations.english: Hearings those words of Bhadra, Raghava was greatly sorry and asked his friends “Do the subjects thus talk about me?”

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे तु शिरसा भूमावभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च
प्रत्यूचू राघवं दीनमेवमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
sarve tu śirasā bhūmāvabhivādya praṇamya ca
pratyūcū rāghavaṁ dīnamevametanna saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon lowering their heads and saluting him they all said to Rāghava, of a depressed mind-“For sooth, the subjects thus talk about.” Thereupon Kakutstha, the slayer of enemies, bearing all those words, dismissed his friends.

verses.sanskrit:
विसृज्य तु सुहृद्वर्गं बुद्ध्या निश्चित्य राघवः
समीपे द्वाःस्थमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
visṛjya tu suhṛdvargaṁ buddhyā niścitya rāghavaḥ
samīpe dvāḥsthamāsīnamidaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: Having sent away his friends and determined what to do, Rāma, the delight of the Råghus, commanded the warder, who was seated hard by, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
शीघ्रमानय सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्
भरतं च महाबाहुं शत्रुघ्नं चापराजितम्
verses.transliteration:
śīghramānaya saumitriṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ śubhalakṣaṇam
bharataṁ ca mahābāhuṁ śatrughnaṁ cāparājitam

translations.english: Do you bring in no time, Lakşmaņa, a son of Sumitrā, gifted with auspicious marks, alongwith great Bharata and the irrepressible Šatrughna.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा द्वाःस्थो मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः
लक्ष्मणस्य गृहं गत्वा प्रविवेशानिवारितः
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā dvāḥstho mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ
lakṣmaṇasya gṛhaṁ gatvā praviveśānivāritaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāma and placing his folded palms on his head the warder reached house of Lakşmaņa and unobstructed entered therein.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच च तदा वाक्यं वर्धयित्वा कृताञ्जलिः
द्रष्टुमिच्छति राजा त्वां गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration:
uvāca ca tadā vākyaṁ vardhayitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ
draṣṭumicchati rājā tvāṁ gamyatāṁ tatra mā ciram

translations.english: And having saluted him, with folded palms he said to the high-souled Laksmana and:-"The King wishes to behold you-do you soon go there.

verses.sanskrit:
बाढमित्येव सौमित्रिः श्रुत्वा राघवशासनम्
प्राद्रवद्रथमारुह्य राघवस्य निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration:
bāḍhamityeva saumitriḥ śrutvā rāghavaśāsanam
prādravadrathamāruhya rāghavasya niveśanam

translations.english: Thereupon being apprised of Rāghava's command and saying 'so be it.' Saumitri ascended his car and went speedily towards Rāma's abode.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयान्तं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा द्वाःस्थो भरतमन्तिकात्
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration:
prayāntaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā dvāḥstho bharatamantikāt
uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ rājā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati

translations.english: Having beheld Lakşmana's departure the warder humbly went to Bharata and having blessed him with folded hands said: “The King wishes to see you."

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा द्वाःस्थाद्रामसमीरितम्
उत्पपातासनात्तूर्णं पद्भ्यामेव ततोऽगमत्
verses.transliteration:
bharatastu vacaḥ śrutvā dvāḥsthādrāmasamīritam
utpapātāsanāttūrṇaṁ padbhyāmeva tato'gamat

translations.english: Hearing of the command of Rāma from the warder, the highly powerful Bharata at once got up from his seat and proceeded on foot.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा प्रयान्तं भरतं त्वरमाणः कृताञ्जलिः
शत्रुघ्नभवनं गत्वा ततो वाक्यं जगाद ह
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā prayāntaṁ bharataṁ tvaramāṇaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
śatrughnabhavanaṁ gatvā tato vākyaṁ jagāda ha

translations.english: Seeing Bharata's departure the warder speedily went to the mansion of Satrughna and with folded hands said.

verses.sanskrit:
एह्यागच्छ रघुश्रेष्ठ राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति
गतो हि लक्ष्मणः पूर्वं भरतश्च महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
ehyāgaccha raghuśreṣṭha rājā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati
gato hi lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvaṁ bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: "Do you come, O foremost Raghus, the King wish to behold you.” Lakşmaņa and Bharata are also there.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य शत्रुघ्नो रामशासनम्
शिरसा वन्द्य धरणीं प्रययौ यत्र राघवः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya śatrughno rāmaśāsanam
śirasā vandya dharaṇīṁ prayayau yatra rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of the warder Satrughna lowered his head and rising up speedily proceeded to Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
कुमारानागताञ्श्रुत्वा चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः
अवाक्शिरा दीनमना द्वाःस्थं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
kumārānāgatāñśrutvā cintāvyākulitendriyaḥ
avākśirā dīnamanā dvāḥsthaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: So long Rāma was engaged poorly in anxious meditation with his crown bent downwards. Informed of the princes' arrival he commanded the warder, “Do you soon bring the princes here. My life depends upon them. They are my dearest life.

verses.sanskrit:
आज्ञप्तास्तु नरेन्द्रेण कुमाराः शुक्लवाससः
प्रह्वाः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा विविशुस्ते समाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
ājñaptāstu narendreṇa kumārāḥ śuklavāsasaḥ
prahvāḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā viviśuste samāhitāḥ

translations.english: Having obtained Rāma's command, the princes, clothed in white raiment, entered there, with folded palms and quiescent mind.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु दृष्ट्वा मुखं तस्य सग्रहं शशिनं यथा
संध्यागतमिवादित्यं प्रभया परिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration:
te tu dṛṣṭvā mukhaṁ tasya sagrahaṁ śaśinaṁ yathā
saṁdhyāgatamivādityaṁ prabhayā parivarjitam

translations.english: Having entered there they saw that Rāma's countenance was shorn of beauty like to the moon possessed by Rāhu, the setting sun and the withered lotus and his eyes were full of tears.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽभिवाद्य त्वरिताः पादौ रामस्य मूर्धभिः
तस्थुः समाहिताः सर्वे रामश्चाश्रूण्यवर्तयत्
verses.transliteration:
tato'bhivādya tvaritāḥ pādau rāmasya mūrdhabhiḥ
tasthuḥ samāhitāḥ sarve rāmaścāśrūṇyavartayat

translations.english: Then having approached him quickly, and saluted his feet they all anxiously sat there. Rāma also wiped off his tears.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यामुत्थाप्य च महाभुजः
आसनेष्वाध्वमित्युक्त्वा ततो वाक्यं जगाद ह
verses.transliteration:
tānpariṣvajya bāhubhyāmutthāpya ca mahābhujaḥ
āsaneṣvādhvamityuktvā tato vākyaṁ jagāda ha

translations.english: Thereupon having embraced them with his arms he raised up the princes and pressed them to take their seats. Then he said.

verses.sanskrit:
भवन्तः कृतशास्त्रार्था बुद्धौ च परिनिष्ठिताः
संभूय च मदर्थोऽयमन्वेष्टव्यो नरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration:
bhavantaḥ kṛtaśāstrārthā buddhau ca pariniṣṭhitāḥ
saṁbhūya ca madartho'yamanveṣṭavyo nareśvarāḥ

translations.english: "You are mine all; you constitute my life; O princes, I am governing the kingdom gained by you; you are all learned, pious and intelligent. Do you follow the duties I point out."

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां दीनचेतसाम्
उवाच वाक्यं काकुत्स्थो मुखेन परिशुष्यता
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ samupaviṣṭānāṁ sarveṣāṁ dīnacetasām
uvāca vākyaṁ kākutstho mukhena pariśuṣyatā

translations.english: The princes were all waiting with a poorly heart when Rama, with a dried countenance, addressed them, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे शृणुत भद्रं वो मा कुरुध्वं मनोऽन्यथा
पौराणां मम सीतायां यादृशी वर्तते कथा
verses.transliteration:
sarve śṛṇuta bhadraṁ vo mā kurudhvaṁ mano'nyathā
paurāṇāṁ mama sītāyāṁ yādṛśī vartate kathā

translations.english: May good betide you-do not act against my desire. Hear, what the citizens have been talking about me and Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
पौरापवादः सुमहांस्तथा जनपदस्य च
वर्तते मयि बीभत्सः स मे मर्माणि कृन्तति
verses.transliteration:
paurāpavādaḥ sumahāṁstathā janapadasya ca
vartate mayi bībhatsaḥ sa me marmāṇi kṛntati

translations.english: The citizens as well as the inhabitants of provinces have been showering censures upon me. I have been pierced to the very vitals by those accusations.

verses.sanskrit:
जानासि हि यथा सौम्य दण्डके विजने वने
रावणेन हृता सीता स च विध्वंसितो मया
verses.transliteration:
jānāsi hi yathā saumya daṇḍake vijane vane
rāvaṇena hṛtā sītā sa ca vidhvaṁsito mayā

translations.english: I have been born in the illustrious family by the high-souled Ikşvākus. Sītā has been born also in the holy family of the great Janaka; gentle Lakṣmaṇa, you know how in the solitary forest of Dandaka, Sītā was stolen away by Rāvana and how have I slain him.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्यक्षं तव सौमित्रे देवानां हव्यवाहनः
अपापां मैथिलीमाह वायुश्चाकाशगोचरः
verses.transliteration:
pratyakṣaṁ tava saumitre devānāṁ havyavāhanaḥ
apāpāṁ maithilīmāha vāyuścākāśagocaraḥ

translations.english: To secure my confidence, Sītā, in your very presence, entered fire. At that time, O Saumitri, fire, carrying sacrificial oblations and the wind of the sky declared Sītā's innocence before the celestials. in the presence of all the Rşis and gods, the Sun and Moon announced the innocence of the daughter of Janaka.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं शुद्धसमाचारा देवगन्धर्वसंनिधौ
लङ्काद्वीपे महेन्द्रेण मम हस्ते निवेशिता
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ śuddhasamācārā devagandharvasaṁnidhau
laṅkādvīpe mahendreṇa mama haste niveśitā

translations.english: Indra, the king of the celestials, himself handed over the chaste Sītā to me in the island of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तरात्मा च मे वेत्ति सीतां शुद्धां यशस्विनीम्
ततो गृहीत्वा वैदेहीमयोध्यामहमागतः
verses.transliteration:
antarātmā ca me vetti sītāṁ śuddhāṁ yaśasvinīm
tato gṛhītvā vaidehīmayodhyāmahamāgataḥ

translations.english: My mind know Sītā as chaste for ever. So, at that time, I came back to Ayodhya with Sita.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं तु मे महान्वादः शोकश्च हृदि वर्तते
पौरापवादः सुमहांस्तथा जनपदस्य च
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ tu me mahānvādaḥ śokaśca hṛdi vartate
paurāpavādaḥ sumahāṁstathā janapadasya ca

translations.english: But now a great sorrow consequent upon the censure of the citizens and villagers has pierced my heart.

verses.sanskrit:
अकीर्तिर्यस्य गीयेत लोके भूतस्य कस्यचित्
पतत्येवाधमाँल्लोकान्यावच्छब्दः स कीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration:
akīrtiryasya gīyeta loke bhūtasya kasyacit
patatyevādhamā̐llokānyāvacchabdaḥ sa kīrtyate

translations.english: He, who is notorious on this earth and as long as that notoriety remains current, is classed among the vile.

verses.sanskrit:
अकीर्तिर्निन्द्यते दैवैः कीर्तिर्देवेषु पूज्यते
कीर्त्यर्थं च समारम्भः सर्व एव महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
akīrtirnindyate daivaiḥ kīrtirdeveṣu pūjyate
kīrtyarthaṁ ca samārambhaḥ sarva eva mahātmanām

translations.english: Even the celestials speak ill of bad name whereas fame is adored in all the regions. Therefore the high-souled exert their best to acquire reputations.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां युष्मान्वा पुरुषर्षभाः
अपवादभयाद्भीतः किं पुनर्जनकात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration:
apyahaṁ jīvitaṁ jahyāṁ yuṣmānvā puruṣarṣabhāḥ
apavādabhayādbhītaḥ kiṁ punarjanakātmajām

translations.english: O foremost of men, what to speak of the daughter of Janaka-I can even renounce my life and yourselves in fear of a bad name.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्भवन्तः पश्यन्तु पतितं शोकसागरे
न हि पश्याम्यहं भूयः किंचिद्दुःखमतोऽधिकम्
verses.transliteration:
tasmādbhavantaḥ paśyantu patitaṁ śokasāgare
na hi paśyāmyahaṁ bhūyaḥ kiṁcidduḥkhamato'dhikam

translations.english: Do you therefore perceive into what great abyss of sorrow and ill-fame I have fallen. Up to this time I have never experienced such a mighty grief.

verses.sanskrit:
श्वस्त्वं प्रभाते सौमित्रे सुमन्त्राधिष्ठितं रथम्
आरुह्य सीतामारोप्य विषयान्ते समुत्सृज
verses.transliteration:
śvastvaṁ prabhāte saumitre sumantrādhiṣṭhitaṁ ratham
āruhya sītāmāropya viṣayānte samutsṛja

translations.english: Do you, O Laksmana, next morning, ascending the car driven by Sumantra, take away Sītā to another country.

verses.sanskrit:
गङ्गायास्तु परे पारे वाल्मीकेः सुमहात्मनः
आश्रमो दिव्यसंकाशस्तमसातीरमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration:
gaṅgāyāstu pare pāre vālmīkeḥ sumahātmanaḥ
āśramo divyasaṁkāśastamasātīramāśritaḥ

translations.english: There is a picturesque hermitage of the highsouled Vālmīki situate on the Tamasā on the other side of the river Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैनां विजने कक्षे विसृज्य रघुनन्दन
शीघ्रमागच्छ सौमित्रे कुरुष्व वचनं मम
verses.transliteration:
tatraināṁ vijane kakṣe visṛjya raghunandana
śīghramāgaccha saumitre kuruṣva vacanaṁ mama

translations.english: Do you, O delight of Raghus, soon come back, leaving behind Sitā in that lonely place. Do you carry out my words. Do you not speak anything regarding Sīta's banishment.

verses.sanskrit:
मानयन्तु भवन्तो मां यदि मच्छासने स्थिताः
इतोऽद्य नीयतां सीता कुरुष्व वचनं मम
verses.transliteration:
mānayantu bhavanto māṁ yadi macchāsane sthitāḥ
ito'dya nīyatāṁ sītā kuruṣva vacanaṁ mama

translations.english: For my life and arms, do you not proffer any request to me regarding this. If so, you shall only endanger my well-being and I shall ever regard you as my enemies. If you obey my behest's, do you honour my words now. Do you take away Sītă from here.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वमुक्तोऽहमनया गङ्गातीरे महाश्रमान्
पश्येयमिति तस्याश्च कामः संवर्त्यतामयम्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvamukto'hamanayā gaṅgātīre mahāśramān
paśyeyamiti tasyāśca kāmaḥ saṁvartyatāmayam

translations.english: Ere this Sītā had communicated her intention of beholding the hermitages of ascetics on the banks of the Gangā. Let that desire of hers be now satisfied.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो बाष्पेण पिहितेक्षणः
प्रविवेश स धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu kākutstho bāṣpeṇa pihitekṣaṇaḥ
praviveśa sa dharmātmā bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ

translations.english: While saying this, the eyes of the virtuoussouled Rāma were covered with tears. Sighing hard like to an elephant, he, with a heart stricken with grief, departed to his own quarter in the company of his brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः
सुमन्त्रमब्रवीद्वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता
verses.transliteration:
tato rajanyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ
sumantramabravīdvākyaṁ mukhena pariśuṣyatā

translations.english: The night being over, Lakṣmaṇa, with a poor heart and dried countenance, addressed Sumantra, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सारथे तुरगाञ्शीघ्रं योजयस्व रथोत्तमे
