yāmeva rātriṁ śatrughnaḥ parṇaśālāṁ samāviśat
tāmeva rātriṁ sītāpi prasūtā dārakadvayam

translations.english: On the same night ſatrughna housed himself in a thatched cottage Sitā gave birth to twin sons.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽर्धरात्रसमये बालका मुनिदारकाः
वाल्मीकेः प्रियमाचख्युः सीतायाः प्रसवं शुभम्
तस्य रक्षां महातेजः कुरु भूतविनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
tato'rdharātrasamaye bālakā munidārakāḥ
vālmīkeḥ priyamācakhyuḥ sītāyāḥ prasavaṁ śubham
tasya rakṣāṁ mahātejaḥ kuru bhūtavināśinīm

translations.english: In the midnight the Muni boys came to Vālmīki and communicated to him this auspicious intelligence, saying. “O illustrious Sir, the beloved spouse of Rāma has given birth to two sons; do you so protect them that evil spirits not injure them."

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनिर्हर्षमुपागमत्
भूतघ्नीं चाकरोत्ताभ्यां रक्षां रक्षोविनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā munirharṣamupāgamat
bhūtaghnīṁ cākarottābhyāṁ rakṣāṁ rakṣovināśinīm

translations.english: Hearing those words the highly effulgent Vālmīki went there and attained to great on beholding those two highly effulgent sons, resembling the newly risen sun and the celestials. Thereupon he made arrangements against the oppression of ghosts and goblins.

verses.sanskrit:
कुशमुष्टिमुपादाय लवं चैव तु स द्विजः
वाल्मीकिः प्रददौ ताभ्यां रक्षां भूतविनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
kuśamuṣṭimupādāya lavaṁ caiva tu sa dvijaḥ
vālmīkiḥ pradadau tābhyāṁ rakṣāṁ bhūtavināśinīm

translations.english: Thereupon taking Kuśa (the upper part of the grass) and Lava (the lower part) the great ascetic Vālmīki made those arrangements.

verses.sanskrit:
ते रक्षां जगृहुस्तां च मुनिहस्तात्समाहिताः
अकुर्वंश्च ततो रक्षां तयोर्विगतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration:
te rakṣāṁ jagṛhustāṁ ca munihastātsamāhitāḥ
akurvaṁśca tato rakṣāṁ tayorvigatakalmaṣāḥ

translations.english: Thereupon reverentially taking from the hands of Vālmīki and Kuśa Lava, the means of protection, the elderly ladies engaged in guarding them.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्धारात्रे तु शत्रुघ्नः शुश्राव सुमहत्प्रियम्
पर्णशालां गतो रात्रौ दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्येति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
ardhārātre tu śatrughnaḥ śuśrāva sumahatpriyam
parṇaśālāṁ gato rātrau diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti cābravīt

translations.english: Hearing the Sītā without any trouble had given birth to two sons and elderly female ascetics had been engaged in protecting them and bearing the chanting of Råma's glories in the midnight, Satrughna thought within himself.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तस्य प्रहृष्टस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः
व्यतीता वार्षिकी रात्रिः श्रावणी लघुविक्रमा
verses.transliteration:
tathā tasya prahṛṣṭasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ
vyatītā vārṣikī rātriḥ śrāvaṇī laghuvikramā

translations.english: "Blessed it is that Sītā has given birth to two sons.” And with this joy the live long night of Śrāvaņa passed away in no time.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभाते तु महावीर्यः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं क्रमम्
मुनिं प्राञ्जलिरामन्त्र्य प्रायात्पश्चान्मुखः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
prabhāte tu mahāvīryaḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikaṁ kramam
muniṁ prāñjalirāmantrya prāyātpaścānmukhaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Having performed the morning rites after the expiration of the night and taken farewell from the ascetic Vālmīki, Lakşmaņa proceeded towards the west.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा यमुनातीरं सप्तरात्रोषितः पथि
ऋषीणां पुण्यकीर्तीनामाश्रमे वासमभ्ययात्
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā yamunātīraṁ saptarātroṣitaḥ pathi
ṛṣīṇāṁ puṇyakīrtīnāmāśrame vāsamabhyayāt

translations.english: And having spent seven nights he at last arrived at the hermitage of the pious Rși living on the banks of the Yamuna.

verses.sanskrit:
स तत्र मुनिभिः सार्धं भार्गवप्रमुखैर्नृपः
कथाभिर्बहुरूपाभिर्वासं चक्रे महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
sa tatra munibhiḥ sārdhaṁ bhārgavapramukhairnṛpaḥ
kathābhirbahurūpābhirvāsaṁ cakre mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Taking shelter there be engaged in pleasant conversation with Cyavana (son of Bhrgu), and other ascetics. Having remained there for the night and talked with those ascetics the highsouled, heroic Raghu prince Śatrughna was greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ रात्र्यां प्रवृत्तायां शत्रुघ्नो भृगुनन्दनम्
पप्रच्छ च्यवनं विप्रं लवणस्य बलाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
atha rātryāṁ pravṛttāyāṁ śatrughno bhṛgunandanam
papraccha cyavanaṁ vipraṁ lavaṇasya balābalam

translations.english: Thereupon when the night set in Śatrughna accosted Bhrgu's son Cyavana saying, “O Brāhmaṇa how powerful is Lavaņa? And what is the strength of his dart? What persons before had been destroyed by this dart in conflict?”

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः
प्रत्युवाच महातेजाश्च्यवनो रघुनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātejāścyavano raghunandanam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the high-souled descendant of Raghu, Satrughna, the highly effulgent Cyavana replied saying.

verses.sanskrit:
असंख्येयानि कर्माणि यान्यस्य पुरुषर्षभ
इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवे यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration:
asaṁkhyeyāni karmāṇi yānyasya puruṣarṣabha
ikṣvākuvaṁśaprabhave yadvṛttaṁ tacchṛṇuṣva me

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, Lavaņa has accomplished many works by this dart; among them, hear, what Māndhāta, born in the race of Iksawaku, did.

verses.sanskrit:
अयोध्यायां पुरा राजा युवनाश्वसुतो बली
मान्धाता इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
ayodhyāyāṁ purā rājā yuvanāśvasuto balī
māndhātā iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān

translations.english: The early king of Ayodhyā was known over the three worlds under the name of Māndhātā. He was the son of Yuvanāśva, highly powerful and strong.

verses.sanskrit:
स कृत्वा पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां शासने पृथिवीपतिः
सुरलोकमथो जेतुमुद्योगमकरोन्नृपः
verses.transliteration:
sa kṛtvā pṛthivīṁ kṛtsnāṁ śāsane pṛthivīpatiḥ
suralokamatho jetumudyogamakaronnṛpaḥ

translations.english: Having brought the whole world under his subjection the king Māndhātā engaged in the conquest of the celestial region.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रस्य तु भयं तीव्रं सुराणां च महात्मनाम्
मान्धातरि कृतोद्योगे देवलोकजिगीषया
verses.transliteration:
indrasya tu bhayaṁ tīvraṁ surāṇāṁ ca mahātmanām
māndhātari kṛtodyoge devalokajigīṣayā

translations.english: He having been engaged in making preparations to conquer the world of gods—the celestial chief Indra with other immortals was greatly terrified.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य पापमभिप्रायं विदित्वा पाकशासनः
सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यमुवाच युवनाश्वजम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya pāpamabhiprāyaṁ viditvā pākaśāsanaḥ
sāntvapūrvamidaṁ vākyamuvāca yuvanāśvajam

translations.english: With this promise, the king Mândhāta went into the celestial region that he would occupy the half of Indra's throne and kingdom and the celestials would adore him. Being apprised of this vicious intention of his, Indra, the slayer of Pāka, consoled him in sweet words, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
राजा त्वं मानुषे लोके न तावत्पुरुषर्षभ
अकृत्वा पृथिवीं वश्यां देवराज्यमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration:
rājā tvaṁ mānuṣe loke na tāvatpuruṣarṣabha
akṛtvā pṛthivīṁ vaśyāṁ devarājyamihecchasi

translations.english: O foremost of men, even in the land of men, you have not been able to become the real king. Without perfectly subjugating the earth how do you wish to lord over the celestial kingdom?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वीर समग्रा ते मेदिनी निखिला वशे
देवराज्यं कुरुष्वेह सभृत्यबलवाहनः
verses.transliteration:
yadi vīra samagrā te medinī nikhilā vaśe
devarājyaṁ kuruṣveha sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ

translations.english: If the whole world is under your subjection, O hero, be you, with the whole host of your servants and soldiers, installed on the celestial throne.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रमेवं ब्रुवाणं तु मान्धाता वाक्यमब्रवीत्
क्व मे शक्र प्रतिहतं शासनं पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration:
indramevaṁ bruvāṇaṁ tu māndhātā vākyamabravīt
kva me śakra pratihataṁ śāsanaṁ pṛthivītale

translations.english: Indra having said this, the high-souled Māndhātā replies: O Sakra, who on this earth, has disobeyed my commands.?

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच सहस्राक्षो लवणो नाम राक्षसः
मधुपुत्रो मधुवने नाज्ञां ते कुरुतेऽनघ
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca sahasrākṣo lavaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ
madhuputro madhuvane nājñāṁ te kurute'nagha

translations.english: Whereto Indra replied o sinless one, the night-ranger, Lavana, Madhu's son, living in Madhuvana, is not under your control.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रियं घोरं सहस्राक्षेण भाषितम्
व्रीडितोऽवाङ्मुखो राजा व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vipriyaṁ ghoraṁ sahasrākṣeṇa bhāṣitam
vrīḍito'vāṅmukho rājā vyāhartuṁ na śaśāka ha

translations.english: Hearing those dreadful and unpleasant words from Indra, the king lowered his head in shame and became silent.

verses.sanskrit:
आमन्त्र्य तु सहस्राक्षं ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः
पुनरेवागमच्छ्रीमानिमं लोकं नरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration:
āmantrya tu sahasrākṣaṁ hriyā kiṁcidavāṅmukhaḥ
punarevāgamacchrīmānimaṁ lokaṁ nareśvaraḥ

translations.english: Thereupon, having welcomed Indra in that way, he left there and returned earth. O slayer of enemies, with an angry heart, army and conveyance he went to subjugate Madhu's son Lavaņa and sent an emissary inviting him to battle.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा विप्रियाण्याह बहूनि मधुनः सुतम्
वदन्तमेवं तं दूतं भक्षयामास राक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā vipriyāṇyāha bahūni madhunaḥ sutam
vadantamevaṁ taṁ dūtaṁ bhakṣayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ

translations.english: The ambassador, having gone there, addressed many unpleasant words to Lavaņa and the nightranger devoured him.

verses.sanskrit:
चिरायमाणे दूते तु राजा क्रोधसमन्वितः
अर्दयामास तद्रक्षः शरवृष्ट्या समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
cirāyamāṇe dūte tu rājā krodhasamanvitaḥ
ardayāmāsa tadrakṣaḥ śaravṛṣṭyā samantataḥ

translations.english: On the other hand finding the delay of his return the king Māndhāta, enraged, began to assail the Raksasa Lavaņa with arrows from all sides.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहस्य लवणः शूलं जग्राह पाणिना
वधाय सानुबन्धस्य मुमोचायुधमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prahasya lavaṇaḥ śūlaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā
vadhāya sānubandhasya mumocāyudhamuttamam

translations.english: Laughing wild Lavaņa took up the dart in his hand and discharged it to destroy the king with his followers.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छूलं दीप्यमानं तु सभृत्यबलवाहनम्
भस्मीकृत्य नृपं भूयो लवणस्यागमत्करम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchūlaṁ dīpyamānaṁ tu sabhṛtyabalavāhanam
bhasmīkṛtya nṛpaṁ bhūyo lavaṇasyāgamatkaram

translations.english: Thereupon growing powerful the dart reduced the king with his servants and army into ashes and returned to Lavaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं स राजा सुमहान्हतः सबलवाहनः
शूलस्य च बलं वीर अप्रमेयमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sa rājā sumahānhataḥ sabalavāhanaḥ
śūlasya ca balaṁ vīra aprameyamanuttamam

translations.english: In this wise the high-souled king Māndhāta, with his huge army, was slain. O gentle hero, incomparable and great is the strength of the dart..

verses.sanskrit:
श्वः प्रभाते तु लवणं वधिष्यसि न संशयः
अगृहीतायुधं क्षिप्रं ध्रुवो हि विजयस्तव
verses.transliteration:
śvaḥ prabhāte tu lavaṇaṁ vadhiṣyasi na saṁśayaḥ
agṛhītāyudhaṁ kṣipraṁ dhruvo hi vijayastava

translations.english: Forsooth you shall slay Lavaņa next morning. Certain is your victory if Lavana cannot take up his dart.

verses.sanskrit:
कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम्
व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
kathāṁ kathayatāṁ teṣāṁ jayaṁ cākāṅkṣatāṁ śubham
vyatītā rajanī śīghraṁ śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: They being thus engaged in conversation regarding his achieving victory without any danger Satrughna in no time passed the night.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रभाते विमले तस्मिन्काले स राक्षसः
निर्गतस्तु पुराद्वीरो भक्षाहारप्रचोदितः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale tasminkāle sa rākṣasaḥ
nirgatastu purādvīro bhakṣāhārapracoditaḥ

translations.english: The clear morning having arrived, that time the heroic Lavana issued out of his city to collect food.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरः शत्रुघ्नो यमुनां नदीम्
तीर्त्वा मधुपुरद्वारि धनुष्पाणिरतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration:
etasminnantare śūraḥ śatrughno yamunāṁ nadīm
tīrtvā madhupuradvāri dhanuṣpāṇiratiṣṭhata

translations.english: In the meantime having crossed the river Yamunā, the heroic Satrughna, with bow in his hands, stood at the gate of Madhu's city.

verses.sanskrit:
आहारश्चाप्यसंपूर्णो ममायं पुरुषाधम
स्वयं प्रविष्टो नु मुखं कथमासाद्य दुर्मते
verses.transliteration:
āhāraścāpyasaṁpūrṇo mamāyaṁ puruṣādhama
svayaṁ praviṣṭo nu mukhaṁ kathamāsādya durmate

translations.english: O vile man, I am fully fed. How shall you, of your own accord, enter into my mouth?

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यैवं भाषमाणस्य हसतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः
शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसंपन्नो रोषादश्रूण्यवर्तयत्
verses.transliteration:
tasyaivaṁ bhāṣamāṇasya hasataśca muhurmuhuḥ
śatrughno vīryasaṁpanno roṣādaśrūṇyavartayat

translations.english: Lavaņa having said this again and again laughing the great hero Satrughna shed tears in anger.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य रोषाभिभूतस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः
तेजोमया मरीच्यस्तु सर्वगात्रैर्विनिष्पतन्
verses.transliteration:
tasya roṣābhibhūtasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ
tejomayā marīcyastu sarvagātrairviniṣpatan

translations.english: The high-minded Śatrughna being beside himself with rage, from all his person issued burning lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
उवाच च सुसंक्रुद्धः शत्रुघ्नस्तं निशाचरम्
योद्धुमिच्छामि दुर्बुद्धे द्वन्द्वयुद्धं त्वया सह
verses.transliteration:
uvāca ca susaṁkruddhaḥ śatrughnastaṁ niśācaram
yoddhumicchāmi durbuddhe dvandvayuddhaṁ tvayā saha

translations.english: Greatly enraged he said to the night-ranger O you of a vicious intellect, I wish to enter into a dual encounter with you.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्रो दशरथस्याहं भ्राता रामस्य धीमतः
शत्रुघ्नो नाम शत्रुघ्नो वधाकाङ्क्षी तवागतः
verses.transliteration:
putro daśarathasyāhaṁ bhrātā rāmasya dhīmataḥ
śatrughno nāma śatrughno vadhākāṅkṣī tavāgataḥ

translations.english: I am the son of the great king Dasaratha, brother of the intelligent Rāma and my name is Satrughna. I slay all my enemies and have come here to destroy you.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य मे युद्धकामस्य द्वन्द्वयुद्धं प्रदीयताम्
शत्रुस्त्वं सर्वजीवानां न मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
tasya me yuddhakāmasya dvandvayuddhaṁ pradīyatām
śatrustvaṁ sarvajīvānāṁ na me jīvangamiṣyasi

translations.english: I wish now to fight with you-do you enter into a dual conflict. You are the enemy of all animals. You shall not be able to survive at my hands.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव
प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि दुर्मते
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstathā bruvāṇe tu rākṣasaḥ prahasanniva
pratyuvāca naraśreṣṭhaṁ diṣṭyā prāpto'si durmate

translations.english: He having said this, the Rākṣasa, laughing aloud, replied to that foremost of men:-Your understanding is bewildered. By the influence of destiny you have come under my control.

verses.sanskrit:
मम मातृष्वसुर्भ्राता रावणो नाम राक्षसः
हतो रामेण दुर्बुद्धे स्त्रीहेतोः पुरुषाधम
verses.transliteration:
mama mātṛṣvasurbhrātā rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ
hato rāmeṇa durbuddhe strīhetoḥ puruṣādhama

translations.english: The Räksasa Rāvana was the brother of my aunts. O you of vicious understanding, O vile wight, it is for his wife that Rāma did slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्च सर्वं मया क्षान्तं रावणस्य कुलक्षयम्
अवज्ञां पुरतः कृत्वा मया यूयं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
tacca sarvaṁ mayā kṣāntaṁ rāvaṇasya kulakṣayam
avajñāṁ purataḥ kṛtvā mayā yūyaṁ viśeṣataḥ

translations.english: It is out of hatred that I have tolerated the destruction of Rāvana's family and have pardoned you all.

verses.sanskrit:
न हताश्च हि मे सर्वे परिभूतास्तृणं यथा
भूताश्चैव भविष्याश्च यूयं च पुरुषाधमाः
verses.transliteration:
na hatāśca hi me sarve paribhūtāstṛṇaṁ yathā
bhūtāścaiva bhaviṣyāśca yūyaṁ ca puruṣādhamāḥ

translations.english: You are all vile men; I have slain and defeated all of your family that have passed away and shall destroy all that are living and shall come into existence.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य ते युद्धकामस्य युद्धं दास्यामि दुर्मते
ईप्सितं यादृशं तुभ्यं सज्जये यावदायुधम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya te yuddhakāmasya yuddhaṁ dāsyāmi durmate
īpsitaṁ yādṛśaṁ tubhyaṁ sajjaye yāvadāyudham

translations.english: O you of vicious intellect, if you wish I shall fight with you. Do you wait here so long I do not bring my weapon.

verses.sanskrit:
यो हि विक्लवया बुद्ध्या प्रसरं शत्रवे ददौ
स हतो मन्दबुद्धित्वाद्यथा कापुरुषस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
yo hi viklavayā buddhyā prasaraṁ śatrave dadau
sa hato mandabuddhitvādyathā kāpuruṣastathā

translations.english: The practical men should never let off the enemies who come out of their own accord. He, who invite an enemy into battle under the influence of perverted understanding, is slain like a coward.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः
क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ
krodhamāhārayattīvraṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of the high-souled Śatrughna Lavaņa was greatly enraged and again and again asked him to wait.

verses.sanskrit:
पाणौ पाणिं विनिष्पिष्य दन्तान्कटकटाय्य च
लवणो रघुशार्दूलमाह्वयामास चासकृत्
verses.transliteration:
pāṇau pāṇiṁ viniṣpiṣya dantānkaṭakaṭāyya ca
lavaṇo raghuśārdūlamāhvayāmāsa cāsakṛt

translations.english: Clashing his hands and grinding his teeth he invited that foremost of Raghus to fight.

verses.sanskrit:
तं ब्रुवाणं तथा वाक्यं लवणं घोरविक्रमम्
शत्रुघ्नो देव शत्रुघ्न इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ bruvāṇaṁ tathā vākyaṁ lavaṇaṁ ghoravikramam
śatrughno deva śatrughna idaṁ vacanamabravīt

translations.english: And Satrughna, the slayer of celestial's enemies, said to the dreadful Lavaņa, giving vent to those words.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघ्नो न तदा जातो यदान्ये निर्जितास्त्वया
तदद्य बाणाभिहतो व्रज तं यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration:
śatrughno na tadā jāto yadānye nirjitāstvayā
tadadya bāṇābhihato vraja taṁ yamasādanam

translations.english: Śatrughna was not born when you did defeat other kings; do you therefore proceed to Death's abode being assailed by shafts.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषयोऽप्यद्य पापात्मन्मया त्वां निहतं रणे
पश्यन्तु विप्रा विद्वांसस्त्रिदशा इव रावणम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣayo'pyadya pāpātmanmayā tvāṁ nihataṁ raṇe
paśyantu viprā vidvāṁsastridaśā iva rāvaṇam

translations.english: O you of a vicious soul, as did the celestials behold Rāvana slain so shall the Rșis and learned Brāhmaṇas behold you, destroyed by me.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वयि मद्बाणनिर्दग्धे पतितेऽद्य निशाचर
पुरं जनपदं चापि क्षेममेतद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tvayi madbāṇanirdagdhe patite'dya niśācara
puraṁ janapadaṁ cāpi kṣemametadbhaviṣyati

translations.english: O Rākşasa, forsooth shall good crown cities and villages when you shall fall down brunt by my arrow.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य मद्बाहुनिष्क्रान्तः शरो वज्रनिभाननः
प्रवेक्ष्यते ते हृदयं पद्ममंशुरिवार्कजः
verses.transliteration:
adya madbāhuniṣkrāntaḥ śaro vajranibhānanaḥ
pravekṣyate te hṛdayaṁ padmamaṁśurivārkajaḥ

translations.english: As the rays of the sun enter into lotus so shall arrows, hard as lightning, discharged by my hands, shall enter into your heart.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्तो महावृक्षं लवणः क्रोधमूर्छितः
शत्रुघ्नोरसि चिक्षेप तं शूरः शतधाच्छिनत्
verses.transliteration:
evamukto mahāvṛkṣaṁ lavaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
śatrughnorasi cikṣepa taṁ śūraḥ śatadhācchinat

translations.english: Being beside himself with ire on hearing those words of Śatrughna, Lavaņa threw a huge tree against his breast. And ſatrughna too sundered it into a hundred pieces.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघ्नश्चापि तेजस्वी वृक्षानापततो बहून्
त्रिभिश्चतुर्भिरेकैकं चिच्छेद नतपर्वभिः
verses.transliteration:
śatrughnaścāpi tejasvī vṛkṣānāpatato bahūn
tribhiścaturbhirekaikaṁ ciccheda nataparvabhiḥ

translations.english: Beholding his own action baffled the Rākşasa again took up many trees and hurled them at Śatrughna, who, with three or four hundred bent arrow, cut them all, one by one, into pieces.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो बाणमयं वर्षं व्यसृजद्राक्षसोरसि
शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसंपन्नो विव्यथे न च राक्षसः
verses.transliteration:
tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ vyasṛjadrākṣasorasi
śatrughno vīryasaṁpanno vivyathe na ca rākṣasaḥ

translations.english: Thereupon when the powerful Satrughna assailed him with arrows the Rākşasa was not the least pained.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहस्य लवणो वृक्षमुत्पाट्य लीलया
शिरस्यभ्यहनच्छूरं स्रस्ताङ्गः स मुमोह वै
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prahasya lavaṇo vṛkṣamutpāṭya līlayā
śirasyabhyahanacchūraṁ srastāṅgaḥ sa mumoha vai

translations.english: Rather laughing aloud the valiant Räksasa uprooted a tree and struck him with that on the head. With that stroke he was wounded and slain.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे हाहाकारो महानभूत्
ऋषीणां देव संघानां गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि
verses.transliteration:
tasminnipatite vīre hāhākāro mahānabhūt
ṛṣīṇāṁ deva saṁghānāṁ gandharvāpsarasāmapi

translations.english: And that hero falling there arose a terrible uproar among the Rșis, celestials, Gandharvas and Apsarās.

verses.sanskrit:
नापि शूलं प्रजग्राह तं दृष्ट्वा भुवि पातितम्
ततो हत इति ज्ञात्वा तान्भक्षान्समुदावहत्
verses.transliteration:
nāpi śūlaṁ prajagrāha taṁ dṛṣṭvā bhuvi pātitam
tato hata iti jñātvā tānbhakṣānsamudāvahat

translations.english: There upon considering Śatrughna slain the night-ranger did not enter his house albeit he got the opportunity; and moreover beholding him fallen and destroyed he did not take up his dart. He then began to carry his collected food.

verses.sanskrit:
मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञस्तु पुनस्तस्थौ धृतायुधः
शत्रुघ्नो राक्षसद्वारि ऋषिभिः संप्रपूजितः
verses.transliteration:
muhūrtāllabdhasaṁjñastu punastasthau dhṛtāyudhaḥ
śatrughno rākṣasadvāri ṛṣibhiḥ saṁprapūjitaḥ

translations.english: Regaining his sense within a moment, Śatrughna, with a weapon in his hand, stood at the city gate and the Rșis began to praise him.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो दिव्यममोघं तं जग्राह शरमुत्तमम्
ज्वलन्तं तेजसा घोरं पूरयन्तं दिशो दश
verses.transliteration:
tato divyamamoghaṁ taṁ jagrāha śaramuttamam
jvalantaṁ tejasā ghoraṁ pūrayantaṁ diśo daśa

translations.english: There upon, he having taken up an excellent arrow of unfailing aim the ten quarters were filled with its native brilliance.

verses.sanskrit:
वज्राननं वज्रवेगं मेरुमन्दर गौरवम्
नतं पर्वसु सर्वेषु संयुगेष्वपराजितम्
verses.transliteration:
vajrānanaṁ vajravegaṁ merumandara gauravam
nataṁ parvasu sarveṣu saṁyugeṣvaparājitam

translations.english: Its face was like lightning and its velocity the same and it looked like Meru and Mandāra; its joints were all bent. None could defeat it in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि परित्रासमुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ dīptamiva kālāgniṁ yugānte samupasthite
dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni paritrāsamupāgaman

translations.english: It was pasted with red sandal resembling blood and its feathers were beautiful. Beholding that dart like to the fire of dissolution, and dreadful to lords of Dānavas, mountains and Asuras, the creatures were greatly terrified.

verses.sanskrit:
सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं समुनिं साप्सरोगणम्
जगद्धि सर्वमस्वस्थं पितामहमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
sadevāsuragandharvaṁ samuniṁ sāpsarogaṇam
jagaddhi sarvamasvasthaṁ pitāmahamupasthitam

translations.english: What more, being disturbed, the celestials, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and Apsarās and all other creatures of the world approached the Great Patriarch, the conferrer of boons and said. The fear of the celestials and the destruction of the creatures has arrived.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामनः
भयकारणमाचष्टे देवानामभयंकरः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmanaḥ
bhayakāraṇamācaṣṭe devānāmabhayaṁkaraḥ

translations.english: Hearing those words the Patriarch Brahmă replied Although it is a source of great fear still it is not dreadful to the celestials. There upon with sweet accents he said:-Hear, O you celestials, ſatrughna has taken up this arrow for the destruction of Pavana.

verses.sanskrit:
एष वै कैटभस्यार्थे मधुनश्च महाशरः
सृष्टो महात्मना तेन वधार्थं दैत्ययोस्तयोः
verses.transliteration:
eṣa vai kaiṭabhasyārthe madhunaśca mahāśaraḥ
sṛṣṭo mahātmanā tena vadhārthaṁ daityayostayoḥ

translations.english: By the energy thereof we have all been overwhelmed. This effulgent, ever existing arrow was made by the Primeval, Deity, Vis nu-the lord of creatures. My children, the burning arrow, of which you are afraid, was made by the high-minded Vişņu for slaying the demons Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.sanskrit:
इतो गच्छता पश्यध्वं वध्यमानं महात्मना
रामानुजेन वीरेण लवणं राक्षसोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
ito gacchatā paśyadhvaṁ vadhyamānaṁ mahātmanā
rāmānujena vīreṇa lavaṇaṁ rākṣasottamam

translations.english: Vişņu alone is cognisant of its energy. This Śatrughna is the first portion of Vişnu's person; do you all go hence and behold the destruction of the foremost Raksasa, Lavana, by the highsouled, heroic Satrughna, the younger brother of Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
तं शरं दिव्यसंकाशं शत्रुघ्नकरधारितम्
ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि युगान्ताग्निमिवोत्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ śaraṁ divyasaṁkāśaṁ śatrughnakaradhāritam
dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni yugāntāgnimivotthitam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the Patriarch Brahmă, the celestials arrived at the battle-field of Šatrughna and Lavana and saw that the arrow, held by Satrughna's hands, was burning like the fire of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit:
आहूतश्च ततस्तेन शत्रुघ्नेन महात्मना
लवणः क्रोधसंयुक्तो युद्धाय समुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
āhūtaśca tatastena śatrughnena mahātmanā
lavaṇaḥ krodhasaṁyukto yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ

translations.english: Beholding the welkin covered by the celestials, Satrughna, the descendant of Raghu, emitting leonine roars, again and again looked towards Lavaņa. And being again excited by the high-souled Śatrughna and enraged Lavaņa arrived for encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ तद्धनुर्धन्विनां वरः
स मुमोच महाबाणं लवणस्य महोरसि
उरस्तस्य विदार्याशु प्रविवेश रसातलम्
verses.transliteration:
ākarṇātsa vikṛṣyātha taddhanurdhanvināṁ varaḥ
sa mumoca mahābāṇaṁ lavaṇasya mahorasi
urastasya vidāryāśu praviveśa rasātalam

translations.english: There upon expanding his bow up to ears, Satrughna, the the most accomplished archer, discharged his arrow against the spacious breast of Lavaņa. And piercing his heart that arrow entered speedily into Rasātala and having entered Rasātala that arrow, honoured by the celestials, again came to the descendant of Raghu.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नो लवणः स निशाचरः
पपात सहसा भूमौ वज्राहत इवाचलः
verses.transliteration:
śatrughnaśaranirbhinno lavaṇaḥ sa niśācaraḥ
papāta sahasā bhūmau vajrāhata ivācalaḥ

translations.english: And being pierced by that shaft the nightranger Lavaņa fell down on earth like a mountain clapped by a thunder-bolt.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्च दिव्यं महच्छूलं हते लवणराक्षसे
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां रुद्रस्य वशमन्वगात्
verses.transliteration:
tacca divyaṁ mahacchūlaṁ hate lavaṇarākṣase
paśyatāṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ rudrasya vaśamanvagāt

translations.english: The Rākşasa being slain that celestial, huge arrow came into the possession of Rudra before the gods.

verses.sanskrit:
एकेषुपातेन भयं निहत्य; लोकत्रयस्यास्य रघुप्रवीरः
विनिर्बभावुद्यतचापबाण;स्तमः प्रणुद्येव सहस्ररश्मिः
verses.transliteration:
ekeṣupātena bhayaṁ nihatya; lokatrayasyāsya raghupravīraḥ
vinirbabhāvudyatacāpabāṇa;stamaḥ praṇudyeva sahasraraśmiḥ

translations.english: Having removed the fear of the three worlds with one shaft, that heroic Raghu, Satrughnayounger brother of Lakşmaņa, holding excellent bow and arrow, appeared like the Sun of thousand rays removing darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः
ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम्
verses.transliteration:
hate tu lavaṇe devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ
ūcuḥ sumadhurāṁ vāṇīṁ śatrughnaṁ śatrutāpanam

translations.english: Lavana being slain the celestials headed by Agni and Indra said in sweet accents to Śatrughna the represser of enemies.

verses.sanskrit:
दिष्ट्या ते विजयो वत्स दिष्ट्या लवणराक्षसः
हतः पुरुषशार्दूल वरं वरय राघव
verses.transliteration:
diṣṭyā te vijayo vatsa diṣṭyā lavaṇarākṣasaḥ
hataḥ puruṣaśārdūla varaṁ varaya rāghava

translations.english: O child, fortunate it is that you have been crowned with success after slaying the Rākṣasa Lavaņa. Do you, therefore, O foremost of men, O you of firm vows, accept boons.

verses.sanskrit:
वरदाः स्म महाबाहो सर्व एव समागताः
विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यममोघं दर्शनं हि नः
verses.transliteration:
varadāḥ sma mahābāho sarva eva samāgatāḥ
vijayākāṅkṣiṇastubhyamamoghaṁ darśanaṁ hi naḥ

translations.english: O you having long arms, all those who can confer boons have arrived here; they all wish for your victory; seeing us does not go without fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा शूरो मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः
प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुः शत्रुघ्नः प्रयतात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
devānāṁ bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā śūro mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ
pratyuvāca mahābāhuḥ śatrughnaḥ prayatātmavān

translations.english: Hearing the words of the celestials the largearmed and self-controlled Satrughna placed his hands on his head and said.

verses.sanskrit:
इमां मधुपुरीं रम्यां मधुरां देव निर्मिताम्
निवेशं प्राप्नुयां शीघ्रमेष मेऽस्तु वरो मतः
verses.transliteration:
imāṁ madhupurīṁ ramyāṁ madhurāṁ deva nirmitām
niveśaṁ prāpnuyāṁ śīghrameṣa me'stu varo mataḥ

translations.english: Let this picturesque and charming city of Madhu, built by the celestials, by my capital; this is the only excellent boon I can beg.

verses.sanskrit:
तं देवाः प्रीतमनसो बाढमित्येव राघवम्
भविष्यति पुरी रम्या शूरसेना न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ devāḥ prītamanaso bāḍhamityeva rāghavam
bhaviṣyati purī ramyā śūrasenā na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: The celestials, with a delighted heart, said to the descendant of Raghu.-Your desire shall be fulfilled and forsooth shall your city be turned into a picturesque capital under the name of Surasena.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तथोक्त्वा महात्मानो दिवमारुरुहुस्तदा
शत्रुघ्नोऽपि महातेजास्तां सेनां समुपानयत्
verses.transliteration:
te tathoktvā mahātmāno divamāruruhustadā
śatrughno'pi mahātejāstāṁ senāṁ samupānayat

translations.english: The high-souled celestials having ascended the welkin saying this, the highly effulgent Śatrughna brought the soldiers there, that were encamped on the banks of the Gangā.

verses.sanskrit:
सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छ्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नशासनम्
निवेशनं च शत्रुघ्नः शासनेन समारभत्
verses.transliteration:
sā senā śīghramāgacchacchrutvā śatrughnaśāsanam
niveśanaṁ ca śatrughnaḥ śāsanena samārabhat

translations.english: When the soldiers arrived there on hearing the commands of Satrughna he engaged in making encampments in the month of Śrāvan.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्राणि सस्ययुक्तानि काले वर्षति वासवः
अरोगा वीरपुरुषा शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता
verses.transliteration:
kṣetrāṇi sasyayuktāni kāle varṣati vāsavaḥ
arogā vīrapuruṣā śatrughnabhujapālitā

translations.english: In this wise the fearlessness of the celestial host, taking the shape of a country, that beautiful and picturesque city was reared in the course of twelve years. All the fields there were filled with crops and Indra began to pour showers in due seasons. And being protected by the strength of Śatrughna's arms all men there became valiant and were freed from deseases.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा यमुनातीरशोभिता
शोभिता गृहमुख्यैश्च शोभिता चत्वरापणैः
verses.transliteration:
ardhacandrapratīkāśā yamunātīraśobhitā
śobhitā gṛhamukhyaiśca śobhitā catvarāpaṇaiḥ

translations.english: That city on the banks of Yamună appeared beautiful like the half moon and was filled with yards, shops, streets beautiful houses, men of four orders and various articles of trade.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्च तेन महच्छून्यं लवणेन कृतं पुरा
शोभयामास तद्वीरो नानापण्यसमृद्धिभिः
verses.transliteration:
yacca tena mahacchūnyaṁ lavaṇena kṛtaṁ purā
śobhayāmāsa tadvīro nānāpaṇyasamṛddhibhiḥ

translations.english: Śatrughna now engaged in beautifying the spacious, white houses that were made by Lavana before, with various ornamental works.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना निवेश्य मधुरां पुरीम्
रामपादौ निरीक्षेयं वर्षे द्वादशमे शुभे
verses.transliteration:
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā niveśya madhurāṁ purīm
rāmapādau nirīkṣeyaṁ varṣe dvādaśame śubhe

translations.english: Having thus reared the beautiful city he resolved within himself The twelfth year has come. I shall now behold the feet of Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रुघ्नो रामपालिताम्
अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः
verses.transliteration:
tato dvādaśame varṣe śatrughno rāmapālitām
ayodhyāṁ cakame gantumalpabhṛtyabalānugaḥ

translations.english: There upon on the completion of the twelfth year, Satrughna, with few servants, soldiers and followers, desired to proceed to Ayodhyā protected by Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रिणो बलमुख्यांश्च निवर्त्य च पुरोधसं
जगाम रथमुख्येन हययुक्तेन भास्वता
verses.transliteration:
mantriṇo balamukhyāṁśca nivartya ca purodhasaṁ
jagāma rathamukhyena hayayuktena bhāsvatā

translations.english: Having prevented his minister and leading generals he proceeded with one hundred chariots and cavalry.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा गणितान्वासान्सप्ताष्टौ रघुनन्दनः
अयोध्यामगमत्तूर्णं राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā gaṇitānvāsānsaptāṣṭau raghunandanaḥ
ayodhyāmagamattūrṇaṁ rāghavotsukadarśanaḥ

translations.english: He was greatly anxious to behold Rāma and saluting the foremost of Munis he speedily preceded to Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रविश्य पुरीं रम्यां श्रीमानिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः
प्रविवेश महाबाहुर्यत्र रामो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
sa praviśya purīṁ ramyāṁ śrīmānikṣvākunandanaḥ
praviveśa mahābāhuryatra rāmo mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: There upon having entered the highly picturesque city Ayodhyā, city Ayodhyā, the graceful descendant of Ikşvākus, ſatrughna, reached where the long-armed and the highly effulgent Råma was waiting.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्
verses.transliteration:
so'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā rāmaṁ satyaparākramam

translations.english: He espied there Rāma in the midst of the councillors like Indra among the immortals burning in his own effulgence. And having bowed with folded hands to Răma, having truth for his prowess, Śatrughna, said.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वादशं च गतं वर्षं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन
नोत्सहेयमहं वस्तुं त्वया विरहितो नृप
verses.transliteration:
dvādaśaṁ ca gataṁ varṣaṁ tvāṁ vinā raghunandana
notsaheyamahaṁ vastuṁ tvayā virahito nṛpa

translations.english: O great king, I have carried out all your behests; I have slain the vicious Lavaņa and filled his city with subjects. O descendant of Raghu, twelve years have passed away without you, I do not wish to live any longer separated from you.

verses.sanskrit:
स मे प्रसादं काकुत्स्थ कुरुष्वामितविक्रम
मातृहीनो यथा वत्सस्त्वां विना प्रवसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
sa me prasādaṁ kākutstha kuruṣvāmitavikrama
mātṛhīno yathā vatsastvāṁ vinā pravasāmyaham

translations.english: Do you therefore, O Kākutstha of unmitigated prowess, have compassion on me. Without you, I cannot live for ever in a foreign province like a motherless child.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणं शत्रुघ्नं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्
मा विषादं कृथा वीर नैतत्क्षत्रियचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ śatrughnaṁ pariṣvajyedamabravīt
mā viṣādaṁ kṛthā vīra naitatkṣatriyaceṣṭitam

translations.english: He having said this, Rāma embraced him and said: Be not sorry O hero. This is not a becoming action for Kşatriyas.

verses.sanskrit:
नावसीदन्ति राजानो विप्रवासेषु राघव
प्रजाश्च परिपाल्या हि क्षत्रधर्मेण राघव
verses.transliteration:
nāvasīdanti rājāno vipravāseṣu rāghava
prajāśca paripālyā hi kṣatradharmeṇa rāghava

translations.english: The kings, O Raghava, are never tired of living in a foreign land. According to the morality of the Kșatriyas, their greatest duty consists in governing the subjects.

verses.sanskrit:
काले काले च मां वीर अयोध्यामवलोकितुम्
आगच्छ त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गन्तासि च पुरं तव
verses.transliteration:
kāle kāle ca māṁ vīra ayodhyāmavalokitum
āgaccha tvaṁ naraśreṣṭha gantāsi ca puraṁ tava

translations.english: O heroic and foremost of men, do you, at intervals, come to Ayodhyå to see me and return to your own city.

verses.sanskrit:
ममापि त्वं सुदयितः प्राणैरपि न संशयः
अवश्यं करणीयं च राज्यस्य परिपालनम्
verses.transliteration:
mamāpi tvaṁ sudayitaḥ prāṇairapi na saṁśayaḥ
avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ ca rājyasya paripālanam

translations.english: Forsooth you are dearer than my life. But it is an incumbent duty to govern the kingdom. Do you therefore, O Kakutstha, live with me for seven nights, and afterwards return to your city with your servants, army and conveyances.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मयुक्तं मनोऽनुगम्
शत्रुघ्नो दीनया वाचा बाढमित्येव चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
rāmasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā dharmayuktaṁ mano'nugam
śatrughno dīnayā vācā bāḍhamityeva cābravīt

translations.english: Hearing those moral and charming words of Rama, Satrughna poorly replied, saying: Your command shall be carried out.

verses.sanskrit:
स पञ्चरात्रं काकुत्स्थो राघवस्य यथाज्ञया
उष्य तत्र महेष्वासो गमनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
sa pañcarātraṁ kākutstho rāghavasya yathājñayā
uṣya tatra maheṣvāso gamanāyopacakrame

translations.english: Thereupon Satrughna, well-skilled in the use of bows, remained with Rāma for seven nights and then addressed himself for departure.

verses.sanskrit:
आमन्त्र्य तु महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्
भरतं लक्ष्मणं चैव महारथमुपारुहत्
verses.transliteration:
āmantrya tu mahātmānaṁ rāmaṁ satyaparākramam
bharataṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva mahārathamupāruhat

translations.english: Thereupon having invited Bharata and Laksmana, the high-souled Rama, having truth for his prowess, speedily went for his city in a huge chariot.

verses.sanskrit:
दूरं ताभ्यामनुगतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
भरतेन च शत्रुघ्नो जगामाशु पुरीं तदा
verses.transliteration:
dūraṁ tābhyāmanugato lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
bharatena ca śatrughno jagāmāśu purīṁ tadā

translations.english: The high-souled Lakşmaņa and slayer of enemies Bharata followed him on foot for some distance.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः
प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन्
verses.transliteration:
prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṁ bhrātṛbhyāṁ saha rāghavaḥ
pramumoda sukhī rājyaṁ dharmeṇa paripālayan

translations.english: Having bade adieu to Satrughna, Rama, the descendant of Raghu, was greatly delighted by governing his subjects piously in the company of Bharata and Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः कतिपयाहःसु वृद्धो जानपदो द्विजः
शवं बालमुपादाय राजद्वारमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu vṛddho jānapado dvijaḥ
śavaṁ bālamupādāya rājadvāramupāgamat

translations.english: Some days having passed in this wise-a villager, an old Brālimaņa, arrived at the palace gate with a dead boy.

verses.sanskrit:
रुदन्बहुविधा वाचः स्नेहाक्षरसमन्विताः
असकृत्पुत्र पुत्रेति वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
rudanbahuvidhā vācaḥ snehākṣarasamanvitāḥ
asakṛtputra putreti vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: That Brāhmaṇa, stricken with affection, again and again bewailed in various piteous accents exclaiming What heinous crime had I committed in my pristine birth that I have been constrained to witness the death of my son.

verses.sanskrit:
अल्पैरहोभिर्निधनं गमिष्यामि न संशयः
अहं च जननी चैव तव शोकेन पुत्रक
verses.transliteration:
alpairahobhirnidhanaṁ gamiṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ
ahaṁ ca jananī caiva tava śokena putraka

translations.english: My son, you have not as yet completed fourteen years. To my misery you have met with untimely death. Forsooth, for your grief, O my son, myself and your mother shall soon be snatched away by death.

verses.sanskrit:
न स्मराम्यनृतं ह्युक्तं न च हिंसां स्मराम्यहम्
केन मे दुष्कृतेनाद्य बाल एव ममात्मजः
अकृत्वा पितृकार्याणि नीतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्
verses.transliteration:
na smarāmyanṛtaṁ hyuktaṁ na ca hiṁsāṁ smarāmyaham
kena me duṣkṛtenādya bāla eva mamātmajaḥ
akṛtvā pitṛkāryāṇi nīto vaivasvatakṣayam

translations.english: I do not remember to have ever uttered a falsehood, or injured an animal or perpetrated any other crime. Therefore for some other sinful action, this boy, without performing the son's duties towards his parents, has gone to the abode of death.

verses.sanskrit:
नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं मे श्रुतं वा घोरदर्शनम्
मृत्युरप्राप्तकालानां रामस्य विषये यथा
verses.transliteration:
nedṛśaṁ dṛṣṭapūrvaṁ me śrutaṁ vā ghoradarśanam
mṛtyuraprāptakālānāṁ rāmasya viṣaye yathā

translations.english: Save under the regime of Rama, I have never seen or heard of the dreadful death of such a boy who has not attained the age.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः
त्वं राजञ्जीवयस्वैनं बालं मृत्युवशं गतम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ
tvaṁ rājañjīvayasvainaṁ bālaṁ mṛtyuvaśaṁ gatam

translations.english: Forsooth, Rāma has perpetrated a mighty iniquity for which boys, during his administration, have been meeting with untimely death.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि
उषिताः स्म सुखं राज्ये तवास्मिन्सुमहाबल
verses.transliteration:
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rājandīrghamāyuravāpnuhi
uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṁ rājye tavāsminsumahābala

translations.english: O you of great prowess, up to this time we have lived happily in your kingdom. And now, O Räma, under your subjection we are being troubled with the sorrow or our son's death. We have been brought under the influence of Kāla; so in your kingdom there is not the least happiness for us.

verses.sanskrit:
सुव्यक्तं राजदोषोऽयं भविष्यति न संशयः
पुरे जनपदे वापि तदा बालवधो ह्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
suvyaktaṁ rājadoṣo'yaṁ bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ
pure janapade vāpi tadā bālavadho hyayam

translations.english: Evident it is therefore that undoubtedly the sin of the king has appeared in cities and provinces. And for that reason this boy has met with death.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्निन्दयानो मुहुर्मुहुः
राजानं दुःखसंतप्तः सुतं तमुपगूहति
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bahuvidhairvākyairnindayāno muhurmuhuḥ
rājānaṁ duḥkhasaṁtaptaḥ sutaṁ tamupagūhati

translations.english: Being overwhelmed with sorrow that old Brāhmaṇa again and again remonstrated with the king in these 'piteous words and afterwards covered the dead body (of his son.)

verses.sanskrit:
स दुःखेन सुसंतप्तो मन्त्रिणः समुपाह्वयत्
वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च भ्रातॄंश्च सहनैगमान्
verses.transliteration:
sa duḥkhena susaṁtapto mantriṇaḥ samupāhvayat
vasiṣṭhaṁ vāmadevaṁ ca bhrātṝṁśca sahanaigamān

translations.english: Hearing those sorrowful words of the Brāhmaṇa, Rāma was greatly sorry and sent for Vasistha, Vamadeva, his brothers, citizens and councillors.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो द्विजा वसिष्ठेन सार्धमष्टौ प्रवेशिताः
राजानं देवसंकाशं वर्धस्वेति ततोऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
tato dvijā vasiṣṭhena sārdhamaṣṭau praveśitāḥ
rājānaṁ devasaṁkāśaṁ vardhasveti tato'bruvan

translations.english: There upon having entered the apartment in the company of Vasiştha, eight Brāhmaṇas blessed the king Rāma, resembling a celestial, saying 'may victory crown you.'

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञो दीनस्य नारदः
प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमृषीणां संनिधौ नृपम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rājño dīnasya nāradaḥ
pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyamṛṣīṇāṁ saṁnidhau nṛpam

translations.english: Hearing those words of the poorly king, Narada, in the presence of all other Rsis, replied.

verses.sanskrit:
शृणु राजन्यथाकाले प्राप्तोऽयं बालसंक्षयः
श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यतां वीर कुरुष्व रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
śṛṇu rājanyathākāle prāpto'yaṁ bālasaṁkṣayaḥ
śrutvā kartavyatāṁ vīra kuruṣva raghunandana

translations.english: Hear, o king, why this boy has met with untimely death. And hearing this, O descendant or Raghu, do you settle what you think proper.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा कृतयुगे राम ब्राह्मणा वै तपस्विनः
अब्राह्मणस्तदा राजन्न तपस्वी कथंचन
verses.transliteration:
purā kṛtayuge rāma brāhmaṇā vai tapasvinaḥ
abrāhmaṇastadā rājanna tapasvī kathaṁcana

translations.english: O king, in the golden age, only the Brahmanas used to engage in asceticism. At that age save the Brāhmaṇas no other caste used to lead the life of an anchoret.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्युगे प्रज्वलिते ब्रह्मभूते अनावृते
अमृत्यवस्तदा सर्वे जज्ञिरे दीर्घदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration:
tasminyuge prajvalite brahmabhūte anāvṛte
amṛtyavastadā sarve jajñire dīrghadarśinaḥ

translations.english: And for this, the Brāhmaṇas were the highest caste, effulgent in asceticism, asceticism, shorn shorn of ignorance, above death and conversant with three ages.

verses.sanskrit:
वीर्येण तपसा चैव तेऽधिकाः पूर्वजन्मनि
मानवा ये महात्मानस्तस्मिंस्त्रेतायुगे युगे
verses.transliteration:
vīryeṇa tapasā caiva te'dhikāḥ pūrvajanmani
mānavā ye mahātmānastasmiṁstretāyuge yuge

translations.english: There upon at the end of the golden age, Brāhmaṇa's understanding became loose and the Tretā Yuga set in. At this age Kşatriyas, gifted with the power acquired by pristine asceticism, were born. And those men, intent upon austere penances, that were born in the Tretā age, were more powerful and greater devotees than those in the former age.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रं तु तत्सर्वं यत्पूर्वमपरं च यत्
युगयोरुभयोरासीत्समवीर्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration:
brahmakṣatraṁ tu tatsarvaṁ yatpūrvamaparaṁ ca yat
yugayorubhayorāsītsamavīryasamanvitam

translations.english: In the golden age the Brāhmaṇas were more powerful than the Kșatriyas. But in the Tretā age the Brāhmaṇas and the Ksatriyas were equally powerful.

verses.sanskrit:
अपश्यन्तस्तु ते सर्वे विशेषमधिकं ततः
स्थापनं चक्रिरे तत्र चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य सर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
apaśyantastu te sarve viśeṣamadhikaṁ tataḥ
sthāpanaṁ cakrire tatra cāturvarṇyasya sarvataḥ

translations.english: Thus in the Tretā age, not beholding prominence of the Brāhmaṇas greater than that of the Kşatriyas, Manu and other religious leaders of the time composed the Sastra describing and setting in the four divisions of castes.

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्मः पादमेकं तु पातयत्पृथिवीतले
अधर्मेण हि संयुक्तास्तेन मन्दाभवन्द्विजाः
verses.transliteration:
adharmaḥ pādamekaṁ tu pātayatpṛthivītale
adharmeṇa hi saṁyuktāstena mandābhavandvijāḥ

translations.english: In this wise the Tretā age was prolific with virtues of the four Varņas, and many pious sacrifices and was shorn of iniquities. But being attacked a little with iniquity, one portion of sin appeared on earth. And growing impious people of sin appeared on earth. And growing impious people lost their strength.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रेतायुगे त्ववर्तन्त ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियश्च ये
तपोऽतप्यन्त ते सर्वे शुश्रूषामपरे जनाः
verses.transliteration:
tretāyuge tvavartanta brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyaśca ye
tapo'tapyanta te sarve śuśrūṣāmapare janāḥ

translations.english: During the Tretă age the Brāhmaṇas and Kș atriyas engaged in austere penances and the Vaiśyas and Sūdras engaged in serving them.

verses.sanskrit:
स धर्मः परमस्तेषां वैश्यशूद्रमथागमत्
पूजां च सर्ववर्णानां शूद्राश्चक्रुर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration:
sa dharmaḥ paramasteṣāṁ vaiśyaśūdramathāgamat
pūjāṁ ca sarvavarṇānāṁ śūdrāścakrurviśeṣataḥ

translations.english: And the greatest piety of the Vaiśyas and Śūdras at that time consisted of serving the Brāhmaṇas and Ksatriyas and specially for the Śūdras the highest religion was to serve people of all Varnas.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पादमधर्मस्य द्वितीयमवतारयत्
ततो द्वापरसंख्या सा युगस्य समजायत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pādamadharmasya dvitīyamavatārayat
tato dvāparasaṁkhyā sā yugasya samajāyata

translations.english: And the second foot of impiety being ushered into the world the Dvāpara age set in.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्द्वापरसंख्ये तु वर्तमाने युगक्षये
अधर्मश्चानृतं चैव ववृधे पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
tasmindvāparasaṁkhye tu vartamāne yugakṣaye
adharmaścānṛtaṁ caiva vavṛdhe puruṣarṣabha

translations.english: O foremost of men, during this age two legs of piety being cut off, impiety and untruth multiplies.

verses.sanskrit:
हीनवर्णो नरश्रेष्ठ तप्यते सुमहत्तपः
भविष्या शूद्रयोन्यां हि तपश्चर्या कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration:
hīnavarṇo naraśreṣṭha tapyate sumahattapaḥ
bhaviṣyā śūdrayonyāṁ hi tapaścaryā kalau yuge

translations.english: O foremost of men, the degraded caste, the Śūdras, during your rege me, have engaged in austere penances. And in the Kali Yuga asceticism shall be established in the Sūdras.

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्मः परमो राम द्वापरे शूद्रधारितः
स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः
शूद्रस्तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम्
verses.transliteration:
adharmaḥ paramo rāma dvāpare śūdradhāritaḥ
sa vai viṣayaparyante tava rājanmahātapāḥ
śūdrastapyati durbuddhistena bālavadho hyayam

translations.english: O king, even in Davāpara, devout penances for Śūdras were considered as impiety, what to speak of the Tretāage. O king, one Śūdras, under the influence of vicious understanding, has begun devout penances within your kingdom. And for that reason this boy has met with death.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल मार्गस्व विषयं स्वकम्
दुष्कृतं यत्र पश्येथास्तत्र यत्नं समाचर
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla mārgasva viṣayaṁ svakam
duṣkṛtaṁ yatra paśyethāstatra yatnaṁ samācara

translations.english: While the king is entitled to the sixth portion of everything why should he not fully protect his subjects? Therefore, O chief of men, do you bring all informations of your kingdom. And be then studious to repress vices wherever you shall find them.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ते धर्मवृद्धिश्च नृणां चायुर्विवर्धनम्
भविष्यति नरश्रेष्ठ बालस्यास्य च जीवितम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ te dharmavṛddhiśca nṛṇāṁ cāyurvivardhanam
bhaviṣyati naraśreṣṭha bālasyāsya ca jīvitam

translations.english: And by that, O foremost of men, the piety of the subjects shall be increased, the lease of their life shall be prolonged and this boy shall regain his life.

verses.sanskrit:
नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वामृतमयं यथा
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
nāradasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvāmṛtamayaṁ yathā
praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṁ cedamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing the sweet words of the celestial saint Nārada, Rāma was greatly delighted and addressing Lakşmaņa said.

verses.sanskrit:
गन्धैश्च परमोदारैस्तैलैश्च सुसुगन्धिभिः
यथा न क्षीयते बालस्तथा सौम्य विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
gandhaiśca paramodāraistailaiśca susugandhibhiḥ
yathā na kṣīyate bālastathā saumya vidhīyatām

translations.english: O gently one, do you console that foremost of twice-born ones and place the dead body of the boy in a jar full of oil. Let this body be protected by sweet-scented oil so that it might not be soiled by any means. See that it is not disfigured, its joints are not loosened and the hairs do not fall off.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप
वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किंकरः समुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
so'bravītpraṇato bhūtvā ayamasmi narādhipa
vaśyastava mahābāho kiṁkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ

translations.english: The highly illustrious Rāma, the descendant of Ikşvākus, thus commanded Lakşmaņa, gifted with auspicious marks, and thought of his car and desired it to come soon. Understanding his intention the golden car appeared before him in no time and saluting him said: O you of long arms, your chariot has come.

verses.sanskrit:
भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः
अभिवाद्य महर्षीस्तान्विमानं सोऽध्यरोहत
verses.transliteration:
bhāṣitaṁ ruciraṁ śrutvā puṣpakasya narādhipaḥ
abhivādya maharṣīstānvimānaṁ so'dhyarohata

translations.english: Hearing the sweet words of Puşpaka the king Rāma saluted the great ascetics, ascended the car with his burning bow, quiver and dagger and left Bharata and Lakşmaņa in charge of the city.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रायात्प्रतीचीं स मरून्विचिन्वंश्च समन्ततः
उत्तरामगमच्छ्रीमान्दिशं हिमवदावृतम्
verses.transliteration:
prāyātpratīcīṁ sa marūnvicinvaṁśca samantataḥ
uttarāmagamacchrīmāndiśaṁ himavadāvṛtam

translations.english: And searching that Śūdra devotee here and there Rāghava proceeded towards the west. And not beholding him there he went to the North bounded by the Himālayas.

verses.sanskrit:
अपश्यमानस्तत्रापि स्वल्पमप्यथ दुष्कृतम्
पूर्वामपि दिशं सर्वामथापश्यन्नराधिपः
verses.transliteration:
apaśyamānastatrāpi svalpamapyatha duṣkṛtam
pūrvāmapi diśaṁ sarvāmathāpaśyannarādhipaḥ

translations.english: And even there he did not espy the Sūdra ascetic and even the smallest iniquity was not seen there. There upon returning from that quarter the king journeyed the whole of east.

verses.sanskrit:
दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः
शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः
verses.transliteration:
dakṣiṇāṁ diśamākrāmattato rājarṣinandanaḥ
śaivalasyottare pārśve dadarśa sumahatsaraḥ

translations.english: From the east Răghava proceeded towards the south and espied a big tank by the side of the Saivala mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम
कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिर्ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration:
kasyāṁ yonyāṁ tapovṛddha vartase dṛḍhavikrama
kautūhalāttvāṁ pṛcchāmi rāmo dāśarathirhyaham

translations.english: On the banks of that pond one ascetic was performing the most austere penances with his legs upwards and head downwards. There upon approaching him, Rama Said O you of good vows, blessed are you; I do ask you, now, O you highly effulgent and grown old in asceticism, in what Varņa you are born. I put this question out of curiosity. I am the son of king Dasaratha and my name is Răma.

verses.sanskrit:
मनीषितस्ते को न्वर्थः स्वर्गलाभो वराश्रयः
यमश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस
verses.transliteration:
manīṣitaste ko nvarthaḥ svargalābho varāśrayaḥ
yamaśritya tapastaptaṁ śrotumicchāmi tāpasa

translations.english: For what are you going through such hard austerities? Is it heaven or anything else that you pray for? O ascetic, I wish to hear, of the purpose for which you are performing such hard penances. a Brāhmaṇa, or irrepressible Kșatriya or the third caste Vaisyas or a Śūdra? Do you speak the truth and you shall be crowned with auspiciousness Art you an

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
अवाक्शिरास्तथाभूतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
avākśirāstathābhūto vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of Räma of unwearied actions, the ascetic, with his face downwards, said.

verses.sanskrit:
शूद्रयोन्यां प्रसूतोऽस्मि तप उग्रं समास्थितः
देवत्वं प्रार्थये राम सशरीरो महायशः
verses.transliteration:
śūdrayonyāṁ prasūto'smi tapa ugraṁ samāsthitaḥ
devatvaṁ prārthaye rāma saśarīro mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: O highly illustrious Rāma, I am born in the race of sūdras; and with a view to reach the region of the celestials with my body I am going through these austere penances.

verses.sanskrit:
न मिथ्याहं वदे राजन्देवलोकजिगीषया
शूद्रं मां विद्धि काकुत्स्थ शम्बूकं नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration:
na mithyāhaṁ vade rājandevalokajigīṣayā
śūdraṁ māṁ viddhi kākutstha śambūkaṁ nāma nāmataḥ

translations.english: O Kākutstha, I shall never utter a falsehood since I am willing to conquer the region of gods. I am a Sūdra and my name is Sambūka.

verses.sanskrit:
भाषतस्तस्य शूद्रस्य खड्गं सुरुचिरप्रभम्
निष्कृष्य कोशाद्विमलं शिरश्चिच्छेद राघवः
verses.transliteration:
bhāṣatastasya śūdrasya khaḍgaṁ suruciraprabham
niṣkṛṣya kośādvimalaṁ śiraściccheda rāghavaḥ

translations.english: The Sūdra ascetic having said this, Rama took out of scabbard a beautiful sharp sword and chopped off his head therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा
आतिथ्यं परमं प्राप्य निषसाद नराधिपः
verses.transliteration:
so'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā
ātithyaṁ paramaṁ prāpya niṣasāda narādhipaḥ

translations.english: Rāma saluted that high-souled and highly effulgent Rșis Agastya. And having received due hospitality he sat there.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः
स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca mahātejāḥ kumbhayonirmahātapāḥ
svāgataṁ te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto'si rāghava

translations.english: Thereupon the highly effulgent and leading ascetic Kumbhayoni said: O Rāghava, I have been greatly delighted with your coming, By my good fortune I have seen the today.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः
अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम राजन्हृदि स्थितः
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ me bahumato rāma guṇairbahubhiruttamaiḥ
atithiḥ pūjanīyaśca mama rājanhṛdi sthitaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, I love you because you are gifted with many qualities. O king, you are my worshipful guest. I was thinking of you.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम्
ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः
verses.transliteration:
surā hi kathayanti tvāmāgataṁ śūdraghātinam
brāhmaṇasya tu dharmeṇa tvayā jīvāpitaḥ sutaḥ

translations.english: The celestials informed me that you went coming having slain the Sūdra ascetic. You have observed piety and have given back life to dead child of the Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit:
उष्यतां चेह रजनीं सकाशे मम राघव
प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता स्वपुरमेव हि
verses.transliteration:
uṣyatāṁ ceha rajanīṁ sakāśe mama rāghava
prabhāte puṣpakeṇa tvaṁ gantā svapurameva hi

translations.english: Do you spend this night with me, O Rāghava. You are the graceful Nārāyaṇa. In you the whole universe is established. You are the lord of all creatures and the eternal Purusha. You shall go to your city next morning in your Pușpaka car.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा
दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ cābharaṇaṁ saumya nirmitaṁ viśvakarmaṇā
divyaṁ divyena vapuṣā dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā
pratigṛhṇīṣva kākutstha matpriyaṁ kuru rāghava

translations.english: This ornament, O gentle one, has been made by the architect of the celestials; its make is very beautiful and it is dazzling by its own lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दानं सुमहत्फलमुच्यते
तस्मात्प्रदास्ये विधिवत्तत्प्रतीच्छ नरर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
dattasya hi punardānaṁ sumahatphalamucyate
tasmātpradāsye vidhivattatpratīccha nararṣabha

translations.english: By accepting this, O Kākutstha, do you satisfy my desire. It is said, that one attains to best fruits if he makes present to his deity, of best articles he gets from another.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्रामः प्रतिजग्राह मुनेस्तस्य महात्मनः
दिव्यमाभरणं चित्रं प्रदीप्तमिव भास्करम्
verses.transliteration:
tadrāmaḥ pratijagrāha munestasya mahātmanaḥ
divyamābharaṇaṁ citraṁ pradīptamiva bhāskaram

translations.english: Therefore, O Rama, by virtue of Indra's portion, do you accept this omament and confer upon me the salvation. Hearing the words of the Muni, Rāma took from him that brilliant celestial ornament burning like the rays of the Sun. And having taken that excellent ornament, Dāsarathi asked the great saint Kumbhayoni, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
कुतूहलतया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः
आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान्
verses.transliteration:
kutūhalatayā brahmanpṛcchāmi tvāṁ mahāyaśaḥ
āścaryāṇāṁ bahūnāṁ hi nidhiḥ paramako bhavān

translations.english: When have you obtained this celestial ornamens of a wondrous make? Who have given you this? O Brāhmaṇa, I do accost you thus out of curiosity. You are the mine of many wonders.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
शृणु राम यथावृत्तं पुरा त्रेतायुगे गते
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvati kākutsthe munirvākyamathābravīt
śṛṇu rāma yathāvṛttaṁ purā tretāyuge gate

translations.english: Whereto Agastya replied, saying Hearken, O Rāma, how I did obtain this ornament in the Tretă age.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा त्रेतायुगे ह्यासीदरण्यं बहुविस्तरम्
समन्ताद्योजनशतं निर्मृगं पक्षिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration:
purā tretāyuge hyāsīdaraṇyaṁ bahuvistaram
samantādyojanaśataṁ nirmṛgaṁ pakṣivarjitam

translations.english: O Răma, in Tretāage, there was a huge forest extending over hundred Yojanas divested of animals and men.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्निर्मानुषेऽरण्ये कुर्वाणस्तप उत्तमम्
अहमाक्रमितुं सौम्य तदरण्यमुपागमम्
verses.transliteration:
tasminnirmānuṣe'raṇye kurvāṇastapa uttamam
ahamākramituṁ saumya tadaraṇyamupāgamam

translations.english: In that forest of without men I used to perform my austere penances. Once on a time I began to roam all over the forest being willing to see well every nook and corner of it. And I saw that it was impossible to ascertain how very pleasant that forest was. In every place there were trees with profuse sweet fruits. and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्राहमवसं रात्रिं नैदाघीं पुरुषर्षभ
प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय सरस्तदुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tatrāhamavasaṁ rātriṁ naidāghīṁ puruṣarṣabha
prabhāte kālyamutthāya sarastadupacakrame

translations.english: O best among the men, it was summer and I spent that night in that hermitage. Next morning leaving my bed I arrived at the banks of the pond and saw a plump dead body in the waters. None of its limbs was pale and its beauty was not spoiled.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्यर्थं स्वर्गिणं तत्र विमाने रघुनन्दन
उपास्तेऽप्सरसां वीर सहस्रं दिव्यभूषणम्
गान्ति गेयानि रम्याणि वादयन्ति तथापराः
verses.transliteration:
atyarthaṁ svargiṇaṁ tatra vimāne raghunandana
upāste'psarasāṁ vīra sahasraṁ divyabhūṣaṇam
gānti geyāni ramyāṇi vādayanti tathāparāḥ

translations.english: Beholding it and standing on the banks I began to mediate upon it. And thought I What is this?' In a moment I espied a beautiful car, swiftcoursing like the mind and drawn by ganders. And I saw in that chariot a celestial person. He was being attended by Apsarās adorned with celestial ornaments and having lotus-eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यतो मे तदा राम विमानादवरुह्य च
तं शवं भक्षयामास स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
paśyato me tadā rāma vimānādavaruhya ca
taṁ śavaṁ bhakṣayāmāsa sa svargī raghunandana

translations.english: O Rāma, the foremost of Raghu's race, like to the moon renouncing the summit of the Sumeru mount that celestial wight got down from his seat in the car and engaged in devouring the dead body.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो भुक्त्वा यथाकामं मांसं बहु च सुष्ठु च
अवतीर्य सरः स्वर्गी संस्प्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tato bhuktvā yathākāmaṁ māṁsaṁ bahu ca suṣṭhu ca
avatīrya saraḥ svargī saṁspraṣṭumupacakrame

translations.english: And having taken enough flesh he got down into waters and duly performed ablution. O Rāma, there after that heavenly being again addressed himself for ascending the car.

verses.sanskrit:
तमहं देवसंकाशमारोहन्तमुदीक्ष्य वै
अथाहमब्रुवं वाक्यं तमेव पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration:
tamahaṁ devasaṁkāśamārohantamudīkṣya vai
athāhamabruvaṁ vākyaṁ tameva puruṣarṣabha

translations.english: O foremost of men, beholding that heavenly being about to get up I accosted him, saying, Who are you? I see, you have a celestial firm, then why have you taken such an abominable food?

verses.sanskrit:
आश्चर्यमीदृशो भावो भास्वरो देवसंमतः
आहारो गर्हितः सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
āścaryamīdṛśo bhāvo bhāsvaro devasaṁmataḥ
āhāro garhitaḥ saumya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ

translations.english: O you adored of the immortals, persons like you should not take such meals. O gentle one, I have been stricken with great curiosity and wish to hear all. Thine living upon dead body does not appear agreeable to me.

verses.sanskrit:
भुक्त्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम्
प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
bhuktvā tu bhāṣitaṁ vākyaṁ mama rāma śubhākṣaram
prāñjaliḥ pratyuvācedaṁ sa svargī raghunandana

translations.english: O Rāma, hearing my words pregnant with sound reasoning, that heavenly being, with folded hands, said.

verses.sanskrit:
शृणु ब्रह्मन्यथावृत्तं ममैतत्सुखदुःखयोः
दुरतिक्रमणीयं हि यथा पृच्छसि मां द्विज
verses.transliteration:
śṛṇu brahmanyathāvṛttaṁ mamaitatsukhaduḥkhayoḥ
duratikramaṇīyaṁ hi yathā pṛcchasi māṁ dvija

translations.english: Hear, O Brāhmaṇa, from what unavoidable cause has proceeded this happy and again painful incident.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः
सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration:
purā vaidarbhako rājā pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ
sudeva iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān

translations.english: There flourished in the days of yore a highly illustratious and powerful Vidarbha king under the name of Sudeva known over three worlds. He was my father.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत
अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya putradvayaṁ brahmandvābhyāṁ strībhyāmajāyata
ahaṁ śveta iti khyāto yavīyānsuratho'bhavat

translations.english: His two queens gave birth to two sons. My name is Sveta and the name of my youngest brother was Suratha.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः पितरि स्वर्याते पौरा मामभ्यषेचयन्
तत्राहं कृतवान्राज्यं धर्मेण सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ pitari svaryāte paurā māmabhyaṣecayan
tatrāhaṁ kṛtavānrājyaṁ dharmeṇa susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: After the decease of my sire the subjects installed me on the throne and I governed them piously and carefully for a thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम
कालधर्मं हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ nimitte kasmiṁścidvijñātāyurdvijottama
kāladharmaṁ hṛdi nyasya tato vanamupāgamam

translations.english: By some reason I was informed of the extent of my life. And when I perceived that the lease of my life had well-night expired I entered into the life of Vānaprastha.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं वनमिदं दुर्गं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम्
तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टोऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ vanamidaṁ durgaṁ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam
tapaścartuṁ praviṣṭo'smi samīpe sarasaḥ śubhe

translations.english: And having placed my brother Suratha on the throne I entered into a dense forest devoid of men and animals at no distance from this pond to perform devout penances. And I performed austerities for a long time near this pond.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महामुने
तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ varṣasahasrāṇi tapastrīṇi mahāmune
taptvā suduṣkaraṁ prāpto brahmalokamanuttamam

translations.english: Having performed hard penances in this forest, for three thousand years I at last attained to the region of Brahmā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मां स्वर्गसंस्थं वै क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम
बाधेते परमोदार ततोऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration:
tato māṁ svargasaṁsthaṁ vai kṣutpipāse dvijottama
bādhete paramodāra tato'haṁ vyathitendriyaḥ

translations.english: And albeit I had reached the Brahmā region I was still being assailed by hunger and thirst. And gradually I grew tired therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
गत्वा त्रिभुवणश्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह
भगवन्ब्रह्मलोकोऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration:
gatvā tribhuvaṇaśreṣṭhaṁ pitāmahamuvāca ha
bhagavanbrahmaloko'yaṁ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ

translations.english: There upon approaching the patriarch Brahma, the lord of three worlds, I said: O lord, here there is no hunger or thirst; still why have I been brought to their control? Of what iniquity of mine is this fruit? O deity, tell me upon what I shall live.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहस्तु मामाह तवाहारः सुदेवज
स्वादूनि स्वानि मांसानि तानि भक्षय नित्यशः
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahastu māmāha tavāhāraḥ sudevaja
svādūni svāni māṁsāni tāni bhakṣaya nityaśaḥ

translations.english: Whereto the patriarch replied: O son of Sudeva, do you live upon sweet savoured meat everyday.

verses.sanskrit:
दत्तं न तेऽस्ति सूक्ष्मोऽपि वने सत्त्वनिषेविते
तेन स्वर्गगतो वत्स बाध्यसे क्षुत्पिपासया
verses.transliteration:
dattaṁ na te'sti sūkṣmo'pi vane sattvaniṣevite
tena svargagato vatsa bādhyase kṣutpipāsayā

translations.english: O Śveta, you did only look to the growth of your person when you did perform rigid penances. O you of a great mind, nothing grows, when nothing is sown. You did only perform ascetic penances, but you did not make any gift of charity. It is for that reason, O my son, that you are, even in heaven, being assailed by hunger and thirst.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम्
भक्षयस्वामृतरसं सा ते तृप्तिर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ supuṣṭamāhāraiḥ svaśarīramanuttamam
bhakṣayasvāmṛtarasaṁ sā te tṛptirbhaviṣyati

translations.english: Thereupon do you now live upon your own dead body fostered by various food. By this you shall keep up your being.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा तु तद्वनं श्वेत अगस्त्यः सुमहानृषिः
आक्रमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा कृच्छाद्विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration:
yadā tu tadvanaṁ śveta agastyaḥ sumahānṛṣiḥ
ākramiṣyati durdharṣastadā kṛcchādvimokṣyase

translations.english: O Sveta, you shall be relived from this affliction when the irrepressible, great Saint Agastya shall reach that forest.

verses.sanskrit:
स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि
किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम्
verses.transliteration:
sa hi tārayituṁ saumya śaktaḥ suragaṇānapi
kiṁ punastvāṁ mahābāho kṣutpipāsāvaśaṁ gatam

translations.english: O gentle one, even to the immortals he can give salvation; what wonder it is that he shall relieve you from the miseries of hunger and thirst.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं भगवतः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य निश्चयम्
आहारं गर्हितं कुर्मि स्वशरीरं द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ bhagavataḥ śrutvā devadevasya niścayam
āhāraṁ garhitaṁ kurmi svaśarīraṁ dvijottama

translations.english: O foremost of twice-born ones, from the time of hearing those words of the great Brahma, the god of gods, I have been engaged in this cursed work of feeding upon my own dead body.

verses.sanskrit:
बहून्वर्षगणान्ब्रह्मन्भुज्यमानमिदं मया
क्षयं नाभ्येति ब्रह्मर्षे तृप्तिश्चापि ममोत्तमा
verses.transliteration:
bahūnvarṣagaṇānbrahmanbhujyamānamidaṁ mayā
kṣayaṁ nābhyeti brahmarṣe tṛptiścāpi mamottamā

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, for many long years I have been living upon this corpse still I have not done with it. O Saint, I, too, derive satisfaction from it; I now understand that you are the illustrious Agastya born of a Kumbha; for none else is capable of coming here; do you therefore save me from this pain, who am afflicted with great miseries.

verses.sanskrit:
इदमाभरणं सौम्य तारणार्थं द्विजोत्तम
प्रतिगृह्णीष्व ब्रह्मर्षे प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
idamābharaṇaṁ saumya tāraṇārthaṁ dvijottama
pratigṛhṇīṣva brahmarṣe prasādaṁ kartumarhasi

translations.english: O foremost of twice-born ones, O gentle one, do you take this ornament; may good betide you. Do you be propitiated with me.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम्
तारणायोपजग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tasyāhaṁ svargiṇo vākyaṁ śrutvā duḥkhasamanvitam
tāraṇāyopajagrāha tadābharaṇamuttamam

translations.english: Hearing those words of the heavenly being, exciting pity, I accepted this ornament for saving him.

verses.sanskrit:
मया प्रतिगृहीते तु तस्मिन्नाभरणे शुभे
मानुषः पूर्वको देहो राजर्षेः स ननाश ह
verses.transliteration:
mayā pratigṛhīte tu tasminnābharaṇe śubhe
mānuṣaḥ pūrvako deho rājarṣeḥ sa nanāśa ha

translations.english: And as soon as I took this ornament that human body of the royal saint disappeared.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रनष्टे तु शरीरेऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा
तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं पुनः
verses.transliteration:
pranaṣṭe tu śarīre'sau rājarṣiḥ parayā mudā
tṛptaḥ pramudito rājā jagāma tridivaṁ punaḥ

translations.english: And the body being dissolved, the royal saint Śveta, greatly delighted, happily went to the land of immortals.

verses.sanskrit:
तेनेदं शक्रतुल्येन दिव्यमाभरणं मम
तस्मिन्निमित्ते काकुत्स्थ दत्तमद्भुतदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
tenedaṁ śakratulyena divyamābharaṇaṁ mama
tasminnimitte kākutstha dattamadbhutadarśanam

translations.english: It is for this reason, O Kākutstha, that royal saint, resembling Indra, conferred upon me this wondrous, celestial ornament.

verses.sanskrit:
तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः
गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव भूयः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tadadbhutatamaṁ vākyaṁ śrutvāgastyasya rāghavaḥ
gauravādvismayāccaiva bhūyaḥ praṣṭuṁ pracakrame

translations.english: Hearing the wondrous words of the great saint Kumbhayoni, Rāma, out of great curiosity and importance of the subject, again asked him, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवंस्तद्वनं घोरं तपस्तप्यति यत्र सः
श्वेतो वैदर्भको राजा कथं तदमृगद्विजम्
verses.transliteration:
bhagavaṁstadvanaṁ ghoraṁ tapastapyati yatra saḥ
śveto vaidarbhako rājā kathaṁ tadamṛgadvijam

translations.english: O Brahmana, why was that dense forest, in which the king Sveta of Vidarbha used to perform hard penances, divested of birds and animals?

verses.sanskrit:
निःसत्त्वं च वनं जातं शून्यं मनुजवर्जितम्
तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टः स श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration:
niḥsattvaṁ ca vanaṁ jātaṁ śūnyaṁ manujavarjitam
tapaścartuṁ praviṣṭaḥ sa śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ

translations.english: And how did he proceed to that forest devoid of men and animals for undergoing penances? I wish to hear the truth.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम्
वाक्यं परमतेजस्वी वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam
vākyaṁ paramatejasvī vaktumevopacakrame

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāma stricken with curiosity, the highly effulgent saint Agastya said.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः
तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलवर्धनः
verses.transliteration:
purā kṛtayuge rāma manurdaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ
tasya putro mahānāsīdikṣvākuḥ kulavardhanaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, formerly in the golden age, Manu was the king. His son was ikṣvāku.

verses.sanskrit:
तं पुत्रं पूर्वके राज्ये निक्षिप्य भुवि दुर्जयम्
पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां भव कर्तेत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
taṁ putraṁ pūrvake rājye nikṣipya bhuvi durjayam
pṛthivyāṁ rājavaṁśānāṁ bhava kartetyuvāca ha

translations.english: Ha. ing instaned the irrepressible Iksvāku, Manu said: 'By you the lord over creatures.' Saying so be it Ikşvāku accepted the command. There upon greatly delighted Manu said to his son.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतोऽस्मि परमोदारकर्ता चासि न संशयः
दण्डेन च प्रजा रक्ष मा च दण्डमकारणे
verses.transliteration:
prīto'smi paramodārakartā cāsi na saṁśayaḥ
daṇḍena ca prajā rakṣa mā ca daṇḍamakāraṇe

translations.english: I have been highly pleased with you. For sooth you shall become a very liberal price. You shall govern the subjects meting out proper punishment to them, but do not punish them without any fault.

verses.sanskrit:
अपराधिषु यो दण्डः पात्यते मानवेषु वै
स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः स्वर्गं नयति पार्थिवम्
verses.transliteration:
aparādhiṣu yo daṇḍaḥ pātyate mānaveṣu vai
sa daṇḍo vidhivanmuktaḥ svargaṁ nayati pārthivam

translations.english: If the punishment, which a king inflicts upon the guilty, be just it becomes the instrumental in taking the giver to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्दण्डे महाबाहो यत्नवान्भव पुत्रक
धर्मो हि परमो लोके कुर्वतस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
tasmāddaṇḍe mahābāho yatnavānbhava putraka
dharmo hi paramo loke kurvataste bhaviṣyati

translations.english: Therefore, O my son having large arms, be particularly studious as regards punishment for thereby you shall acquire great piety.

verses.sanskrit:
इति तं बहु संदिश्य मनुः पुत्रं समाधिना
जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
iti taṁ bahu saṁdiśya manuḥ putraṁ samādhinā
jagāma tridivaṁ hṛṣṭo brahmalokamanuttamam

translations.english: Having in this wise advised Ikşvāku Manu delightedly repaired to the region Brahmā.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयाते त्रिदिवे तस्मिन्निक्ष्वाकुरमितप्रभः
जनयिष्ये कथं पुत्रानिति चिन्तापरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
prayāte tridive tasminnikṣvākuramitaprabhaḥ
janayiṣye kathaṁ putrāniti cintāparo'bhavat

translations.english: After Manu's departure towards the heaven, the effulgent Ikşavku thought of the means for creating progeny.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतः सुतान्
जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान्
verses.transliteration:
karmabhirbahurūpaiśca taistairmanusutaḥ sutān
janayāmāsa dharmātmā śataṁ devasutopamān

translations.english: Thereupon performing many pious rites Manu's son engendered a hundred sons. O descendant of Raghu, the youngest of all those sons became stupid and ignorant and did not respect his elder brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
नाम तस्य च दण्डेति पिता चक्रेऽल्पतेजसः
अवश्यं दण्डपतनं शरीरेऽस्य भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
nāma tasya ca daṇḍeti pitā cakre'lpatejasaḥ
avaśyaṁ daṇḍapatanaṁ śarīre'sya bhaviṣyati

translations.english: And thinking that he should therefore be punished he named this son 'Danda.'

verses.sanskrit:
स पश्यमानस्तं दोषं घोरं पुत्रस्य राघव
विन्ध्यशैवलयोर्मध्ये राज्यं प्रादादरिंदम
verses.transliteration:
sa paśyamānastaṁ doṣaṁ ghoraṁ putrasya rāghava
vindhyaśaivalayormadhye rājyaṁ prādādariṁdama

translations.english: Thereupon finding no other province worthy of Danda he allotted the region between Vihdhya and Saivala to him.

verses.sanskrit:
स दण्डस्तत्र राजाभूद्रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि
पुरं चाप्रतिमं राम न्यवेशयदनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
sa daṇḍastatra rājābhūdramye parvatarodhasi
puraṁ cāpratimaṁ rāma nyaveśayadanuttamam

translations.english: Danda became king of that picturesque valley. And having reared a fine city there he named it as Madhumanta and appointed śukrācārya of firm views as his priest.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं स राजा तद्राज्यं कारयत्सपुरोहितः
प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराज्यं यथा दिवि
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sa rājā tadrājyaṁ kārayatsapurohitaḥ
prahṛṣṭamanujākīrṇaṁ devarājyaṁ yathā divi

translations.english: Having thus established his kingdom, Danda, with his priest, began to lord over it filled with healthy and delighted people like to the lord of celestials in their region.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसंभवः
अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
etadākhyāya rāmāya maharṣiḥ kumbhasaṁbhavaḥ
asyāmevāparaṁ vākyaṁ kathāyāmupacakrame

translations.english: Having related this story to Rāma the great saint Agastya again said in this context.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स दण्डः काकुत्स्थ बहुवर्षगणायुतम्
अकरोत्तत्र मन्दात्मा राज्यं निहतकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa daṇḍaḥ kākutstha bahuvarṣagaṇāyutam
akarottatra mandātmā rājyaṁ nihatakaṇṭakam

translations.english: O Kākutstha, having subdued his passions, the king Danda, reigned undisturbed in this wise for many long years.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ काले तु कस्मिंश्चिद्राजा भार्गवमाश्रमम्
रमणीयमुपाक्रामच्चैत्रे मासि मनोरमे
verses.transliteration:
atha kāle tu kasmiṁścidrājā bhārgavamāśramam
ramaṇīyamupākrāmaccaitre māsi manorame

translations.english: Thereupon during spring, in the month of Caitra the king arrived at the picturesque hermitage of the preceptor Sukra.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्र भार्गवकन्यां स रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि
विचरन्तीं वनोद्देशे दण्डोऽपश्यदनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
tatra bhārgavakanyāṁ sa rūpeṇāpratimāṁ bhuvi
vicarantīṁ vanoddeśe daṇḍo'paśyadanuttamām

translations.english: At that time, Sukra's daughter, matchless in beauty and grace, was walking in the forest. The king saw that jewel of a girl, and being stricken with lust and growing restless he approached her and said.

verses.sanskrit:
कुतस्त्वमसि सुश्रोणि कस्य वासि सुता शुभे
पीडितोऽहमनङ्गेन पृच्छामि त्वां सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration:
kutastvamasi suśroṇi kasya vāsi sutā śubhe
pīḍito'hamanaṅgena pṛcchāmi tvāṁ sumadhyame

translations.english: O you having a beautiful waist, O fair lady, whose daughter are you? O you having a moonlike countenance, I have been assailed by the arrows of Cupid and hence I do accost you thus.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य मोहोन्मत्तस्य कामिनः
भार्गवी प्रत्युवाचेदं वचः सानुनयं नृपम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tvevaṁ bruvāṇasya mohonmattasya kāminaḥ
bhārgavī pratyuvācedaṁ vacaḥ sānunayaṁ nṛpam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the vicious-souled Danda, maddened with lust, Sukra's daughter humbly said.

verses.sanskrit:
भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धि देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
