अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
bhārgavasya sutāṁ viddhi devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
arajāṁ nāma rājendra jyeṣṭhāmāśramavāsinīm

translations.english: "O king of kings I am the daughter of the humbly Sukra of unwearied actions and my name is Araja. I am living in this hermitage, O king, do not touch me forcibly for I am a maid and hence under the guardianship forcibly for my father. Besides my father is my preceptor, and you are also his disciple.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वात्र मया कार्यं धर्मदृष्टेन सत्पथा
वरयस्व नृप श्रेष्ठ पितरं मे महाद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi vātra mayā kāryaṁ dharmadṛṣṭena satpathā
varayasva nṛpa śreṣṭha pitaraṁ me mahādyutim

translations.english: Being enraged he shall imprecate you with a curse. O foremost of men, if you do cherish any desire for me, do you honestly and piously pray for it to my sire. Or else you shall suffer dreadful consequences in the long run.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्यथा तु फलं तुभ्यं भवेद्घोराभिसंहितम्
क्रोधेन हि पिता मेऽसौ त्रैलोक्यमपि निर्दहेत्
verses.transliteration:
anyathā tu phalaṁ tubhyaṁ bhavedghorābhisaṁhitam
krodhena hi pitā me'sau trailokyamapi nirdahet

translations.english: When worked up with ire, my father can reduce even the three worlds to ashes. O you of a blameless person, if you do pray, my father may make me over to your hands.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामशरार्दितः
प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय सोऽञ्जलिम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bruvāṇāmarajāṁ daṇḍaḥ kāmaśarārditaḥ
pratyuvāca madonmattaḥ śirasyādhāya so'ñjalim

translations.english: Arajas having said this, the king Danda, maddened with lust, placing folded palms on his head, said.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि
त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते शुभानने
verses.transliteration:
prasādaṁ kuru suśroṇi na kālaṁ kṣeptumarhasi
tvatkṛte hi mama prāṇā vidīryante śubhānane

translations.english: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वां प्राप्य हि वधो वापि पापं वापि सुदारुणम्
भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम्
verses.transliteration:
tvāṁ prāpya hi vadho vāpi pāpaṁ vāpi sudāruṇam
bhaktaṁ bhajasva māṁ bhīru bhajamānaṁ suvihvalam

translations.english: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोर्भ्यां गृह्य बलाद्बली
विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
evamuktvā tu tāṁ kanyāṁ dorbhyāṁ gṛhya balādbalī
visphurantīṁ yathākāmaṁ maithunāyopacakrame

translations.english: Having said this the king forcibly ravished her. Having perpetrated such a mighty iniquity he speedily returned to his own city Madhumanta.

verses.sanskrit:
तमनर्थं महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम्
नगरं प्रययौ चाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tamanarthaṁ mahāghoraṁ daṇḍaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam
nagaraṁ prayayau cāśu madhumantamanuttamam

translations.english: Having said this the king forcibly ravished her. Having perpetrated such a mighty iniquity he speedily returned to his own city Madhumanta.

verses.sanskrit:
अरजापि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः
प्रतीक्षते सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration:
arajāpi rudantī sā āśramasyāvidūrataḥ
pratīkṣate susaṁtrastā pitaraṁ devasaṁnibham

translations.english: Arajă cried aloud in forest at no distance from the hermitage and waited for here sire who had been away on visiting the celestials. a blameless person, if you do pray, my father may make me over to your hands.

verses.sanskrit:
स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः
स्वमाश्रमं शिष्य वृतः क्षुधार्तः संन्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration:
sa muhūrtādupaśrutya devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ
svamāśramaṁ śiṣya vṛtaḥ kṣudhārtaḥ saṁnyavartata

translations.english: Thereupon having heard everything about Arajă from a disciple, he, surrounded by his pupils, arrived at his own hermitage and beheld her there poorly, soiled with dust and like to the morning rays of the moon possessed by a planet.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य रोषः समभवत्क्षुधार्तस्य विशेषतः
निर्दहन्निव लोकांस्त्रीञ्शिष्यांश्चेदमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tasya roṣaḥ samabhavatkṣudhārtasya viśeṣataḥ
nirdahanniva lokāṁstrīñśiṣyāṁścedamuvāca ha

translations.english: He was stricken with hunger and was greatly incensed on beholding his daughter in that wretched plight, as if burning the three worlds with rage. Addressing his pupils, he said.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यध्वं विपरीतस्य दण्डस्याविदितात्मनः
विपत्तिं घोरसंकाशां क्रुद्धामग्निशिखामिव
verses.transliteration:
paśyadhvaṁ viparītasya daṇḍasyāviditātmanaḥ
vipattiṁ ghorasaṁkāśāṁ kruddhāmagniśikhāmiva

translations.english: Do you witness today the dreadful calamity, arising out of my flaming ire, of the vicious Daņda treading the path of immorality.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षयोऽस्य दुर्मतेः प्राप्तः सानुगस्य दुरात्मनः
यः प्रदीप्तां हुताशस्य शिखां वै स्प्रष्टुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration:
kṣayo'sya durmateḥ prāptaḥ sānugasya durātmanaḥ
yaḥ pradīptāṁ hutāśasya śikhāṁ vai spraṣṭumicchati

translations.english: This vicious wight has placed his hands in the burning flame so he shall, along with followers, meet with destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मात्स कृतवान्पापमीदृशं घोरदर्शनम्
तस्मात्प्राप्स्यति दुर्मेधाः फलं पापस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration:
yasmātsa kṛtavānpāpamīdṛśaṁ ghoradarśanam
tasmātprāpsyati durmedhāḥ phalaṁ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Since that vile being has perpetrated such a dreadful crime he shall forsooth suffer the consequence thereof.

verses.sanskrit:
सप्तरात्रेण राजासौ सभृत्यबलवाहनः
पापकर्मसमाचारो वधं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration:
saptarātreṇa rājāsau sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ
pāpakarmasamācāro vadhaṁ prāpsyati durmatiḥ

translations.english: Within seven nights, the wicked and vicious Daņda, with his son, soldiers and retinue, shall meet with death.

verses.sanskrit:
समन्ताद्योजनशतं विषयं चास्य दुर्मतेः
धक्ष्यते पांसुवर्षेण महता पाकशासनः
verses.transliteration:
samantādyojanaśataṁ viṣayaṁ cāsya durmateḥ
dhakṣyate pāṁsuvarṣeṇa mahatā pākaśāsanaḥ

translations.english: Showering dust Indra shall destroy, to the extent of a hundred Yojana, the territory of this vicious king.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वसत्त्वानि यानीह स्थावराणि चराणि च
महता पांसुवर्षेण नाशं यास्यन्ति सर्वशः
verses.transliteration:
sarvasattvāni yānīha sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
mahatā pāṁsuvarṣeṇa nāśaṁ yāsyanti sarvaśaḥ

translations.english: And all creatures mobile and immobile, wherever they might be, shall be destroyed with this downpour of dust.

verses.sanskrit:
दण्डस्य विषयो यावत्तावत्सर्वसमुच्छ्रयः
पांसुभुत इवालक्ष्यः सप्तरात्राद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍasya viṣayo yāvattāvatsarvasamucchrayaḥ
pāṁsubhuta ivālakṣyaḥ saptarātrādbhaviṣyati

translations.english: All animals as far as this Daņdas' territory extends, shall be destroyed within seven nights.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधसंतपस्तमाश्रमनिवासिनम्
जनं जनपदान्तेषु स्थीयतामिति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā krodhasaṁtapastamāśramanivāsinam
janaṁ janapadānteṣu sthīyatāmiti cābravīt

translations.english: Having said this, with eyes reddened with ire, USanas, Bhrgu's son, said to the inmates of his hermitage: Do you all go and wait outside this kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तूशसनो वाक्यं स आश्रमावसथो जनः
निष्क्रान्तो विषयात्तस्य स्थानं चक्रेऽथ बाह्यतः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tūśasano vākyaṁ sa āśramāvasatho janaḥ
niṣkrānto viṣayāttasya sthānaṁ cakre'tha bāhyataḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of the preceptor Sukra, the inmates left the hermitage and lived at a place beyond the limit of Danda's territories.

verses.sanskrit:
स तथोक्त्वा मुनिजनमरजामिदमब्रवीत्
इहैव वस दुर्मेधे आश्रमे सुसमाहिता
verses.transliteration:
sa tathoktvā munijanamarajāmidamabravīt
ihaiva vasa durmedhe āśrame susamāhitā

translations.english: Having thus addressed the inmates of the hermitage the great saint, said to Arajās. O unfortunate girl, with a devoted mind do you wait at this hermitage.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं योजनपर्यन्तं सरः सुरुचिरप्रभम्
अरजे विज्वरा भुङ्क्ष्व कालश्चात्र प्रतीक्ष्यताम्
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ yojanaparyantaṁ saraḥ suruciraprabham
araje vijvarā bhuṅkṣva kālaścātra pratīkṣyatām

translations.english: Without any anxiety O Arajās, do you wait for the time at the picturesque banks of this pond extending over a Yojana.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वत्समीपे तु ये सत्त्वा वासमेष्यन्ति तां निशाम्
अवध्याः पांसुवर्षेण ते भविष्यन्ति नित्यदा
verses.transliteration:
tvatsamīpe tu ye sattvā vāsameṣyanti tāṁ niśām
avadhyāḥ pāṁsuvarṣeṇa te bhaviṣyanti nityadā

translations.english: Within seven nights whoever shall approach you, shall be destroyed with this downpour of dust.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो वासमन्यत्र समुपाक्रमत्
सप्ताहाद्भस्मसाद्भूतं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना
verses.transliteration:
ityuktvā bhārgavo vāsamanyatra samupākramat
saptāhādbhasmasādbhūtaṁ yathoktaṁ brahmavādinā

translations.english: There upon Sukrācārya went away and lived elsewhere. According to the words of the saint, the entire kingdom of Danda, with servants, army, and conveyances, was destroyed within seven nights.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यासौ दण्डविषयो विन्ध्यशैवलसानुषु
शप्तो ब्रह्मर्षिणा तेन पुरा वैधर्मके कृते
verses.transliteration:
tasyāsau daṇḍaviṣayo vindhyaśaivalasānuṣu
śapto brahmarṣiṇā tena purā vaidharmake kṛte

translations.english: O Rāma, in the golden age, the province between the mountains Vindhya and Saivala comprising Danda's territories, imprecated by the Brāhmaṇa saint, in consequence of the iniquity of the vicious souled, was reduced into a desert. From that time it passes by the name of Dandaka forest.

verses.sanskrit:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव
संध्यामुपासितुं वीर समयो ह्यतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ pṛcchasi rāghava
saṁdhyāmupāsituṁ vīra samayo hyativartate

translations.english: O hero, the time for performing evening rites has come. Behold O foremost of men, having performed ablution, the great saints, on all sides, with jars full of water, are worshipping the sun.

verses.sanskrit:
स तैरृषिभिरभ्यस्तः सहितैर्ब्रह्मसत्तमैः
रविरस्तं गतो राम गच्छोदकमुपस्पृश
verses.transliteration:
sa tairṛṣibhirabhyastaḥ sahitairbrahmasattamaiḥ
ravirastaṁ gato rāma gacchodakamupaspṛśa

translations.english: Having accepted adoration in the shape of Vedic hymns chanted by Brāhmaṇas, wellversed in Vedas, the illustrious Aditya is about to be set. Therefore, O Rāma, do you perform the ceremony.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य संध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम्
आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
tatrodakamupaspṛśya saṁdhyāmanvāsya paścimām
āśramaṁ prāviśadrāmaḥ kumbhayonermahātmanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of the great saint, Rāma, to perform the evening adoration, went to the pond filled with Apsarās; and having performed the worship he again returned to the hermitage of the high-souled Agastya.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं फलमूलं तथौषधीः
शाकानि च पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration:
asyāgastyo bahuguṇaṁ phalamūlaṁ tathauṣadhīḥ
śākāni ca pavitrāṇi bhojanārthamakalpayat

translations.english: Thereupon the great ascetic offered him food many substantial Kanda, roots, Osadhis and the holy Sali rice.

verses.sanskrit:
स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्
प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपावसत्
verses.transliteration:
sa bhuktavānnaraśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam
prītaśca parituṣṭaśca tāṁ rātriṁ samupāvasat

translations.english: And taking that nectar-like cooked rice, Rāma, the foremost of men, was greatly delighted and spent the night there.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षिं कुम्भसंभवम्
आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
abhivādyābravīdrāmo maharṣiṁ kumbhasaṁbhavam
āpṛcche tvāṁ gamiṣyāmi māmanujñātumarhasi

translations.english: Having got up in the morning and performed the necessary ceremonies he approached the ascetic to bid farewell, and saluting him said: O great Rșis, I do crave for your permission to go to my own habitation. Do you permit me.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः
द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनार्थमिहात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi darśanena mahātmanaḥ
draṣṭuṁ caivāgamiṣyāmi pāvanārthamihātmanaḥ

translations.english: O high-souled one, I have been highly favoured and blessed by beholding you. I shall come again some other time to free myself from sins.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्
उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration:
tathā vadati kākutsthe vākyamadbhutadarśanam
uvāca paramaprīto dharmanetrastapodhanaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those wondrous words of Rāma, Agastya having asceticism for his wealth, delightedly said.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम्
पावनः सर्वलोकानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
atyadbhutamidaṁ vākyaṁ tava rāma śubhākṣaram
pāvanaḥ sarvalokānāṁ tvameva raghunandana

translations.english: O Rāma these words, set in charming letters, are highly wonderful. O descendant of Raghu, you are the purifier of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां ये नु पश्यन्ति केचन
पाविताः स्वर्गभूतास्ते पूज्यन्ते दिवि दैवतैः
verses.transliteration:
muhūrtamapi rāma tvāṁ ye nu paśyanti kecana
pāvitāḥ svargabhūtāste pūjyante divi daivataiḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, one, who beholds you, even for a moment, becomes pure and worthy of repairing to heaven. Even the leading deities worship him.

verses.sanskrit:
ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुर्भिरीक्षन्ते प्राणिनो भुवि
हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः
verses.transliteration:
ye ca tvāṁ ghoracakṣurbhirīkṣante prāṇino bhuvi
hatāste yamadaṇḍena sadyo nirayagāminaḥ

translations.english: Those on earth, who cast dreadful looks on you, are immediately brought under the control of Yama and are constrained to go to hell.

verses.sanskrit:
गच्छ चारिष्टमव्यग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्
प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिर्हि जगतो भवान्
verses.transliteration:
gaccha cāriṣṭamavyagraḥ panthānamakutobhayam
praśādhi rājyaṁ dharmeṇa gatirhi jagato bhavān

translations.english: Kākutstha, do you now go with ease and fearlessly, and govern your kingdom righteously. O Rāma you are the refuge of the world.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान्
अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम्
verses.transliteration:
abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṁ tāṁśca sarvāṁstapodhanān
adhyārohattadavyagraḥ puṣpakaṁ hemabhūṣitam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the great and truthful Rşis the wise Rāma, with folded hands, saluted him and other Rșis, and with serene air ascended the golden car Puşpaka.

verses.sanskrit:
तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा आशीर्वादैः समन्ततः
अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ prayāntaṁ munigaṇā āśīrvādaiḥ samantataḥ
apūjayanmahendrābhaṁ sahasrākṣamivāmarāḥ

translations.english: Like to the immortals welcoming the Chief of the deities the Rșis showered blessings upon Rāma from all sides while he was proceeding.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते
शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे
verses.transliteration:
svasthaḥ sa dadṛśe rāmaḥ puṣpake hemabhūṣite
śaśī meghasamīpastho yathā jaladharāgame

translations.english: And seated on golden car, he appeared like the moon, after the expiry of the rainy season.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः
अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो विमानादवरोहत
verses.transliteration:
tato'rdhadivase prāpte pūjyamānastatastataḥ
ayodhyāṁ prāpya kākutstho vimānādavarohata

translations.english: Thereupon being welcomed by the villagers on his way he reached Ayodhyā at noon and descended at the middle apartment.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणं भरतं चैव गत्वा तौ लघुविक्रमौ
ममागमनमाख्याय शब्दापय च मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇaṁ bharataṁ caiva gatvā tau laghuvikramau
mamāgamanamākhyāya śabdāpaya ca mā ciram

translations.english: Thereupon Rama said to the warder, Do you speedily go and having communicated my arrival to Lakşmaņa and Bharata bring them here.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
द्वाःस्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
dvāḥsthaḥ kumārāvāhūya rāghavāya nyavedayat

translations.english: According to the command of Räma of unwearied actions, the warders went to the princes and communicated to them (the arrival).

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः प्राप्तौ प्रियौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ
परिष्वज्य ततो रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ prāptau priyau bharatalakṣmaṇau
pariṣvajya tato rāmo vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Beholding Bharata and Lakşmaņa present, Rāma embraced them and said.

verses.sanskrit:
कृतं मया यथातथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम्
धर्मसेतुमतो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṁ mayā yathātathyaṁ dvijakāryamanuttamam
dharmasetumato bhūyaḥ kartumicchāmi rāghavau

translations.english: I have, as promised, performed the work of the excellent twice-born one. I wish now to perform a Rājasūya sacrifice, the source of religious glory, the destroyer of all sins, inexhaustible and un-ending.

verses.sanskrit:
युवाभ्यामात्मभूताभ्यां राजसूयमनुत्तमम्
सहितो यष्टुमिच्छामि तत्र धर्मो हि शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration:
yuvābhyāmātmabhūtābhyāṁ rājasūyamanuttamam
sahito yaṣṭumicchāmi tatra dharmo hi śāśvataḥ

translations.english: Therefore, with you like my own self, I wish to engage in the most excellent and eternal Rājasūya sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
इष्ट्वा तु राजसूयेन मित्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः
सुहुतेन सुयज्ञेन वरुणत्वमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
iṣṭvā tu rājasūyena mitraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
suhutena suyajñena varuṇatvamupāgamat

translations.english: O slayer of foes, by celebrating Rājasūya, Mitra attained to the dignity of Varuņa.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमश्च राजसूयेन इष्ट्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित्
प्राप्तश्च सर्वलोकानां कीर्तिं स्थानं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration:
somaśca rājasūyena iṣṭvā dharmeṇa dharmavit
prāptaśca sarvalokānāṁ kīrtiṁ sthānaṁ ca śāśvatam

translations.english: And having celebrated the Soma sacrifice, conversant with piety, established eternal fame in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह
हितं चायति युक्तं च प्रयतौ वक्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration:
asminnahani yacchreyaścintyatāṁ tanmayā saha
hitaṁ cāyati yuktaṁ ca prayatau vaktumarhatha

translations.english: Do you therefore consult with me even today as to what is proper. Do you consider carefully and tell me what is auspicious and productive of well-being in the long run.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadvākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ
bharataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of Raghava, Bharata, wellskilled in the are of speech, with folded hands, said O pious Sir, in you are established piety, earth and fame.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजाश्च पितृवद्राजन्पश्यन्ति त्वां महाबल
पृथिव्यां गतिभूतोऽसि प्राणिनामपि राघव
verses.transliteration:
prajāśca pitṛvadrājanpaśyanti tvāṁ mahābala
pṛthivyāṁ gatibhūto'si prāṇināmapi rāghava

translations.english: O you of unmitigated prowess, as the deities honour the patriarch so other kings hold you in reverence. O king, all creatures mobile and immobile consider you as their father. O you of great strength, you are the refuge of all animals and of the universe. Therefore of what use is such a sacrifice to you? In such a sacrifice all the royal families meet with ruin.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिव्यां ये च पुरुषा राजन्पौरुषमागताः
सर्वेषां भविता तत्र क्षयः सर्वान्तकोपमः
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivyāṁ ye ca puruṣā rājanpauruṣamāgatāḥ
sarveṣāṁ bhavitā tatra kṣayaḥ sarvāntakopamaḥ

translations.english: O king! all those men, who are proud of manliness, being incensed with great ire on the occasion of this sacrifice, shall bring ruin upon all.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल गुणैरतुलविक्रम
पृथिवीं नार्हसे हन्तुं वशे हि तव वर्तते
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla guṇairatulavikrama
pṛthivīṁ nārhase hantuṁ vaśe hi tava vartate

translations.english: O foremost of men, the whole earth has been brought under your subjection so it is not proper to devastate it.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वामृतमयं यथा
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
bharatasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvāmṛtamayaṁ yathā
praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those sweet accents of Bharata, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, attained to incomparable delight, and addressed the enhancer of Kaikeyi's delight with kind words, saying: O you freed from sins, I have been greatly delighted with you.

verses.sanskrit:
इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमाहितम्
व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम्
verses.transliteration:
idaṁ vacanamaklībaṁ tvayā dharmasamāhitam
vyāhṛtaṁ puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāḥ paripālanam

translations.english: O foremost of men, for the preservation of earth, you have given vent to words, without any hesitation, pregnant with manliness and piety.

verses.sanskrit:
एष तस्मादभिप्रायाद्राजसूयात्क्रतूत्तमात्
निवर्तयामि धर्मज्ञ तव सुव्याहृतेन वै
verses.transliteration:
eṣa tasmādabhiprāyādrājasūyātkratūttamāt
nivartayāmi dharmajña tava suvyāhṛtena vai

translations.english: O you conversant with piety, according to your wise counsels, I refrain from celebrating this Rājasūya sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि
लक्ष्मणोऽपि शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration:
tathoktavati rāme tu bharate ca mahātmani
lakṣmaṇo'pi śubhaṁ vākyamuvāca raghunandanam

translations.english: After the conversation between Råma and Bharata had been over, Laksmana, with reasonable words, said to the former.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम्
पावनस्तव दुर्धर्षो रोचतां क्रतुपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
aśvamedho mahāyajñaḥ pāvanaḥ sarvapāpmanām
pāvanastava durdharṣo rocatāṁ kratupuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: O Rāma, among sacrifices Aśvamedha is the best and the remover of all sins; it is my prayer therefore that your desire might be turned towards this great and highly purifying sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रूयते हि पुरावृत्तं वासवे सुमहात्मनि
ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रो हयमेधेन पावितः
verses.transliteration:
śrūyate hi purāvṛttaṁ vāsave sumahātmani
brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakro hayamedhena pāvitaḥ

translations.english: It is said in this Purānas, that Purandara, sullied by the sin consequent upon slaying a Brāhmaṇa, was again purified by celebrating a horse sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरा किल महाबाहो देवासुरसमागमे
वृत्रो नाम महानासीद्दैतेयो लोकसंमतः
verses.transliteration:
purā kila mahābāho devāsurasamāgame
vṛtro nāma mahānāsīddaiteyo lokasaṁmataḥ

translations.english: O you having long arms, formerly, during the war between gods and demons there flourished a highly honoured Asura under the name of Vſtra.

verses.sanskrit:
विस्तीर्णा योजनशतमुच्छ्रितस्त्रिगुणं ततः
अनुरागेण लोकांस्त्रीन्स्नेहात्पश्यति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration:
vistīrṇā yojanaśatamucchritastriguṇaṁ tataḥ
anurāgeṇa lokāṁstrīnsnehātpaśyati sarvataḥ

translations.english: The breadth of his body was a hundred Yojanas and the height there of was three hundred Yojanas. Considering all under his subjection he used to regard them with affection.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः
शशास पृथिवीं सर्वां धर्मेण सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ
śaśāsa pṛthivīṁ sarvāṁ dharmeṇa susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: He was pious, grateful and used to perform nothing without proper deliberation. And treading tracks he used to govern his subjects very carefully.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्प्रशासति तदा सर्वकामदुघा मही
रसवन्ति प्रसूतानि मूलानि च फलानि च
verses.transliteration:
tasminpraśāsati tadā sarvakāmadughā mahī
rasavanti prasūtāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca

translations.english: During his administration earth produced all wished-for objects; roots and fruits were tasteful and flowers were fragrant.

verses.sanskrit:
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसंपन्ना महात्मनः
स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration:
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī susaṁpannā mahātmanaḥ
sa rājyaṁ tādṛśaṁ bhuṅkte sphītamadbhutadarśanam

translations.english: Without being cultivated earth used to yield crops. In this wise for many long years he governed a prosperous and wonderful kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम्
तपो हि परमं श्रेयस्तपो हि परमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā tapaḥ kuryāmanuttamam
tapo hi paramaṁ śreyastapo hi paramaṁ sukham

translations.english: Thereupon he determined upon performing a hard penance. He considered asceticism as the best of all and regarded all other things as mere illusions.

verses.sanskrit:
स निक्षिप्य सुतं ज्येष्ठं पौरेषु परमेश्वरम्
तप उग्रमुपातिष्ठत्तापयन्सर्वदेवताः
verses.transliteration:
sa nikṣipya sutaṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ paureṣu parameśvaram
tapa ugramupātiṣṭhattāpayansarvadevatāḥ

translations.english: Having resolved thus and placed his son Madhureśvara on the throne Vſtra engaged in austerities creating terror to all deities.

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्तप्यति वृत्रे तु वासवः परमार्तवत्
विष्णुं समुपसंक्रम्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tapastapyati vṛtre tu vāsavaḥ paramārtavat
viṣṇuṁ samupasaṁkramya vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: He being thus engaged in asceticism, Indra, greatly terrified, approached Vişņu and said.

verses.sanskrit:
तपस्यता महाबाहो लोका वृत्रेण निर्जिताः
बलवान्स हि धर्मात्मा नैनं शक्ष्यामि बाधितुम्
verses.transliteration:
tapasyatā mahābāho lokā vṛtreṇa nirjitāḥ
balavānsa hi dharmātmā nainaṁ śakṣyāmi bādhitum

translations.english: O you having long arms, by virtue of his asceticism Vſtra is about to conquer all the worlds. He is pious, so I cannot subdue him.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एव सुरेश्वर
यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः
verses.transliteration:
yadyasau tapa ātiṣṭhedbhūya eva sureśvara
yāvallokā dhariṣyanti tāvadasya vaśānugāḥ

translations.english: O illustrious Sir, if his ascetic powers grow more we shall be constrained to live under his control for ever from the creation.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं चैनं परमोदारमुपेक्षसि महाबल
क्षणं हि न भवेद्वृत्रः क्रुद्धे त्वयि सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration:
tvaṁ cainaṁ paramodāramupekṣasi mahābala
kṣaṇaṁ hi na bhavedvṛtraḥ kruddhe tvayi sureśvara

translations.english: Do you therefore not neglect any longer this highly Generous Asura. They self being enraged, O lord of deities, Vſtra shall not live even for a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा हि प्रीतिसंयोगं त्वया विष्णो समागतः
तदा प्रभृति लोकानां नाथत्वमुपलब्धवान्
verses.transliteration:
yadā hi prītisaṁyogaṁ tvayā viṣṇo samāgataḥ
tadā prabhṛti lokānāṁ nāthatvamupalabdhavān

translations.english: O Vişnu, from the time he succeeded in propitiating you, he has obtained the sovereignty of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं प्रसादं लोकानां कुरुष्व सुमहायशः
त्वत्कृतेन हि सर्वं स्यात्प्रशान्तमजरं जगत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ prasādaṁ lokānāṁ kuruṣva sumahāyaśaḥ
tvatkṛtena hi sarvaṁ syātpraśāntamajaraṁ jagat

translations.english: Do you, therefore, be propitiated now; save you none can free this world from thorns and bring it at rest.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया हि नित्यशः साह्यं कृतमेषां महात्मनाम्
असह्यमिदमन्येषामगतीनां गतिर्भवान्
verses.transliteration:
tvayā hi nityaśaḥ sāhyaṁ kṛtameṣāṁ mahātmanām
asahyamidamanyeṣāmagatīnāṁ gatirbhavān

translations.english: O Vişnu, all the deities are waiting for you; do you help them by slaying Vộtra. O you having a large mind, you are always the help of these high-souled deities. It is impossible for any one else to accomplish the present work. You are the refuge of the helpless.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शत्रुनिबर्हणः
वृत्रघातमशेषेण कथयेत्याह लक्ष्मणम्
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvā śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa kathayetyāha lakṣmaṇam

translations.english: Hearing the words of Laksmana, Rama, the slayer of enemies, said:-0 you of firm vows, do you at length, describe the destruction of Vrtra.

verses.sanskrit:
राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः
भूय एव कथां दिव्यां कथयामास लक्ष्मणः
verses.transliteration:
rāghaveṇaivamuktastu sumitrānandavardhanaḥ
bhūya eva kathāṁ divyāṁ kathayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāghava, Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of Sumitra's delight, again took up that theme.

verses.sanskrit:
सहस्राक्षवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम्
विष्णुर्देवानुवाचेदं सर्वानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration:
sahasrākṣavacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣāṁ ca divaukasām
viṣṇurdevānuvācedaṁ sarvānindrapurogamān

translations.english: Hearing the words of Indra and other deities Visnu replied.

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वं सौहृदबद्धोऽस्मि वृत्रस्य सुमहात्मनः
तेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं वै नाहं हन्मि महासुरम्
verses.transliteration:
pūrvaṁ sauhṛdabaddho'smi vṛtrasya sumahātmanaḥ
tena yuṣmatpriyārthaṁ vai nāhaṁ hanmi mahāsuram

translations.english: From before I am bound with the high-souled Vrtra by the ties of friendship. For this, even for your satisfaction, I shall not (myself) slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम्
तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये येन वृत्रं हनिष्यथ
verses.transliteration:
avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ ca bhavatāṁ sukhamuttamam
tasmādupāyamākhyāsye yena vṛtraṁ haniṣyatha

translations.english: Again I am to afford excellent felicity to you. I shall say the solution by which Indra will able to slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिधा भूतं करिष्येऽहमात्मानं सुरसत्तमाः
तेन वृत्रं सहस्राक्षो हनिष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tridhā bhūtaṁ kariṣye'hamātmānaṁ surasattamāḥ
tena vṛtraṁ sahasrākṣo haniṣyati na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: I shall myself divide you into three classes and then forsooth your king shall be able to destroy Vrtra.

verses.sanskrit:
एकोंऽशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु
तृतीयो भूतलं शक्रस्ततो वृत्रं हनिष्यति
verses.transliteration:
ekoṁ'śo vāsavaṁ yātu dvitīyo vajrameva tu
tṛtīyo bhūtalaṁ śakrastato vṛtraṁ haniṣyati

translations.english: Of those three portions the first will stay in Indra, second into thunderbolt and the third one into the earth, then he will be able to slay him.

verses.sanskrit:
भद्रं तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामो वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः
भजस्व परमोदारवासवं स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration:
bhadraṁ te'stu gamiṣyāmo vṛtrāsuravadhaiṣiṇaḥ
bhajasva paramodāravāsavaṁ svena tejasā

translations.english: Visnu, the god of gods, having said this, the deities, replied, saying: O slayer of demons, undoubtedly, what you have said, shall prove true; may victory crown you; we proceed now to slay Vſtra. O highly generous deity, do you now make Våsava powerfully by infusing your own energy.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सर्वे महात्मानः सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः
तदरण्यमुपाक्रामन्यत्र वृत्रो महासुरः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sarve mahātmānaḥ sahasrākṣapurogamāḥ
tadaraṇyamupākrāmanyatra vṛtro mahāsuraḥ

translations.english: There upon the highly powerful immortals headed by Indra entered the forest where the great Asura Vſtra was performing austerities.

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽपश्यंस्तेजसा भूतं तपन्तमसुरोत्तमम्
पिबन्तमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्निर्दहन्तमिवाम्बरम्
verses.transliteration:
te'paśyaṁstejasā bhūtaṁ tapantamasurottamam
pibantamiva lokāṁstrīnnirdahantamivāmbaram

translations.english: Arriving there they observed that the leading Asura was spreading rays all over, the outcome of his own effulgence, as if devouring the three worlds and burning down the quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वैव चासुरश्रेष्ठं देवास्त्रासमुपागमन्
कथमेनं वधिष्यामः कथं न स्यात्पराजयः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvaiva cāsuraśreṣṭhaṁ devāstrāsamupāgaman
kathamenaṁ vadhiṣyāmaḥ kathaṁ na syātparājayaḥ

translations.english: Beholding that foremost of Asuras, the deities were greatly terrified and began to thing of plans by which they would be able to slay him and not be defeated.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां चिन्तयतां तत्र सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः
वज्रं प्रगृह्य बाहुभ्यां प्रहिणोद्वृत्रमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ cintayatāṁ tatra sahasrākṣaḥ puraṁdaraḥ
vajraṁ pragṛhya bāhubhyāṁ prahiṇodvṛtramūrdhani

translations.english: While they were thus thinking, Indra, of thousand eyes, taking up a thunderbolt, hurled it against Vrtra's head.

verses.sanskrit:
कालाग्निनेव घोरेण दीप्तेनेव महार्चिषा
प्रतप्तं वृत्रशिरसि जगत्त्रासमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
kālāgnineva ghoreṇa dīpteneva mahārciṣā
prataptaṁ vṛtraśirasi jagattrāsamupāgamat

translations.english: That dreadful burning thunderbolt, like to the fire of dissolution, falling on Vrtra's head, the three worlds were agitated.

verses.sanskrit:
असंभाव्यं वधं तस्य वृत्रस्य विबुधाधिपः
चिन्तयानो जगामाशु लोकस्यान्तं महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
asaṁbhāvyaṁ vadhaṁ tasya vṛtrasya vibudhādhipaḥ
cintayāno jagāmāśu lokasyāntaṁ mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: There upon thinking that he has perpetrated an iniquity by slaying Vịtra engaged in asceticism, Indra, out of fear, fled to the other side of Lokāloka mountain, perpetually enshrouded with darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
तमिन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्याशु गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति
अपतच्चास्य गात्रेषु तमिन्द्रं दुःखमाविशत्
verses.transliteration:
tamindraṁ brahmahatyāśu gacchantamanugacchati
apataccāsya gātreṣu tamindraṁ duḥkhamāviśat

translations.english: And the sin, consequent upon the destruction of a Brahmana, pursuing him vehemently, entered into his person. In this wise Indra became subject to dreadful afflictions.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत्
मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā devānāṁ viṣṇurabravīt
māmeva yajatāṁ śakraḥ pāvayiṣyāmi vajriṇam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the celestials Vişņu said, Let your Chief celebrate a sacrifice in my honour, and by that he shall be cleansed off the sin.

verses.sanskrit:
पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः
पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयः
verses.transliteration:
puṇyena hayamedhena māmiṣṭvā pākaśāsanaḥ
punareṣyati devānāmindratvamakutobhayaḥ

translations.english: If the slayer of Pāka celebrates a horse sacrifice, he shall again fearlessly be installed as the chief of deities.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं संदिश्य देवानां तां वाणीममृतोपमा
जगाम विष्णुर्देवेशः स्तूयमानस्त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ saṁdiśya devānāṁ tāṁ vāṇīmamṛtopamā
jagāma viṣṇurdeveśaḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭapam

translations.english: Having addressed these nectar-like words to the deities and being glorified by them, Visnu, the god of gods, returned to his abode.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयंकरे
ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः संज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा
verses.transliteration:
tato hate mahāvīrye vṛtre devabhayaṁkare
brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakraḥ saṁjñāṁ lebhe na vṛtrahā

translations.english: Having thus described at length and finished the story of Vſtra's destruction Lakşmaņa said:-The mighty Vţtra, the terror of the deities, being slain, and the slayer Indra being assailed by the sin of Brahmanicide, was bewildered and at a loss to ascertain his duty.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसंज्ञो विचेतनः
कालं तत्रावसत्कंचिद्वेष्टमानो यथोरगः
verses.transliteration:
so'ntamāśritya lokānāṁ naṣṭasaṁjño vicetanaḥ
kālaṁ tatrāvasatkaṁcidveṣṭamāno yathoragaḥ

translations.english: Being at his wit's end he repaired to the other side of the Lokāloka mountain and remained there for some time like a coiled serpent.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत्
भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसंकाशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना
verses.transliteration:
atha naṣṭe sahasrākṣe udvignamabhavajjagat
bhūmiśca dhvastasaṁkāśā niḥsnehā śuṣkakānanā

translations.english: And again in consequence of Indra's separation, the whole world was agitated, the forests grew dried and the earth was devoid of water. On account of the rivers being dried up and want of rain all creatures grew impatient.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षीयमाणे तु लोकेऽस्मिन्संभ्रान्तमनसः सुराः
यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तं यज्ञं समुपानयन्
verses.transliteration:
kṣīyamāṇe tu loke'sminsaṁbhrāntamanasaḥ surāḥ
yaduktaṁ viṣṇunā pūrvaṁ taṁ yajñaṁ samupānayan

translations.english: In this wise, the celestials being stricken with anxiety, according to the previous command of Visnu, engaged in celebrating the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तु दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं मोहितं ब्रह्महत्यया
तं पुरस्कृत्य देवेशमश्वमेधं प्रचक्रिरे
verses.transliteration:
te tu dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaṁ mohitaṁ brahmahatyayā
taṁ puraskṛtya deveśamaśvamedhaṁ pracakrire

translations.english: With Rșis and Rtvikas they fearfully approached Purandra; and beholding him assailed by the sin of Brahmanicide, they with him, at their head, engaged in celebrating a horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
ते तामूचुस्ततो देवास्तुष्टाः प्रीतिसमन्विताः
चतुर्धा विभजात्मानमात्मनैव दुरासदे
verses.transliteration:
te tāmūcustato devāstuṣṭāḥ prītisamanvitāḥ
caturdhā vibhajātmānamātmanaiva durāsade

translations.english: After the sacrifice the sin issued out of Indra's person and addressing the high-souled deities said: Do you all ascertain, where I shall go now. There upon highly pleased the deities replied: Do you divide yourself into four portions.

verses.sanskrit:
देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम्
संनिधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा
verses.transliteration:
devānāṁ bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā brahmahatyā mahātmanām
saṁnidhau sthānamanyatra varayāmāsa durvasā

translations.english: Hearing the words of the high-souled celestials she divided herself into four parts and wishing for a separate habitation said:-By one portion, I shall at my pleasure, live in rivers full of water during rains and shall obstruct people from going there.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्यूचुस्तां ततो देवा यथा वदसि दुर्वसे
तथा भवतु तत्सर्वं साधयस्व यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration:
pratyūcustāṁ tato devā yathā vadasi durvase
tathā bhavatu tatsarvaṁ sādhayasva yathepsitam

translations.english: Hearing those words the deities said What you have said shall be carried out. Do what you wish.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रीत्यान्विता देवाः सहस्राक्षं ववन्दिरे
विज्वरः पूतपाप्मा च वासवः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prītyānvitā devāḥ sahasrākṣaṁ vavandire
vijvaraḥ pūtapāpmā ca vāsavaḥ samapadyata

translations.english: There upon the celestials, delighted, adored their Chief divested of sins and crowned with victory.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठते
यज्ञं चाद्भुतसंकाशं तदा शक्रोऽभ्यपूजयत्
verses.transliteration:
praśāntaṁ ca jagatsarvaṁ sahasrākṣe pratiṣṭhate
yajñaṁ cādbhutasaṁkāśaṁ tadā śakro'bhyapūjayat

translations.english: And Väsava being installed again on the throne, the whole universe was at rest. There upon Indra worshipped Vişnu in the shape of that wonderful sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावो रघुनन्दन
यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव
verses.transliteration:
īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prabhāvo raghunandana
yajasva sumahābhāga hayamedhena pārthiva

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, such is the power of a horse-sacrifice. O honourable king, therefore, you may perform this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्राघवो वचः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇenoktaṁ vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ prahasanrāghavo vacaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Laksmana and smiling, the highly effulgent descendant of Raghu, Rāma, skilled in the are of speech, replied.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतन्नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण
वृत्रघातमशेषेण वाजिमेधफलं च यत्
verses.transliteration:
evametannaraśreṣṭha yathā vadasi lakṣmaṇa
vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa vājimedhaphalaṁ ca yat

translations.english: Lakşmaņa, O foremost of men, you have truly related the story of Vſtra's destruction and the fruits of horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रूयते हि पुरा सौम्य कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः
पुत्रो बाह्लीश्वरः श्रीमानिलो नाम सुधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
śrūyate hi purā saumya kardamasya prajāpateḥ
putro bāhlīśvaraḥ śrīmānilo nāma sudhārmikaḥ

translations.english: 0gentle one, I have heard, that formerly in the province of Valhīka, the graceful king lla, the son of the patriarch Kardama, was highly pious.

verses.sanskrit:
स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा महायशाः
राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत्
verses.transliteration:
sa rājā pṛthivīṁ sarvāṁ vaśe kṛtvā mahāyaśāḥ
rājyaṁ caiva naravyāghra putravatparyapālayat

translations.english: O foremost of men, having brought the entire earth under his subjects like to his own sons.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरैश्च परमोदारैर्दैतेयैश्च महासुरैः
नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सुमहात्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
suraiśca paramodārairdaiteyaiśca mahāsuraiḥ
nāgarākṣasagandharvairyakṣaiśca sumahātmabhiḥ

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, being terrified, the generous deities, the rich Daityas, the highly powerful Nägas, the irrepressible Rakşasas, Gandharvas and Yakşas used to adore him perpetually. The high-souled Ila being enraged, the three worlds used to be convulsed with terror.

verses.sanskrit:
स राजा तादृशो ह्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः
बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकानां महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
sa rājā tādṛśo hyāsīddharme vīrye ca niṣṭhitaḥ
buddhyā ca paramodāro bāhlīkānāṁ mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: And albeit so very powerful the highly illustrious king of Vālhika never swerved from the path of morality nor neglected his deities and rather intelligently used to administer all business.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्रचक्रे महाबाहुर्मृगयां रुचिरे वने
चैत्रे मनोरमे मासि सभृत्यबलवाहनः
verses.transliteration:
sa pracakre mahābāhurmṛgayāṁ rucire vane
caitre manorame māsi sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ

translations.english: Once on a time in the picturesque season of spring the mighty-armed Ila, with his army and conveyances, entered into a charming forest, and on the pretext of hunting, slew hundreds and thousands of deer. With slaying deer only the high-souled king was not satisfied.

verses.sanskrit:
नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना
यत्र जातो महासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
nānāmṛgāṇāmayutaṁ vadhyamānaṁ mahātmanā
yatra jāto mahāsenastaṁ deśamupacakrame

translations.english: He slew millions of diverse other animals. In this way being engaged in hunting the king Ila arrived where Kārtikeya was born.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तु देवदेवेशः शैलराजसुतां हरः
रमयामास दुर्धर्षैः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstu devadeveśaḥ śailarājasutāṁ haraḥ
ramayāmāsa durdharṣaiḥ sarvairanucaraiḥ saha

translations.english: At that time, in that hilly fountain there was sporting in the company of his followers, the irrepressible god of gods, the three-eyed deity with the daughter of the Chief of mountains.

verses.sanskrit:
कृत्वा स्त्रीभूतमात्मानमुमेशो गोपतिध्वजः
देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षुः स तस्मिन्पर्वतनिर्झरे
verses.transliteration:
kṛtvā strībhūtamātmānamumeśo gopatidhvajaḥ
devyāḥ priyacikīrṣuḥ sa tasminparvatanirjhare

translations.english: Being desirous of satisfying the goddess Umă, her lord. whose emblem is bull, was sporting under the guise of a female.

verses.sanskrit:
ये च तत्र वनोद्देशे सत्त्वाः पुरुषवादिनः
यच्च किंचन तत्सर्वं नारीसंज्ञं बभूव ह
verses.transliteration:
ye ca tatra vanoddeśe sattvāḥ puruṣavādinaḥ
yacca kiṁcana tatsarvaṁ nārīsaṁjñaṁ babhūva ha

translations.english: In that forest land, all male animals or trees were metamorphosed into the other sex at that time.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो देवं महात्मानं शितिकण्ठं कपर्दिनम्
जगाम शरणं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः
verses.transliteration:
tato devaṁ mahātmānaṁ śitikaṇṭhaṁ kapardinam
jagāma śaraṇaṁ rājā sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ

translations.english: There with his followers and army the king took shelter or the high-souled and red-throated deity.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहस्य वरदः सह देव्या महायशाः
प्रजापतिसुतं वाक्यमुवाच वरदः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prahasya varadaḥ saha devyā mahāyaśāḥ
prajāpatisutaṁ vākyamuvāca varadaḥ svayam

translations.english: There upon the great god, the conferror of boons, with the goddess, smiling said:

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजर्षे कार्दमेय महाबल
पुरुषत्वमृते सौम्य वरं वरय सुव्रत
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājarṣe kārdameya mahābala
puruṣatvamṛte saumya varaṁ varaya suvrata

translations.english: Rise up, O son of Kardama, O you of great strength, O gentle one, do you beg of me any other boon than that of obtaining your manhood. Being thus disappointed by the great deity, the king Ila, metamorphosed into a female, became greatly sorry and did not pray for any other boon.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः
प्रणिपत्य महादेवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śokena mahatā śailarājasutāṁ nṛpaḥ
praṇipatya mahādevīṁ sarveṇaivāntarātmanā

translations.english: Being stricken with great sorrow, the king, with whole heart, saluted the daughter of the mountain-chief and said:-0 goddess, you are the protectress of all-you do confer boons on all; seeing you does not become fruitless. Do you therefore have compassion on me.

verses.sanskrit:
हृद्गतं तस्य राजर्षेर्विज्ञाय हरसंनिधौ
प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं देवी रुद्रस्य संमता
verses.transliteration:
hṛdgataṁ tasya rājarṣervijñāya harasaṁnidhau
pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ devī rudrasya saṁmatā

translations.english: There upon, cognisant of that king's intention, the goddess, with Hara's consent, said. Half of the boon, that you shall beg of us both, shall be granted by Mahādeva, and the other half shall be granted by me. Do you therefore beg of me the half.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि देवि प्रसन्ना मे रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि
मासं स्त्रीत्वमुपासित्वा मासं स्यां पुरुषः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
yadi devi prasannā me rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi
māsaṁ strītvamupāsitvā māsaṁ syāṁ puruṣaḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Hearing of that excellent and wondrous boon the king became greatly delighted and said:-If you are pleased with me, O goddess, do you confer upon me this boon, that I may be for one month, a female gifted with wonderful beauty in the three worlds and for another month I may be a male.

verses.sanskrit:
राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि
स्त्रीभूतश्चापरं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम्
verses.transliteration:
rājanpuruṣabhūtastvaṁ strībhāvaṁ na smariṣyasi
strībhūtaścāparaṁ māsaṁ na smariṣyasi pauruṣam

translations.english: There upon understanding king's desire, the beautiful goddess Pārvatī, mercifully said: The boon, according to your desire, shall be granted. O king, when you shall attain to the male figure, you shall not remember anything of your female form. And when you shall a assume the charming female figure you shall forget everything of your male state.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं स राजा पुरुषो मासं भूत्वाथ कार्दमिः
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी नारी मासमेकमिलाभवत्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sa rājā puruṣo māsaṁ bhūtvātha kārdamiḥ
trailokyasundarī nārī māsamekamilābhavat

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, by virtue of this boon, the king Ila for one month used to become a man and for the next used to become female, charming in the three worlds under the name of Ilă.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ रामं प्राञ्जलीभूत्वा तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः
विस्तरं तस्य भावस्य तदा पप्रच्छतुः पुनः
verses.transliteration:
tau rāmaṁ prāñjalībhūtvā tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ
vistaraṁ tasya bhāvasya tadā papracchatuḥ punaḥ

translations.english: Having heard of the story of the king Ila from Rāma, Lakşmaņa and Bharata were greatly surprised. And And with folded hands they, requesting the noble king Rāma, for further particulars, said.

verses.sanskrit:
कथं स राजा स्त्रीभूतो वर्तयामास दुर्गतिम्
पुरुषो वा यदा भूतः कां वृत्तिं वर्तयत्यसौ
verses.transliteration:
kathaṁ sa rājā strībhūto vartayāmāsa durgatim
puruṣo vā yadā bhūtaḥ kāṁ vṛttiṁ vartayatyasau

translations.english: How could the king Ila subject himself to those afflictions in the shape of a female? And how did he use to behave himself in his male form?

verses.sanskrit:
तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम्
कथयामास काकुत्ष्ठस्तस्य राज्ञो यथा गतम्
verses.transliteration:
tayostadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam
kathayāmāsa kākutṣṭhastasya rājño yathā gatam

translations.english: Hearing those words begotten of curiosity, Rāma engaged in relating the whole story as he had heard before, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
तमेव प्रथमं मासं स्त्रीभूत्वा लोकसुन्दरी
ताभिः परिवृता स्त्रीभिर्येऽस्य पूर्वं पदानुगाः
verses.transliteration:
tameva prathamaṁ māsaṁ strībhūtvā lokasundarī
tābhiḥ parivṛtā strībhirye'sya pūrvaṁ padānugāḥ

translations.english: In the first month, assuming his female form having lotus-eyes and charming the three world, he used to sport in the forest abounding in groves, in the company of his companions metamorphosed into the same form.

verses.sanskrit:
वाहनानि च सर्वाणि संत्यक्त्वा वै समन्ततः
पर्वताभोगविवरे तस्मिन्रेमे इला तदा
verses.transliteration:
vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi saṁtyaktvā vai samantataḥ
parvatābhogavivare tasminreme ilā tadā

translations.english: Having sent away all his conveyances Ilā used to sport in the mountain vale.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे पर्वतस्याविदूरतः
सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यं नानापक्षिगणायुतम्
verses.transliteration:
atha tasminvanoddeśe parvatasyāvidūrataḥ
saraḥ suruciraprakhyaṁ nānāpakṣigaṇāyutam

translations.english: Thus roaming, Ila one day espied Budha, a bundle of rays, resembling the full moon in a picturesque pond filled with birds at some distance from the mountain.

verses.sanskrit:
तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम्
यशक्सरं कामगमं तारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration:
tapantaṁ ca tapastīvramambhomadhye durāsadam
yaśaksaraṁ kāmagamaṁ tāruṇye paryavasthitam

translations.english: Having compassion for all creatures Budha, at that time, was performing, hard, glorious and wished-for austerities within waters.

verses.sanskrit:
सा तं जलाशयं सर्वं क्षोभयामास विस्मिता
सह तैः पूर पुरुषैः स्त्रीभूतै रघुनन्दन
verses.transliteration:
sā taṁ jalāśayaṁ sarvaṁ kṣobhayāmāsa vismitā
saha taiḥ pūra puruṣaiḥ strībhūtai raghunandana

translations.english: O son of Raghu, on beholding him Ilā was greatly surprised, and with her female companions began to agitate waters.

verses.sanskrit:
इलां निरीक्षमाणः स त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां शुभाम्
चिन्तां समभ्यतिक्रामत्का न्वियं देवताधिका
verses.transliteration:
ilāṁ nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sa trailokyābhyadhikāṁ śubhām
cintāṁ samabhyatikrāmatkā nviyaṁ devatādhikā

translations.english: As soon as Budha saw her he was assailed by the arrows of Cupid. Not being able to control himself he grew impatient within waters and thought. This damsel is far more beautiful even than the celestial girls.

verses.sanskrit:
न देवीषु न नागीषु नासुरीष्वप्सरःसु च
दृष्टपूर्वा मया काचिद्रूपेणैतेन शोभिता
verses.transliteration:
na devīṣu na nāgīṣu nāsurīṣvapsaraḥsu ca
dṛṣṭapūrvā mayā kācidrūpeṇaitena śobhitā

translations.english: I have never seen before a like among the celestials, Nagas, Asuras and Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit:
सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहा
इति बुद्धिं समास्थाय जलात्स्थलमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sadṛśīyaṁ mama bhavedyadi nānyaparigrahā
iti buddhiṁ samāsthāya jalātsthalamupāgamat

translations.english: If she has not been married before then she is my worthy spouse. With this resolution Budha got up from the waters, and repairing to his hermitage, sent for the fair ones. they all saluted him.

verses.sanskrit:
स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्म कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी
किमर्थमागता चेह सत्यमाख्यात माचिरम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tāḥ papraccha dharmātma kasyaiṣā lokasundarī
kimarthamāgatā ceha satyamākhyāta māciram

translations.english: Thereupon the virtuous-souled Budha accosted them saying: Whose daughter is this graceful girl among you and for what she has come here? Do not delay-tell me soon.

verses.sanskrit:
शुभं तु तस्य तद्वाक्यं मधुरं मधुराक्षरम्
श्रुत्वा तु ताः स्त्रियः सर्वा ऊचुर्मधुरया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
śubhaṁ tu tasya tadvākyaṁ madhuraṁ madhurākṣaram
śrutvā tu tāḥ striyaḥ sarvā ūcurmadhurayā girā

translations.english: Hearing those sweet words of Budha, the all females also said in sweet accents.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकमेषा सुश्रोणी प्रभुत्वे वर्तते सदा
अपतिः काननान्तेषु सहास्माभिरटत्यसौ
verses.transliteration:
asmākameṣā suśroṇī prabhutve vartate sadā
apatiḥ kānanānteṣu sahāsmābhiraṭatyasau

translations.english: This fair damsel is our supreme lady. She has no husband. Journeying she has come here in the forest with us.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यमव्यक्तपदं तासां स्त्रीणां निशम्य तु
विद्यामावर्तनीं पुण्यामावर्तयत स द्विजः
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyamavyaktapadaṁ tāsāṁ strīṇāṁ niśamya tu
vidyāmāvartanīṁ puṇyāmāvartayata sa dvijaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those plain words, Budha thought of the learning by which one can perceive everything.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽर्थं विदित्वा निखिलं तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम्
सर्वा एव स्त्रियस्ताश्च बभाषे मुनिपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
so'rthaṁ viditvā nikhilaṁ tasya rājño yathāgatam
sarvā eva striyastāśca babhāṣe munipuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: And being informed of all inatters regarding the king Ila, thereby that foremost of sages said to the females.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र किं पुरुषा भद्रा अवसञ्शैलरोधसि
वत्स्यथास्मिन्गिरौ यूयमवकाशो विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
atra kiṁ puruṣā bhadrā avasañśailarodhasi
vatsyathāsmingirau yūyamavakāśo vidhīyatām

translations.english: Do you all live in this mountain being Kimpurusas; do you make your respective habitations here.

verses.sanskrit:
मूलपुत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा
स्त्रियः किम्पुरुषान्नाम भर्तॄन्समुपलप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration:
mūlaputraphalaiḥ sarvā vartayiṣyatha nityadā
striyaḥ kimpuruṣānnāma bhartṝnsamupalapsyatha

translations.english: I shall give you always fruits and roots. O you females, you shall have all Kimpuruşas as your husbands.

verses.sanskrit:
ताः श्रुत्वा सोमपुत्रस्य वाचं किंपुरुषीकृताः
उपासां चक्रिरे शैलं बह्व्यस्ता बहुधा तदा
verses.transliteration:
tāḥ śrutvā somaputrasya vācaṁ kiṁpuruṣīkṛtāḥ
upāsāṁ cakrire śailaṁ bahvyastā bahudhā tadā

translations.english: According to the words of Budha they lived in that mountains as Kimpuruşas. In this wise many Kimpurusa-Budhas were procreated.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा किंपुरुषोत्पत्तिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तदा
आश्चर्यमिति चाब्रूतामुभौ रामं जनेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā kiṁpuruṣotpattiṁ lakṣmaṇo bharatastadā
āścaryamiti cābrūtāmubhau rāmaṁ janeśvaram

translations.english: Having heard of the origin of Kimpuruṣas, both Bharata and Lakşmaņa said to Råma: This is a wonderful story.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ रामः कथामेतां भूय एव महायशाः
कथयामास धर्मात्मा प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै
verses.transliteration:
atha rāmaḥ kathāmetāṁ bhūya eva mahāyaśāḥ
kathayāmāsa dharmātmā prajāpatisutasya vai

translations.english: Thereupon the highly illustrious Råma, the foremost of the pious, again began with the story of Ila, the son of the patriarch.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वास्ता विद्रुता दृष्ट्वा किंनरीरृषिसत्तमः
उवाच रूपसंपन्नां तां स्त्रियं प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration:
sarvāstā vidrutā dṛṣṭvā kiṁnarīrṛṣisattamaḥ
uvāca rūpasaṁpannāṁ tāṁ striyaṁ prahasanniva

translations.english: Beholding the Kinnarīs repairing to a distance, Buddha the foremost of ascetics, smiling said, to the beautiful Ila:

verses.sanskrit:
सोमस्याहं सुदयितः सुतः सुरुचिरानने
भजस्व मां वरारोहे भक्त्या स्निग्धेन चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration:
somasyāhaṁ sudayitaḥ sutaḥ surucirānane
bhajasva māṁ varārohe bhaktyā snigdhena cakṣuṣā

translations.english: O you of a graceful presence, I am the most favourite son of the moon; O fair one, do you, with delight, cast looks upon me.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शून्ये स्वजनवर्जिता
इला सुरुचिरप्रख्यं प्रत्युवाच महाग्रहम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā śūnye svajanavarjitā
ilā suruciraprakhyaṁ pratyuvāca mahāgraham

translations.english: Hearing the words of the highly effulgent and beautiful Budha in the picturesque forest land divested of men and animals, Ila said.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं कामकरी सौम्य तवास्मि वशवर्तिनी
प्रशाधि मां सोमसुत यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ kāmakarī saumya tavāsmi vaśavartinī
praśādhi māṁ somasuta yathecchasi tathā kuru

translations.english: O gentle one, I am not subject to any body; I surrender myself to you out of my own accord. O son of Soma, you may command me whatever you wish.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्यास्तदद्भुतप्रख्यं श्रुत्वा हर्षसमन्वितः
स वै कामी सह तया रेमे चन्द्रमसः सुतः
verses.transliteration:
tasyāstadadbhutaprakhyaṁ śrutvā harṣasamanvitaḥ
sa vai kāmī saha tayā reme candramasaḥ sutaḥ

translations.english: Hearing those wondrous words, the son of moon, possessed by lust, began to live with her.

verses.sanskrit:
बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम्
गतो रमयतोऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः
verses.transliteration:
budhasya mādhavo māsastāmilāṁ rucirānanām
gato ramayato'tyarthaṁ kṣaṇavattasya kāminaḥ

translations.english: And living in the company of Ilā, having a graceful countenance, Budha, possessed by desire, spent the entire month of Madhu like a moment.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ मासे तु संपूर्णे पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः
प्रजापतिसुतः श्रीमाञ्शयने प्रत्यबुध्यत
verses.transliteration:
atha māse tu saṁpūrṇe pūrṇendusadṛśānanaḥ
prajāpatisutaḥ śrīmāñśayane pratyabudhyata

translations.english: There upon after the expiry of a month, the graceful king Ila, son of Soma, engaged from sleep and beholding Budha, the son of Soma, engaged in austerities with uplifted hands in the midst of waters, said.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्पर्वतं दुर्गं प्रविष्टोऽस्मि सहानुगः
न च पश्यामि तत्सैन्यं क्व नु ते मामका गताः
verses.transliteration:
bhagavanparvataṁ durgaṁ praviṣṭo'smi sahānugaḥ
na ca paśyāmi tatsainyaṁ kva nu te māmakā gatāḥ

translations.english: 'O illustrious Sir, with my followers I entered this dense forest-I do not see them now anywhere. Where have they gone?

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्नष्टसंज्ञस्य भाषितम्
प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं सान्त्वयन्परया गिरा
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā tasya rājarṣernaṣṭasaṁjñasya bhāṣitam
pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ sāntvayanparayā girā

translations.english: Hearing the words of the royal saint, who had lost all recollection, Budha, with sweet words consoled him and said.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्मवर्षेण महता भृत्यास्ते विनिपातिताः
त्वं चाश्रमपदे सुप्तो वातवर्षभयार्दितः
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarṣeṇa mahatā bhṛtyāste vinipātitāḥ
tvaṁ cāśramapade supto vātavarṣabhayārditaḥ

translations.english: All your followers have been destroyed by a downpour of huge rocks; yourself, being afraid of the storm, was also asleep in the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit:
समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते निर्भयो विगतज्वरः
फलमूलाशनो वीर वस चेह यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration:
samāśvasihi bhadraṁ te nirbhayo vigatajvaraḥ
phalamūlāśano vīra vasa ceha yathāsukham

translations.english: You have no fear now. Therefore, O hero, being consoled and renouncing all anxiety do you live here happily living upon fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit:
स राजा तेन वाक्येन प्रत्याश्वस्तो महायशाः
प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं दीनो भृत्यजनक्षयात्
verses.transliteration:
sa rājā tena vākyena pratyāśvasto mahāyaśāḥ
pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ dīno bhṛtyajanakṣayāt

translations.english: Being comforted by those words, the highminded king Ila, stricken with distress in consequence of the destruction of his servants, poorly replied.

verses.sanskrit:
त्यक्ष्याम्यहं स्वकं राज्यं नाहं भृत्यैर्विना कृतः
वर्तयेयं क्षणं ब्रह्मन्समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
tyakṣyāmyahaṁ svakaṁ rājyaṁ nāhaṁ bhṛtyairvinā kṛtaḥ
vartayeyaṁ kṣaṇaṁ brahmansamanujñātumarhasi

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, I shall renounce my own kingdom. Separated from my servants, I shall not be able to live even for a moment. Do you give me permission in this.

verses.sanskrit:
सुतो धर्मपरो ब्रह्मञ्ज्येष्ठो मम महायशाः
शशबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स मे राज्यं प्रपत्स्यते
verses.transliteration:
suto dharmaparo brahmañjyeṣṭho mama mahāyaśāḥ
śaśabinduriti khyātaḥ sa me rājyaṁ prapatsyate

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, my eldest son, the highly illustrious Sasabindu, the foremost of the pious, shall be the owner of my kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं गत्वा भृत्यदारान्सुखान्वितान्
प्रतिवक्तुं महातेजः किंचिदप्यशुभं वचः
verses.transliteration:
na hi śakṣyāmyahaṁ gatvā bhṛtyadārānsukhānvitān
prativaktuṁ mahātejaḥ kiṁcidapyaśubhaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, renouncing my servants and wives of the country I shall not be able to wait here. Therefore, O highly effulgent one, do you not give me such an unpleasant command of remaining here.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे बुधः परममद्भुतम्
सान्त्वपूर्वमथोवाच वासस्त इह रोचताम्
verses.transliteration:
tathā bruvati rājendre budhaḥ paramamadbhutam
sāntvapūrvamathovāca vāsasta iha rocatām

translations.english: Hearing those wonderful words of the king Ila, Budha consoling him, said:-Do you wait here. Be not aggrieved, O highly powerful son of Kardama. If you do live here for a year, I shall render your well-being.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बुधस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
वासाय विदधे बुद्धिं यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā budhasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
vāsāya vidadhe buddhiṁ yaduktaṁ brahmavādinā

translations.english: Hearing the words of Budha, of unwearied actions, the king Ila desired to live there.

verses.sanskrit:
मासं स स्त्री तदा भूत्वा रमयत्यनिशं शुभा
मासं पुरुषभावेन धर्मबुद्धिं चकार सः
verses.transliteration:
māsaṁ sa strī tadā bhūtvā ramayatyaniśaṁ śubhā
māsaṁ puruṣabhāvena dharmabuddhiṁ cakāra saḥ

translations.english: There upon becoming a man for the next month he began to perform ascetic penances.

verses.sanskrit:
जातमात्रं तु सुश्रोणी पितुर्हस्ते न्यवेशयत्
बुधस्य समवर्णाभमिलापुत्रं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration:
jātamātraṁ tu suśroṇī piturhaste nyaveśayat
budhasya samavarṇābhamilāputraṁ mahābalam

translations.english: There upon in the ninth month, Ilă, having a beautiful waist, gave birth to a highly effulgent son, under the name of Pururavă, born of the lions of Budha, and equally graceful like him. and she handed over the highly powerful son to his father Budha.

verses.sanskrit:
बुधोऽपि पुरुषीभूतं समाश्वास्य नराधिपम्
कथाभी रमयामास धर्मयुक्ताभिरात्मवान्
verses.transliteration:
budho'pi puruṣībhūtaṁ samāśvāsya narādhipam
kathābhī ramayāmāsa dharmayuktābhirātmavān

translations.english: There upon after a year Ilā having regained the male form, Budha by means of various words afforded delight to him.

verses.sanskrit:
तथोक्तवति रामे तु तस्य जन्म तदद्भुतम्
उवाच लक्ष्मणो भूयो भरतश्च महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
tathoktavati rāme tu tasya janma tadadbhutam
uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhūyo bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Rāma having thus described the wonderful birth of Pururavā, the illustrious Bharata and Lakşmaņa asked him again saying.

verses.sanskrit:
सा प्रिया सोमपुत्रस्य संवत्सरमथोषिता
अकरोत्किं नरश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं शंसितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
sā priyā somaputrasya saṁvatsaramathoṣitā
akarotkiṁ naraśreṣṭha tattvaṁ śaṁsitumarhasi

translations.english: O foremost of men, tell us what did Ila afterwards do after living in the company of Soma's son for a year.

verses.sanskrit:
तयोस्तद्वाक्यमाधुर्यं निशम्य परिपृच्छतोः
रामः पुनरुवाचेमां प्रजापतिसुते कथाम्
verses.transliteration:
tayostadvākyamādhuryaṁ niśamya paripṛcchatoḥ
rāmaḥ punaruvācemāṁ prajāpatisute kathām

translations.english: Hearing their sweet words Råma again began with the story of Kardama's son and said.

verses.sanskrit:
एतान्सर्वान्समानीय वाक्यज्ञस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदो धैर्येण सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
etānsarvānsamānīya vākyajñastattvadarśinaḥ
uvāca sarvānsuhṛdo dhairyeṇa susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: In turn, the heroic Ila, having regained his manhood, the highly illustrious and intelligent Budha, well-informed of birth and well-skilled in the are of speech, sent for the highly liberal Samvarta, Bhrgu's son Cyavana, Aristanemi, the foremost of Munis, Durvasa, capable of affording delight, and other friends gifted with patience and said.

verses.sanskrit:
अयं राजा महाबाहुः कर्दमस्य इलः सुतः
जानीतैनं यथा भूतं श्रेयो ह्यस्य विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
ayaṁ rājā mahābāhuḥ kardamasya ilaḥ sutaḥ
jānītainaṁ yathā bhūtaṁ śreyo hyasya vidhīyatām

translations.english: You all know well, how this mighty-armed Ila, Kardama's son, attained to this peculiar condition.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां संवदतामेव तमाश्रममुपागमत्
कर्दमः सुमहातेजा द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ saṁvadatāmeva tamāśramamupāgamat
kardamaḥ sumahātejā dvijaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ

translations.english: There upon while those high-souled ones were conversing upon this subject, the highly effulgent Kardama arrived at the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit:
पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्चैव वषट्कारस्तथैव च
ओंकारश्च महातेजास्तमाश्रममुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
pulastyaśca kratuścaiva vaṣaṭkārastathaiva ca
oṁkāraśca mahātejāstamāśramamupāgaman

translations.english: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaşatkāra and the highly effulgent Omkāra came there following him.

verses.sanskrit:
ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे
हितैषिणो बाह्लि पतेः पृथग्वाक्यमथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
te sarve hṛṣṭamanasaḥ parasparasamāgame
hitaiṣiṇo bāhli pateḥ pṛthagvākyamathābruvan

translations.english: Being greatly delighted for their arrival they all gave out their individual opinion for bringing about the well-being of the king of Valhika.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम्
द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि
verses.transliteration:
kardamastvabravīdvākyaṁ sutārthaṁ paramaṁ hitam
dvijāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṁ yacchreyaḥ pārthivasya hi

translations.english: For the welfare of his son, the patriarch Kardama said: Hear, O twice-born ones, how the well-being of the king Ila may be secured.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्यं पश्यामि भैषज्यमन्तरेण वृषध्वजम्
नाश्वमेधात्परो यज्ञः प्रियश्चैव महात्मनः
verses.transliteration:
nānyaṁ paśyāmi bhaiṣajyamantareṇa vṛṣadhvajam
nāśvamedhātparo yajñaḥ priyaścaiva mahātmanaḥ

translations.english: For this decease do not find any other good medicine but Umā's lord. And save Aśvamedha there is no other sacrifice more favourite to the high-souled deity.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माद्यजामहे सर्वे पार्थिवार्थे दुरासदम्
कर्दमेनैवमुक्तास्तु सर्व एव द्विजर्षभाः
रोचयन्ति स्म तं यज्ञं रुद्रस्याराधनं प्रति
verses.transliteration:
tasmādyajāmahe sarve pārthivārthe durāsadam
kardamenaivamuktāstu sarva eva dvijarṣabhāḥ
rocayanti sma taṁ yajñaṁ rudrasyārādhanaṁ prati

translations.english: Let us all therefore celebrate that hard sacrifice on behalf of this king. Thereupon the wors of Kardama, Samvarta's disciple, the royal saint Marutta, the conqueror of enemies, collected all articles for the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्बुधाश्रमसमीपतः
रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
tato yajño mahānāsīdbudhāśramasamīpataḥ
rudraśca paramaṁ toṣamājagāma mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: There upon in the vicinity of Budha's hermitage that mighty sacrifice was celebrated. And by that the Great Rudra lord of Umā, attained to delight and said to the twice-born ones, and others at the end of that sacrifice in the presence of the king Ila.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रीतोऽस्मि हयमेधेन भक्त्या च द्विजसत्तमाः
अस्य बाह्लिपतेश्चैव किं करोमि प्रियं शुभम्
verses.transliteration:
prīto'smi hayamedhena bhaktyā ca dvijasattamāḥ
asya bāhlipateścaiva kiṁ karomi priyaṁ śubham

translations.english: O foremost of twice-born ones, I have been greatly delighted with this sacrifice and your devotion. Tell me now, what I can do for this king of Valhika.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा वदति देवेशे द्विजास्ते सुसमाहिताः
प्रसादयन्ति देवेशं यथा स्यात्पुरुषस्त्विला
verses.transliteration:
tathā vadati deveśe dvijāste susamāhitāḥ
prasādayanti deveśaṁ yathā syātpuruṣastvilā

translations.english: Hearing the words of Mahādeva, the Brāhmaṇas having propitiated him with great devotion, prayed for Ila's manhood.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रीतमना रुद्रः पुरुषत्वं ददौ पुनः
इलायै सुमहातेजा दत्त्वा चान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prītamanā rudraḥ puruṣatvaṁ dadau punaḥ
ilāyai sumahātejā dattvā cāntaradhīyata

translations.english: There upon delighted the highly effulgent Mahādeva, having having conferred upon him manhood, disappeared.

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावः पुरुषर्षभौ
स्त्रीभूतः पौरुषं लेभे यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration:
īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prabhāvaḥ puruṣarṣabhau
strībhūtaḥ pauruṣaṁ lebhe yaccānyadapi durlabham

translations.english: O foremost of men, such is the power of the horse-sacrifice, that the king Ila, though converted into a female, regained manhood by virtue thereof.

verses.sanskrit:
एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः
लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration:
etadākhyāya kākutstho bhrātṛbhyāmamitaprabhaḥ
lakṣmaṇaṁ punarevāha dharmayuktamidaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Having thus addressed his both brothers, Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha of unmitigated prowess, again said to Laksmana, in words pregnant with morality.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम्
द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान्
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhaṁ vāmadevaṁ ca jābālimatha kaśyapam
dvijāṁśca sarvapravarānaśvamedhapuraskṛtān

translations.english: O Laksmana, having invited Vasistha, the foremost of twice-born ones, conversant with all the rites of Aśvamedha, Vāmadeva, Jābāli, and Kaśyapa and consulted with them duly I shall set free a horse gifted with all marks.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः
द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyaṁ rāghaveṇoktaṁ śrutvā tvaritavikramaḥ
dvijānsarvānsamāhūya darśayāmāsa rāghavam

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rama, Laksmana, of unmitigated prowess, invited all those Brāhmaṇas and approached Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
ते दृष्ट्वा देवसंकाशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम्
राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीर्भिः समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration:
te dṛṣṭvā devasaṁkāśaṁ kṛtapādābhivandanam
rāghavaṁ sudurādharṣamāśīrbhiḥ samapūjayan

translations.english: Seeing them, Rāma saluted them touching their feet. And the Brāhmaṇas too, beholding the irrepressible celestial, like Rāghava, welcomed him with blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राञ्जलिस्तु ततो भूत्वा राघवो द्विजसत्तमान्
उवाच धर्मसंयुक्तमश्वमेधाश्रितं वचः
verses.transliteration:
prāñjalistu tato bhūtvā rāghavo dvijasattamān
uvāca dharmasaṁyuktamaśvamedhāśritaṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: The.. upon Rama, with folded hands, asked of those leading twice-born ones, questions regarding the Aśvamedha sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्
अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतोऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration:
sa teṣāṁ dvijamukhyānāṁ vākyamadbhutadarśanam
aśvamedhāśritaṁ śrutvā bhṛśaṁ prīto'bhavattadā

translations.english: And being informed from the Brāhmaṇas of many unheard of virtues of Aśvamedha, Rāma was greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
विज्ञाय तु मतं तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
प्रेषयस्व महाबाहो सुग्रीवाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration:
vijñāya tu mataṁ teṣāṁ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt
preṣayasva mahābāho sugrīvāya mahātmane

translations.english: And according to their desire he said to Lakşmaņa:— you having long arms, do you soon send an emissary to the high-souled Sugrīva, communicating to him 'Do you come here to enjoy festivities in the company of all those highly powerful monkeys and hears under you; may good betide you.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः कामगैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
अश्वमेधं महाबाहुः प्राप्नोतु लघुविक्रमः
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhiḥ kāmagairbahubhirvṛtaḥ
aśvamedhaṁ mahābāhuḥ prāpnotu laghuvikramaḥ

translations.english: See that Vibhīşaņa of unequalled prowess, the king of Räkşasas, encircled by his followers coursing at will, may be present at the horse sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
राजानश्च नरव्याघ्र ये मे प्रियचिकीर्षवः
सानुगाः क्षिप्रमायान्तु यज्ञभूमिमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration:
rājānaśca naravyāghra ye me priyacikīrṣavaḥ
sānugāḥ kṣipramāyāntu yajñabhūmimanuttamām

translations.english: Let the great kings, wishing my welfare with their followers be present at the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मपरायणाः
निमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण
verses.transliteration:
deśāntaragatā ye ca dvijā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ
nimantrayasva tānsarvānaśvamedhāya lakṣmaṇa

translations.english: O Laksmana, do you also invite carefully, for witnessing the ceremony, other pious foreign kings who are friendly to me.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषयश्च महाबाहो आहूयन्तां तपोधनाः
देशान्तरगता ये च सदाराश्च महर्षयः
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣayaśca mahābāho āhūyantāṁ tapodhanāḥ
deśāntaragatā ye ca sadārāśca maharṣayaḥ

translations.english: O you having long arms, do you also invite the Rșis, having asceticism for their wealth and other pious Brāhmaṇas living in various provinces with their wives. Do you also invite actors and songsters. Do you order that a spacious, sacrificial ground may be made on the banks of the river Gomati in the Naimișa forest, O you having long arms, that part of the country is best suited and holy.

verses.sanskrit:
सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः
अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महामतिः
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇakoṭyo bahulā hiraṇyasya śatottarāḥ
agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre mahāmatiḥ

translations.english: O you having long arms, let Bharata go before with a million of beasts carrying rice, sessamun seed, Kindney bean, Chickpea, pulse, Masha (a sort of Kindney bean) salt, oil, clarified butter and a hundred koti of silver and golden coins.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तरापणवीथ्यश्च सर्वांश्च नटनर्तकान्
नैगमान्बालवृद्धांश्च द्विजांश्च सुसमाहितान्
verses.transliteration:
antarāpaṇavīthyaśca sarvāṁśca naṭanartakān
naigamānbālavṛddhāṁśca dvijāṁśca susamāhitān

translations.english: Let merchants, to set up shops on the way, actors, dancers, cooks, and many youthful females follow Bharata.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम्
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
yajñavāṭaṁ mahābāhurdṛṣṭvā paramamadbhutam
praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe śrīmāniti ca so'bravīt

translations.english: Having speedily despatched before all articles of sacrifice, Bharata's elder brother Rāma set free a black horse, gifted with all marks and worthy of the sacrifice and placed Lakşmaņa with Rtvik in charge of it. There upon the mighty-armed Kakuthstha, in the company of his soldiers, proceeded to the Naimiņa forest and beholding the wonderful sacrificial ground attained to an excess of delight and said:-It has become highly charming.

verses.sanskrit:
नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः
आजग्मुः सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यस्तान्रामः प्रत्यपूजयत्
verses.transliteration:
naimiṣe vasatastasya sarva eva narādhipāḥ
ājagmuḥ sarvarāṣṭrebhyastānrāmaḥ pratyapūjayat

translations.english: While he remained in the Naimisa forest, all the kings sent him presents and Rāma also made returns.

verses.sanskrit:
उपकार्यान्महार्हांश्च पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम्
सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration:
upakāryānmahārhāṁśca pārthivānāṁ mahātmanām
sānugānāṁ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahādyutiḥ

translations.english: Vibhīşaņa, in the company of many Rākşasas, with a collected mind, began to serve the Rşis, having asceticism for their wealth. And the highly powerful Răma, the foremost of men, set aside valuable houses for the accommodation of the high-souled kings.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नपानानि वस्त्राणि सानुगानां महात्मनाम्
भरतः संददावाशु शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
annapānāni vastrāṇi sānugānāṁ mahātmanām
bharataḥ saṁdadāvāśu śatrughnasahitastadā

translations.english: According to the command of Rāma, Bharata, with Śatrughna, made arrangements for highly valuable quarters, food, drink and clothes.

verses.sanskrit:
वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा
विप्राणां प्रणताः सर्वे चक्रिरे परिवेषणम्
verses.transliteration:
vānarāśca mahātmānaḥ sugrīvasahitāstadā
viprāṇāṁ praṇatāḥ sarve cakrire pariveṣaṇam

translations.english: And the highly powerful monkeys with Sugrīva and Brāhmaṇas engaged in the work of distribution.

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः स्रग्विभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः
ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां किंकरः पर्युपस्थितः
verses.transliteration:
vibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhiḥ sragvibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ
ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṁ kiṁkaraḥ paryupasthitaḥ

translations.english: And Vibhīşaņa, surrounded by various Räkşasas and females, engaged in the service of the high-souled Rsis intent on hard penances.

verses.sanskrit:
न कश्चिन्मलिनस्तत्र दीनो वाप्यथ वा कृशः
तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते
verses.transliteration:
na kaścinmalinastatra dīno vāpyatha vā kṛśaḥ
tasminyajñavare rājño hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛte

translations.english: Indeed before words came out from the lips of the beggars, monkeys and Rakşasas satisfied them with gifts. And all the ascetics living for ever and having asceticism for wealth that were present there, could not think of any other sacrifice, accompanied by so profuse presents, they had seen before.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वत्र वानरास्तस्थुः सर्वत्रैव च राक्षसाः
वासो धनानि कामिभ्यः पूर्णहस्ता ददुर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration:
sarvatra vānarāstasthuḥ sarvatraiva ca rākṣasāḥ
vāso dhanāni kāmibhyaḥ pūrṇahastā dadurbhṛśam

translations.english: Being present everywhere the Rākşasas and Vänaras gave away enough of riches and clothes even to them who did not want.

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः
संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते
verses.transliteration:
īdṛśo rājasiṁhasya yajñaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ
saṁvatsaramatho sāgraṁ vartate na ca hīyate

translations.english: And though this sacrifice, gifted with all marks, of Rama, a lion among kings, continued for a year still his accumulated treasure was not exhausted, but rather was increased.

verses.sanskrit:
वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे परमकेऽद्भुते
सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
vartamāne tathābhūte yajñe paramake'dbhute
saśiṣya ājagāmāśu vālmīkirmunipuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: That sacrifice, the like of which was never seen before, having been undertaken the illustrious ascetic Valmiki, with his disciples, came there.

verses.sanskrit:
स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसंकाशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम्
एकान्ते ऋषिवाटानां चकार उटजाञ्शुभान्
verses.transliteration:
sa dṛṣṭvā divyasaṁkāśaṁ yajñamadbhutadarśanam
ekānte ṛṣivāṭānāṁ cakāra uṭajāñśubhān

translations.english: And beholding this wonderful sacrifice resembling that of the celestials, his followers, the Rşis, made charming cottages in a solitary corner and at no distance.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिवाटेषु पुण्येषु ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च
रथ्यासु राजमार्गेषु पार्थिवानां गृहेषु च
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣivāṭeṣu puṇyeṣu brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu ca
rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu pārthivānāṁ gṛheṣu ca

translations.english: There upon Vālmīki said to his disciples, Lava and Kuća Do you carefully and delightedly sing the whole of Rāmāyaṇa in the highly holy hermitages, of the Rşis, in the homes where perpetual fire is kept up by the Brāhmaṇas, in streets and palaces, at the gate of Rāma's house, in the sacrificial arena and before all Rtvik.

verses.sanskrit:
इमानि च फलान्यत्र स्वादूनि विविधानि च
जातानि पर्वताग्रेषु आस्वाद्यास्वाद्य गीयताम्
verses.transliteration:
imāni ca phalānyatra svādūni vividhāni ca
jātāni parvatāgreṣu āsvādyāsvādya gīyatām

translations.english: And eating all those sweet fruits that are on the summit of the mountain near our hermitage, do you engage in chanting the sweet Rāmāyaṇa.

verses.sanskrit:
न यास्यथः श्रमं वत्सौ भक्षयित्वा फलानि वै
मूलानि च सुमृष्टानि नगरात्परिहास्यथ
verses.transliteration:
na yāsyathaḥ śramaṁ vatsau bhakṣayitvā phalāni vai
mūlāni ca sumṛṣṭāni nagarātparihāsyatha

translations.english: If your begin singing after taking all those sweet fruits you shall not experience exhaustion in singing nor you shall forget measure.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि शब्दापयेद्रामः श्रवणाय महीपतिः
ऋषीणामुपविष्टानां ततो गेयं प्रवर्तताम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi śabdāpayedrāmaḥ śravaṇāya mahīpatiḥ
