ṛṣīṇāmupaviṣṭānāṁ tato geyaṁ pravartatām

translations.english: If Rāma, the lord of earth, invites you to sing the Rāmāyaṇa, you may fearlessly sing it there in due notes and measures before the assembled ascetics.

verses.sanskrit:
दिवसे विंशतिः सर्गा गेया वै परया मुदा
प्रमाणैर्बहुभिस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टं मया पुरा
verses.transliteration:
divase viṁśatiḥ sargā geyā vai parayā mudā
pramāṇairbahubhistatra yathoddiṣṭaṁ mayā purā

translations.english: During the day do you sing, in your sweet voice, twenty sections out of many I have laid in the Rāmāyaṇa consisting of many ślokas.

verses.sanskrit:
लोभश्चापि न कर्तव्यः स्वल्पोऽपि धनकाङ्क्षया
किं धनेनाश्रमस्थानां फलमूलोपभोगिनाम्
verses.transliteration:
lobhaścāpi na kartavyaḥ svalpo'pi dhanakāṅkṣayā
kiṁ dhanenāśramasthānāṁ phalamūlopabhoginām

translations.english: Do not cherish the least longing for riches. Of what avail is wealth to ascetics living perpetually on fruits and roots?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि पृच्छेत्स काकुत्स्थो युवां कस्येति दारकौ
वाल्मीकेरथ शिष्यौ हि ब्रूतामेवं नराधिपम्
verses.transliteration:
yadi pṛcchetsa kākutstho yuvāṁ kasyeti dārakau
vālmīkeratha śiṣyau hi brūtāmevaṁ narādhipam

translations.english: If Rāma asks you about your father you may say, We are both disciples of the high souled Valmiki.

verses.sanskrit:
इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वा पूर्वदर्शितम्
मूर्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायेतां विगतज्वरौ
verses.transliteration:
imāstantrīḥ sumadhurāḥ sthānaṁ vā pūrvadarśitam
mūrchayitvā sumadhuraṁ gāyetāṁ vigatajvarau

translations.english: O Kuśa and Lava, in your proper mood do you sing the sweet song with charming Murchanā accompanied by the sweet notes of Vīņā.

verses.sanskrit:
आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम्
पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भवति धर्मतः
verses.transliteration:
ādiprabhṛti geyaṁ syānna cāvajñāya pārthivam
pitā hi sarvabhūtānāṁ rājā bhavati dharmataḥ

translations.english: Before you begin with the song, without disregarding the king, do you bow to him reverentially. Morally the king is the father of all.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्युवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समाधिना
गायेतां मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration:
tadyuvāṁ hṛṣṭamanasau śvaḥ prabhāte samādhinā
gāyetāṁ madhuraṁ geyaṁ tantrīlayasamanvitam

translations.english: Do you therefore both, delightedly and with a collected mind, early in the morning, sing the theme in a sweet voice and accompanied by the music of the stringed instrument.

verses.sanskrit:
इति संदिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा
वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
iti saṁdiśya bahuśo muniḥ prācetasastadā
vālmīkiḥ paramodārastūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Having in this wise given counsels, the highly generous and great ascetic Vālmīki, son of Pracetā, became silent.

verses.sanskrit:
तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारौ; निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां शुभाम्
समुत्सुकौ तौ सुखमूषतुर्निशां; यथाश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंस्कृतौ
verses.transliteration:
tāmadbhutāṁ tau hṛdaye kumārau; niveśya vāṇīmṛṣibhāṣitāṁ śubhām
samutsukau tau sukhamūṣaturniśāṁ; yathāśvinau bhārgavanītisaṁskṛtau

translations.english: Like to the two Asvins following the moral precepts of Sukra, the two princes, placing those wonderful counsels of Vālmiki in their minds, spent the night with a heart stricken with curiosity.

verses.sanskrit:
तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ
यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्वं तत्र तत्राभ्यगायताम्
verses.transliteration:
tau rajanyāṁ prabhātāyāṁ snātau hutahutāśanau
yathoktamṛṣiṇā pūrvaṁ tatra tatrābhyagāyatām

translations.english: There upon the night being over, having bathed and performed the Homa; both Lava and Kusa, in consonance with Rsi's command, began the song.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रमाणैर्बहुभिर्बद्धां तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम्
बालाभ्यां राघवः श्रुत्वा कौतूहलपरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration:
pramāṇairbahubhirbaddhāṁ tantrīlayasamanvitām
bālābhyāṁ rāghavaḥ śrutvā kautūhalaparo'bhavat

translations.english: That song was composed by the first preceptor (Vālmīki) never heard of before, consisting of sounds originating from six places, containing all metres, many proofs and set in accompaniment with the music of a stringed instrument. Hearing such a song from the boys Rāma was stricken with curiosity.

verses.sanskrit:
जटिलौ यदि न स्यातां न वल्कलधरौ यदि
विशेषं नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च
verses.transliteration:
jaṭilau yadi na syātāṁ na valkaladharau yadi
viśeṣaṁ nādhigacchāmo gāyato rāghavasya ca

translations.english: And they all attentively said to one anotherBoth of them take after Rāma, like to a bubble resembling the one it rises from. There would not have been perceived the least difference between them and Rama had they not been clothed in dark and used clotted hair. The citizens and villagers speaking thus with one another Kuśa and Lava chanted twenty sections beginning from the first, pointed out by Narada.

verses.sanskrit:
ततोऽपराह्णसमये राघवः समभाषत
श्रुत्वा विंशतिसर्गांस्तान्भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलः
verses.transliteration:
tato'parāhṇasamaye rāghavaḥ samabhāṣata
śrutvā viṁśatisargāṁstānbharataṁ bhrātṛvatsalaḥ

translations.english: Having heard up to twentieth section, Răma, fond of his brother, said to Lakşmaņa in the afternoon, O Kakutstha, do you soon confer upon these two high-souled ones eighteen thousand gold coins and all other-things they wish for.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य चैवागमं रामः काव्यस्य श्रोतुमुत्सुकः
पप्रच्छ तौ महातेजास्तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ
verses.transliteration:
tasya caivāgamaṁ rāmaḥ kāvyasya śrotumutsukaḥ
papraccha tau mahātejāstāvubhau munidārakau

translations.english: Hearing those words of them, Råma and the audience were greatly worked up with curiosity and surprise. There upon being anxious to learn of the origin of the poem, the highly effulgent Rāma asked the two Muni boys, saying. What is the proof of the story of this poem?

verses.sanskrit:
किंप्रमाणमिदं काव्यं का प्रतिष्ठा महात्मनः
कर्ता काव्यस्य महतः को वासौ मुनिपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
kiṁpramāṇamidaṁ kāvyaṁ kā pratiṣṭhā mahātmanaḥ
kartā kāvyasya mahataḥ ko vāsau munipuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: How great is his fame who has composed it? What leading ascetic is the author of this great poem?

verses.sanskrit:
पृच्छन्तं राघवं वाक्यमूचतुर्मुनिदारकौ
वाल्मीकिर्भगवान्कर्ता संप्राप्तो यज्ञसंनिधिम्
येनेदं चरितं तुभ्यमशेषं संप्रदर्शितम्
verses.transliteration:
pṛcchantaṁ rāghavaṁ vākyamūcaturmunidārakau
vālmīkirbhagavānkartā saṁprāpto yajñasaṁnidhim
yenedaṁ caritaṁ tubhyamaśeṣaṁ saṁpradarśitam

translations.english: Ráma having thus asked them those two Muni boys said: The illustrious Vālmīki is the author of this poem. He has described in this poem your endless story. He has of late come to your sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि बुद्धिः कृता राजञ्श्रवणाय महारथ
कर्मान्तरे क्षणी हूतस्तच्छृणुष्व सहानुजः
verses.transliteration:
yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā rājañśravaṇāya mahāratha
karmāntare kṣaṇī hūtastacchṛṇuṣva sahānujaḥ

translations.english: O mighty car-warrior, o king, if you do wish to hear the whole of it, do you, at your leisure, hear it delightedly in the company of your younger brother.

verses.sanskrit:
बाढमित्यब्रवीद्रामस्तौ चानुज्ञाप्य राघवम्
प्रहृष्टौ जग्मतुर्वासं यत्रासौ मुनिपुंगवः
verses.transliteration:
bāḍhamityabravīdrāmastau cānujñāpya rāghavam
prahṛṣṭau jagmaturvāsaṁ yatrāsau munipuṁgavaḥ

translations.english: Saying 'so it shall be' Rama bade them adieu and they too, delighted, repaired to where Vālmīki, the foremost of Munis was.

verses.sanskrit:
रामोऽपि मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः
श्रुत्वा तद्गीतमाधुर्यं कर्मशालामुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
rāmo'pi munibhiḥ sārdhaṁ pārthivaiśca mahātmabhiḥ
śrutvā tadgītamādhuryaṁ karmaśālāmupāgamat

translations.english: There upon having heard that charming song in the company of ascetics and kings the highminded Rāma repaired to the place of business.

verses.sanskrit:
रामो बहून्यहान्येव तद्गीतं परमाद्भुतम्
शुश्राव मुनिभिः सार्धं राजभिः सह वानरैः
verses.transliteration:
rāmo bahūnyahānyeva tadgītaṁ paramādbhutam
śuśrāva munibhiḥ sārdhaṁ rājabhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ

translations.english: Rāma heard that highly sacred theme for many long days in the company of ascetics, kings and Vänaras.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ
तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tasmingīte tu vijñāya sītāputrau kuśīlavau
tasyāḥ pariṣado madhye rāmo vacanamabravīt

translations.english: And understanding from the story that Kusa and Lava were Janaki's sons, Rāma mentioning her name said before the assembly:-Send a good emissary to the illustrious Vālmīki and let him communicate to the ascetics that if Janaki is sinless and has lead a pure life in the forest; let her give proof of purity by the great ascetic's permission.

verses.sanskrit:
छन्दं मुनेस्तु विज्ञाय सीतायाश्च मनोगतम्
प्रत्ययं दातुकामायास्ततः शंसत मे लघु
verses.transliteration:
chandaṁ munestu vijñāya sītāyāśca manogatam
pratyayaṁ dātukāmāyāstataḥ śaṁsata me laghu

translations.english: Let the emissaries learn well the intention of the ascetic in this and if Sītā is at heart willing to bring in proofs.

verses.sanskrit:
श्वः प्रभाते तु शपथं मैथिली जनकात्मजा
करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममेह च
verses.transliteration:
śvaḥ prabhāte tu śapathaṁ maithilī janakātmajā
karotu pariṣanmadhye śodhanārthaṁ mameha ca

translations.english: To uphold her as well as mine purity, let Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, swear before the assembly in the morning of the next day.

verses.sanskrit:
ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तममितप्रभम्
ऊचुस्ते रामवाक्यानि मृदूनि मधुराणि च
verses.transliteration:
te praṇamya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamamitaprabham
ūcuste rāmavākyāni mṛdūni madhurāṇi ca

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rānia, messengers went to Vālmīki and saluting the high-souled (ascetic) burning in his effulgence and of incomparable lustre, communicated to him, in sweet words all what Rāma had said.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम्
विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā rāmasya ca manogatam
vijñāya sumahātejā munirvākyamathābravīt

translations.english: Hearing the words of the messengers and understanding Rama's intention the ascetic said.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा तुष्यति राघवः
तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियाः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ bhavatu bhadraṁ vo yathā tuṣyati rāghavaḥ
tathā kariṣyate sītā daivataṁ hi patiḥ striyāḥ

translations.english: What Räma has said shall be satisfied. May good betide you. Husband is the greatest god for women. So SIta shall carry out his behests.

verses.sanskrit:
तथोक्ता मुनिना सर्वे रामदूता महौजसः
प्रत्येत्य राघवं सर्वे मुनिवाक्यं बभाषिरे
verses.transliteration:
tathoktā muninā sarve rāmadūtā mahaujasaḥ
pratyetya rāghavaṁ sarve munivākyaṁ babhāṣire

translations.english: The great ascetic having said this, the highly powerful emissaries, approaching Rāma, communicated to him what the Muni had said.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं महात्मनः
ऋषींस्तत्र समेतांश्च राज्ञश्चैवाभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ kākutsthaḥ śrutvā vākyaṁ mahātmanaḥ
ṛṣīṁstatra sametāṁśca rājñaścaivābhyabhāṣata

translations.english: Hearing the words of the high-souled Valmiki, Rama was greatly delighted. Having addressed the assembled Rșis and kings he said.

verses.sanskrit:
भगवन्तः सशिष्या वै सानुगाश्च नराधिपाः
पश्यन्तु सीताशपथं यश्चैवान्योऽभिकाङ्क्षते
verses.transliteration:
bhagavantaḥ saśiṣyā vai sānugāśca narādhipāḥ
paśyantu sītāśapathaṁ yaścaivānyo'bhikāṅkṣate

translations.english: The Rșis with their disciples, and the kings with their followers and all others willing shall see Sitā swear here.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः
सर्वेषामृषिमुख्यानां साधुवादो महानभूत्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
sarveṣāmṛṣimukhyānāṁ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt

translations.english: Hearing the words of the high-souled Rāma, all the high-souled Rșis began to speak of him in high terms and said.

verses.sanskrit:
राजानश्च महात्मानः प्रशंसन्ति स्म राघवम्
उपपन्नं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येव भुवि नान्यतः
verses.transliteration:
rājānaśca mahātmānaḥ praśaṁsanti sma rāghavam
upapannaṁ naraśreṣṭha tvayyeva bhuvi nānyataḥ

translations.english: O foremost of men, such an action becomes you not any one else.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा श्वोभूत इति राघवः
विसर्जयामास तदा सर्वांस्ताञ्शत्रुसूदनः
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ viniścayaṁ kṛtvā śvobhūta iti rāghavaḥ
visarjayāmāsa tadā sarvāṁstāñśatrusūdanaḥ

translations.english: There upon having settled that Sītă would swear next day, Rāma, the slayer of enemies, dismissed them all.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा समागतं सर्वमश्वभूतमिवाचलम्
श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tathā samāgataṁ sarvamaśvabhūtamivācalam
śrutvā munivarastūrṇaṁ sasītaḥ samupāgamat

translations.english: Besides thousands and thousands of Kșatriyas, Vaiśyas, sadras and Brāhmaṇas of firm tenancies, also hailed there from various parts to witness Sita's trial. Having arrived there they all sat down motionless like mountains. There upon, Valmiki, the foremost of ascetics, speedily came there accompanied by Sitā.

verses.sanskrit:
तां दृष्ट्वा श्रीमिवायान्तीं ब्रह्माणमनुगामिनीम्
वाल्मीकेः पृष्ठतः सीतां साधुकारो महानभूत्
verses.transliteration:
tāṁ dṛṣṭvā śrīmivāyāntīṁ brahmāṇamanugāminīm
vālmīkeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītāṁ sādhukāro mahānabhūt

translations.english: With her face downwards, folded palms, eyes full of tears and meditating upon Råma in her mind, Sita, following the Rsis, came before the assembly. There arose a great uproar of eulogy from the assembly when they saw Sità following Vālmīki like to the Śruti following Brahmā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वेषामेवमाबभौ
दुःखजेन विशालेन शोकेनाकुलितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
tato halahalāśabdaḥ sarveṣāmevamābabhau
duḥkhajena viśālena śokenākulitātmanām

translations.english: There upon members, stricken with sorrow, made a tumultuous sound. Among the visitors some praised Rāma, some praised $ītā and others eulogised both of them.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो मध्यं जनौघानां प्रविश्य मुनिपुंगवः
सीतासहायो वाल्मीकिरिति होवाच राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
tato madhyaṁ janaughānāṁ praviśya munipuṁgavaḥ
sītāsahāyo vālmīkiriti hovāca rāghavam

translations.english: There upon having entered that huge assemblage in company of Sītā, the great ascetic Valmiki addressed Rāma, saying: O son of Dasaratha, in fear of calumny, you did renounce her near my hermitage, albeit Sitā is pure and follows the ways of morality.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत
प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration:
lokāpavādabhītasya tava rāma mahāvrata
pratyayaṁ dāsyate sītā tāmanujñātumarhasi

translations.english: O Rāma of firm vows, you are afraid of the censure of the people. Sitā has becoming willing to give testimony (of her purity) for removing the calumny of the public; do you mercifully give her permission in this.

verses.sanskrit:
इमौ च जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातकौ
सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षौ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration:
imau ca jānakīputrāvubhau ca yamajātakau
sutau tavaiva durdharṣau satyametadbravīmi te

translations.english: I tell you the truth, O Råma, that these irrepressible twin brothers are your sons, O descendant of Raghu. I am the tenth son of Pracetā, so, far from speaking untruth it does not even spring up in my mind. I therefore know the truth that these twins are your sons.

verses.sanskrit:
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता
तस्याः फलमुपाश्नीयामपापा मैथिली यथा
verses.transliteration:
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścaryā mayā kṛtā
tasyāḥ phalamupāśnīyāmapāpā maithilī yathā

translations.english: I have performed austere penances for many thousand years; I now swear before you, that if this Maithili is found touched by any sin I shall not reap the fruit of my ascetic observances extending over many thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनःषष्ठेषु राघव
विचिन्त्य सीतां शुद्धेति न्यगृह्णां वननिर्झरे
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ pañcasu bhūteṣu manaḥṣaṣṭheṣu rāghava
vicintya sītāṁ śuddheti nyagṛhṇāṁ vananirjhare

translations.english: O descendant of Raghu, finding Sitä pure in mind and five elements of body I took her near the spring in the forest.

verses.sanskrit:
इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता
लोकापवादभीतस्य दास्यति प्रत्ययं तव
verses.transliteration:
iyaṁ śuddhasamācārā apāpā patidevatā
lokāpavādabhītasya dāsyati pratyayaṁ tava

translations.english: Besides this Sitā, of pure ways, divested of sins and ever considering her husband as deity, shall give testimony this day.

verses.sanskrit:
वाल्मीकिनैवमुक्तस्तु राघवः प्रत्यभाषत
प्राञ्जलिर्जगतो मध्ये दृष्ट्वा तां देववर्णिनीम्
verses.transliteration:
vālmīkinaivamuktastu rāghavaḥ pratyabhāṣata
prāñjalirjagato madhye dṛṣṭvā tāṁ devavarṇinīm

translations.english: After the great Rșis Vālmīki had said this, Rāma, on beholding the daughter of Janaka resembling a celestial, in the midst of the assembly, with folded hands, said.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतन्महाभाग यथा वदसि धर्मवित्
प्रत्ययो हि मम ब्रह्मंस्तव वाक्यैरकल्मषैः
verses.transliteration:
evametanmahābhāga yathā vadasi dharmavit
pratyayo hi mama brahmaṁstava vākyairakalmaṣaiḥ

translations.english: O great one, you are conversant with piety. By your words shorn of sin, I have been convinced that Janaki is of pure ways. Still, O Brāhmaṇa, what you have commanded shall be carried out; let Sītā produce testimony of the purity of her character.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्ययो हि पुरा दत्तो वैदेह्या सुरसंनिधौ
सेयं लोकभयाद्ब्रह्मन्नपापेत्यभिजानता
परित्यक्ता मया सीता तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
pratyayo hi purā datto vaidehyā surasaṁnidhau
seyaṁ lokabhayādbrahmannapāpetyabhijānatā
parityaktā mayā sītā tadbhavānkṣantumarhati

translations.english: O Brāhmaṇa, vilification of the people is very powerful. Although I know that Jānaki has not been touched by any sin still I have renounced her. Do you therefore forgive me.

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ
शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे
verses.transliteration:
jānāmi cemau putrau me yamajātau kuśīlavau
śuddhāyāṁ jagato madhye maithilyāṁ prītirastu me

translations.english: I know that these twin brothers Kusa and Lava are my sons. Yet if Janaki gives evidence of her own purity before the assembly I shall be greatly satisfied.

verses.sanskrit:
अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय रामस्य सुरसत्तमाः
पितामहं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः
verses.transliteration:
abhiprāyaṁ tu vijñāya rāmasya surasattamāḥ
pitāmahaṁ puraskṛtya sarva eva samāgatāḥ

translations.english: Being apprised of Rama's intention as to Sītā's trial the celestials all came there on the occasion.

verses.sanskrit:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः
अश्विनावृषिगन्धर्वा अप्सराणां गणास्तथा
साध्याश्च देवाः सर्वे ते सर्वे च परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration:
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ
aśvināvṛṣigandharvā apsarāṇāṁ gaṇāstathā
sādhyāśca devāḥ sarve te sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ

translations.english: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Visvadeva, Maruts, Sadhyas, Siddhas, Nagas, and Rsis placing Brahmā before them, all came there.

verses.sanskrit:
तदद्भुतमिवाचिन्त्यं निरीक्षन्ते समाहिताः
मानवाः सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः पूर्वं कृतयुगे यथा
verses.transliteration:
tadadbhutamivācintyaṁ nirīkṣante samāhitāḥ
mānavāḥ sarvarāṣṭrebhyaḥ pūrvaṁ kṛtayuge yathā

translations.english: As soon as those words were uttered, sweet, fragrant, cold air, the witness of virtue and vice, blowing mildly, excited the joy of the assembly. People, hailing from various countries, with all attention began to witness this wondrous and unthought of event. In the golden age only the celestial wind used to blow, and it now blew even in the Tretā Yuga and forsooth it was a matter of exceeding surprise.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वान्समागतान्दृष्ट्वा सीता काषायवासिनी
अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमधोदृष्टिरवाङ्मुखी
verses.transliteration:
sarvānsamāgatāndṛṣṭvā sītā kāṣāyavāsinī
abravītprāñjalirvākyamadhodṛṣṭiravāṅmukhī

translations.english: There upon beholding all people assembled there, Janaka's daughter, wearing a red cloth, with her face and looks downwards and folded palms said.

verses.sanskrit:
यथाहं राघवादन्यं मनसापि न चिन्तये
तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration:
yathāhaṁ rāghavādanyaṁ manasāpi na cintaye
tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṁ dātumarhati

translations.english: I have never thought of any other person in my mind but Rāma; by the strength of this virtue let the goddess Vasundharā give me room.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्यां प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम्
भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration:
tathā śapantyāṁ vaidehyāṁ prādurāsīttadadbhutam
bhūtalādutthitaṁ divyaṁ siṁhāsanamanuttamam

translations.english: As soon as Sītā swore in this wise a wonderful incident took place. From inside the earth a celestial and excellent throne rose up.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रियमाणं शिरोभिस्तन्नागैरमितविक्रमैः
दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration:
dhriyamāṇaṁ śirobhistannāgairamitavikramaiḥ
divyaṁ divyena vapuṣā sarvaratnavibhūṣitam

translations.english: It was carried on head by the Nāgas of unmitigated prowess, having celestial persons and adorned with celestial jewels and ornaments.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम्
स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेषयत्
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstu dharaṇī devī bāhubhyāṁ gṛhya maithilīm
svāgatenābhinandyaināmāsane copaveṣayat

translations.english: Having stretched out her arms and taken Maithilī, the goddess earth welcomed her and placed her on the throne.

verses.sanskrit:
तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तीं रसातलम्
पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत्
verses.transliteration:
tāmāsanagatāṁ dṛṣṭvā praviśantīṁ rasātalam
puṣpavṛṣṭiravicchinnā divyā sītāmavākirat

translations.english: And while seated on the throne she was entering the earth, she was covered with the continued showers of celestial flowers.

verses.sanskrit:
साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः
साधु साध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration:
sādhukāraśca sumahāndevānāṁ sahasotthitaḥ
sādhu sādhviti vai sīte yasyāste śīlamīdṛśam

translations.english: Eulogising her at that time, the celestials said: Oh! highly praiseworthy is your conduct, O Sītā. Being present in the welkin and beholding Sītā enter into the Earth, the celestials again and again eulogised her in various words.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि मुनयः सर्व एव ते
राजानश्च नरव्याघ्रा विस्मयान्नोपरेमिरे
verses.transliteration:
yajñavāṭagatāścāpi munayaḥ sarva eva te
rājānaśca naravyāghrā vismayānnoparemire

translations.english: The Rşis, kings and other leading men present in the sacrificial arena repeatedly expressed their surprise.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः
दानवाश्च महाकायाः पाताले पन्नगाधिपाः
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ
dānavāśca mahākāyāḥ pātāle pannagādhipāḥ

translations.english: Beholding Sita's censure thus removed all animals, animate or inanimate, either on earth or in the sky, were greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
केचिद्विनेदुः संहृष्टाः केचिद्ध्यानपरायणाः
केचिद्रामं निरीक्षन्ते केचित्सीतामचेतनाः
verses.transliteration:
kecidvineduḥ saṁhṛṣṭāḥ keciddhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
kecidrāmaṁ nirīkṣante kecitsītāmacetanāḥ

translations.english: Some cried aloud in joy, some remained silent, and some motionless espied Rāma or Sītā.

verses.sanskrit:
सीताप्रवेशनं दृष्ट्वा तेषामासीत्समागमः
तं मुहूर्तमिवात्यर्थं सर्वं संमोहितं जगत्
verses.transliteration:
sītāpraveśanaṁ dṛṣṭvā teṣāmāsītsamāgamaḥ
taṁ muhūrtamivātyarthaṁ sarvaṁ saṁmohitaṁ jagat

translations.english: In this wise beholding Sītā's entrance into the Earth the ascetics were greatly delighted. They all attaining to the same state of mind, the whole universe, for a moment, was possessed with the state of equality.

verses.sanskrit:
तदावसाने यज्ञस्य रामः परमदुर्मनाः
अपश्यमानो वैदेहीं मेने शून्यमिदं जगत्
शोकेन परमायत्तो न शान्तिं मनसागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tadāvasāne yajñasya rāmaḥ paramadurmanāḥ
apaśyamāno vaidehīṁ mene śūnyamidaṁ jagat
śokena paramāyatto na śāntiṁ manasāgamat

translations.english: In Janaki's absence the whuic orld appeared to him as blank. Now being overwhelmed with grief he lost all mental peace.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विसृज्य तान्सर्वान्रामो राजीवलोचनः
हृदि कृत्वा तदा सीतामयोध्यां प्रविवेश सः
verses.transliteration:
tato visṛjya tānsarvānrāmo rājīvalocanaḥ
hṛdi kṛtvā tadā sītāmayodhyāṁ praviveśa saḥ

translations.english: Having conferred various gifts upon the kings, Rākşasas, monkeys and leading Brāhmaṇas, Räma sent them away and meditating upon Sītā's absence entered Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
न सीतायाः परां भार्यां वव्रे स रघुनन्दनः
यज्ञे यज्ञे च पत्न्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनी भवत्
verses.transliteration:
na sītāyāḥ parāṁ bhāryāṁ vavre sa raghunandanaḥ
yajñe yajñe ca patnyarthaṁ jānakī kāñcanī bhavat

translations.english: And from the time of Sita's entering into Pātāla he did not take any other spouse. And having made a golden image of Sītā he engage in the performance of various sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां गोसवैश्च महाधनैः
ईजे क्रतुभिरन्यैश्च स श्रीमानाप्तदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration:
agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṁ gosavaiśca mahādhanaiḥ
īje kratubhiranyaiśca sa śrīmānāptadakṣiṇaiḥ

translations.english: In this wise for thousand years he celebrated many Horse-sacrifices, many Vajapeyas with profuse gold, Agnistomas, Atiratras, numberless Gomedhas and various other sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं स कालः सुमहान्राज्यस्थस्य महात्मनः
धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य व्यतीयाद्राघवस्य तु
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sa kālaḥ sumahānrājyasthasya mahātmanaḥ
dharme prayatamānasya vyatīyādrāghavasya tu

translations.english: Rāma being engaged in governing the kingdom and performing many pious rites long time passed away.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि स्थिता रामस्य शासने
अनुरज्यन्ति राजानो अहन्यहनि राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣavānararakṣāṁsi sthitā rāmasya śāsane
anurajyanti rājāno ahanyahani rāghavam

translations.english: And being under his subjection, bears monkeys, Raksasa and kings always afforded delight to him.

verses.sanskrit:
काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः सुभिक्षं विमला दिशः
हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं पुरं जनपदस्तथा
verses.transliteration:
kāle varṣati parjanyaḥ subhikṣaṁ vimalā diśaḥ
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṁ puraṁ janapadastathā

translations.english: On account of showers in proper time there was enough of food in his kingdom. The quarters were pure and delightful. The citizens and villagers were happy and healthy.

verses.sanskrit:
नाकाले म्रियते कश्चिन्न व्याधिः प्राणिनां तदा
नाधर्मश्चाभवत्कश्चिद्रामे राज्यं प्रशासति
verses.transliteration:
nākāle mriyate kaścinna vyādhiḥ prāṇināṁ tadā
nādharmaścābhavatkaścidrāme rājyaṁ praśāsati

translations.english: None met with premature death. In fact, in his regime all calamities were removed.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राममाता यशस्विनी
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृता कालधर्ममुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
atha dīrghasya kālasya rāmamātā yaśasvinī
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtā kāladharmamupāgamat

translations.english: There upon after many years, the illustrious, Kausalyā, Rāma's mother, surrounded by her sons and grand-sons, breathed her last.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्वियाय सुमित्रापि कैकेयी च यशस्विनी
धर्मं कृत्वा बहुविधं त्रिदिवे पर्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration:
anviyāya sumitrāpi kaikeyī ca yaśasvinī
dharmaṁ kṛtvā bahuvidhaṁ tridive paryavasthitā

translations.english: Performing many pious observances Kaikayi followed her and obtained peace in the land of immortals. Those noble ladies, being united with the king Dasaratha, in heaven, were greatly delighted and obtained all virtues.

verses.sanskrit:
तासां रामो महादानं काले काले प्रयच्छति
मातॄणामविशेषेण ब्राह्मणेषु तपस्विषु
verses.transliteration:
tāsāṁ rāmo mahādānaṁ kāle kāle prayacchati
mātṝṇāmaviśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇeṣu tapasviṣu

translations.english: Besides, having worshipped the deities and manes on the occasion of his father's Śrădha ceremony the high-souled Rāma distributed many jewels and engaged in the performance of a very difficult sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः
स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration:
kasyacittvatha kālasya yudhājitkekayo nṛpaḥ
svaguruṁ preṣayāmāsa rāghavāya mahātmane

translations.english: Once on a time Yudhajit, the king of Kekaya, sent to the high-souled Rāma, Gārgya— son of his own preceptor Angiras-a Brāhmaṇa saint of unmitigated prowess; and with him he sent, as tokens of affections, gifts of ten thousand horses, numberless blankets various jewels, diverse clothes and well washed coverlets.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्युद्गम्य च काकुत्स्थः क्रोशमात्रं सहानुगः
गार्ग्यं संपूजयामास धनं तत्प्रतिगृह्य च
verses.transliteration:
pratyudgamya ca kākutsthaḥ krośamātraṁ sahānugaḥ
gārgyaṁ saṁpūjayāmāsa dhanaṁ tatpratigṛhya ca

translations.english: Hearing of the arrival of the great saint Gārgya with above valuable presents sent by his maternal uncle Yudhājit, the intelligent Rāma, with his brothers, proceeded about a Krosa to receive him and adored him particularly likely to the lord of celestials honouring Bịhaspati.

verses.sanskrit:
किमाह मातुलो वाक्यं यदर्थं भगवानिह
प्राप्तो वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठ साक्षादिव बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration:
kimāha mātulo vākyaṁ yadarthaṁ bhagavāniha
prāpto vākyavidāṁ śreṣṭha sākṣādiva bṛhaspatiḥ

translations.english: Having thus welcomed that foremost of Rșis and accepted the valuable presents sent by his maternal uncle he asked the ascetic about his welfare in every thing. There upon the great Rșis being seated, he said. You are the foremost of those skilled in the are of speech like the very preceptor of the celestials. Since your own self has here My uncle must have commissioned you with a very important message.

verses.sanskrit:
मातुलस्ते महाबाहो वाक्यमाह नरर्षभ
युधाजित्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते
verses.transliteration:
mātulaste mahābāho vākyamāha nararṣabha
yudhājitprītisaṁyuktaṁ śrūyatāṁ yadi rocate

translations.english: Hearing those words of Rāma the great saint communicated to him the object of his coming, saying. O you having long arms, if you do like, hear what loving words your maternal uncle Yudhājit, the foremost of men, has said.

verses.sanskrit:
तं च रक्षन्ति गन्धर्वाः सायुधा युद्धकोविदाः
शैलूषस्य सुता वीरास्तिस्रः कोट्यो महाबलाः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ ca rakṣanti gandharvāḥ sāyudhā yuddhakovidāḥ
śailūṣasya sutā vīrāstisraḥ koṭyo mahābalāḥ

translations.english: The Gandharvas, holding weapons and expert in warfare, guard that beautiful province abounding in fruits and roots on the banks of the come river Sindhu. O hero, those Gandharvas are highly powerful and three kotis in number.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्विनिर्जित्य काकुत्स्थ गन्धर्वविषयं शुभम्
निवेशय महाबाहो द्वे पुरे सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration:
tānvinirjitya kākutstha gandharvaviṣayaṁ śubham
niveśaya mahābāho dve pure susamāhitaḥ

translations.english: Having hoisted your flag of victory and conquered that highly picturesque city of Gandharvas do you include that kingdom within your well-established territories. None can enter there. O you having long arms, I do not request you for any harm of you. Let that highly charming country be liked by you.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवः प्रीतो महर्षेर्मातुलस्य च
उवाच बाढमित्येवं भरतं चान्ववैक्षत
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā rāghavaḥ prīto maharṣermātulasya ca
uvāca bāḍhamityevaṁ bharataṁ cānvavaikṣata

translations.english: Hearing the words of the maternal uncle communicated by the great saint, Rāma, with delight, said.

verses.sanskrit:
निवेश्य ते पुरवरे आत्माजौ संनिवेश्य च
आगमिष्यति मे भूयः सकाशमतिधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration:
niveśya te puravare ātmājau saṁniveśya ca
āgamiṣyati me bhūyaḥ sakāśamatidhārmikaḥ

translations.english: Having established two kingdoms and installed his two sons there Bharata, the foremost of the pious, shall come back to me.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मर्षिमेवमुक्त्वा तु भरतं सबलानुगम्
आज्ञापयामास तदा कुमारौ चाभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration:
brahmarṣimevamuktvā tu bharataṁ sabalānugam
ājñāpayāmāsa tadā kumārau cābhyaṣecayat

translations.english: Having thus said to the Brahmarși, Rāma commanded Bharata and welcomed the two princes.

verses.sanskrit:
नक्षत्रेण च सौम्येन पुरस्कृत्याङ्गिरः सुतम्
भरतः सह सैन्येन कुमाराभ्यां च निर्ययौ
verses.transliteration:
nakṣatreṇa ca saumyena puraskṛtyāṅgiraḥ sutam
bharataḥ saha sainyena kumārābhyāṁ ca niryayau

translations.english: There upon under the auspices of favourable stars, having placed Gargya, son of Aigiras before them, Bharata with the princes and army issued out of the city of Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
सा सेना शक्रयुक्तेव नरगान्निर्ययावथ
राघवानुगता दूरं दुराधर्षा सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration:
sā senā śakrayukteva naragānniryayāvatha
rāghavānugatā dūraṁ durādharṣā surāsuraiḥ

translations.english: Răma's army unconquerable even by the celestials went out from the city like a celestial host under the command of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
मांसाशीनि च सत्त्वानि रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च
अनुजग्मुश्च भरतं रुधिरस्य पिपासया
verses.transliteration:
māṁsāśīni ca sattvāni rakṣāṁsi sumahānti ca
anujagmuśca bharataṁ rudhirasya pipāsayā

translations.english: Animals, living upon flesh and huge-bodied Rākşasas longing for blood and many terrible and dreadful carnivorous creatures followed Bharata wishing the flesh of Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
भूतग्रामाश्च बहवो मांसभक्षाः सुदारुणाः
गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि भोक्तुकामाः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration:
bhūtagrāmāśca bahavo māṁsabhakṣāḥ sudāruṇāḥ
gandharvaputramāṁsāni bhoktukāmāḥ sahasraśaḥ

translations.english: Animals, living upon flesh and huge-bodied Rākşasas longing for blood and many terrible and dreadful carnivorous creatures followed Bharata wishing the flesh of Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
सिंहव्याघ्रसृगालानां खेचराणां च पक्षिणाम्
बहूनि वै सहस्राणि सेनाया ययुरग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
siṁhavyāghrasṛgālānāṁ khecarāṇāṁ ca pakṣiṇām
bahūni vai sahasrāṇi senāyā yayuragrataḥ

translations.english: Besides many thousand birds, moving in the sky, lions, tigers and boars went before the army.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्यर्धमासमुषिता पथि सेना निरामया
हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा केकयं समुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
adhyardhamāsamuṣitā pathi senā nirāmayā
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā kekayaṁ samupāgamat

translations.english: The army, consisting of delighted and healthy subjects spending half a month in the way, arrived at the Kekaya kingdom in good health. commanded Bharata and welcomed the two princes.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा सेनापतिं प्राप्तं भरतं केकयाधिपः
युधाजिद्गार्ग्यसहितं परां प्रीतिमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā senāpatiṁ prāptaṁ bharataṁ kekayādhipaḥ
yudhājidgārgyasahitaṁ parāṁ prītimupāgamat

translations.english: Hearing of the arrival of the Bharata with the army Gargya and Yudhajit, the king of Kekayas, were greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
स निर्ययौ जनौघेन महता केकयाधिपः
त्वरमाणोऽभिचक्राम गन्धर्वान्देवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration:
sa niryayau janaughena mahatā kekayādhipaḥ
tvaramāṇo'bhicakrāma gandharvāndevarūpiṇaḥ

translations.english: He, the king of Kekaya, with a huge army they speedily went out for conquering the Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतश्च युधाजिच्च समेतौ लघुविक्रमौ
गन्धर्वनगरं प्राप्तौ सबलौ सपदानुगौ
verses.transliteration:
bharataśca yudhājicca sametau laghuvikramau
gandharvanagaraṁ prāptau sabalau sapadānugau

translations.english: There upon the highly powerful and lightarmed Bharata and Yudhājit, with the soldiers and followers, arrived at the city of Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा तु भरतं प्राप्तं गन्धर्वास्ते समागताः
योद्धुकामा महावीर्या विनदन्तः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā tu bharataṁ prāptaṁ gandharvāste samāgatāḥ
yoddhukāmā mahāvīryā vinadantaḥ samantataḥ

translations.english: Having heard of the coming of Bharata the highly powerful Gandharvas gathered round and sent up leonine roars.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्
सप्तरात्रं महाभीमं न चान्यतरयोर्जयः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ lomaharṣaṇam
saptarātraṁ mahābhīmaṁ na cānyatarayorjayaḥ

translations.english: There upon began the battle capable of making down erect and continued for a week. On neither side there was victory or defeat.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो रामानुजः क्रुद्धः कालस्यास्त्रं सुदारुणम्
संवर्तं नाम भरतो गन्धर्वेष्वभ्ययोजयत्
verses.transliteration:
tato rāmānujaḥ kruddhaḥ kālasyāstraṁ sudāruṇam
saṁvartaṁ nāma bharato gandharveṣvabhyayojayat

translations.english: There upon enraged Bharata, Rāma's younger brother, discharged a dreadful arrow named Samvarata resembling the fire of dissolution against Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit:
ते बद्धाः कालपाशेन संवर्तेन विदारिताः
क्षणेनाभिहतास्तिस्रस्तत्र कोट्यो महात्मना
verses.transliteration:
te baddhāḥ kālapāśena saṁvartena vidāritāḥ
kṣaṇenābhihatāstisrastatra koṭyo mahātmanā

translations.english: Having bound them all with the noose of death and sundered them with Sangharata, Bharata despatched all the Gandharvas to the abode of death.

verses.sanskrit:
तं घातं घोरसंकाशं न स्मरन्ति दिवौकसः
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तादृशानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration:
taṁ ghātaṁ ghorasaṁkāśaṁ na smaranti divaukasaḥ
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tādṛśānāṁ mahātmanām

translations.english: Even the celestials could not recollect if such a dreadful encounter had happened before. In a moment the huge Gandharva host was slain. After the destruction of the Gandharvas, Kaikeyi's son Bharata set up two excellent and prosperous cities in the province of Gandharva.

verses.sanskrit:
धनरत्नौघसंपूर्णो काननैरुपशोभिते
अन्योन्यसंघर्षकृते स्पर्धया गुणविस्तरे
verses.transliteration:
dhanaratnaughasaṁpūrṇo kānanairupaśobhite
anyonyasaṁgharṣakṛte spardhayā guṇavistare

translations.english: Both the cities were filled with profuse riches and jewels and covered with various gardens. As for many ornaments both of them as if vied with one another.

verses.sanskrit:
उभे सुरुचिरप्रख्ये व्यवहारैरकल्मषैः
उद्यानयानौघवृते सुविभक्तान्तरापणे
verses.transliteration:
ubhe suruciraprakhye vyavahārairakalmaṣaiḥ
udyānayānaughavṛte suvibhaktāntarāpaṇe

translations.english: By just purchases and sales, and by the conduct of the people the cities grew highly charming. Both of them were filled with gardens and conveyances. Rows of shops were well arranged by the streets in both the cities.

verses.sanskrit:
उभे पुरवरे रम्ये विस्तरैरुपशोभिते
गृहमुख्यैः सुरुचिरैर्विमानैः समवर्णिभिः
verses.transliteration:
ubhe puravare ramye vistarairupaśobhite
gṛhamukhyaiḥ surucirairvimānaiḥ samavarṇibhiḥ

translations.english: Both of them were adorned with many excellent fancy articles, picturesque houses, charming palaces and many beautiful and high Tala, Tamāla, Tilaka and Vakula trees.

verses.sanskrit:
शोभिते शोभनीयैश्च देवायतनविस्तरैः
निवेश्य पञ्चभिर्वर्षैर्भरतो राघवानुजः
पुनरायान्महाबाहुरयोध्यां कैकयीसुतः
verses.transliteration:
śobhite śobhanīyaiśca devāyatanavistaraiḥ
niveśya pañcabhirvarṣairbharato rāghavānujaḥ
punarāyānmahābāhurayodhyāṁ kaikayīsutaḥ

translations.english: Having reared up those two cities within five years, Rāma's younger brother, the mighty armed Bharata, son of Kaikeyl, returned to Ayodhyā.?

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं साक्षाद्धर्ममिवापरम्
राघवं भरतः श्रीमान्ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः
verses.transliteration:
so'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ sākṣāddharmamivāparam
rāghavaṁ bharataḥ śrīmānbrahmāṇamiva vāsavaḥ

translations.english: Like to Vasava saluting Brahmå he adored the high-souled Raghava the very personation of virtue and communicated to him duly the destruction of the Gandharvas and the establishment of the two cities. And hearing the words of Bharata, Råma attained to an excess of delight. are

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह
वाक्यं चाद्भुतसंकाशं भ्रातॄन्प्रोवाच राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā harṣamāpede rāghavo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
vākyaṁ cādbhutasaṁkāśaṁ bhrātṝnprovāca rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the wonderful words of Bharata both Rāma and Lakşmaņa were greatly delighted. And then Rāma said to Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
इमौ कुमारौ सौमित्रे तव धर्मविशारदौ
अङ्गदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्च राज्यार्हौ दृढधन्विनौ
verses.transliteration:
imau kumārau saumitre tava dharmaviśāradau
aṅgadaścandraketuśca rājyārhau dṛḍhadhanvinau

translations.english: O Saumitri, your two sons, Angada and Candraketu well-versed in religions, perfectly qualified in governing the kingdom and highly powerful.

verses.sanskrit:
इमौ राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यामि देशः साधु विधीयताम्
रमणीयो ह्यसंबाधो रमेतां यत्र धन्विनौ
verses.transliteration:
imau rājye'bhiṣekṣyāmi deśaḥ sādhu vidhīyatām
ramaṇīyo hyasaṁbādho rametāṁ yatra dhanvinau

translations.english: I shall therefore install them on throne. O gentle man, do you find out such country where those two skilful archers may unobstructed roam about.

verses.sanskrit:
न राज्ञां यत्र पीदा स्यान्नाश्रमाणां विनाशनम्
स देशो दृश्यतां सौम्य नापराध्यामहे यथा
verses.transliteration:
na rājñāṁ yatra pīdā syānnāśramāṇāṁ vināśanam
sa deśo dṛśyatāṁ saumya nāparādhyāmahe yathā

translations.english: And where if a kingdom is established it might:not disturb the peace of hermitage and happiness of other kings.

verses.sanskrit:
तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह
अयं कारापथो देशः सुरमण्यो निरामयः
verses.transliteration:
tathoktavati rāme tu bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha
ayaṁ kārāpatho deśaḥ suramaṇyo nirāmayaḥ

translations.english: Răma, having finished his speech Bharata replied:-The country of Kårupatha is highly picturesque and freed from all thorns.

verses.sanskrit:
निवेश्यतां तत्र पुरमङ्गदस्य महात्मनः
चन्द्रकेतोश्च रुचिरं चन्द्रकान्तं निरामयम्
verses.transliteration:
niveśyatāṁ tatra puramaṅgadasya mahātmanaḥ
candraketośca ruciraṁ candrakāntaṁ nirāmayam

translations.english: Let the city for high souled Angada be established there. And let the beautiful and healthy country of Candradkānta be the kingdom of Candraketu.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यं भरतेनोक्तं प्रतिजग्राह राघवः
तं च कृत्वा वशे देशमङ्गदस्य न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyaṁ bharatenoktaṁ pratijagrāha rāghavaḥ
taṁ ca kṛtvā vaśe deśamaṅgadasya nyaveśayat

translations.english: Rāma approved of the words of Bharata and having brought the country of Kārupatha under his subjection gave it to Angada.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गदीया पुरी रम्या अङ्गदस्य निवेशिता
रमणीया सुगुप्ता च रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
verses.transliteration:
aṅgadīyā purī ramyā aṅgadasya niveśitā
ramaṇīyā suguptā ca rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā

translations.english: He reared a beautiful and well-protected city for Angada.

verses.sanskrit:
चन्द्रकेतोस्तु मल्लस्य मल्लभूम्यां निवेशिता
चन्द्रकान्तेति विख्याता दिव्या स्वर्गपुरी यथा
verses.transliteration:
candraketostu mallasya mallabhūmyāṁ niveśitā
candrakānteti vikhyātā divyā svargapurī yathā

translations.english: And in the country of Malaya he reared a city for Candraketu, named Candrakāntā highly picturesque and like to the city of celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणस्त्वङ्गदीयायां संवत्सरमथोषितः
पुत्रे स्थिते दुराधर्षे अयोध्यां पुनरागमत्
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇastvaṅgadīyāyāṁ saṁvatsaramathoṣitaḥ
putre sthite durādharṣe ayodhyāṁ punarāgamat

translations.english: Having spent a year in Angada's city and finding his son well established in the kingdom Lakşmana returned to Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतोऽपि तथैवोष्य संवत्सरमथाधिकम्
अयोध्यां पुनरागम्य रामपादावुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
bharato'pi tathaivoṣya saṁvatsaramathādhikam
ayodhyāṁ punarāgamya rāmapādāvupāgamat

translations.english: And Bharata, according to his desire, having spent more than a year in the city of Candrakāntă, came back to Ayodhyā and saluted Rama's feet.

verses.sanskrit:
उभौ सौमित्रिभरतौ रामपादावनुव्रतौ
कालं गतमपि स्नेहान्न जज्ञातेऽतिधार्मिकौ
verses.transliteration:
ubhau saumitribharatau rāmapādāvanuvratau
kālaṁ gatamapi snehānna jajñāte'tidhārmikau

translations.english: The pious Laksmana and Bharata— both the brothers, were greatly attached to Råma; and though the spent their days in another place they did not experience any pain in consequence of separation from their sons.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तेषां ययुस्तदा
धर्मे प्रयतमानानां पौरकार्येषु नित्यदा
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ varṣasahasrāṇi daśa teṣāṁ yayustadā
dharme prayatamānānāṁ paurakāryeṣu nityadā

translations.english: Observing all virtues in this way, Rāma, the foremost of the pious, Bharata and Lakşmaņa governed the subjects for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
विहृत्य कालं परिपूर्णमानसाः; श्रिया वृता धर्मपथे परे स्थिताः
त्रयः समिद्धा इव दीप्ततेजसा; हुताग्नयः साधु महाध्वरे त्रयः
verses.transliteration:
vihṛtya kālaṁ paripūrṇamānasāḥ; śriyā vṛtā dharmapathe pare sthitāḥ
trayaḥ samiddhā iva dīptatejasā; hutāgnayaḥ sādhu mahādhvare trayaḥ

translations.english: Having spent their days in the city of Ayodhyā, the very city of virtue, the three brothers, appearing graceful like the burning fire receiving oblations in a great sacrifice, attained to joy in the fullness of time.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपथे स्थिते
कालस्तापसरूपेण राजद्वारमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
kasyacittvatha kālasya rāme dharmapathe sthite
kālastāpasarūpeṇa rājadvāramupāgamat

translations.english: In this wise the virtuous Rāma having spent some time Kāla, assuming the shape of an ascetic, arrived at the palace gate.

verses.sanskrit:
दूतो ह्यतिबलस्याहं महर्षेरमितौजसः
रामं दिदृक्षुरायातः कार्येण हि महाबल
verses.transliteration:
dūto hyatibalasyāhaṁ maharṣeramitaujasaḥ
rāmaṁ didṛkṣurāyātaḥ kāryeṇa hi mahābala

translations.english: I am the messenger of the great saint Atibala of incomparable effulgence. O you of great strength, for a particular business, I have come here to sec Rāma.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सौमित्रिस्त्वरयान्वितः
न्यवेदयत रामाय तापसस्य विवक्षितम्
verses.transliteration:
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā saumitristvarayānvitaḥ
nyavedayata rāmāya tāpasasya vivakṣitam

translations.english: Hearing the words of the great saint, Saumitri speedily went to Råghava and communicated to him the arrival of the ascetic, saying.

verses.sanskrit:
जयस्व राजन्धर्मेण उभौ लोकौ महाद्युते
दूतस्त्वां द्रष्टुमायातस्तपस्वी भास्करप्रभः
verses.transliteration:
jayasva rājandharmeṇa ubhau lokau mahādyute
dūtastvāṁ draṣṭumāyātastapasvī bhāskaraprabhaḥ

translations.english: O you of great effulgence, observing the royal duties, may you acquire victory in both the worlds; one ambassador radiant like the sun by virtue of his asceticism, has come here to visit you.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं श्रुत्वा राम उवाच ह
प्रवेश्यतां मुनिस्तात महौजास्तस्य वाक्यधृक्
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyaṁ lakṣmaṇenoktaṁ śrutvā rāma uvāca ha
praveśyatāṁ munistāta mahaujāstasya vākyadhṛk

translations.english: Hearing the words of Laksmana, Rāma said: “Do you speedily bring here the highly effulgent ascetic bringing in a message."

verses.sanskrit:
सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रावेशयत तं मुनिम्
ज्वलन्तमिव तेजोभिः प्रदहन्तमिवांशुभिः
verses.transliteration:
saumitristu tathetyuktvā prāveśayata taṁ munim
jvalantamiva tejobhiḥ pradahantamivāṁśubhiḥ

translations.english: There upon saying so be it, Saumitri conducted, the effulgent ascetic to Råma's house.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिगम्य रघुश्रेष्ठं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
ऋषिर्मधुरया वाचा वर्धस्वेत्याह राघवम्
verses.transliteration:
so'bhigamya raghuśreṣṭhaṁ dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā
ṛṣirmadhurayā vācā vardhasvetyāha rāghavam

translations.english: And having approached Rama the foremost? of Raghus, the ascetic, burning in his own energy, said to him, in sweet accents:-0 great king may prosperity crown you.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मै रामो महातेजाः पूजामर्घ्यपुरोगमाम्
ददौ कुशलमव्यग्रं प्रष्टुं चैवोपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tasmai rāmo mahātejāḥ pūjāmarghyapurogamām
dadau kuśalamavyagraṁ praṣṭuṁ caivopacakrame

translations.english: And having welcomed him with water and Argya, the highly effulgent Rāma asked him about his well-being.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष्टश्च कुशलं तेन रामेण वदतां वरः
आसने काञ्चने दिव्ये निषसाद महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣṭaśca kuśalaṁ tena rāmeṇa vadatāṁ varaḥ
āsane kāñcane divye niṣasāda mahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: Being asked by Rāma as to his welfare, that foremost of ascetics, skilled in the are of speech, sat on a golden seat.

verses.sanskrit:
तमुवाच ततो रामः स्वागतं ते महामुने
प्रापयस्व च वाक्यानि यतो दूतस्त्वमागतः
verses.transliteration:
tamuvāca tato rāmaḥ svāgataṁ te mahāmune
prāpayasva ca vākyāni yato dūtastvamāgataḥ

translations.english: There upon welcoming him Rāma said:-Do you communicate to me his words by whom you have been sent.

verses.sanskrit:
चोदितो राजसिंहेन मुनिर्वाक्यमुदीरयत्
द्वन्द्वमेतत्प्रवक्तव्यं न च चक्षुर्हतं वचः
verses.transliteration:
codito rājasiṁhena munirvākyamudīrayat
dvandvametatpravaktavyaṁ na ca cakṣurhataṁ vacaḥ

translations.english: Being thus addressed by Rāma, a lion among kings, the ascetic said:-If do you wish to bring about the well-being of the celestials, my earnest desire is that we may talk over it in a solitary place.

verses.sanskrit:
यः शृणोति निरीक्षेद्वा स वध्यस्तव राघव
भवेद्वै मुनिमुख्यस्य वचनं यद्यवेक्षसे
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ śṛṇoti nirīkṣedvā sa vadhyastava rāghava
bhavedvai munimukhyasya vacanaṁ yadyavekṣase

translations.english: And if you have any regard for the words of that foremost of ascetics, do you so order that whoever shall hear or see us, when we shall converse in a solitary place, shall be slain by you.

verses.sanskrit:
तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
द्वारि तिष्ठ महाबाहो प्रतिहारं विसर्जय
verses.transliteration:
tatheti ca pratijñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt
dvāri tiṣṭha mahābāho pratihāraṁ visarjaya

translations.english: There upon Rāma promised that it should be done and said to Lakşmaņa:-O you having long arms, sending away the warder do you wait at the gate.

verses.sanskrit:
स मे वध्यः खलु भवेत्कथां द्वन्द्वसमीरिताम्
ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद्वा शृणुयाच्च यः
verses.transliteration:
sa me vadhyaḥ khalu bhavetkathāṁ dvandvasamīritām
ṛṣermama ca saumitre paśyedvā śṛṇuyācca yaḥ

translations.english: When I shall talk with this ascetic in this solitary room whoever, shall hear or see us, shall be slain by me.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारसंग्रहे
तमुवाच मुनिं वाक्यं कथयस्वेति राघवः
verses.transliteration:
tato nikṣipya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṁ dvārasaṁgrahe
tamuvāca muniṁ vākyaṁ kathayasveti rāghavaḥ

translations.english: Having thus piaced Lakşmaņa at the gate Rama said to that Rsis:-O great saint, tell me what he has communicated to you. O Muni, what is your intention and by what high-souled Rșis you have been sent here. Tell me all this without any fear, I have become anxious to hear it.

verses.sanskrit:
शृणु राम महाबाहो यदर्थमहमाहतः
पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितोऽस्मि महाबल
verses.transliteration:
śṛṇu rāma mahābāho yadarthamahamāhataḥ
pitāmahena devena preṣito'smi mahābala

translations.english: There upon the great saint said:-Hear, O king, O you gifted with great energy, for what I have come here. O you of great strength, the great Patriarch has sent me to you.

verses.sanskrit:
तवाहं पूर्वके भावे पुत्रः परपुरंजय
मायासंभावितो वीर कालः सर्वसमाहरः
verses.transliteration:
tavāhaṁ pūrvake bhāve putraḥ parapuraṁjaya
māyāsaṁbhāvito vīra kālaḥ sarvasamāharaḥ

translations.english: O hero, I am your son. You did, in your pristine birth, beget me on Maya-I am Kala, the destroyer of all.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः
समयस्ते महाबाहो स्वर्लोकान्परिरक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahaśca bhagavānāha lokapatiḥ prabhuḥ
samayaste mahābāho svarlokānparirakṣitum

translations.english: Lord Brahmā, the father of all creatures, has said that you did promise to preserve the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
संक्षिप्य च पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि
महार्णवे शयानोऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः
verses.transliteration:
saṁkṣipya ca purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi
mahārṇave śayāno'psu māṁ tvaṁ pūrvamajījanaḥ

translations.english: Formerly when having slain all animals by your Māyā you went asleep in the waters of the mighty deep I was born.

verses.sanskrit:
भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदके शयम्
मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ
verses.transliteration:
bhogavantaṁ tato nāgamanantamudake śayam
māyayā janayitvā tvaṁ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau

translations.english: There after you did create the huge-bodied Ananta, living in the waters as the king of serpents. Then you did create two highly powerful Asuras named Madhu and Kaitabha. At that time the bones of those two Asuras having been scattered far and wide this earth containing many mountains was named Medini.

verses.sanskrit:
पद्मे दिव्यार्कसंकाशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि
प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म सर्वं मयि निवेशितम्
verses.transliteration:
padme divyārkasaṁkāśe nābhyāmutpādya māmapi
prājāpatyaṁ tvayā karma sarvaṁ mayi niveśitam

translations.english: Having procreated me in your lotus navel, dazzling in celestial brilliance you did employ me in the work of generation.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽहं संन्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम्
रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान्
verses.transliteration:
so'haṁ saṁnyastabhāro hi tvāmupāse jagatpatim
rakṣāṁ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān

translations.english: I took the charge and procreated men; but finding no other means to preserve them I worshipped you, the lord of the universe and said:-0 lord, you should protect the creatures, for you are my father and giver of energy and therefore irrepressible.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्वमपि दुर्धर्षस्तस्माद्भावात्सनातनात्
रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान्
verses.transliteration:
tatastvamapi durdharṣastasmādbhāvātsanātanāt
rakṣārthaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān

translations.english: Thereupon for concerning means for the preservation of creatures, you did renounce your irrepressible shape and assume Vişņu form.

verses.sanskrit:
अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातॄणां हर्षवर्धनः
समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु लोकसाह्याय कल्पसे
verses.transliteration:
adityāṁ vīryavānputro bhrātṝṇāṁ harṣavardhanaḥ
samutpanneṣu kṛtyeṣu lokasāhyāya kalpase

translations.english: And taking your birth from Aditi's powerful son, you went engaged in enhancing the delight of my brothers. You did use to protect the deities whenever they were assailed by any calamity.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर
रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनोऽदधाः
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṁ vara
rāvaṇasya vadhākāṅkṣī mānuṣeṣu mano'dadhāḥ

translations.english: O lord of the universe, it is for that reason, on beholding the destruction of creatures you went born on earth to slay the Ten-necked demon.

verses.sanskrit:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च
कृत्वा वासस्य नियतिं स्वयमेवात्मनः पुरा
verses.transliteration:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca
kṛtvā vāsasya niyatiṁ svayamevātmanaḥ purā

translations.english: And at that time you did promise that you would live in the land of mortals for eleven thousand years.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह
कालो नरवरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम्
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ manomayaḥ putraḥ pūrṇāyurmānuṣeṣviha
kālo naravaraśreṣṭha samīpamupavartitum

translations.english: There upon you did assume a human form to carry out your desire. Now that period is ripe and this is the proper time to inform you of it.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव
सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration:
atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava
sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ

translations.english: O great king, do you wait in this land of mortals if do you wish to govern people for some time more. And if did you wish to repair to the region of immortals, do you again lord over the deities in your Vişņu form and let them be freed from anxiety. O Hero, the Patriarch has sent this intelligence to you.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम्
राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
śrutvā pitāmahenoktaṁ vākyaṁ kālasamīritam
rāghavaḥ prahasanvākyaṁ sarvasaṁhāramabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those unequalled words of the Patriarch from the mouth of Kala, the destroyer of all, Rama smiling said.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुतं मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम्
प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसंभवा
verses.transliteration:
śrutaṁ me devadevasya vākyaṁ paramamadbhutam
prītirhi mahatī jātā tavāgamanasaṁbhavā

translations.english: I have been greatly pleased and happy for your coming here O my son, I descended on earth to bring about the well-being of the three worlds. May good betide you. I shall now repair to from where I have come here.

verses.sanskrit:
मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम्
स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहारे यथा ह्याह पितामहः
verses.transliteration:
mayā hi sarvakṛtyeṣu devānāṁ vaśavartinām
sthātavyaṁ sarvasaṁhāre yathā hyāha pitāmahaḥ

translations.english: I was thinking of this when you did come here. Therefore, I have no doubt in this. O lord of destruction, the immortals are dependent on me, so I shall be with them in all works. The Great Patriarch has said the truth.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा तयोः कथयतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः
रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
tathā tayoḥ kathayatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ
rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat

translations.english: While Rāma and Kala were thus conversing with one another, the great ascetic Durvāsā arrived at the gate for seeing Rāma and approaching Laksmana said:-O Saumitri, do you soon take me to Rāma; my time goes away, so do you take me first.

verses.sanskrit:
मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
munestu bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
abhivādya mahātmānaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of the ascetic, Laksmana, the slayer of enemies worshipping the feet of that high-souled one, said.

verses.sanskrit:
किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वार्थः किं करोम्यहम्
व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं वा प्रतीक्षताम्
verses.transliteration:
kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi bhagavanko vārthaḥ kiṁ karomyaham
vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṁ vā pratīkṣatām

translations.english: O illustrious Sir, kindly mention your business. What is your object? Order me what I am to do. Råma is engaged in some business so kindly wait here for some time.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः
उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ
uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ vākyaṁ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā

translations.english: Hearing those words that foremost of Rșis, red eyes:

verses.sanskrit:
अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय
विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा
verses.transliteration:
asminkṣaṇe māṁ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya
viṣayaṁ tvāṁ puraṁ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṁ tathā

translations.english: O Saumitri, if do you not go even this very moment and communicate to Ráma my arrival, I shall imprecate you, Rama, Bharata, Satrughana, your sons and grand-sons. I shall curse also your kingdom and cities. I cannot any longer restrain by growing ire.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसंकाशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः
चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā ghorasaṁkāśaṁ vākyaṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ
cintayāmāsa manasā tasya vākyasya niścayam

translations.english: Hearing those dreadful and resolute words of the Rşis, Lakşmaņa thought within himself.

verses.sanskrit:
एकस्य मरणं मेऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम्
इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration:
ekasya maraṇaṁ me'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam
iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat

translations.english: My own destruction is far more desirable than that of all. Having thus resolved Lakşmaņa approached Rāma and communicated to him the intelligence.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च
निष्पत्य त्वरितं राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṁ visṛjya ca
niṣpatya tvaritaṁ rājā atreḥ putraṁ dadarśa ha

translations.english: Hearing the words of Lakşmaņa and having bade adieu, to Kala, Rama soon came out and saw Atri's son.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा
किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration:
so'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā
kiṁ kāryamiti kākutsthaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata

translations.english: And having saluted that great and powerful ascetic he with folded hands, said. What is your business.

verses.sanskrit:
तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुः
प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल
verses.transliteration:
tadvākyaṁ rāghaveṇoktaṁ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhuḥ
pratyāha rāmaṁ durvāsāḥ śrūyatāṁ dharmavatsala

translations.english: Hearing the words of Rāma, the highly powerful Durvāsā, the foremost of Munis, said. Hear, O Rāma fond of virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिर्मम राघव
सोऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ
verses.transliteration:
adya varṣasahasrasya samāptirmama rāghava
so'haṁ bhojanamicchāmi yathāsiddhaṁ tavānagha

translations.english: For a thousand years I have carried on the vow of fasting. It has terminated today, so do you give me food as much as possible.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं रामो हर्षेण महतान्वितः
भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā vacanaṁ rāmo harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ
bhojanaṁ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat

translations.english: Hearing those words Rāma was greatly delighted and gave proper food to that ascetic.

verses.sanskrit:
स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्
साधु रामेति संभाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत्
verses.transliteration:
sa tu bhuktvā muniśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam
sādhu rāmeti saṁbhāṣya svamāśramamupāgamat

translations.english: And feasting on that nectar-like sweet food, Durvāsā, the foremost of Rşis, thanked Rāma and repaired to his own hermitage.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः
नैतदस्तीति चोक्त्वा स तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः
verses.transliteration:
tato buddhyā viniścitya kālavākyāni rāghavaḥ
naitadastīti coktvā sa tūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ

translations.english: There upon remembering the words of Kāla, Rāma was greatly sorry. And thinking of those dreadful words he was overwhelmed with grief. And with a poorly heart, and face downwards he remained silent for some time. There upon thinking of Kāla's words and determining that every calamity would befall him, that highly illustrious descendant, of Raghus, summoned patience.

verses.sanskrit:
अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम्
राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṁ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam
rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṁ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt

translations.english: There upon beholding Räma with his head downwards and poorly like to the moon possessed by Rāhu, Lakşmaņa, delightedly and with sweet words, said.

verses.sanskrit:
न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि
पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी
verses.transliteration:
na saṁtāpaṁ mahābāho madarthaṁ kartumarhasi
pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī

translations.english: Be not aggrieved for me, O you having mighty' arms. Such is the course of time; the movements of creatures are destined by their pristine actions, good or bad.

verses.sanskrit:
जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धः प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय
हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः
verses.transliteration:
jahi māṁ saumya visrabdhaḥ pratijñāṁ paripālaya
hīnapratijñāḥ kākutstha prayānti narakaṁ narāḥ

translations.english: O gentle one, do you satisfy your promise of slaying me without any hesitation. O Kakuthstha, those, who cannot carry out their promises, repair to hell.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि
जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव
verses.transliteration:
yadi prītirmahārāja yadyanugrāhyatā mayi
jahi māṁ nirviśaṅkastvaṁ dharmaṁ vardhaya rāghava

translations.english: O great king, if you have any love or affection for me, do you satisfy your promise by fearlessly slaying me.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः
मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसं
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇena tathoktastu rāmaḥ pracalitendriyaḥ
mantriṇaḥ samupānīya tathaiva ca purodhasaṁ

translations.english: Hearing those words of Lakşmaņa Rāma's mind was greatly moved. There upon having invited his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his promise and Durvasa's arrival.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत
वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā mantriṇaḥ sarve sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata
vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha

translations.english: Hearing it the ministers and priests remained silent. There upon Vasistha, of unmitigated effulgence, said.

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते लोमहर्षणम्
लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṁ te lomaharṣaṇam
lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ

translations.english: O highly illustrious and mighty armed Rāma, I knew before by virtue of my asceticism, of this your present destruction and separation from Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit:
त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृथाः
विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो हि विलयं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration:
tyajainaṁ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṁ vṛthā kṛthāḥ
vinaṣṭāyāṁ pratijñāyāṁ dharmo hi vilayaṁ vrajet

translations.english: Time is powerful; do not falsify your promise. Promise not carried out brings on the destruction of virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरम्
सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत न संशयः
verses.transliteration:
tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokye sacarācaram
sadevarṣigaṇaṁ sarvaṁ vinaśyeta na saṁśayaḥ

translations.english: And on the wane of virtue, forsooth, the three worlds, with celestials, saints, mobile and immobile creations, shall be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनम्
लक्ष्मणस्य वधेनाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla trailokyasyābhipālanam
lakṣmaṇasya vadhenādya jagatsvasthaṁ kuruṣva ha

translations.english: Therefore, O foremost of men, do you protect, the universe by suffering separation from Lakşmaņa, in the interest of the preservation of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम्
श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ tatsamavetānāṁ vākyaṁ dharmārthasaṁhitam
śrutvā pariṣado madhye rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt

translations.english: All other ministers and priests agreed with Vasistha's words. There upon hearing their moral counsels, Rama said to Lakşmaņa before the assembly.

verses.sanskrit:
विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः
त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनामुभयं समम्
verses.transliteration:
visarjaye tvāṁ saumitre mā bhūddharmaviparyayaḥ
tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāmubhayaṁ samam

translations.english: O Lakşmaņa, it is not proper to act against morality, I do therefore renounce you; for the pious hold that destruction and renunciation are all the same.

verses.sanskrit:
रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः
लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितः प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
rāmeṇa bhāṣite vākye bāṣpavyākulitekṣaṇaḥ
lakṣmaṇastvaritaḥ prāyātsvagṛhaṁ na viveśa ha

translations.english: Răma saying this, Lakşmaņa did not go to his own house, but with eyes full of tears specially repaired therefrom.

verses.sanskrit:
स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः
निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह
verses.transliteration:
sa gatvā sarayūtīramupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ
nigṛhya sarvasrotāṁsi niḥśvāsaṁ na mumoca ha

translations.english: Having reached the banks of Sarayů and rinsed his mouth he stood there with folded palms. And having obstructed all passages he did not breathe any more.

verses.sanskrit:
अनुच्छ्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः
देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरवकिरंस्तदा
verses.transliteration:
anucchvasantaṁ yuktaṁ taṁ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ
devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairavakiraṁstadā

translations.english: Laksmana, the younger brother of Rama, being thus engaged in penances, having obstructed his breath, Apsarās, Indra and other deities and Rsis showered flowers on him.

verses.sanskrit:
अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम्
प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रो दिवं संप्रविवेश ह
verses.transliteration:
adṛśyaṁ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṁ mahābalam
pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṁ śakro divaṁ saṁpraviveśa ha

translations.english: There upon beyond the sight of men, having taken the highly powerful Lakşmaņa within his body, the king of celestials entered his own city.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः
हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वेऽपूजयनृषिभिः सह
verses.transliteration:
tato viṣṇoścaturbhāgamāgataṁ surasattamāḥ
hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve'pūjayanṛṣibhiḥ saha

translations.english: There upon beholding Lakşmaņa, the fourth portion of Vişnu arrived at their city the celestials were greatly delighted and engaged in his worship.

verses.sanskrit:
विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः
पुरोधसं मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
visṛjya lakṣmaṇaṁ rāmo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ
purodhasaṁ mantriṇaśca naigamāṁścedamabravīt

translations.english: Having forsaken Lakşmaņa and being stricken with sorrow and grief Råma said to his citizens and ministers.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्य राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यामि भरतं धर्मवत्सलम्
अयोध्यायां पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम्
verses.transliteration:
adya rājye'bhiṣekṣyāmi bharataṁ dharmavatsalam
ayodhyāyāṁ patiṁ vīraṁ tato yāsyāmyahaṁ vanam

translations.english: Having placed the pious and heroic Bharata on the throne of Ayodhyā I shall today repair to woods.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रवेशयत संभारान्मा भूत्कालात्ययो यथा
अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम्
verses.transliteration:
praveśayata saṁbhārānmā bhūtkālātyayo yathā
adyaivāhaṁ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena gatāṁ gatim

translations.english: Do you, without any delay collect there all articles of installation. I shall follow the way which has been wended by Lakşmaņa.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं सर्वाः प्रकृतयो भृशम्
मूर्धभिः प्रणता भूमौ गतसत्त्वा इवाभवन्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṁ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo bhṛśam
mūrdhabhiḥ praṇatā bhūmau gatasattvā ivābhavan

translations.english: Hearing the words of Raghava, the subjects with their heads downwards remained motionless like so many dead bodies.

verses.sanskrit:
भरतश्च विसंज्ञोऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
bharataśca visaṁjño'bhūcchrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
rājyaṁ vigarhayāmāsa rāghavaṁ cedamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing Rāma's words Bharata was also stupified and speaking ill of the kingdom, said.

verses.sanskrit:
इमौ कुशीलवौ राजन्नभिषिञ्च नराधिप
कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम्
verses.transliteration:
imau kuśīlavau rājannabhiṣiñca narādhipa
kosaleṣu kuśaṁ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam

translations.english: O King, I swear by truth, that far from kingdom I do not wish to live in heaven even without you; O King, of these two princes, Kuśī and Lava do you place Kuśī in Kosala and Lava in North Kosala.

verses.sanskrit:
शत्रुघ्नस्य तु गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितविक्रमाः
इदं गमनमस्माकं स्वर्गायाख्यान्तु माचिरम्
verses.transliteration:
śatrughnasya tu gacchantu dūtāstvaritavikramāḥ
idaṁ gamanamasmākaṁ svargāyākhyāntu māciram

translations.english: And let quick-moving emissaries go to Śatrughna and communicate to him the intelligence of our going there.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान्
पौरान्दुःखेन संतप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā bharatenoktaṁ dṛṣṭvā cāpi hyadhomukhān
paurānduḥkhena saṁtaptānvasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt

translations.english: Hearing those words of Bharata and beholding the subjects stricken with sorrow having their heads downwards, Vasistha said.

verses.sanskrit:
वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः
ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः
verses.transliteration:
vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇīṁ prakṛtīrgatāḥ
jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṁ kāryaṁ mā caiṣāṁ vipriyaṁ kṛthāḥ

translations.english: Behold, O Rama, the subjects have placed themselves on the ground. Do you, therefore; apprised of their intention, satisfy their desire.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम्
किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वान्वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
vasiṣṭhasya tu vākyena utthāpya prakṛtījanam
kiṁ karomīti kākutsthaḥ sarvānvacanamabravīt

translations.english: Raising up the subjects according to the words of Vasistha Rama said:-What good can I do for you.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो रामं वचनमब्रुवन्
गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो यतो राम गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo rāmaṁ vacanamabruvan
gacchantamanugacchāmo yato rāma gamiṣyasi

translations.english: Hearing Rama's words they said:-0 King, we shall follow you wherever you shall go.

verses.sanskrit:
एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष धर्मः परो मतः
हृद्गता नः सदा तुष्टिस्तवानुगमने दृढा
verses.transliteration:
eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa dharmaḥ paro mataḥ
hṛdgatā naḥ sadā tuṣṭistavānugamane dṛḍhā

translations.english: O great king, by this we shall be greatly delighted. We pray for this boon only. Our delight consists in following you in everything.

verses.sanskrit:
पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः
सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थ समं गच्छाम सत्पथम्
verses.transliteration:
paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ
saputradārāḥ kākutstha samaṁ gacchāma satpatham

translations.english: If you have any love or affection for the citizens do you permit them that they may follow your good path with their wives and children.

verses.sanskrit:
तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा
वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर
verses.transliteration:
tapovanaṁ vā durgaṁ vā nadīmambhonidhiṁ tathā
vayaṁ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara

translations.english: O lord, if you do not forsake us, let us all go wherever you silt,-be it a forest an intractable tract, a river or an ocean.

verses.sanskrit:
ते दूता रामवाक्येन चोदिता लघुविक्रमाः
प्रजग्मुर्मधुरां शीघ्रं चक्रुर्वासं न चाध्वनि
verses.transliteration:
te dūtā rāmavākyena coditā laghuvikramāḥ
prajagmurmadhurāṁ śīghraṁ cakrurvāsaṁ na cādhvani

translations.english: Having been despatched by Rama, quickmoving emissaries speedily arrived at Mathurā.

verses.sanskrit:
ततस्त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः संप्राप्य मधुरामथ
शत्रुघ्नाय यथावृत्तमाचख्युः सर्वमेव तत्
verses.transliteration:
tatastribhirahorātraiḥ saṁprāpya madhurāmatha
śatrughnāya yathāvṛttamācakhyuḥ sarvameva tat

translations.english: Continually travelling for three nights and days, they arrived there and communicated to Šatrughna the intelligence.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्मणस्य परित्यागं प्रतिज्ञां राघवस्य च
पुत्रयोरभिषेकं च पौरानुगमनं तथा
verses.transliteration:
lakṣmaṇasya parityāgaṁ pratijñāṁ rāghavasya ca
putrayorabhiṣekaṁ ca paurānugamanaṁ tathā

translations.english: Having informed him of the renouncing of Lakşmaņa, Rāma's promise and the following of the citizens they said:-The intelligent Rāma has reared for Kuśī the spacious city of Kuśavati at the foot of the Vindhya range.

verses.sanskrit:
श्राविता च पुरी रम्या श्रावतीति लवस्य च
अयोध्यां विजनां चैव भरतं राघवानुगम्
verses.transliteration:
śrāvitā ca purī ramyā śrāvatīti lavasya ca
ayodhyāṁ vijanāṁ caiva bharataṁ rāghavānugam

translations.english: The city of Śrāvasti has been reared for Lava, and the mighty car-warriors Rama and Bharata, making Ayodhyā void of men, have addressed themselves for repairing to heaven. Having speedily communicated to him this intelligence the emissaries took rest.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं सर्वं निवेद्याशु शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने
विरेमुस्ते ततो दूतास्त्वर राजन्निति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration:
evaṁ sarvaṁ nivedyāśu śatrughnāya mahātmane
viremuste tato dūtāstvara rājanniti bruvan

translations.english: There upon they asked Satrughna to proceed soon. Observing the dreadful destruction of his race, Satrughna sent for his subjects and priests and informed them of everything.

verses.sanskrit:
तेषां सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्याय रघुनन्दनः
आत्मनश्च विपर्यासं भविष्यं भ्रातृभिः सह
verses.transliteration:
teṣāṁ sarvaṁ yathāvṛttamākhyāya raghunandanaḥ
ātmanaśca viparyāsaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha

translations.english: He also communicated to them his own destruction with his brothers. There upon the king Satrughna determined upon installing his two sons in the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit:
द्विधाकृत्वा तु तां सेनां माधुरीं पुत्रयोर्द्वयोः
धनधान्यसमायुक्तौ स्थापयामास पार्थिवौ
verses.transliteration:
dvidhākṛtvā tu tāṁ senāṁ mādhurīṁ putrayordvayoḥ
dhanadhānyasamāyuktau sthāpayāmāsa pārthivau

translations.english: Subāhu was placed on the throne of Mathurā and Satrughāti became the king of Vidiśā. Having thus established Subāhu in Mathură, and Śatrughātī in Vidiśā, the great hero Satrughna ascended his car and went to Ayodhyā.

verses.sanskrit:
सोऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः
उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञो धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration:
so'bhivādya tato rāmaṁ prāñjaliḥ prayatendriyaḥ
uvāca vākyaṁ dharmajño dharmamevānucintayan

translations.english: And there he saw the great Rāma, clothed in silk raiment burning like fire in the midst of the ascetics. There upon remembering his duty he saluted Rāma, conversant with piety and with folded hands said.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य वाक्यस्य वाक्यान्ते वानराः कामरूपिणः
ऋक्षराक्षससंघाश्च समापेतुरनेकशः
verses.transliteration:
tasya vākyasya vākyānte vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
ṛkṣarākṣasasaṁghāśca samāpeturanekaśaḥ

translations.english: Immediately after Råma had said this, monkeys assuming shapes at will bears and Rākşasas, began to assemble there.

verses.sanskrit:
देवपुत्रा ऋषिसुता गन्धर्वाणां सुतास्तथा
रामक्षयं विदित्वा ते सर्व एव समागताः
verses.transliteration:
devaputrā ṛṣisutā gandharvāṇāṁ sutāstathā
rāmakṣayaṁ viditvā te sarva eva samāgatāḥ

translations.english: Apprised of Rama's determination of going to heaven, monkeys, born of the celestials, Rșis and Gandharvas taking Sugriva before them, came there to see Rama.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः
रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration:
prabhātāyāṁ tu śarvaryāṁ pṛthuvakṣā mahāyaśāḥ
rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt

translations.english: After the night had expired the highly illustrious Rāma having a spacious breast and eyes like lotus petals said to the priest.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निहोत्रं व्रजत्वग्रे सर्पिर्ज्वलितपावकम्
वाजपेयातपत्रं च शोभयानं महापथम्
verses.transliteration:
agnihotraṁ vrajatvagre sarpirjvalitapāvakam
vājapeyātapatraṁ ca śobhayānaṁ mahāpatham

translations.english: Let the brilliant umbrellas Agnihotra, and Vājapeya go with the Brāhmaṇas before, which look well in the great road.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्वं निरवशेषतः
चकार विधिवद्धर्म्यं महाप्रास्थानिकं विधिम्
verses.transliteration:
tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ
cakāra vidhivaddharmyaṁ mahāprāsthānikaṁ vidhim

translations.english: There upon the highly effulgent Vasiştha arranged duly all the ceremonies necessary for going to the next world.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः क्षौमाम्बरधरो ब्रह्म चावर्तयन्परम्
कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ kṣaumāmbaradharo brahma cāvartayanparam
kuśāngṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṁ prasajya prayayāvatha

translations.english: There upon wearing a thin cloth, holding Kuśa grass by his fingers, and reciting Vedic hymns he proceeded to the banks of Sarayū.

verses.sanskrit:
अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किंचिन्निश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि
निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमानो यथांशुमान्
verses.transliteration:
avyāharankvacitkiṁcinniśceṣṭo niḥsukhaḥ pathi
nirjagāma gṛhāttasmāddīpyamāno yathāṁśumān

translations.english: Having given up all actions of senses, and suffered the pains of going on foot he issued out of the city speechless like to the burning sun.

verses.sanskrit:
रामस्य पार्श्वे सव्ये तु पद्मा श्रीः सुसमाहिता
दक्षिणे ह्रीर्विशालाक्षी व्यवसायस्तथाग्रतः
verses.transliteration:
rāmasya pārśve savye tu padmā śrīḥ susamāhitā
dakṣiṇe hrīrviśālākṣī vyavasāyastathāgrataḥ
