translations.english: On his right hand side was the lotus-handed Śrī, on his left hand side was the goddess. Earth and before him was the power of destruction. Various arrows, huge bows, and daggers, assuming forms followed him.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदा ब्राह्मणरूपेण सावित्री सर्वरक्षिणी
ओंकारोऽथ वषट्कारः सर्वे राममनुव्रताः
verses.transliteration:
vedā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sāvitrī sarvarakṣiṇī
oṁkāro'tha vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ

translations.english: And also went with him the four Vedas in the shape of the Brāhmaṇas, the all protecting Gayatri, Omkara and Vasatkāra.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सर्व एव महीसुराः
अन्वगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थं स्वर्गद्वारमुपागतम्
verses.transliteration:
ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarva eva mahīsurāḥ
anvagacchanta kākutsthaṁ svargadvāramupāgatam

translations.english: The high-souled Rșis and great Asuras followed the high-souled Rāma to the open gates of heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
तं यान्तमनुयान्ति स्म अन्तःपुरचराः स्त्रियः
सवृद्धबालदासीकाः सवर्षवरकिंकराः
verses.transliteration:
taṁ yāntamanuyānti sma antaḥpuracarāḥ striyaḥ
savṛddhabāladāsīkāḥ savarṣavarakiṁkarāḥ

translations.english: All the female servants, old and young, the damsels of the seraglio accompanied by servants having no manhood, Bharata and Lakşmaņa accompanied by their wives, followed him with Agnihotra.

verses.sanskrit:
रामव्रतमुपागम्य राघवं समनुव्रताः
ततो विप्रा महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समाहिताः
सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थमन्वगच्छन्महामतिम्
verses.transliteration:
rāmavratamupāgamya rāghavaṁ samanuvratāḥ
tato viprā mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāhitāḥ
saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanvagacchanmahāmatim

translations.english: All those high-souled ones, assembled there with Agnihotra and followed Kākutstha with their wives and children.

verses.sanskrit:
मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्राः सहबान्धवाः
सानुगा राघवं सर्वे अन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत्
verses.transliteration:
mantriṇo bhṛtyavargāśca saputrāḥ sahabāndhavāḥ
sānugā rāghavaṁ sarve anvagacchanprahṛṣṭavat

translations.english: The ministers and the servants, with their sons, beasts and friends, followed Rama delightedly.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः
अनुजग्मुः प्रगच्छन्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ
anujagmuḥ pragacchantaṁ rāghavaṁ guṇarañjitāḥ

translations.english: There upon all the subjects healthy and delighted went after Raghava, attracted by his accomplishments and cleansed of their sins.

verses.sanskrit:
स्नातं प्रमुदितं सर्वं हृष्टपुष्टमनुत्तमम्
दृप्तं किलिकिलाशब्दैः सर्वं राममनुव्रतम्
verses.transliteration:
snātaṁ pramuditaṁ sarvaṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭamanuttamam
dṛptaṁ kilikilāśabdaiḥ sarvaṁ rāmamanuvratam

translations.english: All the females and males, with their beasts, birds and friends, delightedly followed Raghava. Bathed and delighted all the monkeys, healthy and joyous following Rāma, created a continued tumult.

verses.sanskrit:
न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनोऽभूद्व्रीडितो वापि दुःखितः
हृष्टं प्रमुदितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration:
na tatra kaściddīno'bhūdvrīḍito vāpi duḥkhitaḥ
hṛṣṭaṁ pramuditaṁ sarvaṁ babhūva paramādbhutam

translations.english: There was none poorly, aggrieved or miserable—all of them appeared wonderfully happy and delighted.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रष्टुकामोऽथ निर्याणं राज्ञो जानपदो जनः
संप्राप्तः सोऽपि दृष्ट्वैव सह सर्वैरनुव्रतः
verses.transliteration:
draṣṭukāmo'tha niryāṇaṁ rājño jānapado janaḥ
saṁprāptaḥ so'pi dṛṣṭvaiva saha sarvairanuvrataḥ

translations.english: When Råma issued out of the city, whoever came to see him followed him being desirous of going to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः
अगछन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः
verses.transliteration:
ṛkṣavānararakṣāṁsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ
agachanparayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ susamāhitāḥ

translations.english: Bears, monkeys and Räkşasas and all the citizens, followed him with great devotion and collected minds.

verses.sanskrit:
अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा नदीं पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम्
सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration:
adhyardhayojanaṁ gatvā nadīṁ paścānmukhāśritām
sarayūṁ puṇyasalilāṁ dadarśa raghunandanaḥ

translations.english: Having thus gone for more than a half Yojana, the descendant of Raghu, espied Şurayū of holy waters flowing towards the west.

verses.sanskrit:
आययौ यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितः
विमानशतकोटीभिर्दिव्याभिरभिसंवृतः
verses.transliteration:
āyayau yatra kākutsthaḥ svargāya samupasthitaḥ
vimānaśatakoṭībhirdivyābhirabhisaṁvṛtaḥ

translations.english: There upon at that moment, Brahmă, the grandfather of all encircled by all high-souled deities and with hundred kotis of celestial cars, arrived there where Kākutstha had addressed himself to repair to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश्च वायुमुक्ता महौघवत्
verses.transliteration: papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca vāyumuktā mahaughavat

translations.english: There blew the holy, fragrant and delightful winds and there fell profusely celestial flowers from the hands of the deities.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मिंस्तूर्यशताकीर्णे गन्धर्वाप्सरसंकुले
सरयूसलिलं रामः पद्भ्यां समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration:
tasmiṁstūryaśatākīrṇe gandharvāpsarasaṁkule
sarayūsalilaṁ rāmaḥ padbhyāṁ samupacakrame

translations.english: The place was filled with the noise of hundreds of bugles sounded by Gandharvas and Apsarās. And then Rāma prepared himself to descend to the waters of Sarayů.

verses.sanskrit:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा विनिश्चित्य महामतिः
विवेश वैष्णवं तेजः सशरीरः सहानुजः
verses.transliteration:
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā viniścitya mahāmatiḥ
viveśa vaiṣṇavaṁ tejaḥ saśarīraḥ sahānujaḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of the Patriarch and determining everything the high-minded Rāma entered there bodily with his brothers in his Visnu form.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो विष्णुगतं देवं पूजयन्ति स्म देवताः
साध्या मरुद्गणाश्चैव सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration:
tato viṣṇugataṁ devaṁ pūjayanti sma devatāḥ
sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ

translations.english: There upon all the celestials Sådhyas Marutas, headed by Indra and Agni worshipped that deity, Visnu.

verses.sanskrit:
ये च दिव्या ऋषिगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च याः
सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration:
ye ca divyā ṛṣigaṇā gandharvāpsarasaśca yāḥ
suparṇanāgayakṣāśca daityadānavarākṣasāḥ

translations.english: So did all the celestial Rşis, Gandharvas Apsaras, Suparnas, Nagas, Yaksas, demons, Dånavas and Räkşasas. There upon eulogising him the celestials said: Our region is now freed from sins and all here have been delighted and all their desires have been fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit:
अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः पितामहमुवाच ह
एषां लोकाञ्जनौघानां दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration:
atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ pitāmahamuvāca ha
eṣāṁ lokāñjanaughānāṁ dātumarhasi suvrata

translations.english: There upon the highly effulgent Vişņu said to the Patriarch Brahmă:-It behove you, O you of good vows, to allot to those people their proper regions.

verses.sanskrit:
इमे हि सर्वे स्नेहान्मामनुयाता मनस्विनः
भक्ता भाजयितव्याश्च त्यक्तात्मानश्च मत्कृते
verses.transliteration:
ime hi sarve snehānmāmanuyātā manasvinaḥ
bhaktā bhājayitavyāśca tyaktātmānaśca matkṛte

translations.english: These illustrious ones have followed me out of love. They are worthy of my respect for they are my devotees and have renounced their persons for me.

verses.sanskrit:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः
लोकान्सान्तानिकान्नाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः
verses.transliteration:
tacchrutvā viṣṇuvacanaṁ brahmā lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ
lokānsāntānikānnāma yāsyantīme samāgatāḥ

translations.english: Hearing the words of Vişņu, the lord Brahma, father of all creatures, said:-All these people who have come here shall go to the region named Santanaka.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्च तिर्यग्गतं किंचिद्राममेवानुचिन्तयत्
प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यति भक्त्या वै संताने तु निवत्स्यति
सर्वैरेव गुणैर्युक्ते ब्रह्मलोकादनन्तरे
verses.transliteration:
yacca tiryaggataṁ kiṁcidrāmamevānucintayat
prāṇāṁstyakṣyati bhaktyā vai saṁtāne tu nivatsyati
sarvaireva guṇairyukte brahmalokādanantare

translations.english: This region is intended even for him, who though born in the most degraded state, thinks of all objects as Vişnu. There is no question about their attaining to this region who, out of devotion, have followed you and renounced their persons. This region has the attributes of the Brahma region and is next to it.

verses.sanskrit:
तथोक्तवति देवेशे गोप्रतारमुपागताः
भेजिरे सरयूं सर्वे हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः
verses.transliteration:
tathoktavati deveśe gopratāramupāgatāḥ
bhejire sarayūṁ sarve harṣapūrṇāśruviklavāḥ

translations.english: The lord of the deities having said this, all those who were present at the holy pilgrimage of Gopratāra descended into the waters of Sarayü with eyes full of tears of joy.

verses.sanskrit:
अवगाह्य जलं यो यः प्राणी ह्यासीत्प्रहृष्टवत्
मानुषं देहमुत्सृज्य विमानं सोऽध्यरोहत
verses.transliteration:
avagāhya jalaṁ yo yaḥ prāṇī hyāsītprahṛṣṭavat
mānuṣaṁ dehamutsṛjya vimānaṁ so'dhyarohata

translations.english: Having bathed there, given up their lives delightedly and renounced their human forms they ascended the celestial cars.

verses.sanskrit:
तिर्यग्योनिगताश्चापि संप्राप्ताः सरयूजलम्
दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन्
verses.transliteration:
tiryagyonigatāścāpi saṁprāptāḥ sarayūjalam
divyā divyena vapuṣā devā dīptā ivābhavan

translations.english: And having obtained the waters of Sarayū, hundreds of those that were born in the race of birds attained to the land of immortals obtaining the respective celestial forms (they had before). And in those celestial forms, they looked effulgent like the deities.

verses.sanskrit:
गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च
प्राप्य तत्तोयविक्लेदं देवलोकमुपागमन्
verses.transliteration:
gatvā tu sarayūtoyaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
prāpya tattoyavikledaṁ devalokamupāgaman

translations.english: And going to the waters of Sarayü all objects, mobile and immobile, having bathed there, repaired to the excellent celestial region.

verses.sanskrit:
तथा स्वर्गगतं सर्वं कृत्वा लोकगुरुर्दिवम्
जगाम त्रिदशैः सार्धं हृष्टैर्हृष्टो महामतिः
verses.transliteration:
tathā svargagataṁ sarvaṁ kṛtvā lokagururdivam
jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṁ hṛṣṭairhṛṣṭo mahāmatiḥ

translations.english: Having thus settled in heaven all those arrived there the father, of creatures with the deities, delighted and happy, repaired to the highest heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
एतावदेव आख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम्
रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकिना कृतम्
verses.transliteration:
etāvadeva ākhyānaṁ sottaraṁ brahmapūjitam
rāmāyaṇamiti khyātaṁ mukhyaṁ vālmīkinā kṛtam

translations.english: This Story ends with the Uttară. It is held in reverence by Brahmå composed by Vālmīki and passes as the foremost of all under the name of the Ramayana.
